p. 1)

atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantram 

|| śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracitam ||

prathamaḥ śvāsaḥ 

udyatsūryasahasrabhāsvaratanuḥ sūkṣmātisūkṣmā parā 
vidyutpuñjanibhendukoṭisadṛśī dhāmatryādhyāsinī | 
tattejastritayātmakaika (muni ? manu) 
bhirvākkāmaśaktyākhyayukkūṭaistryabdhiśarartubhiḥ pariṇatā nityātmikā pātu vaḥ 
|| 1-1 ||

yā śrīmadhumatī śaktirjagaccaitanyarūpiṇī | 
sā stānme purato nityaṃ mālinī viśvavigrahā || 1-2 ||

matadvayaṃ samāloḍya tatsaṅkīrṇabhiyā pṛthak | 
prakāśyate parātantraṃ mayā vidyārṇavābhidham || 1-3 ||

madhumatyā mahādevyāstādātmyaṃ kādisaṃjñakam | 
kālīmataṃ tu mālinyāstādātmyaṃ tāntrikā viduḥ || 1-4 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśadvyañjanairmūlabhūtaiḥ śivamayaiḥ pṛthak | 
ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃbhinnaiḥ pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃjñakaiḥ || 1-5 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśadguṇitaiḥ siddhakālanityāsvarūpakaiḥ |
navātmakairvyāptibhedād dviguṇīkṛtavigrahaiḥ || 1-6 ||

taddvaiguṇyamayaistattvairyantraistaddviguṇīkṛtaiḥ | 
tattadbhedairbhinnamūrtiḥ proktā vedaprakārikā || 1-7 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasampūrṇā sarvamantraphalapradā |
devī madhumatī yā tattādātmyaṃ kādisaṃjñakam || 1-8 ||

āmnāyasamayāpañcapañcikāpīṭhadarśanaiḥ | 
utpattisthitisaṃhārabhedairvṛndamayaiḥ stutā || 1-9 ||

mālinī kathyate yā tattādātmyaṃ kālikāmatam | 
matadvayaparijñānācchivatulyo bhavennaraḥ || 1-10 ||

kālatattvamatavyāptisampradāyāṅgabhāvanāḥ | 
sthūlasūkṣmaparopāṅgabījaśaktyarṇapallavān || 1-11 ||

tattatkramaṃ tadācāraṃ tadutpattiṃ tadarcanam | 
gurutaḥ śāstrato jñātvātattatkarmaṇyatandritaḥ || 1-12 ||

ādyantamadhyarahita ādimadhyāntasaṃyutaḥ | 
anāditattvasaṃśodhī paratantrasvatantravit || 1-13 ||

vidadhyādyajanaṃ devyāḥ phalaṃ syādanyathānyathā |
gurukramamavijñāya pūjayedyaḥ parāṃ śivām || 1-14 ||

sā pūjā niṣphalā jñeyā bhasmanyarpitahavyavat | 
tasmādyatnena vijñeyā mūlād guruparamparām || 1-15 ||

jñātvā gurumukhānnityaṃ sampradāyamatandritaḥ |
pratyahaṃ smaraṇaṃ kuryānmantravīryasya siddhaye || 1-16 ||

ūrdhvāmnāyakrameṇaiva kāmarājakrame tathā | 
lopāmudrā krame caiva sāmānyakrama eva ca || 1-17 ||

p. 2)

vidyāvatāravidyāptikulānāṃ gurusantatim | 
pañcāyatanadīkṣāyāṃ pañcāmnāyamanuṣvapi || 1-18 ||

matadvayavidhau jñātvā tatsāṅkaryaṃ ca yatnataḥ | 
kurute bhajanaṃ devyāḥ so'bhīṣṭaphalamaśnute || 1-19 ||

anyathā kurute pūjāṃ sābhicārāya kalpate | 
parāprāsādamantraśca śrīvidyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 1-20 ||

kālikā dakṣiṇā caiva mālinī śrīgurormanuḥ | 
caraṇaṃ navanāthāśca mūlavidyāśca ṣoḍaśa || 1-21 ||

ādhāraṣaṭkavidyāśca saṃviddevyastathaiva ca | 
catuḥṣaṣṭirmahāmantrā ūrdhvāmnāye vyavasthitāḥ || 1-22 ||

eteṣāṃ smaraṇānmartyaḥ śivatulyo bhavetkṣaṇāt | 
gurukramaśca jñātavyo mantrasiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || 1-23 ||

īśānākhyastatpuruṣaścāghoraśca tataḥ param | 
caturtho vāmadevaśca sadyojātaśca pañcamaḥ || 1-24 ||

ete pañcaiva divyaughāścādināthastataḥ param | 
annadināthaḥ parato'nāmayaśca tataḥ param || 1-25 ||

anantānandanāthaśca cidābhāsastathaiva ca | 
ete pañcaiva siddhaughāḥ prathamastu pareśvaraḥ || 1-26 ||

viśveśvaro dvitīyaścāparo haṃseśvarastataḥ | 
samvartteśvarasaṃjñaśca tato dvīpeśvarastataḥ || 1-27 ||

navātmeśvarasaṃjñaśca mānavaughāḥ ṣaḍīritāḥ | 
ete kulābhidhā jñeyā guravaḥ kulamārgagāḥ || 1-28 ||

kulaśiṣyāvatāścaiva kulamantrārthavedinaḥ | 
kulāsanopaviṣṭāśca kulatantraparāyaṇāḥ || 1-29 ||

kulāliṅganasambhinnamuñcitāśeṣatāmasāḥ | 
mahārasarasollāsanimagnāḥ kulasaṃyutāḥ || 1-30 ||

daśahastāḥ pañcamukhā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāḥ | 
udyatsūryasahasrābhāḥ pūrṇāntaḥkaraṇodyatāḥ || 1-31 ||

khaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ kapālaṃ ca triśūlaṃ mudgaraṃ tathā | 
khaṭvāṅgaṃ śaracāpau ca dadhānāśca varābhaye || 1-32 ||

turīye yāminīyāme kuṇḍalinyāṃ mahaujasi | 
te visargādadhobhāge lākṣārasasamaprabhe || 1-33 ||

cintanīyāḥ prayatnena vidyāsaṃsiddhihetave | 
etān kulagurūn yatnānna cintayati sādhakaḥ || 1-34 ||

tasya pūjā japaścaiva snānadānādikaṃ vṛthā | 
etān kulagurūn dhyāyedūrdhvāmnāya udīritān || 1-35 ||

prajñā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ |
icchā jñānā kriyā caiva kuṇḍalī mātṛkā parā || 1-36 ||

ekādaśaite divyaughā ādināthastataḥ parā | 
acintyanātho'cintyā ca avyakto'vyaktikā tataḥ || 1-37 ||

kuleśvaraḥ kuleśī ca siddhaughā nāgasaṃkhyakāḥ | 
tūṣṇīśaścaiva siddhā ca mitraḥ kubjā tataḥ param || 1-38 ||

gaganaścāṭulī caiva candragarbhastataḥ param | 
vālibhāgī ca muktaśca mahilā lalitastataḥ || 1-39 ||

śaṅkhā śrīkaṇṭhasaṃjñaśca śrīkaṇṭhā ca pareśvaraḥ | 
pareśvarī kumāraśca sahajā ratna eva ca || 1-40 ||

jñānadevī tato brahmā nādinī cāpyajeśvaraḥ | 
mahilā ca pratiṣṭhaśca sahajā śiva eva ca || 1-41 ||

pratimā ca cidānandaḥ sahajā ca tathaiva ca | 
śrīkaṇṭhānandavidye ca śivaśca sahajā tataḥ || 1-42 ||

somaśca sahajā caiva saṃvicca sahajā tataḥ | 
vibudho vibudhā caiva bhairavo bhairavī tathā || 1-43 ||

ānando nandinī caiva tataḥ kāmeśvarābhidhaḥ | 
kāmeśvaro ca kamalaḥ sahajā jinayugmakāḥ || 1-44 ||

mānavaughāḥ smṛtā ete varābhayakarāmbujāḥ | 
vidyāvatāraguravo nyastavyā gaganāmbuje || 1-45 ||

ete proktāśca guravo vidyāyāḥ śāmbhavakrame | 
vyomātītā ca vyomeśī vyomagā vyomacāriṇī || 1-46 ||

vyomasthā caiva divyaughāḥ pañcāmbāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | 
unmanāḥ samanāścaiva vyāpikā śaktireva ca || 1-47 ||

dhvaniśca dhvanimātrānāhatā bindustataḥ param | 
binduścākāśaśabdāntaḥ siddhaughā navasaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-48 ||

paramātmā śāmbhavaśca cinmudro vāgbhavastataḥ | 
līlaśca sambhramaścaiva citprasannastathaiva ca || 1-49 ||

viśvaścaite mānavaughā navasaṃkhyā prakīrtitāḥ | 
vidyāyā guravaścaiva ūrdhvāmnāyakramasya ca || 1-50 ||

ṣoḍaśyupāsakaścaitān navapaṃktikramādyajet | 
devyāḥ pṛṣṭhapradeśe tu viśvānte svagurukramam || 1-51 ||

kapilo'trirvasiṣṭhaśca sanakaśca sanandanaḥ | 
bhṛguḥ sanatsujātaśca vāmadevaśca nāradaḥ || 1-52 ||

gautamaḥ śunakaḥ śaktirmārkaṇḍeyaśca kauśikaḥ | 
parāśaraḥ śukaścaivāṅgirāḥ kaṇvastathaiva ca || 1-53 ||

p. 3)

jābāliśca bharadvājo vedavyāsastathaiva ca | 
īśāno ramaṇaścaiva kapardī bhūdharastataḥ || 1-54 ||

subhaṭo jalajaścaiva bhūteśaḥ paramastataḥ | 
vijayo bharataścaiva padmeśaḥ subhagastataḥ || 1-55 ||

viśuddhaḥ samaraścaiva kaivalyaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ | 
supādyo vibudho yogo vijñāno'naṅgavibhramau || 1-56 ||

dāmodaraścidābhāsaścinmayaśca kalādharaḥ | 
vīreśvaraśca mandārastridaśaḥ sāgaro mṛḍaḥ || 1-57 ||

harṣaḥ siṃhaśca gauḍaśca vīro'ghoro dhruvastataḥ | 
divākaraścakradharaḥ pramatheśaścaturbhujaḥ || 1-58 ||

ānandabhairavo dhīro gauḍaḥ pāvaka eva ca | 
parāśaryaḥ satyanidhī rāmacandrastataḥ param || 1-59 ||

govindaḥ śaṅkarācārya ekasaptatisaṃkhyakāḥ | 
śaṅkarācāryaśiṣyāśca caturdaśa dṛḍhavratāḥ || 1-60 ||

devyātmano dṛḍhātmāno nigrahānugrahakṣamāḥ | 
śaṅkaraḥ padmapādākhyo bodho gīrvāṇa eva ca || 1-61 ||

ānandatīrthānāmā ca pañcaite bhikṣavaḥ smṛtāḥ | 
sundaro viṣṇuśarmā ca lakṣmaṇo mallikārjunaḥ || 1-62 ||

trivikramaḥ śrīdharaśca kapardī keśavastataḥ | 
dāmodara iti khyātā gṛhiṇo * *? saṃkhyakāḥ || 1-63 ||

maṭhapīṭhopapīṭhādhipatyayuktāntyadīkṣitā | 
antyeṣṭikṛcchaṅkarākhyā * * * *? masaṃyutā || 1-64 ||

devātmanaḥ śaṅkarasya vikhyātā śiṣyasantatiḥ | 
padmapādasya ṣaṭ śi * *? ṇḍalaḥ paripāvakaḥ || 1-65 ||

nirvāṇo gīrdhanaścaiva cidānandaḥ śivottamaḥ | 
viviktāśramiṇo dhīrā mauninastyaktamatsarāḥ || 1-66 ||

vicaranti tathā loke tattacchiṣyaparamparāḥ |
bodhasya bahavaḥ śiṣyā vividhā bhuvi kerale || 1-67 ||

gīrvāṇendrasya vai śiṣyo vidvadgīrvāṇa eva ca | 
tacchiṣyoḥ vibudhendraḥ syātsudhīndro vibudhasya ca || 1-68 ||

tacchiṣyo mantragīrvāṇastataḥ syurvividhā narāḥ | 
ānandatīrthanāmnaśca śiṣyāḥ syurgṛhiṇo bhuvi || 1-69 ||

ārādhyapādukāpīṭhasampradāyavido bhuvi | 
sundarācāryaśiṣyāstu vividhāḥ pīṭhanāyakāḥ || 1-70 ||

bhikṣavo gṛhiṇaḥ sarve sundara eva pīṭhake | 
śrīviṣṇuśarmaṇaḥ śiṣyaḥ pragalbhācāryapaṇḍitaḥ || 1-71 ||

tacchiṣyeṇa mayā prokte granthe'smin pūrṇatāṃ gate | 
āvirāsījjagaddhātrī mahāmāyā mamāgrataḥ || 1-72 ||

iti provāca bho vatsa vṛṇīṣva varamīpsitam | 
tadoktavānahaṃ mātarmatkṛtaṃ granthamuttamam || 1-73 ||

dṛṣṭvā gurukramaṃ mantrān gurutvena vibhāvya mām | 
dīkṣāṃ vināpi bhaktyā tu ye japanti ca sādhakāḥ || 1-74 ||

teṣāmatitarāṃ siddhirbhavatviti mamepsitam | 
suprasannā tadā devo tattathaiva bhavatviti || 1-75 ||

varaṃ dattvā mudāpyantarhitāto gurusantateḥ | 
jñānāmātreṇa sā devī tuṣṭā bhavati niścayāt || 1-76 ||

jagadguroḥ śaṅkarasya śiṣyo lakṣmaṇadeśikaḥ | 
loke vikhyātimārūḍhastapasā vidyayā śriyā || 1-77 ||

prāpyāvasthāṃ turīyāṃ tu vītarāgo mahītale | 
vicaran prauḍhadevasya rājadhānīṃ samāśritaḥ || 1-78 ||

prauḍhastasmai dadau veśmabhūṣānnaparicārakān | 
ekadā tatsabhāmadhye tasmistiṣṭhati lakṣmaṇe || 1-79 ||

nānāvastūni vastrāṇi rājñe (dadyu?dadu) rupāyanam | 
dvīpāntarāt samānīya vāṇijye ye niyojitāḥ || 1-80 ||

rājā dadau lakṣmaṇāya tāni vastraṇyanekaśaḥ | 
samādāya nijāgāre lakṣmaṇo deśikottamaḥ || 1-81 ||

kuṇḍe vidhyuktamārgeṇa vahniṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ | 
tāni vastrāṇi hutavān devyātmā bhaktibhāvataḥ || 1-82 ||

tacchutvā prauḍhadevo'pi vaiparītyaṃ hṛdi smaran | 
punardāsyāmi vāsāṃsi mūlyaṃ kṛtvādya yatnataḥ || 1-83 ||

ityuktvā prerito dūto vastrārthaṃ lakṣmaṇāntike | 
tadā sa krodhacittaḥ san rājñe śāpaṃ dadau tadā || 1-84 ||

nirvaṃśo bhavatu prauḍho brahmasvasyāpahārakaḥ | 
iti vāsāṃsi devītī yācayitvā punardadau || 1-85 ||

tatastannagaraṃ tyaktvā gato'sau dakṣiṇāpatham | 
tadodvignamanāḥ prauḍhaḥ sa deśa lakṣmaṇasya tu || 1-86 ||

prāpya taṃ prārthayāmāsa mayi deva kṛpāṃ kuru | 
iti tuṣṭamanā vipraḥ provāca vaca uttamam || 1-87 ||

rājan mama vaco loke'pyamoghaṃ tannibodhaya | 
tathāpi tava bhaktyāhaṃ santuṣṭaḥ san bravīmi te || 1-88 ||

bhaviṣyati tavāpatyaṃ tatsukhaṃ na bhaviṣyati | 
tacchrutvā pramanā rājā gato nijapuraṃ prati || 1-89 ||

p. 4)

tataḥ kāle vyatīte tu prauḍhadevo mahīpatiḥ | 
antarvatnyāṃ svabhāryāyāmāpannaḥ pañcatāṃ gataḥ || 1-90 ||

tatastadrājyabhāraṃ tu (gṛ ? grā) hito'smi prajārthitaḥ | 
arkakoṭisahasreṇa dravyeṇa mahadadbhutaṃ || 1-91 ||

śrīvidyānagaraṃ nāmnā śrīcakrā rasamujjvalam |
nirmāya prauḍhadevasya putre rājyārhatāṃ gate || 1-92 ||

tamambadevaṃ bhūpālamupaveśya nṛpāsane | 
tadājñayā tatsadasi vidvadbhirvimalārthibhiḥ || 1-93 ||

samprārthito'hamambāyā ājñāmāsādya yatnataḥ | 
nānātantrāṇi saṃśodhya yāmalāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 1-94 ||

matadvayaṃ samāloḍya granthaṃ vidyārṇavābhidham | 
mudā racitavānasmi lokānāmupakārakam || 1-95 ||

mallikārjunasaṃjñasya śiṣyā vindhyapradeśake | 
trivikramasya vai śiṣyāḥ śrījagannāthadeśake || 1-96 ||

gauḍamaithilabaṅgāladeśe vai śrīdharasya tu | 
kāśyayodhyāpradeśeṣu śiṣyāḥ khyātāḥ kapardinaḥ || 1-97 ||

sampradāyo hi nānyo'sti loke śrīśaṅkarādbahiḥ kādiśaktimate tantraṃ tantrarājaṃ 
sudurlabham || 1-98 ||

mātṛkārṇavasaṃjñaṃ tu tripurārṇavasaṃjñakam | 
yoginīhṛdayaṃ caiva khyātaṃ granthacatuṣṭayam || 1-99 ||

kālīśaktimate'pyanye granthā khyātā mahītale | 
matadvayaparijñānācchivo'bhūnmānavaḥ svayam || 1-100 ||

tasmādyatnena boddhavyaṃ goptavyaṃ siddhimicchatā | 
matadvayasya saṃmatyā cordhvāmnāye vyavasthitiḥ || 1-101 ||

matasya yasya sammatyā guruṇā yatpradarśitam | 
sādhayet sādhakaśreṣṭhastanmatasyaiva sammitam || 1-102 ||

na kuryānmatasāṃkaryamanyathā siddhirodhakṛt | 
kāmarājākhyavidyāyāḥ kālīmatavibhedataḥ || 1-103 ||

gurukramaṃ vijānīyāt tanmatopāsako naraḥ | 
prahlādānandanāthaśca sanakānanda eva ca || 1-104 ||

vasiṣṭhānandanāthaśca kumārānanda eva ca | 
krodhānandaḥ śukānando dhyānānandastataḥ param || 1-105 ||

bodhānandaḥ surānandaḥ kulākhyā guravo nava | 
sarve dvinetrā dvibhujā varābhayakarāmbujāḥ || 1-106 ||

pūrvoktasamaye sthāne dhyātavyā mantravittamaiḥ | 
cidrūpaścinmayaścaiva cicchaktirdivyasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-107 ||

prabodhaśca subodhaścāpyanantaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ | 
sudhāmaśca trimūrtiśca jhiṇṭīśo mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1-108 ||

ānandanāthaśabdāntā dhruvatāratrayādikāḥ | 
pādukāṃ pūjayāmīti mantrāḥ saptadaśārṇakāḥ || 1-109 ||

śaivī saptadaśīrūpā nityā saptadaśārṇakāḥ | 
ādyaḥ paraprakāśaścāparaḥ paraśivastataḥ || 1-110 ||

paraśaktiśca kauleśaḥ śukradevī kuleśvaraḥ | 
kāmeśvarī saptamī syāddivyaughā munisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-111 ||

bhogaḥ klinnastu samayaḥ sahajo vedasaṃkhyakāḥ | 
siddhā ete tu gagano viśvastu vimalastataḥ || 1-112 ||

madano bhuvano nīlaḥ svātmā priya itīritāḥ | 
vasusaṃkhyāḥ smṛtā ete mānavā viśvavigrahāḥ || 1-113 ||

etān sampūjayeddevyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe nava kramāt |
tadante pūjayeddhīmān priyāṃ tu gurusantatim || 1-114 ||

kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakām | 
karuṇo varuṇaścaiva vijayaḥ samaro guṇaḥ || 1-115 ||

balo viśvambharaḥ satyaḥ priyaḥ śrīdharaśāradau | 
sakaleśo vilāsaśca nityeśo viśvapuruṣau || 1-116 ||

govindo vibudhaḥ siṃho vīraḥ somo divākaraḥ | 
acalo vāgbhavā nādo mohanaḥ sulabhaḥ śivaḥ || 1-117 ||

mṛtyuñjayo vāsudevaḥ śaraṇaśca sanandanaḥ | 
ākāśo gopriyo harṣo bhargaḥ kāmo mahīdharaḥ || 1-118 ||

īśāno gaṇapaḥ śrīmān kapālo bhairavo divaḥ | 
gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptasaṃkhyāḥ samīritāḥ || 1-119 ||

ekasaptatisaṃkhyāśca guravaḥ śivarūpiṇaḥ | 
tacchiṣyāṇāṃ kramaṃ jñātvā svagurūktavidhānataḥ || 1-120 ||

pūjāyāṃ tarpaṇe home jape nyāse viśeṣataḥ | 
smaraṇātsiddhimāpnoti sādhakastu na saṃśayaḥ || 1-121 ||

kālīmatānusāreṇa lopāyāśca gurukramaḥ | 
jñātavyaḥ siddhimicchadbhistathā tattadupāsakaiḥ || 1-122 ||

śrīvidyānandanāthaśca paraśambhustathaiva ca | 
paramātmā ca divyaughāḥ svaprakāśo bhagīrathaḥ || 1-123 || 

virūpākṣaśca siddhaughā jñānānandastataḥ param | 
acalānandanāthaśca yogānandaśca mānavāḥ || 1-124 ||

etān kulagurūn sthāne pūrvokte paricintayet | 
kumudaḥ kamalaścaiva subhojo divyasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-125 ||

p. 5)

ātreyo bhārgavaścaiva gautamaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ | 
śaunako vasudaścaiva surathaścaiva mānavāḥ || 1-126 ||

ānandanāthaśabdāntāstāratritayapūrvakāḥ | 
pādukāṃ pūjayāmyante namaḥ śabdaṃ prayojayet || 1-127 ||

sarva ekonaviṃśārṇā vaiṣṇavāśca svarūpiṇaḥ | 
vidyāvatāraguravaḥ śivarūpā na saṃśayaḥ || 1-128 ||

ādyaḥ proktastu paramaśivaḥ kāmeśvarī tataḥ | 
divyaughaśca mahaughaśca sarvaḥ prajñā prakāśakaḥ || 1-129 ||

ete vai sapta divyaughā divyaścitrastataḥ param | 
kaivalyo'pyanudevī ca tataścāpi mahodayaḥ || 1-130 ||

ete pañcaiva siddhaughāścidānandastataḥ param |
viśvaśaktyānandanātho ramānandastataḥ param || 1-131 ||

kamalānandanāthaśca tataścāpi manoharaḥ |
svātmānandaśca pratibhaḥ saptasaṃkhyāstu mānavāḥ || 1-132 ||

ete ca dīkṣāguravo nava paṃktikramādyajet | 
pratibhānte ca kapilo'pyagastyaśca tataḥ param || 1-133 ||

anasūyā tato'pyatrirlopāmudrā tataḥ param | 
vasiṣṭhādvyāsaparyantamūnaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-134 ||

ādityaśca mahādevo vāgānandastataḥ param | 
vāmadevo ratīdevo'nanto yogo dharādhavaḥ || 1-135 ||

suhastaḥ satyasaṅghaśca brahmānandaśca bhairavaḥ | 
dattānandaśca kuntīśaścidghanaḥ somagauravau || 1-136 ||

tripureśo mahābāhurakrodhanaśivāmbikāḥ | 
vidyānandaguṇānandau gaurīśo vibudho haraḥ || 1-137 ||

bhūteśaḥ somanāthaśca sarvajñaḥ saraso hariḥ | 
gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptasaṃkhyā udāhṛtāḥ || 1-138 ||

catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ smṛtā saṃkhyā gurūṇāṃ deśikottamaiḥ |
eteṣāṃ smaraṇāddevī suprasannā bhaveddhruvam || 1-139 ||

manvādyupāsitānāṃ ca vidyānāṃ ca gurukramam | 
jñātvā tattanmahāvidyā japtavyāstadupāsakaiḥ || 1-140 ||

mahādevaḥ parāmbā ca kūrmeśo divyarūpakāḥ | 
sadyojātaḥ kumāraśca bhūteśaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-141 ||

priyānandaśca līnaścāghoraścāpyatra mānavāḥ | 
prāguktasamaye sthāne smartavyāḥ kulamārgagāḥ || 1-142 ||
 
pūrṇeśaḥ śaṅkaraścaiva pragalbho divyasaṃjñakāḥ | 
bhautikastridaśaścaiva paramaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-143 ||

vidyeśo vāsavaścaiva yatīśaścaiva mānavāḥ | 
vidyāvatāraguravaḥ smartavyā gaganāmbuje || 1-144 ||

paraprakāśaḥ prathamastataḥ paravimarśakaḥ | 
kāmeśvarī ca mokṣaścāpyamṛtaḥ puruṣastataḥ || 1-145 ||

aghoraścaiva saptaite divyaughāḥ śivarūpiṇaḥ |
prakāmaśca sadānandastataḥ siddhaugha uttamaḥ || 1-146 ||

siddhaughāścaiva catvāra uttaraḥ paramastataḥ | 
sarvajñaḥ sarvasiddhau ca govindaḥ śaṅkarastataḥ || 1-147 ||

mānavaughaśca saptaite dīkṣāyāṃ gurusantatiḥ | 
devyāstu pṛṣṭhabhāge ca nava paṃktikramādyajet || 1-148 ||

śaṅkarānte yajedbhaktyā svagurukramamaṇḍalam |
kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-149 ||

tataḥ pareśo vidyeśastripuro vijayo haraḥ | 
kāmeśastripurāntaśca puruṣaḥ paramo hariḥ || 1-150 ||

gālavo mudgaraḥ śauriḥ paramātmā dhaneśvaraḥ | 
dhanañjayo bhāskaraśca bhallāṭaśca vibhāvasuḥ || 1-151 ||

jīvanāthaśca gorakṣo matsyanāthaḥ sadāśivaḥ | 
gurubhakto jitakrodho bodhānandaḥ sureśvaraḥ || 1-152 ||

bhairavaḥ saccidānandaḥ kṛtīśaḥ karuṇākaraḥ | 
śrīkaro vedamūrtiśca sarveśo durlabho vaśī || 1-153 ||

nāgadevaḥ kṣamānātho bhāveśaḥ keśavastataḥ | 
nandīśo gaṇapo vīro durjñeyomihiraḥ priyaḥ || 1-154 ||

gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptaite prāgudīritāḥ | 
catuḥsaptatisaṃkhyāste guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 1-155 ||

smaraṇāt pūjanāccaivopāsakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | 
atha trividhavidyānāṃ mate vai kādisaṃjñake || 1-156 ||

kulavidyāvatārārṇadīkṣāṇāṃ gurusantatau | 
gurupaṃktitrayaṃ jñātvā vidyāsiddhyai bhajetsudhīḥ || 1-157 ||

sarvajñastata īśāno bhūteśo divyasaṃjñakāḥ | 
divyaḥ sarvaśca bhavyaśca siddhāḥ śrīpūrvakā ime || 1-158 ||

praśastaśca prakāmaśca sudhāmo mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
caturbhujāstrinayanā raktamālyāmbarāvṛtāḥ || 1-159 ||

akṣasrakpustakābhītivarodyatkarapaṅkajāḥ | 
kulākhyā guravaścaite smartavyāstatra vai tathā || 1-160 ||

prakāśca vimarśaścāpyānando divyarūpiṇaḥ | 
jñānaḥ satyaśca pūrṇaśca siddhāḥ śrīpūrvakā ime || 1-161 ||

p. 6)

svabhāvaḥ pratibhaścaiva subhago mānavā matāḥ | 
vidyāvatāraguravo dhyeyāḥ pūjyāśca siddhaye || 1-162 ||

uddyotaśca prabhāvaśca kuleśo divyarūpiṇaḥ | 
bhairavo gaṇapaścaiva kumāraḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-163 ||

udbhaṭo vāgbhaṭaścaiva kamano mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
sarve tritryakṣaravyāptā māyāśrībījapūrvakāḥ || 1-164 ||

ānandanāthaśabdāntāḥ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca | 
pūjāyāṃ tarpaṇe caiva pādukāṃ tarpayāmi ca || 1-165 ||

mārjane mārjayāmyatra tattacchabdaṃ prayojayet | 
pūjāṅgahavane caiva pūjayāmyagnisundarī || 1-166 ||

tathaiva tarpaṇānte tu tarpayāmyagnivallabhā | 
mārjane mārjayāmyagnidayitā krama īdṛśaḥ || 1-167 ||

dīkṣāyā guravaścaite nava paṃktikramādyajet | 
kamanānte ca kapilādvyāsānte caikaviṃśatiḥ || 1-168 ||

avyayaśca viśeṣaśca saṃgraho devalastathā |
prakāṇḍo gahanaścaiva durlabho durjayastathā || 1-169 ||

viśveśa udayaścaiva tvaritaḥ sundarastataḥ | 
bharato dhiṣaṇaścaiva śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śaṅkarastataḥ || 1-170 ||

analo vāsavaścaiva sunetraḥ subhagastataḥ | 
vīreśo virahaścaiva klinneśo vijayastataḥ || 1-171 ||

karṣakaśca pragalbhaśca vinayo varadastathā | 
śāntanaścitrakaścaivādbhuto nipuṇa eva ca || 1-172 ||

vipulo vimalaścaiva someśaḥ kuśalastataḥ |
sumantraśca sutantraśca vidyeśo vinatastathā || 1-173 ||

vibhavo vardhanaścaivānindyaḥ supriya eva ca |
sāraṅgo vāruṇaścaiva satyecchurarihā tathā || 1-174 ||

vāgyataḥ kāmanaścaiva vāṅmayaḥ sukṛtastataḥ | 
viśākho maṃjulaścaiva kāmeśo vāgbhavastataḥ || 1-175 ||

gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptasaṃkhyāḥ samīritāḥ | 
aśītisaṃkhyakāścaite guravaścaturuttarāḥ || 1-176 ||

eteṣāṃ smaraṇānmartyaḥ śivatulyo bhavetkṣaṇāt | 
kādiśaktimate'pyete sarvatra guravaḥ smṛtāḥ || 1-177 ||

kālīmate mantrabhedādgurubhedastvanekadhā | 
pūrvadakṣiṇapāścātyamadhyasiṃhāsanasthitāḥ || 1-178 ||

bālādibhairavībhedā dvātriṃśatsaṃkhyakāḥ smṛtāḥ |
nityāḥ ṣoḍaśikāḥ ṣaḍvā darśanāḥ pañcapañcikāḥ || 1-179 ||

catuḥsamayavidyāśca navāvaraṇaśaktayaḥ | 
mantrapārāyaṇe proktā vidyāḥ śrīcakraśaktayaḥ || 1-180 ||

bhajanīyāḥ prayatnena pratipadya gurukramam |
prahlādānandanāthādyāḥ kulīnā guravo nava || 1-181 ||

samayaḥ kakkuṭaścaiva pradhāno divyasaṃjñakāḥ | 
budheśaḥ kutharaścaiva bhārgavaḥ siddharūpiṇaḥ || 1-182 ||

kandalastapanaścaivāpyadīnaścaiva mānavāḥ | 
ete vidyāvatārākhyā guravo navasaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-183 ||

paraprakāśaḥ parameśānaḥ paraśivastataḥ | 
kāmeśvarī ca mokṣaśca kāmaścāmṛtasaṃjñakaḥ || 1-184 ||

ete divyāstu saptaiva īśānaśca tataḥ param | 
jñeyastatpuruṣaścaiva hyaghorastadanantaram || 1-185 ||

vāmadevastataḥ sadyojātaḥ siddhāḥ smṛtā abhī | 
pañcottaraśca paramaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarva eva ca || 1-186 ||

siddho govindanāmā ca śaṅkaraḥ sapta mānavāḥ | 
dīkṣāyā guraścaite pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ || 1-187 ||

kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ | 
gaṇeśaśca kumāraśca vikramo vijayastataḥ || 1-188 ||

rantidevaḥ sudevaśca bhojo rāmo guṇastataḥ | 
bhairavo bhramaṇaścaiva ramaṇo vimalastataḥ || 1-189 ||

vainateyo vāsavaścānalaḥ saṅgharṣaṇastataḥ | 
vīrabhadro viśālaśca vidyādharaviśāradau || 1-190 ||

vaiśvānaraśca yajñeśo mahīdharakulāntakau | 
ananto varadaścaiva kāmo jālandharastataḥ || 1-191 ||

śaivaḥ sadāśivo bhadro rudraḥ kandarpasuvratau | 
satyavrataḥ satyanidhirbodho maudgalya eva ca || 1-192 ||

īśāno gauḍapādādiśaṅkarāt saptasaṃkhyakāḥ |
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiḥ smṛtā ete mānavānte tu pūjane || 1-193 ||

tato gurukrama jñātvā pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ |
pūrvāmnāyādidevīnāmayameva gurukramaḥ || 1-194 ||

tathaiva dakṣiṇāmnāyadevatā ye hyupāsate | 
tattatsiddhyai ca tairjñeyastattanmantragurukramaḥ || 1-195 ||

tārako rucakaścaiva bhadrako divyarūpiṇaḥ | 
amaraḥ satyagaścaiva bhāsvaraḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-196 ||

amṛto bodhapūrṇo ca mānavāḥ kularūpiṇaḥ | 
tattatsamayatatsthānatattejasi vicintayet || 1-197 ||

p. 7)

pradīpaśca prabhāsaśca pragalbho divyasaṃjñakāḥ | 
prabhāvo vinayaścaiva kumudaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-198 ||

cidābhāsaśca cidrūpaḥ prakāmo mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
ete vidyāvatārākhyā guravo bhuvi durlabhāḥ || 1-199 ||

prabhāvāścādināthaśca vimalaḥ samayaḥ śivaḥ | 
ete pañcaiva divyaughā nirvāṇo gaṇapo haraḥ || 1-200 ||

paraśambhuścidaṃśaśca pañcaite siddhasaṃjñakāḥ | 
kurunātho viśuddhiśca kuśalaḥ kuntaśekharaḥ || 1-201 ||

suḍimbhaḥ sundaraḥ keśaḥ saptaite mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
dīkṣāgurukramo devyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe prayatnataḥ || 1-202 ||

pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa svasiddhyai nava paṃktitaḥ | 
vāṅmāyākamalāsiddhaguruśabdamukhāstvime || 1-203 ||

kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ | 
vīrabhadro mahāseno girīśo guṇavardhanaḥ || 1-204 ||

vāṅmayo varado vīraḥ subhavyo nandināyakau |
vijayo viśvavinatau vīreśo girinandanaḥ || 1-205 ||

pramado vyayayogau ca nityānando guṇātigaḥ | 
guṇānando guṇārāmo niroho nirmalo vibhuḥ || 1-206 ||

subhago nirvikalpaśca mahākāro'calo'ruṇaḥ |
tūṇīśastvarito dharmo nirākāro nirindriyaḥ || 1-207 ||

haṃseśvaro rucigrīvau droṇo viśvambharo balaḥ | 
sudakṣiṇo virūpākṣo gurubhakto gurupriyaḥ || 1-208 ||

gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | 
trisaptatimitā ete mānavaughāstu pūjane || 1-209 ||

eteṣāṃ pūjanāddevyo dakṣiṇāmnāyakīrtitāḥ |
prasannāḥ syurata pūjyā vidyāsiddhyai gurūttamāḥ || 1-210 ||

paścimāmnāyadevīnāṃ pratipadya gurukramam | 
vidadhyādbhajanaṃ siddhyai gurutaḥ śāstrato'pivā || 1-211 || 

bhairavo bhairavī caiva mahādevo gaṇeśvaraḥ |
virūpākṣo mahāseno vīrabhadro dhanādhipaḥ || 1-212 ||

bodhaścānandanāthāntā guravaḥ kulasaṃjñakāḥ | 
aghoro ghorasaṃjñaśca ghoraghoratarastathā || 1-213 ||

divyaughāstatparaḥ śarvaḥ sarvo rudraśca siddhagāḥ |
hāṃkāraścaiva hīṃkāro hūṃkāraścaiva mānavāḥ || 1-214 ||

ete vidyāvatārākhyā guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ | 
īśastatpuruṣāghoravāmadevāstataḥ param || 1-215 ||

sadyojātaśca pañcaite divyaughāśca samārasaḥ |
bhūteśo lalitaḥ svasthaḥ kauleśaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-216 ||

ālasyaśca prabhānando rāgiṇī vaktrarāgiṇī | 
atītaḥ kubjasaṃjñaśca kulakauleśvarastataḥ || 1-217 ||

mānavaughāśca saptaite dīkṣāyā guravaḥ smṛtāḥ |
devyāśca pṛṣṭhabhāge tu nava paṃktikramādyajet || 1-218 ||

kulakauleśvarasyānte prayajet svagurukramam |
kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-219 ||

anantaḥ śaṅkaraścaiva piṅgalaśca karālakaḥ | 
siddho ratnaḥ śivo mehī samayaśca khageśvaraḥ || 1-220 ||

bhadraḥ kūrmaśca ghoraśca gopo mīnaśca kaulikaḥ |
tīvraśca ḍāmaraścaiva rāmaḥ kāmaśca śākinī || 1-221 ||

mahāmāyo mahānanda ādhāreśaśca cakrakaḥ | 
kururaḥ samayaḥ śrīśaḥ kubjikā kuladīpikā || 1-222 ||

śiveśaḥ śarvarī dharmī kāmī kāmakalā śivaḥ |
gīḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca saptasaṃkhyāḥ samīritāḥ || 1-223 ||

catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ smṛtāścaiva guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ |
tataḥ sampūjayedbhaktyā jñātvā svagurusantatim || 1-224 ||

uttarāmnāyadevīnāṃ kuryādbhajanamādarāt | 
viśeṣeṇa gurūñ jñātvā vidyāsiddhyai prayatnataḥ || 1-225 ||

prahlādānandanāthādyāḥ prākproktā guravaḥ kule | 
uḍḍīśaśca kuleśaśca pūrṇeśo divyasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-226 ||

kāmeśvaraśca śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śaṅkaraḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ | 
anantaḥ piṅgalo nādo mānavaughāḥ smṛtā amī || 1-227 ||

vidyāvatāraguravaḥ siddhidāḥ pūjitāśca te |
mahādevo mahādevastripuraścāpi bhairavaḥ || 1-228 ||
 
divyaughā guravaḥ proktā brahmānandastataḥ param |
pūrṇadevo'dvitīyaśca calacittaścalācalaḥ || 1-229 ||

kumāraḥ krodhanaścaiva varadaḥ smaradīpanaḥ |
māyā māyāvatī caiva siddhaughāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ || 1-230 ||

vimalaḥ kuśalaścaiva bhīmasenaḥ sudhākaraḥ |
mīno gorakṣakaścaiva bhojadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 1-231 ||

mūladevo ratīdevo vighneśvarahutāśanau | 
samayānandasantoṣau mānavaughāḥ smṛtā amī || 1-232 ||

devyāstu pṛṣṭhabhāge tu nava paṃktikramādyajet |
santoṣānandaparataḥ prayajedgurusantatim || 1-233 ||

p. 8)

kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ | 
śambaro hṛdayo bhogo nābhasaḥ kauliko dharaḥ || 1-234 ||

abhayaḥ śambaro bhadro mahā'ghoro manomayaḥ | 
bhairavaḥ śavaraḥ kālo mato brahmā mahākulaḥ || 1-235 ||

vāhanaḥ khecaro vyomaḥ śvasano jvalano hyajaḥ | 
īśastātaḥ kulātīto vāyuḥ saṃhārakauṭilau || 1-236 ||

virodhaḥ paramo goptā ṣaṭcakraḥ paramaḥ paraḥ | 
mukto jñānaḥ kulaḥ satyo vargājo mantravigrahaḥ || 1-237 ||

svacchando bhairavo bhīmo varṇāḍhyaḥ śabdaśabdajau |
gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāstu saptasaṃkhyāḥ samīritāḥ || 1-238 ||

ṣaṭsaptatimitā hyete guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ | 
eteṣāṃ smaraṇānmartyaḥ śivatulyo na saṃśayaḥ || 1-239 ||

śaṅkarādigurūñ jñātvā pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ | 
pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ pṛthagyajanake'pivā || 1-240 ||

gaṇeśādimanūnāṃ ca jñeyastattadgurukramaḥ | 
gurūṇāṃkulamajñātvā naṣṭamārgo bhaviṣyati || 1-241 ||

naṣṭamārgānmantravidye na tādṛkphalagocare | 
gurūṇāṃ śiṣyabhūtānāṃ nāsti cet santatikramaḥ || 1-242 ||

tatra mantrāśca vidyāśca niṣphalā nātra saṃśayaḥ | 
viṃśatiḥ puruṣā vāpi nava sapta trayo'pivā || 1-243 ||

na jñātā guruvaṃśānāṃ śiṣyaścennaṣṭasantatiḥ | 
svavaṃśādadhiko jñeyo guruvaṃśo mahāśubhaḥ || 1-244 ||

janakādadhiko jñeyo mantradastu maheśvaraḥ |
tasmātsarvatra vijñeyaḥ pūjanīyo gurukramaḥ || 1-245 ||

ādau sarvatra vijñeyo mantradaḥ paramo guruḥ |
parāparaguruḥ śaktiḥ parameṣṭhī guruḥ śivaḥ || 1-246 ||

sarvamantreṣu vidyāsu svayaṃ prakṛtirūpiṇī | 
tataḥ puruṣarūpaśca tataśca gurusantatiḥ || 1-247 ||

tenaiva hi śivāṃśāśca śivabhaktā viśeṣataḥ | 
sarvamantreṣu guravaḥ sarvajñāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 1-248 ||

śivāḥ śaivyaśca yā vidyāstāsāṃ sarvatra deśikāḥ | 
gaṇeśo gāṇapatyānāṃ gaṇadīkṣāprabhurmataḥ || 1-249 ||

vaiṣṇavānāṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ saurāṇāṃ sūrya eva ca | 
divyaughā guravaścaiva siddhaughā guravastathā || 1-250 ||

mānavaughāśca guravo jñeyāḥ sarvatra deśikaiḥ | 
gaṇeśvaro gaṇakrīḍo vikaṭo vighnanāyakaḥ || 1-251 ||

durmukhaḥ sumukho buddho vighnarājo gaṇādhipaḥ | 
ete kulākhyā guravastattejasi vibhāvayet || 1-252 ||

surānandaḥ pramodaśca herambaśca mahotkaṭaḥ | 
śaṅkaro lambakarṇaśca meghanādo mahābalaḥ || 1-253 ||

gaṇaṃjayo navaite tadvidyānāmavatārakāḥ | 
vināyako virūpākṣo buddhaḥ śūro varapradaḥ || 1-254 ||

ete pañcaiva divyaughā vijayo durjayo jayaḥ | 
kavīśvaraśca brahmaṇyo nidhīśaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-255 ||

gajādhirājo duḥkhāriḥ sadyojātaḥ mukhāvahaḥ | 
paramātmā sarvabhūtātmā mahānādaḥ śubhānanaḥ || 1-256 ||

bālacandro navaite ca mānavaughāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | 
dīkṣāyā guravaḥ proktā pūjitāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 1-257 ||

tataśca bālacandrānte pūjayet gurusantatim | 
kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-258 ||

gaṇakaḥ subhago nityo nityālambaśca śāśvataḥ | 
pūrṇānandaḥ parānandaḥ subhaktaḥ padmalocanaḥ || 1-259 ||

kāmapālo budhaḥ śreṣṭho gajavaktro gaṇapriyaḥ | 
bhūteśo bālalīlaśca kumāro bodhano haraḥ || 1-260 ||

satyalīlaḥ sulīlaśca vikaṭo dhūmravarṇakaḥ | 
nandipriyo nandihāso devīputro dhaneśvaraḥ || 1-261 ||

viśvambharo viśālākṣo vighnahartā vināyakaḥ | 
kūṣmāṇḍeśaḥ kapardī ca śivaḥ kālo mahīdharaḥ || 1-262 ||

gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca sapta prāgīritāśca te | 
triṣaṣṭisammitā hyete guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 1-263 ||

pūjitāḥ saṃsmṛtā nityaṃ sarvepsitaphalapradāḥ |
śrīmāyāsmarabījādyāḥ siddhācāryanamontakāḥ || 1-264 ||

vaiṣṇaveṣu tathā jñeyā guravo mantrasiddhaye | 
prahlādaśca vasiṣṭhaśca puṇḍarīkaḥ parāśaraḥ || 1-265 ||

śukaśca śaunakaścaiva nārado dālbhya eva ca | 
vyāsaścaiva nava proktā guravaḥ kularūpiṇaḥ || 1-266 ||

sarasvatī tato jñeyau vināyakaśukau tataḥ | 
sumanturjaiminiścaiva vaiśampāyana eva ca || 1-267 ||

nāradaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca sucelo navasaṃkhyakāḥ | 
vidyāvatāraguravo dhyeyāḥ pūjyāśca siddhaye || 1-268 ||

p. 9)

mahādevo mahādevī parameṣṭhī samīraṇaḥ | 
varuṇo vāmadevaśca kaśyapaścāṅgirāḥ ṛtuḥ || 1-269 ||

dīkṣāyā guravaścaite nava paṃktikramādyajet | 
kapilādvyāsaparyantamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 1-270 ||

nṛsiṃho vāmanaḥ satyo balo bālo dhanurdharaḥ | 
śaṅkhī cakrī halī khaḍgī musalī ramaṇo'jitaḥ || 1-271 ||

puruṣo bhūdharo viśvo govindo govivardhanaḥ | 
gopīśvaro jitakrodho mīnākhyo mīnaketanaḥ || 1-272 ||

manoharaḥ sātvataśca keśavo'cyutavāmanau | 
narasiṃho'vyayo viṣṇurnārāyaṇamahīdharau || 1-273 ||

cidaṃśaścitprakāśaśca mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ | 
puruṣottamapadmākṣau ghanaśyāmo dharādhavaḥ || 1-274 ||

gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca sapta prāguditāśca te | 
aṣṭaṣaṣṭimitā hyete guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 1-275 ||

eteṣāṃ smaraṇānmantrāḥ sidhyantyeva hi tatkṣaṇāt | 
ete manmathabījādyāḥ śrīpādebhyo namontakāḥ || 1-276 ||

athavācāryapādebhyo namontāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ | 
śaivānāṃ mantravidyānāṃ siddhyai tattadgurukramam || 1-277 ||

jñātvā tadbhajanaṃ kuryādanyathā phaladā nahi | 
viśveśvaraśca bhagavānmahādevastriyambakaḥ || 1-278 ||

tripurāntaśca kālāgnirudraḥ kālastataḥ param | 
sarveśvaro nīlakaṇṭho dikpatiśca sadāśivaḥ || 1-279 ||

ekādaśa smṛtā hyete guravaḥ kularūpiṇaḥ | 
vīrabhadro gaṇādhyakṣastataḥ śūlāyudhaḥ śivaḥ || 1-280 ||

īśānaḥ pramathādhīśo nandī bhṛṅgiḥ pracaṇḍakaḥ | 
mahiṣo madanārātirvidyānāmavatārake || 1-281 ||

guravo rudrasaṃkhyāśca smṛtāḥ siddhipradāyakāḥ | 
aghoro'pyathaghoraśca ghoraghoratarastataḥ || 1-282 ||

sarvaḥ sarvaśca rudraśca tatastatpuruṣastataḥ | 
mahādevo virūpākṣaḥ sadyojāto bhavastathā || 1-283 ||

ekādaśaite divyaughā bhavodbhavavināyakau | 
caṇḍīśo vāmadevaśca śaṅkaro viśvanāyakaḥ || 1-284 ||

jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca kālaśca bhūteśaḥ pramatheśvaraḥ | 
ekādaśaite siddhaughāḥ kalavikaraṇastataḥ || 1-285 ||

balavikaraṇaścaiva balapramathanastathā | 
tataśca sarvabhūtānte damanaśca manonmanaḥ || 1-286 ||

ugro bhīmaḥ paśupatirnīlagrīvastrilocanaḥ | 
vīreśvaraśca samproktā mānavā rudrasammitāḥ || 1-287 ||

pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena vidyāsiddhyai ca deśikaiḥ | 
dīkṣāyā guravaścaite vīreśānte gurukramaḥ || 1-288 ||

jñātavyaḥ kapilādvyāsaparyante'pyekaviṃśatiḥ |
kāmeśaḥ kālakaṇṭhaśca kālaghnaḥ kālarūpadhṛk || 1-289 ||

kāmāntako viśālākṣo vīrabhadro vināyakaḥ |
śūlāyudho girīśaśca kailāso vāṅmayo haraḥ || 1-290 ||

budheśaścāmareśaśca caṇḍīśvarakumārakau | 
maheśvaro mahādevo viśvanāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 1-291 ||

ātmeśvaraśca samvartaḥ krameśaśca prakāśanaḥ | 
lalitaḥ sparśabhūteśau cānandaśca prabheśvaraḥ || 1-292 ||

rāgeśaśca karāleśaḥ siddheśasamayeśvarau | 
jñānānandaḥ priyānandaḥ kalānando'mṛteśvaraḥ || 1-293 ||

guhyeśvaraścidānandaḥ kuleśaścaṇḍakaulikau | 
gauḍādiśaṅkarāntāśca sapta prāgīritāśca te || 1-294 ||

ekasaptatisaṃkhyāśca guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ | 
prāsādādyāñca ārādhyacaraṇebhyo namontakāḥ || 1-295 ||

pūjitāḥ saṃsmṛtā nityaṃ mantrasiddhipradāśca te | 
saurāstathaiva yaṣṭavyāḥ pratipadya gurukramam || 1-296 ||

mihiraśca suguptaśca prabheśo divyasaṃjñakāḥ |
aruṇaśca marīciśca mayūkhaḥ siddhasaṃjñakāḥ || 1-297 ||

kātyāyano ghṛṇīśaśca mārtaṇḍo mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
ete kulākhyāḥ guravaścintanīyā mahaujasaḥ || 1-298 ||

vedātmā bhāskaro bradhno divyā bhāsvān prabhākaraḥ | 
nārāyaṇaḥ kapardī ca siddhāścārkastrayīmayaḥ || 1-299 ||

īśāno mānavāḥ proktā vidyānāmavatārake | 
ānandaḥ samayaścaiva vimalo jñānadīpanaḥ || 1-300 ||

cidghanaḥ somanāthaśca savitā poṣaṇo'ruṇaḥ | 
maheśo vijayaścaiva bhūteśo devabhāgakaḥ || 1-301 ||

dīkṣāyā guraścaite trayodaśa samīritāḥ | 
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena nava paktikramādbudhaiḥ || 1-302 ||

tataśca devabhāgānte kapilādekaviṃśatiḥ |
vyāsānte jaiminiścaiva sumanturjñānavardhanaḥ || 1-303 ||

p. 10)

cidānandaścidābhāsaścinmayo yogavidguruḥ | 
satyavrataśca cidrūpo bhairavo'mbaranāyakaḥ || 1-304 ||

viśveśvaro mitrakaraḥ śubhaṃkaradivākarau | 
gaṇeśvaraśca mārtaṇḍabhairavo dyumaṇī raviḥ || 1-305 ||

trivikramo vāsudevaḥ śaṃkaro ravilocanaḥ |
puṇḍarīko rameśaśca guṇārāmo dhaneśvaraḥ || 1-306 ||

devendro gopanāthaśca puruṣaśca mahāśayaḥ | 
ācāryasiṃho govindo vedajño mitravindakaḥ || 1-307 ||

gauḍādiśaṃkarāntāśca catuṣṣaṣṭimitāḥ smṛtāḥ | 
eteṣāṃ smaraṇātsaurā mantrāḥ sidhyanti tatkṣaṇāt || 1-308 ||

śaṃkarāt svagurūñjñātvā pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ |
ete māyādikāḥ sarve pādukābhyo namontakāḥ || 1-309 ||

ye proktā uttarāmnāye guravaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ |
te jñātavyā adhaḥsaṃjñakāmnāye bhairavāntakāḥ || 1-310 ||

śrīvidyā bhedasahitā bālā ca tripurā ca yā | 
bhagamālā tathā nityaklinnā caiva svayaṃvarā || 1-311 ||

madhumatyunmanī bheḍā śārikā surasundarī | 
aśvāruḍhā mahāmāyā kurukullā sureśvarī || 1-312 ||

bhuvaneśyannapūrṇā ca pūrvāmnāyādhidevatāḥ |
bagalā vaśinībhedāstvaritā phaladā tathā || 1-313 ||

vārāhī bhedasahitā bhoginī bhedasaṃyutā | 
kāmeśvarī ca bheruṇḍā vajreśī vahnivāsinī || 1-314 ||

śivadūtī vicitrā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā | 
mahiṣārdī mahālakṣmīrdakṣiṇāmnāyadevatāḥ || 1-315 ||

mahāsarasvatī devī tathā vāgvādinī matā | 
tathā nīlapatākā ca bhairavī bhedasaṃyutā || 1-316 ||

cāmuṇḍā raktacāmuṇḍā brāhmyādidaśadevatāḥ |
pratyaṅgirā bhavānī ca paścimāmnāyadevatāḥ || 1-317 ||

kālikā bhedasahitā tārā bhedaiśca saṃyutā | 
mātaṅgī bhairavī chinnā tathā dhūmāvatī matā || 1-318 ||

uttarāmnāyakathitāḥ śīghrakāla phalapradāḥ | 
nāgaśaktyādayo vidyā adhā amnāyadevatāḥ || 1-319 ||

tattadbhedāṃstathā jñātvā bhajettattadgurukramam |
kālīśaktimate samyak proktaparvasu cādarāt || 1-320 ||

guruṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhūmau vidhāya gurusaṃtatim |
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā sampradāyaprasiddhaye || 1-321 ||

asaṃpradāyāt phaladā na bhavanti hi devatāḥ |
saṃpradāyamavijñāya mohādajñānato'pivā || 1-322 ||

mantra dadyāt prayatnādyo devatāṃ vā samarcayet | 
ācaret tarpaṇaṃ homaṃ pauraścaraṇakaṃ vidhim || 1-323 ||

yadyattattad bhavennityamabhicārāyā niścayāt | 
ādyaṃ gaṇapateścakraṃ tadbahirbhairavaṃ tataḥ || 1-324 ||

tadbahirvaṭukaṃ cakraṃ siddhacakraṃ ca tadbahiḥ | 
caraṇākhyaṃ tadupari śāṃbhavaṃ tadanantaram || 1-325 ||

tadūrdhvaṃ mālinīcakraṃ saptacakrātmakaṃ bhavet |
ādau trikoṇaṃ vinyasya tadbahistryasramuddharet || 1-326 ||

trikoṇaṃ tadbahirnyasyennavakoṇaṃ ca tadbahiḥ | 
tadbahirvasupatrābjaṃ tadbahirvalayatrayam || 1-327 ||

caturasratrayaṃ nyasya tadbahiḥ pūjayed budhaḥ | 
praṇavaṃ vāgbhavaṃ māyāṃ kamalāṃ khecarīṃ tataḥ || 1-328 ||

tatprāsādaparābījamuddhṛtya śivaśaktike | 
saṃvartaśca mahākālaśakrāmbvagnisamīraṇān || 1-329 ||

uddharedantyavarṇastu arghīśārdhendusaṃyutaḥ | 
tataśca śrīgurornāmānandanāthāntamuddharet || 1-330 ||

śrīpādukāpadaṃ coktvā pūjayāmi namo vadet | 
anena mantrarājena madhye śrīgurumarcayet || 1-331 ||

asminmantre parādyaṃ tu kṛtvā sarvatra deśikaḥ | 
deśikākhyasthale tasya patnyā nāma niyojya ca || 1-332 ||

devyambāśrīpadaṃ coktvā pādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca | 
namontavidyayā nāthavāme tatsundarīṃ yajet || 1-333 ||

svāgrādyasratraye pūjyaṃ śrīnāthādigurutrayam | 
śrīcakranāthapārśve tu cakrādhiṣṭhānadaivatam || 1-334 ||

gaṇanāthaṃ susaṃpūjya dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ yajet | 
prathamaṃ kāmarūpākhyaṃ jālandharamataḥ param || 1-335 ||

tṛtīyaṃ pūrṇagiryākhyaṃ svāgrādyasratraye yajet | 
vakṣyamāṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tu coḍyāṇaṃ madhyadeśataḥ || 1-336 ||

bhairavaṃ pūjayet tasyā manunā sādhakottamaḥ | 
dvitīyacakrādhiṣṭhātā yataḥ kāmākhyadakṣiṇe || 1-337 ||

vaṭukaṃ yoginīṃ caiva kṣetrapālaṃ tu sādhakaḥ | 
tattanmantreṇa saṃpūjya svāgrāditryasrake budhaḥ || 1-338 ||

p. 11)

ādyasya dakṣiṇe bhāge vaṭukaṃ cakranāyakam |
tataśca navakoṇe tu svāgrādeśca pradakṣiṇam || 1-339 ||

vidyāvatāraguravo yaṣṭavyā nijasiddhaye | 
tata ādyasya dakṣe tu siddhebhyo nama uccaran || 1-340 ||

siddhaṃ sampūjayedbhaktyā cakrādhiṣṭhānadaivatam | 
tataścāṣṭadale svāgrādyajeddūtyaṣṭakaṃ budhaḥ || 1-341 ||

ādyāyā dakṣavāme tu raktaśuklapadadvayam |
tattanmantreṇa sampūjya pūjayedvalayatraye || 1-342 ||

vāmāvartakramāt paṃktyākāreṇa nijasiddhaye | 
ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatapañcavīreśamaṇḍalam || 1-343 ||

prāguktabījaṣaṭkaṃ ca ādivarṇaṃ dviruccaret | 
rūpavīreśa coccārya pādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca || 1-344 ||

evaṃ mantrāstu kathitāstāvatsaṃkhyāstu pūjane | 
svarāśca prathame vṛtte sparśavarṇā dvitīyake || 1-345 ||

tṛtīye vyāpakā varṇā madhyavṛtte nijāgrake | 
śāmbhavaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā tanmantreṇa prayatnataḥ || 1-346 ||

saptame mālinīcakre caturasratrayātmake |
pūjayedādyarekhāyāṃ brahmāṇyādyaṣṭamātṛkāḥ || 1-347 ||

tato dvitīyarekhāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ pañcabhāgaśaḥ | 
pūjayetpañca bhūtāni tattanmantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 1-348 ||

tattaccaturviṃśatibhirvarṇadevaiḥ kṛtāvṛtiḥ | 
tatastṛtīyarekhāyāmindrādyastrāṇi tadbahiḥ || 1-349 ||

svāgre sampūjayedbhaktyā mālinīṃ viśvavigrahām |
tadvidyayā sādhakendraḥ pīṭhikā ca tato bahiḥ || 1-350 ||

evaṃ pūjayiturdevī prasannā bhavati dhruvam | 
same tithau samarkṣāṇāṃ bhṛgau bhaumasya vā punaḥ || 1-351 ||

yoge rātrau yajedbhaktyā svasiddhyai gurumaṇḍalam |
yastu sampūjayedbhaktyā kuleṣu gurumaṇḍalam || 1-352 ||

sa deśikavaraḥ proktastasmāddīkṣā hyanuttamā | 
sa sampradāyī sa guruḥ sa tu devīsvarūpadhṛt || 1-353 ||

tasmāddīkṣā śubhā proktā cānyathā niṣphalā bhavet |
pratyutaiva guruḥ śiṣyaṃ nihantyeva na cānyathā || 1-354 ||

tasmātkuleṣu tithiṣu pūjanīyaṃ susādhakaiḥ | 
sundarī sumukhī caiva virūpā vimalā tathā || 1-355 ||

antarī badarī caiva dūtarī puṣpabhadrikā | 
dūtīnāmaṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ gurumaṇḍalapūjane || 1-356 ||

upāsyā yā mahāvidyā tatroktāḥ pīṭhaśaktayaḥ |
gurumaṇḍalapūjāyāṃ jñeyāḥ pīṭhasya śaktayaḥ || 1-357 ||

vāṅmāyā kamalā caiva khecarī ṛddhivarjitā |
tataḥ pretaṃ samālikhya bījaṃ vai nādinenduyuk || 1-358 ||

raudryanantayutā senduranantānalacandrayuk | 
nakulīśo'tha māyā ca vidyoktā mālinī parā || 1-359 ||

pūrvoktaguruvidyāyāmādyaṃ yadbījaṣaṭkakam |
ante dadyādvilomena proktaṃ śāmbhavamuttamam || 1-360 ||

jñātavyaṃ mantrajālaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā | 
atha kādimate jñeyaṃ gurumaṇḍalapūjanam || 1-361 ||

śrīparṇīsambhave pīṭhe phalakāyāṃ sthale'pi vā |
sthale tu susame śuddhe dṛḍhe tu sumanohare || 1-362 ||

prākpratyagdakṣiṇodak ca daśa sūtrāṇi vinyaset |
ekāśītipadopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra jāyate || 1-363 ||

samasūtre manoramye pade pañcāṃgulāntare |
prākpratyagdakṣiṇodak ca sūtradvayanipātanāt || 1-364 ||

nava koṣṭhāni jāyante sambhūya ca pade pade |
madhyasthapadamadhyasthanavakoṣṭheṣu madhyataḥ || 1-365 ||

prāgādi vilikhedvarṇān pratikoṣṭhaṃ navaikaśaḥ | 
māyāśrībījapūrvaṃ ca prakāśānandasaṃjñakam || 1-366 ||

nāthaṃ tatra susambodhya navārṇān navakoṣṭhake |
evaṃ tatpūrvanavake dvitīyaṃ nāthanāma ca || 1-367 ||

prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva navake navake likhet |
evaṃ tu navanāthānāṃ maṇḍalāni navaiva hi || 1-368 ||

jāyante varṇavinyāsāt tatra pūjāṃ tu kārayet |
nāthāvṛttikrameṇaiva nāthanāma tu yaddine || 1-369 ||

tadārabhya yajeddhīmāṃstaddine tatra tatra ca |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpairnaivedyakaistathā || 1-370 ||

tāmbūlaiśca namaskāraiḥ stotraiścāpi samāhitaḥ |
aikyabhāvanayā nāthān santoṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 1-371 ||

madhyanāthasya purataḥ śrīguruṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ |
nāmādikramato vidvānnavāgreṣu yajennava || 1-372 ||

tadbahiḥ paṃktito vidvān śivādigurumaṇḍalam |
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ || 1-373 ||

p. 12)

evaṃ parvasvavahitaḥ  pūjāṃ rātrau ca kārayet |
pādukāṃ pūjayāmīti proccārya susamāhitaḥ || 1-374 ||

pūrṇāparvasu teṣveva padeṣu ṣoḍaśaiva hi |
koṣṭhāni guṇasūtrāṇāṃ pātanādvidadhīta vai || 1-375 ||

ṣoḍaśārṇāllikhet prāgvatpūjāṃ prāgvatsamācaret |
evaṃ pūjā prakartavyā gurau jīvati sādhakaiḥ || 1-376 ||

mṛte nāthapadaṃ hitvā śiveti padamunnayet |
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayennityaṃ viśeṣadivaseṣu tu || 1-377 ||

tasmāddīkṣā śubhā proktā cānyathāpyaśubhā bhavet |
pūrṇābhiṣekayuktaistu padeṣu kamalāni vai || 1-378 ||

kṛtvā pūjā viśrātavyā pūrṇāparvātiriktake |
pūrṇāparvasu teṣveva ṣoḍaśīkṛtya pūrvavat || 1-379 ||

candracandanakāśmīrairuśīrairmṛganābhikaiḥ |
sugandhapañcakenaiva vidadhyādgurumaṇḍalam || 1-380 ||

pūjānte lepayedbhāle tatpaṅkaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ |
sampadvijayasiddhyarthamāyurārogyasiddhaye || 1-381 ||

pūjādau ca tadante ca gurustotraṃ paṭhedbudhaḥ |
sandhyātraye susiddhyarthaṃ rātrau caiva samāhitaḥ || 1-382 ||

namaste nātha bhagavan śivāya gururūpiṇe |
vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai svīkṛtānekavigraha || 1-383 ||

navāya navarūpāya paramārthaikarūpiṇe |
sarvājñānatamobhedamānave cidghanāya te || 1-384 ||

svatantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya parātmane |
paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe || 1-385 ||

vivekināṃ vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśinām |
prakāśināṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇe || 1-386 ||

purastātpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaskuryāmuparyadhaḥ |
sadā maccittarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadāsanam || 1-387 ||

idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhennityaṃ vidyāsiddhyai prayatnataḥ |
cakre devyāstu śaktyantā nāthāntā gurumaṇḍale || 1-388 ||

gurau mṛte śivāntāśca gurūṇāṃ trividhāḥ sthitiḥ |
gurumaṇḍalametaddhi pāraṃparyyamiti smṛtam || 1-389 ||

pāraṃparyyaparijñānāt sampradāyaḥ sthiro bhavet |
sampradāye sthire jāte sampradāyavatī bhavet || 1-390 ||

devatā tena vidyāśca mantrāḥ siddhyanti tatkṣaṇāt |
puraścaryāsu nityaṃ hi pūjayedgurumaṇḍalam || 1-391 ||

sampradāyaparijñānaṃ mantravīryasya saṃsmṛtiḥ |
etaddvayaṃ na jānāti sādhakastu kathaṃ bhavet || 1-392 ||

nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva cādyaṃ kāmyaṃ ca taddvayam |
prāptaṃ kālācca paryāyāt prasiddhaṃ trīṇyanukramāt || 1-393 ||

nāmāni sādhakendrasya sampradāyaprasiddhaye |
bhaveyustāni yatnena jñeyāni śrīgurorapi || 1-394 ||

pāraṃparyyaṃ tathā jñātvā svaśiṣyebhyo nivedayet |
gurvātmadevatāṇūnāmaikyaṃ sambhāvayan sadā || 1-395 ||

tadājñāpālanodyaktaścottamaḥ śiṣya ucyate || 

gurumaṇḍalapūjāyāṃ viśeṣadināni tantrarāje-

gurostu janmadivasaṃ vidyāprāptidinaṃ tathā |
svajanmadivasaṃ nāthavyāptivāsarameva ca || 1-1 ||

akṣaratrayasaṃpātadinaṃ pūrṇādinaṃ tathā |
ṣaṭ parvāṇi viviṣṭāni sadarśaṃ saptaparvakam || 1-2 ||

māsato varṣato vāpi kuryādeteṣu pūjanam || 1-iti ||

atha kādimate proktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ |
tattantrasthaṃ vadiṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca || 1-3 ||

sundaraḥ sumukhaḥ svacchaḥ sulabho bahumantravit | 
asaṃśayaḥ saṃśayacchinnirapekṣo gururmataḥ || 1-4 ||

saundaryamanavadyatvaṃ rūpe saumukhyatā punaḥ |
smerapūrvābhibhāṣitvaṃ svacchatā'jihmacittatā || 1-5 ||

saulabhyamapyagarvitvaṃ saṃtoṣo bahutantratā |
asaṃśayastattvabodhe tacchiṣye pratipādanāt || 1-6 ||

nairapekṣyamavittecchā gurutvaṃ hitavāditā |
evaṃvidho gururjñeyastvitaraḥ śiṣyaduḥkhadaḥ || 1-7 ||

caturbhirādyaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ śraddhāvān susthirāśayaḥ |
alubdhaḥ sthiragātraśca prekṣākārī jitendriyaḥ || 1-8 ||

āstiko dṛḍhabuddhiśca gurau mantre sadaivate |
evaṃvidho bhavecchiṣyastvitaro duḥkhakṛd guroḥ || 1-9 ||

gurūcyamāne vacane dadyāditthaṃ vacastadā | 
prasīda nātha deveti tatheti ca kṛtādaram || 1-10 ||

p. 13)

praṇamyopaviśet pārśve tathā gacchedanujñayā |
mukhāvalokī seveta kuryādādiṣṭamādarāt || 1-11 ||

asatyaṃ na vadedagre na bahu pralapedapi |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mānaṃ prahasanaṃ stutim || 1-12 ||

cāpalāni ca jihmāni kāryāṇi paridevanam |
ṛṇādānaṃ tathā dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayam || 1-13 ||

na kuryādguruṇāsārdhaṃ śiṣyo bhūṣṇuḥ kadācana |
yato guruḥ śivaḥ sākṣāt taṃ stuvan praṇaman bhajet || 1-14 ||

yathā deve tathā mantre yathā mantre tathā gurau |
yathā gurau tathā svātmanyevaṃ bhaktikramaḥ priye || 1-15 ||

gurostu janmadivase kuryādutsavamādarāt |
viśeṣapūjāṃ yogibhyo bhojanaṃ tatpadārcanam || 1-16 ||

vyāpte prete dūragate pūjayedagrajādiṣu |
ekadeśe nityapūjā dūrasthe yojanakramāt || 1-17 ||

ekādi ṛtusaṃvṛddhyā varṣe ṣaṭyojanāntare |
tato dūragate sevā tadājñāparipālanam || 1-18 ||

āsanaṃ śayanaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ pādukāṃ tathā |
chāyāṃ kalatramanyacca yat sprṣṭaṃ tattu pūjayet || 1-19 ||

ekagrāme pṛthakpūjāṃ na kuryādananujñayā |
pūjāmadhye samāyāte pūjye natvā sthitiṃ vadet || 1-20 ||

videhi śeṣamityu (ktvā ? ktaḥ) kuryānno cetadājñayā |
varteta so'pi taccheṣaṃ kuryānniścalamānasaḥ || 1-21 ||

pūjāmadhye gurau pūjye tvante vāpi samāgate |
kṛtameveti saṃbhāṣen maunaṃ tairna samācaret || 1-22 ||

guruṃ na martyaṃ budhyeta yadi budhyeta tasya tu |
na kadācidbhavet siddhirmantrairvā devatārcanaiḥ || 1-23 ||

mantreṇa tasya niyataṃ pūjāṃ kuryādyathoditām |
tāṃ ca tatpaṭale samyag jñātvā bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 1-24 ||

iti kālomate proktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ |
tattantroktavidhānena sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca || 1-25 ||

tattantre kulārṇave |

śrīguruḥ parameśāni śuddhaveśo manoharaḥ | 
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥ || 1-1 ||

sarvāgamārthatattvajñaḥ sarvamantravidhānavit |
lokasammohanākāro devavat priyadarśanaḥ || 1-2 ||

sumukhaḥ sulabhaḥ svacchaḥ śuddhāntaśchinnasaṃśayaḥ |
iṅgitākāraceṣṭāvid dūrataḥkṛtadurjanaḥ || 1-3 ||

antarmukho bahirdṛṣṭiḥ sarvajño deśakālavit |
ājñāsiddhastrikālajño nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ || 1-4 ||

vedavedāṅgavicchāntaḥ sarvajīvadayāparaḥ |
svādhīnendriyasaṃcāraḥ ṣaṭvargavijayakṣamaḥ || 1-5 ||

agragaṇyo'tigambhīraḥ pātrāpātraviśeṣavit |
nirmamo nityasaṃtuṣṭo nirdvandvo'nantaśaktimān || 1-6 ||

sadbhaktavatsalo dhīraḥ kṛpāluḥ smitapūrvavāk |
bhaktapriyaḥ sarvasamo dayāluḥ śiṣyaśāsitā || 1-7 ||

śreṣṭhaniṣṭho guruḥ prājño vanitāpūjanotsukaḥ |
nitye naimittike kāmye rataḥ karmaṇyanindite || 1-8 ||

alolupo'hiṃsakaśca pakṣapātī vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vittavidyādibhiḥ pūrṇo mantrayantrādipāragaḥ || 1-9 ||

niḥsaṃkalpavikalpaśca nirṇītārthavidhāyakaḥ |
tulyanindāstutirmaunī nirapekṣo niyāmakaḥ || 1-10 ||

ityādilakṣaṇopetaḥ śrīguruḥ kathitaḥ priye ||

iti śrīgurulakṣaṇāni || atha sacchiṣyalakṣaṇāni-

sacchiṣyaṃ taṃ kuleśāni sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
śamādisādhanopetaṃ guṇaśīlasamanvitam || 1-1 ||

śuddhadehānubandhāṅgaṃ dhārmikaṃ śuddhamānasam |
dṛḍhavrataṃ sadācāraṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitam || 1-2 ||

kṛtajñaṃ pāpabhītaṃ ca sādhusajjanasaṃmatam |
āstikaṃ dānaśīlaṃ ca sarvabhūtahite ratam || 1-3 ||

viśvāsavinayopetaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivarjitam |
asādhyasādhakaṃ śūraṃ balakāntisamanvitam || 1-4 ||

anukūlakriyāyuktamapramattaṃ vicakṣaṇam |
hitasatyamitasnigdhabhāṣaṇaṃ muktadūṣaṇam || 1-5 ||

sakṛduktagṛhītārthaṃ caturaṃ buddhivistaram |
gṛhatalpāsanocchṛṅganirvikāramasevakam || 1-6 ||

vimṛśyakāriṇaṃ vīraṃ manodāridryavarjitam |
sarvakāryātikuśalaṃ dhīraṃ sarvopakārakam || 1-7 ||

svasvārthaparanindāyāṃ vimukhaṃ sumukhaṃ priye |
jitendriyaṃ susantuṣṭaṃ dhīmantaṃ brahmacāriṇam || 1-8 ||

p. 14)

tyaktādhivyādhicāpalyaṃ duḥśaṅkātaṅkavarjitam |
gurudhyānastutikathāsevanābhajanotsukam || 1-9 ||

gurudaivatabhaktaṃ ca kāminībhajanotsukam |
nityaṃ gurusamīpasthaṃ gurusaṃtoṣakāriṇam || 1-10 || 

vāṅmanaḥkarmabhirnityaṃ gurukāryasamutsukam |
gurvājñāpālakaṃ devi gurukīrtiprakāśakam || 1-11 ||

guruvākyapramāṇajñaṃ guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratam |
cittānuvartinaṃ prekṣyakāriṇaṃ kulanāyike || 1-12 ||

lajjābhimānagarvādivarjitaṃ gurusaṃnidhau | 
nirapekṣaṃ gurudravye tatprasādādikāṃkṣiṇam || 1-13 ||

kuladharmakathāyogiyoginīkaulikapriyam |
kulārcanādinirataṃ mokṣamārgānugāminam || 1-14 ||

ityādilakṣaṇopetaṃ guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parigrahet ||

athāsacchiṣyalakṣaṇāni kulārṇave-

duṣṭānvavāyajaṃ duṣṭaṃ guṇahīnamarūpiṇam |
paraśiṣyaṃ ca pāṣāṇāṇḍaṃ dhūrtaṃ paṇḍitamāninam || 1-1 ||
 
hīnādhikavikārāṅgaṃ vikalāvayavānvitam |
paṃgumandhaṃ ca badhiraṃ malinaṃ vyādhipīḍitam || 1-2 ||

ucchiṣṭaṃ durmukhaṃ cāpi svecchāveśadharaṃ viṭam |
durvidagdhaṃ kuceṣṭaṃ ca kuṭilaṃ bhīmavīkṣaṇam || 1-3 ||

nidrālasyayutaṃ tandrādyūtādivyasanānvitam |
kapāṭakuḍyastambhādau tirohitatanuṃ sadā || 1-4 ||

śūnyayuktakaraṃ kṣudraṃ gurubhaktivivarjitam |
kimekavādinaṃ stabdhaṃ preṣakaṃ capalaṃ śaṭham || 1-5 ||

dhanastrīśuddhirahitaṃ niṣedhavidhivarjitam |
rahasyabhedakaṃ cāpi devīkāryārthaghātakam || 1-6 ||

mārjārabakavṛtti ca randhrānveṣaṇatatparam |
māyānvitaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ ca pracchannāntaradāyakam || 1-7 ||

viśvāsaghātakaṃ devadrohiṇaṃ pāpakāriṇam |
aviśvāsamavadyāṅgamanarthasiddhikāṃkṣiṇam || 1-8 ||

ātatāyinamāditsuṃ kutsitaṃ kūṭasākṣikam |
sarvatra yācakaṃ devi sarvākṛṣṭābhigāminam || 1-9 ||

asatyaniṣṭhe cāsaktaṃ grāmyādibahubhāṣiṇam |
durvicārakutarkādikārakaṃ kalahapriyam || 1-10 ||

vṛthākṣepakaraṃ bhrāntaṃ bhrāmakaṃ vāgviḍambakam |
parokṣe dūṣaṇakaraṃ pratyakṣe priyavādinam || 1-11 ||

vāgrūkṣavādinaṃ vidyācauramātmapraśaṃsakam |
guṇāsahiṣṇuṃ sadbhītamārtikrodhasamanvitam || 1-12 ||

cārvākaṃ durjanasakhaṃ sarvalokavigarhitam | 
piśunaṃ parasantāpaṃ sarvaprāṇibhayaṅkaram || 1-13 ||

svakleśavādinaṃ mitradrohiṇaṃ bhrātṛvañcakam |
jihvopasthaparaṃ devi taskaraṃ paśuceṣṭitam || 1-14 ||

akāraṇadveṣahāsakleśakrodhādikāriṇam |
atihāsyasukarmāṇaṃ marmāntaḥparihāsakam || 1-15 ||

kāmukaṃ cāpi nirlajjaṃ mithyāduśceṣṭasūcakam |
asūyāmadamātsaryadambhāhaṅkārasaṃyutam || 1-16 ||

īrṣyāpaiśunyapāruṣyakārpaṇyakrodhamāninam |
adhīraṃ duḥkhitaṃ dveṣyamaśaktaṃ tattvavarjitam || 1-17 ||

aprasannamatiṃ mūḍhaṃ cintākulitamānasam |
tṛṣṇālobhayutaṃ dīnamatuṣṭaṃ sarvayācakam || 1-18 ||

bahvāśinaṃ kapaṭinaṃ bhrāmakaṃ kuṭilaṃ priye |
bhaktiśraddhādayāśāntidharmācāravivarjitam || 1-19 ||

mātāpitṛguruprājñamahatāṃ hāsyakārakam |
kuladravyādibībhatsuṃ gurusevābhimāninam || 1-20 ||

strīdviṣṭaṃ samayabhraṣṭaṃ guruśaptaṃ kuleśvari |
ityādiviguṇopetaṃ guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parityajet || 1-21 ||

snehādvā lobhato vāpi yadi gṛhṇāti dīkṣayet |
tasmin gurau saśiṣye tu devatāśāpa āpatet || 1-22 ||

tasmādevaṃvidhaṃ śiṣyaṃ na gṛhṇīyātkathañcana |
yadi gṛhṇāti mohena tatpāpairvyāpyate guruḥ || 1-23 ||

mantripāpaṃ ca rājānaṃ patiṃ jāyākṛtaṃ yathā |
tathā śiṣyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prāyo gurumapi spṛśet || 1-24 ||

varṇāśramāṇāṃ sarveṣāmācāraḥ sadgatipradaḥ |
gurustrivāramācāraṃ bodhayetkulanāyike || 1-25 ||

na gṛhṇāti hi śiṣyaścettadā pāpaṃ gurornahi ||

iti guruśiṣyalakṣaṇāni || atha śrīgurupādukāmāhātmyaṃ kulārṇave-

vāgurā mūlavalaye sūtrādyāḥ kavalīkṛtāḥ | 
evaṃ kulāgamajñānaṃ pādukāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 1-1 ||

p. 15)

koṭikoṭimahādānātkoṭikoṭimahāvratāt |
koṭikoṭi mahāyajñātparā śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ || 1-2 ||

koṭimantrajapātkoṭipunyatīrthāvagāhanāt |
koṭidevārcanāddevi parā śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ || 1-3 ||

mahāroge mahotpāte mahāduḥkhe mahābhaye | 
mahāpadi mahāpāpe smṛtā rakṣati pādukā || 1-4 ||

tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ jñātaṃ dattamiṣṭaṃ ca pūjitam |
jihvāgre vartate yasya sadā śrīpādukā priye || 1-5 ||

sakṛcchrīpādukāṃ devi yo vā japati bhaktitaḥ |
sa sarvapāparahitaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 1-6 ||

śucirvāpyaśucirvā yo bhaktyā smarati pādukām |
anāyāsena dharmārthakāmamokṣāṁllabheta saḥ || 1-7 ||

śrīnāthacaraṇāmbhojaṃ yasyāṃ diśi virājate | 
tasyāṃ diśi namaskuryādbhaktyā pratidinaṃ priye || 1-8 ||

na pādukāparo mantro na devaḥ śrīguroḥ paraḥ |
nahi śāktātparo mārgo na puṇyaṃ kulapūjanāt || 1-9 ||

dhyānamūlaṃ gurormūrtiḥ pūjāmūlaṃ guroḥ padam |
śāstramūlaṃ gurorvākyaṃ mokṣamūlaṃ guroḥ kṛpā || 1-10 ||

gurumūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ loke'smin kulanāyike |
tasmāt sevyo gururnityaṃ siddhyarthaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaiḥ || 1-11 ||

tāvadārtirbhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ mohaśokabhramādayaḥ | 
yāvannāyāti śaraṇaṃ śrīguruṃ bhaktavatsalam || 1-12 ||

tāvad bhramati saṃsāre sarvaduḥkhamalīmasaḥ |
yāvanna bhajate bhaktyā śrīguruṃ śivarūpiṇam || 1-13 ||

sarvasiddhiphalopeto mantraskandho'tiśobhanaḥ |
guruprasādamūlo'yaṃ paratattvamahādrumaḥ || 1-14 ||

yathā dadāti santuṣṭaḥ prasanno varado manum |
tathā bhaktyā dhanaiḥ prāṇairguruṃ yatnena toṣayet || 1-15 ||

yadā dadyācchivāya svamātmānaṃ deśikottamaḥ |
tadā mukto bhavecchiṣyo na tato'sti punarbhavaḥ || 1-16 ||

tāvadārādhayecchiṣyaḥ suprasanno yathā bhavet |
gurau prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavet || 1-17 ||

manasāpi na kāṅkṣante bhaktā mānānujīvikāḥ |
samvādayanti tatsarvaṃ svāmino bhaktavatsalāḥ || 1-18 ||

brahmaviṣṇumaheśānadevatāmuniyoginaḥ |
kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ || 1-19 ||

bhaktyā santuṣṭaguruṇā yo'padiṣṭaḥ kṛpālunā |
karmamukto bhavecchiṣyo bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanam || 1-20 ||

śiṣyeṇāpi tadā grāhyaṃ yadā santoṣito guruḥ |
tasmādguropriyaṃ kuryānmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 1-21 ||

yadi vā parituṣṭena guruṇā yatra kutracit | 
mukto'sīti samādiṣṭaḥ so'pi mukto bhavetpriye || 1-22 ||

athavā niṣprapañcena dhāmnā kenacidīśvari |
karomi gururūpeṇa paśupāśavimocanam || 1-23 ||

na me priyaścaturvedī madbhaktaḥ śvapaco'pi yaḥ |
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa tu pūjyo hyahaṃ yathā || 1-24 ||

vipro'pi guṇayukto vāpyabhakto na praśasyate |
mlekṣo'pi guṇahīno vā bhaktimān sa viśiṣyate || 1-25 ||

gurubhaktivihīnasya tapo vidyā vrataṃ kulam |
niṣphalaṃ hi kuleśāni kevalaṃ lokarañjanam || 1-26 ||

gurubhaktyākhyadahanadagdhadurjātikalmaṣaḥ |
śvapaco'pyamaraiḥ pūjyo na vidvānapi nāstikaḥ || 1-27 ||

dharmārthakāmaiḥ kiṃ tasya mokṣastasya kare sthitaḥ |
sarvārthaiḥ śrīgurau devi yasya bhaktiḥ sthirā sadā || 1-28 ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapāda-
śrīgovindācāryaśiṣyaśrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya-
śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya-śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite 
vidyārṇavākhye tantre prathamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 1 ||




p. 16)

atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre 

|| dvitīyaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

tathā-

sa śivo gururūpeṇa bhuktimuktiprado mama |
iti bhaktyā smared yastu tasya siddhiradūrataḥ || 2-1 ||

yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā tathā gurau | 
tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante kuleśvari || 2-2 ||

nārāyaṇe mahādeve mātāpitrośca rājani |
yathā bhaktirbhavet devi tathā kāryā nije gurau || 2-3 ||

lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vāṇīdhātārau girijāśivau | 
śrīguruṃ gurupatnīṃ ca pitarāviti cintayet || 2-4 ||

gurubhaktyā yathā devi prāpyante sarvasiddhayaḥ |
yajñadānatapastīrthavratādyairna tathā priye || 2-5 ||

śrīgurau niścalā bhaktirvarddhate hi yathā yathā |
tathā tathāsya vijñānaṃ varddhate kulanāyike || 2-6 ||

kiṃ tīrthādyairmahāyāsaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kāyaśoṣaṇaiḥ |
nirvyājasevā deveśi bhaktiryeṣāṃ hi sadgurau || 2-7 ||

kāyakleśena mahatā tapasā vāpi yatphalam |
tatphalaṃ labhate devi sukhena gurusevayā || 2-8 ||

bhogamokṣārthināṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśapadakāṅkṣiṇām |
bhaktireva gurau devi nānyaḥ panthā iti śrutiḥ || 2-9 ||

aśubhāni ca sarvāṇi samahāpātakāni ca |
bhaktiḥ kṣaṇena dahati tūlarāśimivānalaḥ || 2-10 ||

viśvāsāya namastasmai sarvasiddhipradāyine |
yena mṛddārudṛṣadaḥ phalantyavikalaṃ phalam || 2-11 ||

na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko'pi nigadyate |
amāye kulamārge'smin bhaktirekā viśiṣyate || 2-12 ||

sākṣādgurumaye devi sarvasmin bhuvanāntare |
kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetraṃ mantraḥ kvaiṣāṃ na siddhyati || 2-13 ||

gurau manuṣyabuddhiṃ ca mantre cākṣarabuddhikām |
pratimāsu śilābuddhiṃ kurvāṇo narakaṃ vrajet || 2-14 ||

guruṃ na martyaṃ buddhyeta yadi buddhyeta tasya tu |
kadāpi na bhavet siddhirmantrairvā devatārcanaiḥ || 2-15 ||

śrīguruṃ prākṛtaiḥ sārdhaṃ ye smaranti vadanti vā |
teṣāṃ ca sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pātakaṃ bhavati priye || 2-16 ||

janmahetū hi pitarau pūjanīyau prayatnataḥ |
gururviśeṣataḥ pūjyo dharmādharmapradarśakaḥ || 2-17 ||

guruḥ pitā gururmātā gururdaivaṃ gururgatiḥ |
śive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana || 2-18 ||

gurau hitaṃ hi kartavyaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ |
ahitācaraṇād devi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ || 2-19 ||

śarīravittaprāṇaiśca śrīguruṃ vañcayanti ye |
krimikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ prāpnuvanti narādhamāḥ || 2-20 ||

gurutyāgādbhavenmṛtyurmantratyāgād daridratā |
gurumantraparityāgād rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 2-21 ||

gurvarthaṃ dhārayed dehaṃ tadarthaṃ dhanamarjayet |
nijaprāṇān parityajya gurukāryaṃ samācaret || 2-22 ||

gurūktaṃ paruṣaṃ vākyamāśiṣaṃ cintayet priye |
tena saṃtāḍito vāpi prasādamiti saṃsmaret || 2-23 ||

bhogayogyāni vastūni gurave sarvamarpayet |
taccheṣamiti saṃcintya cānubhūyāt kuleśvari || 2-24 ||

gurvagre na tapaḥ kuryāt nopavāsādikam vratam |
tīrthayātrāṃ ca no kuryānna snāyādātmaśuddhaye || 2-25 ||

na niyogaṃ gurordadyād yuṣmadā naiva bhāṣayet |
ṛṇādānaṃ tathā dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayam || 2-26 ||

na kuryād gurubhiḥ sārdhaṃ śiṣyo bhūṣṇuḥ kadācana | 
na kuryānnāstikairvādaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇamapīśvari || 2-27 ||

p. 17)

vilokya dūrato gacchennāsīta saha taiḥ kvacit |
gurau saṃnihite yastu pūjayedanyamambike || 2-28 ||

sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā niṣphalā bhavet |
śirasā na vahed bhāraṃ gurupādābjadhāriṇā || 2-29 ||

tadājñayā tatkartavyamājñārūpo guruḥ smṛtaḥ |
mantrāgamādyamanyatra śrutaṃ tasmai nivedayet || 2-30 ||

gurvājñayā tad gṛhṇīyāt tadaniṣṭaṃ vivarjayet |
svaśāstroktaṃ rahasyārtha na vadedyasya kasyacit || 2-31 ||

yadi brūyāt sa samayāccyuta eva na saṃśayaḥ |
advaitaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ nādvaitaṃ guruṇā saha || 2-32 ||

ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu hitaṃ kuryātkuleśvari |
ātmasthānāṅgasadbhāvaiḥ śuśrūṣā syāccaturvidhā || 2-33 ||

śuśrūṣayā tayā devi śiṣyaḥ santoṣayed gurum |
pade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 2-34 ||

śuśrūṣaṇaparo yastu gurudevamahātmanām |
kevalaṃ guruśuśrūṣā tatkṛpākāriṇī priya || 2-35 ||

sabhaktisahitā sā cet sarvakāmaphalapradā |
kṣīyante sarvapāpāni varddhante puṇyarāśayaḥ || 2-36 ||

siddhyanti sarvakāryāṇi guruśuśrūṣayā priye |
yadyadātmahitaṃ vastu tattaddhitaṃ na vañcayet || 2-37 ||

gurudevārcako yastu tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate |
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa gurumuddiśya yatkṛtam || 2-38 ||

svalpaṃ vā bahu vā puṇyaṃ tulyamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ |
sarvasvamapi yo dadyād guruve bhaktivarjitaḥ || 2-39 ||

śiṣyo na phalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇam |
yasmin dravye gurorasti spṛhā nānubhavecca tat || 2-40 ||

avaśyaṃ yadi vāñchā syādanubhūyāttadājñayā |
yastilārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā gurusvamupajīvati || 2-41 ||

lobhānmohāt sa pacyeta narake ca trisaptake |
alpādalpaṃ gurudravyamadattaṃ svīkaroti yaḥ || 2-42 ||

tiraścāṃ yonimāpannaḥ kravyādairbhakṣyate priye |
gurudravyābhilāṣī ca gurustrīgamanotsukaḥ || 2-43 ||

patitasya kṣullakasya prāyaścitaṃ na vidyate |
ājñābhaṅgo'rthagrahaṇaṃ gurorapriyavartanam || 2-44 ||

gurudrohamidaṃ prāhuryaḥ karoti sa pātakī |
svadravyaviniyogaṃ ca nānivedya guroścaret || 2-45 ||

anivedya tu yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved brahmaghātakaḥ |
gurusthānaṃ saṃpradāyaṃ taddharma yo vināśayet || 2-46 ||

gurubhiḥ sa bahiṣkāryo daṇḍyo vadhyaśca pātakī |
gurukopānna nāśo'nyo gurudrohānna pātakam || 2-47 ||

na mṛtirgurunindāyā gurvaniṣṭānnacāpadaḥ |
jīvedagnipraviṣṭo vā naraḥ pītaviṣo'pi vā || 2-48 ||

mṛtyuhastagato vāpi nāparādhakaro guroḥ |
yatra śrīgurunindā syātpidhāya śravaṇe svake || 2-49 ||

sadyastasmādapakrāmed dūraṃ na śṛṇuyādyathā |
gurornāma japetpaścācśravaṇe sā pratikriyā || 2-50 ||

gurumitrasuhṛd dāsīdāsādyān nāpamānayet |
na ninded dṛśyasamayān vedaśāstrāgamādikān || 2-51 ||

śrīguroḥ pādukā bhūṣāgurunāmasmṛtirjapaḥ |
gurvājñākaraṇaṃ kṛtyaṃ śuśrūṣā bhajanaṃ guroḥ || 2-52 ||

vivikṣurdeśikāvāsaṃ śāntacitto'tibhaktimān |
vyajanaṃ pādukāṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vāhanādikam || 2-53 ||

tāmbūlamulvaṇaṃ veśamutsṛjya praviśecchanaiḥ |
vāhanaṃ pādukāṃ chatramāsanaṃ vāsanādikam || 2-54 ||

dṛṣṭvā gurornamaskuryānnātmabhogāya kārayet |
pādaprakṣālanaṃ snānamabhyaṅgaṃ dantadhāvanam || 2-55 ||

mūtraṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣauraṃ śayanaṃ strīniṣevaṇam |
vīrāsanaṃ ca durvākyamāsanaṃ hāsyarodane || 2-56 ||

keśamocanamuṣṇīṣaṃ kaṃcukaṃ nagnatāṃ tathā |
pādaprasāraṇaṃ vādaṃ kalahaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ priye || 2-57 ||

aṅgabhaṅgāṅgavādyādi karāsphalānadhūnanam |
dyūtakukkuṭamallādiyuddhamityādi cāmbike || 2-58 ||

guruyogimahāsiddhapīṭhakṣetrāśrameṣu ca |
nācaredācaran mohāddevatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 2-59 ||

upacāraṃ vinā tiṣṭhed gurvagre necchayā viśet |
mukhāvalokī seveta taduktaṃ ca samācaret || 2-60 ||

gurūktānuktakāryeṣu nopekṣāṃ kārayetpriye |
sadasadyad gururbrūyāt tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā || 2-61 ||

nigrahe'nugrahe vāpi guruḥ sarvasya kāraṇam |
nirgataṃ yad gurorvaktrāt sarvaṃ śāstraṃ taducyate || 2-62 ||

p. 18)

gurukāya svayaṃ śakto nāparaṃ preṣayetpriye |
bahutve tatparairbhṛtyaiḥ sahito'pyatibhaktimān || 2-63 ||

gacchaṃstiṣṭhan svapañjāgrajjalpaṃjuhvat prapūjane |
gurvājñāmeva kurvīta tadgatenāntarātmanā || 2-64 ||

abhimāno na kartavyo jātividyādhanādibhiḥ |
sarvadā sevayennityaṃ śiṣyaḥ śrīgurusannidhau || 2-65 ||

chāyābhūmiparītyāgī vinītastvatibhaktimān |
devi gurvagratastiṣṭhed gurukāryasamutsukaḥ || 2-66 ||

svakāryamanyakāryaṃ vā śiṣyaḥ śrīgurucittavit |
gurupārśvagato namraḥ pracchannāsyo mitaṃ vadet || 2-67 ||

sāmānyato niṣedhañcet sadguroryadi sannidhau |
ācāre yadi mūḍhātmā doṣaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 2-68 ||

anāhṛtya gurorvākyaṃ śṛṇuyādyaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ |
ahitaṃ vā hitaṃ vāpi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 2-69 ||

gobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā yatpāpaṃ samavāpnuyāt |
tatpāpaṃ samavāpnoti gurvagre'nṛtabhāṣaṇāt || 2-70 ||

sthānāntaragataṃ cārthavyasane viṣame sthitam |
śrīguruṃ na tyajet kvāpi tadādiṣṭo vrajetpriye || 2-71 ||

adhaḥsthite gurāvūrdhve na tiṣṭheta kadācana |
na gacchedagratastasya na viśedutthite gurau || 2-72 ||

śakticchāyāṃ gurucchāyāṃ devacchāyāṃ na laṅghayet |
svacchāyāṃ teṣu no kuryānna svapedgurusannidhau || 2-73 ||

bhāṣaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ gānaṃ bhojanaṃ śayanādikam |
anādiṣṭo na kurvīta nacāvandanapūrvakam || 2-74 ||

brahmahatyāśataṃ kuryād gurvājñāṃ paripālayan |
vinā gurvājñayā śiṣyo niḥśvasennātiśāsanāt || 2-75 ||

sarvaṃ gurvājñayā kuryānnāliṅgettat striyaṃ priye |
bhaktyā praṇamya cottiṣṭhedbaddhāñjaliputaḥ priye || 2-76 ||

paścātpādena nirgacchennamaskṛtya gurorgahāt |
ekāsane nopaviśedguruṇā tatsamaiḥ saha || 2-77 ||

na viśedāsane devi devatāgurusannidhau |
gurau siṃhāsanaṃ deyaṃ jyeṣṭhānāmuttamāsanam || 2-78 ||

deśyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanam |
jātividyādhanāḍhyo vā dūre dṛṣṭvā guruṃ sadā || 2-79 ||

daṇḍapraṇāmaṃ kurvīta triḥpradakṣiṇamācaret |
tatastriḥ ṣaṭ dvādaśa vā jyeṣṭhādiṣvekameva ca || 2-80 ||

gurutadguruyoge tu vandeta paramaṃ gurum |
tato named guruṃ yo'pi gurvagre taṃ nivārayet || 2-81 ||

praguroḥ sannidhau śiṣyaḥ svaguruṃ manasā namet |
gurubuddhyā nametsarvaṃ daivataṃ tṛṇameva ca || 2-82 ||

na nameddevabuddhyā tu pratimāṃ lohamṛṇmayīm |
guroḥ praṇāmatritayaṃ jyeṣṭhānāmekameva ca || 2-83 ||

pūjyānāmañjalistadvadanyeṣāṃ vākyavandanam |
devāngurūn kulācāryāñjñānavṛddhāṃstapodhanān || 2-84 ||

vidyādhikān svakarmasthān praṇametkulanāyike |
strīdviṣṭaṃ gurubhiḥ śaptaṃ pākhaṇḍaṃ patitaṃ śaṭham || 2-85 ||

vikarmāṇaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ vā nāśramiṇaṃ ca nonamet |
anivedya guruṃ bhuṃkte yastvekagṛhasaṃsthitaḥ || 2-86 ||

amedhyaṃ tena bhuktaṃ syātsūkaro jāyate mṛtaḥ |
ekagrāmasthitaḥ śiṣyastrisandhyaṃ praṇamed gurum || 2-87 ||

krośamātrasthito bhaktyā guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet |
ardhaṃyojanataḥ śiṣyaḥ praṇametpañcaparvasu || 2-88 ||

ekayojanamārabhya yojanadvādaśāvadhi |
tattadyojanasaṃkhyātamāsairgatvā namedgurum || 2-89 ||

dūradeśasthitaḥ śiṣyo bhaktyā tatsannidhiṃ gataḥ |
atidūrasthitaḥ śiṣyo yadecchāsyāttadā vrajet || 2-90 ||

riktahastastu nopeyādrājānaṃ daivataṃ gurum |
phalapuṣpāmbarādīni yathāśaktyā samarpayet || 2-91 ||

evaṃ yo nācareddevi brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajet |
guruśaktiśca tatputro jyeṣṭhabhrātā guroḥ samaḥ || 2-92 ||

ātmavacca kanīyāṃsaḥ putravatkulapālakāḥ |
lokācāryasya deveśi gurujyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhayoḥ || 2-93 ||

gurukulyasya kurvīta praṇāmaṃ svaguroryathā |
svajyeṣṭhaśca kramajyeṣṭhaḥ kulajyeṣṭhastṛtīyakaḥ || 2-94 ||

gurorjyeṣṭhastu deveśi iti jyeṣṭhacatuṣṭayam |
yāvajjyeṣṭhābhivāde tu kramajyeṣṭhāṅga īritaḥ || 2-95 ||

gurośca kulavṛddhasya vandanādi vidhānataḥ |
pitṛmātrādisarveṣu pūjyakoṭiṣu bandhuṣu || 2-96 ||

abhyutthānapraṇāmādyairavyaktadoṣalāghavaḥ |
yadā tvācāryarūpeṇa svātmānaṃ samprakāśayet || 2-97 ||

abhyutthānapraṇāmādyairdoṣadaḥ syāttadā priye |
patirbhūtvā paśubhyastu praṇāmaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati || 2-98 ||

p. 19)

sa mahāpaśurityukto devatāśāpamāpnuyāt |
yo gurusthānakaṃ prāptaḥ pādukāparisaṃkhyayā || 2-99 ||

guruvatsa tu mantavyo jyeṣṭhairvandyo naca priye |

iti pādukāmāhātmyatadācāravidhiḥ |
atha samayācāraḥ | tatra śrīkulārṇave-

śrīguruṃ kulaśāstrāṇi pūjyasthānāni yāni tu |
bhaktyā śrīpūrvakaṃ devi praṇamya parikīrtayet || 2-1 ||

brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yasya me gurusantatiḥ |
tasya me sarvaśiṣyasya ko na pūjyo mahītale || 2-2 ||

guruṃ namnā na bhāṣeta japakālādṛte priye |
śrīnāthadevasvāmīti vivāde bodhane vadet || 2-3 ||

śrīguroḥ pādukāṃ mudrāṃ mūlamantraṃ svapādukām |
śiṣyādanyatra deveśi na vadedyasya kasyacit || 2-4 ||

paraṃparyyāgamāmnāyamantrācārādikaṃ priye |
sarvaṃ gurumukhāllabdhaṃ saphalaṃ syānnacānyathā || 2-5 ||

śrīśāstrāśrayasambhūtaṃ pustakaṃ devavatpriye |
nityaṃ samarcayedbhaktyā paśuhaste nikṣipet || 2-6 ||

svadāravanniveṣeta kulaśāstrāṇi pārvati |
paśuśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi varjayetparadāravat || 2-7 ||

śvacarmasyaṃ yathā kṣīramapeyaṃ syād dvijottamaiḥ |
tathā paśumukhāddharmo na śrotavyaśca kaulikaiḥ || 2-8 ||

yaḥ śṛṇoti kulācāraṃ yathāśāstraṃ ca yo vadet |
tāvubhau gacchataḥ sākṣādyoginīvīramelanam || 2-9 ||

aśraddadhānā ye cātra kuladharmān kuleśvari | 
narakānna nivartante yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 2-10 ||

ūḍhā dhṛtā yathāprītā mū (le ? lye) na ca samāhṛtā |
sakṛtkāmagatā cāpi pañcadhā guruyoṣitaḥ || 2-11 ||

alaṃghyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ syurguruvad guruyoṣitaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṃśukāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ kumārīṃ ca kṛśodarīm || 2-12 ||

manoharāṃ yauvanasthāmarcayeddevatādhiyā |
āmamāṃsaṃ surākumbhaṃ mattebhaṃ siddhaliṅginam || 2-13 ||

sahakāramaśokaṃ ca krīḍālolāṃ kumārikām |
ekavṛkṣaṃ śmaśānaṃ ca samūhaṃ yoṣitāmapi || 2-14 ||

nārīṃ ca raktavasanāṃ dṛṣṭvā vandeta bhaktitaḥ |
guruśaktisutajyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhakuladeśikān || 2-15 ||

kuladarśanaśāstrāṇi kuladravyāṇi kaulikān |
prerakān sūcakāṃścāpi vācakāndarśakāṃstathā || 2-16 ||

śikṣakān bodhikānyogiyoginīsiddhapūruṣān |
kanyākumārakānnagnānunmattāmapi yoṣitam || 2-17 ||

na nindeta jugupseta na hasennāpamānayet |
nāpriyaṃ nānṛtaṃ brūyātkasyāpi kulayoginaḥ || 2-18 ||

kurūpetyatikṛṣṇeti na vadetkulayoṣitam |
parīkṣayenna bhaktānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ ca kṛtākṛtam || 2-19 ||

na paśyedvanitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīm |
na divā sevayennārīṃ tadyoniṃ na nirīkṣayet || 2-20 ||

yā kācidaṅganā loke sā mātṛkulasambhavā |
kupyanti kulayoginyo vanitānāmatikramāt || 2-21 ||

śatāparādhāṃ vanitāṃ puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayet |
doṣānna gaṇayet strīṇāṃ guṇāneva prakāśayet || 2-22 ||

tiṣṭhanti kulayoginyaḥ kulavṛkṣeṣu sarvadā |
tatpatreṣu na bhoktavyamarkapatre viśeṣataḥ || 2-23 ||

na svapetkulavṛkṣādho nacopadravamācaret |
dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā namaskuryācchedayenna kadācana || 2-24 ||

śleṣmāntakakarañjākṣanimbāśvatthakadambakāḥ |
bilvo vaṭodumbarau ca kulavṛkṣā nava smṛtāḥ || 2-25 ||

devatāguruśāstrādisiddhācāraviḍambakaḥ |
vidyācauro gurudrohī brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajet || 2-26 ||

guruṃ mohādanāvṛtya nirmartsya vīrapūruṣān |
vikalpya kulaśāstrāṇi bhavanti brahmarākṣasāḥ || 2-27 ||

ekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruṃ naiva manyate |
śunāṃ yoniśataṃ gatvā caṇḍālatvamavāpnuyāt || 2-28 ||

guruṃ prakāśayeddhīmān mantraṃ naiva prakāśayet |
aprakāśaprakāśābhyāṃ kṣīyate sampadāyuṣī || 2-29 ||

kuladharmān samāśritya ācāraṃ yo na pālayet |
yatheṣṭācāriṇastasya mahāpātakinaḥ priye || 2-30 ||

āpado duritaṃ rogā dāridryaṃ kalaho bhagam |
yoginīnāṃ prakopaśca skhalitaṃ ca pade pade || 2-31 ||

bhraṣṭamānaḥ pranaṣṭaśca tejohīno'tiduḥkhitaḥ | 
ninditaḥ sarvavidviṣṭo vihvalaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ || 2-32 ||

deśāddeśāntaraṃ yāti kāryahāniśca sarvadā |
tatrāpi kulamārgasthāḥ śākinyaḥ kulapālikāḥ || 2-33 ||

p. 20)

bhakṣayanti purā tāsāṃ varo datto mayaiva tu |
tasmādācāravān devi yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet || 2-34 ||

sadācāreṇa devatvaṃ yoginīvīramelanam |
saṃprāpnuvanti tiryaktvaṃ kaulikāstadviparyayāt || 2-35 ||

saṃskāreṇa vihīnatvād guruvākyasya laṅghanāt |
ācāralaṅghanād devi kaulikaḥ patito bhavet || 2-36 ||

nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ mantratantrādilopajam |
anarhapaśuduḥsaṅgamantrasāṃkaryasaṃbhavam || 2-37 ||

guptaprakaṭasaṃbhūtaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ priye |
evamādiṣu doṣeṣu pāpasya gurulāghavam || 2-38 ||

deśaṃ kālaṃ vayo vittaṃ samyagjñātvā yathāvidhi |
prāyaścittaṃ gururdadyātsarvapāpaviśuddhaye || 2-39 ||

śiṣyo'pi ca tathā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret |
athavā sarvapāpānāṃ gurunāmajapasmṛtiḥ || 2-40 ||

jāmbūnadasya kāluṣyaṃ pariśuddhaṃ yathāgninā |
anācārasya mālinyaṃ prāyaścittāgninā dahet || 2-41 ||

bahunātra kimuktena rahasyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati | 
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sarveṣāmācāraḥ sadgatipradaḥ || 2-42 ||

gurustrivāramācāraṃ kathayetkulanāyike |
tanna gṛhṇāti śiṣyaścettadā pāpaṃ gurornahi || 2-43 ||

mantridoṣaśca rājānaṃ bhāryādoṣaḥ patiṃ yathā |
tathā prāpnotyasaṃdehaṃ śiṣyapāpaṃ guruḥ priye || 2-44 ||

iti prayogasāre-

devasthāne gurusthāne śmaśāne vā catuṣpathe |
pādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunādi vivarjayet || 2-1 ||

devaṃ guruṃ gurusthānaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrādhidevatāḥ |
siddhaṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrva samudīrayet || 2-2 ||

pramattāgantyajāṃ kanyāṃ puṣpitāṃ patitastanīm |
virūpāṃ muktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtā ca na nindayet || 2-3 ||

kanyāyoniṃ paśukrīḍāṃ digvastrāṃ prakaṭastanīm |
nālokayetparadravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayet || 2-4 ||

dhānyagoguruviprāgnividyākośagṛhān prati |
naiva prasārayetpādau naitānapi ca laṅghayet || 2-5 ||

ālasyamadasaṃmohaśāṭhyapaiśunyavigrahān |
asūyāmātmasammānaṃ paranindāṃ ca varjayet || 2-6 ||

liṅginaṃ vratinaṃ vipraṃ vedavedāṅgasaṃhitāḥ |
purāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayet || 2-7 ||

yugaṃ musalamaśmānaṃ dāma cullīmulūkhalam |
śūrppaṃ saṃmārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vaiḍūryamāyudham || 2-8 ||

kalaśaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ darpaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
bhogayogyāni cānyāni yoga dravyāṇi yāni ca || 2-9 ||

mahāsthāneṣu vastūni yāni vā devatālaye |
divyoktāni padārthāni bhūtāviṣṭāni yāni vai || 2-10 ||

laṅghayeñjātu naitāni naitāni ca padā spṛśet |
yā goṣṭhī lokavidviṣṭā yā ca svairaṃ visarpiṇī || 2-11 ||

parahiṃsātmikā yā ca na tāmavataret kvacit |
pratigrahaṃ na gṛhṇīyādātmabhogavidhitsayā || 2-12 ||

devatāgurupūjārthaṃ yatnato'pyarjayeddhanam |
dhārayedārjarvaṃ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ dhṛtim || 2-13 ||

kṣāntiṃ dayāmanāsthāṃ ca divyāṃ śaktiṃ ca sarvadā |
vibhītakārkakārañjasnuhicchāyāṃ na saṃśrayet || 2-14 ||

stambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |
nakhāgrakeśanirddhūtasnānavastraghaṭodakam || 2-15 ||

etatsparśaṃ tyajed dūraṃ kharaśvājarajastathā |
na nindetkāraṇaṃ devaṃ na śāstraṃ devanirmitam || 2-16 ||

na guruṃ sādhakaṃ caiva liṅgacchāyāṃ na laṅghayet |
nādyānna laṅghennirmālyaṃ tadadyācchivadīkṣitaḥ || 2-17 ||

na laṅghayed gurorājñāmuttaraṃ na vadettathā |
rātrau divā ca tasyājñāṃ dāsavatparipālayet || 2-18 ||

asatyamaśubhaṃ tadvad bahuvādaṃ parityajet | 
apriyaṃ ca tathālasyaṃ kāmakrodhau viśeṣataḥ || 2-19 ||

apracchannamukho brūyād guroragre kadācana |
abhimānaṃ na kurvīta dhanadhānyāśramādibhiḥ || 2-20 ||

gurudravyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ tenādattaṃ kadācana | 
dattaṃ prasādavad grāhyaṃ lobhato na kadācana || 2-21 ||

advaitaṃ devapūjāṃ ca guroragre parityajet |
pādukāyogapaṭṭādigurucihnāni sādaram || 2-22 ||

na laṅghayetspṛśennaiva pādābhyāṃ praṇametsadā |
paryaṅkaśayanaṃ tadvattathā pādaprasāraṇam || 2-23 ||

aṅgabhaṅgaṃ ca līlāṃ ca na kuryād gurusannidhau | 
gamanāgamane kuryātpraṇamya gurupādukām || 2-24 ||

p. 21)

chāyāṃ na laṅghayettadvanna gacchetpurato guroḥ |
paścātpādena nirgacchetpraṇamya ca gurorgṛhāt || 2-25 ||

guroragre na kurvīta prabhāvaṃ śiṣyasaṃgraham |
ahaṃkāraṃ na kurvīta nolvaṇaṃ dhārayedvapuḥ || 2-26 ||

praguroḥ sannidhau naiva svaguruṃ praṇamed budhaḥ |
namaskārāya codyuktaṃ gururdṛṣṭvā nivārayet || 2-27 ||

nābhiyogaṃ gurordadyādyuṣmadā naiva bhāṣayet |
upayuktaṃ pareṇaiva yadi vā dīkṣitena tu || 2-28 ||

chatropānahavastrādyaṃ nopayuñjīta karhicit |
asaṃpattāvathāpatsu na doṣaḥ kṣālite sati || 2-29 ||

svakule dīkṣitānāṃ ca ācāryāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
upayuktau na doṣaḥ syāttaddattādāhṛtādapi (?) || 2-30 ||

mantropabhuktamannādyaṃ tathā yanmantrasaṃskṛtam |
prāptamāyatanād devyāḥ śirasā praṇato vahet || 2-31 ||

nikṣipedambhasi tato na patedavanau yathā |
jātāyāmāpadi bhraṃśe śapathaṃ (ku ? gu)rusaṃjñakam || 2-32 ||

na kuryād bhagavatsaṃjñaṃ pramādena kriyeta cet |
tadarthaṃ nirvahedyatnādante pūjājapāhutīḥ || 2-33 ||

anirvāhe tu kāryasya yadarthaṃ śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ |
prāyaścittajapo devi sahasraṃ svamanostataḥ || 2-34 ||

lokodvegakarī yā ca yā ca marmanikṛntanī |
sthityudvegakarī yā ca tāṃ giraṃ naiva bhāṣayet || 2-35 ||

ramyamapyujjvalamapi manaso'pi samīpsitam |
lokavidveṣaṇaṃ veṣaṃ na gṛhṇīyātkathañcana | 36 ||

atroktān yaḥ sadā hyetānaihikāmuṣmikocitān |
ācārānādṛtaḥ śāntiṃ dīkṣitaḥ so'dhigacchati || 2-37 ||

strīṇāṃ viśeṣato dadyātsamayāṃścāmalāśayaḥ |
pālanātsamayānāṃ tu siddhirutpadyate'cirāt || 2-38 ||

mantraḥ sāṃmukhyamāyāti samayasthasya sarvadā |
siddhayaḥ samayasthasya sarvāḥ syurmokṣapaścimāḥ || 2-39 ||

ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe sūryacandrayoḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca teṣu naimittiko japaḥ || 2-40 ||

nityāttriguṇitaḥ so'tha pūjāṃ caiva samācaret |
nyāyārjitaiḥ sādhanaiśca dānahomārcanādikam || 2-41 ||

kuryānna cedadho yāti bhaktyā kurvannapīśvari |

iti samayācāraḥ || nāradapañcarātre-

brāhmaṇaḥ sarvakālajñaḥ kuryātsarveṣvanugraham |
tadamāvād dvijaśreṣṭha ! śāntātmā bhagavanmayaḥ || 2-1 ||

bhāvitātmā ca sarvajñaḥ śāstrajñaḥ satkriyāparaḥ |
siddhitrayasamāyukta ācāryatve'bhiṣecitaḥ || 2-2 ||

kṣatraviṭśūdrajātīnāṃ kṣatriyo'nugrahakṣamaḥ |
kṣatriyasyāpi ca gurorabhāvādīdṛśo yadi || 2-3 ||

vaiśyaḥ syā (ttaiḥ ? tte) na kāryaḥ syāddvaye nityamanugrahaḥ |
sajātīyena śūdreṇa tādṛśena mahāmate || 2-4 ||

anugrahābhiṣekau ca kāryau śūdrasya sarvadā |
varṇottame'tha ca gurau sati vā viśrute'pi vā || 2-5 ||

sadeśato'thavānyatra nedaṃ kāryaṃ śubhārthinā |
vidyamāne tu yaḥ kuryādyatra tatra viparyayam || 2-6 ||

tasyehāmutra nāśaḥ syāttasmācchāstroktamācaret |
kṣatraviṭśūdrajātīyaḥ prātilomyena dīkṣayet || 2-7 ||

bahvāśī dīrghasūtrī ca viṣayādiṣu lolupaḥ |
hetuvādarato duṣṭo vāgvādī guṇanindakaḥ || 2-8 ||

aromā bahuromā ca ninditāśramasevakaḥ | 
kāladanto'sitoṣṭhaśca durgandhiśvāsavāhakaḥ || 2-9 ||

duṣṭalakṣaṇasampanno yadyapi svayamīśvaraḥ |
bahupratigrahāsakta ācāryaḥ śrīvahāvahaḥ || 2-10 ||

iti | jñānonnayane-

nirvīryaṃ ca piturmantraṃ tathā mātāmahasya ca |
sodarasya kaniṣṭhasya vairipakṣāśritasya ca || 2-1 ||

bhikṣubhyaśca vanasthebhyo varṇibhyaśca maheśvari |
gṛhastho bhogamokṣārthī mantradīkṣāṃ nacācaret || 2-2 ||

tyaktāgnayaḥ kriyāhīnā yatayo hyaparigrahāḥ |
vanasthāstādṛśaścaiva varṇīnyūnā amī yataḥ || 2-3 ||

atasteṣāṃ nādhikāro dīkṣādāne maheśvari |

iti | bhairavītantre-

tapasvī satyavādī ca gṛhasthaḥ svasthamānasaḥ |
dīkṣāyāṃ na gurutvena yatīnvaikhānasān priye || 2-1 ||

p. 22)

vṛṇuyādbhogamokṣārthī gṛhastho varṇinaṃ tathā |

iti | guruśiṣyaparīkṣā tu kulārṇave-

jñānena kṛpayāvāpi guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parīkṣayet |
saṃvatsaraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi yatnataḥ || 2-1 ||

uttamānadhame kārye nīcānuttamakarmaṇi |
prāṇadravyapradānādyairādeśaiśca samāsamaiḥ || 2-2 ||

tanmarmasūcanairvākyairmāyābhiḥ krūraceṣṭitaiḥ |
pakṣapātairudāsīnairanekaiśca muhurmuhuḥ || 2-3 ||

ākṛṣṭastāḍitaścāpi yo viṣādaṃ na yāti ca |
guruḥ kṛpāṃ karotīti mudā sañcintayetsadā || 2-4 ||

śrīguroḥ smaraṇe vāpi kīrtane darśane'pi vā |
vandane paricaryyāyāmāhvāne preṣaṇe priye || 2-5 ||

ānandakamparomāñcasvaranetrādivikriyāḥ |
yeṣāṃ syuste'tra yogyāḥ syuḥ dīkṣāsaṃskārakarmasu || 2-6 ||

śiṣyo'pi lakṣaṇairetaiḥ kuryād guruparīkṣaṇam |
ānandādyairjapaiḥ stotrairdhyānahomārcanādibhiḥ || 2-7 ||

jñānopadeśasāmarthyaṃ mantrasiddhimapīśvari |
bodhakatvaṃ ca vijñāya śiṣyo bhūyānna cānyathā || 2-8 ||

iti | atha śiṣyāṇāmadhamamadhyamottamatvaṃ tatraiva-

ādimadhyāvasāneṣu yogyā bhaktinipātataḥ |
adhamāḥ madhyamāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śiṣyā api prakīrtitāḥ || 2-9 ||

ādau bhaktirbhaveddevi dīkṣāyāṃ samvadanti ye |
punarvidhvastabhaktāsta ādibhaktāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2-10 ||

dīkṣāsamayasamprāptā jñānavijñānavarjitāḥ |
bhaktyā pradhvastajāḍyā ye madhyayogyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2-11 ||

ādau bhaktivihīno yo madhye bhakto'sti vā navā | 
ante prabhūtabhaktaścapyantayogyā bhavanti te || 2-12 ||

iti | atha varṇavibhāgena yogyatākālaviśeṣastatra śāradāyām-

ekābdena bhevedyogyo brāhmaṇastaddvayānnṛpaḥ |
vaiśyo varṣaistribhiḥ śūdraścaturbhirvatsarairgurau || 2-1 ||

suśuśrūṣuḥ parigrāhyo dīkṣāyāgavratādiṣu | 

iti | atra śūdrāṇāṃ mantreṣvanadhikāraḥ śrūyate |
yathā mahākapilapañcarātre-

na vedapraṇavaṃ tyaktvā mantro vedasamudbhavaḥ |
tasmād vedaḥ paro mantro vedāṅgaścāgamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2-1 ||

vaśyākarṣādikaṃ karma dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam |
vedena sādhyate sarvaṃ grahayajñādibhiḥ kalau || 2-2 ||

na vedena vinā yajñā na vedā yajñavarjitāḥ |
tasmādvedaḥ paro mantro na mantro veda ujjhitaḥ || 2-3 ||

na mantre cādhikāro'sti śūdrāṇāṃ niyamaṃ param |
mantrābhāvādamantreṇa bhāṣitaṃ sarvakarma hi || 2-4 ||

iti | tathā śātātapasaṃhitāyām-

yāvantyarṇāni mantrāṇāṃ śūdrāya pratipādayet |
tāvatyo brahmahatyāḥ syuḥ svayamāha prajāpatiḥ || 2-1 ||

iti | kutracidaniṣedho'pi śrūyate bhaviṣye-

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye śucayo'malāḥ | 
teṣāṃ mantrāḥ pradeyā vai natu saṅkīrṇadharmiṇām || 2-1 ||

brahmakṣatraviśaḥ śūdrā arcāyāṃ śuddhabuddhayaḥ |
gurudevadvijārcāsu ratāḥ syuradhikāriṇaḥ || 2-2 ||

iti yoginītantravacanāt || 

vaidiko miśriko vāpi viprādīnāṃ vidhīyate |
tāntriko viprabhaktasya śūdrasyāpi prakīrtitaḥ || 2-1 ||

svāgamoktena vidhinā śūdraiścāpi prapūjanam |
kartavyaṃ śraddhyā viṣṇościntayitvā patiṃ hṛdi || 2-2 ||

strīṇāmapyadhikāro'sti viṣṇorārādhanādiṣu |
patipriyaratānāṃ ca śrutireṣā sanātanī || 2-3 ||

iti padmapurāṇāt | patipriyeti sadhavāparam |
cintayitveti mṛtabhartṛkāparamiti jñeyam | tathācoktaṃ tantrarāje-

dvijātīnāṃ tu saṃskāraṃ vedoktaṃ samudāhṛtam |
teṣāṃ ca tatra tatrāpi vidyayā vidhimācaret || 2-1 ||

p. 23)

savidyāsmaraṇaṃ kuryātkriyāṃ sarvatra coditām |
tena tanmayatāsiddhiḥ sarvatra bhavati dhruvam || 2-2 ||

anyeṣāmapi varṇānāṃ vidyayā samupācaret |

iti | bhaviṣyottare-

yā strī bhartā viyuktā ca śubhā svātantryasaṃyutā |
sā ca mantrāṇi gṛhṇātu samartrī tada (va ? nu)jñayā || 2-1 ||

vinā svadharmaṃ yatkiñciddevatārādhanādikam |
paribhraśyeta tadyasmātkṣaṇāt saikataharmyavat || 2-2 ||

iti kulārṇave-

vidhavāyāḥ sutādeśātkanyāyāḥ piturājñayā |
nādhikāraḥ svato nāryā bhāryāyā bharturājñayā || 2-1 ||

strīśūdrāṇāmayaṃ mantro namontaśca śubhāvahaḥ |
etajjñātvā mahāsena caṇḍālānapi dīkṣayet || 2-2 ||

iti rudrayāmalāt | ayaṃ prāsādamantraḥ | tathā ca-

śucivratatamāḥ śūdrā dhārmikā dvijasevakāḥ |
striyaḥ pativratāścānye pratilomānulomajāḥ || 2-1 ||

lokāścaṇḍālaparyantāḥ sarve'pyatrādhikāriṇaḥ |
svajātidharmaniratāḥ bhaktāḥ sarveśvarasya ca || 2-2 ||

upadeśamaśeṣāṇāṃ tattajjātyanusārataḥ |
na vaidikaṃ japecchūdraḥ striyaścaiva kadācana || 2-3 ||

namo'ntaṃ śivamantraṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ cocyate budhaiḥ | 

iti | yājñavalkyo'pi-

svāhāpraṇavasaṃyuktaṃ mantraṃ śūdre dadad dvijaḥ |
śūdro nirayagāmī syādvipraḥ śūdratvamāpnuyāt || 2-1 ||

iti yāmale-

ekadvitricatuṣpañcavarṣāṇyālocya yogyatām |
bhaktiyuktaguṇāṃścāpi kramādvarṇe sasaṅkare || 2-1 ||

iti | atha mantrāṇāṃ brahmakṣatrādibhedaḥ kulārṇave-

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro bhavati vai manuḥ |
anulomena deyaḥ syātpratilomena vai kvacit || 2-1 ||

iti vāmakeśvare-

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ paurastyajātayaḥ |
caturvidhāste manavaḥ kramādvarṇe sasaṅkare || 2-1 ||

iti | sautrāmaṇītantre-

māyābījaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ syācchrībījaṃ kṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kāmabījaṃ bhaved vaiśyo vāgbhavaṃ śūdra īritaḥ || 2-1 ||

caturbījaparityakto mantraḥ paurastyasaṃjñakaḥ |
caturbījaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tribījakam || 2-2 ||

bījadvayaṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ tvekabījakam |

iti | kulamūlāvatāre - śrīdevyuvāca 

śāktaśāmbhavasaurāṇāṃ gāṇeśe vaiṣṇaveṣu ca |
brahmakṣatriyavarṇānāṃ saṅkarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2-1 ||

pravṛttiṃ śrotumicchāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca |
yeṣu yeṣu ca ye mantrāstadbhodaṃ brūhi śaṅkara || 2-2 ||

īśvara uvāca 

umāmaheśvaraṃ caiva dakṣiṇāmūrtyaghorakam |
hayagrīvaṃ ca vārāhamaṣṭākṣaramataḥ param || 2-3 ||

praṇavādyaṃ vāsudevaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
varṇatraye tu dātavyaṃ nānyavarṇe kadācana || 2-4 ||

pāśupataṃ nārasiṃhaṃ tathā caiva sudarśanam |
varṇadvaye ca dātavyaṃ nānyayoścaiva karhicit || 2-5 ||

agnimantrāśca ye kecitsūryamantrāśca ye tathā |
tārādighṛṇimantrāśca dātavyāśca trivarṇake || 2-6 ||

ānuṣṭubhaṃ śaktimantrāstathā vindhyanivāsinī |
nīlasārasvataṃ cāpi dātavyāścādivarṇake || 2-7 ||

mātaṅgītyugratārā ca kālikā śyāmalā tathā |
chinnamastā ca bālā ca dātavyā sarvavarṇake || 2-8 ||

tārādistu gaṇeśaśca haridrāsaṃjñakastathā |
trivarṇeṣveva dātavyaḥ kathitaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 2-9 ||

p. 24)

tripurāyā (ñca ? śca) ye mantrā ye mantrā vaṭukādayaḥ |
sarvavarṇeṣu dātavyāḥ purandhrīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2-10 ||

māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ ca praṇavaṃ vāgbhavaṃ cānyabījakam |
etadvījena saṃyuktaṃ dātavyaṃ cādivarṇake || 2-11 ||

māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca dātavyaṃ kṣatriyeṣvapi |
lakṣmī ca vāgbhavaṃ caiva kathitaṃ vaiśyavarṇake || 2-12 ||

vāgbhavaṃ cānyabījaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ samudīritam |
hṛdādi huṃphaṭkārādi saṃkarāṇāṃ praśasyate || 2-13 ||

iti | kulaprakāśatantre-

utpanna manavaḥ sarve pañcāśadvarṇabhedataḥ |
dvividhāste ca saṃproktā mantravidyāvibhāgataḥ || 2-1 ||

strīmantrā vahnijāyāntā hṛdayāntā napuṃsakāḥ |
śeṣāḥ pumāṃsa ityuktāḥ strīmantrāścāpi śāntike || 2-2 ||

napuṃsakāḥ smṛtā mantrā vidveṣe cābhicārake |
pumāṃsaḥ syuḥ smṛtāḥ sarve vaśyoccāṭanakarmasu || 2-3 ||

agnīṣomasvarūpāḥ syurmanavaḥ sarva eva hi |
rephauṅkāraviyatprāyā āgneyāḥ krūrakarmaṇi || 2-4 ||

saumyāścandrasudhāprāyāḥ saumyakarmaṇi te smṛtāḥ |

iti | nārāyaṇīye'pi-

tārāntyāgniviyatprāyo mantra āgneya iṣyate |
