chandomayī jagatsthānā (jhāṃ) kṛtirjñānaprabhā tathā |
ṭaṅkaḍhakkadharā caiva tataśca (ṣṭhaṃ) kṛtiḍāmarī || 3-9 ||

kabhādīnāṃ ca varṇānāṃ proktā dvādaśa śaktayaḥ |
brahmā yajñapatirvedhāḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ || 3-10 ||

vidhātā ca viriñciśca sraṣṭā ca caturānanaḥ |
hiraṇyagarbho vijñeyā yādīnāṃ daśa mūrtayaḥ || 3-11 ||

yakṣiṇī rañjinī lakṣmīrvajriṇī śaśidhāriṇī |
ṣaḍādhārālayā sarvanāyikā hasitānanā || 3-12 ||

lalitā ca kṣamā caiva yādīnāṃ daśa śaktayaḥ |
trimūrtimātṛkā proktā sarvasiddhipradā matā || 3-13 ||

iti trimūrtimātṛkā || atha kāmakalāmātṛkā svarāṇāmeva :

śraddhā prītīratiścaiva dhṛtiḥ kāntirmanoramā |
manoharā tataścaiva proktāṃ sātra manorathā || 3-1 ||

madanonmādinī paścāt mohinī śaṃkhinī tathā |
śoṣiṇī ca vaśaṅkārī śiñjinī subhagā tataḥ || 3-2 ||

kāmasyaitāḥ kalāḥ proktāḥ svarāṇāṃ ṣoḍaśeṣṭadāḥ |

iti kāmakalāmātṛkā || atha somakalāmātṛkā :

pūpā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathā | 
ṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca paratastvaṃśumālinī || 3-1 ||

śaśinī cāṅgirācchāyā tataḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalā |
tuṣṭya mṛtākhyā kathitā kalāḥ syuḥ sasvarā vidhoḥ || 3-2 ||

iti somakalāmātṛkā || athāparājitāmātṛkā :

pratyaṅgirā siṃhamukhī tathā jvālāmukhī śivā | 
vaiṣṇavī nārasiṃhī ca trimātrā śāṅkarī parā || 3-1 ||

arddhamātrā bhagavatī śūlinī śumbhamardinī |
śaśāṅkadhāriṇī caiva bhīṣikā ca kapālinī || 3-2 ||

svarāṇāṃ śaktayaḥ proktā dhṛtaśūlakapālakāḥ |
ugrā vīrā mahājvālā hākinī viśvarūpiṇī || 3-3 ||

stutyā ca jvalinī lakṣmīstamisrā sarvatomukhī |
vareṇyā totulā mukhyā vātītā ca tataḥ param || 3-4 ||

p. 50)

nṛmuṇḍamālā siṃhī ca hantrī bhīmā ca khaṇḍinī |
tāriṇī bhayadā caiva drāviṇī mṛtyurūpiṇī || 3-5 ||

tyutkārī mṛtyuhariṇī tyunnatā ca natipriyā |
mālinī ñārṇarūpā ca haṃsinī ca śikhaṇḍinī || 3-6 ||

kuṇḍinī kṣāntirūpā ca kādīnāṃ śaktayaḥ kramāt |

iti pratyaṅgirāmātṛkā || atha bhavānīmātṛkā :

bhavānyanantā śarabhī cakriṇī karuṇākarā |
ekamātrā dvimātrā ca trimātrā cāparā jayā || 3-1 || 

ardhamātrā parā sūkṣmā ṣaṭpadā ca manasvinī |
niṣkalā śaktayaḥ proktāḥ svarāṇāṃ vasudharmadāḥ || 3-2 ||

svacchandānandasandohā vyomākārā nirūpitā |
gadyapadyātmikā caiva sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutā || 3-3 ||

sādhubandhapadanyāsā sarvoktighaṭanāvalī |
ṣaṭtarkakarkaśākārā sarvatarkavivarjitā || 3-4 ||

ādityavarṇā'varṇā ca tāmasī pararūpiṇī |
brahmāṇī brahmasantānā vedavāgvādinīśvarī || 3-5 ||

purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsā dharmaśāstrāṅgamiśritā |
vedā vedavatī sarvā haṃsavidyādhidevatā || 3-6 ||

viśveśvarī jagaddhātrī viśvanirmāṇakāriṇī |
vedikā vedarūpā ca kālikā kālarūpiṇī || 3-7 ||

nārāyaṇī mahādevī sarvasattvapravartikā |
hiraṇyavarṇarūpā ca kādīnāṃ śaktayaḥ kramāt || 3-8 ||

iti durgā (bhavānī) mātṛkā || atha khecarīmātṛkā :

khecarī śaktiratulā vyomāmbā vyomarūpiṇī |
vyomasthā vyomarūpā ca vyomātītā jaganmayī || 3-1 ||

śāmbhavī śambhuvanitā śaraṇārtiprabhedinī |
jaganmātā jagaddhātrī paravidyā sumaṅgalā || 3-2 ||

svarāṇāṃ śaktayastvetā bhavabandhavimocikāḥ |
parā parāyaṇā bhavyā mālinī madavihvalā || 3-3 ||

vidyā sūkṣmā prabhā saṃdhyā jaganmāyā jagatkriyā |
niśācarī jayā māyā'meyā mohavivardhinī || 3-4 ||

mohanī rañjinī vaśyā'varā mātṛsvarūpiṇī |
vedavidyā mahāvidyā yajñavidyā yamāntakī || 3-5 ||

sukhinī sukhadā bhogyā bhoginī daṇḍinī ramā |
viśāradā viśālākṣī hlādinī cākṣayā tathā || 3-6 ||

kādīnāṃ śaktayaḥ proktāḥ sādhakeṣṭaphalapradāḥ |

iti khecarīmātṛkā || atha cāmuṇḍāmātṛkā :

cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā caṇḍā caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī |
nārāyaṇī bhadrakālī virajā viśvamātṛkā || 3-1 ||

ajitā bhārgavī saumyā durgā durgatināśinī |
āpyāyanī caṇḍaghaṇṭā māyoktāḥ svaraśaktayaḥ || 3-2 ||

kamalā khaṅginī caiva gadinī ghaṇṭikā parā |
caritrā cchatriṇī jaṅghā jhaṅkārī jayadā tataḥ || 3-3 ||

ṭaṅkahastā ca ṭhaṅkārī ḍāmarī ḍhakkikā śivā |
tamopahantrī sthāneśī dayārūpā dhanapradā || 3-4 ||

navyā parā ca phaṭkārī bandhinī bhayavarjitā |
mahāmāyā ca yogīṣī raṅkiṇī lambakeśinī || 3-5 ||

varadā śākinī ṣaṇḍā sarveśī halinī tathā |
lalitā ca tathā kṣāmodarī syāt kādiśaktayaḥ || 3-6 ||

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya caṇḍābhakto bhavedyadi |
cāmuṇḍāśaktisahitāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ || 3-7 ||

iti cāmuṇḍāmātṛkā || atha parāmātṛkā :

parā parāyaṇā sūkṣmā viśvā dākṣāyaṇī jayā |
vijayā mānadā dakṣā yoginī mānadā ratiḥ || 3-1 ||

kaumārī pārvatī durgā māninī svaraśaktayaḥ |
kalāvatī ca karuṇā kāminī kāntidāyinī || 3-2 ||

khātītā khecarī gamyā gāruḍī ghanagarjinī |
cāruhāsā ca capalā jagaddhātrī jayā ramā || 3-3 ||

viśvoddhārā viśvamayī viśālākṣī viśokinī |
varadā vāsukī bālā parameṣṭhinutā dhṛtiḥ || 3-4 ||

bhāsvarā bhāvagamyāryā bhānumaṇḍalavartinī |
(phaṭkārī lāsinī tārā hāriṇī havyavāhinī || 3-5 ||)

hlādinī kledinī klinnā gaditāḥ kādiśaktayaḥ |

p. 51)

iti parāmātṛkā || atha kurukullāmātṛkā :

kurukullā kuraṅgākṣī viṣahantrī viṣāpahā |
viśveśvarī viśālākṣī gāruḍī gajagāminī || 3-1 ||

vinatā viśvajananī viśvākhyā viśvamātṛkā |
rājasī tāmasī sattvā raṇatkāñcīvibhūṣaṇā || 3-2 ||

svarāṇāṃ śaktayastvetā dhanadharmasukhapradāḥ |
kalyāṇī kamalā kāntā sauparṇī tārkṣyaśaktinī || 3-3 ||

nāgahantrī nāgamātā nāginī nagajā priyā |
nalinī nandinī bhavyā sadāpuṣpavatī śivā || 3-4 ||

madadravā madavatī mādinī manmathālasā |
mohinī murajaprītā munimānasavāsinī || 3-5 ||

potasthā purajitkāntā potaśaktiḥ purapriyā |
digambarā ditiḥ saumyā dineśī dīnavallabhā || 3-6 ||

dayāvatī damaprītā dāruṇī lokadhāriṇī |
kādīnāṃ śaktayaḥ proktāḥ sādhakeṣṭaphalapradāḥ || 3-7 ||

iti kurukullāmātṛkā || atha pañcadaśīmātṛkā :

sundarī subhagā bhavyā mahāmāyā manonmanī |
tripurā vaśinī bālā mahātripuradevatā || 3-1 ||

mahākāmakalā śreṣṭhā nīlā nīlasarasvatī |
viśveśī vijayā saumyā saṃproktāḥ svaraśaktayaḥ || 3-2 ||

kaulinī kulamārgasthā kulāntakanivāsinī |
sarvavidyeśvarī caiva sarvamantreśvarī tathā || 3-3 ||

sarvavāgīśvarī siddhā sarvasiddheśvarī jayā |
sarvavīreśvarī vīrā sarvapīṭheśvarī śivā || 3-4 ||

bhairavī bhāvanātītā bhāvagamyā maheśvarī |
mahāvidyā mahājaitrī mahātripurasundarī || 3-5 ||

kālī kātyāyanī durgā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇuvallabhā |
yoginī yogamārgasthā ṣaṭcakrapuravāsinī || 3-6 ||

vimalā viśvanilayā viśvākhyā viśvavigrahā |
śaśinī śāradā caiva candramaṇḍalamadhyagā || 3-7 ||

kādīnāṃ śaktayastvetāḥ saṃproktāḥ siddhidāyikāḥ | 

iti sundarīmātṛkā || atha mālinyādimātṛkā :

mālinī nādinī caiva grasinī priyadarśinī |
nivṛttiḥ supratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistataḥ param || 3-1 ||

cāmuṇḍā guhyaśaktiśca vajriṇī ca karālinī |
kapālinī śivā caiva jñānaśaktiḥ kriyā tathā || 3-2 ||

svarāṇāṃ śaktayastvetā jñānamokṣaphalapradāḥ |
gāyatrīcchā ca sāvitrī dehinī muṇḍamālinī || 3-3 ||

phaṭkārī ca vaṣaṭkārī svadhā svāhāhutipriyā |
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca brahmāṇī brahmavādinī || 3-4 ||

jayā vedamayī durgā jayantī raktadantikā |
jagajjaitrī ca caitanyamayī viśvaprabodhinī || 3-5 ||

kṣamā śāntirdayā nidrā rudraśaktiḥ parāyaṇā |
huṃkārī khecarī māyā viśvayonistrayīmayī || 3-6 ||

saṃsārabhayahantrī ca saṃproktāḥ kādiśaktayaḥ |
nyastavyā mātṛkāstvetā ūrdhvāmnāyāṇudīkṣitaiḥ || 3-7 ||

iti mālinyādimātṛkā || atha pañcabhūtamātṛkā | tatra śāradāyām :

vāyvagnibhūjalākāśāḥ pañcāśallipayaḥ kramāt |
pañca hrasvāḥ pañca dīrghā bindvantāḥ sandhisaṃbhavāḥ || 3-1 ||

pañcaśaḥ kādayaḥ ṣakṣalasahāntasamanvitāḥ |

iti | tantrarāje :

prāṇāgnīlāmbukhātmānaḥ paṅktayaḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ |
māyāśaktyabhidhaḥ sargaḥ pañcabhūtātmakaḥ prabhuḥ || 3-1 ||

tasmāttasyātra vinyāso naikadeśaḥ śivātmanaḥ |
vāto maruccaraḥ prāṇo vāyurnādo rayo javī || 3-2 ||

vyāptaḥ sparśaśca nāmāni varṇānāṃ marutāṃ kramāt |
agnirvahniḥ śucistejaḥ prabhā dāvo śikhī dyutiḥ || 3-3 ||

dāho grāsaśca nāmāni varṇānāṃ tejasāmapi |
dharā kṣmā bhūḥ sthirā jyā kurgotrā bhūmī rasā ilā || 3-4 ||

nāmānyetāni varṇānāṃ bhaumānāṃ syuḥ krameṇa vai ||
jalaṃ vāri vanaṃ vāḥ kaṃ pāthastoyaṃ raso'mbu hṛt || 3-5 ||

nāmānyetāni varṇānāmāpyānāṃ syuryathākramam |
vibhuḥ khaṃ khaṃ dyurabhraṃ ca vyoma śūnyaṃ nabho viyat || 3-6 ||

haṃsaśca nāmānyetāni krameṇa vyomarūpiṇām | 

p. 52)

iti pañcabhūtamātṛkā || atha bhūtalipimātṛkā | tatra siddhasārasvate :

atha vakṣye mahāmantrān sarasvatyāḥ sukāmadān |
teṣvādau bhūtalipyākhyo manuḥ saṃprocyate priye || 3-1 ||

sārasvate mahātantre gopitaścātidurlabhaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ sakāśādyaṃ labdhvā munayo vāñchitaṃ phalam || 3-2 ||

lebhire sakalaṃ devi kiṃ bahūktena sarvadā |
hrasvānāṃ pañcakaṃ varga āditaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 3-3 ||

dvitīyaḥ kathito devi śivādyāścaturakṣarāḥ |
khaṃ vāyuvahnyambudharāḥ tṛtīyaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ || 3-4 ||

vargāntyādyadvitīyopāntyatṛtīyaiḥ kramādamī |
pañca vargā vāntaśāntabhṛgubhirnavamo mataḥ || 3-5 ||

navavargātmako mantro dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraḥ |
vargāṇāmādimo vargaḥ śrīkaṇṭhordhvoṣṭhakhānvitāḥ || 3-6 ||

vargāntyā vāntasaṃyuktāḥ krameṇa kathitā amī |
khaṃ vāyuvahnyambudharā vargavarṇā matāḥ kramāt || 3-7 ||

vargo dvitīyo bhūhīno vāribhūviyuto'ntimaḥ |
navānāmapi vargāṇāṃ devatāḥ kathitāḥ kramāt || 3-8 ||

viriñciviṣṇurudrāhvā aśvineyau prajāpatiḥ |
lokapālāḥ sakriyādiśaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 3-9 ||

iti bhūtalipimātṛkā || atha triṣaṣṭyakṣaramātṛkā mātṛkārṇave-

triṣaṣṭiścatuḥṣaṣṭirvā varṇāḥ śambhumate matāḥ |
prākṛte saṃskṛte vāpi svayaṃ proktāḥ svayambhuvā || 3-1 ||

svarā viśatirekaśca sparśānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
yādayaśca smṛtā hyaṣṭau catvāraśca yamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 3-2 ||

anusvāro visargaścakapau cāpi parāśrayau |
duḥspṛṣṭaśceti vijñeya ḷkāraḥ pluta eva ca || 3-3 ||

iti triṣaṣṭyakṣaramātṛkā || atha śāmbhavīmātṛkā-ūrdhvāmnāyadīkṣitairnyāsaḥ 
kartavyaḥ |

śāmbhavī tāmasī māyā mahāmāyā śivottamā |
ūrdhvakeśī virūpākṣī khecarī śivavallabhā || 3-1 ||

kuṇḍodarī ca lolākṣī viṣṇumāyā mahodarī |
lamboṣṭhī vyomarūpā ca vibhvī ca svaraśaktayaḥ || 3-2 ||

kāntiḥ śraddhā ratiḥ prītirambarā prāṇarūpiṇī |
śuciḥ kṣitiśca bhuvanā dyutiḥ śrīḥ paramā ramā || 3-3 ||

rājasī grasinī caṇḍā rākṣasī ca viśāradā |
vāgvādinī jayā bhīmā śivā śaṅkaravallabhā || 3-4 ||

sandhyā prajñā prabhā jyotsnā vinadā viśvarūpiṇī |
asthimālādharā pañcavaktrogrā kṣobhiṇī matiḥ || 3-5 ||

vyāpinī ca smṛtāḥ kādivarṇānāṃ śaktayaḥ kramāt |
śāmbhavakramadīkṣāyuksādhakānāṃ maheśvari || 3-6 ||

śāmbhavī mātṛkā proktā sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradā |
etāṃ vinyasya cādau tu tato raśmikramaṃ nyaset || 3-7 ||

iti śāmbhavīmātṛkā || atha kālarātrimātṛkā-

kālarātrirmahārātriḥ kaṭukā subhagā śivā |
mohinī moharātriśca vidyā kaṭukapatrikā || 3-1 ||

ātharvaṇasya duhitā rañjinī viśvamohinī |
mohanāstrā moharūpā saubhāgyā mohavardhinī || 3-2 ||

svarāṇāṃ śaktayastvetāḥ sādhakābhīṣṭahetavaḥ |
kāminī kamanaprītā drāviṇī kṣobhiṇī parā || 3-3 ||

madanonmādinī caiva manmathā ca manonmanī |
manasvinī manovāsinyaruṇā madanotsavā || 3-4 ||

mādinī madasantānā maṃjuvāṇī manoharā |
manoramā priyā kāntā maṃjughoṣā madapriyā || 3-5 ||

kāmavardhanikā caiva dāruṇā damanapriyā |
daṇḍinī viśvanaṭinī nalinī viśvamālinī || 3-6 ||

hāvā  bhāvā bhāvagamyā bhāvātītā vinodinī |
pañcabāṇā parotsāhā kādīnāṃ śaktayaḥ kramāt || 3-7 ||

iti kālarātrimātṛkā ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya-śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya-śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre tṛtīyaḥ 
śvāsaḥ || 3 ||





atha 

śrīvidyārṇavatantre 

|| caturthaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

(atha kālīmate traipuraraśmikramastripurāmadhikṛtya-)

mātṛkāvaibhavaṃ vakṣye sarvatantreṣu gopitam |
yaṃ buddhvā sampradāyena sādhako gatasaṃśayaḥ || 4-1 ||

mantroddhāraṃ svayaṃ kuryānmātṛkāraśmibodhanāt |
prathamaṃ mātṛkāraśmikramo jñeyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ || 4-2 ||

raśmikramamavijñāya mantroddhāraṃ karoti yaḥ |
andhakāre sthitaṃ vastu draṣṭumanveṣayatyayam || 4-3 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurutaḥ śāstrato'pi vā |
samyagjñātvā vidhānena sādhako gatasaṃśayaḥ || 4-4 ||

mantrasvarūpaṃ jānīyānmantravīryasya siddhaye |
anāyāsena siddhiḥ syānmantravīryaprabodhanāt || 4-5 ||

mantravīryamavijñāya yo mantraṃ bhajate naraḥ |
kalpakoṭisahasraistu mantrasiddhirna jāyate || 4-6 ||

varṇānāṃ raśmayo jñeyāḥ śvāsarūpā na saṃśayaḥ |
te śvāsāḥ pūrṇarūpāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭśatādhikato'pi ca || 4-7 ||

guṇasaptasahasrāṇi hyapūrṇā dviguṇīkṛtāḥ |
te śvāsā dvividhā proktā bāhyābhyantarayogataḥ || 4-8 ||

sūryacandravibhedena krūrasaumyaprabhedataḥ |
piṅgaleḍāvibhedena ye śvāsāścārdharūpiṇaḥ || 4-9 ||

mūlādhāre nābhipadme svādhiṣṭhāne'pyanāhate |
viśuddhau tu bhruvormadhye ṣaṭcakreṣu vyavasthitāḥ || 4-10 ||

praticakraṃ trisāhasraṃ ṣaṭśatādhikameva ca |
mūlādhāraṃ kṣiteḥ sthānaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tejasaḥ || 4-11 ||

maṇipūramapāṃ sthānaṃ vāyoḥ sthānamanāhatam |
viśuddhaṃ nabhasaḥ sthānamājñācakraṃ tu mānasam || 4-12 ||

mūlādhāre mahāpadmaṃ caturdalasamanvitam |
vādisāntacaturvaṇairdalamadhyeṣu saṃyutam || 4-13 ||

ekasyaikasya varṇasya raśmīnāṃ navaśatyapi |
pārthivā raśmayestu caturdaśa caturdaśa || 4-14 ||

pratyakṣaraṃ tu vijñeyā vādisānte yathākramam |
maṇipūre daśadale ḍādiphāntasamanvite || 4-15 ||

tatrāpyā raśmayo jñeyā dvipañcāśadvibhāgaśaḥ |
svādhiṣṭhāne rasadale bādilāntākṣarānvite || 4-16 ||

dvāṣaṣṭī raśmayo jñeyāstaijasāścātra bhāgaśaḥ |
anāhate ravidale kādiṭhāntākṣarānvite || 4-17 ||

vāyavyā raśmayo jñeyāścatuṣpañcāśadatra vai |
viśuddhe ṣoḍaśadale ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyute || 4-18 ||

nābhasā raśmayo jñeyā dvisaptatirvibhāgaśaḥ |
ājñācakre tu dvidale hakṣābhyāṃ saṃyute pare || 4-19 ||

mānasā raśmayo jñeyāścatuḥṣaṣṭiryathākramam |
ṣaḍādhāreṣu sambhūya triśataṃ ṣaṣṭiraśmayaḥ || 4-20 ||

ekasyaikasya varṇasya raśmayo ye samāśritāḥ |
teṣu raśmiṣu samproktāḥ ṣaḍvidhāḥ pārthivādayaḥ || 4-21 ||

saṅkīrṇā raśmaya iti teṣāṃ nāmāni ca bruve |
caturdalātmakādhāraṣaṭpañcāśaddaleṣu ca || 4-22 ||

pūrvādi pārthivā jñeyā mayūkhāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ |
sundarī tripurādyā ca sundarastripurādikaḥ || 4-23 ||

tato hṛdayadevī ca devo'tra hṛdayādikaḥ |
śirodevī śirodevaḥ śikhādevī tataḥ param || 4-24 ||

śikhādidevaḥ kavacadevī kavacadevakaḥ |
netradevī netradevo'stradevyastrādidevakaḥ || 4-25 ||

kāmeśvarī ca kāmeśastataśca bhagamālinī |
bhagamālī tato nityaklinnā nityādiklinnakaḥ || 4-26 ||

p. 54)

bheruṇḍāpi ca bheruṇḍo vahnivāsinyataḥ param |
vahnivāsī mahāvajreśvarī vajreśvarastathā || 4-27 ||

śivādūtī śivādūtastvaritā tvaritastataḥ |
kulādisundarī caiva tataśca kulasundaraḥ || 4-28 ||

nityā nityastato nīlapatākā tadanantaram |
nīlādikapatākaśca vijayā vijayastataḥ || 4-29 ||

sarvamaṅgalanāmnī ca sarvamaṅgalanāmakaḥ |
jvālāmālinikā caiva jvālāmālī tataḥ param || 4-30 ||

citrā ca citraḥ kathito mahānityā tataḥ param |
mahānityastataścaiva parameśī tataḥ param || 4-31 ||

parameśastu mitreśamayī mitreśasaṃjñakaḥ |
tatastu ṣaṣṭhīśamayī tathā ṣaṣṭhīsaṃjñakaḥ || 4-32 ||

uḍḍīśamayyathoḍḍīśamavaścāpi tataḥ param | 
caryyānāthamayī caiva caryyānāthamayastathā || 4-33 ||

mayūkhāḥ pārthivāḥ proktāḥ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyakāḥ |
nābhisthāne dvipañcāśaddale daśadalātmake || 4-34 ||

tatrāpyā raśmayo jñeyā dvipañcāśat krameṇa vai |
lopāmudrāmayī caiva lopāmudrāmayastataḥ || 4-35 ||

tathāgastyamayī caiva tathāgastyamayastathā |
kālatāpanaśabdādimayī kālāditāpanaḥ || 4-36 ||

mayaḥ ṣaṣṭhaśca vijñeyo dharmācāryamayī tathā |
dharmācāryamayo muktakeśvarādimayī tataḥ || 4-37 ||

muktakeśvaranāmādimayo dīpakalādikaḥ |
nāthamayyapi dīpādikalānāthamayastataḥ || 4-38 ||

viṣṇudevamayī caiva viṣṇudevamayastataḥ |
prabhākarādito devamayastejomayī tataḥ || 4-39 ||

tetodevamayaścaiva manodevamayī tathā |
manodevamayaścaiva kalyāṇapadapūrvakam || 4-40 ||

devamayyapi kalyāṇadevādimayakastathā |
ratnadevamayī caiva ratnadevamayastataḥ || 4-41 ||

vāsudevamayī caiva vāsudevamayastathā |
rāmānandamayī caiva rāmānandamayastathā || 4-42 ||

aṇimāsiddhiraṇimāsiddhaśca laghimādikā |
siddhiśca laghimāsiddho mahimāsiddhirapyatha || 4-43 ||

mahimāsiddha ityeva īśitvādistataḥ param |
siddhirīśitvasiddhaḥ syād vaśitvādistataḥ param || 4-44 ||

siddhirvaśitvasiddhaḥ syāt prākāmyādistataḥ param |
siddhiḥ prākāmyasiddhaḥ syāt bhuktisiddhistataḥ param || 4-45 ||

bhuktisiddhastato'pīcchāsiddhiricchādisiddhakaḥ |
prāptisiddhiḥ prāptisiddhaḥ sarvakāmādisiddhikā || 4-46 ||

sarvakāmādisiddhaśca brāhmī brahmā ataḥ param |
māheśvarī ca māheśo jñeyā vai jalaraśmayaḥ || 4-47 ||

dvāṣaṣṭidalake padme svādhiṣṭhāne rasātmake |
pūrvādidalamārabhya jñeyā taijasaraśmayaḥ || 4-48 ||

kaumārī ca kumāraśca vaiṣṇavī viṣṇureva ca |
vārāhī ca varāhaśca māhendrī ca mahendrakaḥ || 4-49 ||

cāmuṇḍā caiva cāmuṇḍo mahālakṣmīstataḥ param |
mahālakṣmastataścaiva sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇī tataḥ || 4-50 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaścaiva sarvavidrāvaṇī tataḥ |
sarvavidrāvaṇaścaiva sarvākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-51 ||

sarvākarṣaṇakaścaiva sarvavaśaṃkarī tataḥ |
sarvavaśaṃkaraścaiva sarvonmādanikā tataḥ || 4-52 ||

sarvonmādanakaścaiva sarvādikamahāṃkuśā |
tathā mahāṃkuśaḥ sarvakhecarī sarvakhecaraḥ || 4-53 ||

sarvabījā sarvabījaḥ sarvayonistataḥ param |
sarvayonistrikhaṇḍā ca trikhaṇḍastadanantaram || 4-54 ||

trailokyamohanādiśca cakrasvāminikā tataḥ |
tathaiva cakrasvāmī ca prakaṭayoginī tathā || 4-55 ||

tataḥ prakaṭayogī ca kāmākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
kāmākarṣaṇakaścaiva buddhyākarṣarṇikā tataḥ || 4-56 ||

buddhyākarṣaṇakaścaivāhaṅkārākarṣaṇī tathā |
ahaṅkārākarṣaṇaśca śabdākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-57 ||

śabdākarṣaṇakaścaiva sparśākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
sparśākarṣaṇakaścaiva rūpākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-58 ||

rūpākarṣaṇakaścaiva rasākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
rasākarṣaṇakaścaiva gandhākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-59 ||

gandhākarṣaṇakaścaiva cittākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
cittākarṣaṇakaścaiva dhairyākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-60 ||

dhairyākarṣaṇakaścaiva smṛtyākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
smṛtyākarṣaṇakaścaiva nāmākarṣaṇikā tataḥ || 4-61 ||

nāmākarṣaṇakaścaiva bījākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
bījākarṣaṇakaścaiva tataścānāhate tathā || 4-62 ||

p. 55)

caturuttarapañcāśaddale ravidalātmake |
vāyavyā raśmayo jñeyāḥ pūrvapatrāditaḥ kramāt || 4-63 ||

ātmākarṣaṇikā caiva ātmākarṣaṇakastathā |
amṛtākarṣaṇī śaktiramṛtākarṣaṇastathā || 4-64 ||

śarīrākarṣaṇī caiva śarīrākarṣaṇastataḥ |
sarvāśāparipūrādicakrasvāminyataḥ param || 4-65 ||

tathaiva cakrasvāmīti guptayoginyataḥ param |
guptayogī tataścaivānaṅgādikusumā tataḥ || 4-66 ||

anaṅgakusumo'naṅgamekhalānaṅgamekhalaḥ |
anaṅgamadanānaṅgamadano'naṅgaśabdataḥ || 4-67 |

madanāturāto'naṅgamadanātura eva ca |
anaṅgarekhānaṅgādirekho'naṅgādiveginī || 4-68 ||

anaṅgavegyanaṅgāṃkuśānaṅgāṃkuśa eva ca |
anaṅgamālinī cānaṅgādimālī tataḥ param || 4-69 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇādiśca cakrasvāminikā tataḥ |
tathaiva cakrasvāmīti guptāditarayoginī || 4-70 ||

tathaiva yogī sarvādisaṃkṣobhaṇyatha tatparam |
sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaścaiva sarvavidrāvaṇī tataḥ || 4-71 ||

sarvavidrāvaṇaścaiva sarvākarṣaṇikā tataḥ |
sarvākarṣaṇakaścaiva sarvāhlādanikā tataḥ || 4-72 ||

sarvāhlādanakaścaiva sarvasaṃmohanī tataḥ |
sarvasaṃmohanaḥ sarvastambhanī ca tataḥ param || 4-73 ||

sarvastambhanakaścaiva sarvajṛmbhaṇikā tataḥ |
sarvajṛmbhaṇakaścaiva sarvavaśaṃkarī tataḥ || 4-74 ||

sarvavaśaṃkaraḥ sarvarañjanī sarvarañjanaḥ |
sarvonmādanikā sarvonmādanaśca tataḥ param || 4-75 ||

sarvārthasādhanī caiva tataḥ sarvārthasādhanaḥ |
sarvasaṃpattipūraṇyā sarvasaṃpattipūraṇaḥ || 4-76 ||

dvāsaptatidale kaṇṭhe ṣoḍaśacchadakātmake |
nābhasā raśmayo jñeyāḥ pūrvādidalataḥ kramāt || 4-77 ||

sarvamantramayī caiva sarvamantramayastataḥ |
sarvadvandvakṣayakarī sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkaraḥ || 4-78 ||

sarvasaubhāgyadāyādikacakrasvāminī tataḥ |
tathaiva cakrasvāmīti saṃpradāyādiyoginī || 4-79 ||

saṃpradāyādiyogī ca sarvasiddhipradā tathā |
sarvasiddhipradaścaiva sarvasaṃpatpradā tataḥ || 4-80 ||

sarvasaṃpatpradaścaiva sarvapriyakarī tataḥ |
sarvapriyakaraścaiva sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī || 4-81 ||

sarvamaṅgalakārī ca sarvakāmapradā tataḥ |
sarvakāmapradaścaiva sarvaduḥkhavimocanī || 4-82 ||

tathaiva mocanaḥ sarvamṛtyupraśamanī tataḥ |
sarvamṛtyupraśamanaḥ sarvavighnanivāraṇī || 4-83 ||

tathā nivāraṇaścaiva tathā sarvāṅgasundarī |
sarvāṅgasundaraścaiva sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī || 4-84 ||

tathaiva dāyakaścaiva sarvārthasādhakāditaḥ |
cakrasvāminikā caiva tataḥ svāmī kulādikā || 4-85 ||

uttīrṇayoginī caiva tathā yogī tataḥ param |
sarvajñā cātha sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktipradā param || 4-86 ||

sarvaśaktipradaścaiva sarvaiśvaryapradā tataḥ |
sarvaiśvaryapradaścaiva sarvajñānamayī tataḥ || 4-87 ||

sarvajñānamayaścaiva sarvavyādhivināśinī |
sarvavyādhivināśaśca sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī || 4-88 ||

sarvādhārasvarūpaśca sarvapāpaharā tathā |
sarvapāpaharaścaiva sarvānandamayī tathā || 4-89 ||

sarvānandamayaścaiva sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī |
sarvarakṣāsvarūpaśca sarvepsitaphalapradā || 4-90 ||

tathā phalapradaḥ sarvarakṣākarāditaḥ param |
cakrasvāminikā caiva tathā svāmī tataḥ param || 4-91 ||

nigarbhayoginī caiva tathā yogī tataḥ param |
vaśinī ca vaśī caiva tataḥ kāmeśvarī tataḥ || 4-92 ||

kāmeśvaro modinī ca modī ca vimalā tataḥ |
vimalaścāruṇā caivāruṇaśca jayinī jayī || 4-93 ||

sarveśvarī ca sarveśaḥ kaulinī kaulikastataḥ |
ājñācakre dvipatrātmacatuḥṣaṣṭidale'bjake || 4-94 ||

mānasā raśmayo jñeyāḥ sarvarāgaharāditaḥ |
cakrasvāminikā caiva tathā svāmī tataḥ param || 4-95 ||

rahasyayoginī caiva tathā yogī ca bāṇinī |
bāṇī ca cāpinī cāpī pāśinī pāśikastataḥ || 4-96 ||

aṃkuśinyaṃkuśī caiva mahākāmeśvarī tataḥ |
mahākāmeśvaraścaiva mahāvajreśvarī tathā || 4-97 ||

mahāvajreśvaraścaiva tathaiva bhagamālinī |
bhagamālī tathaivātra mahātripurasundarī || 4-98 ||

p. 56)

tathaiva sundaraḥ sarvasiddhipradāditaḥ param |
cakrasvāminyatha tathā svāmī cāpyatipūrvikā || 4-99 ||

rahasyayoginī caiva tathā yogī tataḥ param |
śrībhaṭṭārakasaṃjñā ca śrībhaṭṭārakasaṃjñakaḥ || 4-100 ||

sarvānandamayādiśca cakrasvāminyataḥ param |
tathaiva cakrasvāmīti parāpararahasyataḥ || 4-101 ||

yoginī ca tathā yogī tripurā tripurastathā |
(tripurādīśvarī caiva tataśca tripureśvaraḥ) || 4-102 ||

tripurādisundarī ca tataḥ tripurasundaraḥ |
tripurādirvāsinī ca tathā tripuravāsakaḥ || 4-103 ||

tripurāśrīstathā śrīśca tatastripuramālinī |
mālītripurasiddhā ca tathā siddhastataḥ param || 4-104 ||

tripurāmbā tathaivāmbo mahātripurasundarī |
tathaiva sundaraścātha mahāmāheśvarī tataḥ || 4-105 ||

tathā māheśvaraścaiva mahārājñī tataḥ param |
mahārājo mahāśaktirmahāśaktastataḥ param || 4-106 ||

mahāguptā mahāgupto mahājñaptā tataḥ param |
mahājñapto mahādiśca mahānandā mahādikaḥ || 4-107 ||

mahānandastathaivātra mahāspandā tataḥ param |
mahāmahāspanda iti tathaivānumahāśayā || 4-108 ||

mahāmahāśayaścaiva vijñeyā raśmayo'tra ca |
ārohaṇakramaḥ proktastvavarohakramaṃ bruve || 4-109 ||

lopāpañcadaśārṇānāṃ mithunāni tataḥ param |
navātmeśvaravarṇānāṃ ṣoḍaśasvarayogataḥ || 4-110 ||

catvāri catvāriṃśacca śataṃ teṣāṃ tu yugmakam |
pañcabrahmatrimūrtīnāṃ jyotiṣāṃ ca kalāśca ye || 4-111 ||

mithunāni ca (tvā ? tā) rotthakalānāṃ mithunāni vai |
navātmeśvaravarṇotthakaletarakalāḥ punaḥ || 4-112 || 

ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ guṇaśataṃ vijñeyā yatra sandhiṣu |
navātmeśvaramantrotthamithunāni gamāgame || 4-113 ||

tathā saptaśatī viṃśatyuttarā ca tataḥ param |
saṣaṭtriṃśatsaptaśataṃ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ || 4-114 ||

kālānityāśca vijñeyā mūlasaṃkhyā samīritā |
ṣaṭśatottarayuktāni sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ || 4-115 ||

śvāsarūpāḥ samākhyātā raśmayo'tra kulāgame |
sūryācandramasau jñeyau mūlāṅkād dviguṇīkṛtāt || 4-116 ||

saṅkīrṇaraśmayo jñeyā mūlāṅkādvinduhīnataḥ |
mūlādhārādadhastācca sahasradalakeṣu ca || 4-117 ||

sahasraraśmayo bhānti tathaiva brahmarandhrake |
sandhiṣaṭke'dha ūrdhve ca triṃśadviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 4-118 ||

ūnaviṃśatisāhasraṃ catvāriṃśaccatuḥśatam |
sahajā raśmayo jñeyāḥ saṅkīrṇā dvisahasrakam || 4-119 ||

śataṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ samākhyātā vijñeyāsteṣu bhāgaśaḥ |
varṇānāṃ kramaśo jñeyā pārthivāścaiva pāthasāḥ || 4-120 ||

taijasāścānilāścaiva nābhasā mānasāstathā |
avarṇasya trayaṃ sārdha sapādatrayameva ca || 4-121 || 

aṣṭamāṃśavihīnaṃ syāccatuṣṭyamataḥ param |
aṣṭamāṃśavihīnaṃ syāt sārdhatrayamataḥ param || 4-122 ||

sārdhavedaṃ vedasaṃkhyaṃ raśmayaḥ kramataḥ smṛtāḥ |
ikārādisvarāṇāṃ tu krama eṣa udāhṛtaḥ || 4-123 ||

ekaikasya svarasyaiva sārdhadvāviṃśatikramaḥ |
sadalābdhiḥ kavarṇasya pādanyūnaṃ tu pañcakam || 4-124 ||

pañcakaṃ sārdhavedaṃ ca ṣaṭ sapādaṃ ca pañcakam |
khavarṇasyāpyayaṃ jñeyaḥ kramaḥ pañcāntakasya tu || 4-125 ||

bhūtaṃ sapādavedaṃ ca pañcakaṃ sārdhavāridhiḥ |
ṣaṭakaṃ sapādabhūtaṃ syādapi ghākṣarakasya tu || 4-126 ||

sārdhābdhiśca sapādābdhiḥ sārdhapañcakameva ca |
sārdhāmbhodhī rasāścaiva sapādaṃ pañcakaṃ tataḥ || 4-127 ||

ḍakārasya cakārasya chakārasyāpyayaṃ kramaḥ | 
jakārasya tu pañcaiva sapādaṃ vedameva ca || 4-128 ||

pañcakaṃ sārdhavedaṃ ca ṣaṭkaṃ bhūtaṃ sapādakam |
jhakārasyāmbudhisārdhaṃ sapādāmbudhireva ca || 4-129 ||

pañcakaṃ sārdhavedaṃ ca ṣaṭkaṃ pādavihīnakam |
ṣaṭkaṃ ñārṇasya tu tathā ṭaṭhayośca jakāravat || 4-130 ||

ḍārṇasya pādahīnaṃ syāt ṣaṭkaṃ pañca sapādakāḥ |
sārdhaṣaṭkaṃ pañcakaṃ ca saptakaṃ sārdhaṣaṭkam || 4-131 ||

ḍhaṇatānāmayaṃ jñeyaḥ kramo deśikasattamaiḥ |
thārṇasya sārdhabhūtaṃ syāt sapādaṃ bhūtameva ca || 4-132 ||

rasāśca pādahīnaṃ syāt ṣaṭkaṃ saptakameva ca |
sārdhaṣaṭkaṃ tathā jñeyā dadhanānāṃ ca deśikaiḥ || 4-133 ||

pārṇasya sārdhabhūtaṃ syāt pañcakaṃ ṣaṭkameva ca |
sārdhabhūtaṃ gajāḥ ṣaṭkaṃ phakārasyāpyayaṃ kramaḥ || 4-134 ||

p. 57)

bārṇasya daśakaṃ sārddhā gajā daśakameva ca |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhapaṃktiryathākramam || 4-135 ||

bhārṇasya navakaṃ sārdhaṃ navakaṃ paṃktireva ca |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhapaṃkti krameṇa vai || 4-136 || 

mārṇasya navakaṃ sārdhaṃ gajāścaikādaśāpi vā |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhapaṃktiḥ krameṇa ca || 4-137 ||

yārṇasya navakaṃ sārdhagajāḥ paṃktistathaiva ca |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhaikādaśakaṃ tataḥ || 4-138 ||

rārṇasya navakaṃ sārdhagajā ekādaśa tataḥ |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhapaṃktiryathākramam || 4-139 ||

lārṇasya daśakaṃ sārdhagajā daśakameva ca |
navakaṃ ravisaṃkhyākaṃ sārdhapaṃktistathaiva ca || 4-140 ||

vārṇasya manusaṃkhyākaṃ viśvedevāstathaiva ca |
sadalaṃ tithisaṃkhyākaṃ sadalaṃ viśvameva ca || 4-141 ||

aṣṭādaśa ṣoḍaśa ca śaṣasānāṃ sapaṃktayaḥ |
hārṇasyāṣṭāviśatiśca ṣaḍviṃśatirataḥ param || 4-142 ||

ekatriṃśatsaptatriṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśattadanantaram |
dvātriṃśacca kramo jñeyaḥ kṣakārasyāpyayaṃ kramaḥ || 4-143 ||

tataḥ saṅkīrṇaraśmīnāṃ sahajānāmaśeṣataḥ |
jñānena varṇavṛndasya jñātuṃ vaibhavamuttamam || 4-144 ||

śakyate'tra na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ nacānyathā |
kakārādyarkavarṇānāṃ triṃśattriṃśattathaiva ca || 4-145 ||

ḍakārasya daśārṇānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkrama īritaḥ |
bakārādi (daśā?rasā)rṇānāṃ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā samīritā || 4-146 ||

vādīnāṃ vedavarṇānāṃ navatyevamudāhṛtā |
hakṣayośca śata proktamaśītyuttarameva ca || 4-147 ||

akārādisvarāṇāṃ ca pratyekaṃ ca śatadvayam |
pañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭā mayūkhā mūlataḥ kramāt || 4-148 ||

sārddhadvāviṃśatirjñeyāḥ saṅkīrṇāstu pṛthak pṛthak |
dviśataṃ sārdhayugmaṃ ca sahajā raśmayaḥ pṛthak || 4-149 ||

kādiṭhāntārkavarṇānāṃ mūlabhūtāstu raśmayaḥ |
śatatrayaṃ tu pratyekaṃ jñātavyā deśikottamaiḥ || 4-150 ||

triṃśattriṃśatkrameṇaiva saṅkīrṇā raśmayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
dviśataṃ saptatiścaiva sahajāstu pṛthakpṛthak || 4-151 ||

ḍādīnāṃ daśavarṇānāṃ triśataṃ ṣaṣṭireva ca |
mūlabhūtāstu saṅkīrṇāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśacca pṛthakpṛthak || 4-152 ||

sahajā dviśataṃ ṣaṣṭiścaturuttarameva ca |
bādīnāṃ rasavarṇānāṃ mūlabhūtā hi raśmayaḥ || 4-153 ||

śataṣaṭaṃ tu saṅkīrṇā vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyayā |
nijāḥ pañcaśataṃ catvāriṃśacca kramataḥ pṛthak || 4-154 ||

vādīnāṃ vedavarṇānāṃ navaśatyā pṛthak pṛthak |
mūlabhūtāṃśavo jñeyāḥ saṅkīrṇā navatiḥ pṛthak || 4-155 ||

nijā daśottarāṇyaṣṭau śatāni ca tataḥ param |
hakṣayoraṣṭaśatyūrdhvasahasraṃ mūlaraśmayaḥ || 4-156 ||

aśītyuttarato jñeyāḥ śataṃ saṅkīrṇaraśmayaḥ |
sahasraṃ ṣaṭśataṃ triṃśatsahajā raśmayaḥ kramāt || 4-157 ||

sarveṣāṃ pārthivā jñeyāḥ saṣaṭtriṃśacchatatrayam |
āpyāḥ sadvādaśaṃ jñeyāstriśataṃ deśikottamaiḥ || 4-158 ||

dvisaptatyuttaraṃ jñeyāstriśataṃ taijasāṃśavaḥ |
caturviṃśati jñeyāstriśataṃ vāyuraśmayaḥ || 4-159 ||

catuḥśataṃ ca dvātriṃśadraśmayo nābhasā matāḥ |
triśataṃ cāpyaśītiśca catvāro mānasāḥ smṛtāḥ || 4-160 ||

evaṃ raśmikramajñānāt sākṣātparaśivo bhavet |
nātaḥ parataraṃ loke mantravīryaprakāśakam || 4-161 ||

guhyādguhyataraṃ caiva nādeyaṃ yasya kasyacit |
dattaṃ cetsiddhihāniḥ syādityājñā pārameśvarī || 4-162 ||

stambhane parthivaprāyāḥ vijñeyā manavo'tra ca |
āpyaprāyāśca manavaḥ śastāḥ syuḥ śāntikarmaṇi || 4-163 ||

taijasāstu viyatprāyāḥ kārmaṇe vaśyake'pi ca |
uccāṭane tu vāyavyāḥ praśastā manavo'tra ca || 4-164 ||

mantrāstu mānasaprāyā muktidā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
prabuddhā kuṇḍalīśaktirmantrā bodhaṃ prayānti ca || 4-165 ||

jñātvā samyagvidhānena gurutaḥ śāstrato'pivā |
ārohaṇakrameṇaivāpyavarohakrameṇa ca || 4-166 ||

raśminyāse kṛte caiva mantrāḥ siddhyanti tatkṣaṇāt |
raśminyāsaṃ vinā yastu mantravīryaprayatnavān || 4-167 ||

siddhirna jāyate tasya kalpakoṭiśatairapi |
kālīmate samuddiṣṭā raśmayaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ || 4-168 ||

p. 58)

iti kālīmate śrīvidyāraśmayaḥ ||

vakṣye kādimate samyagraśmayaścakraṣaṭkake |
pārthivāḥ svarahīnāśca sapta hrasvasvarānvitāḥ || 4-1 ||

pañcatriṃśat samuddiṣṭā dīrghayuktāstu saptatiḥ |
te punaḥ śuddhato bindusargābhyāṃ daśapañca ca || 4-2 ||

śatatrayaṃ samuddiṣṭāḥ pārthivāḥ pañca yuksvarāḥ |
udāttāścānudāttāśca svaritāstithisaṃjñakāḥ || 4-3 ||

te punaḥ śuddhato bindusargābhyāṃ samudāhṛtāḥ |
pañcacatvāriṃśaditi triśataṃ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyakāḥ || 4-4 ||

mūlādhāre mahīsthāne vijñeyā deśikottamaiḥ |
saṅkīrṇā raśmayaḥ khyātā maṇipūre jalāśraye || 4-5 ||

svādhiṣṭhāne'nalāvāse'nāhate'nilamandire |
viśuddhe vyomanilaye tathā proktāśca raśmayaḥ || 4-6 ||

ājñācakre manaḥsthāne halakṣāstraya eva hi |
hrasvadīrghasvarairyuktāḥ pañcottaramataḥ param || 4-7 ||

catvāriṃśat samākhyātāste punaḥ sānunāsikāḥ |
tataste'nanunāsāśca tathā navatisaṃkhyakāḥ || 4-8 ||

te punaḥ śuddhato bindusargābhyāmubhayātmanā |
ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ triśatakaṃ samyakkhyātāḥ syuraṃśavaḥ || 4-9 ||

svarāṇāṃ bhāgaśaḥ proktāḥ pārthivādyāśca ṣaḍvidhāḥ |
ekasyaikasya varṇasya sārddhadvāviṃśatiḥ pṛthak || 4-10 ||

kādīnāṃ ravivarṇānāṃ pārthivādyāśca ṣaḍvidhāḥ |
ekasyaikasya varṇasya triṃśat triṃśat pṛthak pṛthak || 4-11 ||

ḍādīnāṃ daśavarṇānāṃ pārthivādyāśca raśmayaḥ |
ekasyaikasya varṇasya ṣaṭtriṃśatkrama īritaḥ || 4-12 ||

bādīnāṃ rasavarṇānāṃ pārthivāṃśādayaḥ kramāt |
ekasyaikasya varṇasya ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaṣṭirudāhṛtāḥ || 4-13 ||

vādīnāṃ vedavarṇānāṃ pārthivādyāśca ṣaḍvidhāḥ |
ekasyaikasya navatirnavatiḥ proktarūpataḥ || 4-14 ||

hakṣayoḥ pārthivādyāśca ṣaḍvidhā raśmayaḥ kramāt |
āśītyuttarato jñeyāḥ śatamekaikavarṇake || 4-15 ||

evaṃ sahasradvitayaṃ śataṃ ṣaṣṭiśca raśmayaḥ |
cakre cakre vijṛmbhante saṅkīrṇā raśmayaḥ pṛthak || 4-16 ||

nikhilā raśmayo jñeyāḥ saṅkīrṇā dvādaśaiva hi |
sahasrāṇi ca ṣaṣṭyūrdhvanavaśatyā yutāni vai || 4-17 ||

sandhiṣaṭake'dha ūrdhve ca catvāriṃśacca ṣaṭśatam |
aṣṭau sahasrāṇyevaṃ hi saṃkīrṇā raśmayo'mbike || 4-18 ||

ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatordhvaṃ ca dvisahasramapāsya ca ( ? ) | 
tricatvāriṃśadevātra sahasrāṇi śatadvayam || 4-19 ||

raśmayo mūlabhūtā hi samuddiṣṭā hyaśeṣataḥ |
nijāśca bhāgaśo jñeyāḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ prāgudīritāḥ || 4-20 ||

ardhaṃ sūryasvarūpāśca ardhaṃ somasvarūpiṇaḥ |

iti | tantrāntare-

kaṇṭhadeśe svarāṇāṃ ca bhūtavarṇatrike trike |
tattadbhūtāṃśavo jñeyāḥ śatatrayavibhāgataḥ || 4-1 ||

anyeṣāṃ pañca pañcaiva visargasya tu mānasāḥ |
śatatrayaṃ samuddiṣṭā anyeṣāṃ tu caturdaśa || 4-2 ||

kādiṣvanilavarṇānāṃ pañcottaraśatakramaḥ |
anyeṣāṃ pañcapañcaiva navānāṃ vāyuraśmayaḥ || 4-3 ||

āgneyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca pañcottaraśatāṃśavaḥ |
anyeṣāṃ pañcapañcaiva navānāmagniraśmayaḥ || 4-4 ||

dharārṇayorekaśatī pañcaviṃśatiruttarāḥ |
anyeṣāṃ rudravarṇānāṃ pārthivāṃśā daśa kramāt || 4-5 ||

jalārṇayorekaśatī pañcaviṃśatiruttarāḥ |
anyeṣāṃ rudravarṇānāṃ kramād daśa jalāṃśavaḥ || 4-6 ||

ākāśārṇadvayasyāpi śataṃ vai pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
ekaikasya tu vijñeyā anyeṣāṃ daśa vai daśa || 4-7 ||

ḍādiphāntadaśārṇeṣu tattadbhūtārṇayoḥ pṛthak |
tattadbhūtāṃśavo jñeyāḥ sārdhaṃ śatamiti sphuṭam || 4-8 ||

anyeṣāṃ vasuvarṇānāṃ sārdhadvādaśa raśmayaḥ |
bādilāntārṇaṣaṭkeṣu dharāvarṇadvaye pṛthak || 4-9 ||

dharāṃśavastu vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraśataṃ tathā |
anyeṣāṃ paṃktisaṃkhyākā vijñeyā vīravandite || 4-10 ||

tattadbhūtāṃśavo bhāditattadbhūtārṇakeṣu ca |
deśikendraiḥ suvijñeyā ekaikasya śatatrayam || 4-11 ||

anyeṣāṃ tu trivarṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ viṃśatikramaḥ |
vārṇādivedavarṇānāṃ jalayorjalaraśmayaḥ || 4-12 ||

p. 59)

sārddhaṃ śataṃ tu vijñeyā anyeṣāṃ viṃśaktikramaḥ |
dvitīyasya śataṃ sārdhamanyeṣāṃ saptatrikramaḥ || 4-13 ||

nābhasāścātra vijñeyāstṛtīyasya tathaiva ca |
vāyavyāḥ kramato jñeyā hakārasya śatatrayam || 4-14 ||

kṣārṇasya ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā syānnābhasā nājña saṃśaya |
agnyaṃśavaḥ kṣakārasya vijñeyā vai śatatrayam || 4-15 ||

hārṇasya ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā syādanye tulyā na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃ raśmikramaḥ proktaḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca || 4-16 ||

gopanīyaḥ prayatnena svayoniriva pārvati |
nāśiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ nābhaktāya kadācana || 4-17 ||

datte ca siddhihāniḥ syādityājñā pārameśvarī |
gurutaḥ śāstrato jñātvā sākṣātparaśivo bhavet || 4-18 ||

svarāḥ ṣoḍaśa vikhyātāḥ sparśāste pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
vyāpakā daśa saṃproktāḥ somasūryāgnirūpiṇaḥ || 4-19 ||

guṇatrayātmakāḥ kāmavasudharmapradāḥ kramāt |
tattvatrayātmakāścaiva bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpiṇaḥ || 4-20 ||

mūrtitrayātmakāḥ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakāriṇaḥ |
dhāmatrayātmakāścaiva hyādimadhyāntarūpiṇaḥ || 4-21 ||

eteṣāṃ vaibhavaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu devi samāhitā |
tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥsthānārohaṇādyavarohataḥ || 4-22 ||

samastavyastarūpeṇa pratilomānulomataḥ |
avasthātrayarūpeṇa vyāpyavyāpakabhedataḥ || 4-23 ||

tejasāṃ śaktimūrtīnāṃ varṇagumphitayogataḥ |
sūtraprāyātmakatvena kuṇḍalinyā vidhānataḥ || 4-24 ||

aṣṭātriṃśatkalā jñeyā mantravīryārthakāriṇaḥ |
svarāṇāṃ ṣoḍaśa proktāḥ pṛthaksomakalāḥ kramāt || 4-25 ||

sparśānāṃ mārṇarāhitye ṣaṭṣaṭ sūryakalāḥ pṛthak |
vyāpakānāṃ kalāḥ vahneḥ pṛthag daśa daśaiva hi || 4-26 ||

ārohaṇe'rghasaṃkhyāstāstathā syuravarohaṇe |
prakṛtisthā vijānīyādraverubhayathākalāḥ || 4-27 ||

aprākṛtāḥ somakalā vahneścāpi na saṃśayaḥ |
mārṇasyobhayathā proktāḥ ṣaṭsaptatikalāḥ kramāt || 4-28 ||

aṣṭāviṃśattathārohe'pyavarohe tathaiva ca |
etā nijakalāḥ proktāḥ pūrṇamaṇḍalarūpiṇaḥ || 4-29 ||

tatsvarūpānusandhānasiddheḥ samyaktvayogataḥ |
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vāpyaṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vā || 4-30 ||

aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāto japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
vīryayukto bhavenmantrastvanāyāsena siddhyati || 4-31 ||

nijāḥ kalāste saṃproktāḥ saṃkīrṇāśca śṛṇu priye |
tato'ṣṭāviṃśadarṇānāmaṣṭātriṃśat pṛthakpṛthak || 4-32 ||

kabhādikaṭhaḍāntāśca dvādaśārṇā raveḥ smṛtāḥ |
svarāḥ ṣoḍaśa somasya vahneryādi daśaiva hi || 4-33 ||

catuścatvāriṃśadabdhiśataṃ sahasrameva ca |
somasūryāgnirūpiṇyaḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ syuḥ kalāstathā || 4-34 ||

asaṃkīrṇāstathā proktāḥ pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyakāḥ |
sarvāḥ kalāstāḥ saṃproktāḥ sahasre dve ca viṃśatiḥ || 4-35 ||

kalā mārṇasya saṃkīrṇāḥ sahasraṃ ca catuḥśatam |
catuścatvāriṃśaditi niḥśeṣaṃ samudāhṛtāḥ || 4-36 ||

hrasvasvarāstu puṃrūpā dīrghāḥ strīrūpiṇaḥ sadā |
svarāṇāṃ madhyagaṃ yattaccatuṣkaṃ tu napuṃsakam || 4-37 ||

kādivarṇāḥ smṛtāḥ kecid puṃrūpāḥ strīsvarūpakāḥ |
kecinnapuṃsakāḥ kecitsarve te hyūbhayātmakāḥ || 4-38 ||

makāraḥ kevalaṃ proktaḥ puruṣastu sadāśivaḥ |
bindurūpī ca sarvātmā sākṣī sarvatra sarvadā || 4-39 ||

tathā ca vyomavarṇānāṃ svarūpaṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
hakāraḥ paramaṃ vyoma bindurūpī sadāśivaḥ || 4-40 ||

nirguṇo nirmalaḥ śuddho nityarūpī nirañjanaḥ |
puruṣastu guṇātīto makāraḥ saguṇaḥ pumān || 4-41 ||

śakāro'mbvātmakaṃ vyoma śabdātītaṃ nirañjanam |
nakāraḥ śūnyarūpī syādanilātmakakhaṃ śive || 4-42 ||

ṇakāro dharaṇīyukto vyomarūpī ca saṃsphuṭaḥ |
ñakāro'pi tathaivokto ṅakāro marudātmakaḥ || 4-43 ||

ḷḹkārau vyomavarṇau pārthivānalasaṃbhavau |
svarūpaṃ vāyuvarṇānāṃ śṛṇuṣva parameśvari || 4-44 ||

yakāro nirguṇo vāyurūpī prāṇamayaḥ śivaḥ | 
ṣakāro jīvabhūtaśca jīvanātmā samīraṇaḥ || 4-45 ||

pakāro vahnirūpī syādvāyuḥ sparśātmakaḥ paraḥ |
takāro vyomarūpī syādvāyuḥ sarvārthatattvagaḥ || 4-46 ||

ṭakāraḥ stambharūpī syādvāyuḥ kṣityātmakaḥ paraḥ |
cakāro'gnyātmako vāyuḥ saumyarūpī maheśvaraḥ || 4-47 ||

kakāraḥ khātmako vāyuḥ sarvalokavimohanaḥ |
ekāro rudrarūpī syādvāyurvyomātmakaḥ paraḥ || 4-48 ||

p. 60)

ākāraḥ śabdarūpī syādvāyuragnyātmakaḥ paraḥ |
akāraḥ saguṇo vāyustejasāṃ nidhiravyayaḥ || 4-49 ||

svarūpamagnivarṇānāṃ vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
rephastu sarvabījānāṃ caitanyaṃ niṣkalaṃ param || 4-50 ||

āgneyamakṣaraṃ śuddha nirmalīkaraṇārthakam |
kṣakāro mārutavyāpī saguṇānilavarṇakaḥ || 4-51 ||

phakāro'gnyātmako varṇo vyomarūpī parātparaḥ |
thakāro vyomarūpī syādāgneyo vyaktavigrahaḥ || 4-52 ||

ṭhakāro'gniścandrarūpī salilātmakamakṣaram |
chakāro'mbvātmako'gniśca sarvastambhanakārakaḥ || 4-53 ||

khavarṇo mārutavyāpī tejovarṇaḥ parātparaḥ |
aikāro'gnirvāyurūpī sarvamantrārthajīvanaḥ || 4-54 ||

tejastrayātmako vahnirikāraḥ śāktamakṣaram |
īkāro'gnirvāyurūpī sarvabījātmakaḥ paraḥ || 4-55 ||

svarūpaṃ bhūmivarṇānāṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye |
(sa ? la) kāraḥ pṛthivīvarṇo nirguṇaḥ paramavyayaḥ || 4-56 ||

(la ? la) kāraḥ saguṇo bhūmivarṇo vāyvātmakaḥ paraḥ |
bakāro'mṛtarūpī syāt kṣitivarṇo'vyayaḥ paraḥ || 4-57 ||

dakāro'gnyātmakaḥ śambhurbhūmivarṇo mahān prabhuḥ |
ḍakāraḥ kṣitivarṇaḥsyāt............ || 4-58 ||

jārṇo'mṛtātmako jñeyo bhṛmivarṇo'mṛtapradaḥ |
gakāro vāyurūpī syāt kṣitivarṇo nirodhakṛt || 4-59 ||

okāro vyomarūpī syāddharāvarṇaḥ parātparaḥ |
ūkāro'gnyātmakaḥ śambhurviśvarūpī dharārṇakaḥ || 4-60 ||

ukāro'nilarūpī syāddhararṇo vyāpakaḥ paraḥ |
svarūpaṃ jalavarṇānāṃ vakṣye śṛṇu maheśvari || 4-61 ||

vakāro'mṛtabījaṃ syānnirguṇaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ |
sakāraścandrarūpī syācchāktārṇo jalarūpadhṛt || 4-62 ||

dharātmako bhakāraḥ syājjalārṇaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ |
vyomātmako dhakāraḥ syātpāthasārṇo maheśvaraḥ || 4-63 ||

ḍhakāro jalavarṇaḥ syādviśvavyāpī dharātmakaḥ |
vāyvātmako jhakāraḥ syājjalārṇaḥ puruṣo'vyayaḥ || 4-64 ||

ghakāro vāyurūpī syātsalilārṇo mahān prabhuḥ |
aukāro vyomarūpī syādvyomavyāpī jalārṇakaḥ || 4-65 ||

ṛ ṝ vahnyātmakau jñeyau jalārṇau śivarūpiṇau |
vaibhavaṃ mātṛkārṇānāṃ proktaṃ te parameśvari || 4-66 ||

tejastrayavidhānaṃ te proktaṃ yadvarṇarūpataḥ |
tena rūpeṇa mantrāṇāṃ bhāvanārūpato'niśam || 4-67 ||

vīryaprakāśanaṃ viddhi sarvamantreṣu gopitam |
mantravīrya smaran mantrī japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ || 4-68 ||

acireṇaiva kālena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate |

iti | śrītantrarāje-

mantravīrya śṛṇu prājñe kathayāmi sukhāspadam |
yena vijñānamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 4-1 ||

tejasāṃ śaktimūrtīnāṃ prapañcasyāpi kāraṇam |
guṇatrayamamīṣāṃ ca yatkāraṇamudāhṛtam || 4-2 ||

tatsvarūpānusaṃdhānasiddhiḥ samyaktvamīritam |
tanmantravīryamuddiṣṭaṃ mantrāṇāṃ jīva īritaḥ || 4-3 ||

asamyaktvaṃ tu mantrāṇāmayogyakathanena vai |
sadā prayogād bhajanādakāle saṃśayād bhavet || 4-4 ||

guroravajñayā pāpānniṣiddhācārayogataḥ |
devatādrohataḥ sarvaparivādānavasthayā || 4-5 ||

asaṃpradāyādajñānādanekabhajanādapi |
tatsamyaktvaṃ yena bhavedvīryaṃ tatpūrvamīritam || 4-6 ||

iti | uttaratantre-

mantravīryaṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca |
yasyājñānena niyataṃ mantrā niścetanāṃ gatāḥ || 4-1 ||

mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām |
vidyutkoṭinibhāṃ devīṃ candrakoṭiprabhāmayīm || 4-2 ||

jagadutpattirakṣāntakāriṇīṃ jñānacitkalām |
aṣṭātriṃśatkalārūpāṃ sarvamantramayīṃ parām || 4-3 ||

sarvatejomayīṃ divyāṃ paramāmṛtajṛmbhiṇīm |
ṣaṭcakramārganilayāṃ vyomaṣaṭkāvalambinīm || 4-4 ||

ciraṃ dhyātvā sādhakendraḥ ṣaṭ cakrāṇi vibhāvya ca |
tadantaraṣṭatriṃśābjanicaya ca vibhāvya ca || 4-5 ||

tattadabjasthitān varṇān kuṇḍalīsūtragumphitān |
tejastrayātmakān dhyātvā sūryāgnīndukalā smaret || 4-6 ||

gamāgamavibhedena tiryagūrdhvavibhedataḥ |
avasthāpañcakāṅgena hyadha ūrdhvavibhedataḥ || 4-7 ||

p. 61)

samastavyastarūpeṇa sarvāvasthāṃ gatā yataḥ |
grathanādikrameṇaiva ṣaṭkarmasu viśeṣataḥ || 4-8 ||

tejastrayātmakairvarṇairmūlamantraṃ suyojya ca |
japitvā bhāvayenmantrī tattaccakrārṇakaiḥ pṛthak || 4-9 ||

tatastu brahmakaṃkāle dhyāyeccakrakramaṃ sudhīḥ |
ādhāracakraṃ prathamaṃ kuladīpamanantaram || 4-10 ||

vajracakraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ svādhiṣṭhānātmakaṃ param |
raudraṃ karālacakraṃ ca gahvarātmakameva ca || 4-11 ||

vidyāpadaṃ ca trimukhaṃ tripadaṃ kāladaṇḍakam |
jhaṅkāracakraṃ ca tataḥ kāloṅgāraṃ karaṅkakam || 4-12 ||

dīpakaṃ kṣobhakaṃ jhambhakānandakalikātmakam |
maṇipūrakasaṃjñaṃ ca lākulaṃ kālabhedanam || 4-13 ||

mahotsāhaṃ ca paramaṃ mādakaṃ padamucyate |
anāhatāntaṃ cakrāṇi chandaḥsaṃkhyātmakāni vai || 4-14 ||

tatastu vaiṣṇavaṃ cakraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ tataḥ |
viśuddhaṃ lambikāntaṃ ca lambikāsthānameva ca || 4-15 ||

inducakraṃ binducakraṃ nādaṃ nādāntameva ca |
śakticakraṃ sahasrārametāni dvādaśaiva tu || 4-16 ||

aṣṭātriṃśatkalāsthānānīti cakrakramaḥ priye |
ādhārāddaśa (cakrāṇi) vahnisthānāni sundari || 4-17 ||

tato dvādaśacakrāṇi raveḥ sthānāni vai priye |
tadūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśānyatra cakrāṇīndoḥ sureśvari || 4-18 ||

kuṇḍalinyā mahāśakteḥ sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā |
sarvāḥ kalāstāścāgneyyaḥ sarvāḥ saurāḥ maheśvari | 19 ||

sarvāḥ saumyāḥ prajāyante bhāvanāmātrataḥ śive |
agnitrayaṃ tathā sūryatrayaṃ somatrayaṃ tathā || 4-20 ||

navadhā bhidyate devi dvāvagnau sūrya eva ca |
tathā somaḥ prātilomyāddvayamindvarkayostathā || 4-21 ||

evaṃ dvādaśadhā devi bhidyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
agnisūryendavaścaiva indusūryāgnayastataḥ || 4-22 ||

sūryasomāgnayaścaiva agnīndvarkāstathaiva ca |
sūryasomāgnayaścaiva agnisūryendavastathā (?) || 4-23 ||

aṣṭādaśa prabhedāḥ syuḥ pratilomānulomataḥ |
sāṃkaryabhedāḥ sañjātā navaiva parameśvari || 4-24 ||

evaṃ bhedā bhavantyaṣṭacatvāriṃśat krameṇa vai |
etairbhedairmūlamantragrathanādirihocyate || 4-25 ||

mantrāḥ sarve maheśāni sakṛduccāramātrataḥ |
vīryavantī bhavantyeva satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 4-26 ||

athavānyaprakāreṇa mantravīryaṃ śṛṇu priye |
aṣṭātriṃśatkalārūpā mālā sarvārthasādhinī || 4-27 ||

makāraṃ merurūpaṃ tu kṛtvāṣṭātriṃśadeva hi |
ekasyaikasya saṃkhyāṅkaṃ (?) japtvā mantraṃ prāsiddhyati || 4-28 ||

athavānyaprakāreṇa mantravīryaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat |
vāgbhavaṃ brahmaṇo bījaṃ śrībījaṃ viṣṇubījakam || 4-29 ||

māyābījaṃ tu rudrasya bījatrayamudāhṛtam |
tejastrayātmakaṃ caiva guṇatrayamayaṃ priye || 4-30 ||

trimūrtīnāṃ kalādau tu tribījaṃ yojayet pṛthak |
pūrvavat prajapenmantraṃ grathanādivibhedataḥ || 4-31 ||

mantravīryaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ nacānyathā |
athavānyaprakāreṇa mantravīryaṃ śṛṇu priye || 4-32 ||

hakāraḥ sūrya ākhyātaḥ sūryo vahnyātmakaḥ priye |
sakāraḥ soma ākhyāta aukāraḥ somarūpadhṛt || 4-33 ||

bindustu gaganaṃ devi sarveṣāṃ samarūpadhṛt |
yo japet prāṇadūtīnāmādau bījaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 4-34 ||

sahasraṃ prajaped devi grathanādivibhedataḥ |
sarvadoṣānapāsyaivaṃ vīryavāñjāyate manuḥ || 4-35 ||

evaṃ caturdhā yatproktaṃ mantravīryaprakāśanam |
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena svayoniriva pārvati || 4-36 ||

mantravīryaṃ śṛṇu prājñe prakārāntarato bhṛśam |
dīkṣākāle tu yadrūpaṃ svasyānugrahakarmaṇi || 4-37 ||

śrīguroḥ sāvadhānena tadrūpaṃ parameśvari |
bhāvayan vyomacakre'smin paramāmṛtajṛmbhite || 4-38 ||

sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ mātṛkākṣaramālayā |
śrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi vīryavāñjāyate manuḥ || 4-39 ||

sugamo'yaṃ prakāraḥ syād durlabho bhuvanatraye |

iti || dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām-

atha vakṣye maheśāni mātṛkāṃ lokamātaram | 
akārādikṣakārāntavarṇāvayavadevatām || 4-1 ||

iti uttaratantre-

atha samyaṅmātṛkāyā vidhānamabhidhīyate |
aśeṣaduḥkhaśamanaṃ samastajñānadīpanam || 4-1 ||

p. 62)

prokto brahmā muniśchando gāyatraṃ devatā matā |
sarasvatī sarvadevavanditā'ninditaprabhā || 4-2 ||

samastamātṛkāyāstu halo bījāni śaktayaḥ |
svarāḥ syuḥ parameśāni jātyā vyaktistu kīlakam || 4-3 ||

anirvācyānāṃ halāṃ svarasaṃyogena suvācyatvaṃ vyaktistatkīlakamityarthaḥ | 
anirvācyā halo varṇāḥ śaktyā vyaktā bhavanti hi iti tatraivoktatvāt || 
siddhasārasvatatantre-

dakṣahastatale pṛṣthe karabheṃ'guṣṭhakādiṣu |
kaniṣṭhāntāsu vāme ca kaniṣṭhāditalāvadhi || 4-1 ||

svarān ṣoḍaśa deveśi kevalān vinyaset priye |
dakṣahastatalāntaṃ tu nyaset saṃhāra īritaḥ || 4-2 ||

dakṣahastatalād devi vāmahastatalāvadhi |
nyasedvisargasaṃyuktān sṛṣṭireṣā prakīrtitā || 4-3 ||

vāmahastakaniṣṭhāditattalāvadhi vinyaset |
bindusargayutānaṣṭau ḷkārādīn svarān punaḥ || 4-4 ||

dakṣahastatalād devi tatkaniṣṭhāvadhi priye | 
akārādi ṝkārāntān sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ || 4-5 ||

vāmahastakaniṣṭhādipañcasvaṃgulīṣu kramāt |
takārādiśakārāntān parvasvekaikaśo nyaset || 4-6 ||

aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntāsvaṃgulīṣu tathā nyaset |
dakṣahaste ca deveśi kādiṇāntān sthitikramāt || 4-7 ||

hakārādīn pañcavarṇān yugapat karayornyaset |
aṃguṣṭhādiṣvaṃgulīṣu vyāpakatvena sundari || 4-8 ||

karaśuddhiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ mātṛkārṇairmaheśvari |
ṣaḍaṅgāni nyaset paścādvakṣyamāṇena vartmanā || 4-9 ||

iti | bhairavītantre-

tataścāsyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyaseddeśikottamaḥ |
amāṃmadhye kavargaḥ syādimīṃmadhye cavargakaḥ || 4-1 ||

umūṃmadhye ṭavargaḥ syādemaiṃmadhye tavargakaḥ |
omauṃmadhye pavargaḥ syādanusvāravisargayoḥ || 4-2 ||

yaśavargau salakṣau sto jātiyuktānimān nyaset |

candrārdhāṅkitaśekharāṃ trinayanāṃ pañcāśadarṇaiḥ kramād 
vyāptāṅgīṃ śaradindukundarucirāṃ vakṣojabhārānvitām |
dānaṃ cākṣavaṭīṃ sudhārasalasatkumbhaṃ śubhaṃ pustakaṃ 
vibhrāṇāṃ karapaṅkajairbhagavatīṃ padmāsanasthāṃ bhaje || 4-1 ||

ādāvabhyantare nyasya ṣaḍādhāreṣu mantravit |
akārādikṣakārāntāṃ tato dehe bahirnyaset || 4-2 ||

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtau-

kalāpatrāmbuje kaṇṭhe svarān samyak pravinyaset |
hṛdyarkapatre tadvarṇān nābhau daśadale nyaset || 4-1 ||

daśavarṇān liṅgamūle ṣaḍdale ṣaṭ tatheśvari |
caturdale tathādhāre caturvarṇāṃstatheśvari || 4-2 ||

bhrūmadhye dvidale hakṣāvityantarmātṛkāṃ nyaset |

iti | uttaratantre-

mastake mukhavṛtte ca netrakarṇeṣu vinyaset |
nāsāgaṇḍoṣṭhadanteṣu samūrdhāsyeṣu vinyaset || 4-1 ||

pāṇipādayugasyāpi sandhyagreṣu nyaset kramāt |
pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhasannābhijaṭhareṣu pravinyaset || 4-2 ||

hṛddormūlakakudvāmadormūleṣu hṛdādiṣu |
karapadyugale caiva jaṭharānanayornyaset || 4-3 ||

vyomāntasaurasanayā yutakarṇikaṃ tat kiñjalkagaṃ svarayugaṃ pravilikhya patre |
vargāṣṭakaṃ tadanu bhūmipureṇa vītamāśāsu vākṣarayujāśriṣu ṭāntayuktam || 4-4 
||

asmin pīṭhe yajeddevīṃ navaśaktisamanvite |
medhā prajñā prabhā vidyā dhīrdhṛtismṛtibuddhayaḥ || 4-5 ||

vidyeśvarīti gaditā bhāratyāḥ pīṭhaśaktayaḥ |

iti | siddhasārasvate-

bījaṃ ca sarvaśaktyante kamalāsanamuccaret |
ṅe'ntaṃ namaḥ padaṃ brūyādayaṃ pīṭhamanurmataḥ || 4-1 ||

p. 63)

bījaṃ yantramadhyastham | tathā-

aṅgādi saṃyajedādau svaradvandvaṃ tato'rcayet |
aṣṭa vargāṃstato'bhyarcya tacchaktīrarcayet kramāt || 4-2 ||

kundābhāścāpavidyāyukkarayugmā daleṣvimāḥ |
vyāpinī pālinī yuktā pāvanī kledinī tataḥ || 4-3 ||

dhāriṇī mālinī ṣaṣṭhī haṃsinī śāntinī tathā |
tataḥ sampūjayenmantrī brāhmyādyāstadanantaram || 4-4 ||

lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi pūjayayet kramataḥ sudhīḥ |
evaṃ kuryānnyāsajālaṃ japellakṣaṃ ca mantravit || 4-5 ||

taddaśāṃśena juhuyānmadhuratrayalolitaiḥ |
tilaiḥ śuddhaistarpaṇādi tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ || 4-6 ||

evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānnijavāṃchitān |
sādhayet sarvasiddhyarthaṃ gurvanujñāpuraḥsaram || 4-7 ||

svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tathā tāmraṃ vargaṣoḍaśadiṅmitam |
etaistu racitaṃ samyagrucakaṃ sarvakāmadam || 4-8 ||

vargaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ dig daśa rucakamaṃgulīyakam |

aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japitvā juhuyāttathā |
ghṛtena tatsamādāya siktaṃ sampātasarpiṣā || 4-9 ||

abhiṣekaprakāreṇa ghaṭe vinyasya mudrikām |
mātṛkāṃ pūjayettatra sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ budhaḥ || 4-10 ||

abhiṣiktāya śiṣyāya mudrāṃ tāṃ vitared guruḥ |
mudrādhārī grahakṣudradasyumārīsarīsṛpaiḥ || 4-11 ||

vimuktaḥ suciraṃ jīvet prathamaṃ vijayī bhavet | 

iti | mantratantraprakāśe-

somasūryāgnirūpāḥ syurvarṇā lohatrayaṃ tathā |
rūpyaminduḥ smṛto hema sūryastāmraṃ hutāśanaḥ || 4-1 ||

lohabhāgāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ svarādyakṣarasaṃkhyayā |
tairlohaiḥ kārayenmudrāmasaṅkalitasaṅgatām || 4-2 ||

sāgraṃ sahasraṃ sañjapya spṛṣṭvā tāṃ juhuyāttataḥ |
tasyāṃ sampātayenmantrī sarpiṣā pūrvasaṃkhyayā || 4-3 ||

iti | uttaratantre-

toyaṃ pibed dinādau yastrivārajaptametayā |
vatsarāñjāyate samyak sa mūko'pi kavitvabhāk || 4-1 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ prātaḥsandhyāvandananāntaraṃ culukena jalamādāya tanmadhye 
vakṣyamāṇamātṛkāyantraṃ vibhāvyākārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ sañjapya 
tajjalamamṛtaṃ bhāvayan mūlādhārāt jihvāgrāntaṃ sārasvatīṃ nāḍīṃ 
dīpaśikhākārāṃ dhyāyaṃstasyāṃ homadhipā pibet | evaṃ pratidinaṃ 
kurvataścaturvidhaṃ pāṇḍityaṃ vaktṛtvavyākhyātṛtvavāditvakavitvaṃ ceti 
svātmajñānaṃ ca bhavatīti paramarahasyārthaḥ | tathā - brāhmīrasena vacayā payasā 
pācayed ghṛtam | ghṛtaṃ goghṛtam atrauṣadhiṃtrayamapi samabhāgaṃ grāhyam || 

ayutaṃ japtamanayā bhakṣitaṃ kavitāpradam |
akṣarauṣadhisamparkapayasā pūrayet ghaṭam || 4-2 ||

payasā jalena | 

sahasrajaptena tataḥ sādhyaṃ siñcet sumantravit |
sa syānmedhendirā kīrtidīrghāyuḥkavitāyutaḥ || 4-3 ||

bandhyā ca labhate putraṃ nānāguṇagaṇālayam |

iti | tantrarāje-

vṛttadvayāvṛtaṃ cāṣṭapatramabjaṃ mahīpuram |
vidhāya vilikhenmadhye haṃsahṛdvanaśaktikam || 4-1 ||

kūṭaṃ svarān kesareṣu vargān patreṣu cālikhet |
pañcapañcākṣaropetān dāvāmbu digvidikṣu ca || 4-2 ||

svareṣvapunaruktāni pañcānyāni tu pañca vai |
savyañjanāvyañjanatvabhedato'bhūd dviranvayaḥ || 4-3 ||

savātāgnidharāsvena śaktistatpañcakaṃ bhavet |

haṃso hakāraḥ hṛt sakāraḥ vanamaukāraḥ śaktirvisargaḥ dāvaṣṭhakāraḥ ambu 
vakāra | vāto'kāraḥ agnirikāraḥ dharā ukāraḥ khamanusvāraḥ śaktirvisargaḥ | 
athaitadyantraracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvadeva madhyasthakūṭādisakalavarṇān 

p. 64)

vilikhya ṣaṣṭhasaptamāṣṭadaleṣu ṣaṣṭhe : yaralavaśa saptame : ṣasahalakṣa iti 
vargadvayaṃ vilikhyāṣṭame : a i u aṃ aḥ iti pañcākṣarāṇi vilikhya caturasre'pi 
prāgvadeva vakāraṭakāro vilikhet | atthā :

etadyantrasya madhyasthaṃ nāma kṛtvā prayojayet |
prātarmūrdhni smaredindubimbasthaṃ sarvasampadam || 4-1 ||

abhiṣekāt dhāraṇācca pūjanāllohakalpite |
sthāpanād gṛhadeśādau yantraṃ sarvārthasiddhidam || 4-2 ||

etadyantrasya madhyasthā devatāḥ sakalā api | 
sannidhi phaladānaṃ ca sādhakānāṃ vitanvate || 4-3 ||

iti | atha pūrvoktaślokasyāpyayamartha | uṣaḥkāle 
brahmarandhrasthasahasradalakamalamadhyagatacandramaṇḍalamadhye proktayantraṃ 
svābhīṣṭasādhyanāmagarbhaṃ bhāvayet tena tatphalaprāptirbhavati | athavā 
bhūmāvevaitadyantraṃ sindūrādinotkīrya tatra prāguktavidhinā kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya 
varṇauṣadhikvāthajalenāpūrya tatra devīṃ sampūjyābhiṣekataḥ 
svābhimataphalaprāptirbhavati | yadvā bhūrjādāvālikhya yathāvidhi dhāraṇāt 
svarṇādikalpite yantre prāguktavidhinā devyāḥ pūjanāttāmrādau kalpitasya gṛhādau 
yathātridhi bhūmyantaḥsthāpanācca svābhimataphalasiddhirbhavati || 
dvitīyaślokasyāyamarthaḥ | tatra sakaladevatācakrapratiṣṭhāsu 
suvarṇarajatatāmrādyanyatamena kṛte paṭṭe yantramutkīryaṃ madhye 
sambuddhyantatattaddevatānāmapūrvakam sannidhehīti vilikhya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ 
vidhāya tatra devīṃ samabhyarcya mātṛkayā lakṣamātraṃ tadyantraṃ spṛśañjapitvā 
tattvavit pūrṇātmā supūjitaṃ taccakraṃ prathamaṃ bhūmyantaḥ saṃsthāpya tadupari 
nijavāṃchitadevatāmūrti yathāvidhi sthāpayet | evaṃ kṛte tasyāṃ mūrtau tasyā 
devatāyāḥ sānnidhyaṃ saviśeṣaṃ bhavati sthāpayituśca sakalamabhīpsitaṃ phalaṃ 
bhavatīti || athaitanmātṛkāyā ye ye nyāsabhedā vartante teṣāmapi pūjopāsanādikaṃ 
sarvaṃ proktavidhinaiva vidheyam || uttaratantre |

nyasedbindvantikāmenāṃ saṃhāreṇa vilokataḥ | 
pūrvoktā eva munyādyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca tathā bhavet || 4-1 ||

saṃcintya sṛṣṭimārgeṇa vinyaset sargasaṃyutām |
bindusargasthitāṃ sthityāṃ ḍādiṭhārṇāntikāṃ nyaset || 4-2 ||

pūrvoktā eva munyādyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca tathā bhavet |

iti | śrīkulārṇave-

yativaikhānasaiḥ kāryaḥ saṃhārāntaḥ kuleśvari | 
nyāso gṛhasthaiḥ sthityantaḥ sṛṣṭyanto varṇināṃ bhavet || 4-1 ||

iti | uttaratantre-

praṇavotthakalāyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset tataḥ |
varṇādikā namontāstā nyastavyā dhruvasaṃyutāḥ || 4-1 ||

ṛṣiḥ prajāpatiḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam | 
sarasvatī kalārūpā devatā parikīrtitā || 4-2 ||

hrasvadīrghasvaradvandvagatairaṅgaṃ dhruvairbhavet |
keśavādihṛdāyuktāṃ nyasettāṃ kāmapūrvakām || 4-3 ||

yādīn dhātuyutān nyaset prāṇaśaktyātmamūrtibhiḥ |
sādhyanārāyaṇa ṛṣirgāyatraṃ chanda īritam || 4-4 ||

lakṣmīnārāyaṇo devi devatā parikīrtitā |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktakāmāntaiḥ prāgvadvargaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 4-5 ||

nyaset tārtīyasaṃyuktāṃ hṛdantāṃ rudrapūrvakām |
yādīn dhātusamāyuktān prāṇaśaktyātmabhiḥ saha || 4-6 || 

munistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiśchando gāyatramucyate |
ardhanārīśvaro devi devatā parikīrtitā || 4-7 ||

ṣaḍdīrghayuktatārtīyaprativargaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
māyādyāṃ mātṛkāṃ devi nyaset sādhakattattamaḥ || 4-8 ||

muniḥ śaktiḥ samākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
devatā jagatāmādirmātṛkā bhuvaneśvarī || 4-9 ||

ṣaḍdīrghayuktamāyāntairvargaiḥ prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgakam |
śrīyutāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasedvidhivat parameśvari || 4-10 ||

munirbhṛguḥ samākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktaśrībījayutairvargaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 4-11 ||

kāmabījayutāṃ nyasenmātṛkāṃ kamalekṣaṇe |
saṃmohano muniśchando gāyatrī devatā priye || 4-12 ||

saṃmohinī samākhyātā devatā viśvamohinī |
dīrghayuktena kāmena yutairvargaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam || 4-13 ||

māyālakṣmīsmarārūḍhāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset priye |
prapañcayāgakarmātha vakṣyate bhuktimuktidam || 4-14 ||

p. 65)

pañcamantramayaṃ sarvasiddhisaṃpatpradāyakam |
mahāgaṇapatiṃ tvādau saṛṣicchandadaivatam || 4-15 ||

sāṅganyāsaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ dhyātvā tanmantramaṣṭadhā |
japed gāṇapataṃ bījaṃ saṛṣicchandadaivatam || 4-16 ||

catvāriṃśacca catvāri tathaiva prajapettataḥ |
sakṛdgāṇapataṃ mantraṃ japtvā vaidikamapyatha || 4-17 ||

mālāmantraṃ caturvāraṃ saṛṇyādiṃ japettataḥ |
mātṛkāṃ vinyased prāgvaddṛṣyādisahitāṃ tridhā || 4-18 ||

svarādisaptavargaistu grahān sapta pravinyaset |
mukhe vāhvoḥ pādayośca jaṭhare hṛdaye kramāt || 4-19 ||

tāro māyā ca haṃsaśca so'haṃ svāheti vai manuḥ |
prapañcayāgamantro'yamaṣṭārṇaḥ samudīritaḥ || 4-20 ||

prapañcayāgamantrasya munirbrahmā samīritaḥ |
paramādyā samākhyātā gāyatrī chanda īritam || 4-21 ||

mahaḥ paraṃ samākhyātaṃ devatā cinmayaṃ priye |
trayyante bodhitaṃ nityaṃ sarvavyāpi nirañjanam || 4-22 ||

vilomagaiḥ pañcamantraiḥ sārdhaṃ hariharākṣaraiḥ |
prāgvad vargāvasānasthaistāramāyādikaiḥ kramāt || 4-23 ||

ṣaḍaṅgāni prakurvīta jātiyuktāni mantravit |
vedādimāyayorante dattvādīn kramatastataḥ || 4-24 ||

mantraśeṣaṃ samuccārya homaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
prapañcayāganāmāyaṃ homaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥ || 4-25 ||

akārādistu śāntāntaḥ prathamo'tra manurmataḥ |
śāntāntaṃ ca hakārādyo dvitīyo mantra iṣyate || 4-26 ||

tṛtīyo'pi samākhyātaḥ sakārākārabindubhiḥ |
sakārākārasargaiścendriyaṣaṭkātmako bhavet || 4-27 ||

caturtho'pi ca sokārahakārākārabindubhiḥ |
bṛhatprayogāt brahmātra munitvena nigadyate || 4-28 ||

śreṣṭhārthavācakaṃ proktaṃ paramākhyaṃ padaṃ budhaiḥ |
gāyantaṃ trāyate yasmād gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate || 4-29 ||

yasmādatiśayaḥ kvāpi tejasāṃ naiva vidyate |
paraṃpadena tatproktaṃ paraṃ jyotiśca devatā || 4-30 ||

svargārthaiḥ svetiśabdo'yamātmārthe'pi tathā bhavet |
hā hānārtho'pi gatyarthaḥ sarvato bhāvatastataḥ || 4-31 ||

svargātmano svarūpaṃ yā vyāptatejaḥparaṃparā |
svāhākāreṇa cākhyātā hutiryasyāṃ samīritā || 4-32 ||

tejorūpaṃ tu yadvyāptaṃ saśabdena taducyate |
ahaṃpadena cātmāpi dvayoraikyaṃ tato bhavet || 4-33 ||

so'haṃ mantre vidhānena hakāre'haṃ vadet tataḥ |
sa ityanena cidrūpa sarvārthasyāvabhāsakam || 4-34 ||

satyaṃ vyāptaṃ ca nirlepaṃ haṃsamantraṃ vadet tataḥ |
carācasya jagataḥ sārabhūtaṃ guṇātmakam || 4-35 ||

janakaṃ sarvalokānāṃ māyābīṃjena cocyate |
akārādyairmakārāntaistribhirvījairguṇātmakaiḥ || 4-36 ||

bhāvasatyaṃ tu yatkuryāt praṇavārthaḥ sa ucyate | 
hṛddhāturharaṇārthaḥ syādaniṣṭaṃ mantriṇastu yat || 4-37 ||

saṃharet tanmahaḥ proktaṃ varṇairhariharairdhruvam |
prapañcayāgamantro'yaṃ prapañcasyādikāraṇam || 4-38 ||

prapañcayāga ākhyāto nyāso yena tu yaḥ kṛtaḥ |
aṅgārṇairjvalane dravyairhomo'tra dvividho mataḥ || 4-39 ||

akārādiṣu saṃyojya yathāpūrvaṃ vidhānavit |
sthāneṣu mātṛkokteṣu nyasadaṣṭākṣareṇa tu || 4-40 ||

sādhakendraḥ suśuddhātmā pañcāśadvāramanvaham |
varṇāḥ sarve tu vikhyātā bāhyajñānendriyātmakāḥ || 4-41 ||

pratyekendriyasaṃgrāhyaṃ jagad vyāptamatastu taiḥ |
parātparataraṃ loke jyotiraiśaṃ tu yadbhavet || 4-42 ||

tasmin brahmānale homo brahmajñairmantribhistu yaḥ |
kṛto jyotirmayaiḥ samyaṅmanubhistaṃ pracakṣate || 4-43 ||

brahmātmakahavirdravyaistadvide brahmaṇe'rpaṇam |
varṇānāṃ bhedato bhinnamitthaṃ śithilatāṃ gatam || 4-44 ||

śarīraṃ carmasannaddhaṃ śoṇitāmita saṃbhṛtam |
medomajjāsthisaṃyuktaṃ gatvaratvena saṃmatam || 4-45 ||

brahmānale mahāsvacche sarvavyāpte nirañjane |
yo juhoti kṛtī mantrī śuddhātmā mahatāṃ nidhiḥ || 4-46 ||

aśeṣaṃ mantrasaṃjāpye dhyāne pūjanakarmaṇi |
adhikārī sa eva syānnetaraḥ phalabhājanam || 4-47 ||

kevalo'pi ca vindvantaḥ kalādikeśavādikaḥ |
śrīkaṇṭhādyaiśca saṃyukto māyābījasamanvitaḥ || 4-48 ||

lakṣmyādyaḥ kāmabījādyo bījatrayayuto'pi ca |
prapañcayāgasaṃyuktā daśa nyāsāḥ samīritāḥ || 4-49 ||

p. 66)

vāñchitārthapradāḥ sarve sarvamantreṣu kalpitāḥ |
eteṣu śreṣṭha ākhyātaḥ prapañcāhvayayāgakaḥ || 4-50 ||

jñānadaḥ puṣṭidaścātha sarvasaṃpatkarastathā |
viśeṣato grahakṣudraprapañcājñānanāśakṛt || 4-51 || iti |

prapañcayāgamātreṇa yathā homo vidhīyate |
yadyaddravyaistathā tāni yadā yallabhyate budhaiḥ || 4-52 ||

etatsarvaṃ vidhānena kathayāmi yathātatham |
uktenaiva vidhānena gāṇapatyāvasānakam || 4-53 ||

ājyena juhuyānmantrī tadvadekāhutiṃ hunet |
prapañcayāgamantreṇa ghṛtenaiva tataḥ param || 4-54 ||

baṭodumbarasaṃbhūtāḥ parppaṭyaḥ pippalasya ca |
samidhastilasiddhārthahavirājyāni ca kramāt || 4-55 ||

parpaṭī plakṣaḥ |

etaddravyāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ hunedetena mantravit |
daśāyutaṃ vidhānena tadarddhamathavā tu yaḥ || 4-56 ||

yathābhilaṣitānatra bhogān bhuktvā sukhaṃ hi saḥ |
dehānte muktimāpnoti munibhiḥ prārthitāṃ tataḥ || 4-57 ||

cauraśatrugrahavyādhisarparākṣasadoṣanut |
catuḥśataṃ tadarddhaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā hutaṃ matam || 4-58 ||

tattaddoṣānusāreṇa homasaṃkhyāṃ pravardhayet |
ravisaṃkhyasahasrāṇi huned dravyāṣṭakena yaḥ || 4-59 ||

ettaddviguṇataścātha caturguṇata eva vā |
bhūtāveśagrahāveśajūrtyādīn sa vināśayet || 4-60 ||

śāstroktakramabhaṅgena japapūjādikṛttu yaḥ |
smṛtibhraṃśo bhavettasya homaṃ dravyāṣṭakena saḥ || 4-61 ||

sahasrasaṃkhyayā kuryāt svastho bhavati tatkṣaṇāt |
pratyekaṃ dvisahasraṃ yo huneddravyāṣṭakena tu || 4-62 ||

apasmāraṃ vismṛtiṃ ca śāpadoṣaṃ sa nāśayet |
dravyāṣṭakaṃ trimadhvaktaṃ lakṣamānaṃ hunet tu yaḥ || 4-63 ||

prādurbhūtena mahatā tasyaiśvaryeṇa tatkṣaṇāt |
devendrasya mahālakṣmīḥ sthirā tucchatarā bhavet || 4-64 ||

lakṣaṃ lakṣārddhakaṃ vātha madhuratrayalolitam |
dravyāṣṭakaṃ hunedyo vai vatsaratrayamadhyataḥ || 4-65 ||

trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya vaśe tiṣṭhati nānyathā |
vaśyādisādhanaṃ proktaṃ huned dravyāṣṭakena yat || 4-66 ||

hrāsavṛddhyādikaṃ home jānīyāt kāryagauravāt |
śuddhaistilaistu yo lakṣaṃ homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 4-67 ||

mahāpāpāni tasyāśu pralayaṃ yānti nānyathā |
lakṣaṃ kamalahomena mahālakṣmīḥ prajāyate || 4-68 ||

haviṣā puṣṭido homo yavahomo yaśaskaraḥ |
mālatīpuṣpahomo'pi sarvavaśyaprado bhavet || 4-69 ||

sāmudralavaṇaṃ hutvā tathā vaśyaṃ prasādhayet |
atha śālisamudbhūtāṃstaṇḍulān suṣṭhu cūrṇayet || 4-70 ||

madhuratrayasaṃyuktataccūrṇenaiva sādhakaḥ |
sādhyapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā samyak sampūjya tāṃ spṛśan || 4-71 ||

prāṇasthāpanamantraṃ tu japetsāṣṭaśataṃ tu tat |
bibhajya juhuyānmantrī nānyāsaktamanā niśi || 4-72 ||

saptarātraṃ prakurvāṇo naraṃ vā striyameva vā |
vaśīkaroti jhaṭiti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4-73 ||

sāmudralavaṇasyāpi puttalyāḥ phalamīdṛśam |
varṇauṣadhivipakvena pañcagavyena pūrite || 4-74 ||

cullyāṃ saṃsthāpya yo'dhastāhvahniṃ kumbhe pradīpayet |
prādurbhūte punastasmin ghaṭāgnau juhuyād ghṛtam || 4-75 ||

aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantrī bhasitaṃ patitaṃ ca yat |
tāvatsaṃkhyaṃ ca sañjapya gṛhṇīyāt sarvasiddhidam || 4-76 ||

bhakṣaṇād gātralepācca tilakakriyayā tathā |
mastake dhāraṇāt sadyaḥ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ || 4-77 ||

bhūtapretapiśācādiviṣarogādināśanam |
sarvavaśyakaraṃ puṃsāṃ śrīsaubhāgyajayapradam || 4-78 ||

sahasrasaṃkhyako homo tadānīṃ gurave budhaḥ |
palaṃ palārdhakaṃ vāpi dadyāddhemno varasya ca || 4-79 ||

kalpavṛkṣādyathā devā labhante vāñchitaṃ phalam |
prapañcayāgato'pyevaṃ sādhako'bhīṣṭamaśnute || 4-80 ||

iti | athaivaṃ mātṛkāvidyopāsakānāmanyavidyopāsakānāṃ ca 

prāṇāgnihotravidhiruktaḥ kālīmate tathā-

prāṇāgnihotraṃ vakṣyāmi sarvasiddhipradāyakam |
hitārthaṃ sarvalokasya mantriṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 4-1 ||

p. 67)

kṛtapadmāsanaḥ pūrvamamalāṅgaḥ śubhāsane |
upaviṣṭaḥ prasannātmā prāṅmukhaḥ sthiramānasaḥ || 4-2 ||

bhuvaneśohakāreṇa sattvarūpeṇa lāñchitam |
madhyamasya tadīyena vāmākṣirajasā vṛtam || 4-3 ||

repheṇa tamasā caiva veṣṭitaṃ ca trikoṇakam |
pūrvarākṣasavāyvasri mūlādhāraṃ vicintayet || 4-4 ||

madhye prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ ca kauveryyāṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
tasminneva same pañca smaret kuṇḍāni mantravit || 4-5 ||

sarvadā jvaladagnīni svīyakāryaprasiddhaye |
āvasarthyaṃ ca sabhyaṃ ca tathācāhavanīyakam || 4-6 ||

anvāhāryaṃ punaḥ proktaṃ gārhapatyaṃ bhavediti |
madhyādikramatastvevaṃ nāmato'mūni caiva hi || 4-7 ||

prabhājvālānidānāddhi jñānarūpānnirañjanāt |
mūlaprakṛtirūpācca kalpādityānnirañjanāt || 4-8 ||

dvādaśānsthitāt sarvavarṇahotuḥ parātmanaḥ |
nirgatāṃ mātṛkāṃ mantrī sudhāniḥṣyandarūpiṇīm || 4-9 ||

pratilomakramādbhinnāmekaikākṣarato dhiyā |
homayet teṣu kuṇḍeṣu jvaladagniṣu deśikaḥ || 4-10 ||

syuste mārakataprakhyāḥ kṣādayaḥ pañcavarṇakāḥ |
pañca yāntā bhavantyeva gomedābhāśca śādikāḥ || 4-11 ||

nīlavarṇāśca mādyāḥ syurnādyā vidrumasannibhāḥ |
ṇādayo vajrasaṃkāśāstāvantaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 4-12 ||

puṣparāgatvivaścāntāḥ kāntā vaiḍūryavarṇakāḥ |
aṣṭa svarāstu muktābhā māṇikyābhāstataḥ param || 4-13 ||

navaratnamayā hyete navavargāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
keturvidhuntado mando vākpatirbudha eva ca || 4-14 ||

bhārgavo bhaumacandrau ca bhāskaro nava kīrtitaḥ |
navavargādhipā hyete ratnānāmadhidevatāḥ || 4-15 ||

homamevaṃ vidhānena kuryurye'nudinaṃ budhāḥ |
pañcāśatsaṃkhyayā te syuḥ saṃmatāḥ bhuvanatraye || 4-16 ||

svarṇavastrādikairāḍhyā bhāgyavantaḥ śubhodayāḥ |
ye varṇā yatra hūyante tānahaṃ vacmi sāṃpratam || 4-17 ||

samvartakaṃ ca tatṣaṣṭhaṃ pañcavargāntikāstathā |
ṣoḍaśasvarajhiṇṭīśāvarghīśaśca tataḥ param || 4-18 ||

daśaitān vidhivat kuṇḍa āvasathyāhvaye hunet |
dharā bālīturīyaśca vargāṇāṃ ca turīyakān || 4-19 ||

mastakaṃ ca harākhyaṃ cāpyamareśaṃ daśāpyamūn |
sabhyākhye juhuyāt kuṇḍe mantravittadanantaram || 4-20 ||

nakulīśaṃ ca tatṣaṣṭhaṃ vargāṇāṃ ca tṛtīyakān |
sadyāntasthāṇuke cāpi vāmanetraṃ vaśī kramāt || 4-21 ||

saṃjuhotu yathānyāsaṃ kuṇḍa āhavanīyake | 
yasaptamadvitīyau ca vargāṇāṃ ca dvitīyakān || 4-22 ||

bhautikāntatithīśākhyau sūkṣmasaṃjñamanantaram |
anvāhāryābhidhe kuṇḍe varṇānetān hunet kramāt || 4-23 ||

vāyuṣaṣṭhaṃ ca vāyuṃ ca vargādyān pañca pādikān |
adharaṃ ca kriyāṃ cāpi nārāyaṇamimān daśa || 4-24 ||

gārhapatyābhidhe kuṇḍe hunenmantrī samāhitaḥ |
varṇahomaḥ krameṇaivaṃ yathāvat parikīrtitaḥ || 4-25 ||

ākāśena samaṃ sarvaṃ śabdajātaṃ tu mantravit |
āvasathyābhidhe kuṇḍe juhuyāt tadanantaram || 4-26 ||

vāyunā tadguṇaṃ pūrve vahninā paścime mataḥ |
rūpaṃ kuṇḍe hunenmantrī payasā rasasañcayam || 4-27 ||

uttarākhye hunet kuṇḍe dakṣiṇe tadanantaram |
dharayā sarvagandhaṃ ca mantravijjuhuyād vaśī || 4-28 ||

pralayānalasaṅkāśajvaladagniṣvaharniśam |
homaṃ kurvīta kuṇḍeṣu mātṛkāvarṇasaṃyutam || 4-29 ||

nityaśuddhaparānandacidrūpātmā prajāyate |
dhruvamāyādikaṃ homamajapāntaṃ tu pūrvavat || 4-30 ||

pañcāśatsaṃkhyayā kṛtvā nyasya tāvadyathāvidhi |
jīvanmukto bhavenmantrī cirañjīvī ca jāyate || 4-31 ||

tejasā sūryakalpo'sau kartā hartā ca śambhuvat |

iti | asyārthaḥ | tatra baddhapadmāsanaḥ prāṅmukho mṛdvāsane samupaviśya, 
prāguktalakṣaṇe svamūlādhāre bhuvaneśvarībījamantrasya sattvaguṇātmakena 
hakāreṇākrāntamadhyapradeśaṃ tasya rajoguṇātmakena vāmākṣaṇā 
īkāreṇāvṛtaṃ tamoguṇātmakena tadīyarepheṇa veṣṭitaṃ trikoṇamagnimaṇḍalaṃ 
pūrvanir-ṛtivāyavyagatānyasrāṇi koṇāni yasya tādṛśaṃ mūlādhāraṃ vicintya 
tasminmadhye 
pūrvapaścimottaradakṣeṣvāvasathyasabhyāhavanīyānvāhāryagārhapatyākhyāni 
pañca kuṇḍāni jvaladagniśikhāsamākulāni 

p. 68)

vāṃchitārthapradāni sañcintya 
sarvatejaḥprakāśapratibimbahetubhūtānavacchinnacaitanyātmakān 
sakalavarṇakāraṇaśabdabrahmātmakamūlaprakṛtyātmano dvādaśāntasthitān 
kalpāntāgniśikhāsphuratkuharakeṣu kuṇḍeṣu vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa varṇān manasā 
juhuyāt | tatra varṇānāṃ ratnavarṇatāmāha | syuriti | ratnānāmadhidaivatatvena 
grahānupadiśati | keturityādi | amṛtamayatvena dhyātānāṃ ratnasavarṇavarṇānāṃ 
homamāha homamiti | pañcakuṇḍeṣu pañcāśadvarṇānāmekaikasmin kuṇḍe 
hotavyān varṇān darśayati : saṃvartakamityādibhiḥ | saṃvartakaḥ kṣakārastasya 
ṣaṣṭhaḥ pratilomena śakāraḥ pañcavargāntikāḥ vilomena manaṇañaṅāḥ 
ṣoḍaśasvaraḥ aḥ jhiṇṭīśa ekāraḥ arghīśo hakāraḥ etān 
daśavarṇānāvasathyākhyakuṃḍe juhuyāt | dharā lakāraḥ vālīturīyo vakāraḥ 
vargaturīyakā vilomena bhadhaḍhajhaghāḥ mastakaṃ aṃ haraḥ ḹkāraḥ amareśa 
ukāraḥ etāndaśa varṇān sabhye juhuyāt | nakulīśo hakārastatṣaṣṭho lakāraḥ 
vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyakāḥ badaḍajagāḥ sadyānta aukāraḥ sthāṇuko ḷsvaraḥ 
vāmanetramīkāraḥ etāndaśa varṇān āhavanīye juhuyāt | (yasaptamadvitīyau 
sakārarakārau vargadvitīyāḥ phathaṭhachakhāḥ bhautikānta okāraḥ tithīśaḥ ṝ 
sūkṣma ikāraḥ etān daśa varṇān anvāhārye juhuyāt) | vāyuṣaṣṭhaḥ ṣakāraḥ 
vāyuryakāraḥ vargādyāḥ pataṭacakāḥ adhara aikāraḥ kriyā ṛsvaraḥ nārāyaṇa 
ākāraḥ etāndaśa varṇān gārhapatye juhuyāt | iti homakriyā || homaprakārastu oṃ hrīṃ 
kṣaṃ haṃsaḥ so'haṃ svāhā ityādikrameṇaikaikasmin kuṇḍe pratyekamakṣaraṃ 
punaḥpunarjuhuyāt | tatprakārastu - āvasathye kṣakāraṃ (sabhye lakāra) māhavanīye 
hakāramanvāhārye sakāraṃ gārhapatye ṣakāraṃ punarevaṃ krameṇa 
śakārādyakārāntān varṇān pañca pañca juhuyāt | athātra aḥ iti brahme ti śruteḥ 
pariśiṣṭhoḥ'kāraḥ sarvathātra brahmarūpeṇa dhyātavyaḥ ||

athaivaṃ kurvatāṃ sādhakānāṃ bhojanakāle kartavyaprāṇāgnihotramāha-
uttaratantre-

pratyahaṃ vidhānānena bhojanaṃ kurute yadi | 
gārhapatyādikuṇḍāni tadā prāṇādivāyavaḥ || 4-1 ||

uddharet kuṇḍanāmāni saptamīsahitāni tu |
prāṇādīnāṃ ca nāmāni saptamyantaṃ samuddharet || 4-2 ||

hiraṇyānantaraṃ varṇā gaganānantaraṃ tathā |
raktānte kṛṣṇaśabdānte suprabhānte tathā bhavet || 4-3 ||

śucayaḥ padamabhāṣya pāvakā iti coccaret |
agni vihṛtyaśabdānta ātmānaṃ ca tato vadet || 4-4 ||

upacaryapadaṃ paścādūrdhvādhastiryaguddharet |
punarūrdhvapadaṃ cādhastiryagūrdhvaṃ samaṃ vadet || 4-5 ||

gacchantu vahnijāyāntān pañca mantrān samuddharet |
ahaṃ vaiśvāpadaṃ paścānnaro bhūtvā padaṃ vadet || 4-6 ||

juhomyannaṃ padaṃ paścāccaturvidhapadaṃ caret |
pacāmyevaṃ padaṃ brūyād vidhānena padaṃ vadet || 4-7 ||

svāhāntaṃ sarvamuktvā tu tṛptiparyantamādarāt |
tūṣṇīṃ homaṃ vidhāyādau saṃskṛtānnena mantravit || 4-8 ||

amṛtetyādimantreṇa pītvā tu culukodakam |
ācamyavidhinā paścācchuddhācamanamācaret || 4-9 ||

mūlādhāraṃ samārabhya dvādaśāntāvadhi smaret |
jīvātmānaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ nityamevamananyagam || 4-10 ||

prakṛtisthaṃ śubhaṃ śāntamādyantarahitaṃ param |
havanīyena śuddhena hutenāpi sutarpitam || 4-11 ||

evaṃ galatsudhānnaṃ ca pañcāśadvarṇasecitam |
bhuktvā havirhutaṃ mantrī sa jvalatpañcavahnikaḥ || 4-12 ||

prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca kurvāṇo mantrī prāṇāgnihotrakam |
garbhasthitibhavaṃ kleśaṃ vindati kadācana || 4-13 || 

asyārthaḥ tatrādau prāṇādipañcamantrā uddhrīyante gārhapatyetyādibhiḥ | 
ayamarthaḥ - gārhapatye prāṇe hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ 
vihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaṃ gacchantu svāhā | anvāhārye'pāne gaganavarṇāḥ 
śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ vihṛtyātmānamupacaryādho gacchantu svāhā | āhavanīye 
vyāne raktavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ vihṛtyātmānamupacarya tiryaggacchantu 
svāhā | sabhya udāne kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ 
vihṛtyātmānamupacaryordhvaṃ gacchantu svāhā | āvasathye samāne suprabhāvarṇāḥ 
śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ vihṛtyātmānamupacaryādhastiryaggacchantu svāhā | 
ebhirmantraiḥ pañcāhutīḥ pañcakuṇḍeṣu hutvā 
gārhapatyānvāhāryāhavanīyasabhyāvasathyeṣu prāṇāpānavyānodānasamāneṣu 
hiraṇyagaganaraktakṛṣṇasuprabhāvarṇāḥ 

p. 69)

śucayaḥ pāvakā agniṃ vihṛtyātmānamupacarya ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā 
juhomyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ pacāmyevaṃ vidhānenordhvādhastiryak samaṃ gacchantu 
svāheti gārhapatyānvāhāryāhavanīyasabhyāvasathyānāṃ 
yamaśaśivaruṇendramadhyamāni sthitāni sañcintya 
pūrvāvadānebhyo'dhikaparimāṇenāvadānena hutvā paścāt tṛptiparyantaṃ 
homadhiyā bhuktvā amṛtāpidhānamasi mantreṇa culukodakaṃ prāśya 
śuddhācamanaṃ kuryāt || evaṃ kurvataḥ phalamāha prātaḥ sāyamityādi | 
prapañcabinduvinirgatāmṛtadhārayā 
samāsiktamakāravinirgatacandramaṇḍaladvayarūpeṇa visargaṃ dhyātvā tābhyāṃ 
prathamatarāgnīndutejovilasitābhyāmamṛtapūrṇasakāravinirgatāmṛtadhārayā 
samāsiktabindubhyāṃ nāḍīmārgeṇātmanaḥ sakalaśarīramāpūryāvasthitābhyāṃ 
rogāḥ sarve bādhitā bhavantīti || atha kādimate prāṇāgnihotravidhiḥ | tatra 
śrītantrarāje :

tataḥ sūkṣmaiḥ parākhyaiśca homaiḥ siddhiṃ śṛṇu priye |  
svamūlādhārake vahnau kuṇḍalinyagragāmini || 4-1 ||

vācyavācakarūpaṃ tu prapañcaṃ juhuyāttathā |
yenāvayoḥ samo devi jāyate havanena ca || 4-2 ||

tadvidhānaṃ vada prājña śambho samyaṅmamādhunā |
ādhāre vahnisaṃsthānaṃ kuṇḍalinyāḥ sthitiṃ tataḥ || 4-3 ||

tadrūpaṃ tatkriyāṃ sarvaṃ vada me viśadaṃ prabho |
śṛṇu vakṣye vidhānaṃ te samyagvistarato'dhunā || 4-4 ||

prāṇāgnihotravidyeti yat trayāṃ śrūyate param |
yajjñātvā vanitāgarbhaṃ na prayāti naro dhruvam || 4-5 ||

yadvyayāyāsarahitamananyāpekṣanirvaham |
yanmanaḥkleśaviśrānteḥ sthānaṃ niḥśeṣakalmaṣam || 4-6 ||

sukhāspadaṃ svagaṃ viśvamayaṃ cidvedyavedanāt |
atroktaśeṣamakhilaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśe paṭale sphuṭam || 4-7 ||

pradarśyate tatastvatra varṇayāmi ca kiñcana |
nityānityodite mūlādhāramadhye'sti pāvakaḥ || 4-8 ||

sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tadvad hṛdaye ca prabhākaraḥ |
mūrdhani brahmarandhrādhaścandramāśca vyavasthitaḥ || 4-9 ||

tattrayātmakameva syādādyānityātrikhaṇḍakam |
teṣāṃ trayāṇāmaikyaṃ tu manasā bhāvayettathā || 4-10 ||

gamāgamābhyāṃ tejobhisteṣāmanyonyajaiḥ śive |
tathā samiddhaṃ tattejastrayaṃ buddhvātha tanmayam || 4-11 ||

cittaṃ vikalpavidhuraṃ bhāvayedadbhutaṃ hutam |
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ praguktānāṃ krameṇa vai || 4-12 ||

dvābhyāmanyatamaṃ kṛtvā puṭitaṃ juhuyācca taiḥ |
puṭitān bhānuhṛdvarṇaiḥ svarāṁstāreṇa huṃkṛtaiḥ || 4-13 ||

kuṇḍalīmukhamārgāgnau juhuyānniścalāśayaḥ |
vahnibhānupuṭāntaḥsthaiścāndraistadvad hunet kramāt || 4-14 ||

candrabhānupuṭāntaḥsthairvahnyarṇairjuhuyāt tathā | 
bhānucandrapuṭāntaḥsthairvahnyarṇairjuhuyāt tathā || 4-15 ||

candravahnipuṭāntaḥstharbhāvarṇairjuhuyādapi |
vahnicandrapuṭāntaḥsthairapi tadvad hunettu taiḥ || 4-16 ||

tathā teṣāṃ prātilomyāt ṣoḍaśānāṃ hunedapi |
evaṃ dvādaśadhā homamakṣaraiḥ syādudīritaiḥ || 4-17 ||

kṛtvā tadvācyamakhilamartharūpaṃ ca taiḥ samam |
tejastrayātmarūpaṃ syādāvayorapi tadvapuḥ || 4-18 ||

anyāni cāvayoricchāgṛhītāni vapūṃṣi vai |
tānyanyadevatādehasamānīcchāvaśāni ca || 4-19 ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya-śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya-śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
caturthaḥ śvāsaḥ || 4 ||






atha 

śrīvidyārṇavatantre 

|| pañcamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 

atha kālīmate mantroddhāraḥ | tatrādau bhūtalipiḥ | tatra siddhasārasvatatantre-

atha bhūtalipiṃ vakṣye sugopyāmatidurlabhām |
sārasvate mahātantre gopitāṃ cātisiddhidām || 5-1 ||

viṣṇoḥ sakāśādyāṃ labdhvā munayo vāṃchitaṃ phalam |
lebhire sakalaṃ devi kiṃ bahūktena sarvadā || 5-2 ||

hrasvānāṃ pañcakaṃ varga āditaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | 
dvitīyaḥ kathito devi śivādyāścaturakṣarāḥ || 5-3 ||

khaṃ vāyuvahnyambudharāstṛtīyaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ |
vargāntyādidvitīyopāntyatṛtīyaiḥ kramādamī || 5-4 ||

pañcavargā vāntaśāntabhṛgubhirnavamo mataḥ |
navavargātmako mantro dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraḥ || 5-5 ||

vargāṇāmādimo vargaḥ śrīkaṇṭhordhvoṣṭhakhānvitāḥ |
vargāntyā vāntasaṃyuktāḥ krameṇa kathitā amī || 5-6 ||

khaṃ vāyuvahnyambudharā vargavarṇā matāḥ kramāt |
vargo dvitīyo bhūhīno vāribhūviyuto'ntimaḥ || 5-7 ||

navānāmapi vargāṇāṃ devatāḥ kathitāḥ kramāt |
viriñciviṣṇurudrāhvā āśvineyau prajāpatiḥ || 5-8 ||

lokapālāḥ sakriyādiśaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatraṃ chanda īritam || 5-9 ||

sarasvatī devatāsya gaditā viśvavanditā |
vyomādivargaṣaṭkaiḥ syājjātiyuktaiḥ ṣaḍaṅga (kaiḥ?kam) || 5-10 ||

ādyavargadvayasyātha navārṇanyāsamucyate |
ādhārādhiṣṭhānanābhihṛdgaleṣu sabaindave || 5-11 ||

nāde śaktyāṃ śive samyaksvarān kramavaśāt sudhīḥ |
tṛtīyavargahādyarṇān nyasedūrdhvādi pañcasu || 5-12 ||

mukheṣu pañcavargāṇāṃ sthāneṣveṣu pravinyaset |
doḥpadagreṣu mūleṣu cāpamūlāgrakeṣu ca || 5-13 ||

madhyadeśeṣu jaṭhare pārśvadvayasanābhiṣu |
pṛṣṭhe'vaśiṣṭavargārṇān guhyahṛdbhrūṣu vinyaset || 5-14 ||

sṛṣṭinyāse visargāntān bindusargāntimān sthitau |
ādidvitīyakopāntyaprāntamadhyakramānnyaset || 5-15 ||

sṛṣṭiṣu kramagān nyasyet saṃhṛtau bindusaṃyutān |
dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi deveśi munipūjitam || 5-16 ||

śāśvataṃ yaṃ bhūtamayaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
cidbījaṃ vindunādāhvaśiphaṃ viśvambharākṣaraiḥ || 5-17 ||

śākhāsamūhaiḥ sakalādiśāsu suvijṛmbhitam |
jalavarṇadalavrātenācchāditajagattrayam || 5-18 ||

kṛśānuvarṇāṃkuraiśca saṃdīptaṃ surabhūruham |
ratnāṃkurairiva śubhaṃ pavanākṣaraśobhitaiḥ || 5-19 ||

kusumairdīpayantaṃ ca svakīyatanusacchriyam |
viyadakṣarasadrūpaphalairānamramambike || 5-20 ||

sarvabhūtāśrayaṃ nityaṃ parāmṛtamadhudravaiḥ |
siñcantaṃ parameśāni devīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ parām || 5-21 ||

nigamāgamasaṃkḷptasamunnatisuśobhitam |
śivaśaktyātmakaṃ chāyāsamāśritajagattrayam || 5-22 ||

yamāśritya munīndraughā vāñchitārthān prapedire |
evaṃbhūtārṇavṛkṣasya mūle tvakṣarapaṅkaje || 5-23 ||

vāgīśvarīṃ smared devīṃ sakaleṣṭaphalapradām |

kundābhāsāmurukucaghaṭāṃ śobhicandrārdhamauliṃ 
hastāmbhojairvarajapavaṭīpustakaṃ puṃskapālam |
bibhrāṇāṃ tāṃ madhumadalasadvihvalāṃ yugmanetrāṃ 
devīṃ dhyāyellipimayatatuṃ yauvanaprāptaśobhām || 5-24 ||

p. 71)

iti dhyātvā maheśāni hṛdi devīmananyadhīḥ |
mātṛkokte yajetpīṭhe pratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ śive || 5-25 ||

varṇapadme maheśāni mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet |
tasyāmāvāhya vāgīśīṃ yajedāvaraṇaiḥ saha || 5-26 ||

purāṅgāni yajenmantrī kesareṣu puroktavat |
ambikādyā yajet paścādvakṣyamāṇāścaturdale || 5-27 ||

ambikā vāgbhavā durgā śrīśca mātṝstato yajet |
aṣṭapatre maheśāni tadvahiḥ ṣoḍaśacchade || 5-28 ||

karālyādyā yajecchaktīrvakṣyamāṇāstu ṣoḍaśa |
karālī vikarālī ca tṛtīyomā sarasvatī || 5-29 ||

śrīdurgeśā ca lakṣmīśca śrutiḥ smṛtiritīritāḥ |
dhṛtiḥ ca śraddhā ca medhā ca matiḥ kāntirudīritāḥ || 5-30 || 

āryā ca ṣoḍaśī proktāḥ khaḍgakheṭakarā imāḥ |
śyāmāśca smeravadanāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 5-31 ||

vidyāhīpuṣṭayaḥ prajñā sinīvālī kuhūḥ punaḥ |
rudravīryā prabhā nandā syātpūṣā ṛddhidā śubhā || 5-32 ||

kālarātrirmahārātrirbhadrakālī kapālinī |
vikṛtirdaṇḍimuṇḍinyau sendukhaṇḍā śikhaṇḍinī || 5-33 ||

niśumbhaśumbhamathinī mahiṣāsuramardinī |
indrāṇī caiva rudrāṇī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī || 5-34 ||

nārī nārāyaṇī caiva triśūlinyapi pālinī |
ambikā hāriṇī caiva dvātriṃśacchaktayaḥ sitāḥ || 5-35 ||

piśācāsyāścakrahastāḥ sampūjyāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ |
piṅgalākṣī viśālākṣī samṛddhirvṛddhireva ca || 5-36 ||

śraddhā svāhā svadhā bhikṣā māyā saṃjñā vasundharā |
trilokadhātrī sāvitrī gāyatrī tridaśeśvarī || 5-37 ||

surūpā bahurūpā ca skandamātā ca tatpriyā |
vimalā vipulā paścādaruṇī punarāruṇī || 5-38 ||

prakṛtirvikṛtiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ saṃhṛtireva ca |
sandhyā matiḥ sati haṃsī mardikā paradevatā || 5-39 ||

devamātā bhagavatī devakī kamalāsanā |
trimukhī saptamukhyanyā surāsuravimardinī || 5-40 ||

lamboṣṭhī cordhvakeśī ca bahuśīrṣā vṛkodarī |
ratharekhāhvayā paścācchaśirekhāhvayā parā || 5-41 || 

gaganarekhā ca pavanavegā ca tadanantaram |
tato bhuvanapālākhyā tataḥ syānmadanāturā || 5-42 ||

anaṅgānaṅgamadanā tathaivānaṅgamekhalā |
anaṅgakusumā viśvarūpāsurabhayaṅkarī || 5-43 ||

akṣobhyāsatyavādinyau vajrarūpā śucivratā |
varadākhyā ca vāgīśā catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ samīritāḥ || 5-44 ||

cāpabaṇadharāḥ sarvā jvālājihvāḥ samīritāḥ |
daṃṣṭriṇyaścordhvakeśyaśca yuddhopakrāntamānasāḥ || 5-45 ||

sarvābharaṇasaṃdīptāḥ pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
tato'rcayellokapālāṃstadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ || 5-46 ||

evaṃ bhūtalipiṃ samyag jagaddhātrīṃ yajetsudhīḥ |
vāgaiśvaryasamṛddhaḥ san vandyate sa surairapi || 5-47 ||

sādhakaḥ kṛtadīkṣaḥ san nyasellakṣaṃ japetsadā |
taddaśāṃśaṃ tilaiḥ śuddhaistrimadhvaktairhunet tataḥ || 5-48 ||

tarpaṇādidvijārcāntaṃ prāgvat kṛtvā tu mantravit |
kāmyakarma tataḥ kuryāt svagurūktavidhānataḥ || 5-49 ||

juhuyādayutaṃ padmairvaśagāḥ syurnarādhipāḥ |
mahālakṣmīrutpalānāṃ homāt saṃjāyate'cirāt || 5-50 ||

brahmavṛkṣaprasūnaiśca juhuyāt sādhakaḥ priye |
vatsareṇaiva mahatāṃ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet || 5-51 ||

rājikālavaṇairhutvā vaśayedyoṣitaḥ sudhīḥ |
anayā bhūtalipyā ca saṃpuṭīkṛtya yaṃ manum || 5-52 ||

śataṃ kramādvilomācca bhajate tasya siddhyati |
suptāśīrviṣaramyāṃ tāṃ samyak kuṇḍalinīṃ parām || 5-53 ||

saṃgamayya ca madhyena vartmanā sthānamuttamam |
parāmṛtaiḥ plāvayettāṃ mūrdhni mūlāvadhi kramāt || 5-54 ||

yaugināṃ khalvayaṃ yogaḥ saṃmataḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ |
etannyastaśarīrastu tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ || 5-55 ||

jñātvā yantraviśeṣāṃśca kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet |

bindvāḍhyaṃ vyoma bhūyastadapi ca śivayug jñānine syād hṛdanto 
mantro'yaṃ karṇikāyāṃ praṇigadita ito vyomavarṇān daleṣu |
sādhyākhyābandhuvarṇāṃllikhatu khapuṭitān śiṣṭamantye'tha patre 
vṛttāvītaṃ khayantraṃ malayajajatubhirnirmitaṃ kṣveḍahartṛ || 5-56 ||

p. 72)

vāyū netraiyutau sto viratinatiyuto ṅentakopeśaśabdo 
madhye vāyavyavarṇān pavanasupuṭitān patramadhye'ntyamantye |
svātyāṃ mandodaye tatpavanagṛhagataṃ tālapatrasthayantraṃ 
śatroruccāṭakṛt syādripumṛtiphaladaṃ dvāri tasyaiva khātam || 5-57 ||

vahnī kramācchrutiradenduyujau svakāntau rauroḥ saphalaṇatirayaṃ manurabjamadhye |
patreṣu vahnipuṭitānyanalākṣarāṇi prānte'ntimaṃ ca saha sādhyasupoṣakārṇaiḥ |
agnisthitaṃ bhujadale śubhavāsararkṣe lākṣāsukuṃkumakṛtaṃ prakaroti rakṣām || 5-58 
||

nāsāmanusvarasabinduyutābuyumgmaṃ ṅe'nto vidhurvidhubhuve natireṣa madhye |
abvarṇakān (su?va) puṭitān śiśubandhuvarṇaiḥ patreṣu 
cāpyapurayugvaruṇāhvayantram || 5-59 || 

gaṇḍānante sabindū vilikhatu ca jagau gaṇḍayormadhyasaṃsthau 
lvante ke hṛttu madhye tadanu kupuṭitān bhūmivarṇān dharāntān |
patrāntaḥ sevakārṇairdharaṇigṛhayutaṃ cendrasaumyodaye tad 
bhūrjasthaṃ bhūmiyantraṃ sumṛdi viracitaṃ gairikaiḥ stambhakṛt syāt || 5-51 ||

iti bhūtalipipraghaṭṭakam | atha kālīmate śrīvidyāprakaraṇam-

pañcasiṃhāsano'nyatra tato vai pañcapañcikā |
ṣaḍāyatanavidyāśca pañcāmnāyāstathaiva ca || 5-1 ||

catuḥsamayavidyāśca śrīvidyāvṛndameva ca |
jñātavyāstu viśeṣeṇa devatābhāvasiddhaye || 5-2 ||

sampatpradābhairavī ca tataścaitanyabhairavī |
caitanyabhairavī cānyā dvitīyā sarvasiddhidā || 5-3 ||

kāmeśvarībhairavī ca bālādyāḥ pañca devatāḥ |
pūrvasiṃhāsanasthāśca smartavyāḥ sarvasiddhaye || 5-4 ||

nyāse home ca pūjāyāṃ sarvatraiva tu sādhakaḥ |
aghorabhairavī caiva mahābhairavyataḥ param || 5-5 ||

lalitābhairavī caiva kāmeśībhairavī tathā |
raktanetrābhairavī ca dakṣasiṃhāsane sthitāḥ || 5-6 ||

ṣaṭkūṭābhairavī caiva tato vai nityabhairavī |
mṛtasañjīvanī caiva mṛtyuñjayaparā tataḥ || 5-7 ||

vajraprastāriṇī caiva pratyaksiṃhāsane sthitāḥ |
bhuvaneśībhairavī ca kamaleśī ca bhairavī || 5-8 || 

kauleśī bhairavī caiva tato ḍāmarabhairavī |
kāminībhairavī caiva saumyasiṃhāsane sthitāḥ || 5-9 ||

prathamā sundarī caiva dvitīyā sundarī tathā |
tṛtīyā sundarī caiva caturthī sundarī tathā || 5-10 ||

pañcamī sundarī caiva ūrdhvasiṃhāsanasthitāḥ |
śrīvidyā ca tathā lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīstathaiva ca || 5-11 ||

triśaktiḥ sarvasāmrājyā lakṣmyaḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ |
śrīvidyā ca paraṃjyotiḥ paraniṣkalaśāmbhavī || 5-12 ||

ajapā mātṛkā ceti pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
śrīvidyā tvaritā caiva pārijāteśvarī tataḥ || 5-13 ||

trikūṭā pañcabāṇeśī pañca kalpalatāḥ smṛtāḥ |
śrīvidyāmṛtapīṭheśī sudhāsūramṛteśvarī || 5-14 ||

annapūrṇeti vikhyātāḥ pañca kāmadughāḥ kramāt |
śrīvidyā siddhalakṣmīśca mātaṅgī bhuvaneśvarī || 5-15 ||

vārāhīti ca saṃproktāḥ pañcaratnamiti dhruvam |

iti | atha mantroddhāraḥ tatrādau gurupādukā-

śivacandrānalārghīśabindubhiḥ prathamākṣaram |
ākāśacandrasaṃvartamahākālakṣamāmbubhiḥ || 5-1 ||

vāyvagnyanantabindvātairdvitīyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam |
tadeva vāmakarṇena tṛtīyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam || 5-2 ||

tadeva takṣanetreṇa caturthaṃ bījamīritam |
śrīpareti tathā pāvaketi sarvapadaṃ tataḥ || 5-3 ||

ārādhyasarvaguru ca nāthasarvaguruguru |
śrīgurvatha tathā nātha vahnirbījaṃ tṛtīyakam || 5-4 ||

ādyabījacatuṣkaṃ ca śrīśaṃbhuguruśabdataḥ |
prathamaṃ tu dvidhā coktvā dvitīyāditrayaṃ bhavet || 5-5 ||

p. 73)

prathamaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca proktā ca sthūlapādukā |
tārapañcakamādau tu deyaṃ sarvārthasādhikā || 5-6 ||

khecarībījamukteyaṃ proktā syānmadhyapādukā |
tāratrayayuteyaṃ tu saṃproktā laghupādukā || 5-7 ||

tāratrayaṃ śrī-amukānandanāthapadaṃ tataḥ |
śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmītyuktā laghutarāparā || 5-8 ||

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hasakhaphreṃ hasauḥ hasrūṁ hasakṣamalavayarāṁ 
hasakṣamalavayarūṁ hasakṣamalavaya [rīṃ ? riṃ] śrīparapāvaka 
sarvārādhyasarvagurunātha sarvaguruguruśrīgurunātha raṃhasakṣamalavayarūṁ | hasrūṁ 
hasakṣamalavayarāṃ hasakṣamalavayarūṁ hasakṣamalavaya [rīṃ ? riṃ] śrīśambhuguru 
hasrūṃ hasrūṃ hasakṣamalavayarāṃ hasakṣamalavayarūṁ hasakṣamalavaya [rīṃ ? 
riṃ] hasrūṁ hasakṣamalavayarūṁ iti sthūlapādukā ||

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hasauṁ shakṣamalavayarūṁ shakṣamalavayarūṁ hasrauḥ 
sahakṣamalavayarauḥ hasrauḥ śrīparapāvaka sarvārādhyasarvagurunātha 
sarvagurusvayaṃguru śrīgurunātha raṁ hasakṣamalavayarūṁ hasauṁ sahakṣamalavayarīṃ 
sahakṣamalavayarūṁ sahalakṣamavayarāṁ śrīśambhuguruhasrauṃ sahakṣamalavayarūṁ
