śrī-amukānandanāthāmukaśaktidevyambāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti 
madhyamapādukā ||

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hasakhaphreṃ hasauḥ hasakṣamalavarayūṁ śrī-amukānandanātha oṃ 
aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sahakhaphreṃ shauḥ sahakṣamalavarayīṃ 
amukadevyambāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti laghupādukā || oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ 
amukānandanāthāmukaśaktyambāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti laghutarapādukā || oṃ 
aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrī-amukānandanāthaśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi - iti 
sāmānyapādukā || 

brāhme muhūrte cotthāya cintayedgurupādukām |
svasthacittaḥ sthiravapuryogamārgavicakṣaṇaḥ || 5-1 ||

śrīguroḥ pādukāmantre ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥ |
gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ nicṛdādyaṃ maheśvari || 5-2 ||

bījaśaktī tathādyantau madhyamaṃ kīlakaṃ bhavet |
mokṣārthe viniyogaḥ syādṛṣinyāsa udīritaḥ || 5-3 ||

prātaḥ śirasi śukle'bje dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ gurum |
varābhayakaraṃ śāntaṃ smaret tannāmapūrvakam || 5-4 ||

śaśāṅkāyutasaṅkāśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham |
śuklāmbaradharaṃ śrīmacchuklamālyānulepanam || 5-5 ||

vāmorusthitayā raktavarṇayā padmahastayā |
śaktyāliṅgitamānandāmodamānaṃ guruṃ smaret || 5-6 ||

athaughatrayagurudhyānam-

karābhyāṃ cinmudrāṃ samadhunṛkapālaṃ ca dadhatīṃ 
drutasvarṇaprakhyāmaruṇakusumālepavasanām |
kṛpāpūrṇāpāṅgāmaruṇanayanāṃ karburajaṭāmupetāṃ siddhaughairbhajatu 
gurupaṅkti kṛtamatiḥ || 5-1 ||

atha gurunamaskāraḥ-

ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā |
cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 5-1 ||

akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram |
tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 5-2 ||

gururbrahmā gururviṣṇugururdevo maheśvaraḥ |
guruḥ kartā ca hartā ca gurave vai namo namaḥ || 5-3 ||

atha kuṇḍalinīmantraḥ-

vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśī ca śrībījaṃ tu tathaiva ca |
tryakṣaro mantra ākhyātaḥ kuṇḍalinyāḥ susiddhidaḥ || 5-1 ||

ṛṣiḥ śaktiḥ samākhyāto gāyatrī chanda īritam |
cetanā kuṇḍalī śaktirdevatātra samīritā || 5-2 ||

vāgbhavaṃ bījamākhyātaṃ śaktiḥ śrībījamucyate |
hṛllekhā kīlaka proktaṃ kuṇḍalinyāstu cintane || 5-3 ||

viniyogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ |
bījatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 5-4 ||

dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi kuṇḍalyāḥ sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu |
mūlādhāre trikoṇe tu sūryakoṭisamatviṣi || 5-5 ||

prasuptabhujagākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayasthitām |
nīvāraśūkavat tanvīṃ taḍitkoṭisamaprabhām || 5-6 ||

sūryakoṭiprabhāṃ dīptāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām |
śivaśaktimayīṃ devīṃ śaṅkhāvartakramāt sthitām || 5-7 ||

suṣumnāmadhyamārgeṇa yāntīṃ paraśivāvadhi |
hrīṅkārabījarūpeṇa cintayedyogavartmanā || 5-8 ||

p. 74)

sindūrāruṇavigrahāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamaulisphura-
ttārānāyakaśekharāṃ smitamukhīmāpīnavakṣoruhām |
pāṇibhyāṃ maṇipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃ bibhratīṃ 
saumyāṃ ratnaghaṭasthasavyacaraṇāṃ dhyāyet parāmambikām || 5-9 ||

kulagurudhyānaṃ prāgevoktam | atha kuṇḍalīstutiḥ śāradāyām-

mūlonnidrabhujaṅgarājasadṛśīṃ yāntīṃ suṣumnāntaraṃ 
bhittvādhārasamūhamāśu vilasatsaudāminīsannibhām |
vyomāmbhojagatendumaṇḍalagaladdivyāmṛtaughaiḥ patiṃ 
sambhāvya svagṛhāgatāṃ punarimāṃ sañcintayet kuṇḍalīm || 5-1 ||

haṃsaṃ nityamanantamadvayaguṇaṃ svādhārato nirgatā 
śaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī samastajananī haste gṛhītvā ca tam |
yātā śambuniketanaṃ parasukhaṃ tenānubhūya svayaṃ 
yāntī svāśramamarkakoṭirucirā dhyeyā jaganmohinī || 5-2 ||

avyaktaṃ parabimbamañcitaruciṃ nītvā śivasyālayaṃ 
śaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī guṇatrayavapurvidyullatāsannibhā |
ānandāmṛtakandagaṃ purabhidaṃ candrārkakoṭiprabhaṃ 
saṃvīkṣya svagṛhaṃ gatā bhagavatī dhyeyānavadyā guṇaiḥ || 5-3 ||

madhyevartma samīraṇadvayamithaḥsaṅghaṭṭasaṃkṣobhajaṃ 
śabdastomamatītya tejasi taḍitkoṭiprabhābhāsvarām |
udyantīṃ samupāsmahe navajapāsindūrasāndrāruṇāṃ 
sāndrānandasudhāmayīṃ paraśivaṃ prāptāṃ parāṃ devatām || 5-4 ||

gamanāgamaneṣu jāṅghikī sā tanuyādyogaphalāni kuṇḍalī |
muditā kulakāmadhenureṣā bhajatāṃ vāṃchitakalpavallarī || 5-5 ||

ādhārasthitaśaktibindunilayāṃ nīvāraśūkopamāṃ 
nityānandamayīṃ galatparasudhāvarṣaiḥ prabodhapradaiḥ |
siktvā ṣaṭ sarasīruhāṇi vidhivat kodaṇḍamadhyoditāṃ 
dhyāyed bhāsvarabandhujīvarucirāṃ saṃvinmayīṃ devatām || 5-6 ||

hṛtpaṅkeruhabhānubimbanilayāṃ vidyullatāmantharāṃ 
bālārkāruṇatejasā bhagavatīṃ nirbhartsayantīṃ tamaḥ |
nādākhyaṃ paramardhacandrakuṭilaṃ saṃvinmayīṃ śāśvatīṃ 
yāntīmakṣararūpiṇīṃ vimaladhīrdhyāyedvibhuṃ tejasām || 5-7 ||

bhāle pūrṇaniśākarapratibhaṭāṃ nīhārahāratviṣā 
siñcantīmamṛtena devamamitenānandayantīṃ tanum |
varṇānāṃ jananīṃ tadīyavapuṣā samvāpya viśvaṃ sthitāṃ 
dhyāyet samyaganākulena manasā samvinmayīmambikām || 5-8 ||

p. 75)

mūle bhāle hṛdi ca vilasadvarṇarūpā sāvitrī 
pīnottuṅgastanabharanamanmadhyadeśā maheśī |
cakre cakre galitasudhayā siktagātrī prakāmaṃ 
dadyādadya śriyamavikalāṃ vāṅmayī devatā naḥ || 5-9 ||

ādhārabandhapramukhakriyābhiḥ samutthitā kuṇḍalinī sudhābhiḥ |
tridhāmabījaṃ śivamarcayantī śivāṅganā vaḥ śivamātanotu || 5-10 ||

nijabhuvananivāsāduccalantī vilāsaiḥ pathi pathi kamalānāṃ cāruhāsaṃ vidhāya |
taruṇatapanakāntiḥ kuṇḍalī devatā sā śivasadanasudhābhirdīpayedātmatejaḥ || 5-11 ||

sindūrapuñjanibhamindukalāvataṃsamānandapūrṇanayanatrayaśobhivaktram |
āpīnatuṅgakucanamramanaṅgatantraṃ śambhoḥ kalatramamitāṃ śriyamātanotu || 5-12 
||

varṇairarṇavaṣaṭdiśā ravikalācakṣurvibhaktaiḥ kramāt 
sāntairādibhirāvṛtān kṣahayutaiḥ ṣaṭcakramadhyānimān |
ḍākinyādibhirāśritān paricitān brahmādibhirdaivatai
rbhindānā paradevatā trijagatāṃ citteṣu dattāṃ mudam || 5-13 ||

ādhārād guṇavṛttaśobhitatanuṃ nirgatvarīṃ satvaraṃ 
bhindantīṃ kamalāni cinmayaghanānandaprabodhoddhurām |
saṃkṣubdhadhruvamaṇḍalāmṛtakaraprasyandamānāmṛta-
srotaḥkandalitāmamandataḍidākārāṃ śivāṃ bhāvaye || 5-14 ||

mūlādhāre trikoṇe taruṇataraṇibhābhāsvare vibhramantaṃ 
kāmaṃ bālārkakālānalajaraṭhakuraṅgāṅkakoṭiprabhābham |
vidyunmālāsahasradyutiruciralasadbandhujīvābhirāmaṃ 
traiguṇyākrāntabinduṃ jagadudayalayaikāntahetuṃ vicintya || 5-15 || 

tasyordhve visphurantīṃ sphuṭarucirataḍitpuñjabhābhāsvarāṅgī-
muṅgacchantīṃ suṣumnāmanu saraṇiśikhāmālalāṭendubimbam |
cinmātrāṃ sūkṣmarūpāṃ jagadudayakarīṃ bhāvanāmātragamyāṃ 
mūlaṃ yā sarvadhāmnāṃ sphurati nirupamā hūṃkṛtodañcitoraḥ || 5-16 ||

nītā sā śanakairadhomukhasahasrārāruṇābjodare 
cyotatpūrṇaśaśāṅkabimbamadhutaḥ pīyūṣadhārāsrutim |
rakto mantramayīṃ nipīya ca sudhāniḥṣyandarūpā viśe-
dbhūyo'pyātmaniketanaṃ punarapi protthāya pītvā viśet || 5-17 ||

yo'bhyasyatyanudinamevātmano'ntarbījaśa duritajarāpamṛtyurogān |
jitvāsau svayamiva mūrtimānanaṅgaḥ sañjīvecciramatinīlakeśajālaḥ || 5-18 ||

iti kuṇḍalinīstutiḥ | atha mūlavidyācintanam-

pañcadaśyā ṛṣiḥ prokto dakṣiṇāmūrtiravyayaḥ | 
paṃktiśchandaḥ samākhyātaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 5-1 ||

devatā hyuditā śrīmanmahātripurasundarī |
vāgbhavaṃ bījamākhyātaṃ śaktistārtoyamucyate || 5-2 ||

p. 76)

kīlakaṃ madhyakūṭaṃ syāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye |
viniyogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ || 5-3 ||

kūṭatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret | 

sindūrapuñjanibhamindukalāvataṃsamānandapūrṇanayanatrayaśobhivaktram |
āpīnatuṅgakucanamramanaṅgatantraṃ śambhoḥ kalatramamitāṃ śriyamātanotu || 5-4 ||

atha kūṭatrayacintanam-

mūlādhare vāgbhavākhyaṃ kūṭaṃ saṃcintayedbudhaḥ |
vāgbhavākhyasya kūṭasya ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥ || 5-1 ||

chando gāyatramākhyātaṃ devatā vāgadhīśvarī |
ādyavarṇaṃ tu bījaṃ syādantyaṃ śaktiḥ samīritā || 5-2 ||

madhyatrayaṃ kīlakaṃ syādvāksiddhyaṃ viniyogakam |
brahmavāgrūpiṇī ṅentā viṣṇuvāgrūpiṇī tathā || 5-3 ||

rudravāgrūpiṇī ṅentā paravāgrūpiṇī tathā |
śivavāgrūpiṇī ṅentākhilavāgrūpiṇī tathā || 5-4 ||

ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vinyasedetairvāgbhavādyaiḥ susādhakaḥ |

śuklāṃ svacchavilepamālyavasanāṃ śītāṃśukhaṇḍojjvalāṃ 
vyākhyāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalaśaṃ vidyāṃ ca hastāmbujaiḥ |
vibhrāṇāṃ kamalāsanāṃ kucanatāṃ vāgdevatāṃ sasmitāṃ 
vande vāgvibhavapradāṃ trinayanāṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatkarīm || 5-5 ||

hṛdaye kāmarājākhyaṃ kūṭaṃ saṃcintayed budhaḥ |
kāmarājākhyakūṭasya ṛṣiḥ sammohanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5-6 ||

gāyatrī chanda ākhyātaṃ kāmeśī devatā smṛtā |
ādyaṃ bījaṃ tathā śaktirhṛllekhā kīlakaṃ smṛtam || 5-7 ||

madhyavarṇacatuṣkaṃ tu vaśīkaraṇasiddhaye |
viniyogo'tra vikhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ || 5-8 ||

drāṃsaṃkṣobhaṇabāṇāya drīṃdrāvaṇapadaṃ tathā |
bāṇāya ca tathā klīṃ ca ākarṣaṇapadaṃ punaḥ || 5-9 ||

bāṇāya blūṃ vaśīkārabāṇāya ca tataḥ punaḥ |
saḥ unmādanabāṇāya pañca bījāni coccaret || 5-10 ||

sarvabāṇebhya ityuktvā ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |
kāmakūṭādibhirmantrairnamontai rasasaṃkhyakaiḥ || 5-11 ||

bālārkakoṭirucirāṃ sphaṭikākṣamālāṃ kodaṇḍamikṣujanitaṃ smarapañcabāṇān |
vidyāṃ ca hastakamalairdadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ dhyāyet samastajananīṃ 
navacandracūḍām || 5-12 || 

ājñācakre śaktikūṭaṃ cintayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ |
athāsya śaktikūṭasya ṛṣiḥ śiva udāhṛtiḥ || 5-13 ||

paṅktiśchandastvādiśaktirdevatā bījamatra saḥ |
hṛllekhā śaktiruddiṣṭā kīlakaṃ madhyavarṇakau || 5-14 ||

viniyogastu vijñeyaścaturvargāptaye dhruvam |
ṅentā sarvajñatāśaktiḥ śaktyantā nityatṛptatā || 5-15 ||

caturthyantā samuddiṣṭā tathaivānādibodhinī |
ṅentā svatantratā śaktistathā nityamaluptatā || 5-16 ||

śaktirṅentānantatādiśaktirṅentā tathaiva ca |
etairmantrairjātiyuktaiḥ śaktikūṭādikaiḥ kramāt || 5-17 ||

vinyasya ca ṣaḍaṅgāni dhyāyed devīmananyadhīḥ |

kadambavanamadhyagāṃ kanakamaṇḍapāntaḥsthitāṃ 
ṣaḍamburuhavāsinīmamarasiddhasaudāminīm |
bijṛmbhitajapāruciṃ vimalacandracūḍāmaṇiṃ triyambakakuṭumbinīṃ 
tripurasundarīmāśraye || 5-18 || 

athābhedacintanam-

mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ brahmavidyāṃ vibhāvayet |
tatprabhāpaṭalavāptaṃ svaśarīraṃ vicintayet || 5-1 ||

ahaṃ devi na cānyo'smi brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk |
saccidānandarūpo'haṃ nityamuktasvabhāvavān || 5-2 ||

tvamevāhamahaṃ tvaṃ ca saṃvinmātravapustava |
āvayorantaraṃ devi naśyatvājñābalāt tataḥ || 5-3 ||

ahaṃ tīrṇo bhavaṃ ghoraṃ kṛtyaṃ kiñcinna me'sti vai |
tathāpi dehi me mātarājñāṃ tava susevane || 5-4 ||

p. 77)

kṛtvā samādhisthitayā dhiyā te cintāṃ navādhāranivāsabhūtām |
prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ saṃsārayātrāmanuvartayiṣye || 5-5 ||

maṃjuśiñjitamañjīraṃ vāmamardhaṃ maheśituḥ | 
āśrayāmi jaganmūlaṃ yanmūlaṃ vacasāmapi || 5-6 ||

atha mūladevatāstutiḥ-

kalyāṇavṛṣṭibhirivāmṛtapūritābhirlakṣmīsvayaṃvaraṇamaṅgaladīpikābhiḥ |
sevābhiramba tava pādasarojamūle nākāri kiṃ manasi bhaktimatāṃ janānām || 5-1 ||

etāvadeva janani spṛhaṇīyamāste tvadvandaneṣu salilasthagite ca netre |
sānnidhyamudyadaruṇāmbujasodarasya tvadvigrahasya sudhayā parayāplutasya || 5-2 ||

īśitvabhāgakaluṣāḥ kati nāma santi brahmādayaḥ pratiyugaṃ pralayābhibhūtāḥ |
ekaḥ sa eva janani sthirasiddhirāste yaḥ pādayostava sukṛt praṇatiṃ karoti || 5-3 ||

labdhvā sakṛt tripurasundari tāvakīnaṃ kāruṇyakandalitakāntibharaṃ kaṭākṣam |
kandarpabhāvasubhagāstvayi bhaktibhājaḥ sammohayanti taruṇīrbhuvanatrayeṣu || 5-4 ||

hrīṅkārameva tava nāma gṛṇanti vedā mātastrikoṇanilaye tripure trinetre |
yatsaṃsmṛtau yamabhaṭādibhayaṃ vihāya divyanti nandanavane saha lokapālaiḥ || 5-5 ||

hantuḥ purāmadhigalaṃ paripūryamāṇaḥ krūraḥ kathaṃ nu bhavitā garalasya vegaḥ |
āśvāsanāya kila mātaridaṃ tavārdhaṃ dehasya śaśvadamṛtāplutaśītalasya || 5-6 ||

sarvajñatāṃ sadasi vākpaṭutāṃ prasūte devi tvadaṃghrisarasīruhayoḥ praṇāmaḥ |
kiñca sphuranmukuṭamujjvalamātapatraṃ dve cāmare ca vasudhāṃ mahatīṃ dadāti || 5-
7 ||

kalpadrumairabhimatapratipādaneṣu kāruṇyavāridhibhiramba bhavatkaṭākṣaiḥ |
ālokayatripurasundari mamanāthaṃ tvayyeva bhaktibharitaṃ tvayi dattadṛṣṭim || 5-8 ||

hantetareṣvapi manāṃsi nidhāya cānye bhaktiṃ vahanti kila pāmaradaivateṣu |
tvāmeva devi manasāhamanusmarāmi tvāmeva naumi śaraṇaṃ jagati tvameva || 5-9 ||

lakṣyeṣu satsvapi tavākṣivilokanānāmālokaya tripurasundari māṃ kathañcit |
nūnaṃ bhayāpi sadṛśaṃ karuṇaikapātraṃ jāto janiṣyati jano naca jāyate ca || 5-10 ||

hrīṃhrīmiti pratidinaṃ japatāṃ janānāṃ kiṃnāma durlabhamiha tripurādhivāse |
mālākirīṭamadavāraṇamānanīyāṃstān sevate madhumatī svayameva lakṣmīḥ || 5-11 
||

sampatakarāṇi sakalendriyanandanāni sāmrājyadānakuśalāni saroruhākṣi |
tvadvandanāni duritaughaharodyatāni māmeva mātaraniśaṃ kalayantu nānyam || 5-12 ||

kalpopasaṃharaṇakalpitatāṇḍavasya devasya khaṇḍaparaśoḥ parabhairavasya |
pāśāṃkuśaikṣavaśarāsanapuṣpabāṇā sā sākṣiṇī vijayate tava mūrtirekā || 5-13 ||

lagnaṃ sadā bhavatu mātaridaṃ tvadīyaṃ tejaḥparaṃ bahulakuṃkumapaṅkaśoṇam |
bhāsvatkirīṭamamṛtāṃśukalāvataṃsaṃ madhye trikoṇamuditaṃ paramāmṛtārdram || 
5-14 ||

hrīṅkārameva tava dhāma tadevarūpaṃ tvannāma sundari sarojanivāsaśīle |
tvattejasā pariṇataṃ jagadādimūlaṃ saṅgaṃ tanotu sarasīruhasaṅgamasya || 5-15 ||

hrīṅkāratrayasampuṭena mahatā mantreṇa sandīpitaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ prativāsaraṃ tava 
puro mātarjapenmantravit | 
tasya kṣoṇibhujo bhavanti vaśagā lakṣmīścirasthāyinī vāṇī 
nirmalasūktibhārabharitā jāgarti dīrgha vapuḥ || 

p. 78)

iti stutiḥ ||

samudramekhale devi parvatastanamaṇḍale | viṣṇupatni namastubhyaṃ pādasparśaṃ 
kṣamasva me || 5-17 ||

iti bhūmiprārthanā ||

sandhyāsūdaṅmukho'hanyapi niśi ca punardakṣiṇāsyo nivītaṃ 
kuryānmūtrādiśaucaṃ bahiratha salilāt tatra liṅge mṛdekā |
pañcāpāne'tha haste daśa punarubhayoḥ sapta caitadgṛhasthe 
dvaiguṇyādikramāt tadvrativaniyatiṣu syāt tadardhaṃ niśāyām || 5-1 ||

iti śaucam ||

tataḥ śrīkāmamantrasya sammohana ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ |
gāyatrīcchanda ākhyātaṃ śrīkāmo devatā smṛtā || 5-1 ||

bījaṃ tu kāmarājaḥ syānnamaḥ śaktirudīritā | 
sarvajanapriyāyeti kīlakaṃ samudāhṛtam || 5-2 || 

ṣaḍdīrghakāmarājena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |

japāruṇaṃ ratnavibhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ mīnadhvajaṃ cārukṛtāṅgarāgam |
karāmbujairaṃkuśamikṣucāpaṃ puṣpāstrapāśau dadhataṃ bhajāmi || 5-3 ||

dhyātvaivaṃ kāmabījaṃ ca kāmadevāya sarva ca | 
janapriyāya hṛdayaṃ kāmamantra udāhṛtaḥ || 5-4 ||

anena dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu abhimantryāṣṭadhā punaḥ |
dantān viśodhya matimān mukhaprakṣālanaṃ caret || 5-5 ||

iti dantadhāvanam ||

śrīvidyāṃ brahmarandhre tu vicintya ca tataḥ param |
caturlakṣmīmahāmantrairmukhakṣālanamācaret || 5-6 ||

iti mukhaprakṣālanam ||

tīramāgatya cācamya kuryāt saṅkalpamādarāt |
atitīkṣṇa mahākāya kalpāntadahanopam || 5-7 ||

bhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi |
bhairavājñāmanusmṛtya snānaṃ vaidikamācaret || 5-8 ||

tāntrikaṃ snānamanutat kuryānmantroktavartmanā |
jale śrīcakramābhāvya tīrthānyākṛṣya maṇḍalāt || 5-9 ||

brahmāṇḍoradatīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te rave |
tena satyena me deva tīrthaṃ dehi divākara || 5-10 ||

mudrayāṃkuśarūpiṇyā tīrthānyākṛṣya yojya ca |
gaṅgāsvarūpiṇīṃ devīṃ dhyātvā mūlamanuṃ japan || 5-11 ||

jātavedādi-ṛgbhiśca samūlābhiḥ svamūrdhani |
abhiṣiñcet saptakṛtvaḥ kumbhākhyamudrayā tataḥ || 5-12 ||

devīṃ svahṛdi saṃyojya svasthāne tīrthasantatim |
yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ toyaṃ śarīramalasaṃyutam || 5-13 ||

tasya pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ tarpayāmyaham |
iti tīre tu santarpya gṛhṇīyācchuddhavāsasī || 5-14 ||

iti snānam | tato vibhūtidhāraṇam-

haste vibhūtiṃ saṃsthāpya pañcatāraiḥ pramantrayet |
agnirityādimantraiśca īśānādyaiśca mantrayet || 5-15 ||

tatastu dhārayenmantrī kevalaṃ mūlavidyayā |

iti bhasmadhāraṇam | atha vaidikasandhyānantaraṃ tāntrikasaṃdhyāṃ kuryāt- 

tato maṇidhariṇyante vajriṇyante mahāprati |
sare rakṣadvayaṃ huṃphaṭsvāhānto manurīritaḥ || 5-1 ||

anenaiva tu mantreṇa śikhāṃ baddhvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tribhiḥ kūṭaistrirācāmet tritattvāntaiḥ samāhitaḥ || 5-2 ||

vidyātattvāya ca tathā śivatattvāya caiva hi |
māyātattvāya ca tathā svāhāntaistadanantaram || 5-3 ||

prāṇānāyamya saṅkalpya purato jalamadhyataḥ |
śrīcakraṃ tu vibhāvyānu sūryāttīrthānimudrayā || 5-4 ||

prāgvadāvāhya vidhivadāvāhanyādimudrikāḥ |
pradarśya dakṣahaste tu jalaṃ saṃgṛhya yatnataḥ || 5-5 ||

vāmahastena saṃchādya pañcabhūtākṣaraiḥ kramāt |
abhimantrya sakṛttoyaṃ vāmahaste nidhāya ca || 5-6 ||

p. 79)

svaraiḥ saṃmārjayenmūrdhni tatpṛṣṭhasrūtabindubhiḥ |
tato dakṣe jalaṃ grāhyaṃ sahitairmūlavidyayā || 5-7 ||

kādimāntaiḥ sparśavarṇaiḥ svāhāntairabhimantrya ca |
pītvā tattoyamatha ca punardakṣe jalaṃ kṣipet || 5-8 ||

abhimantrya ca tatprāgvadvāmahaste nidhāya tat |
viniḥsṛtaiśca tatpṛṣṭhādvindubhirmārjayettathā || 5-9 ||

yādikṣāntairvyāpakārṇaistatastajjalamādarāt |
iḍayākṛṣya dehāntaḥ kṣālayet kalmaṣaṃ tataḥ || 5-10 ||

virecya piṅgalāmārgāt kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu tajjalam |
jvaladvajraśilāyāṃ tu sphālayedastramuccaran || 5-11 ||

tataḥ prakṣālya ca karāvācamyāñjalinā jalam |
gṛhītvotthāya gāyatryā sūryābhimukhamutkṣipet || 5-12 ||

evamarghyatrayaṃ dattvā copaviśya prayatnataḥ |
śrīcakrāvṛtidevīśca tarpayedvidhivat punaḥ || 5-13 || 

pañcaviṃśatidhā mūlamuccārya sveṣṭadevatām |
saṃtarpyācamya gāyatryāprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret || 5-14 ||

gāyatryāśca ṛṣirbrahmā gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
gāyatrī devatā proktā dvirāvṛttyā tribhiḥ padaiḥ || 5-15 ||

ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyasya dhyāyeddevīmananyadhīḥ |
bhāsvadratnaughamukuṭasphuraccandrakalādharām || 5-16 ||

sadyaḥ saṃtaptahemābhāṃ sūryamaṇḍalarūpiṇīm |
pāśāṃkuśābhayavarān dhārayantīṃ smaran budhaḥ || 5-17 ||

iti | kulārṇave-

prātaḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta dharmakāmārthasiddhaye |
mūladhāre vasābje ca hrīṃ bījaṃ raktasaṃnibham || 5-1 ||

dhyātvā prabhāpuṭāntaḥsthaṃ bahirniḥsāryya maṇḍale |
saure vibhāvya raktābhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca caturbhujām || 5-2 ||

vahnimaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ kumārīrūpadhāriṇīm |
bibhrāṇāṃ pustakaṃ mālāṃ varadaṃ cābhayaṃ tathā || 5-3 ||

bālasūryasamāmambāṃ dhyātvaivaṃ saṃjapenmanum |
atha mādhyandine saṃdhyānāhate ca kaṭhābjake || 5-4 ||

hrīṃ bījaṃ śuklasaṃkāśaṃ dhyātvā niḥsārya pūrvavat |
sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ trinetrāṃ śuklavigrahām || 5-5 ||

ārūḍhayauvanāṃ cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ tathā |
vibhrāṇāṃ ca tathā jyeṣṭhāṃ dhyātvaivaṃ saṃjapenmanum || 5-6 ||

atha sāyantanī sandhyā bhrūmadhye hakṣapadmake |
hrīṃ bījaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu dhyātvā niḥsārya pūrvavat || 5-7 ||

somamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ caturbhujām |
bibhrāṇāmabhayaṃ śūlaṃ kapālīṃ tarjanīṃ tathā || 5-8 ||

vāme dakṣe ca bibhrāṇāṃ citrāṃ netratrayānvitām |
vicitrābharaṇāṃ raudrīṃ dhyātvaivaṃ saṃjapenmanum || 5-9 ||

aṣṭabījāni coccārya vāgbhavaṃ kūṭamuccaret |
vāgīśvarye vidmahe ca kāmakūṭaṃ tatoccaret || 5-10 ||

kāmeśvaryai dhīmahīti śaktikūṭaṃ tataḥ param |
tannaḥ śaktiḥpadaṃ proktvā vyāharecca pracodayāt || 5-11 ||

bījapañcakamuccārya gāyatryeṣā samīritā mūlavidyāṃ tato japtvā guhyātīti 
nivedayet || 5-12 ||

iti sandhyāvidhānam | saṃkṣepasandhyā tu tantrāntare - sāyaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne 
devīṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japet iti sandhyātrayamāvaśyakam | tathā kulārṇave-

sandhyālopo na kartavyaḥ śambhorājñaivameva hi | 
dīkṣitaḥ sandhyayā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnute || 5-1 ||

na kuryādyadi tāṃ sandhyāṃ patito daśadhā japet |
anyasandhyāsame kāle sautrakaṇṭakividyayā || 5-2 ||

kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgamantreṇa dhyāyet tāṃ sautrakaṇṭakīm |
ṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ trinetrāṃ parameśvarīm || 5-3 ||

galādūrdhvaṃ śvetavarṇāṃ pītāṃ galatalādadhaḥ |
kaṭyādipādaparyantaṃ nīlābhāṃ ca tataḥ smaret || 5-4 ||

dviraṣṭavarṣāṃ raktāṅgīṃ sarvaśṛṅgāracarccitām |
svarṇaratnaprabhābhiśca maṇḍitābhiḥ (li) sahasrikām || 5-5 ||

mocinīṃ sarvapāpānāṃ raktasiṃhāsane sthitām |
tadūrdhvaṃ śvetapadmaṃ ca tadūrdhvaṃ śvetakesaram || 5-6 ||

tatpṛṣṭhe saṃsthitāṃ devīṃ trikhaṇḍāguṇamaṇḍitām |
ratnamukuṭojjvalāṃ divyāṃ santatāṃ nādapūritām || 5-7 ||

hasadvaktrāṃ mahādevīṃ dakṣiṇodayagāminīm |
mahāsamayayāgāya nityaniṣkalagāminīm || 5-8 ||

pañcapraṇavamuccārya vāgbhavaṃ paraduṣkaram |
karmacchedanakārīti aghore varade tathā || 5-9 ||

p. 80)

vicce māyāpadaṃ proktvā trailokyapadamuddharet |
rūpeti ca padaṃ proktvā sahasraparivartinī || 5-10 ||

mātṛgaṇe padaṃ cānu hasrūṃ praṇavapañcakam |
luptasandhyāmahāpāpanivṛttyarthamimaṃ japet || 5-11 ||

daśavāraṃ tato japyānmūlamantraṃ yathāvidhi |
svayaṃ jyotirmayo bhūtvā mūlavidyāṃ hṛdi smaran || 5-12 ||

pūjārthaṃ jalamādāya yāgamaṇḍapamāviśet |

iti | jñānārṇave-

sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyaḥ karpūraghusṛṇādibhiḥ |
mahāmṛgamadoddāmaliptāṅgaḥ kuṃkumāru *?ḥ || 5-1 ||

navaratnavibhūṣāḍhyo raktāmbaravirājitaḥ |
tāmbūlarāgavadano mādanānandamānasaḥ || 5-2 ||

yāgamandiramāgatya lākṣārasavicitritam |
anekadhūpabahulaṃ puṣpasaṃbhārapūritam || 5-3 ||

gomayena ca saṃliptaṃ cārupuṣpavirājitam |

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām-

atha yāgagṛhaṃ yāyādalaṅkāravibhūṣitam |
anekacitrasubhagaṃ bhūmau gomayacarcitam || 5-1 ||

upariṣṭāllasatpuṣpavitānaṃ dhūpadhūpitam |
dīpamālāvalīramyavikīrṇakusumojjvalam || 5-2 ||

iti yāgamaṇḍapam |

tāraṃ vajrodake huṃphaṭsvāhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ |
jalenāsanamabhyukṣya taduparyupaviśya ca || 5-3 ||

tāraṃ māyā viśuddheti sarvapāpāni coccaret |
śamayāśeṣeti tato vikalpamapaneti ca || 5-4 ||

ya hūmiti ca mantreṇa hastau pādau ca kṣālayet |
oṃ hrīṃ svāhetimantreṇa trirācamyāṅgane tataḥ || 5-5 ||

upaviśya tataḥ saurapūjāṃ kuryādyathāvidhi |

iti | kularṇave - prāṅmukhaḥ prāṅgaṇe pūrve yajenmārtaṇḍabhairavam | iti | 
śambhunirṇaye-

caturanvayasiddhyarthaṃ saurapūjeyamīritā | 
tadvicārya cidādityapūjāṃ kartuṃ sukhāsane || 5-1 ||

prāṅmukhaḥ pratyagāsīnaḥ smasnigdhamahītale |
sāmānyārghyaṃ ca vāme syāt praṇavānpañca coccaret || 5-2 ||

maṇḍaloccā (ddhā) raṇaṃ kuryāditi sādhāraṇaṃ matam | 
bhūtāṃgulaṃ ca vedāsraṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caurdhvarekhikam || 5-3 ||

vilikhya tasmin sādhārapātramastraviśodhitam |
saṃsthāpya payasāpūryādhārapātrajaleṣu ca || 5-4 ||

vahnyarkasomabījaistu tathā cātmavibhāvitam |
evaṃ niṣpādya ṣaṭdīrghaṃ dvitīyapraṇavātmakam || 5-5 ||

aṅgaṃ tasya vidhāyaivaṃ śaṅkhaṃ saṃsthāpya deśikaḥ |
vahacchvāsakarāgreṇa purataḥ sauramaṇḍalam || 5-6 ||

vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa kastūrīcandanādibhiḥ |

iti | aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ hasakhaphreṃ hasauḥ candrasūryāgnigarbhaṃ sphurasphura 
dharmārthakāmamokṣalābhaṃ kurukuru mahākhecarīmudrāṃ prakaṭayaprakaṭaya 
śāmbhavājñayā caturanvayānāṃ siddhisāmarthyādi dadadada kicakica kilakila phreṃ 
maṇḍalabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍala hasrūṃ mahācaṇḍaśive sahaphreṃ || 5-5 ||

anena mantreṇābhyarcyaṃ vṛttāṣṭadalapadmakam |
maṇḍalaṃ caturasraṃ tu kṛtvā saṃsthāpya cāgrata || 5-7 ||

sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣārghyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ |
dakṣe saurārghyapūjārthe maṇḍalaṃ caturasrakam || 5-8 ||

kṛtvādhāraṃ tu saṃsthāpya pūjayedamunāṇunā |

iti | aiṃ pātrāsādanāya namaḥ aiṃ | tatrāstrakṣālitaṃ pātraṃ dhūpitaṃ 
sthāpayedbudhāḥ klīṃ || 5-5 ||

iti mantreṇa cārghyaṃ tu pūjayecchuddhavāriṇā |
hauṃbījena ca ṣaṭdīrghasvarasaṃbheditena ca || 5-9 ||

aṣṭa gandhānvinikṣipya raktapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
astreṇa rakṣāṃ saṃkalpya svātmānamadhidhārayet || 5-10 ||

athāṣṭapadmamadhye tu dhyātvā pretasvarūpiṇam |
anantamarcayettatra śayānaṃ manunāmunā || 5-11 ||

p. 81)

aṃ anantāya namaḥ aṃ |

talpīkṛtasvayaṃdehaṃ chatrīkṛtaphaṇātrayam | 
phaṇināmīśvaraṃ śvetaṃ dhyātvā sampūjayettataḥ || 5-12 ||

agrīśāsuravāyavyeṣvasriṣu kramato yajet |

hūṃhūṃphreṃ prabandhanāthāya hūṃhūṃhaṃ | yaṃraṃlaṃ trimūrtaye | yaṃ 
ārādhyāya yaṃ | haṃ paramasukhāya haṃ | haṃ 

daharākāśamadhyasthaṃ hrīṃbījaṃ raktasannibham | vahatpuṭādviniḥsāryānantaṃ 
pretātmakāsanam || 5-13 ||

āvāhya tadbījamayaṃ dhyāyenmārtaṇḍabhairavam | dhyānam-

raktavarṇaṃ sthūladehaṃ ṣaḍvaktramūrdhvakeśikam | 
bhujadvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ sarpāsthiratnacarcitam || 5-14 ||

krodhinaṃ cordhvaliṅgaṃ ca jvaladraśmisamākulam |
vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitam || 5-15 ||

huṃhuṃkāraṃ pramuñcantaṃ saṃharantaṃ mahāśinām |
triśūlāsicakrakhaḍgasṛṇivaradapāṇikam || 5-16 ||

tarjāśokagadācāpapāśābhayakarālinam |
āvāhanādimudrāśca saṃdarśyābhyarcya sādhakaḥ || 5-17 ||

hrāmādikramataścāṅgaṃ kṛtvā mārtaṇḍabhairave | 
tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ sārghyaṃ samantraṃ ca nivedayet || 5-18 ||

hrauṃ hasrauḥ śrīkulamārtaṇḍabhairavāya hrauṃ hasrauḥ || 

paścāt samprokṣya cātmānaṃ japenmantramimaṃ punaḥ |
puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet samyaksavitre sarvasākṣiṇe || 5-19 ||

hasrauḥ kṣrauṃ hasrauḥ phaṭ khaphreṃ bhāṃ phaṭ hasrauḥ kṣoṃ hasrauḥ phaṭ 
khaphreṃbhāṃ | iti puṣpāñjalimantraḥ |

mudre ca śūlatarjanyau tridhāṅkāṃ hariṇīmapi |
kṛtvāṃgulipradaraśya tu pūrvādyaṣṭadaleṣu ca || 5-20 ||

madhye ca śūlatarjanyau dadhānaṃ caṇḍarociṣam |
nava śaktīryajettatra bhairavānapi pūjayet || 5-21 ||

jūṃ jvālāyai jūṃ | kṣāṃ mitrīśāyai kṣāṃ | huṁphaṭ caṇḍālinyai huṃphaṭ | sauḥ 
bhīṣaṇāyai sauḥ | aiṃ nārasiṃhāyai aiṃ | hrīṃ kamalādevyai hrīṃ | phreṃ 
mārtaṇḍāyai phreṃ | phreṃ kapālinyai phreṃ | sauḥ kaulinyai sauḥ || 5-atha 
bhairavamantrāḥ - phreṃ caṇḍāya phreṃ evaṃ viśveśāya mahādevāya 
mahākālāya gabhastīśāya caṇḍeśāya taijasāya mārtaṇḍāya | 

mudrāṃ ca khecarīṃ baddhvā layāṅgaṃ bhogamaṅgakam | 
hrāmādikaṃ vidhāyaiva dūrvāraktaprasūnakaiḥ || 5-22 ||

sampūjya dhūpadīpādinaivedyantārghamantrakam |
yathāśakti japitvā tu arghyamantreṇa tajjapam || 5-23 ||

pūrvoktamarghyamantre ca cidāditya hṛdambuje |
dahadaha kahakahātmānaṃ tadā samuddharet || 5-24 ||

nidhāyārghyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tejo'rghyaṃ ca tathā bahiḥ |
vāmabhāge likhitvā tu caturasraṃ tu maṇḍalam || 5-25 ||

tasmin sādhārapātre tu paśumārtaṇḍabhairavam |
abhyarcya ca vidhānena tanmantreṇaiva deśikaḥ || 5-26 ||

samarpyāśeṣanirmālyaṃ tasmai sarvaṃ nivedayet |

hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ paśumārtaṇḍabhairavāya | iti saurapūjā || atha maṇḍapapūjā | ādau 
maṇḍapadhyānam | 

amṛtābdhau maṇidvīpe cintayennandanaṃ vanam |
campakāśokapunnāgapāṭalairupaśobhitam || 5-27 ||

lavaṅgamālatībilvadevadārunamerubhiḥ |
mandārapārijātādyaiḥ kalpavṛkṣaiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ || 5-28 ||

candanaiḥ karṇikāraiśca mātuluṅgaiśca vañjulaiḥ |
dāḍimīlakucāṅkālaiḥ pūgaiḥ kurubakairapi || 5-29 ||

kadalīkundamandāranārikelairalaṃkṛtam |
anyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpāḍhyairvṛkṣapaṇḍaiśca maṇḍitam || 5-30 ||

mālatīmallikājātīketakaiḥ śatapatrakaiḥ |
pārantītulasīnandyāvartairdamanakairapi || 5-31 ||

sarvartukusumopetairlasadbhirupaśobhitam |
mandamārutasambhinnakusumāmodidiṅmukham || 5-32 ||

tasya madhye parajyotiḥsvarūpo meruparvataḥ |
tasya madhye sadā phulleḥ kumudotpalapaṅkajaiḥ || 5-33 ||

p. 82)

sugandhikaiśca kahlārairnavaiḥ kubalayairapi |
haṃsasārasakāraṇḍabhramaraiścakranāmabhiḥ || 5-34 ||

anyaiḥ kalakalārāvavihaṅgairupaśobhitam |
mahāsarasi tanmadhye puline'timanohare || 5-35 ||

paritaḥ pārijātāḍhyaṃ mahākalpataruṃ smaret |
nīpopavanamadhyasthaṃ nānāpuṣpasupuṣpitam || 5-36 || 

nānāratnaphalākīrṇa chāyāśritajagattrayam |
udbhūtaratnacchāyābhiraruṇīkṛtabhūtalam || 5-37 ||

udyaddinakarendubhyāmudbhāsitadigantaram |
ṛtubhiḥ sevitaṃ ṣaḍbhiraniśaṃ prītivarddhanam || 5-38 ||

parāmṛtākhyamadhubhiḥ siñcantaṃ maṇḍapaṃ muhuḥ |
tasyādhastānmahāvedirmāṇikyaikavinirmitā || 5-39 ||

vajraprākārasandīptā śatayojanavistṛtā |
tanmadhye cintayed dīptaṃ maṇḍapaṃ maṇikuṭṭimam || 5-40 ||

udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ bhāsvaraṃ śaśiśītalam |
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ hemaprākāraśobhitam || 5-41 ||

ratnopakḷptasaṃśobhikapāṭāṣṭakaśobhitam |
navaratnasamākḷptatuṅgagopuratoraṇam || 5-42 ||

hemadaṇḍasamālambidhvajāvalipariṣkṛtam |
navaratnasamābaddhastambharājivirājitam || 5-43 ||

sahasradīpasaṃyuktadīpamaṇḍalarājitam |
taptahāṭakasaṃkḷptavātāyanamanoharam || 5-44 ||

nānāvarṇāṃśukābaddhasuvarṇaśatakoṭibhiḥ |
kiṅkiṇīmālikāyuktapatākābhiralaṃkṛtam || 5-45 ||

hemakumbhāvalīramyanānācitravicitritam |
jātarūpamayai ratnakhacitairativistṛtaiḥ || 5-46 ||

māṇikyaratnavaiḍūryasvarṇamālāvalīyutaiḥ |
antarāntarasambaddharatnairdṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ || 5-47 ||

vicitraiścitravarṇaiśca vitānairupaśobhitam |
sarvaratnasamāyuktahemakuṭṭimamujjvalam || 5-48 ||

ketakīmālatījātīcampakotpalakesaraiḥ |
mallikātulasīyūthīṃnandyāvartakadambakaiḥ || 5-49 ||

etairanyaiśca kusumairalaṃkṛtamahītalam |
ratnasopānasannaddhabhūmikābhirupaskṛtam || 5-50 ||

candrakāśmīrakastūrīmṛganābhitamālakaiḥ |
candanāgurukarpūrairādīpitadigantaram || 5-51 ||

puṣpamālāvalīramyamuktāśreṇivirājitam |
karpūradīpabhāsvantaṃ māṇikyadīpamaṇḍitam || 5-52 ||

kalpavṛkṣataruprāntamantarāratnavedikām |
ratnasiṃhāsane naddhaṃ śrīmacchrīcakramaṇḍitam || 5-53 ||

indrādidevatāvṛndairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ |
anekayoginīvṛndairastradaivatakairapi || 5-54 ||

saṃsevyamānapādābjayugmayā tatsvarūpayā |
mahātripurasundaryādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvakāmadam || 5-55 ||

sudhāsandohakallolalolitaṃ mokṣakāmadam |
anekadhūpabahulaṃ maṇḍapaṃ cintayet sudhīḥ || 5-56 ||

tanmaṇḍapasthamātmānaṃ dhyāyennākulacetasam |
bhairavo'hamiti jñātvā sarvajñādiguṇānvitaḥ || 5-57 ||

iti śrīmaṇḍapadhyānam || atha dvārapūjā-

tatra svarṇaprākārasya pūrvadvāreṇāntaḥ praviśya prādakṣiṇyena maṇimaṇḍapasya 
paścimadvāraṃ gatvā tadārabhya maṇimaṇḍapaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya paścimadvāreṇa 
maṇimaṇḍapāntaḥ praviśya sādhakaḥ pūjayed devīmiti kramastenaiva krameṇa 
dvārapūjanāmityato yāgamaṇḍapasya prākārasambhave taddvārāśritaḥ tadasambhave 
yāgamaṇḍapasya paścimadvāre maṇḍapāsambhave gomayopaliptāyā yāgabhūmeḥ 
paścimabhāge kvāpi sthitvā sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ kalpayitvā krameṇa 
pūjayet | tatra koṭiyojanavistīrṇasudhārṇavāntargataṃ koṭiyojanavistīrṇāyataṃ 
mahādbhutam navaratnamayaṃ dvīpaṃ sahasrādityatejasaṃ tanmadhyatṛtīyāṃśe 
madanonmādanaṃ nāma nānāpuṣpalatākulaṃ kadambakānanagarbhakaṃ 
nandanodyānaṃ tanmadhyatṛtīyāṃśe koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ 
jvalatsvarṇaprākāraveṣṭitaṃ nānāsurabhiśālitoraṇadvāraṃ nānāratnavimaṇḍitaṃ 
paritaḥ sevāyātendrādigaṇasamākulaṃ śrīmaṇḍapaṃ dhyātvā 
sāmānyārghyodakenābhyukṣya puṣpatoyābhyāṃ krameṇa pūjayet || 4 sudhārṇavāya 
namaḥ 4 navaratnamayadvīpāya namaḥ 4 nandanodyānāya namaḥ 4 svarṇaprākārāya 
namaḥ taddvārasya dakṣiṇottaraśākhayoruparyadhaśca pūjayet | 4 gāṃ 
gaṇeśapādukāṃ pūjayāmi 4 kṣāṃ kṣetrapālapādukāṃ pūjayāmi 4 dvāṃ 
dvāraśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi 4 deṃ dehalīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | 

p. 83)

dakṣiṇapādapuraḥsaramantaḥ praviśyābhyantare prāgādyaṣṭadikṣu indrādidikpālān 
pūjayet | tataḥ paścimabhāge tiraskaraṇīṃ pūjayet | vṛttatrikoṇacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ 
vidhāya tatra-

nīlaṃ turaṅgamadhiruhya suśobhamānā nīlāṃśukābharaṇamālyavibhūṣaṇāḍhyā 
| 
nidrāpaṭena bhuvanāni tirodadhānā khaṅgāyudhā bhagavatī paripātu cāsmān ||

iti dhyātvā 4 aiṃ namo bhagavati māheśvari paśujanamanuścakṣustiraskaraṇaṃ 
kurukuru svāheti gandhākṣatakusumaiḥ pūjayet | tataḥ 4 kadambavanāya namaḥ 4 
śrīratnamaṇḍapāya namaḥ itisampūjya tasya dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | sauḥ astrāya 
phaḍityanena paścimadvāramabhyukṣyordhvaśākhāyāṃ 4 māṃ mahālakṣmīpā0 
vāme 4 sāṃ sarasvatīpā0 madhye 4 duṃ durgāśrīpā0 4 dvāṃ dvāraśrīpā0 | 
dakṣavāmaśākhayoḥ 4 śaṃ śaṅkhanidhivasudhārābhyāṃ namaḥ 4 
padmanidhivasumatībhyāṃ namaḥ | ūrdhve dakṣe 4 gaṃ vighneśapā0 vāme 4 kṣaṃ 
kṣetreśapādukāṃ0 tadūrdhve ca dakṣe 4 gāṃ gaṅgāpā0 vāme 4 yāṃ yamunāpā0 
tadūrdhve dakṣe 4 dhāṃ dhātre namaḥ vāme 4 viṃ vidhātre namaḥ adhodehalyāṃ 4 
deṃ dehalīpā0 4 vāṃ varuṇapā0 iti paścimadvārapūjā || tataḥ uttaradvāraṃ gatvā 
tadūrdhvaśākhāyāṃ 4 vaṃ vaṭukanāthapā0 4 dvāṃ dvāraśrīpā0 | tataḥ 
pūrvavacchaṅkhanidhivasudhārādidehalyantaṃ sampūjya dehalyagrataḥ 4 
kuṃkuberapā0 iti uttaradvārapūjā || tataḥ pūrvadvāraṃ gatvā 
tadūrdhvaśākhāyāṃ 4 kṣauṃ kṣetrapālapā0 dakṣiṇe 4 viṃ vighnanāthapā0 tataḥ 
svasmādvāmataḥ kṣetrapālasya dakṣiṇavāmāgreṣu 
mahālakṣmīsarasvatīdvāraśriyaḥ pūjayitvā śaṅkhapadmamithunādārabhya 
dehalyantaṃ prāgvat pūjayitvā dehalyagrataḥ 4 lāṃ indranāthapā0 iti 
pūrvadvārapūjā || tato dakṣiṇadvāraṃ gatvābhyukṣya tadūrdhvaśākhāyāṃ 4 
glauṃ gaṇanāthapā0 4 dvāṃ dvāraśīpādukāṃ pū0 | dakṣavāmaśākhayoḥ 
kāmadevavasantamithune prathamaṃ pūjayet | tadūrdhve 
śaṅkhapadmamithunādidehalyantaṃ sampūjya dehalyagrataḥ 4 yāṃ yamanāthapā0 iti 
dakṣiṇadvārapūjā || tataḥ punaḥ paścimadvāraṃ gatvā vāmapādapuraḥsaraṃ 
tattoraṇāntaḥ praviśya maṇimaṇḍapābhimukhasthā mañcasthadevatāḥ pūjayet | 4 
raṃ ratnasopānāya namaḥ iti ratnasopānaṃ pūjayitvā tadūrdhve mañcasthadevatā 
dhyātvā pūjayet | paścimadvārasya purato dakṣe 4 sāṃ sarasvatīpā0 vāme 4 māṃ 
mahālakṣmīpā0 tayormadhye uparyadho'greṣu gauryādayo mānavaughāntāḥ pūjyāḥ 
| 4 gauṃ gaurīpā0 4 loṃ lokadhātrīpā0 4 vāṃ vāgīśvarīpā0 4 divyaughaśrīpā0 4 
siddhaughaśrīpā0 4 mānavaughaśrīpā0 | tataḥ punaruttaradvāre prāgvanmāyādurge 
gauryādimānavaughāntaṃ pūjayet | tataḥ pūrvadvāri 
prāgvadbhadrakālīsvastīgauryādimānavaughāntaṃ pūjayet | tato dakṣiṇadvāri 
svāhāśubhaṅkarīdevyai gauryādimānavaughāntaṃ pūjayet | tataḥ punaḥ 
paścimadvāraṃ gatvā pālitaṃ bahirindrādyaiḥ paramaiśvaryaśobhitam | prapadye 
paścimadvāraṃ bhavānyā mandiraṃ mahat || iti dhyātvā | 4 paścimadvārāya 
ratnamaṇḍapāya namaḥ iti maṇḍapaṃ sampūjya tālatrayapūrvakaṃ dvāramudghāṭya 
siddhārthākṣatakusumāni nārācāstraprayogena āṃ apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā 
bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || 5-hraḥ astrāya 
phaḍityantena maṇḍapāntaḥ prakṣipya tasmānnirgacchatāṃ vighnasaṅghānāṃ 
vāmāṅgasaṅkocanena mārgaṃ dattvā trividhavighnānutsārayet dehalyāmeva 
mūlavidyāṃ vāstramantraṃ vā manasā japan vāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa bhaumān 
tālatrayeṇāntarikṣagān divyadṛṣṭyavalokanena ca divyān vighnānutsārya oṃ 
pākhaṇḍakāriṇo bhūtā bhūmau ye cāntarikṣagāḥ | divyaloke sthitā ye ca te naśyantu 
śivājñayā || iti paṭhitvā vāmapādapuraḥsaraṃ dehalīṃ laṅghayan maṇḍapāntaḥ 
tato maunī viśuddhātmā hṛdi devīṃ parāmṛśam | avahirmānaso yogī 
yāgabhūmimathāviśet || iti dvārapūjā || atra pratidvāraṃ gamanāsambhave 
paścimadvāra eva sthitvā tattaddvārāṇi kalpayitvā pūjayet | paścimadvārameveti kecit | 
atha dvāradevatānāṃ dhyānāni :

padmadvayavarābhītibhāsvatpāṇicatuṣṭayām |
padmavarṇā bhajetpadmāṃ padmākṣīṃ padmavāsinīm || 5-1 ||

akṣasrakpustakadharā pūrṇacandrasamadyutiḥ |
viśvavidyāmayī devī bhāratī bhāsatāṃ mayi || 5-2 ||

śaṅkhacakrāṅkitakarā kumārī kuṭilālakā |
mṛgendravāhanā devī durgā durgāṇi hantu me || 5-3 ||

p. 84)

taptakārtasvarābhāsā divyaratnavibhūṣitā |
dvāraśrīrūrdhvapadmasthā varābhayakarāmbujā || 5-4 ||

muktāmāṇikyasaṅkāśau kiñcit smitamukhāmbujau |
anyonyāliṅganaparau śaṅkhapaṅkajadhāriṇau || 5-5 ||

vigaladratnavarṣābhyāṃ śaṅkhābhyāṃ mūrdhni lāṃchitau |
śaṅkhāsanasamāsīnau viśvasaṅkalpakalpakau || 5-6 ||

tundilaṃ kambukanidhiṃ vasudhārāṃ ghanastanīm |
vāmataḥ paṅkajanidhiṃ priyayā sahitaṃ yajet || 5-7 ||

sindūrābhau bhujāśliṣṭau raktapadmotpalānvitau |
niḥsaradratnavarṣābhyāṃ padmābhyāṃ mūrdhni lāṃchitau || 5-8 ||

padmāsanasamāsīnau viśvasaṅkalpakalpakau |
tundilaṃ paṅkajanidhiṃ tanvīṃ vasumatīmapi || 5-9 ||

palāśapāṭalacchāyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ratipriyam |
puṇḍrekṣucāpapuṣpeṣumantaṃ vande manobhavam || 5-10 ||

prapadye prītidayitaṃ pūrṇendusadṛśaprabham |
vasantaṃ nandanodyāne vasantaṃ santatotsavam || 5-11 ||

pāśāṃkuśāruṇāmbhojapāṇiṃ pāṭalatundilam |
vīraṃ vighneśvaraṃ vande gajavaktraṃ trilocanam || 5-12 ||

kapālaśūle vibhrāṇaṃ karābhyāṃ kṛṣṇavigraham |
tīkṣṇaṃ tryakṣaṃ samarcāmi kṣetreśaṃ kṣatavidviṣam || 5-13 ||

varābhayakarāṃ saumyāṃ somakoṭisamaprabhām |
bhaje gaṅgāṃ mahādevyāḥ pādodakataraṅgiṇīm || 5-14 ||

vāmapādārdhasambhūtāṃ paradevyāstaraṅgiṇīm |
varābhayakarāṃ vande kālindīṃ kālavigrahām || 5-15 ||

bhartāraṃ jagatāṃ vande śaṅkhacakragadāmbujam |
vibhrāṇaṃ garuḍārūḍhaṃ dhātāraṃ kṛṣṇavigraham || 5-16 ||

raktaṃ raktārabindasthaṃ varābhayakamaṇḍalum |
haṃsārūḍhaṃ vidhātāraṃ vande'kṣasraksamanvitam || 5-17 ||

siṃhārūḍhāṃ śyāmalāṅgīṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīm |
adhastāddehalīṃ vande paścimāsyāṃ svarakṣiṇīm || 5-18 ||

pāśābhayadharaṃ vande pūrṇendusadṛśacchavim |
varuṇaṃ makarārūḍhaṃ dvāre śrīpādadaivatam || 5-19 ||

iti paścimadvāre ||

karakalitakapālaḥ kuṇḍalī daṇḍapāṇistaruṇatimiranīlo vyālayajñovavītī |
kratusamayasaparyāvighnavicchedaheturjayati vaṭukanāthaḥ siddhidaḥ sādhakānām || 5-
20 ||

dhūmravarṇo gadāhastaḥ kubero naravāhanaḥ | 
saumyadvārādhipaḥ pāyāt paradevyā dhaneśvaraḥ || 5-21 ||

vyālavyagrajaṭādharaṃ trinayanaṃ nīlāñjanādriprabhaṃ 
dordaṇḍāttakapālabhālamaruṇasragvastragandhojjvalam |
ghaṇṭāghrghuramekhaladhvanimiladdhāṃkārabhīmaṃ vibhuṃ 
vande'haṃ sitasarpakuṇḍaladharaṃ taṃ kṣetrapālaṃ sadā || 5-22 || 

sito gajāsyaḥ paraśuṃ dantaṃ pāśaṃ triśūlakam |
bhujaiścaturbhirbibhrāṇo mūṣakopari saṃsthitaḥ || 5-23 ||

pūrvadvārādhipaḥ śakraḥ paradevyāḥ supītakaḥ |
vajrahastaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ pāyādairāvatadhvajaḥ || 5-24 ||

gaṇeśaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ digambaram |
vāmadakṣordhvabāhubhyāṃ pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ tathā || 5-25 ||

dakṣiṇādhaḥkareṇaiva madhupūrṇaṃ kapālakam |
dadhānaṃ vāmahastena devyā madanamandiram || 5-26 ||

spṛśan vāmāṅgasaṃsthāyā raktāyā dakṣapāṇinā |
ātmayonau nyasya liṅgaṃ padmaṃ vāmena pāṇinā || 5-27 ||

dadhatyāḥ śuṇḍayā yoni jighran dhyātvā prapūjayet |
nīlāñjanacayaprakhyaṃ yamaṃ mahiṣavāhanam || 5-28 ||

daṇḍamaṇḍitadordaṇḍaṃ dakṣadvārādhipaṃ smaret |

iti | atha mañcasthadevatādhyānam-

akṣasrakpustakābhītīrdadhānāṃ bāhubhirvaram |
trilocanāṃ smareddevīṃ sarvaśuklāṃ sarasvatīm || 5-1 ||

padmadvayavarābhītibhāsvatpāṇicatuṣṭayām |
nirdagdhahemagaurāṅgīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ trilocanām || 5-2 ||

pāśāṃkuśavarābhītirbibhratīmaruṇaprabhām |
trinetrāṃ mātaraṃ vande gaurīṃ raktāmbarojjvalām || 5-3 ||

p. 85)

natyutpalavarābhītīrbibhratīṃ kāñcanaprabhām |
mātaraṃ divyaratnāṅgīṃ lokadhātrīṃ namāmyaham || 5-4 ||

śvetāṃ śvetāmbarāṃ śvetabhūṣaṇasragvilepanām |
padmadvayavarādarśakarāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ bhaje || 5-5 ||

varāṃkuśau pāśamabhītiśūlaṃ karairdadhānāṃ bhavabhāvamūlam |
ghanāghanaughaprabhadehakāntiṃ māyāṃ trinetrāmaniśaṃ smarāmi || 5-6 ||

śaṅkhacakradhanurbāṇān dhārayantīṃ trilocanām |
dūrvādalanibhāṃ vande durgāṃ durgatihāriṇīm || 5-7 ||

kapālaṃ kheṭakaṃ khaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ |
bhinnāñjanacayaprakhyāṃ bhadrakālīṃ namāmyaham || 5-8 ||

śaktisvastikamudrābhīhastāṃ candrasamaprabhām |
trinetrāṃ saṃsmared devīṃ svastiṃ svastikarīṃ parām || 5-9 ||

raktotpaladvandvavarābhayāni karairvahantīṃ smitaśobhivaktrām |
raktāṃ trinetrāmaruṇāmbarāḍhyāṃ svāhāṃ bhaje devagaṇakavandyām || 5-10 ||

śālikalpalatāśārṅgabāṇapāṇicatuṣṭayā |
jvalatkāñcanavarṇābhā śubhaṃ kuryācchubhaṅkarī || 5-11 ||

iti dhyānāni || tato maṇḍalamadhye brahmaṇe namaḥ gṛheśānāya namaḥ nair-ṛtyāṃ 
vāstupuruṣāya namaḥ iti sampūjya oṃ rakṣarakṣa huṃphaṭsvāhā iti bhūmimabhyukṣya 
oṃ pavitravajrabhūme rakṣarakṣa huṃphaṭsvāhā iti bhūmimabhimantrya āḥ surekhe 
vajrarekhe huṃphaṭsvāhā iti bhūmau vilikhya taduparyāsanamāstīrya 
brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivān pūrvādicaturdikṣu madhye ca sampūjya tadupari 
trikoṇaṃ saṃcintya koṇatraye madhye ca kāmarūpapūrṇagirijālandharoḍyānapīṭhāni 
sampūjya 4 hrīṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ iti mantreṇāsanaṃ sampūjya 
tasmin prāṅmukho vodaṅmukho vopaviśyāthavā mātṛkāmaṇḍalaṃ dhyātvā 
taduparyyupaviśya bhūmiṃ prārthayet | oṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā 
dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhārayā māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam | māṃ ca pūtaṃ kuru dhare 
namo'smi tvāṃ sureśvari | oṃ pṛthivyā merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kṛmoṃ 
devatā āsane viniyogaḥ | oṃ praṇavasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ paramātmā devatā 
prāṇāyāme viniyogaḥ | tataḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dīpanāthāya namaḥ | 
dakṣabhuje gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ gaṇānāṃ tvā0 | vāme duṃ durgāyai namaḥ oṃ 
jātavedase0 | dakṣajānuni kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ oṃ kṣetrasya patinā vayaṃ0 | 
vāmajānuni saṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ praṇo devī sarasvatī0 | tataḥ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ 
paramagurubhyo namaḥ parameṣṭhigurubhyo namaḥ iti namaskṛtya | tataḥ 
pārṣṇighātakarāsphoṭasamudañcitavaktrakaiḥ | pātālabhūnabholīnān 
vighnānutsārayed budhaḥ | iti vighnānutsāryaṃ | uktapāśupatāstreṇa vāmahastatalaṃ 
dvidhā | maṇibandhaṃ samārabhya saṃspṛṣṭaṃ dakṣapāṇinā || pramṛjya dakṣiṇaṃ 
pāṇiṃ sakṛdevoktamārgataḥ | iti karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya digbandhaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā-
laṃ indrāya namaḥ indradiśaṃ cakreṇa badhnāmi namaścakrāya svāhā | oṃ 
sudarśanāya vidmahe mahājvālāya dhīmahi tannaścakraṃ pracodayāt 3 | ugraṃ vīraṃ 
mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham | nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ 
namāmyaham || evaṃ daśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā raṃ agniprākārāya namaḥ | sahasrāra 
huṁphaṭ sudarśanāgniprākārāya namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ sphura sphura prasphura prasphura ghora 
ghoratara tanurūpa caṭa caṭa pracaṭapracaṭa kahakaha vamavama bandhayabandhaya 
ghātayaghātaya huṃphaṭ aghorāgniprākārāya namaḥ idi jalenāgniprākāratrayaṃ 
kuryāt |

triragniveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā gaṇeśaṃ pañcamīṃ tataḥ |
durgāṃ vighnaṃ ca śarabhamaghoraṃ ca sudarśanam || 5-1 ||

etāḥ samayavidyāśca japet pratyūhaśāntaye | 
evaṃ rakṣāṃ purā kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhimathācaret || 5-2 ||

ete mantrā uddhārapaṭale boddhavyāḥ | tantrāntare-

sthāpayed dakṣiṇe bhāge pūjādravyāṇi deśikaḥ |
suvāsitāmbusampūrṇaṃ savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanam || 5-1 ||

prakṣālanāya karayoḥ paścāt pātraṃ niveśayet |
ghṛtaprajvālitān dīpān sthāpayet paritaḥ śubhān || 5-2 ||

darpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ tālavṛntaṃ manoharam | 

p. 86)

iti | kulacūḍāmaṇau-

nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi gandhāni vividhāni ca |
karpūrajātidhūpādivāsitaṃ paṭavāsitam || 5-1 ||

tāmbūlaṃ devadravyāṇi dhūpadīpādikaṃ ca yat |
sarvālaṅkārabhūṣādi vastrādīni kuleśvaraḥ || 5-2 ||

mūlamantrajaptatoyaiḥ saṃśodhya sthāpayettataḥ |
sarvaṃ svadakṣiṇe sthāpyaṃ vāme cārghyaṃ niveśayet || 5-3 ||

paścime devatāyāśca kuladravyāṇi dhārayet |

iti | tathaiva - oṃ puṣpaketurājārhate sarvagatāya samyak saṃbaddhāya oṃ puṣpe puṣpe 
mahāpuṣpe supuṣpe puṣpasaṃbhave puṣpāvacāyasaṃkīrṇaṃ huṁphaṭ svāhā iti 
mantreṇa puṣpādiśodhanam | oṃ rakṣarakṣa huṁphaṭsvāhā iti mantreṇa hṛdi hastaṃ 
dattvātmarakṣāṃ kuryāt | tataḥ praṇavena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhaṃ 
kuryāt | 

śarīrākārabhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ yadviśodhanam |
avyayabrahmasamparkād bhūtaśuddhiriyaṃ matā || 5-4 ||

suṣumnāvartmanātmānaṃ paramātmani yojayet |
yogayuktena vidhinā cinmantreṇa samāhitaḥ || 5-5 ||

iti | cinmantreṇa paramātmamantreṇetyarthaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥsohaṃsvāhā iti mantreṇa 
pūrvoktamūlādhārādiṣaṭcakrāṇi vicintya hṛdayacakrasthitaṃ jīvātmānaṃ manasā 
saha suṣumnāvartmanā kulakuṇḍalinīṃ jīvātmanā saha 
brahmarandhrasthaparamaśivapade yojayāmi svāhā idaṃ liṅgaśarīraṃ śodhayāmi 
svāhā iti jīvātmanā manodaṇḍenāhatya 
huṃbījenākuñcitādhovāyunā'dhovahnervivṛddhoṣmaṇā tāṃ jārayitvā 
suṣumnāntarvarticitrākhyanāḍīmadhyamārgeṇa ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa 
sthānārṇadaivataiḥ saha saṃhārayogato 
brahmarandhrasthasahasradalakamalakarṇikāsthacandramaṇḍalāntarasthite paramaśive 
līnāṃ cintayet | tataḥ pādādijānuparyantaṃ pṛthivīsthānaṃ pītavarṇaṃ 
caturasrākāraṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ nivṛttikalātmakaṃ tanmadhye laṃbījaṃ 
pañcoddhātaprayogeṇa jale saṃlāpayāmi | jānvādiliṅgaparyantaṃ jalasthānaṃ 
śuklavarṇaṃ padmalāñchitārddhacandrākāraṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ 
pratiṣṭhākalātmakaṃ tanmadhye vaṃbījaṃ caturuddhātaprayogeṇa tejasi saṃlāpayāmi 
| liṅgādinābhiparyantaṃ tejaḥsthānaṃ raktavarṇaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ rudradaitvayaṃ 
vidyākalātmakaṃ tanmadhye raṃbījaṃ triruddhātaprayogeṇa vāyau saṃlāpayāmi | 
nābhyādihṛdayaparyantaṃ vāyusthānaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇākāraṃ 
ṣaḍbindulāñchitamīśvaradaivatyaṃ śāntikalātmakaṃ tanmadhye yaṃbījaṃ 
dviruddhātaprayogeṇākāśe saṃlāpayāmi | 
hṛdayādikaṇṭhaparyantamākāśasthānaṃ svacchavarṇaṃ vṛttākāraṃ 
sadāśivadaivatyaṃ śāntyatītākalātmakaṃ tanmadhye 
haṃbījamekoddhātaprayogeṇāhaṃkāre saṃlāpayāmi | 
kaṇṭhādibhrūmadhyaparyantam ahaṅkārasthānaṃ trivarṇaṃ 
daṇḍākāramādiśivadaivatyaṃ sarvakalātmakaṃ tanmadhye haṃsaḥbījaṃ 
sarvoddhātaprayogeṇa mahattattve saṃlāpayāmi | bhrūmadhyādibhālaparyantaṃ 
mahattattvasthānaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ardhacandrākāramāndaśivadaivatyaṃ 
kalāsvarūpaṃ tanmadhye sohaṃbījamardhoddhātaprayogeṇa prakṛtau saṃlāpayāmi | 
bhālādisīmantaparyantaṃ prakṛtisthānaṃ bālārkavarṇaṃ 
yonyākāramānandaśivadaivatyaṃ kalāsvarūpaṃ tanmadhye haṃbījam 
ādyoddhātaprayogeṇa puruṣe saṃlāpayāmi | sīmantādibrahmarandhraparyantaṃ 
puruṣasthānamuddīptavarṇaṃ liṅgākāraṃ caitanyadaivatyaṃ niṣkalaṃ tanmadhye 
nādākṣaraṃ bījaṃ parabindusvarūpaṃ niruddhātaprayogeṇa cicchaktau saṃlāpayāmi 
| brahmarandhraṃ cicchaktisthānaṃ karpūravarṇaṃ sahasrāram ānandadaivatyaṃ 
nirākārasvarūpaṃ tanmadhye hrīṃ bījaṃ saṃhāradhyānaprayogeṇa 
parabrahmaśivātmakaṃ cidānandaghanaṃ cintayāmi iti vibhāvya oṃ 
pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśagandharasarūpasparśaśabda-
ghrāṇarasanācakṣustvakśrotrapādopasthapāyupāṇivāggamanā-
nandavisargādānavacanāhaṅkāramanobuddhicitta-
vikalpasaṃkalpavyavasāniścayajīvātmaparamātmābhidhasamastatattvātmakaṃ 
prapañcasvarūpaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaśarīradvayaṃ saṃhārakrameṇa 
pṛthivīmapsvapastejasi tejo vāyau vāyumākāśe ākāśamahaṅkāre ahaṅkāraṃ 
mahati mahāntaṃ prakṛtau prakṛtiṃ puruṣe puruṣaṃ paramaśive saṃyojayāmi svāhā 
idaṃ sthūlaśarīraṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti sasthānāni sākṣarāṇi sakāryāṇi 
sakāraṇāni sadaivatāni sāṅgopāṅgāni sthūlāni sūkṣmāṇi ca sarvāṇi tattvāni 
svasvakāraṇeṣu saṃhārakrameṇa līnāni kṛtvā sahasradalakamalaparamaśive 
bījabhāvena līnāni cintayet | paramaśivaṃ cicchaktyātmakamānandaghanaṃ viniveśya 
nirmaladhiyā nirlīnasarvendriyo yogī yāgaphalaṃ prayāti satataṃ nityoditaṃ 
niṣkriyamevaṃ krameṇa saccidānandamayaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet iti saṃhārakramaḥ || atha 
pāpapuruṣacintanam-

p. 87)

vāmakukṣigataṃ pāpapuruṣaṃ kajjalaprabham |
brahmahatyāśiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteyabhujadvayam || 5-1 ||

surāpānahṛdā yuktaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayam |
tatsaṃsargipadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅgapātakam || 5-2 ||

upapātakaromāṇaṃ raktaśmaśruvilocanam |
khaḍgacarmadharaṃ krūraṃ pāpamevaṃ vicintayet || 5-3 ||

iti dhyātvā yaṃ pāpaśarīraṃ śoṣaya śoṣaya śoṣayāmi svāhā yaṃbījaṃ 
dhūmravarṇaṃ ṣoḍaśavāraṃ japan vāmanāsayā vāyumāpūrya tadeva 
catuṣṣaṣṭivāraṃ japan kumbhakayogena hṛdayādudgatena ṣaṭkāṇādāgatena 
mahāvāyunā pāpapuruṣaṃ śuṣkaṃ vicintya tadeva bījaṃ dvāviṃśadvāraṃ japan 
dakṣiṇanātayā? vāyuṃ recayet raṃ śuṣkapāpaśarīraṃ dāhaya dāhaya dāhayāmi 
svāhā raṃbījaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ṣoḍaśavāraṃ japan piṅgalayā vāyumāpūrya tadeva 
catuḥṣaṣṭivāraṃ japan kumbhakayogena nābheruditena trikoṇādāgatena mahatā 
vahninā pāpapuruṣaṃ dagdhaṃ vicintya tadeva dvātriṃśadvāraṃ japan iḍayā vāyuṃ 
recayet | ṭaṃ candramaṇḍalaṃ preraya preraya prerayāmi svāhā ṭamiti candrabījaṃ 
śuklavarṇaṃ 16 vāraṃ japan iḍayā vāyumāpūrya 64 vāraṃ japan kumbhakayogena 
sahasrāramadhye mahāmṛtaughapūritaṃ viśvāhlādakaṃ candrabījaṃ vicintya 32 
vāraṃ japan piṅgalayā recayet | vaṃ paramāmṛtaṃ varṣaya varṣaya varṣayāmi svāhā 
vamiti varuṇabījaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ 16 vāraṃ japan piṅgalayā vāyumāpūrya 64 vāraṃ 
japan kumbhakayogena tasmāccandrabimbānmātṛkāmayoṃ mahāvṛṣṭimutpādya 
tadasthiśmaśānādikamāplāvitaṃ vicintya 32 vāraṃ japan iḍayā vāyuṃ recayet | laṃ 
śarīramutpādaya utpādaya utpādayāmi svāhā lamiti pṛthivībījaṃ pītavarṇaṃ 16 
vāraṃ japan iḍayā vāyumāpūrya 64 vāraṃ japan kumbhakayogena oṃ 
paramātmajīvātmacittabuddhimano'haṅkāra-
niścayavyavasāyasaṃkalpavikalpavacanādānavisargānandagamanavākpāṇi-
pāyūpasthāpādaśrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇaśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśa-
vāyutejojalapṛthivyākhyasamastatattvātmakaṃ prapañcarūpaṃ 
sthūlasūkṣmaśarīradvayaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa pṛthagbhūtābhyāṃ 
paramaśivacicchaktibhyāṃ nirutpattiprayogeṇa puruṣaṃ puruṣādādyotpattiprayogeṇa 
prakṛtiṃ prakṛterarddhotpattiprayogeṇa mahāntaṃ mahataḥ 
sarvotpattiprayogeṇākāśamākāśād dvirutpattiprayogeṇa vāyuṃ 
vāyostrirutpattiprayogeṇa tejastejasaścaturutpattiprayogeṇa jalaṃ 
jalatpañcotpattiprayogeṇa pṛthivīṃ pṛthivyāḥ ṣaḍutpattiprayogeṇātpādayāmi svāhā-
iti sasthānāni sākṣarāṇi sakāraṇāni sakāryāṇi sadaivatāni sāṅgopāṅgāni 
sthūlāni sūkṣmāṇi ca sarvāṇi tattvāni sṛṣṭikrameṇa paraśivacicchaktisakāśāt 
svasvakāraṇebhya utpāditāni kṛtvā pādādudgatayā caturasrādāgatayā mahatyā 
pṛthivyā upaṣṭabhya devatāpūjāyogyaṃ navaṃ puṇyaśarīramutpāditaṃ vicintya 
tattvāni ca nijasthāneṣu sthitāni kṛtvā tadeva laṃbījaṃ dvātriṃśadvāraṃ japan 
piṅgalayā vāyumāpūrya 64 vāraṃ japan iḍayā vāyuṃ recayet iti ṣaṭ prāṇāyāmā 
bhavanti | ātmānaṃ hṛdayāmbhojādānayetparamātmanaḥ | manunā haṃsadevasya 
kuryānnyāsādikaṃ tataḥ || oṃ haṃsaḥ so'haṃ avatarāvatara śivapadāt jīvapadena 
suṣumnāvartmanā mūlaśṛṅgāṭamullasollasa jvalajvala prajvalaprajvala oṃ haṃsaḥ 
so'haṃ iti kuṇḍalinīrūpadhāriṇīṃ cicchaktiṃ jīvātmā saha sṛṣṭiyogena 
sthānārṇadaivataiḥ saha suṣumnāntarvarticitrākhyanāḍīmadhyamārgeṇa 
ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa brahmarandhratā mūlādhāramānīya sthāpayet mūlādhārāt 
jīvātmānaṃ hṛdisthaṃ cintayet - iti bhūtaśuddhiḥ ||

atha prāṇapratiṣṭhā | oṃ asya śrīprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantrasya brahmaviṣṇurudrā ṛṣayaḥ 
ṛgyajuḥsāmāni chandāṃsi caitanyarūpā prāṇaśaktirdevatā oṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ 
kroṃ kīlakaṃ prāṇasthāpane viniyogaḥ iti yathāsthānaṃ vinyasya aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ 
ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ ākāśavāyutejojalapṛthivyātmane aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iṃ caṃ 
chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmane tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | uṃ 
ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṃ śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇātmane 
madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ 
vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ 
maṃ auṃ vacanādānavisargānandagamanātmane kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | aṃ yaṃ 
raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aḥ cittabuddhimano'haṅkārātmane 
karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | ebhireva jātiyuktaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni | āṃ namaḥ 
nābheścaraṇaparyantaṃ hrīṃ namaḥ hṛdayānnābhiparyantaṃ kroṃ namaḥ 
mūrdhādihṛdayaparyantaṃ | yaṃ tvagātmane namaḥ raṃ asṛgātmane namaḥ | laṃ 
māṃsātmane namaḥ vaṃ medā-ātmane namaḥ śaṃ asthyātmane namaḥ ṣaṃ 
majjātmane namaḥ saṃ śukrātmane namaḥ haṃ prāṇātmane namaḥ laṃ jīvātmane 
namaḥ kṣaṃ paramātmane namaḥ | evaṃ vinyasya prāṇaśaktiṃ dhyāyet |

p. 88)

raktābdhipotāruṇapadyasaṃsthāṃ pāśāṃkuśāvikṣuśarāsabāṇān | 
śūlaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ karābjai raktāṃ trinetrāṃ praṇamāmi devīm || 5-1 ||

iti dhyātvā | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ 
hoṃ so'haṃ haṃsaḥ śrīmanmahātripurasundaryāḥ prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ 30 jīva iha 
sthitā 30 sarvendriyāṇi 30 vāṅmanaścakṣustvakśrotraghrāṇaprāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ 
ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti jñānamudrayā hṛdi hastaṃ dattvā vāratrayaṃ paṭhet | oṃ 
āṃ haṃsaḥ iti sarvānandamayaṃ dehaṃ dṛḍhaṃ cintayet (antarbahiḥstha) 
pradhānadevatātmakamātmānaṃ cintayet - iti prāṇapratiṣṭhā || 

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya - śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya - śrīvidyāraṇyativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
pañcamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 5 ||






atha 

śrīvidyārṇavatantre 

ṣaṣṭhaḥ śvāsaḥ 

atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ - tato dehasya saṃnāhaṃ saṃmyaknyāsaṃ samācaret |

antarvahiṣṭhāśca kalāyutāśca śrīkaṇṭhaviṣṇvādisamanvitāśca |
lajjāramākāmapṛthaksamoha prapañcayāgo daśa mātṛkāḥ syuḥ || 6-1 ||

gudāttu dvyaṃgulādūrdhvaṃ suṣumnāsūkṣmarandhragam |
vādivedārṇalasitaṃ paṅkajaṃ kanakaprabham || 6-2 ||

tatsthāṃ vidyullatākārāṃ tejorūpāmaṇīyasīm |
kulakuṇḍalinīmūrdhvaṃ nayet ṣaṭcakrabhedataḥ || 6-3 ||

dvādaśāntendumadhyasthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ mātṛkāvrajam |
navanītanibhaṃ dhyātvā drutaṃ kuṇḍalinītviṣā || 6-4 ||

tejoñjalau viniḥsārya mātṛkānyāsamācaret | 

tato'kārādiṣaṭsvarān karatalakaratatpṛṣṭhavyāptikrameṇa 
vinyasyāvaśiṣṭadaśasvarān daśasvaṃgulīṣu vinyasya ādikṣāntamātṛkāmuccaran 
karaśuddhiṃ kuryāt | yathā - prakoṣṭe maṇibandhe ca kūrpare karayostale | tatpṛṣṭhe ca 
tadagre ca karaśuddhirudāhṛtā || iti mātṛkākaraśuddhiḥ | athāntarmātṛkānyāsaḥ - 
tatra svaraiḥ pūrakaṃ sparśaiḥ kumbhakaṃ vyāpakaiḥ recakamiti krameṇa 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā asyā antarmātṛkāyāḥ brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ 
śrīmātṛkāsarasvatī devatā halo bījāni svarāḥ śaktayaḥ jātāvyaktiḥ kīlakaṃ mama 
śarīraśuddhyarthaṃ nyāse viniyogaḥ iti vinyasya aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ 
hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādinā prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya dhyāyet | tathā saṃhitāyām-

atha vakṣye maheśāni mātṛkāṃ lokamātaram | 
akārādikṣakārāntavarṇāvayavadevatām || 6-1 ||

ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
mātṛkā devatā devi halo bījāni śaktayaḥ || 6-2 ||

svarāstu parameśāni jātāvyaktistu kīlakam |
anirvācyā halo varṇāḥ śaktyā vyaktā bhavanti hi || 6-3 ||

śaktyā vinā śive sūkṣme nāma dhāma na vidyate |
asadrūpā halo varṇāḥ śaktyāsannāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ || 6-4 ||

sphuranmātrāstadoccāryyāḥ sammukhā vyaktavarṇakāḥ |
ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ parityajya ṣaḍyugmasvaramadhyagāḥ || 6-5 ||

vargāḥ ṣaṭ ca krameṇaiva saptamaḥ krodhasaṃyutaḥ |
ante nikṣipya deveśi ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset || 6-6 ||

kalāpatrāmbuje kaṇṭhe svarān samyak pravinyaset |
hṛdyarkapatre tadvarṇānnābhau daśadale nyaset || 6-7 ||

daśavarṇāṃlliṅgamadhye ṣaḍdale ṣaḍatheśvari |
caturdale tathādhāre caturvarṇāṃstato nyaset || 6-8 ||

bhrūmadhye dvidale hakṣau ityantarmātṛkāṃ nyaset | 

iti | tantrāntare-

ādhāre liṅganābhau hṛdayasarasije tālamūle lalāṭe 
dve patre ṣoḍaśāre dvidaśadaśadale dvādaśārdhe catuṣke |
vāsānte bālamadhye ḍaphakaṭhasahite kaṇṭhadeśe svarāṇāṃ 
haṃkṣaṃtattvārthayuktaṃ sakaladalagataṃ varṇarūpaṃ namāmi || 6-1 ||

p. 90)

iti dhyātvā nyasedityantarmātṛkā || atha bahirmātṛkā - ṛṣyādinyāsaṃ prāgvad 
vinyasya dhyāyet |

dhyāyedvarṇasvarūpāḍhyāṃ svaravaktrāṃ krameṇa hi |
kacavargakarāṃ ramyāṃ ṭatavargapadāmbujām || 6-1 ||

pavargacārupārśvāṅgalasacchātodarīṃ parām |
yaśavargāṅgasubhagāpīnonnataghanastanīm || 6-2 ||

nitabimbagahanāṃ śuklākṣīṃ kṣāmamadhyamām |
śuklamālyāṅgarāgāṅgīṃ akṣasrakkumbhaśobhitām || 6-3 ||

cintālikhitasatpāṇiṃ samagravaradāyinīm | iti dhyātvā |

brahmarandhre tathā vaktraveṣṭane nayanadvaye |
śrutināsāpuṭadvandvagaṇḍoṣṭhadvayakeṣu ca || 6-1 ||

dantayugme ca mūrdhāsyadvaye ṣoḍaśa vinyaset |
doḥpatsandhiṣu sāgreṣu pārśvayugme nyaset kramāt || 6-2 ||

pṛṣṭhanābhidvaye caiva jaṭhare vinyasedatha |
tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimañjāśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ || 6-3 ||

prāṇajīvau ca paramau yakārādiṣu saṃsthitāḥ | 
krameṇa devadeveśi nyastavyā etadātmakāḥ || 6-4 ||

hṛddormūleṣu sannyasya tathā paragale nyaset |
kakṣadvaye hṛdārabhya pāṇipādayuge tathā || 6-5 ||

jaṭharānanayornyasedityantargātrarūpiṇī |
anena nyāsayogena mantrī varṇasvarūpavān || 6-6 ||

iti bahirmātṛkā | atha sṛṣṭimātṛkā - kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya brahmacārī 
bhavedyadi | visargasahitāṃ tāṃ ca sṛṣṭisaṃjñāṃ nyasedbudhaḥ || iti sṛṣṭimātṛkā | 
atha sthiti mātṛkā : kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya gṛhasthaḥ sādhako yadi | 
visargabindusahitāṃ ḍakārādyāṃ sthitiṃ nyaset || dhyānaṃ tu :

sindūrakāntimamitābharaṇāṃ trinetrāṃ vidyākṣasūtramṛgapītavarān dadhānām |
pārśvasthitāṃ bhagavatīmapi kāñcanābhāṃ dhyāyet 
karābjadhṛtapustakavarṇamālām || 6-1 ||

iti dhyātvā ḍaṃḥ namaḥ ityādi binduvisargasahitān ṭhakārāvasānān 
varṇāṃstattatsthāneṣu nyasediti sthitimātṛkā || atha saṃhāramātṛkā : kevalāṃ 
mātṛkāṃ nyasya vānaprastho'thavā yatiḥ | binduyuktāṃ vilomena 
saṃhāramātṛkāṃ nyaset || dhyānaṃ tu |

akṣasrajaṃ hariṇapotamudagraṭaṅkaṃ vidyāṃ karairavirataṃ dadhatīṃ trinetrām |
arghendumaulimaruṇāmarabindavāsāṃ varṇeśvarīṃ praṇamata stanabhāranamrām || 
6-1 ||

iti dhyātvā | kṣaṃ namaḥ ityādibindusahitān vilomatastattadvarṇāṃstattatsthāneṣu 
nyasediti saṃhāramātṛkā || atha kalāmātṛkā :

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya tārabhakto bhavedyadi | 
praṇavāṃśakalāyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

prajāpati-ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
kalāsarasvatī devī devatā parikīrtitā || 6-2 || 

oṃ bījaṃ ca namaḥ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ tu kalāḥ smṛtāḥ |
praṇavadvayamadhyasthairviṣaṇḍhairdīrghasusvaraiḥ || 6-3 || 

ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyasya dhyāyed devīṃ parāṃ śivām | atha dhyānam-

hastaiḥ padmaṃ rathāṅgaṃ guṇamatha hariṇaṃ pustakaṃ varṇamālāṃ 
ṭaṅkaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ kapālaṃ daramamṛtalasaddhemakumbhaṃ vahantīm |
muktāvidyutpayodasphaṭikanavajapāvandhuraiḥ pañcavaktraistryakṣairvakṣojanamrāṃ 
sakalaśaśinibhāṃ śāradāṃ tāṃ namāmi || 6-1 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ aṃnivṛttikalāyai namaḥ ityādimātṛkāsthāneṣu nyasediti kalāmātṛkā || 
atha śrīkaṇṭhādimātṛkā :

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya śivabhakto bhavedyadi |
śrīkaṇṭhādiśaktiyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiśchando gāyatramīritam |
ardhanārīśvaro devo devatā parikīrtitā || 6-1 ||

p. 91)

hasauṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktiḥ śivaśaktistuḥ kīlakam |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset || 6-3 ||

bandhūkakāñcananibhaṃ rucirākṣamālāṃ pāśāṃkuśau ca varadaṃ 
nijabāhudaṇḍaiḥ |
vibhrāṇaminduśakalābharaṇaṃ trinetramardhāmbikeśamaniśaṃ vapurāśrayāmaḥ || 
6-4 ||

iti dhyātvā hasauṃ aṃśrīkaṇṭhāya pūrṇodaryai namaḥ ityādi nyasediti 
śrīkaṇṭhādimātṛkā || atha keśavādimātṛkānyāsaḥ :

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya viṣṇubhakto bhavedyadi |
keśavādiśaktiyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyased budhaḥ || 6-1 ||

prajāpatir-ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
arddhalakṣmīhariḥ sākṣād devatā parikīrtitā || 6-2 ||

kāmabījaṃ tu bījaṃ syānnamaḥ śaktirudāhṛtā |
viṣṇulakṣmīḥ kīlakaṃ tu viniyogastu pūrvavat || 6-3 ||

ṣaḍdīrghakāmarājena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |

hastairbibhrat sarasijagadāśaṃkhacakrāṇi vidyāṃ padmādarśau kanakakalaśaṃ 
meghavidyudvilāsam 
vāmottuṅgastanamaviralākalpamāśleṣalobhādekībhūtaṃ vapuravatuḥ vaḥ 
puṇḍarīkākṣalakṣmyoḥ || 6-1 ||

iti dhyātvā klīṃ śrīṃ aṃ keśavāya kīrtyai namaḥ ityādi nyasediti keśavamātṛkā || 
atha śaktimātṛkānyāsāḥ | 

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya bhuvaneśīṃ bhajedyadi | 
bhuvaneśībījapūrvāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

ṛṣiḥ śaktiḥ samuddiṣṭo gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
bhuvaneśī mātṛkā syād devatā devavanditā || 6-2 ||

hrīṃ bījaṃ tu namaḥ śaktirmūlaprakṛtiḥ kīlakam |
māyāṣaḍdīrghakenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 6-3 ||

udyatkoṭidivākarapratibhaṭātuṅgorupīnastanī 
mūrdhārdhendukirīṭahāraraśanāmañjīrasaṃśobhitā |
bibhrāṇā karapaṅkajairjapavaṭīṃ pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ 
diśyādvo jagadīśvarī trinayanā padme niṣaṇṇā sukham || 6-4 ||

iti dhyātvā hrīṃ aṃnamaḥ ityādi nyasediti bhuvaneśvarīmātṛkā | atha 
lakṣmīmātṛkā |

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya lakṣmīpūjārato yadi |
lakṣmībījasamāyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-5 ||

ṛṣirbhṛgustu gāyatraṃ chando lakṣmīstu mātṛkā |
devatā śrīṃ namo bījaṃ śaktiḥ prakṛtiḥ kīlakam || 6-6 ||

ṣaḍdīrghalakṣmībījena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |

vidyuddāmasamaprabhāṃ himagiriprakhyaiścaturbhirgajaiḥ 
śuṇḍādaṇḍasamuddhṛtāmṛtaghaṭairāsicyamānāmimām |
bibhrāṇāṃ karapaṅkajairjapavaṭīṃ padmadvayaṃ pustakaṃ 
bhāsvadratnasamujjvalāṃ kucanatāṃ dhyāyejjagatsvāminīm || 6-7 ||

iti dhyātvā śrīṃ aṃ namāḥ ityādi nyasediti lakṣmīmātṛkā | atha 
kāmeśvarīmātṛkā :

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya kāmeśīpūjako yadi |
kāmabījena saṃyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

ṛṣiḥ sammohanaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā smṛtā |
kāmeśvarī ca klīṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktistu kīlakam || 6-2 ||

ṣaḍdīrghakāmabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet |

bālārkakoṭirucirāṃ sphaṭikākṣamālāṃ kodaṇḍamikṣujanitaṃ smarapañcabāṇān |
vidyāṃ ca hastakamalairdadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ dhyāyet samastajananīṃ 
navacandracūḍām || 6-3 ||

iti dhyātvā klīṃ aṃnamaḥ ityādi nyasediti kāmabījamātṛkā | atha 
sammohanīmātṛkā | 

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya tripurārādhako yadi |
śaktiśrīkāmasaṃyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyasetsudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

p. 92)

ṛṣiḥ sammohanaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā manoḥ |
sammohanī ca klīṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ śrīṃ ca kīlakam || 6-2 ||

bījatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |

dhyāyeyamakṣavalayekṣuśarāsapāśān padmadvayāṃkuśaśarān navapustakaṃ ca |
ābibhratīṃ nijakarairaruṇāṃ kucārtāṃ sammohanīṃ trinayanāṃ taruṇenducūḍām 
|| 6-3 ||

iti dhyātvā hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ aṃ namaḥ ityādi nyasediti sammohanīmātṛkā | 
prapañcayāgastu prāgeva prapañcitaḥ | iti daśavidhamātṛkāḥ | ete sāmānyataḥ 
proktāḥ sarvatra daśamātṛkāḥ ityuktatvāt | durvāsovākyam | 

nyāsaṃ kṛtvā gaṇeśagrahabhagaṇamahāyoginīrāśipīṭhaiḥ 
ṣaḍbhiḥ śrīmātṛkārṇaiḥ sahitabahukalairaṣṭavāgdevatābhiḥ |
saśrīkaṇṭhādiyugmairvimalanijatanau keśavādyaiśca tattvaiḥ 
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhirdharādyairbhagavati bhavatīṃ yaḥ smaretsa tvameva || 6-1 ||

iti | (sacavarṇamātṛkā - kalāmātṛkā - mūrtimātṛkā -
prapañcayāgamātṛkānyāsākhyaḥ sampradaścaturvidhaḥ) tatra varṇamātṛkānyāso 
daśavidhaḥ śrīvidyāṅgabhūtaḥ | tathācoktam :

śuddhaṃ binduyutaṃ visargasahitaṃ hṛllekhayā saṃśritaṃ 
bālāsampuṭitaṃ tathā ca parayā śrīvidyālaṃkṛtam |
ārohādavarohataśca kurute nyāsaṃ punarhaṃsayoryo 
jānāti sa eva sarvajagatāṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsakṛt || 6-2 ||

iti | atha bālāsampuṭitamātṛkānyāsaḥ -

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ paṃktiśchanda udāhṛtam | 
tathā varṇamayī bālā devatā parikīrtitā || 6-1 ||

vāgbhavaṃ bījamākhyātaṃ tārtīyaṃ śaktirucyate |
kāmarājaṃ kīlakaṃ syācchrīvidyāṅgatayā punaḥ || 6-2 ||

nyāse tu viniyogaḥ syādbālābījatrayeṇa tu |
dvirāvṛttyā krameṇaiva ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret || 6-3 ||

muktāśekharakuṇḍalāṅgadamaṇigraiveyahārormikāṃ 
vidyotadvalayādikaṅkaṇakaṭīsūtrāṃ sphurannūpurām |
māṇikyodarabandhurastanabharāmindoḥ kalāṃ bibhratīṃ pāśaṃ 
sāṃkuśapustakākṣavalayaṃ dakṣordhvavāhvāditaḥ || 6-4 ||

pūrṇendupratimaprasannavadanāṃ 
netratrayodbhāsitāmindukṣīravalakṣagātravilasanmālyānulepāmbarām |
pañcāśallipijṛmbhitākhilajagadvāgdevatādevatāṃ mūlādhārasamudgatāṃ 
bhagavatīṃ varṇāmbuje cintayet || 6-5 ||

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ aṃ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ ityādi nyasediti 
bālāsampuṭitamātṛkānyāsaḥ || atha parāsampuṭitamātṛkānyāsaḥ :

ṛṣirbrahmā samuddiṣṭo gāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
parāsarasvatī devī mātṛkā devatā smṛtā || 6-1 ||

ṣaḍdīrghaparayā caiva ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |
akalaṅkaśaśāṅkābhā tryakṣāṃ candrakalāvatīm || 6-2 ||

mudrāpustakalasadbāhuṃ praṇamāmi parāṃ kalām |

sau aṃ sauḥ ityādi nyasediti parāmātṛkā || atha śrīvidyāmātṛkānyāsaḥ :

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiśchandaḥ paṃktirudāhṛtā |
devatā mātṛkārūpā mahātripurasundarī || 6-1 ||

kūṭatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |

āraktābhāṃ trinetrāṃ maṇimukuṭavatīṃ ratnatāṭaṅkaramyāṃ 
hastāmbhojaiḥ sapāśāṃkuśamadanadhanuḥsāyakairvisphurantīm |
āpīnottuṅgavakṣoruhataṭaviluṭhattārahārojjvalāṅgīṃ 
dhyāyannmbhoruhasthāmaruṇanivasanāmīśvarīmāśrayāmi || 6-1 ||

p. 93)

iti dhyātvā "4 mūlaṃ aṃ namāḥ śirasītyādi nyasediti śrīvidyāmātṛkā | atha 
haṃsamātṛkā :

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiśchando gāyatramucyate |
haragaurīmahādevī mātṛkā devatā smṛtā || 6-1 ||

hasā ṣaḍdīrghayuktena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret |

udyadbhānusphuṭitatāḍidākāramarghāmbikeśaṃ pāśābhītī varadaparaśū 
saṃsadhānaṃ karābjaiḥ |
divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ śobhitaṃ viśvamūlaṃ saumyāgneyaṃ vapuravatu 
vaścandracūḍaṃ trinetram || 6-1 ||

iti dhyātvā 4 haṃsaḥ aṃ namaḥ sirasītyādi nyasediti haṃsamātṛkā || atha 
paramahaṃsamātṛkā :

ṛṣiḥ paramahaṃsaḥ syādvirāṭ chanda udāhṛtam |
cinmayī devatā proktā paramātmasvarūpiṇī || 6-1 ||

praṇavadvayamadhyasthavargaiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgakam |

śrīmatparātmamanujṛmbhidavarṇarūpāṃ mānairagamyapadavīparicīyamānām |
vidyākṣasūtrakalaśān dadhatīṃ ca mudrāṃ dhyāyet samastajananīṃ viśadāṃ 
trinetrām || 6-2 ||

iti dhyātvā 4 so'haṃ kṣaṃ namaḥ ityādi vilomena tattatsthāneṣu nyasediti 
paramahaṃsamātṛkā || atha kalānyāsaḥ sa tu pañcavidhaḥ | tārotthakalā0 kāmakalā0 
somakalā0 trimūrtikalā0 aṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsaśceti | aṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāso'pi 
dvividhaḥ jyotiraṣṭātriṃśatkalā0 śivāṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsaśceti | 
tārotthakalānyāsastu prāgevoktaḥ | viśeṣastu- 

tārādyavarṇasaṃyuktā nyastavyāstā namonvitāḥ | 
sthāneṣveteṣvatha punarmātṛkāyāḥ kalā nyaset || 6-1 ||

tārasya pañcabhedebhyaḥ pañcāśadvarṇagāḥ kalāḥ | svarakalānyāsottaram-

sadāśivena sañjātā nādādetāḥ sitatviṣaḥ | 
akṣasrakpustakaguṇa kapālāḍhyakarāmbujāḥ || 6-1 ||

iti dhyeyāḥ | kacavargakalānyāsottaram-

akārād brahmaṇotpannastaptacāmīkaraprabhāḥ | 
karāmbujadhṛtākṣasrakpaṅkajābhayakuṇḍikāḥ || 6-1 ||

iti dhyeyāḥ | ṭatavargakalānyāsottaram-

ukārādviṣṇunotpannāstamāladalasannibhāḥ |
abhītidaracakreṣṭabāhavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 6-1 ||

iti dhyeyāḥ | payavargakalānyāsottaram-

rudreṇa mārṇādutpannā śaraccandrasamaprabhāḥ |
udbahantyo'bhayaṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ bāhubhirvaram || 6-1 ||

iti dhyeyāḥ | ṣavargakalānyāsottaram-

īśvareṇoditā bindorjapākusumasannibhāḥ |
abhayaṃ hariṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ dadhānā bāhubhirvaram || 6-1 ||

iti dhyeyāḥ iti | viśeṣārcā tu pātrāsādanaprakaraṇe veditavyā | atha 
jyotiraṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsaḥ | 4 aṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ śirasi ityādisvarakalāḥ krameṇa 
vinyaset | tato dakṣahastasandhyagreṣu 4 kaṃbhaṃ tapinyai namaḥ ityādi ṅaṃ naṃ 
jvālinyai namaḥ ityantaṃ vinyasya vāmahastasandhyagreṣu 4 caṃdhaṃ rucyai namaḥ 
ityādi aṃ ṇaṃ bodhinyai namaḥ ityantaṃ vinyasya dakṣapādasandhyagreṣu 4 ṭaṃ ḍhaṃ 
dhāriṇyai namaḥ ityādi 4 laṃ jvalinyai namaḥ ityantaṃ vinyaset | tato 
vāmapādasandhyagreṣu 4 vaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ ityādi 4 haṃ kapilāyai namaḥ ityantaṃ 
vinyasyāvaśiṣṭakalādvayaṃ mastake vyāpakaṃ ca 
kuryādityaṣṭātriṃśattejaḥkalānyāsaḥ | anye kalānyāsā agre vakṣyante | etaduttaraṃ 
prapañcayāgaḥ iti śrīmadācāryamataṃ satu prāguktarītyāvagantavyaḥ | tasya phalam :

evaṃvarṇamayaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā divyatanurnaraḥ | 
prajapet sakalān mantrāṃstataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 6-1 ||

prapañcayāgasya vidhervidhātā bhavetsa mantrī kṛtakṛtya eva |
sarve sphurantaḥ prabhavanti mantrāḥ sadātmayāgīti nigadyate saḥ || 6-2 ||

p. 94)

etasya homasya na koṭibhāgabhāgetena tulyaṃ dhruvamagnihotram |
evaṃ vidhātuḥ khalu yatra tatra śarīrapāte'pi bhavedvimuktiḥ || 6-3 ||

tathā ca prapañcasārḥ-(7 pa0 51 ślo0)

śuddhaścāpi sabindukastvatha kalāyukkeśavādyaistathā śrīkaṇṭhādiyutaśca 
śaktikamalāmāraistathaikaikaśaḥ |

nyāsāste daśadhā pṛthaṅnigaditaḥ syurbrahmayāgāntikāḥ sarve 
sādhakasiddhisādhanavidhau saṃkalpakalpadrumāḥ ||

prapañcayāgastu viśeṣato vipatprapañcasaṃsāraviśeṣapāvakaḥ |
paraṃ ca nityaṃ bhajatāmayatnataḥ parasya cārthāsya nivedakaḥ sadā || 6-2 ||

nyasya mantrī yathānyāyaṃ dehe viśvasya mātaram | 
japemantrān bhajeddevān yajedagnimananyadhīḥ || 6-3 ||

devo bhūtvā yajeddevānnādevo devamarcayet |
evamāha śrutiḥ sākṣādato'gre vinyasedbudhaḥ || 6-4 ||

yo nyāsakavacacchanno mantraṃ japati taṃ priye |
vighnā dṛṣṭvā palāyante siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā gajāḥ || 6-5 ||

akṛtvā nyāsajātaṃ yo mūḍhātmā prajapenmanum |
bādhyate sarvavighnaiśca vyāghrairmṛgaśiśuryathā || 6-6 ||

iti sarve mātṛkānyāsāḥ || atha ṣaṭtriṃśattattvanyāsaḥ : 4 kṣaṃ 
pṛthivītattvavyāpikāyai śrīmahātripurasundaryai namaḥ pādayoḥ | evaṃ laṃ aptattva0 
liṅge vilomakrameṇa tejo hṛdi vāyuḥ mukhe ākāśaṃ śirasi gandhaḥ pādayoḥ raso 
liṅge rūpaṃ hṛdi sparśo mukhe śabdaḥ śirasi upastho liṅge pāyuḥ pāyau pādaḥ 
pādayoḥ pāṇiḥ pāṇyoḥ vāk mukhe ghrārṇaṃ ghrāṇayoḥ jihvā jihvāyāṃ cakṣuḥ 
cakṣuṣoḥ tvak sarvāṅge śrotraṃ śrotrayoḥ mano hṛdi ahaṅkāro hṛdi buddhiḥ hṛdi 
prakṛtiḥ sarvagātre puruṣaḥ sarvagātre rāgo hṛdi vidyā hṛdi kalā hṛdi niyatiḥ 
sarvagātre kālatattvaṃ sarvagātre māyā hṛdi śuddhavidyā hṛdi īśvaro hṛdi sadāśivo 
grīvāyāṃ śaktirmūlādhāre śivaḥ sahasrāre iti ṣaṭtriṃśattattvanyāsaḥ || atha 
prāṇāyāmaḥ :

itikṛte'dhikṛto bhavati dhruvaṃ paramadaivatamantrajapādiṣu |
pavanasaṃyamanaṃ tvamunā caredyamiha japtumasau manumicchati || 6-1 ||

iti vacanāt | prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ nyasettanau iti vacanācca 
mūlavidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā yogapīṭhanyāsaṃ kuryāt || tatra 
prāṇāyāmavidhirvivicyate - tatra prāṇānāṃ śarīrādapi 
dvādaśāṃgulādhikānāmāyāmaḥ | āyamanamāyāmaḥ saṃkucitabhāvaḥ 
śarīraśāmyaṃ śarīrānnyūnabhāvāpādanaṃ veti prāṇāyāma ityarthaḥ ata eva 
pavanasaṃyamanamityuktam | tripurāsārasamuccaye :

athedaṃ śarīraṃ svakīyāṃgulībhirbudhaiḥ ṣaṇavatyaṃgulāyāmamuktam |
dineśāṃgulībhiḥ śarīrāt samīro'dhikaḥ prāṇasaṃjño mato yogavidbhiḥ || 6-2 ||

iti prāṇavāyuṃ sadābhyāsato yo naro nyūnabhāvaṃ nayatyenamaṅgāt | 
samatvaṃ śarīreṇa vā bhūtale'smin sa pūjyo budhairuttamau yogavitsu || 6-3 || 

iti | satu pūrakādyaṅgatrayātmakaḥ | tathāca aṅgatrayātmakaḥ proktaḥ 
pūrakumbhakarecakairiti tatra kumbhaka eva prāṇāyāmaśabdo mukhyaḥ 
itarayostadupakārakatvāt | jñānārṇave :

kaniṣṭhānāmikāṃguṣṭhairyannāsāpuṭadhāraṇam | 
prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vinā || 6-1 || 

iti | sa punardvividhaḥ sahitaḥ kevalaśca | tatra sahito'pi dvividho recakādikramaḥ 
pūrakādikramaśceti | tatra recakādikramamāha yogaśāstre :

prāṇāyāmastridhā prokto recapūrakakumbhakaiḥ | 
sahitaḥ kevalaśceti kumbhako dvividho mataḥ || 6-1 ||

virecya pūrakaḥ kāryaḥ śanaiḥ sahitakumbhake | 
yāvatkevalasiddhiḥ syāt tāvatsahitamabhyaset || 6-2 ||

p. 95)

iti | tatkramamāha prapañcasāre-

recakapūrakakumbhakabhedāt trividhaḥ prabhañjanāyāmaḥ | 
muñceddakṣiṇayānilamantarnayedvāmayā ca madhyamayā saṃsthāpayecca 
nāḍyetyevaṃ proktāni recakādīni | ṣoḍaśataddviguṇacatuḥṣaṣṭhimātrakāṇi tāni ca 
kramaśaḥ 

iti | nāḍyetyasya dakṣiṇayetyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ | tathāca iḍā vāme tanormadhye 
suṣumnā piṅgalā pare | dviguṇa iti ṣoḍaśānāṃ dviguṇa ityarthaḥ | atha 
pūrakādikramamāha samuccaye-

śītāṃśumārgeṇa śanaiḥ samīramāpūrayet sodaramādareṇa |
vikāramātrābhirapetatandraḥ kālāgnimūlārpitacittavṛttiḥ || 6-1 ||

tato dhārayenmārutaṃ dhīracetāḥ catuḥṣaṣṭhimātrāsamāpūritaṃ tam |
bahirbhāsvatā recayenmandamemaṃ tadardhābhirantarniruddhaṃ tu tābhiḥ || 6-2 ||

tathā vāmakeśvare-

pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ caiva recakaṃ ca vicintayet |
mūlādhāre layaṃ kṛtvā pītvā vāyuṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 6-1 ||

yatheṣṭaṃ pūrayed dehaṃ tattvajño vijitendriyaḥ |
tatastu stambhayedvāyuṃ prakāśagatamānasaḥ || 6-2 ||

kumbhake cintayedvidvān vidyāṃ muktikarīṃ śubhām |
tadā tu recayed vāyuṃ gamyate yatsvabhāvataḥ || 6-3 ||

dehānniḥsārayenmantrī svadehasthaṃ tamoguṇam |
vāmena pūrayed vāyuṃ dakṣiṇena virecayet || 6-4 ||

māhendreṇa samenaiva mantrī kumbhakamabhyaset |
sadā kumbhakayogena labhate siddhiruttamā || 6-5 ||

abhyāsī kārayenmātrāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ tattvadarśinām |
yathāśaktyā pibedvāyuṃ yathāśaktyā ca kumbhayet || 6-6 ||

svabhāvaṃ ca tyajedvāyustataḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate |

iti | tasyāṃ vidyāyāṃ pūrakādikrama eva nityātantroktaḥ recakādikramastu 
sādhāraṇatayā prāptaḥ | śrutyanusāreṇa prapañcasārādau 
vaiṣṇavādisāmānyatayā proktatvāt | tathāca śrutiḥ - prāṇāyāmāstrayaḥ proktā 
recapūrakakumbhakāḥ iti | susādhitaprāṇānāṃ recakādikrama iti kaścit ubhayathāpi 
sāmānyatvaṃ tantrāntareṇa pūrakādikramo'pi sāmānyatayā vaiṣṇavādau yujyate | 
tasmādasminnapi prakaraṇe sāmānyatvenobhayo prāpto viśeṣatvena 
pūrakādikramasyaiva mukhyatvamāha maheśvaraḥ - pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ cetyādi | 
tatra vāyorādānakāle pūrakanāmā prāṇāyāmaḥ dhāraṇakāle kumbhakanāmā 
tyāgakāle recakanāmā | taduktam - bāhyādāpūraṇaṃ vāyorudare pūrako hi saḥ | 
sampūrṇakumbhavadvāyordhāraṇaṃ kumbhako mataḥ || bahiryadrecanaṃ 
vāyorudarādrecakaḥ smṛtaḥ iti | tathāca dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ :

mūlamantreṇa deveśi vāmenāpūrya codaram | 
kumbhakena trirāvṛttyā dakṣiṇenāpasārayet || 6-1 ||

iti | jñānārṇave āsane samyagāsīno vāmenāpūrya codaram iti | tantrarāje'pi- vāmena 
nāsārandhreṇa pūrayedamṛtātmanā | smarannambu marutpaścāddakṣiṇenāpasārayet | 
iti | tatra kramamāha- mūlādhāra ityādi | layamiti manaso layamityarthaḥ tenaiva vāyorapi 
layabhāvitvāt | tantrarāje : 

mūlādhāre manaḥ kṛtvā vāyumāpūrya mūlataḥ |
nāḍīcakrāntaraṃ nītvā sarvāṅgāni ca cārayet || 6-1 ||

iti | yatheṣṭamiti sahajagatāgataśīlaṃ vāyu yathāśakyamākarṣayedityarthaḥ | prakāśe 
paramātmani gataṃ līnaṃ mānasaṃ yasya saḥ prakāśagatamānasaḥ | tena 
svaprakāśasaccidānanandaparamātmasparūpaḥ san kumbhayedityarthaḥ | 
athāṅgatrayātmake prāṇāyāme kvāpi vidyādhyānaṃ bhavati navetyata āha-
kumbhake cintayedityādi | vidyāṃ - mokṣopayogi jñānaṃ vidyā tāṃ sā ca 
śrīvidyetyata āha - muktikarīṃ śubhāmiti | tena kumbhakakāle 
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ mūlavidyāṃ vibhāvayedityuktaṃ śrīvidyāyāḥ 
sūkṣmadhyānaṃ kuryāditi tu sagarbhapakṣe pūrakādiṣu pratyekamaśaktau 
kevalakumbhake veti dhyeyam | recakaprakāramāha - tadetyādi | gamyate bahiriti śeṣaḥ 
svabhāvato natu nyūnādhikatvādanyathā tu ayuktābhyāsāddoṣāpatteḥ | tathā coktaṃ 
gorakṣaśatake :

p. 96)

yuktaṃ yuktaṃ pibedvāyuṃ yuktaṃ yuktaṃ ca dhārayet |
yuktaṃ yuktaṃ tyajedenamevaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 6-1 ||

yathā siṃho gajo vyāghro bhaveddhāryaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
tathaiva hi nijo vāyuranyathā hanti sādhakam || 6-2 ||

prāṇāyāmena yuktena sarvarogakṣayo bhavet |
ayuktābhyāsayogena sarvarogasamudbhavaḥ || 6-3 ||

hikkā śvāsaśva kāsaśca śiraḥkarṇākṣivedanāḥ |
bhavanti vividhā rogāḥ prāṇāyāmavyatikramāt || 6-4 ||

tataḥ śāstroktamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmān samācaret |

iti | dehānniḥsārayediti | recakayogavāyunā saha dehasthastamoguṇo bahirniḥsṛta iti 
bhāvayedityarthaḥ | atha pūrakādernāḍīniyamamāha - vāmenetyādi | 
ityekaprāṇāyāme prathame dvitīyādiyugme tu dakṣiṇenaiva pūrayet | taduktam | yenaiva 
saṃtyajettena pūrayet dhārayet tataḥ | recayecca tato'nyena śanairevaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 6-1 
||

iti | yogaśāstre-

athāsane dṛḍhe yogī vaśī hitamitāśanaḥ | 
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmān samabhyaset || 6-1 ||

cale vāte calaṃ cittaṃ niścale dṛḍhabandhanam |
yogī sthānatvamāpnoti tato vāyuṃ nibandhayet || 6-2 ||

yāvadvāyuḥ sthito dehe tāvajjīvanamucyate |
maraṇaṃ tasya niṣkrāntistato vāyuṃ nibandhayet || 6-3 ||

malākulāsu nāḍīṣu māruto naiva madhyagaḥ |
kathaṃ syādunmanībhāvaḥ kāryasiddhi kathaṃ bhavet || 6-4 ||

śuddhimeti yadā sarvaṃ nāḍīcakraṃ malākulam |
tadaiva jāyate yogī praṇasaṃgrahaṇe kṣamaḥ || 6-5 ||

prāṇābhyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryānnityaṃ sāttvikayā dhiyā |
yathā suṣumnāpārśvasthā malāḥ śoṣaṃ prayānti ca || 6-6 ||

baddhapadmāsano yogī prāṇaṃ candreṇa pūrayet |
dhārayitvā yathāśakti punaḥ sūryeṇa recayet || 6-7 ||

prāṇaṃ sūryeṇa cākṛṣya pūrayedudaraṃ śanaiḥ |
vidhivat kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā punaścandreṇa recayed || 6-8 ||

yena tyajettena pītvā dhārayedanirodhataḥ | 
recayecca tato'nyena śanairevaṃ na vegataḥ || 6-9 ||

prāṇaṃ cediḍayā pibenniyamitaṃ bhūyo'nyayā recayet 
pītvā piṅgalayā samīraṇamatho baddhvā tyajed vāmayā |
sūryācandramasoranena vidhinābhyāsaṃ sadā tanvatāṃ 
śuddhā nāḍigaṇā bhavanti yamināṃ māsatrayādūrdhvataḥ || 6-10 ||

iti tathā tripurāsāre-

viparītamato vidadhīta punaḥ punarapyatha tadviparītamiti |
amunā vidhinā sumanāḥ satataṃ maruto vidadhīta susaṃyamanam || 6-1 ||

iti | atha kumbhakaphalamāha - sadetyādi kevalakumbhakayogenetyarthaḥ | susādhite vāyau 
mātrāsaṃkhyānamuktaṃ prathamābhyāse tatrāpyayaṃ kāmacāramāha - abhyāsī 
ityādi | abhyāsī prathamābhyāsī tattvadarśināṃ mātrāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ yathecchaṃ 
kārayedityarthaḥ | etadeva spaṣṭayati yathāśaktyetyādi | tathā ca sati prathamābhyāsī 
yathoktasaṃkhyāmātrāyā nyūnamapi kuryāt madhyamābhyāsī 
yathoktasaṃkhyāmeva uttamābhyāsī tato'dhikasaṃkhyāmapi kuryāditi 
yatheṣṭapadatātparyam | atha mātrālakṣaṇamāha nāradaḥ :

kālena yāvatātmīyo hastaḥ svaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | 
paryeti mātrā syāt tulyā svayaikaśvāsamātrayā || 6-1 ||

iti | tathā phetkāriṇītantre-

jānuṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya na drutaṃ na vilambitam | 
kriyate cāṃgulīsphoṭaḥ sā mātrā parikīrtitā || 6-1 ||

iti | api ca kātyāyanītantre-

madhyā mūlādyāvadagramaṃguṣṭhena ca pīḍyate | 
mātrā sā procyate sadbhiryoge'bhīṣṭaṃ prayacchati || 6-1 ||

p. 97)

iti | vastutastu tattanmantroccāraṇameva mātrā | tathā ca gautamīye-

recayeddakṣiṇe vāyuṃ pūrayedvāmatastataḥ | 
dvātriṃśadabhyasenmantraṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate || 6-1 ||

iti | tataḥ pūrakānantaraṃ kumbhake'bhyasedityarthaḥ | etattu recakādipakṣe ata eva 
kumbhaka eva japādikaṃ netarayoḥ | dakṣiṇāmūrtikalpe :

prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā suvidhāya ca kumbhakam | 
hṛtpaṅkaje samāsīnaṃ māṃ dhyāyedyatamānasaḥ || 6-1 ||

iti | agastyasaṃhitāyām-

yāvacchakyaṃ niyamyāsūn manasaiva japenmanum |
rāmaṃ muhurmuhurdhyāyan pūrvoktavidhinā sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

iti | asūn niyamya kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā rāmaṃ dhyāyan yāvacchakyaṃ manuṃ japediti 
sambandhaḥ | etena yatra viśeṣo noktastatra yathāśakti mantraṃ japediti vaiṣṇavāḥ | 
tathaiva rītyaikatra dṛṣṭanyāyena sarvatraivāyaṃ prakāraḥ | ata eva śrīvidyāyāṃ 
vāmakeśvaratantre - kumbhake cintayedvidvān vidyāṃ muktakarīṃ śubhām | 
ityuktamiti vadanti | vastutastu sagarbhake prāṇāyāme kevalakumbhake kumbhaka eva 
sahitakumbhake śaktāvaṅgatraye'pya'śaktau kumbhake tvāvaśyakaṃ japadhyānamiti 
tu teṣāṃ vacanānāṃ nirgalitārthaḥ | saca mūlayā bālayā vā tadaśaktau praṇavena 
vā kāryaḥ | taduktaṃ phetkārīye : prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryānmūlena praṇavena vā | 
iti | niṣiddhapraṇavoccāriṇāṃ praṇavasthāne sārddhatrimātrika auṃkāro jñeyaḥ | 
kālikāpurāṇe - caturdaśasvaro yastu sārddhatrimātrasaṃjñakaḥ | 
nādabindusamāyuktaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ seturucyate || 6-1 ||

iti | atra susādhitaprāṇānāṃ pūrakādau tripurāsāroktaiva saṃkhyā japādau 
tantrarāje tadanyathā | yaduktaṃ tantrarāje :

evaṃ susādhite paścāddvātriṃśanmātrayā haret |
dhārayettaccatuṣṣaṣṭyā recayet tatturīyataḥ || 6-1 ||

iti tu śrīkādimatam tadetayormatayorvikalpaḥ | tatrāśaktau sāmānyapaṭale 
phetkārīyatantroktaḥ kāryaḥ | tadyathā : 

tathā dvādaśamātrābhiḥ kumbhakaḥ kriyate sadā |
tasmāddviguṇamātrābhī recakaḥ kriyate tathā || 6-1 ||

prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ tvevamekaikaṃ tritayātmakam |

iti | atrāpyaśaktau subhagodayoktaḥ kāryaḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt smaran 
vidyāṃ hṛdā punaḥ | iti | tadvacanaṃ tatpaddhatau vyākhyātaṃ dakṣiṇanāḍyā 
ekavāraṃ mūlamuccaran vāyumāpūrya caturvāraṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vāmanāḍyā 
dvivāraṃ recayediti prāṇāyāmatrayaṃkuryādityarthaḥ | atra dakṣiṇena pūraṇaṃ 
yugme boddhavyamayugme pūrakādau vāmasyaivoktatvādathavā tanmatamevedamiti 
vayaṃ na vidmaḥ | tatrāpyaśaktau jñānārṇavadakṣiṇāmūrtibhyāmuktasya 
kumbhakena trirāvṛttye tyasyaiva grahaṇamiti saṃkṣepa iti sahitakumbhakaḥ || atha 
kevalakumbhakaḥ yogaśāstre :

recakaṃ pūrakaṃ muktvā mukhe yadvāyudhāraṇam |
prāṇāyāmo'yamityuktaḥ sa vai kevalakumbhakaḥ || 6-1 ||

kevale kumbhake siddhe recapūravivarjite | 
na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 6-2 ||

śaktaḥ kevalakumbhena yatheṣṭaṃ vāyudhāraṇe | 
rājayogapadaṃ caiva labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 6-3 ||

haṭhaṃ vinā rājayogo rājayogaṃ vinā haṭhaḥ |
na sidhyati tato yugmamāniṣpatteḥ samabhyaset || 6-4 ||

kumbhitaprāṇarecānte kuryāccittaṃ nirāśrayam |
evamabhyāsayogena rājayogapadaṃ vrajet || 6-5 ||

kumbhakāt kuṇḍalībodho kuṇḍalībodhato bhavet |
anargalā suṣumnā ca haṭhasiddhiśca jāyate || 6-6 ||

iti | haḥ sūryo ṭhaścandrastābhyāṃ sūryacandrābhyāṃ dakṣiṇavāmābhyāṃ 
piṅgaleḍābhyāṃ prāṇavāyormūlādhārādau yogo haṭhayoga ityarthaḥ | saca 
prāṇāyāmo rājayogaḥ saca suṣumnāmārgeṇa ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa 
śivaśaktisāmarasyalakṣaṇamāha tantrarāje :

kampaśca pulakānando vaimalyasthairyalāghavāḥ |
tadvat kāntiprakāśau ca yogasiddhasya lakṣaṇam || 6-1 ||

p. 98)

yogaśāstre-

vapuḥkṛśatvaṃ vadanaprasannatā nādasphuṭatvaṃ nayane sunirmale |
arogitā bindujayo'gnidīpanaṃ nāḍīviśuddherhaṭhasiddhilakṣaṇam || 6-1 ||

iti kevalakumbhakaḥ ityuktaḥ | prāṇāyāmaḥ sa garbho vigarbhaśceti dvividhaḥ syāt | 
uktaṃ ca rudrayāmale : sagarbhaśca vigarbhaśca prāṇāyāmo dvidhā mataḥ | iti | tathā 
ca yoginītantre :

ayaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ sakaladuritardhvasanakaro vigarbhaḥ prokto'sau śataguṇaphalo 
garbhakalitaḥ |
japadhyānāpetaḥ satu nigadito garbharahitaḥ sagarbhastadyukto 
muniparivṛḍhairyoganirataiḥ || 6-1 || 

iti | sa punastrividhaḥ uttamādhamamadhyamabhedāt | tathā ca tantrarāje-

prāṇāyāmastridhā prokta uttamādhamamadhyataḥ |
lāghavo bhūtalatyāga uttame cittanirvṛtiḥ || 6-1 ||

sarvāṅgasvedasaṃvṛddhiradhame madhyame tathā |
sarvāṅgakampanaṃ proktamabhyāsāt kālasaṃyutāt || 6-2 ||

te'pyuttamaguṇā bhūyurabhyāsāt kālayogataḥ | 
tasmāt samabhyaset prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca niyamena vai || 6-3 ||

iti | tathā tripurāsāre-

śuciḥ prāṇāyāmān praṇavasahitān ṣoḍaśa vaśī prabhāte sāyaṃ ca 
pratidivasamevaṃ vitanute |
dvijo yastaṃ bhrūṇapraharaṇakṛtāṃhobhikalitaṃ punantyete māsādiha 
duritatūlaughadahanāḥ || 6-1 ||

trāyantyamī ṣaḍbhirapīha māsairjanmāntaropārjitapāpapuñjāt |
saṃvatsarād brahmapadaṃ tadekaṃ prakāśayatyeva yadacyutākhyam || 6-2 ||

iti | yogaśāstre tu-

prātarmadhyandine sāyamarddharātre ca kumbhakān |
śanairaśītiparyantaṃ caturvāraṃ samabhyaset || 6-1 ||

kanīyasi bhavet spandaḥ kampo bhavati madhyame |
uttiṣṭhatyuttame prāṇarodhe padmāsane muhuḥ || 6-2 ||

jalena śramajātena gātramardanamācaret |
dṛḍhatā laghutā caiva tena gātrasya jāyate || 6-3 ||

abhyāsakāle prathame śastaṃ kṣīrājyabhojanam |
tato'bhyāse dṛḍhe jāte na tādṛṅniyamagrahaḥ || 6-4 ||

iti | tatra kramaḥ - vihitapadmāsanaḥ sannimīlitanayanayugalo 
mūlādhārārpitacittavṛttirmūlamantrādikamuccaran iḍayā vāmanāḍyā 
ṣoḍaśamātrayā vāyumāpūrya mūlādhāraṃ 
prāpayyāṃguṣṭhakaniṣṭhānāmābhirnāsāpuṭau vidhṛtya catuḥṣaṣṭimātrayā taṃ 
vāyuṃ stambhayitvā dvātriṃśanmātrayā piṅgalayā dakṣiṇanāḍyā 
śanaiḥśanaistaṃ vāyuṃ recayedityekaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ | punastaṃ piṅgalayā vāyuṃ 
śanaiḥśanaiḥ samākṛṣya tathaiveḍayā recayedityanyaḥ | evaṃ vaiparītyena 
viṃśativāraṃ ṣoḍaśavāraṃ dvādaśa ṣaṭ trirvā dvirvā yathāśakti kuryāt tataḥ 
siddhimavāpnuyāditi | śāradātilake : mātrāvṛddhikrameṇaiva samyagdvādaśa 
ṣoḍaśa | iti saṃkṣepaḥ | atra sarvatra prāṇāyāmenaiva sarveṣāṃ karmādhikāraḥ 
akaraṇe nindāśravaṇāt | agastyasaṃhitāyām :

prāṇāyāmairvinā yadyat kṛtaṃ karma nirarthakam |
ato yatnena kartavyāḥ prāṇāyāmāḥ śubhārthibhiḥ || 6-1 ||

iti | ata evāvaśyako'yaṃ bhūtaśuddhiriva pūjayāmiti | iti 
prāṇāyāmavidhirmatadvayasādhāraṇaḥ ||

tripureśvarīpotāmbujāsanāya namaḥ | 4 hrīṃ klīṃ sauḥ

catuṣpīṭhacaturāsanaṃ nyaset | aiśāne 4 vāgbhavadvayamuccāryaṃ agnicakre 
kāmagiryālaye mitreśanāthātmake jāgraddaśādhiṣṭhāyake

tripurasundarīdevyātmāsanāya namaḥ | vāyavyakoṇe 4 kāmarājadvayaṃ sūryacakre

parabrahmaśaktyātmakaśrītripurasundarīdevī hrīṃ klīṃ bleṃ 
tripuramālinīsādhyasiddhāsanāya namaḥ | madhye 4 aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ ka0 15 
śrīmahātripurasundarīsarvamantrāsanāya nama iti vinyasya 4 aṃ 51 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyāmāyākālaniyatikalāvidyārāgapuruṣaprakṛti-
buddhyahaṅkāramanastvakcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇavākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaśabda-
sparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyuvahnisalilapṛthivyātmane śrīmahātripurasundaryā 
yogapīṭhāsanāya namaḥ iti vyāpakaṃ kuryāt | tato mūlamuccārya 
śrīmanmahātripurasundarīśrī0 iti ṣaṭtriṃśattatvātmake dehamaye mahāyogapīṭhe 
nijeṣṭadevatā hṛdi nyaset | iti dehamaye pīṭhe cintayetparadevatām iti yogapīṭhanyāsaḥ | 
śāradāyām :

saṃhārasṛṣṭimārgeṇa mātṛkānyastavigrahaḥ | 
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryād devatābhāvasiddhaye || 6-1 ||

iti | tata iti mantranyāsānantaramityarthaḥ | mantranyāsa upāsyamantrasambandhī nyāsaḥ 
| vaiśampāyanasaṃhitāyām-

tata upāsyamantrasya nyāsāmṛṣyādikāṃścaret | 
yasya mantrasya ye nāsāḥ kartavyāḥ siddhimicchatā || 6-1 ||

japatarpaṇahomārcāḥ siddhamantrakṛtā api | 
aṅganyāsādibhirhīnā na dāsyanti phalānyamī || 6-2 ||

nyāsānaśeṣān nyasataḥ svadehe trailokyametadvaśameti puṃsaḥ |
pāpāni sadyaḥ praśamaṃ prayānti trasyanti rakṣāṃsi sapannagāni || 6-3 ||

ādāvṛṣyādi vinyasya karāṅganyasanaṃ tataḥ | 
tato mantrākṣaranyāsaḥ padanyāsastataḥ param || 6-4 ||

tattatkalpaviśeṣoktān nyāsānanyān samācaret |
tato mantrapuṭairvaṇairmātṛkāyāḥ sabindukaiḥ || 6-5 ||

vinyasenmantravit samyakśāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā |
atharpyaṅgakaranyāsastato mudrāḥ pradarśayet || 6-6 ||

iti kramaḥ | anyatrāpi śrīvidyāmadhikṛtya-

antaḥ śuddhā ca sṛṣṭisthitivilayamayī tārajābhiḥ kalābhiḥ
