śrīkaṇṭhādyaiśca viṣṇupramuditatanubhirśaktilakṣmīmanojaiḥ |
bījairvyastaiḥ samastaiḥ kalitalipivarā cātmayāgaśca maunī 
ṣoḍhā kāmaśca ṣoḍhā navavidhabhavanā mantragupsarvamantrāḥ || 6-7 ||

iti | sa punarasyāṃ vidyāyāṃ trividhaḥ ṣoḍhāśrīcakrakaraśuddhyādibhedāt | 
tatra ṣoḍhā dvividhaḥ pūrvottarabhedāt | tatra pūrvaṣoḍhānyāsaḥ 
sarvāmnāyaviṣayaḥ uttaraṣoḍhānyāsa ūrdhvāmnāya viṣayaḥ | 
śrīcakranyāsastrividhaḥ saṃhārasṛṣṭisthitibhedāt | 

p. 101)

kararaśuddhyādinyāsastu bahutataḥ śrīkaṇṭhādiratikāmādinyāsādīnāmapi 
tatraivāntarbhāvāt | tatra ṣoḍhānyāsaḥ saṃhāraśrīcakranyāsaḥ 
sṛṣṭiśrīcakranyāsaḥ karaśuddhyādinyāsaśceti japakāle sthitiśrīcakranyāsasya 
karaśuddhyādāvantarbhāvāt pūjākāle saṃhāraśrīcakranyāsasyopalakṣaṇatvena 
tadantarbhāvācca caturvidho nyāsastadavasare saṃkṣepādāvaśyakaḥ iti 
yoginīhṛdayamatam | yoginīhṛdaye :

evaṃ caturvidho nyāsaḥ kartavyo vīravandite | 
ṣoḍhānyāso'ṇimādyaśca mūladevyādikaḥ priye || 6-1 ||

karaśuddhyādikaścaiva sādhakenāśu siddhaye | 
prātaḥkāle'thavā pūjāsamaye homakarmaṇi || 6-2 ||

japakāle'thavā teṣāṃ viniyogaḥ pṛṭhak pṛthak |
pūjākāle samastaṃ vā kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥ || 6-3 ||

iti | tatrādau pūrvaṣoḍhānyāso yoginīhṛdaye-

nyāsānnirvartayeddevi ṣoḍhānyāsapuraḥsaram |
gaṇeśaiḥ prathamo nyāso dvitīyaśca grahairmataḥ || 6-1 ||

nakṣatraiśca tṛtīyaḥ syādyoginībhiścaturthakaḥ | 
rāśibhiḥ pañcamo nyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ pīṭhairnigadyate || 6-2 ||

ṣoḍhānyāsastvayaṃ proktaḥ sarvatraivāparājitaḥ |
evaṃ yo nyastagātrastu sa pūjyaḥ sarvayogibhiḥ || 6-3 ||

nāstyasya pūjyo lokeṣu pitṛmātṛmukho janaḥ |
sa eva pūjyaḥ sarveṣāṃ sa svayaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 6-4 ||

ṣoḍhānyāsavihīnaṃ yaṃ praṇamedeṣa pārvati | 
so'cirānmṛtyumāpnoti narakaṃ ca prapadyate || 6-5 ||

iti | jñānārṇave-

ṣoḍhānyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādyena brahmāṇḍarūpakaḥ |
virāṭsvarūpo varṇātmā śivaḥ sākṣānnasaṃśayaḥ || 6-1 ||

geṇeśāḥ prathamo nyāsaḥ sarvavighnavināśakaḥ |
taruṇādityasaṃkāśān gajavaktrāṃstrilocanān || 6-2 ||

pāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarāṃśaktisamanvitān |
etāṃstu vinyaseddevi mātṛkānyāsavat priye || 6-3 ||

iti | atra 4 aṃ śrīvighneśvarābhyāṃ nama ityante | vighneśvarāya śriyai nama ityapare | 
vighneśvaraśrībhyāṃ nama iti kecit | gaṇeśāḥ śaktayaśca mātṛkāśvāse 
boddhavyā iti gaṇeśanyāsaḥ | atha grahanyāsaḥ jñānārṇave : grahanyāsaṃ tato 
nyatediti |

raktaṃ śvetaṃ tathā raktaṃ śyāmaṃ pītaṃ ca pāṇḍuram |
dhūmraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhūmraṃ ca dhūmradhūmraṃ vicintayet || 6-1 ||

ravimukhyān kāmarūpān sarvābharaṇabhūṣitān |
svarairarkaṃ hṛdi nyasya yavargeṇa śaśī tataḥ || 6-2 ||

bhrūmadhye tu kavargeṇa bhaumaṃ netratraye nyaset |
ṭavargeṇa budhaṃ hṛdi tavargeṇa bṛhaspatim || 6-3 ||

hṛdayopari deveśi cavargeṇa gale bhṛgum |
pavargeṇa śaniṃ nābhau rāhuṃ vaktre śavargataḥ || 6-4 ||

lakṣābhyāṃ pādayoḥ ketuṃ nyasedevaṃ varānane |
sūryaśca reṇukā caiva somaścaivāmṛtā tathā || 6-5 ||

maṅgalo dhāmayāyukto budhaśca jñānarūpayā |
gururyaśasvinīyuktaḥ śāṅkarīsahito bhṛguḥ || 6-6 ||

śaniḥ śaktisamāyukto rāhuḥ kṛṣṇāsamanvitaḥ |
dhūmrayā sahitaḥ ketuḥ śaktayo'mbāntikāḥ smṛtāḥ || 6-7 ||

iti pūrvavatprayogaḥ | atha nakṣatranyāsaḥ-

atha nakṣatravṛndasya nyāsaṃ kuryāt sukhapradam |
jvalatkālāgnisaṅkāśāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 6-1 ||

natipāṇyo'śvinīpūrvā varadābhayapāṇayaḥ |
yugmaṃ yugmaṃ tathā yugmaṃ yugmayugmena rohiṇī || 6-2 ||

ekamekaṃ tathā dvandvamekaṃ puṣyāntamucyate |
lalāṭe locane paścādvāmadakṣiṇakarṇayoḥ || 6-3 ||

nāsādvaye ca deveśi tathā kaṇṭhe nyaset kramāt |
puṣyāntaṃ ca pravinyasya khagābhyāṃ caiva sarpakam || 6-4 ||

dakṣaskandhe ghaṅābhyāṃ ca maghāṃ skandhe dvitīyake | 
ca pūrvaphālgunīṃ dakṣe kūrpare chajasaṃsthitām || 6-5 ||

uttarāṃ phālgunīṃ vāme kūrpare vinyasetpriye |
jhañavarṇasthitau haste maṇibandhe nyasetpriye || 6-6 ||

ṭaṭhārṇena yutāṃ citrāṃ vāme tu maṇibandhake |
ḍakāreṇa yutāṃ svātīṃ dakṣahastena vinyaset || 6-7 ||

p. 102)

ḍhaṇayuktāṃ viśākhāṃ ca vāmahaste pravinyaset |
tathadasthā'nurādhāṃ ca nābhau nyasettu pārvati || 6-8 ||

dhakāreṇa yutāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ nyaseddakṣakaṭau priye |
napaphasthaṃ tathā mūlaṃ nyasedvāmakaṭau priye || 6-9 ||

pūrvāṣāḍhāṃ bakāreṇa dakṣorau vinyasettataḥ |
bhakāreṇottarāṣāḍhāṃ vāmorau tadanantaram || 6-10 ||

makārayuktaṃ śravaṇaṃ dakṣajānuni vinyaset |
yarānvitāṃ dhaniṣṭhāṃ ca vāmajānuni vinyaset || 6-11 ||

lakāreṇa yutāṃ devi śatabhiṣāṃ nyaset priye |
dakṣajaṅghāgatāṃ paścāt pūrvabhādrapadāṃ tataḥ || 6-12 ||

vaśavarṇātmikāṃ nyasedvāmajaṅghāgatāṃ kramāt |
ṣasahasthottarābhādrapadāṃ dakṣiṇapādake || 6-13 ||

kṣakāreṇa tathā binduvisargābhyāṃ ca revatīm |
vāmapādatale nyasya yoginīnyāsamārabhet || 6-14 ||

iti | dhyānamāha jvaladityādi pūrvavat | iti nakṣatranyāsaḥ || atha yoginīnyāsaḥ-
tantrāntare - viśuddhau ṣoḍaśāre tu ḍākinīṃ bhāvayet sudhīḥ | tvagdhātudevatāṃ 
kaṇṭhe sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 6-1 ||

raktāṃ raktatrinetrāṃ paśujanabhayakṛcchūlakhaṭvāṅgahastāṃ 
vāme kheṭaṃ dadhānāṃ caṣakamapi surāpūritaṃ caikavaktrām |
atyugrāmugradaṃṣṭrāmarikulamathanīṃ pāyasānne prasaktāṃ 
kaṇṭhasthāne'mṛtādyaiḥ parivṛtavapuṣaṃ bhāvayeḍḍākinīṃ tām || 6-2 ||

ḍāṃḍīṃḍūṃḍaiṃ tato ḍoṃḍauṃ ḍamaleti vareti ca |
yūṃ ḍākinīpadaṃ proktvā māṃ rakṣadvitayaṃ vadet || 6-3 ||

sarvasattvavaśaṃ proktvā kari devi tataḥ param |
āgacchadvitayaṃ proktvā imāṃ pūjāṃ tathaiva ca || 6-4 ||

gṛhṇadvayaṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca ghore devi tataḥ param |
māyābījaṃ bhṛguḥ sargī parameti tataḥ param || 6-5 ||

ghorehūṃ ghorarūpe ca ehyehīti namaḥpadam | 
cāmuṇḍe ḍaralānte ca kasa haiṃ śrīmahātri ca || 6-6 ||

purasundari devīti viccentaṃ varade padam |
svarān viśuddhapīṭhasthe viśuddhānte tu ḍākini || 6-7 ||

viśuddhanāthadevaśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca |
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca karṇikāyāmimaṃ nyaset || 6-8 ||

tavaḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūrvādyakṣarapūrvikāḥ |
amṛtādiśaktīstu vinyaset tā yathākramam || 6-9 ||

amṛtākarṣiṇīndrāṇīśānyumā cordhvakeśinī |
ṛddhidā ca tato ṝṣā ḷkārā ca tataḥ param || 6-10 ||

ḹṣā caikapadā caiśvaryātmikauṅkāriṇī tataḥ |
tatauṣadhātmikā caivāmbikā cāpyakṣarātmikā || 6-11 ||

amṛtādikaśaktīnāṃ ḍākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-12 ||

anāhate dvādaśāre rākiṇīṃ raktadhātugām |
dhyāyet tatkarṇikāmadhye sādhakaḥ sarvasiddhaye || 6-13 ||

śyāmāṃ śūlābjahastāṃ ḍamarukasahitāṃ tīkṣṇacakraṃ vahantīṃ 
dvyāsyāṃ raktatrinetrāṃ bhrukuṭivalilasaddaṣṭadantaprabhābhiḥ |
dīptāṃ tāṃ devadevīṃ hṛdayakamalagāṃ raktadhātvekanāthāṃ 
śuddhānneṣu prasaktāṃ madhumadamuditāṃ bhāvayedrākiṇī tām || 6-14 ||

tattadakṣaratatsthānatadantapadayojanāt | 
pūrvavanmantramuccārya karṇikāyāṃ nyasedbudhaḥ || 6-15 ||

paritaḥ kālarātryādiśaktīstadvarṇapūrvikāḥ |
nyaseddvādaśapatreṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam || 6-16 ||

kālarātriśca khātītā gāyatrī ca tataḥ param |
ghaṇṭādhāriṇikā caiva tato ṅārṇātmikā punaḥ || 6-17 ||

cāmuṇḍācchāyā jayā jhaṅkāriṇī ñārṇātmikā punaḥ |
ṭaṅkahastā ca ṭhaṅkāriṇyetāḥ pūrvādi vinyaset || 6-18 ||

kālarātryādiśaktīnāṃ rākiṇīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-19 ||

maṇipūre daśadale lākinīṃ māṃsadhātugām |
dhyāyet tatkarṇikāmadhye sādhakaḥ sarvasiddhaye || 6-20 ||

kṛṣṇāṃ devīṃ trivaktrāṃ trinayanasahitāṃ daṃṣṭriṇīmugrarūpāṃ 
vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍābhayavaradadarān dakṣavāme dadhānām |

p. 103)

dhyātvā nābhisthapadme daśadalavilasatkarṇike lākinīṃ tāṃ 
māṃsasthāṃ gauḍabhaktotsukahṛdayavatīṃ cintayet sādhakendraḥ || 6-21 ||

mantraṃ prāgvat pravinyasya ḍāmaryādīn pravinyaset |
ḍāmarī ḍhaṅkāriṇī ca ṇakāriṇyatha tāmasī || 6-22 ||

sthānadevī ca dākṣāyaṇyatha dhātrī tathaiva ca |
nandā ca pārvatī phaṭkāriṇyetā daśapatragāḥ || 6-23 ||

ḍāmaryādikaśaktīnāṃ lākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-24 ||

svādhiṣṭhāne rasadale kākinīṃ bhāvayetsudhīḥ |
medodhātusthadeveśīṃ parivārasamanvitām || 6-25 ||

svādhiṣṭhānākhyapadme rasadalalalite vedavaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ 
pītābhāṃ dhārayantīṃ triśikhaguṇakapālābhayānyāttavargām |
medodhātupratiṣṭhāmalimadamuditāṃ bandhinītyādiyuktāṃ 
dadhyanne saktacittāmabhimataphaladāṃ kākinīṃ bhāvayettām || 6-26 ||

bandhinī bhadrakālī ca mahāmāyā yaśasvinī | 
ramā tathā ca lamboṣṭhī ṣaḍdale pūrvavannyaset || 6-27 ||

bandhinyādikaśaktīnāṃ kākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-28 ||

mūlādhāre vedadale śākinīmasthidhātugām |
parivārayutāṃ devī karṇikāyāṃ tu bhāvayet || 6-29 ||

devīṃ jyotiḥsvarūpāṃ trinayanavilasatpañcavaktrāṃ sudaṃṣṭrāṃ 
hastāmbhojeṣu cāpaṃ sṛṇimapi dadhatīṃ pustakaṃ jñānamudrām |
mūlādhārasthapadme nikhilapaśujanonmādinīmasthisaṃsthāṃ 
mudgānne prītiyuktāṃ madhumadamuditāṃ cintayet śākinīṃ tām || 6-30 ||

varadā śaśinī ṣaṇḍā caturthī syātsarasvatī |
caturdaleṣu pūrvādi nyasedetāstu sādhakaḥ || 6-31 ||

varadādikaśaktīnāṃ śākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-32 ||

ājñāyāṃ dvidale padme yā majjādhātudevatā |
dhyātvā tāṃ karṇikāmadhye tanmantraṃ tatra vinyaset || 6-33 ||

bhrūmadhye bindupadme dvidalasulalite śuklavarṇāṃ karābjai
rbibhrāṇāṃ jñānamudrāṃ ḍamarukasahitāmakṣamālāṃ kapālam |
ṣaḍvaktrāṃ majjasaṃsthāṃ trinayanalalitāṃ haṃsavatyādiyuktāṃ 
hāridrānne prasaktāṃ sakalasuranutā hākinīṃ bhāvayettām || 6-34 ||

haṃsavatyai kṣamāvatyai nama ityapi vinyaset |
daladvaye kramāddevi tattadakṣarapūrvakam || 6-35 ||

haṃsavatyādiśaktyostu hākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ |
tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane || 6-36 ||

brahmarandhre sahasrāre karṇikāyāṃ tu yākinīm |
tāṃ śukradhātugāṃ devīṃ dhyāyet sāvaraṇāṃ śubhām || 6-37 ||

muṇḍavyomasthapadme sakaladalayute yākinīṃ bhairavīṃ tāṃ 
yakṣiṇyāḍhyāṃ samastāyudhakalitakarāṃ sarvavarṇāṃ samaṣṭim |
ḍādīnāṃ sarvavaktrāṃ sakalasukhakarīṃ sarvadhātusvarūpāṃ 
sarvānne saktacittāṃ paraśivarasikāṃ bhāvayet sarvarūpām || 6-38 ||

tanmantraṃ pūrvavannyasya parito'pyamṛtādikāḥ | 
amṛtādikaśaktīnāṃ yākinīsadṛśaṃ vapuḥ || 6-39 ||

tatsamānāyudhādīni nyāsapūjanacintane |

iti yoginīnyāsaḥ || atha rāśinyāsaḥ-

prāṇānāyamya mūlena rāśīnāṃ dhyānamācaret |
raktaṃ śvetaṃ haridvarṇaṃ pāṇḍuṃ citraṃ sitaṃ smaret || 6-1 ||

p. 104)

piśaṅgakapilo kadrukarburāruṇadhūmalān |
akārādicatuṣkeṇa vinyaset suravandite || 6-2 ||

meṣaṃ dakṣiṇapadagulphe tato dvandvena vai vṛṣam |
nyasejjāni vedaistu mithunaṃ vṛṣaṇe tataḥ || 6-3 ||

dvābhyāṃ kakaṃṭakaṃ kukṣau dvābhyāṃ skandhe ca siṃhakam |
anusvāravisargābhyāṃ śavargeṇa ca kanyakām || 6-4 ||

dakṣiṇe tu śirobhāge vinyasedvīravandite |
tathā vāme śirobhāge kavargeṇa tulābhṛtam || 6-5 ||

cavargeṇa tathā skandhe vṛścikaṃ vinyaset priye |
ṭavargeṇa tathā kukṣau dhanvinaṃ vinyaset priye || 6-6 ||

makaraṃ tu tavargeṇa vṛṣaṇe vāmake nyaset |
pavargeṇa tathā kumbhaṃ vāmajānuni vinyaset || 6-7 ||

yavargeṇa kṣakāreṇa mīnaṃ gulphe tu vāmake | tathā-

prāṇāpānodānavyānasamānāḥpañca vāyavaḥ |
meṣādyā rāśayo jñeyāḥ pañca siṃhāvasānakāḥ || 6-8 ||

tathā nāgaśca kūrmaśca kṛkalo devadattakaḥ |
dhanañjaya iti proktāḥ kanyādyāḥ pañca rāśayaḥ || 6-9 ||

jīvātmaparamātmānau kumbhamīnau prakīrtitau |
nyastavyā mantribhiḥ siddhyai tadādyā ravirāśayaḥ || 6-10 ||

iti rāśinyāsaḥ || atha pīṭhanyāsaḥ-

atha pīṭhāni vidhinā nyaset sarvamayāni hi |
sitāsitāruṇaśyāmaharitpītānyanukramāt || 6-1 ||

punaḥpunaḥ kramāddevi pañcāśatsthānasaṃcaye |
pīṭhāni saṃsmaredvidvān sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 6-2 ||

kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhamityādipīṭhamātṛkoktakramo boddhavya iti pīṭhanyāsaḥ || iti 
pūrvaṣoḍhānyāsaḥ samāptaḥ || 

atha kāmaratinyāsaḥ-

kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasya kāmabhakto bhavedyadi |
kāmaśaktisamāyuktāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyaset sudhīḥ || 6-1 ||

sammohana ṛṣiścaiva jagatī chanda ucyate |
śrīkāmaśaktayo devi devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 6-2 ||

klīṃbījaṃ ca namaḥ śaktirmātṛkā kīlakaṃ smṛtam |
ṣaṭdīrghakāmabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset || 6-3 ||

atha kāmā varārohe dāḍimīkusumaprabhāḥ |
vāmāṅgaśaktisahitāḥ puṣpabāṇekṣukārmukāḥ || 6-4 ||

śaktayaḥ kuṃkumanibhāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
nīlotpalakarā dhyeyāstrailokyākarṣaṇakṣamāḥ || 6-5 ||

iti dhyātvā | 4 aṃ kāmāya ratyaiḥ ityādi kāmaratimātṛkoktakrameṇa nyasediti 
kāmaratimātṛkānyāsaḥ || 

atha śrīcakranyāsastaduktaṃ tantrāntare-

evaṃ ṣoḍhā purā kṛtvā kāmaratyādikaṃ nyaset |
tataḥ śrīcakravinyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ śivatāptaye || 6-1 ||

śrīmattripurasundaryāścakranyāsaṃ śṛṇu priye |
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tanuśuddhikaraṃ param || 6-2 ||

śrīrudrayāmale-

śarīraṃ cintayedādau nijaṃ śrīcakrarūpakam |
tvagādyākāranirmuktaṃ jvalatkālāgnisatprabham || 6-1 || iti | 

ṛṣicchandodaivatāni smṛtvā nyāsaṃ samācaret |
anulomavilomasthabālayā syāt ṣaḍaṅgakam || 6-1 ||

dvādaśānte cidākāśe śivaśaktyātmakaṃ gurum |
paratejomayaṃ dhyāyedbhogamokṣaphalāptaye || 6-2 ||

ānandamānandakaraṃ prasannaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ nijabhāvayuktam |
yogīndramīḍhyaṃ bhavarogavaidyaṃ śrīmadguruṃ nityamahaṃ namāmi || 6-3 ||

vāmajānau gaṇeśānaṃ vāmāṃse kṣetrapālakam |
yoginīṃ dakṣiṇe jānau skandhe vaṭukabhairavam || 6-4 ||

nyased dakṣapadāgre'tha śakraṃ vātha hutāśanam |
dakṣajānau yamaṃ paścād dakṣapārśve nyased budhaḥ || 6-5 ||

dakṣāṃse nir-ṛti paścādvāmāṃse varuṇaṃ tataḥ |
vāmapārśve samīraṃ ca vāmajānau dhanādhipam || 6-6 ||

īśānaṃ vāmapādāgre brahmāṇaṃ brahmarandhrataḥ |
anantaṃ vinyasenmantrī mūlādhāre samāhitaḥ || 6-7 ||

caturasrādirekhāyai nama ityādito nyaset |
dakṣāṃsapṛṣṭha pāṇyagra sphik pādāgrāṃgulīṣvatha || 6-8 ||

p. 105)

vāmapādāṃguli sphikpāṇyagre cāṃsakūṭake |
sacūlītala pṛṣṭheṣu vyāpakatvena sundari || 6-9 ||

siddhīstadantarālasthā vyāpakatvena vinyaset | 
caturasramadhyarekhāyai nama ityapi vallabhe || 6-10 ||

vinyasya tasyāḥ sthāneṣu brahmāṇyādyāstathāṣṭasu | 

iti | śrīrudrayāmale-

kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ śivaṃ papraccha pārvatī |
śrīcakranyāsakavacaṃ brūhi me deva śaṅkara || 6-1 ||

śaṅkara uvāca-

sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
śrīcakranyāsakavacaṃ prasphutaṃ kathayāmi te || 6-2 ||

śarīraṃ cintayedādau nijaṃ śrīcakrarūpakam |
tvagādyākāranirmuktaṃ jvalatkālāgnisatprabham || 6-3 ||

dvādaśānte cidākāśe śivaśaktyātmakaṃ gurum |
paratejomayaṃ dhyāyedbhogamokṣaphalāptaye || 6-4 ||

gaṇeśo jānu (me ? nī) pātu vāmāṃsaṃ kṣetranāyakaḥ |
yoginyo dakṣiṇaṃ (pāntu) skandhaṃ vaṭukabhairavaḥ || 6-5 ||

dakṣapādāgramindro me pātvagnirdakṣajānukam |
dakṣapārśvaṃ yamaḥ pātu dakṣāṃsaṃ nir-ṛnirmama || 6-6 ||

varuṇaḥ pātu vāmāṃsaṃ vāmapārśvaṃ samīraṇaḥ |
vāmajānu dhanādhyakṣo vāmapādāgramīśvaraḥ || 6-7 ||

brahmarandhraṃ vidhiḥ pātu mūlādhāramanantakaḥ |
caturasrādirekhāyai nama ityādyanukramāt || 6-8 ||

vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari |
nidhivāhanamārūḍhā varābhayakarāmbujāḥ || 6-9 ||

padmarāgapratīkāśāḥ prasīdantvaṇimādayaḥ |
dakṣāṃsapṛṣṭhamaṇimā karāgraṃlaghimāvatu || 6-10 ||

dakṣasphicaṃ tu mahimā īśitvaṃ caraṇāgrakam |
vaśitvaṃ vāmapāde'vyāt prākāmyaṃ sphicaketare || 6-11 ||

icchāsiddhistu vāmāṃsaṃ karāgraṃ bhuktisiddikā |
rasasiddhiḥ śiro me'vyācchiraḥpṛṣṭhaṃ tu mokṣadā || 6-12 ||

caturasramadhyarekhāyai nama ityādyanukramāt |
vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari || 6-13 ||

(pādāṃguṣṭhau tu brahmāṇī māheśī dakṣapārśvakam |
kaumārī ca śiraḥ pātu vaiṣṇavī vāmapārśvakam || 6-14 ||

vāmajānuni vārāhī cendrāṇī dakṣajānuni |
cāmuṇḍā pātu dakṣāṃse mahālakṣmīstu  vāmake || 6-15 ||

caturasrāntarekhāyai nama ityādyanukramāt |
vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari || 6-16 ||

mudrādevyaḥ prasīdantu varābhayakarāmbujāḥ |
bhaktānugrahasaṃdhānadevatāmodahetave || 6-17 ||

pādāṃguṣṭhadvayaṃ mudrā sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī mama |
sarvavidrāviṇī mudrā pārśvaṃ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam || 6-18 ||

ākarṣiṇī mūrdhni deśaṃ vāmapārśvaṃ vaśaṅkarī |
unmādinī vāmajānuṃ dakṣajānuṃ mahāṃkuśā || 6-19 ||

savyāṃsaṃ khecarī pātu vāmāṃsaṃ bījamudrikā |
trikhaṇḍā dvādaśāntaṃ tu yonyaṃguṣṭhadvayaṃ padoḥ || 6-20 ||

hṛnmadhyaṃ tripurā pātu siddhimudrāsamanvitā |
sarvāśāpūrakaṃ ṅa'ntaṃ ṣoḍaśārāya vai namaḥ || 6-21 ||

vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari |
kālādevyaḥ prasīdantu pāśāṃkuśakarodyatāḥ || 6-22 ||

raktāṃgyo raktavasanāḥ sarvābharabhūṣitāḥ |
kāmākarṣiṇikā pātu karṇapṛṣṭhaṃ tu dakṣiṇam || 6-23 ||

buddhyākarṣiṇikā nityā rakṣatād dakṣiṇāṃsakam |
ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī me kūrparaṃ pātu dakṣiṇam || 6-24 ||

dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ me śabdākarṣiṇikāvatu |
sparśākarṣiṇikā pāyāddakṣiṇorutaṭaṃ mama || 6-25 ||

rūpākarṣiṇikā jānu rasākarṣī tu gulphakam |
gandhākarṣiṇikā rakṣeddakṣapādatalaṃ mama || 6-26 ||

vāmapādatalaṃ devī cittākarṣiṇikāvatu |
pādādhoyāvatā gulphaṃ dhairyākarṣaṇikāvatu || 6-27 ||

smṛtyākarṣiṇikā jānuṃ vāmoruṃ nāmakarṣiṇī |
bījākarṣiṇikā pātu karapṛṣṭhamadakṣiṇam || 6-28 ||

kūrparaṃ pātu me savyamātmākarṣaṇakāriṇī |
amṛtākarṣiṇī vāmāṃsaṃ śarīrākarṣiṇī śrutim || 6-29 ||

siddhimudrānvitā yāvad hṛnmadhyaṃ tripureśvarī |
sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ cakrāya nama ityapi || 6-30 ||

p. 106)

vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari |
anaṅgakusumādevyāḥ prasannā raktakaṃcukāḥ || 6-31 ||

veṇīkṛtajagatkeśāḥ śarakārmukapāṇayaḥ |
anaṅgakusumā pātu dakṣaśaṅkhaṃ sadā mama || 6-32 ||

anaṅgamekhalādevī trāyatāṃ dakṣajānukam |
anaṅgamadanāśaktirūruṃ pāyāt sadā mama || 6-33 ||

gulphamadhyāntaraṃ me'vyādanaṅgamadanāturā |
anaṅgarekhā vāmāṅgaṃ rakṣatāṃ gulphamantaram || 6-34 ||

anaṅgaveginī pāyādūruprāntaṃ sadā mama |
mamānaṅgāṃkuśā jānudeśaṃ rakṣatu vāmakam || 6-35 ||

anaṅgamālinī śaṅkhaṃ vāme rakṣatu me'niśam |
sundarī siddhimudrābhyāṃ pātu me hṛdayāntaram || 6-36 ||

sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ cakrāya nama ityapi |
vyāpaktvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari || 6-37 ||

śaktidevyaḥ prasīdantu bāṇakārmukapāṇayaḥ |
sarvābharaṇasampannā vaiḍūryamaṇirociṣaḥ || 6-38 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī phālaṃ tadantaṃ drāviṇī mama |
dakṣiṇaṃ pālayedgaṇḍaṃ sarvākarṣiṇikā sadā || 6-39 ||

sarvāhlādakarī dakṣamaṃsāntaṃ pātu me sadā |
sarvasammohanīśaktiḥ pārśvāntaṃ pātu dakṣiṇam || 6-40 ||

sarvasaṃstambhinī rakṣeddakṣamūruṃ tu pṛṣṭhakam |
jaṅghāntaṃ jṛmbhiṇī dakṣaṃ vāmaṃ sarvavaśaṅkarī || 6-41 ||

rañjinī vāmapūrvaṃ tu pṛṣṭhaṃ pālayatānmama |
pārśvāntaṃ sarvamavyānme sarvonmādanakāriṇī || 6-42 ||

sarvārthasādhinī pāyādaṃsāntaṃ dakṣiṇetaram |
vāmaṃ pātu kapolaṃ me sarvasampatprapūraṇī || 6-43 ||

sarvamantramayī bhālaṃ vāmabhāgaṃ mamāvatu |
pālayeddvārakūpaṃ me sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī || 6-44 ||

tripuravāsinī siddhimudrābhyāṃ pātu hṛnmama |
sarvārthasādhakaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ cakrāya nama ityapi || 6-45 ||

vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari |
daśa devyaḥ prasīdantu sarvasiddhipradāyikāḥ || 6-46 ||

kundamandārahārābhā varābhayakarāmbujāḥ |
sarvasiddhipradā me'vyāddakṣiṇekṣaṇakoṇakam || 6-47 ||

pālayennāsikāmūlaṃ sarvasampatpradā mama |
nityaṃ rakṣatu vāmākṣikoṇaṃ sarvapriyaṅkarī || 6-48 ||

rakṣet kukṣiṃ sakoṇaṃ me sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī |
tathaiva kukṣivāyavyaṃ sarvakāmapradāvatu || 6-49 ||

vāmajānvantaraṃ pātu sarvaduḥkhavimocanī | 
sarvamṛtyupraśamanī dakṣiṇaṃ jānukāntaram || 6-50 ||

sadā pāyādapānaṃ me sarvavighnanivāriṇī |
sarvāṅgasundarī devī rakṣatāt kukṣinair-ṛtam || 6-51 ||

āgneyaṃ pālayet kukṣiṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī |
hṛnmadhyaṃ tripurāśrīrme siddhimudrānvitāvatu || 6-52 ||

sarvarakṣākaraṃ ṅe'ntaṃ cakrāya nama ityapi |
vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari || 6-53 ||

antardaśāravāsinyaḥ prasīdantu mamāniśam |
devyaḥ sphaṭikasaṅkāśāḥ pustakākṣālibāhavaḥ || 6-54 ||

sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca dakṣiṇaghrāṇasṛktriṇī |
sarvaiśvaryapradā jñānamayī ca stanamuṣkakau || 6-55 ||

sīvanīmaniśa pātu sarvavyādhivināśinī |
vāmaṃ me vṛṣaṇaṃ pātu sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī || 6-56 ||

sarvapāpaharānandamayī ca stanasṛkviṇī | 
vāmanāsāpuṭaṃ pātu sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī || 6-57 ||

agradeśaṃ nāsikāyāḥ sarvepsitaphalapradā |
hṛtpadmaṃ siddhimudrābhyāṃ pātu tripuramālinī || 6-58 ||

sarvarogaharāṣṭāracakrāya nama ityapi |
vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari || 6-59 ||

vāgdevyo naḥ prasīdantu sindūrakanakāmbarāḥ |
pustakākṣālivilasadvaradābhītibāhavaḥ || 6-60 ||

dakṣiṇaṃ cibukasyāṃśaṃ vaśinī pātu sarvadā |
kaṇṭhaṃ kāmeśvarī dakṣaṃ hṛdayaṃ pātu modinī || 6-61 ||

vimalā dakṣiṇaṃ nābhestadvāmamaruṇāvatu |
hṛdvāmaṃ jayinī pātu kaṇṭhaṃ sarveśvarī tathā || 6-62 ||

kaulinī cibukaṃ siddhā tripurā hṛdayāmbujam |
sarvasiddhipradāntarālacakrāya nama ityapi || 6-63 ||

vyāpakatvena vinyaset kusumāñjalimīśvari |
kāmakāmeśvarībāṇacāpapāśāṃkuśāḥ kramāt || 6-64 ||

parito hṛdi koṇasya caturasraṃ mamāvatu |
mahāmokṣapradāṃ yoniṃ hṛdayopari rājitām || 6-65 ||

kāmeśvaryādikaṃ pātu nityāṣoḍaśakaṃ mama |
kāmapradā rudraśaktiḥ kāmarūpanivāsinī || 6-66 ||

p. 107)

agrakoṇaṃ mahāyoneḥ pātu kāmeśvarī mama |
dharmadā vaiṣṇavī śaktirjālandhrakṛtamandirā || 6-67 ||

dakṣakoṇāntaraṃ yoneḥ pāyānme vaiṣṇavī sadā |
arthadā brahmaṇaḥ śaktiḥ pūrṇaśailukṛtālayā || 6-68 ||

vāmakoṇāntaraṃ pātu subhagā bhagamālinī |
tripurāmbā yonimadhyaṃ siddhimudrā mamāvatu || 6-69 ||

uḍyānapīṭhanilayā parabrahmasvarūpiṇī |
pañcaśrīkośakalpadrukāmadhugratnadaivataiḥ || 6-70 ||

maṇḍitāsanasaṃsthānā sarvadarśanasaṃsthitā |
stutā ṣaḍaṅgadevībhiścatuḥsamayapūjitā  || 6-71 ||

mahāsaubhāgyajananī mahāmokṣapradāyinī |
hṛdi dorantaraṃ pāta mahātripurasundarī || 6-72 ||

saiva cakreśvarī devī siddhimudrāsamanvitā |
āpādamastakaṃ devī pātu tripurabhairavī || 6-73 ||

etatte kavacaṃ bhadre rahasyaṃ sarvakāmadam |
turīyavidyāmuccārya parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 6-74 ||

śrīmahātripuraśūnyāśūnyavarjitaśaktiparabaindavacakravāsinyanākhyābhāsā-
śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarpayāmi namaḥ | tatraiva navacakreśvarīḥ pūjayet | ka e ī la 
hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ 
tripuraśūnyāśūnyaparabaindavacakravāsinyanākhyābhāsāṃ śrīpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmi namaḥ | iti vinyasya svamudrāṃ pradarśayet |

yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tadadya prakaṭīkṛtam |
ya idaṃ vinyaseddehe sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ || 6-75 ||

vimucya mānuṣa bhāvaṃ sa sadyaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet |
trikālaṃ bhāvayedyastu tasya sarvāṅgasaṅgatam || 6-76 ||

āmastaṃ yoginīvṛndaṃ sphuradrūpaṃ prakāśate |
bhūtapretapiśācādyairbādhituṃ naiva śakyate || 6-77 ||

siddhavadvicarelloke tāpatrayavivarjitaḥ | 
yatra yogī smaredetat tasmādārabhya sarvataḥ || 6-78 ||

dharaṇī kṣetratāṃ yāti yāvad dvādaśayojanam |

iti śrīrudrayāmale śrīcakranyāsakavacam | iti saṃhāraśrīcakranyāsaḥ || atha 
suṣṭicakranyāsaḥ - saca mūladevyādyaṇimāntaḥ | tatra kramamāha yoginīhṛdaye |

mūladevyādikaṃ nyāsamaṇimāntaṃ punarnyaset |
śirastrikoṇe pūrvādi kāmeśvaryādikaṃ nyaset || 6-1 ||

bāṇā netre bhruvau cāpau carṇau pāśadvayaṃ punaḥ |
sṛṇidvayaṃ ca nāsāgraṃ dakṣiṇādyaṃ ca vinyaset || 6-2 ||

muṇḍamālākrameṇaiva nyasedvāgdevatāṣṭakam |
vaindavādīni cakrāṇi nyastavyāni varānane || 6-3 ||

netramūle tvapāṅge ca karṇapūrvottare tathā |
cūlikāyāśca nimnārdhe śeṣārdhe karṇapṛṣṭhake || 6-4 ||

karṇamūle tvapāṅge ca tasya mūle ca vinyaset |
sarvasiddhyādikaṃ kaṇṭhe prādakṣiṇyena vinyaset || 6-5 ||

hṛdaye manukoṇasthāḥ śaktayo'pi ca pūrvavat |
nābhau tvaṣṭadalaṃ tatra vaṃśe vāme ca pārśvayoḥ || 6-6 ||

udare savyapārśve ca nyasedādicatuṣṭayam |
vaṃśavāmāntarālādi nyasedanyacatuṣṭayam || 6-7 ||

svādhiṣṭhāne nyaset svasya pūrvāddakṣāvasānakam |
mūlādhāre nyasenmudrādaśakaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 6-8 ||

puraḥ savye ca vaṃśe ca vāme caivāntarālake |
ūrdhvādho daśa mudrāśca ūrdhvādhovarjitaṃ punaḥ || 6-9 ||

brahmāṇyādyaṣṭakaṃ dakṣajaṅghāyāṃ tāśca pūrvavat |
vāmajaṅghāṃ samārabhya vāmādikramato'pi vā || 6-10 ||

siddhyaṣṭakaṃ nyaseccheṣadvayaṃ pādatale nyaset |
kāraṇāt prasṛtaṃ nyāsaṃ dīpāddīpamivoditam || 6-11 ||

evaṃ vinyasya deveśi svābhedena vicintayet |

iti samaṣṭirūpeṇa mahācakrasya saṃhārakramanyāsamuktvā sṛṣṭikrameṇāha-
mūladevyādikamiti | evaṃ cet kriyate tadā nyāsaḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa bhavati taṃ 
punarnyasedityarthaḥ tatra prakāramāha - śira ityādi | śirasi kalpitatrikoṇaḥ 
śirastrikoṇastasmin kāmeśvaryādikaṃ bījadevītrayaṃ nyasedityarthaḥ kena 
krameṇetyata āha - pūrvādīti | pūrvaścātra mastakādyabhāgastadādi yathā syāt | 
tena lalāṭābhimukhastrikoṇaḥ kalpanīya ityāyātam | saca śrīcakranirmāṇakrameṇa 
yathā yogyavinyāsarekho bhavati tathāṣṭāraparyantaṃ kalpanīya iti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca 
sati śiropekṣayā pūrvāgraṃ trikoṇaṃ jātamiti paścimakoṇe āgneyakoṇe īśānakoṇe 
iti vā bhaviṣyati | tatrādye pūrvāditi prādakṣiṇyenetyarthaḥ | 
antye'pradakṣiṇamityarthaḥ | tena 

p. 108)

paścimādyapradakṣiṇamiti tantrarājamatamāyātam | tena saha 
yoginīhṛdayasyaikavākyatayaivameva nyāsaḥ kārya iti kaścit | catuḥśatyekavākyatayā 
pūrvamatadvayena nyāsaḥ kārya iti kaścit | vastutastvayaṃ pakṣaḥ samīcīnaḥ 
pūrvacatuḥśatyā tātparyagrāhakatvādasyeti saṃkṣepaḥ | āyudhanyāse 
sthānaviśeṣamāha - bāṇā ityādi | bāṇāḥ pañcabāṇāḥ śivasya śaktyāśceti 
dvividhāḥ netre netradvayasvarūpā ityarthaḥ | netre iti dvivacanaṃ tena dakṣanetraṃ 
kāmeśvarabāṇāḥ vāmanetraṃ kāmeśvarībāṇāḥ evaṃ dakṣabhrūḥ 
kāmeśvaracāpaḥ vāmabhrūḥ kāmeśvarīcāpaḥ dakṣakarṇaḥ kāmeśvarapāśaḥ 
vāmakarṇaḥ kāmeśvarīpāśaḥ dakṣanāsāpuṭāgraṃ kāmeśvarāṃkuśaḥ 
vāmanāsāpuṭāgraṃ kāmeśvaryaṃkuśaḥ iti tatra tatraiva tān nyasedityata 
āhadakṣiṇādyamityādi | atra yadyapi trikoṇāṣṭārayormadhyamāyudhasthānamiti 
pūrvavadapi tatraiva nyāsa upapadyate tathāpi sṛṣṭikrameṇa svaramūrtīnāṃ 
sāṃnidhyāt tatraivāyudhānāṃ nyāso yukta itīśvarājñā | evaṃ 
ṣoḍaśanityānāmapi svaramūrtitvāt sṛṣṭikrame tatsthānāmapi saṃnidhānāt teṣveva 
tāsāṃ nyāso yukta itīśvarecchā mantavyā | śrīvidyānyāsasthānasya pṛṣṭhataḥ 
svasthāna eva gurupaṅktayo nyastavyāḥ tataḥ ṣoḍaśanityāmaṇḍala iti kramaḥ 
sṛṣṭikramanyāse anyatra tu pūrvoktakrama eveti | jñanārṇave :

śrīvidyāṃ brahmarandhre tu pṛṣṭhato guravaḥ kramāt |
tithinityāstato devi mātṛkāsvarasaṃyutāḥ || 6-1 ||

mātṛkāvannyasedvaktre sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī |
aḥsvare parameśāni śrīvidyāṃ viśvamātṛkām || 6-2 ||

svaravadvinyasennityāṃ nīrajāyatalocane |

ityayaṃ nyāsaḥ sṛṣṭiśrīcakranyāsāntargataḥ svato'pīti mantavyam || 
athāṣṭāranyāsakramamāha - muṇḍamāleti | muṇḍo mastakaḥ muṇḍe mālā 
muṇḍamālā tasyāḥ krameṇa pratipādyetyarthaḥ | tena lalāṭordhvakoṇāditaḥ 
pūrvādiprādakṣiṇyena śironavayoginīcakrarītyāṣṭakoṇeṣu mālākrameṇa 
vāgdevatāṣṭakaṃ nyasediti bhāvaḥ | nanu binducakranyāsaṃ kathaṃ kuryādityata āha-
baindavādīnīti | baindavaṃ sarvānandamayaṃ mahābinducakraṃ tadevādiryeṣāṃ tāni 
yathācakrāṇi trikoṇādīni baindavādīni kṛtvā nyastavyānīti sambandhaḥ | ādau 
binducakraṃ nyasya paścāt trikoṇādīni nyasediti bhāvaḥ | tarhi binducakranyāsaḥ 
kathaṃ prathamaṃ nokta iti cet na tasyāvacchedakatvāt trikoṇasya trikoṇamadhyaṃ hi 
binducakraṃ tena vinā kathaṃ tadupapadyatām | tenāyaṃ kalitārthaḥ paripāṭīviśeṣaḥ 
prathamaṃ śirasi trikoṇaṃ vicintya tanmadhye śarvānandamayacakrāya namaḥ iti 
vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā tadbindutvena vicintya tatra yathāvidhi mūladevīṃ nyaset | 
tatastrikoṇādau nyāsaḥ | ataḥ śirastrikoṇe iti siddhavibhaktinirdeśaḥ | kecittu 
taṭasthameva prathamaṃ binducakraṃ vibhāvya vinyasya tadbāhyatastrikoṇacakraṃ 
vibhāvya vinyasediti kramamāhuḥ | saca no yoginīhṛdayasammata iti cintyam || 
athāntardaśāracakrasya nyāsasthānānyāhanetramūla ityādi | netrasya dakṣiṇanetrasya 
mūle pūrvakaṇṭhe nāsikopakaṇṭha iti yāvat tasyaivāpāṅga añcale karṇopakaṇṭhe iti 
yāvat karṇasya dakṣiṇasya pūrvottare pūrve madhye uttare pṛṣṭhe cūlikāyāḥ 
cūlāyā nimnārdhe paścādardhe śeṣārdhe pūrvārdhaśiraḥ 
pṛṣṭhārdhabhāgayorityarthaḥ iti kaścit | cūlikāyā nimnārdhe cūlikāyā 
adhastādnimnasthalaṃ ghāṭāsīvanī tasyārdhe śeṣārdhe vāmārdhe tena 
skandhasīvanyā dakṣavāmabhāgayorityarthaḥ iti kaścit | atra prathamabhaṅgaprasaṅga 
iti dik | karṇapṛṣṭhe vāmakarṇapṛṣṭhe karṇamūle vāmakarṇamadhye apāṅge 
vāmanetraprānte tasya vāmanetramūle pūrvakaṇṭhe ceti daśasu sthāneṣu cakrakrameṇa 
nyaset sarvajñādyā daśaśaktīriti śeṣaḥ || atha bāhyadaśāracakranyāsamāha-
sarvasiddhyādikamityādi | kaṇṭhe viśuddhacakre akārādivisargāntaṣoḍaśadale 
sarvasiddhyādikaṃ devīdaśakaṃ pūrvadalādiprādakṣiṇyena nyasedityarthaḥ 
padmasyordhvamukhatvabhāvanāpūrvakamitibhāvaḥ | tadā kaṇṭhakūpa eva 
pūrvadalamata evāntaḥ kaṇṭhaveṣṭanarūpa evāyaṃ nyāso bahiḥ kaṇṭhaveṣṭanatvena 
nyaset || atha caturdaśāranyāsamāha-hṛdaya ityādi | anāhatacakre 
kaṇṭhāntadvādaśadale manukoṇasthāścaturdaśārasthāḥ 
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyādicaturdaśaśaktayo'pi pūrvavat pūrvadalādiprādakṣiṇyena 
nyastavyā ityarthaḥ || athāṣṭadalanyāsamāhanābhāviti | bhinnaprakrame 
aṣṭadalapadmaṃ nābhau nyaset tato bāhyāṅgaveṣṭanatvena 
pūrvavadantarveṣṭanenetyarthaḥ | ato nyāsasthānaviśeṣamaṣṭadalātmakamāha-vaṃśe 
vāme tadavacchannamerudaṇḍe ityarthaḥ | tena pṛṣṭhe paścimadalaṃ vāmapārśve 
uttaradalamuttare pūrvadalaṃ dakṣapārśve dakṣiṇadalamiti 

p. 109)

digdalacatuṣṭaye'naṅgakusumādicatuṣṭayaṃ paścimādapradakṣiṇaṃ 
vinyasedityarthaḥ | digdalamāha-vaṃśa iti | vāmo vāmapārśvaḥ vaṃśaśca vāmaśca 
vaṃśavāmau tayorantarālaṃ vaṃśavāmāntarālaṃ 
vaṃśavāmapārśvāntarālamityarthaḥ | tena vāyavyadalaṃ jātaṃ tadevādiryatra 
nyasanakriyāyāṃ tattatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ tena vaṃśavāmāntarālādiryathā syāt 
tathānyadanaṅgarekhādicatuṣṭayaṃ nyasedityarthaḥ | ādipadena 
vāmapārśvodarāntarālamudaradakṣapārśvāntarālaṃ 
dakṣapārśvavaṃśāntarālamiti krameṇa vāyavyeśānāgneyanair-
ṛtavidigdalacatuṣṭayaṃ jātamityaṣṭadaleṣvevaṃ nyāsaḥ || atha 
ṣoḍaśadalacakranyāsamāha-śvādhiṣṭhāne iti svādhiṣṭhāne liṅgamūle ṣaḍdale 
svasyātmano dehasya pūrvabhāgdalādārabhyāgneyadalaparyantaṃ 
kāmākarṣiṇyādipañcaśaktīrvinyasya ṣaṣṭhe dale śarīrākarṣiṇīṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ 
śaktiṃ nyasediti liṅgaveṣṭanatvena nyāsakramaḥ || atha 
trailokyamohanacakrasyāntaścaturasrarekhāyā nyāsamāha-mūlādhāra ityādi | 
mūlādhāre caturdale | tatra prakāramāha-pura ityādi | puraḥ pūrve dehasyeti śeṣaḥ | 
svasyeti cānuvartate | savye dakṣiṇe savyaṃ syāddakṣavāmayorityabhidhānāt | vaṃśe 
pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vāme vā dale etaddalacatuṣṭaye 
sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇyādimudrācatuṣṭayaṃ prādakṣiṇyena vinyasyāntarālake āgneyanair-
ṛtyavāyavyeśāneti dalasaṃdhicatuṣṭaye unmādinyādimudrācatuṣṭayaṃ ca 
vinyasyordhvamindreśānayormadhye nir-ṛtivaruṇayormadhye'dhastayoryathākramaṃ 
khecarīyonimudre nyasediti daśa mudrāśceti || atha madhyamacaturasrarekhāyā 
nyāsamāha-ūrdhvādhovarjitaṃ punarityādi | pūrvavanmūlādhāra iva 
pūrvādiprādakṣiṇyena caturdikṣu caturmātṝrvinyasyāgneyādicaturantarāle 
vārāhyādicaturmātṛrnyasedityarthaḥ | ata evordhvādhovarjitamiti mātṝṇāmaṣṭatvāt || 
6-atha bāhyacaturasrarekhānyāsamāha-vāmajaṅghāmityādi | vāmādikramataḥ 
prādakṣiṇyenetyarthaḥ | tena pūrvādidigdaleṣu catuṣṭayaṃ nyasyāgneyādividigdaleṣu 
catuṣṭayamiti sidhyaṣṭakaṃ nyaset | tato'vaśiṣṭasiddhidvayaṃ pādatale vāmapādatale 
ceti nyasedityarthaḥ || sṛṣṭitvamasya pratipādayannāha-kāraṇāt 
sarvānandamayādityarthaḥ | evamiti svātmābhedena dhyānaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || 

bhrūmadhye hṛdaye nābhau svādhiṣṭhāne tataḥ param |
mūlādhāre tathaivoruyugale jānunorapi || 6-1 ||

jaṅghayoḥ pādayoścaiva kramādvindvādikeśvarīḥ |
vinyaset sādhakaśreṣṭhastripurāntaḥsamāhitaḥ || 6-2 ||

tatastu vyāpakaṃ kuryāt tattaccakrārpaṇāṇunā |

iti sṛṣṭiśrīcakranyāsanirūpaṇam || atha sthiticakrānyāso nirūpyate yoginīhṛdaye-

tatastu karaśuddhyādinyāsaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
mūrdhni guhye ca hṛdaye netratritaya eva ca || 6-1 ||

śrotrayoryugale devi mukhe ca bhujayoḥ punaḥ |
pṛṣṭhe jānau ca nābhau ca vidyānyāsaṃ vidhāya ca || 6-2 ||

iti | mūrdhādiṣu vidyānyāsaṃ vidhāya karaśudhyādividyānyāsaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | 
tatrādheyādhārabhāvāccakracakreśvarīṇāmapi nyāso mantavyaḥ | prathamaṃ 
cakreśvarīvidyādinyāsaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ tena sthititvamāyātam | tathā ca :

sṛṣṭiḥ syānnavayonyādipṛthvyataṃ saṃhṛtiḥ punaḥ |
pṛthvyādinavayonyantamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 6-1 ||

iti tatraivoktatvāt | tathā-

karaśuddhikarī tvādyā dvitīyā cātmarakṣikā |
ātmāsanagatā devī tṛtīyā tadanantaram || 6-1 ||

cakrāsanagatā paścād sarvamantrāsanasthitā |
sādhyasiddhāsanā ṣaṣṭhī māyālakṣmīmayī parā || 6-2 ||

mūrtividyā ca sā devī saptamī parikīrtitā |
aṣṭamyāvāhanī mudrā navamī bhairavī parā || 6-3 ||

mūlavidyā tathā khyātā trailokyavaśakāriṇī |
evaṃ navaprakārāḥ syuḥ pūjākāle prayatnataḥ || 6-4 ||

etāḥ krameṇa nyastavyāḥ sādhakena kuleśvari |
pādāgrajaṅghājānūrugudaliṅgāgrakeṣu ca || 6-5 ||

ādhāre vinyasenmūrti tasyāmāvāhanīṃ nyaset |
mūlena vyāpakanyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ parameśvari || 6-6 ||

akulādiṣu pūrvoktasthāneṣu paricintayet |
cakreśvarīsamāyuktaṃ navacakraṃ puroditam || 6-7 ||

āsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi yathānukramayogataḥ |
tatrādyā tripurādevī dvitīyā tripureśvarī || 6-8 ||

p. 110)

tṛtīyā ca tathā proktā devī tripurasundarī |
caturthī ca mahādevi devī tripuravāsinī || 6-9 ||

pañcamī tripurāśrīḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhī tripuramālinī |
saptamī tripurāsiddhiraṣṭamī tripurāmbikā || 6-10 ||

navamī tu mahādevī mahātripurasundarī |
pūjayecca kramādetā navacakre purodite || 6-11 ||

evaṃ navaprakārādyā pūjākāle tu pārvatī |
ekākārā hyādiśaktirajarāmarakāriṇī || 6-12 ||

iti | tatra prathamamakulādikaṃ dhyātvā trailokyamohanādikaṃ tattanmantroccāreṇa 
manasā dhyāyaṃstadavacchinnabāhyāntaḥsparśena vinyasya tatra trailokyamohanādau 
tathaiva navacakreśvarīrnyaset tatastaccakreśvarīyuktaṃ tattaccakraṃ punardhyāyet ityata 
uktaṃ cakreśvarīsamāyuktamiti cakreśvaryādhiṣṭhitamityarthaḥ | tadyathā-akule 
viṣusaṃjñe suṣumnāmūlabhāgasthasahasradalakamale tripurādhiṣṭhitaṃ 
trailokyamohanaṃ cakraṃ vahnau ādhāre caturdalakamale tripureśvaryadhiṣṭhitaṃ 
sarvāśāparipūraṇaṃ cakraṃ śākte svādhiṣṭhānasthaṣaḍdalakamale 
tripurasundaryadhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvasaṃkṣobhakaṃ cakraṃ nābhau daśadalakamale 
tripuravāsinyadhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyakaṃ cakraṃ anāhate dvādaśadale 
tripurāśrayadhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ viśuddhau ṣoḍaśadale 
tripuramālinyadhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ cakraṃ lambikāgre'ṣṭadalakamale 
tripurāsiddhādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvarogaharaṃ cakraṃ bhruvorantare dvidalakamale 
tripurāmbādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ cakramindau lalāṭe bindau 
mahātripurasundaryadhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvānandakaraṃ cakraṃ bhāvayediti | tathā ca 
yoginīhṛdaye :

akule viṣusaṃjñe ca śākte vahnau tathā punaḥ | 
nābhāvanāhate śuddhau lambikāgre bhruvontare || 6-1 ||

indau iti | kulaṃ mūlādhārādadhaḥ ṣaḍdalapadmaṃ nāma tasmādekāṃgulādadhaḥ 
padmamaṣṭadalapadmaṃ tasmādekāṃgulādadhaḥ śoṇasahasradalapaṅkajamiti kramaḥ 
| kulādanyadakulaṃ suṣumnāmūlastharaktasahasradalakamalaṃ tasminnityarthaḥ | nanu 
ṣaḍdalasyaiva kulatvāttadanutvenāṣṭadalasyāpyakulatvamiti tatra kathaṃ na syādityata 
āha-viṣusaṃjñe ceti | viṣusaṃjña evākule nyāso natvakulamātre ityarthaḥ | 
viṣusaṃjñe vyāpakanāmni sahasradale iti yāvat yatastatra sthitā suṣumnā 
tadantarbhūtatriṃśatpaṅkajāni vyāpnotīti | ato nāṣṭadalakamalarūpamakulaṃ gṛhyate 
ityarthaḥ | śākte vahnāviti vahnau śākte iti vyatyayenānvayaścakrakramānurodhāt 
tadvyātyayadeśastu maheśvarasya svatantrecchatvāt | tathā ca vahnirmūlādhāro 
vahnimaṇḍalādhāratvāt śaktiḥ hṛllekhā tadūrdhvasthitvāt śāktaṃ 
svādhiṣṭhānamityarthaḥ | nābhau maṇipūrake anāhate hṛdayapaṅkaje viśuddhau 
kaṇṭhapadme lambikāgre kaṇṭhordhve tālumūle aṣṭadalakamale bhruvorantare 
ājñāyāṃ dvidalakamale indau lalāṭabindāvityarthaḥ | dīpākāro'rdhamātraṃ ca 
lalāṭe vṛttamiṣyate iti svayamuktatvāt | ardhamātramiti hrasvasyoccāraṇakālo 
mātretyucyate mātrāyā ardhaṃmuccāraṇakālo yasya tadardhaṃmātraṃ | lalāṭe 
bhruvoparibhāge vṛttaṃ vartulākāro bindurevenduriṣyata ityarthaḥ | tena bindoḥ 
rūpamuccāraṇakālaḥ sthānaṃ coktam dīpākāro'rdhamātroccāraṇakālo 
vṛttasaṃniveśo bindurityarthaḥ | adhaḥsahasrārādīnāṃ prapañcamāha 
svacchandasaṃgrahe :

adhaścordhvaṃ suṣumnāyāḥ sahasradalasaṃyutam | 
raktaṃ śvetaṃ ca sāhasradalasthaśaktibhiryutam || 6-1 ||

ūrdhvādhomukhamīśāni karṇikākesarānvitam |
śaktirūpaṃ mahādevi kulākulamayaṃ śubham || 6-2 ||

paṅkajadvayamīśāni sthitaṃ śāśvatamavyayam |
tayormadhye suṣumnāntastridaśādhārāṅkajam || 6-3 ||

śaktirūpaṃ śivākāraṃ śarvāṇyāḥ sannijālayam | 
teṣāṃ rūpakramaṃ caiva kramādvakṣye'dhunā śṛṇu || 6-4 ||

gudameḍhrāntaraṃ devi pañcāṃgulasamucchritam |
gudamekāṃgulaṃ madhye dvayāṃgulavisāraṇam || 6-5 ||

tasya mūle mahāyonistrikoṇākārarūpiṇī |
suṣumnā yonimadhyasthā tasyā mūle maheśvari || 6-6 ||

adhaḥ padmaṃ sahasrāraṃ karṇikākesarānvitam |
taijasaṃ raktavaddīptaṃ taddalasthitaśaktibhiḥ || 6-7 ||

pratikiñjalkasaṃsthābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sahitā priye |
karṇikāmadhyato devī kuladevī ca saṃsthitā || 6-8 ||

tatpadmordhve suṣumnāyāṃ madhye tvekāṃgulopari |
padmamaṣṭadalairyuktamaṣṭagranthisamanvitam || 6-9 ||

p. 111)

raktaṃ svakarṇikopetaṃ raktakiñjalkaśobhitam |
granthyagrasthaṃ triśṛṅgaṃ ca brahmāṇyādyaṣṭabhairavaiḥ || 6-10 ||

aṣṭapatrasthitagranthisthitavargādiśaktibhiḥ |
tadanyaśaktibhiścaiva saṃgatābhiḥ samāvṛtam || 6-11 ||

tanmadhye kaulaśaktyā ca sevitaṃ saṃsmaret tataḥ |
ekāṃgulapramāṇordhve ṣaḍdalaṃ kulapaṅkajam || 6-12 ||

ādhārapaṅkajaṃ pītaṃ catuṣpatraṃ sukesaram |
adhomukhaṃ ca tanmadhye kuṇḍalī parameśvari || 6-13 ||

svayambhūmadhyagā cintyā varadādibhirāvṛtā |
pārthivaṃ paṅkajaṃ hyetat tasyādhaḥ paṅkajaṃ param || 6-14 ||

taijasaṃ parameśāni tanmadhyasthitaśaktayaḥ |
niṣkalāḥ parameśāni vidyutpuñjanibhāḥ smaret || 6-15 ||

tadūrdhve karṇikāmadhye vahnibimbaṃ tadūrdhvagam |
pūrṇapīṭhaṃ ca tasyordhve śākinī saṃsthitā śive || 6-16 ||

ādhārapaṅkajasyordhve sārdhadvyaṃgulakopari |
taijasaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ ca pītakarṇikayā yutam || 6-17 ||

hṛllekhā karṇikāmadhye sthitānaṅgādisevitā |
etasmāddvyaṃgulādūrdhve svādhiṣṭhānaṃ ṣaḍasrakam || 6-18 ||

āpyaṃ ca bandhinīśaktipūrvābhiḥ śaktibhirvṛtām |
kākinīmabhicintyātha nābhāvaṣṭāṃgulopari || 6-19 ||

tatpadmaṃ maṇipūraṃ ca daśapatraṃ suśobhanam |
lākinīmadhyagaṃ tacca ḍāmaryādibhirāvṛtam || 6-20 ||

caturdaśāṃgulādūrdhve maṇipūrākhyapaṅkajāt |
paṅkajaṃ rākiṇīmadhyaṃ dvādaśāramanāhatam || 6-21 ||

patrasthakālarātryādiśaktibhiśca samāvṛtam |
madhyasthasūryabimbe tu nādoḍyānākhyapīṭhakam || 6-22 ||

tasmādekāṃgulādūrdhve viśuddhaṃ ṣoḍaśārakam |
madhyagā ḍākinī bāhyapatreṣu parameśvari || 6-23 ||

amṛtādyakṣarāntaḥsthā candrabimbaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ |
kaṇṭhordhvaṃ parameśāni lambikā caturaṃgule || 6-24 ||

tasmādaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ rasikādibhirāvṛtam |
ājñācakraṃ dvipatrābjaṃ hakṣadvidalasaṃyutam || 6-25 ||

haṃsavatīkṣamāpārśvadvaye madhye tu hākinī |
tato lalāṭagaṃ vṛttaṃ bindvāvaraṇamūrdhvataḥ || 6-26 ||

sūryakoṭipratīkāśamatidīptaṃ mahadguṇam |
tanmadhye daśakoṭīnāṃ saṃkhyāyojanapaṅkajam || 6-27 ||

tatkarṇikā samāsīnaḥ śāntyatoteśvaraḥ prabhuḥ |
pañcavaktro daśabhujo vidyutpuñjanibhākṛtiḥ || 6-28 ||

nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntiranukramāt |
parivāryya sthitāścaitāḥ śāntyatītasya sundari || 6-29 ||

vāmabhāge samāsīnā śāntyatītā manonmanī |
pañcavaktradharāḥ sarvāḥ daśabāhvindubhūṣaṇāḥ || 6-30 ||

bindutattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ koṭyarbudaśatairvṛtam |

iti sthitiśrīcakranyāsanirūpaṇam || 

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya-śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya-śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite 
śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ śvāsaḥ || 6 ||



atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| saptamaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

	atha sthitiśrīcakranyāsastu vidyācakracakreśvarītyaṅgatrayātmaka iti 
siddhāntaḥ | tatra prathamaṃ sampradāyāt karaśuddhividyayā karaśuddhiṃ 
vidhāyātmarakṣāvidyayātmarakṣāṃ kṛtvā devīṃ svātmābhedena vibhāvayet 
| tathā śrītantrarāje |

aruṇāṃ karuṇātaraṅgitākṣīṃ dhṛtapāśāṃkuśapuṣpabāṇacāpām |
aṇimādibhirāvṛtāṃ mayūkhairahamityeva vibhāvaye bhavānīm || 1 ||

	iti vibhāvya śrīcakranyāsamārabhet | tatra vidyānyāsastu-ādau 
kūṭākṣarabhedena vyastāvyastāṃ mūlavidyāṃ nyasedyathākrameṇa :

mūrdhni guhye ca hṛdaye netrayordakṣavāmayoḥ |
śrotrayorbhujayoḥ pṛṣṭhe jānvornābhau ca vinyaset || 1 ||

iti kūṭanyāsaḥ || athākṣaranyāsaḥ - mūrdhni guhye ca hṛdaye netreṣu 
śrotrayormukhe | bhujayoḥ pṛṣṭhake jānvornābhau pañcadaśa nyaset 
ityakṣaranyāsaḥ || atha samastavidyānyāsaḥ :

sthāneṣu pañcadaśasu mūrdhādiṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ | 
mūlavidyāṃ pṛthaṅnyaset tritārādi yathākramam || 1 ||

iti vidyānyāsaḥ | atha navacakreśvarīvidyānyāsaḥ : -

pādayorjaṅghayorjānvorūrvośca gudapārśvayoḥ | 
sphicordhvajāgre cādhāre mūlādhāre ca vinyaset || 1 ||

navacakreśvarīvidyānyāso'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ |

	iti navacakreśvarīvidyānyāsaḥ | atha navacakranyāsaḥ -

brahmarandhre tathādhāre svādhiṣṭhāne ca nābhike | 
anāhate viśuddhau ca lambike bhrūyugāntare || 1 ||

bindusthāne krameṇaiva nava cakraṇi vinyaset |

iti navacakranyāsaḥ | atha cakreśvarīnyāsaḥ tatra -

tatra vidyāḥ samuccārya tripurā tripureśvarī | 
sundarī tripurādyā ca tathā tripuravāsinī || 1 ||

tripurāśrīḥ pañcamī syātṣaṣṭhī tripuramālinī |
saptamī tripurāsiddhā tripurāmbāṣṭamī bhavet || 2 ||

navamī tu mahādevī mahātripurasundarī |
navacakreṣu vinyasediti nyāsaḥ samīritaḥ || 3 ||

iti cakreśvarīnyāsaḥ | iti sthitiśrīcakranyāsoddhāraḥ | atha 
rakṣāṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ -

tāratrayaṃ tato bālā namastripurasundari | 
māṃ rakṣayugalaṃ proktvā ṣaḍaṅgānyatra vinyaset || 1 ||

iti rakṣāṣaḍaṅgam |

bālābījatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam |
kuryācca sādhako bījaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 1 ||

kūṭatrayadvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |
vidyāpañcadaśīmūlaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 2 ||

pañcatryekaikakaikaistu pañcabījaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakaiḥ |
śrīvidyāṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'yamudāhṛtaḥ || 3 ||

sarvajñatā nityatṛptā tathaivānādibodhinī |
svatantrā ca tato nityāluptaśaktistataḥ param || 4 ||

anantaśaktiṅantāstā bālābījaikapūrvikāḥ |
ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīnyāsaḥ proktaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye || 5 ||

p. 113)

ekaikaṃ kūṭamādau śrīmahātripurasundarī |
sarvajñatāśatidhāmne ityādi prāgvadīritaḥ || 6 ||

ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīnyāso mūlavidyāpradīpakaḥ |

	iti mūlaṣaḍaṅgayuvatīnyāsaḥ | māyā ṣaḍadīrghakādyādi 
prakārāntaramiṣyate || iti atha ṣaḍaṅga yuvatīnāṃ dhyānam -

kundendunīlāsitapītaraktraprabhā varābhītikarāḥ varāṃgyaḥ |
lāvaṇyalīlākhilayauvanāḍhyāḥ śrīdevadevyāstanavo yuvatyaḥ || 1 ||

iti dhyānam | atha śrīvidyāpūrṇanyāsaḥ jñānārṇave -

atha vakṣye maheśāni śrīvidyānyāsamuttamam |
sampūrṇāṃ cintayedvidyāṃ brahmarandhre'ruṇaprabhām || 1 ||

sravatsudhāṣoḍaśārṇāṃ mahāsaubhāgyadāṃ smaret |
vāmāṃsadeśe saubhāgyadāṃgulīṃ bhrāmayettataḥ || 2 ||

ripujihvāgrahāṃ mudrāṃ pādamūle pravinyaset |
punaḥ sampūrṇayā devi galordhve vinyasettataḥ || 3 ||

punaḥ sampūrṇayā devi vyāpakatvena vinyaset |
vyāpakānte yonimudrāṃ mukhe kṣiptvābhivandya ca || 4 ||

śrīvidyāpūrṇarūpo'yaṃ nyāsaḥ saubhāgyavardhanaḥ |
brahmarandhre nyaseddevi maṇibandhe nyasettataḥ || 5 ||

lalāṭe'nāmikāṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ smaredbudhaḥ |
sammohanākhyo deveśi nyāso'yaṃ kṣobhakārakaḥ || 6 ||

trailokyamaruṇaṃ dhyāyan śrīvidyāṃ manasi smaran |
pādayorjaṅghayorjānvoḥ kaṭyorandhuni pṛṣṭhake || 7 ||

nābhau ca pārśvayoścaiva stanayorasayostathā |
karṇayorbrahmarandhre ca vadane caiva pārvati || 8 ||

tataḥ karṇapradeśe tu kare caitadanukramāt |
saṃhāro'yaṃ mahānyāso bījaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kramāt || 9 ||

śrīvidyāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇanyāsairviśveśvaro bhavet |
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ vinyaseddevi mātṛkāṃ pūrvavat priye || 10 ||

iti | atra ṣoḍaśārṇayā bahubhedyādyena bhedena yo dīkṣitastasya varṇāneva 
nyaset [atrāsmingranthe śrītantrarājavihitārcākramaśca, tatra pañcadaśyāḥ 
śrībhagavatā śambhunā uddhāraḥ kṛtastasmātpūrvaṃ pañcadaśyā 
mantroddhāraḥ kriyate | pūjā tvetasyā agre viśeṣato likhyate | asyāḥ 
śrīvidyāyā mukhyāmnāya ṛgvedaḥ | pañcamamaṇḍale (5 | 47 | 4) catvāra īṃ 
vibhrati kṣemayante iti mantroddhāraḥ ṛgvede prasiddhaḥ | atharvaṇe 
śaunakaśākhāyāṃ copaniṣadi uddhṛto'syā mūlamanuḥ tadānusāratāṃ 
gamayati ] atha ṣoḍaśārṇānāmuddhārakramaḥ pradarśyate | tatra 
śrījñānārṇave -

śrīdevyuvāca :

tripurā vividhā deva bhavatā prakaṭīkṛtā |
trividheti yaduktaṃ tu prakaṭīkuru śaṅkara || 1 ||

īśvara uvāca 

parabrahmasvarūpaṃ ca nādabindukalānvitam |
śivaśaktimayaṃ tattra kathayāmi tavānaghe || 2 ||

vyāpya tiṣṭhati vai viśvaṃ sa śivaḥ parameśvari |
pūrvaṃ guṇaistu kathitā śivaśaktyātmikāṃ śṛṇu || 3 ||

akārādisakārāntā mātṝkāśaktiravyayā |
hakāraḥ parameśāni kevalaṃ śiva ucyate || 4 ||

ādyantākṣarabhāvena tadāhaṃsakalārthadaḥ |
yaducyate mātṛkārṇaistatsarvamahamīśvaraḥ || 5 ||

hakāraḥ parameśāni śūnyarūpaḥ sadāvyayaḥ |
sakāraḥ śaktirūpatvāt paravācī ca sargavān || 6 ||

utpatteḥ kāraṇaṃ yasmācchaktirityabhidhīyate |
ātmānaṃ darśayedyogaḥ so'haṃśabdena sundari || 7 ||

bindutrayasamāyogānmahātripurasundarī |
nādarūpeṇa sā devī hakārārdhasvarūpiṇī || 8 ||

hakāraḥ parameśāni śivarūpī yatastadā |
tasyārdhāṅgaṃ mahāśaktirhakārārdhasvarūpiṇī || 9 ||

ata eva mahāvidyā mahātripurasundarī |
nityeti kathyate devi citkalā paradevatā || 10 ||

śrīguroḥ kṛpayā bhadre sampradāyakulānvitaḥ |
prātarutthāya deveśi guruṃ smṛtvā svanāmabhiḥ || 11 ||

sandhyāsnānādikaṃ devi vidhāya manuvittamaḥ |
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyaḥ karpūraghusṛṇādibhiḥ || 12 ||

śrīvi0 15

p. 114) 

mahāmṛgamadoddāmaliptāṅgaḥ kuṃkumāruṇaḥ |
navaratnavibhūṣāḍhyo raktāmbaravirājitaḥ || 13 ||

tāmbūlarāgavadano mādanānandamānasaḥ |
yāgamaṇḍapamāsādya lākṣācitravicitritam || 14 ||

anekadhūpabahulaṃ puṣpaprakaraśobhitam |
gomayena ca saṃliptaṃ cārupuṣpavitānitam || 15 ||

manohare mṛdau sūkṣma āsane copaviṣaya ca |
mantroddhāraṃ prakurvīta sarvakāryārthasiddhaye || 16 ||

ādyaṃ vāgbhavamucārya kāmabījaṃ dvitīyakam |
kumāryāstu tṛtīyaṃ tu tripurā parameśvari || 17 ||

karaśuddhikarī vidyā prathamā parameśvari |
kumārī tu dvitīyā sā tripureśī maheśvari || 18 ||

tripureśyādimaṃ tyaktvā bhuvaneśīṃ parikṣipet |
anayā cāsanaṃ vidyāt tripureśyā ṣaḍaṅgakam || 19 ||

tripureśī maheśāni tribījā hasthitā sadā |
cakrāsanagatāviddhi devi tripuravāsinī || 20 ||

tripureśyā maheśāni vāgbhave kāmarājake |
śivacandrasamāyuktā tārtīye śivarūpiṇī || 21 ||

sarvamantrāsanagatā tripurāśrīriyaṃ priye |
ātmāsanagatāyāstu hitvā tārtīyamadrije || 22 ||

balemātmakamāropya sādhyasiddhāsanasthitā |
sādhyasiddhāsanagatā viddhi tripuramālinī || 23 ||

sampatpradā bhairavī yā tatastārtīyabījake |
binduṃ hitvā tatra sargaṃ nikṣipet surasundari || 24 ||

mūlavidyāṃ śṛṇu prauḍhe sakalāgamasevitām |
sarvadarśanavandyāṃ ca citkalāmavyayāṃ śive || 25 ||

bhūmiścandraḥ śivo māyā śaktiḥ kṛṣṇādhvamādanam |
ardhacandraśca binduśca navārṇo merurucyate || 26 ||

mahātripurasundaryā mantrā merusamudbhavā |
lakārāt pṛthivī devī saśailaṃvanakānanā || 27 ||

pañcāśanpīṭhasampannā sarvatīrthamayī parā |
sakārācandratārādigraharāśisvarūpiṇī || 28 ||

hakārācchivasaṃyogādvyomamaṇḍalasaṃsthitā |
īkārādviśvamūrtiryā mahāturyātmikā priye || 29 ||

ekārādvaiṣṇavī śaktirviśvapālanatatparā |
rakārāt tejasā yuktā parajyotiḥsvarūpiṇī || 30 ||

kakārāt kāmadā kāmarūpiṇī sphuradavyayā |
ardhacandreṇa deveśi viśvayoniritīritā || 31 ||

bindunā śivarūpeṇa śūnyarūpeṇa sākṣiṇī |
anayā saha sarvatra vyāptirniścalatātmanā || 32 ||

evaṃ parabrahmarūpameruṇānena suvrate |
evaṃ ca navabhirvarṇairjāyate tripurāmanuḥ || 33 ||

anyathā devi niṣpattirnāsti śrītripurāmanoḥ |
śrīcakramapi deveśi merurūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 34 ||

lakāraḥ pṛthivībījaṃ tena corvī taducyate |
sakāraścandramā bhadre kalāṣoḍaśakātmakam || 35 ||

tasmāt ṣoḍaṣapatraṃ tu hakāraḥ śiva ucyate |
aṣṭamūrtiḥ sadā bhadre tasmādvasudalaṃ bhavet || 36 ||

īkārastu mahāmāyā bhuvanāni caturdaśa |
pālayantī parā tasmācchakrakoṇaṃ bhavet priye || 37 ||

śaktirekā daśasthāne sthitvā sūte jagattrayam |
viśvayoniriti khyātā sā viṣṇordaśarūpakā || 38 ||

rakārāt parameśāni cakraṃ vyāpya vijṛmbhate |
daśakoṇaparā tasmādrakārājjyotiravyayaḥ || 39 ||

kalādaśānvito vahnirdaśakoṇapravartakaḥ |
kakārānmādanaṃ devi śivaṃ cāṣṭasvarūpakam || 40 ||

yonīrasya tadā cakre vasuyonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet |
ardhamātrā guṇān sūte bhedarūpā yatastataḥ || 41 ||

trikoṇarūpā yonistu bindunā baindavaṃ bhavet |
kāmeśvarasya rūpaṃ tadviśvādhārasvarūpakam || 42 ||

śrīcakraṃ tu varārohe śrīvidyāvarṇasambhavam |

iti | tantrāntare -

manuścandra kuberaśca lopāmudrā ca kāmarāṭ |
agastyanandisūryāśca viṣṇuskandaśivāstathā || 1 ||

durvāsāśca mahādevyā dvādaśopāsakāḥ |
smṛtāḥ śakraśca cotmanī caiva tathā ca varuṇastathā || 2 ||

dharmarājo'nalo nāgarājo vāyurbudhastathā |
īśānaśca ratiścaiva tathā nārāyaṇastathā ||

p. 115) brahmā jīvo mahādevyāstrayodaśa upāsakāḥ |
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākopāsakānāṃ maheśvari || 4 ||

upāsyamantrabhedāṃste pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ |

iti jñānārṇave -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi bījaṃ kāmeśvarīmatam |
sakalā bhuvaneśānī kāmeśībījamuttamam || 1 ||

anena sakalā vidyāḥ kathayāmi viśeṣataḥ |
śaktyantastūryavarṇo'yaṃ kalāmadhye sulocane || 2 ||

vāgbhavaṃ pañcavarṇāḍhyaṃ kāmarājamathocyate |
mādanaṃ śivacandrādyaṃ śivāntaṃ mīnalocane || 3 ||

caturakṣararūpaṃ tu tryakṣarā tripurā parā |

atra śaktikūṭaṃ prāguddhṛtakāmeśībījarūpamityarthaḥ |

sarvatīrthamayī devī sarvadevasvarūpiṇī |
sarvasākṣimayī nityā sarvayonimayī parā || 5 ||

sarvajñānamayī saṃvitsarvaprajñānarūpiṇī |
sarvadevamayī sākṣāt sarvasaubhāgyasundarī || 6 ||

etāmupāsya deveśi kāmaḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥ |

iyaṃ kāmarājopāsitā śrīvidyā | tathā -

devyuvāca -

etasyā devadeveśa bhedān kathaya sundara |
kena kenopāsiteyaṃ viśadīkuru śaṅkara || 1 ||

īśvara uvāca -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi lopāmudrābhidhāṃ parām |
kāmarājākhyavidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ turyaṃ ca sundari || 2 ||

hitvā mukhe śivendvāḍhyā lopāmudrā prakāśitā |

kāmarājavidyāyā vāgbhave ekāramīkāraṃ ca hitvādau hakāraṃ sakāraṃ ca 
dadyādanyat samānam | tathā :

agastyopāsitā vidyā trailokyakṣobhakāriṇī |
eṣā vidyā kāmarājapūjitaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 3 ||

hasakalahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ iti lopāmudropāsitā śrīvidyā | 
anayorbhedamagre vakṣyāmaḥ |

vidyādvayamidaṃ bhadra durlabhaṃ bhuvanatraye |
kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhavena varānane || 4 ||

vidyoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śaktimādanamadhyagam |
śivaṃ kuryādvāgbhave tu śivādyaṃ kāmarājakam || 5 ||

candrādyaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ syādvidyeyaṃ manupūjitā |

kaha-e-ī-lahrīṃ haka-e-ī-lahrīṃ saka-e-ī-lahrīṃ iti manūpāsitā śrīvidyā |

sahādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ devi candrādyaṃ śivamadhyagam |
mādanaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu śaktibījaṃ hasānanam || 6 ||

candrārādhitavidyeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā |

sahaka-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahakaha-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahaka-e-ī-lahrīṃ iti candropāsitā 
śrīvidyā | tathā :

hasādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ viddhi śivādyaṃ sahamadhyagam |
mādanaṃ kāmabīje tu tārtīyaṃ ṛṇu pārvati || 7 ||

hasādyaṃ śaktibījaṃ tu kubereṇa prapūjitā |

hasaka-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahakaha-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahaka-e-ī-lahrīṃ iti kuberopāsitā vidyā 
tathā :

kāmarājākhyavidyāyāstārtīyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
śaktibījaṃ sahādyaṃ syādvidyāgastyaprapūjitā || 8 ||

iti | ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ hasasakalahrīṃ ityagastyopāsitā śrīvidyā | 
tathā - lopāmudrā prabhāvena sākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇī itīyaṃ 
vidyālopāmudrayāpyupāsitetyarthaḥ | eteneyaṃ dvitīyā lopāmudropāsitā 
śrīvidyeti | tathā :

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhave mādanaṃ tyaja |
candraṃ tatraiva saṃyojya kāmarāje tataḥ param || 9 ||

hitvā candraṃ mukhe kuryādvidyeyaṃ nandipūjitā |

sa-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ iti nandyupāsitā śrīvidyā | tathā :

p. 116) kāmarājamidaṃ bhadre ṣaḍvarṇaṃ sarvamohanam |
śaktibījaṃ varārohe candrādyaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 4 ||

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā hitvā bhūmi tṛtīyake |
śaktibīje sthitāṃ devi candrādhaḥ kuru tatra ca || 10 ||

indrārādhitavidyeyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradā |

iti | ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ salakahrīṃ itīndropāsitā śrīvidyā | tathā :

lopāmudrākhyavidyāyā dvitīyāyā maheśvari |
kāmarāje bhṛguṃ hitvā mukhe kuryāttameva hi || 11 ||

śivaṃ vinā caturthaṃ tu tārtīye śakragaḥ śivaḥ |
eṣā vidyā vārārohe tripurā sūryapūjitā || 12 ||

iti | ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahakalahrīṃ sahasakahahrīṃ iti sūryopāsitā śrīvidyā | tathā 
:

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi catuṣkūṭāṃ ca śāṅkarīm |
lopāmudrā dvitīyāṃ tu vilikhya surasundari || 13 ||

punarvilikhya tāmeva caturthe pañcame sthitām |
hitvā tu bhuvaneśānīmekocāreṇa coccaret || 14 ||

catuṣkūṭā mahāvidyā śaṅkareṇa prapūjitā |

iti | ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sahasakalahrīṃ ka-e-īla 
hsakahalasahasakalahrīṃ iti śivopāsitā śrīvidyā | tathā :

lopāmudrāṃ punardevi vilikhettadanantaram |
nandikeśvaravidyāṃ ca ṣaṭkūṭā vaiṣṇavī bhavet || 15 ||

lopāmudrāṃ dvitīyāmityarthaḥ | ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sahasakalahrīṃ 
sa-e-ī-lahrīṃ sahakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ iti ṣaṭkūṭā viṣṇūpāsitā śrīvidyā |

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā trikūṭeṣu varānane |
yā sthitā bhuvaneśānī dvidhā kuru maheśvari || 16 ||

binduhīnā nādahīnā durvāsaḥpūjitā bhavet |
durvāsasā purā devi niṣkalā pūjitā parā || 17 ||

iti ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ hrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃhrīṃ, sakalahrīṃhrīṃ, iti 
durvāsasopāsitā śrīvidyā | iti dvādaśa bhedāḥ | anyāstrayodaśa vidyā agre 
uddhariṣyāmaḥ | atha ṣoḍaśārṇavidyāyā uddhārakramamāha, jñānārṇave :

caturvidhaprakāreṇa śṛṇu deveśi kathyate |
tvaṃ manohāriṇī yasmāt kathyate bhuvi durlabhā || 1 ||

candrāntaṃ vāruṇāntaṃ ca śakrādisahitaṃ pṛthak |
vāmākṣibindunādāḍhyaṃ viśvamātṛkalānvitam || 2 ||

vidyādau yojayeddevi sākṣājjāgratsvarūpiṇī |
utpattirjāgaro bodho vyāvṛttirmanasastathā || 3 ||

kalācatuṣṭayaṃ jāgradavasthāyāṃ vyavasthitam |
jāgrat sattvaguṇā proktā kevalaṃ śaktirūpiṇī || 4 ||

trikūṭāḥ sakalā bhadre pañcakūṭā bhavanti hi |
vaiṣṇavī vasukūṭā syāt ṣaṭkūṭā śāṅkarī bhavet || 5 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ :

candrāntaṃ hakāraḥ, vāruṇāntaṃ śakāraḥ, śakrādi rephaḥ, vāmākṣi 
īkāraḥ, bindunādābhyāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iti bījadvayaṃ siddham | 
prākproktavidyā māyābījādikāścedutpattirūpā bhavanti kūṭādiṣu 
māyābījadānena jāgararūpā bhavanti | kūṭādiṣu śrībījadānena 
manovyāvṛttirūpā | bhavanti | vidyādiṣu śrībījadānena bodharūpā bhavanti | 
ete bhedā jāgratsvarūpāḥ | taduktaṃ svacchandasaṃgrahe :

lajjābījādikā vidyāḥ proktā utpattirūpakāḥ |
lajjābījādikūṭaistu proktā jāgararūpakāḥ || 1 ||

evaṃ śrībījayogena bodhavyāvṛttirūpakāḥ |
jāgratsvarūpā śrīvidyā caturddhā sā prakīrtitā || 2 ||

tadā bhedāstu sakalāścatuṣkūṭā bhavanti hi |
vaiṣṇavī saptakūṭā syātpañcakūṭā tu śāṅkarī || 3 ||

svapnarūpā mahāvidyāḥ proktā bījadvayādikaḥ |
māyālakṣmyādikāścaitā abhilāṣasvarūpakāḥ || 4 ||

bījadvayādikūṭāścedbhramarūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
ramāmāyādikāścintārūpiṇyaḥ kūṭayojitāḥ || 5 ||

smṛtirūpāśca kathitāsthā bhedā maheśvari |
paścakūṭā bhavantyete vasukūṭā tu vaiṣṇavī || 6 ||

ṣaṭkūṭā śāṅkarī proktā svapnāvasthā samīritā |
vedādibījayugalayogāt sarvāḥ samīritāḥ || 7 ||

suṣuptirūpā jāyante suṣuptiḥ śivarūpiṇī |
maraṇaṃ vismṛtirmūrcchā nidrā ca tamasāvṛtā || 8 ||

p. 117) suṣuptestu kalā jñeyāścatasraḥ parameśvari |
tāramāyādikāścaiva māyātārādikāstathā || 9 ||

suṣuptibhedāścatvāraḥ kalārūpā maheśvari |

iti | atra tāramāyāramādikā, māyātāraramādikā, tāraramāmāyādikā, 
ramātāramāyādikā, ityarthaḥ | evaṃ krameṇa dvādaśavidhavidyānāṃ tu 
catuścatvāriṃśaduttaraśataṃ bhedā bhavanti || jñānārṇave :

vedādimaṇḍitā devi śivaśaktimayī sadā |
tadā bhedāstu sakalāḥ ṣaṭkūṭāḥ parameśvari || 1 ||

vaiṣṇavī navakūṭā syāt saptakūṭā tu śāṅkarī |
asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa jagadānanditaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

bhedatrayaṃ tu kathitaṃ mahāvidyāṃ śṛṇu priye |
yasya vijñānamātreṇa brahma sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ || 3 ||

suṣuptyādau jāgarānte sphurattāmātralakṣaṇā |
avasthāśeṣatāṃ prāptā turyā tu parameśvari || 4 ||

bhāvābhāvavinirmuktā guṇātītā nigadyate |
vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ samādhirvimalaṃ manaḥ || 5 ||

sadasadvastunirdhārasturīyāyāḥ kalā imāḥ |
ādyabījadvayaṃ bhadre viparītakrameṇa tu || 6 ||

vilikhya parameśāni tato'nyāni samuddharet |
antarmukhī vārārohe kumārī tripureśvarī || 7 ||

ebhistu pañcasaṃkhyākairbījaiḥ saṃpuṭitāṃ yajet |
ṣaṭkūṭāṃ parameśāni vidyeyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 8 ||

trikūṭāḥ sakalā bhadre ṣoḍaśārṇā bhavanti hi |
vaiṣṇavyekonaviṃśārṇā śaivī saptadaśākṣarī || 9 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ ādyabījadvayaṃ māyāramātmakaṃ tasya viparītakramaḥ ādau 
ramā paścānmāyetyarthaḥ | antarmadhye sthitaṃ kāmabījaṃ mukhe ādau 
yasyāḥ kumāryāḥ | etaiḥ pañcasaṃkhyākairbījaiḥ ṣaṭkūṭāṃ navakūṭāṃ 
vā sampuṭitāṃ sampuṭavatkṛtām tenānulomavilomataḥ sampuṭitāmityarthaḥ | 
gāndharve'pi :

ramābījaṃ samuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ niyojayet |
kāmabījaṃ samālikhya vāgbījaṃ tadanantaram || 1 ||

caturdaśasvaropetaṃ candraṃ binduyugānvitam |
praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ caiva maheśvari || 2 ||

uddharet parameśāni tataḥ pañcadaśākṣarīm |
vyutkramāt parameśāni pūrvoktaṃ bījapañcakam || 3 ||

ālikhya saṃpuṭaṃkuryādvidyeyaṃ dvyaṣṭakūṭakā |

iti | tathā ca yoginītantre -

śrībījamāyāsmarayoniśaktistāraṃ ca māyā kamalātha vidyā |
śaktyādibījaiśca vilomataḥ sā śrīṣoḍaśīyaṃ ca śivapradiṣṭā || 1 ||

iti | tathā rudrayāmale -

śrīrmāyā madano vāṇī parā tāraṃ śivapriyā | 
haripriyā trikūṭā sā parā vāṇī manobhavaḥ || 1 ||

māyā lakṣmīrmahāvidyā śrīvidyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī |

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtau ca -

dvitīyasyādiyugmaṃ tu viparītaṃ likhet sudhīḥ |
bālāṃ cāntarmukhīṃ kṛtvā vilikhettadanantaram || 1 ||

tāraṃ māyāṃ tatao lakṣmīṃ tathā kūṭatrayaṃ likhet |
bālādi saṃpuṭāṃ kuryādramākhyāṃ parameśvari || 2 ||

iti | kalayā pūrvokta (śaktyādi) pañcakalayā ramākhyāṃ 
praṇavādiṣaṭkūṭāṃ, umākhyāmiti pāṭhe'yamevārthaḥ | kecittu 
kalayāsthāne bālayāpāṭhaṃ kurvantastatra parameśvarīmiti ca 
bālayāntarmukhyā sampuṭāṃ vadanti | ramākhyāṃ śrīṃ parameśvarīṃ 
hrīmiti ca, tenottaradale klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ śrīṃ hrīmiti vadanti | tatra 
sampuṭaśabdārthāparijñānāt | navaranteśvare :

mantramādau vadet pūrvaṃ sādhyasaṃjñāmanantaram |
viparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsaṃpuṭaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||

iti saṃpuṭalakṣaṇādananvayāpatteḥ sarvatantravirodhācca | tathā śrīkrame -

śrīrmāyā madano yoniḥ paraitāni mukhe kuru |
vedādirbhuvaneśānī śrībījaṃ ca trikūṭakam || 1 ||

p. 118) ṣaṭkūṭāṃ saṃpūṭāṃ kuryādādyaiḥ pañcabhirakṣaraiḥ | iti | 
māyātantre -

lakṣmīḥ parā madanayoniyutā ca śaktistāraṃ parā ca kamalāpyatha mūlavidyā 
|
śaktyādibhiśca viparītatayā pradiṣṭaṃ śrīmantrarājamuditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ 
|| 1 ||

iti | etenānulomataḥ pañcabījaiḥ sampuṭitamiti mataṃ heyam | śrutau ca ramā 
māyā tāraḥ parā lakṣmīḥ kumārikā | vidyā vyastā bālā śrīḥ parā tathā 
vyastā viparītā tatheti vyastetyarthaḥ | kumārī cāntarmukhī bodhyā | atra 
kumārikānantaraṃ tārāditribījasambandhastatraikavākyatābalāt 
(traipurīśrutibalācca | tathā ca śrīmāye madhyādibālikā tāro māyā 
śrīrvidyā parādipañcabījāsyante ceti) śrīparā ceti pāṭhe na kevalaṃ bālā 
vyastā śrīparā ceti vidyāyāṃ ṣoḍaśabījānāṃ svarūpakathanaṃ vā 
kramoktatvābhāvāt | etena śrīrmāyā tāraṃ māyā bālātrikūṭaṃ vyastā 
bālā ramā māyeti mataṃ heyam | kulāmṛte :

śrībījaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca kāmabījaṃ ca vāgbhavam |
bālāntaḥ saṃsthitaṃ bījaṃ praṇavaṃ ca tataḥ param || 1 ||

śaktibījaṃ ramāṃ caiva vidyāṃ ca parameśvari |
lopāṃ vā kāmarājaṃ vā trikūṭāmathavā parām || 2 ||

vinyasya punarādyāni pañcabījāni sundari |
viparītakrameṇaiva vinyaset ṣoḍaśī parā || 3 ||

iti | yāmale ca -

lakṣmīḥ parā madanavāgbhavaśaktibījaṃ 
tāraṃ ca bhūtikamale kathitā ca vidyā |
kūṭatrayaṃ ca viparītatayā niyuktaṃ 
śrīṣoḍaśākṣaramihāgamasuprasiddham || 1 ||

trikūṭaṃ kāmādi bālāyāścakārādramāṃ māyāṃ ca nibandhe -

sāntāntaṃ śivapūrvasaptamayutaṃ sūkṣmāntamastānvitaṃ 
devīṃ dakṣiṇabāhuśakranayanaṃ kāmaṃ kalālāñchitam |
dantāntordhvamukhaṃ sajīvadaśanaṃ śeṣaṃ mukhenānvitaṃ 
bījaṃ pañcakamitthamevamuditaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradam || 1 ||

vedādyaṃ triguṇaṃ ramāmatha vadet kāmena saṃsevitāṃ 
lopāṃ vā punareva pañcakramadho pūrvaṃ vilomakramaiḥ |
eṣā śrīparamā parātparatamā sarvārthasiddhipradā 
sārātsāratarā samastajagatāmutpattibhūtā śivā || 2 ||

seyaṃ śrībrahmarūpā sakalaguṇamayī nirguṇā niṣprapañcā |
sākṣātkāmadudhā suramuninivahairvanditānandarūpā 

iti jñānārṇave -

vaktrakoṭisahasrastu jihvākoṭiśatairapi |
varṇituṃ naiva śakye'haṃ śrīvidyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarīm || 1 ||

vaikharī vācyabhāvatvādaśaktā guṇavarṇane |
yato nirakṣaraṃ vastu parā tatraiva kāraṇam || 2 ||

mūkībhūtā hi paśyantī madhyamā madhyamā bhavet |
brahmavidyāsvarūpā hi bhuktimuktiphalapradā || 3 ||

ekoccāreṇa deveśi vājapeyasya koṭayaḥ |
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā || 4 ||

kāśyāditīrthayātrāḥ syuḥ sārdhakoṭitrayānvitāḥ |
tulāṃ nārhanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 ||

ekoccāreṇa girije kiṃ punarbrahma kevalam |
ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadācana || 6 ||

gopitavyā tvayā bhadre svayoniriva pārvati |
ṣoḍaśīyaṃ sugopyā hi snehāddevi prakāśitā || 7 ||

api priyatamaṃ deyaṃ sutadāradhanādikam |
rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 8 ||

iti | siddhayāmale - (prakārāntareṇa ṣoḍaśīmāha)

kāmo māyā ramā bālā trikūṭā strī bhagāṃkuśau |
kālī kāmakalā kūrcaḥ sarvādau praṇavaḥ priye || 1 ||

śrīmahāṣoḍaśīyaṃ ca yā khyātā bhuvanatraye |
jñānena mṛtyuhā vidyā sarvāmnāyairnamaskṛtā || 2 ||

saptalakṣā mahāvidyāstantrādau kathitāḥ priye |
tāsāṃ sāratamā bhūtā yā yā vidyāḥ sugopitāḥ || 3 ||

bahunā kimihoktena tāsāṃ sārā tu ṣoḍaśī |
prakāśitā mahādevi yā pṛṣṭā te punaḥ punaḥ || 4 ||

oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ ka e ī la hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ 
strīṃ aiṃ kroṃ krīṃ klīṃ hūṃ iti | rudrayāmale :

p. 119) lopāyāḥ śaktikūṭānte haṃsabījayutā yadi |
tadā saptadaśavidyā sākṣājjñānasvarūpiṇī || 1 ||

hasakalahrīṃ sahakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ haṃsaḥ iti |

lopāmudrāvāgbhave tu pṛthvyante śivayojanāt |
sakāraṃ kāmarājādau lopā tu ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 1 ||

anayā dasṛśī vidyā na vidyārṇavagocare |

hasakalahahrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃ, sakalahrīmiti | hasakalahrīṃ, sahasakahalahrīṃ, 
sakalahrīṃ iti ṣoḍaśīdvayam | tatraiva :

vidyārājñovāgbhave tu kānte'nantaniyojanāt |
ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā cidbrahmakyamayī śubhā || 1 ||

hasaka-ālahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīmiti |

lopāvāgbhavaśakrānte śivabījaṃ niyojayet |
tathaiva śaktibīje tu lopā saptadaśākṣarī || 1 ||

asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa śivo bhavati nānyathā |
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīśaḥ sākṣādbhūmipurandaraḥ || 2 ||

hasakalahahrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃ, sakalahahrīṃ iti lopā saptadaśākṣarī | 
tatraivāṣṭādaśākṣarī :

adharaṃ bindunāyuktaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayet |
mādanaṃ kāmabījādye tartīyādye maheśvari || 1 ||

bhṛguḥ sargānvito devi manunā ca samanvitaḥ |
aṣṭādaśākṣarī hyeṣā śrīvidyā bhuvi durlabhā || 2 ||

śrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi nityā siddhipradāyinī |
navalakṣaṃ japitvā tu lopāmudrāṃ maheśvari || 3 ||

aṣṭādaśākṣarī vidyā paścādrādhyā varānane |
anyathā śāpamāpnoti kulaṃ tasya vinaśyati || 4 ||

sarvakalyāṇadā vidyā sarvavighnavināśinī |
sarvasaubhāgyadā devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī || 5 ||

anayā sadṛśī vidyā trailokye cātidurlabhā |

aiṃhasakalahrīṃ, klīṃhasakahalahrīṃ, sauḥsakalahrīṃ iti lopāṣṭādaśākṣarī | 
tathā :

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhavādye tu vāgbhavan |
bhuvaneśīṃ kāmarāje śrībījaṃ śaktipūrvataḥ || 1 ||

eṣāpyaṣṭādaśī proktā sarvasiddhipradāyikā |
bhogamokṣapradā sākṣāt puruṣārthapradāyikā || 2 ||

anayā sadṛśī vidyā na vidyārṇavagocare |
nāsti nāsti punarnāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 3 ||

aiṃ ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ, hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ, śrīṃsakalahrīṃ iti 
kāmarājāṣṭādaśākṣarī | tathā :

praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya tato vai kulasundarīm |
kāmākṣaraṃ śaktivarṇaṃ purandaraharau tataḥ || 1 ||

bhuvaneśīṃ samuddhṛtya vilomāṃ bālikāṃ tataḥ |
praṇavaṃ savisargaṃ ca punaśca kulasundarīṃ || 2 ||

lopāvāgbhavamuddhṛtya vilomāṃ bālikāṃ tataḥ |
praṇavaṃ savisargaṃ tu tato vai kulasundarīm || 3 ||

śaktikūṭamadhyabhāge hakāraṃ yojayecchive |
vilomāṃ bālikāṃ tatra brahmārṇaḥ savisargakaḥ || 4 ||

iyaṃ śrīparamāvidyā kevalā mokṣadāyinī |
asyā lakṣajapenaiva kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale || 5 ||

asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa śivo bhavati nānyathā |

oṃ aiṃ klīṃ soḥ ka-elahahrīṃsauḥ klīṃ aiṃ oṃḥ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ hasakalahrīṃ 
sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ śroṃḥ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ sakahalahrīṃ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ oṃḥ iti 
paramāvidyā | śrīkrame :

tāṃ vidyāṃ śṛṇu deveśi kāmamindrasamanvitam |
nādabindukalābhedāt turīyasvarasaṃyutam || 1 ||

mahāśrīsundarīvidyā mahātripurasundarī |
kakāre sarvamutpannaṃ kāmakaivalyadāyakam || 2 ||

lakāre sakalaiśvaryaṃ īkāre sarvasaukhyadam |
evaṃ bījatrayaṃ devi vidyānāṃ sārasaṃgraham || 3 ||

vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca śaktiṃ tena niyojayet |
ekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalam || 4 ||

kala-īṃ iti brahmavidyā | kāmarājalopāmudrayorviśeṣamāha kuloḍḍīśe :

śrīparāvāgbhavākhyaiśca īśvarītāramanmathaiḥ |
ādyabhūtairvidyamānā sundarī ṣaḍvidhā smṛtā || 1 ||

p. 120) anayorādye kāmo māyā śrībījaṃ, māyāśrīkāmabījaṃ, tathā 
trividhā cāṣṭādakṣākṣarī tathāca -

kāmamāyāramā pūrvaṃ māyā lakṣmīḥ smarastathā |
ramāmāyā tathā kāmo vasucandrākṣarī tridhā || 1 ||

smaraṃ yoniṃ lakṣmīṃ tritayamidamādye tava manau iti bhagavadācāryeṇa 
pratipāditam | śaktikāmarājastu śrīkrame |

māyābījaṃ tato jhiṇṭhiḥ kāmaḥ śakraṃ viyat kramāt |
jātavedomṛgāṅkena lāñchitaṃ parameśvari || 1 ||

etadvāgbhavakūṭaṃ ca pūrvavat kāmarājakam |
tathaiva śaktibījaṃ tu sundaryeṣā prakīrtitā || 2  
 
sundarī siddhidā vidyā trailokyavaśakāriṇī |

atrāpi pūrvavadbījasaṃyogaḥ | māyā īkāraḥ, jhiṇṭhiḥ ekāraḥ | punaḥ 
śaktimāha -

etadbhagaṃ tato māyā brahmā śakro haro'gninā |
vāmanetreṇa saṃyukto nādabinduvibhūṣitaḥ || 1 ||

etadvāgbhavamuddiṣṭaṃ pūrvavat kāmaśaktikam |

bhagaṃ ekāraḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadbījasaṃyogaḥ | atra viśeṣaḥ -

brahmabījaṃ yadā dadyāt trikūṭeṣu varānane |
prathamā sundarī devī dvitīyā brahmasundarī || 1 ||

śaktikūṭe maheśāni anantasundarī matā |
eṣā tu ṣoḍaśī vidyā matabhedena darśitā || 2 ||

iti mantrāntaramāha -

trikūṭānte haṃsabījaṃ bindusargavibhūṣitam |
eṣā śrīprāṇasaṃyuktā dāridryaduḥkhanāśinī || 1 ||

śaktilopāmudrā tu -

śaktirmaheśaḥ kāmaśca indrabījaṃ tataḥ param |
mahāmāyā tataḥ paścāttavasnehāt prakīrtitam || 1 ||

pūrvavat kāmaśaktyākhyau varṇau niṣkīlitātmakau |
iti śaktī mahāvidyā paścimāmnāyayojitā || 2 ||

śaktiḥ sakāraḥ | pūrvavat kāmarājavidyāvat | atrāpi pūrvavadbījasaṃyogaḥ |

śivabījaṃ śaktisomaṃ mādanaṃ ca purandaram |
vyomavahnisamāyuktaṃ turīyasvarabindukam || 1 ||

pūrvavat kāmarājastu śaktibījaṃ samuddharet |
eṣā vidyā maheśāni varṇituṃ naiva śakyate || 2 ||

śaktiḥ sakāraḥ, somaḥ sakāraḥ pūrvavat kāmarājavidyāvat | atrāpi pūrvavat 
bījasaṃyogaḥ :

śivaśaktirbhuvaneśānī vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamam |
kāmaṃ vyoma ca deveśi mahāmāyā tataḥ param || 1 ||

somaṃ vyoma mahāmāyā navārṇā parikīrtitā |
rudraśaktiriyaṃ devi pūrvāmnāye hi yojitā || 2 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

mādanaṃ gotrabhitsānto rephavāmākṣicandravān |
nādabindusamāyuktaḥ kathitaḥ parameśvari || 1 ||

brahmā ca gaganaṃ śakro nakulīśo'nalastathā |
māyābindusanādena kāmarājaṃ samuddharet || 2 ||

śaktirmādanaśakraśca haro vahnīndumāyayā |
bindunādasamākrāntaḥ kathitaḥ kāmado manuḥ || 3 ||

eṣā vidyā maheśāni kathitaikādaśākṣarī |
arihā siddhidā devī mahātripurasundarī || 4 ||

mādanaṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca lohitā rudrayoginī |
purandaro mahāmāyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamam || 5 ||

pūrvavat kāmaśaktyākhyamuddhared devi sundarīm |

lohitā kṣakāraḥ, rudrayoginī makāraḥ, pūrvavat kāmarājavidyāvat |

bhṛgvīśaṃ gaganaṃ hāntaṃ kālamindraṃ maheśvaram |
vāmākṣivahnicandrāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvari || 1 ||

kāmarājaṃ śaktikūṭaṃ pūrvavattu samuccaret |

bhṛgvīśaṃ sakāraḥ, hāntaḥ kṣakāraḥ, kālo makāraḥ | 
pūrvavatkāmarājavidyāvat |

p. 121) viṣṇurīśastato hāntaḥ kāleśaḥ pṛthivī tataḥ |
bhuvaneśī tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ tvayi || 1 ||

kāmarājaṃ śaktikūṭaṃ pūrvavat kathitaṃ priye |

viṣṇurīśaḥ akārayukto hakāraḥ, kāleśo makāraḥ | saubhāgyavidyāmāha 
śrīkrame :

saubhāgyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye |
śaktiḥ svayambhūḥ śambhuśca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

śivo mādanarudrendramahāmāyā tataḥ param |
kāmaḥ śivastato brahmā indraśca bhuvaneśvarī || 2 ||

eṣā tu paramā vidyā bhaktānāṃ subhagodayā |
trikūṭānte haṃsabījaṃ tadā saptadaśī bhavet || 3 ||

vāgbījaṃ vijayā māyā brahmā śakrastu pārvatī |
mānmathaṃ śivaśaktī ca mādano hara indrakaḥ || 4 ||

mahāmāyā tataḥ paścācchaktirmanusasargikā |
candraḥ prajāpatiḥ śakro mahāmāyā tataḥ param || 5 ||

aṣṭādaśākṣarī vidyā mahātripurasundarī |
sarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā viṃśākṣarī tadā bhavet || 6 ||

śrīdevyuvāca :

bhāṣā sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ saṃhṛnnirākhyā pañca sundarīḥ |
kathayasva prabho deva yadi te rocate mayi || 1 ||

īśvara uvāca :

śivo mādana indraśca śaktiśca bhuvaneśvarī |
brahmā śivendrau śaktiśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parā || 1 ||

mādanendrau śaktiśivau mahāmāyā tadantake |

śaktiḥ sakāraḥ | eṣā bhāṣā (hakalasahrīṃ kahalasahrīṃ kalasahahrīṃ)

śivaścandrastathā kāmaḥ śakraśca bhuvaneśvarī |
śivendrakāmarudrāśca candraśca parameśvarī || 1 ||

śaktiḥ kāmaśca indraśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parā |

(hasakalahrīṃ halakahasahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ) iyaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ |

śivendrau kāmaśaktī ca mahāmāyā tataḥ parā |
kāmaścandro maheśaśca indraḥ śaktiśca pārvatī || 1 ||

brahmā maheśvaraḥ śaktiḥ śakrastu bhuvaneśvarī |

(halakasahrīṃ kasahalasahrīṃ kahasalahrīṃ) iti sthitireṣā |

śivendrau kāmaśaktī ca tatparā bhuvaneśvarī |
śivaśaktī mādanendrau śivo vahnīndumāyayā || 1 ||

śivaḥ śivaśca kalahā vahnimāyendubhuṣitāḥ |

(halakasahrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ hahakalahrīṃ) iti eṣā saṃhṛtiḥ |

śakro brahmā cendubījaṃ mahāmāyā tataḥ parā |
vāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ caitatkāmarājaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu || 1 ||

śaktiḥ śivo mādanendrau tatparā parameśvarī |
śivaḥ śaktiśca somaśca śūnyo brahmā maheśvarī || 2 ||

śūnyo hakāraḥ | (lakasahrīṃ sahakalahrīṃ hasasahakahrīṃ) eṣā nirākhyā |

devyuvāca

svapnāvatīṃ madhumatīṃ kathayasva mayi prabho |
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yadi cāsti kṛpā mayi || 1 ||

īśvara uvāca :

śivo mādanaśakrau ca śaktiśca bhuvaneśvarī |
maheśo brahma haṃsaśca indro'pi bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

maheśaḥ śaktiḥ kāmaśca purandaro viyattathā |
agnimāyākalāyuktaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitam || 2 ||

haṃso hakāraḥ māyākalā īkāraḥ | (hakalasahrīṃ, hakahasahrīṃ, 
hasakalahrīṃ)

eṣā svapnāvatī khyātā kalā pañcadaśī yathā |
brahmā maheśa indraśca śaktiśca bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

brahmā viyanmarucchakrastatparā bhuvaneśvarī |
mādanaṃ somacandrau ca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarī || 2 ||

śrīvi0 16

 p. 122) (marut yakāraḥ | kahalasahrīṃ kahayalahrīṃ kasasalahrīṃ iti |)

eṣā madhumatī khyātā sarvaśāstreṣu gopitā |
vāmakeśvara vidyaiva trikūṭakramapāṭhitā || 1 ||

saubhāgyāyāśāstrikūṭena pañcamyāḥ pañcakūṭakam |
tripurāyā mahāvidyā kūṭaikādaśanirmitā || 2 ||

sārātsāratarā vidyā kathitaikādaśākṣarī |

atha pañcamī -

kāmaṃ viṣṇuyutaṃ devi śaktimāyendrameva ca |
mahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ bījamuddharet || 1 ||

viṣṇurakāraḥ, śaktirekāraḥ māyā īkāraḥ |

viyaccandrastataḥ paścāt kalau nakulivahni ca |
māyāsvareṇa saṃyuktaṃ nādabindukalānvitam || 1 ||

prathamaṃ kāmarājasya kūṭaṃ paramadurlabham |
viyadviṣṇuyutaṃ kāmo haṃsaḥ śakrastataḥ param || 2 ||

mahāmāyā tataḥ paścāt svapnāvatīti kathyate |

haṃso hakāraḥ | etat dvitīyaṃ kāmarājakūṭakam |

mādanaṃ śivabījaṃ ca vāyubījaṃ tataḥ param |
indrabījaṃ tataḥ paścānmahāmāyāṃ samuddharet || 1 ||

iti tṛtīyam | iyaṃ madhumatī |

śivabījaṃ tathā kāmamindraṃ devīṃ niyojayet |
mahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścācchaktikūṭaṃ samuddharet || 1 ||

vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ devi śaktikūṭaṃ ca pañcamam |
madhyakūṭatrayaṃ devi kāmarājaṃ manoharam || 2 ||

kathitā pañcamī vidyā trailokyasubhagodayā |

devīṃ sakāram |

īśvara uvāca -

śṛṇu devi mahābhāge śaktikūṭaṃ sudurlabham |
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ kūṭaṃ kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakam || 1 ||

śaktikūṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava snehādviśeṣataḥ |
jīvaprāṇau mahādevi mādanaṃ tadanantaram || 2 ||

indrabījaṃ tataḥ paścādbhuvaneśī ca pañcamam |

iti vā śaktikūṭam | jīvaḥ sakāraḥ, prāṇo hakāraḥ |

athavā devadeveśi saubhāgyāyāśca vāgbhavam |
kūṭatrayaṃ kāmarājaṃ śaktibījaṃ (kūṭaṃ) ca pūrvavat || 1 ||

eṣā śaktyā (proktā) mahādevi pañcamī parameśvarī |

asyārthastu : asya vāgbhavakūṭaṃ hitvā saubhāgyāyāḥ prathamakūṭaṃ 
vāgbhavakūṭe deyamityarthaḥ |

vāmanetrādikūṭaṃ vā (gbhavāṃ?bhagā)dikūṭameva vā |
arihā siddhidā vidyā sarvadoṣavivarjitā || 1 ||

bhaga ekāraḥ | etenāṣṭadhā pañcamī vāgbhavaśaktikūṭabhedena | yāmale :

dvividhā pañcamī vidyā pañcapañcākṣarī parā |
madhye ṣaḍakṣaraṃ caiva śaktiśca caturakṣarā || 1 ||

ṣaḍiti kāmarājavidyāmadhyakūṭamityarthaḥ | śaktikūṭamiti kāmarājasya 
śaktikūṭamityarthaḥ eṣā caturdhā vāgbhavakūṭabhedāt, etena dvādaśadhā 
bhavati | tathā etayoraṣṭadhā caturdhā vyavasthitayoḥ kāmarājasya tṛtīyaṃ 
kūṭaṃ tatraiva :

kāmabījaṃ maheśāni śivabījaṃ tataḥ param |
tadadho haṃsabījaṃ tu indrabījaṃ vicintayet || 1 ||

mahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścāt kūṭaṃ paramadurlabham |

eṣāpi pūrvavadaṣṭadhā, anyā caturdhā | tathāca tattvabodhe - 
kāmākāśaparāśakrāḥ saṃsthānakṛtarūpiṇī | parā sakāraḥ | 
saṃsthānakṛtarūpiṇī mahāmāyā | tathāca tantre :

kāmabījaṃ maheśāni śambhubījaṃ tataḥ param |
tadadhaścandrabījaṃ tu pṛthvībījaṃ tato likhet || 1 ||

tadante ca mahāmāyā kūṭaṃ paramadurlabham |

p. 123) eṣā pūrvavadaṣṭadhā | anyā caturdhā | tena ṣaṭtriṃśadrūpiṇī 
pañcamī (śrīkrame -)

etāsāṃ caiva vidyānāṃ prāṇaṃ śṛṇu varānane |
ramāṃ māyāṃ haṃsabījaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayet || 1 ||

śaktyante tu mahādevi haṃsaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ tathā |
ebhiryuktena deveśi vidyājapanamācaret || 2 ||

japaśca saptavārameva dīpinyāṃ tathā darśanāt | etāsāmiti 
śrīpūrvoktaśrīkramoktavidyānām | pañcamyāṃ tu viśaṣo yathā :

ramāṃ māyāṃ haṃsabījaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayet |
śaktyante tu maheśāni haṃsaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ tathā || 1 ||

kāmarājatraye devi kakāraṃ śakrasaṃyutam |
māyābindvīśvarayutaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 2 ||

prathamaṃ kāmakūṭasya cādye niyojayedidam |
vāntaṃ vahnisamāyuktaṃ vāmanetreṇa bhūṣitam || 3 ||

nādabindusamāyuktaṃ śriyo bījamudāhṛtam |
dvitīyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tu japeduktvā tu sundarīm || 4 ||

gaganaṃ vahnisaṃyuktaṃ vāmanetrasamanvitam |
nādabindusamāyuktaṃ māyābījaṃ prakīrtitam || 5 ||

jvaladagninibhaṃ bījaṃ śuddhahāṭakaguñjanam |
kulākulamaye madhye dhyeyaṃ sākṣānmaheśvari || 6 ||

madhumatīṃ japeccāpi sarvakāmaphalapradām |

iti | atha dīpinī -

tāraṃ lakṣmīṃ ca vāgbījaṃ mānmathaṃ bhuvaneśvarīm |
etajjaptvā tataḥ paścādvāgbhavākhyaṃ samuddharet || 1 ||

praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ ca vāgbhavam |
kāmarājaṃ tato japtvā trailokyakṣobhakārakam || 2 ||

oṃkāraṃ caiva vāgbījaṃ ramāṃ manmathamāyayā |
svapnāvatīṃ mahādevi prajapecca samāhitaḥ || 3 ||

praṇavaṃ cādharaṃ kāmaṃ ramāṃ ca bhuvaneśvarīm |
madhumatīṃ tato japtvā māyāṃ śrīkūrcabījakam || 4 ||

praṇavādyaṃ ca deveśi haṃsabījapuṭīkṛtam |
etadbījaṃ samuccārya śaktikūṭaṃ tato japet || 5 ||

eṣā tu dīpinīvidyā ajapāprāṇarūpiṇī |

japaniyamastu -

japedādau japetpaścāt saptavāramanukramāt |
kāmarājādividyānāṃ dīpinīṃ caiva kārayet || 1 ||

vāgbhave kāmarāje tu śaktikūṭe sureśvari |

tatra kramaḥ - vāgbhavaśaktikūṭayordīpinī pañcamīvadboddhavyā, 
kāmarājakūṭe punaḥ praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ ca 
vāgbhavam | dīpinīmiti sarvakūṭeṣu sambandhaḥ | tathā 
saubhāgyādividyāmadhikṛtya yoginīhṛdaye :

svaravyañjanabhedena saptatriṃśatprabhedinī |
saptatriṃśatprabhedena ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpiṇī || 1 ||

tattvātītasvabhāvā ca vidyaiṣā bhāvyate sadā |
śrīkaṇṭhadaśakaṃ tadvadavyaktasya hi vācakam || 2 ||

prāṇabhūtaḥ sthito devi tadvadekādaśaḥ paraḥ |

saubhāgyādividyāyāḥ prathamakūṭe akāracatuṣṭayamīkāraśceti pañca 
svarāḥ, ṣaṭ vyañjanāni | dvitīyakūṭe svaravyañjanabhedena trayodaśa, 
tṛtīyakūṭe'pi nava, evaṃ tena militvā trayastriṃśadakṣarāṇi, kūṭatraye 
bindutrayaṃ nādatvenaika iti militvā saptatriṃśat, tena nādaṃ vihāya 
ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpiṇī, nādayuktā cettattvātītā, iti saṃjñā sadā ca 
tattvātītasvabhāvā || atha śrīvidyāyā bhedānāmuddhāraḥ :

kāmarājasya vidyāyā vāgbhavaṃ tu vilikhya ca |
śivakāmaharendrāṃśca bhuvaneśīmataḥ param || 1 ||

lopāvāgbhavakūṭaṃ tu unmanī sakaleṣṭadā |

ka-e-ī-lahrīṃ, hakahalahrīṃ, hasakalahrīṃ - iyamunmanī śrīvidyā |

kāmarājasya vidyāyā vāgbhavaṃ tu vilikhya ca |
unmanyāḥ kāmarājaṃ tu candrahaṃsau tu mādanam || 1 ||

bhūmiśca bhuvaneśānī varuṇena samarcitā |

p. 124) bhūmiśca laḥ |

ka-e-īlahrīṃ, hakahalahrīṃ, sahakalahrīṃ - - iyaṃ varuṇopāsitā śrīvidyā |

śaktirmādanayormadhye indraśca bhuvaneśvarī |
śivayormādanaṃ māyā tārtīyaṃ varuṇasya ca || 1 ||

dharmarājopāsiteyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā |

ka-ekalahrīṃ, hakahahrīṃ, sahakalahrīṃ -- iyaṃ dharmarājopāsitā śrīvidyā ||

candro mādanayormadhye indraśca bhuvaneśvarī |
śivacandrendramadanā bhūmiśca bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

candramādanaśakrāśca vahnīndrau bhuvaneśvarī |
vahnīnopāsitā vidyā bhogamokṣaphalapradā || 2 ||

kasakalahrīṃ, hasalakalahrīṃ, sakalaralahrīṃ - iyaṃ vahnyupāsitā śrīvidyā ||

lopāvāgbhavamuccārya tasyā vai kāmarājakam |
sakalā vahnibhūmiśca bhuvaneśīṃ samuddharet || 1 ||

nāgarājopāsiteyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadā |

hasakalahrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃ, sakalaralahrīṃ - iyaṃ nāgarājopāsitā śrīvidyā 
||


mādarna śaktivahnī ca bhūmirvahniḥ sureśvarī |
śivamādanabhūmiśca rahalā bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

candrānalau mādanendravahniśca bhuvaneśvarī |
vāyūpāsitavidyeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradā || 2 ||

ka-eralarahrīṃ, hakalarahalahrīṃ, sarakalarahrīṃ - iyaṃ vāyūpāsitā śrīvidyā 
||

mādanaṃ śaktituryau ca vahnīndrau bhuvaneśvarī |
śivamādanasūryendravahnayo bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

candrasūryau kalau vahnirbhuvaneśīṃ samuddharet |
budhopāsitavidyeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā || 2 ||

ka-e-īralahrīṃ, hakahalarahrīṃ, salakalarahrīṃ - iyaṃ bodhopāsitā śrīvidyā ||

mādanaṃ ca śivendrau ca bhuvaneśīmataḥ param |
śivamādanabhūmiśca śivendrendrānalāstathā || 1 ||

māyā ca kāmarājasya śaktikūṭaṃ samuddharet |
īśānopāsitā vidyā hyaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidā || 2 ||

kahalahrīṃ, hakalahalalarahrīṃ, sakalahrīṃ - imamīśānopāsitā śrīvidyā | ----- 
? (ka-e-īlahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ | iyaṃ ratyupāsitā śrīvidyā)

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā anulomavilomataḥ |
nārāyaṇopāsiteyaṃ ṣaṭkūṭā bhuvi durlabhā || 1 ||

ka-e-īlahrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃ, sakalahrīṃ, sakalahrīṃ, hasakahalahrīṃ, ka-e-
īlahrīṃ - iyaṃ nārāyanopāsitā śrīvidyā ||

kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhavaṃ tu samuddharet |
śivamādanasūryenduvahniśca bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

lopāyā vāgbhavaṃ caiva brahmaṇeyamupāsitā |

ka-e-īlahrīṃ, hakahasarahrīṃ, hasakalahrīṃ - iyaṃ brahmopāsitā śrīvidyā ||

lopāvāgbhavamuddhṛtya brhmaṇaḥ kāmarājakam | 
lopāvāgbhavakūṭaṃ tu jīvenārādhitātviyam || 1 ||

hasakalahrīṃ, hakahasarahrīṃ, hasakalahrīṃ - iyaṃ jīvopāsitā śrīvidyā ||

jāgratsvarūpā māyādiḥ pañcadaśyuditātra tu |
māyāśrībījapūrvā tu svapnāvasyāsvarūpiṇī || 1 ||

tāramāyāramādiḥ syāt sā suṣuptisvarūpiṇī |
śrīmahāṣoḍaśārṇā tu turīyā samprakīrtitā || 2 ||

vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ samādhirvimalaṃ manaḥ |
sadasadvastunirdhārasturīyāyā imāḥ kalāḥ || 3 ||

vairāgyarūpā tārādiḥ ṣoḍaśī parikīrtitā |
māyādiḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tu mumukṣutvasvarūpiṇī || 4 ||

kāmādiḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā syāt sā samādhisvarūpiṇī |
ramādiḥ ṣoḍaśī cittavaimalyasya svarūpiṇī || 5 ||

sadasadvastunirdhārasvarūpā vāgbhavādikā |
pañcadhā ṣoḍaśārṇā tu durlabhā bhuvanatraye || 6 ||

parādiḥ ṣoḍaśīvidyā turyātītā prakīrtitā |
bhedāḥ pūrvoktarītyā ca jñātavyāstantrakovidaiḥ || 7 ||

śuddhāśuddhavibhedena dvividhāḥ parikīrtitā |
ubhayātmakabhedāśca śavalāśca tathaiva ca || 8 ||

anulomāśca yā vidyāḥ śuddhāḥ syuḥ pratilomajāḥ |
aśuddhā iti vijñeyā ubhayātmāna eva ca || 9 ||

p. 125) śuddhāśuddhāśca śavalā vyatyastavyākulakramāt |
evaṃ caturvidhā vidyā vijñeyā deśikottamaiḥ || 10 ||

aśeṣeṇa yahāvidyābhedāste kathitāḥ śive |

iti śrīvidyāyā bhedanirūpaṇam || atha pañcasiṃhāsanavidyāḥ | tatra prathamaṃ 
pūrvasiṃhāsanavidyā, tatrāpyādyā bālā || śrījñānārṇave -

īśvara uvāca

tripurā trividhā devi bālāṃ tu prathamāṃ śṛṇu |
yayā vijñātayā devi sākṣāt suraguruprabhaḥ || 1 ||

sūryasvaraṃ samuccārya bindunādakalātmakam |
svarāntaṃ pṛthivīsthaṃ tu turyasvarasamanvitam || 2 ||

bindunādakalākrāntaṃ sargavān bhṛguravyayaḥ |
śakrasvarasamopeto vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā || 3 ||

gaṅgātaraṅgakallolavāggumphapadadāyinī |
mahāsaubhāgyajananī mahāsārasvatapradā || 4 ||

iti | aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ iti | tathā :

ṛṣirasya maheśāni dakṣiṇāmūrtiravyayaḥ |
nyasecchirasi pūjyatvāt paṃktiśchando mukhe priye || 5 ||

devatā hṛdaye bālātripurā parameśvarī |
bījaṃ tu vāgbhavaṃ śaktistārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ tathā || 6 ||

kāmarājaṃ maheśāni cchandonyāsa udāhṛtaḥ |
nābhyādipādaparyantaṃ galādānābhi cāparam || 7 ||

murdhādigalaparyantaṃ tryakṣarī vinyaset kramāt |
vāmapāṇitale caikaṃ dakṣapāṇitale tathā || 8 ||

ubhayoḥ sampuṭe vidyātribījaṃ vinyaset priye |
pañca bāṇān krameṇaiva karāṃguliṣu vinyaset || 9 ||

aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ krameṇa parameśvari |
thāntadvayaṃ samālikhya vahnisaṃsthaṃ krameṇa tu || 10 ||

mukhavṛttena netreṇa vāmena parimaṇḍitam |
bāṇadvayamidaṃ proktaṃ mādanaṃ bhūmisaṃsthitam || 11 ||

caturthasvarabindvāḍhyaṃ nādarūpaṃ varānane |
phāntaṃ śakreṇa saṃyuktaṃ vāmakarṇavibhūṣitam || 12 ||

bindunādasamāyuktaṃ sargavāṃścandramāḥ priye |
pañca bāṇā maheśāni nāmāni śṛṇu pārvati || 13 ||

kṣobhaṇo drāvaṇo devi tathākarṣaṇasaṃjñakaḥ |
vaśyonmādau krameṇaiva nāmāni parameśvari || 14 ||

kāmāstatrava vijñeyāsteṣāṃ bījāni saṃśṛṇu |
parābījaṃ madhyabāṇaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvari || 15 ||

turyabāṇaṃ tataścaiva strībījaṃ tu kramāt priye |
pañca kāmāḥ kramāddevi nāmāni śṛṇu vallabhe || 16 ||

kāmamanmathakandarpamakaradhvajasaṃjñakāḥ |
mīnaketurmaheśāni pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 17 ||

etān vinyasya deveśi karanyāsastataḥ param |
mūlavidyādvirāvṛttyā sarvāṃgulitaleṣvapi || 18 ||

ṣaḍaṅgakramayogeṣu mātṛkāṃ vinyaset tataḥ |

atra ṣaḍaṅganyāsottaraṃ mātṛkāṣaḍaṅgamantarmātṛkānyāsaṃ 
bahirmātṛkānyāsaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | tathā -

evaṃ dhyātvā nyaset paścādvidyānyāsaṃ sureśvari |
kurvīta dehasannāhaṃ tribhirbījaiḥ kramāt priye || 19 ||

karayorvinyasedādau maṇibandhe tale'grake |
dakṣe vāme ca vinyasya dakṣakūrparapāṇiṣu || 20 ||

punardakṣe ca vāme ca pādayośca tathā nyaset |
nādānte hṛdaye liṅge nyaseddevi tataḥ param || 21 ||

eteṣvaṅgeṣu deveśi saṃhārakramato nyaset |
vidyāsṛṣṭikrameṇaiva jānīhi parameśvari || 22 ||

tato nyasenmaheśāni navayonyaṅkitaṃ vidhim|
karṇayościbuke devi śaṅkhayormukhamaṇḍale || 23 ||

ntetrayornāsikāyāṃ ca bāhuyugme hṛdi priye |
tathā karpūrayoḥ kukṣau jānvorjaṅghe ca vinyaset || 24 ||

pādayordevi guhye ca pārśvahastastanadvaye |
kaṇṭhe ca navayonyākhyaṃ nyasedbījatrayātmakam || 25 ||

ṣaḍaṅgamācareddevi dvirāvṛttyā krameṇa tu |
tridvyekadaśakatridvisaṃkhyayā śailasambhave || 26 ||

aṃgulīṣu punardevi bāṇān kāmāṃśca vinyaset |
lalāṭagalahṛnnābhimūlādhāreṣu vai kramāt ||

mūlena vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret |

iti | atra prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya 
dhyāyet |

p. 126) dhyāyeddevīṃ maheśāni kadambavanamadhyagām |
ratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntare || 28 ||

muktātapatracchāyāyāṃ ratnasiṃhāsane sthitām |
anarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalām || 29 ||

hāragraiveyasadratnacitritāṃ kaṅkaṇojjvalam |
pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām || 30 ||

varadānaratāṃ divyāṃ mahāsārasvatapradām |

iti bālā || atha saṃpatpradābhairavī | śrījñānārṇave -

īśvara uvāca
