yathā śrītripurā bālā tathā tripurabhairavī |
saṃpatpradā nāma tasyāḥ śṛṇu nirmalamānase || 1 ||

śivacandrau vahnisaṃsthau vāgbhavaṃ tadanantaram |
kāmarājaṃ tathā devi śivacandrānvitaṃ tataḥ || 2 ||

pṛthvībījāntavahnyāḍhyaṃ tārtīyaṃ śṛṇu sundari |
śaktibīje maheśāni śivavahnī niyojayet || 3 ||

kumāryāstripureśāni hitvā sargaṃ tu baindavam |
tripurābhairavī devī mahāsaṃpatpradā priye || 4 ||

hasraiṃ, hasakalarīṃ, hassrauṃ iti |

anayā sadṛśī vidyā triṣulokeṣu durlabhā |
mūlamantradvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 5 ||

dhyānam -

udyadbhānusahasrakāntimaruṇakṣaumāṃ śiromālikāṃ 
raktāliptapayodharāṃ japavaṭīṃ vidyāmabhītiṃ varam |
hastābjairdadhatīṃ trinetravilasadvaktrārabindaśriyam |
devīṃ baddhahimāṃśukhaṇḍamukuṭāṃ vande sumandasmitām || 6 ||

iti saṃpatpradā bhairavī || atha caitanyabhairavī, śrījñānārṇave -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pūrvasiṃhāsanasthitām |
vāgbhavaṃ bījamuccāryaṃ jīvaprāṇasamanvitam || 1 ||

sakalā bhuvaneśānīṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam |
jīvaprāṇaṃ vahnisaṃsthaṃ śakrasvaravibhūṣitam || 2 ||

visargāḍhyaṃ mahādevī vidyātrailokyamātṛkā |
trailokyamohanī devī parabrahmacidātmikā || 3 ||

shaiṃ, sakalahrīṃ, shrauḥ - iyaṃ sakārādiriti | asyā ṛṣyādikaṃ prāgvat | 
dhyānam :

udyadbhānusahasrābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
mukuṭordhvalasaccandralekhāṃ raktāmbarānvitām || 1 ||

pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ nityāṃ vāmahaste kapālinī |
varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghaṭastanīm || 2 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā yajeddevīṃ preta(pūrva)siṃhāsanasthitām |

iti caitanyabhairavī || atha dvitīyā caitanyabhairavī śrījñānārṇave -

etasyā eva vidyāyā bījadvayamudāhṛtam |
tadante parameśāni nityaklinne madadrave || 1 ||

etasyā eva tārtīyaṃ rudrāṇā parameśvari |

shaiṃ sakalahrīṃ nityaklinne madadrave shrauḥ iti | asyā ṛṣyādikaṃ prāgvat || 
dhyānam :

caitanyabhairavī dhyāyet pāśāṃkuśakapālinīm |
raktāṃ muṇḍasrajaṃ pañcapretasiṃhāsanasthitām || 1 ||

iti dvitīyā caitanyabhairavī || atha kāmeśvarī bhairavī śrījñānārṇave -

śivacandrau mādanāntaṃ pāntaṃ vahni samanvitam |
śaktibhinnaṃ bindunādakalāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ priye || 1 ||

saṃpatpradāyā bhairavyāḥ kāmarājaṃ tathaiva hi |
sadāśivasya bījaṃ tu mahāsiṃhāsanasya ca || 2 ||

hasakhaphreṃ, hasakalarīṃ, hasauṃ iti | ṛṣyādikaṃ pūrvavat |

dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi ripubhāranikṛntanam |
udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām || 1 ||

nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ sarvavairinikṛntanīm |
vamadrudhiramuṇḍālikalitāṃ raktavāsasam || 2 ||

triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭakameva ca |
pinākaṃ ca śarān devi pāśāṃkuśayugaṃ kramāt || 3 ||

pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca śavasiṃhāsanasthitām |

iti kāmeśvarī bhairavī || iti pūrvasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ | atha 
dakṣiṇasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ | tatrādāthaghorabhairavī -

p. 127) aghoravidyārūpaṃ tu mahāpāpanikṛntanam |
aghore vāgbhavaṃ paścādghore tu bhuvaneśvarī || 1 ||

sarvataḥ śarvasarvebhyo ghoraghoratare ramām |
namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyo devyā bījayugaṃ likhet || 2 ||

triṃśadbhiśca tribhirvarṇairvidyeyaṃ kathitā priye |

aghore aiṃ ghore hrīṃ sarvataḥ śarvasarvebhyo ghoraghoratare śrīṃ namaste'stu 
rudrarūpebhyaḥ klīṃsauḥ | asyā ṛṣyādiṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānāni prāgvat, 
ityaghorabhairavī || atha mahābhairavī -

īśvara uvāca

śivacandrau vahnisaṃsthau vāgbhavena samanvitau |
nādabindususaṃyuktaṃ prathamaṃ bījamuddhṛtam || 1 ||

lopāyā vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam |
śivacandrau vahnisaṃsthau manusvarasamanvitau || 2 ||

tṛtīyaṃ bījamākhyātaṃ bindunādakalānvitam |
hasraiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasrauṃ iti |

pūrvavat parameśāni ṛṣyādinyāsameva ca |
madhyakūṭena ṣaḍadīrghayuktenāṅgāni kalpayet || 1 ||

ātāmrārkasahasrābhāṃ lasaccandrajaṭāsphurat |
kirīṭaratnavilasaccitracitritamauktikām || 2 ||

sphuradrudhirapaṅkāḍhyamuṇḍamālāvirājitām |
nayanatrayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pūrṇenduvadanānvitām || 3 ||

muktāhāralatārājatpīnonnataghaṭastanīm |
raktāmbaraparīdhānāṃ yauvanonmattarūpiṇīm || 4 ||

pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām |
varadānaratāṃ nityāṃ mahāpretāsanasthitām || 5 ||

iti mahābhairavī || atha lalitābhairavī -

māyābījaṃ samuddhṛtya kāmarājaṃ tathoddharet |
pretabījaṃ samuddhṛtya vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavet || 1 ||

hrīṃ klīṃ hsrauṃ iti |

pūrvoktā eva munyādyā ādyenāṅgakriyā matā |
udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām || 1 ||

ratnakuṇḍalamuktālipadakāṅgadabhūṣaṇām |
ratnamañjīrasubhagāṃ raktavastrānulepanām || 2 ||

pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca dadhatīmakṣamālikām |
bālyalīlāparāṃ devīṃ kumārīrūpadhāriṇīm || 3 ||

sarvāṅgasundarīṃ dhyāyet sarvasaṃpattihetave |

iti lalitābhairavī | atha kāmeśvarībhairavī - kāmeśvarībhairavī syāt 
kāmarājena sundarī | klīṃ, iti |

ṛṣirasyāḥ kāmadevī gāyatrī chanda ucyate |
kāmeśvarīdevatā syādbījenāṅgakriyā matā || 1 ||

japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dhanurbāṇadharāṃ smaret |
nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ mohayantīṃ jagattrayam || 2 ||

iti kāmeśvarībhairavī || atha raktanetrābhairavī -

candravāgbhavasaṃyuktaṃ bījaṃ prathamamīritam |
sakalā vahnimāyābhyāṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamīritam || 1 ||

bālāyāścaiva tārtīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bījamuddhṛtam |
saiṃ, sakalarīṃ, sauḥ iti

kumāryā eva ṛṣyādirasyāśca parameśvari |
ṣaḍdīrghacandrabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ || 1 ||

udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām |
ratnakuṇḍalamuktālipadakāṅgadabhūṣaṇām || 2 ||

ratnamañjīrasubhagāṃ raktavastrānulepanām |
pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca dadhānāṃ cākṣamālikām || 3 ||

unmattayauvanaprauḍhāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm |
nitambinīṃ kṣāmamadhyāṃ prāntaraktasulocanām || 4 ||

iti raktanetrābhairavī | iti dakṣiṇasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ || atha 
paścimasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ | tatrādau ṣaṭkūṭā bhairavī -

śivacandau mādanaṃ ca bhūmirvahnistu ḍāmaram |
vākśāntimanubhiryuktaṃ bījatrayamudāhṛtam || 1 ||

hasakalaraḍaiṃ, hasakalaraḍīṃ, hasakalaraḍauḥ - iti ||

ṛṣyādīn pūrvavannyasya dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam |
bālasūryaprabhāṃ devīṃ japākusumasannibhām || 1 ||

p. 128) muṇḍamālāvalīramyāṃ bālasūryasamāṃśukām |
suvarṇakalaśākārapīnonnatapayodharām || 2 ||

pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca tathāca japamālikām |
dadhatīṃ bhairavīṃ dhyāyet pretasiṃhāsanasthitām || 3 ||

iti ṣaṭkūṭābhairavī || atha nityābhairavī -

ṣaṭkūṭā bhairavī devī pratilomatayā bhavet |
nityā ca bhairavī proktā caturvargaphalapradā || 1 ||

ḍaralakasahaiṃ, ḍaralakasahīṃ, ḍaralakasahauḥ - iti ||

pūrvoktā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi te |
pañcamuṇḍasamāsīnāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām || 1 ||

ātāmrārkāyutābhāsāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhuṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśābhayavarān dadhatīṃ bhāvayecchivām || 2 ||

iti nityā bhairavī | atha mṛtasañjīvanī -

māyāṃ haṃsaḥ padaṃ coktvā sañjīvani tataḥ param |
jūṃjīvaṃ prāṇapadaṃ granthiṃ kuruyugaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

svāhāntā kathitā vidyā mṛtasañjīvanī parā |

hrīṃhaṃsaḥ saṃjīvani sūṃjīvaṃ prāṇagranthiṃ kuru kuru svāhā |

ṛṣiḥ śukraḥ samākhyāto gāyatrī chanda īritam |
mṛtasañjīvanī devī devatā parikīrtitā || 1 ||

māyābījaṃ tu bījaṃ syāt svāhā śaktirudāhṛtā |
haṃsastu kīlakaṃ proktaṃ mṛtasañjīvanāya ca || 2 ||

viniyogaḥ samākhyātastricatuścaikakaṃ punaḥ |
ṣaṭcaturdikakenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret || 3 ||

dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

īśvara uvāca :

devī paścimavaktreṇa mayādyāpi prajapyate |
vidyācatuṣṭayaṃ sākṣādamṛtānandavigraham || 1 ||

mahāsiṃhāsanagataṃ tatra sañjīvanīṃ śṛṇu |
śaktibījaṃ samālikhya śivacandrau samālikhet || 2 ||

anusvāravisargābhyāṃ maṇḍitau kramataḥ priye |
sañjīvani ca jūṃ jīvaṃ prāṇagranthisthamālikhet || 3 ||

kuruśabdastriśaḥ sauḥsauḥ vahnijāyānvito manuḥ | 

viṃśatyarṇeti |

hrīṃhaṃsaḥ saṃjīvanijūṃ haṃsaḥ kurukurukuru sauḥsauḥ svāhā iti |

ṛṣiḥ śukraḥ samākhyāto gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
sañjīvanī devatā syācchaktirasyādibījakam || 1 ||

catuṣkaṃ tritayaṃ pañca pañcakaṃ catureva hi |
trikaṃ ca kramato devi ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset || 2 ||

karpūrābhāṃ hīramuktābhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāmbarām |
jñānamudrāmakṣamālāṃ dadhatīṃ cintayet parām || 3 ||

iti mṛtasañjīvanī | atha mṛtyuñjaya parā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni mṛtyuñjayaparāṃ parām |
vadadvandvaṃ vādanīti vāṅmadhye nikṣipet priye || 1 ||

hasrāṅkaṃ vāgbhavaṃ devi klinne kledini cālikhet |
mahākṣobhaṃ kurudvandvaṃ śivacandrakalānalām || 2 ||

vāmākṣibindunādāṅkāṃ tārabījaṃ tato vadet |
mokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ haṃsraṃ śakrasvaravisargavat || 3 ||

vadavadavāgvādini hasaiṃ, klinne kledini mahākṣobhaṃ kuru kuru hasrīṃ, oṃ 
mokṣaṃ kuru kuru hasauḥ iti ||

iyaṃ sañjīvanī devī ṛṣirasyāḥ śivaḥ priye |
gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devateyaṃ tu bhairavī || 1 ||

ādikūṭaṃ bhavedbījaṃ madhyakūṭaṃ tu kīlakam |
antyakūṭaṃ bhavecchaktiḥ sākṣānmṛtyuvināśinī || 2 ||

navaśakrāṣṭavarṇaistu ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |
dhyātvā cāvāhayeddevīṃ kadambavanamadhyagām || 3 ||

pustakaṃ vāmahatesna dakṣiṇenākṣamālikām |
vibhratīṃ kundadhavalāṃ kumārīṃ cintayet parām || 4 ||

iti mṛtyuñjayaparā || atha vajraprastāriṇī -

īśvara uvāca :

parāṃ klinne vāgbhavaṃ ca tatkromātmakamakṣaram |
tato nityamadaprānte drave māyāṃ ca saṃlikhet || 1 ||

hrīṃklinne aiṃkroṃ nityamadadrave hrīṃ - iti ||

vajreśī ravivarṇeyaṃ ṛṣirbrahmāsya sanmanoḥ |
chando virāṭ ca vajreśī devatā parikīrtitā || 1 ||

p. 129) pañcamaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca bījaśaktī krameṇa tu |
tārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ devyāstato'ṅgāni pravinyaset || 2 ||

ādyantabījaṃ saṃtyajya dvikaṃ caikaikarūpakam |
dvikaṃ dvikaṃ trikaṃcaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet || 3 ||

dhyātvā cāvāhayeddevīṃ kadambavanamadhyagām |
raktāṃ candrakalācārumukuṭāṃ varabhūṣaṇām || 4 ||

mahātāruṇyagarvāḍhyalocanatrayaśobhitām |
śoṇitābdhitaratpotamahāyantroparisthitām || 5 ||

dāḍimaṃ sāyakāṃścaiva pāśaṃ caiva sṛṇi tathā |
cāpaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ śoṇamālyānulepanām || 6 ||

smaredraktatarāṃ devīmupacāraiḥ samarcayet |

iti vajrapastāriṇī || iti paścimasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ || athottarasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ | 
tatrādau bhuvaneśvarībhairavī -

-------------------------------------- | (?)

lopāvāgbhavamuccārya pretabījaṃ samuddharet |
rephaṃ śivādho niḥkṣipya bhuvaneśī ca bhairavī || 1 ||

hasraiṃ, hasakalahrīṃ, hrasauṃ iti |

akumāryā eva ṛṣyādyā ādyenāṅgakriyā matā |
japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhām || 2 ||

candralekhājaṭājūṭāṃ trinetrāṃ raktavāsasam |
nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 3 ||

pretāsanasamāsīnāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśavarābhītīrdhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śraye || 4 ||

iti bhuvaneśībhairavī || atha kamaleśvarībhairavī - bhuvaneśī ca candrādyā 
kamaleśī tathā bhavet sahaiṃ, sahakalahrīṃ, sahauṃ iti | anyatsarvaṃ 
bhuvaneśībhairavīvat | iti kamaleśībhairavī || atha siddhakauleśabhairavī:

hasraiṃ hasrīṃ ca hasrauḥ ca siddhakauleśabhairavī |
kumāryā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi te || 1 ||

ātāmrārkasahasrābhāṃ trinetrāṃ candrasanmukhīm |
candrakhaṇḍasphuradratnamukuṭāṃ kṣāmamadhyamām || 2 ||

nitambinīṃ sphuradratnavasanāṃ raktabhūṣaṇām |
unmattayauvanaprauḍhāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 3 ||

asṛkpaṅkāḍhyamuṇḍasraṅmaṇḍitāṅgī subhūṣaṇām |
pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām || 4 ||

varadaṃ dadhatīṃ dhyāyet pretasiṃhāsanasthitām |

iti siddhakauleśabhairavī || atha ḍāmarabhairavī -

īśvara uvāca

uttarāsyena deveśi mayādyāpi prajapyate |
mahāsiṃhāsanagatā bhairavī ḍāmareśvarī || 1 ||

pūrvoktabhairavīdevyāḥ kāmakūṭe parāṃ śivām |
hitvoccaret tadā vidyāṃ mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarīm || 2 ||

hasaiṃ, haklīṃ, hasauḥ - iti |

pūrvoktā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi te |
bandhūkakusumābhāsāṃ pañcamuṇḍādhivāsinīm || 1 ||

sphuraccandrakalāratnamukuṭāṃ muṇḍamālinīm |
trinetrāṃ raktavasanāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 2 ||

pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca varadaṃ cābhayaṃ kramāt |
dadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityamuttarāmnāyamānitām || 3 ||

iti ḍāmarabhairavī || atha kāminībhairavī -

saṃpatpradāyā bhairavyā vahniṃ tyaktvā samuddharet |
kāminībhairavī ceyaṃ bhayavidhvaṃsinīti vā || 1 ||

hasaiṃ, hasaklīṃ hasauṃ - iti |

pūrvoktā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi te |
ātāmrārkāyutābhāsāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām || 1 ||

pāśāṃkuśābhayavarān dhārayantīṃ śavāsanām |
muṇḍamālāvalīramyāṃ cintayedbhairavīṃ parām || 2 ||

iti kāminībhairavī | ityuttarasiṃhāsanadevatāḥ | 
athordhvasiṃhāsanadevatāstatrādau prathamasundarī -

īśvara uvāca

śrīvi0 17

p. 130) atheśānena vaktreṇa mayādyāpi prajapyate |
vidyānāṃ pañcakaṃ devi triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || 1 ||

vāgbhavaṃ śivasaṃyuktaṃ vāgbhave madhyamaṃ śṛṇu |
hakālānte maheśāni śivabījaṃ tu saṃlikhet || 2 ||

rephavāmākṣibindbindughaṭitaṃ tu tṛtīyakam |
hasānugrahasargāḍhyaṃ vidyaikā sundarī priye || 3 ||

haiṃ, hakalahrīṃ, hasauḥ - iti prathamasundarī || atha dvitīyasundarī :

ahasādyairjapenmantrī ravituryamanusvaraiḥ |
antyaṃ sasargamādye hi bindunādakalātmike || 1 ||

iyaṃ dvitīyā deveśi sundarī parikīrtitā |

ahasaiṃ, ahasīṃ, ahasauḥ iti dvitīyasundarī || atha tṛtīyasundarī :

kevalaṃ vāgbhavaṃ devi vāgbhave madhyamaṃ śṛṇu |
hasa-ehasahasrāṃśca vāgbhavena ca yojayet || 1 ||

hatrayaṃ kalahṛllekhāṃ śaktikūṭaṃ śṛṇu priye |
catuṣkaṃ śivabījānāṃ repho'nugrahasargavān || 2 ||

evaṃ tṛtīyā deveśi sundarī caturakṣarā |

aiṃ, hasa-ehasahasraiṃ hahahakalahrīṃ, hahahaharauḥ, iti tṛtīyasundarī || atha 
caturthasundarī :

kalānte śivayugmaṃ tu tathā jīvatrayaṃ śive |
parayā piṇḍitaṃ kuryāt kūṭametat tridherayet || 1 ||

vāgbhave kāmarāje ca śaktibīje ca saṃlikhet |
caturthī sundarī khyātā bhogamokṣapradāyinī || 2 ||

kalahahasasasahraiṃ(hrīṃ), kalahahasasasahrīṃ, kalahahasasasasahrauḥ (hrīṃ) - iti 
caturthasundarī | atha pañcamasundarī

jīvaḥ śivayugaṃ jīvaḥ kṣmākṣakāraśivendumat |
etadādyaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca hasayukkṣmākṣahendumat || 1 ||

antyaṃ tu hasalakṣenduhendvākāśavibhūṣitam |
tripureśīmanoreṣā pañcamī sundarī bhavet || 2 ||

sahahasalakṣahasaiṃ, hasahasalakṣahasīṃ, hasalakṣasahasahauḥ - iti 
pañcamasundarī |

sampatpradābhairavīvaddhyāyet pañcakamuttamam |
ṛṣyādipūjā vijñeyā tripureśīva nānyathā || 1 ||

ityūdhūrvasiṃhāsanavidyāḥ | iti pañcasiṃhāsanavidyānirūpaṇam || atha 
pañcapañcikāgaṇastatrādau pañcalakṣmyaḥ, tatrādau śrīvidyālakṣmīḥ :

ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyāṃ samuccārya vidhānavit |
mahālakṣmīśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitā || 1 ||

sarvasaubhāgyajananīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca |

iti śrīvidyālakṣmīḥ || athaikākṣaralakṣmīḥ -

varuṇāntaṃ vahnisaṃsthaṃ dīrghanetravibhūṣitam |
bindunādasamāyuktaṃ lakṣmīmantra udāhṛtaḥ || 1 ||

śrīṃ - iti

ṛṣirbhṛgunicṛcchandastathā śrīrdevatā priye |
śaturye bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ repha ucyate || 2 ||

ṣaḍdīrghayuksvabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret |
dhyāyet tataḥ śriyaṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām || 3 ||

taptakārtasvarābhāsāṃ divyaratnavibhūṣitām |
āsicyamānāmamṛtairmuktāratnadravairapi || 4 ||

śubhrābhrābhebhayugmena muhurmuhurapi priye |
ratnaughabaddhamukuṭāṃ śuddhakṣaumāṅgarāgiṇīm || 5 ||

padmākṣīṃ padmanābhena hṛdi cintyāṃ smaredbudhaḥ |
evaṃ dhyātvā japeddevīṃ padmayugmadharāṃ sadā || 6 ||

varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ caturbāhuṃ sulocanām |

iti lakṣmīḥ || atha mahālakṣmīḥ -

praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya harīmātmakamakṣaram |
śrīpuṭaṃ cātha kamale kamalāye prasīda ca || 1 ||

lāyemadhyagatāṃ bhūmiṃ rudrasthāne tu yojayet |
prasīda pūrvabījāni sampuṭatvena yojayet || 2 ||

mahālakṣmīhṛdanto'ṇuraṣṭāviṃśativarṇavān |

oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kamale kamalālaye prasīda prasīda śrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ oṃ 
mahālakṣmyai namaḥ - iti |

p. 131) dakṣaḥ prajāpatiścāsya ṛṣiśchandastathaiva ca |
gāyatrī devatā lakṣmīrhṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam || 1 ||

dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca bījaśaktī krameṇa tu |
praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi tato'ṅgāni pravinyaset || 2 ||

aṅgāni pūrvavaddevi nyasenmantrī samāhitaḥ |
ratnodyadvasupātraṃ ca padmayugmaṃ ca hemajam || 3 ||

agraratnāvalīrājadādarśa dadhatīṃ parām |
caturbhujāṃ sphuradratnanūpurāṃ mukuṭojjvalām || 4 ||

graiveyāṅgadahārāḍhyakaṅkaṇāṃ ratnakuṇḍalām |
padmāsanasamāsīnāṃ dūtībhirmaṇḍitāṃ sadā || 5 ||

śuklāṅgarāgavasanāṃ mahādivyāṅganānatām |

evaṃ dhyātvārcayeddevīmiti |

iti mahālakṣmīḥ || atha triśaktilakṣmīḥ -

śrībījaṃ ca parābījaṃ kāmabījaṃ samālikhet |
iyaṃ triśaktirdeveśi triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā || 1 ||

śrīṃhrīṃklīṃ - iti |

ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chando'pi kathitaṃ priye |
triśaktirdevatāṅgāni dvirāvṛttyā yajet priye || 1 ||

(?) * * * * * * * * dhyāyetsarvasamṛddhidām |
navahemasphuradbhūmau ratnakuṭṭimamaṇḍape || 2 ||

mahākalpavanāntaḥsthe ratnasiṃhāsane vare |
kamalāsanaśobhāḍhyāṃ ratnamañjīramaṇḍitām || 3 ||

sphuradratnalasanmauliṃ ratnakuṇḍalamaṇḍitām |
anarghyaratnaghaṭitanānāmaṇḍalabhūṣitām || 4 ||

dadhatīṃ padmayugalaṃ pāśāṃkuśadhanuḥśarān |
ṣaḍbhujāminduvadanāṃ dūtībhiḥ parivāritām || 5 ||

cārucāmarahastābhī ratnādarśasupāṇibhiḥ |
tāmbūlasvarṇapātrībhirbhūṣāpeṭīsupāṇibhiḥ || 6 ||

taptakārtasvarābhāsām iti | iti triśaktilakṣmīḥ || atha sarvasāmrājyalakṣmīḥ -

atha vakṣye maheśāni sarvasāmrājyadevatām |
yasyā ārādhane viṣṇurabhūllakṣmīpatiḥ svayam || 1 ||

candreśamādanakṣmeśavahnidīrghākṣimaṇḍitam |
vidhvakrūreśvarīyuktaṃ vidyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī priye || 2 ||

śrībījasampuṭaṃ kuryāt sarvasāmrājyadāyinī |

śrīṃsahakalahrīṃśrīṃ iti |

ṛṣirharistathā chando gāyatrī cāsya sanmanoḥ |
devatā mohanī lakṣmīrmahāsāmrājyadāyinī || 1 ||

bījaṃ kūṭaṃ samākhyātaṃ śaktiḥ śrībījamucyate |
ṣaḍbhirādyaiḥ svarairbhitvā ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset || 2 ||

atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥ || 3 ||

ṣaḍbhiḥ karābhyāṃ deveśi varadābhayaśobhitām |
evamaṣṭabhujāṃ dhyātveti |

iti sarvasāmrājyalakṣmīḥ | iti pañcalakṣmyaḥ || atha pañcakośavidyāḥ - tatra 
śrīvidyākośeśvarī - oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ, mūlam |

mahākośeśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitā |
sarvasaubhāgyajananīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca || 1 ||

iti śrīvidyākośeśvarī ||

atha śrīkośavidyānāṃ catuṣkaṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyate || 1 ||

śrīvidyā ca parajyotiḥ paraniṣkaladevatā |
ajapā mātṛkā caiva pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2 ||

praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya parāṃ haṃsaḥpadaṃ likhet |
tataḥ so'haṃ śiro devi vasuvarṇayamīritā || 3 ||

oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥso'haṃ svāhā iti |

ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
parajyotirmayī sākṣāddevatā parikīrtitā || 4 ||

praṇavāntyadvayaṃ bījaśaktī śeṣaṃ tu kīlakam |
svāhā tu hṛdayaṃ so'haṃ śiro haṃsaḥ śikhā bhavet || 5 ||

māyayā kavacaṃ tārabījena nayanatrayam |
sṛṣṭyānmantreṇa deveśi samagraṇāstrakaṃ bhavet || 6 ||

dhyānaṃ tu prapañcayāgakaraṇe prapañcitamiti parajyotiḥ kośeśvarī || atha 
paraniṣkaladevatā kośeśvarī -

p. 132) atha vakṣye maheśāni paraniṣkaladevatām |
yasyāḥ smaraṇalātreṇa cidānandāyaye tanuḥ || 1 ||

anugrahādirdeveśi bindunādakalātmakaḥ |
paraniṣkaladevīyaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 2 ||

śuklāmbaraparīdhānā śuklamālyānulepanā |
jñānamudrāṅkitā yogipativṛndena sevitā || 3 ||

dhyeyeti śeṣaḥ |

ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatraṃ manośchandaḥ kramādbhavet |
brahmaiva devatā bījaśaktī a-ū krameṇa tu || 4 ||

makāraḥ kīlakaṃ mokṣaphaladā jñānadāyinī |
svaradvandvasya madhye tu kṣiptvā tyaktvā catuṣṭayam || 5 ||

ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ ca deveśi ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |

iti paraniṣkaladevatā || athājapākośeśvarī -

ajapārādhanaṃ devi kathayāmi tavānaghe |
yasya vijñānamātreṇa parabrahmaiva deśikaḥ || 1 ||

haṃsaḥpadaṃ pareśāni pratyahaṃ japate naraḥ |
mohabaddho na jānāti mokṣastasya na vidyate || 2 ||

śrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi jñāyate japyate tadā |
ucchvāsaniḥśvāsatayā tadā bandhakṣayo bhavet || 3 ||

ucchvāse caiva niḥśvāse haṃsa ityakṣaradvayam |
tasmāt prāṇastu haṃsākhya ātmākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 4 ||

ṣaṣṭiśvāsaiḥ bhavet prāṇaḥ ṣaṣṭyā tairnāḍikā matā (?) |
ṣaṣṭināḍyā ahorātraṃ japasaṃkhyājapāmanoḥ || 5 ||

ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ ṣaṭśatādhikamīśvari |
japate pratyahaṃ prāṇī spandānandamayīṃ parām || 6 ||

utpattirjapa ārambho mṛtirasya nivedanam |
vinā japena deveśi japo bhavati mantriṇaḥ || 7 ||

ajapeyaṃ tataḥ proktā bhavapāśanikṛntanī |
śrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi labhate nānyathā priye || 8 ||

evaṃ japaṃ maheśāni pratyahaṃ vinivedayet |
gaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇubhyo harāya parameśvari || 9 ||

jīvātmane krameṇaiva tathā ca paramātmane |
ṣaṭśatāni sahasrāṇi ṣaḍeva ca tathā punaḥ || 10 ||

ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi ca punaḥ sahasraṃ ca sahasrakam |
punaḥ sahasraṃ gurave krameṇa tu nivedayet || 11 ||

japaṃ nivedayitvā tamahorātrabhavaṃ priye |
sahajaṃ parameśāni nyāsaṃ kuru vicakṣaṇe || 12 ||

ṛṣirhaṃso'vyaktapūrvaṃ gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
devatā paramādistu haṃso haṃ bījamucyate || 13 ||

saḥ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ so'haṃ praṇavastattvameva hi |
nāda sthānaṃ tathā śveto varṇastu parameśvari || 14 ||

udāttaḥ svara ityevaṃ manorasya prakīrtitam |
mokṣārthe viniyogaḥ syādevaṃ jānīhi pārvati || 15 ||

tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsaṃ kuryāddehasya śuddhaye |
sūryaṃ somaṃ tathā devi nirañjanamataḥ param || 16 ||

nirābhāsaṃ caturthyantasvāhāntān kramato nyaset |
kavacāntān pravinyasya tato'nantapadaṃ smaret || 17 ||

tanusūkṣmacaturvarṇānuktvā ṅe'ntaṃ pracodayāt |
svāhāntenaiva nayanamavyaktapadapūrvakaḥ || 18 ||

prabodhātmā caturthyagnijāyānto'straṃ nigadyate |
asya haṃsasya deveśi nigamāgamapakṣakau || 19 ||

agnīṣomāvatho vāpi pakṣau tāraḥ śiro bhavet |
bindutrayaṃ śikhā netre mukhe nādaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 20 ||

śivaśaktipadadvandvaṃ kālāgnipārśvayugmakam |
ayaṃ paramahaṃsastu sarvavyāpī prakāśavān || 21 ||

sūryakoṭipratīkāśaḥ svaprakāśena bhāsate |
saṃhārarūpī haṃso'yaṃ vivekaṃ darśayatyapi || 22 ||

ajapā nāma gāyatrī triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā |

ityajapākośeśvarī || mātṛkā prāgeva prapañcitā | iti pañca kośadevatāḥ | atha 
pañca kalpalatāḥ -

atha vakṣye maheśāni vidyāḥ kalpalatāḥ priye |
yāsāṃ vijñānamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ || 1 ||

śrīvidyā pārijāteśī pañcakāmeśvarī tathā |
pañcabāṇeśvarī devī kumārī pañca kīrtitāḥ || 2 ||

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mū0 mahākalpalateśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitasarva-
saubhāgyajananīśrīvidyākalpalatāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | iti 
śrīvidyākalpalateśvarī || atha pārijāteśvarī :

p. 133) sampatpradāyā bhairavyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamālikhet |
tāreṇa parayā devī sampuṭīkṛtya mantravit || 1 ||

sarasvatyai hṛdanto'yaṃ rudrārṇo manurīritaḥ |

oṃ hrīṃ hsraiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ iti |

ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatraṃ chanda īritam |
pārijāteśvarī vāṇī devatā parikīrtitā || 2 ||

tṛtīyaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ca bījaśaktī ca tārakam |
kīlakaṃ parameśāni mahāsārasvatapradam || 3 ||

ṣaḍadīrghasvarasaṃbhinnabījenāṅgāni vinyaset |
haṃsārūḍhāṃ lasanmuktādhavalāṃ śubhravāsasam || 4 ||

śucismitāṃ candramauliṃ vajramuktāvibhūṣaṇām |
vidyāṃ vīṇāṃ sudhākumbhamakṣamālāṃ ca bibhratīm || 5 ||

iti pārijāteśvarī | atha pañcabāṇeśvarī -

atha vakṣye maheśāni pañcabāṇeśvarīṃ śivām |
tripureśīmantramadhye bāṇāḥ proktā maheśvari || 1 ||

taireva pañcabhirbāṇairvidyā pañcākṣarī bhavet |
drāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥ | iti

ṛṣirasyāstu madano gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
kāmeśvarīva bījādi devatā ceyamīśvarī || 2 ||

vyastaiḥ samastairaṅgāni bāṇaiḥ pañcabhirācaret |
udyaddivākarābhāsāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 3 ||

bandhūkakusumākāraraktavastrāṅgarāgiṇīm |
ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvirājitabhujadvayām || 4 ||

iti pañcabāṇeśvarī || atha pañcakāmeśvarī -

atha vakṣye pañcakāmanāyikāṃ viśvamātaram |
pūrvoktapañcakāmaistu pañcakāmeśvarī bhavet || 1 ||

ṛṣiḥ sammohano nāma gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
devateyaṃ kāmadā ca bījaśaktī tu kīlakam || 2 ||

antyametairnyasenmantrī vyastaiścaiva samastakaiḥ |
aṅgāni pūrvavat kāmabāṇanyāsadvayaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

raktāṃ raktadugūlāṅgalepanāṃ raktabhūṣaṇām |
pāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikām || 4 ||

varābhītī ca dadhatīṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇīm |

iti pañcakāmeśvarī || atha kumārī -

atha vakṣye maheśāni kumārīṃ viśvamātaram |
kāmeśvarīṃ bhagavatīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām || 1 ||

vāgbhavaṃ tripureśānyā hitvā tatra kṣipet sudhīḥ |
kāmaśaktidvayāntastu vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavet || 2 ||

klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ iti |

tripureśīvadṛśyādi bījaśaktī krameṇa tu |
ādyante kīlakaṃ madhyaṃ mahāvaśyakarī bhavet || 3 ||

dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni iti | tathā -

udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ māṇikyavarabhūṣaṇām |
sphuradratnadukūlāḍhyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 4 ||

ikṣukodaṇḍabāṇāṃśca pustakaṃ cākṣamālikām |
dadhatīṃ cintayennityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarīm || 5 ||

iti pañcakalpalatāvidyāḥ || atha pañcakāmadughāḥ - oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ 
mūlaṃ mahākāladugheśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthita-
sarvasaubhāgyajananīśrīvidyākāmadughāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti 
śrīvidyākāmadughā || hrīṃ haṃsaḥ sañjīvani jūṃjīvaṃ prāṇagranthisthaṃ 
kurukuru saḥ svāhā | ṛṣyādinyāsadhyānāni prāgevoktāni | 
ityamṛtapīṭheśvarī || atha amṛteśvarī - aiṃ blūṃ oṃ jūṃsaḥ amṛte 
amṛtodbhave amṛteśvari amṛtavarṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya svāhā 
ṛṣyādicchandonyāsādi prāgvat |

amṛtāmṛtaraśmyoghasantarpitacarācarām |
bhavāni bhavaśāntyai tvāṃ bhāvayāmyamṛteśvarīm || 1 ||

ityevaṃ sudhāsūḥ || athānnapūrṇā -

śivāgnivāmanayanabindunādakalātmakam |
śrīkāmayugalaṃ proktvā hṛdante bhagavatyapi || 1 ||

p. 134) māheśvarī caturvarṇamannapūrṇe tathā likhet |
caturvarṇaṃ vahnijāyātārādyo manurīritaḥ || 2 ||

dvidaśārṇā maheśāni iti | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namo bhagavati māheśvari 
annapūrṇe svāhā | ayaṃ mantraḥ praṇavādi ||

ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya uṣṇikchando'bhidhīyate |
annapūrṇeśvarī devī devatā parikīrtitā || 3 ||

bījaṃ śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ ca hṛllekhādikamucyate |
ṣaḍdīrghamāyayā kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvari || 4 ||

udyatsūryasamābhāsāṃ vicitravasanojjvalām |
candracūḍāmannadānaniratāṃ ratnabhūṣitām || 5 ||

suvarṇakalāśākārastanabhāranatāṃ parām |
rudratāṇḍavasānandāṃ dvibhujāṃ parameśvarīm || 6 ||

varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāmannadānaratāṃ sadā |

ityannapūrṇeśvarī | iti pañca kāmadughāvidyāḥ || atha pañca 
ratneśvarīvidyāḥ | tatrādau śrīvidyāratneśvarī - 4 mūlaṃ 
mahāratneśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitasarvasaubhāgyajananīśrīvidyāratne
śvarīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | iti śrīvidyāratneśvarī || atha 
siddhalakṣmīratneśvarī - oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ phreṃ phreṃ khphreṃ aiṃ 
kṣamarīṃ mahācaṇḍatejaḥ saṅkarṣiṇi kālimanthāne hrīṃsaḥ svāhā | 
khaphreṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarvasiddhiyogini hasakhaphreṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ nityoditāye 
sakalakulacakranāyikāyai bhagavatyai caṇḍikapālinyai hrīṃ śrīṃhūṃ 
khphreṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ haphreṃkṣyai kroṃ klīṃsaḥ khaphavayareṃ paramahaṃsi 
nivārṇamārgade devi viṣamopaplavapraśamani sakaladuritāriṣṭakleśadamani 
sarvāpadambhodhitāriṇi sakalaśatrupramathini devi āgaccha āgaccha hasa hasa 
bala bala nararudhirāntravasābhakṣiṇi mama śatrūn mardaya mardaya khāhi 
khāhi triśūlena bhindhi bhindhi chindi chindi khaḍgena tāḍaya ṭāḍaya chedaya 
chedaya vadakavalahrīṃ hasakṣamalavarayūṃ hasakṣamalavarayīṃ 
sahakṣamalavarayīṃ mama sakalamanorathān sādhaya sādhaya parama kāruṇike 
devi bhagavati mahābhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśavaranamite mahāmantramātaḥ 
praṇatajanavatsale devi mahātikālanāśini hrīṃ prasīda madanāturāṃ kuru kuru 
surāsurakanyakāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kroṃ phaṭ ṭhaḥṭhaḥ sahakhaphreṃ phreṃphreṃ 
mahāratneśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitasarvasaubhāgyajananī-
śrīsiddhamahālakṣmī-śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmī | iti siddhalakṣmīḥ || atha 
mātaṅgī ratneśvarī |

athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi mātaṅgīṃ ratnadevatām |
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca sargavān bhṛguruttame || 1 ||

anugraheṇa saṃyuktaḥ punarādyaṃ parāṃ likhet |
śrībījaṃ tārakaṃ caiva namo bhagavatīti ca || 2 ||

mātaṅgīśvari sarvānte manohari janādikam |
sarvarājavaśaṃ cānte kari sarvamukhāntakam || 3 ||

rañjinīti tataḥ sarvastrīśabdaṃ ca tato vadet |
puruṣānte vaśaṃ coktvā karyante sarvaduṣṭataḥ || 4 ||

mṛgānte vaśamālikhya sarvalokapadaṃ likhet |
śailaje vaśamālikhya kariśabdaṃ tato vadet || 5 ||

parāṃ śrīyaṃ kāmabījaṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca samālikhet |
saptatiśca trayo varṇā mātaṅgīvigrahāḥ priye || 6 ||

aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ oṃ namo bhagavati mātaṅgīśvari 
sarvajanamanohari sarvarājavaśaṅkari sarvamukharañjini 
sarvastrīpuruṣavaśaṅkari sarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṅkari sarvalokavaśaṅkari 
hrīṃśrīṃklīṃ aiṃ ||

iyaṃ mataṅgavidyānāṃ rājñīmokṣārthasiddhidā |
ṛṣirmataṅgo bhagavān gāyatrī chanda ucyate || 7 ||

devatā nādamūrtistu mātaṅgī parameśvarī |
kāmabījaṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca bījaśaktī ca kīlakam || 8 ||

tārtīyaṃ devadeveśi ṣaḍaṅgānyatha vinyaset |
ādyabījatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam || 9 ||

ambhojārpitadakṣāṃghrikṣaumāṃ dhyāyenmataṅginīm |
kvaṇadvīṇālasannādaślāghāndolitakuṇḍalām || 10 ||

dantapaṃktiprabhāramyāṃ śivāṃ sarvāṅgasundarīm |
kadambapuṣpadāmāḍhyāṃ vīṇāvādanatatparām || 11 ||

śyāmāṅgīṃ śaṅkhavalayāṃ dhyāyet sarvārthasiddhaye |

iti mātaṅgīratneśvarī || atha bhuvaneśvarīratneśvarī sātu prāgeva prapañcitā | 
atha vārāhīratneśvarī dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

p. 135) pañcamīṃ ratnavidyeśīṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye |
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa pavano'yaṃ sthiro bhavet || 1 ||

vāgbhavaṃ bījamuccārya galānugrahabindubhiḥ |
nādena bhūṣitaṃ bījaṃ pārthivaṃ coccarettataḥ || 2 ||

punarādyaṃ namo'nte ca bhagavati samālikhet |
vārtāliyugmaṃ vārāhi punaretaddvayaṃ likhet || 3 ||

vārāhamukhi ca dvandvaṃ sandhihīnaṃ tataḥ param |
andhe cāndhini saptārṇaṃ hṛdantena bhavetpriye || 4 ||

rundhe rundhinyato hṛcca jambhe jambhini hṛttataḥ |
mohe mohini hṛccāpi stambhe stambhini hṛttataḥ || 5 ||

etaduktvā maheśāni sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭa ca |
sānāmantaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgiti citta ca || 6 ||

cakṣurmukhagati proktvā jihvāstambhaṃ kurudvayam |
śīghraṃ vaśyaṃ kurudvandvaṃ vāgbhavaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ || 7 ||

ṭhakārasya catuskānte kavacāstrāgnivallabhā |
caturdaśottaraśataṃ mantravarṇā bhavanti hi || 8 ||

aiṃ glauṃ aiṃ namobhagavati vārtāli vārtāli vārāhi vārāhi vārāhamukhi 
vārāhamukhi andhe andhini namaḥ, rundhe rundhini namaḥ, jambhe jambhini namaḥ, 
mohi mohini namaḥ, stambhe stambhini namaḥ, sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ 
sarveṣāṃ sarvavākcittacakṣurmukhagatijihvāstambhaṃ kuru kuru śīghraṃ 
vaśyaṃ kuru kuru aiṃ glauṃ ṭhaṭhaṭhaṭha huṃ phaṭ svāhā | 114 varṇāḥ |

catuścatvāriṃśatibhirpadairnyāsastu kīrtitaḥ |
mātṛkāvannyasedvaktre padāni daśa mantravit || 9 ||

doḥpatsandhiṣu sāgreṣu nyasedviṃśatisaṃkhyakān |
padārṇānyatha vinyasya pārśvayorekamuttamam || 10 ||

anenaiva prakāreṇa mātṛkāvannyaset sudhīḥ |
tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsaṃ kuryād dehaviśuddhaye || 11 ||

vārtālyāstu padadvandvaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca tataḥ param |
vārāhiyugalaṃ devi śiromantra udāhṛtaḥ || 12 ||

vārāhamukhiyugalaṃ śikhā saptākṣaraṃ tataḥ |
kavacaṃ ca tataḥ saptavarṇairnetraṃ nyaset kramāt || 13 ||

pratyagrāruṇasaṅkāśapadmāntargatavāsinīm |
indranīlamahātejaḥprakāśāṃ viśvamātaram || 14 ||

kadamba muṇḍamālāḍhyanavaratnavibhūṣitām |
anarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭaśrīvirājitām || 15 ||

kauśeyārdhorukāṃ cārupravālamaṇibhūṣaṇām |
halena muśalenāpi varadenābhayena ca || 16 ||

virājitacaturbāhuṃ kapilākṣīṃ sumadhyamām |
nitambinīmutpalābhāṃ kaṭhoraghanasatkucām || 17 ||

kolānanām * * * * * * * * * * * * |

iti vārāhīranteśvarī || iti pañcapañcikāgaṇaḥ || atha ṣoḍaśanityāvivaraṇam -

atha vakṣye maheśāni nityāvivaraṇaṃ mahat |
kāmeśvarī mahābhedā bahavaḥ santi pārvati || 1 ||

tatra kāmeśvarī nityā kathyate bhuvi durlabhā |
tripureśīṃ samuccārya tārānte hṛtpadaṃ tataḥ || 2 ||

kāmeśvaripadaṃ coktvā tvicchākāmaphalaprade |
sarvasattvavaśaṃ proktvā kari sarvajagatpadam || 3 ||

kṣobhānte tu kare hūṃ hūṃ bāṇāṃśca tripureśvarīm |
viparītāṃ samālikhya vidyā ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā (?) || 4 ||

aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ oṃ namaḥ (hṛt) kāmeśvarīcchākāmaphalaprade 
sarvasattvavaśaṅkari sarvajagatkṣobhakare hūṃ hūṃ drāṃ drīṃ klīṃ blūṃ 
saḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ |

ādyabhāgatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā saḍaṅgakam |
kāmeśvarīvadṛṣyādi dhyānayantrārcanādikam || 5 ||

iti kāmeśvarīnityā || atha bhagamālinīnityā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni vidyāṃ śrībhagamālinīm |
vāgbhavaṃ bhagaśabdānte bhuge vāgbhavameva ca || 1 ||

bhaginyante vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagodari ca vāgbhavam |
bhagaklinne vāgbhavaṃ ca vāgbhavādau bhagāvahe || 2 ||

bhagaguhye vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagayoni ca vāgbhavam |
bhaganyante pātanīti vāgbhavaṃ bhagasarva ca || 3 ||

vadi vāgbhavamālikhya tato bhagavaśaṅkari |
vāgbhavaṃ bhagarūpe tadbhaganitye ca vāgbhavam || 4 ||

bhagaklinne vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagasvānte samālikhet |
rūpe sarvabhagānīti me hyānaya ca vāgbhavam || 5 ||

p. 136) bhagaklinnadrave cānte bhagaṃ kledaya cālikhet |
bhagaṃ drāvaya cālikhya bhagāmoghe bhageti ca || 6 ||

vicce bhagaṃ kṣobhayeti sarvasattvānbhageśvari |
vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagajaṃ likhet || 7 ||

vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagarbhe likhet |
vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagamoṃ likhet || 8 ||

bhagaklinne ca sarvāṇi bhagānyatha ca me likhet |
vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagaheṃ likhet || 9 ||

vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagaheṃ likhet |
bhagaklinne ca sarvāṇi bhagānyatha ca me likhet || 10 ||

vaśamānaya cālikhya bhagapañcamamanmatham |
bhagāntare bhagānte'tha harablemātmakamālikhet || 11 ||

bhagānte(pañca?pratha)maṃ kāmaṃ tato vai bhagamālinīm |
ṅe'ntāmuccārya vidyeyaṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇī || 12 ||

caturadhikaviṃśatyā dviśatena ca maṇḍitā |
varṇānāṃ bhagamāleyaṃ nityā sā phalasiddhidā || 13 ||

mantroddhārastu sugamaḥ |

ṛṣirasyāstu subhago gāyatraṃ chanda eva ca |
devateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priye || 14 ||

śaktiḥ strībījakaṃ blūṃ tu kīlakaṃ parameśvari |
ṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥ || 15 ||

kāmanyāsaṃ tathā bāṇanyāsaṃ kuryāttu pūrvavat |
kadambavanamadhyasthāmudyatsūryasamadyutim || 16 ||

nānābharaṇasampannāṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām |
pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca taulikīnakhalekhanīm || 17 ||

varadaṃ cābhayaṃ caiva dadhatīṃ viśvamātaram |

iti bhagamālinī || atha nityaklinnā -

bhuvaneśīṃ samuccārya nityaklinne madadrave |
vahnijāyā ca vidyeyaṃ rudravarṇā mahotkaṭā || 1 ||

hrīṃ nityaklinne madadrave svāhā iti |

ekena ca tathā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kramātpriye |
dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgānivinyaseddeśikottamaḥ || 2 ||

raktāṃ raktāṅgavasanāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām |
svidyatvaktrāṃ mahāghūrṇalocanāṃ ratnabhūṣitām || 3 ||

pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca mahābhītiharaṃ tathā |
dadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityāṃ padmāsanavirājitām || 4 ||

iti nityaklinnā nityā || atha bheruṇḍā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni bheruṇḍāṃ parameśvarīm |
bherākāraṃ samuccāryāṃkuśābhyāṃ taṃ ca veṣṭayet || 1 ||

antyahīnaṃ cavargaṃ tu caturdhā rephamaṇḍitam |
anugrahendubindvāḍhyaṃ tārasvāhodarasthitaḥ || 2 ||

manurdaśārṇo deveśi mahāviṣaharo bhavet |
oṃ kroṃbheḥkroṃ crauṃ chrauṃ jrauṃ jhrauṃ svāhā |

ṛṣirasya mahāviṣṇurgāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
devateyaṃ parāśaktistṛtīyaṃ bījamucyate || 3 ||

vahnijāyā ca śaktiḥ syāt kīlakaṃ sṛṇireva ca |
ṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam || 4 ||

candrakoṭipratīkāśāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravaiḥ |
nīlakaṇṭhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nānābharaṇabhūṣitām || 5 ||

indranīlasphuratkānti śikhivāhanaśobhitām |
pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca cchurikāṃ varādābhaye || 6 ||

bibhratīṃ hemasambaddhagāruḍāṅgadabhūṣitām |

iti bheruṇḍā nityā || atha vahnivāsinī nityā -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi nityāṃ vai vahnivāsinīm |
parāṃ vilikhya vahnyante vāsinyai nama ityapi || 1 ||

aṣṭārṇo'yaṃ maheśāni puruṣārthaprado manuḥ |
hrīṃ vahnivāsinyai namaḥ iti |

ṛṣirasya vasiṣṭhaḥ syādgāyatrī chanda ucyate |
ādyante bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ madhya eva ca || 2 ||

devi padatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyāṅgakaṃ nyaset |
dhyāyettāṃ ca suvarṇābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 3 ||

pāśāṃkuśau svastikaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca varadābhaye |
dadhatīṃ ratnamukuṭāṃ trailokyatimirāpahām || 4 ||

p. 137) iti vahnivāsinī nityā || atha mahā[vidye?vajre]śvarī nityā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni mahā[vidye?vajre]śvarīṃ parām |
nityaklinnāṃ samālikhya mukhe tāraṃ samālikhet || 1 ||

hṛllekhānte karomātma candrabījaṃ visargavat | 
caturdaśākṣarī vidyā * * * * * * * * ||

oṃ hrīṃkroṃsaḥ nityaklinne madadrave svāhā iti |

* * * * * * * * * ṛṣirbrahmā nigadyate |
gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devatā parameśvarī || 2 ||

ādyante bījaśaktī tu hṛllekhā kīlakaṃ bhavet |
catuṣkeṇa ca yugmena yugmena yugalena ca || 3 ||

yugalena ca yugmena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥ |
japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitām || 4 ||

māṇikyabhūṣaṇāṃ nityāṃ nānābhūṣāvibhūṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitām || 5 ||

abhayaṃ dadhatīṃ dhyāyet | iti mahā[vidye?vajre]śvarī nityā || atha śivadūtī 
nityā -

atha dūtīṃ pravakṣyāmi trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām |
bhuvaneśīṃ samuccārya śivadūtyai namo likhet || 1 ||

saptārṇā śivadūtīyaṃ trailokyasvāminī priye | hrīṃ śivadūtyai namaḥ iti |

ṛṣī rudrastu gāyatī chando'syā devatā śivā |
ādyante bījaśaktī ca madhye kīlakamucyate || 2 ||

vidyābhāgatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyāṅgakaṃ nyaset |
dūrvānibhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhasamāsanām || 3 ||

śaṅkhāribāṇacāpāṃśca sṛṇipāśau varābhaye |
dadhatīṃ cintayenityām ||

iti śivadūtī nityā || atha tvaritā nityā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni tvaritāṃ siddhidāyinīm |
tāraṃ parānte kavacaṃ khecachekṣaḥ samālikhet || 1 ||

strīṃ hūmātmakamuccārya kṣe parāmastrakaṃ likhet |
tvaritā ravivarṇeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā || 2 ||

oṃ hrīṃ hūṃ khecachekṣaḥ strīhūṃkṣehrīṃ phaṭ iti |

ṛṣirīśo virāṭchando devateyaṃ ca pārvati |
kavaca strīśaktibīje kīlakaṃ ca prakīrtitam || 3 ||

cacheyugmaṃ hṛcchirastu chekṣaḥyugmaṃ śikhā tataḥ |
kṣaḥstrīyugmaṃ ca kavacaṃ strīṃhūmātmayugaṃ tathā || 4 ||

hūṃkṣe netrāṇi vinyasya kṣephaḍastraṃ prakīrttam |
śyāmāṅgīṃ raktasatpāṇicaraṇāmbujaśobhitām || 5 ||

vṛṣalāhisumañjīrāṃ phaṭārantavibhūṣitām |
svarṇāṃśukāṃ svarṇabhūṣāṃ vaisyāhidvandvamekhalām || 6 ||

tanumadhyāṃ pīnavṛttakucayugmāṃ varābhaye |
dadhatīṃ śikhipicchānāṃ valayāṅgadaśobhitām || 7 ||

guñjāruṇāṃ nṛpāhīndrakeyūrāṃ raktabhūṣaṇām |
dvijanāgasphuratkarṇabhūṣāṃ mattāruṇekṣaṇām || 8 ||

nīlakuñcitadhammillavanapuṣpakalāpinīm |
kairātīṃ śikhipatrāḍhyaniketanavirājitām || 9 ||

sphuratsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ smaredbhayavināśinīm |
iti tvaritānityā || atha kulasundarī -

atha vakṣye maheśāni vidyāṃ śrīkulasundarīm |
bālākhyā tripureśānī pūrvasiṃhāsane sthitā || 1 ||

brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ pūjyā sā kulasundarī |
iti kulasundarī atha nityānityā -

atha vakṣye parāṃ nityāṃ puruṣārthapradāyinīm |
tripureśīṃ samuccāryaṃ nityākhyāṃ bhairavīṃ tathā || 1 ||

huṃkāratritayaṃ bāṇā vidyeyaṃ vā navākṣarī |

aiṃklīṃsauḥ hasakalaraḍaiḥ hasakalaraḍīṃ hasakalaraḍauḥ 
huṃhuṃhuṃdrāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥ iti | anyat tripureśīvat | iti nityā | atha 
nīlapatākā :

atha vakṣye maheśāni vidyāṃ nīlapatākinīm |
tāraṃ hṛtpadamābhāṣya kāmeśvarīparaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

kāmāṃkuśe padaṃ coktvā tataḥ kāmapatākike |
bhagavatyatha nīlānte patāke ca bhagāntike || 2 ||

śrīvi0 18

p. 138) vati hṛnmantramālikhya tato'sviti ca me likhet |
paramānte tathā guhye hrīṅkāratritayaṃ likhet || 3 ||

madane madanānte ca dehe trailokyamālikhet |
āveśaya tathā lekhyaṃ kavacāstrāgnivallabhā || 4 ||

ṣaṣṭavarṇā parameśāni devī nīlapatākinī |

oṃ hṛtkāmeśvari kāmāṃkuśe kāmapatākike bhagavati nīlapatāke bhagavati 
namo'stu me paramaguhye hrīṃhrīṃhrīṃ madane madanadehe trailokyamāveśaya 
huṃphaṭ svāhā ||

raktāṃ raktāṃśukaprauḍhāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām |
indranīlasphurannīlapatākāṃ kamale sthitām || 1 ||

kāmagraveyasaṃlagnasṛṇī ca varadābhaye |
dadhatīṃ parameśānīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām || 2 ||

iti nīlapatākā nityā || atha vijayā nityā -

atha vakṣye parāṃ vidyāṃ jayadāṃ vijayāṃ sadā |
śivacandrakhapāntāgnirudrasvaravibhūṣitam || 1 ||

bindunādakalākrāntaṃ vijayāyai namo likhet |
hasakhaphreṃ vijayāyai namaḥ iti |

ṛṣirasyāḥ śivaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā svayam |
bījaṃ hṛnmadhyavarṇāstu bījaśaktī tu kīlakam || 2 ||

ṣaḍdīrghasvarasambhinnabījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam |
ekavaktrāṃ daśabhujāṃ sarpayajñopavītinīm || 3 ||

daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ naramālāvibhūṣitām |
asthicarmāviśeṣāṃ tāṃ vahnikūṭasamaprabhām || 4 ||

vyāghrāmbarāṃ mahāprauḍhaśavāsanavirājitām |
raṇe smaraṇamātreṇa bhaktebhyo vijayapradām || 5 ||

śūlaṃ sarpaṃ ca ṭaṅkāsisṛṇighaṇṭāśanidvayam |
pāśamagnimabhītiṃ ca dadhānāṃ vijayāṃ smaret || 6 ||

iti vijayā nityā || atra sarvamaṅgalā -

atha vakṣye maheśāni nittāṃ vai sarvamaṅgalām |
jīvaṃ varuṇatārāḍhyaṃ sarvānte maṅgalāpadam || 1 ||

ṅe'ntaṃ hṛdayamālikhya navārṇā sarvamaṅgalā |
svoṃ sarvamaṅgalāyai namaḥ iti ||

ṛṣiśchando maheśāni gāyatraṃ chanda ucyate |
vidyābhāgatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam || 1 ||

śubhrapadmāsaneramyāṃ candrakundasamadyutim |
suprasannāṃ śaśimukhīṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām || 2 ||

anantamuktābharaṇāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravam |
varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ smaret saubhāgyavardhinīm || 3 ||

iti sarvamaṅgalā || atha jvālāmālinī -

jvālāmālāṃ pravakṣyāmi puruṣārthapradāṃ sadā |
oṃkārabījamuccārya namo bhagavatīti ca || 1 ||

jvālāmālinidevyante sarvabhūtāntasaṃ likhet |
hārakāri ca ke jātavedasīti jvalanti ca || 2 ||

jvalayugmaṃ prajvaleti yugaṃ hūmātmakaṃ tri(dvi)dhā |
vahni dvidhā ca kavacamastraṃ cāpi samālikhet || 3 ||

catvāriṃśadvarṇārūpā vasvarṇā ca kramādvadet |

oṃ namo bhagavati jvālāmālinī devi sarvabhūtasaṃhārakārike jātavedasi jvalanti 
jvala jvala prajvala prajvala huṃ huṃ rarahuṃ phaṭ iti ||

rephāstre bījaśaktī tu kīlakaṃ kavacaṃ priye |
ravisūryaśarāgāṣṭavedairaraṅgāni vinyaset || 1 ||

dvandvaśaḥ parameśāni vahnivarṇena veṣṭayet |
udyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇābharaṇabhūṣitām || 2 ||

mahāsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ jvālāmālāṃ karālinīm |
ariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭe triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā || 3 ||

pānapātraṃ ca varadaṃ dadhatīṃ saṃsmared yajet |
iti jvālāmālinī nityā || atha vicitrānityā -

atha vakṣye mahādevi vicitrāṃ viśvamātaram |
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ || 1 ||

cakrānugrahabindvindubhūṣitaṃ manumālikhet | cakauṃ iti |

ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya gāyatrī chanda ucyate |
vicitrā devatā bījaṃ kakāraḥ kīlakaṃ ca tu || 1 ||

p. 139) tārarājastu śaktiḥ syāt puruṣārthapradāyinī |
ṣaṭdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥ || 2 ||

śubhrāṅgī jñānadā nityaṃ vicitravasanā sadā |
vicitratilakā nityaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalā || 3 ||

varadābhayaśobhāḍhyā nānāratnadharā kvacit | 
iti vicitrā nityā || iti ṣoḍaśa nityāḥ |

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya-
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
saptamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 7 ||




|| aṣṭamaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

athāyatanavidyā -

brāhmyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ sauraṃ bauddhaṃ śaivaṃ ca darśanam |
pūrve ca dakṣiṇe paścādudagūrdhvaṃ krameṇa ca || 1 ||

āyatanāni pañca syuḥ pṛṣṭhe śāktaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ |

tatra prathamaṃ brāhmyadarśanabrahmagāyatrī pūrvāyatanavidyā -

atho vadāmi gāyatrīṃ tattvarūpāṃ trayīmayīm |
yayā prakāśyate brahmasaccidānandalakṣaṇam || 1 ||

praṇavādyā vyāhṛtayaḥ sapta syustatpadādikā |
caturviṃśatyakṣarātmā gāyatrī śirasā saha || 2 ||

sarvavedodghṛtaḥ sāro mantro'yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ |

iti brāhmyadarśanam || atha vaiṣṇavadarśanadakṣiṇāyatanavidyā - asya 
śrīnārāyaṇamantrasya sādhyanārāyaṇa ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ, 
śrīmahāviṣṇurdevatā, oṃ bījaṃ, namaḥ śaktiḥ, nārāyaṇāyeti kīlakaṃ 
śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ ||

oṃ kruddholkāya namaḥ, maholkāya0, vīrolkāya0, dyulkāya0, caṇḍolkāya0, 
sahasrolkāya0, iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || dhyānam:

udyatkoṭidivākarābhamaniśaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ paṅkajaṃ 
cakraṃ vibhratamindirāvasumatīsaṃśobhipārśvadvayam |
koṭīrāṅgadahārakuṇḍaladharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ kaustubhod-
dīptaṃ viśvadharaṃ svavakṣasi lasacchrīvatsacihnaṃ bhaje || 1 ||

oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya iti vaiṣṇavadarśanadakṣiṇāyatanavidyā || 

atha sauradarśanapaścimāyatanavidyā - asya śrīsūryamantrasya devabhāga 
ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śrī-ādityo devatā oṃ bījaṃ, ādityaḥ śaktiḥ, ghṛṇiḥ 
kīlakaṃ, śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

oṃ satyatejojvālāmāline huṃphaṭsvāhā, brahmatejojvālāmāline 
huṃphaṭsvāhā, viṣṇutejojvālāmāline huṃphaṭsvāhā, rudratejojvālāmāline 
huṃphaṭsvāhā, agnitejojvālāmāline huṃphaṭsvāhā, sarvatejojvālāmāline 
huṃphaṭsvāhā, - iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrāḥ | dhyānam:

raktābjayugmābhayadānahastaṃ keyūrahārāṅgadakuṇḍalāḍhyam |
māṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍe bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattrinetram || 2 ||

oṃ ghṛṇiḥsūrya ādityom, iti sauradarśanapaścimāyatanavidyā || atha 
bauddhadarśanottarāyatanavidyā - asyaśrībauddhamantrasya buddha ṛṣiḥ, 
triṣṭupcchandaḥ, śrībauddhodevatā, oṃ bījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥ, hrīṃ kīlakaṃ, 
śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

oṃ, hrīṃ, tāraya, tāraya, svāhā - oṃ hrīṃ tāraya tāraya svāhā iti 
ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || dhyānam:

purā purāṇānasurān vijetuṃ saṃbhāvayan pīṭharacihnaveṣam |
cakāraḥ yaḥ śāstramamoghakalpaṃ taṃ mūlabhūtaṃ praṇamāmi buddham || 1 
||

oṃ hrīṃ tārayatāraya svāhā - iti bauddhadarśanottarāyatana*idyā || atha 
śaivadarśanordhvāyatanavidyā - asya śrīśivamantrasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ, 
paṃktiśchandaḥ, paramaśivāṃ devatā, oṃ bījaṃ, namaḥ śaktiḥ, śivāya 
kīlakaṃ śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

sarvajñā0 nityatṛptāya0 anādibodhāya0 svatantrāya0 nityamaluptaśaktaye0 
nityamanantaśaktaye - iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | dhyānam:

p. 141) namo'stu sthāṇubhūtāya jyotirliṅgāmṛtātmane |
caturmūrtivapuṣkāya bhāsitāṅgāya śambhave || 1 ||


iti śaivadarśanordhvāyatanavidyā || atha śaktidarśanavidyā tu pradhānavidyaiva, 
kecidbhuvaneśvarīṃ vadanti, tadvidhānaṃ prāgevoktam | ityāyatanavidyāḥ || atha 
samayavidyāḥ aiṃklīṃsauḥ oṃ namaḥ (hṛt) kāmeśvari icchākāmaphalaprade 
sarvasattvavaśaṅkari sajarvagatkṣobhakari (raṃ) 
hūṃhūṃhūṃdrāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ || 1 ||

aiṃ hrīṃ sarvakāmārthasādhini vajreśvari vajrapade vajrapañjaramadhyagate 
hrīṃ klinne aiṃkroṃ nityamadadrave hrīṃ vajranityāyai namaḥ || 2 ||

tato bhagamālinīvidyā || 3 ||

klīṃ bhagavati blūṃ nitye kāmeśvari hrīṃ sarvasattvavaśaṅkari saḥ 
tripurabhairavī aiṃ vicce klīṃ mahātripurasundaryai namaḥ || 4 ||

iti catuḥsamayavidyāḥ || athāmnāyavidyānyāsaḥ:

pūrvadakṣiṇapāścātyairudagūrdhvakrameṇa ca |
pañcavaktraiḥ śivaproktāḥ pañca cāmnāyadevatāḥ || 1 ||

pañcasiṃhāsanaprauḍhāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ |

iti | tatrādau pūrvāmnāyavidyā unmanī - oṃ asya śrī-unmanīmantrasya 
dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣiḥ, paṅktiśchandaḥ, śrī-unmanī devatā, hsrīṃ bījaṃ, 
kalahrīṃ śaktiḥ, shrīṃ kīlakaṃ, śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni | dhyānaṃ saṃpatpradābhairavīvat | hsrīṃ 
shrīṃśrīṃkalahrīṃ iyutnmanī pūrvāmnāyavidyā || atha 
dakṣiṇāmnāyavidyā - asya śrībhoginīmantrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtirṛṣiḥ, 
paṅktiśchandaḥ, bhoginī devatā, aiṃ bījaṃ, sraiṃ śaktiḥ, klīṃ kīlakaṃ, 
śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

aiṃ klinne, klīṃ, madadrave kule hsauḥ - iti ṣaḍaṅgāni, 
dhyānamaghorabhairavīvat | aiṃ klinne klīṃ madadrave kule hsauḥ - iti 
dakṣiṇāmnyāyabhoginī vidyā || 

atha paścimāmnāyavidyā - asya śrīkubjikāmantrasya rudraṛṣiḥ, gāyatrī 
chandaḥ, kubjikā devatā, hasauḥ bījaṃ hasakhaphreṃ śaktiḥ, hasūṃ kīlakaṃ, 
śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hasakhaphreṃ hasauḥ oṃ namo 
bhagavati hasakhaphreṃ kubjikā hasrāṃhasrūṃ aghore ghore aghoramukhi chrāṃ 
chrīṃ kiṇikiṇi vicce hasauḥ hasakhaphreṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ - iti ṣaḍaṅgāni | 
dhyānaṃ ṣaṭkūṭābhairavīvat | iti paścimāmnāyavidyā kubjikā || 
athottarāmnāyavidyā kālikā - asya śrīkālikāmantrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ, uṣṇik 
chandaḥ, śrīkālikā devatā khaphreṃ bījaṃ īśvari śaktiḥ, mahācaṇḍayoga 
kīlakaṃ, śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | 

khaphrāṃ khaphrīmiti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | dhyānaṃ bhuvaneśvarībhairavīvat | 
khaphreṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvari ityuttarāmnāyavidyā kālikā || 

athordhvāmnāyakramaḥ - tatra parāprāsādamantra, tadaṅgatvena 
mahāṣoḍhānyāsaṃ kuryāt mahāṣoḍhānyāse'pi kāmaratinyāsa -  
antaḥkāmakalā - bahiḥkāmakalāmahāśaktinyāsa 
mūlaṣoḍaśārṇavidyānyāsāṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsānāmakaraṇe'dhikāro 
nāsti, tān nyāsānagre vadiṣyāmaḥ | idānīṃ mahāṣoḍhānyāso vakṣyate | 
tatrādāvaṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsaḥ - tadyathā :

īśānādīn nyasenmūrdhni cāṃguṣṭhādiṣu deśikaḥ |
īśānākhyaṃ tatpuruṣamaghoraṃ tadanantaram || 1 ||

vāmadevāhvayaṃ sadyamāsāṃ bījakramān biduḥ |
oṃkārādyaiḥ pañcahrasvairvilomāt sayutaṃ viyat || 2 ||

tattadaṃgulirbhūyastattadbījādikān nyaset |
śirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśe yathākramam || 3 ||

ūrdhvaprāgdakṣiṇodīcyapaścimeṣu mukheṣu tāḥ |
īśānādyā ṛcaḥ samyagaṃgulīṣu yathākramam || 4 ||

aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyaseddeśikasattamaḥ |
mūrdhāsyahṛdayāmbhojaguhyapādeṣu vā punaḥ || 5 ||

vaktreṣūrdhvādi vinyasedbhuyo'ṅgāni prakalpayet |
tārapañcakamuccārya sarvajñāya hṛdīritam || 6 ||

amṛtetejomālinī tṛptāyeti padaṃ punaḥ |
tadante brahmaśirase śiro'ṅgaṃ jvalitāntataḥ || 7 ||

śikhiśikhāya parato'nādibodhāya tacchikhā |
vajriṇe vajrahastāya svatantrāya tanucchadaḥ || 8 ||

p. 142) sauṃbauṃhaumiti saṃbhāvya parato'luptaśaktaye |
netramuktaṃ ślīṃpaśu huṃ phaḍanto'nantaśaktaye || 9 ||

astramuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādevaṃ samāhitaḥ |
tataḥ pravinyasedvidvānaṣṭātriṃśatkalāstanau || 10 ||

pūrvadakṣiṇapāścātyasaumyamadhyeṣu pañcasu |
vaktreṣu pañca vinyasedīśānasya kalāḥ kramāt || 11 ||

īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ śaśinī prathamā kalā |
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmaṅgadā tadanantaram || 12 ||

brahmādhipatiśabdānte brahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ punaḥ |
brahmeṣṭadā tṛtīyā syācchivo me astu tatparā || 13 ||

marīciḥ kathitā tantre caturthī ca sadāśivom |
aṃśumālinyatha parā praṇavādyā namontakāḥ || 14 ||

pūrvapaścimayāmyodagvaktreṣu tadanantaram |
catasro vinyasenmantrī puruṣasya kalāḥ kramāt || 15 ||

ādyā tatpuruṣāyeti vidmahe śāntirīritā |
mahādevāya śabdānte dhīmahi syāt tataḥ param || 16 ||

vidyā dvitīyā kathitā tanno rudraḥ padaṃ tataḥ |
pratiṣṭhā kathitā paścāt tṛtīyā syāt pracodayāt || 17 ||

nivṛttistatpadāḥ sarvāḥ praṇavādyā namontakāḥ |
hṛdgrīvāṃsadvaye nābhau kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi || 18 ||

aghorasya kalā hyetā aṣṭau mantrī yathāvidhi |
aghorebhyastamā pūrvamīritā prathamā kalā || 19 ||

atha ghorebhya ityante mohā syāt tadanantaram |
ghorānte syāt kṣamā paścāt tṛtīyā parikīrtitā || 20 ||

ghoratarebhyo nidrā syāt sarvataḥ śarvatatparā |
vyādhistu pañcamī proktā sarvebhyastadanantaram || 21 ||

mṛtyurnigaditā ṣaṣṭhī namaste astu tatparā |
kṣudhā syāt saptamī proktā rudrarūpebhyastṛṣṇikā || 22 ||

guhyaliṅgoruyugalajānujaṅghāsphicoryuge |
kaṭyāṃ pārśvadvaye caiva vāmadevakalā nyaset || 23 ||

prathamā vāmadevāya namontā syādrajā kalā |
syājjyeṣṭhāya namo rakṣā dvitīyā parikīrtitā || 24 ||

syādrudrāya namaḥ paścāt tṛtīyā ratirīritā |
kālāya nama ityante mālinī parikīrtitā || 25 ||

kalā kāmyā pañcamī syāt tato vikaraṇāya ca |
namaḥ saṃyaminī ṣaṣṭhī kathitā tadanantaram || 26 ||

balakriyā samādiṣṭā balavikaraṇāya ca |
namo vṛddhiraṣṭamī syādbalānte ca sthitā kalā || 27 ||

paścāt pramathanāyānte namo rātrirudīritā |
sarvabhūtadamanāya namo'nte bhrāmiṇī kalā || 28 ||

manonte mohinī proktā tantrajñairdvādaśī kalā |
unmanāya namaḥ paścājjvarā proktā trayodaśī || 29 ||

praṇavādyāścaturthyantā namontāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
pādadostalanāsāsu mūrdhni bāhuyuge nyaset || 30 ||

sadyojātodbhavāḥ samyagaṣṭau mantrī kalāḥ kramāt |
sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi siddhiḥ syāt prathamā kalā || 31 ||

sadyojātāya vai bhūyo namaḥ syādṛddhiḥrīritā |
bhave dyutistṛtīyā syādabhave tadanantaram || 32 ||

lakṣmīścaturthī kathitā tato'nādibhave bhavet |
medhā syāt pañcamī proktā kalā bhūyo bhavasva mām || 33 ||

prajñā samāhitā ṣaṣṭhī bhavānte tu prabhā kalā |
udbhavāya namaḥ paścāt sudhā syādaṣṭamī kalā || 34 ||

praṇavādyāścaturthyantāḥ kalāḥ sarvā namo'ntakāḥ |
aṣṭātriṃśatkalāḥ proktāḥ pañcabrahmapadādikāḥ || 35 ||

iti vinyastadeho'sau bhavedgaṅgādharaṃ svayam |
anantacandrabhuvano bindurbinduyugānvitaḥ || 36 ||

śrīprāsādaparāmantro bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ |
parāprāsādamantrastu sādiruktaḥ kuleśvari || 37 ||

prakāśānandarūpatvāt pratyakṣaphalado yataḥ |

iti | anantacandro nādabinduḥ, bhuvana aukāraḥ, bindurhakāraḥ, binduyugaḥ 
sakārastena hasauṃ iti siddham || 

idaṃ sādiścet shauṃ iti siddham | idaṃ bījadvayaṃ visargayuktamiti 
kvaciduddhāraḥ |

paraśambhurṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam |
ardhanārīśvaro devo devatā parikīrtitā || 1 ||

ṣaṭdīrghayuktabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsamaṅgaṣoḍhāpuraḥsaram || 2 ||

etadaṅgatayā kuryāt siddhikāmaḥ samāhitaḥ |

p. 143) iti | kulārṇave -

aṅgaṣoḍhāṃ kuleśāni kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ || 1 ||

iti atrāṅgaṣoḍhāṣṭātriṃśatkalānyāsastaduddhāraḥ prāgevoktaḥ |
kevalapañcabrahmanyāsa ityapare |

mahāṣoḍhābhidhasyāsya ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥ |
jagatī chanda ākhyātamardhanārīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 1 ||

devatā ca samuddiṣṭā śrīvidyāṅgatayā tathā |
viniyogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ || 2 ||

athāṅganyāsaḥ | tatrāṃguṣṭhayoḥ oṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃhasauṃ shauṃ hauṃ 
īśānāya namaḥ | tarjanyoḥ 5 heṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ | madhyamayoḥ 5 huṃ-
aghorāya namaḥ | anāmikayoḥ 5 hiṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ | kaniṣṭhikayoḥ 5 haṃ 
sadyojātāya namaḥ | evaṃ mūrdhavadanahṛdguhyapādadeśeṣu krameṇa nyaset | 
ūrdhvaprāgdakṣiṇodīcyapaścimamukheṣu ca | punaraṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntam | 
punarapi mūrdhāsyahṛdayāmbhojaguhyapādeṣu | punarapyūrdhvādimukhādiṣu 
vinyasya hasāṃhasīṃmityādinā ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | tataḥ shāṃshīmityādināpi 
ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | tataḥ 5 sarvajñāya, 5 amṛtetejomālinī nityatṛptāya, 5 
brahmaśirase svāhā jvalitaśikhiśikhāyānādibodhāya, 5 vajriṇe 
vajrahastāyasvatantrāya, 5 sauṃbauṃhauṃnityamaluptaśaktaye, 5 
śrīṃślīṃpaśuhuṃphaṭ nityamanantaśaktaye, - iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrānaṃguṣṭhāditalāntaṃ karayorvinyasya 
hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣvāpi nyaset | tataḥ prāguktarītyā aṣṭātriṃśatkalā api 
vinyasya dhyāyet | dhyānamagre vakṣyate | atha mahāṣoḍhānyāsaḥ :

prapañco bhuvanaṃ mūrtirmantradaivatamātaraḥ |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayo nyāsaḥ sarvanyāsottamottamaḥ || 1 ||

tatrādau prapañcanyāsaḥ - oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hasauḥshauḥ aṃ 
prapañcarūpāyai śriye namaḥ, ityādiprayogaḥ prāguktarītyāvagantavyaḥ | iti 
prapañcanyāsaḥ | kulārṇave :

tritāramūlasakalaprapañcasya svarūpataḥ |
āyai parāmbādevyai ca namo'stu vyāpakaṃ nyaset || 1 ||

iti | 5 mūlaṃ0 sakalaprapañcasvarūpāyai parāmbādevyai namo'stu iti 
vyāpakaṃ nyasedityarthaḥ | tathā -

prapañcanyāsa evaṃ syādbhuvananyāsa ucyate |
tritāramūlavidyānte amāṃ-imatalaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

lokaṃ ca nilayaṃ caiva śatakoṭipadaṃ tataḥ |
guhyādyayoginīmūladevānte'yutaṃ vadet || 2 ||

vadedādhāraśaktyambādevyai hṛtpādayornyaset |

iti | 5 aṃ-āṃ-iṃ atalalokanilayaśatakoṭiguhyādyayoginīmūladevatāyutādhāra-
śaktyambādevyai namaḥ iti pādayornyasedityarthaḥ |

imumūṃ vitalaṃ lokaguhyānte śatasaṃjñakam |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā gulphayorvinyasetpriye || 3 ||

ṛṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ sutalaṃ paramaguhyaṃ vācintyasaṃjñakam |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā jaṅghayorvinyaset priye || 4 ||

ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ mahātalaṃ ca mahāghyāditantrakam |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā devi jānvoḥ pravinyaset || 5 ||

omauṃ talātalaparamaguhyaṃ svādhiṣṭhānakam |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktamūrvordeveśi vinyaset || 6 ||

aṃ aḥ rasātalaṃ caiva rahasyaṃ jñānasaṃjñakam |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā guhyadeśe pravinyaset || 7 ||

kavargamapi pātālaṃ sarahasyataraṃ kriyām |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā mūlādhāre pravinyaset || 8 ||

cavargaṃ bhūtirahasyaṃ ca śrīḍākinīmapi |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā svādhiṣṭhāne nyaset priye || 9 ||

ṭavargaṃ bhuvarmahārahasyapadānte rākiṇīmapi |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā nābhideśe nyaset priye || 10 ||

tavargaṃ svargaparamarahasyaṃ lākinīmapi |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā hṛdaye vinyaset priye || 11 ||

pavargaṃ ca mahāguptaṃ kākinīmapi ca kramāt |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tālumūle nyaset priye || 12 ||

yavargaṃ ca janaṃ guptataraṃ śrīśākinīmapi |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā ājñāyāṃ vinyaset priye || 13 ||

śavargaṃ ca tapaścātiguptaṃ śrīhākinīmapi |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā lalāṭe vinyaset priye || 14 ||

laṃkṣaḥ satyamahāguptaṃ yākinīmapi ca priye |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā brahmarandhre nyaset priye || 15 ||

p. 144) tritāramūlamantrānte caturdaśabhuvaṃ vadet |
nādhipāyai śrīparāmbādevyai hṛd vyāpakaṃ nyaset || 16 ||

kṛtvaivaṃ bhuvananyāsaṃ mūrtinyāsamathācaret |
keśavo nārāyaṇo mādhavagovindaviṣṇavaḥ || 17 ||

madhusūdanasaṃjñaśca syāt trivikramavāmanau |
śrīdharastu hṛṣikeśaḥ padmanābho dāmodaraḥ || 18 ||

vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ |
akṣarādyeṣṭadeśāno ugrordhvanayanā tathā || 19 ||

ṛddhiśca rupiṇī luptā lūnadoṣaikanāyikā |
aikāriṇī caughavatī sarvakāmāñjanaprabhā || 20 ||

asthimālādharā ceti samproktāḥ svaradevatāḥ |
bhavaḥ śarvaśca rudraśca paśupatiścogra eva ca || 21 ||

mahādevastathā bhīma īśānastatpuruṣāhvayaḥ |
aghorasadyojātau ca vāmadeva itīritāḥ || 22 ||

karabhadrā khagabalā garimādiphalapradā |
dharmapraśamanī paṃktināsā candrārdhadhāriṇī || 23 ||

chandomayī jagatsthānā jharattārā tataḥ param |
jñānānādāṭaṅkaḍhakkādharā ṭhaṅkāraḍāmarī || 24 ||

kabhādīnāṃ ṭhaḍāntānāṃ varṇānāṃ devatāstvimāḥ |
brahmā prajāpatirvedhāḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ || 25 ||

vidhātā ca viriñcaśca sraṣṭā ca caturānanaḥ |
hiraṇyagarbha ityuktāḥ kramād brahmādayo'pyamī || 26 ||

yakṣiṇī rañjanīlakṣmīrvajriṇī śaktidhāriṇī |
ṣaḍādhārālayā sarvanāyikā hasitānanā || 27 ||

lalitā ca kṣamā ceti proktā yavargadevatāḥ |
tritāramūlamantrānte svarādyakṣaraśaktikān || 28 ||

caturthīnamasā yuktān mastake cānane nyaset |
svaskandhapārśvakukṣyūrujānujaṅghāpadeṣu ca || 29 ||

dakṣādivāmaparyantaṃ vinyaset parameśvari |
kabhādyarṇayutān mantrī ṭhaḍāntān śaktisaṃyutān || 30 ||

pādapārśvabāhukaṇṭhapañcavaktreṣu vinyaset |
daśādhāreṣu brahmādīn yādīñ śaktiyutān nyaset || 31 ||

tritāramūlamantrānte śrītrimūrtyātmikā nyaset |
āyai parāmbādevyai ca namaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ nyaset || 32 ||

tritāramūlaṃ aṃ-āṃ-iṃ ekalakṣaṃ ca koṭi ca |
bhedaśca praṇavādyekākṣarātmākhilamantrataḥ || 33 ||

tato'dhidevatāyai syāt sakalaṃ ca phalapradam |
āyai tathaikakūṭeśvaryambādevyai namo vadet || 34 ||

iti | atra mūrtinyāsottaraṃ mantranyāsoddhārakramaḥ pradarśitaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ 
śrīṃ hsauḥ shauḥ aṃ āṃ iṃ ekalakṣakoṭibhedapraṇavādyekākṣarātmakā-
khilamantrādhidevatāyai sakalaphalapradāyai ekakūṭeśvaryambādevyai namaḥ, 
iti mūlādhāre nyasediti prayogaḥ || tathā :

īmumūmādi haṃsādidvikūṭaṃ pūrvavatparam |
ṛ ṝṃ ḷmādi vahnyāditrikūṭaṃ pūrvavatparam || 35 ||

ḹmemaiṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ candrādi pūrvavatparam |
omaumaṃmaḥpañcalakṣaṃ sūryādi pūrvavatparam || 36 ||

kaṃkhaṃgaṃ caiva ṣaḍlakṣaṃ skandādi pūrvavatparam |
ghaṃṅaṃcaṃ saptalakṣaṃ gaṇeśādi pūrvavatparam || 37 ||

chaṃjaṃjhamaṣṭalakṣaṃ vaṭukādi pūrvavatparam |
ñaṃ ṭaṃṭhaṃ navalakṣaṃ ca brahmādi pūrvavatparam || 38 ||

ḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ daśalakṣaṃ ca viṣṇvādi pūrvavatparam |
taṃthaṃdamekādaśalakṣaṃ rudrādi pūrvavatparam || 39 ||

dhaṃnaṃpaṃ dvādaśalakṣaṃ vāṇyādi pūrvavatparam |
(phaṃbaṃbhaṃ trayodaśalakṣaṃ lakṣmyādi pūrvavatparam) || 40 ||

maṃyaṃraṃ caturdaśalakṣaṃ gauryādi pūrvavatparam |
laṃvaṃśaṃ pañcadaśalakṣaṃ durgādi pūrvavatparam || 41 ||

ṣaṃsaṃhaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ traipurādi ca pūrvavat |
tritāramūlamantrānte sakalāṃ mātṛkāṃ vadet || 42 ||

sakalādi ca mantrādhidevatāyai parāmbikā |
devyai hṛdvyāpakaṃ kuryānmantranyāse maheśvari || 43 ||

ādhāraliṅgayornābhihṛtkaṇṭhājñendutatparaḥ |
nirodhikāyāmardhendau bindau caiva kalāpade || 44 ||

unmanyādiṣu vaktreṣu nādanādāntayorapi |
dhruvamaṇḍaladeśe ca vinyaset kulanāyike || 45 ||

tritāramūlamantrānte sarvamantrātmikāpadam |
āyai devyai parādi syāt pūrvavadvyāpakaṃ nyaset || 46 ||

iti mantranyāsaḥ | atha devatānyāsaḥ -

mantranyāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ devatānyāsamācaret |
tritāramūlamantrānte amāṃ sahasrakoṭi ca || 47 ||

p. 145) yoginīkulaśabdānte sevitāyai padaṃ vadet |
nivṛttyambāpadaṃ devyai nama ityuccaret priye || 48 ||

prayogastu oṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃhsauḥshauḥ sahasrakoṭiyoginīkulasevitāyai 
nivṛttyambādevyai namaḥ ityādi |

iṃ īṃ yoginīpratiṣṭhāṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
uṃ ūṃ tapasvividyāṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavaccaret || 49 ||

ṛṃ ṝṃ śāntaṃ tathā śāntiṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
ḷṃ ḹṃ muniṃ tathā śāntyatītāṃ śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat || 50 ||

eṃ aiṃ devaṃ ca hṛllekhānte śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
oṃ auṃ rakṣaḥkulānte ca gaganāṃ pūrvavat priye || 51 ||

aṃ aḥ vidyādharaṃ raktāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
kaṃkhaṃ siddhaṃ mahocchuṣmāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret || 52 ||

gaṃghaṃ sādhyaṃ karālāṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
ṅaṃcaṃ tathāpsarojayāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret || 53 ||

chaṃjaṃ gandharvavijayāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
jhaṃ ñaṃ guhyakaśabdānte ajitāṃ pūrvavatparam || 54 ||

ṭaṃṭhamaparājitāyakṣā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
ḍaṃḍhaṃ kinnaravāmāmbā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam || 55 ||

ṇaṃtaṃ ca pannagaṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
thaṃdaṃ ca pitṛraudryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat param || 56 ||

dhaṃnaṃ gaṇeśamāyāṃ ca śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
paṃphaṃ bhaivaraśabdānte kuṇḍalī pūrvavat param || 57 ||

baṃbhaṃ vaṭukakālī ca śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
maṃyaṃ ca kṣetraśabdānte kālarātrī ca pūrvavat || 58 ||

raṃlaṃ pramathabhagavatī śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
vaṃśaṃ brahmāpi sarveśvaryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat || 59 ||

ṣaṃsaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca sarvajñāṃ śeṣa ca pūrvavatparam |
haṃlaṃ rudraḥ sarvakartrī śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam || 60 ||

kṣaṃ carācaraśaktiṃ ca śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam |
aṃguṣṭhagulphajaṅghāsu jānūrukaṭipārśvake || 61 ||

stanakakṣakaraskandhakarṇamūrdhasu ca kramāt |
dakṣabhāgādivāmāntaṃ vinyaset kulanāyike || 62 ||

tritāramūlamantrānte sakalāṃ mātṛkāṃ vadet |
samastadevatādhiṃ ca pāyai śrī ca parāmbikām || 63 ||

devyai nama iti brūyādvyāpakaṃ vinyaset priye |
devatānyāsa evaṃ syānmātṛnyāsastathocyate || 64 ||

tritāramūlamantrānte kavargānantakoṭi ca |
bhūcarīkulaśabdānte sahitāyaipadaṃ vadet || 65 ||

āṃkṣāmante maṅgalāmbādevyai nama itīrayet |
āṃkṣāmante tu brahmāṇyambādevyai ca padaṃ vadet || 66 ||

anantakoṭibhūteti kulānte sahitāya ca |
akṣaṃ maṅgalanāthāya aṃkṣamante'sitāṅga ca || 67 ||

bhairavānte tu nāthāya nama ityuccaret priye |
cavargaṃ khecarīmīlāṃ carcikāṃ ca maheśvarīm || 68 ||

vetālaṃ ceti nāthāya nama ityuccaret priye |
śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tato vakṣye maheśvari || 69 ||

ṭavargaṃ pātālacarīmūṃhāṃ yogeśvarīṃ vadet |
kaumārīṃ piśācamūhāṃ vadedyogeśacaṇḍakau || 70 ||

tavargaṃ dikcarīṃ ṝsāṃ harasiddhāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīm |
apasmāraṃ harasiddhiṃ krodha ca pūrvavat param || 71 ||

pavargaṃ giricarīmaiṃśāṃ tataḥ kilikileti ca |
indrāṇīṃ vaṭuka eṃśaṃ kilikilānte kapālinam || 73 ||

śavargānte vanacarīmauṃvāṃ kālādirātri ca |
cāmuṇḍāṃ pretamāvaṃ ca kālarātraśca bhīṣaṇam || 75 ||

saṃhārabhairavaṃ caiva śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret |
tritāramūlamantrānte mātṛbhairavaśabdataḥ || 76 ||

adhipāyai parādevyai namo'ntaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyaset |
mātṛnyāsaṃ maheśāni aṣṭādhāreṣu vinyaset || 77 ||

evaṃ nyastatanurdevi dhyāyeddevamananyadhīḥ |
amṛtārṇavamadhyasthasvarṇadvīpe manorame || 78 ||

kalpavṛkṣavanāntaḥsthe navamāṇikyamaṇḍape |
navaratnamaye śrīmatsiṃhāsanagatāmbje || 79 ||

trikoṇāntaḥsamāsīnaṃ candrasūryasamaprabham |
ardhāmbikāsamāyuktaṃ pravibhaktavibhūṣaṇam || 80 ||

śrīvi0 19

p. 146) koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ sadā ṣoḍaśavārṣikam |
mandasmitamukhāmbhojaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam || 81 ||

divyāmbarasragālepaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam |
pānapātraṃ ca cinmudrāṃ triśūlaṃ pustakaṃ karaiḥ || 82 ||

vidyāsaṃsiddhiṃ bibhrāṇaṃ sadānandamukhekṣaṇam |
mahāṣoḍhoditāśeṣadevatāgaṇasevitam || 83 ||

evaṃ cittāmbuje dhyāyedardhanārīśvaraṃ śivam |
puṃrūpaṃ vā smareddevi strīrūpaṃ vā vicintayet || 84 ||

athavā niṣkalaṃ dhyāyet saccidānandalakṣaṇam |
sarvatejomayaṃ dhyāyet sacarācaravigraham || 85 ||

tataḥ saṃdarśayenmudrādaśakaṃ parameśvari |
yoniṃ liṅgaṃ ca surabhiṃ hetimudrācatuṣṭayam || 86 ||

vanamālāṃ nabhomudrāṃ mahāmudrāmiti kramāt |

iti | tataḥ śirasi śrīguruṃ dhyāyet | yathā -

sahasradalapaṅkaje sakalaśītaraśmiprabhaṃ 
varābhayakarāmbujaṃ vimalagandhapuṣpāmbaram |
prasannavadanekṣaṇaṃ sakaladevatārūpiṇaṃ 
smarecchirasi haṃsagaṃ tadabhidhānapūrvaṃ gurum || 1 ||

iti | atha mahāṣoḍhānyāsaphalaṃ śrīkulārṇave -

evaṃ nyāse kṛte devi sākṣāt paraśivo bhavet |
mantrī nacātra sandeho nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ || 1 ||

mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti dine dine |
devāḥ sarve namasyanti taṃ namāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ yatramantrī nyasettataḥ |
divyakṣetraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ samantād daśayojanam || 3 ||

kṛtvā nyāsamimaṃ devi yatra gacchati mānavaḥ |
tatra śrīrvijayo lābhaḥ sanmānaṃ pauruṣaṃ priye || 4 ||

mahāṣoḍhākṛtanyāsaṃ nodvīkṣya yo'bhivandate |
samāsānmṛtyumāpnoti yadi trātā śivaḥ svayam || 5 ||

vajrapañjaranāmānamenaṃ nyāsaṃ karoti yaḥ |
divyāntarikṣabhūśailajalāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 6 ||

uddaṇḍabhūtavetāladevarakṣograhādayaḥ |
bhayagrastena manasā nekṣante sādhakaṃ priye || 7 ||

mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ |
devāḥ sarve prakūrvanti ṛṣayaśca munīśvarāḥ || 8 ||

bahunoktena kiṃ devi suśiṣyāya prakāśayet |
akṣayāṃ labhate siddhiṃ rahasi nyāsamācaret || 9 ||

asmātparataraḥ sākṣāddevatābhāvasiddhaye |
loke nāsti na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||

ūrdhvāmnāyapraveśaśca parāprāsādacintanam |
mahāṣoḍhāparijñānaṃ nālpasya tapasaḥ phalam || 11 ||

iti mahāṣoḍhānyāsaḥ || atha turīyavidyā - sā tu parā ṣoḍaśī | 
sauḥśrīṃhrīṃklīṃ-aiṃsauḥ oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ ka-e-īlahasakahalasakalahrīṃ sauḥ-
aiṃklīṃhrīṃśrīṃsauḥ iti turīyavidyā || atha caraṇavidyāḥ -

praṇavaṃ ca tritāraṃ ca haṃsaḥ śivaḥ hsauḥ padam |
so'haṃ turīyavidyāṃ ca cidānandapadaṃ tataḥ || 12 ||

tathā jyotirahaṃ ceti prathamaṃ parikīrtitam |
prāgvat sarvaṃ samuccārya saccidānandaśabdataḥ || 13 ||

tato jyotirahaṃ ceti dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam |
tataḥ prāgvat samuccāryāhamevāsmīti coccaret || 14 ||

tṛtīyaṃ tu samuddiṣṭaṃ caraṇatrayamīritam |
saṃghaṭṭamudrayā mūrdhni vinyased deśikottamaḥ || 15 ||

iti caraṇatrayam || atha śaṃbhucaraṇam -

praṇavaṃ ca tritāraṃ ca praṇavaṃ yo'hamasmyatha |
ahamasmīti brahmāhamasmi so'haṃ samīrayet || 16 ||

svacchaprakāśaśabdānte paripūrṇaparāpara |
mahāprakāśaparyante pūrṇānandapadaṃ tataḥ || 17 ||

nāthaśrīpādukāmante pūjayāmīti mūrdhani |

nyasediti śeṣaḥ | śambhucaraṇam || pañcāmbāstu prāgeva prapañcitāḥ | 
unmanākāśādinavanāthāḥ ātmānandādinavanāthāḥ 
svapāramparyādikramaśca prāgevoktāḥ || atha ṣoḍaśa mūlavidyāḥ:

(1) praṇavāditritāraṃ ca svaccheti padamīrayet |
prakāśaparipūrṇeti parāparamahāpi ca || 1 ||

p. 147) siddhividyākulaṃ yogi māyābījaṃ kuleti ca |
yoginīmūlavidyāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca || 2 ||

(2)śrīprāsādaparābījaṃ svātmānaṃ bodhayadvayam |
parāprāsādabījaṃ ca śrīprāsādapareti ca || 3 ||

ambeti mūlavidyāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca |
(3)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ makaradhvajaḥ || 4 ||

klinne klediniśabdānte mahāmadapadadrave |
kāmarājadvayaṃ mohayadvayaṃ kāmarājahṛt || 5 ||

vahnijāyāmiyaṃ vidyātirahasyātiyoginī |
(4)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca haṃsaḥ svaccheti vai vadet || 6 ||

ānandaparamaṃ haṃsaḥpadaṃ ca paramātmane |
svāhā hsau hsau vidyeyaṃ śambhavīmūla pūrvikā || 7 ||

(5)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca māyā nityaṃ sphuratteti |
tmacaitanyānandamayi mahābindupadaṃ vadet || 8 ||

vyāpakānte mātṛpadaṃ svarūpiṇipadaṃ vadet |
praṇavāditritāraṃ mīmiyaṃ vai kathitā budhaiḥ || 9 ||

hṛllekhāmūlavidyeti (6)praṇavādi tritārakam |
svacchaprakāśātmike ca māyāṃ kulamahāpadam || 10 ||

mālinīvākkulagarbhamātṛke bhuvaneśvarīm |
samayānte ca vimale śrībījamiyamīśvari || 11 ||

samayānte ca vimalamūlavidyeti kathyate |
(7)tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ haṃsastato nityaprakāśa ca || 12 ||

ātmike kulakuṇḍeti lini ājñāpadaṃ tataḥ |
siddhe mahābhairavīti ātmānaṃ bodhayadvayam || 13 ||

ambe ca bhagavatyante māyā humiyamīśvari |
parabodhinī mūlānte vidyā syāt parameśvari || 14 ||

(8)tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ tāraṃ mokṣaṃ itīrayet |
kulapañcākṣarīmūlavidyeti paripaṭhyate || 15 ||

(9)tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ proktvā lopā pañcadaśākṣarī |
caitanyatripurāmūlavidyeyaṃ parameśvari || 16 ||

(10)tāraṃ tāratrayasyānte vāgbhavaṃ bījamuddharet |
śuddhasūkṣma-nirākāra-nirvikalpapadaṃ tataḥ || 17 ||

parabrahmasvarūpyante ṇiklīmante parāpadam |
nandaśaktipadaṃ bālātṛtīyaṃ bījamuddharet || 18 ||

iyaṃ tu śāmbhavānandanāthānuttarakaulinī |
mūlavidyeti kathitā sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ || 19 ||

(11) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ haṃsaḥ so'haṃ svacchāntananda ca |
paramānte haṃsaparamātmane vahnivallabhā || 20 ||

gurūttamavimarśinī mūlavidyā samīritā |
(12) tāraṃ tāratrayasyānte'pnāmākhyapadaṃ bhavet || 21 ||

vyomātītapadaṃ nāthaparāparapadaṃ tataḥ |
vyomātītapadaṃ vyomeśvaryambāpadamuddharet || 22 ||

anāmākhyāmūlavidyā prokteyaṃ parameśvarī |
(13) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ vāṇīṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ bījamuddharet || 23 ||

proktā saṃketasārākhyā mūlavidyā maheśvari |
(14) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ māyāṃ tato bhagavatīti ca || 24 ||

vicce vāgvādinī ceti kāmarājaṃ mahāhrada |
mahāmātaṅgini vāṇīṃ klinne blūṃstrīṃ likhediyam || 25 ||

anuttarādivāgvādinīvidyā parikīrtitā |
(15) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ prāsādaparāṃ khecarīṃ tataḥ || 26 ||

sampatpradāyā madhyaṃ tu śrīprāsādaparāṃ likhet |
iyaṃ tu kathitā mūlavidyānuttaraśāṅkarī || 27 ||

(16) turīyavidyāmuccārya sarvānandamayādikam |
uddharet parameśāni mahātripurasundarī || 28 ||

mūlavidyeyamīśāni proktābhīṣṭaphalapradā |

iti ṣoḍaśa vidyāḥ || atha ṣaḍādhāravidyāḥ, tatra parameśvaramantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuddhṛtya sarahasrauṃ vāgbhavaṃ tataḥ |
phreṃbījaṃ ca tato lekhyaṃ pareśvaramanurmataḥ || 1 ||

ājñāyāṃ karṇikāmadhye parameśvaramanu nyaset |

iti parameśvaramantraḥ || atha viśveśvaramantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuccārya hasrūṃ vāgbhavamuddharet |
kubjike phreṃ viśuddhau tu vicceśvaramahāmanuḥ || 1 ||

iti vicceśvaramantraḥ | atha haṃseśvaramantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuccārya hasraiṃ vāgbhavamuddharet |
kubjikāyai padaṃ caiva hsaphraṃ vicce tathaiva ca || 1 ||

haṃseśvaramahāmantrastvanāhatapade sthitaḥ |

p. 148) iti haṃseśvaramantraḥ || atha saṃvarteśamantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuddhṛtya hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃhrīṃ tathaiva ca |
hasroṃkṣrāṃkṣrīṃ tathaivakṣrīṃ kiṇidvandvamataḥ param || 1 ||

hasaphrāṃ hasaphramato hasphrīṃ vicce hrauṃ ca hasadvayam |
hasaphreṃ hasakṣamalavayarūṃ praṇavameva ca || 2 ||

hasakṣamalavān procya yarāṃ hasa tathaiva ca |
kṣamalān vayarūṃ caiva tadbījaṃ vāmanetrayuk || 3 ||

vāgbhavaṃ ca tato hasrīṃhasrūṃhasrāṃ ca tataḥ param |
hrīṃhraṃhrāṃhlāṃ tato vāṇīṃ nitye bhagavatīti ca || 4 ||

hasaphraṃ kuleśvari hrāṃhrūṃhlīṃhlāṃhvīṃhuṃ tataḥ param |
hyehauṃṅañaṇanān me ca kṣrāṃkṣrīṃkṣrūṃkṣrastathaiva ca || 5 ||

kṣraṃ śrīphaṭ ca hsrauṃ phreṃ ca aghoramukhi coccaret |
kubjikāyai tataśchrāṃ chraṃchrīṃ ghore ca tataḥ param || 6 ||

aghore vāyuvahnīndrān vaṃsaṃhaṃ ca kiṇidvayam |
mahākiṇiyugaṃ vicce saṃvarteśamahāmanuḥ || 7 ||

svādhiṣṭhāne mahācakre nyastavyaḥ sādhakottamaiḥ |

iti saṃvarteśvaramantraḥ || atha dvīpeśvaramantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuccārya hasaphrūṃ vāgbhavaṃ tataḥ |
rigaṭini padaṃ caiva piṅgaṭini padaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

vicce mantro'yamudito dvīpeśasya varānane |
maṇipūrakacakre tu nyastavyaḥ sādhakottamaiḥ || 2 ||

iti dvīpeśvaramantraḥ || atha navātmeśvaramantraḥ -

tārapañcakamuccārya sahakṣamalaveti ca |
rayūṃ namo bhagavati hasphreṃ bījamataḥ param || 1 ||

kubjikāyai tato hrāṃhrūṃhrīṃ caiva ḍñaṇanme |
aghoramukhi chrāṃchrūṃchrīṃ kiṇidvandvaṃ kiṇidvayam || 2 ||

vicce navātmeśvarasya mantraḥ syānmūlapaṅkaje |

iti navātmeśvaramantraḥ || iti ṣaḍanvayaśāmbhavamantrāḥ || tato dhyānam -

sahasrasūryasaṅkāśo mahādīptidharo guruḥ |
ṣaḍanvayeśvaraḥ śrīmān paraśambhurajo'vyayaḥ || 1 ||

ṣaḍānanasphurannetratrayaṣaṭkasamanvitaḥ |
dvīpicarmakaṭisphāramuṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||

nānāsthiratnapārijātapuṣpamālāsamāvṛtaḥ |
brahmanābhikajāṃguṣṭho daṃṣṭrāvistṛtalāpanaḥ || 3 ||

vicitrābharaṇairyuktaḥ sarvavitpaśupāśahṛt |
śūlāsīṣuśaktisṛṇivaradhārī mahātanuḥ || 4 ||

kapālaphalacāpāripāśābhayakarāmbujaḥ |
devāvṛtaḥ pitṛvane krīḍākṛnmānasottare || 5 ||

evaṃ pareśvarīṃ dhyāyet stanabhāravirājitām |
iti dhyātvābhisampūjya mūlavidyādvayaṃ punaḥ || 6 ||

samabhyasya samarpyātha caraṇadvitayaṃ smaret |

raśmikramaḥ prāgeva prapañcitaḥ || athordhvāmnāyamantrabhedā agre 
vakṣyante | atha tantrāntare samayāvidyāḥ, yathā -

śrīvidyā bagalā caiva kālarātristathaiva ca |
jayadurgā cchinnamastā samayāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ || 1 ||

śrīvidyā prāguktā | atha bagalā - asya śrībagalāmukhīmantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ, 
jagatī chandaḥ, śrībagalāmukhī devatā, hrīṃbījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥ, kīlaya 
kīlakaṃ, śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ, oṃ hrīṃ, bagalāmukhi, sarvaduṣṭānāṃ, 
vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ stambhaya, jihvāṃ kīlaya, buddhiṃ vināśya hrī oṃ 
svāhā, iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrāḥ | dhyānam:

madhye sudhābdhi maṇimaṇḍaparatnavedyāṃ 
siṃhāsanoparigatāṃ paripītavarṇām |
pītāmbarābharaṇamālyavibhūṣitāṅgīṃ 
devīṃ bhajāmi dhṛtamudgaravairijihvām || 1 ||

oṃ hrīṃ bagalāmukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ stambhaya 
jihvāṃ kīlaya buddhiṃ vināśaya hrīṃ oṃ svāha, iti bagalāmukhī || atha 
kālarātriḥ : asya śrīkālarātrimantrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchandaḥ 
śrīkālarātrirdevatā, hrīṃ bījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥ, hūṃ kīlakaṃ, 
śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ, ṣaḍdīrghayuktena māyābījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | 
dhyānam -

p. 149) āraktabhānusadṛśīṃ yauvanonmattavigrahām |
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ candraśekharām || 1 ||

pretāsanasamāsīnāṃ bhajatāṃ sarvakāmadām |
dakṣiṇe cābhayaṃ pāśaṃ vāme bhuvanameva ca || 2 ||

raktadaṇḍadharāṃ devīṃ kālarātriṃ vicintayet |

aiṃhrīṃklīṃśrīṃkāleśvari sarvajanamanohāri sarvamukhastambhini 
sarvarājavaśaṅkari sarvaduṣṭanirdalini sarvastrīpuruṣākarṣiṇi 
bandiśṛṅkhalāṃstroṭayatroṭaya sarvaśatrūñjambhaya jambhaya dveṣaṃ 
nirdalaya nirdalaya sarvaṃ stambhaya stambhaya uccāṭaya uccāṭaya sarvavaśyaṃ 
kuru kuru sarvakālarātrikāmini gaṇeśvari huṃ phaṭ svāhā, iti kālarātriḥ || atha 
jayadurgā : asya jayadurgāmantrasya nārada ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ jayadurgā 
devatā, oṃ bījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥ, rakṣiṇi kīlakaṃ śrīvidyāṅgatvena 
viniyogaḥ | oṃ, durge, durge, rakṣaṇi, svāhā, oṃ durge durge rakṣiṇi svāhā, iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrāḥ | dhyānam :

kīlālābhāṃ kaṭākṣairarikulabhayadāṃ maulibaddhendukhaṇḍāṃ
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ kṛpāṇaṃ triśikhamapi karairudvahantīṃ trinetrām |
siṃhaskandhādhirūḍhāṃ tribhuvanamakhilaṃ tejasā pūrayantīṃ
dhyāyed durgāṃ jayākhyāṃ tridaśaparivṛtāṃ sevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥ || 1 ||

iti | oṃ durge durge rakṣiṇi svāhā, iti jayadurgā || atha cchinnamastāḥ: asya 
triśaktimantrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ samrāṭ chandaḥ śrīvajravairocanīyā devatā 
hrīṃ bījaṃ, svāhā śaktiḥ, phaṭkīlakaṃ, śrīvidyāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ | oṃ 
āṃ khaḍgāya svāhā, oṃ īṃ sukhaḍgāya svāhā, oṃ ūṃ śrīṃvirājāya 
svāhā, oṃ aiṃ pāśāya svāhā, oṃ auṃ aṃkuśāya svāyā, oṃ aḥ asurāntakāya 
svāhā, - iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrāḥ | dhyānam:

svanābhau nīrajaṃ dhyāyecchuddhaṃ vikasitaṃ sitam |
tatpadmakośamadhye tu maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍarociṣaḥ || 1 ||

japākusumasaṅkāśaṃ navabandhūkasannibham |
rajaḥsattvatamorekhāyonimaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 2 ||

madhye tu tāṃ mahādevīṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhām |
chinnamastāṃ kare vāme dhārayantīṃ svamastakam || 3 ||

prasāritamukhāṃ bhīmāṃ lelihānograjihvikām |
pibandīṃ raudhirīṃ dharāṃ nijakaṇṭhasamudbhavām || 4 ||

vikīrṇakeśapāśāṃ ca nānāpuṣpasamanvitām |
dakṣiṇe ca kare katrīṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām || 5 ||

digambarāṃ mahāghorāṃ pratyālīḍhapadasthitām |
asthimālādharāṃ devīṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm || 6 ||

ratikāmopaviṣṭāṃ ca kecid dhyāyanti mantriṇaḥ |
sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 7 ||

viparītaratāsaktau dhyāyedratimanobhavau |
yonimudrāsamārūḍhāṃ vicitrāsanasaṃsthitām || 8 ||

varṇinīḍākinīyuktāṃ vāmadakṣiṇayogataḥ |

iti || śrīṃklīṃhrīṃ aiṃ vajravairocanīye hrīṃhrīṃphaṭsvāhā iti cchinnamastā 
|| iti samayāvidyāḥ ||

gāyatrīṃ tu samuccārya tattadāvṛtidevatāḥ |
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 1 ||

iti vacanācchrīcakrāvaraṇadevīnāṃ gāyatryaḥ procyante -

oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi tanno dantī pracodayāt : iti 
gaṇapatigāyatrī || 
āpaduddharaṇāya vidmahe vaṭukeśvarāya dhīmahi tanno vīraḥ pracodayāt : iti 
vaṭukagāyatrī || 
oṃ digambarāya vidmahe kapālahastāya dhīmahi tannaḥ kṣetrapālaḥ pracodayāt : 
iti kṣetrapālagāyatrī | 
oṃ vyāpikāyai vidmahe nānārūpāyai dhīmahi tanno yoginī pracodayāt : iti 
yoginīgāyatrī | 
oṃ devarājāya vidmahe vajrahastāya dhīmahi tannaḥ śakraḥ pracodayāt : 
itīndragāyatrī | 
rudranetrāya vidmahe śaktihastāya dhīmahi tannoṃ vahniḥ pracodayāt : iti 
vahnigāyatrī | 
oṃ vaivasvatāya vidmahe daṇḍahastāya dhīmahi tanno yamaḥ pracodayāt : iti 
yamagāyatrī | 
oṃ niśācarāya vidmahe khaḍgahastāya dhīmahi tanno nirṛtiḥ pracodayāt : iti 
nirṛtigāyatrī |
p. 150) śuddhahastāya vidmahe pāśahastāya dhīmahi tanno varuṇaḥ pracodayāt 
iti varuṇagāyatrī | 
sarvaprāṇāya vidmahe yaṣṭihastāya dhīmahi tanno vāyuḥ pracodayāt : iti 
vāyugāyatrī | 
yakṣeśvarāya vidmahe gadāhastāya dhīmahi tanno yakṣaḥ pracodayāt : iti 
kuberagāyatrī | 
sarveśvarāya vidmahe śūlahastāya dhīmahi tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt : iti 
śivagāyatrī | 
caturānanāya vidmahe vedavaktrāya dhīmahi tanno brahmā pracodayāt : iti 
brahmagāyatrī | 
pātālavāsine vidmahe sahasravadanāya dhīmahi tanno'nantaḥ pracodayāt : 
ityanantagāyatrī | 
śatakoṭine vidmahe mahāvajrāya dhīmahi tanno vajraṃ pracodayāt : iti 
vajragāyatrī | 
tīkṣṇabhallāya vidmahe dīrghadaṇḍāya dhīmahi tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt : iti 
śaktigāyatrī | 
śatrughnāya vidmahe dīrghakāyāya dhīmahi tanno daṇḍaḥ pracodayāt : iti 
daṇḍagāyatrī | 
tīkṣṇadhārāya vidmahe trimūrtyātmakāya dhīmahi tannaḥ khaḍgaḥ pracodayāt 
: iti khaḍgagāyatrī | 
jagadākarṣaṇāya vidmahe mahāpāśāya dhīmahi tannaḥ pāśaḥ pracodayāt : iti 
pāśagāyatrī | 
vaśīkaraṇāya vidmahe mahāṃkuśāya dhīmahi tanno'ṃkuśaḥ pracodayāt : 
ityaṃkuśagāyatrī | 
ayaḥ sārāyai vidmahe dīrghagātryai dhīmahi tanno gadā pracodayāt : iti 
gadāgāyatrī | 
tīkṣṇaśikhāya vidmahe mahākāyāya dhīmahi tannaḥ śūlaṃ pracodayāt : iti 
śūlagāyatrī | 
ramāvāsāya vidmahe sahasrapatrāya dhīmahi tannaḥ, padmaṃ pracodayāt : iti 
padmagāyatrī | 
sudarśanāya vidmahe mahājvālāya dhīmahi tannaścakraṃ pracodayāt : iti 
sudarśanagāyatrī | 
aṇimāsiddhyai vidmahe varābhayahastāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt : 
ityaṇimāgāyatrī | 
laghimāsiddhyaividmahe nidhivāhanāyai dhīmahi tanno laghimā pracodayāt : iti 
laghimāgāyatrī | 
mahimāsiddhyai vidmahe mahāsiddhyai dhīmahi tanno mahimā pracodayāt : iti 
mahimāgāyatrī | 
īśitvasiddhyai vidmahe jagadvyāpikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt : 
itīśitvagāyatrī | 
vaśitvasiddhyai vidmahe śoṇavarṇāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt : iti 
vaśitvagāyatrī | 
prākāmyasiddhyi vidmahe nidhivāhanāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt : iti 
prākāmyagāyatrī | 
icchāsiddhyai vidmahe padmahastāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt 3 | 
bhuktisiddhyai vidmahe mahāsiddhyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt 3 | 
rasasiddhyai vidmahe bhaktavatsalāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt 3 | 
mokṣasiddhyai vidmahe mahānirmalāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt : iti 
siddhīnāṃ gāyatryaḥ ||

brahmaśaktyai vidmahe pītavarṇāyai dhīmahi tanno brāhmī pracodayāt 3 | 
śvetavarṇāyai vidmahe śūlahastāyai dhīmahi tanno māheśvari pracodayāt 3 | 
śikhivāhanāyai vidmahe śaktihastāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kaumārī pracodayāt 3 | 
śyāmavarṇāyai vidmahe cakrahastāyai dhīmahi tanno vaiṣṇavī pracodayāt 3 | 
śyāmalāyai vidmahe halahastāyai dhīmahi tanno vārāhī pracodayāt 3 | 
śyāmavarṇāyai vidmahe vajrahastāyai dhīmahi tanna aindrī pracodayāt 3 | 
kṛṣṇavarṇāyai vidmahe śūlahastāyai dhīmahi tannaścāmuṇḍā pracodayāt 3 | 
pītavarṇāyai vidmahe padmahastāyai dhīmahi tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt 3 - iti 
mātṛgāyatryaḥ ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyai vidmahe varahastāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 |

sarvākarṣiṇyai vidmahe mahāmudrāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

sarvavaśaṅkaryai vidmahe mahāvaśyāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

sarvonmādinyai vidmahe mahāmāyāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

mahāṃkuśāyai vidmahe śoṇavarṇāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

sarvakhecaryai vidmahe gaganavarṇāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 6 | 

bījarūpāyai vidmahe mahābījāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

mahāyonyai vidmahe viśvajananyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt 3 | 

trikhaṇḍāyai vidmahe trikātmikāyai dhīmahi tanno mudrā pracodayāt : iti 
mudrāgāyatryaḥ ||

kāmākarṣiṇyai vidmahe raktavastrāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

buddhyākarṣiṇyai vidmahe buddhyātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

ahaṅkārākarṣiṇyai vidmahe tattvātmikāyai dhīmahiḥ tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 
|

p. 151) śabdākarṣiṇyai vidmahe sarvaśabdātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā 
pracodayāt 3 | 

sparśākarṣiṇyai vidmahe sparśātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 : 

rūpākarṣiṇyai vidmahe rūpātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt | 

rasākarṣiṇyai vidmahe rasātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

gandhākarṣiṇyai vidmahe gandhātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 |

dhairyākarṣiṇyai vidmahe dhairyātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

smṛtyākarṣiṇyai vidmahe smṛtisvarūpiṇyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

nāmākarṣiṇyai vidmahe nāmātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

bījākarṣiṇyai vidmahe bījātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

ātmākarṣiṇyai vidmahe ātmasvarūpiṇyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

amṛtākarṣiṇyai vidmahe amṛtasvarūpiṇyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt 3 | 

śarīrākarṣiṇyai vidmahe śarīrātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalā pracodayāt, 3 - iti 
kāmakarṣiṇyādīnāṃ gāyatryaḥ ||

anaṅgakusumāyai vidmahe raktakaṃcukāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt, 3 | 

anaṅgamekhalāyai vidmahe pāśahastāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt, 3 |

anaṅgamālinyai vidmahe suprasannāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 - 
ityaṣṭadaladevatānāṃ gāyatryaḥ ||

|

tripurādevyai vidmahe kāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ klinnā pracodayāt 3 |

mahātripurasundaryai vidmahe kāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ klinnā pracodayāt 3 - 
iti cakreśvarīgāyatryaḥ || atha ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ gāyatryaḥ :

kāmeśvaryai vidmahe nityaklinnāyai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 |
