bheruṇḍāyai vidmahe viṣaharāyai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 | 

vahnivāsinyai vidmahe siddhipradāyai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 | 

mahāvajreśvaryai vidmahe vajranityāyai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 | 

śivadūtyai vidmahe śivaṃkaryai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 | 

tvaritāyai vidmahe mahānityāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

vagīśvaryai(kulasundaryai) vidmahe kāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ śaktiḥ 
pracodayāt 3 | 

nityābhairavyai vidmahe nityānityāyai dhīmahi tanno yoginī pracodayāt 3 | 

nīlapatākāyai vidmahe mahānityāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

vijayādevyai vidmahe mahānityāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

sarvamaṅgalāyai vidmahe candrātmikāyai dhīmahi tanno nityā pracodayāt 3 | 

jvālāmālinyai vidmahe mahājvālāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

vicitrāyai vidmahe mahānityāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

(lalitāgāyatrī ṣoḍaśī) iti ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ gāyatryaḥ || atha 
ṣaḍdarśanagāyatryaḥ :

brahmagāyatrī spaṣṭaiva || 

nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

ādityāva vidmahe mārtaṇḍāya dhīmahi tannaḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

śivagāyatrī tu prāgeva darśitā | 

mahāsiddhāya vidmahe sarvajñāya dhīmahi tanno buddhaḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

sarvasaṃmohinyai vidmahe viśvajananyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

iti ṣaḍdarśanagāyatryaḥ || atha samayavidyānāṃ gāyatryaḥ :

p. 153) sarvonmanyai vidmahe viśvajananyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pūrvasamayā || 

bagalāmbāyai vidmahe brahmāstravidyāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ stambhinī pracodayāt 
3 | 

iti dakṣiṇasamayā || 

kālarātryai vidmahe kāleśvaryai dhīmahi tanno mohinī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti paścimasamayā || 

tantrāntareṣu jayadurgā kubjikā pratyaṅgirā durgāḥ paścimasamaye devatā iti || 
tathā - 

nārāyaṇyai vidmahe durgāyai dhīmahi tanno gaurī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti jayadurgāgāyatrī || 

kubjikāyai vidmahe narāntramālāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti kubjikāgāyatrī || 

aparājitāyai vidmahe pratyaṅgirāyai dhīmahi tanna ugrā pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pratyaṅgirāgāyatrī || 

mahādevyai vidmahe durgāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti durgāgāyatrī || iti paścimasamayadevatānāṃ gāyatryaḥ || 

athottarasamayānāṃ gāyatryaḥ -

vajravairocinyai vidmahe chinnamastāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti chinnamastāgāyatrī || 

kālikāyai vidmahe śmaśānavāsinyai dhīmahi tanno ghore pracodayāt 3 | 

iti kālīgāyatrī || 

tārāyai vadmahe chinnamastāyai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti tārāgāyatrī || āmnāyavidyānāṃ gāyatryo'traivāntarbhūtā boddhavyāḥ || 
atha pañcapañcikāgaṇagāyatryaḥ :

śrīvidyāyai vidmahe mahāśriyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śrīḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

lakṣmyai devyai vidmahe śrīdevyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śrīḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

mahālakṣmyai vidmahe mahāśriyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śrīḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

triśaktilakṣmyai vidmahe mahābhairavyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śrīḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

sāmrājyalakṣmyai vidmahe jayaṅkaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ śrīḥ pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pañcalakṣmyaḥ || atha pañcakośāḥ :

śrīvidyāyai vidmahe mahākośeśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ kośā pracodayāt 3 | 

parajyotiṣai vidmahe praṇavātmikāyai dhīmahiḥ tannaḥ kośā pracodayāt 3 | 

paraniṣkalāyai vidmahe paraśāmbhavyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kośā pracodayāt 3 | 

ajapāyai vidmahe haṃsātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kośā pracodayāt 3 | 

mātṛkāyai vidmahe vāgīśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ kośā pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pañcakośāḥ || atha pañcakalpalatāḥ :

śrīvidyāyai vidmahe kalpalateśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalpalatā pracodayāt 3 | 

tvaritāgāyatrī prāgevoktā | svacchandasaṃgrahe || 

tvaritādevyai vidmahe mahādevyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalpalatā pracodayat 3 | 

pārijāteśvaryai vidmahe kāmapradāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalpalatā pracodayāt 3 | 

trikūṭāyai vidmahe jagajjananyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalpalatā pracodayāt 3 | 

pañcabāṇeśyai vidmahe sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kalpalatā 
pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pañcakalpalatāḥ | atha pañcakāmadughānāṃ gāyatryaḥ :

śrīvidyāyai vidmahe kāmadugheśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ kāmadughā pracodayāt 
3 | 

amṛtapīṭheśyai vidmahe amṛteśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ kāmadughā pracodayāt 3 | 

sudhāsūtyai vidmahe sudhātmikāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kāmadughā pracodayāt 3 | 

amṛteśvaryai vidmahe viśvadīpinyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kāmadughā pracodayāt 3 | 

annapūrṇāyai vidmahe sarvasaṃjīvinyai dhīmahi tannaḥ kāmadughā pracodayāt 
3 | 

iti pañcakāmadughāḥ || atha pañcaratnavidyānāṃ gāyatryaḥ

śrīvidyāyai vidmahe ratneśvaryai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

siddhalakṣmyai vidmahe ratneśvaryai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

mātaṅginyai vidmahe ratneśvaryai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

bhuvaneśvaryai vidmahe ratneśvaryai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

vārāhyai vidmahe ratneśvaryai dhīmahi tanno devī pracodayāt 3 | 

iti pañcapañcikāgaṇagāyatryaḥ || atha śrīcakranirmāṇaprakāro'tra 
pradarśyate :

śrīvi0 20

p. 154) prastāro'tra tridhā proktaḥ śrīcakrasya tatheśvari |
merukailāsabhūsaṃjñā bhedāstasya tridhā bhavet || 1 ||

meruprastārakaṃ yantraṃ nityātādātmyakaṃ smṛtam |
mātṛkāyāstu kailāsaprastārākhyaṃ sureśvari || 2 ||

bhūprastāraṃ mahādevī vaśinyātmakamuttamam |
sṛṣṭikramaṃ merucakraṃ kailāsaṃ cārddhamerukam || 3 ||

saṃhārākhyaṃ maheśāni bhūprastāraṃ sthitikramam |
ekaikasva tu cakrasya tribhedāstu bhavanti hi || 4 ||

sṛṣṭyādibhedairdeveśi saṃhāraṃ kaulikaṃ matam |
sṛṣṭikramaṃ tu samayamataṃ syāt sthitisaṃjñakam || 5 ||

śuddhaṃ tu kathitaṃ devi rahasyātirahasyakam |
merucakre tu saṃhārakramapūjā na vidyate || 6 ||

sṛṣṭikrameṇa deveśi pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
saṃhārapūjā kailāsaprastāre'tra vidhīyate || 7 ||

bhūprastāre maheśāni sthitipūjā sadottamā |
sthitikramo gṛhasthasya saṃhāro vaninoyateḥ || 8 ||

brahmacāriṇa utpattiḥ striyāḥ śūdrasya ceṣṭataḥ |

iti | śrīrudrayāmale -

tataḥ kuṃkumasindūraiḥ kāryaṃ yantraṃ tu yoginā |
sauvarṇe rājate tāmre sphāṭike vaidrume tathā || 1 ||

cakre tathoktavidhinā pūjyā devī varottamaiḥ |

iti | śrītantrarāje -

ratne hemanirūpye vā tāmre dṛṣadi ca kramāt |
kṛtvā cakrasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpayet pūjayedapi || 1 ||

lakṣmīkāntiyaśaḥputradhanārogyādisiddhaye || iti |

dṛṣadi gaṇḍakīśilāyām | dakṣiṇāmūrtau - gaṇḍakībhavapāṣāṇe svarṇa 
rajatatāmrayoḥ | iti | 

ratnasāgare -

yāvajjīvaṃ suvarṇe syādrūpye dvāviṃśatiḥ priye |
tāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣaṃ tadardhaṃ bhūrjapatrake || 1 || anyatra -

tāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣaṃ sphaṭikādau tu sarvadā |
teṣāṃ madhye sphāṭikaṃ tu sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

iti | lakṣasāgare -

bhūmau sindūrarajasā racitaṃ sarvakāmadam |
suvarṇaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkaram || 1 ||

rajatena kṛtaṃ yantramāyurārogyakāmadam |
tāmre tu racitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matam || 2 ||

kḷptaṃ marakate yantraṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam |
lohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ matam || 3 ||

devyuvāca |

lohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ maheśvara |
tanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 4 ||

īśvara uvāca |

bhāgā daśa suvarṇasya rajatasya tu ṣoḍaśa |
tāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭhaṃ kuryānmanoharam || 5 ||

tasmin pīṭhe tu nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet |
śāntidaṃ puṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇam || 6 ||

āyurārogyajanakaṃ kāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ matam |
traividhyaṃ śṛṇu cakrasya bhūprastāro'rdhamerukam || 7 ||

pātālavāsināṃ devi prastāro nimnarekhakaḥ |
ūrdhvarekho mahāśāntirmartyalokanivāsinām || 8 ||

svargalokādivāsānāṃ yantrāṇāṃ merusaṃjñakaḥ |
bhūpuraṃ tu samārabhya vaindavāntaṃ maheśvari || 9 ||

kramāt samunnataṃ sarvaṃ merurūpaṃ mayoditam |
samordhvarekhānavakamūrdhvarekhaṃ prakīrtitam || 10 ||

nimnarekhāsamāyogādbhūprastāro mayoditaḥ |
yantrabījasvarūpaṃ te mayā snehāt prakāśitam || 11 ||

gopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre svayoniriva santatam |

iti | śrītantrarāje -

caturasraṃ samārabhya navacakrāṇyanukramāt |
unnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanam || 1 ||

p. 155) tritrikramādunnataṃ tadaprajatvaṃ śriyaṃ labhet |
ekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaḥ śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpate || 2 ||

navāni samarūpāṇi sarvābhīṣṭārthasiddhaye |

iti kulamūlāvatāre -

ucchritaṃ kramaśo devi vittaprāptistato mṛtiḥ |
bhūcakre ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

śeṣamunnatamīśāni cārthāptyaprajadaṃ bhavet |
caturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukam || 2 ||

mithaḥ samunnataṃ devi śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpate |
caturasraṃ samārabhya vindvantaṃ samarekhakam || 3 ||

tathā śrīḥ kīrtirārogyamamṛtāyopakalpate |

iti | tantrarāje -

sīsakāṃsyādiṣu punaḥ pūrvoktaviparītakṛt |
phalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācana || 1 ||

sthāpitaṃ yadi mohena lobhādajñānato'pi vā |
kulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathā || 2 ||

iti | lakṣasāgare - vaṅge'tha sīsake lohe na kartavyaṃ kadācana | iti 
kulamūlāvatāre :

agniraṃgulavistāraṃ prākpratyagdakṣiṇottaram |
palapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarccāpīṭhaṃ manoharam || 1 ||

yavārdhoccaṃ prakurvīta caturasraṃ samantataḥ |
tasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet || 2 ||

iti | sautrāmaṇītantre -

ṛjurekhā bhavellakṣmīrvakrarekhā daridratā |
agniraṃgulavistāro yavārdhenocchritirbhavet || 1 || iti |

agniraṃgulaṃ hemasya rajatasya tathaiva ca |
tāmrasya pūrvasaṃkhyaiva māṇikyādau yathecchayā || 2 ||

palaṃ tu viṃśatyuttaratriśataguñjāparimitam | aṃgulapramāṇaṃ tu 
mahākapilapañcarātre -

vinyastaistiryagaṣṭābhiryavairmānāntarāṃgulam |
śālibhirvā ṛjunyastaistribhirmānāntaraṃ bhavet || 1 ||

iti | vedikāpīṭhaśivikārathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ | mānāntarāṃgulenaiva 
bhavennānyena kenacit || ityukteḥ śrīcakrasya 
pīṭhaśabdavācyatvānmānāṃgulenaiva tatpramāṇaṃ bodhyam | atra 
vindvādyaṣṭārāntaṃ cakratrayaṃ saṃhārātmakaṃ, daśāradvayaṃ 
caturdaśāraṃ cakratrayaṃ sthityātmakaṃ, tadupari aṣṭadalādibhūpurāntaṃ 
cakratrayaṃ sṛṣṭyātmakam | rudrayāmale :

bindutrikoṇavasukoṇadaśārayugmamanvasranāgadalasaṃyutaṣoḍaśāram |
vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ || 1 ||

iti | subhagodaye -

caturbhiḥ śivacakraiśca śakticakraiśca pañcabhiḥ |
śivaśaktyātmakaṃ jñeyaṃ śrīcakraṃ śivayorvapuḥ || 1 ||

iti | śrībhūtabhairava -

yo'smin manve maheśāni kesarāṇi prakalpayet |
yoginīsahitāstasya hiṃsāṃ kurvanti bhairavāḥ || 1 ||

iti vacanānnātra kesarāṇi | svacchandasaṃgrahe - kuryācca sthaṇḍile yantraṃ 
hastamātraṃ susundaram |

iti | tantrarāje tu -

navahastaṃ trihastaṃ vā śrīcakramabhiṣecane |
sthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyate || 1 ||

ratnādiṣu tu nirmāṇe mānamicchāvaśādbhavet | iti | tathā -

raktena rajasāpūrya śrīcakraṃ bhuvi pūrayet |
naśyanti sarvavighnāni prāpsyate ca yathepsitam || 1 ||

daśabhāgaṃ suvarṇasya tāmrasya dvidaśaṃ tathā |
ṣaḍguṇaṃ (ṣoḍaśa) rajatasyāpi caitallohatrayaṃ śubham || 2 ||

cakre'smin pūjayedyo hi sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt |
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmadhipo jāyate'cirāt || 3 ||

vidrume racite yantre padmarāge'thavā priye |
indranīle ca vaiḍūrye sphaṭike marakate'pi vā || 4 ||

p. 156) dhanaṃ putraṃ tathā dārān yaśāṃsi labhate dhruvam |
tāmraṃ tu kāntidaṃ yantraṃ suvarṇaṃ śatrunāśanam || 5 ||

rājataṃ kṣemadaṃ caiva sphaṭikaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
khaṇḍite sphuṭite bhagne bhraṣṭe mānavivarjite || 6 ||

dagdhe'narhapaśuspṛṣṭe patite duṣṭabhūmiṣu |
anyamantrārcite caiva patitasparśadūṣite || 7 ||

daśamvapi ca no kuryuḥ sannidhānaṃ divaukasaḥ |
dagdhaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ yantraṃ hṛtaṃ caureṇa vā priye || 8 ||

upavāsaṃ prakurvīta dinamekamatandritaḥ |
lakṣamātraṃ japedvidyāṃ homatarpaṇapūrvikām || 9 ||

sadbhaktyā ca guruṃ toṣya brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet |
lakṣamayutamityeke ||

kadācilluptacihnaṃ vā sphuṭatādividūṣitam |
bhagnaṃ karoti yo mūrkho mṛtyustamya dhruvaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

tasmācca tīrtharāje vā gaṅgādisaritāṃ vare |
samudre vā kṣipeddevi anyathā duḥkhamāpnuyāt || 2 ||

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

raktāsanopaviṣṭastu yantroddhāraṃ samācaret |
śaktyopaviṣṭāṃ śaktiṃ tu vilikhedvistṛtāṃ sakṛt || 1 ||

vahninā tāṃ puṭīkuryāt sandhibhedakrameṇa tu |
agnīśāsuravāyavyarekhā vistārya yojayet || 2 ||

daśakoṇadvayaṃ devi jāyate tadvadeva hi |
madhyakoṇacatuṣkasya rekhe ākṛṣya buddhimān || 3 ||

kuryāt tatsandhibhedena manvasraṃ jāyate yathā |
samatrikoṇaśaktyaikyaṃ sukhadaṃ netrayoryathā || 4 ||

suśrīkaṃ sandhibhedena ṛjurekhāvijṛmbhitam |
bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmamakiñjalkaṃ samālikhet || 5 ||

tadvat ṣoḍaśapatraṃ hi vilikhet padmamuttamam |
suvṛttaṃ parameśāni tato bhūbimbamālikhet || 6 ||

caturdvāraṃ viśobhāḍhyaṃ puṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipet | iti |

kāśmīre darpaṇe bhūrje arcāpīṭha likhedbudhaḥ |
śalākayā suvarṇasya miśrayā ghusṛṇendubhiḥ || 1 ||

sindūrarajasā miśraḥ paṭṭe dhātumaye likhet |
athavā bhūtale devi surekhaṃ kuṃkumena vā || 2 ||

sindūrarajasā vāpi likhet sarvārthasiddhaye |
etaccakraṃ maheśāni madhye binduvirājitam || 3 ||

tatastrikoṇaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ daśāraṃ ca daśārakam |
manukoṇaṃ maheśāni madhyacakramidaṃ priye || 4 ||

baindavādaṣṭakoṇāntaṃ sarvamadhyaṃ sureśvari |
catvāriṃśadbhagairyuktaṃ tribhagairapi pārvati || 5 ||

vasupatraṃ kalāpatraṃ caturasraṃ kramāt priye |
navātmakamidaṃ bhadre navayonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet || 6 ||

iti | jñānārṇave -

śrīcakramapi deveśi merurūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
lakāraḥ pṛthivībījaṃ tatrovāpuramucyate || 1 ||

sakāraścandramā bhadre kalāṣoḍaśakātmakaḥ |
tasmāt ṣoḍaśapatraṃ tu hakāraḥ śiva ucyate || 2 ||

aṣṭamūrtistathā bhadre tasmādvasudalaṃ bhavet |
īkārastu mahāmāyā bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 3 ||

pālayantī parā tasmācchakrakoṇaṃ bhavet priye |
śaktirekā daśasthāne sthitvā sūte jagattrayam || 4 ||

viśvayoniriti khyātā sā viṣṇordaśarūpakā |
rakārāt parameśāni cakraṃ vyāpya vijṛmbhate || 5 ||

daśakoṇaparā tasmādrakārājjyotiravyayaḥ |
kalādaśānvito vahnirdaśakoṇapravartakaḥ || 6 ||

kakārānmādanaṃ devi śivaṃ cāṣṭasvarūpakam |
yonirasya tadā cakre vasuyonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet || 7 ||

ardhamātrā guṇān sūte bhedarūpā yatastataḥ |
trikoṇarūpā yonistu bindunā baindavaṃ bhavet || 8 ||

kāmeśvarasya rūpaṃ tadviśvādhārasvarūpakam |
śrīcakraṃ tu varārohe śrīvidyāvarṇasambhavam || 9 ||

tatra prāṅmukha āsīnaścakrarājaṃ samālikhet |
bhūpradeśe same cāḍhye sindūrarajasā'thavā || 10 ||

kuṃkumasya rajobhiśca bhūmau cakraṃ samālikhet |
ṛjurekhaṃ netraramyaṃ sandhibhedaṃ samamṛju || 11 ||

athavā hemarūpyābhyāṃ tāmreṇa ratnadhātubhiḥ |
paṭṭaṃ viracya śrīkāṣṭhe raktacandanasambhave || 12 ||

p. 157) paṭṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vilikhedlekhanyā hemayā priye |
rocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ ca kastūrīcandanendubhiḥ || 13 ||

īśānādagniparyantamṛjurekhāṃ samālikhet |
īśādagrestadagrābhyāṃ rekhe ākṛṣya deśikaḥ || 14 ||

ekīkṛtya ca vāruṇyāṃ śaktirekā parā priye |
trikoṇākārarūpeyaṃ tasyā upari saṃlikhet || 15 ||

trikoṇākārarūpaṃ tu śaktidvayamudāhṛtam |
pūrvaśaktyagrabhāge tu mānayaṣṭivadālikhet || 16 ||

rekhāṃ tu parameśāni vāyurākṣasakoṇagām |
saṃdhibhedakrameṇaiva tayoḥ śaktyostataḥ param || 17 ||

rekhe ākṛṣya koṇābhyāṃ tadagrāt pūrvage kuru |
vahnimaṇḍalametattu pūrvāgraṃ vīravandite || 18 ||

tacca trayamabhūdante tataḥ śṛṇu varānane |
pūrvaśaktīśavahnibhyāṃ koṇābhyāṃ suravandite || 19 ||

pūrvarekhāṃ tu vistārya tathā paścimavahnitaḥ |
vāyurākṣasakoṇābhyāṃ rekhāṃ paścimagāṃ tathā || 20 ||

vistārya yojayeddevi śaktibhedakrameṇa tu |
yonyagragāṃ pūrvadeśe dakṣiṇottarataḥ kramāt || 21 ||

tarā rekhe yonisaṃsthe paścimasyāṃ diśi kramāt |
koṇāgragāṃ yojayitvā daśakoṇaṃ tadā bhavet || 22 ||

tathaiva devadeveśi dvitīyaṃ daśakoṇagam |
īśānavahnito rekhe pūrvayonyagrayoḥ kramāt || 23 ||

vistārya yojayet paścāt paścimāyāṃ diśi kramāt |
vāyurākṣasakoṇāgrarekhe vistārya sundari || 24 ||

paścimāgre tathā devi yojayedindradiggate |
ekāgra pūrvakoṇāgracumbinīṃ tu manoharām || 25 ||

yojayed devedeveśi yathāśaktyudbhavaṃ bhavet |
daśakoṇeṣu deveśi tyaktvā koṇacatuṣṭayam || 26 ||

daśakoṇāntayordevi madhyarekhāṃ prakāśayet |
dve dakṣiṇe vibhāge tu tathā cottarabhāgake || 27 ||

ṣaṭkoṇasya tato devi sandhibhedakrameṇa tu |
yoniṃ vahniṃ ca saṃyojya śakrāraṃ jāyate tathā || 28 ||

kakṣāmadhyagatāṃ rekhāṃ nijarūpāṃ tu yojayet |
ṛjvākṛtiryathā devi jāyate'timanoharā || 29 ||

sammukhaṃ pañcaśaktyagraṃ prāgagraṃ caturagnikam |
bindutrikoṇavasvāraṃ cakrabhedādvarānane || 30 ||

madhyacakraṃ tu jānīhi daśārayugalaṃ tathā |
śakrayonyaṅkitaṃ devi bāhyamadhyagataṃ bhavet || 31 ||

etaccakraṃ maheśāni sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ bhavet |
sarvasāmrājyadaṃ devi sarvopadravanāśanam || 32 ||

anekahayamāṇikyasuvarṇaparipūrakam |
mahāmokṣapradaṃ devi vāgvilāsakaraṃ mahat || 33 ||

etadbāhyaṃ maheśāni vṛttaṃ pūrṇandusaṃnibham |
tadyutaṃ kuru padmākṣi vasupatraṃ manoharam || 34 ||

tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ tu vilikhet surasundari |
caturasraṃ caturdvārasahitaṃ parameśvari || 35 ||

catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahāprabham |
cakre'smin saviśeṣāstāḥ sādhakaṃ mānayanti hi || 36 ||

caturasraṃ mātṛkārṇairmaṇḍitaṃ siddhihetave |
muktāmāṇikyaghaṭitasamujjvala virājitam || 37 ||

trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kalpadrumaphalapradam |
ṣoḍaśāraṃ candrabimbarūpaṃ tu svakalālayam || 38 ||

sarvāśāpūrakaṃ devi kṣaratpīyuṣavarṣavat |
aṣṭapatraṃ maheśāni japākusumasannibham || 39 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ nāma sarvakāmaprapūrakam |
etat trayaṃ varārohe sṛṣṭicakraṃ vasupradam || 40 ||

pūrvāmnāyādidevyā tu maṇḍitaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
caturdaśāraṃ deveśi dāḍimīkusumaprabham || 41 ||

anantaphaladaṃ bhadre sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ sadā |
daśāraṃ taptahemābhaṃ sindūrasadṛśaṃ priye || 42 ||

sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ manaścintitadaṃ sadā |
dvitīyamapi paṃktyasraṃ japākusumasannibham || 43 ||

sarvarakṣākaraṃ cakraṃ mahājñānamayaṃ śive |
etat trayaṃ maheśāni sthiticakraṃ sukhapradam || 44 ||

dakṣiṇāmnāyapūjyaṃ tu yathepsitaphalapradam |
aṣṭakoṇaṃ varārohe bālārkakiraṇāruṇam || 45 ||

padmarāgāmalaprakhyaṃ sarvarogaharaṃ sadā |
udyatsūryasahasrābhaṃ bandhūkakusumaprabham || 46 ||

sarvasiddhipradaṃ cakraṃ svakalālayamīśvari |
trikoṇaṃ sarvasambhūtikāraṇaṃ bhṛtidaṃ sadā || 47 ||

binducakraṃ varārohe sarvānandamayaṃ priye |
sadāśivamayaṃ cakranāyakaṃ parameśvari || 48 ||

p. 158) etaccakraṃ tu saṃhārarūpaṃ brahmamayaṃ sadā |
paścimāmnāyasaṃsevyaṃ trayamuttarasevitam || 49 ||

asmiṃścakre ṣaḍadhvāno vartante vīravandite |
cakrapatreṣu deveśi padādhvā tu nigadyate || 50 ||

patrasandhivibhede tu bhuvanādhvā vyavasthitaḥ |
varṇādhvā mātṛkārūpī kathayāmi tavānaghe || 51 ||

vargāṣṭakaṃ mātṛkāyā dikṣu siddhīryataḥ priye |
pārthivaṃ tanmayaṃ viddhi ṣoḍaśāraṃ kalātmakam || 52 ||

aṣṭapatraṃ kādivargaiḥ kṣāntaṃ dikṣu vidikṣu ca |
kādiḍhāntāḥ śakravarṇāḥ śakrakoṇeṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 53 ||

ṇakārādibhakārāntā daśavarṇā daśārake |
makārādikṣakārāntā dvitīye tu daśārake || 54 ||

vargāṣṭakaṃ cāṣṭakoṇe trikoṇe kathayāmi te |
akathāditrikoṇāntaṃ hakṣayugmaṃ tu madhyamam || 55 ||

varṇādhvā kathito devi mātṛkāpīṭharūpakaḥ |
saṭtriṃśattattvabharitaṃ cakramūlānurūpataḥ || 56 ||

pañcasiṃhāsanonnaddha kalādhvā cakrapālanāt |
sā bālā bhairavīyuktā mahātripurabhairavī || 57 ||

tripurādyambikādyāntā cakraṃ vyāpya vijṛmbhite |
mantrādhvā ca samākhyāto niścayena sadā priye || 58 ||

evaṃ ṣaḍadhvavimalaṃ śrīcakraṃ paricintayet |

iti subhagodaye -

ṣaṇavatyaṃgulāyāmaṃ caturasraṃ mahītalam |
taccaturdhā vibhajyādau caturviṃśāṃgulaṃ kramāt || 1 ||

guhānanarasāṅgāgnivedāgnitriśarartuṣu |
tāsāṃ sammārjayed bhāgānagrayorubhayorimān || 2 ||

sūrye guṇaṃ niśānāthe vedaṃ somasute kalām |
jīve purāṇaṃ śukre tu svaraṃ rāhau śaraṃ punaḥ || 3 ||

keto guṇaṃ pañcaśakticaturvahnikriyāntare |
rekhāyugmaṃ śaniṃ sūryāddharāvṛtte niyojayet || 4 ||

ketūrdhvavṛttaṃ bhūputraṃ rāhorādityamānayet |
candrāt ketuṃ kaveḥ somaṃ budhādrāhuṃ guroḥ kujam || 5 ||

ketorbudhaṃ raveḥ saurimevaṃ ṣaṭcakrasambhavaḥ |
aṣṭāṣṭāṃgulamānena bahiścakratrayaṃ likhet || 6 ||

vasupatraṃ kalāpatraṃ medinīsadanatrayam |
tatra kramānmadhyayonistiryagrekhāḥ samantataḥ || 7 ||

sārdhaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ ceti kuryādvāratrayaṃ budhaḥ |
sampradāyaviśeṣaṇa kṣamā viśvakalāśraye || 8 ||

madhye guṇatrayamayaṃ vilikhedvartulatrayam |
cakrarājamidaṃ proktaṃ madhye binduvibhūṣitam || 9 ||

mahāsaubhāgyajananaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam |
sindūrarajasā bhūmau likhitvā cakramarcayet || 10 ||

athavā hemarūpyādipaṭṭaṃ pīṭhopari sthitam |

iti | ayamuddhāraḥ sthitikramaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrtijñānārṇavayoḥ sṛṣṭikrama 
uddhāraḥ pradarśitaḥ | saṃhārakrameṇoddhārastu śrītantrarāje -

bhrameṇa vṛttaṃ niṣpādyaṃ susame caturasrake |
pramṛjya tiryaṅmadhyasthaṃ sūtraṃ tiryaṅ nipātayet || 1 ||

sūtrāṇi nava teṣu dve vṛttaspṛṣṭobhayāntake |
vidhāya taddvayorantānmadhyasūtrāntataḥ kramāt || 2 ||

kṛte sūtracatuṣke tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ syāt trisaptagam |
dvyaṣṭāgrataḥ samārambhānnavamaprathamāntarā || 3 ||

kuryāt sūtracatuṣkaṃ tu caturmarmānuguṇyataḥ |
navamaprathamāgrābhyāṃ turyasaptamakāvadhi || 4 ||

kuryāt sūtracatuṣkaṃ tu marmāṣṭakavibhedanāt |
tataścaturthaṣaṣṭhāntadvayārambhāt tathāṣṭagam || 5 ||

dvitīyagaṃ ca sūtrāṇāṃ catuṣkaṃ pātayet tathā |
caturmarmānuguṇyena tataḥ pañcamakāntayoḥ || 6 ||

tṛtīyagaṃ sūtrayugaṃ kuryānmarmadvayāśrayam |
mārjayenmadhyagaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syāccakramuttamam || 7 ||

bahiraṣṭacchadāmbhojaṃ tathā taddviguṇacchadam |
vidhāya ṣaḍbhirvṛttaiśca caturasraṃ tathāṣṭabhiḥ || 8 ||

sūtrairvidhāya tasyaiva prākpratyagdvārasaṃyutam |
dakṣiṇottarato rekhātrayāt sthānadvayaṃ tathā || 9 ||

koṇeṣu tiryaksūtraiśca caturbhistānyanukramāt |
dvidhā kuryācca catvāri padāni parameśvari || 10 ||

lalitārcācakramidaṃ labhyaṃ sadgurutaḥ kramāt | iti | ācāryairapyuktam -

p. 159) caturbhiḥ śrīkaṇṭhaiḥ śivayuvatibhiḥ pañcabhirapi prabhinnābhiḥ 
śambhornavabhirapi mūlaprakṛtibhiḥ |
catuścatvāriṃśadvasudalakalāsratrivalayatrirekhābhiḥ sārdhaṃ tava 
śaraṇakoṇāḥ pariṇatāḥ || 1 ||

iti | caturbhiścatuḥsaṃkhyāsaṃkhyeyaiḥ śrīkaṇṭhaiḥ śṛṇāti śrīrviṣaṃ 
kaṇṭhe yasya saḥ śrīkaṇṭho haraste koṇā api śrīkaṇṭhāstadātmanaḥ 
śrīkaṇṭhātmakairityarthaḥ | śivayuvatibhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktyātmakairityarthaḥ | 
pañcabhiḥ pañcasaṃkhyāsaṃkhyeyaiḥ | apiśabdo bhede | prabhinnābhiḥ 
prakarṣeṇa bhinnābhiḥ | prakarṣastu śivaśakticakramadhye vaindavamānavasya 
vidyamānatvāt etacca samayimatena sṛṣṭikrameṇa pañcacakralekhane jñeyam | 
kaulamatena saṃhārakrameṇa navayonicakralekhane 
ūrdhvādhomukhatayāvasthiteḥ prabhinnatvaṃ jñeyaṃ tenobhayaṃ pṛthakpṛthak 
sthitam | śambhoriti pañcamī śaṃbhuśabdena catvāraḥ śrīkaṇṭhā ucyante | 
navabhirnavasaṃkhyaiḥ | apiśabdo vakṣyamāṇabāhulyaṃ samuccinoti | 
mūlaprakṛtibhiḥ prapañcasya mūlakāraṇairata eva teṣāṃ 
yoniśabdavyavahāraḥ | navayonayo navadhātvātmakāḥ | tathā coktaṃ 
kāmikāyām - tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthidhātavaḥ śaktimūlakā | 
majjāśukraprāṇajīvadhātavaḥ śivamūlakāḥ || navadhāturayaṃ deho 
navayonisamudbhavaḥ || jīvadhātūnāmajīvādhiṣṭhānatvādojodhātureva 
jīvadhāturityucyate | yathoktaṃ vāgbhaṭṭena raja-ādiśukrāntānāṃ 
dhātūnāṃ prasādaśreṣṭho jīvādhārabhūto dhāturojaḥ iti (daśamo) 
dhāturekaiva parā śaktistadīśvarī | daśamī yonirvaindavasthānaṃ danīśvarī 
tasya dehasyetyarthaḥ |

evaṃ piṇḍāṇḍamutpannaṃ tadbrahmāṇḍaṃ samudbabhau |
pañca tāni ca śāktāni māyādīni śivasya tu || 1 ||

māyā ca śuddhavidyāṃ ca maheśvarasadāśivau |
pañcaviṃśatitatvāni tatraivāntarbhavanti te || 2 ||

ekādaśendriyāṇi śabdāditanmātrāstacchabdena parāmṛśyante | 
śivaśaktyātmakaṃ viddhi jagadetaccarācaram | caraṃ piṇḍāṇḍamacaraṃ 
brahmāṇḍamityarthaḥ | he bhagavati caturbhiḥ śrīkaṇṭhaiḥ śambhoḥ sakāśāt 
prabhinnābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śivayuvatibhirnavabhirapi mūlaprakṛtibhiḥ sārdhaṃ 
pariṇatāḥ santaścatuścatvāriṃśaditi | atredamanusandheyam atra cakre 
aṣṭāviṃśatirmarmasthānāni saṃdhayastu caturviṃśatiḥ | nanu marmāṇi 
caturviṃśatireva kathamaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ |

dvirekhāsaṅgamasthānaṃ sandhirityabhidhīyate |
trirekhāsaṅgamasthānaṃ marmamarmavido viduḥ || 1 ||

ityaṣṭadalaṣoḍaśāramekhalātrayabhūpuratrayāṇāṃ śivacakrāṇāṃ 
trirekhāsaṅgamasthānatvābhāve'pi vācanikī marmasaṃjñā | yathoktaṃ 
candrajñānavidyāyām :

manvasradvidaśārāṣṭakoṇavṛttacatuṣṭayam |
aṣṭāviṃśatimarmāṇi caturviṃśatisandhayaḥ || 1 ||

iti | rudrayāmale -

pṛśnayo nāma munyādyāḥ sarve cakrasamāśrayāḥ |
sevamānāścakrakidyāṃ devagandharvasevitām || 1 ||

agnīṣomātmakaṃ cakramagnīṣomamayaṃ jagat |
agnāvantarvabhau bhānuragnīṣomamayaṃ smṛtam || 2 ||

trikhaṇḍaṃ mātṛkācakraṃ somasūryānalātmakam |
trikoṇaṃ vaindavaṃ saumyamaṣṭakoṇaṃ ca miśrakam || 3 ||

caturdaśāraṃ vahnestu caturasraṃ ca bhānumat |
etat prasādādindrādyā vasavo'ṣṭau marudgaṇāḥ || 4 ||

ye ye samṛddhā loke'smistriṃpurācakrasevakāḥ |
puratrayaṃ ca cakrasya somasūryānalātmakam || 5 ||

mahālakṣmyāḥ puraṃ cakraṃ tatraivāste tayā śivaḥ |

iti | bhairavayāmale candrajñānavidyāyāṃ gaurīṃ prati maheśvareṇoktam -

sādhu sādhu mahābhāge pṛṣṭaṃ trailokyasundari |
guhyādguhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ na kutrāpi prakāśitam || 1 ||

kalāvidyā parāśaktiḥ śrīcakrākārarūpiṇī |
tanmadhye baindavasthānaṃ tatrāste parameśvarī || 2 ||

sadāśivena saṃpṛktā sarvasattvātigā satī |
cakraṃ tripurasurandaryā brahmāṇḍākāramīśvari || 3 ||

pañcabhūtātmakaṃ caiva tanmātrātmakameva ca |
indriyātmakamevaṃ ca manastattvātmakaṃ tathā || 4 ||

p. 160) māyāditattvarūpaṃ ca tattvātītaṃ ca baindavam |
baindave jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāriṇī || 5 ||

sadāśivena sampṛktā tattvātītā maheśvarī |
jyotīrūpā varākārā yasya dehodbhavāḥ śive || 6 ||

kiraṇāśca sahasraṃ ca dvisahasraṃ ca lakṣakam |
kodirarbudameteṣāṃ parā saṃkhyā na vidyate || 7 ||

tamevānupraviśyeva bhāti lokaṃ carācaram |
yasyā devyā maheśāni bhāsā sarvaṃ vibhāsate || 8 ||

yadbhāvarahitaṃ kiñcinna ca yacca prakāśyate |
tasyāśca śivaśakteśca cidrupāyāścitiṃ vinā || 9 ||

āndhyamāpadyate nūnaṃ jagadetaccarācaram |
teṣāmanantakoṭīnāṃ mayūkhānāṃ maheśvari || 10 ||

madhye ṣaṣṭhyuttaraṃ te me triśataṃ kiraṇāḥ śive |
brahmāṇḍaṃ vyaśnuvānāste somasūryānalātmanā || 11 ||

agreraṣṭottaraśataṃ ṣoḍaśottarakaṃ raveḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśataṃ candrasya kiraṇāḥ śive || 12 ||

brahmāṇḍaṃ bhāsayantaste piṇḍāṇḍamapi śāṅkari |
divā sūryastathā rātrau somo vahniśca sandhyayoḥ || 13 ||

prakāśayantaḥ kālaṃ te tasmāt kālātmakāstrayaḥ |
ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ ca triśataṃ dinānyeva tu hāyanaḥ || 15 ||

hāyanātmā mahādevaḥ prajāpatiriti śrutaḥ |
prajāpatirlokakartā marīcipramukhān munīn || 16 ||

sṛjatyetāṃllokapālāṃste sarve lokarakṣakāḥ |
saṃhāraśca harāyatta utpatirbhavanirmitā || 16 ||

rakṣā tu mṛḍasaṃlagnā sṛṣṭisthitilaye śivaḥ |
niyuktaḥ parameśānyā jagadevaṃ pravartate || 17 ||

iti | tamevānuprāveśyetyādinā tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvaṃ tasya bhāsā 
sarvamidaṃ vibhātīti śrutyarthaṃ uktaḥ ||

iti 
śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣyaśrībhagava
cchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya 
śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre'ṣṭamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 8 ||




atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| navamaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atra meruprastārakaṃ yantraṃ nityātādātmyakaṃ smṛtam ityatra meruyantre 
sṛṣṭikrameṇa pūjane tu pramāṇamuktam | tatrāyamarthaḥ 
madhyādyaṇimādyantapūjā sṛṣṭipūjā tatra madhyādi ṣoḍaśanityādītyarthaḥ 
| ata eva sṛṣṭicakraṃ ṣoḍaśanityā tādātmyam tathā saṃhāracakraṃ 
mātṛkātādātmyaṃ sthiticakraṃ vaśinyāditādātmyamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ 
śrīcakrarājamuddhṛtya samaṣṭividyayā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt | athavā 
loharatnādinirmitaṃ vā śrīparṇyādisambhave pīṭhe purataḥ saṃsthāpya 
puṣpaṃ dadyāt | samaṣṭividyā tu praṇavatāratrayapūrvakaṃ 
mūlamantramuccāryaṃ 
samastaprakaṭaguptaguptatarasampradāyakulakaulanigarbharahasyātirahasyaparāpara
rahasyayoginīyutaśrīcakrapādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ iti | 
proktaśrīcakroddhārastu ubhayamatasādhāraṇaḥ paraṃ tu kādimate caturasre 
pūrvapaścimadvāradvayamuktamiti viśeṣaḥ | lopāmudropāsakānāṃ viśeṣaḥ 
bhairavayāmale :

lopāmudropāsakaistu proktaśrīcakramadhyataḥ |
bindumadhye pretabījaṃ vilikhet parameśvari || 1 ||

tadbāhyasthatrikoṇeṣu pūrvadakṣiṇasaumyake |
dvāratrayaṃ prakartavyaṃ yathā dvārāṇi bhūpure || 2 ||

manvasrabāhyataścāṣṭadalāgreṣu maheśvari |
granthayastu prakartavyāstriśūlāṣṭakameva ca || 3 ||

granthayaḥ praṇavābhyāṃ ca saṃpuṭatvena yojitāḥ |
pūrvādigranthiṣu tathā pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavān || 4 ||

tadagreṣu daśa proktān vaṭukān pūjayet kramāt |
triśūleṣu mahādevi pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavīḥ || 5 ||

vṛttatraye tu deveśi bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnivāsikāḥ |
yoginīḥ pūjayet tāsāṃ mantrāstu parameśvari || 6 ||

pātālavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ |
bhūrlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ || 7 ||

bhuvarlokanivāsābhyo yoginībhyo namo namaḥ |
(svarlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ) || 8 ||

iti vṛttatraye pūjyamiti viśeṣaḥ | atra sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārabhedena prastārabhedena 
ca śrīcakrabhedā bahavaḥ santi te bhedā agre vakṣyante - iti tu saṃkṣepaḥ | atra 
pātrāsādanapaddhatirlikhyate - tatra dhyānamānasapūjānte svarṇādi paṭṭe 
kuṃkumādinā pūjāyantraṃ vilikhya svapurataḥ saṃsthāpyābhyarcya 
pātrāsādanaṃ kuryāt | atra pūjāyāṃ pātrāṇyatīva praśastāni | taduktaṃ 
rudrayāmale :

vinā pātreṇa yaḥ kuryāt pratiṣṭhāṃ yājñikī kriyā |
viphalā jāyate sarvā vāhanādidhanāpahā || 1 ||

balihīne tu durbhikṣaṃ gandhahīne tvabhāgyatā |
dhūpahīne tathodvegaṃ vastrahīne dhanakṣayam || 2 ||

chatrahīne harecchatraṃ vitānena bako bhavet |
vitānaṃ vimānaṃ tena hīne |

vedihīne tu nāśaḥ syānnagarasya purasya ca |
kalaśairbandhunāśaśca bhavedvai girikanyake || 3 ||

kalaśairhīne ityanuṣajyate |

toraṇānāmabhāve tu hanyājjñātīn sabāndhavān |
dakṣiṇārahite sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||

mantravidyāvihīne tu sampūrṇamapi naśyati |
pātramantrasamāyuktaṃ sarvadoṣāpahaṃ bhavet || 5 ||

iti | anyatrāpi -

ekapātraṃ na kartavyaṃ yadi sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ |
mantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti āpadaśca pade pade || 1 ||

p. 162) iha loke daridraḥ syāt paratra narakaṃ vrajet |
ādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti devatāḥ || 2 ||

iti tantrāntaravacanāccātra tāvatpātratadādhāratatpramāṇatacchodhanādi-
vicāraḥ pradarśyate | tāni pātrāṇi tantrarāje -

trilohakācamṛtpātre tvekasminnarghyakalpanam iti trilohaḥ svarṇarajatatāmrāṇi | 
bhairavītantre -

pātraṃ kāñcanakācarūpyajanitaṃ muktākapālodbhavaṃ viśvāmitrabhavaṃ 
ca kāmaphaladaṃ haimaṃ śriye sphāṭikam |

tāraṃ prītidamiṣṭasiddhijanakaṃ śrīnārikelodbhavaṃ kāpālaṃ sphuṭamatra 
siddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikam || 1 ||

iti | kulārṇave -

hemaraupyaśilātāmrakapālālābumṛnmayam |
nārikelaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca muktāśuktisamudbhavam || 1 ||

puṇyavṛkṣakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ pātraṃ saṃlolitaṃ śubham |

iti | bhairavayāmale -

tārapātraṃ varārohe vijñeyaṃ cottamottamam |
nārikelodbhavaṃ devi jñeyaṃ cottamamadhyayam || 1 ||

kācapātraṃ tu suśroṇi jñeyaṃ cottamakanyasam |
madhyamottamakaṃ haimaṃ tāraṃ madhyamamadhyamam || 2 ||

tāmrapātrādikaṃ caiva proktaṃ madhyamakanyasam |
kanyasottamakaṃ bailvaṃ brahmavṛkṣajameva ca || 3 ||

kanyasamadhyamaṃ proktaṃ mṛnmayaṃ kanyasādhamam |

iti | mahāhārakatantre -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi nārikelavidhiṃ śubham |
purā vai nirmitaṃ pātraṃ viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā || 1 ||

viśvāmitrakapālaṃ tu sarvapātrottamottamam |
tasmin sampūjayeccaiva siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hi || 2 ||

tasya darśanamātreṇa caikaviṃśatikaṃ kulam |
uddhariṣyatyasandeho gṛhastho bhavati priye || 3 ||

brahmahatyādipāpāni tathā viśvāsaghātakam |
dṛṣṭvā pātraṃ nārikelaṃ sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 4 ||

kanyākoṭipradānāni tathā hemaśatāni ca |
yo dadāti maheśāni rāhugraste divākare || 5 ||

tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ nārikelārghyadānataḥ |
alābhe tasya pātrasya pātrasya cānyapātraistu pūjayet || 6 ||

dṛṣṭvārghyapātraṃ deveśi brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ |
nṛtyanti sarvayoginyaḥ prītāḥ siddhiṃ dadanti ca || 7 ||

iti | devīpurāṇe -

hemarājatapātrāṇi kāṣṭhamṛcchailajāni ca |
ratnādīni ca pātrāṇi śubharekhāṅkitāni ca || 1 ||

arghyanaivedyapūjārthaṃ balidāne na kalpayet |

iti | śivarahasye -

hemapātreṇa sarvāṇi īhitāni bhavantyume |
arghyaṃ datvā tu raupyeṇa āyū rājyaṃ sutāṃllabhet || 1 ||

tāmrapātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ dharmaṃ mṛnmayasambhave |
sarvālābhe tu māheyaṃ svahastaghaṭitaṃ yadi || 2 ||

āsanaṃ cārghyapātraṃ ca bhagnamāsādayenna tu |
sarvatra svarṇavat tāmramarghyapātre tato'dhikam || 3 ||

pātrādhārāstathā kāryāḥ pātrāṇīvottamāni ca |
balihomakriyārthaṃ hi vinā pātraṃ na siddhyati || 4 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ pātramuttamaṃ parikīrtitam |
madhyamaṃ tu tribhāgonaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam || 5 ||

vasvaṃgulavihīnaṃ tu na pātraṃ kārayet kvacit |
nābhivivararūpāṇi puṇḍarīkākṛtīni ca || 6 ||

śaṅkhanīlotpalābhāni pātrāṇi parikalpayet |
tattadbhūtasamānābhamaṇḍalābhāni kalpayet || 7 ||

taduktāni phalānyatra kārayet parameśvari |
yādṛśaṃ pātrarūpaṃ syādādhāraṃ tādṛgānayet || 8 ||

iti | devīyāmale -

vaśyākarṣaṇakarmāṇi hemapātre sureśvari |
śāntike pauṣṭike caiva rājataṃ kārayet priye || 1 ||

p. 163) lohapātre samunneye māraṇoccāṭane tathā |
stambhakāryeṣu sarveṣu viśeṣeṇa tu mṛnmayam || 2 ||

mantrārṇauṣadhicūrṇaiśca ghaṭitaṃ pātramuttamam |
tatpātreṇa varārohe devatāṃ yastu tarpayet || 3 ||

ṣaṇmāsābhyantare tasya mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate |
tathā mantrārṇanakṣatravṛkṣotthaṃ pātramuttamam || 4 ||

tenottamena pātreṇa tarpayet paradevatām |
tathaiva mantrasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 ||

etat pātradvayaṃ devi na vaktavyaṃ kadācana |
mantrarkṣayonisambhūtapātraṃ caivottamottamam || 6 ||

parasiddhyāhvānakaraṃ tatpātreṇa ca tarpaṇam |
parābhicāraśamanaṃ svamantrāṇāṃ ca siddhidam || 7 ||

akṣarauṣadhinakṣatrayonyutthāni maheśvari |
pātrāṇi śrīgurumukhājjñātvārcanavidhau kṣipet || 8 ||

sarvakāryeṣu kartavyaṃ vaiśvāmitraṃ ca suvrate |
kāṣṭhapātraṃ vijānīyānmantrārādhanakarmaṇi || 9 ||

iti | kulārṇave -

ādau kumbhaṃ tathā śaṅkhaṃ śrīpātraṃ śaktipātrakam |
gurupātraṃ bhogapātraṃ balipātramanukramāt || 1 ||

svavāmāgrāt tathā sthāpyamityetat pātrapañcakam |
aṅgaṃ vīraṃ tathā guhyaṃ yoginīpātrameva ca || 2 ||

ātmano gaṇanāthasya vaṭukakṣetrapālayoḥ |
prokṣaṇīsahitāni syurnava pātrāṇi suvrate || 3 ||

sthāpayet pṛṣṭhato devyā dūtīpātracatuṣṭayam |
pātrāṇyaṣṭādaśaitāni devyāḥ prītikarāṇi ca || 4 ||

sāmānyārghyaviśeṣārghyāvātmaśrīvakramadhyataḥ |
ādyapaṃkteradhaḥsthāpyau vidhivat parameśvari || 5 ||

iti | sāmānyārghyalakṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe -

raktabilvākṣatairpuṣpairdadhidūrvākuśaistilaiḥ |
sāmānyaḥ sarvadevānāmarghyo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 ||

raktamatra kuṃkumam |

śrīmattripurasundaryāḥ śaṅkhaṃ sāmānyakaṃ bhavet |
anyeṣāṃ devi devānāṃ sāmānyaṃ cācyadīśvari || 2 ||

arghyādipañcapātrāṇi tadadhaḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ |
arghyapātraṃ tu vāyavye nair-ṛtyāṃ pādyapātrakam || 3 ||

āgneyyāṃ snānakalaśamīśe tvācamanīyakam |
madhye tu madhuparkaḥ syādityetatpātralakṣaṇam || 4 ||

āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi akṣatā dadhi taṇḍulāḥ |
sahā siddhārthakā dūrvā kuṃkumaṃ rocanā niśā || 5 ||

arghyo'yaṃ devadevyāstu dvādaśāṅga udāhṛtaḥ |
siddhārthaḥ kuṃkumaṃ dūrvā kuṣṭhaṃ lāmañjakaṃ śaśī || 6 ||

amūni cātra dravyāṇi pādyasya pravadanti ṣaṭ |

iti | sārasaṃgrahe - pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntādbhiruttamam | iti | 
tathā -

phalakaccorakarpūrakuṣṭhailośīrakāṇi ca |
amūnyācamanīyasya dravyāṇi pravadanti ṣaṭ || 1 ||

madhuparke ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhi proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
daghyabhāve payaḥ kāryaṃ maghvabhāve tathā guḍaḥ || 2 ||

ghṛte pratinidhirnāsti jalaṃ tatra samācaret |
aṣṭagandhaṃ samāloḍya snānāmbhaḥ sādhu sādhayet || 3 ||

payodadhighṛtānāṃ ca śarkarākṣaudrayostathā |
pṛthak pātrāṇi pañca syurekaṃ pañcāmṛtasya ca || 4 ||

ṣaṭ pātrāṇi viśiṣṭāni punarācamanīyakam |
saptamaṃ koṣṭhyatoyasya cāṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathā || 5 ||

udvartanasya deveśi daśamaṃ śuddhapāthasaḥ |
etāni daśa pātrāṇi saure śaive ca vaiṣṇave || 6 ||

gāṇapatye ca mukhyāni upapātrāṇi śāktake |
arghyādipañcapātrāṇi tridhā saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ || 7 ||

punarācamanīyasya pātradvayamudāhṛtam |
pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ pañcadhārghyādipañcakam || 8 ||

viśeṣāvaraṇaṃ devi viśeṣārghyeṇa tarpayet |
sāmānyāvaraṇaṃ devi sāmānyārghyeṇa sundari || 9 ||

śrīpātrasthāmṛtenaiva devīnāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet |
śaktīnāṃ śaktipātreṇa gurūṇāṃ gurupātrataḥ || 10 ||

yoginīnāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ navāvaraṇayoginīḥ |
yoginīpātratoyena tarpayet kulanāyike || 11 ||

p. 164) anyāni bhogyavastūni bhogapātreṇa sādhayet |
bhairavasya ca pātreṇa bhairavāṃstarpayedbudhaḥ || 12 ||

vaṭukasya ca pātreṇa vaṭukāṃstarpayet tataḥ |
balipātreṇa deveśi balyutsarjanamācaret || 13 ||

vārāhīkurukullādibalidevīśca tarpayet |
atrādipadena navadurgābaliḥ |

pañcabhūtabaliṃ caiva sarvabhūtabaliṃ tathā |
rājarājeśvarasyāpi baliṃ tenaiva kārayet || 14 ||

vīrāṇāṃ vīrapātreṇa tarpaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam |
guhyapātrāmṛtenaiva tarpayed guhyayoginīḥ || 15 ||

bhogāṅgaṃ bhogapātreṇa layāṅgaṃ cāṅgapātrataḥ |
ūrdhvāmnāyakramaṃ caiva śrīvidyāvṛndapūjanam || 16 ||

viśeṣārghyeṇa deveśi tarpayedbhaktibhāvataḥ |
antaryāgaṃ cātmapūjāṃ cāntarhavanameva ca || 17 ||

ātmapātrasthatoyena kuryāddeśikasattamaḥ |
dūtīyāge prayoktavyaṃ dūtīpātracatuṣṭayam || 18 ||

kulasadbhāvabhāvāya śaktipātrāṇi sundari |
pañca vā ṣaṭ ca saptāṣṭau nava vā sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 19 ||

khaṇḍitaṃ sphuṭitaṃ dagdhaṃ mānahīnamasundaram |
apavitraṃ karodbhraṣṭaṃ paśuspṛṣṭaṃ vivarjayet || 20 ||

sadā śuddhāmlatoyena prakṣālya sthāpayedbudhaḥ |
na kuryāt pātrasāṃkaryaṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||

ūrdhvāmnāyagurūn devi viśeṣārghyeṇa tarpayet |
raśmicakraṃ ca deveśi nānyapātreṇa tarpayet || 22 ||

anyasya guruvargasya gurupātreṇa tarpaṇam |
pātraṃ yanna bhavet tatra prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaret || 23 ||

samaṣṭivyaṣṭiyajanaṃ śaṅkhatoyena vai bhavet |
kṣetrādhipasya pātreṇa kṣetrapālabalirbhavet || 24 ||

gaṇanāthasya pātreṇa gaṇeśasya balirbhavet |
madhyadevyā baliṃ devi śrīpātreṇa visarjayet || 25 ||

śrīvidyāyā maheśāni pūjāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
balyādhārāṇi pātrāṇi śṛṇu vakṣye samāsataḥ || 26 ||

śrīgurorbalipātraṃ ca vārāhyā balipātrakam |
trīṇi vai kurukullāyā vaṭukādeścatuṣṭyam || 27 ||

pañca vai pañcabhūtānāmekaṃ bhūtabalestataḥ |
rājarājeśvarasyaikamekaṃ devyāstataḥ param || 28 ||

ekaṃ tu navadurgāyā dhūpadīpānnasaṃyutam |
ityaṣṭādaśa pātrāṇi sarvavighnaharāṇi ca || 29 ||

pātrapañcakamākhyātaṃ siddhadravyasya śodhane |
pūjādravyasya racanadravyārthaṃ caikapātrakam || 30 ||

kastūrikāgarusudhākarakuṇḍagolotthajāṅgalaguḍaiḥ sapaṭīrapaṅkairyuktaiḥ 
svayambhūkusumeneti yoginītantravacanāt |

anyāni bhogyavastūnāṃ gandhādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
manoharāṇi pātrāṇi sthāpayet pūjayedapi || 31 ||

mārtaṇḍasyārghyadāne tu bṛhadarghyaṃ maheśvari |
ekaṃ prasthajalāgrāhi ekaṃ tarpaṇapātrakam || 32 ||

dvārādipūjane śastamekaṃ sāmānyapātrakam |
tadeva ravipūjāyāṃ sāmānyārghyaṃ bhavet priye || 33 ||

pidhānoddharaṇīyuktaṃ kalaśānāṃ catuṣṭayam |
dukūlavastrasaṃvītaṃ bṛhadādhārasaṃyutam || 34 ||

śuddhodakāmṛtakṣīrasamayāmṛtapūritam |
svavāmāgrāt tataḥ sthāpyaṃ devyā dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ || 35 ||

iti | śuddhodakakalaśalakṣaṇaṃ tu matsyapurāṇe -

-------------dadhyakṣatasamanvitam |
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ pañcabhaṅgadalānvitam || 1 ||

pañca bhaṅgadalāni -

cūtāśvatthavaṭaplakṣoḍumbarāṇāṃ ca pallavāḥ |
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ varuṇaṃ tatra vinyaset || 2 ||

gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāṃśca sarāṃsi ca |
gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamahradagokulāt || 3 ||

mṛdamānīya rājendra sarvauṣadhisamanvitām |
snānārthaṃ vinyaset tatra yajamānaśca dharmavit || 4 ||

sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca nadā hradāḥ |
āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ || 5 ||

iti | rudrayāmale -

śrīkāmastu nyaset samyagdeśavṛttikaraṃ śubham |
kāñcanaṃ ghṛtagodhūmān dūrvārocanayā saha || 1 ||

p. 165) etāni pañca dravyāṇi sarveṣu kalaśeṣu ca |
viśeṣārghyādipātreṣu śrīpātreṣu viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||

dadyācchrīkīrtisārogyaputrāyurjayasiddhaye |

iti | devīpurāṇe -

agnirbrahmā bhavānī ca gajavaktro mahoragaḥ |
skando bhānurmātṛgaṇā dikpālāśca navagrahāḥ || 1 ||

eṣāṃ ghaṭeṣu pratyekaṃ pūjayitvā yathā vidhi |

iti gautamīye -

haimaṃ rūpyaṃ tathā tāmraṃ mārtikyaṃ vā svaśaktitaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ kumbhaṃ vistāronnatiśālinam || 1 ||

ṣoḍaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ vāpi tato nyūnaṃ na kārayet |
arghyasya trīṇi pātrāṇi pādyasyāpi trayaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

tathaivācamanīyāni pātrāṇi ca vibhāgaśaḥ |

iti | bhairavītantre -

yo vāṣṭāṅgārghyamāpūrya devyā mūrdhni nivedayet |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi durgāloke mahīyate || 1 ||

āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi dadhi sarpiḥ sataṇḍulāḥ |
tilā siddhārthakāścaiva aṣṭāṅgārghyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 2 ||

dāraveṇārghyapātreṇa dattvārghyaṃ vidhivannaraḥ |
devyai tadā mahārāja agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 3 ||

tāmrapātrārghyadānena puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet |
raupyapātreṇa dattvā vai viṣṇuyāgaphalaṃ labhet || 4 ||

arghyaṃ dattvā tu raupyeṇa āyū rājyaṃ śubhaṃ labhet |
dattvā sauvarṇapātreṇa labhedbahuḥ suvarṇakam || 5 ||

hemapātreṇa sarvāṇi īhitāni labhenmune |

iti | bhairavayāmale -

pātradvayaṃ tu nirmālyavasinyāḥ śivadiksthitam |
pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ daśa pātrāṇi vai kṣipet || 1 ||

iti | bhairavītantre -

chāgādibalidāne tu nava pātrāṇi sthāpayet |
balipātrāṇi pañca syuḥ rudhirasyaikapātrakam || 1 ||

aparaṃ māṃsakhaṇḍānāṃ mastakādhārameva ca |
ekaṃ pakvasya māṃsasya -------------------------------- || 2 ||

iti rudrayāmale -

arghyādipañcapātrāṇi kumārīpūjane pṛthak |
sthāpanīyāni yatnena yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 1 ||

iti | vārāhī tantre -

dampatīyajane caiva suvāsinyāḥ prapūjane |
yoginīnāṃ samarcāyāṃ pañcāśanmithunārcane || 1 ||

yajane kālanityāyā dhātudaivatapūjane |
gurumaṇḍalapūjāyāṃ dineśānāṃ tathaiva ca || 2 ||

vāreśārcananakṣatradevatārcanayostathā |
akṣarauṣadhipūjāyāṃ japamālāprapūjane || 3 ||

pustakasya ca pūjāyāmagnipūjāvidhau tathā |
arghyādipañcapātrāṇi sampādyāni pṛthak pṛthak || 4 ||

iti | kuṇḍaprakāśe -

home tu daśa pātrāṇi ājyāsthālīdvayaṃ tathā |
carusthālīdvayaṃ caiva praṇītā prokṣaṇī tathā || 1 ||

sruksruvau pūrṇapātraṃ ca homadravyasya cāparam |
mukhyānyetāni pātrāṇi ------------------------------- || 2 ||

iti nāradīye -

devāgrataḥ svavāmāgre trikoṇaṃ candanāmbhasā |
vṛttena veṣṭitaṃ bāhye caturasreṇa caiva hi || 1 ||

viracya mudrayā matsyarūpayā sādhako bhuvi |

p. 166) iti | sārasaṃgrahe -

trikoṇaṃ vṛttasaṃvītaṃ caturasreṇa veṣṭitam |
gandhalipte svavāmāgre vidadhyānmatsyamudrayā || 1 ||

sampūjya gandhairdevārghyamaṇḍalāya namo'ṇunā |
aṅgāni caturasrasya koṇeṣu puratastathā || 2 ||

dikṣu cāstraṃ samabhyarcya śaṅkhādhāraṃ pravinyaset |
mūlena kṣālitaṃ śaṅkhādhāraṃ saṃsthāpayāmi || 3 ||

kālaṃ sabindukaṃ tadvadbhujaṅgeśaṃ samuddharet |
vahnyante maṇḍalāyeti tathā dharmapradeti ca || 4 ||

daśakalātmane proktvā namo gandhādibhiryajet |
vahnerdaśa kalāstatra prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet || 5 ||

iti kulārṇave -

ādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti mātaraḥ |
tasmād vidhivadādhāraṃ kalpayet kulanāyike || 1 ||

ādhāraṃ tripadaṃ prāhuḥ ṣaṭpadaṃ vā catuṣpadam |
athavā vartulākāraṃ kuryād devi manoharam || 2 ||

ityetāni sāmānyavacanāni viśeṣastu prāgevābhihitaḥ | rudrayāmale -

dhūmrārcirūṣmā jvalinī jvālinī visphuliṅginī |
suśrīḥ svarūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe tathā || 2 ||

vahneścaitāḥ kalā jñeyā daśa dharmapradāḥ matāḥ |

iti | sārasaṃgrahe -

astreṇa kṣālitaṃ śaṅkhaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya pūjayet |
śaṅkhamānaṃ tu prādeśaṃ caturaṃgulamucchritam || 1 ||

arghyapātramiti proktvā sthāpayāmīti mantrataḥ |
ahamarthapradāyeti vadeta dvādaśetyapi || 2 ||

kalātmane padaṃ proktvā arghyapātrāya hṛnmanuḥ |
anena śaṅkhamabhyarcya kalāḥ sūryasya pūjayet || 3 ||

iti | yāmale -

tapinī tāpinī dhūmrā marīcirjvālinī ruciḥ |
suṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā || 1 ||

etā dvādaśa sampūjyā raverarthapradāḥ kalāḥ |

iti | sārasaṃgrahe -

tataḥ sudhāmayaistoyairmūlānte mātṛkāṃ paṭhan |
vilomāṃ pūjayettatra pūjako manunāmunā || 1 ||

arghyapātraṃ pūrayāmityuktvā sampūrayet tataḥ

iti śāradātilake -

--------------------- bindusrutasudhāmayai |
toyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpāḍhyai pūjayettaṃ yathāvidhi || 1 ||

bindurbhrūmadhyaṃ tatra candramaṇḍalasya vidyamānatvāt | sārasaṃgrahe -

karṇacandrau binduyuktau kāmapradapadaṃ tataḥ |
ṣoḍaśānte kalāśabdamātmane nama ityatha || 1 ||

gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya kalāṣoḍaśakaṃ yajet |

iti | karṇa ukāraḥ candraḥ sakāro binduranusvārastena uṁ saṁ iti | yāmale -

amṛtā mānadā pūṣā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭī ratirdhṛtiḥ |
śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā || 1 ||

pūrṇā pūrṇāmṛtā kāmadāyinyaḥ svaragāḥ kalāḥ |
somamaṇḍalamadhyasthāḥ ----------------------------------- || 2 ||

iti | sārasaṃgrahe -

prāgvattīrtha samāvāhya mūlamantreṇa tatra ca |
saṃyojya netramantreṇa puṣpaṃ nyasya śikhāṇunā || 1 ||

pradarśya gālinīmudrāṃ mudrayā dhenusaṃjñayā |
amṛtīkṛtya vidhivat sudhābījena sādhakaḥ || 2 ||

dhyātveṣṭadevatāṃ tatra sakalīkṛtya deśikaḥ |
aṅganyāsena cāstreṇa kalayecca diśo daśa || 3 ||

netramantreṇa saṃvīkṣya mudrayā śaṅkhasaṃjñayā |
avaṣṭabhya (guṇṭhya) taduddipya mudrayā yonirūpayā || 4 ||

p. 167) gandhapuṣpādibhistatra pūjayediṣṭadevatām |
ṣaḍaṅgāni ca sampūjya mantrayenmūlamantrataḥ || 5 ||

aṣṭakṛtvastataścārghyaṃ chādayenmatsyamudrayā |

iti | nāradīye - vīkṣaṇaṃ netramantreṇa na cenmūlena mantravit | iti | mūleneti 
pañcāṅgaparaṃ tatra netramantrābhāvāt | atrāpi sarvatra 
tattadaṅgamantrāṇāmevopādānaṃ hṛdayādipadairiti aṅgarūpaiḥ | 
kavacenāvaguṇṭhyeti tattanmudrayeti śeṣaḥ | sārasaṃgrahe - tacchaṅkhasthaṃ 
jalaṃ kiñcit kumbhatoye vinikṣipet iti | śāradātilake :

arghyasyottarataḥ kāryaṃ pādyaṃ sācamanīyakam |
madhuparkaṃ ca saṃsthāpya trikoṇeṣu yathākramam || 1 ||

ekaikapātraṃ mantreṇa hyaṣṭakṛtvo'bhimantrayet |

iti | uttaratantre taddayāt kāṃsyapātreṇa raukmaśvetabhavena vā | iti | śvetaṃ 
rūpyam | vārāhapurāṇe -

paramaṃ yatparaṃ dhāma madhusaṃjñaṃ taducyate |
tadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ || 1 ||

iti | śāradāyām -

dakṣiṇe prokṣaṇīpātramādhāyādbhiḥ prapūrayet |
kiñcidarghyāmbu saṃgṛhya prokṣaṇyambhasi nikṣipet || 1 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre - punarācamanīyārthaṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpayettataḥ | iti | 
prapañcasāre -

gandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilasarṣapāḥ |
dūrvā ceti kramādarghyadravyāṣṭakamudīritam || 1 ||

iti | akṣatāstaṇḍulāḥ | nāradapañcarātre viṣṇorarghyamuktam -

siddhārthakāstilā dūrvāḥ sayavāstilataṇḍulāḥ |
toyakṣīraghṛtopetamidamarghyamudāhṛtam ||

iti | siddhārthāḥ sarṣapāḥ | dūrvāḥ patratrayānvitāḥ | patratrayānvitā 
dūrvāḥ praśastā arghyakarmaṇi | iti somaśambhuvacanāt | prapañcasāre :

pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntābhirucyate |
jātīlavaṅgakakkolairmatamācamanīyakam ||

jātī jātīphalam | tathācamanapātre'pi dadyājjātīphalaṃ mune | 
ityagastyasaṃhitāvacanāt | jātīphalādīni cūrṇitāni deyāni | cūrṇayitvā 
yathānyāyaṃ dadyādācamanīyakam | iti phetkāriṇītantravacanāt | liṅgapurāṇe 
:

kuśāgrāṇyakṣatāścaiva yavavrīhitilāni ca |
ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrake || 1 ||

kuśapuṣpayavavrīhibahumūlatamālakam |
dāpayet prokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ praṇavena ca || 2 ||

uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye caiva prakalpayet |
jātīkakkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakam || 3 ||

cūrṇayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kṣipedācamanīyakam | 
bahumūlaṃ dūrvā |

sahasraparamā devi śatamūlā śatāṃkurā |
sarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinī || 1 ||

śataśabdasya bahutvavācakatvāt | prapañcasāre - śuddhābhiradbhirvihitaṃ 
punarācamanīyakam | ityatra śuddhābhirityukterjātyādi na deyamityavagamyate | 
arghyādidravyālābhe tu śaunakaḥ eṣāmabhāve puṣpādi tattadbhāvanayā 
kṣipet | iti | mantratantraprakāśe - dravyābhāve pradātavyāḥ kṣālitāstaṇḍulāḥ 
śubhāḥ | iti | bhāsitaṃ tu śivapūjāyāmeva | ādrācāre (ādyābhāve) tu 
anukalpāstatpramāṇavacanāni ca tatprayoge pradarśyante ||

atha pātrāsādanaprayogaḥ :

tatrādau śuddhodakakalaśasthāpanamatra kālīmate prathamataḥ 
śaṅkhasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā tadanantaraṃ kalaśasthāpanaṃ vidheyam | kulārṇave :

śaṅkhasya vāmabhāge tu kalaśasthāpanaṃ bhavet |
maṇḍale sthāpayet kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā || 1 ||

tāmraṃ bhūmimayaṃ vāpi yadvā lohajavarjitam |

iti | kādimate tu ādau kumbhaṃ tathā śaṅkhamityādirītyā vidheyam idaṃ tu 
dīkṣāyāṃ vaiparītyaṃ bodhyam |

p. 168) atra yathāgurūpadeśaṃ kāryamiti | svavāmabhāge 
trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ viracya pāśupatāstreṇa tanmaṇḍalaṃ 
prokṣya oṃ hrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ iti trikoṇe oṃ akhaṇḍamaṇḍalāya namaḥ 
iti ṣaṭkoṇe oṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya nama iti vṛtte oṃ sarvatovyāpakamaṇḍalāya nama 
iti caturasre iti | koṇeṣu kāmarūpapīṭhāya nama iti trikoṇe pūrṇagiripīṭhāya 
nama iti ṣaṭkoṇe oṃ jālandharapīṭhāya nama iti vṛtte oṃ uḍiyānapīṭhāya nama iti 
caturasre - iti sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇe mūlavidyāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni trikoṇakoṇeṣu 
mūlavidyāyāḥ kūṭatrayaṃ madhye sampūrṇamūlavidyāṃ 
punarvyastasamastakūṭairmaṇḍalacatuṣṭayaṃ sarvameva pūjayet | tataḥ 
pāśupatāstreṇa suvarṇādinirmitamādhāraṃ prakṣālya maṇḍalopari 
saṃsthāpya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ maṃ dharmapradadaśakalātmane 
vahnimaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ kalaśādhārāya namaḥ iti tadupari 
sampūjya tatra vahnerdaśa kalā vṛttākāreṇa pūjayet | 4 yaṃ dhūmrārciṣe 
namaḥ 4 raṃ ūṣmāyai namaḥ 4 laṃ jvalinyai namaḥ 4 vaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ 4 
śaṃ visphuliṅginyai namaḥ 4 ṣaṃ suśriyai namaḥ 4 saṃ surūpāyai namaḥ 4 
haṃ kapilāyai namaḥ 4 laṃ havyavahāye namaḥ 4 kṣaṃ kavyavahāyai namaḥ iti 
sampūjya abhayeṣṭakarā raktā āgneyo dharmadāḥ kalāḥ iti rītyā dhyātvā 
vahneḥ kalā ihāgacchatāgacchateti krameṇāvāhya vahnikalānāṃ prāṇā iha 
prāṇā ityādyamuṣyapadasthānayojitaprāṇapratiṣṭhāvidyayā tāsāṃ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya tadupari hemādinirmitaṃ sulakṣaṇaṃ 
raktavastragrīvaṃ raktacandanacarcitaṃ pāśupatāstreṇa prakṣālitaṃ kalaśaṃ 
saṃsthāpya tatra 4 aṃ arthapradadvādaśakalātmane sūryamaṇḍalāya 
śrīparadevatāyāḥ kalaśāya namaḥ iti sampūjya sūryasya dvādaśakalā 
vṛttākāreṇa pūjayet | 4 kaṃbhaṃ tapinyai namaḥ 4 khaṃbaṃ tāpinyai namaḥ 4 
gaṃphaṃ dhūmrāyai namaḥ 4 ghaṃ paṃ marīcyai namaḥ 4 ṅaṃ naṃ jvālinyai 
namaḥ 4 caṃdhaṃ rucyai namaḥ 4 chaṃdaṃ suṣumnāyai namaḥ 4 jaṃthaṃ 
bhogadāyai namaḥ 4 jhaṃtaṃ viśvāyai namaḥ aṃṇaṃ bodhinyai namaḥ 4 
ṭaṃḍhaṃ dhāriṇyai namaḥ 4 ṭhaṃḍaṃ kṣamāyai namaḥ iti sampūjya 
abhayeṣṭakarāḥ pītāḥ saurā arthapradāḥ kalāḥ iti rītyā dhyātvā 
prāgvattāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya tanmadhye vilomamātṛkāsahitāṃ 
mūlavidyāmuccaran śuddhodakamāpūryaṃ 4 uṃ kāmapradaṣoḍaśakalātmane 
somamaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ kalaśāmṛtāya namaḥ iti sampūjya somasya 
ṣoḍaśa kalā vṛttākāreṇa pūjayet | 4 aṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ 4 āṃ mānadāyai 
namaḥ 4 iṃ pūṣāyai namaḥ 4 īṃ tuṣṭyai namaḥ 4 uṃ puṣṭyai namaḥ 4 ūṃ 
ratyai namaḥ 4 ṛṃ dhṛtyai namaḥ 4 ṝṃ śaśinyai namaḥ 4 ḷṃ candrikāyai 
namaḥ 4 ḹṃ kāntyai namaḥ 4 eṃ jyotsnāyai namaḥ 4 aiṃ śrīyai namaḥ 4 oṃ 
prītyai namaḥ 4 auṃ aṅgadāyai namaḥ 4 aṃ pūrṇāyai namaḥ 4 aḥ 
pūrṇāmṛtāyai namaḥ iti sampūjya abhayeṣṭakarāḥ śvetāḥ saumyāḥ 
kāmapradāḥ kalāḥ iti krameṇa dhyātvā prāgvattāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ 
vidhāya 
tanmadhye'dhibindvakṣatagajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamahradagokulamṛdaḥ 
kāñcanagoghṛtagodhūmadūrvārocanasarvauṣadhīḥ saṃsthāpya 4 agnaye 
namaḥ 4 brahmaṇe namaḥ 4 bhavānyai namaḥ 4 gajavaktrāya namaḥ 4 
mahoragāya namaḥ 4 skandāya namaḥ 4 bhānave namaḥ 4 mātṛgaṇebhyo namaḥ 
4 dikpālebhyo namaḥ 4 navagrahebhyo namaḥ iti tajjale sampūjya tanmadhye 
gandhāṣṭakaṃ nikṣipya tatra 4 vaṃ varuṇāya namaḥ iti varuṇaṃ 
pañcopacārairārāghya

sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca nadā hradāḥ |
āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ || 1 ||

iti | kromityaṃkuśamudrayā tīrthānyākṛṣya |

gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati |
narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || 1 ||

ityāvāhyāvāhanādiparamīkaraṇāntā mudrāḥ pradarśya mūlamantreṇa 
vīkṣyāstreṇa prokṣya tenaiva kuśaistriḥ santāḍya kavacenāvaguṇṭhya vamiti 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya tanmukhe pañca pallavānnikṣipya

kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇuḥ kaṇṭhe rudraḥ samāśritaḥ |
mūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ || 1 ||

kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sarve saptadvīpā vasundharā |
ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥ || 2 ||

aṅgaiśca sahitā sarve kalaśa tu samāśritāḥ |

iti dhyātvā tadupari uddharaṇīsahitapidhānapātraṃ saṃsthāpya 
sūkṣmavastreṇācchādayet iti śuddhodakakalaśasthāpanavidhiḥ ||

p. 169) atra kṣīrakalaśasthāpanavidhistu śuddhodakakalaśasthāpanavadeva 
bodhyaḥ || tato dūtīpātracatuṣṭayaṃ gṛhītvā kulagehe gatvā tatra dūtīyajanaṃ 
vidhivadācaryya tadutpannakuṇḍagolākhyaṃ dravyaṃ gopyenaikaikasminpātre 
kṛtvā tadānīya svāgre sthāpayitvā tatraivādyādicatuṣṭayamapi 
pṛthakpṛthakpātracatuṣṭaye saṃsthāpya pañcapātrasthadravyapañcakasya 
saṃskāraṃ kuryāt | tadyathā -

tatrādāvādyasya saṃskāraḥ :

ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam |
kacodbhavāṃ | brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham || 1 ||

sūryamaṇḍalasambhūte varuṇālayasambhave |
amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || 2 ||

vedānāṃ praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi |
tena satyena me devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu || 3 ||

oṃ 4 vāṃvīṃvūṃvaiṃvauṃvaḥ brahmaśāpavimocikāyai sudhādevyai namaḥ 
iti tadupari daśadhā japet | 4 hrīṃśrīṃkrāṃkrīṃkrūṃkraiṃkrauṃkraḥ 
brahmaśāpaṃ vimocaya amṛtaṃ (srāvaya srāvaya) svāhā iti daśadhā japet | 
tato mūlavidyāṃ taduparyaṣṭadhā japedityādyaśuddhiḥ || atha dvitīyaśodhanam 
4 oṃ prātadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu 
triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣayanti bhuvanāni viśvā || 4 oṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe 
mahādevāya dhīmahi tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya 
mūlavidyāmapi daśadhā japediti dvitīyaśodhanam || atha tṛtīyaśodhanam 4 oṃ 
tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivarddhanam | urvārukamiva 
bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya 
mūlamantramapi daśadhā japediti tṛtīyaśodhanam || atha caturthaśodhanam :

kṛsaraṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ candrabimbanibhaṃ śubham |
carukaṃ ca manohari śarkarādyaiśca pūritam || 1 ||

pūjākāle devatāyā mudraiṣā parikīrtitā |

tacchodhanaṃ tu 4 oṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva 
cakṣurātatam || tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate | 
viṣṇoryataparamaṃ padam || iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya mūlavidyāmapi 
daśadhā japediti caturthaśodhanam || atha pañcamaśodhanam 4 oṃ amṛte 
amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi śukraśāpaṃ pramocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya 
amṛtaṃ kuru kuru svāhā iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya mūlavidyāmapi daśadhā 
japet iti pañcamaśuddhiḥ || eva sāmānyataḥ pañcadravyāṇi saṃśodhya 
ghaṭādipātreṣu nikṣipya viśiṣya dvitīyavāraṃ śodhayet | tato devīpūjānte 
ātmasamarpaṇasamaye tṛtīyavāraṃ śodhayitvātmasamarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | tacca 
śrīgurumukhādavagantavyam |

taduktaṃ kulārṇave -

āsavaṃ palalaṃ matsyaṃ mudrā golotthameva ca |
etāni pañcadravyāṇi tridhā saṃśodhayettataḥ || 1 ||

śuddhyanti nānyathā devi na ceduktaṃ prayāti ca |

iti | triprakāraśodhanaṃ na cet uktaṃ śrutismṛtipurāṇādau 
uktametatpañcadravyasaṃsargaprayuktadoṣaṃ prayāti prāpnotītyarthaḥ | 
dūtīyāgavidhistu sthūlapaddhatyādau boddhavyaḥ | svayambhūśodhanaṃ tu 
golotthaśodhanavat jñeyam || atha samayāśodhanaṃ kulārṇave :

saṃvidāsavayormadhye saṃvideva garīyasī |
saṃvitprayogaḥ kartavyaḥ pūjādau sādhakottamaiḥ || 1 ||

kartavyā ca mahāpūjā karaṇīyāsuniścitaiḥ |

iti | ayaṃ prayogaḥ kulīnaiḥ sarvatra pūjādau kartavyaḥ | anyatrāpi : ānandena 
vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti devatāḥ | iti | sā ca brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā 
śūdrā : iti caturvidhā śuklaraktapītakṛṣṇapuṣpabhedaiḥ | tāsāṃ śuddhyastu :

saṃvide brahmasambhūte brahmaputri sadānaghe |
bhairavāṇāṃ ca tṛptyarthaṃ pavitrā bhava sarvadā || 1 ||

oṃ brāhmayai namaḥ svāhā iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya 
mūlamantramapyaṣṭadhā japediti brāhmīśuddhiḥ ||

p. 170) siddhimūlakare devi mūlabodhaprabodhini |
rājaputravaśaṅkāri śatrukaṇṭhatriśūlini || 1 ||

aiṃ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā iti daśadhā prajapya mūlamapyaṣṭadhā japet : iti 
kṣatriyāśuddhiḥ ||

ajñānendhanadīpāgre jñānāgre jñānarūpiṇi |
ānandādyāhutiṃ matvā samyajjñānaṃ prayaccha me || 1 ||

hrīṃvaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā iti daśadhā prajapya mūlamapyaṣṭadhā japediti 
vaiśyāśuddhiḥ ||

namasyāmi namasyāmi yogamārgapradarśini |
trailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhava || 1 ||

śrīṃ śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhā iti daśadhā prajapya mūlamaṣṭadhā japediti 
śudddhāśuddhiḥ || atha sāmānyataḥ sarvāsāṃ śodhanaprakārastu mūlena 
vīkṣyāstreṇa prokṣya tenaiva kuśadūrvādinā triḥ santāḍya 
kavacenāvaguṇṭhya vamiti amṛtīkṛtya 4 oṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi 
amṛtamākarṣaya tvaṃ siddhiṃ dehi svāhā iti tadupari daśadhā prajapya 
mūlamaṣṭadhā japet | taduparyāvāhanādidaśamudrāḥ pradarśya 
śuddhodakakalaśasthāpanavat kalaśasthāpanaṃ vidhāya vijayāmṛtenāpūryaṃ 
cakrakalāpūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhodakakalaśasthāpanavadeva vidhāya 
digbandhacchoṭikātālatrayapūrvakaṃ 
pārṣṇighātakarāsphoṭanasamudañcitavaktraiḥ pātālabhūnabholīnān 
vighnānnirasya mūlamantreṇa saptadhā brahmarandhre tarpayitvā 
sahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyavartinaṃ śrīguruṃ saṅketavidyayā 
śrīgurupādukāvidyānte śrīgurupādukāṃ tarpayāmīti tridhā saṃtarpya 
mūlānte śrīparadevatāṃ tarpayāmīti tattvamudrayā mūladevīṃ tridhā 
tarpayitvā 4 mūlaṃ aiṃvadavada vāgvādini mama jihvāgre sthirībhava 
sarvasattvavaśaṅkari svāhā : iti mantramuccaran kalaśāt pātrāntareṇa gṛhītaṃ 
vijayāmṛtaṃ svayaṃ prāśya kalaśoparyuddharaṇīyuktapātreṇācchādya 
tatsarvaṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa cchādayediti vijayākalaśasthāpanavidhiḥ || 
athānukalpadravyāṇi kulārṇave :

ādyābhāve tu vaṭakaṃ jale saṃyojya pūjayet |
satakraṃ vaṭakaṃ vāpi saṃgṛhya ca vicakṣaṇaḥ || 1 ||

guḍamiśreṇa takreṇa tena vā madhubhājinā |
sauvīreṇāthavā kuryādetatkarma na lopayet || 2 ||

dvitīyābhāve laśunamārdrakaṃ nāgaraṃ tu vā |
ādhāya pūjayeddevīmanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

iti | vīratantre -

lavaṇārdrakapiṇyākagodhūmamāṣapañcakam |
laśunaṃ ca maheśāni dvitīyapratinidhau smṛtam || 1 ||

tṛtīyāderabhāve tu yojayedetadeva hi |

iti | caturthādyanukalpastu nāsti | pañcamādyanukalpastvaparājitāpuṣpaṃ 
hayāripuṣpaṃ ca samānīya candanādināparājitāpuṣpamāpūrya 
hayārikusumaṃ tatra saṃyojyobhayaṃ śivaśaktisamāyogatvena paricintya 
kuladravyotpattiṃ vibhāvya tadupari yathāśaktyā nijavidyāṃ japitvā 
tatkusumadvayaṃ viśeṣārghyamadhye nikṣipet | anyānyapi 
kṣīrādīnyanukalpadravyāṇi yathādhikāramavadheyāni || atha kālīmatarītyā 
sāmānyārghyasthāpanam :

tatra svavāmāgre trikoṇavṛttacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ candanādinā 
yathāsaṃbhavadravyeṇa rajobhirjalena vā viracya pāśupatāstreṇa tanmaṇḍalaṃ 
saṃprokṣya oṃ hrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ iti trikoṇamadhye evaṃ koṇatraye 
vṛtte caturasre ca oṃ akhaṇḍamaṇḍalāya namaḥ | oṃ pūrṇamaṇḍalāya namaḥ | oṃ 
sarvatovyāpakamaṇḍalāya nama iti maṇḍalaṃ sampūjya pāśupatāstreṇa 
suvarṇādinirmitamādhāraṃ prakṣālya maṇḍalopari saṃsthāpya maṃ 
dharmapradadaśakalātmane vahnimaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
śaṅkhādhārāya namaḥ iti śaṅkhādhāraṃ sampūjya vahnirūpamādhāraṃ 
vicintya punaḥ pāśupatāstreṇa śaṅkha prakṣālyādhāropari saṃsthāpya aṃ 
arthapradadvādaśakalātmane sūryamaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
śaṅkhapātrāya namaḥ iti śaṅkhaṃ sampūjya sūryarūpaṃ śaṅkhaṃ 
saṃcintya vilomamātṛkāṃ mūlataddinanityāvidyāsahitāmuccaran śuddhatoyena 
tribhāgaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pūrayedbhāgamekaṃ viśeṣapūraṇārthamavaśeṣayet | 
tataḥ oṃ kāmapradaṣoḍaśakalātmane somamaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
śaṅkhāmṛtāya namaḥ iti jalamadhye sampūjya tajjalaṃ candrarūpaṃ vicintya 
sugandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilaśvetasarṣapadadhidūrvādīni śaṅkhajale 
vinyasya pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni karaspṛṣṭāni te rave | tena satyena me deva 
tīrthaṃ dehi divākara || iti sūryamaṇḍalādaṃkuśamudrayā

p. 171) tīrthānyākṛṣya śaṅkhajale vinyasya gaṅge ca yamune ceti 
tīrthānyāvāhya āvāhanādidaśamudrāḥ pradarśya pañcopacāraistāni 
sampūjya vaṣaḍiti gālinīmudrāṃ pradarśyaṃ vauṣaḍiti vīkṣya 
humityavaguṇṭhya agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye dikṣu ca mūlavidyāyāḥ 
ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya tathaiva ṣaḍaṅgamudrāḥ pradarśyaṃ dakṣāṃguṣṭhaṃ 
jale nikṣipya matsyamudrayācchādya jalaṃ spṛśan mūlavidyāmaṣṭadhā 
prajapya nārācamudrayā pāśupatāstreṇa saṃrakṣya vamiti 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya aimiti yonimudrāṃ pradarśya śrīmiti śaṅkhamudrāṃ 
phaṭ iti cakramudrāṃ hrīmiti paramīkaraṇamudrāṃ ca pradarśyaṃ tajjalaṃ 
tejomayaṃ vicintayet iti śaṅkhasthāpanam || atra kādimatānusāreṇa 
pradhānakalaśasāmānyaviśeṣapātrāṇāṃ sthāpanaprakāramagre lekhiṣyāmi 
śrīpātrasthāpanamapi vakṣyāmi | śaktyādi pātrāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ tu 
sāmānyapātravadeva | viśeṣastu viśeṣārghyabinduṃ dattvā tattanmantreṇa 
daśadhā daśadhā prajapet | śaktipātraṃ bālayā gurupātraṃ 
gurupādukāvidyayā bhogapātraṃ samaṣṭividyayā sarveṣāṃ 
balipātrāṇāmabhimantraṇaṃ tattaddevatāmantraiḥ aṅgapātraṃ 
ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīmantrairvīrapātraṃ kāmarājena guhyapātraṃ vāgbhavena 
yoginīpātraṃ navacakreśvarīvidyābhiḥ 
sakṛtsakṛdātmapātramātmāṣṭākṣareṇa prokṣaṇīpātraṃ 
mūlaṣaḍaṅgamantrairdūtīpātracatuṣṭayaṃ bālayaivābhimantrayet | taduktaṃ 
śrīkulārṇave :

śaktipātraṃ varārohe daśadhā prajapet sudhīḥ |
kareṇācchādya dakṣeṇa kumārīṃ tripureśvarīm || 1 ||

tathaiva gurupātraṃ ca pādukāvidyayā śive |
samaṣṭividyayā devi bhogapātre'bhimantraṇam || 2 ||

manubhirbalidevīnāṃ tatpātrāṇāṃ sureśvari |
ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīmantrairaṅgapātraṃ sakṛtsakṛt || 3 ||

vīrapātraṃ mahādevi kāmarājena suvrate |
guhyapātraṃ tu kuṇḍanyā bījena parameśvari || 4 ||

navacakreśvarībhiśca yoginīpātramambike |
ātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa cātmapātraṃ maheśvari || 5 ||

vidyāṣaḍaṅgamantraiśca prokṣaṇīpātramadrije |
kūmāryaiva maheśāni dūtīpātracatuṣṭayam || 6 ||

ityādipramāṇavacanāni tattattantroktāni bodhyāni | 
tathaivārghyādipañcapātrāṇāmapi tattaddevatātmakamantrairabhimantraṇaṃ 
bodhyam | yattu arghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamūlābhyāṃ saṃsādhya vidhivadyajet | 
ityādikramastu saṃkṣepapūjāyāṃ jñeyaḥ | sa kramastu prāgvanmaṇḍalaṃ 
vilikhya tatrākṣataiḥ sampūjya tatra kṣālitamādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya taṃ 
vahnirūpaṃ vicintya tadupari astrakṣālitamarghyādi saṃsthāpya pātraṃ 
sūryarūpaṃ vicintya sampūjya tasmin mūlavidyāsahitavilomamātṛkāmuccaran 
jalenāpūryaṃ tajjalaṃ candrarūpaṃ vicintya sampūjya tasmin prāgvat 
pātrapañcake pṛthakpṛthak śodhitaṃ dravyapañcakaṃ krameṇa nikṣipya 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrairdaśadhā agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye 
dikṣvityādikrameṇākṣataiḥ sampūjya śrīvidyāyāṃ tārtīyakūṭamanyatra 
tattaddevatāmantrai daśadhā prajapya tajjalaṃ tejorūpaṃ vicintayet | iti kādimate 
saṃkṣepataḥ pātrāsādanam ||

vidyātārtīyakūṭena mūladevyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgakaiḥ |
daśadhā japapūjābhyāmarghyaṃ saṃsādhyapūjayet || 1 ||

iti kādimatavacanāt | vastutastvayamāpatkalpaḥ mukhyapūjāyāmāpatkalpo 
garhitastatra mukhyakalpa eva sādhīyān || 
kumārīpūjane'rghyādipañcapātrāṇāmabhimantraṇaṃ bālayaiva 
mālāpūjāvidhau tu prāsādena akṣarauṣadhipūjane pañcabhūtamantraiḥ 
pañcāyatanapūjāyāmapi tattatpātrāṇi tattanmantraireva 
pañcāśanmithunapūjāyāṃ ca mātṛkayā dhātudaivatapūjāyāṃ bhairavyā 
kālanityāyajane tattaddinanityāvidyayā pustakapūjāyāṃ tu prāsādenaiva 
agnipūjāyāṃ tanmantreṇaiva dampatīsuvāsinīyoginīnāṃ yajanādiṣu 
bālayaivābhimantraṇaṃ kuryāt | uddharaṇopidhānānāmapi pāśupatāstreṇa 
kṣālanaṃ tatraivābhimantraṇam | naivedyapātrādibhogyavastūnāṃ 
pātrāṇāṃ tattaddevatāmūlamantraṣaḍaṅgamantreṣūktāstramantreṇa 
kṣālanaṃ tenaivābhimantraṇaṃ ca | idaṃ sarvaṃ gurutaḥ śāstraśca jñātvā 
pūjāyāṃ yojanīyamiti | 
nāravaiśvāmitrākṣarauṣadhicūrṇaghaṭitamantranakṣatravṛkṣotthatādṛśayonyu
tthapātrāṇāṃ saṃskāraḥ prāguktasaṃkṣepakalparītyaiva jñeyasteṣu 
saṃskārabāhulye prayojanābhāvāt | siddhadravyāṇāṃ saṃskāraḥ pratidinaṃ 
vidheyaḥ | anyadinasaṃskṛtadravyamanyadinapūjāyāṃ garhitaṃ 
svayambhūkusumasya tu saṃskṛtasya punaranyadine saṃskāro nāsti || taduktaṃ 
kulārṇave :

svayambhūkusumaṃ samyak śodhayitvā tu deśikaḥ |
nikṣipettena pūjāyāṃ devyāḥ saṃmīlanena ca || 1 ||

p. 172) tena prītā mahādevī sarvasiddhiṃ dadāti ca |
anyāni siddhadravyāṇi pratyahaṃ śodhayedbudhaḥ || 2 ||

ekasmin divase śuddhamanyasmin garhitaṃ bhavet |

ityetena siddhadravyāṇi svayambhūkusumarahitāni pratyahaṃ pūjāyāṃ 
navīnānyeva praśastānītyarthaḥ | atha yantralekhanadravyasya śodhanam : tatra 
kastūryagurukarpūrakuṇḍagolodbhavadravyakesaraguḍacandanasvayambhū-
kusumātmakāṣṭadravyāṇyekasmin pātre 
saṃsthāpyāmṛteśvarīdīpinīvidyābhyāṃ saptavāramabhimantrayet | taduktaṃ 
bhairavītantre :

kastūryagurukarpūragolotthaṃ jāṅgalaṃ guḍam |
malayotthaṃ mahādevi svayambhūkusumaṃ tathā || 1 ||

sarvamekatra saṃyojya dīpinyāmṛtavidyayā |
pṛthakpṛthak saptavāraṃ hastaṃ dattvābhimantrayet || 2 ||

tena śuddhaṃ bhaveddravyaṃ tena dravyeṇa vai likhet |

iti | atra golotthaṃ svayambhūkusumaṃ ca prāgvatpātrāntareṇa śodhitameva 
grāhyam ||

atha kālīmatarītyā kalaśādisthāpanam : tatra svavāmāgre 
vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣārghyamaṇḍalavat maṇḍalaṃ viracya tathaiva sampūjya tatra 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā kṣālitamādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya tathaiva sampūjya 
suvarṇādiracitaṃ kalaśaṃ dhūpavāsitaṃ huṁ huṁ brahmāṇḍacaṣakāya svāhā 
iti vāmakareṇa prakṣālitaṃ aiṃ sandīpini jvālāmālini hrīṃ iti 
sandīpinīvidyayā yonimudrayā sandīpitaṃ kavacenāvaguṇṭhitaṃ oṃ namaḥ hrīṃ 
namaḥ kṣaṃ namaḥ haṃ namaḥ saḥ namaḥ - iti vinyasya pañcamantrān oṃ 3 
śrīmahātripurasundaryā mahākalaśaṃ sthāpayāmi - iti tatra kalaśaṃ 
saṃsthāpya tatra vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣārghyapātravat sūryakalāntaṃ sampūjya 
tatra vakṣyamāṇavidhinaiva karpūrādisuvāsitā paryuṣitaparisrutāpayaḥ 
samāpūrya tatrābjādikaṃ nikṣipya tanmadhye viśeṣārghye vakṣyamāṇaṃ 
maṇḍalaṃ vibhāvya vakṣyamāṇavidhinā somakalāntaṃ sampūjya 
taccaturasraṃ paritaḥ oṃ 3 hsakhapreṃ pathikadevatābhyo huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | 
oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ grāmacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hasakhaphreṃ 
krodhacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hasakhaphreṃ dṛṣṭicaṇḍālini 
huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hasakhaphreṃ sparśacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā 
namaḥ | oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ sṛṣṭicaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 
hsakhaphreṃ ghaṭacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ 
tapanavedhacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ nindā (ṣa) 
caṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ 
sarvajanadṛṣṭisparśacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | oṃ 3 hsakhaphreṃ 
paśupāśacaṇḍālini huṃphaṭ svāhā namaḥ | iti svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena 
pūjayet | ityevaṃ daśa doṣānnirasya oṃ 3 kāṃkīṃkūṃkaiṃkauṃkaḥ 
vikāraśoṣiṇi asya vikārān hanahana svāhā - iti hetumadhye sampūjya

svādiṣṭhayādibhiḥ pūrvabhṛgbhiḥ pañcabhirāyataḥ |
viṣṇuryoniṃ trayeṇaiva tribhiṣṭvāditrayeṇa ca || 1 ||

imaṃ ma iti ca dvābhyāṃ tā mandetyekayā tathā |
śroṇāmeketi caikena śukraśāpaṃ vimocayet || 2 ||

iti kulārṇavavacanāduktapañcadaśamantraiḥ sakṛtsakṛdabhimantrayet | mantrāstu 
ṛgvede yathā svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasya soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave 
sutaḥ || 1 ||

rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam | druṇā sadhasthamāsadat || 2 ||

varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ | parṣi rādho maghonām || 3 ||

abhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ || 4 ||

tvāmacchā carāmasi tadidarthaṃ divedive | indo tve na āśasaḥ || 5 || (9 | 1 | 1-5) 

viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayastu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu |
āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te || 1 ||

garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati |
garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā || 2 ||

hiraṇyayī araṇī yaṃ nirmathato aśvinā |
taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave || 3 || (10 | 184 | 1-3) 

tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva savitarvarṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ |
agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ || 1 ||

punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā |
viśvedevāḥ punīta māṃ jātavedaḥ punīhi mā || 2 ||

prapyāpayasva prasyandasva soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ |
devebhya uttamaṃ haviḥ || 3 || (9 | 67 | 6-28)

p. 173) imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudristomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇyā |
asiknyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhyā suṣomayā || 1 || (10 | 75 | 5)

candanādiliptabhūmau vahannāsāpuṭādhvanā tritāramuccaran nirmāya

agnīśanir-ṛtivāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādyaṅgacatuṣṭayaṃ madhye netraṃ 
prāgādicaturdikṣu astramiti ṣaḍaṅgamantraiḥ sampūjya tatra mūlena 
kṣālitamādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ prathamakūṭamuccārya raṃ 
vahnimaṇḍalāya dharmapradadaśakalātmane śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
sāmānyārghyādhārāya namaḥ iti sampūjya (tatra vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa 
vahnerdaśa kalāḥ sampūjya tatrāstreṇa kṣālitaṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpya oṃ aiṃ 
hrīṃ śrīṃ dvitīyakūṭamuccārya aṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya 
arthapradadvādaśakalātmane śrīparadevatāyāḥ sāmānyārghyapātrāya 
namaḥ iti pātraṃ sampūjya) tatra vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa sūryasya dvādaśa 
kalāḥ sampūjya gandhādisuvāsitaśuddhatoyena praṇavatritāramūlavidyānte

somamaṇḍalāya 

p. 174) kāmapradaṣoḍaśakalātmane śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
sāmānyārghyāmṛtāya namaḥ iti jalaṃ sampūjya vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa 
somasya ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ sampūjya tatra prāgvat savitṛmaṇḍalāttīrthamāvāhya 
kalaśāmṛtabinduṃ dattvā tatra mūlena gandhapuṣpādikaṃ nikṣipya prāgvat 
ṣaḍaṅgamantraiḥ sampūjya hasakṣamalavarayūṃ sahakṣamalavarayīṃ iti 
navātmakamithūnamantreṇa trirabhimantrya hasauṃ varuṇāya namaḥ shauṃ 
vāruṇīdevyai namaḥ iti varuṇamithūnamantreṇa ca trirabhimantrya 
mūlenāṣṭadhābhimantrya dhenuyonimudre pradarśayediti sāmānyārghyaṃ 
vidhāya tatsamīpe sāmānyārghajalena yakṣakardamādigandhadravyamiśritena 
bhūmiṃ vilipya tatra vahacchvāsordhvapuṭābhyāṃ 
caturasravṛttaṣaṭkoṇatrikoṇātmakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vidhāya tanmaṇḍalaṃ 
śaṅkhamudrāmudritavāmakareṇāvaṣṭabhya tanmadhyatrikoṇamadhye 
sabinduturyasvarūpāṃ kāmakalāṃ vilikhya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃśrīṃ 
śrīparadevatāyā viśeṣārghyādhāramaṇḍalāya namaḥ iti maṇḍalaṃ 
sampūjya 4 namontamūlena trikoṇamadhyaṃ sampūjya trikoṇāgrakoṇe 4 
prathamaṃkūṭaṃ namaḥ vāme 4 dvitīyaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇe 4 tṛtīyaṃ namaḥ - iti 
trikoṇaṃ prādakṣiṇyena sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣu prādakṣiṇyena 
svāgramārabhya mūlakūṭatrayasya dvirāvṛttyā pūjayitvā caturasre prāgvat 
ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya taccaturasre svāgrādicaturdikṣu madhye ca prādakṣiṇyena 
4 glūṃ gaganaratnāya namaḥ 4 slūṃ svargaratnāya namaḥ 4 mlūṃ 
martyaratnāya namaḥ 4 plūṃ pātālaratnāya namaḥ 4 nlūṃ nāgaratnāya 
namaḥ iti pañcaratnāni sampūjya punaḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣu svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena 
nyāsoktaṣaḍāsanāni sampūjya caturasravṛttaṣaṭkoṇatrikoṇeṣu 4 
kāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ 4 jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ 4 pūrṇagiripīṭhāya 
namaḥ 4 uḍyānapīṭhāya namaḥ iti pīṭhacatuṣṭayaṃ sampūjya 
śāmbhavadīkṣāvāṃśceccaturasre svāgrādicaturdikṣu madhye ca 
pañcapraṇava puṭitaiḥ praṇavapañcakaiḥ pūjayet | tadyathā aiṃ hrīṃśrīṃ 
hasakhaphreṃ hasauḥ aiṃ hasauḥ hasakhaphreṃ śrīṃhrīṃ aiṃ namaḥ | evaṃ 5 
hrīṃ 5 namaḥ 5 śrīṃ 5 namaḥ 5 hasakhaphreṃ 5 namaḥ 5 hasauḥ 5 namaḥ iti 
sampūjayet | tataḥ mūlaṃ0 sarvaśaktimayīśrīparadevatāyāḥ 
pīṭhacatuṣṭayātmakārghyamaṇḍalāya namaḥ - iti samastaṃ maṇḍalaṃ 
sampūjya tatra mūlena prakṣālitamādhāraṃ gṛhītvā 4 śrīparadevatāyā 
viśeṣārghyādhāraṃ sthāpayāmiti maṇḍalopari saṃsthāpya 4 
prathamakūṭamuccārya maṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya dharmapradadaśakalātmane 
śrīparadevatāyā viśeṣārghyapātrādhārāya namaḥ ityādhāraṃ sampūjya 
tadupari dhūmrārcirādidaśakalāḥ ihāgacchatāgacchata iti vahnerdaśakalāḥ 
samāvāhya tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | tatra 
pūrvoktaprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa mamapadasthāne dhūmrārcirādīnāmiti 
padaṃ nikṣipya prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantramādhāraṃ spṛśan paṭhediti 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya 4 yaṃ dhūmrārciṣai namaḥ 4 raṃ uṣmāyai namaḥ 4 
laṃ jvalinyai namaḥ 4 vaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ 4 śaṃ visphuliṅginyai namaḥ 4 ṣaṃ 
suśriye namaḥ 4 saṃ surūpāyai namaḥ 4 haṃ kapilāyai namaḥ 4 laṃ 
havyavāhāyai namaḥ 4 kṣaṃ kavyavāhāyai namaḥ iti tāḥ sampūjya 
svarṇādiracitaṃ pātramastreṇa prakṣālya 4 śrīparadevatāyā 
viśeṣārghyapātraṃ saṃsthāpayāmi namaḥ iti tatra saṃsthāpya 4 
dvitīyakūṭamuccārya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāyārthapradadvādaśakalātmane 
śrīparadevatāyā viśeṣārghyapātrāya namaḥ - iti pātramadhye sampūjya 
pūrvoktamaṇḍalaṃ vibhāvya pūrvavat pañcaratnāntaṃ sampūjya tathaiva 
pañcapraṇavaistamabhyarcyaṃ tatra sūryasya dvādaśa kalāḥ prāgvat 
samāvāhya prāgvat tannāmapuraḥsaraṃ tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya 
vṛttākāreṇa prādakṣiṇyena tāḥ pūjayet | tadyathā - 4 kaṃbhaṃ tapinyai namaḥ 
4 khaṃbaṃ tāpinyai namaḥ 4 gaṃphaṃ dhūmrāyai namaḥ 4 ghaṃpaṃ marīcyai 
namaḥ 4 ṅaṃnaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ 4 caṃdhaṃ rucyai namaḥ chaṃdaṃ 
suṣumnāyai namaḥ 4 jaṃthaṃ bhogadāyai namaḥ 4 jhaṃtaṃ viśvāyai namaḥ 4 
ñaṃṇa bodhinyai namaḥ 4 ṭaḍhaṃ dhāriṇyai namaḥ 4 ṭhaṃḍaṃ kṣamāyai 
namaḥ : iti sampūjya kalaśasthaṃ jalamuddharaṇapātreṇoddhṛtya mūlavidyānte 
vilomamātṛkāmuccaran tatpātramāpūrya tatrābjādikaṃ nikṣipya aiṃ 
ityaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ puṣpeṇa tatpātrasthaṃ jalamāloḍya tatpuṣpaṃ 
nirasya klīmiti 
candanāgurukarpūracorakuṃkumarocanājaṭāmāṃsīśilārasātmaka-
gandhāṣṭakapaṅkalolitaṃ candanādipaṅkalolitaṃ vā puṣpaṃ nikṣipya sauḥ iti 
gālinīmudrayā nirīkṣya 4 tṛtīyakūṭaṃ oṃ somamaṇḍalāya 
kāmapradāṣoḍaśakalātmane śrīparadevatāyā viśeṣārghyāmṛtāya namaḥ : 
iti pātrasthajalamadhye sampūjya tatra pūrvoktaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vibhāvya pūrvavat 
pañcaratnāntaṃ sampūjya śāmbhavadīkṣāyuktaścettathaiva pañcapraṇavaiḥ 
pūjayet : tatastatra somasya ṣoḍaṣakalāḥ prāgvat samāvāhya prāgvat

ānandabhairavāya vauṣaṭ ānandabhairavaśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarpayāmi

ṣaḍanvayaśāmbhavadīkṣāyuktaścet tadvidyābhistrirabhimantrya tato

jalamadhye samāvāhya prāgvat tannāmapuraḥsaraṃ tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ 
vidhāya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ jagatī chandaḥ sūryo devatā oṃ haṃsaḥ 
śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | 
nṛpadvarasaddatasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ vṛhat | ityanayarcā 
sakṛdabhimantrya punaruccāryaṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ iti jalamadhye sampūjya 4 kaṃ 
sṛṣṭyai namaḥ ityādiprāguktakalāmātṛkānyāsoktaprakāreṇa kacavargakalā 
sampūjya tataḥ ṭatavargotthajarādidaśakalāḥ samāvāhya prāgvattāsāṃ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya oṃ pratadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ 
kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā 
ityanayā ṛcā sakṛdabhimantrya punaruccārya viṣṇave namaḥ iti sampūjya ṭaṃ 
jarāyai namaḥ ityādi tāḥ sampūjya punaḥ payavargotthakalāstīkṣṇādyāḥ 
samāvāhya prāgvat tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya tryambakamityasya 
vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupcchandaḥ tryambakarudro devatā oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe 
sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt || 
ityabhimantrya punaruccārya rudrāya namaḥ iti sampūjya paṃ tīkṣṇāyai namaḥ 
ityādibhiḥ sampūjya punaḥ sakārādikṣakārāntapañcavarṇosthāḥ

gāyatryābhimantrya punaruccārya īśvarāya namaḥ iti sampūjya ṣaṃ pātāyai 
namaḥ ityādi tāḥ sampūjya tataḥ svarotthā nivṛttyādikalāḥ samāvāhya 
prāgvat tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu iti mantrasya
