viniyogaḥ | viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu | āsiñcatu 
prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te || ityabhimantrya punaruccārya sadāśivāya 
namaḥ iti jalamadhye sampūjya aṃ nivṛttyai namaḥ ityādinā sampūjya 
mātṛkayā dvirabhimantrya punaruccārya mātṛkāsarasvatīśrī0 iti sampūjya 4 
aiṃ akhaṇḍaikarasānandakare parasudhāmayi | svacchandasphuraṇāmatra 
vidhehyakularūpiṇi ||

p. 176) ityanena trirabhimantrya | klīṃ akulasthāmṛtākāre siddhijñānakare pare 
amṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasmin vastuni klinnarūpiṇi || iti ca trirabhimantrya sauḥ 
tvadrūpeṇaikarasyatvaṃ dattvā hye tatsvarūpiṇi | bhūtvā parā mṛtākāre mayi 
citsphuraṇaṃ kuru || iti ca trirabhimantrya | aiṃplūṃhrauṃ jūṃsaḥ amṛte 
amṛtodbhave amṛteśvari amṛtavarṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya svāhā 
ityamṛteśvarīvidyayā caturvāramabhimantrya punastāmuccārya amṛteśvarīśrī0 
iti sakṛt saṃpūjya tataḥ aiṃ vadavada vāgvādini aiṃklīṃ klīnnekledini kledaya 
kledaya mahākṣobhaṃ kuru kuru klīṃsauḥ mokṣaṃ kuru kuru sauḥ hsauḥ iti 
dīpinīvidyayā pañcavāramabhimantrya tatastatra mūlavidyāmaṣṭadhā japitvā 
tanmadhye caturasraṃ paścimadvāraṃ vicintya taddvārapārśvayoḥ 
kulavaṭukanāthatadvallabhāmbāśrī0 iti dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ sampūjya tadantaḥ 
prāgvat ṣaḍāsanāni sampūjya tanmadhyatrikoṇamadhyasthabindumadhye 
kāmakalāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa devīmāvāhya dhyātvā 
ṣaḍaṅganyāsayogena sakalīkṛtyagandhādibhiḥ sampūjya vakṣyamāṇavidhinā 
devyaṅge layāṅgaṃ sampūjya tithinityāṃ ṣoḍaśanityā gurupaṃktitrayaṃ 
ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīśca sampūjya vakṣyamāṇasamaṣṭiyoginīmantreṇa triḥ sakṛdvā 
puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā dhūpadīpau nivedya yonidhenumahāyonitriśikhā 
padmasaṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmādamahāṃkuśākhecarībījayoni-
pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇākhyā aṣṭādaśa mudrāḥ pradarśya 
namaskāramudrayā praṇamet | 
atraitāvatkartumaśaktaścedabhimantraṇapūjanayoranyatarat kuryāt |
atrāpyaśaktaścedātmāṣṭākṣarapūjāntaṃ kṛtvānandabhairavamithūnaṃ 
sampūjya santarpyaṃ sṛṣṭyādikalāpūjāmārabhya śeṣaṃ prāgvat samāpayet 
iti viśeṣārghyasthāpanavidhiḥ || tatastatparatastenaiva vidhinā śrīpātrākhyaṃ 
pātrāntaraṃ sthāpayet | tena mūladevyatiriktāvaraṇadevatāstarpayet | 
pūjāsamarpaṇādikaṃ mūladevyāstarpaṇaṃ ca viśeṣārghyeṇaiva | 
tatrānaṅgakusumādiparyantamāvaraṇatrayapūjāsamarpaṇamarghyadānaṃ ca 
sāmānyarghyajalenaiva kuryāt - iti śrīpātrasthāpanavidhiḥ ||

tatastadanukrameṇaiva tadadhaḥ paṃktyākāreṇa 
pādyācamanīyamadhuparkārthaṃ pātradvayaṃ śuddhajalenāpūryaṃ tṛtīyaṃ 
madhuparkadravyeṇāpūrvaṃ teṣu viśeṣārghyajalaṃ kiñcitkiñcid dattvā 
mūlavidyayā pṛthakpṛthagaṣṭavāramabhimantrayet | madhuparke tu 
kāṃsyapātraṃ praśastaṃ tāmrapātravarjamanyadvā pātrāntareṇāchāditaṃ 
kuryāt | gandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratilasarṣapadūrvāḥ sāmānyārghye 
niḥkṣipet | pādyapātre 
śyāmākataṇḍuladūrvākamalāparājitāpuṣpośīrarocanākhyadravyāṣṭakaṃ 
niḥkṣipet | ācamanīyapātre jātīphalalavaṅgakakkolacūrṇāni niḥkṣipet | 
uktadravyābhāve tattadvastubhāvanayā taṇḍulān niḥkṣipet | madhuparkapātre 
dadhimadhughṛtāni niḥkṣipya viśeṣārghyabindunā saṃskuryāt | 
dadhyādyalābhe jalenaiva tadbhāvanayā pūrayet | tataḥ svadakṣiṇāgre 
pādyādipātra vidhānenaiva punarācamanīyapātramapi sthāpayet | 
atrāpyaśaktau pādyāditrayamekasminneva pātre dadyāt | tataḥ 
svagurumukhādavagataviniyogavidhau pātracatuṣṭayaṃ sāmānyārghyavidhinā 
prokṣaṇīpātrāt parataḥ sthāpayet | teṣāṃ nāmāni tu gurupātraṃ śaktipātraṃ 
vaṭukapātraṃ ātmapātraṃ ceti | gurupādukāvidyayā gurupātraṃ bālayā 
śaktipātraṃ vaṭukapātraṃ tanmantreṇātmapātramātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa ceti 
tattanmantreṇa tattatpātramaṣṭadhābhimantrayet | tataḥ prokṣaṇīpātrodakena 
pātrāntaroddhṛtena oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ prathamakūṭamūccārya 
ātmatattvātmane namaḥ || 4 klīṃ dvitīyaṃ vidyātattvātmane namaḥ | 4 sauḥ 
tṛtīyaṃ śivatattvātmane namaḥ | 4 aiṃklīṃsauḥ samastamūlamuccāryaṃ 
sarvatattvātmane namaḥ iti svātmānaṃ prokṣya punarmūlena yāgabhūmiṃ 
yāgopakaraṇāni ca śrīcakraṃ ca prokṣya sarvavastuṣu dhenumudrāṃ 
pradarśayet : ityarghyādipātrasthāpanavidhiḥ || atra śrīpātrasthāpanāśaktau 
viśeṣārghyeṇaiva proktapūjādikaṃ kuryāt ||

atha saṃkṣepataḥ pātrāsādanaprayogaḥ : tatra svavāmabhāge candanādinā 
trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturasrātmakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vilikhya tatra 
pīṭhacatuṣṭayātmakaṃ sampūjya 4 maṃ dharmapradadaśakalātmane 
vahnimaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ kalaśādhārāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
tadupari prāgādiprādakṣiṇyena prāgvat dhūmrārcirādidaśakalāḥ sampūjya 
tatrāstrakṣālitaṃ sudhūpitaṃ kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya 4 aṃ 
arthapradadvādaśakalātmane sūryamaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
kalaśapātrāya namaḥ : iti sampūjya kalaśopari prāgādiprādakṣiṇyena 
tapinyādidvādaśakalāḥ sampūjya tasminnadhikāribhedena vihitaṃ 
kṣīrājyamadhvāsavānyatamaṃ sāṅgaṃ pṛthakpātreṣu prāksaṃskṛta dravyaṃ 
mūlavidyāsahitavilomānulomamātṛkāmūccaran samāpūryaṃ tatra 
ṣaḍaṅgayuvato gurupaṃktitrayaṣoḍaśanityā taddinanityā ratneśvarīḥ sampūjya 
4 oṃ kāmapradaṣoḍaśakalātmane somamaṇḍalāya śrīparadevatāyāḥ 
kalaśāmṛtāya namaḥ : iti ca sampūjya 
prāgādiprādakṣiṇyenāmṛtādiṣoḍaśakalāḥ sampūjya tadamṛtaṃ 
parabrahmamayaṃ sañcintyoddharaṇīsahitapidhānapātreṇācchādya 
sūkṣmavastreṇa samācchādayediti kalaśasthāpanavidhiḥ || anyāni ca pātrāṇi 
etaduktarītyā tattanmantraiḥ sthāpayediti saṃkṣepaḥ ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya- 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
navamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 9 ||




atha 

śrīvidyārṇavatantr

|| daśamaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

athātmapūjā - tatra svapuratastrikoṇamaṇḍale sādhāraṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpya 
kalaśodakenāpūrya viśeṣārghyabinduṃ dattvā svadehaṃ 
candanādibhiralaṃkṛtyātmānamiṣṭadevatārūpaṃ dhyāyan 
gurugaṇapatiparadevatāḥ praṇamya mūlādhārādibrahmarandhraparyantaṃ 
prāgvat kuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā tadrūpiṇīṃ mūlavidyāṃ paribhāvya tattejasā 
pariṇataṃ sveṣṭadevatārūpaṃ svadehaṃ bhāvayan ātmapūjāṃ kuryāt | 
prāguktayogapīṭhanyāsarītyā svadehaṃ yogapīṭhatvena vibhāvya 
hṛtkamalakarṇikāyāṃ śrīcakrādhirūḍhāṃ śrīparadevatāṃ vibhāvya 
vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa ṣoḍaśopacārairārādhya puṣpāñjalipañcakaṃ svadehe 
samarpyaṃ dhūpadīpau nivedyāntarhavanaṃ kuryāt | tatra mūlādhāre tryasraṃ 
kuṇḍaṃ vibhāvya tanmadhye kālāgnimeva kāmāgniṃ 
vāsanārūpendhanaprajvalitaṃ prāṇādipañcavāyubhiḥ saṃdhukṣitaṃ 
kuṇḍalinīrūpaparadevādhiṣṭhitaṃ cidagnimaṇḍalaṃ vibhāvya 
praṇavatritārādimūlavidyānte dharmādharmahavirdīpte ātmāgnau manasā 
srucā | ṣuṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham idaṃ juhomi svāhā iti 
puṇyapāpakṛtyākṛtyasaṅkalpavikalpadharmātmakaṃ haviḥsaptakaṃ 
saptāvṛttyā hutvā tataḥ praṇavatritārādimūlavidyānte 
prakāśāmarśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam | dharmādharmakalāsnehaṃ 
pūrṇavahnau juhomyaham || adharmaṃ juhomi svāheti pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā 
nirastanikhilaprapañco niṣkalabrahmarūpaṃ sādhakaḥ kiyatkṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet | tato 
devīrūpamātmānaṃ dhyātvā śrīgurupādukāṃ praṇamya 
śirasyannapūrṇāṃ dhyātvā tadvidyāṃ yathāśakti japitvā samarpya 
prāṇāyāmarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ 
mūlavidyāmaṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japitvā japaṃ samarpyaṃ stutvā 
praṇamedityātmapūjā || atha śaktiśodhanam | taduktaṃ bhāvacūḍāmaṇau :

adīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyate |
balādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaret || 1 ||

ādau bālāṃ samuccārya tripurāyai samuccaret |
namaḥśabdaṃ samuccāryaṃ imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet || 2 ||

pavitraṃ kuru śabdānte mama śaktiṃ kuru priye |
vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvari || 3 ||

tasyāḥ karṇe'bhedabuddhyā māyābījaṃ samuccaret | iti śaktiśodhanam || tataḥ 
śodhitadravyaṃ tu arghye niḥkṣipet | tathā śrīcakrakrame pūrvaśodhitadravyaṃ 
tu guptenaiva ca saṃkṣipet | iti svatantre :

arghyadravyamarghyapātre niḥkṣipya prayataḥ sudhīḥ |
kuṇḍagolodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ svayambhūkusumaṃ tathā || 1 ||

arghyaṃ datvā maheśāni sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
sudhayā cārghyadānena yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ || 2 ||

mahāyogī bhaved devī pīṭhaprakṣālitairjalaiḥ |

iti | bhairavatantre -

pañcamāttu paraṃ nāsti śāktānāṃ sukhamokṣayoḥ |
kevalaiḥ pañcamairvāpi siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ || 1 ||

iti | tathā -

pūjayedatha paryaṅkamadhye maṇḍukamapyataḥ |
kālāgnirudramādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmamanantakam || 1 ||

varāhaṃ pṛthivīṃ kandaṃ sunālaṃ kesarāṇyapi |
padmaṃ ca karṇikāṃ caiva maṇḍalaṃ samarcayet || 2 ||

dharmaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ jñānamajñānameva ca |
anaiśvaryamavairāgyamadharmamapi pūjayet || 3 ||

p. 179) jñānavidyātmakaṃ caivamātmanaścāpi pūjayet |
gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni dattvā tatra nidhāpayet || 4 ||

tatropari kulaṃ sthāpya pūjānuṣṭhānameva ca |
pūjayecca tatastasyāṃ pañca kāmān samāhitaḥ || 5 ||

oṃkārādinamontaiśca kusumairgandhasaṃyutaiḥ |
arcayitvā caturdikṣu pūjayet kulanāyakam || 6 ||

vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca strībījaṃ kāmarājakam |
blūmātmakaṃ tato dattvā ādhāraśaktimuddharet || 7 ||

trikoṇaṃ tatra saṃlikhya sindūrādyairvarānane |

iti uttaratantre -

tasyā mūrdhni trikoṇaṃ ca mantramālikhya sādhakaḥ |
mahāpretāsanaṃ madhye bālāṃ ca pūjayettataḥ || 1 ||

hsauṃ sadāśivamahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ - iti pūjayet | kulārṇave -

gaṇeśaṃ ca kulādhyakṣaṃ durgāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm |
trikoṇeṣu tu sampūjya basantaṃ madanaṃ priye || 1 ||

stanayoḥ pūjayet paścānmukhe tasyāḥ sudhākaram |

iti | uttaratantre -

maulau gaṇeśaṃ keśāgre kulādhyakṣaṃ lalāṭake |
durgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm || 1 ||

iti jñānārṇave -

dakṣapādādimūrdhāntaṃ vāmamūrdhādi sundari |
pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥ || 1 ||

śraddhā prītī ratiścaivetyādi mātṛkāśvāse draṣṭavyāḥ |
uttaratantre svarairevaṃ prapūjyā hi sarvakāryārthasiddhaye | iti | lalitātantre :

bhage tadīye vijñeyā nāḍyastisraḥ pravāhikāḥ |
ekā tu vāhikā cāndrī saurī cānyā tu vāhikā || 1 ||

āgneyī cāparā jñeyā pūjayet tāstu sādhakaḥ |
ambu sravati cāndrī sā puṣpaṃ sravati bhānavī || 2 ||

bījaṃ sravati cāgneyī tāsu nāmabhirarcayet |
vāgbhavādyairnamoyuktaiḥ pūjayet suprasannadhīḥ || 3 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

pūjayenmadanāgāre raktacandanacarcite |
bhagamālāmanuṃ procya tritārānantaraṃ tathā || 1 ||

aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ jūṃ blūṃ caiva klinne caiva tataḥ param (?) |
sarvāṇīti bhagānīti vaśamānaya me tataḥ || 2 ||

strīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ blūṃ bhagamālinyai namaḥ |

aiṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti mantreṇa gandhādyaistāṃ samarcayet |
ihāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāso maheśvari || 3 ||

athaivaṃ ca vidhānena tāṃ ṣoḍaśopacārakaiḥ |
iṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 4 ||

arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaram |
mūlamantraṃ tataḥ oṃ namo śivāya tataḥ param || 5 ||

yajet tatpuruṣāghorasadyojātādisaṃjñakaiḥ |
tāraṃ ca śāntyatītāṃ ca tadaṅge tadanantaram || 6 ||

samagravidyāmuccārya trikoṇaṃ caiva pūjayet |

iti | ūttaratantre -

avadhūteśvarīṃ kubjāṃ kāmākhyāṃ samayāmapi |
vajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīm || 1 ||

mahācaṇḍeśvarīṃ tārāṃ pūjayettatra sādhakaḥ |
tadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva ca || 2 ||

śivaṃ ca tatra niḥkṣipya gajatuṇḍākhyamudrayā |
dharmādharmahavirdīpte ātmāgnau manasā srucā || 3 ||

suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham |
svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥ || 4 ||

tato japet striyaṃ gacchan vidyāṃ trirbhuvaneśvarīm |
prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucā || 5 ||

p. 180) dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyaham |
svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ śukratyāge prakīrtitaḥ || 6 ||

iti | jñānārṇave -

śivaśaktisamāyogo yoga eva na saṃśayaḥ |
sītkāro mantrarūpaṃ ca vacanaṃ stavanaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

āliṅganaṃ tu kastūrīkarpūraṃ cumbanaṃ bhavet |
nakhadantakṣatādīni puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca || 2 ||

maihunaṃ tarpaṇaṃ viddhi vīryapāto visarjanam |

iti | kulārṇave -

āliṅganaṃ cumbanaṃ ca stanayormardanaṃ tathā |
darśanasparśane yonervikāraṃ (so) liṅgagharṣaṇam || 1 ||

praveśaḥ sthāpanaṃ śakternava puṣpāṇi pūjayet |

iti | yāmale -

saṃyogājjāyate saukhyaṃ paramānandalakṣaṇam |
kulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyāddurlabhaṃ naraḥ || 1 ||

tenāmṛtena divyena sarve tuṣṭā bhavanti hi |
yatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tat kṣaṇādeva siddhyati || 2 ||

iti jñānārṇave -

kuladravyaṃ ca saṃśodhya śivaśaktimayaṃ priye |
bījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japannikṣipya sundari || 1 ||

arghyapātrāmṛtairyatnānnirvikalpaḥ sadānaghaḥ |
śrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavet || 2 ||

iti te kathitaṃ jñānaṃ sāraṃ ramyaṃ varānane |
savikalpastu satataṃ pāpabhāgjāyate naraḥ || 3 ||

vicikitsāparo mantrī jāyate gurutalpagaḥ |
ata eva varārohe nirvikalpaḥ sadā bhavet || 4 ||

iti | kulārṇave -

kulāmṛtaṃ samādāya tadarghye nikṣipedbudhaḥ |
tadarghyeṇa samārādhya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 1 ||

śodhitasya kulāmṛtasaṃjñā | śodhanamantrastu śrīkrame -

oṃ amṛte-amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi priye |
devi padaṃ śukraśāpaṃ pramocaya padadvayam || 1 ||

amṛtaṃ srāvayadvandvamamṛtaṃ kuruyogmakam |
svāhāpadaṃ tato devi śukraśuddhirbhavet priye || 2 ||

śuklairakṣatataṇḍulaiḥ sugandhikusumairyutaiḥ |
arghyadravyaiśca deveśi yonau devīṃ prapūjayet || 3 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvividhaiḥ kulasādhakaḥ |
vidhāya vanditāṃ tāṃ ca taducchiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ caret || 1 ||

iti | śivāgame ca -

avicāraṃ śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibeccakrapuro yadi |
ghoraṃ ca narakaṃ yāti kulamārgāt pateddhruvam || 1 ||

tasmādvircārya yatnena śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibet sudhīḥ |
ānandaṃ kārayedvīrastattvaṃ nirbhrāntitaḥ pibet || 2 ||

iti saṃkṣepataḥ śaktiśodhanaṃ viśeṣastvagre prayogavidhau vakṣyate || atha 
pīṭhapūjā prayogarūpe tatrārghyodakena śrīcakramabhyukṣya svavāmataḥ 
pīṭhopari 4 gurupādukāvidyāmuccārya śrī-amukānandanāthaśrīpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmiti sampūjya dakṣiṇe gaṃgaṇapatiśrī0 iti sampūjya 
sarvādhastādārabhyātalādisaptapātālādibhāvanayoparyupari 4 maṇḍūkāya 
namaḥ 4 kālāgnirudrāya namaḥ 4 mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ ādhāraśaktaye0 4

triḥ sapūjya śrīcakraṃ puratrayātmakaṃ dhyātvā

ṣaḍāsanāni sampūjya caturasre 4 nādaśaktiśrī0 ṣoḍaśadale binduśaktiśrī0 
aṣṭadale 4 kalaśāśaktiśrī0 caturdaśāre 4 jyeṣṭhāśaktiśrī0 bāhmadaśāre 4 
raudrīśaktiśrī0 antardaśāre 4 vāmaśaktiśrī0 aṣṭakoṇe 4 vibadhnīśaktiśrī0

sampūjya ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātmakaṃ śrīcakraṃ dhyātvā 4 aṃ 50 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyāmāyākalāvidyārāgakālaniyatipuruṣa-
prakṛtyahaṅkārabuddhimanaḥśrotratvakcakṣurjihvā 
ghrāṇavākpāṇipāyūpasthaśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyvagni-
salilapṛthivyātmane śrīmahātripurasundaryāḥ yogapīṭhāya namaḥ iti samastaṃ 
pīṭhaṃ puṣpāñjalinā sampūjya tatastadupari madhye prasūnatūlikāṃ 
kalpayāmīti puṣpaṃ niḥkṣipya tadupari 4 hrīṃśrīṃ mahātripurasundaryāḥ 
sakalacaitanyānandamayīṃ oṃkāmeśvarakāmeśvarīmūrti kalpayāmīti 
puṣpādiprakṣepeṇa dhyānoktāṃ mūrtiṃ bhāvayan śaktyutthāpanamudrāṃ 
pradarśya mūlamuccārya parasyai kāmeśvarakāmeśvarīmūrtyai namaḥ iti 
kalpitamūrti pūjayediti yogapīṭhapūjā ||

atha śrīcakrapūjā - 

tatra prathamaṃ svahṛtkamale śrīcakraṃ dhyātvā tanmadhye devīṃ dhyāyet |

tato dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tridaśaiḥ sevanīyakam |
tataḥ padmanibhāṃ devīṃ bālārkakiraṇāruṇām || 1 ||

japākusumasaṃkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumopamām |
padmarāgapratikāśāṃ kuṃkumodarasaṃnibhām || 2 ||

sphuranmukuṭamāṇikyakiṅkiṇījālamaṇḍitām |
kālālikulasaṃkāśakuṭilālakapallavām || 3 ||

pratyagrāruṇasaṃkāśavadanāmbhojamaṇḍalām |
kiñcidardhendukuṭilalalāṭamṛdupaṭṭikām || 4 ||

pinākadhanurākārabhrūlatāṃ parameśvarīm |
ānandamuditollolalīlāndolitalocanām || 5 ||

sphuranmayūkhasaṅghātavilasaddhemakuṇḍalām |
sugaṇḍamaṇḍalābhogajitendvamṛtamaṇḍalām || 6 ||

viśvakarmāvinirmāṇasūtrasuspaṣṭanāsikām |
tāmravidrumavimbābharaktoṣṭhīmamṛtopapām || 7 ||

dāḍimībījavajrābhadantapaṃktivirājitām |
ratnadvi(dī)pasamudbhāsijihvāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīm || 8 ||

smitamādhūryavijitamādhuryarasasāgarām |
anaupamyaguṇopetacibukoddeśaśobhitām || 9 ||

kambugrīvāṃ mahādevīṃ mṛṇālalalitairbhujaiḥ |
maṇikaṅkaṇakeyurabhārakhinnaiḥ praśobhitām || 10 ||

p. 182) raktotpaladalākārasukumārakarāmbujām |
karāmbujanakhajyotirvitānitanabhastalām || 11 ||

muktāhāralatopetasamunnatapayodharām |
trivalīvalayāyuktamadhyadeśasuśobhitām || 12 ||

lāvaṇyasaridāvartākāranābhivibhūṣitām |
anargharatnaghaṭitakāñcīyuktanitambinīm || 13 ||

nitambabimbadviradaromarājīvarāṃkuśām |
kadalīlalitastambhasukumārorumīśvarīm || 14 ||

lāvaṇyakadalītulyajaṅghāyugalamaṇḍitām |
gūḍhagulphapadadvandvaprapadājitakacchapām || 15 ||

nūpurairvilasatpādapaṅkajātimanoharām |
brahmaviṣṇuśiroratnanirghṛṣṭacaraṇāmbujām || 16 ||

tanudīrghāṃgulībhāsvannakhacandravirājitām |
śītāṃśuśatasaṅkāśakāntisantānahāsinīm || 17 ||

lauhityajitasindūrajapādāḍimarāgiṇīm |
raktavastraparīdhānāṃ pāśāṃkuśakarodyatām || 18 ||

ratnapuṣpaniviṣṭāṃ ca raktābharaṇamaṇḍitām |
caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca pañcabāṇadhanurdharām || 19 ||

karpūraśakalonmiśratāmbūlāpūritānanām |
mahāmṛgamadoddāmakuṃkumāruṇavigrahām || 20 ||

sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
jagadāhlādajananīṃ jagadrañjanakāriṇīm || 21 ||

jagadākarṣaṇakarīṃ jagatkāraṇarūpiṇīm |
sarvamantramayīṃ devīṃ sarvasaubhāgyasundarīm || 22 ||

sarvalakṣmīmayīṃ nityāṃ paramānandananditām |
evaṃ dhyāyet pareśānīṃ mahātripurasundarīm || 22 ||

ityevaṃ svaikyena dhyātvā mūlavidyayā śirasi puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā 
punarhṛdayakamale yathoktarūpāṃ bhagavatīṃ sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ 
dhyātvā devīṃ mānasairupacāraiḥ sampūjya naivedyaṃ dattvā 
bhojanāvasare'ntarvaiśvadevaṃ kuryāt || tadyathā tatra mūlādhāre 
ātmāntarātmaparamātmajñānātmetyādicatuṣṭayakḷptaṃ caturasraṃ 
kuṇḍalyagnisamujjvalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhyātvā tatra śrīdevatāṃ dhyātvā tanmukhe 
mūlavidyānte ahantāṃ juhomi svāhā 
ityādyahantāsatyapaiśunyakāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryāṇi suṣumnā 
srugyuktamanaḥsruveṇa pratyekaṃ hutvā punarhṛdayakamale bhuktavatīṃ 
dhyātvā uttarāpośānādisarvopacārairārādhya mūlavidyāṃ yathāśakti 
japitvā japaṃ samarpyaṃ mūlavidyayā vyāpakaṃ vinyasya karābhyāṃ 
puṣpāñjalimādāya mātṛkāmbhojatvena kalpayitvā trikhaṇḍāṃ mudrāṃ 
baddhvā hṛdi śrīcakrarāje devīṃ yathoktarūpāṃ saparivārāṃ dhyātvā 
tejorūpatāmāpādyāntarmudrāprayogeṇa mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīmutthāpya 
tathā saha ṣaṭcakramedakrameṇa hṛdayāntaḥ sphurantīṃ tāṃ tejomayīṃ 
ṣuṣumnāmārgeṇa brahmarandhraṃ nītvā 
paratejaḥsaṅgamenāmṛtamahāmbudhau kṣaṇaṃ viśramya 
śivaśaktisāmarasyasukhamanubhūya 4 hasraiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasrauḥ namaḥ 
śrīmahātripurasundari |

mahāpadmavanāntaḥsthe kāraṇānandavigrahe | sarvabhūtahite mātarehyehi 
parameśvari | ehyehi devadeveśi tripure devapūjite | parāmṛtapriye śīghraṃ 
sānnidhyaṃ kuru siddhaye || deveśi bhaktasulabhe parivārasamanvite | yāvat tvāṃ 
pūjayiṣyāmi tāvat tvaṃ susthirā bhava ||

ityāvāhanamantramuccārya vahannāsāpuṭādhvanā 
trikhaṇḍāmudrāmudritakarasthapuṣpāñjalau tattejaḥ samānīya 
śrīpīṭhāntaḥkalpitamūrteḥ śirasi brahmarandhrasthāne sanniveśya 
kāmeśvarāṅkasthāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ śrīmahātripurasundarīṃ 
sarvāvayavabhāvena dhyāyan mūlamuccārya śrīmahātripurasundari iha tiṣṭha 
tiṣṭheti sthāpinyā mudrayā saṃsthāpya tathaiva iha sannidhehi sannidhehīti 
sannidhāpanīyamudrayā sannidhāpya punastathaiva sannirudhyasva 2 iti 
sannirodhinyā sannirudhya tathaiva sammukhībhava 2 iti tanmudrayā sammukhīkṛtya 
tathaivāvaguṇṭhitā bhava 2 iti tanmudrayāvaguṇṭhya devyaṅge 
ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsena sakalīkṛtya tathaiva 
dhunemudrayāmṛtadhārayābhiṣecanenāmṛtīkṛtya tathaiva mahāmudrayā 
paramīkṛtya etā āvāhanyādinavamudrāḥ pradarśya tato mūlavidyāṃ 
pūrvoktadīpinīvidyāmakārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ coccārya mūlena 
devīṃ triḥ samprokṣya 4 śrīṃhrīṃklīṃhaṃgaṇapakālike sauḥ 
sakalahrīṃklīṃhrīṃkrīṃśrīṃ iti jīvanyāsavidyayā devyā hṛdayakamale 
jīvaṃ saṃsthāpya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | tatra 
pūrvoktaprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa devīṃ hṛdaye spṛśan tanmantraṃ triḥ 
sakṛdvā paṭhedityevaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya tataḥ 
saṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmādamahāṃkuśākhecarībījayonyākhyā 
navamudrāḥ drāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥkroṃ hasakhaphreṃ hsauṃ aiṃ 
ityekaikabījoccāraṇa pūrvakamekaikāṃ mudrāṃ pradarśya āṃ hrīṃ iti 

p. 183) pāśamudrāṃ kroṃkroṃ ityaṃkuśamudrāṃ ghaṃghaṃ iti 
dhanurmudrāṃ drāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥyāṃrāṃlāṃvāṃsāṃ iti 
daśabhirbījairbāṇamudrāṃ ca pradarśya 4 mūlaṃ 
śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāṃ pūjayāmīti devīṃ sampūjya punaḥ 4 
mūlamuccārya śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāṃ tarpayāmīti 
savyahastāṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ 
viśeṣārghyabindubhistrivārādanyūnamaṣṭottarasahasrāvadhi yathāśakti 
śrīparadevatāyā mukhakamale tarpayitvā āsanādiṣoḍaśopacārān kuryāt | tato 
mūlavidyāmuccārya bhagavati śrīmahātripurasundari tubhyamidamāsanaṃ 
kalpayāmi atra āsyatāṃ bhavatyeti 
vārkṣapauṣpacārmavāstrataijasādyanyatamamāsanaṃ kalpayitvā devyā 
vāmabhāge niveśya siṃhāsanapadmamudre pradarśya praṇamya haṃhaṃhaṃ 
idamidaṃ gṛhāṇa syāheti prārthanamudrayā nivedya mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ 
dadyāt | tato mūlavidyāmuccārya śrīmahātripurasundari svāgamitiṃ 
kuśalapraśnaṃ kṛtvā svāgatakuśalamudre pradarśya mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ 
dadyāt | tato mūlaṃ0 śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai arghyaṃ kalpayāmi 
svāheti devyāḥ śirasi sāmānyārghyāt kiñcijjalamuddhṛtya dadyāt | tato 
nivedanamantreṇa nivedyārghyamudrāṃ pradarśya puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt | tataḥ 
pādyapātrājjalamuddhṛtya 4 mū0 śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai pādyaṃ 
parikalpayāmi namaḥ iti devyāḥ pādayoḥ pādyaṃ dattvā prāgvannivedya 
pādyamudrāṃ pradarśya puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt | evamācamanīyaṃ 
parikalpayāmi sudheti mukhe madhuparkaṃ kalpayāmi sudhā iti mukhe dattvā 
tanmudre pradarśya tataḥ punarācamanīyapātrasthaśuddhajalena 
pūrvavadācamanīyaṃ mukhe dattvā tato ratnapāduke upanīya ||

pāduke paridhāyāmba tripure ratnanirmite | snānamaṇḍapamāyāhi snānārthaṃ 
śakradiggatam ||

iti prārthya ratnapāduke paridhāpya snānamaṇḍapaṃ nītvā snānavastraṃ 
paridhāpya kanakāsane samupaveśya pragvadarghyapādyācamanīyāni dattvā 4 
mūlamuccārya śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai snānīyaṃ kalpayāmi namaḥ 
iti sugandhitailāmalakādisnānīyadravyāṇi parikalpya prāgvannivedya 
mahārājopacāravadabhyaṅgādvartanakeśaprasādhanāni vidhāyoṣṇodakena 
nirmalasnānanaṃ kārayitvā vaidikapaurāṇikamantraiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ 
pañcāmṛtena ca snapayitvā punaḥ śuddhajalena snapayitvā 
ikṣurasanārikelasalilapanasāmrādivividhaphalarasaiḥ karpūrādisuvāsitaiḥ 
snapayitvā punarjalenābhiṣicya devāṅganābhiḥ 
suvarṇādighaṭairnānātīrthopahṛtaiḥ salilaiḥ snapayitvā prāgvatpaṣpā~jaliṃ 
mūlena dattvā snānamudrāṃ pradarśyācamanīyaṃ kalpayitvā 
keśāṅgamārjanārthaṃ vastraṃ dattvā jalapracyavanaṃ kārayitvā 
nānāratnakhacitaṃ ratnadukūladvayaṃ vamiti prokṣya mūlenābhimantrya 
bṛhaspatidevatābhyāṃ vāsobhyāṃ namaḥ iti sampūjya 4 mūlaṃ 
śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai vāsasī parikalpayāmi namaḥ iti paridhāpya 
vastramudrāṃ pradarśya punarācamanīyanivedanaṃ puṣpāñjalidānaṃ ca 
kṛtvā paṭṭasūtrabhavaṃ svarṇādiracitaṃ vā kaṇṭhasūtraṃ viṣṇudaivatyāya 
kaṇṭhasūtrāya namaḥ iti pūjitaṃ devyai samarpyopavītamudrāṃ pradarśya 
mū0 śrīmahātripurasundari ||

pāduke paridhāyāmba tripure ratnanirmite | āgaccha nirmalaṃ 
yāmyamalaṅkārasya maṇḍapam ||

iti prārthyālaṅkāramaṇḍapaṃ nītvā siṃhāsane samupaveśyālaṅkārān 
purato nidhāya vamiti prokṣya mūlenābhimantrya viṣṇudaivatebhyo'laṅkārebhyo 
namaḥ iti sampūjya mūlaṃ śrimahātripurasundarīpādukāyai 
mukuṭādyalaṅkārān parikalpayāmi namaḥ iti sāmānyata utsṛjya viśeṣatā 
mukuṭaṃ parikalpayāmi namaḥ ityādi mukuṭa lalāṭābharaṇa karṇapūra hāra 
graiveya kāṃgulīyaka prālambikā ratnasūtrākṣarāvalī karṇottaṃsa 
pārśvabhūṣaṇa nakhadyotāṃgulīyakakaṇṭhalambārdhahāra 
mṛdubhāralalantikāṅgada keyūra valaya bāhuveṣṭana sīmantika 
gaṇḍabhūṣaṇa bhrūbhūṣaṇa nābhibhūṣaṇa ratnamālā maṇimekhalā 
śṛṅkhalā dantaratna karṇaka nīvīratna jānubhūṣaṇa pādāṃgulīyaka 
nupūragucchaka pādakaṭaka haṃsaka kṣudraghaṇṭikā mukhapatrakamiti 
catvāriṃśadbhiranyaiśca cūḍāratnatāṭaṅkādinānāvidhaiḥ 
stryalaṅkaraṇairalaṃkṛtya pūrvavannivedanamantreṇa nivedya puṣpāñjaliṃ 
dattvābharaṇamudrāṃ pradarśya ratnapāduke upanīya 4 mū0 
śrīmahātripurasundari ||

pādukāyugamāruhya pañcavādyapuraḥsaram | yāgamaṇḍapamāyāhi 
parivāragaṇaiḥ saha |

iti prārthya cchatracāmarādinānopakaraṇahastābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha 
yāgamaṇḍapaṃ nītvā kāmeśvarāṅke bhagavatīṃ samupaveśya 
parivāradevatāśca yathāsthānaṃ samupaveśayet || tataḥ śrīcakramārūḍhāṃ 
dhyāyet tripurasundarī mityādiprāguktarītyā dhyātvā mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ 

p. 184) datvā candanāgarukastūryādigandhapañcakaṃ 
cūrṇaghṛṣṭadāhajasamardajaprāṇyaṅgajamiti pañcavidhaṃ gandhaṃ 
tadanyatamaṃ vā prāgvat prokṣya viṣṇudevatāya gandhāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
4 mū0 śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai gandhaṃ parikalpayāmīti gandhaṃ 
samarpya prāgvannivedya gandhamudrāṃ pradarśyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā 
sugandharūpāṇi nānāvidhapuṣpāṇyānīya prokṣya vanaspatidevatābhyaḥ 
puṣpebhyo namaḥ iti sampūjya 4 mū0 śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai 
puṣpāṇi parikalpayāmi vauṣaḍiti puṣpāṇi nivedya puṣpamudrāṃ pradarśya 
puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā dhūpagrāhiṇyāṃ dhūpamānīya prokṣya 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya klīṃ surabhitejase svāhā iti mantreṇa daśāṅga 
śarkarāghṛtamiśritaṃ guggulaṃ vā niḥkṣipya gandharvadaivatyāya dhūpāya 
namaḥ iti dhūpaṃ sampūjya 4 mūlaṃ |

vanaspatirasotpanno gandhādhyo gandha uttamaḥ | āghreyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ 
dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||

śrīmahātripurasudarīpādukāyai dhūpaṃ parikalpayāmi namaḥ iti 
dhūpamutsṛjya dhūpamudrāṃ pradarśyaṃ vāmabhāge ghaṇṭāṃ 
nidhāyāstreṇa prokṣya dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya punarastreṇa gandhādibhiḥ 
sampūjya oṃ jagat dhvanimantramātaḥ svāhā iti ghaṇṭāmantreṇābhimantrya 
vāmahastena vādayan dakṣiṇahastena dhūpapātraṃ cālayan nīcairdhūpaṃ 
nivedya tatpātraṃ devyā vāmabhāge nidhāya dīpapātraṃ goghṛtenāpūryaṃ 
tasmin karpūragarbhiṇīṃ varti niḥkṣipya hrīmiti prajvālya 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya viṣṇudaivatyāya dīpāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 4 mūlaṃ 
svaprakāśo mahādīpaḥ sarvatra timirāpahaḥ | sabāhyabhyantaraṃ 
jyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām || śrītripurasundarīpādukāyai dīpaṃ 
parikalpayāmi namaḥ iti dīpamutsṛjya dīpamudrāṃ pradarśya prāgvannivedya 
ghaṇṭāvādanapūrvakamuccairdīpaṃ pradarśyaṃ tatpātraṃ devyā 
dakṣiṇabhāge niveśya devyagre caturasramaṇḍalaṃ jalena nirmāya 
svarṇādipātraṃ nānāvyañjanabharitaṃ ṣaḍrasopetaṃ 
pañcavidhanaivedyopetaṃ tasmin maṇḍale sādhāraṃ nidhāya mūlena 
nirīkṣyāstreṇa prokṣya tenaiva kuśaistriḥ saṃtāḍya kavacenābhyukṣya oṃ 
jūṃsaḥ vauṣaṭ ityanena saptābhimantritena jalena punaḥ prokṣyāstramantreṇa 
cakramudrāṃ pradarśyādhomukhavāmakareṇa naivedyaṃ spṛśan yamiti bījena 
saptadhā japan tadgatadoṣān saṃśoṣya adhomukhadakṣakareṇa spṛśan ramiti 
vahnibījaṃ saptavāraṃ japan tadgatadoṣān saṃdahya adhomukhavāmakareṇa 
spṛśan vamiti bījena saptadhābhimantreṇa tadamṛtīkṛtya mūlena 
viśeṣārghyabindubhiḥ prokṣya viṣṇudaivatyāya naivedyāya namaḥ iti 
samprajyāstreṇa saṃrakṣya mūlena saptavāramabhimantrya oṃ klīṃkāmadughe 
amoghe varade vicce sphura sphura śrīṃśrīṃśrīṃ iti kāmadhenuṃvidyayā 
dhenumudrayāmṛtokṛtya (mahāmudrayā paramīkṛtya) devyai prāgvat 
pādyācamanīye dattvā mūlavidyayā devīṃ sampūjya pātrāntare 
jalamamṛtīkṛtya culukenādāya vāmāṃguṣṭhena naivedyapātraṃ spṛśan 
mūlamuccārya sāṅgāyai sāyudhāyai saparivārāyai sarvātmikāyai bhagavatyai 
śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai naivedyaṃ kalpayāmi namaḥ iti naivedyopari 
culukodakaṃ samarpayet | tataḥ kṛtāñjalirmūlamuccārya śrīmahātripurasundari

hemapātramataṃ divyaṃ paramānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam | pañcadhā ṣaḍrasopetaṃ 
gṛhāṇa parameśvari ||

ityante prāguktamanunā nivedya pātrāntare jalamamṛtīkṛtya devyā dakṣiṇahaste 
tajjalaṃ kiñcid dattvā kroṃ amṛtopastaraṇamasi svāhā iti devīṃ prāśayitvā 
vāmakareṇa grāsamudrāṃ vikacotpalasannibhāṃ darśayan dakṣiṇahastena 
prāṇādipañcamudrāḥ pradarśayet | tadyathā - 4 aiṃ oṃ prāṇāya svāhā 
ityaṃguṣṭhena kaniṣṭhānāmike spṛśet | 4 klīṃ oṃ apānāya svāhā 
ityaṃguṣṭhena tarjanīmadhyame spṛśet | 4 sauḥoṃ vyānāya svāhā 
ityaṃguṣṭhenānāmikāmadhyame spṛśet | 4 aiṃklīṃ udānāya svāhā 
ityaṃguṣṭhenānāmikāmadhyamātarjanīḥ spṛśet | 4 aiṃklīṃsauḥ samānāya 
svāhā ityaṃguṣṭhena sarvāḥ spṛśet - iti prāṇādipañcamudrāḥ pradarśayan 
pañca grāsān grāhayitvā kṛtāñjalirmūlavidyāmuccārya aiṃ 
ātmatattvavyāpikāśrīmahātripurasundarī tṛpyatu | punaḥ mūlaṃ klīṃ 
vidyātattva0 | 3 mūlaṃsauḥ śivatattva0 | mūlaṃ aiṃklīṃsauḥ sarvatattva0 iti 
tattvairgrāsacatuṣṭayaṃ grāhayitvā kṛtāñjalirmūlavidyāmuccārya 
naivedyamudrāṃ karadvayena pradarśayan 4 mū0 śrīmahātripurasundari

p.185) citpātre saddhaviḥ saukhyavividhānekabhakṣyayuk | nivedayāmi te devi 
sānugāyai juṣāṇa tat ||

ityanena mantreṇa puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpya naivedyajātaṃ tādātmyena 
saparivārāyai devyai nivedayet | tataḥ svarṇādipātrasthaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitaṃ 
jalaṃ dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya 4 mūla0 śrīmahātripurasundari

namaste devadeveśi sarvatṛptikaraṃ param | anyāniveditaṃ śuddhaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ 
śuśītalam || amṛtānandasampūrṇaṃ gṛhāṇa jalamuttamam || iti devyai jalaṃ 
nivedyāstramantreṇa javanikayā bhojanasthalaṃ saṃveṣṭya ghaṇṭāṃ vādayan 
bhuñjānāṃ paradevatāṃ dhyāyet | tadyathā :

brahmeśādyaiḥ sarasamabhitaḥ sūpaviṣṭaiḥ sametā 
śiñjadvālavyajananikarairbījmānā sakhībhiḥ |
narmakrīḍāprahasanaparā paṃktibhoktṝn hasantī bhuṃkte pātre kanakaghaṭite 
ṣaḍrasān cidvilāsā ||

iti dhyātvā mūlavidyāṃ daśadhā japitvā japaṃ samarpya bhuktavatīṃ 
saṃtṛptāṃ devīṃ vibhāvya dhenumudrayā pātrāntare jalenamṛtīkṛtya oṃ 
amṛtāpidhānamasi svāhā iti devyā haste uttarāpāśānajalaṃ dattvā tathā 
tatprāśitaṃ vibhāvya gatasāraṃ naivedyaṃ samuddhṛtya nair-ṛtyāṃ diśi 
sthāpayet | tato'stramantreṇa tatsthānaṃ prokṣiṇyadbhiḥ saṃśodhya 
hastamukhaprakṣālanārthaṃ devyai jalaṃ datvā karodvartanārthe 
sugandhacūrṇaṃ ca datvā gaṇḍūṣāṇi kārayitvā 
karpūraśakalairdantadhāvanaṃ kārayitvā punargaṇḍūṣāṇi kārayitvā 
caraṇaprakṣālanamācamanīyaṃ ca datvā karpūrādinā sugandhamiśritaṃ 
tāmbūlamānīya prokṣya vanaspatidaivatyāya tāmbūlāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
mū0 śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai tāmbūlaṃ kalpayāmi namaḥ ityutsṛjya 
4 mūlaṃ śrīmahātripurasundari

tamāladalakarpūrapūgabhārataraṅgitam | saṃśodhitaṃ sugandhaṃ ca 
tāmbūlaṃparigṛhyatām ||

ityante oṃ haṃhaṃhaṃ idamidamidaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā iti devyai tāmbūlaṃ 
nivedya yonimudrayā praṇamya mūlaṃ śrīmahātripurasundarīśrīpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmi iti sampūjya vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa pūjāṃ vidhāya klīmiti 
namaskāramudrāṃ baddhvā mūlena pradarśya praṇamya hūmiti tyajet | 
śāktaścedanulomavilomena mūlavidyayā saṃpuṭitairmātṛkākṣaraiḥ 
śuddhamātṛkāsthāneṣu devyā dehe gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ sampūjayet | 
ṣaḍaṅgapūjāmapi devyā dehe kuryāt - iti layāṅgapūjā vidyāya 
saṃkṣobhaṇyādi mudrāḥ pradarśya viśeṣārghyabindubhistrirvāmahastena 
saṃtarpyāvaraṇapūjāṃ kuryāt ||

atha layāṅgapūjā tu tantrāntare -

samūlairmātṛkāvarṇairanulomavilomagaiḥ |
tattatsthāneṣu devyaṅge gandhāmbhobhyaktapuṣpakaiḥ || 1 ||

pūjayitvā prathamataḥ ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ pūjayet sudhīḥ |
layāṅgametat saṃproktaṃ devatābhāvasiddhidam || 2 ||

ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ cakre kalpoktavidhinā yajet |
bhogāṅgaṃ tatsamuddiṣṭaṃ devatāprītikārakam || 3 ||

iti | atra layāṅgabhogāṅgapūjā tvāvaśyakī layāṅgaṃ kalpayeddehe devyāstu 
parameśvari iti jñānārṇavoktatvāt atra layāṅgabhogāṅge matadvayasaṃmate | 
devaśuddhau viśeṣamāha kulārṇave :

mūlamantreṇa dīpinyā mālinyārghyodakena ca |
trivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritā || 1 ||

idaṃ tu kālīmate | kādimate tu -

mūlamantreṇa dīpinyā madhu(parkā ? matyā)rghyābindubhiḥ |
trivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritā || 1 ||

iti tripurārṇavoktatvāt | atra samaṣṭipūjā vyaṣṭipūjā ca kartavyā | taduktaṃ 
svacchandasaṃgrahe -

samaṣṭipūjā prārambhe vyaṣṭipūjāvasānake |
kartavyā siddhimicchadbhirdevatāprītikāriṇī || 1 ||

raśmirūpā mahādevyāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ |
svacchādarśe yathā yantre tathaiva pratibimbitāḥ || 2 ||

pratibimbitadevānāṃ pūjā śāstroktamārgataḥ |
samaṣṭipūjā sā proktā vyaṣṭipūjā tathocyate || 3 ||

p. 186) raśmipūjā mahādevyā atra pūjitadevatāḥ |
śrīsundaryaṅgalīnāstāḥ santu sarvasukhāvahāḥ || 4 ||

evamuktvā tu devyaṅge vilīnā yantradevatāḥ |
bimbībhūtā vibhāvyaivaṃ tattatsthāneṣu deśikaḥ || 5 ||

devyaṅgeṣu yajet puṣpairvyaṣṭipūjā samīritā |

iti | āvaraṇapūjāprārambhe tu 4 mūlaṃ saṃvinmaye pare devi 
parāmṛtacarupriye | anujñāṃ dehi deveśi parivārārcanāya me || iti 
puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvāvaraṇapūjāmārabhediti sampradāyaḥ |

tāratrayaṃ dhruvo māyā haṃsaḥsohaṃ śucipriyā |
sarvasaubhāgyajanīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca || 1 ||

natyantamanunā devyai dadyāt puṣpāñjalitrayam |
pradarśayedyonimudrāṃ tataḥ saṃprāthayed budhaḥ || 2 ||

sarvamantramaye devi sarvadevanamaskṛte |
anujñāṃ dehi deveśi parivārārcanāya me || 3 ||

iti saṃprārthya devyaṅgānniryātā visphuliṅgavat |
vahneḥ samastāvaraṇadevatā raśmirūpiṇaḥ || 4 ||

devyājñayā sthitāḥ svasvasthāneṣu paricintayet |
manuścandraḥ kuberaśca lopāmudrā ca kāmarāṭ || 5 ||

agastyanandisūryāśca viṣṇuskandaśivāstathā |
dūrvāsāśca tathā śakraḥ unmanī varuṇastathā || 6 ||

dharmarājo'nalo nāgarājo vāyurbudhastathā |
īśānaśca ratiścaiva tathā nārāyaṇastathā || 7 ||

brahmā jīvo mahādevyupāsakāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
etairupāsitā vidyā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptikāḥ || 8 ||

turīyā binducakre'smin viśeṣārghyāmṛtena ca |
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena tāratrayapuṭāḥ kramāt || 9 ||

amukopāsitā śrī ca vidyā śrīpādukāṃ tataḥ |
pūjayāmi namaścoktvā yajet pañcopacārakaiḥ || 10 ||

pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇadhāriṇyo raktavigrahāḥ |
cintanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvasaubhāgyadā budhaiḥ || 11 ||

darśayedyonimudrāṃ vai sarvasaubhāgyavākpradām |
anena kramayogena vidyāvṛndaṃ prapūjayet || 12 ||

vidyāvṛndamayīṃ pūjāṃ puṣpāñjalividhānataḥ |
nivedayenmahādevyai tarpaṇādi samācaret || 13 ||

etasmin samaye devi tithinityāḥ samarcayet |
vibhāvya ca mahātryasraṃ dakṣapūrvottarakramāt || 14 ||

rekhāsu tisṛṣu devi pañca pañca vibhāgataḥ |
pratipattithimārabhya paurṇamāsyantamadrije || 15 ||

ekaikāṃ pūjayennityāṃ mahāsaubhāgyabhāgbhavet |
kṛṣṇapakṣe vicitrādikāmeśvaryantameva hi || 16 ||

ekaikavṛddhyā hānyā ca darśāntaṃ kramato yajet |
kāmeśvaryādikā nityā vicitrāntāḥ kramādyajet || 17 ||

pañcopacārairgandhādyai śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ |
tattadvidyāṃ samuccārya tāratritayasaṃpuṭām || 18 ||

uccāryāmukanityāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca |
namaḥpadaṃ mahādevi sarvatrāyaṃ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ || 19 ||

kāmeśvarī mahānityā tato vai bhagamālinī |
nityaklinnā mahānityā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinī || 20 ||

mahāvajreśvarī nityā śivadūtī tathaiva ca |
tvaritā ca mahādevi tato vai kulasundarī || 21 ||

nityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā |
jvālāmālinyatha tataścitrā tripurasundarī || 22 ||

raktāṃ raktadukūlāṅgalepanāṃ raktabhūṣaṇām |
pāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikām || 23 ||

varābhīti ca dadhatīṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇīm |
evaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ dhyāyed vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradām || 24 ||

kadambavanamadhyasthāmudyatsūryasamadyutim |
nānābhūṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām || 25 ||

pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca taulikāgatalekhinīm |
varadaṃ cābhayaṃ caiva dadhatī viśvamātaram || 26 ||

evaṃ dhyāyenmahādevīṃ bhagamālāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
raktāṃ raktāṅgavasanāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām || 27 ||

svidyadvaktrāṃ madāghūrṇalocanāṃ ratnamūrcchitām |
pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca mahābhītiharaṃ tathā || 28 ||

dadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityaklinnāṃ padmāsanasthitām |
candrakoṭipratīkāśāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravam || 29 ||

nīlakaṇṭhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nānābharaṇabhūṣitām |
indranīlasphuratkāntiṃ śikhivāhanaśobhitām || 30 ||

pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca cchurikāṃ varadābhaye |
dadhatīṃ cintayed devīṃ bheruṇḍāṃ viṣanāśinīm || 31 ||

p. 187) dhāyet taptasuvarṇābhāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśau svastikaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca varadābhaye || 32 ||

dadhatīṃ ratnamukuṭāṃ devīṃ vai vahnivāsinīm |
japākusumasaṃkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitām || 33 ||

māṇikyabhūṣaṇāṃ nityāṃ nānābhūṣāvibhūṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitām || 34 ||

abhayaṃ dadhatīṃ dhyāyenmahāvajreśvarī parām |
dūrvāvarṇā trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhāsanāsanām || 35 ||

śaṅkhāricāpabāṇāṃśca sṛṇipāśau varābhaye |
dadhatīṃ cintayennityāṃ śivadūtīṃ parāṃ śivām || 36 ||

śyāmāṅgīṃ raktasatpāṇicaraṇāmbujaśobhitām |
vṛṣalāhisumañjirāṃ phaṭāratnavibhūṣitām || 37 ||

parṇāṃśukāṃ parṇabhūṣāṃ vaiśyāhidvandvamekhalām |
tanumadhyāṃ pīnavṛttakucayugmāṃ varābhaye || 38 ||

dadhatīṃ śikhipicchābhāṃ valayāṅgadaśobhitām |
guñjāruṇāṃ nṛpāhīndrakeyūrāṃ ratnabhūṣitām || 39 ||

dvijanāgasphuratkarṇabhūṣāṃ mattāruṇekṣaṇām |
nīlakuñcitadhamillavarapuṣpāṃ kapālinīm || 40 ||

kairātīṃ śikhipicchāḍhyaniketanavirājitām |
sphuratsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ saṃsmaret tvaritāṃ budhaḥ || 41 ||

dhyāyeddevīṃ maheśānīṃ kadambavanamadhyagām |
ratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntare || 42 ||

muktātapatracchāyāyāṃ ratnasiṃhāsane sthitām |
anargharatnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalām || 43 ||

hāragraiveyasadratnacitritāṃ kaṅkaṇojjvalām |
hīramuktālasadbhūṣāṃ śuklakṣaumavirājitām || 44 ||

hīramañjīrasubhagāraktotpalapadāmbujām |
śubhāṅgarāgasubhagāṃ karpuraśakalojjvalām || 45 ||

pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām |
varadānaratāṃ divyāṃ mahāsārasvatapradām || 46 ||

evaṃ dhāyenmahānityāṃ deveśīṃ kulasundarīm |
------------------------------------------------------------------(?) || 47 ||

evaṃ nityāṃ mahādevī cintayeddeśikottamaḥ |
śubhravastrāsanāṃ ramyāṃ candrakundasamadyutim || 48 ||

suprasannāṃ śaśimukhīṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām |
anantamuktābharaṇāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravam || 49 ||

varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ smarennīlapatākikām |
--------------------------------------------------------------(?) || 50 ||

dhyāyeddevīṃ mahānityā svarṇābharaṇabhūṣitām |
udyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇāṃśukavirājitān || 51 ||

mahāsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ jvālāmālāṃ karālinīm |
ariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭau triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā || 52 ||

pānapātraṃ ca varadaṃ dadhatīṃ śatrunāśinīm |
śubhrāṅgī jñānadā nityāṃ vicitravasanāṃ sadā || 53 ||

vicitratilakāṃ nityāṃ vicitrā kuṃkumojjvalām |
varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ nānāśastradharāṃ kvacit || 54 ||

bālārkamaṇḍalābhāsāṃ caturbāhuṃ trilocanām |
pāśāṃkuśau śarāṃścāpaṃ dhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śriye || 55 ||

iti ṣoḍaśanityādhyānāni |

etasmin samaye devi gurūn sampūjayedbudhaḥ |
prāṅmadhyayonyantarāle gurupaṃktitrayaṃ yajet || 1 ||

gurumantreṇa nāmnāpi nijaṃ sampūjayedgurum |
aṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ ca gurūn samyak pratarpayet || 2 ||

ānandanāthaśabdāntā ambāntāḥ śaktayaḥ kramāt |
gurūn sampujayeddevi paramādigurūṃstathā || 3 ||

parāparagurūṃścaiva parameṣṭhigurūṃstathā |
guruśaktīryajed devi tataḥ śrīgurupādukāḥ || 4 ||

iti sāmānyato devi gurupātrodakairyajet |
athādiśivanāthaśca jñānāmbā ca sadāśivaḥ || 5 ||

icchāmbā īśvaraścaiva ambikā rudra eva ca |
raudrī viṣṇustathā jyeṣṭhā brahmā vāmā parābhidhāḥ || 6 ||

rudrasaṃkhyāśca divyaughāḥ sanakaśca sanandanaḥ |
sanātanaścāpi sanatkukārastu tathaiva ca || 7 ||

sanatsujātaśca vibhurdattātreyo'tha rocanaḥ |
vāmadevastathā vyāsaḥ śukaḥ siddhaughasaṃjñakāḥ || 8 ||

parāparākhyā guravo nṛsiṃhaśca maheśvaraḥ |
bhāskaraśca mahādevi tatastasmānmahāśivaḥ || 9 ||

sadāśivo mānavaughā aparākhyā maheśvari |
ete sāmānyaguravaḥ śrīnāthādīn yajettataḥ || 10 ||

paraprakāśābhiśaśca tataḥ paraśivastathā |
paraśaktiśca kauleśaḥ śukladevī kuleśvaraḥ || 11 ||

p. 188) kāmeśvarī ca divyaughāḥ parākhyā guravaḥ kramāt |
bhogaḥ klinnastu samayaḥ sahajo vedasaṃkhyakāḥ || 12 ||

parāparākhyāḥ siddhaughā gagano viśva eva ca |
vimalo madanaścaiva bhuvano līla eva ca || 13 ||

ātmā priyo mānavaughā aparākhyā nijāstathā |
kāmarājākhyavidyāyā guravo'tra prakīrtitāḥ || 14 ||

ajñātaguruśiṣyāṇāṃ kathyante guravaḥ kramāt |
gurubhyo nama ityuktvā pādukābhyo namo vadet || 15 ||

tathaiva parameśāni paramāśca parāparāḥ |
parameṣṭhina ācāryāstato nijagurūn yajet || 16 ||

paramādiśivaścaiva kāmeśvaryambikā tathā |
divyaughaśca mahaughaśca sarvākhyastadanantaram || 17 ||

prajñādevī prakāśaśca divyaughāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ |
lopāmudrā prabhā māyā divyaścitrastathaiva ca || 18 ||

kaivalyānandanāthaśca devyātmānandanāthakaḥ |
mahodayaśca siddhaughāścidānandastathaiva ca || 19 ||

ṛddhyambā ca tathā viśvaḥ śaktyambā ca ramā tathā |
kamalaśca paraścaiva manohara iti kramāt || 20 ||

ātmā ca pramitaścaiva mānavaughāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
lopāmudrākhyavidyāyā guravaśca nijāstataḥ || 21 ||

paraprakāśaśca tathā vimarśastu parādikaḥ |
kāmeśvarī ca mokṣaścāpyamṛtaḥ puruṣastataḥ || 22 ||

aghoraścaiva divyaughāḥ prakāmaḥ sadgurustathā |
siddhaugha uttamaścaite catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 23 ||

siddhaughāśca maheśāni tata uttamasaṃjñakaḥ |
paramākhyaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃjñaśca siddhakaḥ || 24 ||

govindaḥ śaṅkaraścaite mānavaughāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
śrīvidyāmātraguravastato nijagurukramāt || 25 ||

ete turīyāviṣaye guravaḥ sarva eva hi |
jñānamudrāsudhāpūrṇakapālāḍhyakaradvayāḥ || 26 ||

guravo raktavarṇāḥ syurjaṭābhāraśirodharāḥ |
etān pañcopacāraistu yajet saṅghaṭṭamudrayā || 27 ||

gurukramaṃ prapūjyātha yajedāmnāyadevatāḥ |
vasukoṇe tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 28 ||

pūrvāmnāyeśvarīṃ devīmunmanīṃ pūrvadiggatām |
dakṣiṇāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca bhoginīṃ dakṣiṇe yajet || 29 ||

paścimāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca kubjikāṃ paścime yajet |
uttarāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca kālikāmuttare yajet || 30 ||

ūrdhvāmnāyeśvarīṃ devīṃ mahātripurasundarīm |
varābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ śubhāḥ || 31 ||

pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya yonimudrāṃ ca darśayet |
āmnāyaṃ tu prapūjyātha samyagāyatanaṃ yajet || 32 ||

antardaśāre pūrvādi gurupātrāmṛtena ca |
brāhmyadarśanagāyatrīṃ pūrvāyatanadevatām || 33 ||

nārāyaṇaṃ vaiṣṇavākhyaṃ yāmyāyatanadevatām |
sauradarśanasūryaṃ ca paścimāyatanādhipam || 34 ||

bauddhadarśanabuddhaṃ ca uttarāyatanādhipam |
ūrdhvāyatanaśaivākhyadarśaneśaṃ śivaṃ yajet || 35 ||

ūrdhvāyatanaśāktākhyadarśaneśīṃ parābhidhām |
śaktiṃ yajedbinducakre devatāḥ paricintayet || 36 ||

varābhayakarā raktāḥ svasvāyudhakaradvayāḥ |
pañcopacārairārādhya liṅgamudrāṃ pradarśayet || 37 ||

prapūjyāyatanaṃ paścāt pañcaratnaṃ prapūjayet |
bahirdaśāre pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 38 ||

śrīvidyā siddhalakṣmīśca mātaṅgī bhuvaneśvarī |
vārāhīti maheśāni pañcaratnaṃ prakīrtitam || 39 ||

śrīvidyāpūjanasthāne cakrarāje maheśvari |
mahāratneśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitā || 40 ||

sarvasaubhāgyajananīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca |
ityuccārya yajettatra yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet || 41 ||

pāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥ |
pañcaratnaṃ prapūjyātha pañca kalpalatā yajet || 42 ||

caturdaśāre pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ |
śrīvidyā tvaritā caiva pārijāteśvarī tathā || 43 ||

trikūṭā pañcabāṇeśī pañca kalpalatāḥ smṛtāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥ || 44 ||

latānāṃ pūjanānte ca pañcasiṃhāsanaṃ yajet |
aṣṭapatre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 45 ||

bālā sampatpradā ca caitanyā tadanantaram |
dvitīyā caitanyarūpā kāmeśī tadanantaram || 46 ||

(unmanī ca yajedetāḥ pūrvasyāṃ ca diśi kramāt |
siṃhāsanaṃ ca brahmākhyaṃ yajecca tadanantaram || 47 ||

p. 189) aghorabhairavī caiva bhairavī ca mahādikā) |
lalitābhairavī caiva kāmeśī bhairavī tathā || 48 ||

raktanetrā bhoginī ca viṣṇusiṃhāsanaṃ tataḥ |
dakṣiṇe saṃsthitāścaiva yajet saubhāgyahetave || 49 ||

ṣaṭkūṭābhairavī nityābhairavī tadanantaram |
mṛtasañjīvinī caiva mṛtyuñjayaparā tathā || 50 ||

vajraprastāriṇī caiva kubjikā raudrameva ca |
siṃhāsanaṃ yajeddevi paścimāyāṃ diśi kramāt || 51 ||

siṃhāsane tūttare tu prayajedbhuvaneśvarīm |
kamaleśībhairavīṃ ca siddhakauleśabhairavīm || 52 ||

ḍāmarākhyāṃ bhairavīṃ ca kāminībhairavīṃ tathā |
kālikāmīśvarākhyaṃ ca yajet siṃhāsanaṃ budhaḥ || 53 ||

bindumadhye maheśāni ūrdhvasiṃhāsanasthitāḥ |
prathamā sundarī caiva dvitīyā sundarī tathā || 54 ||

tṛtīyā sundarī caiva caturthī sundarī tathā |
pañcamī sundarī caiva mahātripurasundarī || 55 ||

sadāśivākhyaṃ deveśi yajet siṃhāsanaṃ tataḥ |
varābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśakarāḥ śubhāḥ || 56 ||

siṃhāsanābhyarcanānte pañcakośārcanaṃ bhavet |
ṣoḍaśāre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 57 ||

śrīvidyā ca parajyotiḥ paraniṣkalaśāmbhavī |
ajapā mātṛkā ceti pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 58 ||

kośānte pūjayellakṣmīḥ pañca sarvasamṛddhaye |
caturasre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 59 ||

śrīvidyā ca tathā lakṣmīrmahālakṣmīstathaiva ca |
triśaktiḥ sarvasāmrājyā lakṣmyaḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ || 60 ||

pāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥ |
pañca lakṣmīḥ pūjayitvā pañca kāmadughā yajet || 61 ||

sṛṣṭicakre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ |
śrīvidyāmṛtapīṭheśī sudhāsūramṛteśvarī || 62 ||

annapūrṇeti vikhyātāḥ pañca kāmadughāḥ kramāt |
pāśāṃkuśasudhāpātrakalaśā raktavigrahāḥ || 63 ||

pūjayitvā kāmadughāḥ samayāḥ pañca pūjayet |
sthiticakre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 64 ||

bagalā kālarātriśca jayadurgā tathaiva ca |
vajravairocanī devī samayāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ || 65 ||

pāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥ |
samayā pūjanānte tu ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yajet || 66 ||

saṃhāracakre agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇake |
bindumadhye caturdikṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 67 ||

madhye dikṣu krameṇaiva yajet sarvārthasiddhaye |
sarvajñā nityatṛptā ca tathānādiprabodhinī || 68 ||

svatantrā ca mahāśaktirnityāluptā tathaiva ca |
nityānantā ca kathitā tathā bhogaṣaḍaṅgake || 69 ||

tuṣārasphaṭikaśyāmanīlakṛṣṇāruṇārciṣaḥ |
varadābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥ || 70 ||

etāni tu mahādevi viśeṣāvaraṇāni vai |
turīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vai || 71 ||

kūṭavidyāsu vai tattadguravastattadaṅgakam |
atra madhyavidhānīśe navāvṛttirathāmbike || 72 ||

devi madhyavidhānīhāvaraṇāni śṛṇu priye |
turīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vai || 73 ||

aṣṭārapārśvayoragre sāmānyāmṛtabindubhiḥ |
udīcyāṃ prayajed devi kṣobhaṇadrāvaṇau tataḥ || 74 ||

ākarṣavaśyabāṇau ca dakṣiṇe tu samarcayet |
agre saṃmohanaṃ yaṣṭvā cintayed bāṇadevatāḥ || 75 ||

varābhayakarā raktāḥ sṛṇibāṇadhanurdharāḥ |
antardaśāre deveśi pārśvayoragrayostathā || 76 ||

bāṇavad yajanaṃ kuryātpañcakāmān varānane |
kāmamanmathakandarpamakaradhvajasaṃjñakāḥ || 77 ||

mīnaketurmaheśāni pañca kāmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
varābhayakarā raktāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥ || 78 ||

bahirdaśāre ṣaḍvācaḥ kāmavat pūjayet priye |
sāmānyapātrasudhayā līnā vāgaparā parā || 79 ||

madhyamā vāk ca paśyantī vaikharīti prakīrtitāḥ |
jñānamudrābhayāḥ śuklā vīṇāpustakapāṇayaḥ || 80 ||

caturdaśāracakre ca pārśvayorubhayostathā |
agre ca bindumadhye ca sāmānyāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 81 ||

vedasaṃkhyā avasthāśca yajet sarvārthasiddhaye |
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyaśca turīyā ca prakīrtitāḥ || 82 ||

p. 190) varābhayakarā raktā dhṛtapāśāṃkuśāḥ śubhāḥ |
athāṣṭadalamūle ca vṛtte veṣṭanātha śive || 83 ||

sāmānyapātrasudhayā yajedvāmādidevatāḥ |
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī ambikecchā tathaiva ca || 84 ||

jñānā kriyā kubjikā ca bibhvī citrā viṣaghnikā |
bhūcarī khecarī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā || 85 ||

nandā sundandā deveśi śaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
dalāṣṭamūlavṛtte tu vāmādyā divyabhūṣaṇāḥ || 86 ||

pāśāṃkuśadharā raktā varadānaratāstathā |
muktācchatraṃ śaraccandracandrikāramyācamaraiḥ || 87 ||

uśīrakṣiptacandrārkakḷptavyajanayugmakam |
prāntamuktāvalīrājatsvarṇādarśaṃ ca pīṭhikām || 88 ||

alaṅkāramayīṃ peṭīṃ karaṇḍaṃ śaśipūritam |
navaratnasphuraddīptiṃ tāmbūlasya karaṇḍakam || 89 ||

karpūramṛganābhyāḍhyakuṃkumakṣodabhājanam |
caṣakaṃ svarṇaracitaṃ sudhākumbhaṃ kamaṇḍalum || 90 ||

mallikāmālatījātīśatapatrāḍhyadāmabhiḥ |
pūrṇaṃ ratnamayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kaṅkatīṃ gajadantajām || 91 ||

kajjalasya śalākāṃ ca dadhānā nijaśaktayaḥ |
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjamūlavṛtte maheśvari || 92 ||

veṣṭanatvena sāmānyasudhayā raśmipūjanam |
vidadhyādbhāvacinmāyānāthecchātuṣṭipuṣṭayaḥ || 93 ||

sthitimuktī bhuktiśa (?) sadasatsadasadātmikāḥ |
kriyātmajñānalokāśca devavedau tathaiva ca || 94 ||

saṃvijjanmaspandasaṃjñānispandāḥ kuṇḍalī tathā |
śabdavarṇasvarāścaiva vargasaṃyogamantrakāḥ || 95 ||

bhairavo bhūtaraśmiśca raśmivṛndaṃ prakīrtitam |
ṣoḍaśāramūlavṛtte raktā bhāvādiraśmayaḥ || 96 ||

pāśāṃkuśasudhākumbhapānapātradharāḥ śubhāḥ |
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjabāhye prathamavṛttake || 97 ||

veṣṭanatvena sāmānyasudhayā yoginīryajet |
ḍākinī rākiṇī caiva lākinī kākinī tathā || 98 ||

śākinī hākinī caiva yākinī yoginī tathā |
ṣoḍaśārabāhyavṛtte yoginyo ḍākinīmukhāḥ || 99 ||

pāśāṃkuśakapālāsidhāriṇyaḥ śavavāhanāḥ |
muṇḍamālāsamāyuktā daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhāmbujāḥ || 100 ||

caturvaktrā raktavarṇā bhīmarūpā madoddhatāḥ |
madhyavṛtte veṣṭanatve sāmānyasudhayā śive || 1 ||

bhairavīḥ pūjayed devi bhairavī tadanantaram |
mahābhairavyatha siṃhabhairavī dhūmrabhairavī || 2 ||

bhīmādyonmanabhairavyo vaśīkaraṇabhairavī |
mohanākhyā bhairavīti bhairavyaḥ kathitāḥ priye || 3 ||

ṣoḍaśārabahirmadhyavṛtte tu bhairavīmukhāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśakarā bhīmāḥ kapālaśūlapāṇayaḥ || 4 ||

muṇḍamālādharā raktā bhīmadaṃṣṭrāḥ śavāsanāḥ |
tataḥ sāmānyasudhayā bhairavān daśa pūjayet || 5 ||

herukaṃ caiva vetālaṃ tripurāntakameva ca |
agnijihva ca kālāntaṃ karālaṃ caikapādakam || 6 ||

bhīmarūpaṃ mahādevi acalaṃ hāṭakeśvaram |
ṣoḍaśārāntyavṛtte tu herukādyā daśa sthitāḥ || 7 ||

bhairavā bhīmadaṃṣṭrāsyāstriśūlaṭaṅkadhāriṇaḥ |
meghaśyāmāḥ śavārūḍhāḥ kapāladaṇḍadhāriṇaḥ || 8 ||

pūjanaṃ kathitaṃ madhyavidhāvaraṇasaṃjñakam |
śṛṇu vakṣye mahādevi navāvaraṇapūjanam || 9 ||

etaccakraṃ maheśāni madhye binduvirājitam |
tatastrikoṇaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ daśāraṃ ca daśārakam || 10 ||

manukoṇaṃ maheśāni madhyacakramidaṃ priye |
baindavādaṣṭakoṇāntaṃ sarvamadhyamidaṃ bhavet || 11 ||

catvāriṃśadbhagairyuktaṃ tribhagairapi pārvati |
vasupatraṃ kalāpatraṃ caturasraṃ kramāt priye || 12 ||

bhagātkamidaṃ sarvaṃ navayonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet |
catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām || 13 ||

cakre'smin saviśeṣāstāḥ sādhakaṃ mānayanti hi |
vinā gurūpadeśena sādhakaṃ bhakṣayanti hi || 14 ||

trailokyamohane cakre bāhyarekhāṃ samāśritāḥ |
sāmānyapātrasudhayā pūjayet siddhidevatāḥ || 15 ||

caturasrāntarekhāyāṃ paścimādiṣu vai kramāt |
dvāreṣu vāyukoṇādikoṇeṣu hyadha ūrdhvataḥ || 16 ||

dakṣiṇāvartayogena yajet sarvārthasiddhaye |
aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā garimā tathā || 17 ||

īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ bhuktireva ca |
icchā prāptiḥ sarvakāmā mokṣasiddhiḥ kramāt priye || 18 ||

p. 191) sadyaḥsantaptahemābhāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharā śubhāḥ |
mahābharaṇaratnāni sasuvarṇāni vai nidhīn || 19 ||

prayacchantyaḥ sādhakebhyaḥ padmayugmadharāstathā |
trailokyamohane cakre madhyarekhāsamāśritāḥ || 20 ||

taptajāmbūnadābhāsāḥ pañcāśat pīṭhadevatāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśābhayavarakarāḥ prakaṭarūpakāḥ || 21 ||

tāḥ pūjayitvā ca tato brāhmyādyāḥ siddhivadyajet |
pūrvadvārādidvāreṣu śucikoṇādiṣu kramāt || 22 ||

brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā |
vārāhyaindrī ca cāmuṇḍā mahālakṣmīḥ kramāt priye || 23 ||

asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhaśconmattasaṃjñakaḥ |
kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭa bhairavāḥ || 24 ||

kāmarūpaṃ ca malayaṃ kauhlākhyaṃ ca kulāntakam |
cohārapīṭhaṃ deveśi jālandharamataḥ param || 25 ||

uḍyānaṃ devikoṭṭaṃ ca pīṭhāṣṭakamudāhṛtam |
mātaro bhairavāṅkasthāḥ smeravaktrāḥ madālasāḥ || 26 ||

brāhmīprabhṛtayo divyā yoginyaḥ prakaṭāḥ śubhāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ krameṇa dadhatīṃḥ smaret || 27 ||

vidyāṃ śūlaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca cakraṃ caiva gadāṃ tataḥ |
vajravaidūryamālāṃ ca padmaṃ ca varadaṃ tathā || 28 ||

bhairavāstvasitāṅgādyāḥ pīṭhāṣṭakanivāsinaḥ |
śūlaṃ kapālaṃ pretaṃ ca bibhrāṇāḥ kṣudradundubhim || 29 ||

gajatvagambarā bhīmāḥ kuṭilālakaśobhinaḥ |
pāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarāḥ pīṭhāṣṭadevatāḥ || 30 ||

tatra jāmbūnadaprakhyā yoginyaḥ prakaṭāḥ śubhāḥ |
evaṃ tṛtīyarekhāyāṃ siddhivat pūjayet priye || 31 ||

mudrādevīḥ prayatnena sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇādikā tathā |
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā || 32 ||

sarvākarṣaṇikā sarvavaśīkāriṇikā tathā |
sarvonmādinikā caiva tataḥ sarvamahāṃkuśā ||  33 ||

sarvakhecarikā sarvabījamudrā tathaiva ca |
sarvayonistataḥ sarvatrikhaṇḍā parikīrtitā || 34 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyā mudrāstāḥ saumyavigrahāḥ |
ghṛtapāśāṃkuśāḥ sarvāḥ svasvamudrākarāstathā || 35 ||

taptacāmīkarābhāsā yoginyaḥ prakaṭāḥ śubhāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśotpalābhītipāṇayo raktavigrahāḥ || 36 ||

prakaṭāḥ kāmarūpādicatuṣpīṭhādidevatāḥ |
aṇimāsiddhipurataścakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajet || 37 ||

pañcopacārairārādhya mudrāmādyāṃ ca darśayet |
etāḥ prakaṭayoginyaścaturasre vyavasthitāḥ || 38 ||

trailokyamohinīcakre samudrāḥ sāyudhāstathā |
savāhanāśca saparivārāścaiva sasiddhayaḥ || 39 ||

sāṅgopāṅgāśca sarvopacāraiḥ sampūjitāstathā |
tarpitāḥ santviti vadejjalaṃ tatra viniḥkṣipet || 40 ||

abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ me dehi tripure devapūjite |
bhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ prathamāvaraṇarcanam || 41 ||

ityuccārya mahādevyai dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ |
iti te kathitaṃ bhadre prathamāvaraṇārcanam || 42 ||

atha vakṣye maheśāni dvitīyāvaraṇārcanam |
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu kāmākarṣiṇikāṃ yajet || 43 ||

sāmānyapātrasudhayā paścimādikrameṇa tu |
kāmākarṣiṇikā caiva buddhyākarṣiṇikā tathā || 44 ||

ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī ca śabdākarṣiṇikā tathā |
sparśākarṣiṇikā caiva rūpākarṣiṇikā tathā || 45 ||

rasākarṣiṇikā caiva gandhākarṣiṇikā tathā |
cittākarṣiṇikā caiva dhairyākarṣiṇikā tathā || 46 ||

smṛtyākarṣiṇikā caiva nāmākarṣiṇikā tathā |
bījākarṣiṇikā caivāmṛtākarṣiṇikā tathā || 47 ||

ātmākarṣiṇikā caiva śarīrākarṣiṇī tathā |
sarvāśāpūrake cakre dalaṣoḍaśake sthitāḥ || 48 ||

kāmākarṣiṇikādyāśca yoginyo guptasaṃjñakāḥ |
kalāṣoḍaśarūpāśca candramaṇḍalamadhyagāḥ || 49 ||

svaravarṇā raktavarṇāḥ sravatpīyūṣavigrahāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśa(dharāḥ)sudhāpūrṇakāśmarīghaṭadānandāḥ (?) || 50 ||

cakreśīṃ tripureśīṃ ca kāmākarṣiṇikāgrataḥ |
yajedvidrāviṇīṃ mudrāṃ darśayedbhāgyahetave || 51 ||

etāstu guptayoginyaḥ sarvāśāpūrake tathā |
cakre samudrā ityādi devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet || 52 ||

abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ me dehi tripure devapūjite |
bhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇārcanam || 53 ||

p. 192) ityuccārya ca deveśyai dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ |
sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇe cakre dalāṣṭakavijṛmbhite || 54 ||

yajet sāmānyasudhayā anaṅgakusumādikāḥ |
pūrvādidikṣu patreṣu āgneyādividikṣu ca || 55 ||

anaṅgakusumānaṅgamekhalā tadanantaram |
anaṅgamadanā paścādanaṅgamadanāturā || 56 ||

anaṅgarekhānaṅgaveginyathānaṅgāṃkuśā tataḥ |
anaṅgamālinī hyetā bandhūkakusumaprabhāḥ || 57 ||

pāśāṃkuśasphuratkundanīlotpalakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
anaṅgakusumāgre tu yajet tripurasundarīm || 58 ||

cakreśīṃ darśayenmudrāṃ sarvākarṣiṇikāṃ tataḥ |
etāguptatarāścaiva yoginyaḥ sarvasaṃ tataḥ || 59 ||

kṣobhaṇe ca tathā cakre samudretyādinā tataḥ |
devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyādabhīṣṭheti ca mantravit || 60 ||

caturdaśārake cakre sarvasaubhāgyadābhidhe |
sāmānyādbhiḥ paścimādivāmāvartakrameṇa ca || 61 ||

sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyāḥ śaktīrvai pūjayet priye |
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī śaktiḥ sarvavidrāviṇī tathā || 62 ||

sarvākarṣiṇyatha tataḥ sarvāhlādinyanantaram |
sarvasammohinī sarvastambhinī sarvajṛmbhiṇī || 63 ||

sarvavaśaṅkarī śaktiḥ tathā sarvārtharañjinī |
tataḥ sarvonmādinī ca tathā sarvārthasādhinī || 64 ||

tato vai sarvasampattipūraṇī śaktireva ca |
sarvamantramayī śaktiḥ sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī || 65 ||

sarvasaubhāgyade cakre sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīmukhāḥ |
sampradāyākhyayoginyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 66 ||

indragopanibhāḥ sarvāḥ sagarvonmattayauvanāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśau darpaṇaṃ ca pānapātraṃ sudhāmayam || 67 ||

bibhratyaḥ sarvasubhagāḥ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyikāḥ |
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīpūrve yajet tripuravāsinīm || 68 ||

sarvavaśyakarīṃ mudrāṃ darśayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tata etāḥ sampradāyayoginya iti vai kramāt || 69 ||

devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt tataḥ sarvārthasādhake |
bahirdaśārake cakre sāmānyasudhayā śive || 70 ||

pūrvavat pūjayed devi sarvasiddhipradāmukhāḥ |
sarvasiddhipradā devī sarvasampatpradā tathā || 71 ||

sarvapriyaṅkarī devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī |
sarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocinī || 72 ||

sarvamṛtyupraśamanī sarvavighnavināśinī |
sarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī || 73 ||

sarvārthasādhake cakre kulakaulābhidhāḥ parāḥ |
sarvasiddhipradādyāśca yoginyaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ || 74 ||

japākusumasaṅkāśāḥ sphuranmaṇivibhūṣitāḥ |
mahāsaubhāgyagambhīrāḥ pīnavṛttaghanastanāḥ || 75 ||

ratnapeṭīviniḥkṣiptasādhakepsitabhūṣaṇāḥ |
nānāratnamayān dīpān dadhatyo hasitānanāḥ || 76 ||

pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvā ratnadānaparāstathā |
sarvasiddhipradāgre tu cakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajet || 77 ||

tataḥ sarvonmādinīṃ ca mudrāṃ saṃdarśayedbudhaḥ |
etāśca kulakaulākhyayoginya iti pūrvavat || 78 ||

devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāttataḥ ṣaṣṭhāvṛtiṃ yajet |
sarvarakṣākare cakre'ntardaśāre maheśvari || 79 ||

sāmānyapātrasudhayā paścimādikrameṇa tu |
sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradā tathā || 80 ||

sarvajñānamayī caiva sarvavyādhivināśinī |
sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathā || 81 ||

sarvānandamayī devī sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī |
pūjanīyā prayatnena sarvepsitaphalapradā || 82 ||

sarvarakṣākare cakre nigarbhākhyāḥ śubhapradāḥ |
sarvajñādyāśca yoginyo jvalatpāvakatejasaḥ || 83 ||

udyatsūryasahasrābhā muktālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ |
pāśaṭaṅkāyudhajñānamudrāvaradasatkarāḥ || 84 ||

sarvajñāpurato devi yajet tripuramālinīm |
devyai saṃdarśayed devi mudrāṃ sarvamahāṃkuśām || 85 ||

etā nigarbhayoginyaḥ sarvarakṣākarābhidhe |
cakre samudrā ityādi dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ || 86 ||

sarvarogaharāṣṭāracakre sāmānyabindubhiḥ |
paścimādi krameṇaiva vaśinyādyā yajet kramāt || 87 ||

vaśinī kāmeśvarī ca modinī vimalāruṇā |
jayinī sarveśvarī ca kaulinī vāgaghīśvarī || 88 ||

p. 193) sarvarogahare cakre rahasyākhyāḥ śubhapradāḥ |
yoginyaḥ kāmadāyinyau dāḍimīkusumaprabhāḥ || 89 ||

raktavastraparidhānā raktagandhānulepanāḥ |
nānābharaṇasampannāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥ || 90 ||

pustakaṃ varadānaṃ ca dadhānā vākpradā imāḥ |
yajet tripurasiddhāṃ ca cakreśīṃ vaśinīpuraḥ || 91 ||

mudrāṃ pradarśayet sarvakhecarīṃ bhāgyahetave |
etā rahasyayoginya ityādi ca maheśvari || 92 ||

abhīṣṭasiddhimiti ca devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet |
antarāle mahācakre sarvasiddhipradābhidhe || 93 ||

sāmānyapātrasudhayā yajedāyudhadevatāḥ |
kāmeśvarasya kāmeśyā jṛmbhakā bāṇadevatāḥ || 94 ||

mohakāścāpadevyaśca pāśadevyo vaśaṅkarāḥ |
stambhakākhyā mahādevi tathaivāṃkuśadevatāḥ || 95 ||

tataḥ śrīpātrasudhayā nijāgrāditrikoṇake |
vāgbhavākhye sūryacakre kāmarūpe ca pīṭhake 96 ||

mitreśanāthātmikā ca tathā jāgradadhiṣṭhitā |
rudrātmaśaktisahitā kāmeśī sarvasiddhidā || 97 ||

tato vai kāmarājākhye somacakre maheśvari |
pīṭhe pūrṇagirau caivoḍḍīśanāthātmikā tataḥ || 98 ||

tathā svapnādhiṣṭhitā ca viṣṇuśaktirudīritā |
vajreśvarī mahādevī tatastṛtīyakoṇake || 99 ||

śaktyākhye vahnicakre ca pīṭhe jālandhare tataḥ |
ṣaṣṭheśanāthātmikā ca tathā suṣuptyadhiṣṭhitā || 100 ||

brahmātmaśaktiruditā devī śrībhagamālinī |
bindumadhye maheśāni kūṭatrayavijṛmbhite || 101 ||

samastavyomacakre ca pīṭhe coḍyānasaṃjñake |
caryānāthātmikā caiva turīyādhiṣṭhitā tataḥ || 102 ||

parabrahmātmaśaktiḥ śrīmahātripurasundarī |
sarvasiddhiprade cakre yoginyaḥ siddhidāyikāḥ || 103 ||

atirahasyasaṃjñāstā āyudhāṣṭakadevatāḥ |
kāmeśvarīmukhāstisraḥ koṇatrayavirājitāḥ || 104 ||

āyudhāṣṭakadevyastā yauvanonmattavigrahāḥ |
raktāḥ vidyullatākārā uddāmakusumānvitāḥ || 105 ||

navaratnaviśobhāḍhyāḥ svasvāyudhadharāḥ kramāt |
varābhaye sudhāpātraṃ dhārayantyaḥ sukhāvahāḥ || 106 ||

kāmeśvarī śuklavarṇā śuklamālyānulepanā |
muktāphalasphuradbhūṣā nānābharaṇabhūṣitā || 107 ||

pustakaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca varadaṃ cābhayaṃ tathā |
dadhato cāgrakoṇasthā rudraśaktiḥ prikīrtitā || 108 ||

vajreśvarī kuṃkumābhā sphuradratnavibhūṣaṇā |
bālārkavasanā nīlakarṇacumbivilocanā || 109 ||

ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvaradābhayaśobhitā |
dakṣakoṇasthitā devī viṣṇuśaktiriyaṃ matā || 110 ||

sadyaḥsantaptahemābhā bhagamālā suśobhanā |
anargharatnaghaṭitabhūṣaṇā bhuvaneśvarī || 111 ||

pāśāṃkuśajñānamudrāvaradānakarāmbujā |
brahmaśaktirmaheśānī tāpatrayanikṛntanī || 112 ||

udakkoṇasthitā devī sarvakāmaphalapradā |
cakreśīṃ tripurāmbāṃ ca kāmeśīpurato yajet || 113 ||

pañcopacārairārādhya bījamudrāṃ pradarśayet |
etā atirahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvavat || 114 ||

puṣpāñjaliṃ pradadyādvai devyai devi maheśvari |
binducakre maheśāni sarvānandamayābhidhe || 115 ||

paścimādikrameṇaiva śrīpātrasudhayā śive |
kūṭatrayakrameṇaiva ratiḥ pratirmanobhavā || 116 ||

pūjanīyā prayatnena śrīmattripurasundarī |
sarvamantreśvarī caiva sarvacakreśvarī tathā || 117 ||

sarvatantreśvarī caiva sarvayogeśvarī tathā |
sarvabhogeśvarī caiva sarvavīreśvarī tathā || 118 ||

sarvapīṭheśvarī caiva sarvavāgīśvarī tathā |
sarvavidyeśvarī caiva sarvasiddheśvarī tathā || 119 ||

sarvalokeśvarī caiva sarvayogeśvarī tathā |
(--------------------) sarvacakreśvarī tathā) || 120 ||

sarvānandamaye cakre pare śabdātigocare |
parāpararahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvakāḥ || 121 ||

udyatsūryasahasrābhā nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ |
pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvā jñānamudrābhaye tathā || 122 ||

dadhānā yauvanaprauḍhāḥ pīnavṛttaghanastanāḥ |
śrīvidyābhimukhāḥ sarvā devatāḥ paricintayet || 123 ||

p. 194) śrīvidyāṃ cāpi sarvāsāmābhimukhye sthitāṃ smaret |
athavā raśmayaḥ sarvā devīrūpeṇa cintayet || 124 ||

śrīcakre parameśāni svatantre svasvasannibhāḥ |
cakreśīṃ ratipūrve tu mahātripurabhairavīm || 125 ||

pūjayitvā tataḥ sarvayonimudrāṃ pradarśayet |
parāpararahasyākhyā yoginītyādinā priye || 126 ||

devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā tarpayecca tridhā tridhā ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
daśamaḥ śvāsaḥ || 10 ||




atha 

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| ekādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

athordhvāmnāyāvaraṇāni | tathā kulārṇave -

navāvaraṇapūjāṃ ca kṛtvā devīṃ pratarpya ca |
ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ śivam || 1 ||

pūjayenmūlamantreṇa gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
mahāṣoḍhotitāśeṣaparivārāṃśca śāmbhavi || 2 ||

praṇavādinamontena tattannāmnā prapūjayet |

iti | uttaratantre -

bindāvāsanarūpeṇa sthitaṃ ca paramaṃ śivam |
parāprāsādamantreṇa turīyāvidyayāthavā || 1 ||

ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu pūjayet tarpayet tridhā |
gurupātrāmṛtenaivāthavā śrīpātrabindubhiḥ || 2 ||

pañcapraṇavamuccārya śivaśaktyātmakādi ca |
paramādiśivaśrī ca pādukāṃ tarpayāmi ca || 3 ||

tarpayeddaśadhā proktadaśamudrāśca darśayet |
binducakre ca pūrvādicaturdikṣu ca madhyataḥ || 4 ||

gurupātrāmṛtenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yayet |
īśatatpuruṣāghoravāmasadyādimūlakaiḥ || 5 ||

ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇamiṣṭvā brahmaviṣṇvostathaiva ca |
rudraśambhuparāṇāṃ ca viśrānticaraṇān yajet || 6 ||

ādināthādiguravo divyasiddhaughamānavāḥ |
pūjanīyāḥ pratyatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 7 ||

tatoṣṭakoṇasaṃdhisthagranthyaṣṭakavibhedataḥ |
yogmaśaḥ pārśvayugmeṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 8 ||

kulayoginipūrvādimūlavidyāstu ṣoḍaśa |
ghṛtapāśāṃkuśā raktā varadābhayapāṇayaḥ || 9 ||

pūjayet tarpayeccāpi tato'ntardaśakoṇake |
caturdikṣu tatho'rdhvādhaḥ śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ || 10 ||

yajet ṣaḍādhāravidyāstadvāhyasthadaśārake |
īśānasya kalā iṣṭvā manvasre puruṣasya tu || 11 ||

aghorasya kalā hyaṣṭa dalagranthiṣu saṃyajet |
ṣoḍaśacchadapadme tu vāmedevakalā yajet || 12 ||

sadyojātakalā bhūmipure sampūjayet tataḥ |
śrīcakrasthāntarāleṣu kesareṣu ca vai kramāt || 13 ||

caturasraprakrameṇa sāmānyārghyasthabindubhiḥ |
mahāṣoḍoditāśeṣadevatāḥ paripūjayet || 14 ||

ṣaṭśāmbhavasuraśmīnāṃ binducakre tu pūjanam |
itthaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyātha ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ || 15 ||

sarvāvaraṇasampūrṇāṃ sampūjya tadanantaram |

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

naivedyaṃ ṣaḍrasopetaṃ kāmadhenupavitritam |
dadyāt karpūrasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ paraśaktaye || 1 ||

nityahomaṃ prakūrvīta pūrvoktavidhinā priye |
yathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt stutiṃ ca parameśvari || 2 ||

ādiślokadvayenāpi tathā saubhāgyadevatām |

iti | ādiślokadvayaṃ tu -

śrīmacchrīkośahṛdayaṃ pañcasiṃhāsanātmakaṃ |
phalaṃ kalpalatānāṃ ca cāruratnasphuratkalam || 1 ||

caturāyatanānandi caturanvayakośagam |
nityānandi paraṃ brahmadhāma naumi sukhāptaye || 2 ||

p. 196) iti | tathā -

sauvarṇe raupyakāṃsyādipātre vasudalaṃ likhet |
gandhena culukaṃ madhye mudrāṃ vā tatra vai nyaset || 3 ||

vasupatreṣu cājyena pūritān nava dīpakān |
bhrāmayedratnavidyābhistridhā bhṛtvā tu mastake || 4 ||

mūlena tāṃ smaredante sarvavighnopaśāntaye |

iti | ratnavidyā tu jñānārṇave -

gasau ca pamanāḥ paścādindrasthāḥ kramaśaḥ śive |
vāmakarṇaviśobhāḍyā bindubhūṣitamastakāḥ || 1 ||

ramāyāsaṃpuṭena ratneśīyaṃ navākṣarī |

śrīṃhrīṃglūṃslūṃplūṃmlūṃnlūṃhrīṃśrīṃ iti | svacchandasaṃgrahe -

pradyotana ṛṣiḥ proktastriṣṭupcchandaḥ prakīrtitam |
ratneśvarī devatā syānmāyābījaṃ tu bījakam || 1 ||

śrībījaṃ śaktiruddiṣṭā glūṃbījaṃ kīlakaṃ smṛtam |
svaprakāśe tu deveśi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 2 ||

māyayā dīrghabhājā ca ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset |

ratneśvarīṃ ratnavibhūṣitāṅgīṃ māṇikyamauliṃ taruṇārkakāntim |
karairvahantīṃ nava ratnadīpān prakāśamānāṃ manasā smarāmi ||

iti | tathā -

samastacakracakreśīyute devi navātmike |
ārā(rti ? tri)kamidaṃ devi gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye || 1 ||

maṇḍalaṃ kāmataḥ kuryāt sādhako bhūmijānukaḥ |
vahatpuṭena hastābhyāṃ maṇḍaloddhāralakṣaṇam || 2 ||

caturasre vyomacakraṃ krameṇānena pūjayet |
tāraṃ ca bhuvaneśānīṃ vyāpakādi ca maṇḍalam || 3 ||

ṅentaṃ vāgbhavahṛnmantro manuḥ sūryākṣaro bhavet |
annodamiśraṃ bhāgena sādhāraṃ puṣpapūjitam || 4 ||

saṃsthāpya pātraṃ tatraiva kalārṇena baliṃ haret |
tāraṃ parāṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarva ca bhū likhet || 5 ||

tebhyo huṃvahnijāyā ca trivāroccāraṇadbaliḥ |
pūrvoktabalidānaṃ tu kuryādvighnopaśāntaye || 6 ||

caturdhā balidānaṃ tu triṣu lokeṣu durlabham |
tataḥ kumārīḥ santarpya tripureśyānayāthavā || 7 ||

mayūkhān parameśvaryāḥ saṃbhāvya manuvittamaḥ |
khecaryāḥ śakticakrasya svāminīṃ saṃvidaṃ parām || 8 ||

yojayedātmani jñānagahane kṛpayā guroḥ |
śivakoṇe deśikebhyo nirmālyaṃ siddhaye kṣipet || 9 ||

arghyapātraṃ tato devi gurave gurumantravit |
nāmamantreṇa ca svasya tarpayedupadeśataḥ || 10 ||

vāmamārgeṇa deveśi tattvamudrādharaḥ śuciḥ |
punarādhāragaṃ kuryādācāre dīpalakṣaṇam || 11 ||

ārātrikasya madhyasthaṃ mūlenaiva tu bhakṣayet |
kapālinyā vāpi pātraṃ tayā vāpi samuddharet || 12 ||

dvitīyaṃ tattvagaṃ dakṣe saṃyogenaiva pārvati |
tattvatrayeṇa saṃyogāttarpayet svāntavāsinīm || 13 ||

prathamaṃ brahmarūpatvaṃ dvitīyaṃ sarvamantravit |
tṛtīyamīśarūpaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ munisattamaiḥ || 14 ||

kiñcidullāsya mudrābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ parameśvari |
śrīgurorājñayā devi svayaṃ śrītripurā bhavet || 15 ||

adhomukhāni sarvāṇi pātrāṇyagnau pratiṣṭhayet |
ākṛṣya mantrāt tatrasthaṃ śiṣikābhyo'kṣatādikam || 16 ||

dattvā tu parameśāni sukhībhūyānna saṃśayaḥ |
anarghyamapi vijñeyamakṣaraiḥ kathitaṃ mayā || 17 ||

alākṣareṇa nyāyena candradīpena ca priye |
gopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre jananījāragarbhavat || 18 ||

iti | atra nityahomavidhānaṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ prayogarūpam | tathā 
dakṣiṇāmūrti saṃhitāyām -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vidyāyantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
sahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥ || 1 ||

pūjayedratnakhacitaiścampakaiḥ svarṇajaiḥ priye |
avaśyaṃ sarvakāleṣu paramājñādharo bhavet || 2 ||

p. 197) nāśayet sarvapāpāni koṭijanmabhavānyapi |
samudravalayāṃ pṛthvīṃ saṃprāpya sukhamedhate || 3 ||

nityaṃ yaḥ pūjayeddevīṃ campakai rajatodbhavaiḥ |
sa buddhimān bhaveddevi sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 4 ||

paścimābhimukhaṃ liṅgaṃ vṛṣaśūnyamathāpi vā |
svayambhūbāṇadeśe vā śaivasthāne maheśvari || 5 ||

tatra sthitvā japenmantraṃ pravālākṣasrajā tathā |
muktārudrākṣapadmākṣasphaṭikodbhavayā tathā || 6 ||

māṇikyapadmarāgādimanoharyā japedbudhaḥ |
japtvā lakṣaikamātre tu bhūcaryo vighnakārikāḥ || 7 ||

tāsāmapi yadā nasau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi |
tadā lakṣatrayaṃ kuryānniyamena śucirbudhaḥ || 8 ||

mānasenāthavā vācopāṃśunā vā japet sudhīḥ |
manasoccāraṇaṃ devi japakoṭiphalapradam || 9 ||

upāṃśūccāraṇaṃ devi vācikaṃ śatadhā bhavet |
vācikāt mukhapātraṃ syācchrīgurorājñayā priye || 10 ||

taddaśāṃśena homaḥ syāt kusumairbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥ |
kusumbhapuṣpairjuhuyānmadhuratrayasamplutaiḥ || 11 ||

siddhā bhavati vidyaikaṃ sarvavidyāsvarūpiṇī |
yonikuṇḍe bhagākāre vartulendvardhayoḥ priye || 12 ||

navatrikoṇacakre vā caturasre'tha vasvare |
vākpatiryonikuṇḍe tu bhage cākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 13 ||

vartulaṃ śrīpadaṃ devi candrārdhe tu trayaṃ bhavet |
navatrikoṇe mahatīkhecarīsiddhivān bhavet || 14 ||

caturasre tu sakalaṃ śubhajātaṃ bhavet sadā |
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ lakṣmīrārogyaṃ vasukoṇake || 15 ||

padmāṅke daśa siddhīstu sādhayennātra saṃśayaḥ |
mallikāmālatībhiśca trimadhvaktairvacaspatiḥ || 16 ||

karavīraja(yā ? pā)puṣpaiḥ saghṛtairbhuvanatraye |
yoṣidvaśyā tato devī karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ madam || 17 ||

mṛgasya miśritaṃ kṛtvā kāmasaubhāgyavān bhavet |
cāmpeyaiḥ pāṭalai ramyairāmrairanyaiḥ phalairhunet || 18 ||

saptāhaṃ māsamātraṃ vā lakṣmīḥ prāpnoti mantriṇam |
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ cāgaruṃ devi karpūraṃ gugguluṃ hunet || 19 ||

samagrapurasundaryo vaśyāstasya bhavanti hi |
hutvā phalaṃ trimadhvaktaṃ khecaratvaṃ catuṣpathe || 20 ||

dadhikṣīramadhusarpirlājān hutvā na kālabhāk |
athavā navalakṣa tu japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 21 ||

taddaśāṃśena homastu pūrvoktavidhinā yajet |
sādhayet svargabhūlokapātālatalavāsinaḥ || 22 ||

rājikālavaṇābhyāṃ tu kṣobhayejjagatīmimām |
dadhnā śatāṣṭakaṃ hutvā kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayet || 23 ||

ghṛtakṣīradvayādāyuṣyato'ṣṭaśatakaṃ hunet |
madhvājyaguggulenaiva rājendraṃ vaśamānayet || 24 ||

ārogyaṃ ghṛtadūrvābhyāṃ havanena śatāṣṭakam |
madhvājyāktai raktavarṇaiḥ karavīraiḥ saguggulaiḥ || 25 ||

hunellakṣaṃ vaśīkuryādviṃśatiṃ dharaṇībhujām |
madhvaktakaravīraistu sāṅgaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 26 ||

saptarātreṇa sājyena śaśinā pūrvavadyajet |
pāṭalairyūthikākundaiḥ śatapatraiśca jātibhiḥ || 27 ||

mālatīnavavallibhirmallikāpadmakiṃśukaiḥ |
pūjanāddhavanādvāpi miśrairvā'miśritairapi || 28 ||

sarvasaubhāgyamāpnoti buddhyā vākpatirucyate |
mucukundairbilvapatreḥ phalairasitanīrajaiḥ || 29 ||

nāgarai rājacampaiśca siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hi |
nārikelaiśca kharjūrairdrākṣābhiścūtasatphalaiḥ || 30 ||

manasā cintitaṃ kāryaṃ sādhakasya tu homataḥ |
pūjanena ca homena śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayet || 31 ||

caruṃ vikīrya sarvatra kumārīpūjanādibhiḥ |
pūrvoktabalidānena guruṃ santoṣya ca kramāt || 32 ||

suvāsinīśca sampūjya dadyādbhūri dhanaṃ satām |
samagraṃ kusumaṃ home kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bahudhā hunet || 33 ||

nārikelāntaraphalaiḥ sakalaistu manaḥpriyam |
samagreṇaiva cūtasya phalena badaraṃ tathā || 34 ||

panasaiḥ phalagarbhasthairgarbhairvilokitairhunet |
jambūphalaṃ samagraṃ syāddrākṣāṃ caiva tathā hunet || 35 ||

rambhāphalaṃ manobhāgaṃ laghu cet khaṇḍitaṃ nahi |
phalaṃ laghu samagraṃ syāt kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ śaśī || 36 ||

guñjāmātraṃ huneddevi tilarājīśataṃ hunet |
tathaiva lavaṇaṃ lājā muṣṭipātraṃ hunedbudhaḥ || 37 ||

annaṃ tu grāsamātraṃ hi pakvānnaiśca tathā hunet |
pūrṇaṃ tu kramukārdhena śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kramukākṛti || 38 ||

p. 198) tathāguru hunetprājyaṃ manaḥsantoṣakāri yat |
taccaturguṇabhedena dadhidugdhairhunet sadā || 39 ||

sarvāsāmāhūtīnāṃ tu mānaṃ devi manaḥpriyam |
kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ vakṣye mahāvighnavināśanam || 40 ||

caturviṃśatisaṃkhyābhiraṃgulibhiḥ suvistṛtam |
khātaṃ ca racayet kuṇḍaṃ sarvatra sumanoharam || 41 ||

caturasraṃ sarvanetrasubhagaṃ mekhalāstataḥ |
sarvatraikāṃgulaṃ tyaktvā tisraḥ kāryāḥ suśobhanāḥ || 42 ||

ādityavasuvedānāṃ saṃkhyāṃgulibhirunnatāḥ |
caturaṃgulavistārāstisro'pi parameśvari || 43 ||

kuṇḍasya paścime bhāge yoniṃ kuryāt sulakṣaṇām |
ravyaṃgulisuvistārāṃ vasvaṃgulisuvistṛtām || 44 ||

madhye ṣaḍaṃgulāṃ devi dvyaṃguloccāṃ manoramām |
lakṣaṇaṃ caturasrasya kathitaṃ tava sundari || 45 ||

etasminmāne yadvānyat tadanyeṣu yathā bhavet |
tena mānena sarvāṇi kuṇḍāni racayed budhaḥ || 46 ||

gomayodakasaṃlipte pūrvātpaścimadiggatāḥ |
dakṣiṇādyūttarāntaṃ tu tisrastisraśca kārayet || 47 ||

praṇaveṇābhyukṣya madhye kalpayedyāgaviṣṭaram |
śarkarāṃ vikirettatra trikoṇaṃ tatpuṭaṃ likhet || 48 ||

tadbahirvasupatraṃ ca tato bhūmaṇḍalaṃ likhet |
uparyupari bhedena tatra pīṭhaṃ samarcayet || 49 ||

maṇḍūkaṃ ca tathā rudraṃ kālāgnyādyaṃ tataḥ param |
ādhāraśaktikūrmau ca tato'nantaṃ varāhakaṃ || 50 ||

pṛthivīṃ ca tathā kandaṃ nālaṃ padmaṃ ca karṇikām |
pātrāṇi kesarāṇyevaṃ tattatsthāneṣu pūjayet || 51 ||

dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ pīṭhadikṣu ca |
adharmāścaiva koṇeṣu pīṭhasya paripūjayet || 52 ||

punastāreṇa sampūjya yāgaviṣṭarakaṃ nyaset |
madhye ṛtumatīṃ vedamātaraṃ vedamasyakām || 53 ||

puruṣādhiṣṭhitāṃ dhyātvā tadyaunau sampuṭasthitām |
vahniṃ kuṇḍe paribhrāmya kiñcidaṅgārakaṃ tyajet || 54 ||

astramantreṇa sakalān bhūtān saṃtrāyaset sudhīḥ |
paścāt prajvālayedvahniṃ jñānāgneḥ saṃkrameṇa tu || 55 ||

dīpāddīpāntaranyāyāt sphurantaṃ sarvato mukham |
śvāsamārgeṇa manuvidyonimārgeṇa saṃkṣipet || 56 ||

kuṇḍatrikoṇamadhye tu tatra prakṣālayecchucim |
ādau vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścādvahnimantreṇa ca kramāt || 57 ||

citpiṅgala hanadvandvaṃ dahadvandvaṃ paca dvidhā |
sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā manunā prārthayet tataḥ || 58 ||

agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam |
suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukham || 59 ||

upasthānaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ jihvāṅgāni pravinyaset |
saṣaśā valarāyaśca ramasvasvarayā(rayaṣaṣṭhasvarā)nvitāḥ || 60 ||

bindunādāṅkitāḥ sapta jihvārṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
padmarāgā suvarṇā ca tṛtīyā bhadralohitā || 61 ||

lohitā ca tathā śvetā dhūminī ca karālikā |
krameṇa yojayedbījairvinyaset parameśvari || 62 ||

palliṅgagudamūrdhāsyanāsānetreṣu ca kramāt |
surāśca pitaraścaiva gandharvā yakṣapannagāḥ || 63 ||

piśācā rākṣasāścaiva smartavyāstāsu saptasu |
sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇaṃ uttiṣṭhapuruṣastathā || 64 ||

dhūmavyāpī saptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritaiḥ |
ṅahṛdantaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ nyaset || 65 ||

jātavedaḥ saptajihvo havyavāhana eva ca |
aśvodayaiścaturthaḥ syādvaiśvānara ume tataḥ || 66 ||

ṣaṣṭhaḥ kaumāratejāśca viśvadevamukhau nyaset |
mūrdhāṃsapārśvakaṭyandhukaṭipārśvāsakeṣu ca || 67 ||

ṅe'ntā tu sakalā jñeyā agnimūrtyaṅgakāḥ kramāt |
evaṃ vinyastadehaḥ san paryukṣyārghyajalena ca || 68 ||

dikṣu darbhaiḥ paristīrya tatastu pariṣecayet |
vaiśvānara tato jātaveda paścādihāvaha || 69 ||

lohitākṣa ca sarvānte karmāṇyapi ca sādhaya |
svāhānto'ṇurayaṃ tāraṃ vaktre citpiṅgalo'pi ca || 70 ||

anena vahnimabhyarcya tato jihvāḥ samarcayet |
madhye ca koṇaṣaṭke ca tato'ṅgāni prapūjayet || 71 ||

mūrtayo vasupatreṣu bhūbimbe digadhīśvarāḥ |
punarvaiśvānaraṃ japtvā trinetramaruṇaprabham || 72 ||

śuklāmbaraṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaṃ padmasaṃsthitam |
varaṃ śaktiṃ svastikaṃ cābhītiṃ hastaiśca vibhratam || 73 ||

anekahemamālābhiraṅkitaṃ saṃsmaredbudhaḥ |
arghyodakena pātrāṇi prokṣayecchuddhaye tataḥ || 74 ||

p. 199) unmukhīkṛtya sarvāṇi tatra tatra vinikṣipet |
praṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalaṃ sthālyāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || 75 ||

anyat sarvaṣu pātreṣu homadravyāṇi saṃkṣipet |
srukpātre ca sruve pātre ghṛte puṣpaṃ vinikṣipet || 76 ||

sthālīṃ pūrvā(dhūpā)nvitāṃ kuryāt sarvato dhūpayet priye |
mekhalāsu ca sarvāsu veṣṭayeddīpamālikāḥ || 77 ||

tripaṃktyā cābhitaḥ kuṇḍaṃ tato vyāhṛtibhirhunet |
brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya hunedvaiśvānarāṇunā || 78 ||

garbhādhānādisaṃskāraṃ cintayet siddhihetave |
anena vidhinābhyarcya śrīcakraṃ tatra cintayet || 79 ||

tadantare samāvāhya mahātripurasundarīm |
samastacakracakreśīsahitāṃ homayet tataḥ || 80 ||

daśājyāhutibhiḥ paścāt pūjanādikrameṇa ca |
samastacakracakreśīḥ prakaṭādyāśca yoginīḥ || 81 ||

homayecca ghṛtenaiva caikaikāmāhutiṃ kramāt |
tataḥ pūrvoktasudravyairhomayet subhagāṃ parām || 82 ||

havanaṃ padmarāgāyāṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet |
rudraraktā suvarṇā ca sarvakāmaphalāptaye || 83 ||

lohitāyāṃ bhavecchāntiḥ stambhanaṃ ca kramādbhavet |
uccāṭanaṃ ca dhūminyāṃ karālinyāṃ ca māraṇam || 84 ||

iti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ homalakṣaṇamuttamam |
kṛte vighnaughaśamanaṃ nānyathā varavarṇini || 85 ||

dīpasthānaṃ samāśritya japahomau samācaret |
vasukoṣṭhaṃ likhet kūrmaṃ madhye sthāne prakalpayet || 86 ||

svarān dvandvavibhāgena pūrvādikramato likhet |
kādyā vargāstu saptaite pūrvādikramato likhet || 87 ||

lakṣavargo'ṣṭame yojyaḥ kūrmacakramidaṃ bhavet |
sthānākṣaraṃ yatra devi siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ || 88 ||

sthānākṣaraṃ mukhaṃ jñeyaṃ pārśvayostasya vai karau |
tatra śūnyaṃ phalaṃ madhyakoṣṭhayugmaṃ tu mṛtyudam || 89 ||

udaraṃ kacchapasyaitatpādau tu paścimau kramāt |
rogahānikarau pucchaṃ tayormadhyagataṃ bhavet || 90 ||

dāridryadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ ca tasmādvaktraṃ samāśrayet |
tathaiva siddhirnānyatra śrīgurorājñayā priye || 91 ||

deśaṃ vā kalpayet sthānaṃ nagaraṃ grāmameva ca |
dīpāvaso'pi kartavyaḥ kiṃ punarhavane yajet || 92 ||

iti svacchandasaṃgrahe -

cakrarājaṃ samālikhya sindūrarajasā priye |
svabhambhūkusumāktaiśca kusumairakṣatairyajet || 1 ||

navāvaraṇadevīnāṃ gāyatrībhiḥ samantataḥ |
gāyatrī samyaguccārya tadante'pyamukaṃ tataḥ || 2 ||

vaśamānaya me'nte ca tattatpallavamuccaret |
tataścāmukadevīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca || 3 ||

evāmākarṣaṇe mohe stambhanoccāṭakarmasu |
saptāhābhyantare mantrī vāṃchitaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 4 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ kvacidvivikte deśe sindūrādiraktadravyaiścakrarājaṃ 
vilikhyārghyasthāpanādyātmapūjānantaraṃ yathoktapīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāya 
svayambhūkusumāktairakṣataiḥ puṣpairvāvaraṇapūjāṃ kuryāt | tatra vaśye 
tāratrayapūrvakatattadgāyatrīmuccāryāmukadevi amukaṃ me vaśamānaya 
athavā vaśaṃ kuru kuru vauṣaṭ-amukadevīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti prayogaḥ 
| evaṃ pratyāvaraṇaṃ pratidevīḥ pūjayet | ākarṣaṇe amukamākarṣayākarṣayeti 
evaṃ stambhanādiprayogeṣu yojanīyamityarthaḥ || tathā :

mūlādhārādicakreṣu śrīcakraṃ bhāvayan pṛthak |
tattadbhūtārṇakiraṇairvṛtāścakrasthadevatāḥ || 1 ||

pārthivaiḥ stambhanaṃ kuryādityādi prākproktaphalāni jñeyāni 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi cakrarājasya sādhanam |
evaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakrama śṛṇu || 1 ||

kṛtvā sindūrarajasā cakraṃ tatra vicintayet |
sādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma lekhanyaikāṃ śubhāṃ tataḥ || 2 ||

jvalantīṃ tu kṣaṇāt devi mohitā bhayavarjitā |
tyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti hyathānyat kathyate priye || 3 ||

tanmadhyasaṃsthito mantrī cintayedaruṇaprabham |
ātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tathā saubhāgyasundaraḥ || 4 ||

aruṇairupacāraistu pūjayenmudrayā vṛtaḥ |
yasya nāmnā punaḥ samyak sa bhaveddāsa eva hi || 5 ||

adṛṣṭastrīnāmasvarṇāṃścakramadhye vilikhya tu |
yonimudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 6 ||

devakanyāṃ rājakanyāṃ nāgakanyāmathāpi vā |
gorocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanam || 7 ||

aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā tilakaṃ sarvamohanam |
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam || 8 ||

p. 200) tāmbūlaṃ pūrvajaptaṃ ca yasmai sampreṣyate sa tu |
aṅganā vīkṣaṇādeva dāsī cāsya bhavet priye || 9 ||

karavīrai raktavarṇaistrimadhvaktaiḥ prapūjayet |
cintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥ || 10 ||

iti kurvan maheśānīṃ pūjayedaruṇaprabhām |
sindūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt || 11 ||

trailokyadurlabhāṃ cāpi rambhāṃ vā karṣayed drutam |
cittāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hi || 12 ||

baddhvā bāhāvatha kvāpi jvaraṃ nāśayati kṣaṇāt |
arkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu likhinyārkasya saṃlikhet || 13 ||

gomūtre sthāpayet tacca bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt |
dhūpayeccandanaṃ rātrau vastraṃ vā dhārayet tataḥ || 14 ||

aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mohayedbhuvanatrayam |
liptagomayabhūmau tu likhedrocanayā tataḥ || 15 ||

surūpāṃ pratimāṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣāḍhyāṃ paricintayet |
tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇdalayojitam || 16 ||

janmanāma mahāvidyāmaṃkuśāntavidarbhitām |
sarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnaṃ kāmakūṭaṃ samālikhet || 17 ||

sādhyāśābhimukho bhūtvā śrīvidyānyāsavigrahaḥ |
kṣobhiṇībījamudrābhyāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japet || 18 ||

yojayet tāṃ kāmagehe candrasūryakalātmake |
sānurāgātivimalā kāmasāyakapīḍitā || 19 ||

trailokyasundarī nāma kṣaṇādāyāti mohitā |
athavā mātṛkācakraṃ bāhyaṃ saṃveṣṭya mantravit || 20 ||

cakraṃ prapūjayet samyag vidyāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca dhārayet |
avadhyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||

śrīkhaṇḍāgurukastūrīkarpūraiśca sakuṃkumaiḥ |
svanāma kramato lekhyaṃ pūrvavanmātṛkāṃ likhet || 22 ||

tenājarāmaratvaṃ tu sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ |
anenaiva prakāreṇa rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ || 23 ||

cakraṃ vilikhya sādhyārṇaṃ sādhakārṇavidarbhitaṃ |
trailokyamohano mantrī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||

kāmakūṭena deveśi sandarbhyaṃ pṛthagakṣaram |
sādhyanāmnastrikoṇāntarmātṛkāṃ veṣṭayedbahiḥ || 25 ||

svarṇamadhyagataṃ dhāryaṃ śikhāyāṃ yatra kutracit |
lokapālāśca rājāno duṣṭāstrailokyasaṃsthitāḥ || 26 ||

te sarve vaśamāyānti sannipātādayo jvarāḥ |
anena vidhinā nāma purīṃ sandarbhya saṃkṣipet || 27 ||

catuṣpathe madhyadeśe dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt |
tasya saubhāgyamāyāti rājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ sadā || 28 ||

sphurattejomayīṃ puṛthvīṃ prajvalantīṃ carācaram |
cakrāntaścintayennityaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tato naraḥ || 29 ||

tena kandarpasubhago loke bhavati niścayāt |
dṛṣṭyākarṣayate lokān viṣaṃ nāśayati jvarān || 30 ||

tathā viṣaṃ ca harati dṛṣṭyāveśaṃ karoti ca |
rātrau sindūralikhitaṃ pūjayedekacittataḥ || 31 ||

karotyākarṣaṇaṃ dūrādyojanānāṃ śatādapi |
akhaṇḍaṃ dikṣu koṇeṣu krameṇa paripūjayet || 32 ||

yadā tadaiva loko'yaṃ vaśyo bhavati nānyathā |
bhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ || 33 ||

svanāmadarbhitaṃ kuryāddeśaṃ vā puṭabhedanam |
maṇḍalaṃ viṣamasthānaṃ bhūmau cakraṃ nidhāpayet || 34 ||

dhārayedvā tato mantrī puraṃ kṣobhayati kṣaṇāt |
unmattarasalākṣārkakṣīrakuṃkumarocanāḥ || 35 ||

kastūryalaktasahitā ekīkṛtya tu saṃlikhet |
yannāma tasya deveśi caurajaṃ vyāghrajaṃ bhayam || 36 ||

grahajaṃ vyādhijaṃ caiva ripujaṃ siṃhajaṃ bhayam |
ahijaṃ vājijaṃ vāsti sarvān mohayati kṣaṇāt || 37 ||

rocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ tu madhyagāṃ saṃlikhedbudhaḥ |
trikoṇobhayagāṃ caiva sādhyanāmāṅkitāmadhaḥ || 38 ||

taccakraṃ dhārayet tasmāt saptāhāt kiṅkaro bhavet |
pītadravyeṇa cakrānte likhedvidyāmadhastataḥ || 39 ||

sādhyanāma vilikhyaitatpūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃkṣipet |
tasmādbrahmāpi jīvo'pi sarvajño mūkatāṃ vrajet || 40 ||

anena vidhinā nīlīrasena vilikhecca tat |
dakṣiṇābhimukho mantrī vahnau dagdhvā ripūn dahet || 41 ||

mahiṣāśvapurīṣeṇa gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhet |
āranālasthitaṃ kuryādbhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt || 42 ||

sādhyanāma likhenmadhye kākapatreṇa sañcayet |
saṃlikhya rocanādravyairākāśe dṛṣṭigaṃ yathā || 43 ||

śatrūnuccāṭayedāśu haṭhoccāṭo'yamīritaḥ |
mahānīlīrasodbhinnarocanādugdhamiśritaiḥ || 44 ||

p. 201) lākṣārasairlikheccakraṃ caturvarṇān vaśaṃ nayet |
anena vidhinā nīre sthāpayet tajjalena tu || 45 ||

saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti snānapānānna saṃśayaḥ |
pītaṃ cakraṃ yajet pūrve stambhayet sarvavādinaḥ || 46 ||

sindūralikhitaṃ cakramuttare lokavaśyakṛt |
paścime pūjitaṃ cakraṃ gairikālikhitaṃ tataḥ || 47 ||

mantriṇo devatā vaśyāḥ kiṃ punaryoṣitaḥ priye |
tathaiva dakṣiṇāsyastu kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayet || 48 ||

sādhyasya mantrahāniḥ syānmaraṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
kramāddigantarāsyaḥ san vahnikoṇādiṣu kramāt || 49 ||
