stambhaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ vyādhimuccāṭaṃ kurute naraḥ |
dugdhe vaśyakaraṃ kṣiptaṃ rocanālikhitaṃ haṭhāt || 50 ||

dagdhaṃ tadvahnimadhyasthaṃ sarvaśatrūn vināśayet |
gomūtramadhyagaṃ caitadbhaveduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ || 51 ||

vidveṣaṇaṃ bhaveccakre tenaiva parameśvari |
sindūreṇa likheccakraṃ nirjane tu catuṣpathe || 52 ||

sarvāṃ bāhyat ārabhya madhyāntaṃ mātṛkāṃ likhet |
kulācārakrameṇaiva rātrau sampūjayet kramam || 53 ||

sādhakaḥ khecaro devi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
caturdaśyāṃ niśi svastho rudrabhūmau prapūjayet || 54||

ṣaṇmāsasaṃkhyajātena sākṣādrudra ivāparaḥ |
añjanaṃ vivaraṃ siddhiṃ guṭikāṃ pādukāñjanam || 55 ||

khaḍgaṃ vetālasaubhāgyaṃ yakṣiṇīṃ ceṭakādikam |
sakalaṃ siddhijananaṃ mantrī prāpnoti nānyathā || 56 ||

caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pratyaṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
ekaviṃśatirātraṃ tu niśi pretasthito jale || 57 ||

śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tadvat surapūjyastu sādhakaḥ |
pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇaiḥ pauruṣeyairmaheśvari || 58 ||

kāmo bhūtvā sarvabhūśca (svargabhūmi) pātālatalayoṣitām |
hartā kartā svayaṃ caiva mahadākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 59 ||

tattatkāmeśvarīśastrairdevyātmā bhuvanatraye |
puruṣākarṣaṇaṃ caitadrājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ priye || 60 ||

etatkāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ bījabhedataḥ |
vāgbhavārādhane devi jñānaṃ sārasvataṃ bhavet || 61 ||

śvetābharaṇavastrābhyāṃ śvetapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
anena vidhinā devi vāgbhavārādhanaṃ bhavet || 62 ||

atha kāmakalānāma sāmarthyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
kāmamanmathakandarpā makaradhvaja eva ca || 63 ||

mahākāmaśca pūrvoktāḥ pañca kāmāḥ krameṇa tu |
kāmaṃ manmathamadhyasthaṃ devi kandarpaveśmagam || 64 ||

tatpuṭasthaṃ mīnaketuṃ mahākāmeśamastakam |
anena kāmatattvena mohayejjagatīmimām || 65 ||

mūlādisṛṣṭisaṃhāravisatantutanīyasīm |
tasmāt kuṇḍalinī śaktiḥ śaktikūṭe maheśvari || 66 ||

trikūṭā tripurā devī sarvasiddhipradā bhavet |
catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām || 67 ||

cakrametatsamāśritya satāṃ siddhipradāḥ sadā |

iti || atha nānāvaidikamantramiśritāḥ śrīvidyāmantrā uddhriyante | 
svacchandasaṃgrahe -

praṇavaṃ kamalā māyā kāmapiṇḍaṃ ca gāṇapam |
tato vāgbhavakūṭaṃ ca yadadyakacca vṛtrahan || 1 ||

kāmarājaṃ mahākūṭamudagā abhisūrya ca |
śaktikūṭaṃ samālikhya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe || 2 ||

ṅe'ntaṃ gaṇapatiṃ paścādvarānte varadeti ca |
tataḥ sarvajanaṃ me'nte vaśamānaya ṭhadvayam || 3 ||

gaṇarājeśvaro mantraḥ sarvaiśvaryaphalapradaḥ |
sarvavaśyakaraḥ puṃsāmāyurārogyasiddhidaḥ || 4 ||

mahāgaṇapatermantraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jātavedasam |
ardhaṃ saṃvādasūktasya punarardhaṃ kramāllikhet || 5 ||

catuḥkhaṇḍāni coktāni trikūṭairgarbhitāni ca |
pratyahaṃ japataḥ puṃso yathāśakti viśeṣataḥ || 6 ||

jagatsammohanaṃ vaśyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidam |

iti | asyārthaḥ - oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ ka-e-īlahrīṃ yaddyakacca vṛtrahan 
hasakahalahrīṃ udagā abhisūryaṃ sakalahrīṃ sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe 
gaṇapataye vara varada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā || ka-e-īlahrīṃ 
jātavedase sunavāma

p. 202) somamarātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva 
sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ hasakahalahrīṃ saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne 
viśvānyarthaṃ ā | ilaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyābhara | saṃgacchadhvaṃ 
saṃvadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām | devā bhāgaṃ yāthapūrve 
saṃjānānā upāsate sakalahrīṃ || samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ 
manaḥ sasacittameṣām | samānaṃ mantramabhimantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā 
juhomi || samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ | samānamastu vo mano 
yathā vaḥ susahāsati || ityuddhāraḥ ||

bhadranno abhimantrasya garbhasthāṃ sundarīṃ japet |
kubera iva vittāḍhyo jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥ || 1 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ - bhadraṃ no abhivātaya manaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ marutāmojase svāhā 
hasakahalahrīṃ indro viśvasya rājati sakalahrīṃ śanno bhava dvipade śaṃ 
catuṣpade || iti ||

yadvāgdevīṃ ca catvāri sasarparīyugaṃ tataḥ |
ṛkpañcakaṃ samākhyātaṃ mahāsārasvatapradam || 1 ||

iti || asyārthaḥ yadvāgvadantyavicetanāni ka-e-īlahrīṃ rāṣṭrī devānāṃ 
niṣasāda mandrā hasakahalahrīṃ catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi sakalahrīṃ 
vavasvidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma || 1 ||

devīṃ vācamajanayanta devīḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ tāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti 
hasakahalahrīṃ sā no mandreṣamūrjaṃ duhānā sakalahrīṃ 
dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaituḥ || 2 ||

catvāri vākparimitā padāni ka-e-īlahrīṃ tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ 
hasakahalahrīṃ guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti sakalahrīṃ turīyaṃ vāco 
manuṣyā vadanti || 3 ||

sasarparamatiṃ bādhamānā ka-e-īlahrīṃ bṛhanmimāya jamadagnidattā 
hasakahalahrīṃ āsūryasya duhitā tatāna sakalahrīṃ śravo 
deveṣvamṛtamajuryam || 4 ||

sasarparīrabharantūyamebhyaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ adhiśravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu 
hasakahalahrīṃ sā pakṣyā3navyamāyurdadhānā sakalahrīṃ yāṃ me 
palastijamadagnayo dadhuḥ || 5 ||

iti pañcamantrāḥ || tathā :

yacchandasā śarīraṃ me yo devānāmiti trayam |
sundarī garbhagaṃ japyāt pṛthakpṛthagatandritaḥ || 1 ||

medhāvī śrutidhārī ca nārogī ca priyaṃvadaḥ |
bahuśrutaḥ śāstrakartā śrutān vedāgamānapi || 2 ||

na vismarati martyo'sau sarvajño bhavati dhruvam |

iti | asyārthaḥ - yacchandasāmṛṣabho viśvarūpaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ 
chandobhyo'dhyamṛtātsaṃvabhūva hasakahalahrīṃ sa mendro medhayā spṛṇotu 
sakalahrīṃ amṛtasya deva dhāraṇo bhūyāsam || 1 ||

śarīraṃ me vicarṣaṇaṃ ka-e-īlahrīṃ jihvā me madhumattamā hasakahalahrīṃ 
manasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ sakalahrīṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīmahi || 2 ||

yo devanāṃ prathamaṃ purastāt ka-e-īlahrīṃ viśvādhīpo rudro maharṣibhiḥ 
hasakahalahrīṃ hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paśyata jāyamānaṃ sakalahrīṃ sa no devaḥ 
śubhayā smṛtyā saṃyunavatu || 3 ||

iti trayo mantrāḥ || tathā :

evāpitre yūyamasmānevendrāgnī trayaṃ bhavet |
caturthī tvaṃ soma praceti pañcamī tu prajāpate || 1 ||

etatpañcarcagarbhasthāṃ sundarīṃ prajapet pṛthak |
yo narastasya niyataṃ dhanadhānyadharāsutaiḥ || 2 ||

gogajāśvāvimahiṣaśasyabhūṣādisaṃkulam |
lakṣmīṃ samāvahedramyāṃ putrapautrādigāminīm || 3 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ evā pitre viśvedevāya vṛṣṇe ka-e-īlahrīṃ yajñairvidhema 
namasā havirbhiḥ hasakahalahrīṃ bṛhaspate suprajā vīravantaḥ sakalahrīṃ 
vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || 1 ||

yūyamasmānnayata vasyo acchā ka-e-īlahrīṃ niraṃhatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ 
hasakahalahrīṃ juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā sakalahrīṃ vayaṃ syāma 
patayo rayīṇām || 2 ||

evendrāgnī papivāṃsā sutasya ka-e-īlahrīṃ viśvāsmabhyaṃ sañjayataṃ 
dhanāni hasakahalahrīṃ tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāṃ sakalahrīṃ aditiḥ 
sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ || 3 ||

tvaṃ soma pracikito manīṣā ka-e-īlahrīṃ tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanuneṣi panthām 
hasakahalahrīṃ tava praṇīti pitaro na indo sakalahrīṃ deveṣu ratnamabhajanta 
dhīrāḥ || 4 ||

prajāpate na tvadetānyanyaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ viśvā jātāni paritā babhūva 
hasakahalahrīṃ yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu sakalahrīṃ vayaṃ syāma patayo 
rayīṇām || 5 ||

p. 203) iti pañca mantrāḥ || atha :

atha yā lakṣmyaśvadāyigarbhasthāṃ sundarīṃ yajet |
dhanairdhānyaiśca vibhavairanyaiścāśvagavādibhiḥ || 1 ||

āpūrayantī satataṃ tatraiva ramate ramā |

iti | asyārthaḥ - yā lakṣmīḥ sindhusambhavā ka-e-īlahrīṃ 
bhūtidhenuparūvasūḥ hasakahalahrīṃ padmā viśvāvasurdevī sakalahrīṃ sadā 
no juṣatāṃ gṛham || aśvadāyi godāyi ka-e-īlahrīṃ dhanadāyi mahādhane 
hasakahalahrīṃ dhanaṃ me juṣatāṃ devī sakalahrīṃ sarvakamārthasiddhaye || iti 
mantradvayam |

kalātithyūcasūktasthamantrapādacatuṣṭayaiḥ |
sampuṭīkṛtya japatāṃ phalānyācakṣmahe sphuṭam || 1 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ - kalā-ṛcasūktaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ sahasraśīrṣe tyādi yajurvede 
prasiddham | tithyūcasūktaṃ śrīsūktaṃ hiraṇyavarṇā mityādi ṛgvede 
prasiddham : sampuṭīkaraṇaṃ tu sahasraśīrṣaḥ puruṣaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ 
sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt hasakahalahrīṃ sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā sakalahrīṃ 
atyatiṣṭhaddaśāṃgulam || puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ ka-e-īlahrīṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca 
bhavyam hasakahalahrīṃ utāmṛtatvasyeśāno sakalahrīṃ yadannenātirohati || 
etāvānasya mahimā ka-e-īlahrīṃ ato jyāyāṃśca puruṣaḥ hasakahalahrīṃ 
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni sakalahrīṃ tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi || tripādūrdhvaṃ 
udetpuruṣaḥ ka-e-īlahrīṃ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ hasakahalahrīṃ tato viśvaṃ 
vyakrāmat sakalahrīṃ sāśanānaśane abhi || tasmādvirāḍajāyata ka-e-īlahrīṃ 
virājo adhi puruṣaḥ hasakahalahrīṃ sa jāto atiricyata sakalahrīṃ 
paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ || yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā ka-e-īlahrīṃ devā 
yajñamatanvata hasakahalahrīṃ vasanto'syāsīdājyaṃ sakalahrīṃ grīṣma 
idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ || ityādikrameṇa ṣoḍaśamantrāṇāṃ pādaiḥ sampuṭaṃ 
kṛtvā japet || puruṣasūktamantrapādairlopāyāḥ sampuṭaṃ 
śrīsūktamantrapādaiḥ kāmarājavidyāyāḥ sampuṭamiti jñeyam || taduktaṃ 
kulārṇave :

lopāmbāṃ sampuṭīkṛtya pauruṣaiśca japedbhudhaḥ |
śrīsūktaiḥ kāmarājākhyāṃ prajapedyatnato budhaḥ || 1 ||

iti | pauruṣaiḥ puruṣasūktasthamantrapādaiḥ śrīsūktaiḥ śrīsūktamantrapādaiḥ 
| evaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ hariṇīṃ ka-e-īlahrīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajam hasakahalahrīṃ 
candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ sakalahrīṃ jātavedo mamāvaha || evaṃ 
krameṇa pratyekaṃ jayet || tathā :

prathamena sutāvāptirdvitīyā jīvasūrbhavet |
tṛtīyena caturthena vandhyādoṣavināśanam || 2 ||

pañcamenātha ṣaṣṭhena putraṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ labhet |
saptamena tu garbhasya sthiratā hyaṣṭamena tu || 3 ||

sukhaprasūtirnavamādgarbhadoṣān vināśayet |
daśamena pareṇāpi puṣpadoṣān vināśayet || 4 ||

dvādaśena tu kanyāyāḥ sūtidoṣamapāsya ca |
pumapatyaṃ bhavatyeva caturbhistatparairdhruvam || 5 ||

sarve doṣā vinaśyanti garbhajā nātra saṃśayaḥ |

iti || atha śrīsūktaphalāni -

prathame sampadāṃ prāptirdvitīyena paśūn vahet |
tṛtīyena bhaveddhānyaṃ caturthena mahīṃ labhet || 1 ||

bhṛtyān pañcamamantreṇa ṣaṣṭhena tu mahadyaśaḥ |
saptamādrājasammānamaṣṭamena dhṛtiḥ sthirā || 2 ||

navamena turaṅgāptirdaśamena gajāṁllabhet |
ekādaśena vastrāṇi dvādaśena sutāṁllabhet || 3 ||

trayodaśena ratnāni caturdaśamahāmanoḥ |
pṛthivīṃ śasyasampannāṃ śriyaṃ pañcadaśena tu || 4 ||

rudramantraistathā kṛtvā tattatkarmāṇi sādhayet |
śrīvidyāvṛndanivahastvevaṃ sampuṭito yadi || 5 ||

pañcāśacca sahasrāṇi daśalakṣamitāni ca |
jāyante tatkramaṃ jñātvā gurutaḥ śāstrato'pi vā || 6 ||

viniyuñjyāt prayogeṣu tattatkarmaṇyatandritaḥ |
dīkṣā tu ṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ (ṣaḍdarśanavidhā bhavet || 7 ||

tatrādau śāktadīkṣāyāḥ)kramaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi |
caturviṃśatihastaṃ tu maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 8 ||

p. 204) nava kuṇḍāni kurvīta caturasrāṇi vai kramāt |
yonikuṇḍāni vā kuryādardhacandranibhāni vā || 9 ||

trikoṇāni ca vṛttāni ṣaṭkoṇānyambujāni vā |
aṣṭāstrāṇyathavācāryakuṇḍamīśendramadhyataḥ || 10 ||

sārdhahastadvayaṃ tyaktvā vedikāntaḥ prakalpayet |
hastamātraṃ parityajya kuṇḍānyanyāni kalpayet || 11 ||

iti || kuṇḍalakṣaṇaṃ tvagre vakṣyāmaḥ || śrīkulārṇave -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
dīkṣāyāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāyāṃ japahomeṣu ṛtvijām || 1 ||

mantrān vakṣye śṛnu prājñe kuṇḍeṣvaṣṭasu vai kramāt |
nārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ varāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || 2 ||

śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca gopālaṃ kārṣṇameva ca |
pañcadaśyāṃ samāyojya jape home ca pārvati || 3 ||

vaidike tu viśeṣeṇa gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram |
jātavedasapañcarcaṃ devīlakṣmyostu sūktake || 4 ||

śaive tu śivapañcārṇamaghoraṃ śarabhaṃ tathā |
prāsādaṃ vāpāśupataṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjñakam || 5 ||

mṛtyuñjayaṃ daśārṇaṃ ca krameṇa parameśvari |
saure tu ghṛṇimantraṃ ca ṣaḍarṇaṃ vedavarṇakam || 6 ||

tryakṣaraṃ ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ ca dvādaśārṇaṃ ṣaḍarṇakam |
ajapākhyaṃ tu śākte tu bālāmantraśca bhairavī || 7 ||

tripurā vāsinī siddhā mālinī tripurādikā |
bhairavī tripurāmbā ca bauddhe padmāvatī tathā || 8 ||

ugratārāpyekajaṭā tārā nīlasarasvatī |
mātaṅgī sumukhī caiva caṇḍamātaṅginī tathā || 9 ||

ūrdhvāmnāyakrameṇa dvedve vidye tathaiva ca |
mūlavidyāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva dīkṣāyāṃ śrīgurormanoḥ || 10 ||

śuklaṃ miśraṃ ca raktaṃ viśrānticaraṇatrayam |
śambhoścaraṇavidye dve parāprasādasaṃjñake || 11 ||

pañca brahmātmakā mantrā aṣṭātriṃśatkalāstridhā |
ekārṇaṃ gāṇapatye tu mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathā || 12 ||

kṣiprasaṃjñaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca vakratuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca |
lakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ caiva herambagaṇapaṃ tathā || 13 ||

viryākhyagaṇapaṃ caiva tathā śaktigaṇeśvaram |
dakṣiṇākālikāyāstu ekārṇaṃ tryarṇameva ca || 14 ||

siddhakālī ṣaḍarṇā ca manuvasvarṇakau tathā |
daśākṣaradvayaṃ caiva tārāyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 15 ||

ādyahīnāścāṣṭa tārā bhuvaneśyā guṇārṇakam |
śrīvākkāmaparāruddhā trividhā tripuṭā tathā || 16 ||

pañcadaśyā viśeṣeṇa tricatuṣpañcakūṭakāḥ |
ṣaṭkūṭā saptakūṭā syādaṣṭakūṭā tu pañcamī || 17 ||

nityāpañcadaśīnāṃ ca aṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam |
pītāmbarāṣṭavārāhyo dīkṣāyāṃ tu parasparam || 18 ||

durgāyā mahiṣārdinyā śūlinī vanadurgikā |
jayākhyā ca navārṇā ca śāntyagnilavaṇātmikā || 19 ||

atidurgā ca samproktā gāyatryāstadanantaram |
pañcāyatanabhedaistu saure śākte ca vaiṣṇave || 20 ||

śaive ca gāṇapatye ca prāguktā mantranāyakāḥ |
vaiṣṇavāṣṭakamadhye tu hitvā svāṣṭadaśākṣaram || 21 ||

turīyā vedamātā ca saṃyojyā parameśvari |
śaive pāśupataṃ hitvā tatra traiyambakaṃ kṣipet || 22 ||

saure'pyāṣṭākṣaraṃ hitvā udyanmantraṃ niyojayet |
gāṇapatye gaṇānāṃ tvā hitvocchiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśvaram || 23 ||

śākte prāgvacca saṃyojya dīkṣāhomajapādiṣu |
etadāyatanānāṃ cāpyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam || 24 ||

śākte samyak pravakṣyāmi cakreśvaryaḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
ṣaṭśāmbhavopadeśe tu hyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam || 25 ||

tryakṣaraṃ caturarṇaṃ cāpyekākṣaramataḥ param |
siddhalakṣmī rājyalakṣmīrvānyadbhedatrayaṃ punaḥ || 26 ||

punaranyanmilitvātra cāṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam |
anyavidyāsu mantreṣu tattadbhedaiḥ parasparam || 27 ||

aṅgāṅgitvaṃ prakartavyaṃ tattatkarmaṇi niścayāt |
pañcāyatanadīkṣāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 28 ||

aṅgāṅgitvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāhitaḥ |
mahāgaṇeśamantreṇa ghṛṇimantreṇa saṃyutā || 29 ||

parāprāsādamantreṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇena ca |
saṃyojya ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ japapūjanāt || 30 ||

dakṣiṇākālikāyāstu tathaiva parikīrtitaḥ |
tārāyāśchinnamastāyā viśeṣo'tra nigadyate || 31 ||

mārtaṇḍabhairavaścaiva maṃjughoṣastathaiva ca |
ucchiṣṭagaṇanāthaśca mukundo bāla eva ca || 32 ||

p. 205) bhuvaneśyā mahādevyā yāvanto vaiṣṇavāḥ priye |
gāṇapatyāśca saurāśca śaivāścāpi viśeṣataḥ || 33 ||

bhairavī bagalā caṇḍā mātaṅgī cāparājitā |
dīkṣāyāṃ japahome ca pūjane ca viśeṣataḥ || 34 ||

pañcāyatanatantreṣu tārāvat parikīrtitā |
durgā ca bhuvaneśīvanmahālakṣmīstathaiva ca || 35 ||

anyāstu sampradāyena prayojyā deśikottamaiḥ |

iti || tathā ca kādimate śrītantrarāje -

ṣaḍaṣṭadvādaśārṇānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāmaśeṣataḥ |
mantrāṇāṃ paratattvārthavācakatvādabhedataḥ || 1 ||

lalitavidyayā tadvat prāsādasya trayātmanaḥ |
tathaiva ca parāyāśca gāyatryāścoktarūpataḥ || 2 ||

vyāhṛtīnāṃ mahāvākyaparamātmājapātmanām |
praṇavasya ca tādrūpyayogāt syāttattadātmatā || 3 || (26|46)

iti || atha saṃpradāyāmnāyakramasta tvagre vadiṣyāmaḥ || atha (śrīvidyāyāḥ 
śrīcakra āvaraṇapūjāyāṃ nārāyaṇādi) proktamantrāṇāṃ 
ṛṣyādinyāsadhyānāni yathā tantrāntareṣu - tataḥ 
prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi 
sādhyanārāyaṇāya-ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe devyai gāyatryai chandase namaḥ 
hṛdaye śrīparamātmane devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mameṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā mūlena vyāpakaṃ karayorvinyasya kroddholkāya svāhā 
hṛdayāya namaḥ maholkāya svāhā śirase svāhā vorolkāya svāhā śikhāyai 
vaṣaṭ dyulkāya svāhā kavacāya huṃ sahasrolkāya svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti 
mantrānaṃgulīṣu hṛdayādiṣu vinyasya dhyāyet |

hastaiścakradarau gadāsarasije vibhrāṇamarkollasat-
kāntiṃ śrīdharaṇīvibhūṣitalasatpārśvaṃ kirīṭānvitam |
śrīvatsāṅkasakaustubhorupadakaṃ keyūrahārojjvalaṃ
rājatkuṇḍalamaṇḍitaṃ hṛdi bhaje pītāmbaraṃ śārṅgiṇam || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ityaṣṭākṣaraṃ japet ||

atha vāsudevamantrasya tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi prajāpati ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrīvāsudevadevatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā mūlena karayorvyāpakaṃ kṛtvā oṃ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ namo śirase svāhā bhagavate śikhāyai vaṣaṭ vāsudevāya kavacāya huṃ 
namo bhagavate vāsudevāya astrāya phaṭ |

tataḥ samāhito bhūtvā vāsudevaṃ hṛdi smaret |
madhyedugdhāmbudhi dvīpe divyayoṣāniṣevite || 1 ||

tatra sañcintya vipinamakhilartuniṣevitam |
tanmadhye kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca divyamadbhutadarśanam || 2 ||

tasyādhastādratnamañca kamalaṃ vimalaprabham |
śaratpūrṇenduvilasatprabhāpaṭalarājitam || 3 ||

tatra sañcintayeddevaṃ vāsudevaṃ smitānanam |
kundendvābhaṃ gadācakrapadmaśaṅkhalasatkaram || 4 ||

candrāyutalasatkāntyā mohayantaṃ jagattrayam |
keyurāṅgadasaṃrājaddordaṇḍaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam || 5 ||

śrīvatsāṅkaṃ lasadratnamukuṭaṃ kaustubhānvitam |
aravindadalātāmrasuramyāyatalocanam || 6 ||

kuṇḍalaprollasadgaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ pītavāsasam |
graiveyahārasaṃśobhikambukaṇṭhaṃ sukaṅkaṇam || 7 ||

viśālavakṣaḥsaṃrājatprapullavanamālakam |
sanakādimunīndraiśca tattvanirṇayakāṃkṣamā || 8 ||

niṣevitaṃ dityaditijātagandharvasaṃcayaiḥ |
uddhavidyādharāścaiva sevitaṃ ca mahoragaiḥ || 9 ||

iti dhyātvā japādikaṃ vidadhyāt ||

atha varāhamantrasya tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi bhārgavāya ṛṣaye namaḥ 
mukhe'nuṣṭupcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīvarāhadevatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 

p. 206) kṛtāñjaliruktvā ekaśṛṅgāya hṛdayāya namaḥ vyomolkāya śirase 
svāhā tejo'dhipataye śikhāyai vaṣaṭ viśvarūpāya kavacāya hūṃ 
mahādaṃṣṭrāyāstrāya phaṭ iti pañcāṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet | 
dhyānam :

jānoḥ padāvadhi suvarṇanibhaṃ ca nābherājānu candradhavalaṃ ca 
galāddhadantam |
vahniprabhaṃ śaśinibhaṃ śiraso galāntaṃ maulisthalādviyata endunibhaṃ ca 
kāntam || 1 ||

saṃvibhrataṃ karatalairariśaṅkhakhaṅgān kheṭaṃ gadāṃ tadanu 
śaktivarābhayāni |
sarvaṃsahādharaṇaśobhisadekadaṃṣṭramādyaṃ varāhamaniśaṃ prabhaje 
svacitte || 2 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ namo bhagavate varāharūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥsvarpataye bhūpatitvaṃ 
me dehi dadāpaya svāhā ayaṃ mantro yojyaḥ ||

atha viṣṇoḥ - tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi kapilāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrye chandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrībhogavāmanāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mama 
sarvābhīṣṭāvāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ 
bhagavate śirase svāhā viṣṇave śikhāyai vaṣaṭ surapataye kavacāya huṃ 
mahāvalāya netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ svāhāstrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrānvinyasya dhyāyet | dhyānam :

nīlavarṇaścaturbāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadābjadhṛk |
sarvān bhogān dadātyeṣa bhaktānāṃ bhogavāmanaḥ || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ namo bhagavate viṣṇve surapataye mahābalāya svāhā iti ||

atha śrīkaramantrasya tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi vāmadevāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
paṃkticchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīkarāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mama 
sarvābhīṣṭāvāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā uṃ bhīṣaya bhīṣaya huṃ 
hṛdayāya namaḥ ttiṃ trāsaya trāsaya huṃ śirase svāhā ṣṭhaṃ mardaya 
mardaya huṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ śrīṃ pradhvaṃsaya huṃ kavacāya huṃ kaṃ 
rakṣaya rakṣaya huṃ astrāya phaṭ | tataḥ netrayoḥ raṃ udare svāṃ pṛṣṭhe hāṃ 
iti vinyasya dhyāyet ||

tataḥ sañcintayedviṣṇuṃ śrīkaraṃ hṛdayāmbuje |
lolakallolajālena phenile sormimālake || 1 ||

dugdhāmbudhāvastra madhye dvīpaṃ śuklamayaṃ śubham |
hemasthalīsamākīrṇaṃ nānāmaṇigaṇaiḥ śubham || 2 ||

vanaṃ sañcintayettatra sakalatuṃniṣevitam |
kalpadrumasamūhaiśca vāritātapamuttamam || 3 ||

ṣaṭapadālīkalārāvasaṃkulaṃ lolapallavam |
puṣpavajraparāgodyat tuṣāraparipūritam || 4 ||

hiraṇyamayānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ maṇipuṣpeṣu cañcalam |
indindirālikramaṇaśīlaśakramaṇīrucam || 5 ||

aṅgīkaroti yatrāpi ramante'psarasaḥ suraiḥ |
audāryaśobhanaiśvaryasaubhāgyādiguṇairyutaiḥ || 6 ||

rūpābhirāmamadhurākṛtibhiḥ sukumārakaiḥ |
mandasmitalasaddantamarīcidyotitānanāḥ || 7 ||

manojñā jitacandrābhā madasphuritalocanāḥ |
jalpākapuṃskokilodyaddevavṛndaṃ nirantram || 8 ||

unnidritodyanmadanāḥ pīnastanaghaṭālasāḥ |
suśroṇibhārādatyarthamandagāminya uttamāḥ || 9 ||

evaṃ bhūtāścāpsarasaḥ krīḍante yatra cāmaraiḥ |
mārasenāpatiriva vanalakṣmyā gṛhaṃ yathā || 10 ||

janmasthānamṛtūnāṃ ca kalpavṛkṣataroradhaḥ |
indirāyāḥ sodarasya navaratnamayasya ca || 11 ||

śikhāvalisamuddyotiśītalasya tale śubhe |
svarṇakuṭṭimasaṃśobhimahāratnamanorame || 12 ||

udyadarkaprabhābhāsvatpīṭhasannihitasya ca |
prasiddhavikramaughasya pakṣirājasya copari || 13 ||

upaviṣṭaṃ galitācchaśucihāṭakasannibham |
ratnodyanmakarākāracārukuṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 14 ||

kirīṭamaṇisandīptadikcakraṃ cārubhūṣaṇam |
śaśikhaṇḍalasacchubhrakḷptāmalaviśeṣakam || 15 ||

aticañcalasaccilli mukuṭojjvalagaṇḍakam |
smitasaṃśobhivaktrendukapolaphalakojjvalam || 16 ||

p. 207) daśanāvaliraśmyoghavirājitaśubhādharam |
pakvabimbādharaṃ ramyaraktapadmapalāśavat || 17 ||

āyatāruṇanetraṃ ca samyakpakṣmavirājitam |
uruhāramaṇivrātadīdhitiprollasadgalam || 18 ||

divyaratnāṅgadadyotibāhunāladharaṃ harim |
gadākamalaśaṅkhāridhāriṇaṃ bāhudaṇḍakaiḥ || 19 ||

kapāṭavipulenātha kamalānilayena ca |
lasatkaustubhadīptyoghavidyotitatalena ca || 20 ||

vakṣasā suvirājantaṃ trailokyanilayena ca |
trivalīśobhinā samyagromarājilasadrucā || 21 ||

uddhareṇa virājantaṃ ramyaṃ kaṭitaṭena ca |
pītapaṭṭāṃśukarucā vilasanmaṇimekhalam || 22 ||

śaratūṇasadṛkpīnaramyoruparibhūṣitam |
kekikaṇṭhalasatkāntijaṅghāyugamanoharam || 23 ||

raktotpalābhacaraṇaṃ pādāgrajitakacchapam |
śaśaraktasadṛkkāntidhvajābjāṅkitapattalam || 24 ||

karasadraktakamalaramayāliṅgitaṃ sadā |
kṣamayā copagūḍhaṃ ca navamāṇikyaśobhitam || 25 ||

navayauvanakāntyoghasaṃśobhisakalāṅgakam |
surāsurarṣipramukhaiḥ sevitaṃ cāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 26 ||

pūrṇendubimbasadṛśavitānasamalaṃkṛtam |
surayopākarābjālilasaccāmararājitam || 27 ||

vidyullatāsaṃvilolavaijayantīsuśobhitam |
yakṣavidyādharavyūhacāraṇādiniṣevitam || 28 ||

ityevaṃ dhyātvā uttiṣṭha śrīkara svāhā | ayaṃ mantro (ṣoḍaśārṇāyāṃ) 
yojyaḥ ||

atha nṛsiṃhamantraḥ - tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ 
mukhe'nuṣṭupcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīnṛsiṃhadevatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā ugraṃ vīraṃ 
hṛdayāya namaḥ mahāviṣṇuṃ śirase svāhā jvalantaṃ sarvato mukhaṃ 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kavacāya huṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ namāmyaham astrāya phaṭ iti vinyasya dhyāyet :

nṛsiṃhaṃ bhaje jānuvinyastabāhuṃ trinetraṃ bhujaprollasaccakraśaṅkham |
kṛśānūpamajyotiṣā grastadaityaṃ śiraḥśobhidaṃṣṭrāsudīptadvijihvam || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ viśvatomukham | nṛsiṃhaṃ 
bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham iti mantro yojyaḥ ||

atha gopālamantraḥ - tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi nāradāya-ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe virāṭchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrīkṛṣṇāya devatāyai namaḥ guhye klīṃbījāya namaḥ 
pādayoḥ svāhāśaktaye namaḥ sarvāṅge kṛṣṇāya prakṛtaye namaḥ hṛdi 
śrīdurgāyai adhiṣṭhātryai devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ kṛtāñjaliruktvā mūlena karayorvyāpakaṃ kṛtvā ācakrāya svāhā 
hṛdayāya namaḥ vicakrāya svāhā śirase svāhā sucakrāya svāhā śikhāyai 
vaṣaṭ trailokyarakṣaṇacakrāya svāhā kavacāya huṃ asurāntacakrāya svāhā 
astrāyaphaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

darāricāpasadbāṇaguṇāṃśukakarāmbujam |
veṇumādāya hastābhyāṃ vādayantaṃ mudānvitam || 1 ||

ravimaṇḍalagaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyediṣṭaphalāptaye |

iti dhyātvā klīṃkṛṣṇāya govindāya gopījanavallabhāya svāhā iti mantro 
yojyaḥ ||

atha kṛṣṇamantraḥ - tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi nārada-ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīcchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrīkṛṣṇadevatāyai namaḥ guhye klīṃbījāya namaḥ ityādi 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
pūrṇajñānātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ pūrṇaiśvaryātmane śirase svāhā 
pūrṇaprabhātmane śikhāyai vaṣṭ pūrṇānandātmane kavacāya huṃ 
pūrṇateja-ātmane netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ pūrṇaśaktyātmane astrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

p. 208) dhyāyeddharinmaṇinibhaṃ jagadekavandyaṃ 
saundaryasāramariśaṅkhavarābhayāni |
dorbhidadhānamajitaṃ saramaṃ ca bhaiṣmīsatyāsametamakhilapradamindireśam || 
1 ||

iti dhyātvā klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ iti mantro yojyaḥ || yogastu oṃ hasakalahrīṃ 
namo hasakahalahrīṃ nārāyaṇāya sakalahrīṃ || 1 ||

oṃ hasakalahrīṃ namo hasakalahrīṃ bhagavate sakala hrīṃ vāsudevāya || 2 ||

oṃ namo bhagavate hasakalahrīṃ varāharūpāya hasakahalahrīṃ 
bhūrbhuvaḥsvarpataye sakalahrīṃ bhūpatitvaṃ me dehi dadāpaya svāhā || 3 ||

oṃ namo bhagavate hasakalahrīṃ viṣṇave hasakahalahrīṃ surapataye sakalahrīṃ 
mahābalāya svāhā || 4 ||

uttiṣṭha hasakalahrīṃ śrīkara hasakalahrīṃ svāhā sakalahrīṃ || 5 ||

ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ hasakalahrīṃ jvalantaṃ sarvato mukhaṃ 
hasakahalahrīṃ nṛsiṃhabhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ sakalahrīṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ 
namāmyaham || 6 ||

klīṃkṛṣṇāya hasakalahrīṃ govindāya hasakahalahrīṃ gopījanavallabhāya 
sakalahrīṃ svāhā || 7 ||

klīṃ hasakalahrīṃ kṛṣṇāya hasakahalahrīṃ namaḥ sakalahrīṃ || 8 ||

evaṃ yoga ityarthaḥ ||

vaidikadarśane tu mantrānāha - tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā asya śrīgāyatrīmantrasya śirasi viśvāmitrāya 
ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatryai cchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīparamātmane 
devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
tatsaviturbrahmātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ vareṇyaṃ viṣṇvātmane śirase svāhā 
bhargodevasya rudrātmane śikhāyai vaṣaṭ dhīmahi īśvarātmane kavacāya huṃ 
dhiyo yo naḥ sadāśivātmane netratrayāya vauṣaṭ pracodayāt paramātmane 
astrāyaphaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet |

muktāvidrumahemanīladhavalacchāyairmukhaistrīkṣaṇai-
ryuktāmindunibaddharatnamukuṭāṃ tattvārthavarṇātmikām |
gāyatrīṃ varadābhayāṃkuśakarāṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ guṇaṃ
śaṅkhaṃ cakramathārabinduyugalaṃ hastairvahantīṃ bhaje || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ hasakalahrīṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi 
hasakahalahrīṃ dhiyo yonaḥ sakalahrīṃ pracodayāt ||

atha jātavedase mantrasya - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā asya jātaveda mantrasya śirasi mārocaputrakaśyapāya 
ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe triṣṭupchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrījātavedāgnaye durgāyai 
devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
jātavedase sunavāma hṛdayāya namaḥ somamarātīyato śirase svāhā nidahāti 
vedaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ sa naḥ parṣadati kavacāya huṃ durgāṇi viśvā nāveva 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān 
vinyasya dhāyet :

vidyuddāmasamaprabhāṃ mṛgapatiskandhasthitāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ
kanyābhiḥ karavālakheṭavilasaddhastābhirāsevitām |
hastaiścakragadāsikheṭaviśikhāṃścāpaṃ guṇaṃ tarjanīṃ
vibhrāṇāmanalātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃ durgāṃ trinetrāṃ smaret || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā jātavedase sunavāma somaṃ hasakalahrīṃ arātīyato nidahāti vedaḥ 
hasakahalahrīṃ sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sakalahrīṃ sindhuṃ 
duritātyagniḥ ||

atha tāmagnivarṇāmiti mantrasya - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādīn prāgvadvinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ 
hrīṃ śirase svāhā hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ hrauṃ 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti vinyasya prāgvad dhyātvā 
tāmagnivarṇāṃ tapasā jvalantīṃ hasakalahrīṃ vairocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu 
juṣṭāṃ hasakahalahrīṃ durgāṃ devīṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye sakalahrīṃ 
sutarasi tarase namaḥ || iti japet ||

p. 209) athāgne ityasya prayogaḥ tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
ṛṣyādiṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ ca prāgvat vidhāya agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo 
asmān hasakalahrīṃ svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā hasakahalahrīṃ pūśca pṛthivī 
bahulā na urvī sakalahrīṃ bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃyoḥ || iti japet ||

atha viśvāni na ityasya prayogaḥ tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānāni 
prāgvadvidhāya viśvāni no durgahā jātavedaḥ hasakalahrīṃ sindhuṃ na nāvā 
duritāti papiṃ hasakahalahrīṃ agne atrivannamasā gṛṇāno sakalahrīṃ asmākaṃ 
bodhyavitā tanūnām || iti japet ||

atha pṛtanājitamityasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādidhyānāntaṃ vidhāya 
pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānamugraṃ hasakalahrīṃ agniṃ huvema paramātsadhastāt 
hasakahalahrīṃ sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā sakalahrīṃ kṣāmaddevo 
duritātyagniḥ || tataḥ śrīsūktadevīsūkte ṛgvede prasiddhe ||

atha śaive prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi vāmadevāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe paṃktyai 
cchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsadāśivāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā sarvajñāya hṛdayāya 
namaḥ nityatṛptāya śirase svāhā anādibodhāya śikhāyai vaṣṭ svatantrāya 
kavacāya huṃ nityamaluptaśaktaye netratrayāya vauṣaṭ nityamanantaśaktaye 
astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

gokṣīraphenadhavalaṃ rajatādrisamaprabham |
cārucandrakalārājajjaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam || 1 ||

pañcavaktradharaṃ śambhuṃ prativaktra.ṃ trilocanam |
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam || 2 ||

iti dhyātvā hasakalahrīṃ oṃ hasakahalahrīṃ namaḥ sakalahrīṃ śivāya iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

athāghorāstrasya prayogaḥ tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi aghorāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe triṣṭupcchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrī-aghorarudrāya devatāyai namaḥ guhye hrīṃbījāya namaḥ 
padāyoḥ hrūṃśaktaye namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrīṃ sphurasphura hṛdayāya namaḥ prasphuraprasphura śirase 
svāhā ghora ghoratara tanūrūpa śikhāyai vaṣaṭ caṭacaṭa pracaṭa pracaṭa 
kavacāya huṃ kahakaha vamavama netratrayāya vauṣaṭ bandhabandha 
ghātayaghātaya huṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

evaṃ nyastatanurmantrau dhāyeddevamananyadhīḥ |
kālameghanibhaṃ devaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ trilocanam || 1 ||

bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ raktavasanālepasaṃyutam |
paraśuṃ karavālaṃ ca bāṇāṃstriśikhameva ca || 2 ||

dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇairhastairūrdhvādikramataḥ paraiḥ |
ḍamaruṃ kheṭakaṃ cāpaṃ nṛkapālaṃ ca pārvati || 3 ||

kāmyakarmasu raktābhamasitaṃ cābhicārake |
nigrahe grahabhūtādimuktyai muktānibhaṃ smaret || 4 ||

iti | evaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hrīṃsphurasphura prasphuraprasphura ghora ghoratara 
tanurūpa hasakalahrīṃ caṭacaṭa pracaṭapracaṭa kahakaha hasakahalahrīṃ 
vamavama bandhabandha sakalahrīṃ ghatayaghātaya huṃ phaṭ iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha śarabhaprayogaḥ tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe paṃktyai 
chandase namaḥ hṛdaye śarabhaśālvāya pakṣirājāya devatāyai namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ namo bhagavate 
hṛdayāya namaḥ śarabhaśālvāya śirase svāhā pakṣirājāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ 
mama śatrūnnāśaya nāśaya kavacāya huṃ huṃphaṭ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ 
svāhā astrāya phaṭ | dhyānam :

aṣṭāpadaṃ pakṣatimūlarājadvajrāṃkuṃ hāṭakapakṣakūṭam |
hemāṅgamaṅgīkṛtapadmarāgaṃ cañcūpuṭollāsimukhārabindam || 1 ||

sūryānalendudyutirājamānanetratrayollāsitapadmarāgam |

p. 210) nīlāśmadīptākhilaromasaṅghaṃ śītāṃśukhaṇḍojjvalitottamāṅgam || 
2 ||

viprāhidvandvabaddhottamakapilajaṭābhārasañcārigaṅgā-
saṅgākrāntottamāṅgāt kramagalitapṛṣatsaṅghahārābhirāmam |
agrodyannāgabandhakramaghaṭitasaṭāgranthipañcāṃgulodya-
tpucchasthagranthibāhūdbhavabhujayugalollāsimālābhirāmam || 3 ||

kakṣyāsaṃbaddhavaiśyāhipayugalalasaccandratīvrāṃśulīlā-
ghaṇṭāṭopākulāśādaśakapatikulaṃ vairisaṅghaṃkakālam |
pāśākārāṃsaloladvṛṣalakulabhavāśīrviṣādhīśabhoga-
sphūrjatphūtkāraghoraṃ khurapuṭanikarakṣuṇāsarvaṃsahaṃ tam || 4 ||

bhakṣayantaṃ pakṣirūpaṃ bhaktānāṃ vairisañcayam |
śarabhaṃ śālvarūpaṃ ca dhyāyedekāgramānasaḥ || 5 ||

iti śarabharūpaṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā oṃ namo bhagavate śarabhaśālvāya 
hasakalahrīṃ pakṣirājāya hasakahalahrīṃ mama śatrūn nāśayanāśaya 
sakalahrīṃ ghaghahuṃphaṭ svāhā iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha prāsādamantrasya prayogaḥ tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi vāmadevāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
paṃkticchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsadāśivāya devatāyai namaḥ guhye 
haṃbījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ oṃ śaktaye namaḥ iti vinyasya mama 
sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā hāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ hīṃ 
śirase svāhā hūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ haiṃ kavacāya hum hauṃ netratrayāya 
vauṣaṭ haḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

dhyāyeddevaṃ tato vatsa hṛdi caikāgramānasaḥ |
sindūrapuñjaśoṇāṅgaṃ smeravaktraṃ trilocanam || 1 ||

maṇimaulilasaccandrakalālaṃkṛtamastakam |
dakṣiṇordhvakare ṭaṅkaṃ dadhānaṃ tadadho varam || 2 ||

vāmordhvahaste hariṇaṃ tadadho'bhayamādarāt |
pīnavṛttaghanottuṅgastanāgre viniveśya ca || 3 ||

vāmāṅke saniviṣṭāyāḥ priyāyāḥ raktapaṅkaje |
dadhatyā dakṣiṇe haste cāsīnaṃ raktapaṅkaje || 4 ||

nānābharaṇasaṃdīptaṃ divyagandhasragambaram |

iti dhyātvā oṃ hauṃ hasakalahrīṃ hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ namaḥ sakalahrīṃ 
śivāya iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha pāśupatāstrāya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāyāṇāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi vāmadevāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
paṃkticchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīpaśupataye devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ huṃ phaṭ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ ślīṃ huṃphaṭ śirase svāhā pa huṃphaṭ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ śu huṃ phaṭ 
kavacāya huṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭ netratrayā vauṣaṭ phaṭ huṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

dhyāyet paśupatiṃ samyaṃmantrī caikāgramānasaḥ |
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanam || 1 ||

agnijvālānibhaśmaśrusaṃyutaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭrakam |
khaḍgaṃ bāṇānakṣasūtraṃ śaktiṃ paraśumeva ca || 2 ||

dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇairhastairūrdhvādikramato gurum |
kheṭacāpau kuṇḍikāṃ ca triśūlaṃ brahmadaṇḍayuk || 3 ||

vāmahastaiśca bibhrāṇaṃ madhyāhnārkasamaprabham |
nānābharaṇasandīptaṃ pannagendrairalaṃkṛtam || 4 ||

sphaṭikaughanibhaṃ śāntaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ smaret |

iti | evaṃ dhyātvā oṃ ślīṃ hasakalahrīṃ paśu hasakahalahrīṃ huṃ sakalahrīṃ 
phaṭ iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha dakṣiṇāmūrtimantrasya prayogaḥ : tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi śukāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtaye devatāyai namaḥ guhye oṃ 
bījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā mūlamantreṇa karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya oṃ hrāṃ 
dakṣiṇāmūrtaye hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ tubhyaṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā 
oṃ hrīṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ oṃ hrīṃ 
dhyānaikaniratāṅgāya hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃ hrīṃ namo rudrāya hrauṃ 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ hrīṃ śambhave hraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān 
vinyasya dhyāyet :

vaṭaviṭapisamīpe bhūmibhāge niṣaṇṇaṃ sakalamunijanānāṃ 
jñānadātāramārāt |
tribhuvanagurumīśaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtirūpaṃ jananamaraṇaduḥkhacchedadakṣaṃ 
namāmi || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtaye tubhyaṃ hasakalahrīṃ vaṭamūlanivāsine 
hasakahalahrīṃ dhyānaikaniratāṅgāya sakalahrīṃ namo rudrāya śambhave 
hrīṃ oṃ iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha mṛtyuñjayasya prayogaḥ : tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi kaholāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
nicṛdgāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīmṛtyuñjayāya devatāyai namaḥ guhye 
oṃ bījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ saḥ śaktaye namaḥ nābhau jūṃ kīlakāya namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣaṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā mūlamantreṇa 
karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya sāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ sīṃ śirase svāhā sūṃ śikhāyai 
vaṣaṭ saiṃ kavacāya huṃ sauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ saḥ astrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

dhyāyeddevaṃ tato vatsa samāhitamanāściram |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śubhrapadmāsanasthitam || 1 ||

kapardamaulivilasaccandrakhaṇḍacyutāmṛtaiḥ |
abhiṣiktasamastāṅgamarkendvanalalocanam || 2 ||

dakṣiṇordhvakare mudrāṃ jñānākhyāṃ tadadhaḥkare |
akṣamālāṃ ca vāmordhve pāśaṃ vedamadhaḥkare || 3 ||

dadhānaṃ cintayeddevaṃ mṛtyurogabhayāpaham |

iti dhyātvā oṃ hasakalahrīṃ jūṃ hasakahalahrīṃ saḥ sakalahrīṃ iti mantraṃ 
japet ||

atha daśākṣarasya prayogaḥ : tataḥ prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe virāṭchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye sadāśivāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ namaḥ śirase svāhā bhagavate 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ rudrāya kavacāya huṃ oṃ namo bhagavate netratrayāya vauṣaṭ 
rudrāya astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhāyet :

ārkīrṇaṃ divyabhogairamaraditisutairarcitaṃ śailakanyā-
dehārdhaṃ dhārayantaṃ sphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyam |
dvaipīṃ kṛttiṃ vasānaṃ himakiraṇakalāśekharaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ
hṛṣṭaṃ vyāptaṃ kalābhirdhṛtakapilajaṭaṃ bhāvaye'haṃ maheśam || 1 ||

iti dhyātyā oṃ hasakalahrīṃ namo hasakahalahrīṃ bhagavate sakalahrīṃ rudrāya 
iti japet ||

atha sauradarśanavidhānam | tatrādau ghṛṇimantrasya prayogaḥ - tatra 
prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi 
devabhāgāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsūryāya 
devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā satyatejojvālāmaṇi huṃphaṭ svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ 
brahmatejojvālāmaṇi huṃphaṭ svāhā śirase svāhā viṣṇutejojvālāmaṇi 
huṃphaṭ svāhā śikhāyai vaṣaṭ rudratejojvālāmaṇi huṃphaṭ svāhā kavacāya 
huṃ agnitejojvālāmaṇi huṃphaṭ svāhā netratrayāya vauṣaṭ sarvatejo 
jvālāmaṇi huṃphaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

raktābjayugmābhayadānahastaṃ keyūrahārāṅgadakuṇḍalāḍhyam |
māṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍaṃ bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattrinetram || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā ghṛṇiḥ hasakalahrīṃ sūrya hasakahalahrīṃ āditya sakalahrīṃ oṃ iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

p. 212) atha ṣaḍarṇasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte śirasi 
brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsavitre 
devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtā~jaliruktvā 
sūkṣmarūpāya svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ sūkṣmatejase svāhā śirase svāhā 
sūkṣmākārāya svāhā śikhāyai vaṣaṭ sūkṣmabālāya svāhā kavacāya 
huṃ sūkṣmakāyāya svāhā netratrayāya vauṣaṭ mūlamantramuccāryai astrāya 
phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

raktapadmadvayaṃ hastairbibhrāṇaṃ varadābhaye |
bandhūkābhaṃ trinetraṃ ca raviṃ dhyāyet subhūṣitam || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā kha hasakalahrīṃ kho hasakahalahrīṃ lkāya sakalahrīṃ svāhā iti 
mantraṃ japet |

atha caturarṇasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsūryarūpiṇyai bhuvaneśvarye devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ hrīṃ 
śirase svāhā oṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ hrīṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ 
hrīṃ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

bhāsvadratnasahasramaulivilasaccandrārdhamuddyotaya-
ddhastābjairdadhadaṃkuśaṃ guṇavarābhītīḥ sutuṅgastanam |
pāyādgālitakāñcanāmbujajapāvidyujjvalatakāntibhi-
rviśvaṃ dyotayadārkamāśvaśiśiraṃ viśveśikāyā vapuḥ || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā oṃ hasakalahrīṃ hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ haṃ sakalahrīṃ saḥ iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

atha tryakṣarasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi ajāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsūryāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā guhyādipādaparyantaṃ hāṃ namaḥ 
kaṇṭhādguhyaparyantaṃ hīṃ namaḥ mūrdhādikaṇṭhāntaṃ saḥ namaḥ iti 
vinyasya hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hraḥ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya 
dhyāyet :

aruṇakamalasaṃsthaṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ bhūribhūṣaṃ 
hyaruṇakamalayugmābhīṣṭadābhītihastam |
aruṇataraśarīraṃ bhāvayāmo dineśaṃ hyaruṇakarasusevyaṃ 
sarvadevaughavandyam || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā hrāṃ hasakalahrīṃ hrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ saḥ sakalahrīṃ iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

atha ṣoḍaśārṇaprayogaḥ : tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
pāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe jagatīcchandase 
namaḥ hṛdaye śrībhāskarāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ aiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ klāṃklīṃklūṃ śirase 
svāhā hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ saḥ kavacāya huṃ śrībhāskarāya 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

māṇikyāḍhyarathārūḍhaṃ maṇikuṇḍaladhāriṇam |
hastaiścābhīṣṭadaṃ śaṅkhacakrapadmadharaṃ vibhum || 1 ||

kirīṭinaṃ mekhalinaṃ kavaciṃ śuśarīriṇam |
nānāratnasamopetaṃ ṛṣisaṃkhyāśvaśobhitam || 2 ||

nakṣatragraharāśyādyaiḥ sevitaṃ munimaṇḍalaiḥ |
sāvitryā caiva gāyatryā sarasvatyā ca śobhitam || 3 ||

nānādevasamāyuktaṃ bhāskaraṃ cintayedbudhaḥ |

evaṃ dhyātvā oṃ aiṃ hasakalahrīṃ klāṃklīṃklūṃ hasakahalahrīṃ 
hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃsaḥ sakalahrīṃ śrībhāskarāya svāhā iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha dvādaśākṣarasya prayogaḥ : tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi devabhāgāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
virāṭachandase namaḥ hṛdayeśrī-ādityāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃhraiṃhraḥ 
iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya prāgvaddhyātvā oṃ āṃ hasakalahrīṃ 
hrīṃśrīṃghṛṇiḥ hasakahalahrīṃ sūriya sakalahrīṃ āditya oṃ iti mantraṃ japet 
||

p. 213) atha ṣaḍakṣarasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrī-ādityāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭāvāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ śrīṃ 
śirase svāhā hrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ klīṃ kavacāya huṃ glauṃ netratrayāya 
vauṣaṭ hrāṃ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya prāgvaddhyāyet : oṃ 
śrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ hrīṃklīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ glauṃ sakalahrīṃ hrāṃ iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

athātmāṣṭākṣarasya prayogaḥ - tasya nyāsadhyānādikaṃ prāgeva 
prapañcayāgamātṛkāvidhane'bhihitam oṃ hrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ haṃsaḥ 
hasakahalahrīṃ so'haṃ sakalahrīṃ svāhā iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha śāktadarśanavidhānam || tatrādau bālāmantrasya prayogaḥ tatra 
prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā 
śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ hṛdaye 
śrībālāyai devatāyai namaḥ guhye aiṃ bījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ sauḥ śaktaye 
namaḥ nābhau klīṃ kīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ 
iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā aiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ klīṃ śirase svāhā sauḥ śikhāyai 
vaṣaṭ aiṃ kavacāya huṃ klīṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ sauḥ astrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

bhramadbhramaranīlābhadhamillāmalapuṣpikām |
brahmarandhrasphuradbhinnamuktālekhāvirājitām || 1 ||

muktālekhāratnalagnatilakāñcitabhālikām |
viśuddhamuktābindvāḍhyacandrarekhākirīṭinīm || 2 ||

bhramadbhramaranīlābhanayanatrayarājitām |
sūryabhāsvanmahāratnakuṇḍalālaṃkṛtāṃ parām || 3 ||

śukrākārasphuranmuktāhārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
kaṅkaṇādilasadbhūṣāmaṇibandhalasatprabhām || 4 ||

pravālalatikākārapāṇipādapallavaśobhitām |
vajravaiḍūryamuktālimekhalāṃ vimalaprabhām || 5 ||

raktotpaladalākārapādapallavaśobhitām |
nakṣatramālāsaṅkāśamuktāma~jīramaṇḍitām || 6 ||

vāmena pāṇinaikena pustakaṃ cāpareṇa tu |
abhayaṃ ca prayacchantīṃ sādhakāya varānane || 7 ||

akṣamālāṃ ca varadaṃ dakṣapāṇidvayena tu |
dadhatīṃ cintayeddevīṃ vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradām || 8 ||

kṣīrakundendudhavalāṃ prasannāṃ saṃsmaret priye |

iti dhyātvā aiṃ hasakalahrīṃ klīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sauḥ sakalahrīṃ iti mantraṃ 
japet ||

atha bhairavyāḥ prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
paṃkticchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrītripurabhairavyai devatāyai namaḥ guhye 
vāgbhavakūṭabījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ śakti kūṭaśaktaye namaḥ nābhau 
kāmarājakūṭakīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā bījatrayādvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya dhyāyet :

hṛdayasthāruṇāmbhojakarṇikāmadhyasaṃsthitām |
japākusumasaṅkāśāmaruṇāmbarabhūṣaṇām || 1 ||

smitadhautamahāmohāṃ trinetrāṃ candraśekharām |
viśvasaundaryasarvasvaviśvasāgararūpiṇīm || 2 ||

ānandamadhurāṃ devīṃ madaghūrṇitalocanām |
brahmābjanetrarudreśaśivākhyairmuṇḍasaṃjñakaiḥ || 3 ||

maṇḍitāṅgīṃ mahādevīṃ muktājapavaṭīdharām |
pustakālaṃkṛtakarāṃ varadābhayadhāriṇīm || 4 ||

raktāṅgarāgasubhagāṃ dhyāyet tripurabhairavīm |

evaṃ dhyātvā hasakalaraiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasakalarīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ hasauḥ 
sakalahrīṃ iti japet ||

atha caitanyabhairavyāḥ prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsānprāguktavadvidhāya 
dhyāyet -

udyadbhānusahasrābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām |
mukuṭordhvalasaccandrarekhāṃ raktāmbarāñcitām || 1 ||

p. 214) pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ nityavāmahastakapālinīm |
varadābhayahastāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 2 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā yajeddevīṃ pūrvasiṃhāsanasthitām |

iti dhyātvā sahaiṃ hasakalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sahauḥ sakalahrīṃ 
iti japet ||

atha kāmeśvarībhairavyāḥ prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādidhyānāntaṃ 
prāgvadvidhāya sahraiṃ hasakalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ nityaklinne 
madadrave sakalahrīṃ sahrauḥ iti japet ||

atha bhairavyāḥ prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiṣaḍaṅganyāsāntaṃ 
pūrvavadvidhāya dhyāyet -

udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām |
nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ sarvavairinikṛntanīm || 1 ||

sravadrudhiramuṇḍālikalitāṃ raktavāsasam |
triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭakameva ca || 2 ||

pinākaṃ ca śarāndevi pāśāṃkuśayugaṃ kramāt |
pustakaṃ ca cākṣamālāṃ ca śavasiṃhāsanasthitām || 3 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā hasakhaphreṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasakalarīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ hsauṃ 
sakalahrīṃ iti japet || iti nityābhairavī ||

atha bhuvaneśvarībhairavyāḥ prayogaḥ - tatra 
prātaḥkṛtyādiṣaḍaṅganyāsāntaṃ prāgvadvidhāya dhyāyet -

----------dhyāyed devīṃ caturbhujām |
japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhām || 1 ||

candrarekhājaṭājūṭāṃ trinetrāṃ raktavāsasam |
nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm || 2 ||

pretāsanasamāsīnāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām |
pāśāṃkuśavarābhītirdadhānāṃ ca śivāṃ śraye || 3 ||

iti dhyātvā hasraiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ hrasauḥ sakalahrīṃ iti japet || 
iyameva sakalapūrvāṃ vidheyā bhuvaneśvarībhairavībhedaḥ | sampatpradā 
sakārādyā cetkauleśabhairavī sampatpradāyā ādyante rephaṃ hitvā 
sakalasiddhidā bhairavī | etāsāṃ vidyānāmṛṣyādikaṃ prāgvat ||

atha bauddhadarśanādhidevatāmantrāḥ | tatrādau padmāvatīprayogaḥ - tatra 
prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi 
brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīpadmāvatyai 
devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
hrāṃhrīmityādinā ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet ||

padmāsanasthāṃ navakuṃkumābhāṃ raktotpale saṃdadhatīṃ trinetrām |
ābibhratīmābharaṇāni raktāṃ padmāvatīṃ padmamukhīṃ namāmi || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā hrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ padmāvatī hasakahalahrīṃ svāhā sakalahrīṃ iti 
mantraṃ japet || ugratārāpyekajaṭā tārā nīlasarasvatī ityuktatvāt | etāsāṃ 
mantrāstu : aiṃ hrīṃśrīṃklīṃsauḥ huṃ ugratāre huṃphaṭ ityugratārā | 
śrīṃhuṃ hrīṃhuṃphaṭ ityekajaṭā | oṃ hrīṃstrīṃhūṃphaṭ iti tārā | 
hrīṃstrīṃhūṃ iti nīlasarasvatī | etāsāṃ catasṛṇāṃ jape tu 
bījāntaritapañcadaśīkūṭatrayaṃ pratyekaṃpratyekaṃ saṃyojya japet || 
prayogāstu : prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ 
kṛtvā śirasi akṣobhyāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye 
amukatārāyai devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ 
iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ hrāṃ akhilavāgrūpiṇyai hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ 
akhaṇḍavāgrūpiṇyai śirase svāhā oṃ hrūṃ brahmavāgrūpiṇyai śikhāyai 
vaṣaṭ oṃ hraiṃ viṣṇuvāgrūpiṇyai kavacāya huṃ oṃ hrauṃ rudravāgrūpiṇyai 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ hraḥ sarvavāgrūpiṇyai astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān 
vinyasya dhyāyet -

viśvavyāpakavārimadhyavilasacchvetāmbujanmasthitāṃ
kartrīkhaḍgakapālanīlanalinai rājatkarāṃ nīlabhām |
kāñcīkuṇḍalahārakaṅkaṇalasatkeyūramañjīratā-
māptairnāgavarairvibhūṣitatanumāraktanetratrayām || 1 ||

piṅgograikajaṭāṃ lasatsurasanāṃ daṃṣṭrākarālānanāṃ
p. 215) vyāghratvakparidhānaśobhitakaṭiṃ śvetāsthipaṭṭālikām |
akṣobhyeṇa virājamānaśirasaṃ smerānanāmbhoruhāṃ
tārāṃ śāvahṛdāvasanāṃ dṛḍhakucāmambāṃ trilokyāḥ smaret || 1 ||

iti dhyāyet ||

atha mātaṅgīprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīmātaṅginyai devatāyai namaḥ mama 
sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ-oṃ namo 
bhagavati śrīmātaṅgīśvari sarvajanamanohāri hṛdayāya namaḥ 
sarvamukharājisarvamukharañjini śirase svāhā sarvarājavaśaṅkari 
sarvastrīpuruṣavaśaṅkari śikhāyai vaṣaṭ sarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṅkari 
sarvasattvavaśaṅkari kavacāya huṃ sarvalokamamukaṃ me vaśamānaya 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

evaṃ nyastaśarīro'sau cintayenmantradevatām |
amṛtodadhimadhyasthe ratnadvīpe manorame || 1 ||

svarṇaprākārasaṃvīte maṇḍape ratnanirmite |
kadambabilvakadvāri kalpavṛkṣopaśobhite || 2 ||

vedimadhye sukhāstīrṇe ratnasiṃhāsane prabho |
aṣṭapatraṃ mahāpadmaṃ kesarāntaḥsakarṇikam || 3 ||

tanmadhye ca trikoṇaṃ syādaṣṭapatre tato bahiḥ |
punaḥ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ syāttadbāhye syāccaturdalam || 4 ||

vedāsraṃ ca caturdvāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktamuttamam |
tasya madhye sukhāsīnāṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ śucismitām || 5 ||

kadambamālābharaṇāṃ pūjitāṃ ca surāsuraiḥ |
pralambālakasaṃyuktāṃ candrarekhāvataṃsitām || 6 ||

lalāṭe tilakopetāmīpatprahasitānanām |
kiñcitsvedāmbumadhuralalāṭaphalakojjvalām || 7 ||

valītaraṅgamadhyāntāromarājivirājitām |
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā muktāhāravibhūṣitām || 8 ||

nānāmaṇigaṇonnaddhakaṭisūtrairalaṃkṛtām |
valayai ratnakhacitaiḥ keyurairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥ || 9 ||

bhūṣitāṃ dvibhujāṃ bālāṃ madaghūrṇitalocanām |
āpīnamaṇḍalābhogasamunnatapayodharām || 10 ||

pralambakarṇābharaṇāṃ karṇottaṃsavirājitām |
tamālanīlāṃ taruṇīṃ madhumattāṃ mataṅginīm || 11 ||

catuṣṣaṣṭikalārūpapārśvasyaśukasārikām |
koṭibālārkasaṅkāśāṃ japākusumasannibhām || 22 ||

evaṃ vā pītavarṇāṃ ca dhyāyenmātaṅginīṃ parām |

evaṃ dhyātvā aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ-oṃ namo bhagavati śrīmātaṅgīśvari 
sarvajanamanohāri sarvamukharāji sarvamukharañjini hasakalahrīṃ 
sarvarājavaśaṅkari sarvastrīpuruṣavaśaṅkari hasakahalahrīṃ 
sarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṅkari sakalahrīṃ sarvalokamamukaṃ me vaśamānaya 
svāhā evaṃ japet ||

atha sumukhoprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi tumburave ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīsumukhyai devatāyai namaḥ | iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ ucchiṣṭa śirase svāhā cāṇḍāli śikhāyai vaṣaṭ mātaṅgi kavacāya 
huṃ sarvavaśaṅkari netratrayāya vauṣaṭ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ iti 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

smaret prathamapuṣpiṇīṃ rudhirabindunīlāmbarāṃ
gṛhītamadhupātrikāṃ madavighūrṇanetratrayām |
ghanastanabharālasāṃ galitacūrṇikāṃ bālikāṃ
karasphuritavallakīṃ vimalaśaṅkhatāṭaṅkinīm || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā aiṃ hrīṃśrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālimātaṅgi 
hasakahalahrīṃ sarvavaśaṅkari sakalahrīṃ namaḥ svāhā iti japet ||

p. 216) atha caṇḍamātaṅginīprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīcaṇḍamātaṅginyai devatāyai namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ : iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā māyayā 
ṣaḍdīrghayā ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya dhyāyet :

mātaṅgīṃ navayāvakārdracaraṇāmullāsikṛṣṇāṃśukāṃ
vīṇollāsikarāṃ samunnatakucāṃ muktāpravālāvalīm |
hṛdyāṅgīṃ sitaśaṅkhakuṇḍaladharāṃ bimbādharāṃ sasmitā-
mākīrṇālakaveṇimabjajanayanāṃ dhyāyecchukaśyāmalām || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā hrīṃ namaḥ hasakalahrīṃ hilihili hasakahalahrīṃ caṇḍamātaṅginī 
sakalahrīṃ svāhā iti japet ||

atha gāṇapatyadarśanādhidevatāmantrāḥ | 
ādāvekākṣaragaṇapatimantraprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
nicṛcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīvighneśvarāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ gaṇajayāya svāhā 
hṛdayāya namaḥ ekadaṃṣṭrāya huṃphaṭ śirase svāhā acalakarṇine namaḥ 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ gajavaktrāya namo namaḥ kavacāya huṃ mahodarāya 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ caṇḍāya huṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ | athavā gāṅgīmityādinā 
ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāya dhyāyet |

raktābhaḥ śaśimauliraṃkuśaguṇau dantaṃ varaṃ dhārayan
hastābjairdviradānanastrinayano raktāṅgarāgāvṛtaḥ |
bījāpūrabṛhatkarorujaṭharo dānārdragaṇḍasthalo
vighneśaḥ phaṇibhūṣaṇo gaṇapatirbhūyādbhavadbhūtaye || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā gaṃ hasakalahrīṃ gaṃ hasakahalahrīṃ gaṃ sakalahrīṃ iti japet ||

atha mahāgaṇapateḥ prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
nicṛdgāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīgaṇapataye devatāyai namaḥ guhye gaṃ 
bījāya namaḥ pādayoḥ hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ gāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ śrīṃ gīṃ śirase 
svāhā hrīṃ gūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ klīṃ gaiṃ kavacāya huṃ glauṃ gauṃ 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ gaṃ gaḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet 
:

cakrābjatriṃśikhān guṇaikṣavadhanū raktotpalaṃ sadgadāṃ
vrīhyagrānvitabījapūraradanaṃ kumbhaṃ karairbibhratam |
padmodyatkarayā nijapramadayāśliṣṭaṃ japāsannibhaṃ
sārdhendu prabhaje mahāgaṇapatiṃ netratrayodbhāsitam || 1 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃ klīṃglauṃgaṃ hasakalahrīṃ gaṇapataye 
varavarada hasakahalahrīṃ sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya sakalahrīṃ svāhā iti japet 
||

atha kṣipragaṇapatiprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe virāṭchandase 
namaḥ hṛdi kṣipraprasādanāya gaṇapataye devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā gāṃgīmityādinā 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya dhyāyet |

sindūrābhamibhānanaṃ trinayanaṃ hasteṣu pāśāṃkuśau
bibhrāṇaṃ madhumatkapālamaniśaṃ sārdhendumauliṃ bhaje |
p. 217) puṣṭyāśliṣṭatanuṃ dhvajāgrakarayā padmollasaddhastayā
tadyonyāhitapāṇimāttavasumatpātrollasatpuṣkaram || 1 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā gaṃ hasakalahrīṃ kṣipraprasādanāya hasakahalahrīṃ namaḥ 
sakalahrīṃ iti mantraṃ japet ||

atha vakratuṇḍaprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi bhārgava ṛṣaye namaḥ 
mukhe'nuṣṭupcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīvakratuṇḍāya devatāyai namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā va hṛdayāya namaḥ 
kra śirase svāhā tu śikhāyai vaṣaṭ ṇḍā kavacāya huṃ ya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ 
hūṃ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya dhyāyet :

ramyodbhinnāruṇataramaṇiyātasaṃśobhikāntiṃ
saṃbibhrāṇaṃ karakisalayaiḥ pāśamapyaṃkuśāṅgam |
sābhītīṣṭaṃ trinayanayutaṃ ratnamālyāṃśukāḍhya-
mambhojodyatpuṭagatamamuṃ saṃsmaredvakratuṇḍam || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā hasakalahrīṃ vakratuṇḍāya hasakahalahrīṃ hūṃ sakalahrīṃ iti 
mantraṃ japet ||

atha lakṣmīgaṇeśaprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi antaryāmi ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
nicṛdgāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīlakṣmīgaṇeśāya devatāyai namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā śrāṃ gāṃ 
ityādinā ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya dhyāyet :

hemābhaḥ pītavastraḥ karakamalatalaiḥ saṃdadhaccakraśa"khau
dantābhītī ca nāsādhṛtakanakaghaṭaḥ padmasaṃsthastrinetraḥ |
vāmāṅgāviṣṭalakṣmyā vidhṛtakamalayā prollasaddakṣadoṣṇā
śliṣṭaḥ sauvarṇakāntyā gaṇapa iha mahāśrīkaro vaḥ śriye'stu || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā śrīṃgaṃsaumyāya hasakalahrīṃ mahāgaṇapataye varavarada 
hasakahalahrīṃ sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya sakalahrīṃ svāhā iti japet ||

atha herambasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śrīherambāya devatāyai nama iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭāptaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā gāṃgīṃ ityādinā 
ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya dhyāyet :

muktāvidyutpayodāmṛtaghusṛṇanibhaiḥ pañcabhirnāgavaktrai-
rherambo bhāvanīyaḥ śaśidharamukuṭo dṛptasiṃhādhirūḍhaḥ |
hastairbibhrat triśulāṃkuśakajapavaṭīmudgarān puṃskapālaṃ
ṭaṅkāṅko modakaṃsyādradalasadabhaye dānamakaughadīptiḥ || 1 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hasakalahrīṃ gūṃ hasakahalahrīṃ namaṃ sakalahrīṃ iti japet 
||

atha virigaṇeśamantraprayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdi virivighneśvarāya devatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā viriviri hṛdayāya namaḥ 
gaṇapati śirase svāhā varavarada śikhāyai vaṣaṭ sarvalokaṃ me kavacāya huṃ 
vaśamānaya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān 
vinyasya dhyāyet sindūrābhamibhānana miti prāgvat | hrīṃ viriviri hasakalahrīṃ 
gaṇapativaravarada hasakahalahrīṃ sarvalokaṃ me vaśamānaya sakalahrīṃ 
svāhā iti japet ||

p. 218) atha śaktigaṇeśasya prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi gaṇakāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe 
nicṛdgāyatrīcchandase namaḥ hṛdaye śaktiśrīgaṇeśāya devatāyai namaḥ iti 
vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrīṃ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ gaṃ śirase svāhā hrīṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ mahāgaṇapataye kavacāya 
hūṃ svāhā netratrayāya vauṣaṭ hrīṃgaṃhrīṃ mahāgaṇapataye svāhā 
astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrān vinyasya prāgvaddhyātvā -

hrīṃgaṃhrīṃ hasakalahrīṃ mahāgaṇapataye hasakahalahrīṃ svāhā 
sakalahrīṃ iti japet ||

athordhvāmnāyakrameṇa śrīvidyāṣoḍaśārṇāyā upadeśe 
ṣoḍaśamūlavidyāsvaikaikasya dvedve vidye prayojye | tā vidyāstu -

oṃ aiṃ hrīṃśrīṃsahakhaphreṃ sahauḥ sahakṣamalavarayīṃ hauṃhrīṃhaṃsaḥ 
so'haṃ svāhā ityekādaśa bījāni sarvatra vidyādau yojyāni ||

11 svaprakāśa paripūrṇaparāparamahākula siddhavidyāmahākulayoginīhrīṃ | 
iti kulayoginīmūlavidyā || 1 ||

11 hasauḥ svātmānaṃ bodhaya bodhaya hasauḥ prāsādaparāyoginī hrīṃ iti 
prāsādaparāyoginīmūlavidyā || 2 ||

11 aiṃblūṃklinne kledini klinnadrave kledaya kledaya klīṃklīṃ mahāmada 
mohayamohaya klīṃ namaḥ svāhā iti rahasyayoginīmūlavidyā || 3 ||

11 svacchānanda paramahaṃsaparamātmane svāhā hasakṣyauṃ iti 
śāṃbhavīyoginīmūlavidyā || 4 ||

11 hrīṃ nityasphurattānandamayī mahābinduvyāpakamātṛsvarūpiṇī hrīṃ iti 
hṛllekhāyoginīmūlavidyā || 5 ||

11 svacchaprakāśātmike hrīṃ kulamahāmālinī hrīṃ iti 
samayavimalāyoginīmūlavidyā || 6 ||

11 haṃsaḥ nityaprakāśātmike kulakuṇḍalini ājñāsiddhimahābhairavī 
ātmānaṃ bodhaya bodhaya ambe bhagavati hrīṃ huṃ iti 
parabodhinīyoginīmūlavidyā || 7 ||

11 oṃ mokṣaṃ kuru iti pañcākṣarī yoginīmūlavidyā || 8 ||

11 hasaiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasauḥ lopāmudrācaitanyatripurāyoginīmūlavidyā || 9 ||

11 aiṃ śuddhasūkṣmanirākāranirvikalpa parabrahmasvarūpiṇī klīṃ 
parānandamayīśaktiḥ sauḥ ityanuttarakaulinīyoginīmūlavidyā || 10 ||

11 svacchānandaparamahaṃsaparamātmane svāhā hasrūṃ iti 
gurūttamavimarśinīyoginīmūlavidyā || 11 ||

11 anābhāsāvyomātītā parāparavyomātītā vyomeśvarī hrīṃ iti 
anābhāsāyoginīmūlavidyā || 12 ||

11 aiṃ iṃ īṃ ūṃ iti saṅketasāravidyāyoginīmūlavidyā || 13 ||

11 hrīṃ vicce bhagavati vāgvādini mahāhrade mahāmāyā mataṅgini 
aiṃblūṃraṃstrīṃ ityanuttaravāgvādinīyoginīmūlavidyā || 14 ||

11 hasraiṃhasrīṃhasrauḥ ityanuttaravidyāyoginīmūlavidyā || 15 ||

11 hīṃ sarvānandamaye mahācakre vaindave parabrahmasvarūpiṇī 
parāmṛtaśaktiḥ sarvamantreśvarī sarvatantreśvarī sarvayogīśvarī 
sarvajñāneśvarī sarvapīṭheśvarī jagadutpattimātṛkāhrīṃ iti 
turīyāyoginīmūlavidyā || 16 ||

tathottaratantre :

pañcamāmnāyadīkṣāyāṃ caturāmnāyadevatāḥ |
aṅgatvena samākhyātā dvedve vidye samabhyaset || 1 ||

surendrānalayoraindryo yāmye vai yāmyakoṇayoḥ |
vāruṇyau pāśimarutostatpare saumyadigbhave || 2 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ - pañcamāmnāya ūrdhvāmnāyastatra dīkṣāyāṃ 
caturāmnāyadevatāḥ pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimottarāmnāya devatā ityarthaḥ | 
dvedve vidye ekaikasyāmnāyasya samabhyaset yojayet | digvibhāgamāha surendreti | 
prākkuṇḍāgneyakuṇḍayorendryāṃ pūrvāmnyāyavidye 
yāmyakoṇayoryāmyanair-ṛtayoryāmye dakṣiṇāmnāyavidye pāśimarutoḥ 
paścimavāyavyayorvāruṇyau paścimāmnāyavidye tatpare uttareśānakuṇḍayoḥ 
saumyadigbhave uttaradiṅmukhasaṃbhūte uttarāmnāyavidye ityarthaḥ || 
śrīkulārṇave :

prākkuṇḍe bhairavī proktā hyāgneye bhuvaneśvarī |
pītāmbarā bhoginī vā yāmyakuṇḍe praśasyate || 1 ||

vārāhī nair-ṛte kuṇḍe paścime cāparājitā |
bhavānī vāyukoṇe tu śyāmā tārā tu tatpare || 2 ||

iti | tathaiva -

pañcakuṇḍātmake pakṣe catuḥsamayadevatāḥ |
caturāmnāyavidyā vā prayojyāḥ parameśvari || 1 ||

iti || atha śrīguruvidyādīkṣāyāṃ tvaṅgatvena caraṇādividyāḥ prayojyāḥ 
parāprāsādadīkṣāyāṃ tu pañcabrahmamantrāḥ pañcānāṃ trayāṇāṃ 
vibhāgamāha aṣṭātriṃśatkalāstridheti | 
pañcabrahmamantrāṇāmaṣṭātriṃśatkalāḥ ṣoḍaśa dvādaśa daśa krameṇa 
prayojyā ityarthaḥ | 

p. 219) prasaṅgato'nyāsāṃ vidyānāṃ dīkṣāyāṃ kramamāha dakṣiṇeti 
ādyahīneti spaṣṭo'rthaḥ | bhuvaneśvaryāstu guṇārṇakaṃ 
pāśāṃkuśabhuvaneśvarī | śrīḥ śriyābhiṣiktabhuvaneśvarī vāk 
vāgbhavaruddhābhuvaneśvī kāmarājaruddhā parābījaruddhā | trividhā 
tripuṭeti śrībījādikā kāmabījādikā māyābījādiketyarthaḥ | pañcadaśyā iti 
- atra jāgratsvapnasuṣupti turīyaturīyātīteti pañcavidhāḥ | jāgradvidyāyāḥ 
(jāgradvidyā svapnavidyāyāḥ) svapnavidyā suṣuptividyāyāḥ suṣuptividyā 
turīyavidyāyāḥ turīyavidyā turīyātītāyāsturīyātītavidyā eva prayojyā 
ītyarthaḥ | śrīkulārṇave :

parāprāsādamantraśca lakṣmīnārāyaṇastathā |
cidambaramahāmantraḥ pakṣirūpaśca śārabhaḥ || 1 ||

ṣaḍeva śāmbhavāścaiva mahāmṛtyuñjayastathā |
lakṣmījanārdano lakṣmīvāsudevastathaiva ca || 2 ||

rājarājeśvaraścaiva pañcavaktraśca mārutiḥ |
mārtaṇḍabhairavaścaiva mahāgaṇapatistathā || 3 ||

ucchiṣṭagaṇanāthaśca vakratuṇḍastathaiva ca |
gāṇapatyāḥ śriyā yuktāḥ sītārāmastathaiva ca || 4 ||

nṛsiṃhānuṣṭubhaṃ caiva pañcabāṇāstathaiva ca |
pañcakāmāśca deveśi jainā bauddhāstathaiva ca || 5 ||

śambhorūrdhvamukhādeva nirgatā vīravandite |
śivapañcākṣarībhedāḥ prāsādākhyāḥ śivāstathā || 6 ||

viṣṇoraṣṭākṣarībhedā vāsudevāhvayāstathā |
gāṇapatye tathaikārṇabhedā ghṛṇimanustathā || 7 ||

pūrvāmnāyāstu kathitā varāhastumburustathā |
haridrāgaṇapaścaiva vaṭukāḥ kṣetrapālakāḥ || 8 ||

śāstṛmantrā nṛsiṃhākhyāstathā hariharātmakāḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇamantrabhedāśca dadhivāmanasaṃjñakāḥ || 9 ||

dakṣiṇāmnāyavikhyātāstathocchiṣṭāṇubhedakāḥ |
puruṣottamasaṃjñāśca mālāmantrāstathaiva ca || 10 ||

aghorarudrabhedāśca ye'pi bauddhaprabhedakāḥ |
paścimāmnāyavikhyātā dakṣiṇāmūrtireva ca || 11 ||

grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ mantrāścaṇḍeśvarasya tu |
vetālāśceṭakāścaiva ye vai hariharātmakāḥ || 12 ||

vīrabhadrāśca subrahmaṇyādayo mātṛputrakāḥ |
uttarāmnāyavikhyātāḥ śīghrakālaphalapradāḥ || 3 ||

atheṣṭadevatāprītyai yajedāyatanānyapi |

āyatanāni caturāyatanāni | tāni tu madhyasthasveṣṭadevatāyā aṅgabhūtāni | 
tatsthāpanakramamāha tatraiva -

tatrātha pañcāyatanasya vakṣye saṃsthāpanaṃ bhaktivibhedabhinnam |
bhāsvadgaṇaśrīpatipārvatīśā vighneśvarārkādrisutā hariśca || 1 ||

kṛṣṇaikadantenanagendrajeśā māyeśvarebhānanabhāskarājāḥ |
īśenavighnādhipaśaktikṛṣṇā madhyāgnikoṇakramatastu pūjyāḥ || 2 ||

iti ratnasāgare -

ravirvināyako devī viṣṇuḥ śaṅkarapūjaye |
gaṇeśārkāmbikeśānāstathā nārāyaṇārcane || 1 ||

śivo vighno hariḥ kātyāyanī sūryārcane kramāt |
devyarcane śivo vighnaḥ sūryo viṣṇustathaiva ca || 2 ||

śivo ravirbhavānī ca viṣṇurvighneśvarārcane |
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu sthāpyā aṅgāṅgibhāvataḥ || 3 ||

pūjyāścaiva maheśāni vyastāḥ syurduḥkhadāḥ sadā |

iti | atra sarvatra devapūjāyāṃ tattatpūjārūpaṃ cakramuddhṛtya 
tattatkalpoktavidhinā tattatpīṭhapūjāpūrvakaṃ pañcāyatanadevatāḥ pūjayet | 
anyathā pūjāyā naiṣphalayaṃ syāt | taduktaṃ kulārṇave :

devasya yantrarūpasya yantravyāptimajānatā |
kṛtārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati śāmbhavi || 1 ||

yantraṃ mantramayaṃ proktaṃ devatā mantrarūpiṇī |
yantre sampūjitā devī sahasaiva prasīdati || 2 ||

kāmakrodhādidoṣotthasarvaduḥkhaniyantraṇāt |
yantramityāhuretasmin devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥ || 3 ||

p. 220) śarīramiva jīvasya dīpasya snehavatpriye |
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tathā yantraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 4 ||

tasmādyantraṃ likhitvā vā dhyātvā vā bhajate śive |
jñātvā gurumukhāt sarvaṃ pūjayedvidhinā śive || 5 ||

ekapīṭhe pṛthakpūjāṃ vinā yantraṃ karoti yaḥ |
aṅgāṅgitvamapi tyaktvā devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 6 ||

ekapīṭhe sureśāni svesve yantre pṛthakpṛthak |
yajedāvaraṇopetān devāṁstattadvidhānataḥ || 7 ||

āvāhya devatāmanyāmarcayeccānyadevatāḥ |
ubhābhyāṃ labhate śāpaṃ mantrī cañcalamānasaḥ || 8 ||

iti || kulaprakāśatantre -

khaṇḍite sphuṭite dagdhe bhraṣṭe mānavivarjite |
vyaṅge'narhapaśuspṛṣṭe patite duṣṭabhūmiṣu || 1 ||

anyamantrārcite caiva patitasparśadūṣite |
daśasvapi ca no kuryuḥ sannidhānaṃ divaukasaḥ || 2 ||

iti : atra pañcāyatanapūjāyāmapi sampradāyāt pūjyapūjakayormadhye 
pūrvadiśaṃ prakalpya tadanusāreṇāgneyyādikaṃ parikalpya 
caturāyatanadevatāḥ pūjayet | dharmādipūjāyāmuktayuktestulyanyāyāt | atra 
kecit pradhānadevatāvāhanāntarameva tadāvaraṇapūjārthaṃ devatāgre 
prācīnakalpanā tatpūrvameva caturāyatanadevatānāṃ pūjāyāḥ 
kāryatvātkalpanamayuktamiti yathā sthitāgneyādidikṣu caturāyatanadevatāḥ 
pūjanīyāḥ ityāhustanna | kāmyapūjāsu :

pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā vaśyakarmaṇi pūjayet |
dakṣiṇāśāmukho bhūtvā māraṇe pūjayetpriye || 1 ||

paścimābhimukho bhūtvā pūjayeddhanasiddhaye |
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā śāntikarmaṇi pūjayet || 2 ||

iti brahmayāmalavacanāt | agnirākṣasavāyavyaśambhukoṇamukho'rcayet | iti 
kulamūlāvatāravacanādanyatrāpyevamanekatantreṣu darśanācca 
yathāsthitadikkrameṇa pūjāyāmīśānakoṇasthitāyāḥ 
kadācitpradhānadevatāyā vāmabhāge kadāciddakṣiṇe kadācidagre 
kadācitpṛṣṭhe ceti sthityanaiyatyaprasaṅgāt yathāsthitāgneyādiṣu 
sthāpanāsambhavāt pradhānadevatāyāḥ pīṭhapūjānantarameva 
caturāyatanadevatāpūjanāt pīṭhapūjāyāmapi dharmādipūjane 
kalpitaprācyanusāreṇaivāgneyādikalpanāt caturāyatanadevatānāmaṅgatvāt 
pradhānadevatāmūrteḥ kalpitatvācca tadagre prācīnakalpanasyaivocitatvāditi || 
anyetu tāntrikadīkṣāvadbhiḥ :

śambhau madhyagate harīnaharabhūdevyo harau śaṅkare-
bhāsyenāgasutā ravau haragaṇeśājāmbikāḥ sthāpitāḥ |
devyāṃ viṣṇuharaikadantaravayo lambodare'jeśvare-
nāryāḥ śaṅkaramārgato hi sukhadā vyastāstu te duḥkhadāḥ || 1 ||

iti nārāyaṇīyoktarītyā kalpitaprācyanusāreṇa 
madhyeśānādikoṇeṣviṣṭadevatādikāḥ pañca devatāḥ sthāpyāḥ | 
tāntrikadīkṣāhīnaistu bhaviṣyapurāṇavacanena 
pañcāyatanadevatāyajanasyāvaśyakatvaṃ matvā 
vaidikasmārtapaurāṇikānyatamavidhinā pañcāyatanayajanaṃ 
kurvadbhiryathāsthiteśānādikoṇeṣu madhye ca pañcāyatanadevatāḥ sthāpyā 
ityāhuḥ tadatyantamasaṅgataṃ teṣāṃ pañcānāṃ madhye 
ekasyāpīṣṭadevatātvābhāvanayāṅgitvābhāvāt kasyāpi madhye 
sthāpanāsambhavāt ravirvināyako viṣṇuścaṇḍikeśaśca pañcamaḥ | 
anukrameṇa pūjyāste vyutkrameṇa bhayāvahāḥ | iti purāṇasārasamuccaye 
teṣāṃ pañcāyatanadevatānāṃ yajanakramasyoktatvācceti | atra 
pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ gaṇeśavyatiriktacaturdevatopāsakaiḥ proktakrameṇa 
devatāḥ saṃsthāpya gaṇeśamārabhya 
prādakṣiṇyakramaprāptadevatācatuṣṭayaṃ sampūjya madhye sveṣṭadevatāṃ 
pūjayet | gaṇeśopāsakaistu sūryamārabhya prādakṣiṇya 
kramaprāptadevatācatuṣṭayaṃ sampūjya gaṇeśaṃ 
pūjayedityāgamasiddhāntaḥ || atra kecit pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ 
devyārādhakaḥ sūryagaṇeśaśivaviṣṇūnabhyarcyānte devīṃ pūjayediti 
smṛtyuktam - iti vadanti tadasaṅgatam aprādakṣiṇyāpatteḥ [a]kramasyāpya 
lābhatayāstavyastakramāpatteśca | vastutastu gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadurgā 
āvāhya pūjayet | iti yoginītantre devīpūjāyāṃ 
pañcāyatanapūjākramadarśanāt | ādau gaṇapatiṃ devaṃ sūryaṃ 
viṣṇumumāpatim | durgāṃ ca pūjayedvidvān iti bhairavītantre'pi 
pañcāyatanapūjākramadarśanāccāyameva tāntrikasiddhāntaḥ 
satsampradāyasiddhaśca | anyadevatopāsakairapi tathaiva gaṇeśādikrama eva 
kāryaḥ |

p. 221) ekatradṛṣṭanyāyādiyaṃ pañcāyatanapūjā tvāvaśyaṅkāryā śivaṃ 
bhāskaramagniṃ ca keśavaṃ kauśikīmapi | manasā nārcayanyāti 
svargalokādadhogatim | iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe tadakaraṇe pratyavāyaśravaṇāt | 
manasāpyanarcayannityarthaḥ | agnirgaṇeśaḥ | yo brahmā sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ 
sa maheśvaraḥ | maheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sūryaḥ pāvaka ucyate | pāvakā 
kārtikeyo'sau kārtikeyo vināyakaḥ | iti bhaviṣyottara purāṇavacanāt ||

atha madhyasthāpitamūrtau sveṣṭadevatāmāvāhya pūjayet | tatra mūrtistu 
tattaddhyānoktarūpā tatra tu śivaliṅgaśālagrāmādāvapi bhāvanīyā 
śivaliṅgānāṃ sarvadaivatapūjādhikaraṇatvāt teṣu sarvāśca devatāḥ 
pūjyāḥ teṣāṃ liṅgamaṇau kumbhe maṇḍale ca prapūjanam | śālagrāme ca 
tadbudhyā yantrādau ca prapūjayet || bhūmāveva kṛtā pūjā 
putrāyurdhananāśinī iti rudrayāmalavacanāt | śālagrāmaśilāyāṃ tu 
tattadbuddhyā samarcayet | iti somaśambhuvacanāt | liṅgasthaṇḍilayorvahnau 
sūryakuṇḍyapaṭeṣu ca | maṇḍale phalake mūrdhni hṛdaye daśa kīrtitāḥ || eṣu 
sthāneṣu deveśi yajanti paramaṃ śivam | iti kulārṇavavacanācca 
śivamityupalakṣaṇam | teṣāmityukteḥ teṣāṃ pañcāyatanadevatānāṃ 
yantrādāvityādipadaṃ pratimādiparam || śālagrāme maṇau yantre sthaṇḍile 
pratimāsu ca | hareḥ pūjā tu kartavyā kevale natu bhūtale || iti 
trailokyasammohanatantravacanāttattaddhyānoktarūpā pratimā kāryā | sātu 
mātrāṃgulapramāṇena daśapañcadaśāṃgulā | gṛhe tu pratimā pūjyā 
nādhikā tu praśasyate || iti kapilapañcarātroktarūpā pratimā kāryā 
daśāṃgulamitā pañcadaśāṃgulamitā vetyarthaḥ | daśāṃgulapramāṇā 
sātithyaṃgulamitāthavā | abhyarcyā pratimā viṣṇorgṛheṣu gṛhamedhibhiḥ || iti 
hayagrīvapañcarātravacanāt | atrāpi vetyanena daśāṃgulamārabhya 
pañcadaśāṃgulaparyantoccā pratimā kāryetyuktamiti sāmpradāyikāḥ | 
pūrvaślokasyāpyayamevārthaḥ iti vadanti | mātrāṃgulapramāṇaṃ tu 
maṇḍapanirmāṇaprakaraṇe boddhavyaṃ | śivaliṅganirmāṇaprakārastu 
śilpiśāstre -

liṅgamastakamadhyāttu sūtraṃ syādāpraṇālakam |
liṅgapraṇālipuṣṭatvaṃ tāvadeva prakīrtitam || 1 ||

uccatve ca tathā pīṭhe pañcasūtraṃ pracakṣate |
pañcasūtrasamāyuktaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ prapūjayet || 2 ||

bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ caiva dhanārogyasukhapradam |

iti | tannirmāṇaprakārastu kālottare -

aṃgulādivitastyantaṃ liṅgaṃ gehe prapūjyate |
prāsāde tu tadūrdhvaṃ syāt pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 1 ||

liṅgamastakavistāraṃ pūjyabhāgasamaṃ nayet |
nāhaṃ tat triguṇaṃ kuryānnāhavat pīṭhavistṛtiḥ || 2 ||

pūjyāṃśadviguṇaṃ kuryāt tacca pīṭhaṃ samunnatam |
vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā madhye kaṇṭhasamanvitam || 3 ||

dviguṇaṃ liṅganāhacca kaṇṭhanāhaṃ samācaret |
trimekhalamadhaścordhvaṃ samaṃ vāpi dvimekhalam || 4 ||

liṅgamastakavistāraṃ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ vibhajettataḥ |
mekhalāmekabhāgena kuryāt khātaṃ ca tatsamam || 5 ||

liṅgadairghyasamaṃ kuryāt praṇālaṃ tasya bāhyataḥ |
vistāraṃ tatsamaṃ mūle tadagraṃ ca tadardhataḥ || 6 ||

jalamārgaḥ prakartavyastasya madhye vibhāgataḥ |
kuryāt pīṭhārdhaṃ dīrghaṃ vā praṇālaṃ śrīśivoditam || 7 ||

sarveṣāṃ ratnaliṅgānāṃ sapīṭhānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
lohādīnāṃ ca liṅgānāmidaṃ lakṣaṇamācaret || 8 ||

iti || asyārthaḥ - svābhimataliṅgaṃ kṛtvā tasya mastakasya vistāraṃ pūjyasya 
liṅgasya yo bhāga uccatā tatsamaṃ nayet kuryādirtyarthaḥ | liṅgamastakavistāro 
loṅgocchrāyasamo bhavet iti śaivāgamavacanāt | tato liṅgamastakavistāro 
yāvattriguṇasūtraveṣṭanayogyaṃ liṅgasya nāhaṃ sthaulyaṃ kṛtvā liṅgasya yo 
nāhastatsūtramānavistāraṃ pūjyasya liṅgasya yoṃśa uccastato 
dviguṇaunnatyayuktaṃ vṛttākāraṃ caturasraṃ vā pīṭhasya madhye liṅgasya 
nāhasūtrasya sthaulyamātrasya dviguṇasūtraveṣṭanayogyaṃ sthūlaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ 
kṛtvā kaṇṭhasyordhvamadhaśca samāṃśena mekhalātrayaṃ mekhalādvayaṃ 
vā vidhāya liṅgamastakavistāraṃ ṣoḍhā vibhajya teṣvekāṃśamānena 
pīṭhoparibhāge sarvavāhyāṃśena mekhalāṃ kṛtvā tadantastanmānena 
tatsaṃlagnāṃśena khātaṃ viracya pīṭhādvahirliṅgasamāna dairghyaṃ 
pīṭhamānasyārdhamānadīrghaṃ vā mūladeśe 
dīrghāṃśamānavistāramagradeśe tadardhamānavistāraṃ tanmadhye 
mūlādagrāvadhi praṇālavistārasya 
tṛtīyāṃśamānavistārakhātarūpajalamārgayuktaṃ pīṭhavatsamekhalaṃ 
praṇālaṃ ca kuryāditi sphaṭikādiratnaviśeṣaiḥ pāṣāṇādibhirvā 
śivaliṅganirmāṇe sādhāraṇo'yaṃ vidhiḥ || iti śivaliṅganirmāṇaprakāraḥ ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
ekādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 11 ||




atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| dvādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha śrīcakranirmāṇaprakāraḥ | śrīrudrayāmale -

tataḥ kuṃkumasindūraiḥ kāryaṃ yantraṃ tu yoginā |
sauvarṇe rājate tāmre sphāṭike vaidrume tathā || 1 ||

cakre yathoktavidhinā pūjyā devī narottamaiḥ |

iti | tantrarāje -

ratne hemani rūpye vā tāmre dṛṣadi ca kramāt |
kṛtvā cakrasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpayet pūjayedapi || 1 ||

lakṣmīkāntiyaśaḥputradhanārogyādisiddhaye |

dṛṣadi gaṇḍakīśilāyām | gaṇḍakībhavapāṣāṇe svarṇe rajatatāmrayo riti 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāvacanāt ||

atha dhātuviśeṣe pūjyakālasaṃkhyāviśeṣamāha ratnasāgare -

yāvañjīvaṃ suvarṇe syādrūpye dvāviṃśatiḥ priye |
tāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣaṃ tadardhaṃ bhūrjapatrake || 1 ||

iti tantrāntare -

tāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣa sphāṭikādau tu sarvadā |
teṣāṃ madhye sphāṭike tu sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

iti | lakṣasāgare -

bhūmau sindūrarajasā racitaṃ sarvakāmadam |
suvarṇaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkaram || 1 ||

rajatena kṛtaṃ yantramāyurārogyakāntidam |
tāmraistu racitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matam || 2 ||

yantraṃ hi sphāṭike devi mano'bhilaṣitapradam |
māṇikyali(khya ? khi)taṃ yantraṃ rājyadaṃ bhuktidaṃ matam || 3 ||

gomedaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam |
kḷptaṃ marakate yantraṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam || 4 ||

lohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ matam |

iti || devyuvāca -

lohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ maheśvara |
tanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 1 ||

īśvara uvāca -

bhāgā daśa suvarṇasya rajatasya ca ṣoḍaśa |
tāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭha kuryānmanoharam || 1 ||

tasmin pīṭhe tu nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet |
śāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇam || 2 ||

āyurārogyajanakaṃ kāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ matam |

iti || atha cakrasya prastārabhedena traividhyaṃ ca tatraiva -

traividhyaṃ tasya cakrasya bhūprastāro'rdhamerukam |
pātālavāsināṃ devi prastāro nimnarekhakaḥ || 1 ||

ūrdhvarekho maheśāni martyalokanivāsinām |
svargalokādivāsānāṃ yantrāṇmerusaṃjñakaḥ || 2 ||

bhūpuraṃ tu samārabhya baindavāntaṃ maheśvari |
kramātsamunnataṃ sarvaṃ merurūpaṃ mayoditam || 3 ||

samordhvarekhā navakamūrdhvarekhaṃ prakīrtitam |
nimnarekhāsamāyogādbhūprastāro mayoditaḥ  || 4 ||

p. 224) yantrarājasvarūpaṃ te mayā snehāt prakāśitam |
gopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre svaguhyamiva santatam || 5 ||

iti || athaitatprastāratrayasya phalāni prastārāntaraṃ ca śrītantrarāje -

caturasraṃ samārabhya navacakrāṇyanukramāt |
unnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanam || 1 ||

tridvikramādunnataṃ tadaprajatvaṃ śriyaṃ labhet |
ekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaṃ śriyai kīrtye ca kalpate || 2 ||

navāni samarūpāṇi sarvābhīṣṭārthasiddhaye |

iti || tathā kulamūlāvatāre -

ucchritaṃ kramaśo devi vittaprāptistato mṛtiḥ |
bhūcakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

śeṣamunnatamīśāni cārthāptyaprajadaṃ bhavet |
caturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukam || 2 ||

mithaḥ samunnataṃ devi śriyai kīrtye ca kalpate |
caturasraṃ samārabhya bindvantaṃ samarekhakam || 3 ||

tathā śrīḥ kīrtirārogyamamṛtāyopakalpate |

iti || atha śrīcakrādhikaraṇe niṣiddhadhātūnanyāni niṣiddhādhikaraṇāni cāha 
tantrarāje -

sīsakāṃsyādiṣu punaḥ pūrvoktaviparītakṛt |
phalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācana || 1 ||

sthāpitaṃ yadi mohena lobhenājñānato'pi vā |
kulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathā || 2 ||

iti | kulamūlāvatāre -

agniraṃgulavistāraṃ prākpratyagdakṣiṇottaram |
palapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarcāpīṭhaṃ manoharam || 1 ||

yavārdhoccaṃ prakurvīta caturasraṃ samantataḥ |
tasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet || 2 ||

iti | sautrāmaṇītantre -

ṛjurekhā bhavellakṣmīrvakrarekhā daridratā |
agniraṃgulavistāro yavārdhenocchritirbhavet || 1 ||

iti | lakṣasāgare agniraṃgulihemasya (?) ityādi prāguktaśrīcakranirmāṇaprastāve 
sṛṣṭyādiprapañco na prapañcito'dhunā viśeṣamāha uttaratantre :

sṛṣṭikrameṇa pūjā hi sṛṣṭicakre'bhidhīyate |
sthitikrameṇa pūjā syāt sthiticakre maheśvari || 1 ||

saṃhārakramayogena pūjā saṃhāracakrake |

iti | atra śrīcakraṃ trividhaṃ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārabhedāt | taduktaṃ 
mātṛkāsarvasve -

śrīcakraṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ sṛṣṭisthitilayātmakam |
pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ tatsāṅkaryāt prayatnataḥ || 1 ||

mūlabhedā navaiva syustattadbhedā hyanekadhā |

atra sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyātmakaṃ sthitisthityātmakaṃ layalayātmakaṃ ceti trividham | 
sṛṣṭisthityātmakaṃ sthitisṛṣṭyātmakaṃ sṛṣṭilayātmakaṃ layasṛṣṭyātmakaṃ 
sthitilayātmakaṃ layasthityātmakam ete nava bhedāḥ | evaṃ sarve dvādaśa 
bhedāḥ atra vivekastu tatraiva :

sṛṣṭicakraṃ samākhyātaṃ navacakrāṇyanukramāt |
unnatonnatamāmadhyaṃ vijñeyaṃ deśikottamaiḥ || 1 ||

śrīcakraṃ sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyākhyaṃ pratirekhaṃ tathonnatam |
samordhvarekhānavakaṃ same pīṭhe ca yadbhavet || 2 ||

sthiticakraṃ tadevoktaṃ sthūlarekhaṃ maheśvari |
sūkṣmarekhaṃ bhavettatra sthitisthityātmakaṃ śive || 3 ||

layātmakaṃ nimnarekhaṃ sthūlaṃ layalayātmakam |

sūkṣmaṃ pātālarekhaṃ layātmakaṃ sthūlaṃ pātālarekhaṃ 
layalayātmakamityarthaḥ | sṛṣṭisthityātmakaṃ ceti sṛṣtisthityātmakaṃ 
tvityarthaḥ |

ardhamervātmakaṃ yantraṃ dvidhā khyātaṃ maheśvari |
ardhaṃ kramādunnataṃ yaccaturasrāditastataḥ || 1 ||

tadūrdhvaṃ samarekhaṃ syātsṛṣtisthityātmakaṃ śive |
vaiparītyena caitasya sthitisṛṣṭyātmatā bhavet || 2 ||

p. 225) caturasraṃ samārabhya cakratrayamapīśvari |
kramonnataṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu samaṃ syānnimnarekhakam || 3 ||

sṛṣṭisaṃhārarūpaṃ syādvaiparītyena tasya tu |
layasṛṣṭyātmakatvaṃ tu proktaṃ jñeyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 4 ||

ardhaṃ pātālarekhaṃ tu tadūrdhvaṃ cordhvarekhakam |
layasthityātmakaṃ proktaṃ vaiparītyena tasya tu || 5 ||

sthitisaṃhārarūpaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ deśikottamaiḥ |
sthitisthityātmakaṃ cakraṃ praśastaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 6 ||

āyuḥkīrtidhanārogyaputrapautravivardhanam |
sṛṣṭisthityātmakaṃ cakramaprajatvaṃ śriyaṃ labhet || 7 ||

pañcāśadvarṣataścorddhvaṃ putrapautrapradaṃ bhavet |
sthitisṛṣṭyātmakaṃ yantraṃ putrāyurdhanavṛddhidam || 8 ||

pañcāśadvarṣataścordhvamapatyadhvaṃsakṛdbhavet |
anye proktāstu ye bhedāḥ śrīcakrasya maheśvari || 9 ||

yativaikhānasānāṃ tu viśeṣo varṇināmiti |

uttaratantre -

kūrmapṛṣṭhe tu yadyantraṃ na pūjyaṃ śreya icchatā |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena parīkṣyaiva samācaret || 1 ||

sṛṣṭicakre maheśāni pūjā sṛṣṭyantatā bhavet |
sthiticakre tu sthityantā saṃhāre tu layāntatā || 2 ||

gurupāramparyato vā pitṛbhrātṛkramācca vā |
prāptaṃ śrīguruṇā dattaṃ gurujyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhakaiḥ || 3 ||

dattaṃ bhāgyavaśād devi labhyate yadi sādhakaḥ |
pūjāṃ tatra prakurvīta sthityantāṃ parameśvari || 4 ||

duṣṭayantramapi proktaṃ phaladaṃ nānyathā śive |

iti | pitṛpitāmahakramato gurupāramparyakramataśca kālavaśādbhāgyavaśād 
duṣṭayantraṃ prāpyate cettasmin yantre pūjā tu prathamataḥ saṃhārakrameṇa 
tataḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tataḥ sthitikrameṇa vidheyā śubhaphaladaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

atha dīkṣāpūrṇābhiṣekāṅgakuṇḍamaṇḍapavidhiḥ | 
dīkṣāṅgabhūtamaṇḍaparacanārthaṃ prācīparijñānasyāvaśyakatvāt 
tatparijñānaprakāraḥ pradarśyate | tatra divyasārasvatatantre :

nirmale divase vṛkṣaprāsādādivivarjite |
sthāne samatale ślakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā haṃsapadaṃ sudhīḥ || 1 ||

tadavaṣṭambhataḥ kuryāddvādaśāṃgulamānataḥ |
vṛttaṃ tu parito bhrāntvā tanmadhye sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 2 ||

sūcyagraṃ saralaṃ śaṃkuṃ vartulaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam |
ṣaḍaṃgulaparīṇāhamūlaṃ śilpivareṇa tu || 3 ||

racitaṃ yatnatastasmin vṛtte pūrvāparāhṇayoḥ |
śaṃkvagracchāyāsaṃpātasthānayościhnayugmakam || 4 ||

kṛtvā cihnadvayaprāpi sūtraṃ prākpratyagāyatam |
datvā vṛttāyatādhana sūtreṇecchādhikena vā || 5 ||

pūrvapaścimayorvṛttadvayaṃ śliṣṭaṃ parasparam |
vidhāya ca tayoḥ sandhidvayaprāpi prasārayet || 6 ||

madhyacihnaspṛṣṭamadhyaṃ tatsūtraṃ dakṣiṇottaram |
etasyārddhāṃśamānena kṛtvā koṇeṣu lāñchanam || 7 ||

teṣu sūtrāṣṭakanyāsāccaturasraṃ samaṃ bhavet |

iti | athaitadracanāprakāraḥ - atra medhādyanāvṛtasūrye nirmalanabhomaṇḍale 
divase vṛkṣaprāsādādyanāvṛte bhūpradeśe same sthāne kvacidbinduṃ kṛtvā 
tadavaṣṭambhataḥ pratidiśaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamānena vṛttaṃ niṣpādya tatra 
ṣaḍaṃgulamānapariṇāhamūlam uttarottarapariṇāhāpacayena 
sūcīmātrakṛtāgrapariṇāhamṛjvākṛtiṃ dvādaśāṃgulocchrāyopetaṃ 
vṛttākāraṃ śilpivareṇa nirmitaṃ śaṃku 
vṛttamadhyasthabindumadhyaśaṃkumūlapariṇāhamadhyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā 
saṃsthāpya tacchaṃkucchāyāgrasya pūrvāhṇe tadvṛttarekhāpaścimabhāge 
yatra sampātastatra cihnaṃ kṛtvā aparāhṇe'pi śaṃkucchāyāgrasya 
tadvṛttarekhāpūrvabhāge yatra sampāto bhavati tatra ca cihnaṃ vidhāya 
taccihnadvayaprāpi sūtraṃ vidhāya pūrvapaścimaṃ parikalpya 
taccihnadvayāvaṣṭambhena taccihnāntarālasthamānasya 
sveṣṭādhikārdhamānenānyonyaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ pūrvāparaṃ vṛttadvayaṃ 
vidhāya vṛttarekhādakṣiṇottarasandhidvayaprāpi prākpaścimasūtramadhyagatyā 
tiryagrūpeṇa yatsūtraṃ tat dakṣiṇottaraṃ parikalpya 
pūrvapaścimadakṣiṇottarasūtradvayāgracatuṣkasampātādvakṣyamāṇamānena 
tulyarūpakalpitasūtrāgrasteṣāṃ maṇḍapakuṇḍādīnāṃ 
prākpratyagdakṣiṇottarātmakadikcatuṣṭayaṃ parikalpayediti sthūladṛṣṭyā 
prācīsādhanavidhiḥ pradarśitaḥ || sūkṣmaprakārastu tantrāntare - susame 
bhūtale kṛtve tyārabhyoktaprakāreṇa pūrvadinakṛtyamuktvā

p. 226) dināntare'pi deveśi prāgvaccihnadvayaṃ sudhīḥ |
kṛtvā vṛtte tu yatra syācchāyāyāḥ parameśvari || 1 ||

praveśo nirgamaścaiva tatra pūrvadine yadā |
praviṣṭanirgatācchāyā yadā tanmadhyanāḍikāḥ || 2 ||

cchāyādinā tu vijñāya cchāyāpagamacihnayoḥ |
antaraṃ dinayoriṣṭaiścaturādyairvibhāgataḥ || 3 ||

vibhajya tatra cihnāni kṛtvā tābhiḥ sureśvari |
nāḍībhiḥ kalpitā bhāgā guṇanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 4 ||

ṣaṣṭyā hṛtaṃ tu labdhāṃśaiḥ pūrvedyuryatkṛtaṃ bhavet |
prācīsūtraṃ pūrvabhāge uttare tūttarāyaṇe || 5 ||

ayane dakṣiṇe caiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dhruvam |
cālyate cet sphuṭā sā syātprācī tu parameśvari || 6 ||

iti prācīsādhanaṃ vidhāya

vyāsadviguṇarajjvāntau pāśau kṛtvāṅkayedimām |
vyāsārdhamāne śaṃkvardhaṃ sārdhe'sminkarṣaṇāya ca || 1 ||

prācyantaśaṅkostatpāśau kṛtvā cākarṣakarṣaṇe |
śaṃkvaṅke'rvākśroṇirevamudagvyatyasya cāṃsakau || 2 ||

iti śilpiśāstroktarītyā 
maṇḍapakṣetramuddiṣṭamānādadhikavistārāyāmasamacaturasraṃ kalpayet || 
asyārthaḥ kuṇḍa maṇḍapādervyāso 
yāvāniṣṭastāvaddviguṇarajjumubhayataḥpāśaṃ kṛtvā tāmekataḥpāśād 
vyāsārdhamātre śaṃkvardhaṃ cihnayet : tataḥ śaṃkvaṅkādagrato
