vyāsārdhamānena cihnāpakarṣaṇataḥ kuṇḍamaṇḍapādau prācīsūtraṃ 
pramāṇena datvā tadantayoḥ śaṃkuṃ nikhanya tayostadrajjupāśau tathā 
kuryādyathā vyāsārddhādaṅko yataḥ kṛtaḥ sa pāśaḥ pratīcyāṃ syāt 
karṣacihnadakṣiṇata ākṛṣya vyāsārdhaṃ cihne dakṣiṇaśroṇiśaṃkuṃ datvā 
tasyaivottaradikśroṇyāṃ ca śaṃkuṃ dadyāt | tataḥ pāśau vyatyasyaivamaṃsau 
sādhyāviti | evaṃ samacaturasraṃ kṣetraṃ kṛtvā 
bāhumātroddiṣṭamānābhyadhikāṃ caturasrāṃ bhuvaṃ 
bāhumātrakhananādibhistuṣāṅgarādi loṣṭādikaṃ bhirastha 
śuddhamṛdbhirāpūrya dṛḍhīkṛtya

kīlenaikīkṛte mūle pṛthaksūkṣmasamāgrayoḥ |
daṇḍayoragranaikaṭye'nyastiryamadhyacihnataḥ || 1 ||

kīlādinā yojanīye daṇḍaḥ samatayā dvayoḥ |
mūladeśe lambasūtramaspṛśadbhāravadbhuvam || 2 ||

bhūsthe'grayugme madhyāṅkāt tiryagdaṇḍagatādyataḥ |
skhalettatpūrayedanyannimnayedvāpi yuktitaḥ || 3 ||

aṅke yāvat sūtrameti bhūrevaṃ samatāṃ vrajet |

iti || ayamarthaḥ - samasthaulyadīrgharajjvoḥ kīlena 
protamūlayordaṇḍayoragranikaṭe tādṛśaṃ tiryagdaṇḍaṃ tadardhadīrghaṃ 
kīlena yojayitvā tanmadhye cihnaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍatrayeṇa dīrghatrikoṇākāraṃ 
vidhāya dīrghadaṇḍayormūlāllambamānaṃ sūtramagre 
laghupāṣāṇādibaddhaṃ tiryagdaṇḍasya madhyacihnopari bhūmiṃ yathā na 
spṛśati tathā vidhāya bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvāgrayostayormūlaṃ dhṛtvā 
śanairākṛṣṭe tiryagdaṇḍamadhyāṅkādyatra sūtraṃ calati tatra nimnā 
bhūstāṃ pūrayet | anyat khanitvā vā yathā madhyacihne sūtrameti tathā sarvatra 
kuryāditi śilpiśāstroktaprakāreṇa bhūmiṃ samīkṛtya 
tatrottamamadhyamakaniṣṭhādyanyatamaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt || 
maṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ tu tantrāntare :

rājñāṃ homābhiṣekeṣu dīkṣādānavratādiṣu |
bhānorgatyā diśo jñātvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet sudhīḥ || 1 ||

tataḥ pañcaninādena maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham |
jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamatvena tanmānaṃ trividhaṃ matam || 2 ||

ṣoḍaśāṣṭādaśamitairhastairmānamihottamam |
hastairviṃśatibhiḥ kecinmānamuttamamūcire || 3 ||

madhyamaṃ dvādaśakaraiścaturdaśakarairmitam |
adhamaṃ daśabhirhastairmitamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 4 ||

kecittu navabhistadvat saptabhirvātha pañcabhiḥ |
hastairmittaṃ vadantyeva vistārāyāmasaṃyutam || 5 ||

stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam |
dikṣu dvārāṇi catvāri sāṣṭāṃgulakaradvayāt || 6 ||

sādhyāṃgulakaradvandvādvidadhīta karadvayāt |
tato maṇḍapasūtraṃ tu triguṇaṃ parikalpayet || 7 ||

pūrvādiṣu kramāttasya madhyabhāgastu vedikā |
iṣṭakābhirmṛdā vā sā kāryā darpaṇasannibhā || 8 ||

vedīkoṇeṣu vinyasyāḥ stambhā vedasvarūpakāḥ |
te cottame tadardhoccā madhyamādhamayoḥ punaḥ || 9 ||

p. 227) aṣṭahastonnatibhṛtastato dvādaśa śobhanāḥ |
ṛjavaḥ pañcahastāste saśikhāstu samantataḥ || 10 ||

catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāraścāṣṭau te sūtrakoṭiṣu |
samāntarālāḥ sarve te sthāpyāḥ ṣoḍaśa deśikaiḥ || 11 ||

pañcamāṃśonmitāṃstāṃśca nikhanedbhuvi deśikaḥ | 
madhyastambhacatuṣkāgrādekībhutāgrakaṃ punaḥ || 12 ||

kṛtvā kāṣṭhacatuṣkaṃ tu tadagre kalaśaṃ śubham |
śobhitaṃ kalaśenātha mukhasthena sudārujam || 13 ||

nirmitaṃ śilpibhiḥ samyaksthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ |
ācchādayettato vaṃśaiḥ kaṭaiḥ karadalaiśca tam || 14 ||

maṇḍapadvārabāhye ca yugmaṃ yugmaṃ diśāṃ kramāt |
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭotthaṃ toraṇaṃ nyaset || 15 ||

saptaṣaṭpañcakakaraṃ nikhanedbhuvi pūrvavat |
viśālatā ca tasyātha daśabhistvaṃgulairmatā || 16 ||

pañcāṃgulamitasthaulyaṃ viṣamaṃ caturasrakam |
madhyabhāge toraṇayostiryak kāṣṭhaṃ pravinyaset || 17 ||

sārdhahastadvayāt (pāda) hastayugdhastayugmataḥ |
agnimīlītimantreṇa vinyaset pūrvatoraṇam || 18 ||

iṣe tvetyādimantreṇa dakṣiṇaṃ toraṇaṃ nyaset |
agna āyeti mantreṇa paścimasya niveśanam || 19 ||

śanno devītimantreṇa dadyāduttaratoraṇam |
ūrdhve dhvajaṃ ca badhnīyāt ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam || 20 ||

pañcahasto dhvajaḥ prokto daṇḍastu daśahastakaḥ |
tatastu lokapālānāṃ patākā bāhusammitāḥ || 21 ||

dvādaśāṃgulavistārāstattanmūrtyā ca lāṃchitāḥ |
pītāraktaśyāmadhūmrāśvetadhūmrāsitārjunāḥ || 22 ||

āyudhāṅkāḥ patākāḥ syuḥ puṣpagandhasamanvitāḥ |
yathāyogyaṃ daṇḍayutāstattanmantreṇa tānnyaset || 23 ||

candramaṇḍalagaureṇa vitānena vibhuṣitam |
dukūlaveṣṭitastambhaṃ nānādīpādyalaṃkṛtam || 24 ||

āmrapallavamālābhiḥ śobhitaṃ dvāramuttamam |
veṣṭitaṃ darbharajjvā ca vidadhyānmaṇḍapaṃ śubham || 25 ||

iti || uttaratantre -

viṃśatyūrdhvaśatairhastairmaṇḍapaścottamo mataḥ |
aṣṭottaraśatairhastaiḥ śatahastairathāpi vā || 1 ||

ekāśītimitairhastairdvāsaptatikarairapi |
ṣaṣṭihastairaṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhirhastakaiḥ kramāt || 2 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśadbhiśca triṃśadbhiḥ saptaviṃśatihastakaiḥ |
caturviṃśatihastairvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 3 ||

caturasraṃ tathā vṛttaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam |
trikoṇamaṣṭapatrābhaṃ navakoṇaṃ dvikoṇakam || 4 ||

pañcakoṇaṃ saptakoṇaṃ rudrakoṇaṃ tathaiva ca |
dvādaśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ cāṣṭādaśaviṃśatikoṇakam || 5 ||

caturviṃśatikoṇaṃ ca saptaviṃśatikoṇakam |
dvātriṃśatkoṇakaṃ caiva ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṇakaṃ tathā || 6 ||

aṣṭacatvāriṃśadasraṃ matsyākāro dhvajākṛtiḥ |
śūrpakuntāsiśṛṅgāṭadhanurmudgarakākṛtiḥ || 7 ||

maṇḍapāstatra kartavyāḥ kuṇḍānyapi viśeṣataḥ |
pūrṇābhiṣeke dīkṣāyāmabhiṣekādiśāntiṣu || 8 ||

tattatkāmyaprayogeṣu tattatkuṇḍāni deśikaiḥ |
kartavyāni viśeṣeṇa tattakarmaṇyatandritaiḥ || 9 ||

iti || atra yāvanto maṇḍapabhedā uktāstāvantaḥ kuṇḍabhedā api jñeyāḥ || 
athaitanmaṇḍaparacanāprakāraḥ - atra pūrṇābhiṣekādiṣu 
caturviṃśatihastaparimitāḥ kuṇḍamaṇḍapā ye uktāste kartavyāḥ | 
caturviṃśatirviṃśati aṣṭādaśaṣoḍaśahastairvottamo maṇḍapaḥ caturdhā |
caturdaśahastairdvādaśahastairvā madhyamo dvividhaḥ |
daśahastairnavahastaiḥ saptahastaiḥ pañcahastaiśca samāyāmavistāraiśca 
kaniṣṭhaścaturvidhaḥ | atra pakṣe trividhe yathāvakāśaṃ 
ṛtviksadasyasāmājikādyupaveśādeḥ saukaryayuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt || 
hastastu caturviṃśāṃguladairghya | aṃgulamānaṃ tu mahākapilapañcarātre :

vātāyanapathaṃ prāpya ye bhānti raviraśmayaḥ |
teṣu sūkṣmā visarpante reṇukāstrasareṇavaḥ || 1 ||

paramāṇoraṣṭaguṇastrasareṇurudāhṛtaḥ |
te'ṣṭau keśāhvayāste'ṣṭau likṣā yukāstadaṣṭakam || 2 ||

tadaṣṭakaṃ yavaste'ṣṭāvaṃguliḥ samudāhṛtā |
sā tūttamāṃguliḥ saptayavā saiva tu madhyamā || 3 ||

ṣaṭyavā sādhamā proktā mānāṃgulamitīritam |
vinyastaistiryagaṣṭābhiryavairmānāntarāṃgulam || 4 ||

śālibhirvā ṛjunyastaistribhirmānāntaraṃ bhavet |
ācāryadakṣiṇakare madhyamāṃgulimadhyagam || 5 ||

p. 228) parvaṇorantaraṃ dīrghaṃ mānāṃgulamudāhṛtam |
vināṃguṣṭhena śeṣābhirmuṣṭimaṃgulibhiḥ kṛtam || 6 ||

caturdhā vibhajedeko bhāgo muṣṭyaṃgulaḥ smṛtaḥ |
yaṃ kaṃcitpauruṣāyāmaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥ || 7 ||

ekaṃ dvādaśadhā bhāgaṃ kṛtvā teṣvekamaṃgulam |
dehalabdhāṃgulaṃ nāma jānīyāt tasya tatpunaḥ || 8 ||

ucchrāyaḥ pratimāyāḥ syānmahāmānāṃgulāśrayaḥ |
mahāmānāṃguliriti mātrāṃgulirihocyate || 9 ||

prāsādādīṃśca tenaiva kuryānmānāntareṇa vai |
vedikāpīṭhaśivikārathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ || 10 ||

mānāntarāṃgulenaiva bhavennānyena kenacit |
yāgopakaraṇānāṃ ca kuryānmānāṃgulena vai || 11 ||

homāṅgādisruvādīni kuṇḍaṃ muṣṭyaṃgulāśrayam |
dehalabdhāṃgulenaiva pratimāṅgāni kalpayet || 12 ||

caturviṃśatisaṃkhyābhirhastastvaṃgulibhirbhavet |

iti | atrācāryo yajamānaḥ | etāvaduktaṃ yanmānaṃ yajamānasya tadbhavediti 
tantrāntare karturdakṣiṇahastasyeti śāradāvacanāt || uttaratantre viśeṣaḥ :

navaikādaśa kuṇḍāni kuryāduttamamaṇḍape |
catuṣkuṇḍī madhyame syātkaniṣṭhe'pyekakuṇḍakam || 1 ||

ityevamuktaprakāramātrāṃgulātmakāṃgulādibhirhastādi parikalpya proktaṃ 
maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt | tatra proktavidhinā samīkṛte bhūtale 
pañcavādyaghoṣapuraḥsaraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ svasti vācayitvā 
yathoddiṣṭamānahastavistāraṃ samacaturasraṃ 
koṇacatuṣṭayanikhātaśaṃkucatuṣṭayaṃ vidhāya pūrvāparāyataṃ 
dakṣiṇottarāayataṃ ca madhyasūtraṃ dūrīkṛtya taccaturasrakṣetraṃ 
punarnavadhā vibhajya paritaḥ koṇacatuṣṭaye stambhacatuṣṭayaṃ 
dikcatuṣṭayagatapūrvāparāyatadakṣiṇottarāyatacatuṣkakoṭyaṣṭakagata-
stambhāṣṭakamiti sambhūya dvādaśa 
stambhānatisthūlānnātikṛśānavakrānavraṇānekajātīyān suvṛttān 
pañcahastasamucchrāyān khātapraviṣṭasvasvapañcamāṃśān 
pramāṇādbahirhastasthaulyatṛtīyāṃśān sthūlavitastyunnatiśikhāyuktān 
madhyavibhakte koṇacatuṣṭaye stambhacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvastambhasajātīyaṃ 
pūrvataḥ kiñcitsthūlamuttamamaṇḍape 
tanmānasyādharmānoccamanyamaṇḍape'ṣṭahastoccaṃ pūrvavat saśikhaṃ 
pañcamāṃśena praviṣṭabhūtalamiti sambhūya ṣoḍaśa stambhānnikhāya 
teṣāmupari sajātīyāni ṛjūnyavraṇāni 
śikhāpraveśayogyavedhayuktakoṭidvayavat tiryakkāṣṭhāni śilpibhiḥ 
parikalpitāni dvādaśastambhāgreṣu madhyastambhacatuṣṭayāgreṣu ca 
caturasrākāreṇa samāropya 
madhyastambhacatuṣṭayaśikhāgrapraviṣṭamūlavedhayuktamekīkṛtāgrakāṣṭha-
catuṣṭayaniviṣṭasajātīyakāṣṭhakalaśaṃ kamalākṛtiśobhitāgraṃ 
digvidiksthadvādaśastambhaśikhāgraprotamūlamadhyastambhacatuṣṭayāgra-
spṛṣṭāgramadhyatiryakkāṣṭhacatuṣṭayamadhyagatāgram ṛjvākṛti 
yathāyogyadīrghasthaulyayutaprasāritadvādaśakāṣṭhayutamanyairapi 
kāṣṭhairyathāyogyaṃ dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ nārikeladalairvaṃśakaṭairvā 
samyagācchāditaṃ taireva niḥśeṣapihitakoṇacatuṣṭayaṃ 
caturdikṣūttamamadhyamakaniṣṭheṣu sāṣṭāṃgulahastadvaya 
sacaturaṃgulahastadvaya dvihastavistārayutasaśākhadvāracatuṣṭayopetaṃ 
maṇḍapaṃ viracya maṇḍapasya pūrvadvārādbahirhastamātraṃ 
parityajyāśvatthavṛkṣasyottamamadhyamakaniṣṭheṣu 
saptaṣaṭpañcahastocchritaṃ daśāṃgulavistṛtaṃ pañcāṃgulasthūlavistārasya 
daśāṃgulatvāt sthaulyasya pañcāṃgulatvādvaiṣamyaṃ boddhavyam | 
viṣamacaturasraṃ pramāṇātiriktavitastyunnataśikhaṃ 
dvārasyobhayapārśvayoruttamamadhyamakaniṣṭheṣu 
sārdhahastadvayasapādahastadvayahastadvayāntarālaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ 
pañcamāṃśena praviṣṭabhūtalaphalakadvayaṃ agnimīle purohitaṃ yajñasya 
devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnaghātamam iti mantreṇa nikhāya tatsajātīyakāṣṭhena 
samānavistārasthaulyaṃ viṣamacaturasraṃ koṭidvaye'pi 
śikhāpraveśayogyavedhayutaṃ tiryaktiryakphalaṃ samāropya darbhamālāṃ ca 
badhnīyāt | evaṃ dakṣiṇadvāra udumbaratarumayaṃ toraṇaṃ iṣe tvorje tvā 
vāyavaḥ sthopāyavaḥ stha devovaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe || 
iti mantreṇa nyaset | tataḥ paścimadvāre plakṣamayaṃ toraṇaṃ prāgvannirmitaṃ 
agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye | ni hotā satsi barhiṣi iti mantreṇa nyaset || 
tataḥ uttaradvāre vaṭavṛkṣamayaṃ toraṇaṃ prāgvannirmitaṃ śanno 
devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavanti pītaye | śaṃyorabhisravantu naḥ iti nyaset | 
tatasteṣāmuparigatatiryakphalakeṣu madhyataḥ ṣuṣiraṃ vidhāya teṣu 
toraṇasajātīyakāṣṭhena nirmitamuttamamadhyamakaniṣṭheṣu 
trayodaśaikādaśanavāṃgulamātradairghyaṃ taccaturthāṃśavistāraṃ śaive 
triśūlākāraṃ vaiṣṇave cakrākāraṃ toraṇoparigatatiryakphalakasya 

p. 229) dvādaśāṃśamātradīrghaṃ prāgādikrameṇa 
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmalāṃchitaṃ pratitoraṇamekaikaṃ kīlamāropayet | tatra 
triśūlanirmāṇaprakārastu piṅgalāmate :

śūlena nirmitāḥ kuryād dvāraśākhāstu mastake |
śūle navāṃgulaṃ dairghya turīyāṃśena vistṛtiḥ || 1 ||

ṛjurvai madhyaśṛṅgaḥ syāt kiñcidvakraṃ ca pārśvayoḥ |
hīne caivaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ ropayettathā || 2 ||

śeṣāṇāṃ dvyaṃgulā vṛddhirviṃśaścāṃgulavṛddhitaḥ |

iti | hīne kaniṣṭhamaṇḍape | śeṣāṇāṃ madhyamottamānāṃ | viśaḥ praveśaḥ 
|| vāstuśāstre -

mastake dvādaśāṃśena śaṅkhacakragadāmbujam |
prāgādikramayogena nyasetteṣāṃ svadārujam || 1 ||

iti || dvādaśāṃśaṃ tiryakphalakasya svadārujaṃ 
tattattoraṇasajātīyakāṣṭhasambhavaṃ tena kaniṣṭhamaṇḍape caturaṃguloccaṃ 
madhyame sārdhacaturaṃgulamuttame pañcāṃgulamiti || kecittu tatra hastonmitāḥ 
kīlāḥ saṃsthāpya vaiṣṇave tathā | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmalāñchitāḥ 
śūlasannibhāḥ || śaive iti tantrāntaravacanāddhastamātraṃ kīlaṃ vadanti | tatra 
tiryakphalakeṣu tadā tu hastamātreṣu kīleṣūktamānenaivāgradeśeṣu 
śaṅkhacakrākāraṃ vā triśūlākāraṃ vā kāryaṃ bilapraveśaśca tathaiva 
kāryaḥ urvaritaṃ tu teṣāṃ daṇḍavaddṛśyate iti | tato maṇḍapāgre 
daśahastadairghyavaṃśadaṇḍāvalambitaṃ hastamātravistṛtaṃ 
pañcahastadairghyaṃ dātavyaṃ | 
mantradevatāvāhanamūrtyaṅkitaghaṇṭādibhūṣitāgraṃ suśvetaṃ ca tathaiva 
tattaddaivatavarṇānurūpavarṇaṃ vā dhvajamāropya daśadikṣu 
bāhumātradīrghā 
yathāyogyamānadaṇḍāvalambitāstattallokapālavarṇānurūpavarṇāstattalloka-
pālavāhanamūrtyaṅkitā dvādaśāṃgulavistṛtā lokapālānāṃ 
vedoktatattanmantreṇa patākāśca badhnīyāt | tatrendrasya pītavarṇā vahneḥ 
piṅgalavarṇā yamasya kṛṣṇavarṇā nir-ṛteḥ śyāmavarṇā varuṇasya 
śvetavarṇā vāyordhūmravarṇāḥ somasyāmalavarṇā īśānasya śvetavarṇā 
brahmaṇo raktavarṇā anantasya śvetavarṇāḥ iti patākābhiralaṃkṛtya 
maṇḍapābhyantaraṃ 
suśvetavitānapuṣpamālābhiralaṃkṛtyāmrāśvatthadalagrathitadarbharajjurūpa-
vandanamālayā maṇḍapamantarbahiśca pariveṣṭya stambhān dukūlena 
saṃveṣṭya tanmadhyastambhacatuṣṭayamadhyagate caturasrarūpe 
madhyakhaṇḍe'pakveṣṭakādibhiḥ snigdhamṛdbhirvā caturasrāṃ 
darpaṇodaranibhapārśva catuṣṭayamadhyapradeśāṃ samatalāṃ 
vedyāyāmasyaikādaśāṃśena navamāṃśena saptamāṃśena 
pañcamāṃśena caturthāṃśena tṛtīyāṃśena vā samunnatāṃ 
hastamātronnatāṃ vā vedīṃ vidadhyāt | taduktaṃ tantrāntare ucchrāyā'syā 
īśanavasapteṣvabdhitribhāgakairiti || kapilapañcarātre :

caturthāṃśocchritastasyāstripañcasaptamo'pi vā |
navaikādaśabhāgaistāmiṣṭakābhiḥ prakalpayet || 1 ||

iti | tantrarāje vidadhyānmadhyato vedīṃ karamātrasamunnatām iti | śāradāyām 
-

nakṣatragrahavārāṇāmanukūle śubhe'hani |
tato bhūmitale śuddha tuṣāṅgāravivarjite || 1 ||

puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham |
pañcibhaḥ saptabhirhastairnavabhirvā mitāntaram || 2 ||

ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ catvārasteṣu madhyagāḥ |
aṣṭahastasamucchrāyāḥ saṃsthāpyā dvādaśābhitaḥ || 3 ||

pañcahastapramāṇāste niśchidrā ṛjavaḥ śubhāḥ |
tatpañcamāṃśaṃ nikhanenmedinyāṃ tantravittamaḥ || 4 ||

nārikeladalairvaṃśaiśchādayet tatsamantataḥ |
dvāreṣu toraṇāni syuḥ kramāt kṣīramahīruhām || 5 ||

stambhocchrāyaḥ smṛtasteṣāṃ saptahastaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak |
daśāṃgulapramāṇena tatparīṇāha īritaḥ || 6 ||

tiryakphalakamānaṃ syāt stambhānāṃ madhyamānataḥ |
śūlāni kalpayenmadhye toraṇe hastamānataḥ || 7 ||

dikṣu dhvajānnibadhnīyāllokapālasamaprabhān |
vitānadarbhamālādyairalaṃkurvīta maṇḍapam || 8 ||

tattribhāgamite kṣetre'ratnimātrasamunnatām |
caturasrāṃ tato vedīṃ maṇḍalāya prakalpayet || 9 ||

iti maṇḍapanirmāṇavidhiḥ || atra kaniṣṭhamaṇḍapeṣu daśahastamaṇḍape'pi 
madhyatryaṃśādhikatrikarāyatā vedī kuṇḍavedyorantarālamubhayataḥ 
padadvayamātraṃ tadbahirubhayataḥ 
kaṇṭhamekhalāsahitakuṇḍadvayavyāptabhūmiścaturhastamitā 
tadbahiḥpārśvadvaye'pi kumbhasthāpanārthaṃ 

p. 230) hastadvayamitisamastamaṇḍapabhūmirvyāptā | ataḥ paramācārya-
ṛtviksadasyādyupaveśanasthānamapi na labhyate iti nāyaṃ pakṣaḥsamīcīnaḥ | 
tasmādayaṃ pakṣastvaikaikakuṇḍaikamekhalādisaṃkṣepacikīrṣāyāmetāvatā 
cāritārthyāttattadviṣaya iti jñeyaḥ | itthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vidhāya tasmin 
pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu 
caturasrayonyardhacandratrikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇapadmāṣṭāmnākhyānyaṣṭau 
kuṇḍāni kuryāt ||

tatrādau caturasrakuṇḍanirmāṇaprakāramāha śāradāyām -

prākprokte maṇḍape vidvān vedikāyā bahistridhā |
kṣetraṃ vibhajya madhyeṃ'śe pūrvādi parikalpayet || 1 ||

aṣṭāsvāśāsu kuṇḍāni ramyākārāṇyanukramāt |
caturasraṃ yonimardhacandraṃ tryasraṃ ca vartulam || 2 ||

ṣaḍasraṃ paṅkajākāramaṣṭāsraṃ tāni nāmataḥ |
ācāryakuṇḍaṃ madhye syād gaurīpatimahendrayoḥ || 3 ||

hastamānamitāṃ bhūmiṃ pūrvavatparisūtrayet |
samantāt kuṇḍametat syāccaturasraṃ śubhāvaham || 4 ||

caturviṃśatyaṃgulāḍhyaṃ hastaṃ tantravido viduḥ |
caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcadhā vibhajet sudhīḥ || 5 ||

nyaset purastādekāṃśaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ |
bhrāmayet koṇamānena tadānyadapi mantravit || 6 ||

sūtrayugmaṃ tato dadyāt kuṇḍaṃ yoninibhaṃ bhavet |
caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ daśadhā vibhajet punaḥ || 7 ||

ekamekaṃ tyajedaṃśamadha ūrdhvaṃ ca tantravit |
jyāsūtraṃ pātayedagre tanmānādbhrāmayet tataḥ || 8 ||

ardhacandranibhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavet |
caturdhā bhedite kṣetre nyasedubhayapārśvayoḥ || 9 ||

ekaikamaṃśaṃ tanmānādagrato lāñchayettataḥ |
sūtratrayamadhaḥ kuryāt tryasraṃ kuṇḍamudāhṛtam || 10 ||

aṣṭādaśāṃśe kṣetreṃ'śe nyasedekaṃ bahirbudhaḥ |
bhrāmayettena mānena vṛttaṃ kuṇḍamanuttamam || 11 ||

aṣṭadhā vibhajet kṣetraṃ madhyasūtrasya pārśvayoḥ |
bhāgaṃ nyasedekamekaṃ mānenānena madhyataḥ || 12 ||

kuryāt pārśvayuge matsyacatuṣka tantravittamaḥ |
sūtraṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamuttamam || 13 ||

caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajyāṣṭādaśāṃśataḥ |
ekabhāgaṃ bahirnyasya bhrāmayettena vartulam || 14 ||

vṛttādi karṇikādīnāṃ bahistrīṇi prakalpayet |
padmakuṇḍamidaṃ proktaṃ vilocanamanoharam || 15 ||

pūrvoktaṃ vibhajet kṣetraṃ caturviṃśatibhāgataḥ |
bhāgamekaṃ bahirnyasya caturasraṃ prakalpayet || 16 ||

aṃsayoścaturasrasya koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ |
bāhyasya caturasrasya koṇābhyāṃ parilāñchayet || 17 ||

diśaṃ prati yathānyāyamaṣṭau sūtrāṇi pātayet |
aṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍametaddhi tantravidbhirudīritam || 18 ||

iti | śrītantrarāje (29 pa0 26 ślo)

prākpratyaksūtramāsphālya tanmadhye cihnakalpanam |
kṛtvā tatpūrvataḥ paścāddvādaśāṃgulamānataḥ || 1 ||

tatastadagrāṇyālambya madhyacihnasya mānataḥ |
kuryāddhaṃsapadaṃ koṣṭhānyabhitasteṣu pātayet || 2 ||

paraṃ pramṛjya tatrāpi vidadhyācihnayugmakaṃ |
prākpratyakcihnamānena tayorevāvalambataḥ || 3 ||

dakṣiṇottarato haṃsapade kṛtvā tayostataḥ |
prasārya sūtraṃ tasyāpi mārjayitvoktamānataḥ || 4 ||

catuṣṭayaṃ tu sūtrāṇāṃ caturasraṃ bhavetsamam |

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra vedyāḥ pūrvabhāge 
muṣṭyaṃgulamānena hastamātrāṃ bhuvaṃ parityajya prākkalpitadikkrameṇa 
prākpratyagāyataṃ sūtramāsphālya tanmadhye cihnaṃ kṛtvā 
taccihnātpūrvataḥ paścimataśca muṣṭyaṃgulairdvādaśamānena cihnaṃ kṛtvā 
tattadadhikāṃśaṃ mārjayitvā taccihnadvayāvaṣṭambhena tatsūtrārdhāt 
kiñcidadhikamānabhrameṇa pūrvāparataḥ kiñcidanyonyasaṃśliṣṭaṃ 
vṛttadvayaṃ vidhāya tayordakṣiṇottarasaṃdaṃśarūpahaṃsapadadvayaprāpi 
prākpratyakbrahmasūtramadhyagatahaṃsapadabhedaṃ dakṣiṇottaraṃ 
sūtramāsphālya tatrāpi madhyacihnāddvādaśāṃgulamānena dakṣiṇottaraṃ 
cihnadvayaṃ vidhāya tattadadhikāṃśaṃ mārjayitvā 
tatsūtrāgracatuṣṭayāvalambena dvādaśāṃgulamānena caturṣvapi koṇeṣu 
haṃsapadaṃ vidhāya tattadagrāttattaddhaṃsapadaprāpiprākpratyaksūtradvayaṃ 
dakṣiṇottaraṃ sūtradvayaṃ ca saṃbhūya sūtracatuṣṭayamāsphālya caturasraṃ 
kuryāt | tatastatprākpratyagāyatabrahmasūtramānanimnaṃ samacaturasraṃ tatra 
khātaṃ kṛtvā tatparitaḥ kuṇḍamānasya caturviṃśāṃśamitāṃ bhuvaṃ 
parityajya tadbahirdvādaśāṃgulavistarāṃ caturaṃgulotsedhāṃ mekhalāṃ 
kṛtvā tadupari bāhye paritaścaturaṃgulamānaṃ tyaktvāṣṭāṃgulavistarāṃ 
caturaṃgulonnatāṃ dvitīyāṃ mekhalāṃ kṛtvā tadupari bāhye caturaṃgulaṃ 
tyaktvā vistārotsedhābhyāṃ caturaṃgulamitāṃ tṛtīyāṃ mekhalāṃ kuryāt | 
evaṃ kṛte prathamā mekhalāṃ dvādaśāṃgulonnatā caturaṃgulavistṛtā 
dvitīyāṣṭāṃgulonnatā caturaṃgulavistṛtā tṛtīyā caturaṃgulonnatā 
caturaṃgulavistṛtā ca bhavatīti | atra kecit prathamā mekhalā caturaṃgulavistṛtā 
navāṃgulonnatā dvitīyā tu tryaṃgulavistṛtā pañcāṃgulonnatā tṛtīyā tu 
dvyaṃgulavistṛtā dvyaṃgulonnateti mekhalāmānamāhuḥ | etanmekhalayā saha 
hastamātrakhātapakṣe jñeyam tatra pañcadaśāṃgulanimnakhātasyaiva 
viśvakarmaṇoktatvāt tadūrdhve navāṃgulocchrāyasyaivāvaśyakatvāt | 
hastamātrakhātapakṣe tu - sarveṣāṃ mekhalāmānaṃ vitastyaṣṭatadardhakaiḥ | 
vistārotsedhayoḥ kuryāt iti tantrarājavacanāt |

sattvapūrvakaguṇānvitāḥ kramād dvādaśāṣṭacaturaṃgulocchritāḥ |
sarvato'ṃgulacatuṣkavistṛtā mekhalāḥ sakalasiddhidā matāḥ || 1 || (5 - 33)

iti prapañcasāravacanāccā pūrvokta eva pakṣaḥ samīcīna iti || tataḥ 
sarvabāhyasthamekhalāyā bahiścaturaṃgulāyāmavistārotsedhaṃ caturasraṃ 
pīṭhaṃ mṛdā kṛtvā tadupari 
nihitamūladvādaśāṃguladīrghottarottarahīnapariṇāhamadhyamekhalāsaṃlagna
randhranālayutāṃ mūle kumbhadvayayuktāṃ madhye 
sagarbhāmuparitanamekhaloparigatāmaṣṭāṃgulamānamūlāṃ 
tatpradeśādubhayapārśvataḥ krameṇa saṃkucitāmekāṃgulavistārāgrāṃ 
dvādaśāṃgulamānāyāmāmekāṃgulotsedhamekhalāyuktāmaśvatthapatrā-
kārāṃ mūlātkiñcit kramānnimnāmīṣatkuṇḍapraviṣṭāgrāṃ yoniṃ kuryāt | 
atha kuṇḍamadhyasthahaṃsapadāvalambena pratidiśaṃ caturaṃgulamānena 
vṛttaṃ niṣpādya tadbahiḥ punaḥ ṣaḍaṃgulamānena ca vṛttaṃ kṛtvā tadvṛttaṃ 
karṇikāṃ ca parikalpya vṛttadvayāntarālavīthyāmaṣṭadalāni kṛtvā 
ṣaḍaṃguloccanābhiṃ kuryāt || iti caturasrakuṇḍanirmāṇavidhiḥ ||

atha yonikuṇḍamāha tantrarāje -

tanmadhyapañcamāṃśena vikāsya brahmasūtrakam |
pūrvataḥ paścimadvandvakoṣṭhayormadhyadeśataḥ || 1 ||

tatkoṇamānena tathā bhrāmayetpaścimāgrakāt |
uttarāgrāvadhi tathā dakṣiṇāgrāvadhi priye || 2 ||

tanmadhyatiryaksūtrāgradvayāvaṣṭambhatastathā |
vikāsitabrahmasūtrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

yonikuṇḍamidaṃ bhadre syāccaturṣūbhayātmasu |
tasminnevānyakuṇḍāni vadāmi samamānataḥ || 4 ||

caturasrābhito yā tu tyājyā bhūḥ sānyataḥ sthitā |
labhyate sarvakuṇḍeṣu tena sarvāṇi sarvataḥ || 5 ||

tatsamānyeva jāyante ṣaṇavatyaṃgulātmanā |

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ tatra prāgvat caturasraṃ nirmāya 
catuṣkoṣṭhayutasya brahmasūtrasya tanmānapañcamāṃśena pūrvasyāṃ diśi 
varddhayitvā tatkoṣṭhacatuṣṭayātmakacaturasrasya 
paścimabhāgasthadakṣiṇottarakoṣṭhayornir-ṛtyādīśānāntamāgneyā 
divāyavyāntaṃ catuṣkoṇasūtradvayāsphālanena 
lakṣitasūtradvayasaṃpātanaviditamadhyadeśāvaṣṭambhatastatkoṇavadhimāne-
nottarakoṣṭhe 
prākpratyagbrahmasūtrapaścimāgrādidakṣiṇottaratiryaksūtrottarāgrāvadhi 
taddakṣiṇakoṣṭhe tatsūtrapaścimāgrādi tattiryaksūtradakṣiṇāgrāvadhi 
bhramādardhacandradvayamutpādya tanmadhyatiryaksūtrāgramārabhya 
prākprasāritabrahmasūtrāgrāvadhi sūtradvayāsphālanena yonyākāraṃ 
kṣetraṃ parikalpya tadbahiśca kaṇṭhamekhalayoryathoktamānenoktayuktyā 
yonimaṇḍaladvayaṃ niṣpādya prāgvat khātaṃ kṛtvā yonyākārameva 
kaṇṭhamekhalādi kalpayediti kuṇḍānāṃ yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ mekhalānāṃ ca 
tādṛśam | kuryātsarveṣu kuṇḍeṣu iti kulaprakāśavacanāt ||

athārdhacandrākārakuṇḍamāha tantrarāje -

tanmadhyadaśamāṃśaṃ tu parityajyādha ūrdhvataḥ |
śeṣāṃśāṃśakamānena tanmadhyādbhrāmayet tathā || 1 ||

ardhacandrākṛtiryena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ tadīritam |

p. 232) iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvat caturasraṃ nirmāya 
tadviṣkambhamānaṃ daśadhā vibhajya teṣvekaikāṃśaṃ prākpaścimayoḥ 
parityajya cihnadvayaṃ kṛtvā tatpaścimacihnāt dakṣiṇottarāyataṃ tiryaksūtraṃ 
taccaturasrādbahirapyaṃśatrayamānena dakṣiṇottarayorvarddhayitvā 
tadagradvayāvadhi tatkalpitapaścimabrahmasūtrasandhimadhyāvalambanena 
vārdhacandranibhaṃ maṇḍaladvayaṃ kṛtvā 
prāgrekhāmadhyagatabrahmasūtrasandhimārabhyāṣṭāṃśamānasūtra-
bhramādardhacandrākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ bhavet | ityardhacandrākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ 
nirmāya tadbahirapyuktayuktvā ekāṃgulamānena dvādaśāṃgulamānena 
vārdhacandranibhaṃ maṇḍaladvayaṃ kṛtvā prathamakṛtamaṇḍalamadhye 
hastamātraṃ nimnaḥ khātaṃ kṛtvā bahiḥ kaṇṭhasthānaṃ parityajya 
prāgvanmekhelādikaṃ kuryāditi ||

atha trikoṇakuṇḍamāha tatraiva -

tasyaiva ṣaṣṭhamaṃśaṃ tu pārśvayostu vikāsayet |
pratyekaṃ paścimaṃ sūtraṃ tanmānenātha sūtrayoḥ || 1 ||

vinyāsādbrahmasūtrāntaṃ taddvayāgrāvalambanāt |
kuṇḍaṃ trikoṇamuditam |

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvaccaturasraṃ kṛtvā 
tadbrahmasūtrasya prāgagraṃ bahirgatyā prasārya taccaturasraviṣkambhamānaṃ 
ṣoḍhā vibhajya teṣ.vekaikāṃśena paścimatiryaksūtrāgradvayaṃ 
pārśvadvaye'pi bahiḥ prasārya tadagradvayāt tatsūtramānopetasūtradvayasya 
prākprasāritabrahmasūtrasya ca yatra sampātastadavadhyāsphālya 
trikoṇakuṇḍaṃ parikalpya tadbahirekāṃśamānena 
tadbahirdvāṃdaśāṃśamānenoktayuktyā trikoṇadvayaṃ niṣpādya 
khātakaṇṭhamekhalādi prāgvatkalpayediti ||

atha vṛttakuṇḍamāha tatraiva -

tanmadhyāṣṭādaśāṃśena prāksūtrāgraṃ vikāsayet |
tiryaksūtrādbahistena mānena bhramayettathā || 1 ||

madhyacihnāvalambena tadbhavedvṛttamaṇḍalam |

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvat caturasraṃ kṣetraṃ sādhayitvā 
tanmadhye viṣkambhamānamaṣṭādaśadhā vibhajya 
teṣvekāṃśamānataścaturasrādbahirbrahmasūtrasthaprāgagraṃ vistārya 
madhyacihnamavalambya vistāritabrahmasūtrāgramānena parito bhrameṇa vṛttaṃ 
niṣpādya tadbahiḥ punaścaturasrasya caturviṃśamānena kaṇṭhārthaṃ vṛttaṃ 
kṛtvā tadbahiḥ punardvādaśāṃgulamānena vṛttāntaraṃ niṣpādya 
prathamakṛtavṛttamadhye hastamātraṃ nimnaṃ khātaṃ kṛtvā 
kaṇṭhavṛttādbahirdvādaśāṃgulāntarālaṃ vīthyāṃ prāgvanmekhalātrayaṃ 
yonyādikaṃ racayediti || atha vṛttakuṇḍe yonirnāstīti kaścit tanna yonikuṇḍe 
yoniḥ padmakuṇḍe nābhiśca nāstīti tāntrikasiddhāntaḥ ||

atha saḍasrakuṇḍamāha tatraiva -

tanmadhyaṣoḍaśāṃśena vikāsya brahmasūtrakam |
tena mānena ca tathā kṛtvā vṛttamatisphuṭam || 1 ||

tadvṛtte vṛttamadhyasya kuryādardhena lāñchanam |
tatra ṣaṭsūtrapātena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍasrakam || 2 ||

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvatcaturasraṃ vidhāya 
tanmadhyamānaṃ ṣoḍaśadhā vibhajya teṣvekāṃśamānena brahmasūtrasya 
prāgagraṃ vikāśya tanmānena caturasratanmadhsthahaṃsapadamadhyāvalambena 
bhramādvṛttaṃ niṣpādya tanmadhyaviṣkambhamānārdhena 
tanmadhyatiryaksūtradakṣiṇāgrādiparitovṛtte cihnaṣaṭkaṃ vidhāya tatra cihnāt 
cihnaṃ jyārūpaṃ sūtraṣaṭkamāsphālya tattaccāparūpavṛttakhaṇḍamārjanena 
ṣaṭkoṇakuṇḍakṣetraṃ niṣpādya tadbahirekāṃśato 
dvādaśāṃśataścoktayuktyā ṣaṭkoṇadvayaṃ niṣpādya khātādīni prāgvat 
kalpayediti ||

atha padmakuṇḍamāha lakṣaṇasaṃgrahe -

caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajedaṣṭadhāmbike |
aṣṭamāṃśapramāṇena karkaṭena tu madhyataḥ || 1 ||

vartulaṃ bhrāmayetseyaṃ karṇikā kesarāḥ punaḥ |
aṣṭamāṃśadvayenaiva madhyato vartulaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

tṛtīyenāṣṭamāṃśena patrāṇāṃ madhyabhūrmatā |
caturthaṃ tu bhavet kṣetraṃ vyāsatulyena ca bhramāt || 3 ||

caturviṃśatidhā bhaktvā brahmasūtraṃ varānane |
tasyaikaṃ bhāgamādāya bhaktvā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ || 4 ||

pañcabhiḥ ṣoḍaśairbhāgairnyūnaṃ pañcakamaṣṭakam |
bhāgamādāya tadbāhye pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śive || 5 ||

p. 233) madhyato bhrāmayet sarvaiḥ patrāṇāmagrabhūrmatā |
śāstroktavidhinā devi tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhet || 6 ||

vāhyavṛttāntarālaṃ yattanmānaṃ kesarāgrataḥ |
tanmānaṃ karkaṭaṃ kṛtvā kesarāgre vidhāya ca || 7 ||

gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa ṣoḍaśārdhaniśākarān |
likhitvā kṛtihastena patrāgrāṇi samālikhet || 8 ||

karṇikāvyāsamānena parityajya taduccatām |
likhenedavaśiṣṭaṃ tu kesarāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalam || 9 ||

khanedantastathākāraṃ kurvan patrabhuvaṃ khanet |
patrākārā yathā samyagjāyante parameśvari || 10 ||

padmakuṇḍamiti proktam |

iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvaccaturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetramaṣṭadhā 
vibhajya tanmadhyacihnāvalambena paritasteṣvekāṃśamānena karṇikārthaṃ 
vṛttaṃ niṣpādya tadbahirapyaṃśadvayamānena kesarārthaṃ vṛttaṃ kṛtvā 
tadbahirapyaṃśatrayamānena taddalārthaṃ vṛttaṃ viracya 
tadbahirapyaṃśacatuṣṭayamānena vṛttaṃ bhrāmayitvā tadbahirapi 
sārghaṣaḍyavamānena caturasrakṣetrādbahiḥ vṛttamekaṃ bhrāmayediti 
vṛttapañcakaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyavṛttapañcamavṛttayorantarālamānakarkaṭena 
kesaravṛttāgrāt sarvabāhyavṛttaspṛṣṭasṛṅgadvayāgrakān 
ṣoḍaśārdhacandrānniṣpādya sāgrāṇyaṣṭadalāni kṛtvā 
tanmadhyakarṇikāvṛttaṃ vihāya kesarāṇi karṇikāṃ paritaḥ prakāśayat 
kesaravṛttaṃ dalamadhyavṛttaṃ ca samyak khanitvā 
caturthapañcamavṛttayordalāni sāgrāṇi yathā bhavanti caturasrakuṇḍasya 
vistārāyāmakhātasamānakṣetraphalavat kṣetraphalaṃ ca yathā bhavati tathā 
gurūktayuktyā khananaṃ vidhāya bahiḥ padmākāreṇaiva kaṇṭhamekhalādikaṃ 
kuryāditi ||

athāṣṭāsrakuṇḍamāha tantrarāje -

tanmadhyasya caturviṃśamāne bāhye'pi pūrvavat |
vidhāya caturasra tu pūrvakoṇārdhamānataḥ || 1 ||

koṇādabhita evāsya kṛtvā cihnāni cāṣṭa vai |
teṣu cihneṣu kṛtvāṣṭasūtrāṇi paritaḥ śive || 2 ||

kuryādaṣṭāsrakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra 
prāgvaccaturasraṃ vidhāya tanmadhyasūtramānaṃ caturviṃśatidhā vibhajya 
teṣvekāṃśamānaṃ tadbahiḥ pratidiśaṃ prasāritasūtrāgre 
pūrvavaccaturasraṃ proktakrameṇa vidhāya tatra 
pūrvacaturasrasthakoṇasūyasyārdhamānena bāhyacaturasre 
koṇacatuṣṭayavyatyāsāvaṣṭambhādubhayataḥ pratirekhaṃ cihnadvayaṃ 
kramātsambhūyāṣṭacihnāni kṛtvā cihnāt cihnaṃ 
prāgvatsūtrāṣṭakamāsphālya tadbahirgatakoṇamārjanādaṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍaṃ 
bhavati | itthamaṣṭāsrakuṇḍakṣetraṃ parikalpya khātakaṇṭhamekhalādikaṃ 
yathāvatkuryāditi dīkṣāyāmaṣṭau kuṇḍāni kāryāṇi ||

atha prasaktyā kāmyahomārthaṃ pañcāsrasaptāsrakuṇḍayorapi lakṣaṇamucyate 
|
tatrādau pañcāsrakuṇḍamāha tatraiva -

tanmadhyasaptamāṃeśena brahmasūtraṃ vikāsya tat |
mānena parito bhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ yathā tataḥ || 1 ||

tattryaṃśamānāt tadvṛtte kṛtvā cihnāni tatra vai |
pātayet pañca sūtrāṇi tat syātpañcāsrakuṇḍakam || 2 ||

iti || athaitkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prāgvaccaturasrakṣetraṃ kṛtvā 
tanmadhyamānasya saptamāṃśena brahmasūtrasya prāgagraṃ bahirvikāśya 
tanmānena taccaturasramadhyasthahaṃsapadāvalambanena bhramād vṛttaṃ 
niṣpādya taccaturasramadhyasūtraṃ caturdhā kṛtvā teṣvaṃśatrayeṇa 
aṃśatrayeṇa tadvṛtte brahmasūtraprāgagrādiparitaḥ pañca cihnāni vidhāya 
tatra cihnāt cihnaṃ jyārūpāṇi pañcasūtrāṇyāsphālya 
tattaccāpa(rūpa)vṛttakhaṇḍamārjanāt pañcāsrakuṇḍaṃ bhavati | itthaṃ 
pañcāsrakuṇḍakṣetraṃ parikalpya tadbahirapi proktayuktyā 
kaṇṭhamekhalārthaṃ pañcāsradvayaṃ parikalpya khātādikaṃ kuryāditi ||

atha saptāsrakuṇḍamāha tatraiva -

tanmadhyadaśamāṃśena vikāśya brahmasūtrakam |
tena mānena saṃbhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥ || 1 ||

taccatuṣṣaṣṭibhāgeṣu trayastriṃśāṃśamānataḥ |
vṛtte vidhāya cihnāni sapta sūtrāṇi pātayet || 2 ||

p. 234) tatsaptāsraṃ bhavetkuṇḍam iti || athaitatkuṇḍaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra 
prāgvatsamacaturasraṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyamānaṃ daśadhā vibhajya 
teṣvekāṃśamānena brahmasūtraṃ bahirvikāśya tanmānena 
taccturasramadhyasthahaṃsapadamavaṣṭamya vṛttaṃ kṛtvā taccaturasramadhya 
sūtrapramāṇaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭidhā vibhajya teṣu trayastriṃśadaṃśamānena 
brahmasūtraprāgagrādārabhya vṛtte sapta cihnāni kṛtvā cihnāccihnaṃ 
jyārūpeṇa sapta sūtrāṇyāsphālya 
tattaccāparūpavṛttakhaṇḍamārjanādetatsaptāsraṃkuṇḍaṃ bhavediti || iti 
daśavidhakuṇḍanirmāṇaprakāraḥ | atra dīkṣāyāmaṣṭau kuṇḍāni 
prāgādyaṣṭadikṣu navamamācāryakuṇḍaṃ caturasramevendreśānayormadhye 
kuryāditi sambhūya nava kuṇḍāi kāryāṇi | aṣṭakuṇḍakaraṇāśaktau 
prāgādicaturdikṣu caturasrārdhacandravṛttapadmākhyāni catvāryeva kuṇḍāni 
kuryāt | atrāpyaśaktāvindreśānayormadhye caturasramācāryakuṇḍamekameva 
kuryāditi || athaiteṣāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ kāmyahomeṣu kuṇḍabhedena phalabhedaḥ | 
tatra kulaprakāśatantre :

caturasre stambhanaṃ syātsarvasiddhikaraṃ ca tat |
bhogāḥ putrā yonikuṇḍe hyardhacandraṃ śubhāvaham || 1 ||

māraṇe kecidicchanti trikoṇaṃ dveṣakārakam |
ripughātakaraṃ kecidvṛttaṃ śāntikaraṃ jaguḥ || 2 ||

ṣaṭkoṇamuccāṭamṛtibhedeṣu suviśiṣyate |
vṛṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ vāpi padmakuṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 3 ||

aṣṭakoṇaṃ tu muktau syādaroge'pīti kecana |
pañcakoṇaṃ cābhicāraśamane bhūtakṛntane || 4 ||

saptāsrameva vijñāya kāmyakarmāṇi sādhayet |

iti || atha varṇabhedena kuṇḍabhedaḥ | kulamūlāvatāre -

varṇanāmāditaḥ kuṇḍānyuktāni kramataḥ śive |
caturasraṃ vṛttamardhacandraṃ tryasramiti kramāt || 1 ||

sarveṣāṃ caturasraṃ vā dīkṣāyāmuttamaṃ śive |

iti | atha vedikāparitaḥ kuṇḍanirmāṇe viśeṣamāha tantrarāje -

kuṇḍānyaṣṭau catuṣkaṃ ca teṣāṃ rūpaṃ ca nāmakam |
nirmāṇaṃ sakalaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi tavānaghe || 1 ||

tulākulīrameṣāṇāṃ makarasya ca deśataḥ |
vidadhyādvṛttakuṇḍāni cararāśicatuṣṭaye || 2 ||

vṛṣe siṃhe vṛścike ca kumbhe ca sthirarāśiṣu |
vidadhyāccaturasrāṇiḥ tataḥ kuṇḍānyanukramāt || 3 ||

mithune kanyakāyāṃ ca cāpe mīne krameṇa vai |
ubhayātmasu kurvīta yonikuṇḍāni maṅgale || 4 ||

amaṅgaleṣu kurvīta careṣvardhaśaśāṅkakam |
sthireṣvapi trikoṇāni pareṣu tu catuṣṭaye || 5 ||

pañcāsraṃ ca ṣaḍasraṃ ca saptāsraṃ cāṣṭakoṇakam |

iti || rāśisthitimāha tatraiva -

prācyāṃ meṣavṛṣau vahnau mithunaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
kulīrasiṃhāvatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā tathā || 1 ||

tulākīṭau paścimato dhanurvāyau tu saṃsthitam |
nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitam || 2 ||

iti || atha kuṇḍasvarūpaṃ tadvāsanā ca prathamatantre -

paraṃ śarīraṃ prakṛteḥ kuṇḍarūpaṃ puraḥ śiraḥ |
yāmyasaumyakarau kuṇḍamudaraṃ paścime tathā || 1 ||

yoniśca caraṇau proktā sarvatantreṣu śāmbhavi |

iti || atha homasaṃkhyābhedena kuṇḍamānabhedastatra lakṣasāgare -

pañcāśatpramite home kuṇḍaṃ ratnimitaṃ bhavet |
aratnimātraṃ tu śate sahasramitahomake || 1 ||

caturviṃśatyagulāḍhyaṃ dvihastamayute matam |
caturhastamitaṃ lakṣe ṣaṭkaraṃ daśalakṣake || 2 ||

koṭihome cāṣṭahastaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kuryānmaheśvari |

iti || prakārāntaraṃ ca tatraiva -

ekalakṣaṃ samārabhya yāvatsyād daśalakṣakaṃ |
tathaikahastamārabhya daśahastaṃ vivarddhayet || 1 ||

koṭyāṃ daśakaraṃ kuṇḍaṃ praśastaṃ parameśvari |

p. 235) iti || etatpatrapuṣpakevaladhṛtahomeṣviti jñeyam | tatrātivistārasya 
prayojanābhāvāt || athaiteṣāṃ dvihastādikuṇḍaviśeṣāṇāṃ 
mānāṃgulakṣetraphalāni lakṣasāgare -

phalāṃgulāni yāvanti hastakṣetre bhavanti hi |
dvihastasya ca kuṇḍasya tato dvaiguṇyamiṣyate || 1 ||

hastakṣetrāṃgulānyatra ṣaṭsaptatyā sahaiva ca |
śatāni pañca vidyante tanmūlaṃ brahmasūtrakam || 2 ||

caturviṃśatyaṃgulāni vidadhyādvidhivatpunaḥ |
aṃgulāni dvipañcāśadekādaśaśatāni ca || 3 ||

tadbījaṃ madhyato likṣācatuṣkaṃ cārdhasaṃyutam |
catasraśca tathā yūkā yavāḥ sapta tathaiva ca || 4 ||

aṃgulāni trayastriṃśanmānaṃ sūtre tu madhyame |
saptadaśaśatānyaṣṭāviṃśatistvaṃgulāni ca || 5 ||

kṣetrasya tu trihastasya mānametadudīritam |
tanmūlamaṃgulānyekacatvāriṃśaccaturyavāḥ || 6 ||

yūkācatuṣṭayaṃ kiñcinnyūnaṃ likṣācatuṣṭayam |
caturaṃgulayuktāni trayoviṃśacchatāni ca || 7 ||

caturhastasya kuṇḍasya mānamevamudīritam |
mūlaṃ tasyāṃgulānyaṣṭacatvāriṃśanmitaṃ bhavet || 8 ||

brahmasūtraṃ tataḥ pañcahastakṣetrāṃgulāni tu |
dvisahasraṃ śatānyaṣṭāvaśītirbījamucyate || 9 ||

ṣaṭpañcāśadaṃgulāni catustriṃśacchatāni ca |
tanmūlamaṣṭapañcāśadaṃgulāni ca ṣaḍyavā || 10 ||

kiñcidbhāgādikaṃ yūkādvayaṃ saptakarasya ca |
vedasaṃkhyāsahasrāṇi dvāviṃśatsahitāni ca || 11 ||

mūlaṃ caturyavaiḥ sākaṃ triṣaṣṭiraṃgulāni ca |
brahmasūtraṃ tataścāṣṭahastakṣetrāṃgulāni ca || 12 ||

vedasaṃkhyāsahasrāṇi sāṣṭāni ṣaṭśatāni ca |
aṃgulāni tathā saptaṣaṣṭiḥ sapta yavāḥ punaḥ || 13 ||

kiñcidūnaṃ mūlamasya navahasteṣu dṛśyate |
śatāni tvekapañcāśaccaturbhiradhikāni ca || 14 ||

aśītiraṃgulānyatra kṣetraṃ mānamitaṃ bhavet |
dvāsaptatiraṃgulāni mūlamasya prakīrtitam || 15 ||

pañcāgulāni kṣetrasya daśahastamitasya ca |
sahasrāṇīṣusaṃkhyāni munisaṃkhyaśatāni ca || 16 ||

ṣaṣṭiśca kathitānyasya tanmūlaṃ brahmasūtrakam |
vardhayet pañcasaptatyādhikaiḥ saptayavaistathā || 17 ||

asyādhikābhyāṃ likṣābhyāṃ sākamevaṃ prakalpayet |
atiyatnaṃ samāsthāya kuṇḍānyāracayet sudhīḥ || 18 ||

dvihastādimitānāṃ ca nirmāṇaṃ durghaṭaṃ śive |

iti || atiyatnamiti atra trasareṇvādidaśaparyantān mānabhedān samyagjñātvā 
tatkuṇḍavistārāyāmasamānanimnakhātaṃ yathoktamānakaṇṭhamekhalādikaṃ 
ca kuryādityarthaḥ | durghaṭaṃ cātiyatnasādhyatvāt | trasareṇvādimānabhedāstu 
lakṣaṇasaṃgrahe :

jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate || 1 ||

trasareṇustu vijñeyo hyaṣṭau syuḥ paramāṇavaḥ |
trasareṇuraṣṭaguṇau rathareṇustu saṃsmṛtaḥ || 2 ||

rathareṇavastu te hyaṣṭau bālāgraṃ tanmataṃ budhaiḥ |
bālāgrāṇyaṣṭa likṣā tu yūkā likṣāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || 3 ||

aṣṭau yūkā yavaṃ prāhuraṃgulaṃ tu yavāṣṭakam |
ratniraṃguliparvāṇāṃ vijñeyastvekaviṃśatiḥ || 4 ||

kara eva kalāṃśena hīno'ratnirudāhṛtaḥ |
catvāri viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulāni tu || 5 ||

iti || athāsya kuṇḍavistārāyāmasamānanimnakhātakaraṇe mekhalādīnāṃ ca 
pramāṇavacanāni tathā ca -

viṃśatyā caturadhikābhiraṃgulībhiḥ sūtreṇāpyatha parisūtrya bhūmibhāgam 
|
tābhiśca prakhanatu tāvatībhirekāṃ tyaktvā cāṃgulimapi mekhalāśca 
kāryāḥ || 1 ||

iti prapañcasāravacanāt || yāvān kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritam | iti 
śāradāvacanāt | kuṇḍavistāravannimnamiti vāyavīyasaṃhitāvacanāt |

caturasraṃ catuṣkoṣṭhaṃ sūtraiḥ kṛtvā yathā purā |
hastamānena tanmadhye tāvannimnāyataṃ khanet || 1 ||

p. 236) iti divyasārasvataprayogasāravacanāt | caturviṃśāṃgulāyāmaṃ 
tāvatkhātasamanvitam | iti gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinīvacanāt | 
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyābhiraṃgulībhiḥ savistṛtam | khātaṃ ca racayetkuṇḍaṃ iti 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāvacanācca kuṇḍaṃ viratārāyāmasamānanimnakhātaṃ 
kartavyamiti siddhāntaḥ || atra kecit - hastamātraṃ khanet tiryagūrdhvamekhalayā 
saha | iti homasāravacanāt | pañcatrimekhalocchrāyaṃ jñātvā śeṣamadhaḥ 
khanet | iti pratiṣṭhāsārasaṃgrahavacanāt | vyāsāt khātakaraḥ prokto 
nimnastithyaṃgulena tu | iti viśvakarmavacanāt | kuṇḍaṃ nijāṃgule 
tiryagūrdhvamekhalayā saha | iti prathamatantre vacanāt | khātaṃ 
kuṇḍapramāṇaṃ syādūrdhvamekhalayā saha | iti siddhāntaśekharavacanācca 
mekhalayā saha hastamānaṃ khātaṃ vadanti etanna ramyaṃ 
mekhalayānugamanena khātasyāpyanugamanaprasaṅgāt | khātaṃ 
kuṇḍāyatestulyamaṅgatvaṃ tasya kīrtitam | sannipatyopakāreṇa 
mekhalāderviṃśiṣyate || iti yoginīhṛdayavacanāt sannipatyopakārasya 
khātasyārādupakārāṅgamekhalayā saha nirvāhānaucityāt tathoktapakṣasyaiva 
niyuktatvāt || kiñca :

madhyamāṃgulimadhyasthaparvaṇaḥ pariṇāhataḥ |
tṛtīyāṃśo bhavedatra tantre sarvatra cāṃguliḥ || 1 ||

taiścaturbhirbhavenmuṣṭirvitastistattribhirguṇaiḥ |
aratnistaddvayena syāddhastastaddvayataḥ śive || 2 ||

taddvayaṃ tu bhavedvyāmastanmānā syānnaronnatiḥ |
ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulā sā syāt tanmānaiḥ kuṇḍakalpanam || 3 ||

iti śrītantrarājavacanāt kuṇḍasya 
ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulāyāmavistārasyāvaśyakatvāt pañcadaśāṃgulakhātapakṣe 
khātamadhyādārabhya mekhalordhvaparyantasya dvādaśa pañcadaśa naveti 
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulamātradarśanāt tasya pārśvadvaye'pi dvaiguṇyena 
dvāsaptatyaṃgulamātrayā caturviṃśatyaṃgulasya tṛtīyāṃśasya nyūnatvād 
dvādaśāṃguloccamekhalāsahitahastamātrakhāte tu pārśvadvaye'pi 
madhyapradeśād dvādaśa caturviṃśatirdvādaśeti 
gaṇanayāṣṭācatvāriṃśaddvaiguṇyena ṣaṇṇavatiriti 
proktasaṃkhyāparipūrṇatvāt 
hastamātrakhātayuktadvādaśāṃguloccamekhalāpakṣa eva śreyāniti | 
ekāṃgulavistārasya kaṇṭhasya vidyamānatvāt pārśvadvaye'pi tadgrahaṇena 
dvyaṃgulavistārādhikyāt ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulāyāmatvaṃ 
kuṇḍasyānupapannamiticenna kaṇṭhasyānāvaśyakatvāt | ata eva tantrarāje 
kaṇṭho noktaḥ | tarhi kaṇṭhākaraṇe'pi doṣaḥ śrūyate | satyaṃ tasya 
tantrarājavirodhādeva nyūnamekhalānyūnakhātaparatvaṃ kalpanīyamiti | 
tasmānmekhalayā saha khātapratipādakavacanāni ratnyaratnyādiṣu kuṇḍeṣu 
pañcāśadādihomavidhānena khātādhikyaprayojanābhāvāt tadviṣayakāṇi iti 
mantavyāni | athātra mekhalāḥ pañca vā kāryāḥ ṣaṭpañcābdhitripakṣakaiḥ | 
iti lakṣaṇasaṃgrahavacanāt | ṣaḍbāṇābdhivahninetramitāḥ syuḥ pañca 
mekhalāḥ | iti siddhāntaśekharavacanācca pañca vā mekhalāḥ kāryāḥ ||

tathā piṅgalāmate -

ṣaṣṭhāṃśenāṣṭamāṃśena mekhalādvitayaṃ matam |
ekā saḍaṃgulotsedhavistarā mekhalā matā || 1 ||

iti || atha kuṇḍānāmayathākaraṇe doṣā bhavantītyāha vasiṣṭhaḥ -

anekadoṣadaṃ kuṇḍamatra nyūnādhikaṃ yadi |
tasmātsamyak parīkṣyaivaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatā || 1 ||

iti || tatra doṣānāha viśvakarmā -

khātādhike bhavedrogī hīne dhenudhanakṣayaḥ |
vakrakuṇḍe tu santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhale || 1 ||

mekhalārahite śoko'bhyadhike vittasaṃkṣayaḥ |
bhāryāvināśakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ yonyā vinā kṛtam || 2 ||

apatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yatkaṇṭhavarjitam ||

iti || tathā kriyāsāgare -

nyūnādhikapramāṇaṃ yatkuṇḍaṃ jarjaramekhalam |
śṛṅgārarahitaṃ yacca yajamānavināśakṛt || 1 ||

iti || tathā jayadrathayāmale -

sūtrādhike suhṛddveṣo mānahīne daridratā |
vāgrodhaḥ kaṇṭhahīne syādasiddhirnyūnakhātake || 1 ||

p. 237) adhike cāsurabhogo mānenādhikamekhale |
vyādhayaḥ saṃpravartante viyonau syādapasmṛtiḥ || 2 ||

uccāṭaḥ sphuṭite chidrasaṃkule vācyatā bhavet |

iti | itthaṃ nindāśravaṇād yathoktalakṣaṇasampannāni sarvāṇi kuṇḍāni 
kāryāṇi iti || atha kaṇṭhaḥ | tatra vasiṣṭhaḥ : kaṇṭho'ṣṭayavamātraḥ syāt 
kuṇḍe tu karamātrake | iti || tathā kālottare :

khātādbāhyo'ṃgulaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ sarvakuṇḍeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ |
caturviṃśatikaṃ bhāgamaṃgulaṃ parikalpayet || 1 ||

iti || atha yoniḥ vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

mekhalāmadhyataḥ kuryātpaścime dakṣiṇe'pi vā |
yoniṃ suśobhanāṃ kiñcinnimnāmunnālikāṃ śanaiḥ || 1 ||

agreṇa kuṇḍābhimukhīṃ kiñcida spṛṣṭamekhalām |
kumbhadvayasamāyuktāmaśvatthadalasannibhām || 2 ||

iti || tathā ca vasiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām -

yoniśca madhyame bhāge prāṅmukhī madhyasaṃsthitā |
aṣṭāṃgulaiśca vistīrṇā cāyatā dvādaśāṃgulaiḥ || 1 ||

pṛṣṭhonnatā gajoṣṭhī ca sacchidrā madhyatonnatā |

iti | sacchidrā madhye | madhye tvājyadhṛtiḥ smṛtā iti trailokyasāravacanāt 
ājyadhṛtiriti yonimadhye gartaṃ kartavyamityāhuḥ sāmpradāyikāḥ || tathā 
lakṣaṇasaṃgrahe :

īṣatkuṇḍapraviṣṭāgrā jināṃśakṛtamekhalā |
mekhalārthaṃ pṛthagbhūmirna grāhyā bāhyataḥ priye || 1 ||

iti | yonikṣetre tu sā kāryā iti nāradaḥ | kuṇḍe trayaṃśena vistārā 
yonirucchrāyatoṃ'gulā | kuṇḍārdhena tu dīrghā syāt | iti | tathā trailokyasāre 
dairghyāt sūryāṃgulā nālatrayaṃśonā vistāreṇa tu | ekāṃgulocchritā sā tu | 
iti nālatryaṃśonāṣṭāṃgulavistārā nālasya dvādaśāṃguladairghyāditi | 
svāyambhuve'pi mekhalāmadhyato yoniḥ kuṇḍārdhā tryaṃśavistṛtā iti | 
vistāro mūladeśe pippalapatrākṛtitvāt dvihastādikuṇḍeṣvanayā rītyā 
tattakuṇḍārdhaṃ dīrghā tattattṛtīyāṃśavistārā tattaccaturviṃśāṃśoccā ca 
yoniḥ kāryā ||

taduktaṃ somaśambhau -

kuṇḍānāṃ yaścaturviṃśo bhāgaḥ soṃ'gulasaṃjñakaḥ |
vibhajya tena kartavyā mekhalākaṇṭhanābhayaḥ || 1 ||

iti | siddhāntaśekhare'pi - caturviṃśatimo bhāgaḥ kuṇḍānāmaṃgulaṃ smṛtam 
| iti | dīrghārkaparvabhiryonirvistāreṇa ṣaḍaṃgulā | unnatidvyaṃgulenonā syāt | 
ityuktam | atrāṣṭāṃgulasaḍaṃgulayorekāṃguladvyaṃgulayośca vikalpaḥ | 
tathā hoturagre yonirāsāmuparyaśvatthapatravat | iti śāradāvacanāt yoniḥ 
sarvatra hoturagre proktavidhinā sthāpyeti | tatra catuṣkuṇḍapakṣe caturasre 
ardhacandre kuṇḍe ca yonirdakṣiṇabhāgasthamekhalopari sthāpyā 
tayorhotroruttarābhimukhatvāt | anyakuṇḍayoḥ paścimamekhalopari yoniḥ 
sthāpyā tayorhotroḥ pūrvābhimukhatvāt ||

dakṣasthā pūrvayāmye tu jalasthā paścimottare |
pañcamasyāpi kuṇḍasya yonirdakṣiṇadiksthitā || 1 ||

iti trailokyasāravacanāt |
pañcamasyācāryakuṇḍasyetyarthaḥ | atra kuṇḍapakṣe tu - 
prāgagniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ proktā yonirudaṅmukhī | śeṣāṇāṃ prāṅmukhī 
proktā iti tantrāntaravacanāt pūrvāgneyayāmyeṣu udaṅmukhī yoniranyeṣu 
prāṅmukhī navamasya tu prāgvadeva | etena yonikuṇḍe'pi yoniḥ kartavyeti kecit | 
tanna yonikuṇḍe yonimabjakuṇḍe nābhiṃ ca varjayet | iti viśvakarmavacanāt | 
āsāṃ mekhalānāṃ nālamuktaṃ tantrarāje bahiḥsthamekhalāmadhyādārabhya 
nijanālakam | vitastimātrakam iti | bahiḥsthamekhalāmadhyāt 
tanmadhyagatacaturasrapīṭhādityarthaḥ | tathaiva taṭṭīkākṛtā manoramākāreṇa 
vyākhyātatvāt | ācāryacaraṇaistu - yonistatpaścimāyāmatha diśi 
caturasrasthalārabdhanālā ityuktaṃ tatra padmapādācāryaiḥ - 
mekhalātrayādbahiścaturaṃgulāyāmavistāraṃ kṛtvā tatra nālaṃ sthāpyamiti 
vyākhyātam | vitastimātraṃ dvādaśāṃgulamātram || prayogasāre tu -

p. 238) yonyāḥ paścimato nālamāyāme caturaṃgulam |
tridvyekāṃgulavistāraṃ kramānnyūnāgramiṣyate || 1 ||

iti caturaṃgulamānena nālamuktam | etaccaturaṃgulaṣaḍaṃgulādi 
svalpamekhalāpakṣe jñeyam || nābhimāha tantrarāje -

nābhiṃ kuryāttu sarvatra kuṇḍamadhye vidhānataḥ |
aṣṭacchadaṃ sarojaṃ tu vidadhyāccāruvigraham || 1 ||

caturbhiraṃgulaiḥ kuryāt karṇikāṃ dalameva ca |
vistārādapi cotsedhaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhirudāhṛtam || 2 ||

iti || śāradāyām -

kuṇḍānāṃ kalpayedantarnābhimambujasaṃnibham |
tattatkuṇḍānurūpaṃ vā mānamasya nigadyate || 1 ||

muṣṭyaratnyekahastānāṃ nābhirutsedhatārataḥ |
dvitrivedāṃgulopetaḥ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayet || 2 ||

yavadvayakrameṇaiva nābhiṃ pṛthagudāradhīḥ |
nābhikṣetraṃ tridhā bhittvā tataḥ kurvīta karṇikām || 3 ||

bahiraṃśadvayenāṣṭau patrāṇi parikalpayet |

iti nābhilakṣaṇamuktaṃ tatra yathāramyaṃ jñeyam | ātape kṣatriye nābhiḥ 
prāṇyaṅge'pi dvayo riti nābhiśabdā puliṅge'pyasti || atha vāstupūjā | tatra 
śrītantrarāje -

caturasrākṛtiḥ kaścidasuraḥ sarvanāśakaḥ |
purā tasya vadhāyaiva sarve devāḥ samudyamam || 1 ||

kṛtvā nihantumudyukāstairavadhyo'bhavadvarāt |
āvayostannirāsāya māmetyākathayaṃstathā || 2 ||

kathayāsmākamadhunā tadvāstupuruṣasya tu |
darpaśāntirna cedasya viśvamāsīdupadrutam || 3 ||

ityuktaṃ tairmayā proktaṃ nidhanaṃ tasya duḥśakam |
khātvā tamavanau tasya śarīre sthāpayettathā || 4 ||

nityaśaśca tripañcāśanniḥspandākramaṇāya vai |
niyojya teṣāṃ ye pūjāvimukhāstaiḥ kṛtāni tu || 5 ||

sukṛtāni samādadhyurduṣkṛtāni ca kurvate |
tasmātteṣāmarcanaṃ tu pratyabdaṃ kurvatāṃ sadā || 6 ||

śubhānyevāsu jāyante nāśubhāni kadāpi ca |

iti || taccakrādimāha -

taccakrādividhānaṃ tu yathāvadabhidhīyate |
kṛtvā samalatāṃ bhūmiṃ caturasrākṛtiṃ śubhām || 1 ||

aṣṭāṣṭakodyatapadāṃ koṇasūtrasamanvitām |
catuṣpadayute tasyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhe ca deśikaḥ || 2 ||

brahmāṇamarcayettatra catuṣpadayute punaḥ |
prādakṣiṇyena pūrvādi yajet koṣṭhacatuṣṭaye || 3 ||

aryakaṃ ca vivasvantaṃ mitramanyaṃ mahīdharam |
koṇārdhakoṣṭhayorekamekaṃ mantrī samarcayet || 4 ||

vahnyādīśāntamabhito vakṣyamāṇeṣvanukramāt |
sāvitraḥ savitā śakra indrajidrudratajjitau || 5 ||

āpāpavatsakau ceti proktāsteṣṭau tu nāmataḥ |
koṇārdhakoṇapārśveṣu vahnyādīśāntamarcayet || 6 ||

śarva guhaṃ cāryamaṇaṃ jambhakaṃ pilipicchakam |
carakiṃ ca vidāriṃ ca pūtānāṃ caiva deśikaḥ || 7 ||

tataḥ pūrvādiparato yajedaṣṭau diśaṃ prati |
īśānaścā (tha parjanyo jayantaḥ śakrabhāskarau || 8 ||

satyo vṛṣo'ntarikṣaśca pūrvāśākoṣṭhagāḥ kramāt |
agniḥ pūṣā ca vitatho yamo'tha gṛharakṣakaḥ || 9 ||

gandharvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇakoṣṭhagāḥ |
nir-ṛtiśca) tathā dauvārikaḥ sugrīvakastathā || 10 ||

varuṇaḥ puṣpadantaścāsuraḥ śoṣākhyarogakau |
paścimāśāsthakoṣṭheṣu pūjyā ete yathākramam || 11 ||

vāyurnāgastathā mukhyaḥ somo bhallāṭakastathā |
argalo ditirapyevamaditiśca yathākramam || 12 ||

koṣṭheṣūttarasastheṣu devā ete samīritāḥ |
citrai rajobhirāpūrya devatānāṃ padāni vai || 13 ||

vrīhimudgayavaiḥ kṣaudraghṛtadugdhāplutaiḥ kramāt |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ cāṣṭottaraviṃśatimeva vā || 14 ||

pratyekaṃ taddhuned dravyairmantraistadvacca pāyasaiḥ |
baliṃ ca teṣāṃ kurvīta pāyasairvyañjanānvitaiḥ || 15 ||

sasitairdugdhakadalīphalāpūpādisaṃyutaiḥ |

p. 239) iti || athaitaccakraracanāprakāraḥ - pūjāvidhiṃ ca vakṣyate - tatra 
maṇḍapasya nair-ṛtakoṇe hastamātravistārāyāmāṃ vitastyunnatāṃ 
samacaturasrāṃ vedikāmatiślakṣṇāṃ kṛtvā prākpratyagāyatā 
dakṣiṇottarāyatāśca nava nava rekhāḥ kṛtvā samāntarālāni 
catuṣṣaṣṭikoṣṭhāni kṛtvā tatra vāyukoṇādāgneyakoṇagataṃ nair-
ṛtakoṇādīśānagataṃ ceti karṇasūtradvayamāsphālya vāstucakraṃ nirmāya 
tanmadhyakoṣṭha catuṣṭayamekīkṛtya tadbahiḥ prāgādicaturdikṣu pratidiśaṃ 
catvāri koṣṭhāni madhyakoṣṭhasaṃlagnānyekīkṛtya 
tripañcāśaddevatāsthānāni parikalpya tāni sthānāni 
vakṣyamāṇarajobhirmanoharaṃ yathā bhavati tathā samyagāpūrya 
puṣpāñjalimādāya brahmāditripañcāśaddevatā ihāgacchatāgacchateti 
puṣpāñjaliprakṣepeṇāvāhya brahmāditripañcāśaddevatā yathāsthānamiha 
tiṣṭhata tiṣṭhateti saṃsthāpya brahmādibhya idamāsanam iti puṭapuṣpāñjaliṃ 
dattvā sarvamadhye brahmaṇe namaḥ | pūrvādicaturdikṣu oṃ aryakāya namaḥ oṃ 
vivasvate namaḥ oṃ mitrāya namaḥ oṃ mahīdharāya namaḥ iti prādakṣiṇyena 
sampūjyāgneyādikoṇacatuṣkagatārdhakoṣṭhāṣṭake 
prādakṣiṇyenāgneyādīśānaparyantaṃ oṃ sāvitrāya namaḥ oṃ savitre namaḥ oṃ 
śukrāya namaḥ oṃ śakrajite namaḥ oṃ rudrāya namaḥ oṃ rudrajite namaḥ oṃ āpāya 
namaḥ oṃ āpavatsakāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
tadbahiḥsthavedyāmāgneyādikoṇacatuṣkagatakarṇasūtrabhinnakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaya-
pārśvagatakoṣṭhāṣṭake āgneyādīśānaparyantaṃ oṃ śarvāya namaḥ oṃ 
guhāya namaḥ oṃ aryamṇe namaḥ oṃ jambhakāya namaḥ oṃ pilipicchakāya namaḥ oṃ 
carikyainamaḥ oṃ vidāryai namaḥ oṃ pūtanāyai namaḥ iti sampūjya 
tadbahirgatavīthīcatuṣṭaye prācīdiggatavīthyāmīśānādyāgneyāntaṃ oṃ 
īśānāya namaḥ oṃ parjanyāya namaḥ oṃ jayantāya namaḥ oṃ śakrāya namaḥ oṃ 
bhāskarāya namaḥ oṃ satyāya namaḥ oṃ vṛṣāya namaḥ oṃ antarikṣāya namaḥ 
ityaṣṭau devatāḥ sampūjya dakṣiṇavīthyāmāgneyādinair-ṛtāntaṃ oṃ agnaye 
namaḥ oṃ pūṣṇe namaḥ oṃ vitathāya namaḥ oṃ yamāya namaḥ oṃ gṛharakṣakāya 
namaḥ oṃ gandharvāya namaḥ oṃ bhṛṅgarājāya namaḥ oṃ mṛgāya namaḥ iti 
sampūjya tataḥ paścimavīthyāṃ nair-ṛtādivāyavyāntaṃ oṃ nir-ṛtaye namaḥ oṃ 
dauvārikāya namaḥ oṃ sugrāvāya namaḥ oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ oṃ puṣpadantāya 
namaḥ oṃ asurāya namaḥ oṃ śoṣāya namaḥ oṃ rogāya namaḥ iti 
sampūjyottaravīthyāṃ vāyavyādīśānāntaṃ oṃ vāyave namaḥ oṃ nāgāya 
namaḥ oṃ mukhyāya namaḥ oṃ somāya namaḥ oṃ bhallāṭakāya namaḥ oṃ argalāya 
namaḥ oṃ dityai namaḥ oṃ adityai namaḥ iti gandhapuṣpādyaistripañcāśaddevatāḥ 
sampūjya kuṇḍasthaṇḍilādau vakṣyamāṇavidhināgnisthāpanaṃ kṛtvā oṃ 
brahmaṇe svāhā aryakāya svāhā ityādipūjitadevatānāṃ 
svāhāntairnāmamantraiḥ pratyekaṃ 
vrīhiyavamudgairdhṛtamadhudugdhapariplutaiḥ saghṛtaiḥ 
pāyasaiścaikaikadravyeṇāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyaṃ 
vaikaikadevatānāmnā hutvā oṃ brahmaṇe eṣa balirnamaḥ ityādi 
pūjitadevatābhyastattannāmnā 
tiladugdhakadalīphalāpūpanānāvyañjanānvitapāyasaistattatpade tasyaitasyai 
baliṃ nivedayet || iti vāstupūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha vāstupūjāphalaṃ tadakaraṇe phalavaiparītyaṃ ca tantrarāje -

evaṃ siṃhagate bhānau pūrṇāyāṃ prativatsaram |
svagehe vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍale tu samācaret || 1 ||

na bālamaraṇavyādhibhūtapretādikāni ca |
na sarpapīḍā nānyonyakalahādyaśubhāni ca || 2 ||

putrapautradhanārogyapaśudāsīsamṛddhibhāk |
arogī vijayī khyātaḥ ciraṃ jīvati tadgṛhe || 3 ||

rājaveśmasu sarvatra tathā ca mahiṣīgṛhe |
sacivāmātyasenānībhavaneṣu pure tathā || 4 ||

vidadhyāt prativarṣaṃ tu proktasiddhyai tu deśikaḥ |
na ceduktānyathārūpaphalaiḥ kleśo'niśaṃ bhavet || 5 ||

iti || athāṃkurārpaṇavidhiḥ tantrāntare -

saptabhirnavabhirvāpi dinairdīkṣādināt purā |
bījāropaṇakarmedaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvakāmadam || 1 ||

maṇḍapottaradigbhāge susaṃvṛtatare pare |
bhavane maṇḍale kuryādeke prāgvaruṇāyatam || 2 ||

yāmyodīcyāyataṃ tvanye pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
padāni dvādaśātra syusteṣu sthānatrayaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

catuṣṭayapadopetaṃ padānyāpūrayet tataḥ |
pītaraktasitaśyāmai rajobhirvahnipūrvakam || 4 ||

īśāntaṃ kramatastvāhuḥ pātrāṇi trividhāni ca |
vaiṣṇavyaḥ pālikāḥ proktāścaturviṃśāṃgulocchritāḥ || 5 ||

p. 240) vairiñcyaḥ pañcamukhyaścāpyucchritāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃgulaiḥ |
śaivāḥ śarāvāścatvāro bhānvaṃgulasamucchrayāḥ || 6 ||

prakṣālya sūtraiḥ saṃveṣtya sthāneṣvagnyādi vinyaset |
śālipūrṇeṣu gandhādidarbhakūrcayuteṣu ca || 7 ||

pūrayet tāni pātrāṇi vālukāmṛtakarīṣakaiḥ |
śaṅkhasvanena nādaiśca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇāśiṣā || 8 ||

kṣālayed dugdhavaṃbījaistato bījāni nirvapet |
tāni priyaṃguśyāmākatilasarṣapaśālayaḥ || 9 ||

mudgāḍhakīsuniṣpāvakhanvamāṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
haridrābhiśca saṃsicya vastrairāchādayedguruḥ || 10 ||

sandhyayorubhayo rātrau pradadyāduttamaṃ balim |
trividhasyāpi pātrasya saptasvapi dineṣu ca || 11 ||

prathame'hani bhūtebhyastilā lājā haridrayā |
dadhisaktvannamityuktaṃ pitṛbhyastilataṇḍulāḥ || 12 ||

tṛtīye'hani yakṣebhyaḥ karambhā lājasaṃyutāḥ |
caturthe'hani nāgebhyo nārikelaghṛtāplutam || 13 ||

saktupiṣṭaṃ ca samproktaṃ pañcame brahmaṇe balim |
padmākṣatāśca ṣaṣṭhe'hni śivāyāpūpasaṃyutam || 14 ||

annaṃ syātsaptame cāhni viṣṇave syādguḍaudanam |
yadi syānnavarātraṃ ca tadobhayadine balim || 15 ||

viṣṇave syācca dugdhānnaṃ kṛsaraṃ ca kramāttataḥ |
praṇavādyairhṛdantaiḥ svanāmabhirbalimantrakaḥ || 16 ||

iti || karambhā dadhisaktavaḥ | padmākṣatāḥ padmabījāni | kṛsarastilamudgaiḥ 
saha siddha odanaḥ || athaitanmaṇḍalaracanāprakāraḥ - tatra 
dīkṣādinātpūrvameva navabhiḥ saptabhirvā dinaiḥ 
prāṅnirmitamaṇḍapasyottarabhāge susaṃvṛtaṃ gṛhaṃ nirmāya tatra 
gomayopalipte susame bhūtale prākpratyagāyatāḥ pañcahastadīrghāḥ 
pañcarekhā yāmyodīcyāyatā vitastyantarālāścaikādaśa rekhāḥ kṛtvā 
catvāriṃśatkoṣṭhopetaṃ sārdhadvayahastavistāropetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā 
tatrodaggatakoṣṭhānyekīkṛtya vīthīḥ kṛtvā madhyacatuṣkobhayapārśvayoḥ 
koṣṭhadvayaṃ koṣṭhadvayaṃ sammārjyāvasiṣṭacatuṣkatrayātmakaṃ 
dvādaśapadopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya catuścatuḥkoṣṭhairekamekaṃ sthānaṃ 
brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ paścimamadhyamapūrvakrameṇa parikalpya tatra 
paścimādicatuṣkatraye'pi praticatuṣkaṃ āgneyakoṣṭhamārabhya 
īśānakoṣṭhaparyantaṃ pītaraktaśvetaśyāmavarṇaiḥ rajobhiḥ 
praticatuṣkamekena rajasā ekaikaṃ koṣṭhamiti krameṇa dvādaśa 
koṣṭhānyāpūrya tatra sthānatraye madhyamacatuṣke 
viṣṇudaivatyāścaturviṃśatyaṃgulonnatavistṛtiyuktā ḍamarukākārāścatusraḥ 
pālikā madhye pippaladalāmrapallavaiḥ saha śvetasūtreṇa samveṣṭitāḥ 
saṃsthāpya tathā paścimacatuṣkepyekasmin pātre pañca pātrāṇi yathā 
bhavanti tathā śilpivaranirmitāni prāgvat ḍamarukākārāṇi 
ṣoḍaśāṃgulonnatavistṛtiyuktāni brahmadaivatyāni catvāri pātrāṇi tathaiva 
pippalādidalayuktāni saṃsthāpya tathā pūrvacatuṣke 
dvādaśāṃgulonnatavistṛtibhṛtaḥ śivadaivatyā prāgvat 
pippalādidalayuktāścatvāraḥ śāravāḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ iti dvādaśapātrāṇi 
prakṣālitāni dvādaśakoṣṭhe pratikoṣṭhamekamekaṃ pātraṃ śālipuñjeṣu 
gandhākṣatakūrcayukteṣu saṃsthāpya tānitāni pātrāṇi vālukāmṛtkarīṣakaiḥ 
sampūryaikasmin nūtanabhāṇḍe svarṇādiracite mṛṇmaye vā 
priyaṃguśyāmākatilasarṣapaśālimudgāḍhakīniṣpāvakhalvamāṣākhyāni 
daśadhānyānyekīkṛtya vamiti amṛtabījena godugdhaiḥ prakṣālya 
śaṅkhasvanādipañcavādyapuraḥsaraṃ teṣu pātreṣu brahmadaivatyeṣu 
prathamaṃ tato viṣṇudaivatyeṣu tataḥ śivadaivatyeṣviti krameṇa bījāni nirvāpya 
haridrāmiśrajalaiḥ saṃsicya nūtanavastrairāchādya sandhyayorardharātre ca 
saptasvapi dineṣu pratidinaṃ baliṃ dadyāt | tatra prathamadivase 
tilalājāsaktuśālyodanāni haridrācūrṇasaṃyuktānyekīkṛtya kavalatrayaṃ 
niṣpādya trividhasyāpi pātrasya samīpe sarvabhūtāni ihāgacchateha tiṣṭhateti 
bhūtānyāvāhya saṃsthāpya oṃ sarvabhūtebhyo namaḥ iti gandhādibhiḥ 
sampūjya sarvabhūtabalidravyāya namaḥ iti balidravyaṃ sampūjya hastatale jalaṃ 
gṛhītvā vāmahastena balipātraṃ spṛśan oṃ sarvabhūtebhya eṣa balirnamaḥ iti 
balipātropari jalaṃ niḥkṣipya balimutsṛjet | evaṃ viṣṇupātrasamīpe 
śivapātracatuṣkasamīpe ca baliṃ dadyāditi proktakālatraye'pi balidānavidhiḥ | 
atra maṇḍalasya caturdikṣu balirdeyaḥ iti kecidāhustatra yathāgurūpadeśaṃ 
kāryamiti | tato dvitīyadine pitṛbhyastilataṇḍulaiḥ prāguktaparipāṭyaiva 
proktakālatraye'pi baliṃ dadyāt | caturthe'hni nāgebhyo 
nārikelajalāplutasaktupiṣṭabaliḥ | pañcamadivase brahmaṇe padmākṣatabaliḥ | 
ṣaṣṭhadivase śivāyāpūpasayutaudanabaliḥ | saptamadivase viṣṇuve 
guḍaudanabaliḥ | navarātrapakṣe viṣṇava evāṣṭamadivase 

p. 241) dugdhaudanabaliḥ navamadine kṛsarabalirdeyaḥ | atra sarvatra balidāne 
prathamadinaprokta eva vidhirjñeyaḥ tattannāmnā pūjanaṃ balyutsarjanaṃ ca 
jñeyamiti | atra navasvapi dineṣu pratidinaṃ tattaddevatāyā balidānānantaraṃ 
daśadikpālebhyo'pi tattaddikṣu oṃ indrāya eṣa balirmamaḥ ityāditattannāmnā 
ghṛtaśarkarāsahitapāyasena balirdeyaḥ || iti bījāropaṇavidhiḥ ||

atha dīkṣākālaḥ | tatrādau māsāḥ | tatra manthānabhairavatantre -

caitre duḥkhāya dīkṣā syādvaiśākhe sarvasiddhidā |
jyaiṣṭhe mṛtyupradā sā syādāṣāḍhe bandhunāśinī || 1 ||

śrāvaṇe vṛddhidā nṛṇāṃ nabhasye duḥkhadā matā |
āśvine sarvasiddhiḥ syāt kārtike jñānadāyinī || 2 ||

śubhadā mārgaśīrṣe ca pauṣe meghāvināśinī |
māghe suvarṇalābhaḥ syāt phālgune sarvasiddhidā || 3 ||

iti || tathā tantrāntare -

madhumāse bhaveddukhaṃ mādhave ratnasaṃcayaḥ |
maraṇaṃ bhavati jyaiṣṭhe cāṣāḍhe bandhunāśanam || 1 ||

samṛddhiḥ śrāvaṇe nūnaṃ bhavedbhādrapade kṣayaḥ |
prajānāmāśvine māse sarvataḥ śubhameva hi || 2 ||

jñānaṃ syātkārtike saukhyaṃ mārgaśīrṣe bhavatyapi |
pauṣe jñānakṣayo māghe bhavenmedhāvivardhanam || 3 ||

phālgune'pi samṛddhiḥ syānmalamāsaṃ parityajet | iti | -------- (?)

dadanmantraṃ labhenmantrī saptajanmasu |

iti śivayāmalavacanādāśvinamāso dīkṣāyāṃ vihito'pi niṣiddhaḥ |
mahābalacaturdaśī śivarātriḥ || tathā śrīkaṇṭhasaṃhitāyām :

śaratkāle ca vaiśākhe dīkṣā śreṣṭhaphalapradā |
mārgaphālgunake śreṣṭhā jyaiṣṭhe caiva tu sādhamā || 1 ||

māghamāse tu śubhadā duṣṭā sāṣāḍhamāsake |
ānandadā śrāvaṇe sā pauṣe bhādre ca ninditā || 2 ||

iti || tathā ca jñānārṇave - śuklapakṣe śubhadine śubhavāre varānane | 
mantrādyārambhaṇaṃ kuryāt iti || tathā kālottare muktikāmaiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe 
bhūmikāmaiḥ site tathā | dīkṣā kāryā mahādevi iti || tathā śaivāgame :

śuklapakṣe prakurvīta kṛṣṇe vā deśikottamaḥ |
śukle sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kṛṣṇe madhyamato bhavet || 1 ||

iti || atha nakṣatrāṇi cintāmaṇau -

aśvinī rohiṇī cārdrā tathā puṣyottarātrayam |
hastacitrāsvātimaitraviśākhāśca dhaniṣṭhayā || 1 ||

punarvasū revatī ca dīkṣāyāmuttamā matā |

iti | maitramanūrādhā | tathā kāmadhenau -

rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣaṃ ca tathā puṣyaśca hastakaḥ |
svātīrādhe revatī ca tathā cāpyuttarātrayam || 1 ||

śubhānyetāni dīkṣāyāṃ nakṣatrāṇi varānane |

iti | atha niṣiddhāni piṅgalāmate -

kṛttikāyāṃ manastāpo bharaṇyāṃ ca mahāpadaḥ |
pūrvāyāṃ daṇḍayedrājā maghāyāṃ mṛtyumādiśet || 1 ||

mūlena kalahaṃ vidyājjyeṣṭhā bhavati hānidā |
pūrvāṣāḍhe bhayaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇe'nekarogadā || 2 ||

śatabhiṣāyāṃ kṣobhadā santāpaṃ bhādrapadā bhavet |

iti || atha tithayaḥ -

pūrṇimā pañcamī caiva dvitīyā saptamī tathā |
trayodaśī ca daśamī praśastāa sarvakāmadā || 1 ||

iti || tathā śrīkaṇṭhasaṃhitāyām -

p. 242) dvitīyā saptamī śreṣṭhā ṣaṣṭhī sarvatra ninditā |
dvādaśyāmapi kartavyaṃ trayodaśyāmathāpi vā || 1 ||

iti | vijayamālinītantre -

pañcamyekādaśī śuklā saptamī ca trayodaśī |
daśamī śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī ca viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

iti ratnasāgare -

tṛtīyā vihitā nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhī sarvatra ninditā |
saptamyāṃ dhanalābhaḥ syādaṣṭamyāṃ gurunāśanam || 1 ||

navamyāmṛkthanāśaḥ syāddaśamī sukhadāyinī |
ekādaśyāṃ bhavellābho dhanasya vṛṣabhasya ca || 2 ||

dvādaśyāṃ dhanalābhaḥ syāt trayodaśyāṃ sadodayaḥ |
śiṣyahāniścaturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsī tu siddhidā || 3 ||

amāyāṃ putranāśaḥ syāt pratipadvṛddhināśinī |

iti || atha devatāviśeṣe tithiviśeṣaḥ | kālottare -

brahmaṇaḥ paurṇamāsyuktā dvādaśī cakradhāriṇaḥ |
caturdaśī śivasyoktā vācaḥ proktā trayodaśī || 1 ||

dvitīyā tu śrīyaḥ proktā pārvatyāśca tṛtīyakā |
caturthī gaṇanāthasya bhānoḥ proktā tu saptamī || 2 ||

iti || atha vāsarāṇi tatra mantrasadbhāve -

mantrārambho ravau śukle budhe jīve viśeṣataḥ |
śanau mṛtyuḥ kṣayaṃ bhaume some sarvatra niṣphalam || 1 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

ravau gurau budhe śukre kartavyaṃ parameśvari |
iti jñātvā varārohe mantraṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 1 ||

iti | vijayamālinītantre -

ravau buddhimavāpnoti śukre caiva dhanāgamam |
budhe'bhiyogarahitā gurau putrānvito bhavet || 1 ||

śanyaṅgārakayormṛtyuravidyā somake bhavet |
iti jñātvā varārohe dīkṣāṃ dadyādviśāladhīḥ || 2 ||

iti || atha yogāstantraratnāvalyām -

yogāśca prītirāyuṣmānsaubhāgyaḥ śobhanastathā |
sukarmā ca dhṛtirvṛddhirdhruvaḥ siddhiśca harṣaṇaḥ || 1 ||

varīyāṃśca śivaḥ siddho brahmā aindraśca ṣoḍaśa |

iti || tathātra yogāstatra vasiṣṭhaḥ -

pūrvāṣāḍhāṃ pratipadaṃ pañcamīṃ kṛttikāmatha |
pūrvābhādrapadā ṣaṣṭhī daśamī rohiṇī tathā || 1 ||

dvādaśyāṃ sarpanakṣatramāryamṇaṃ ca trayodaśī |
nakṣatralumpā ityete devānāmapi nāśadāḥ || 2 ||

iti | sarpanakṣatramaśleṣā | uttarāphālgunī āryamṇam || atha jyotiṣaśāstre 
karaṇāni -

śubhāni karaṇānyāhurdīkṣāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
śakunyādīni viṣṭiṃ ca viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet || 1 ||

iti | ātrādipadena kistughnacatuṣpadanāgānāṃ grahaṇam || atha lagnāni 
tantrāntare -

mantrādyārambhaṇaṃ meṣe dhanadhānyapradaṃ bhavet |
vṛṣe maraṇamāpnoti mithune'patyanāśanam || 1 ||

karkaṭe sarvasiddhiḥ syāt siṃhe meghāvināśanam |
kanyā lakṣmīpradā nityaṃ tulāyāṃ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 2 ||

vṛścike sarvasiddhiḥ syāddhanurjñānavināśanam |
makaraḥ putradaḥ proktaḥ kumbho dhanasamṛddhidaḥ || 3 ||

mīno duḥkhaprado nityamevaṃ rāśiphalaṃ priye |

iti | tathā ca rudrayāmale -

mīne siṃhe tathā cāpe vṛṣe hāniḥ prajāyate |
meṣe sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kanyā ratnapradā bhavet || 1 ||

tulāyāṃ dhanadhānyaṃ syādvṛścike sarvasiddhayaḥ |
makare putralābhaḥ syātkumbhe paśusamṛddhayaḥ || 2 ||

mithune paśunāśaḥ syāt karkaṭo rājyado mataḥ |
evaṃ lagnaphalaṃ jñātvā mantraṃ dadyād viśāladhiḥ || 3 ||

p. 243) vṛṣamīnaṃ tathā cāpaṃ siṃhalagnaṃ vivarjayet |
sukhadaṃ śubhadaṃ nityaṃ kanyādyaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 4 ||

iti || atha dīkṣālagnāt sthānaviśeṣeṣu sthitānāṃ grahāṇāṃ 
śubhāśubhaphalāni -

triṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ śubhāḥ kendratrikoṇagāḥ |
dīkṣāyāṃ tu śubhāḥ sarve randhrasthāḥ sarvanāśakāḥ || 1 ||

iti | āyaḥ ekādaśasthānam | lagnacaturthasaptamadaśamasthānānāṃ 
kendrasaṃjñā pañcamanavamasyānayostrikoṇasaṃjñā | 
sūryaśanirāhuketukujāḥ pāpayuto budhaḥ kṣīṇaśaśī ca pāpāḥ 
gurubhṛgusutapāparahitabudhapūrṇacandrāḥ śubhāḥ | randhramaṣṭamasthānam 
| sarve navagrahā api || atha candraphalam - janmatriṣaṭsaptaikādaśapaṃktigaḥ 
śaśī śubhaphalaprado mataḥ | netradvādaśavasupañcavedagraharāśigaḥ śaśī 
duṣṭaḥ smṛtaḥ || atha dīkṣāyāṃ kālaḥ tatra śaivāgame -

adhomukhe śubhe bhe ca candraśuddhau viśeṣataḥ |
kṛṣṇe tārābalaṃ kuryāt svanāmādivicintanam || 1 ||

dharmadaḥ prātaḥkālaḥ syāt saṅgavo rājyadaḥ smṛtaḥ |
madhyāhne sarvasiddhiḥ syāt sāyāhne sarvato bhaved || 2 ||

rajanī mantradāne tu niṣiddhā deśikottamaiḥ |
divā sarvaṃ prakurvīta siddhidaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 3 ||

iti || adhomukhanakṣatrāṇi tu -

mūlāgneyamaghādvidaivabharaṇīsārpāṇi pūrvātrayaṃ
jyotirvidbhiradhomukhaṃ hi navakaṃ bhānāmidaṃ kīrtitam |
vāpīkūpataḍākagartaparikhākhāto nidheruddhṛtiḥ
kṣepo dyūtabilapraveśagaṇanārambhāḥ prasiddhyanti ca || 1 ||

iti | dvidaivaṃ viśākhā viśākhānakṣatrasyendrāgnī devateti śrutiḥ || atha 
dīkṣāyāḥ kāla viśeṣastatra jñānārṇave -

mantrādyārambhaṇaṃ kuryādgrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
grahaṇāddevadeveśi kālaḥ sapta dināvadhi || 1 ||

pavitraparva deveśi vāmamevāśubhe dine |
kālacarcā na kartavyā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ || 2 ||

puṇyatīrthe kurukṣetre devīpīṭhacatuṣṭaye |

iti | tathā ratnasāgare -

sattīrthe'rkavidhugrāse'nantavāmanaparvaṇoḥ |
mantradīkṣāṃ prakurvāṇo māsarkṣādīnna śodhayet || 1 ||

iti | atra yadyapi

sūryagrahaṇakāle tu nānyadanveṣitaṃ bhavet |
sūryagrahaṇakālena samo nānyaḥ kadācana || 1 ||

tatra yadyatkṛtaṃ sarvamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet |
na māsatithivārādiśodhanaṃ sūryaparvaṇi || 2 ||

dadātīṣṭaṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt tasminkāle gurornaraḥ |
siddhirbhavati mantrasya vinābhyāsena vegataḥ || 3 ||

iti cintāmaṇikālikodbhavayoḥ sūryagrahaṇasyaiva vidhāyakavacanadarśanāt |

candragrahe tu yā dīkṣā yā dīkṣā vanacāriṇām |
janakasya tu dīkṣā dāridryaṃ saptajanmasu || 1 ||

iti yoginītantre candragrahe dīkṣāniṣedhavacanadarśanāt 
prāguktarajanīmantraniṣedhavacanācceti 
sūryoparāgakālo'pyuparāgasādhāraṇatayā prāguktaśivayāmalavacanena 
niṣiddhatvānnātyantaṃ praśasta ityavadheyam | kiṃtu :

candrasūryagrahe tīrthe siddhikṣetre śivālaye |
mantramātrasya kathanamupadeśaḥ sa ucyaye || 1 ||

iti kālikodbhavavacanānmantrāntareṣu vidhivaddīkṣitānāṃ doṣāvaha iti || atha 
kriyāvatī dīkṣā uttaratantre -

atha vakṣyāmi dīkṣāṇāṃ vidhānaṃ mantrakāmyāya |
yābhirvinā na labhyante sarvamantraphalāni vai || 1 ||

ātmalābhaṃ dadatyetāḥ kṣiṇvanti duritānyapi |
tena dīkṣā iti proktāstāsāṃ tattvavicārakaiḥ || 2 ||

tāśca krameṇa kathitāḥ kriyāmayyarṇamayyapi |
kalāmayī vedhamayī catasro jñānadāḥ śubhāḥ || 3 ||

p. 244) iti | pañcamīśvarītantre -

puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvādau brāhmaṇaiḥ svastipūrvakam |
pañcavādyaninādaiśca vedaghoṣaiḥ suhṛdvṛtaḥ || 1 ||

gatvā gurugṛhaṃ śiṣyaḥ praṇamya gurupādukām |
datvā varaṇasāmagrīṃ saṃkalpya vṛṇuyādgurum || 2 ||

uccāryāmukamantrasya grahaṇāya dvijottamaḥ |
gurutveneti sambhāṣya tvāmahaṃ ca tato vṛṇe || 3 ||

ityuktvā vṛṇuyācchiṣyo vṛto'smīti tato guruḥ |
yathocitaṃ guro karma kuruṣveti vadecchiśuḥ || 4 ||

karavāṇīti coccārya pañcavādyapuraḥsaram |
tataḥ śiṣyeṇa sahito yāyādyāgagṛhaṃ guruḥ || 5 ||

puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
hārakuṇḍalakeyuramudrikāṅgadabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 6 ||

hemayajñopavītaiśca madhuparkairyathāvidhi |
mahārghavastratāmbūlaiḥ phalapuṣpasugandhakaiḥ || 7 ||

avittaśāṭhyamabhyarcya yathāvad vṛṇuyād gurum |
ṛtvijo'pi tathābhyarcya vṛṇuyāduktasaṃkhyakān || 8 ||

iti || atha madhuparkavidhānamuktaṃ ḍāmare -

madhuparkavidhānaṃ te yathāvat kathayāmyaham |
śrīparṇīvṛkṣapīṭhāni hastamānāniḥ mānataḥ || 1 ||

aṣṭāṃgulasamucchrāyasahitāni samāni ca |
saptaviṃśatidarbhāṇāṃ veṇyo'gre granthibhūṣitāḥ || 2 ||

viṣṭare sarvayajñeṣu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
sukhoṣṇodakasampūrṇāḥ pādyārthe tāmragaṇḍakāḥ || 3 ||

śaṅkhā arghyapradānāya gandhapuṣpajalānvitāḥ |
dūrvodakasamāyuktāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 4 ||

kamaṇḍaluḥ sutāmrasya ācamyodakapūritaḥ |
sampuṭā madhuparkārthaṃ kāṃsyā daghyādipūritāḥ || 5 ||

mahāntyarghyāṇi dravyāṇi mudrikādyaṃ subhūṣaṇam |
mayūrapatracchatrāṇi soṣṇīṣāṇi samāharet || 6 ||

padukā āharettatra carmabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
anyatsmārte yadapyuktaṃ madhuparkasya pūjane || 7 ||

tatkṛtvā phalamāpnoti mahāyajñārhaṇopamam |
anyebhyo madhuparkasya viprebhyaḥ pūjanaṃ smṛtam || 8 ||

bhaktyā taddviguṇaṃ dadyādācāryāya subhaktimān |
anyairdvijaiḥ samaṃ yatra deśikasya prapūjanam || 9 ||

tasmin yajñe phalaṃ svalpamanāvṛṣṭau yathā kṣitiḥ |
deśikendro vidhānena snātvā nirvatitāhnikaḥ || 10 ||

maunamāsthāya bhūṣāḍhyo gacchedyāgagṛhaṃ prati |
ācāryaḥ pūrvadivase upaveśya samāsane || 11 ||

śiṣyaṃ mūlena saṃjaptaṃ dadyādvai dantadhāvanam |
dantān viśodhya purataḥ sthaṇḍile hastamātrake || 12 ||

caturasre pūjayet tatparīkṣeta tato guruḥ |
īśānāgre jñānalābhaḥ prāgagre bhūtiruttamā || 13 ||

āgneyāgre manastāpo bandhunāśaśca dakṣiṇe |
rākṣasāgre mṛtyubhayaṃ vāruṇyagre manaḥśucam || 14 ||

vāyavyāgre vyagratā ca kauverāgre sukhāvaham |
amaṅgalasthānapāte prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 15 ||

prāyaścittamagre puraścaraṇaprakaraṇe vakṣyate ||

tataḥ svapnaparīkṣāṃ ca kuryāddeśikasattamaḥ |
krūrasvapne'dhamā dīkṣā hyakrūre madhyamā matā || 16 ||

uttamasvapnapūrvā tu dīkṣā sarvottamā matā |

svapnalakṣaṇāni tannivedanaprakāraṃ duḥkhasvapne prāyaścittaṃ cāgre 
puraścaraṇaprakaraṇe vakṣyate ||

evaṃ vicārya purato guruḥ pūjāṃ samācaret |
vidhāyācamanaṃ tatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca || 17 ||

arghyodakena samprokṣya dvārapūjāṃ samācaret |
tataśca deśiko vighnān divyānālokanena ca || 18 ||

antarikṣagatānastrodakairutsārayet tataḥ |
pārthivān pārṣṇighātaistattribhirutsārya yatnataḥ || 19 ||

aṅgaṃ saṅkocya kiñcittu śākhāṃ vāmagatāṃ spṛśan |
utsāritānāṃ bhūtānāṃ dadadvartma tu dakṣiṇe || 20 ||

pādena dakṣiṇenātha praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam |

iti | dvārapūjā vakṣyate | dakṣiṇapādapuraḥsaraṃ praveśaḥ puṃdaivataviṣayaḥ 
śākte tu vāmapādapuraḥsarameva vāmapādaṃ puraskṛtya 
praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam | iti tripurārṇavavacanāt | tathā -

p. 245) brahmāṇaṃ vāstvadhīśaṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ diśi pūjayet |
arghyāmbunā ca gavyena yāgasthāne susecite || 21 ||

vīkṣaṇādyaistataḥ śuddhiṃ caturdvārāntamācaret |
samvīkṣya mūlamanunā hyastreṇa prokṣayet tataḥ || 22 ||

kuryāt tāḍanamastreṇa kavacenātha secayet |
śrīkhaṇḍāgarucandraiśca bhūṣite'streṇa saptadhā || 23 ||

japtāṃścandanasiddhārthadūrvābhasmākṣatān kuśān |
sajalān vikirenmantrī pratyūhaghnān hi maṇḍalam || 24 ||

mārjayedastramantreṇa tān mantrī darbhamuṣṭinā |
āsanāya tu vārddhānyā īśāne sthāpayecca tān || 25 ||

puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātha viprān santoṣya yatnataḥ |
vedikāyāṃ likhet paścāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 26 ||

tallakṣaṇamatho vakṣye sarvatantrānusārataḥ |
deśiko vedikāmadhye gomayenopalepite || 27 ||

pūrvoktakramayogena caturasraṃ prakalpayet |
catuṣkoṣṭhasamāyuktaṃ karṇasūtravibhūṣitam || 28 ||

tatra koṣṭhacatuṣkāntaḥsūtrāṇāṃ syāccatuṣṭayam |
koṇasthakoṣṭhamadhyeṣu dṛśyante matsyakā yathā || 29 ||

aindravāruṇagaṃ yugmaṃ saumyayāmyagatadvayam |
makareṣveṣu sūtrāṇi dadyāccatvāri mantravit || 30 ||

pūrvapaścimagaṃ tadvaddakṣottaragataṃ punaḥ |
makarān pūrvavat kuryāt tatra sūtrāṇi pātayet || 31 ||

śatayugmaṃ ca pañcāśatṣaṭpadāni yathā punaḥ |
prādurbhavanti ramyāṇi sūtrāṇyevaṃ vikāśayet || 32 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhakairmadhye sarojaṃ parikalpayet |
tadbahiḥ paritaḥ pīṭhamekapaṃktyā prakalpayet || 33 ||

paṃktidvayena tadbāhye vīthīkalpanamīritam |
tato'nyapaṃktiyugmena dvāraśobhā vidhānataḥ || 34 ||

upaśobhāśca koṇāni mantravit parikalpayet |
atha vakṣye vidhānena sarojalekhanakramam || 35 ||

sarojasthānajaṃ bhāgaṃ dvādaśaṃ tu parityajet |
tato vṛttatrayaṃ madhye kuryāt samyag yathāvidhi || 36 ||

karṇikāṃ madhyavṛttena dvitīyena tu kesarān |
antyavṛttena patrāṇi patrāgrāṃstyakta bhāgataḥ || 37 ||

antyavartulamadhyasya parimāṇaṃ ca yadbhavet |
kiñjalkāgreṣu saṃsthāpya pārśvatastvardhacandrakān || 38 ||

saṃlikhya sandhisambaddhasūtranyāsaṃ vidhāya ca |
dalāgramānato vṛttaṃ kuryāt samyag vicakṣaṇaḥ || 39 ||

vṛttāntarmadhyasūtrasya pārśvayostu yathāvidhi |
bahirekena kurvīta patrāgrāṇi vidhānavit || 40 ||

kiñjalkān patramūleṣu dviśaḥ kurvīta deśikaḥ |
sāmānyaṃ kamalaṃ hyetacchāstre sarvatra gīyate || 41 ||

tribhiḥ padaistu pīṭhasya pādān koṇeṣu kalpayet |
atiriktaiḥ padaiḥ pīṭhagātrāṇi racayettataḥ || 42 ||

vīthīpaṃktidvayaṃ samyagekīkṛtya pramārjayet |
koṣṭhadvayena caikena pratyekaṃ dvārapārśvayoḥ || 43 ||

śobhā bhavatyataḥ koṣṭhairekatastribhireva ca |
upaśobhāstataḥ koṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṇāni kalpayet || 44 ||

rajobhirbhūṣayet pañcavarṇairetattu maṇḍalam |
niśārajo bhavetpītaṃ śuklaṃ taṇḍulajaṃ smṛtam || 45 ||

raktaṃ kausumbhamuddiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
pulākadāhasaṃbhūtaṃ śyāmaṃ bilvacchadotthitam || 46 ||

pañcavarṇāḥ samākhyātā dīkṣāmaṇḍalakarmaṇi |
utsedhatārako rekhāḥ śuklā aṃgulamānataḥ || 47 ||

tāro vistāraḥ |

sarvāḥ sīmāgataḥ kāryā śubhrā maṇḍalakarmaṇi |
pītavarṇena cūrṇena karṇikāṃ pūrayettataḥ || 48 ||

kiñjalkān raktavarṇena dalāni śvetavarṇataḥ |
śyāmena rajasā sandhiṃ mantraviccābhipūrayet || 49 ||

athavā karṇikāṃ mantrī pītenaiva prapūrayet |
kiñjalkān pītaraktena pīṭhagātrāṇi śubhrataḥ || 50 ||

vīthīcatuṣkamadhyeṣu kalpavallīḥ prakalpayet |
patramūlaphalākāramaṇḍitā hṛdayaṅgamāḥ || 51 ||

nānāvarṇarajobhistā rañjayet kuśalī guruḥ |
śubhreṇa rajasā dvāracatuṣkaṃ pūrayettataḥ || 52 ||

raktavarṇena tacchobhāḥ pītenaivopaśobhikāḥ |
kṛṣṇavarṇena koṇāni bahī rekhātrayaṃ tataḥ || 53 ||

śuklāruṇākhyakṛṣṇaistu rajobhirbhūṣayet kramāt |
sāmānyaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetaduttamam || 54 ||

anyāni maṇḍalānyatra vakṣyante'pi prasaṅgataḥ |
pūrvokte caturasre tu tāvat sūtrāṇi pātayet || 55 ||

p. 246) yāvatsyāt koṣṭhaśatakaṃ catvāriṃśatsamanvitam |
vedānvitaṃ tu tanmadhye padmaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā śubham || 56 ||

ekapaṃktyā bhavetpīṭhaṃ vīthī naivātra dṛśyate |
pūrvavadvāraśobhā syādupaśobhātra nāsti vai || 57 ||

ṣaḍbhiḥ koṣṭhaistathā kuryātkoṇāni proktavartmanā |
anyatsarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ proktamaṇḍalavacchubham || 58 ||

etanmaṇḍalamanyattu caturasre suśobhane |
pātayet kramaśaḥ sūtraṃ yāvatkoṣṭhāni sarvataḥ || 59 ||

(ṣaṣṭistathā caturyuktāni syustanmadhyatastataḥ |
padmaṃ caturbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ syāt kuryāt tatparitaḥ punaḥ || 60 ||

caturvīthīmaṇḍalāntāvasānā diggateṣu ca ) |
catuṣkeṣu tu padmāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥ || 61 ||

catuṣkāṇi vidiksthāni catvāri vibhajet sudhīḥ |
yāvatṣoḍaśa koṣṭhāni bhavantyetāni mārjayet || 62 ||

tathā yāvatsvastikānāmākāraḥ prakaṭībhavet |
rajobhiḥ śuklahāridraraktanīlaiḥ prapūrayet || 63 ||

svastikāni śataṃ cānyatpūrvavatparikalpayet |
uditaṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetannavanābhaṃ suśobhanam || 64 ||

etadevoktamārgeṇa svastikākhyamanuttamam |
maṇḍalaṃ syāttu pañcābjaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 65 ||

dīkṣāyāṃ vā mahādāne devapūjāvratādiṣu |
etanmaṇḍalamadhye tu kuryādanyatamaṃ budhaḥ || 66 ||

evaṃ maṇḍalamālikhya prokteṣvanyatamaṃ guruḥ |
vedikāyāmāsane sa prāṅmukhaḥ saṃviśedatha || 67 ||

baddhapadmāsano maunī ṛjukāyo jitendriyaḥ |
deśikendrastu saṃsthāpya pūjopakaraṇāni tu || 68 ||

dakṣiṇe vāmabhāge tu sthāpayet kalaśaṃ śubham |
sugandhijalapūrṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanāya ca || 69 ||

paścātpātraṃ vidhāyātha dīpān prajvālayecchubhān |
vyajanaṃ mukuraṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ dikṣu mantravit || 70 ||

saṃskuryāt tāni sarvāṇi vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ |
karaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha kuryāt tālatrayaṃ budhaḥ || 71 ||

śaramantreṇa digbandhaṃ kuryānmantrī samāhitaḥ |
mahastu tata utpannaṃ rakṣayettaṃ hi sarvataḥ || 72 ||

bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanamācaret |
nyāsādikaṃ tataḥ kuryāddeśiko yatamānasaḥ || 73 ||

ṛṣiṃ nyaset tato mūrdhni cchando vaktragataṃ nyaset |
devatāṃ hṛdaye nyasya mūlamantrasya deśikaḥ || 74 ||

ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vinyasenmantrī pañcāṅgaṃ vā yathāvidhi |
yasya mantrasya pañcāṅgaṃ netraṃ tasya vihīyate || 75 ||

aṃgairvihīnasya manoraṅgaṃ teraiva kalpyate |
tattanmantroktamārgeṇa nyāsānanyān samācaret || 76 ||

śarīre svasya mantrasya yogapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet |
dehātmake tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyenmantrasya devatām || 77 ||

darśayitvā tato mudrāḥ sthāpayedarghyamuttamam |
jalena pūritāṃ dakṣe prokṣaṇīṃ sthāpayet tataḥ || 78 ||

tatrālpamalpaṃ śaṅkhāmbu tata uttarato nyaset |
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca mantravit || 79 ||

tato mūlāṇunā mantrī prokṣṇyadbhiḥ samāhitaḥ |
svātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cānyatpūjopakaraṇādikam || 80 ||

prokṣayedgandhapuṣpādyairdehe sve deśikottamaḥ |
yogapīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya nyāsamārgeṇa mantravit || 81 ||

pīṭhāntaṃ ca tatastatra pūjayediṣṭadevatām |
devatātmā tataḥ pañca kuryādvā sumanoñjalīn || 82 ||

śīrṣe hṛdi tathādhāre caraṇe sarvagātrake |
pūjayecca nivedyena rahitaiścandanādibhiḥ || 83 ||

sarvopacāraistaccheṣaṃ gurvādiṣṭena karmaṇā |
samāpayedidaṃ sarvaṃ prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaret || 84 ||

pānīyaṃ prokṣaṇīsaṃsthaṃ tyaktvā sampūrya pūrvavat |
upacāraiścandanādyairmaṇḍalaṃ pūjayedguruḥ || 85 ||

pūrayet karṇikāṃ pūrvaṃ śālibhistaṇḍulaistataḥ |
darbhāṃ nyaseduparyeṣāṃ sākṣataṃ kūrcakraṃ tataḥ || 86 ||

chinnamūlāḥ kuśā dīrghāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ |
brahmagranthiyutāstvagradeśe kūrca ihocyate || 87 ||

yajedādhāraśaktyādipīṭhamantrāvasānakam |
svarṇādiracitaṃ tatra kalaśaṃ chidravarjitam || 88 ||

triguṇātmakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sarvato bahiḥ |
candanāgurukarpūrairmadhye samyakpradhūpitam || 89 ||

dhruvaṃ japavidhānena sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ |
nava ratnāni niḥkṣipya kumbhe kūrcamathopari || 90 ||

dūrvācandanasaṃyuktaṃ vinyasedakṣatānvitam |
puṣpaṃ nīlaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ vidrumaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā || 91 ||

p. 247) tato marakataṃ vajraṃ gomedaṃ padmarāgakam |
mauktikāni ca ratnāni deśikastantravittamaḥ || 92 ||

kṣādyāntakramato mantrī mātṛkāṃ manasā japan |
mūlamantraṃ japannante cintayannaikyamātmanaḥ || 93 ||

ghaṭasya pīṭhabhedaṃ ca cintayet sādhakottamaḥ |
pañcāśadoṣadhikvāthaiḥ pūrayettadanantaram || 94 ||

dugdhavṛkṣatvacā kvāthairbrahmabhūruṭatvagudbhavaiḥ |
gandhapaṅkaprasūnādivāsitairvā śubhairjalaiḥ || 95 ||

kvāthāditoyairāpūrya śaṅkhaṃ tasmin viloḍayet |
gandhāṣṭakaṃ śubhaṃ mantrī sarvasamaptatpradāyakam || 96 ||

kalāḥ sarvāḥ samāvāhya pūjayecca yathāvidhi |
kalādidevatārūpaṃ śaṅkhanīraṃ ghaṭe kṣipet || 97 ||

candanāgarukarpūrakāśmīrai rocanānvitaiḥ |
sasihlakajaṭāmāṃsīsaṭībhiḥ śaktisambhavam || 98 ||

gandhāṣṭakaṃ śubhaṃ vaśyaṃ śaktimantreṣu yojayet |

iti | kāśmīraṃ kuṃkumam | sihlakaṃ śilārasaḥ | saṭī kacoraḥ | 
candanāgarukarpūracorakuṃkumarocanāḥ jaṭāmāṃsīkapiyutāḥ 
śaktergandhāṣṭakaṃ matam || iti śāradātilakavacanāt |

hrīveraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhamaguruṃ kuṃkumaṃ muram |
sevyakaṃ ca jaṭāmāṃsī vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudīritam || 1 ||

hrīveraṃ bālakaṃ | sevyakumuśīram | suraṃ moraharīti prasiddham |

murā gandhavatī daityā gandhāḍhyā gandhamādinī |
surabhirbhūtagandhā ca kuṭhī gandhakuṭhī smṛtā || 1 ||

ekāṅgīti nānārthavacanādekāṃgyeva muraśabdenocyate | ekāṅgī charvyuriti 
loke prasiddhā ||

jalakāśmīrakuṣṭhaistu raktacandanacandanaiḥ |
tamālāgarukarpūraiḥ śāmbhavaṃ cāṣṭagandhakam || 1 ||

jalaṃ bālakam |

gandhāṣṭakasya saṃyogāt sāmarthyāddeśikasya ca |
saśaktikaṃ jalaṃ kumbhe bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ || 99 ||

ādau kṛśānusambandhi kalādaśakamarcayet |
kalādvādaśakaṃ sauraṃ pūjayet tadanantaram || 100 ||

kalāṣoḍaśakaṃ cāndraṃ yajet paścādgurūttamaḥ |
vedādibhedasañjātāḥ kalāḥ pañcāśatairyutāḥ || 101 ||

sannidhāpya samabhyarcya tato mantrī tu tāḥ kramāt |
madhye madhye ṛcaḥ pañca pūjanīyā imā api || 102 ||

ātmamantraṃ samuccārya śuciṣatpadamuccaret |
vasurantamantrapadaṃ rikṣasaddhopadaṃ tataḥ || 103 ||

padaṃ tā vediṣapade datithirdupadaṃ tataḥ |
roṇasatpadamuccārya nṛṣadvarapade vadet || 104 ||

vadet sadṛtasad vyomasadabjā gopadaṃ vadet |
vadejjā ṛtajetyasmādadrijāśabdamuccaret || 105 ||

saptamasvaramuccārya sabindvāṣāḍhinaṃ vadet |
uktvā bṛhatpadaṃ vānte prathamo mantra īritaḥ || 106 ||

iti | ātmamantraḥ haṃsa iti | saptamasvara ṛkāraḥ | āṣāḍhī takāraḥ | anyāni 
padāni svarūpāṇi || tathā -

lohito vahnisahitaḥ pūtanā dvyantikā tataḥ |
uktvā ṣṇuḥ stavate paścādvīryeṇa mṛpadaṃ vadet || 107 ||

go na bhīmaśca kucaro giriṣṭhāśca tato vadet |
yasyoruṣu triṣu padaṃ tato vikramaṇeṣvadhi || 108 ||

kṣiyanti tu padaṃ brūyādbhuvanāni tato vadet |
toyastho mādhavaḥ paścādvāntaṃ syāttāyaśāntiyuk || 109 ||

dvitīyo manurākhyātastṛtīyaḥ procyate'dhunā |

lohitaḥ pakāraḥ vahnī rephastena pra pūtanā takāraḥ | toyaṃ vakāraḥ tatstho 
mādhava ikāraḥ tena vi vāntaṃ śa toyaṃ va śānti ā tena śvā | anyāni padāni 
svarūpāṇi ||

ṇānto'gnimāntopāntyasya kalāyuk patṛtīyakaḥ |
caturmukhaḥ sacandrārdhastataḥ syācca yajāmahe || 110 ||

paraṃ sugandhiṃ puṣṭīti vardhanaṃ ca tato bhavet |
padamurvārukamiva bandhanānmṛpadaṃ vadet || 111 ||

tyormukṣīyapade paścānmāmṛtātpadamuccaret |

p. 248) ṇāntastakāraḥ agnī rephaḥ māntā yakāraḥ upāntyakalā binduretena 
tryaṃ patṛtīyo vakāraḥ caturmukhaḥ kakāraḥ candrārdho bindustena kaṃ anyāni 
padāni svarūpāṇi ||

gāyatryātmā caturthaḥ syānmantraḥ khyāto jagatyalam |
toyasthā śālmalī proktā sahajāḍhāntaviṣṇuyuk || 112 ||

agniśca kevalaḥ prokto yoniṃ kalpapadaṃ vadet |
yatu tvaṣṭāpadaṃ paścāt tato rūpāṇi piṃśatu || 113 ||

āsiñcatu prajā paścātpatirdhātāpadaṃ vadet |
garbhaṃ dadhātviti padamāṣāḍhī padmanābhayuk || 114 ||

pañcaite vaidikā mantrāsteṣvekaikaṃ prapūjayet |

toyaṃ vakāraḥ śālmalī ikārastena vi sahajā ṣakāraḥ ḍhānto ṇakāro 
viṣṇuyuk ukārayuktastena ṣṇu | agnī rephaḥ kevalo visvaraḥ || āṣāḍhī takāraḥ 
padmanābha ekārastema te iti ||

tārasya pañcabhedotthakalānāmantare sudhīḥ |
āvāhyādau kalāḥ paścāt sannidhāpya ca deśikaḥ || 115 ||

prāṇān saṃsthāpya gandhādyaiḥ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ |
yatra yatra kalāpūjāvidhistatraivameva hi || 116 ||

tārasya pañcabhedotthakalānāṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ |
kalādaśakamāvāhya sṛṣṭyādyāḥ sannidhāpya ca || 117 ||

haṃsaḥ śucipadityādyāmṛcaṃ sañjapya pūjayet |
prāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kalānāṃ pūjayecca tāḥ || 118 ||

evaṃ jarādyāstīkṣṇādyāḥ pītādyāśca vidhānataḥ |
nivṛttyādyāścāpi yajeduktayuktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 119 ||

akārokārakau proktau makāro bindunādakau |
śaktisāntāvamī sapta dhruvabhedāḥ samīritāḥ || 120 ||

antimau dvauvimau bhedau pṛthageva samīritau |

śaktiḥ sakāraḥ sānto hakāraḥ |

tato rasālapanasapippaladrumapallavaiḥ |
sutrāmavallarīnaddhaiḥ kalpavṛkṣamanīpayā || 121 ||

kalaśasthāpanaṃ mantrī vidadhīta samāhitaḥ |
paścādakṣatasaṃyuktāṃ saphalāṃ śubhacakrikām || 122 ||

deśikendraḥ samādāya sthāpayet pallavopari |
kalpavṛkṣaphalānāṃ hi matyā viśadadhīrguruḥ || 123 ||

paṭṭāmbarayugenaiva ghaṭaṃ paścāt praveṣṭayet |
pradhānakumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya vedyāmevaṃ gurūttamaḥ || 124 ||

toraṇānāṃ samīpeṣu pūrvādiṣu yathākramam |
prāgvanmaṇḍalamālikhya padmaṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ śubham || 125 ||

prāguktavidhinā teṣu kumbhān saṃsthāpya deśikaḥ |
dhruvaṃ dharāṃ vākpatiṃ ca vighneśaṃ teṣu pūjayet || 126 ||

āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu kumbhān saṃsthāpya pūrvavat |
amṛtaṃ durjayaṃ caiva siddhārthaṃ maṅgalaṃ tathā || 127 ||

sampūjya vahnikoṇādiṣvindrādīnatha pūjayet |
pūrvādiṣvaṣṭakumbheṣu teṣāṃ mantraistu vaidikaiḥ || 128 ||

punaḥ pūrvādikumbheṣu pūjayed diggajānapi |
airāvataṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanau || 129 ||

puṣpadantaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ supratīkaṃ ca deśikaḥ |
punarvedyāṃ gururgatvā upaviśya nijāsane || 130 ||

sañcintya mūlamantreṇa mūrtiṃ tasmin gurūttamaḥ |
tasyāṃ mūrtau samāvāhya pūjayediṣṭadevatām || 131 ||

smṛtvā mūlamanuṃ mantrī samyaṅnāḍīpathā tataḥ |
nirgamayya ca caitanyaṃ nāsikāgravinirgatam || 132 ||

añjalau mātṛkāpadme mahaḥ puṣpānvite guruḥ |
mastakāntaṃ samutthāpya tasyāmāvāhayet tataḥ || 133 ||

saṃsthāpanaṃ prathamataḥ sannidhānamataḥ param |
sannirodha ca sakalīkaraṇaṃ tvavaguṇṭhanam || 134 ||

amṛtīkaraṇaṃ paramīkaraṇaṃ svasvamudrayā |

sannirodhaṃ ceti cakārātsammukhīkaraṇamapi jñeyam ||

kramād vidadhyācca tata upacārān prakalpayet |
āsanādiprasūnāntānupacārān prakalpya ca || 135 ||

tattanmantravidhāneṣu proktāṅgāvaraṇānyapi |
sarvānte lokapālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ ca pūjanam || 136 ||

vidhāya pūjāmevaṃ hi dhūpadīpanivedyakaiḥ |

p. 249) iti || prapañcasāre -

kṛte nivedye ca tato maṇḍalaṃ paritaḥ kramāt |
maṅgalāṃkurapātrāṇi sthāpanīyāni mantriṇā || 1 ||

iti || tathā -

vedikāyā dakṣabhāge kṛtvā sthaṇḍilamuttamam |
saṃsthāpya vahniṃ saṃskṛtya vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret || 137 ||

tatra praṇavapūrvābhirhutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ punaḥ |
mūlāṇunā tato hutvā sājyena haviṣā sudhīḥ || 138 ||

pañcaviṃśatidhā paścād hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ punaḥ |
sampūjya tāṃ candanādyaiḥ pīṭhamūrtau tu yojayet || 139 ||

agniṃ visṛjya śiṣṭena pāyasena baliṃ haret |
pārṣadebhyaścandanādipuṣpākṣatasamanvitam || 140 ||

tata utthāpya naivedyaṃ tatsthalaṃ śodhayet sudhīḥ |
punaryajeccopacāraiḥ pañcabhirdarśayet tataḥ || 141 ||

chatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ paścād dadyāttāmbūlamuttamam |

chatraṃ ceti cakārāddarpaṇavyajane'pi gṛhyete ||

sahasraṃ ca japenmantrī mūlamantraṃ samāhitaḥ |
devatāyai nivedyātha taṃ japaṃ saṃpade tataḥ || 142 ||

īśānadiśi yaḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpito vikiro'tra ca |
suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ karakaṃ jalapūritam || 143 ||

nyasedatra yajedastradevatāṃ ghorarūpiṇīm |
paścimāsyāṃ khaḍgakheṭadhāriṇīṃ siṃhasaṃsthitām || 144 ||

tiṣṭhan sampūjya ca tato gṛhītvā taṃ pradakṣiṇam |
bhramedantastu rakṣeti lokeśānāmitīrayan || 145 ||

nālayuktenodakena devatāṃ bhāvayettataḥ |
svasthāne sthāpayettaṃ tu phaṇmantreṇa tato'rcayet || 146 ||

upaviśya tu bhūyo'straṃ gandhādyairmantravittamaḥ |
tato vahniṃ susaṃskṛtya caruṃ gopayasā pacet || 147 ||

nave tāmrādije pātre kṣālite ca śarāṇunā |
mūlāṇunābhimantryātha taṇḍulāñśālisambhavān || 148 ||

tithiprasṛtimānena śarāṇuṃ prajapan kṣipet |
prakṣālitena pātreṇa pātravaktraṃ pidhāya ca || 149 ||

huṃmantreṇa tato mūlamanunā deśikottamaḥ |
paced guruḥ prāṅmukhastu svinne tamabhidhārayet || 150 ||

mūlena sruvasaṃsthena ghṛtenāthāvatārayet |
huṃmantreṇāstrasaṃjapte kuśāstīrṇe vibhajya tat || 151 ||

tridhā tvekaṃ devatāyai paraṃ vahnau nivedayet |
śiṣṭaṃ  śiṣyeṇa sahito gururbhuñjīta mantravit || 152 ||
