kṛtācamana ācāntaṃ śiṣyamānīya mantravit |
prādeśamātraṃ hṛñjaptaṃ yathoktaṃ dantadhāvanam || 153 ||

śiṣyāya dadyātsa radān viśodhya kṣālitaṃ tyajet |

ācāntamatra ca yathāvidhi tacchikhāyā bandhaiḥ surakṣitamamuṃ pravidhāya 
mantrī |
vedyāṃ śayīta kuśasaṃstaraṇe rajanyāṃ śiṣyeṇa sārdhamamunā 
gadito'dhivāsaḥ || 154 ||

tāmrādītyādipadena mṛṇmayagrahaṇam | tallakṣaṇamuktaṃ kātyāyanena -

tiryagūrdhvaṃ saminmātrā dṛḍhā nātibṛhanmukhī |
mṛṇmayyaudumbarī vāpi carusthālī praśasyate || 1 ||

iti | saminmātrā prādeśapramāṇā prādeśānnādhikānūnā iti kapilavacanāt | 
tithiprasṛtiḥ pañcadaśaprasṛtiḥ śarāṇurastramantraḥ taṇḍulāṃstriḥkṣālitān | 
taduktaṃ govilena triḥphalīkṛtāṃstaṇḍulān trirdevebhyaḥ prakṣālayedityāhuriti 
|| kuśalo dakṣastena śṛtamiva pradakṣiṇa | tataḥ ūrdhvamavadānakriyākṣamamiti 
| svinna iti :

suśākhoktaśca susvinno hyadagdho'kaṭhinaḥ śubhaḥ |
nacātiśithilaḥ pācyo na ca vītaraso bhavet || 1 ||

ityuktalakṣaṇe ghṛtena saṃskṛte huṃmantreṇāvatārayediti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | atra 
huṃmantreṇetyādiṣu tattakalpoktakavacamantrāstramantrādayo jñeyāḥ na tu 
huṃmātraṃ phaṇmātraṃ vā || athāgnisthāpanaṃ nāradapañcarātre :

kuṇḍasyārambhakāle tu saṃskārā na kṛtā yadi |
niṣpannasya ca te sarve vidheyāḥ syuḥ krameṇa vai || 1 ||

p. 250) iti || uttaratantre -

homakarma tato vakṣye sakalāgamasaṃmatam |
susaṃskṛte guroḥ kuṇḍe saṃskāraiśca yathāvidhi || 1 ||

te daśāṣṭādhikāḥ proktāḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ |
mūlāṇunā ca saṃvīkṣya saṃprokṣyāstrāṇunā tataḥ || 2 ||

kuśaiḥ saṃtāḍya cāstreṇa prokṣayet kavacāṇunā |
khananaṃ syācchareṇātha tenaivoddhāra īritaḥ || 3 ||

pūraṇaṃ ca hṛdāstreṇa samīkuryācca secanam |
kavacenātha śastreṇa kuṭṭanaṃ varmaṇā matam || 4 ||

mārjanaṃ ca vilepaṃ ca saṃcintya ca kalātmatām |
kuryāt trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ namomantreṇa pūrayet || 5 ||

śareṇa vajrīkaraṇaṃ kuśaiḥ kuryāccatuṣpatham |
kavacenendriyāṇāṃ cāpyudghāṭanamathācaret || 6 ||

evamuktaistu saṃskārairhome kuṇḍāni deśikaḥ |
saṃskuryādathavā tāni caturbhiḥ prathamoditaiḥ || 6 ||

śareṇa tattadaṅgabhūtāstramantreṇa prokṣaṇamuttānahastāgreṇa | 
abhyukṣaṇaṃ muṣṭibandhenāsecanam | uddhāraḥ khātamṛdā | 
pūraṇamanyamṛdā | uktaṃ ca nāradapañcarātre :

gṛhītvā caikadeśāttu kuṇḍamadhyāttu mṛttikām |
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu hṛdayenātha pūrayet || 1 ||

secanamabhyukṣanameva śastreṇāstramantreṇa | varmaṇetyetadagrimeṣu caturṣu 
sambadhnāti | taduktaṃ somaśambhunā -

sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanam |
trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ hṛdā || 1 ||

iti || kalārūpaprakalpanaṃ somasūryāgnikalārūpaprakalpanam | trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ 
sūtratrayakalpanam | hṛdayena pūjanaṃ tu mekhalātrayasyaiva || taduktaṃ 
nāradapañcarātre :

samabhyarcya tato bāhye madhyataḥ praṇavena ca |
tenaiva vidhinā nābhiṃ pūjayeccandrasannibhām || 1 ||

mekhalātrayapūjāyāṃ hṛnmantraṃ tu prapūjayet |

iti | vajrīkaraṇaṃ vajravaddṛḍhacintanam | catuṣpathaṃ kuśaiścaturdikṣu 
mārgacatuṣṭayakaraṇam | śāradātilake tu : tanutreṇa 
tanuyādakṣapāṭanamityuktam | akṣapāṭanalakṣaṇaṃ tu nāradapañcarātre :

acchinnāgraistadā darbhairastramantrābhimantritaiḥ |
kuṇḍabhittigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varmaṇā paribhūṣayet || 1 ||

ityevamakṣapāṭākhyaṃ kuṇḍasaṃskāramuttamam |

atrendriyāṇāmudghāṭanamiti yaduktaṃ tattvevameva kartavyam | 
akṣaśabdasyendriyavācakatvādakṣapāṭanamindriyāṇāmudghāṭanamityarthaḥ | 
huṃkāreṇa rākṣasanivāraṇamiti kecit | ādikṣāntānāṃ varṇānāṃ pāṭanaṃ 
vyāptirityapare | pakṣāntaramāha | atha veti | 
prathamoditairvīkṣaṇaprokṣaṇatāḍanābhyukṣaṇaiḥ | tathā : triśastriśo 
likhellekhāḥ prāgudagrā hṛdāṇunā | udagrā iti divyatvādudagagrāḥ |

smṛtāśca prāṅmukhāgrāṇāṃ devā viṣṇvīśavāsavāḥ |
udaṅmukhāgrarekhāṇāṃ brahmasūryendavaḥ kramāt || 1 ||

atra rekhālikhane kuta ārambhaḥ kutravasānamityākāṃkṣāyāmāha 
sautrāmaṇītantre -

prācīmūrdhamudaksaṃsthaṃ dakṣiṇārambhamālikhet |
udagagraṃ puraḥsaṃsthaṃ paścimārambhamālikhet || 1 ||

prācīmūrdhaṃ prāgagram | udagagraṃ puraḥsaṃsthaṃ pūrvāvasānakam | 
nāradapañcarātre -

ullikhedastrarājena darbhakāṇḍena yatnataḥ |
bhūmāvabhyantare kuṇḍe dakṣiṇāśāditaḥ kramāt || 1 ||

uttarāśāvadhiṃ yāvaddadyādrekhātrayaṃ samam |
pratyagbhāgātsamārabhya yāvatpūrvāvadhiṃ tathā || 2 ||

iti || atra hṛnmantrāstramantrayorvikalpaḥ | tathā : athavāgniyugāntaḥsthaṃ 
vahnigehaṃ (koṇaṃ) likhet kramāt | agniyugaṃ trikoṇadvayarūpaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ 
vahnikoṇaṃ trikoṇam | atra rekhāṣaṭkoṇayorvikalpaḥ | tathā yāmale : 
ṣaṭkoṇenāvṛtaṃ devi trikoṇaṃ tatra saṃlikhet | iti | ata eva nāradapañcarātre 
rekhāmātramuktam | śāradātilake : varmaṇābhyukṣya tāreṇa 

p. 151) yogapīṭhamathārcayet | iti | sautrāmaṇītantre tu | prokṣayedvāgbhavena 
vetyuktaṃ vāśabdaḥ praṇavāpekṣayā | abhyukṣya kuśasalilena | abhyukṣya ca 
kuśāmbhobhiriti yoginītantravacanāt | prapañcasāre : 
prāṇāgnihotravidhināpyāvasathīye'nalasthāne | prāṇāgnihotravidhirapi tatraiva 
madhyendravaruṇaśaśiyamadiggatāni krameṇa kuṇḍāni | 
āvasathyasabhyāhavanīyānvāhāryagārhapatyāni || iti | uttaratantre : samprokṣya 
praṇavenātha yogapīṭhaṃ samarcayet | yogapīṭhārcanaṃ prayoge vakṣyate |

tatra śaktiṃ ca saṃsmṛtya samyagṛtumatīṃ śubhām |
atīndriyābhāṃ sakalajagadātmasvarūpiṇīm || 1 ||

īśānasahitāṃ tatra samyaggandhādibhiryajet |
śaktimantreṇa tāṃ śaktimīśānaṃ mūlamantrataḥ || 2 ||

abhyarcya mūlavit samyak maṇijaṃ vā'raṇeyakam |
kulīnadvijagehotthaṃ pātre hutavahaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||

ānīyāstreṇa nair-ṛtyāṃ kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet |
devāṃśa mūlamantreṇa sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥ || 4 ||

paścāttamagnīṃ saṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ |
pradīpakalikākāraṃ teja āvāhya yatnataḥ || 5 ||

aikyaṃ jāṭharabaindavavahnibhyāṃ pārthivasya ca |
smṛtvāgnibījakenāsya caitanyaṃ yojayedatha || 6 ||

oṃkāreṇābhimantryātha dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam |
saṃrakṣya ca śareṇātha kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet || 7 ||

tataḥ sampūjya kuṇḍasya bhrāmayet triḥpradakṣiṇam |
praṇavena tataḥ svasya sammukhaṃ svīyakuṇḍake || 8 ||

devyā yonau tatra jānuspṛṣṭabhūmiśca deśikaḥ |
śivabījamiti dhyātvā nikṣipedāśuśukṣaṇim || 9 ||

tata ācamanīyaṃ ca devyā devasya kalpayet |

vaiṣṇavayāge tu nāradapañcarātre -

tatra nārāyaṇākhyasya śaktirvidyotalakṣaṇā |
lakṣmyākṛtipadaṃ prāptā amṛtāmṛtajīvanī || 1 ||

iti || tathā kapilapañcarātre -

kāmonmattaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīmṛtumatīṃ smaret |
tayoḥ saṃgamayogena vahniḥ sañjātasaṃsthitiḥ || 1 ||

iti || kumbhasaṃbhavo'pyāha -

lakṣmīmṛtumatīṃ bhadrāṃ prabhāṃ nārāyaṇasya ca |
grāmyadharmeṇa sañjātamagniṃ tatra vicintayet || 1 ||

pātre tāmrādipātre || yadāhātriḥ -

pātrāntareṇa pihite tāmrāpātrādike |
agnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāccharāve tādṛśe'pi vā || 1 ||

pihite kavacamantreṇa | taduktaṃ piṅgalāmate -

astreṇāgniṃ samādhāya kavacena pidhāya ca |
kravyādāṃśaṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ tyajedastreṇa pārvati || 1 ||

iti || tathā nāradapañcarātre : taijase tāmrapātra vā mṛṇmaye'bhinave'pi vā | 
iti || taijasapadaṃ govalīvardanyāyena tāmretaraparam | etena :

śarāve bhinnapātre vā kapāle colmuke'pi vā |
nāgnipraṇayanaṃ kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvaham || 1 ||

iti sarasvatīsāralikhitavacanaṃ purātanamṛtpātraparam abhinavetyukteḥ | 
bhairavītantre tu : yonāvevaṃ vinyaset svābhivaktraṃ paścādevaṃ 
mūlamantreṇa mantrī ityuktaṃ tadatra praṇavamūlamantrayorvikalpaḥ || jāṭhara 
iti : binduḥ paramātmā tasyāgnīṣomakatvāttadbhavo vahnirvaindavaḥ pārthivo 
bhaumaḥ | amṛtīkṛtaṃ vaṃbījena || amṛtīkaraṇaṃ tato vidadhyājjalabījena 
sabindunā kṛśānoḥ | iti yoginītantravacanāt | śareṇāstreṇa | uttaratantre -

uktvā citpiṅgalapadaṃ hanayugmaṃ pacadvayam |
dahayugmaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ ājñāpaya tato dviṭhaḥ || 1 ||

amuṃ mantraṃ prabhāṣyaiva kṛśānuṃ jvālayettataḥ |

iti || dviṭhaḥ svāhākāraḥ | prapañcasāre -

p. 252) agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam |
suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham || 1 ||

anena jvalitaṃ mantreṇopatiṣṭheddhutāśanam |

iti | sarvajñamiti śabdakarmaṇi dvitīyā | mantre tu sambuddhyantaṃ jñeyam | 
sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā iti dakṣiṇāmūrtivacanāt | jvālayet kuśairmukhena 
vā | tataḥ prajvālayet kuśaiḥ iti kumbhasambhavavacanāt | mukhenaiva 
dhamedagniṃ mukhādeṣo'ghyajāyata iti kātyāyanavacanācca | 
mantratantraprakāśe :

tataḥ pravinyasejjihvā dehe mantrairvibhāvasoḥ |
saliṅgagudamūrdhāsyanāsānetreṣu ca kramāt || 1 ||

sasarvāṅgeṣu sarvāstā vakṣyante trividhā api |
hiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhā || 2 ||

bahurūpātiraktā ca jihvāḥ sapteti sāttvikāḥ |
analerārghibindvantasādiyāntākṣarānvitāḥ || 3 ||

iti || analo rephaḥ īraḥ yakāraḥ arghirūkāraḥ | ayaṃ kramo 
bījoddhārapyaikaryāṃyaiva | nyāse tu -

saliṅgagudamūrdhāsyanāsānetreṣu ca kramāt |
vinyasedatiraktāntāḥ sarvāṅgebahurūpiṇīm || 1 ||

iti siddhāntaśekharavacanāt sarvāṅge bahurūpāṃ nyaset | prapañcasāre -

mantrī pravinyasedbhūyo vahneraṅgāni vai kramāt |
sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇa uttiṣṭha puruṣastathā || 1 ||

dhūmavyāpī saptajihvo dhanurdharaḥ itīritaḥ |
aṅgamantrān kramādaṣṭa mūrtīścāpi pravinyaset || 2 ||

mūrdhāṃsapārśvakaṭyandhukaṭipārśvāṃsakeṣu ca |
pradakṣiṇyena vinyased yathāvaddeśikottamaḥ || 3 ||

jātavedāḥ saptajihvo havyavāhana eva ca |
aśvodarajasaṃjñaśca savaiśvānara eva ca || 4 ||

kaumāratejāśca tathā viśvadevamukhāhvayau |
syuraṣṭa mūrtayo vahneragnaye padapūrvikāḥ || 5 ||

praṇavādinamontāśca iti | prādakṣiṇyena śira ārabhya vāmāṃsādikrameṇa 
dakṣiṇāṃsāvadhi nyasediti | andhu liṅgaṃ gudamiti kecit | mukhaśabdaḥ 
pratyekaṃ sambadhyate | kaumāratejāḥ syādviśvamukho devatāmukhastathā iti 
śāradātilakavacanāt | uttaratantre :

prādakṣiṇyakrameṇaiva saṃsicya ca tato jalaiḥ |
mekhalopari saṃśuddhaiḥ punardarbhacatuṣṭayaḥ || 1 ||

dikkrameṇa paristīrya dikṣvaindrīvarjamātmavit |
nikṣipet paridhīn brahmaviṣṇavīśāṃstatra pūjayet || 2 ||

darbhacatuṣṭayaiḥ prāgudagagraiḥ | pūrvāgrairuttarāgraiśca darbhairagniṃ 
paristaret | iti gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinīvacanāt | prāgagrairatha 
darbhairdhanadadiśāgraiḥ paristaret kuṇḍam | iti bhairavītantravacanāt | 
trimekhalakuṇḍe | madhyamekhalāyāṃ paristaraṇaparidhiprakṣepaḥ kāryaḥ | 
taduktaṃ yoginītantre :

ekamekhalake kuṇḍe mekhalādhaḥ paristaret |
dvimekhale dvitīyāyāṃ madhyamāyāṃ trimekhale || 1 ||

iti || nanu paścimamekhalāsaṃlagnatayā nālasya 
vidyamānatvānmadhyamekhalāyāṃ paristaraṇaparidhiprakṣepaḥ kathaṃ 
bhavedityāṅkṣāyāmāha uttaratantre :

nālamekhalayormadhye paridheḥ sthāpanasya tu |
randhraṃ kuryāttathā vidvān madhyasthamekhalopari || 1 ||

iti | sthaṇḍile sikatānāṃ tu bāhye bhūmeḥ paristaret | iti paridhayastu 
kātyāyanenoktāḥ : paridhīn paridadhātyārdrānekavṛkṣīyān bāhumātrān 
palāśavaikaṅkatakāśmaryavailvādi | iti | sthaṇḍile sikatānāṃ bāhye'tha 
vinyaset paridhī niti ca | aindrīvarjaṃ paridhīn dikṣu kṣipediti sambandhaḥ | dikṣu 
paścimādakṣiṇottarāsu sthaviṣṭho madhyamaḥ | aṇīyān drādhīyān 
dakṣiṇārthaḥ | kaniṣṭho hvasiṣṭha uttarārthaḥ iti sūtritatvāt | paścime 
uttarāgramanyayoḥ pūrvāgraṃ ceti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām : 
praṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalaṃ cātha ghṛtaṃ tathā iti || 
tatpātrasthāpanaprakāramāha kumbhasambhavaḥ :

prāṇānāyamya vidhivat paristīrya kuśāntaraiḥ |
svagṛhyoktavidhānena vāyudeśāttato mune || 1 ||

p. 253) pātrāṇyāsādya vidhivadidhmaṃ tantreṇa mantravit |
tānyavokṣya pavitreṇa cottānāni vidhāya ca || 2 ||

punaḥ prokṣya nayet pātraṃ paripūrya śubhāmbunā |
dattvākṣatān pavitraṃ ca tadutpūya nidhāpayet || 3 ||

diśyuttarasyāṃ tatpātraṃ praṇītetyucyate budhaiḥ |
tataḥ kiñcit praṇītāmbu prokṣaṇyādāya tajjalaiḥ || 4 ||

yajñasādhanasambhāraṃ prokṣayenmūlamantrataḥ |

iti || uttaratantre -

āsanaṃ ca tato vahneḥ kalpayitvā prapūjayet |

āsanaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ ca prayoge vakṣyate tathā -

koṇaṣaṭke ca madhye ca jihvā aṅgāni kesare |
tadbāhye vasumūrtīśca madhye vahniṃ tato yajet || 1 ||

vakṣyamāṇena vidhinā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sudhīḥ |

iti prapañcasāre -

koṇaṣaṭke ca madhye ca jihvābhiḥ kesareṣu ca |
aṅgamantraistato bāhye cāṣṭabhiḥ mūrtibhiḥ kramāt || 1 ||

tato'gnimanunā tena mantrī madhye ca saṃyajet |
vaiśvānara jātaveda proktvā cehāvaheti ca || 2 ||

lohitākṣapadaṃ sarvakarmāṇīti samīrayet |
brūyācca sādhayetyantaṃ vahnijāyāntiko manuḥ || 3 ||

iti | mantre sarvāṇi padāni sambuddhyantāni jñeyāni ||

trinayanamaruṇaptābaddhamauliṃ 
suśuklāṃśukamaruṇamanekākalpamambhojasaṃstham |
abhimatavaraśaktisvastikābhītihastaṃ namata kanakamālālaṃkṛtāṃsaṃ 
kṛśānum || 4 ||

jihvā jvālārucaḥ proktā varābhayayutāni ca |
aṅgāni mūrtayaḥ śaktisvastikodyatadordvayāḥ || 5 ||

koṇaṣaṭke ca madhye ceti sambandhaḥ |
taduktaṃ somaśambhunā -

rudrendravahnimāṃsādavaruṇānilagocare |
hiraṇyādyāḥ sthitā vahne rasanāḥ ṣaḍanukramāt || 1 ||

madhyato bahurūpā tu iti || gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinyām -

madhye ca koṇaṣaṭke ca jihvāḥ sapta yajettataḥ |
hiraṇyā taptahemābhā śūlapāṇidiśi sthitā || 1 ||

vaidūryavarṇā kanakā prācyāṃ diśi samāśritā |
taruṇādityasaṅkāśā raktā jihvāgnisaṃsthitā || 2 ||

kṛṣṇāñjanacayaprakhyā nair-ṛtyāṃ diśi saṃsthitā |
suprabhā padmarāgābhā vāruṇyāṃ diśi saṃsthitā || 3 ||

atiraktā japābhāsā vāyavyāṃ diśi saṃsthitā |
bahurūpā yathārthābhā dakṣiṇottaramadhyagā || 4 ||

iti || nāradapañcarātre -

prabhā dīptā prakāśā ca marīcistāpinī tathā |
karālā lelihā ceti kuṇḍaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitāḥ || 1 ||

īśapūrvāgnidigbhāge prabhādyaṃ tritayaṃ sthitam |
rakṣovāruṇavāyavye marīcyādyaṃ trayaṃ tathā || 2 ||

saumye ca madhyame yāmye sthitaikā lelihābhidhā |

iti || hiraṇyādīnāmeva nāmantarāṇi prabhādīni | yadvā vaiṣṇavayāge tvetāḥ 
svatantrāḥ | tathā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

hiraṇyā prāgudagjihvā kanakā pūrvataḥ sthitā |
raktāgneyī nair-ṛtī ca kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā || 1 ||

atiraktā marujjihvā svanāmānuguṇaprabhāḥ | anyā ca aruṇā |

triṃśikhā madhyamā jihvā bahurūpāsamāhvayā | tacchikhaikā dakṣiṇato 
jvalantī vāmataḥ parā 

iti sāttvikajihvāḥ | rājasyastāmasyaśca vakṣyante || kecittu -

kuṇḍasya madhye hyatha sā praśastā jihvā hiraṇyā bhuvi kārmaṇādau ||
stambhanādiṣu matā kanakāntardveṣaṇādiṣu matā khalu raktā |

p. 254) māraṇe nigaditā bhuvi kṛṣṇā suprabhā budhavarairiha śāntyām || 1 ||

uccāṭane'tiraktāntara iti vadanti | jvālāruca iti jihvānāṃ dhyānam | jihvāḥ 
sarvāḥ parijñeyā jvālābhāsāḥ svarūpataḥ | iti prayogasāravacanāt | etā 
jvālārucā vītā varābhayayutā api | iti gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinīvacanācca | 
prapañcasāre :

saṃskṛtena ghṛtenābhidyotanoddyotanena ca |
vyāhṛtyanantaraṃ tena juhuyānmanunā triśaḥ || 1 ||

abhidyotanoddyotanākhyasaṃskāradvayasaṃskṛteneti saṃbandhaḥ |
apare tu saṃskārāntaramapyaṅgīkurvanti | piṅgalāmate :

kuṇḍe cāṣṭādaśa jñeyāḥ saṃskārāḥ śivaśāstrataḥ |
ghṛte sruci sruve cāṣṭau iti || uttaratantre :

samādāya ghṛtasthālīmastramantreṇa secayet |
ghṛtaṃ tatra samāpūrya vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtam || 1 ||

vāyavye bāhyato'ṅgārān kṛtvā teṣu hṛdā nyaset |
tāpanaṃ tu samuddiṣṭaṃ kuśadvayamataḥ kṣipet || 2 ||

ājye prajvalitaṃ vahnau vinyasettu dhṛtānvitam |
pavitrīkaraṇaṃ darbhadvayena jvalitena tu || 3 ||

varmaṇājyaṃ ca nīrājya vahnau darbhadvayaṃ kṣipet |
abhidyotanametat syāduddyotanamathocyate || 4 ||

kuśaṃ prajvalitaṃ vahnau vinyasettad hṛdā kṣipet |
vahnābudvāsya ca ghṛtamaṅgārānagniṣu kṣipet || 5 ||

apaḥ saṃspṛśya mantrajñaḥ kuryādutpavanaṃ tataḥ |
astramantraṃ japanmantrī kuśau prādeśamātrakau || 6 ||

aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca gṛhītvā ghṛtamutpavet |
tato hṛdā kuśābhyāṃ tu svābhimukhyena samplavet || 7 ||

ghṛtaṃ tatsyāt samplavanaṃ ṣaṭ saṃskārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |

iti || ājyamiti -

uttamaṃ goghṛtaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ mahiśībhavam |
adhamaṃ chāgalījātaṃ tasmādgavyaṃ praśasyate || 1 ||

iti piṅgalāmatoktaṃ vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ samāpūrya 
mūlamantreṇābhimantrya dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya paścāduktasaṃskāraiḥ 
saṃskuryāt || uktaṃ ca śaivāgame :

gavyamājyaṃ samādāya mūlamantrābhimantritam |
svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintya paritāpayet || 1 ||

iti || vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām : nyasya mantraṃ ghṛte mudrāṃ 
darśayeddhenusaṃjñitām iti | bāhyataḥ kuṇḍavyāsāditi śeṣaḥ | prajvalitaṃ 
kuśadvayaṃ hṛdā ājye kṣipedityanvayaḥ | nīrājyābhitaḥ paribhrāmya 
darbhadvayaṃ darbhāṇāmagnau prakṣepaḥ pratipattikarma ata eva mantro'pi 
noktastena darbhanāśe sati akṛte'pi prakṣepe na vaiguṇyamiti | 
aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ hastadvayeteti śeṣaḥ | 
utpavedagnisaṃmukhamityarthaḥ || śaivāgame :

prādeśamātradarbhābhyāmaṃguṣṭhānāmikāgrakaiḥ |
ghṛtābhyāṃ saṃmukhaṃ vahnerastreṇotpavamācaret || 1 ||

iti || ubhayatra vahniprakṣepa eva kuśānāṃ pratipattikarma || punastatraiva -

gṛhītvā sruksruvāvūrdhvamukhāvadhomukhau kramāt |
pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet || 1 ||

mūlamadhyāgradeśe tu ātmavidyāśivātmakam |
kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasyet hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃbījakaiḥ priye || 2 ||

sruci śaktiṃ sruve śambhuṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunā |
trisūtraveṣṭitagrīvau pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ || 3 ||

kuśānāmupariṣṭāttu sthāpyāvetau svadakṣiṇe |

darbhamūlādibhiḥ sruksruvayormūlādisparśaḥ | 
sparśamabhidhāyoktamuttaratantre -

tata ādāya vāmena prokṣayeddakṣapāṇinā |
bhūyo'gnau tau pratāpyātha kuśānagnau nivedayet || 1 ||

pratāpya triśa iti śeṣaḥ || uktaṃ ca piṅgalāmate -

punastriṃśaḥ pratāpyādhomukhāvagnau kuśān kṣipet |
mūlamadhyāgrake nyasecchaktīricchādikāḥ kramāt || 1 ||

iti | icchājñānakriyāḥ śaktayaḥ || uttaratantre -

kuśadvayaṃ ghṛte nyasya tataḥ prādeśasaṃmitam |
sagranthi kṛtvā sāgraṃ dvau śuklakṛṣṇau vicintayet || 1 ||

p. 255) pakṣau vāma iḍāṃ dakṣe piṅgalāṃ madhyatastataḥ |
suṣumnāṃ saṃsmarenmantrī tato homaṃ samācaret || 2 ||

sagranthi kuśadvayamityanvayaḥ ||

dakṣabhāgādgṛhītvājyaṃ sruveṇātha hṛdāṇunā |
juhuyāddakṣanetre'gneḥ svāhāntāyāgnaye tataḥ || 1 ||

gṛhītvā vāmabhāgācca ghṛtaṃ vāme'gnilocane |
juhuyācca hṛdā somāya svāheti ca deśikaḥ || 2 ||

gṛhītvā madhyatastvājyamagneralikalocane |
hṛdāṇunāgnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti juhuyāt sudhīḥ || 3 ||

dakṣabhāgādgṛhītvā tu hṛdājyaṃ juhuyāt sudhīḥ |
vaktre vahneḥ sviṣṭakṛte svāheti ca tato guruḥ || 4 ||

sarvatra hṛnmantrastvājyagrahaṇe jñeyaḥ || śāradātilake -

satārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyāt punaḥ |
juhuyādagnimantreṇa trivāraṃ deśikottamaḥ || 1 ||

vyāhṛtibhirvyastasamastābhistisṛbhiḥ | prapañcasāre -

garbhādhānādikā vahneḥ samudvāhāvasānikāḥ |
kriyāstāreṇa vai kuryādājyāhutyaṣṭabhiḥ kramāt || 1 ||

iti || śāradātilake - garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā iti | 
vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

jātaṃ dhyātvaivamākāraṃ jātakarma samācaret |
nālāpanayanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ saṃśodhya sūtakam || 1 ||

śivāgniriti nāmāsya kṛtvāhutipuraḥsaram |
pitrorvisarjanaṃ kṛtvā cūḍopanayanādikam || 2 ||

athodvāhāvasānaṃ yat kṛtvā saṃskāramasya tu |

iti | śivāgniriti śaive | anyatra tu nārāyaṇāgnirdurgāgnirityādi || uttaratantre -

garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā |
jātakarma tato nāmakaraṇaṃ copaniṣkramam || 1 ||

annaprāśanacaulopanayanāni tataḥ param |
mahānāmnyaṃ mahāpūrvavrataṃ ca tadanantaram || 2 ||

athaupaniṣadaṃ caiva godānaṃ tadanantaram |
samāvartanamudvāhaḥ saṃskārā maraṇāntikāḥ || 3 ||

krūrakarmaṇi kartavyā maraṇāntāśca deśikaiḥ |

iti || etanmantraśca nāradapañcarātre -

praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya tataḥ karma samuccaret |
sampādayāmi svāheti sarvakarmasvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 1 ||

iti || sautrāmaṇītantre : vivāhāntā vāgbhavena ityuktam tadetayorvikalpaḥ | 
uttaratantre : vivāhānantaram abhyarcyaṃ vahniṃ pitarau saṃyojyātmani mantravit 
| ityuktaṃ yathāsampradāyaṃ jñeyam || tathā :

ādyante ghṛtasaṃśliṣṭāḥ pañcātha samidho hunet |
juhuyādrasanāṅgāṣṭamūrtimantraiḥ sakṛdghṛtaiḥ || 1 ||

iti || gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinyām -

tato ('pi) juhuyādaṅgamantrādyaiśca sakṛt sakṛt |
tannāmānte niśitadhīḥ svāhāntaiśca yathākramam || 1 ||

iti || viṣṇudharmottare -

mantreṇoṃkārapūrveṇa svāhāntena vicakṣaṇaḥ |
svāhāvasāne juhuyāddhyāyanvai mantradevatām || 1 ||

iti || śrutirapi : yasyai devatāyai havirgṛhītaṃ syāttāṃ manasā dhyāyedvaṣaṭ 
kariṣyan iti | svāhāntamantrastu tadanto na kartavyaḥ || uttaratantre :

caturvāraṃ sruveṇājyaṃ gṛhītvā sruci niḥkṣipet |
nenaiva tāṃ pidhāyāgnau hunettiṣṭhan guruḥ svayam || 1 ||

vauṣaḍantena vahnestu manunā sampade tataḥ |

iti || prapañcasāre -

jihvāyāṃ madhyasaṃsthāyāṃ mantrī jvālāvalītanau |
tārādyairdaśabhirmantraiḥ pūrvapūrvasamanvitaiḥ || 1 ||

manunā gāṇapatyena hunet pūrvaṃ daśāhutīḥ |
juhuyācca caturvāraṃ samastenaiva tena tu || 2 ||

ājyena sādhyamanunā pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyakam |
juhuyāt sarvahomeṣu sudhīranalatṛptaye || 3 ||

p. 256) tāntrikāṇāmayaṃ nyāyo hutānāṃ samudīritaḥ |

iti || gāṇapatyena mahāgaṇeśamantreṇa || gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinyām -

mahāgaṇeśamantreṇa pūrvapūrvayutena ca |
tārādibījaṣaṭkeṣukaraṇeṣvadrivarṇakaiḥ || 1 ||

bhinnena daśadhā tena samastena hunet priye |

iti || mantraḥ prayoge vakṣyate | iṣavaḥ pañca karaṇānīndriyāṇi pañca adrayaḥ 
sapta bījaṣaṭkaḥ eṣu padacchedaḥ | caruhome tu carumidānīṃ śrapayet 
tatprakāraḥ prāgeva prapañcitaḥ || uttaratantre :

sampūjya devatāpīṭhaṃ vahnau samyak tato guruḥ |
agnirūpadharāṃ tatra pūjayediṣṭadevatām || 1 ||

ājyena sādhyamanunā pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyakam |
hunenmantrī cā (jya ? gni) mukhe vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ matam || 2 ||

ātmāgnidevatānāṃ ca cintayannaikyamātmavit |
ekādaśātha mūlena hunedājyena cāhutīḥ || 3 ||

nāḍīsaṃdhānamevaṃ hi proktaṃ deśikasattamaiḥ |
aṅgaprabhṛtyāvṛtīnāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hunet || 4 ||

pūrvādidikṣu kuṇḍeṣu sarveṣvapi yathāvidhi |
gururvahni praviharet saṃskṛteṣūktavartmanā || 5 ||

sarvartvijaścandanādyaiḥ sampūjya proktadevatām |
sarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktāṃ mūlena juhuyustataḥ || 6 ||

pañcaviṃśatidhā sarpiḥ saṃyutena payondhasā ||

iti || vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

sruveṇājyaṃ samitpāṇisrucā śeṣaṃ kareṇa vā |
tattaddravyeṇa hotavyaṃ tīrthenārṣeṇa vā tathā || 1 ||

iti || chandogapariśiṣṭe : daivena tīrthe ca hūyate haviḥ svaṅgāriṇi svarcciṣi tacca 
pāvake | iti ||

yo'narcciṣi juhotyagnau vyaṅgāriṇi ca mānavaḥ |
mandāgnirāmayāvī ca daridraścopajāyate || 1 ||

iti || tathā prapañcasāre -

hute tu deśikaḥ paścānmaṇḍale balimāharet |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ savārāṇāṃ sarāśīnāṃ yathākramaṃ || 1 ||

dadyādbaliṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpakamādarāt |
tārāṇāmaśvinyādīnāṃ rāśiḥ pādādhikaṃ dvayam || 2 ||

meṣādiyukta nakṣatra saṃjñāpūrvamanantaram |
devatābhyaḥ padaṃ proktvā divānaktaṃ vadettathā || 3 ||

cāribhyaścātha sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo vai namo vadet |
evaṃ rāśau tu sampūrṇe tasmiṃstadvat prayojayet || 4 ||

tathā rāśyadhipānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ tatra tatra ca |
saptānāṃ karaṇānāṃ ca dadyānmīnāhvameṣayoḥ || 5 ||

antarāle balistvevaṃ samproktaḥ kalaśātmakaḥ |
punarnivedyamuddhṛtya pūrvavat paripūjya ca || 6 ||

mukhavāsādikaṃ dattvā tadā tadyuktayā punaḥ |
stutvā yathāvat praṇamedbhaktiyuktastu sādhakaḥ || 7 ||

iti || mīnāhvameṣayorantarāle īśānapūrvadiśormadhye || tathā tantrarāje -

prācyāṃ meṣavṛṣau vahnau mithunaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
kulīrasiṃho ca tathā nair-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitā || 1 ||

tulākīṭau paścimato dhanurvāyau tu saṃsthitam |
nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitam || 2 ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
dvādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 12 ||





|| trayodaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

uttaratantre -

samutthāyoṣasi tilairjuhuyuḥ sarpiranvitaiḥ |
punaḥ sādhyena manunā aṣṭottarasahasrakam || 1 ||

dravyairvidhānaproktairvā hunedaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam |
śiṣyaṃ snātaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayenmantravittamaḥ || 2 ||

kuṇḍasyābhyāśamānīya divyadṛṣṭyāvalokayet |
hṛtpuṇḍarīkāccaitanyaṃ tasya svātmani yojayet || 3 ||

ācāryastata adhvānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ śodhayet kramāt |
te kalātattvabhuvanārṇapadā mantrapūrvakāḥ || 4 ||

adhvānaḥ ṣaṭ ca samproktāsteṣāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate |
kalā nivṛttiprasukhāstadadhvā pañca kīrtitāḥ || 5 ||

śaivādinigamairbhinnāstattvādhvāno bahukramāḥ |
tatra śaivāni tattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśatpramitānyatha || 6 ||

vakṣyante śivaśaktī ca sadāśiva itīritaḥ |
vidyā caitāni śuddhāni śuddhāśuddhāni sapta ca || 7 ||

māyā vidyā kalā rāgaḥ kālo niyatireva ca |
puruṣaścāpyaśuddhāni prakṛtirbuddhyahaṃkṛtiḥ || 8 ||

manaścendriyadaśakaṃ tanmātrā bhūtapañcakam |
uktāni śaivatattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśanmantravedibhiḥ || 9 ||

atha vaiṣṇavatattvāni dvātriṃśatpramitāni ca |
vakṣyante jīvasahitaḥ prāṇo buddhirmanastataḥ || 10 ||

daśendriyāṇi tanmātrā bhūtānāṃ pañcakaṃ tathā |
hṛtpadmaṃ tejasāṃ caiva trayaṃ catvāra eva ca || 11 ||

vāsudevādayaḥ saurāṇyucyante bhūtapañcakam |
tanmātrāścendriyāṇi syurmano'haṅkārabuddhayaḥ || 12 ||

pradhānaṃ ceti śaktestu tattvāni syurdaśaiva hi |
(nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāḥ pañca tato bindukalā punaḥ || 13 ||

nādaḥ śaktiḥ sadāpūrvaḥ śivaśca prakṛterviduḥ |
sapta tattvāni proktāni tantrajñaistripadātmanaḥ) || 14 ||

ātmavidyāśivā ete viparītāsta eva ca |
sarvatattvaṃ ca samproktāstattvādhvānastu deśikaiḥ || 15 ||

bhuvanānīha sarvāṇi bhuvanādhvā prakīrtitaḥ |

iti || bhuvanāni lokāḥ | tetu kulārṇave -

atalo vitalaścaiva sutalaśca mahātalaḥ |
rasātalaśca tadanu talātala iti smṛtāḥ || 1 ||

pātālo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca maharjanatapāhvayāḥ |
satyalokaśca samproktā lokā ete yathākramam || 2 ||

ādikṣāntāṃstathā varṇān varṇādhvānaṃ pracakṣate |
padādhvā varṇavṛndaṃ syānmantrādhvā padasaṃcayaḥ || 3 ||

śiṣye smaret tān pādāndhunābhihṛdbhālamūrdhasu |
kūrcena ca guruḥ śiṣyaṃ spṛśan kuṇḍe svake hunet || 4 ||

tilairghṛtāktaistārādyamamukādhvānamatra ca |
śodhayāmi dviṭhāntena mantreṇāṣṭāhutīḥ pṛthak || 5 ||

iti || kulārṇave -

śūdrasaṃkarajātīnāṃ nādhvaśuddhirvidhīyate |
pādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryāt pāpavimocanam || 1 ||

iti || tathā -

ṣaḍadhvanaḥ kramāt samyak pravilāpya śivāvadhi |
sṛjet sṛṣṭyā vilīnāṃstāñ śivāntāṃśca gurūttamaḥ || 1 ||

p. 258) deśikendraśca taṃ śiṣyaṃ dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭvā ca divyāya |
taccaitanyaṃ sthitaṃ tasmiṃstasminneva niyojayet || 2 ||

hunenmahāvyāhṛtibhistato deśikasattamaḥ |
aṅgaprabhṛtyā vṛtīnāṃ hunedbhūyo ghṛtena vai || 3 ||

bhūragnaye ca paścācca pṛthivyai ca yuto manuḥ |
bhuvaḥ syādvāyave cāntarikṣāya ca yuto manuḥ || 4 ||

svarādityāya ca dive ca yuto manurīritaḥ |
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramase nakṣatrebhyaśca pūrvataḥ || 5 ||

digbhyastato vadedeṣa mantraḥ proktasturīyakaḥ |
mahate ca dviṭhāntāḥ syurmahāvyāhṛtimantrakāḥ || 6 ||

mahate iti padaṃ bhūrityādicatasṛṣvapyanveti | dviṭhaḥ svāhākāraḥ ||

brahmārpaṇāhvamantreṇa sarvakarmacchide sudhīḥ |
juhuyādāhutīraṣṭau kevalājyena mantravit || 7 ||

vadeditaḥ paraṃ pūrvaprāṇabuddhistato vadet |
dehadharmādhikāraṃ ca jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu || 8 ||

vadet svāvasthāsu manasā vācā padamuddharet |
karmaṇā caiva hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmuktvodareṇa ca || 9 ||

vadecchiśnā ca yacchabdaṃ smṛtaṃ yatpadamuccaret |
uktaṃ ya yatkṛtaṃ tacca sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhava || 10 ||

tu svāhāntaśca samprokto brahmārpaṇamanūttamaḥ |
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ mantrī srucā mūlāṇunā tataḥ || 11 ||

iti | brahmārpaṇamantraḥ prayoge spaṣṭīkriyate | kapilapañcarātre -

arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ juhuyādvai punaḥ sudhīḥ |
nyūnātiriktapūrṇārthaṃ dadāmi saghṛtaṃ tilam || 1 ||

viṣṇubījaṃ samuccārya sāṅgaṃ kurukuru dviṭhaḥ |
yānulomāṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhopāntyasvarākulam || 2 ||

praṇavena samāyuktaṃ viṣṇubījaṃ prakīrtitam |

iti | yānulomāṣṭamo hakāraḥ ṣaṣṭhasvaraḥ ūkāraḥ upāntyasvaro 
binduḥ || śaivāgame -

kṛtvā tu mṛḍanāmāgnimabhyarcya prayataḥ paṭhet |
sahasrārcirmahātejaḥ namaste bahurūpadhṛk (t) || 1 ||

sarvāśine sarvagate pāvakāya namo'stu te |
tvaṃ raudro raudrakarmā ca ghorahā tvaṃ namāmi te || 2 ||

viṣṇustvaṃ lokapālo'si śāntimatra prayaccha me |
sarpiṣā srucamāpūrya puṣpaṃ coparyadhomukham || 3 ||

srugupari srucaṃ dattvā puṣpaṃ tatra pradāpayet |
savyottarakarābhyāṃ ca sampuṭābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhavat || 4 ||

saṃgṛhyotthāya saṃlagnau nābhau tiryaṅnidhāya ca |
pūrṇādarvīti mantreṇa mūlena ca susaṃyataḥ || 5 ||

dadyāt pūrṇāhutīstisraḥ sarvakāmaprapūraṇīḥ |

iti | puṣpadānaṃ srugupari || taduktaṃ vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

tato homāvaśiṣṭena ghṛtenāpūrya vai srucam |
nidhāya puṣpaṃ tasyāgre sruveṇādhomukhena tām || 1 ||

sadarbheṇa samācchādya mūlenāñjalinā tataḥ |
vauṣaḍantena juhuyāddhārāṃ japasamanvitām || 2 ||

iti | pūrṇādarvīti śākhāviśeṣe vaidikahome | mūlena vauṣaḍantena | 
svāhākāraṃ tato home pūrṇāyāṃ vauṣaḍeva hi iti tadīyavacanāt |

hutvā ca haviṣā dadyāt srucā pūrṇāhutitrayam |
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena surottamam || 1 ||

iti hayaśīrṣapañcarātravacanācca || ghṛtābhāve tu nāradapañcarātre -

abhāve tu ghṛtasyaiva homadravyeṇa pūrayet |
tasyopari ghṛtaṃ dadyāttadūrdhvaṃ kusumādikam || 1 ||

iti || devīhome tu pūrṇāyāge -

ājyena sruvamāpūrya tenāpūrya srucaṃ tataḥ |
tadūrdhve'dhomukhaṃ kṛtvā sruvamutthāya mantravit || 1 ||

ṛjukāyastayormūlaṃ nābhimūle nidhāya ca |
mūlaṃ namontamuccārya vāmapādapuraḥsaram || 2 ||

dadyāt pūrṇāhutīrmantrī parāmṛtadhiyā tataḥ |

p. 259) iti || gaṇeśvaraparāmarśinyām -

oṃ bho bho vahne mahāśakte sarvakarmaprasādhaka |
karmāntare'pi saṃprāpte sannidhiṃ kuru sādaram || 1 ||

iti mantreṇa saṃprārthya vahnimudvāsayedapi |

iti || uttaratantre -

punaḥ sampūjya gandhādyairmūlamantreṇa mantravit |
kuṇḍādudvāsya cācāryo devatāṃ kalaśe nyaset || 1 ||

sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ tatra pūjayecca yathāvidhi |
saptavyāhṛtyāgnijihvādīnāmekāhutiṃ kramāt || 2 ||

hutvādbhiḥ pariṣicyāgnim iti || kapilapañcarātre -

tato brahmāṇamudvāsya brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet |
dvātriṃśatpalatāmreṇa nirmitaṃ tāmrapātrakam || 1 ||

taṇḍulena samāpūrya sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇam |
gururvṛtāya tattasmai pūrṇapātraṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 2 ||

iti || uttaratantre -

-------------------saṃyojyātmani mantravit |
tataḥ paristarānagnau paridhīn nikṣipannatu || 1 ||

nitye naimittike tāstu kṣipeddeśikasattamaḥ |
vastreṇa netramantreṇa śiṣyanetre nibadhya ca || 2 ||

kuṇḍāddhaste samādāya nayenmaṇḍalasannidhau |
sumanobhiḥ prapūryāsya hyañjali kṣepayedghaṭe || 3 ||

mūlamantroccārapūrvaṃ devatāprītaye guruḥ |
netrabandhamapāsyopaveśayet kuśasaṃstare || 4 ||

tataśca pāṭhayecchiṣyaṃ mantramenaṃ guruttamaḥ |
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā || 5 ||

cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ |
ataḥ pūjāvidhānena saṃharejjanayecca tam || 6 ||

tān manūktāñśiśordehe nyāsān sarvān pravinyaset |
pañcopacārairabhyarcya kalaśastheṣṭadevatām || 7 ||

tantroktavartmanā tatra sakalīkṛtimācaret |
athopaveśayecchiṣyaṃ bhūṣitaṃ maṇḍalāntare || 8 ||

kumbhāsyasthasuradrūṃśca mūrdhni nyasya śiśorguruḥ |
atha pañcaninādaiśca viprāśīrvacanaiḥ saha || 9 ||

susthitaṃ niyatātmānaṃ siñcet kalaśapuṣkaraiḥ |
yena prakāreṇa purā pūritaśca sudhārasaiḥ || 10 ||

toyairakṣarasaṃyuktairghaṭastenaiva vartmanā |
tathaivainaṃ cābhiṣiñcedāśu saṃpadavāptaye || 11 ||

gṛhītvābhyarcitaṃ pūrvaṃ karakaṃ hyastrarūpiṇam |
tattoyairabhiṣiñcet taṃ rakṣāyai deśikottamaḥ || 12 ||

jalena śiṣṭena śiśuṃ gururācāmayet tataḥ |
taddevatāsvarūpaṃ ca vidadhyāt sakalīkṛtim || 13 ||

vāsasī vimale ramye paridhāyājñayā guroḥ |
ācamya nikaṭe tasya niviśedvāgyataḥ śiśuḥ || 14 ||

guruḥ sampūjya śiṣyasthadevatāṃ bhāvayaṃstayoḥ |
aikyaṃ gururvinītasya samyak tasya manuṃ triśaḥ || 15 ||

dakṣakarṇe vadedvidvān viprāyodakapūrvakam |
anyebhyastu vadedevamevaṃ mantrī vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16 ||

iti || agastyaḥ -

svayaṃjyotīrmayīṃ vidyāṃ gacchantīṃ bhāvayedguruḥ |
āgatāṃ bhāvayecchiṣyo dhanyo'smīti viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

iti || tathā -

aṣṭottaraśataṃ śiṣyaḥ prajapedguruṇoditam |
aṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ vā hyaṣṭakṛtvo'thavā japaḥ || 1 ||

gurudevātmamantrāṇāmaikyaṃ śiṣyo vibhāvayet |
praṇāmaṃ vibhave kuryāt sādhako bhaktimān muhuḥ || 2 ||

so'ṣṭāṅgaścātha pañcāṅgaḥ pūjākarmasu saṃmataḥ |
hastābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca jānubhyāṃ vakṣasā tathā || 3 ||

mūrdhnā dṛṣṭyā tathā vācā cittenāṣṭāṅga īritaḥ |
hastajānuśirovākyadhībhiḥ pañcāṅga īritaḥ || 4 ||

ācāryājñāṃ tataḥ kuryāt sadyaḥ śiṣyo vibhāvya ca |
alaṃkārāṃśca vāsāsi dadyādṛtvigbhya ādarāt || 5 ||

īśvarārpaṇabuddhyā tu dvijāśīrbhiśca nanditaḥ |
pradadyādgurave śiṣyo vicāryārdhaṃ tadardhakam || 6 ||

daśāṃśaṃ vā pradadyācca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
tadadhīnamanā nityaṃ taccittastatparāyaṇaḥ || 7 ||

p. 260) tatpādābjarajobhūṣo bhavet sādhakasattamaḥ |

iti || tantrarāje -

gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt pratyakṣāya śivātmane |
sarvasvaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadājñayā || 1 ||

nacettacchaktisaṃkrāntiḥ kathamasya bhaviṣyati |
gajāśvamahiṣīmeṣapaśudāsīmahīyutam || 2 ||

suvarṇaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vāso bhavanaṃ cānyadīpsitam |
svadehaṃ svātmaprāṇāṃśca dadyāt svaśaktibhaktitaḥ || 3 ||

iti || tathā -

tato nānāvidhairbhakṣyairlehyaiścoṣyaistathetaraiḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścāt pradadyādbhūridakṣiṇām || 1 ||

evaṃ kriyāmayī dīkṣā sambaddhātra nirūpitā |

iti || atrodakapūrvakamityanena gohiraṇyavanmantrasya pradānaṃ pratīyate | 
dānaṃ tu svasvatvaparityāgapūrvakaṃ vidhivat 
parasvatvapratipādanarūpaṃ bhavati | tattu kvāpi śiṣyāya mantraṃ dattvā 
punastaṃ mantraṃ gururna japati nārādhayati ca | taṃ punaranyasmai 
kasmaicit na dadāti iti vacanaṃ sampradāyo vā na dṛśyate | 
tasmādudakadānaṃ tvaupacārikamiti vācyam | tarhi caturṇāmapi 
varṇānāmudakadānaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kathaṃ na syād dīkṣāyāṃ 
viśeṣābhāvādaupacārikatvācca | tasmādudakadānaṃ 
mantradānarūpameva | tatra parasvatvāpādane kṛte'pi 
svasvatvāparityāgarāhityaṃ tu kanyādānavadbhavitumarhatītyāstāṃ 
vicāraḥ ||

anantaroktavarṇātmadīkṣāṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi |
puṃsprakṛtyātmakatvaṃ hi varṇānāṃ samudīritam || 1 ||

tādṛktvaṃ ca śarīrasya proktamevātra deśikaiḥ |
tatastanau śiśornyasedvarṇān deśikasattamaḥ || 2 ||

saṃharedvaiparītyena varṇān tatsthānasaṃsthitān |
deśikendrasya sāmarthyādājñayā devatātmanaḥ || 3 ||

devatātmā bhavecchiṣyastadā saṃlīnatattvakaḥ |
tatastu śiṣyacaitanyaṃ paramātmani yojayet || 4 ||

tānarṇāṃstata utpādya nyasecchiśuśarīrake |
tasmiṃśca sṛṣṭikramatastaccaitanyaṃ punarnyaset || 5 ||

bhavecchiṣyo devatātmā nityānandātmakaḥ śiśuḥ |
jñānadārṇamayī dīkṣā kathitā sarvasiddhidā || 6 ||

athocyate kalātmā sā dīkṣā divyatvadāyinī |
kalā nivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥ || 7 ||

śiṣyakāye bhūtamaye vedhayet tāḥ kramāt sudhīḥ |
pādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃsthitā kalā || 8 ||

jānvoḥ sakāśādānābhi pratiṣṭhākhyā kalā smṛtā |
nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā || 9 ||

kaṇṭhato hyālalāṭaṃ tu śāntyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā |
bhālācchirovadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathā || 10 ||

ayathākramato vidvān vedhayet sthānato'nyataḥ |
sthāneṣvīśājñayā caiṣā kalādīkṣā samīritā || 11 ||

atha vedhātmikā dīkṣā procyate bhavamocanī |
caturdale smaret patre mūlādhāre śiśostanau || 12 ||

dhāmatritasaṃyukte trikoṇoktabile sudhīḥ |
trirāvartamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīm || 13 ||

mahādevamayīṃ sākṣājjñānamātrasvarūpiṇīm |
aṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīm || 14 ||

suṣumnāvartmanā divyāṃ yāntīṃ śivagṛhaṃ prati |
sāntān vādīn dalasthārṇān padmayonau samāharet || 15 ||

ṣaḍdale kamale taṃ tu lāntabādyarṇayugdale |
svādhiṣṭhāne guruḥ samyag yojayitvā tu vedhayet || 16 ||

tānarṇānānayedviṣṇau viṣṇuṃ taṃ nābhipaṅkaje |
phāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayet svayam || 17 ||

varṇāṃstān yojayedrudre rudraṃ taṃ hṛtsaroruhe |
ṭhāntakādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayam || 18 ||

vārṇāṃstānāharedasmin kaṇṭhapadme ca taṃ tathā |
kalāmayadale padme svarān saṃyojya yatnataḥ || 19 ||

sadāśive ca saṃyojya tāṃstadbhrūmadhyapadmake |
dvidale hakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥ || 20 ||

hakṣau tāvāharedbindau kalāyāmāharecca tam |
kalāṃ nāde samāyojya nādaṃ nādāntake punaḥ || 21 ||

nādāntamunmanīmadhye viṣuvaktre tathonmanīm |
viṣuvaktraṃ svake vaktre saṃhared deśikaḥ svayam || 22 ||

p. 261) śaktyā sahaivamātmānaṃ nayetparaśivāvadhi |
deśikājñāvaśācchiṣyo dagdhājñānastadā kṣitau || 23 ||

patedavāptavijñānaḥ sarvajño jāyate tataḥ |
sadāśivaḥ svayaṃ bhūyāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||

jñānapradā mayā proktā dīkṣā vedhātmikā śubhā |
catasrastvevamuddiṣṭā dīkṣāḥ samyak śubhāvahāḥ || 25 ||

iti | śrīkulārṇave -

haste śivapuraṃ dhyātvā japad mūlāṅgamālinīm |
guruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ sparśadīkṣā bhavediyam || 1 ||

cittaṃ tattve samādhāya paratattvopabṛṃhitān |
uccaret saṃhatān mantrān vāgdīkṣeti nigadyate || 2 ||

nimīlya nayane dhyātvā paratattvaṃ prasannadhīḥ |
samyakpaśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā sā bhavet priye || 3 ||

gurorālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇāt sparśanādapi |
sadyaḥ saṃjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matā || 4 ||

jñeyā siddhāntaśāstrārthasaṃpradāyādihetubhiḥ |
antareṇopadiṣṭā ye mantrāḥ syurviphalā yataḥ || 5 ||

devāstameva śaṃsanti pāramparyapravartakam |
gurumantrāgamābhijñaṃ samayācārapālakam || 6 ||

guruḥ śiṣyādhikārārtha virakto'pi śivājñayā |
kañcitkālaṃ vidhāyaitat suśiṣyāyā samarpayet || 7 ||

tasyārpitādhikārasya yogaḥ sākṣātpare śive |
tatastu śāśvatī muktiriti śaṅkarabhāṣitam || 8 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sākṣāt paraśivoditam |
sampradāyamavicchinnaṃ sadā kuryādguruḥ priye || 9 ||

bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ parīkṣya vidhivadguruḥ |
paścādupadiśenmantramanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 10 ||

anyāyena ca yo dadyādgṛhṇātyanyāyataśca yaḥ |
dadato gṛhṇato devi kulaśāpo bhaviṣyati || 11 ||

guruśiṣyāvubhau mohādaparīkṣya parasparam |
upadeśaṃ dadadgṛhṇan tau prayātāṃ piśācatām || 12 ||

aśāstrīyopadeśaṃ tu yo gṛhṇāti dadāti ca |
bhuñjāte tāvubhau ghorān narakānekaviṃśatim || 13 ||

asaṃskṛtyopadeśaṃ tu yaḥ karoti vimūḍhadhīḥ |
vinyasyati ca taṃ mantraṃ saikate śālibījavat || 14 ||

anahaṃ tattvavijñānaṃ na tiṣṭhati kadācana |
tasmāt parīkṣya vaktavyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 15 ||

suśiṣyāyātibhaktāya yajjñānamupadiśyate |
tat prāpayati tattattvaṃ gauḥ kṣīrāttu ghṛtaṃ yathā || 16 ||

dhanecchābhayalobhādyairayogyaṃ paridīkṣayet |
devatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ bhavet || 17 ||

iti || (atha pūrṇābhiṣekavidhirlikhyate) uttaratantre -

pūrṇābhiṣekaṃ vakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ śubhāvaham |
vinā yenābhiṣekeṇa sādhakaḥ pūrṇabodhatām || 1 ||

ācāryatvaṃ ca nāpnoti sadgatiṃ ca samīhitām |
tasmād guruḥ priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ bodhayitvābhiṣecayet || 2 ||

viracya vipulaṃ cakraṃ maṇḍape'timanorame |
khārītoyabhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ sthāpayeccakramadhyataḥ || 3 ||

anyeṣu kalaśān ratnavastrahemasamanvitān |
daleṣu vidhivat sthāpya tatrābāhyeṣṭadevatām || 4 ||

abhyarcya madhye cānyeṣu cāṅgāvaraṇadevatāḥ |
śiṣyasya janmanakṣatre prāgvat tairabhiṣecayet || 5 ||

ayaṃ pūrṇābhiṣekaḥ syāt sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥ |

iti || khārīpramāṇaṃ tu skandapurāṇe -

paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ kuḍavaṃ dviguṇaṃ matam |
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthamāḍhakaṃ taiścaturguṇaiḥ || 1 ||

caturguṇo bhaveddroṇaḥ kumbhastaddvayataḥ smṛtaḥ |
kumbhaistairaṣṭabhiḥ khārī -------------------------- || 2 ||

iti || atha dīkṣāprayogaḥ : tatraivaṃ vicārya vihitakāleṣu dīkṣādināt 
pūrvadine śiṣyaḥ prātaḥsnātaḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ 
pañcavādyaghoṣapuraḥsaraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtasvastivācanaḥ 
priyasuhṛdbhiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ gurugṛhaṃ gatvā taṃ vidhivat praṇamya 
tadājñayā prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram oṃ adyāmukamāse'mukarāśigate 
savitaryamukapakṣe'mukatithāvamukagotro brāhmaṇaścedamukaśarmā 
kṣatriyaścedamukavarmā vaiśyaścedamukaguptaḥ 
śūdraścedamukadāso'haṃ 
caturvidhapuruṣārthasiddhikāmo'mukamantragrahaṇaṃ kariṣye 

p. 262) iti kuśahastaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā saṅkalpaṃ vidhāya 
pramāṇoktamadhuparkasāmagrībhiḥ svaśākhoktavidhinā śrīguruṃ 
madhuparkeṇābhyarcya 
dhautottarīyapracchadapaṭasvarṇāṃgulīyakakarṇābharaṇasvarṇayajño-
pavītahārakeyūrāṅgadādinānābharaṇacchatracāmaropānadyugala-
śayyātalpārataraṇasampannāṃ varaṇasāmagrīṃ gurusannidhau nidhāya 
adyetyādi prāgvat tithyullekhanānte'mukagotro'mukaśarmetyādi 
yathāvarṇavihitamuccāryāhaṃ 
caturvidhapuruṣārthasiddhikāmo'mukamantragrahaṇārthamamukagotra-
mamukavedāntargatāmukhaśākhādhyāyinamamukamebhiryathāśakti 
vihitavaraṇasādhanairgurutvena vṛṇe iti gurupādayoḥ praṇamya 
varaṇasāmagrīṃ nivedayet | tato vṛto'smīti guruṇā prativacane datte 
śiṣyaḥ kṛtāñjaliryathoktaṃ guro karma kuruṣveti brūyāt | tato guruḥ 
karavāṇīti pratibrūyāt | itthaṃ guruvarṇaṃ vidhāya tadanujñayāṣṭau 
brāhmaṇān vedavedāṅgapāragān sveṣṭadevatopāsakān 
prāguktaguruvaraṇokta sāmagrībhistathaiva ṛtvivatvena vṛṇuyāt | 
catuṣkuṇḍapakṣe catvāra eva ṛtvijaḥ kāryāḥ | tataḥ śiṣyeṇaivaṃvṛto 
guruḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ pañcavādyaghoṣapuraḥsaraṃ 
brāhmaṇaiḥ suhṛjjanaiśca vṛtaḥ śiṣyeṇa saha maṇḍapadvāraṃ gatvā 
tatra vakṣyamāṇavidhinā dvārapūjāṃ vidhāya tathaiva 
bhūtotsādanapūrvakaṃ maṇḍapāntaḥ praviśya tathaiva 
pañcagavyārghyatoyaprokṣaṇapūrvakaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇavīkṣaṇādicaturbhiḥ saṃskāraiḥ 
saṃskṛtamaṇḍapābhyantare candanāgarukarpūradhūpite 
candanasarṣapadūrvābhasmākṣatalājān astramantreṇa 
saptadhābhimantritān maṇḍapāntarvikīrya astramantreṇa kuśamuṣṭinā 
sammārjya maṇḍapasyeśānakoṇe saṃsthāpya brāhmaṇaiḥ 
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kārayitvā vāstupuruṣapūjādikaṃ vidhāya 
bhairavājñāpuraḥsaraṃ vedikāyāmastīrya vakṣyamāṇavidhinā 
sampūjya tatra prāṅmukhopaviṣṭaḥ svapurataḥ susame bhūtale vedikopari 
sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ kuryāt | tatra prākpratyagāyatā 
dakṣiṇottarāyatāśca saptadaśasaptadaśa rekhāḥ kṛtvā 
ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatadvayakoṣṭhayutaṃ caturasramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā 
tanmadhyagataṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhānyekīkṛtya 
tadbahiścaturdikṣvekapaṃktiṃ paritaḥ sammārjyaikīkṛtya pīṭhaṃ 
parikalpya tadbahiścaturdiggatapaṃktidvayamekīkṛtya sammārjyaṃ vīthīṃ 
parikalpya sarvamadhyagatasarojasthāne bahiḥ paritaḥ dvādaśabhāgaṃ 
parityajya sarvamadhyāvalambanena samāntarālavṛttatrayaṃ niṣpādya tatra 
sarvavṛttamadhyakarṇikāṃ parikalpya tadbahirgatavṛttavīthīṃ 
kesarārthaṃ parikalpya kesarasthānaṃ ṣoḍaśadhā vibhajya 
taccihnāvalambanena dvitīyatṛtīyavṛttayorantarālamānasūtramānena 
gurūktayuktyā ṣoḍaśārdhacandrān parikalpya tenāṣṭadalāni kṛtvā 
tṛtīyavṛttādbahistyaktaikāṃśato madhyacihnāvalambanena vṛttāntaraṃ 
niṣpādya gurūktayuktyā pātrāgrāṇi vidhāyaikaikadalamūle 
kesaradvayaṃ yathā dṛśyate tathā viracya padmaṃ kṛtvā 
padmabahirgataikapaṃktirūpacaturasrapīṭhasya koṇacatuṣṭaye'pi 
koṣṭhatrayeṇa koṣṭhatrayeṇa pīṭhapādān 
parikalpyāvaśiṣṭakoṣṭhairekībhūtaiḥ pīṭhagātrāṇi vidhāya 
tadbahirgatapaṃktidvayakoṣṭhāni samyak pramārjya 
tadbahirgatapaṃkteścaturdikṣu madhye madhye koṣṭhadvaya 
koṣṭhadvayamekīkṛtya sarvavāhyagatapaṃkterapi caturdikṣu pratidiśaṃ 
koṣṭhacatuṣṭayamārjanena dvāracatuṣṭaya parikalpya 
dvāracatuṣṭayasyāpi pārśvayoḥ paṃktidvayagatakoṣṭheṣu 
antaḥpaṃkteḥ koṣṭhatrayaṃ bahiḥpaṃkteḥ koṣṭhamekamiti 
koṣṭhacatuṣṭayamekīkṛtya śobhāṃ vidhāya tatpārśvayorapyanyaḥ 
paṃkteḥ koṣṭhamekaṃ bahiḥpaṃkteḥ koṣṭhatrayamiti koṣṭhacatuṣṭayam 
koṣṭhacatuṣṭayam ekīkṛtyopaśobhāṃ vidhāyāvaśiṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ 
koṣṭhaiścatvāri koṇāni kalpayet iti sarvatobhadramaṇḍala nirmāya 
sarojakarṇikākesaradalāgrapīṭhavīthīdvāraśobhopaśobhākoṇasthānāni 
pañcavarṇarajobhirbhūṣayet | pañcavarṇarajāṃsi tu - haridrācūrṇaṃ 
pītaṃ rajaḥ taṇḍulacūrṇaṃ śuklaṃ kusumbhakusumacūrṇaṃ raktaṃ 
dagdhataṇḍulacūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bilvapatracūrṇaṃ śyāmamiti | 
rajovinyāsaprakārastu : sīmāgatāḥ sarvarekhāḥ śuklarajasā 
ekāṃgulotsedhavistārayutāḥ kāryāḥ | pītarajasā kamalakarṇikāṃ 
kesarāṇi ca samyak samāpūrya śuklarajasā dalāni ca sampūrya 
śyāmarajasā dalasandhīnāpūrayet | athavā karṇikāṃ pītena kesarān 
pītaraktābhyāṃ dalāni raktena dalasandhīn kṛṣṇena rajasā sampūrya 
pītena kṛṣṇena vā pīṭhagarbhamāpūrya pīṭhapādān raktenāpūrya 
pīṭhagātrāṇi śubhrarajasāpūrya vīthīcatuṣṭaye kalpavallīḥ 
korakapuṣpapallavaphalamaṇḍitā nānāvarṇarajobhirāracayya śubhreṇa 
rajasā dvāracatuṣkamāpūrya raktavarṇena dvāraśobhāḥ 
pītenopaśobhāḥ kṛṣṇena koṇāni cāpūrya tadbahī 
rekhātrayamekaikāṃgulāntarālaṃ śuklaraktakṛṣṇarajobhiḥ kuryāditi 
sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ vidhāya vedīparito dīpān prajvālya 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā pūjādravyāṇyāsādya tathaiva tāni saṃskṛtya 
chatracāmaradvayadarpaṇavyajanādikaṃ ca yathāyathaṃ nidhāya 
gurvādivandanapūrvakaṃ 
karaśuddhitālatrayadigbandhanāgniprākāratrayabhūtaśuddhiprāṇa-
pratiṣṭhāmātṛkānyāsayogapīṭhanyāsamūlamantranyāsāṃśca 
vidhāya

p. 263)

mudrāviracanasveṣṭadevatādhyānamānasapūjānte 
vaiśvadevamūlamantrajapatatsamarpaṇārghyasthāpanātmapūjāntarhavana
mūlamantrajapatatsamarpaṇāni vidhāya śarvatobhadramaṇḍalāya namaḥ 
iti maṇḍalaṃ gandhādipañcopacāraiḥ sampūjyārghyajalena prokṣya tatra 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā pīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāya tatkarṇikāṃ 
śālibhirāpūryaṃ taṇḍulān kuśān dūrvāḥ saptaviṃśatibhiḥ 
kuśairekīkṛtāgraviracitabrahmagrathinkaṃ kūrcaṃ ca nidhāya tatra 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā śālipuñjopari vahnimaṇḍalaṃ vahnikalāśca 
sampūjya tatra svarṇādinirmitaṃ triguṇīkṛtasūtraveṣṭitasarvāṅgaṃ 
candanāgarukarpūradhūpadhūpitaṃ kumbhaṃ praṇavamuccaran 
saṃsthāpya tatra puṣparāganīlavaidūryavidrumamauktikamarakatavajra-
gomedapadmarāgākhyāni navaratnāni sasuvarṇāni nikṣipya kumbhasyopari 
gandhākṣatadūrvānvitaprāguktalakṣaṇaṃ kūrcaṃ ca nidhāya tatra 
kṣaṃlamityādivilomamātṛkānte mūlamantraṃ trirjapan ātmanaḥ 
kumbhasya yogapīṭhasya caivayaṃ bhāvayan 
vakṣmāṇapañcāśadakṣarauṣadhikvāthairaśvatthayodumbaraplakṣavaṭa-
kvāthaiḥ palāśavṛkṣatvacākvāthaiḥ 
karpūracandanakastūrīkuṃkumavāsitaistīrthajalairvā kumbhamāpūryaṃ 
svapurato vakṣyamāṇavidhinā śaṅkhaṃ saṃsthāpya 
kumbhapūritajalasajātīyajalenāpūrya tatra gandhāṣṭakaṃ viloḍya tatra 
vakṣyamāṇavahnikalāḥ sūryakalāḥ somakalāścāvāhya tāsāṃ pṛthak 
pṛthak prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya sampūjya 
praṇavotthaikapañcāśatkalāḥ kalāmātṛkānyāsoktāḥ sampūjyāḥ | 
tatra prathamamakārādbrahmaṇa utpannāḥ kacavargotthāḥ 
sṛṣṭyādidaśakalāḥ samāvāhya haṃsaḥ śucipaditi ṛco vāmadeva 
ṛṣirjagatīcchandaḥ sūryo devateti ṛṣyādīn smṛtvā oṃ haṃsaḥ 
śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | 
nṛpadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā ādrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat || iti 
mantramuccārya brahmaṇe namaḥ iti sampūjya 
pūrvoktaprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa mamapadasthāne sṛṣṭyādīnāmiti 
padaṃ dattvā sṛṣṭyādīnāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya oṃ kaṁ sṛṣṭyai 
namaḥ ityādi daśakalāḥ sampūjyāḥ | 
ukārādviṣṇorutpannāṣṭatavargotthā jarādidaśakalāḥ samāvāhya oṃ 
pratadviṣṇuriti mantrasya dīrghatamā ṛṣistriṣṭupchando viṣṇurdevatā iti 
ṛṣyādikaṃ smṛtvā oṃ pratadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ 
kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyāruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni 
viśvā || iti paṭhitvā viṣṇave namaḥ iti sampūjya 
prāgvajjarādidaśakalānāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya oṃ ṭaṃ jarāyai 
namaḥ ityādidaśakalāḥ sampūjyāḥ | makārādrudrādutpannāḥ 
payavargotthāstīkṣṇādidaśakalāḥ samāvāhya oṃ tryambakamiti mantrasya 
vasiṣṭha ṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ tryambakarudro devanā iti ṛṣyādikaṃ 
smṛtvā oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | 
urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt || iti paṭhitvā rudrāya 
namaḥ iti sampūjya tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya oṃ paṃ tīkṣṇāyai 
namaḥ ityādidaśakalāḥ sampūjyāḥ | īśvarādbindorutpannāḥ 
ṣakārādikṣakārāntāḥ pañcavarṇotthāḥ pītādipañcakalā āvāhya 
ṛṣyādismaraṇapūrvakaṃ gāyatrīmuccārya iśvarāya namaḥ iti 
sampūjya tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya oṃ ṣaṃ pītāyai namaḥ 
ityādipañcakalāḥ sampūjyāḥ  tato nādotthāḥ sadāśivādutpannāḥ 
svarajā nivṛttyādyāḥ ṣoḍaśakalāḥ samāvāhya viṣṇuryoniṃ 
kalpayatviti mantrasya tvaṣṭā garbhakartā ṛṣiranuṣṭupchando viṣṇurdevateti 
ṛṣyādikaṃ smṛtvā oṃ viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu | 
āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te || iti paṭhitvā śadāśivāya 
namaḥ iti sampūjya tāsāṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya aṃ nivṛttyai 
namaḥ ityādiṣoḍaśakalāḥ sampūjyāḥ | itthaṃ caturnavatidevatāḥ 
śaṅkhe sampūjya sakalakalāmayaṃ śaṅkhajalaṃ mūlamantreṇa kumbhe 
saṃyojya tato'śvatthapanasāmrapallavān indravāruṇīlatayā saṃveṣṭya 
kalpavṛkṣadhiyā kalaśe nidhāya tadupari kalaśasajātīyaṃ 
taṇḍulapūrṇaṃ nārikelaphalāḍhyakalpavṛkṣaphalabuddhyā pātraṃ 
saṃsthāpya paṭṭavastrayugena ghaṭaṃ saṃveṣṭayediti vedyāṃ 
pradhānakumbhasthāpanaṃ vidhāya pūrvāditoraṇasamīpe 
prāguktamaṇḍale'pi aṣṭadalakamaleṣu vā śālipuñjopari 
prāguktavidhinā pratidvāramekamekaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra 
pūrvadiggatakumbhe dhruvaṃ dakṣiṇe dharāṃ paścime vākpatimuttare 
vighneśaṃ ca sampūjya tadvadāgneyādikoṇacatuṣṭaye kumbhān 
saṃsthāpyāgneyakumbhe'mṛtaṃ nair-ṛte durjayaṃ vāyavye 
siddhārthamīśāne maṅgalaṃ ca sampūjya punaḥ 
pūrvādikumbheṣvindrādilokapālānāvāhya vedoktatattanmantreṇa 
sampūjya punaḥ pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu kumbhādbahiḥ airāvataṃ puṇrīkaṃ 
vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanau | puṣpadantaṃ sarvabhaumaṃ supratīkaṃ ca 
pūjayet || iti diggajān sampūjya punargururvedyāṃ gatvā svāsane 
samupaveśya sveṣṭamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā tasya 
mantrasyarpyādi

p. 264)

karaṣaḍaṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ sakalanyāsajālaṃ vidhāya devatāṃ 
dhyātvā mānasairupacāraiḥ sampūjya pradhānakumbhe 
vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa mūrtiṃ parikalpya tatra sveṣṭadevatāmāvāhya 
vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ sāṅgāvaṇaṃ 
tattatkalpoktavidhinā sampūjya vedyā dakṣiṇabhāge 
hastamātrāyāmavistāramaṃguṣṭhaparvamātroccaṃ vālukābhiḥ 
samacaturasraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇanityahomaproktavidhinā 
vahniṃ saṃsthāpya caruṃ śrapayitvā tatra devatāmāvāhya sampūjya 
nityahomoktavidhinā sājyena tena carudravyeṇa hutvā punardevaṃ 
sampūjya kumbhasthamūrtau saṃyojya tathaiva vahniṃ sampūjya visṛjya 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā sarvabhūtabaliṃ tattatkalpoktabalidānaṃ ca vidhāya 
devāyottarāpośānādinīrājanāntaṃ nityapūjoktavidhinā vidhāya 
prāṇāyāmatraya-ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ 
mūlamantramaṣṭottarasahasraṃ japitvā devāya vakṣyamāṇavidhinā 
japaṃ samarpya pūrvamaṇḍapasyeśānakoṇe sthāpitavikirapuñjopari 
suvarṇagarbhaṃ vastrayugmaveṣṭitaṃ jalapūritaṃ karakaṃ vinyasya 
tatrāstradevatāṃ siṃharūpāṃ dakṣavāmakarayoḥ 
khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīṃ ghorarūpāṃ paścimābhimukhāṃ dhyātvā 
tiṣṭhan gandhādipañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya namaskṛtya taṃ karakaṃ 
karābhyāmuddhṛtya maṇḍapābhyantare pradakṣiṇaṃ bhraman karakaṃ 
svasthāne niveśyopaviśyāstramantreṇa punastāmastradevatāṃ 
pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya tataḥ prākkṛteṣu kuṇḍeṣu 
indreśānayormadhyagatācāryakuṇḍe gururagnisthāpanaṃ kuryāt ||

tatrādau kuṇḍaṃ gomayenopalipya kuṇḍasamīpe nityapūjoktavidhinā 
svāsanamāstīrya sampūjya tatrodaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vopaviśya 
mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāma-ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vinyasya 
devatāṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ sampūjya mūlaṃ yathāśakti 
japitvā japaṃ samarpya śrīguruṃ praṇamya kuṇḍasaṃskārān kuryāt || 
tatrādau kuṇḍaṃ mūlamantreṇa vīkṣyāstramantreṇaprokṣyāstreṇaiva 
kuśaistriḥ saṃtāḍya kavacenābhyukṣyāstreṇa kuṇḍamadhye kiñcit 
khātvāstramantreṇa tāṃ mṛdamaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ uddhṛtya 
bahistyaktvā hṛnmantreṇa śuddhamṛttikayā khātamāpūrya astramantreṇa 
samīkṛtya kavacamantreṇa jalaiḥ saṃsicyāstramantreṇa kāṣṭhādinā 
kuṭṭayitvā dṛḍhīkṛtya kavacamantreṇa kuśaiḥ kuṇḍaṃ sammārjya 
kavacenaiva gomayādbhiḥ saṃlipya 
kavacenaivāgnisūryasomānāmaṣṭātriṃśatkalārūpaṃ sañcintya 
kavacenaiva mekhalātraye'pi triguṇīkṛtasūtreṇa pratimekhalaṃ tristriḥ 
saṃveṣṭya oṃ amukakuṇḍāya etadāsanaṃ namaḥ 
ityādyāsanādidīpāntairupacāraiḥ prathamacaturasrāditattatkuṇḍanāmnā 
caturthīnamo'ntena sampūjya tathaiva nābhiṃ ca sampūjya 
mekhalātrayaṃ tathaiva hṛnmantreṇa sampūjyāstramantreṇa kuṇḍaṃ 
vajravaddṛḍhaṃ sañcintya hṛnmantreṇa kuśaiḥ kuṇḍasya 
caturdikṣuvahnijvālāvilāsāya catuṣpathaṃ mārgacatuṣṭyaṃ parikalpya 
kavacamantreṇācchinnāgraiḥ kuśairastramantrābhimantritaiḥ 
kuṇḍabhittigaṇaṃ sarvamācchādayan akṣapāṭanaṃ kuryāt ityaṣṭādaśa 
saṃskārān kuryāt | aśaktau prathamoditaiścaturbhireva saṃskāraiḥ 
kuṇḍaṃ saṃskṛtya tatra hṛnmantreṇāstramantreṇa vā 
dakṣiṇamadhyottareṣu prāgagrāḥ paścimamadhyapūrveṣūdagagrā iti 
tisrastisro rekhāḥ kuśamūlena vilikhya praṇavenābhyukṣya prāgagrāsu 
rekhāsu dakṣiṇarekhāyāṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | madhyarekhāyāṃ rudrāya 
namaḥ | uttarasyām indrāya namaḥ | udagagrāsu rakhāsu paścimāyāṃ 
brahmaṇe namaḥ | madhyamāyāṃ sūryāyanamaḥ | pūrvarekhāyāṃ 
somāya namaḥ | iti sampūjya tatra vakṣyamāṇayogapīṭhakrameṇa 
maṇḍūkādiparatattvāntaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ sampūjya tatra padmakesareṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena madhyāntaṃ oṃ jayāyai namaḥ | evaṃ vijayāyai 
namaḥ | ajitāyai namaḥ | aparājitāyai namaḥ | nityāyai namaḥ | vilāsinyai 
namaḥ | dogdhryai namaḥ | aghorāyai namaḥ | maṅgalāyai namaḥ iti 
sampūjya | hrīṃ sarvaśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ iti madhye puṣpāñjaliṃ 
nikṣipya tatra bhuvaneśvarīṃ 
tattanmantreṇāvāhyāvāhanādiparamīkaraṇāntaṃ tattanmudrayā 
vidhāyāsanādiṣoḍaśopacārairārādhya tatra śrīśivaṃ dhyātvā 
mūlamantreṇa tathaiva sampūjya devīmṛtusnātāṃ devaṃ ca 
kāmonmattaṃ vicintya svarṇādipātreṇa mṛtpātraṃ cet nūtanena 
sūryakāntādibhavamaraṇibhavaṃ śrotriyagṛhādvāgnimastramantreṇa 
pātre kṛtvā kavacamantreṇa sajātīyena pātrāntareṇapidhāya kanyayā 
suvāsinyā vā samānītaṃ gururādāyāstramantreṇaikamaṅgāraṃ 
tanmadhyāt kravyādāṃśaṃ nair-ṛtakoṇe parityajya devāṃśaṃ mūlena 
vīkṣyāstreṇa prokṣyāstreṇa kuśaiḥ saṃtāḍya kavacenābhyukṣya tatra 
svamūlādhārasthavahnimaṇḍalagataparamātmasvarūpāgnīṣomātmakād
vindoḥ sakāśādbahiṃ maṇipūragatajāṭharānalena saha 
suṣumnāmārgeṇa vahannāsāpuṭādhvanā niṣkāsya ramiti 
vahnibījamuccaran purataḥ pātrasthite vahnau 

p. 265)

vahnicaitanyaṃ saṃyojya audaryavaindavapārthivavahnīnāmaikyaṃ 
vibhāvayan praṇavenābhimantrya vamiti 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtyāstramantreṇasaṃrakṣya kavacenāvaguṇṭhya oṃ 
raṃ vahnaye namaḥ iti gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya jānubhyāmavaniṃ 
gatastatpātraṃ karābhyāmādāya kuṇḍopari triḥpradakṣiṇaṃ 
paribhrāmya devyā yonau śivavījamiti dhyāyana svābhimukhaṃ 
kuṇḍamadhye praṇavamuccaran tamagniṃ nikṣipya maithunadhiyā 
devadevyorācamanaṃ dattvā oṃ citpiṅgala hanahana pacapaca dahadaha 
sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā iti mantramuccaran mukhena phūtkṛtya 
kuśairagniṃ prajvālya kāṣṭhaiḥ paṭṭakṛtya kṛtāñjalistiṣṭhan oṃ agniṃ 
prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam | suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ 
samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham || iti jvalantaṃ vahnimupasthāya 
vakṣyamāṇavahnimantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi bhṛgu-ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye agnaye devatāyaiḥ namaḥ | 
guhye raṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ svāhāśaktaye namaḥ iti vinyasya 
dīkṣāṅgahome viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjalirvadet | liṅge sarayūṃ hiraṇyāyai 
namaḥ | gude ṣarayūṃ kanakāyai namaḥ | śirasi śarayūṃ raktāyai 
namaḥ | mukhe varayūṃ kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ | nāsikāyāṃ larayūṃ 
suprabhāyai namaḥ | netrayoḥ rarayūṃ raktāyai namaḥ | sarvāṅge 
yarayūṃ bahurūpāyai namaḥ iti saptajihvā vinyasya oṃ sahasrārciṣa 
hṛdayāya namaḥ | svastipūrṇāya śirase svāhā | uttiṣṭhapuruṣāya 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | dhūmavyāpine kavacāya huṃ | saptajihvāya netratrayāya 
vauṣaṭ | dhanurdharāyāstrāya phaṭ | iti ṣaḍaṅgāni vinyasya śirasi agnaye 
jātavedase namaḥ | vāṃmāṃse agnaye saptajihvāya namaḥ | 
vāmapārśva agnaye havyavāhanāya namaḥ | vāmakaṭyāṃ agnye 
aśvodarajāya namaḥ | liṅge agnaye vaiśvānarāya namaḥ | dakṣakaṭyāṃ 
agnaye kaumāratejase namaḥ | dakṣapārśve agnaye viśvamukhāya namaḥ | 
dakṣāṃse agnaye devamukhāya namaḥ  iti mūrtīrvinyasya vahnirūpaṃ 
svātmānaṃ dhyātvā saptajihvāmudrāṃ pradarśya kuṇḍasyottarabhāge 
kuśāstare sruvasruvau prokṣaṇīpātre ājyasthālī carusthālī paridhitrayaṃ 
samitpañcātmakamidhmaṃ lūnamūlasāgrakuśamuṣṭiriti 
pātrāṇyadhomukhāni saṃsthāpya anyānyapi dadhyakṣatādibalidravyāṇi 
gandhapuṣpādipūjādravyāṇi ca yathāyathaṃ saṃsthāpyādhomukhāni 
sruksruvādīni 
sapavitrādhomukhahastasekarūpāvīkṣaṇapūrvakamuttānīkṛtya 
praṇītapātraṃ prakṣālya svapurataḥ kuśāstare nidhāya 
śuddhajalairāpūrya tatra gandhākṣatān nikṣipya prādeśamātraṃ 
sāgraṃ kuśadvayaṃ madhye brahmagranthiyutaṃ jalāgre uttarāgraṃ 
pavitraṃ nidhāya karadvayānāmikāṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ pavitraṃ mūlāgre 
vidhṛtyāstramantramuccaran pavitramadhyena jalaṃ pātrādbahistrivāraṃ 
nikṣipet || ityutpavanaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye kiñcit ghṛtaṃ nikṣipya 
tatpātraṃ karābhyāmāmastakamuddhṛtya kuṇḍasyottarabhāge kuśāstare 
vidhāya tadupari prāgagrān darbhān nikṣipet iti praṇītāpātraṃ 
saṃsthāpya prokṣaṇīpātraṃ prakṣālya śuddhajalairāpūrya tanmadhye 
praṇītāpātrajalaṃ pātrāntareṇoddhṛtya kiñciddattvā tena jalena 
mūlamantreṇa sarvāṇi pātrāṇi homadravyāṇi pūjādravyāṇi ca 
prokṣayet iti dravyāsādanaṃ vidhāya prokṣaṇīyajalenāgniṃ 
pariṣicyāgarbhaiścaturbhirdarbhaiḥ prācīdiśamārabhya 
prācyāmuttarāgrairīśānādyāgneyāntaṃ paristīrya punardakṣiṇasyāṃ 
prāgagraiḥ pūrvaparistaraṇamūlamagrairācchādayan punaḥ 
paścimāyāmuttarāgrairdakṣiṇaparistaraṇamūlaṃ mūlenācchādayan 
punaruttarasyāṃ prāgagraiḥ paścimaparistaraṇāgraṃ 
pūrvaparistaraṇagramagreṇa ca paristīrya paridhitrayamādāya sarvataḥ 
sthūlaṃ paścima uttarāgraṃ tataḥ kaniṣṭhaṃ dakṣiṇe pūrvāgraṃ 
paścimaparidhermūlopari mūlaṃ yathā bhavati tathā punastato'pi 
kaniṣṭhamuttarasyāṃ pūrvāgraṃ paścimaparidheragropari mūlamiti 
kuṇḍasya madhyamekhalopari paristaraṇopari paridhitrayaṃ nikṣipet | atha 
paścimamekhalāyāṃ tu paristaraṇaparidhisthāpanaṃ 
yoninālordhvamekhalayorantarāle kāryamiti | paścimaparidhau oṃ brahmaṇe 
namaḥ | dakṣiṇaparidhau oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | uttaraparidhau oṃ rudrāya namaḥ 
| iti sampūjya sveṣṭadevatādīkṣitaṃ brāhmaṇamāhūya kuṇḍasya 
dakṣiṇe bhāge kuśāsane samupaveśya 
amukagotro'mukaśarmāhamamukagotrāmukavedāntargatāmukaśākhā-
dhyāyinamamukaśarmāṇaṃ mameṣṭadīkṣāṅgabhūtahomakarmaṇi 
kṛtākṛtāvekṣaṇāya brahmatvena tvāṃ vṛṇe iti 
vastrālaṅkārādibhirvṛṇuyāt | tatastaṃ gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya 
brāhmaṇālābhe kuśavaṭuṃ vā sampūjya 
vahnimantreṇārdhyapādyādyācamanīyamadhuparkapātrāṇi saṃsthāpya 
saṃskṛtya kuṇḍamadhye ṣaṭkoṇagarbhitakarṇikaṃ sakesaraṃ 
caturdvārayuktacaturasratrayaveṣṭitamaṣṭadalakamalaṃ

p. 266)

vahneḥ pūjāpīṭhaṃ vibhāvya tatra prāguktavidhinā 
maṇḍukādiparatattvāntaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya aṣṭadalakesareṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena pītāyai namaḥ śvetāyai0 aruṇāyai0 kṛṣṇāyai0 
dhūmrāyai0 tīvrāyai0 visphuliṅginyai0 rucirāyai0 jvālinyai0 namaḥ iti 
madhyāntaṃ navaśaktīḥ sampūjya raṃ sarvaśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ 
iti samastaṃ pīṭhaṃ sampūjya tanmadhye vahniṃ

karairvarasvastikaśaktyabhītīrdadhānamambhojagataṃ trinetram |
sindūravarṇaṃ tapanīyabhūṣaṃ vahniṃ jaṭābhūṣitamaulimīḍe || 1 ||

iti dhyātvā saptajihvāmudrāṃ pradarśya oṃ vaiśvānara jātaveda 
lohitākṣa sarvakarmāṇi sādhaya svāhā agnaye namaḥ ityagniṃ triḥ 
puṣpāñjalinā sampūjya punarvahnimantramuccāryāgnaye etadāsanaṃ 
namaḥ evamagne eṣa te ardhaḥ svāhā etatte pādyaṃ namaḥ etatte 
ācamanīyaṃ svadhā eṣa te madhuparkaḥ svadhā etatte punarācamanīyaṃ 
svadhā etatte snānaṃ namaḥ iti 
puraścaraṇamukhamūrdhādivasarvāṅgoddeśena mekhalāyā bahiḥ 
pātrāntare arghyapādyādisnānāntāṃ vahnestattadaṅgabhāvanāṃ 
parikalpya punarācamanīyaṃ dattvā vahnāveva vastraṃ dattvā 
punarācamanīyaṃ dattvā yajñopavītaṃ nivedya bahiḥ punarācamanīyaṃ 
dattvā gandhapuṣpe vahnāveva nivedayet iti 
vahnimantreṇāsanādipuṣpāntānupacārānupacarya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu 
devāgrādikoṇamārabhya madhyāntaṃ sarayūṃ hiraṇyāyai namaḥ | 
ṣarayūṃ kanakāyai namaḥ | śarayūṃ raktāyai namaḥ | varayūṃ 
kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ | larayūṃ prabhāyai namaḥ | rarayūṃ atiraktāyai 
namaḥ | yarayūṃ bahurūpāyai namaḥ iti sampūjya aṣṭadalakesareṣu 
agnīśāsuravāyavyadevatāgratadādicaturdikṣu oṃ sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya 
namaḥ | oṃ svastipūrṇāya śirase svāhā namaḥ | oṃ uttiṣṭhapuruṣāya 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ namaḥ | oṃ dhūmavyāpine kavacāya huṃ namaḥ | 
saptajihvāya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ namaḥ | oṃ dhanurdharāyāstrāya phaṭ 
namaḥ | iti ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya aṣṭadaleṣu devāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena oṃ 
agnaye jātavedase namaḥ | evaṃ agnaye saptajihvāya0 agnaye 
havyavāhanāya0 agnaye'śvodarajāya0 agnaye vaiśvānarāya0 agnaye 
kaumāratejase agnaye viśvamukhāya0 agnaye devamukhāya namaḥ iti 
prādakṣiṇyenāṣṭamūrtīḥ sampūjya tadbahiścaturasre indrādīn 
sāyudhān sampūjya punarvahnimantreṇa vahniṃ sampūjya dhūpadīpādi 
dattvā naivedyamutsṛjyāgnau prakṣipya prāgvadācamanīyaṃ dattvā tataḥ 
sruksruvau prāñcāvadhomukhāvagnau saṃtāpya tayoragraṃ 
kuśāgrairmadhyaṃ madhyairmūlaṃ mūlairiti triḥ sammṛjyāgnau tān 
prakṣipya sruksruvau svadakṣiṇabhāge kuśāstare nidhāya 
ājyasthālīmādāyāstramantreṇa prakṣālya svapurataḥ kuśāstare 
nidhāya taduparyuttarāgraṃ prādeśamātraṃ madhye brahmagranthiyutaṃ 
kuśadvayarūpaṃ pavitraṃ nidhāya pātrāntarasthaṃ śuddhaṃ goghṛtaṃ 
durgandhādidūṣaṇarahitaṃ vīkṣaṇādicatuḥsaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ 
vamiti dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtaṃ 
mūlenāṣṭadhābhimantritamājyasthālyāṃ nikṣipya 
kuṇḍādaṅgārānuddhṛtya mekhalāyā bahirbhūmau vāyavyakoṇe 
nikṣipya teṣvājyasthālīṃ hṛnmantreṇa nidhāya kuśadvayaṃ prajvālya 
hṛnmantreṇājye nikṣipya śeṣamagnau nikṣipya punardarbhadvayaṃ 
prajvālya kavacamantreṇājyasthālīmabhitaḥ paribhrāmya 
dagdhaśeṣamagnau nikṣipya punaḥ kuśān prajvālya hṛnmantreṇājye 
pradarśya dagdhaśeṣamagnau nikṣipya ājyasthālīmuddhṛtya 
prādakṣiṇyena kuṇḍaṃ parito bhrāmayan ānīya svapurataḥ kuśāstare 
nidhāya bāhyasthānaṅgārān kuṇḍamadhye nikṣipya apaḥ 
saṃspṛśyāṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ karadvayena pavitraṃ mūlāgre 
dhṛtvā mantramuccaran pavitramadhyena ghṛtamutpūya hṛnmantramuccaran 
tathaiva pavitramadhyena svābhimukhaṃ ghṛtaṃ triḥ saṃplāvya 
tatpavitramājyasthālyāṃ prāgagraṃ madhye niveśya bhāgadvayaṃ 
kṛtvā dakṣiṇabhāgaṃ śuklapakṣaṃ vāmabhāgaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ 
parikalpya punastathaiva vāmabhāge iḍāṃ dakṣiṇabhāge piṅgalāṃ 
madhye suṣumnāmiti nāḍītrayaṃ sañcintya sruveṇa dakṣiṇabhāgāt 
hṛnmantreṇājyamādāya agnaye svāhā iti vahnerdakṣiṇanetre hutvā 
agnaye idaṃ na mama ityuddeśatyāgaṃ vidhāya punarhṛnmantreṇa 
vāmabhāgādājyaṃ gṛhītvā somāya svāhā iti vahnervāmanetre hutvā 
somāya idaṃ na mama ityuddeśatyāgaṃ vidhāya punarhṛdayamantreṇa 
madhyādājyaṃ gṛhītvā oṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā iti 
vahnerlalāṭalocane hutvā idamagnīṣomābhyāṃ na mama 
ityuddeśatyāgaṃ kṛtvā punardakṣiṇabhāgāddhṛdājyaṃ gṛhītvā 
agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā iti vahnervaktre hutvā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte idaṃ na 
mama ityuddeśatyāgaṃ vidhāya oṃ bhūḥ svāhā āgnaye idaṃ na mama oṃ 
bhūvaḥ svāhā vāyave idaṃ na mama oṃ svaḥ svāhā

p. 267)

sūryāya idaṃ na mama oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ svāhā prajāpataye idaṃ na 
mama oṃ vaisvānara jātaveda ihāvaha lohitākṣa sarvakarmāṇi sādhya 
svāhā iti vahnimantreṇa vāratrayaṃ hutvā agnaye idaṃ na mama 
ityuddeśatyāgaṃ kṛtvā oṃ agnergarbhādhānaṃ sampādayāmi svāhā 
evaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanam iti pratikarmājyāhutyaṣṭakaṃ hutvā 
vāgīśvarājjātaṃ vahniṃ prāguktarūpaṃ dhyāyan agnerjātakarma0 
ityaṣṭāvājyāhutīrhutvā vahnernālacchedaṃ kṛtvā sūtakaṃ saṃśodhya 
vahnernāmakaraṇaṃ saṃ0 ityaṣṭāvājyāhutīrhutvā śivāgniriti tasya 
nāma kṛtvā oṃ vahnerupaniṣkramaṇaṃ saṃ0 agnerannaprāśanaṃ sa0 
agneścaulaṃ saṃ0 agnerupanayanaṃ saṃ0 agnermahānāmnyaṃ saṃ0 
agnermahāvrataṃ saṃ0 agneraupaniṣadaṃ saṃ0 agnergodānaṃ saṃ0 
agneḥ samāvartanaṃ saṃ0 agnerudvāhaṃ sampādayāmi svāhā iti 
pratikarmāṣṭāvājyāhutīrhutvā vahnergarbhādhānādyudvāhāntān 
saṃskārān vidhāya vahneḥ pitarau devadevyau prāgvat sampūjya visṛjya 
mūlāgreṣu ghṛtasaṃsiktāḥ pañcasamidhastūṣṇīmekadevāñjalinā 
vahnau samarpyaṃ oṃ sarayūṃ hiraṇyāyai svāhā evaṃ ṣarayūṃ 
kanakāyai.0 śarayūṃ raktāyai0 varayūṃ kṛṣṇāyai0 larayūṃ 
suprabhāyai0 rarayūṃ atiraktāyai0 yarayūṃ bahurūpāyai0 | oṃ 
sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya svāhā evaṃ svastipūrṇāya śirase0 
uttiṣṭhapuruṣāya śikhāyai0 dhūmavyāpine kavacāya0 saptajihvāya 
netratrayāya0 dhanurddharāya astrāya0 | oṃ agnaye jātavedase svāhā evaṃ 
agnaye saptajihvāya0 agnaye havyavāhanāya0 agnaye aśvodarāya0 agnaye 
vaiśvānarāya0 agnaye kaumāratejase0 agnaye viśvamukhāya0 agnaye 
devamukhāya0 iti jihvāṅgamūrtimantrairekaikāmāhutiṃ dattvā oṃ laṃ 
indrāya svāhā indrāya idaṃ na mama evaṃ agnaye0 yamāya0 nir-ṛtaye0 
varuṇāya0 vāyave0 kuverāya0 īśānāya0 brahmaṇe0 anantāya0 vajrāya0 
śaktaye0 daṇḍāya0 khaḍgāya0 pāśāya0 aṃkuśāya0 gadāyai0 
śūlāya0 padmāya0 cakrāya0 | evaṃ tattannāmabhirekaikāmāhutiṃ 
hutvā sarvatra tattannāmoddeśatyāgaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ sruveṇājyamādāya 
caturvāraṃ nikṣipyādhomukhaṃ sruco mukhe nidhāyotthāya 
prāguktavahnimantramuccārya svāhāsthāne vauṣaḍityagnau tiṣṭhan srucā 
hutvopaviśya oṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃ svāhā oṃ śrī hrīṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃ 
hrīṃ klīṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃ svāhā oṃ 
śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ 
gaṇapataye svāhā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada 
svāhā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me 
svāhā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me 
vaśamānaya svāhā iti daśadhā vibhaktena mahāgaṇapatimantreṇa 
daśāhutīrhutvā oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada 
sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā iti samastavyastamantreṇa catasra 
ājyāhutīrjuhuyāt | ityagnisthāpanavidhiḥ ||

itthagnisthāpanaṃ vidhāya nūtanatāmrādipātramastramantreṇa 
prākṣalya tatra mūlamantreṇāṣṭadhābhimantritāṃstaṇḍulān 
pañcadaśaprasṛtimitān triḥprakṣālitānastramantraṃ japannikṣipya tatra 
godugdhaṃ vāṣpaṃ yāvattāvat pakvaṃ bhavati tāvannikṣipya 
prakṣālitena pātreṇa kavacamantramuccaran tatpātravadanaṃ pidhāya 
yadā taddugdhaṃ vāṣpavaśāduparyāyāti tadā mekṣaṇena 
pradakṣiṇamūrdhvamavaghaṭṭayan mūlamantraṃ smaran prāṅmukho 
guruścaruṃ pacitvā śṛte tasmin mūlamantreṇājyaṃ sruveṇa nikṣipya 
kavacamantreṇa tatpātramavatārya astramantreṇābhimantritaṃ kuśāstare 
caruṃ nikṣipya tridhā vibhajyaikaṃ bhāga devāya kumbhasthāya nivedya 
maṇḍapaparitaḥ purvamaṃkurārpaṇakarmaṇi kṛtāṃkurabhājanāni 
nikṣipya ghṛtapūrṇān piṣṭamayadīpāṃśca nidhāya kuṇḍasamīpaṃ 
gatvā svāsane samupaviśya tatra vakṣyamāṇavidhinā 
mūlamantreṇārghyādipātrasthāpanaṃ vidhāya kuṇḍamadhye 
vahnermukhe pūjācakraṃ vibhāvya tatra vakṣyamāṇavidhinā 
maṇḍūkādipīṭhamanvantaṃ sampūjya tatra devatāmāvāhya 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ sarvopacāraiḥ pūjayet | 
atrarghyādisnānāntamagnipūjāvadeva kuṇḍādbahiḥ pātrāntare 
devamuddiśya kalpayet | anyatsarvaṃ kuṇḍamadhye eva kalpayet | tato 
mūlamantreṇa vahnidevatayorvaktraikākaraṇārthaṃ 
pañcaviṃśatyājyāhutīrhutvā svātmāgnidevatānāmaikyaṃ vibhāvayan 
mūlena nāḍīsandhānārthamekādaśavāraṃ ghṛtairhutvā 
ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇadevatānāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā 
prāṅnirmitacarostṛtīyāṃśaṃ navadhā vibhajyaikāṃśena mūlena 
pañcaviṃśatidhā hutvā prāgādidiksthakuṇḍeṣu ṛtvigbhiḥ 
prāguktavidhināṣṭādaśasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛteṣu guruḥ 
svakuṇḍādagnimuddhṛtyoddhṛtya nikṣipet | ṛtvijaśca svasvakuṇḍe vahniṃ 
prāguktavidhinā prajvālyopasthāya 
pariṣecanaparistaraṇaparidhiprakṣeṇapūjādibhiḥ samyakparitoṣya samiddhe 
tasmin

p. 268

sveṣṭadevatānityapūjoktavidhinā devamāvāhya tāmbūlāntairupacāraiḥ 
samyak sampūjya vaktraikīkaraṇanāḍīsandhānāṅgāvaraṇahomānte 
mūlamantreṇa guruṇā vibhajya dattena ghṛtamiśreṇa pāyasena 
pañcaviṃśatidhā svasvakuṇḍe juhuyuḥ ||

atha guruḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalasya pūrvādivīthīcatuṣṭaye 
meṣādirāśisthāneṣu prācyāṃ meṣavṛṣau āgneyyāṃ mithunaṃ 
dakṣiṇe karkaṭasiṃhau nair-ṛte kanyāṃ paścime tulāvṛścikau vāyavye 
dhanuḥ uttare makarakumbhau īśāne mīnaḥ iti vibhakteṣu rāśisthāneṣu 
rāśyadhināthebhyo grahebhyo nakṣatrebhyaḥ karaṇebhyaśca hutaśeṣeṇa 
pāyasena baliṃ dadyāt | yathā meṣavṛścikasthānayoḥ 
kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ meṣavṛścikarāśyadhipataye maṅgalāya eṣa 
gandhapuṣpāṃkuśaḥ pāyasabalirnamaḥ | evaṃ caṃ 5 
vṛṣatulārāśyadhipataye śukrāya eṣa0 | ṭaṃ 5 
mithunakanyārāśyadhipataye budhāya eṣa0 | yaṃ 10 
karkaṭarāśyadhipataye somāya eṣa0 | aṃ 16 siṃharāśyadhipataye 
sūryāya eṣa0 | taṃ 5 dhanurmīnādhipataye gurave eṣa0 | paṃ 5 
makarakumbhādhipataye śanaiścarāya eṣa gandhapuṣpākṣatayuktaḥ 
pāyasabalirnamaḥ || punaḥ krameṇa meṣādisthāneṣu 
meṣarāśyaṃśabhūtāśvinībharaṇīkṛttikāpādanakṣatradevatābhyo 
divānaktaṃcarebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ eṣa gandha0 ityādi prāgvat | 
evaṃ 
vṛṣarāśyaṃśabhūtakṛttikāpādatrayarohiṇīmṛgaśirordhanakṣatra-
devatābhyo0 | mithunarāśyaṃśabhūtamṛgaśira-
uttarārdhādrāpunarvasupādatrayanakṣatradevatābhyo | evamagre'pi 
mantrā ūhyāḥ || tato mīnameṣayorantarāle vavakaraṇāya eṣa0 ityādi | 
evaṃ vṛṣamithunayorantarāle vālavāya eṣa0 | mithunakarkayormadhye 
kaulavāya0 | siṃhakanyayormadhye taitilāya0 | kanyātulayormadhye garāya0 
| vṛścikadhanvormadhye vaṇije0 | dhanurmakarayormadhye viṣṭaye eṣa 
gandhākṣatapuṣpayutapāyasabalirnamaḥ iti baliṃ dadyāt | atra 
rāśidvayādhipatīnāṃ rāśidvayasthāne'pi balirdeyaḥ iti sampradāyaḥ || 
tato guruḥ kumbhasthāya devāyottarāpośānādinīrājanāntaṃ 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā kṛtvā stutvā praṇamya kṣamāpayet : tatastṛtīyaṃ 
bhāgaṃ śiṣyeṇa saha gururbhuktvā svayamācāntaḥ svācāntāya 
śiṣyāya ṣaḍaṅganyāsayogena sakalīkṛtāya prādeśamātraṃ 
yathoktahṛnmantreṇāṣṭadhābhimantritaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ dadyāt | 
śiṣyo'pi tena dantadhāvanaṃ vidhāya dantakāṣṭhaṃ prakṣālya purataḥ 
parityajyācamya guroḥ samīpaṃ gacchet | tato guruḥ śiṣyaṃ 
śikhābandhanena mūlamantrābhimantritena saṃrakṣya tena sārdhaṃ 
vedyāṃ kuśāstaraṇe tasyāṃ rātrau śayanaṃ kuryādityadhivāsaḥ ||

atra prākproktavidhinordhvāmnāyādyāmnāyadevatānāṃ dīkṣāyāṃ 
tattanmantrahomastattaddevatāpūjanakrama ṛtvigbhirvidheyaḥ | 
navagrahapūjā tu āgamoktairvaidikamantrairvā vidheyā 
īśānakoṇavedyāṃ pṛthageveti sampradāyaḥ | 
pañcapaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥ  iti krame 
proktakrameṇaiva dīkṣāprayogakramaḥ sādhīyān 
tatrāṅgatvenānyamantrākathanāt | 
ṣaḍdarśanāṅgabhūtapradhānavidyādīkṣāvidhau tu 
ṣaḍdarśaneṣvaṅgatvena ye ye mantrā 
abhihitāstadrītyaivartviksāmayikairhomajapapūjādayo vidheyāḥ || 
guruṇāpi tathaiva saṅgopāṅgapūrṇarūpeṇopadeśaḥ kāryaḥ | 
pūrṇābhiṣekavidhimagre tatprakaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ || 
vaidikadarśanaprādhānyena yatropadeśastatra śrutismṛtyuktavidhinaiva 
viśeṣo boddhavyaḥ anyatsāmyam ||

atha vaidikadarśanadīkṣāyā ādau 
gaṇādhipapūjādimaṇḍapapūjāprayogaḥ | tatrādau gaṇeśapūjā : 
yajamān āsanoparyyupaviśyācamya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā 
kuśākṣatān haste gṛhītvā saṅkalpaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā : 
adyetyādimāsapakṣādyullekhānantaraṃ 
kariṣyamāṇāmukadevatāmantradīkṣākarṃaṇi pratyūhaśāntaye 
gaṇapatipūjanamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpyāvāhanādiṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ 
gaṇānāṃ tvā iti mantreṇa gaṇapatiṃ sampūjya baddhāñjaliḥ 
prārthayet |

vakratuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭisamaprabha |
avighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || 1 ||

pūjā sampūrṇatāṃ yātu vācayitvā visarjayet |

iti || tataḥ pīṭhe'kṣatapuñjeṣu gauryādiṣoḍaśamātṛkā 
brāhmyādisaptamātṛkāśca pūjayet | tāstu -

gaurī padmā medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā |
devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ || 1 ||

dhṛtistuṣṭistathā puṣṭirātmanaḥ kuladevatā |
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā || 2 ||

vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā saptamātaraḥ |

p. 269)

iti | pūjāprakārastuḥ : pūjopakaraṇānyupakalpya prāṅmukha upaviśya 
kuśayavatilānyādaya adyehetyādi0 
kariṣyamāṇamantradīkṣāṅgabhūtatayā gauryādiṣoḍaśamātṛpūjanaṃ 
brāhmayādisaptamātṛpūjanaṃ ca kariṣye iti saṅkalpya akṣataiḥ oṃ 
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ gaurīhāgaccha iha tiṣṭhetyāvāhya 
svaśākhoktamantreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya gauryai namaḥ 
idamāsanamityādirītyā padārthānusamayena sarvāḥ 
pratyekamuttarasaṃsthāḥ pūjyāḥ | evaṃ brāhmyādyā api | yadā tu 
mātṝṇāṃ gaṇadevatātvaṃ tadā pratyekaṃ nāma gṛhītvā 
gauryādibhya iti coktvā yugapatpūjayet evaṃ brāhmyādyā api | tataḥ 
svācārato vasoḥ pavitramasīti kuṇḍyalagnāḥ pañca sapta vā ghṛtena 
dhārāḥ kuryāt | tatpūjanamapi kecidāhuḥ | tataḥ śāntipāṭhaḥ | tato 
yathācāraṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ saṅkalpapūrvakaṃ svaśākhoktaṃ kuryāt 
| tataḥ puṇyāhavācanam : taccāvanikṛtajānumaṇḍala ityādi puṇyāhaṃ 
bhavanto bruvantviti trīn brāhmaṇān śrāvayet | te ca puṇyāhamiti triḥ 
pratibrūyuḥ | oṃ svasti bhavanto bruvantviti triḥ | oṃ svasti iti triḥ prativacanam | 
oṃ ṛddhiṃ bhavanto bruvantviti triḥ | oṃ ṛdhvatāmiti triḥ prativacanam | tato 
maṇḍapādbahiḥ paścimadeśe upalipte yajamānaḥ prāṅmukha 
upaviśyācamya prāṇānāyamya adyehetyādi 
amukadevatāmantradīkṣākarma kartumācāryartvijāṃ varaṇamahaṃ 
kariṣye iti saṅkalpya ācāryamudaṅmukhamupaveśya 
sitāmbarahemakuṇḍalasūtrakeyūrakaṇṭhābharaṇābhirāmaṃ kṛtvā 
baddhāñjaliḥ dīkṣādāne tvaṃ me gururbhava iti prārthya bhavāni iti 
tenovate 
amukapravarānvitāmukagotramamukavedāntargatāmukaśākhādhyāyina-
mamukaśarmāṇamamukapravarānvitāmukagātro'mukaśarmāham 
ebhirgandhapuṣpākṣatatāmbūlahemābharaṇāṃgulīyakavāsobhiramuka-
mantradīkṣādāne gurutvena tvāṃ vṛṇe | vṛto'smīti sa vadet | evaṃ 
pūrvakuṇḍe gāyatrīhomārthamekamāgneyadakṣiṇanair-
ṛtapaścimavāyavyasaumyeśānakuṇḍeṣu homārthaṃ sapta brāhmaṇān 
evaṃ nava brāhmaṇān vṛṇuyāt | tataḥ pūrvadvārapālanārthaṃ 
dvāvṛgvedinau dakṣiṇadvārapālanārthaṃ dvau yajurvedinau 
paścimadvārapālanārthaṃ dvau sāmagau uttaradvārapālanārthaṃ 
dvāvatharvāṇau evamaṣṭau pṛthak pṛthagvṛṇuyāt | varaṇavākyaṃ 
prāgvadeva | evaṃ pustakācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt | atra dvārapālakāstu 
sarvadarśanasādhāraṇāḥ | tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ 
śuklamālyānulepanaḥ sapatnīkaḥ saśiṣyartvik ācāryo maṅgalaghoṣe 
jāyamāne sampūrṇakalaśahasto bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ ityādimantraghoṣaṇa 
maṇḍapaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya paścimadvāreṇa praviśya maṇḍapāntaḥ 
paścima deśe upaviśyācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau smṛtvā 
kariṣyamāṇadīkṣādānāṅgatayā adya 
gaṇeśapūjāmaṇḍapadevatāsthāpanādi kariṣye iti saṅkalpya 
ṣoḍaśopacārairgaṇeśaṃ prapūjya gaurasarṣapān sarvato 
maṇḍapāntarvikiret | tatra mantrā rakṣoghnāḥ :

yadatra saṃśritaṃ bhūtaṃ sthānamāśritya sarvadā |
sthānaṃ tyaktvā tu tatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatra gacchatu || 1 ||

apakrāmantu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvato diśam |
sarveṣāmavirodhena brahmakarma samārabhe || 2 ||

iti pañcagavyena kuśaiḥ sarvatra sarvataḥ prokṣayet śuci vo havyeti āpo hi 
ṣṭhe ti ṛcā | tataḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ svastyayanaṃ tārkṣyamiti mantradvayaṃ 
japet | tataḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi maṇḍapadvārādbahirhastamātre 
vaṭatoraṇamāśvatthaṃ vā sudṛḍhanāmakaṃ suśobhananāmakaṃ vā 
śaṅkhāṅkitam agnimīle purohitamiti nidhāya nāmnā sampūjya 
candanādicarcitaṃ kṛtvā rāhuṃ bṛhaspatiṃ tatra nyaset | tatraikaḥ 
kalaśaḥ sthāpyaḥ | tatra mantrāḥ - mahīdyauriti bhūmiṃ spṛśan 
prārthya oṣadhayaḥ samiti yavān kṣiptvā ākalaśeṣviti ājighra kalaśamiti 
vā kalaśaṃ nidhāya imaṃ me gaṅge iti jalenāpūrya gandhadvārāṃ iti 
gandhaṃ yā oṣadhīriti sarvauṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ samiti yavān 
kāṇḍātkāṇḍāditi dūrvāḥ aśvatthe vo iti pañcapallavān śyonā 
pṛthivi iti pañca mṛdaḥ yāḥ phalinī riti phalam śa hi ratnānīti pañca 
ratnāni hiraṇyarūpamiti hiraṇyaṃ kṣiptvā yuvā suvāsā iti vastreṇa 
raktasūtreṇa ca mukhe veṣṭayet | pūrṇā davītyupari 
dhānyapūrṇaśarāvaṃ nidhāya tatra dhruvamāvāhya pūjayet || tato 
dakṣiṇe audumbaraṃ vā subhadraṃ vikaṭaṃ vā cakrāṅkitaṃ toraṇaṃ 
iṣe tvorje tvā iti nidhāya nāmnā pūrvavat sampūjya candanādicarcitaṃ 
kṛtvā sūryamaṅgārakaṃ ca nyaset | tataḥ pūrvavat kalaśaṃ sthāpayitvā 
tatra dharāmāvāhya pūjayet || tataḥ paścime plākṣamaudumbaraṃ vā 
suhotraṃ suprabhaṃ padmāṅkitaṃ toraṇaṃ śanno devīriti nidhāya 
nāmnā pūrvavat sampūjya candanādicarcitaṃ kṛtvā śukraṃ budhaṃ ca 
tatra nyaset | pūrvavat kalaśaṃ nidhāya vākpatimāvāhya pūjayet || tata 
uttare vāṭamāśvatthaṃ pālāśaṃ vā pūrṇasukarmaṃ subhīmaṃ vā 
gadāṅkitaṃ toraṇam agna āyāhi iti nidhāya nāmnā sampūjya 
candanādicarcitaṃ kṛtvā somaketuśanīṃstatra nyaset | tataḥ pūrvavat 
kalaśaṃ nidhāya tatra vighneśamāvāhya pūjayet || tataḥ punaḥ 
pūrvadvāre dvāraśākhādvaye kalaśadvayaṃ dadhyakṣatabhūṣitaṃ 
pūrvavanmantraiḥ sthāpayet | pratikalaśaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ | 
airāvatakalaśadvayaṃ nyasya pūjayet | tatra ṛgvedinau ṛtvijau |

ṛgvedaḥ padmapatrākṣo gāyatryaḥ somadevatā |
atrigotrastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru || 1 ||

iti prārthya pratyekamagnimīle iti gandhādinā pūjayet | tataḥ

ehyehi sarvāmarasiddhasādhyairabhiṣṭuto vajradharāmareśa |
saṃvījyamāno'psarasāṃ gaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃ no bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho indrehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti indraṃ sāṅga saparivāraṃ sāyudhaṃ 
saśaktikaṃ dvārakalaśe āvāhya tatra trātāramindra mitīndraṃ sampūjya 
āśuḥ śiśāna iti pītāṃ etākāṃ pītaṃ ca dhvajadvayamapi 
pañcahastadaṇḍamucchrayet | indraṃ vo viśvataspari iti vā mantraḥ | tatra 
sahasrākṣaṃ mattairāvaṇasthitaṃ pītakirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ 
dakṣiṇavāmakarasthavajrotpalamindraṃ dhyātvā

indraḥ surapatiḥ śreṣṭho vajrahasto mahābalaḥ |
śatayajñādhipo devastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā indrāya sāṅgāya saparivārāya sāyudhāya saśaktikāyaitaṃ 
māṣa (bhakta) baliṃ samarpayāmi iti baliṃ dadyāt || tata ācamyāgneye 
gatvā pūrvavat kalaśaṃ nidhāya tatra puṇḍarīkaṃ pūjayitvā'mṛtaṃ ca 
prapūjya

ehyehi vaiśvānarahavyavāha munipravīrairabhito'bhijuṣṭa |
tejovatā lokagaṇena sārdhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ pāhi kave namaste || 1 ||

bho agne ihāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgaṃ saparivāraṃ sāyudhaṃ 
saśaktimagniṃ kalaśe āvāhya tvanno agne ityagniṃ gandhādinā prapūjya 
agniṃ dūtamiti raktāṃ patākāṃ raktadhvajaṃ 
pañcahastadaṇḍamucchrayet | tataḥ chāgasthaṃ raktaṃ 
dakṣiṇavāmakaradhṛtaraktakamaṇḍaluṃ yajñopavītinamagniṃ dhyātvā

āgneyaḥ puruṣo raktaḥ sarvadevamayo'vyayaḥ |
dhūmraketurajo'dhyakṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādikamuktvā agnaye etaṃ māṣabhaktavaliṃ 
samarpayāmi iti baliṃ dadyāt ||
tata ācamya dakṣiṇe gatvā pratidvāraśākhaṃ pūrvavat kalaśadvayaṃ 
saṃsthāpya vāmanagajaṃ tatra nyasya pūjayet | tato yajurvedavidāvṛtvijau

kātarākṣo yajurvedastraiṣṭubho viṣṇudaivataḥ |
kāśyapeyastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru || 1 ||

iti pratyekaṃ prārthya gandhādinā iṣe tvorje tvā iti pūjayet | tataḥ

ehyahi vaivasvat dharmarāja sarvāmarairarcita dharmamūrte |
śubhāśubhānandaśucāmadhīśa śivāya naḥ pāhi makhaṃ namaste || 1 ||

bho yamehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭaṃ mayamāvāhya yamāya 
somamiti gandhādibhiḥ pūjayitvā kṛṣṇāṃ patākāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca 
dhvajaṃ pañcahastāyataṃ daṇḍaṃ āyaṃ gaurityucchrayet | tato 
mahiṣārūḍhaṃ dhṛtadaṇḍapāśadakṣiṇavāmakaradvayaṃ 
kṛṣṇāñjanacayanibhamagnisamanayanaṃ yamaṃ dhyātvā

mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ mahābalam |
āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi yamāyaitaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi iti 
baliṃ dadyāt ||
tataḥ ācamya nair-ṛtyāṃ pūrvavat kalaśaṃ sthāpayitvā kumudagajaṃ 
durjayaṃ ca pūjayitvā

p. 271) ehyehi rakṣogaṇanāyakastvaṃ viśālavetālapiśācasaṅghaiḥ |
mamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanāya lokeśvarastvaṃ bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho nir-ṛte ihāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭamāvāhya mo ṣu ṇa iti 
asunvantamiti vā nir-ṛtiṃ gandhādibhiḥ pūjayitvā nīlāṃ patākāṃ 
dhvajaṃ ca pañcahastadaṇḍaṃ mā ṣu ṇa ityucchrayet | tato narārūḍhaṃ 
khaḍgahastaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ nīlābharaṇaṃ nir-ṛtiṃ dhyātvā

narārūḍhaṃ mahākāyaṃ khaḍgahastaṃ mahābalam |
nīlaṃ rakṣogaṇairjuṣṭaṃ nīlābharaṇabhūṣitam || 1 ||

nir-ṛtiṃ khaḍgahastaṃ ca sarvalokaikanāyakam |
āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām || 2 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi nir-ṛtaye evaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi iti 
baliṃ dadyāt ||
tata ācamya paścimadvāre pratiśākhaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ pūrvavat 
sthāpayitvā añjanaṃ diggajaṃ nyasya pūjayet | tataḥ 
sāmavedavidāvṛtvijau

sāmavedastu piṅgākṣo jāgataḥ śakradaivataḥ |
bhāradvājastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru || 1 ||

iti prārthya gandhādinā agna āyāhi iti pūjayet | tataḥ

ehyehi yādogaṇavāridhīnāṃ gaṇena parjanya sahāpsarobhiḥ |
vidyādharendrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasmān bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho varuṇehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭaṃ varuṇamāvāhya tattvā 
yāmi iti gandhādibhiḥ pūjayitvā śvetāṃ patākāṃ dhvajaṃ caṃ ima 
me varuṇa ityucchravet | tato makarasya pāśahastaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ 
kirīṭadhāriṇaṃ varuṇaṃ vyākhvā

pāśahastaṃ ca varuṇamarṇasāṃ nidhimīśvaram |
āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin varuṇāya namonamaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetthādi varuṇāyaitaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi 
iti baliṃ dadyāt ||
tata ācamya vāyavyāṃ pūrvavat kalaśaṃ nidhāya puṣpadantaṃ 
siddhārthaṃ ca sampūjya

ehyehi yajñe mama rakṣaṇāya mṛgādhirūḍhaḥ sahasiddhasaṅghaiḥ |
prāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāya gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho vāyo ihāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭaṃ vāyumāvāhya tava 
vāyavṛtaspate iti gandhādinā pūjayitvā dhūmrāṃ patākāṃ dhvajaṃ 
ca vāyo śatamityucchrayet | tato mṛgādhiruḍhaṃ 
citrāmbaradhvajadharadakṣavāmahastaṃ vāyuṃ dhyātvā

vāyumākāśagaṃ caiva pavanaṃ vegavāhanam |
āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 1 ||

anākāro mahaujāśca paśudṛṣṭagatirdivi |
tasmai pūjyāya jagatī vāyave'haṃ namāmi ca || 2 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi vāyave etaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi iti 
baliṃ dadyāt ||
tata ācamyottaradvāre pratidvāraśākhaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ prāgvat 
sthāpayitvā sārvabhau?ma diggajaṃ nyasya prapūjyātharvavidāvṛtvijau


bṛhannetro'tharvavedo'nuṣṭubho gurudaivataḥ |
vaiśampāyana viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru || 1 ||

iti prārthaya śanno devīriti gandhādinā prapūjya tataḥ

ehyehi yakṣeśvara yajñarakṣāṃ vidhatsva nakṣatragaṇena sārdham |
sarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sahaiva gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho somehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṭaṃ somamāvāhya soso 
dhenuṃ vayaṃ someti vā pūjayitvā haritāṃ śvetāṃ patākāṃ dhvajaṃ 
ca āpyāyasva iti nyasya narayutavimānasthaṃ kuṇḍalahārakeyūraruciraṃ 
varagadādharadakṣiṇavāma bhujadvayaṃ mukuṭinaṃ mahodaraṃ 
mahākāyaṃ haritavarṇaṃ kuveraṃ dhyātvā

p. 272)

sarvanakṣatramadhye tu somo rājā vyavasthitaḥ |
tasmai somāya devāya nakṣatrapataye namaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi somāyaitaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi iti 
baliṃ dadyāt ||

tata ācamya aiṣānyāṃ pūrvavat kalaśaṃ nidhāya supratīkaṃ diggajaṃ 
maṅgalaṃ ca tatra sampūjya

ehyehi viśveśvara nastriśūlakhaṭvāṅgadhārin svagaṇena sārdham |
lokeśa yajñeśvara yajñasiddhyai gṛḥāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste || 1 ||

bho īśānehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭhamīśānamāvāhya 
tamīśānamiti gandhādinā prapūjya śvetāṃ sarvavarṇāṃ vā 
patākāṃ dhvajaṃ ca abhitvā deva savitaḥ ityucchrayet | tato vṛṣārūḍhaṃ 
dakṣiṇavāmahastadhṛtavaratriśūlaṃ trinetraṃ śubhravarṇaṃmīśānaṃ 
dhyātvā

bṛṣaskandhasamārūḍhaṃ śūlahastaṃ trilocanam |
āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām || 1 ||

sarvādhipo mahādeva īśānaḥ śukla īśvaraḥ |
śūlapāṇirvirūpākṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ || 2 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi īśānāyaitaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi 
iti baliṃ dadyāt ||

tata ācamya īśānapūrvayormadhye'dhaḥ

ehyehi pātāladharāmarendra nāgāṅganākinnaragīyamān |
yakṣoragendrāmaralokasaṅghairananta rakṣādhvaramasmadīyam || 1 ||

bho anantehāgaccheda tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭamanantamāvāhya āyaṃ 
gauriti gandhādibhirabhyarcya meghavarṇāṃ śvetāṃ patākāṃ dhvajaṃ 
ca āyaṃ gaurityucchrayet |

anantaśayanāsīnaṃ phaṇasaptakamaṇḍitam |
padmaśaṅkhadharordhvādhodakṣabhāgakaradvayam || 1 ||

cakragadādharordhvāṃdhovāmabhāgakaradvayam |

iti nīlavarṇamanantaṃ dhyātvā

yo'sāvanantarūpeṇa brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram |
puṣpavaddhārayenmūrdhni tasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi anantāyaitaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi iti 
baliṃ dadyāt ||

tata ācamya paścimanair-ṛtamadhye ūrdhvam

ehyehi sarvādhipate surendralokena sārdhaṃ pitṛdevatābhiḥ |
sarvasya dhātāsyamitaprabhāvo viśādhvaraṃ naḥ satataṃ śivāya || 1 ||

bho brahmannihāgaccheha tiṣṭheti sāṅgādiviśiṣṭaṃ 
brahmāṇamāvāhya brahma jajñānamiti gandhādibhirabhyarcya raktāṃ 
patākāṃ dhvajaṃ ca tenaivocchritya
