akṣasūtrakuśamuṣṭidharordhvādhodakṣiṇakaraṃ 
sruvakamaṇḍaludharordhvādhovāmakaradvayaṃ caturmukhaṃ śmaśrulaṃ 
jaṭilaṃ lambodaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhyātvā

padmayoniścaturmūrtivedāvāsaḥ pitāmaḥ |
yajñādhyakṣaścaturvaktrastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ || 1 ||

iti natvā sāṅgāyetyādi brahmaṇe etaṃ māṣabhaktabaliṃ samarpayāmi 
iti baliṃ dadyāt ||

tata ācamya maṇḍapamadhye cāmarakiṅkiṇīyutātyuccadaṇḍo vā 
daśaṣoḍaśahastadaṇḍo vā daśahastadīrghaṃ strihastavistāraḥ 
pañcahastadīrgho hastavistāro vā mahādhvajo vicitravarṇaḥ indrasya 
vṛṣṇo iti saṃsthāpyaḥ | brahma jajñānamiti ca tatraiva brahmapūjanaṃ 
kāryam | tato maṇḍapaṣoḍaśastambheṣu sarvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ | 
vaṃśeṣu kinnarebhyo namaḥ | tataḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi 
kiñcidbhūmimupalipyopaviśya

trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
brahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārdhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvantu tāni me || 1 ||

devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannāgāḥ |
ṛṣayo manavogāvo devamātara eva ca || 2 ||

p. 273)

sarva mamādhvare rakṣāṃ prakurvantu mudānvitāḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca kṣetrapālā gaṇaiḥ saha || 3 ||

rakṣantu maṇḍapaṃ ghnantu rakṣāṃsi sarvataḥ |

iti trailokyasthebhyaḥ sthāvarebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ | 
trailokyasthebhyaścarebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ | brahmaṇe namaḥ | viṣṇave0 
śivāya0 devebhyo0 dānavebhyo0 gandharvebhyo0 yakṣebhyo0 
rākṣasebhyo0 pannagebhyo0 ṛṣibhyo0 manuṣyebhyo0 gobhyo0 
devamātṛbhyo namaḥ | iti pratyekaṃ sampūjya puṣpādiyutaṃ 
pūrvavanmantraireva tasyāṃ bhūmāvevaitebhya eva māṣabhaktabaliṃ 
dadyāt ||

tata ācāryaḥ sārtvik prakṣālitapādapāṇirācāntaḥ prāgvadvāreṇa 
maṇḍapaṃ praviśya dakṣiṇadvārapaścimadeśe upaviśyācamya bho 
brāhmaṇā yathāvihitaṃ karma kurudhvamiti brūyāt | tato 
gururmahāvedyupari puṣpāṇi vikīrya upari ca vitānaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ 
phalapuṣpopaśobhitaṃ vedimānaṃ badhnīyāt | grahavedyāṃ ca 
tanmānaṃ badhnīyāt sarvatobhadraṃ ca likhet | 
pūrṇābhiṣekadīkṣāyāṃ tu navahastaparimitamadhyavedyāṃ śrīcakraṃ 
tattadiṣṭadevatācakraṃ vā racayet |

navahastaṃ trihastaṃ vā śrīcakramabhiṣecate |
sthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyate || 1 ||

iti tantrarājavacanāt | tasmin pakṣe grahavedī sarvatobhadramaṇḍalavedī 
caiśānyāṃ kriyate | gurumaṇḍalavedī vāyavye mithunapūjāvedī āgneye 
taddinanityāpūjāvedī vāstumaṇḍalasamīpe iti sampradāyaḥ | 
tathātrāvasare ācāryaḥ svagṛhoktavidhina | svakuṇḍe'gnisthāpanaṃ 
kuryāt | tenaiva krameṇānyakuṇḍeṣvapi svasvaśākhoktavidhinā 
ṛtvijo'gnisthāpanaṃ kuryuḥ | guruśca sarvakarmādhyakṣastiṣṭhet | 
evamagniṣu praṇīteṣu gururgrahavedyāṃ sarvatobhadre ca adyehetyādi 
dīkṣādānākhyakarmāṅgatayā maṇḍapadevatāsthāpanaṃ kariṣye iti 
saṅkalpya brahmādīn sthāpayet | madhye brahmā brahma jajñānaṃ 
gautamo vāmadevo brahmā triṣṭup brahmasthāpane pūjane ca viniyogaḥ | 
evamuttaratra oṃ brahma jajñānaṃ | 1 | uttare somaḥ | 2 | oṃ abhitvā deva 
savitaḥ | 3 | pūrve indraḥ indraṃ vo madhucchandā indro gāyatrī | 4 | 
āgneye agniḥ agniṃ kāṇvo medhātithiragnirgāyatrī agniṃ dūtaṃ 
vṛṇīmahe | 5 | dakṣiṇe yamaḥ yamāyasomaṃ vaivasvato yamo 
yamo'nuṣṭup | 6 | nair-ṛtyāṃ nir-ṛtiḥ moṣuṇo ghoraḥ kaṇvo nir-
ṛtirgāyatrī | 7 | paścime varuṇaḥ tattvā yāmi śunaḥśepo varuṇastriṣṭup | 
8 | vāyavyāṃ vāyuḥ vāyo śataṃ gautamo vāmadevo vāyuranuṣṭup | 9 | 
vāyusomamadhye'ṣṭau vasavaḥ jmayā atra maitrāvaruṇo vasiṣṭho 
vasavastriṣṭup | 10 | someśānamadhye ekādaśa rudrāḥ ā rudrāsaḥ 
śyāvāśvasyaikādaśa rudrā jagatī ā rudrāsaḥ | 11 | īśānendramadhye 
dvādaśādityāḥ tyānnu kṣatriyān sāṃmado (matsyo) mage 
dvādaśādityā gāyatrī | 12 | indrāgnimadhye aśvinau aśvinā rāhūgaṇo 
gautamo'śvinau uṣṇik | 13 | agniyamamadhye viśvedevāḥ sapaitṛkāḥ 
omāsaḥ madhucchandā viśvedevā gāyatrī | 14 | yamanir-ṛtimadhye 
saptayakṣāḥ abhi tyaṃ vāmadevaḥ saptayakṣāḥ prakṛtiḥ oṃ abhi tyaṃ 
devaṃ savitāramoṇyo kavikratumarcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhiḥ 
priyaṃ matikaviṃ matim | ūrdhvā yasyā matirbhā adidyutatsavīmani 
hiraṇyapāṇiramimītaḥ sukratuḥ priyā svaḥ | 15 | nir-ṛtivaruṇamadhye 
bhūtanāgāḥ āyaṃ gauḥ sārpaṃrājñī sarpā gāyatrī āyaṃ gauḥ | 16 | 
varuṇavāyumadhye gandharvāpsarasaḥ apsarasām etaśa ṛṣyaśṛṅgo 
gandharvāpsaraso'nuṣṭup | oṃ apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ | 17 | 
brahmasomamadhye skandanandīśvaraśūlamahākālāḥ kumāraṃ 
kumāraḥ skandastriṣṭup kumāraṃ mātā | 18 | ṛṣabhaṃ ṛṣabho 
vairājoṣnuṣṭup ṛṣabhaṃ mā | 19 | brahmeśānamadhye dakṣādiḥ 
saptakoṇe vā aditiḥ lokyo bṛhaspatirdakṣo'nuṣṭup oṃ aditirhyajaniṣṭa | 20 | 
brahmendramadhye durgā viṣṇuśca tāmagnivarṇāṃ saubharirdurgā 
triṣṭup oṃ tāmagnivarṇāṃ | 21 | idaṃ viṣṇuḥ kāṇvo medhātithirgāyatrī 
oṃ idaṃ viṣṇuḥ | 22 | brahmāgneya madhye svadhā udīratāṃ śaṃkhaḥ 
svadhā triṣṭup udīratāmavara | 23 | brahma  madhye viṣṇumṛtyurogāḥ 
paraṃ mṛtyo saṅkasuko mṛtyurogāstriṣṭup | 24 |

p. 274)

brahmanir-ṛtimadhye gaṇapatiḥ gaṇānāṃ tvā gṛtsamado gaṇapatirjagatī | 
25 | brahmavaruṇamadhye āpaḥ śanno ambarīṣaḥ sindhudvīpa āpo 
gāyatrī | 26 | brahmavāyu madhye marutaḥ maruto yasya rāhūgaṇo gautamo 
maruto gāyatrī | 27 | brahmaṇaḥ pādamūle karṇikādhaḥ pṛthvī śyonā 
medhātithirbhūmirgāyatrī | 28 | tatraiva gaṅgādinadyaḥ imaṃ me 
sindhukṣit praiyamedho gaṅgāyamunāsarasvatyo jagatī | 29 | tatraiva sapta 
sāgarāḥ dhāmno dhāmno rājannito varuṇa no muñca | yadāpo aghnyā it 
varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca | mayi vāyo moṣadhīrhisīrato 
viśvavyacā bhūstveto varuṇa no muñca | 30 | tadupari meruṃ nāmnā 
pūjayet | bāhye somādisamīpe krameṇāyudhāni gadāṃ0 triśūlaṃ0 
vajraṃ0 śaktiṃ0 khaḍgaṃ0 pāśaṃ0 aṃkuśaṃ0 | tadbāhye uttarāditaḥ 
gautamaḥ bharadvājaḥ viśvāmitraḥ kaśyapaḥ jamadagniḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ atriḥ 
arundhatīti | 8 | tadbāhye pūrvādi aindrī kaumārī brāhmī vārāhi 
cāmuṇḍā vaiṣṇavī māheśvarī vaināyakī ityaṣṭau śaktayaḥ etān 
svasvamantraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya pratyekaṃ saha vā pūjayet | evamagniṃ 
praṇīya devatāsthāpanavedyāṃ grahādipañcāśītidevatāsthāpanaṃ 
kuryāt | tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ- adyehetyādi dīkṣādānākhyakarmaṇi 
grahādipīṭhadevatāsthāpanamahaṃ kariṣye | praṇavasya parabrahma-ṛṣiḥ 
paramātmā devatā devīgāyatrī chandaḥ vyāhṛtīnāṃ krameṇa 
jamadagnibharadvājabhṛgavo ṛṣayaḥ agnivāyusūryā devatā :  
devīgāyatrīdevī-uṣṇik devībṛhatyaḥ chandāṃsi sūryādyāvāhane 
viniyogaḥ | tatrāgrapīṭhamadhye vartule dvādaśāṃgule maṇḍale 
prāṅmukhaṃ sūryaṃ raktapuṣpākṣataiḥ ākṛṣṇeti hiraṇyastūpa ṛṣiḥ 
savitā devatā triṣṭup chandaḥ sūryāvāhane viniyagaḥ | akṛṣṇena oṃ 
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ kaliṅgadeśodbhava kāśyapasagotra 
sūryehāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti sthāpayet | 1 | tata āgneye caturasre 
caturviṃśāṃgule maṇḍale prāṅmukhaṃ somaṃ śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ 
āpyāyasveti gautamaḥ somo gāyatrī somāvāhane viniyogaḥ | oṃ 
āpyāyasva0 oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ yamunātīrodbhava ātreyasagotra 
somehāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti sthāpayet | 2 | tato dakṣiṇe trikoṇe 
tryaṃgule maṇḍale dakṣiṇamukhaṃ bhaumaṃ raktapuṣpākṣataiḥ 
agnirmūrdheti virūpaḥ āṅgiraso'ṅgārako gāyatrī aṅgārakāvāhane 
viniyogaḥ | oṃ agnirmūdho oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ sarasvatīsamudbhava 
bhāradvājasagotra bhaumehāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti sthāpayet | 3 | tata 
aiśāne bāṇākāre caturaṃgule maṇḍale udaṅmukhaṃ budhaṃ 
pītapuṣpākṣataiḥ udbudhyadhvamiti budhaḥ saumyo budhastriṣṭup 
budhāvāhane viniyogaḥ | oṃ udbudhyadhvaṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ 
magadhadeśodbhavātreyasagotra budhehāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti 
sthāpayet | 4 | tata uttarato dīrghacaturasre ṣaḍaṃgule udaṅmukhaṃ 
bṛhaspatiṃ pītapuṣpākṣataiḥ bṛhaspate iti gṛtsamado bṛhaspatistriṣṭup 
bṛhaspatyāvāhane viniyogaḥ | bṛhaspate'ti ya oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ 
sindhudeśodbhavāṅgirasagotra bṛhaspate ihāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti 
sthāpayet | 5 | tataḥ pūrve pañcakoṇe navāṃgule maṇḍale prāṅmukhaṃ 
śukraṃ śubhrapuṣpākṣataiḥ śukra iti pārāśaraḥ śukro dvipadā virāṭ 
śukrāvāhane viniyogaḥ | oṃ śukraḥ śuśukvān oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ 
bhojarāḍdeśodbhava bhārgavasagotra śukrehāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti 
sthāpayet | 6 | tataḥ paścime dhanuṣi hyaṃgule maṇḍale pratyaṅmukhaṃ 
śaniṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣataiḥ śamagniriti iriṃbiṭhiḥ śanaiścara uṣṇik 
śanyāvāhane viniyogaḥ | śamagniḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ 
saurāṣṭradeśodbhava kāśyapasagotra śane ihāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti 
saṃsthāpayet | 7 | tataḥ kṛṣṇaśūrpamaṇḍale dakṣiṇamukhaṃ rāhuṃ 
dhūmrapuṣpākṣataiḥ kayā na iti vāmadevo rāhurgāyatrī viniyogaḥ | oṃ 
kayā naḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ pūrvadeśodbhava pāṭalisagotra rāho 
ihāgacchetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭheti sthāpayet | 8 | tato vāyavye dhvajākāre 
maṇḍale dakṣiṇamukhān ketūn kṛṣṇapuṣpākṣataiḥ ketuṃ kṛṇvan iti 
madhucchandāḥ ketavo gāyatrī ketvāvāhane viniyogaḥ | oṃ ketuṃ kṛṇvan 
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ madhyadeśodbhavā jaiminigotrāḥ ketava 
ihāgacchatetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭhateti sthāpayet || 9 ||

athādhidevatāḥ śvetapuṣpākṣataiḥ kramāt sūryādīnāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ 
sthāpyāḥ | tryambakaṃ vasiṣṭho rudro'nuṣṭup | viniyogaḥ sarvatra deyaḥ | 
tryambakaṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ īśvara0 | 1 | gaurīrmimāya dīrghatamā 
umā jagatī somadakṣiṇe | 2 | yadakrando dīrghatamā skandastriṣṭup | 3 | 
viṣṇo dīrghatamā viṣṇustriṣṭup | 4 | brahma jajñānaṃ gautamo vāmadevo 
brahmā triṣṭup | 5 |

p. 275)

indraṃ vo madhucchandā indro gāyatrī | 6 | yamāya somaṃ yamo 
yamo'nuṣṭup | 7 | moṣuṇo ghoraḥ kaṇvo gāyatrī | 8 | uṣo vājaṃ 
praskaṇvaścitragupto bṛhatī | 9 | evameva śuklapuṣpākṣatairgrahāṇāṃ 
vāme mantrānte vyāhṛtīruktvā ihāgaccheha tiṣṭheti coktvā 
pratyadhidevatāḥ sthāpayet | agniṃ kāṇvo medhātithiragnirgāyatrī agniṃ 
dūtaṃ | 1 | apsu medhātithirāpo'nuṣṭup | 2 | syonā 
medhātithirbhūmirgāyatrī | 3 | idaṃ viṣṇuḥ medhātithirviṣṇurgāyatrī | 4 
| indra śreṣṭhāni gṛtsamada indrastriṣṭup | 5 | indrāṇī vṛṣākapirindrāṇī 
paṃktiḥ | 6 | prajāpate nahi hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpatistrīṣṭup | 7 | āyaṃ 
gauḥ sārparājñī sarpā gāyatrī | 8 | brahma jajñānaṃ gautamo 
vāmadevo brahmā triṣṭup | 9 | tataḥ śuklapuṣpākṣatairvināyakādīn 
pañca0 | gaṇānāṃ tvā gṛtsamado gaṇapatirjagatī rāhoḥ (vāme) 
vināyakam | 1 | jātavedase kaśyapo durgā triṣṭup śaneruttarato durgāṃ0 | 
2 | tavavāyavṛtaspate āṅgiraso vāyurgāyatrī raveruttarato vāyuṃ0 | etān 
mantrān paṭhanti sāṃpradāyikāḥ | 3 | ādityapratnasya vatsa ākāśo 
gāyatrī rāhordakṣiṇe ākāśam | 4 | eṣo uṣā praskaṇvo'śvinau gāyatrī 
aśvināvihāgacchateha tiṣṭhateti ketordakṣiṇe'śvinau || 5 ||

atha lokapālāḥ - indraṃ viśvā jetā mādhucchandasa indro'nuṣṭup 
indrehāgaccheha tiṣṭheti pūrve indraṃ0 | evamuttaratra | 1 | agniḥ 
medhātithiragnirgāyatrī | 2 | yamāya somaṃ yamo yamā'nuṣṭup | 3 | 
moṣuṇo ghoraḥ kaṇvo nir-ṛtirgāyatrī | 4 | tvannao agne vāmadevo 
varuṇastrīṣṭup | 5 | tava vāyo vyaśvyo vāyurgāyatrī | 6 | somo dhenuṃ 
gautamaḥ somastriṣṭup | 7 | tamīśānaṃ gautamaḥ soma īśāno gāyatrī | 8 
| śahasraśīrṣaḥ nārāyaṇo'nanto'nuṣṭup 
īśānapūrvayormadhye'nantam0 | 9 | brahma jajñānaṃ gautamo 
vāmadevo brahmā triṣṭup | 10 | nair-ṛtyapaścimayormadhye brahmāṇam0 | 
12 | tataḥ uttare kṣetrasya vāmadevaḥ kṣetrapālo'nuṣṭup | vāsto'pate 
vasiṣṭho vāstīṣpatistriṣṭup | tataḥ

sāmadhvaniśarīrastvaṃ vāhanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
viṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me || 1 ||

ityanena cottare garutmantamāvāhya | raveḥ pūrve śeṣaṃ somasyāgre 
vāsukiṃ bhaumāgre takṣakaṃ budhottare kārkoṭakaṃ bṛhaspateragre 
padmakaṃ śanipaścime śaṅkhapālaṃ rāhoḥ puraḥ kambalaṃ ketoḥ 
puraḥ kulikaṃ  pīṭhāt prācyāmaśvinyādisaptanakṣatrāṇi 
viṣkambhādisaptayogān vavavālavakaraṇe saptadvīpāni ṛgvedaṃ ca | 
dakṣiṇe puṣyādisaptanakṣatrāṇi dhṛtyādisaptayogān kaulavataitile karaṇe 
saptasāgarān yajurvedaṃ ca | paścime svātyādisaptanakṣatrāṇi 
vajrādisaptayogān garavaṇije karaṇe saptapātālāni sāmavedam ca | 
uttare'bhijidādisaptanakṣatrāṇi sādhyādiṣaṭyogān viṣṭikaraṇaṃ 
bhūrādisaptalokān atharvavedaṃ ca | vāyavye dhruvaṃ saptarṣīśca | atha 
yathāvakāśaṃ gaṅgādisaptasaritaḥ sapta kulācalān aṣṭau vasūn 
dvādaśādityān ekādaśarudrān ekonapañcāśanmarutaḥ ṣoḍaśa 
mātṝḥ ṣaḍ-ṛtūn dvādaśa māsān dve ayane pañcadaśa tithīn ṣaṣṭiṃ 
samvatsarān nāgānsarpān yakṣān gandharvān vidyādharān apsarasaḥ 
rakṣāṃsi bhūtāni manuṣyān iti | tato vedyaiśānyāṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpya 
tatra varuṇamāvāhya sampūjyārccayet | yathā kalaśābhimantraṇam :

kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇuḥ kaṇṭhe rudraḥ samāśritaḥ |
mūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1 ||

kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sapta saptadvīpā vasundharā |
ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥ || 2 ||

aṅgaiśca sahitāḥ sarve kalaśa tu samāśritāḥ |
atra gāyatrī sāvitrī śāntiḥ puṣṭikarī tathā || 3 ||

āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ |
devadānavasaṃvāde mathyamāne mahodadhau || 4 ||

utpanno'si tadā kumbha vidhṛto viṣṇunā svayam |
tvattoye sarvatīrthāni devāḥ sarve tvayi sthitāḥ || 5 ||

tvayi tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni tyayi prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
śivaḥ svayaṃ tvamevāsi viṣṇustvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ || 6 ||

ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāḥ sapaitṛkāḥ |
tyayi tiṣṭhanti sarve'pi yataḥ kāmaphalapradāḥ || 7 ||

tvatprasādādimaṃ yajñaṃ kartumīhe jalodbhava |
sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva prasanno bhava sarvadā || 8 ||

p. 276) 

iti | tataḥ phalapuṣpamālollasitaṃ vitānaṃ bṛhaspatidaivataṃ sūryādibhya 
idaṃ na mametyutsṛjya grahavedyupari badhnīyāt | evaṃ 
vedoktamaṇḍapapratiṣṭhādikaṃ vidadhyāditi | anyatsarvaṃ 
prāguktavidhinā vidheyam ||

tato guruḥ saśiṣyaḥ prātarutthāya kṛtāvaśyakakriyaḥ prādeśamātraṃ 
śiṣyāya yathoktaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ mūlamantreṇa saptavārābhi 
mantritaṃ dattvā dantadhāvanaṃ kārayet | dantān viśodhya 
dantakāṣṭhaṃ prakṣālya puraścaturasre hastamātre vā sthaṇḍile tyajet | 
tato gurustatparīkṣāṃ kuryāt | tatra śubhāśubhaphalāni prāgeva 
pramāṇanirupaṇe proktāni prāyaścittaṃ cāgre vakṣyate | tataḥ śiṣyo'pi 
snātaḥ kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ śrīguruṃ praṇamya 
tadājñayā tatpārśve upaviśet | tato guruśca ṛtvijaśca svasvakuṇḍe 
tathaiva devaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ sampūjya 
saghṛtaistilaistattatkalpoktapuraścaraṇahāmadravyairvā'ṣṭottarasahasra-
maṣṭottaraśataṃ vā juhuyuḥ | tato guruḥ śiṣyaṃ sūdravyatiriktaṃ 
pañcagavyaṃ pāyayitvā kuṇḍasamīpaṃ notvā divyadṛṣṭyā vilokya 
tasya hṛdayāravindāt jīvātmānaṃ bhūtaśuddhyuktaparipāṭyā taddehād 
brahmarandhramārgāt niḥsārya svātmani gurūktayuktyā yogabalena 
saṃyojya śiṣyaṣaḍadhvaśodhanaṃ kuryāt | tatra śiṣyasya pādayoḥ 
kalādhvānaṃ nivṛttipratiṣṭhāvidyāśāntiśāntyatītāśceti 
pañcakalātmakaṃ sañcintya tatastasya liṅgapradeśe 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyāmāyākalāvidyākālarāganiyati-
puruṣaprakṛtyahaṅkārabuddhimanaḥśrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāk-
pāṇipādapāyūpasthaśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyavyagnisalila
pṛthivyātmakaṣaṭtriṃśattattvarupaṃ śiva tattvādhvānaṃ dhyāyet | iti 
śaivadīkṣāyām || vaiṣṇavadīkṣāyāṃ tu - jīvaprāṇadhiyomana 
indriyadaśakaṃ tanmantrāḥ bhūtānāṃ pañcakamapi hṛtpadmatetrasāṃ 
tritayaṃ tadvacca vāsudevapramukhāścatvāra upadiṣṭā iti | 
indriyadaśakaṃ prāguktaṃ śrotrādayo vāgādayaśca | tanmātrāśca 
śabdādayaḥ | bhūtapañcakamākāśādi | tejasāṃ tritayaṃ 
somasūryāgnimayaṃ vāsudevapramukhāśca 
vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhāścatvāraḥ || sauradīkṣāyāṃ tu 
bhūtatanmātrendriyāṇi mano garvaśca buddhiśca dhīstathā pradhānaṃ 
ceti | indriyāṇi daśa jñānakramabhedāt | garvo'haṅkāraḥ | pradhānaṃ 
prakṛtitattvam || śaktidīkṣāyāṃ tu (nivṛttyādyāḥ pañca kalāḥ binduḥ 
nādaḥ śaktiḥ sadāśivaḥ śiva iti daśa tattvāni || tripadadīkṣāyāṃ tu) 
ātmavidyāśivā ete viparītāsta eva ca | sarvatattvaṃ ceti | viparītāḥ 
śivavidyātmānaḥ iti krameṇa ta eva ca ātmavidyāśivā eveti sapta tattvāni 
| itthaṃ tattaddīkṣāyāṃ tattadadhvānaṃ cintayediti || 
gāṇapatyadīkṣāyāṃ tu śaivatattvānyeva jñātavyāni || tataḥ śiṣyasya 
nābhau 
atalavitalasutalamahātalatalātalarasātalapātālabhūrbhuvaḥsvarmaharjanas-
tapaḥsatyalokātmakacaturdaśa bhuvanādhvānaṃ sañcintya (tatastasya 
hṛdaye ādikṣāntārṇasvarūpaṃ varṇādhvānaṃ bhāvayet | tataḥ 
śiṣyalalāṭe varṇasaṅghamayaṃ padādhvānaṃ vibhāvayet |) tataḥ 
śiṣyaśirasi padasamudāyamayaṃ mūlamantrasvarūpaṃ mantrādhvānaṃ 
bhāvayet iti śiṣyaśarīre'dhvaṣaṭkaṃ sañcintya taṃ kūrcena spṛśan 
guru svakuṇḍe oṃ amukasya kalādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti 
ghṛtāktaistilairaṣṭadhā hutvā kalādhvānam tattvādhvani vilīnaṃ 
vibhāvya oṃ amukasya tattvādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityaṣṭadhā 
hutvā tattvādhvānaṃ bhuvanādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya punaḥ oṃ 
amukasya bhuvanādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityaṣṭadhā hutvā 
bhuvanādhvānaṃ varṇādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya punaḥ oṃ amukasya 
varṇādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityaṣṭadhā hutvā taṃ padādhvani 
vilīnaṃ vibhāvya punaḥ oṃ amukasya padādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā 
ityaṣṭadhā hutvā taṃ mantrādhvani vilīnaṃ vibhāvya punaḥ oṃ amukasya 
mantrādhvānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityaṣṭadhā hutvā taṃ 
brahmarandhrasthaparaśive līnaṃ vibhāvya punaḥ saṃhṛtipratilomena 
paramaśivasya sakāśāt  mantrādhvānaṃ sṛṣṭvā tataḥ padādhvānam 
tasmādvarṇādhvānaṃ tato bhuvanādhvānaṃ tasmāttattvādhvānaṃ 
tataḥ kalādhvānaṃ ca sṛṣṭvā  tattatsthāne saṃsthāpya śiṣyaṃ 
divyadṛṣṭyā vilokya svasmin sthitaṃ śiṣyacaitanyaṃ tato hṛdayārabinde 
āvāhanoktaprakāreṇa tadbrahmarandhre niyojayet | atra 
śūdrasaṅkarajātīnāmadhvaśodhanaṃ na kāryam | teṣāṃ 
pādodakapradānena śodhanam kuryāt | tataḥ pūrvavat sveṣṭadevatāyā 
aṅgāvaraṇadevatānāṃ ghṛtenaikaikāmāhutiṃ dattvā oṃ bhūragnaye ca 
pṛthivyai ca mahate ca svāhā oṃ bhūvo vāyave cāntarikṣāya ca mahate ca 
svāhā oṃ svarādityāya ca dive ca mahate ca svāhā oṃ 
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramase ca nakṣatrebhyaśca digbhyaśca mahate ca 
svāhā ityāhuticatuṣṭayaṃ hutvā itaḥ pūrvaṃ 
prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā 
vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ 
yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā 
ityaṣṭāvājyāhutīrhutvā

p. 277)

oṃ sahasrārcirmahātejā namaste bahurūpadhṛk |
sarvāśine sarvagata pāvakāya namo'stu te || 1 ||

tvaṃ raudra ghorakarmā ca ghorahā tvaṃ namostu te |
viṣṇustvaṃ lokapālo'si śāntimatra prayaccha me || 2 ||

ityagniṃ prārthya agnimantreṇa prāgvadagniṃ sampūjya 
nyūnātiriktasiddhyarthaṃ dadāmi saghṛtaṃ tilaṃ oṃ hūṃ sāṅgaṃ 
kurukuru svāhā iti tilairāhutiṃ hutvā ghṛtena srucamāpūrya tadupari 
puṣpamadhomukhaṃ sruca ca nidhāya śaṅkhavatsampuṭābhyāṃ 
karābhyāṃ gṛhītvotthāya sruvasruvayormūlaṃ nābhau nidhāya 
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇāhutitrayaṃ dattvā prāgvattatra devaṃ sampūjya 
vahneḥ sakāśādudvāsya kalaśe visṛjya prāgvad 
vyāhṛtyāgnijigvāṅgamūrtimantrairekaikāmājyāhutiṃ hutvā prāgvat 
prokṣaṇīyajalenāgniṃ pariṣicya

bho bho vahne mahāśakte sarvakāmaprasādhaka |
karmāntare'pi samprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram || 1 ||

ityagniṃ prārthya saṃhāramudrayā taṃ svātmanyudvāsya paridhīn 
paristaraṇāṃśca tūṣṇīmagnau prakṣipya praṇītāpātramudvāsya 
svapurataḥ kuśāstare nidhāya oṃ prācyai diśe namaḥ evaṃ dakṣiṇāyai0 
pratīcyai0 udīcyai0 ūrdhvāyai diśe namaḥ iti tattaddiśi 
praṇītājalamutkṣipya adharāyai diśe namaḥ  iti bhūmau jalaṃ nikṣipya 
bhūmau patitajalena svātmānaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca kuśaiḥ samprokṣayediti 
praṇītodvāsanaṃ vidhāya brahmāṇamudvāsya brahmasthāne 
brāhmaṇāya sahiraṇyaṃ pūrṇapātraṃ dāpayet iti 
dīkṣāṅgahomavidhiḥ || pūrṇapātrasvarūpaṃ tu 
dīkṣāprakaraṇe'bhihitam || tato netramantreṇa śiṣyanetre 
nūtanavastrapaṭṭena baddhvā taṃ hastena gṛhītvā kumbhasamīpe gatvā 
tena saha tasyāñjaliṃ puṣpairāpūryaṃ svayaṃ mūlamantramuccaran 
ghaṭasthadevatāyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dāpayitvā tasya netrabandhanaṃ 
vimucya kuśāstare tamupaveśya

ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā |
cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 1 ||

iti mantraṃ pāṭhayitvā kumbhe devaṃ sāṅgāvaraṇaṃ sarvopacāraiḥ 
sampūjya prāguktabhūtaśuddhividhinā śiṣyasya dehaṃ saṃsmṛtya 
saṃśodhyotpādya tasya dehe mulamantrasya ṛṣyādyakhilanyāsajālaṃ 
vidhāya punaḥ kumbhasthadevatāṃ gandhādipañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya 
maṇḍapadvāradevatāḥ salokapālāṅgāvaraṇadevatā 
gaṇeśādicaturāyatanadevatāḥ svasvāṅgāvaraṇasahitā devasyāṅge 
vilīnā iti vibhāvya taṃ prāguktavidhinā ṣaḍaṅganyāsayogena 
sakalīkṛtya tejorūpamāpādya tattejorūpaṃ kalaśajalaṃ 
parabrahmamayaṃ sañcintayan śiṣyaṃ samalaṃkṛtaṃ vedyāḥ samīpe 
pūrveśānottarānyatamadiśi sarvatobhadrādimaṇḍale pūrvābhimukhaṃ 
bhadrapīṭhe samupaveśya pañcavādyaghoṣapuraḥsaraṃ guruḥ kumbhaṃ 
samuddhṛtya kumbhasthāmrapallavādikaṃ kalpav.kṣaśākhābuddhyā 
śiṣyaśirasi nidhāya vedaghoṣaṃ kurvadbhir-ṛtvigbhiranyaiśca 
brāhmaṇaiḥ saha mūlamantreṇa vilomamātṛkayā taṃ 
pūrvābhimukhopaviṣṭamuttarābhimukhastiṣṭhan abhiṣicya punaḥ 
pūrvamabhyarcitamastrarūpaṃ gṛhītvā tattoyairabhiṣicya 
tatkarakāvaśiṣṭajalena śiṣyamācāmayitvā devatāsvarūpaṃ taṃ 
prāgvat ṣaḍaṅganyāsena sakalīkṛtya śuddhe nūtane vāsasī paridhāpya 
svācāntaṃ svasamīpe samupaveśya śiṣyadehe saṃkrāntaṃ devaṃ 
tasyaiva dehe gandhādipañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya śiṣyadevatayoraikyaṃ 
bibhāvayan suviśītasya śiṣyasya dakṣiṇakarṇe śrīmūlamantraṃ 
gaṇeśādicaturāyatanamantrapūrvakaṃ gaṇeśadīkṣāyāṃ 
sūryādipūrvakaṃ tattadaṅgatayā pūjanakrameṇa vāratrayaṃ ca vadet | 
śiṣyo brāhmaṇaścettasya haste mantradānarūpeṇodakaṃ dadyāt 
anyebhyastvevameva vadet | tataḥ śiṣyaḥ svagurūpadiṣṭa 
mantramṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsapūrvakamaṣṭottaraśatamaṣṭāviṃśati
vāramaṣṭadhā vā japitvā japaṃ samarpyaṃ gurumantradevatānāmaikyam 
vibhāvya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ bahuśo guruṃ praṇamya punaḥ pañcāṅgaṃ 
praṇamet | tatrāṣṭāṅgapañcāṅgayorlakṣaṇamuktaṃ prāgeva pramāṇe | 
itthaṃ praṇamya gurave ṛtvigbhyaśca pramāṇoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt 
iti kriyāmayī dīkṣā ||

athaivaṃ vistarataḥ kriyādīkṣāṃ kartumaśaktaścet pūrvokte 
kaniṣṭhamaṇḍapaṃ prāgvadvedikāyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva tatra 
kumbhasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā ṛtvigvaraṇāśaktau guruścaturasrameva kuṇḍaṃ 
kṛtvā tatrāgnisthāpanādyakhilaṃ kṛtvoktavidhinābhiṣicya dīkṣāṃ 
dadyāt |

p. 278)

maṇḍapakaraṇāśaktau kvacit praśaste sthale prāgvat maṇḍalaṃ 
tattaddevatāpūjācakraṃ ca vā kṛtvā tadaśaktau prāguktavidhinā 
sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tatroktavidhināgniṃ saṃsthāpyoktavidhinā 
homādikaṃ kṛtvābhiṣicya mantraṃ dadyāt || atha 
ye'gnervarṇādyāstānāha tatra nāradapañcarātre :

agnerbhāsaśca gandhāśca śabdāścākṛtayastathā |
vikāśāśca śikhāścaiva saṃvedyāḥ karmasiddhaye ||1 ||

padmarāgadyutiḥ śreṣṭho lākṣārasasamaprabhaḥ |
bālārkavarṇo hutabhugjapābhaḥ śasyate budhaiḥ || 2 ||

indragopakasaṃkāśaḥ śoṇitābho'tha pāvakaḥ |
śakracāpanibhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kusumbhābhastathaiva ca || 6 ||

raktānāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ varṇenāgnirihocyate |

iti || atha gandhaḥ -

sugandhadravyagandho'gnirghṛtagandhaḥ suśobhanaḥ |
āyurdaḥ padmagandhaḥ syādbilvagandhaśca suvrataḥ || 1 ||

nāgacampakapunnagapāṭalīyūthikānibhaḥ |
padmendīvarakahlārasarpiguggulasannibhaḥ || 2 ||

pāvakasya śubho gandhaḥ iti || atha śabdaḥ

jīmūtavallakīśikhimṛdaṅgadhvanitulyakaḥ |
śabdo'gneḥ siddhaye hoturanyathā syādasiddhidaḥ || 1 ||

iti || śāradātilake - bherīvāridahastīndradhvanirvahneḥ śubhāvahaḥ | iti || 
athākṛtiḥ 

vṛttākāro dvijaśreṣṭha dhvajacāmarasannibhaḥ |
vimānānāṃ hayānāṃ ca prāsādānāṃ vṛṣasya ca || 1 ||

ākāreṇātha haṃsānāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ ca siddhidaḥ |
tadākṛtiḥ sadā vahniḥ sadyaḥ siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 ||

śeṣāṇāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ rūpaṃ na śastaṃ homakarmaṇi |
yadrūpaṃ kathitaṃ caitadyadi tasya pratīkṣaṇam || 3 ||

anyonyatvaṃ prapadyeta tadā siddhikaro'nalaḥ |

iti || atha śikhāḥ -

viṣamāśca śikhā vahnestryādayaśca śubhāvahāḥ |
hrasvā hrasvonnatā dīrghāgnijvālāḥ siddhidāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1 ||

iti || tatha śāradātilake -

pradakṣiṇāstyaktakampāśchatrābhāḥ śikhinaḥ śikhāḥ |
śubhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

iti || atha nāradapañcarātre -

pradīpte lelihāne'gnau nirdhūme saguṇe tathā |
hṛdye tuṣṭiprade caiva hotavyaṃ siddhimicchatā || 1 ||

snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ suśabdaścāpi yo bhavet |
nityamevaṃ śubhakaro yadanyairvarjito'guṇaiḥ || 2 ||

iti || atha niṣiddhaḥ-

alpatejāśca rukṣaśca visphuliṅgasamanvitaḥ |
dhūmāvalīḍhajvālaśca kṛśānurnaiva siddhidaḥ || 1 ||

durgandhaścāvalīḍhaśca sitakṛṣṇaśca yo bhavet |
bhūmiṃ ca vilikhedyastu so'pi dadyāt parābhavam || 2 ||

iti || tathā śāradātilake

kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇagatervarṇo yajamānaṃ vināśayet |
śveto rāṣṭraṃ nihantyāśu vāyasasvarasaṃnibhaḥ || 1 ||

kharasvarasamo vahnerdhvaniḥ sarvavināśakṛt |
pūtigandho hutavaho hoturduḥkhaprado bhavet || 2 ||

chinnāvṛttā śikhā kuryānmṛtyuṃ dhanaparikṣayam |
śukapakṣanibho dhūmaḥ pārāvatasamaprabhaḥ || 3 ||

hāniṃ turaṅgajātīnāṃ gavāṃ ca kurute'cirāt |

iti || tathā tantrasāre 

kharoṣṭramahiṣādīnāṃ rutamatra na siddhaye |
rūkṣaścaṭacaṭāśabdastvapasavyagatistathā || 1 ||

ullikhedvasudhāṃ yaśca yaścādhaḥśikha eva ca |
neṣyate'sau muniśreṣṭha śāstre'smin pārameśvare || 2 ||

p. 279)

iti || atraivaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittamuktaṃ kulaprakāśatantre

evaṃ vidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittāya deśikaḥ |
mūlenājyena juhuyāt pañcaviṃśatimāhutīḥ || 1 ||

pañcaviṃśatirekaikasmin doṣe || athavahneḥ sāttvikādijihvābhedāḥ - 
tatra dīkṣāṅgahome sāttvika
śāntikahome hiraṇyādyāḥ prāgevoktāḥ | atha vaśyādikāmyahomeṣu 
rājasyo jihvāḥ kulamūlāvatāre rājasyaḥ padmarāgaikā suvarṇā 
bhadralohitā | caturthī lohitā śvetā dhūminyanyā karālikā || 1 ||

iti || tāmasyo'pi tatraiva-

* * * * * * * * tāmasyo viśvamūrtikā |
sphuliṅginī dhūmravarṇā caturthī tu manojavā || 1 ||

pañcamī lohitākhyā syāt karālī gaditā tathā |
kālī ca saptamī proktā jñātavyāḥ kāryabhedataḥ || 2 ||

yāgakriyākāmyahomakrūrahomeṣu ca kramāt |

iti || atha jihvānāmadhidevatāḥ kulaprakāśatantre

jihvānāmadhidevāḥ syurvibudhāḥ pitarastathā |
gandharvayakṣanāgāśca piśācā rākṣasāstathā || 2 ||

rasanāsu surādīnāṃ juhuyāt kāryasiddhaye |
tṛptā dadyustato devā vāñchitāṃ siddhimuttamām || 2 ||

rasanāḥ svīyanāmābhāḥ kṛśānoḥ prāyaśo matāḥ |

iti || uttaratantre -

vaiśvānaraṃ sthitaṃ dhyāyet samiddhomeṣu deśikaḥ |
śayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇaṃ śeṣakarmasu || 1 ||

iti || athātra homakāle vahnerjihvāśiraḥkarṇādikaṃ jñātvā 
jihvāyāmeva juhuyāt | tathā coktaṃ mahākapilapañcarātre rāhukalpe ca -

sarvakāryaprasiddhyarthaṃ jihvāyāṃ tasya homayet |
cakṣuḥkarṇādikaṃ jñātvā homayed deśikottamaḥ || 1 ||

agnikarṇe hutaṃ yattat kuryācca vyādhito bhayam |
nāsikāyāṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ cakṣuṣornāśanaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

keśe dāridryadaṃ proktaṃ tasmājjihvāsu homayet |
yatra kāṣṭhaṃ tatra karṇau yatra dhūmastu nāsikā || 3 ||

yatrālpajvalanaṃ netraṃ yatra bhasma tu tacchiraḥ |
yatra prajvalito vahnistatra jihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 4 ||

iti || tathā śāradātilake -

āsyāntarjuhuyādvahneḥ vipaścit sarvakarmasu |
karṇahome bhavedavyādhirnetre tvandhatvamīritam || 1 ||

nāsikāyāṃ manaḥpīḍā mastake dhanasaṃkṣayaḥ |
sadhūmo'gniḥ śiraḥ proktaṃ nirdhūmaścakṣureva ca || 2 ||

jvalan kṛśo bhavetkarṇaḥ kāṣṭhamagneśca nāsikā |
agnirvijāyate yatra śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ || 3 ||

tanmūlaṃ tatra vijñeyaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ |

iti || atha sruksruvau uttaratantre -

sruksruvau śiṃśapāśvatyaśrīparṇīkhadirāmrajau |
candanadvayadevadruvikaṅkataśamībhavau || 1 ||

bilvodumbarapalāśanāgakesarasaṃbhavau |
bakulāśokapunnāgaplakṣanyagrodhacampakaiḥ || 2 ||

nirmitā viti | śāradātilake

śrīparṇīśiṃśapākṣīraśākhiṣvekatamaṃbudhaḥ |
gṛhītvā vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥ || 1 ||

viṃśatyaṃśairbhaved daṇḍo vedistairaṣṭabhirbhavet |
ekāṃśena mitaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ saptabhāgamitaṃ mukham || 2 ||

veditryaṃśena vistāraḥ kaṇṭhasya parikīrtitaḥ |
agraṃ kaṇṭhasamānaṃ syānmukhe mārgaṃ prakalpayet || 3 ||

kaniṣṭhāṃgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya vai |
vedīmadhye vidhātavyā bhāgenaikena karṇikā || 4 ||

vidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśe nābhipaṅkajam |
tasya khātaṃ tribhirbhāgairvṛttamardhāṃśato bahiḥ || 5 ||

p. 280)

aṃśenaikena parito dalānyaṣṭau prakalpayet |
mekhalā mukhavedyoḥ syāt parito'rdhāṃśamānataḥ || 6 ||

daṇḍamūlāgrayoḥ kumbhau guṇavedāṃgulaiḥ kramāt |
da (ga) ṇḍīyugaṃ yamāṃśaiḥ syāddaṇḍasyānāha īritaḥ || 7 ||

ṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavet |
haṃsasya vā hastino vā potriṇo vā mukhaṃ likhet || 8 ||

mukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāgo'syāḥ samproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sruvaḥ |
srucaścaturviṃśatibhirbhāgairārarcayet sruvam || 9 ||

dvāviṃśatyā daṇḍamānamaṃśairetasya kīrtitam |
caturbhiraṃśairānāhaḥ karṣājya grāhi tacchiraḥ || 10 ||

aṃśadvayena nikhanet paṅke mṛgapadākṛtim |
daṇḍamūlāgrayorgaṇḍī bhavet kaṅkaṇabhūṣitā || 11 ||

iti | gaṇḍīyugaṃ kaṅkaṇākāraṃ kaṅkabhūṣiteti svayamuktatvāt | 
gaṇḍī kaṅkaṇavad bhavediti vāyavīyasaṃhitāvacanācca | anyatra tu 
gaṇḍī kumbhaḥ | tatra tasyaivāvaśyakatvāt | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāṃ 
śruksrūvau taijasau vāpi iti || sruksruvābhāve kumbhasambhavaḥ :

palāśapatre niśchidre rucirau sruksruvau mune |
vidadhyādvāśvatthapatre saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇi || 1 ||

iti || athaitadracanāprakāramāha - tatra 
śiṃśapāśvatthaśrīparṇīkhadirāmracandanaraktacandanadevadāruvi-
kaṅkataśamīpalāśodumbarabilvapanasabakulāśokanāgakesarapunnāga-
campakavaṭavṛkṣāṇāmanyatamamaśuṣkamavraṇamaśīrṇaṃ 
ghuṇādibhiraduṣṭamuddiṣṭamānādadhikasthūladīrghaṃ samacaturasraṃ 
kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā tatra muṣṭyaṃgulena caturviṃśatyaṃgulamānaṃ 
ṣaṭtriśadaṃśena vibhajya teṣu viṃśatyaṃśaṃ daṇḍārdhaṃ 
vibhajyāvaśiṣṭaṣoḍaśabhāgeṣvagradeśe bhāgāṣṭakaṃ mukhārtthaṃ 
parikalpyāvaśiṣṭabhāgāṣṭakena samacaturasrāṃ vedīṃ kṛtvā 
tanmadhyacihnaṃ kṛtvā taccihnamavalambyārdhāṃśamānenābhito 
vṛttaṃ niṣpādya tadbahirapyekāṃśamānena vṛttāntaraṃ niṣpādya 
vṛttayorantarāle bhāgatrayaṃ nimnaṃ madhye vṛttākārāṃ karṇikāṃ 
sthāpayitvā tadbahirgataṃ kṛtvā tadbahirardhāṃśamānenābhito vṛttaṃ 
niṣpādya tadbahirapi ekāṃśamānena vṛttāntaraṃ niṣpādya 
vṛttayorantarāle'ṣṭadalāni parikalpya tadbahirardhāṃśamāne 
susamākārāṃ citritāṃ vā śobhāṃ vidadhyāt | 
tato'gre'vaśiṣṭāṃśena vedyāstṛtīyāṃśena pārśvadvayakhaṇḍanena 
madhye ekāṃśena kaṇṭhaṃ vidhāya kaṇṭhataḥ 
kiñciduccamavaśiṣṭhaṃ saptabhiraṃśairagraṃ kaṇṭhasamānavistaraṃ 
samatalamadhastādadhodhaḥ kṣīyamāṇavistāraṃ kṛtvā mukhe'pi 
vedīvat mekhalāṃ parikalpya kaṇṭhādadho mukhasya mekhalāmabhindan 
praṇālikākāramekāṃśamānanimnaḥ kaniṣṭhāpraveśayogyaṃ 
khātaṃ kṛtvā karṇikāmadhyasthakhātamadhyāt 
mukhamadhyasthapraṇālikākārakhātamadhye yathā ghṛtaṃ niḥsarati 
tathā taptalohaśalākayā kaṇṭhavediparidhibhedanaṃ suṣiraṃ vidhāya 
tathaivāgre'pi mukhaparidhibhedanaṃ ghṛtanirgamāya 
kaniṣṭhāpraveśayogyaṃ randhraṃ kuryāt | tato vedyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge 
kūrmākāraṃ madhye kiñcitsamatalaṃ bhūmau yathā niścala tiṣṭhati 
tathā kṛtvā mukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge madhye kiñcinnimnaṃ kṛtvā 
mukharandhrādhastāt uccabhāgaṃ haṃsamukhākāraṃ 
gajamukhākāraṃ varāhamukhākāraṃ vā suramyaṃ kārayitvā 
daṇḍasyāgre vedhata ekāṅgena kaṅkaṇākāratrayaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ vā 
kṛtvāa tadardhāṃśacatuṣṭayena mukhakaṇṭhamadhya 
mūlādisuśobhitamūrdhvamukhaṃ nirmāya tadadhaḥ punarekāṃśena 
prāgvat kaṅkaṇāni kṛtvā tadadho navāṃśamānaṃ suvartulaṃ 
ṣaḍaṃśamānadairghyaṃ sūtreṇa veṣṭanayogyasthalaṃ daṇḍamadhyaṃ 
kṛtvā tadadhaḥ punarekāṃśena kaṅkaṇāni tadardhāṃśatrayeṇa 
prāgvadūrdhvamukhaṃ kumbhaṃ tadadhaḥ punarekāṃśena kaṅkaṇāni 
ca kuryāt iti srucaṃ nirmāya srucaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśabhāgeṣu 
caturviṃśatibhāgadairghyamagradeśeṃdvayamānena vartulākāraṃ 
sthūlaśirobhāgayutaṃ suvartulaṃ sruvaṃ nirmāya tasya mukhapradeśe 
paṅkamadhyagatamṛgapadākāraṃ karṣamātragrāhi khātaṃ kṛtvā 
tadadhastvekāṃśamānena prāgvat kaṅkaṇāni tadardhāṃśacatuṣṭaye 
kumbhaṃ tata ekāṃśena punaḥ kaṅkaṇāni tata ekādaśāṃśamānaṃ 
caturaṃśamānadairghyasūtraveṣṭanayogyasthalaṃ kṛtvā 
punarekāṃśena kaṅkaṇāni tatoṃśatrayeṇa kumbhaṃ punarekāṃśena 
kaṅkaṇāni ca kuryāditi sruvanirmāṇaprakāraḥ || evaṃ 
svarṇaraupyatāmrayau vā sruksruvau kāryau | sruvābhāve pālāśasya 
madhyapatradvayaṃ pippaladaladvayaṃ vā home grāhyaṃ saṃskāro'pi 
sruksruvayoriva patrayorapi kāryaḥ | atha homadravyapramāṇi tatra 
śāradāyām :

karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam |
uktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni maniṣibhiḥ || 1 ||

p. 281)

tatsamaṃ madhudugdhānnamakṣamātramudāhṛtam |
dadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisaṃmitāḥ || 2 ||

pṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathoditāḥ |
guḍaṃ palārdhamānaṃ syāccharkarāpi tathā smṛtā || 3 ||

grāsārdhaṃ carumānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvāvadhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayet || 4 ||

kadalīnāgaraṅgāṇāṃ phalānyekaikaśo viduḥ |
mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtam || 5 ||

aṣṭadhā nārikelāni khaṇḍitāni vidurbudhāḥ |
tridhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhā || 6 ||

urvārukaphalaṃ home kaṭhitaṃkhaṇḍitaṃ tridhā |
phalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥ || 7 ||

dūrvātrayaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ guḍucī caturaṃgulā |
vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā api || 8 ||

taṇḍulāḥ syustadardhāṃśāḥ kodravā muṣṭisaṃmitāḥ |
godhūmā raktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ || 9 ||

tilāśculukamātrāḥ syuḥ sarṣapāstatpramāṇakāḥ |
śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi viṃśatiḥ || 10 ||

puraṃ varadamānaṃ syādrāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ smṛtam |
candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca || 11 ||

tintiṇībījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥ |

iti || uttaratantre - pāyasaṃ cākṣasaṃmitam iti | karṣalakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva 
māṣo daśa guñjāḥ syāt ṣoḍaśamāṣo nigadyate karṣaḥ iti | 
tailasyāpyetadeva parimāṇam | śuktiḥ karṣadvayam prasṛtimātraṃ 
paladvayamātraṃ muṣṭiḥ palaṃ palārdhaṃ karṣadvayaṃ grāsārdham 
aśītiraktikāmitam || kulamūlāvatāre :

guñjābhirdaṃśabhirmāṣaḥ śāṇo māṣacatuṣṭayam |
dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ ikṣaṇaśca (?) saḥ || 1 ||

tau dvau pāṇitalaṃ karṣaḥ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ |
picurbiḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayam || 2 ||

śuktiraṣṭātmikā te dve palaṃ bilvacaturthikā |
muṣṭirāmraṃ praguñjo'tha dve pale prasṛtistathā || 3 ||

iti | mātuluṅgaṃ bījapūram | urvārukaṃ karkaṭī | tadardhāṃśāḥ 
śuktimitā | culukamātrāḥ pāṇitalapramāṇāḥ karṣamātrā ityarthaḥ | 
akṣasammitaṃ karṣadvayamātraṃ | puraṃ guggulaḥ | 
badaramānamaśītiguñjāmitaṃ | rāmaṭha hiṃguḥ || nāradapañcarātre : 
tṛtīyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ mūlānāṃ hrasvāni svapramāṇataḥ | iti | 
śaivāgame'pi : khaṇḍatrayaṃ syānmūlānāṃ sukṣmāṇyevaṃ ca 
homayet | evaṃ kevalamakhaṇḍamiti yāvat | kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ 
latānāmaṃguladvayam | iti ||

atha samidhaḥ | tatra nāradapañcarātre -

samitprādeśamātreṇa samacchedānvitā tathā |
viśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhā || 1 ||

krimidaṣṭāśca dīrghāśca nistvacaḥ parivarjitāḥ |
viśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryāt dvidalā vyādhisambhavā || 2 ||

hrasvāyāṃ mṛtyumāpnoti vakrā vighnakarī matā |
sthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ || 3 ||

dvidhāyāṃ netradoṣāḥ syuḥ kīṭadaṣṭārthanāśinī |
dveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ kṛtāḥ || 4 ||

sakṣīrā nādhikānyūnāḥ samidhaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ |
ārdratvacaṃ samacchedā jarjharyaṃgulavartulām || 5 ||

īdṛśīṃ homayet prājñaḥ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam |
śraute smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 6 ||

iti | tathā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

tāḥ pālāśyaḥ parā vāpi yajñiyā dvādaśāṃgulāḥ |
avakrā na svayaṃ śuṣkāḥ satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ || 1 ||

daśāṃgulā vā vihitāḥ kaniṣṭhāṃgulasaṃmitāḥ |
prādeśamātrā vā lābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api || 2 ||

iti || atha prakṛte kriyādīkṣāśaktānāṃ varṇadīkṣādividhirlikhyate : tatra 
puṃsprakṛtyātmakānakārādikṣakārāntān mātṛkāvarṇān 
puṃsprakṛtyātmake śiṣyadehe yathāvidhi vinyasya punaḥ 
saṃhārakrameṇa mūrdhādihṛdayāntasthaṃ kṣakāraṃ 
nābhyantasthalakāre saṃharāmi hṛdādinābhiparyantasthalakāraṃ 
hṛdādivāmapādāgrasthe hakāre saṃharāmi 
hṛdādivāmapādāgraparyantasthaṃ 

p. 282)

hakāraṃ hṛdādidakṣiṇapādāgraparyaṃntasthe sakāre saṃharāmi 
hṛdādidakṣiṇapādāgraparyantasthaṃ sakāraṃ 
hṛdādivāmapāṇyagnāvadhisthe ṣakāre saṃharāmi 
hṛdādivāmapāṇyagrāvadhisthaṃ ṣakāraṃ 
hṛdādidakṣiṇapāṇyagrāvadhisthe śakāre saṃharāmi evaṃ yuktyā 
śakāraṃ vakāre saṃharāmityādi mukhavṛttasthamākāraṃ śiraḥsthe 
akāre saṃharāmi evaṃ yuktyā varṇān saṃhṛtya punastaccaitanyaṃ 
sakalatattvagrāmasametaṃ paramātmani saṃyojya 
vilīnasakalatattvasamūhaṃ vigatanikhilakaluṣaṃ divyatanuṃ śiṣyaṃ 
vicintya punaḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśādakārādikṣakārāntān 
varṇānutpādya vakṣyamāṇasṛṣṭinyāsakrameṇa śiṣyadehe 
mātṛkāvarnān vinyasya punastaccaitanyaṃ tattvagrāmasametaṃ tasmin 
saṃyojyoktavidhinopadeśaṃ kuryāt iti varṇātmadīkṣā ||

atha kalādīkṣā : tatra pādatalato jānuparyantaṃ nivṛttikalāṃ jānuto 
nābhiparyantaṃ pratiṣṭhākalāṃ nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ 
vidyākalāṃ kaṇṭhato lalāṭaparyantaṃ śāntikalāṃ lalāṭāt 
brahmarandhraparyantaṃ śāntyatītākalāṃ ca śiṣyadehe sañcintya 
nivṛttikalāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāyāṃ saṃharāmi pratiṣṭhākalāṃ 
vidyākalāyāṃ saṃharāmi vidyākalāṃ śāntikalāyāṃ 
śāntyatītākalāyāṃ saṃharāmi iti kramāt saṃhṛtya vedhayitvā tāṃ 
paramātmani saṃhṛtya prāgvattasya śarīraṃ saṃśodhya samutpādya 
paramātmanaḥ sakāśācchāntyatītākalāṃ tataḥ śāntiṃ tato vidyāṃ 
tataḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ tato nivṛttiṃ ca sṛṣṭikrameṇa śiṣyadehe tattadsthāne 
saṃyojyopadeśādikaṃ kuryāditi | evamaṣṭātriṃśatkalābhirvoktyuktyā 
saṃhārasṛṣṭinyāsakrameṇa śiṣyaṃ saṃskṛtya dīkṣāṃ dadyāt iti 
kalādīkṣā ||

atha sparśadīkṣā : tatra guruḥ svahastatale śivarūpaṃ svaguruṃ dhyāyan 
mūlavidyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgamātṛkāṃ ca japan śiṣyasya śirasi 
svadakṣiṇakaraṃ nidhāyopadiśet iti sparśadīkṣā ||

atha vāgdīkṣā : tatra guruḥ paracidrūpe śive cittaṃ nidhāya tadudbhūtān 
samastamantrān dhyāyaṃstanmanāḥ svayaṃ siṣyāyopadiśemantrān iti 
vāgdīkṣā ||

atha dṛgdīkṣā : tatra guruḥ svanetre nimīlya paramātmasvarūpiṇīṃ 
devatāṃ dhyātvā prasannacitto divyacakṣuṣā śiṣyaṃ nirīkṣya 
mantropadeśaṃ kuryāt iti dṛgdīkṣā | paścāduktametat dīkṣātrayaṃ 
viraktānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ tattvavidā guruṇā karyamiti | strīṇāṃ tu 
vāgdīkṣaiva vihitā nānyā ||

atha vedhadīkṣā : tatra guruḥ śiṣyasya mūlādhāre 
caturdalapaṅkajamadhyatrikoṇamadhye yathoktarūpāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ 
dhyātvā tatpatracatuṣṭyamadhyasthavādisāntākṣaracatuṣṭayaṃ 
tanmadhyasthite kamalāsane saṃhṛtya taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tadūrdhvagaṃ 
tasvādhiṣṭhānākhyaṣaṭpatrakamalamadhyasthite viṣṇau saṃyojya 
vedhayitvā tatpatraṣaṭkamadhyasthavādilāntavarṇaṣaṭkaṃ viṣṇau 
saṃyojya tadūrdhve nābhimaṇḍale daśakalātmake maṇipūrākhye 
viṣṇuṃ saṃyojya 
tatpatradaśakamadhyasthaḍādiphāntavarṇadaśakasahitaṃ viṣṇuṃ 
tatpaṅkajamadhyasthe rudre saṃyojya vedhayitvā taṃ rudramanāhatākhye 
hṛtpadme kādiṭhāntadvādaśavarṇāḍhyadvādaśadalasaṃyukte saṃyojya 
tairakṣaraiḥ sārdhaṃ taṃ tanmadhyasthiteśvare saṃyojya vedhayitvā 
kaṇṭhadeśe ṣoḍaśasvarāḍhyaṣoḍaśadalakamale viśuddhacakre 
tamīśvaraṃ saṃyojya taiḥ svaraiḥ sārdhaṃ īśvaraṃ tanmadhyasthe 
sadāśive saṃyojya vedhayitvā taṃ sadāśivaṃ 
bhrūmadhyadvidalapaṅkajamājñācakraṃ nītvā 
tatpatradvayahakṣavarṇadvayasahitaṃ sadāśivaṃ tanmadhyavartini bindau 
saṃyojya vedhayitvā taṃ binduṃ tadūrdhvasthitāyāṃ kalāyāṃ 
saṃyojya tāṃ punarnāde taṃ nādānte tamunmanyāṃ tāṃ viṣucakre 
viṣucakraṃ guruvaktre cetyuttarottaraṃ saṃyojya vedhayitvā jīvātmanā 
saha tāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ paraśive saṃyojya vedhayet | evaṃ kṛte śiṣyo 
gurvājñayā chinnasaṃsārapāśo visaṃjñaḥ sadyaḥ kṣititale patati | tato 
guruḥ saṃhṛtaviparītakrameṇa paraśivāt kuṇḍalinīmutpādya tathā 
hṛtmakhilaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa śiṣyadehe  tattaccakre tāṃ tāṃ devatāṃ 
saṃyojya hṛdaye jīvaṃ mūlādhāre kuṇḍaliniṃ saṃyojyopadeśādikaṃ 
kuryāt | tataḥ saṃjātadivyabodho bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānajñaḥ 
sadāśivo bhavati iti vidhadīkṣā || prāyaḥ kalau vedhadīkṣākaro 
gurustadyogyaḥ śiṣyaśca durlabha ityāhurācāryāḥ | prasaṅgādatrāpi 
likhiteyamiti śivam ||

athaivaṃ dīkṣitānāṃ sadbhaktiyuktānāṃ gurutaḥ 
śāstrataścādhigatāśeṣarahasyaparamārthānāṃ guruḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ 
pūrṇābhiṣekākhyaṃ

p. 283)

dvitīyamabhiṣekaṃ kuryāt | tatra prāgukte maṇḍape vedikāyāṃ 
vakṣyamāṇaṃ vipulaṃ tatpūjācakraṃ nirmāya prāgvat pañcajobhiḥ 
karṇikādalakesarakoṇādikamāpūrya tasya madhye 
khārītoyapūrṇakumbhaṃ prāguktavidhinā saṃsthāpyānyeṣu daleṣu 
koṇeṣu caturasreṣu ca sarvāvaraṇadevatāpūjāsthāneṣu 
prasthadvayajalapūrṇakalaśān saṃsthāpya tatra madhyekumbhe 
devatāmāvāhya prāguktavidhinā ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ sampūjyānyeṣu 
kalaśeṣu tathaivāṅgāvaraṇadevatāḥ sampūjya dīkṣoktavidhinā 
śiṣyajanmanakṣatre prāgvat pañcavādyaghoṣa puraḥsaraṃ 
sveṣṭadevatābhaktairbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha taṃ samyagabhiṣiñcet | tataḥ 
śiṣyo'pi prāgvat śrīguruṃ praṇamya dakṣiṇādikaṃ dattvā 
brāhmaṇān bhūridakṣiṇādibhiḥ santoṣayediti pūrṇābhiṣekavidhiḥ ||

pūrṇābhiṣekahīno yaḥ sādhako mriyate yadi |
piśācatvamavāpnoti narakaṃ ca prapadyate || 1 ||

iti kulārṇavavacanādāvaśyako'yamabhiṣekaḥ |

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya-
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya-
śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣyaśrīpraglabhācāryaśiṣya -  
śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre trayodaśaḥ śvāsaḥ 
|| 13 ||





atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| caturdaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha kādimate pūrṇābhiṣekavidhiḥ ||
śrītantrarāje - (2 pa0 52 ślo0)

uktalakṣaṇasampannaṃ śiṣyamācārabhūṣaṇam |
pañcaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥ || 1 ||

kalaśairabhiṣicyāmuṃ śrīcakre sanniveśya ca |
ādhāre hṛdaye mūrdhni cakraṃ sañcintya madhyataḥ || 2 ||

svāntādāvāhya saṃsthāpya sampūjya nyāsasaṃyutam |
triśo vidyāṃ japetkarṇe devyātmā pūrṇamānasaḥ || 3 ||

devatāgurumantrātmatattvaikyaṃ bhāvayan mudā |
śataṃ japettadagrastho nikaṭe tridinaṃ vaset || 4 ||

nacet sañcāriṇī śaktirgurumeti na saṃśayaḥ |
tasmāttadantike tasya pūjādeśādikṛdvaset || 5 ||

tādātmyamātmano labdhuṃ gurormantrātmano yataḥ |
tatastadā samārabhya tadāyatto dhanādibhiḥ || 6 ||

athābhiṣekaṃ dvividhaṃ samavāpya tadājñayā |
anugrahādi kurvīta siddhye nānyathā bhavet || 7 ||

vidhāya cakraṃ tanmadhye yaonyāṃ kumbhaṃ nidhāya tam |
kvāthodakaiḥ samāpūryābhiṣicyābhivadenmanum || 8 ||

kramāgatasamācāranirate bhaktiśālini |
dvitīyamabhiṣekaṃ tu kuryād devyātmasiddhye || 9 ||

viracya vipulaṃ catraṃ pratiyoni ca ṣoḍaśa |
trikoṇāni vidhāyātra madhye kumbhaṃ tu vinyaset || 10 ||

sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāamraṃ kācaṃ mārtikameva ca |
pūritaṃ khāritoyena kathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥ || 11 ||

nikṣipya navaratnāni dhānyāni vividhāni ca |
hiraṇyāni satāmrāṇi vāsobhyāmabhiveṣṭayet || 12 ||

raktābhyāṃ candanaiścūtapanasāśvatthapallavaiḥ 
śatakratulatābaddhairmātuluṅgaphalānvitaḥ || 13 ||

pidhāya kalaśānanyānanyeṣvekaikaśo nyaset |
sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatpañcasaṃkhya kramoditāḥ || 14 ||

madhye cakre sutoyādi kṛtvāvāhyābhipūjya ca |
kālātmanityāmantrāṃśca japitvā pūrvavāsare || 15 ||

janmarkṣe prātarutthāya svanityāṃ tatra pūjayet |
sahasraṃ prajapet paścāddhomaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥ || 16 ||

śṛṅgakāhalaśaṅkhādivādyasaṅgītanartanaiḥ |
muditairyoginīvṛndairekaikaṃ devatātmabhiḥ || 17 ||

vṛttaiḥ supūjitaiḥ sārdhamabhisiñcet svayaṃ guruḥ |
svakramaṃ tasya kathayettadā prabhṛti so'pi tam || 18 ||

anutiṣṭhedavicchinnaparyāyaṃ tasya vicyutau |
sahasraṃ prajaped vidyāmabhiṣekasamanvitam || 19 ||

athavā ṣaṇavatyastu kalaśāstatra vinyaset |
teṣu śaktīḥ samāvāhya sampūjyaivābhiṣecayet || 20 ||

ekaṃ vā kalaśaṃ janmadine kṛtvābhiṣecayet |
evaṃ naimittikaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ samācaret || 21 ||

iti mātṛkārṇave -

śiṣyāyopadiśedvidyā nityāḥ pañcadaśātmikāḥ |
trikuṭāśca catuṣkuṭāḥ pañcakūṭāstathaiva ca || 1 ||

ṣaṭkūṭāḥ saptakūṭāśca vasukūṭā navātmikāḥ |
daśaikādaśakūṭāśca ravikūṭāstathaiva ca || 2 ||

trayodaśātmikāścaiva caturdaśabhidhāstathā |
tathā pañcadaśākhyāśca tathā ṣoḍaśakūṭakāḥ || 3 ||

aṅgapratyaṅgavidyāśca tathā cāvṛtidevatāḥ |
pañcāyatanavidyāśca nyāsajālaṃ tathaiva ca || 4 ||

śuddhāśuddhāśca śabalāḥ sarvāścopadiśet kramāt |
tā vidyāḥ prajapecchiṣyaḥ kramaprāptāḥ krameṇa vai || 5 ||

p. 285)

gurusevāparo nityaṃ gurvājñāpālako vaset |
kramaprāptamahāvidyānicaye bhaktiśālini || 6 ||

dvitīyamabhiṣekaṃ tu kuryāddevyātmasiddhaye |
prākproktavidhinā samyaṅmaṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 7 ||

caturviṃśatyuttaraiśca śatahastaiśca maṇḍapam |
sudine śubhanakṣatre sumuhūrte śubhodaye || 8 ||

gaṇeśaṃ pūjayedādau pañcavādyapuraḥsaram |
prākproktavidhinā samyak kuryāt puṇyāhavācanam || 9 ||

mātṛkāpūjanaṃ caiva vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca |
brāhmaṇān pūjayet paścāt svastivācanapūrvakam || 10 ||

suvarṇabhūṣaṇairvastraiḥ śrīguruṃ vṛṇuyād budhaḥ |
dadājñayānyaviprāṃśca vṛṇuyāt svarṇavastrakaiḥ || 11 ||

ekaṃ tu pustakācāryamṛtvijo vasusaṃkhyakān |
brāhmaṇān navasaṃkhyāṃśca hyaṣṭau ca dvārapālakān || 12 ||

caturaḥ śāntipāṭhāya dvijānanyān śucivratān |
svavidyopāsakān bhaktyā svarṇaratnāṃgulīyakaiḥ || 13 ||

dvijājñayā gururmadhyavedyāṃ cakraṃ likhet sudhīḥ |
śrīgurūktaprakāreṇa samasūtraṃ manoharam || 14 ||

pratirekhaṃ prayatnena pūrayedraktataṇḍulaiḥ |
saptasaptatikoṇeṣu yoniṣu pratiyoni ca || 15 ||

ṣoḍaśāracayet sūtraistribhiḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayā |
sarvatra śālipuñjeṣu kalaśān sthāpayedbudhaḥ || 16 ||

madhyasthayonimadhye ca khārītāyabhṛtaṃ ghaṭam |
prasthamātragrāhighaṭān itareṣu nidhāpayet || 17 ||

padeṣukāmeśyādīnāṃ pratidevi ca ṣoḍaśa |
aṣṭāyudhānāṃ sthāneṣu pratiheti ca ṣoḍaśa || 18 ||

pratisthānaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva siddhimudrāpadeṣu ca |
pārśvayorekamekaṃ ca devyāḥ pṛṣṭhe ghaṭatrayam || 19 ||

hemaratnaphalairvāsodvayapallavaśobhitān |
gurumaṇḍalanirmāṇaṃ ṣaḍkoṇāṣṭābjamadhyataḥ || 20 ||

kamalāṣṭāsrayormadhye tithīśānāṃ ca maṇḍalam |
grahamaṇḍalamīśāne sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 21 ||

vāreśamaṇḍalaṃ madhye aṣṭāsrācāryakuṇḍayoḥ |
āgneyapūrvamadhye tu kūryānnakṣatramaṇḍalam || 22 ||

yonyardhacandramadhye tu nityāmaṇḍalamuttamam |
yāmyanair-ṛtamadhye daddinanityāprapūjane || 23 ||

maṇḍalaṃ racayediti śeṣaḥ |

nair-ṛtye vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍala racayedbudhaḥ |
vṛttatrikoṇamadhye tu dhātudaivatamaṇḍalam || 24 ||

ṣaṭkoṇavṛttayormadhye mithunānāṃ ca maṇḍalam |
āgnaye kurukullāyā vārāhyā vāyugocare || 25 ||

śeṣikābalidevīnāṃ maṇḍalānyantarāntarā |

iti | gurumaṇḍalasarvatobhadramaṇḍalapūjākramaḥ prāgevābhihitaḥ ||

atha navagrahādipūjāvidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (28 pa0 72 ślo0)

grahāṇāṃ mātṛkāvidyāvigrahaṃ vigrahaṃ yataḥ|
tena teṣāṃ pūjārthaṃ vakṣye taddhāmamaṇḍalam || 1 ||

sudhāsvarairbhavedindormaṇḍalaṃ bhāskarasya tu |
sudhāvyañjanarūpaṃ syāditare tanmayā yataḥ || 2 ||

tena teṣāṃ maṇḍalāni taistairvarṇairvadāmi te |
teṣāṃ navānāṃ pūjāsu tanmayaṃ navamaṇḍalam || 3 ||

candrārkayoḥ pṛthakpūjāsvabhyarcya maṇḍalaṃ tayoḥ |
krameṇa śṛṇu deveśi sarvaśreyaskarātmakam || 4 ||

prākpratyagdakṣiṇodak ca catuḥsūtranipātanāt |
trihastamātre janayennava koṣṭhāni teṣu vai || 5 ||

madhye prākkoṣṭhayoḥkṛtvā vṛttatrayamatisphuṭam |
tanmadhye tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca sūtradvayanipātanāt || 6 ||

vidhāya navadhā madhyamīśādi vilikhet kramāt |
vātādyaṣṭasvarān madhye praṇavaṃ nabhasā yutam || 7 ||

vṛttavīthyoḥ svaropetaṃ nabhasā mātṛkāṃ likhet |
tatrārkamarcayet tasya nāmabhirdvādaśoditaiḥ || 8 ||

praṇavādyairnamontaiśca bhānoḥ sarvatra sarvadā |
somasyādyaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tena tathārcayet || 9 ||

tannāmnā tatra vilikhedvindvāḍhyaṃ ca svarāṣṭakam |
ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ ca mātṛkāṃ ca svayogataḥ || 10 ||

vilikhedvṛttayormadhye madhyakoṣṭhe'pi taṃ likhet |
dāhavahnisvasahitamarcayettatra maṇḍale || 11 ||

p. 286)

somamuktakrameṇaiva proktakāleṣu sarvadā |
nivedya śarkarādugdhapāyasaiścopacārakaiḥ || 12 ||

saptasvanyeṣu koṣṭheṣu kṛtvā vṛttatrayaṃ tathā |
tattadvargādivarṇaṃ ca svaraistāṃ mātṛkāmapi || 13 ||

vilikhya madhyaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā teṣu ca tatkramāt |
tattadvargākṣarāṇyākhyātryakṣarairālikhedapi || 14 ||

madhye praṇavagarbhasthavargādyakṣaramālikhet |
evaṃ kṛteṣu navasu pūjayecca nava grahān || 15 ||

agnyādīśāntamabhito likhennāmānyanukramāt |
tryakṣarāṇi caturthyantānyarccayettaiśca tāniti || 16 ||

bhaumaṃ budhaṃ tathā sauriṃ guruṃ rāhuṃ ca śukrakam |
ketumetaistu sarvatra mantrānuktau ca pūjanam || 17 ||

evaṃ navagrahāṇāṃ tu maṇḍalānyuditāni vai |
teṣveva teṣāmarcātaste kuryustadanugraham || 18 ||

bhāskarendvośca tadvāradvaye darśe ca pūrṇike |
svoccayoḥ sthitayoḥ pūjāṃ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 19 ||

vilikhya vṛttayugalaṃ tanmadhye tiryagūrdhvataḥ |
rekhābhirnavabhirmadhye tvekāśītipadaṃ likhet || 20 ||

īśakoṣṭhādi paritaḥ praveśenāmṛtārṇakān |
māyantāśītisaṃkhyātān madhye dāvagataṃ ca tata || 21 ||

vṛttayorantarā kṛtvā mātṛkāṃ grathitāṃ ca taiḥ |
pañcabhiścālikhettatra bimbe somaṃ samarcayet || 22 ||

karpūracandanābhyāṃ tadālikhedindubimbakam |
raktacandanasindūragairikeṣvekato raveḥ || 23 ||

kṛtvā bimbaṃ tatra taṃ ca pūjayet proktarūpataḥ |
dvivṛttāntastiryagūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā rekhāḥ samāntarāḥ || 24 ||

ekonaviśaṃ tanmadhyeṣvā likhet prāgvadudīritān |
prāṇādikānnamontāṃstu svairupetān svarairyutān || 25 ||

vṛttayorantarā taiśca pañcaviṃśativarṇakaiḥ |
svarairbhāntayutairvahnidaśārṇairgrathitāṃ lipim || 26 ||

vilikhya viśadākāraṃ trihastāyāmavistaram |
tanmadhye bhānumāvāhya pūjayet prāgvadīśvari || 27 ||

pīṭhe vā sudhayā klipte bhūtale vā śikhātale |
susame'nāvṛte kṛtvā bimbāyuktāni pūjayet || 28 ||

evaṃ sarvatra tantre'smin grahapūjā samīritā |
viśeṣādeśarahite tatra tatkramato'rcayet || 29 ||

asyārthaḥ prayoge vakṣyate | vāstumaṇḍalapūjā prāgeva pradarśitā || 
atha tithivārarkṣadevatāḥ piṅgalāmate -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vāratithyṛkṣadevatāḥ |
ravau sūryaśivau devi candre somāmbike tataḥ || 1 ||

bhaume tu maṅgalaguhau śuddha (budho) viṣṇustataḥ pare |
pare gurucaturvaktrau bhṛgau śukrapurandarau || 2 ||

mande vāre (dhane)śvaraḥ kālo vāreśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |

iti | pare budhavāre | pare guruvāre | tathā -

brahmā vidhātā viṣṇuśca yamaḥ śītakaro guruḥ |
indraśca vasavo nāgā dharmaḥ śivadivākarau || 1 ||

manmathaśca kaliścaiva viśvedevāstithīśvarāḥ |
darśe tu pitaro devi pūjyāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ || 2 ||

aśvinau ca yamo vahnirbrahmenduśca śivo'ditiḥ |
guruḥ sarpāśca pitaro bhago'ryamadineśvarau || 3 ||

tvaṣṭā vāyurathendrāgnī mitraścendrastataḥ priye |
nir-ṛtiścaiva toyaṃ ca viśvedevāḥ prajāpatiḥ || 4 ||

viṣṇuśca vasavo devi varuṇāścāja ekapāt |
ahirbudhnyaśca pūṣā ca proktā nakṣatradevatāḥ || 5 ||

etāḥ sarvopacāraistutaddineṣusamayarcayet |
praṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśvari || 6 ||

iti | atrendrāgnī ityekasyaiva nakṣatrasya devatādvayam | 
viśākhānakṣatramindrāgnidevateti śruteḥ | uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatrasya 
viśvedevāḥ śravaṇasya viṣṇuḥ | etayormadhye prajāpatiriti yaduktaṃ 
tadabhijitamasti tajjyotiḥśāstre'vagantavyam || atha taddinanityāpūjāvidhiḥ 
| śrītantrarāje - (25 pa0 78 ślo0)

āsāṃ tu nityāvidyānāmaṅgāni ca śṛṇu priye |
dviruktaistaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādarṇaiḥ karāṅgayoḥ || 1 ||

vinyasya mātṛkāmuktāṃ japedvidyāstathaikaśaḥ |
raktā raktāmbarā raktabhūṣaṇasragvilepanāḥ || 2 ||

pāśāṃkuśekṣukodaṇḍaprasūnaviśikhāḥ smaret |
tadāvṛtīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śaktīstatsadṛśīḥ smaret || 3 ||

caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā dvāradvayavibhūṣitam |
aṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ madhye navayonau ca tāṃ yajet || 4 ||

p. 287)

aṅgāvṛtiṃ madhyayonāvantare syāyudhāvṛtīḥ |
pṛṣṭhato gurupaṃktiṃ ca koṇeṣvaṣṭasu ca kramāt || 5 ||

bahirdaleṣvapi tathā yajedvarṇairvilomataḥ |
rūpiṇīśaktisahitairmāyāsaptākṣarīyutaiḥ || 6 ||

brāhyādiśaktīstadbāhye caturasradvaye yajet |
āsāṃ balipradānaṃ ca karotu kurukullayā || 7 ||

saptākṣaryā kevalayā proktarūpāṃ smaran dhiyā |

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
taddinanityāvidyā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi 
hrīṃśrīṃdakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ 
| hṛdaye kālanityāyai devatāyai namaḥ | iti vinyasya 
hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣvapi vinyasya raktāṃ raktāmbarāmityādi dhyātvā 
mānasapūjādikaṃ vidhāya svapurataḥ svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
sakesaramaṣṭadalakamalaṃ viracya tanmadhye navayonicakraṃ 
vidhāyāṣṭadalādbahiścaturasradvayamantarvibhāgena 
prākpaścimayordvāradvayayutaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye yonau 
taddinanityāvidyāyā akṣaratrayaṃ likhitvā śrīparṇyādipīṭhe svapurataḥ 
saṃsthāpya tatra taddinanityāvidyayā puṣpāñjaliṃ 
tattvārghyādiprātrāṇi saṃsthāpyātmapūjāṃ vidhāya 
śrīcakrapīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāyāvāhanādipuṣpāntairupacārairupacarya 
layāṅgapūjanaṃ kṛtvā yonimudrāṃ pāśādicaturmudrāḥ pradarśya 
madhyayonimadhye'gnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu devyagre tadādicaturdikṣu 
ca prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya 
madhyayonerbahiraṣṭakoṇābhyantarasthāntarāleṣu 
prāgvadāyudhacatuṣṭayaṃ sampūjya devyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge yonimadhye 
yonyantarāle gurupaṃktitrayasthāne rekhātrayaṃ vibhāvya tāsu 
prathamarekhāyāṃ prakāśānandādigurutrayaṃ madhyarekhāyāṃ 
śrījñānānandanāthādigurutrayaṃ tṛtīyarekhāyāṃ 
svabhāvānandādigurutrayaṃ ceti gurupaṃktitrayaṃ pūjayet | 
tato'ṣṭayoniṣu devyagramārabhya vāmāvartena taddinaniyāvidyāyā 
madhyākṣaraṃ ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ kṛtvā māyābījapūrvakaṃ 
teṣāmādyakṣaramuccārya rūpiṇośaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi divitīyaṃ 
rūpiṇīśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi ityādyaṣṭaśaktīḥ 
sampūjyāṣṭadaleṣu vāmāvartenāvaśiṣṭākṣaraśaktīḥ sampūjya 
bahiścaturasravīthyāṃ vāmāvartena 
brāhmyādyaṣṭaśaktīrmāyābījādikāḥ sampūjya 
lokapālārcanādinaivedyadānānte kurukullāvidyā saptākṣaryā 
balidānaṃ ca vidhāya sarvaṃ samāpayediti taddinanityāyāḥ pūjāvidhiḥ 
||

atha ḍākinyādiṣaḍdhātudevatāpūjāvidhirlikhyate | tatra śrītantrarāje - 
(16 pā0 72 ślo0)

bhūmau vidhāya ṣaṭkoṇasaptakaṃ proktadikkramāt |
madhye ca tatra tāṃ nityānityāṃ gandhādibhiryajet || 16 ||

abhitastatṣaḍasreṣu tatṣaṭkaṃ tatkramādyajet |
bāhyeṣvapi ca tāḥ prāgvat proktavarṇāḥ samarcayet || 2 ||

tāsāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi tathā ṣaṭkoṇeṣu saśaktayaḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśattāḥ samā devyāḥ sarvarūpāyudhādibhiḥ || 3 ||

prāgvat svarāṇāṃ pañca syurapūrvāḥ kādimāntakāḥ |
pareṣu yavalakṣārṇarahitaistaistathārcayet || 4 ||

teṣāmapi ca cakrāṇāṃ śaktīnāṃ ca vilomataḥ |
pūjā nigrahasaṃjñā syātsā śatrūṇāṃ vipattaye || 5 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra vedikāyāṃ gomayopalipte paśudṛṣṭirahite 
svāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte nityānityāpūjoktavidhinā 
prāṇāyāmādimānasapūjāntaṃ kṛtvā svapurataḥ kvacidvinduṃ kṛtvā 
tadavaṣṭambhataḥ paritaścaturviṃśāṃgulamānabhramādvṛttaṃ 
niṣpādya tanmadhye prākpratyagāyataṃ brahmasūtramāsphālya 
tadbrahmasūtrasyārdhamānena tasmin vṛtte brahmasūtrasya pūrvāgraditaḥ 
paścimāgrāditaśca dakṣiṇa (bhāge) cihnadvayamuttarabhāge 
cihnadvayamiti sambhūya cihnacatuṣṭayaṃ kṛtvā cihnāt cihnaṃ 
dakṣiṇottarāyataṃ tiryaksūtradvayamāsphālya 
paścimatiryaksūtrāgradvayamārabhya brahmasūtrasya pūrvāgrāvadhi 
sūtradvayaṃ vinyasya punaḥ pūrvatiryaksūtrasya koṭidvayamārabhya 
brahmasūtrasya paścimāgrāvadhi sūtradvayamāsphālya ṣaṭkoṇaṃ 
jāyate | tato vahnikoṇādivāyukoṇāntaṃ tatheśānādinir-ṛtyantaṃ 
brahmasūtradvayayamāsphālya sametāni tāni trīṇyapi sūtrāṇi 
pratyekaṃ tridhā vibhajya cihnāni kṛtvā 
paścimavāyavyeśānapūrvāgneyanir-ṛtidiggateṣu ṣaṭsu 
brahmasūtratṛtīyāṃśasthāneṣu madhye ca 
tattadardhamānasūtrapramāṇena vṛttasaptakaṃ kṛtvā brahmasūtratrayaṃ 
pratyekaṃ caturviṃśatidhā vibhajya madhyavṛttamadhyagatabindumārabhya 
paritaḥ ṣaṭsu vṛtteṣu daśamāṃśadaśamāṃśasthāneṣu 
tattanmadhyagatabrahmasūtracihnāni kṛtvā punarmadhyavṛttasya ca 
madhyādita

p. 288)

āgneyakoṇagatavṛttabrahmasūtre prāgvaddaśamāṃśe cihnaṃ kṛtvā 
tathaivāgneyamadhyavṛttayorantarālādito 
vāyavyavṛttamadhyagatabrahmasūtre daśamāṃśe cihnaṃ kṛtvā 
tathaiveśānanir-ṛtikoṇagatavṛttayorapyuktayuktyā prativṛttaṃ cihnadvayaṃ 
vidhāya tathaiva prākpratyagāyatabrahmasūtrasya paścmāgrāditaḥ 
pūrvāgrāditaśca prāgvaddaśamāṃśe cihnadvayaṃ vidhāya saptasyapi 
vṛtteṣu cihne cihne prativṛttaṃ tiryagrekhādvayaṃ kṛtvā teṣu 
prāguktayuktyā ṣaṭkoṇasaptakaṃ niṣpādya teṣu pratiṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhye 
ca ṣaṭsu trikoṇeṣu vṛttāni kṛtvā brahmasūtrāṇi mārjayediti 
pūjācakramuddhṛtya tanmadhye nityānityāvidyayā puṣpāñjaliṃ 
nikṣipya nityāvidyayārghyasthāpanādyātmapūjānte madhyaṣaṭkoṇe 
nityānityāpūjoktavidhinā pīṭhapūjādipuṣpopacārānte tatroktavidhinā 
ḍākinyādiṣaṭkaṃ sampūjya dhūpadīpau dattvā 
vakṣyamāṇanaivedyaṣaṭkaṃ nivedya tāmbūlādi sarvaṃ ca nivedya nir-
ṛtikoṇe dhūmravarṇe madhye ḍākinīmāvāhya dhūmravarṇo 
nityāsamānamukhabhujādiyutāṃ dhyātvā 
ḍāṃḍīmityādiṣaḍaṅgamantrairjātiyutaḥ ṣaḍaṅganyāsayogena 
sakalīkṛtya tasyāḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidadhyāt | evamuttaratrāpi 
rākiṇyādīnāmādyakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍdīrghajātiyutaistāsāṃ sakalīkaraṇaṃ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kuryāt | tataḥ 
svābhimukhīmāsanādipuṣpāntairupacārairabhyarcya 
tadāvaraṇaśaktīśca nirṛtikoṇe hrīṃ-āṃ-aṃśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi 
| evaṃ vāyavyakoṇe 2 kaṃśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi | pūrvakoṇe 2 
khaṃśaktipādu0 | āgneyakoṇe 2 gaṃśaktipā0 | īśānakoṇe 2 
ghaṃśaktipā0 | paścimakoṇe 2 ṅaṃśaktapādu0 | iti sampūjya 
dhūpadīpau dattvā yāyasānnaṃ nivedya 
tāmbūlādipraṇāmāntairupacāraiḥ paritoṣya vāyavyaṣaṭkoṇe 
sindūravarṇe rākiṇīmāvāhya sindūravarṇāṃ 
nityānityāsamānamukhabhujādiyutāṃ dhyātvāsanādipuṣpopacārānte 
rākiṇyādivāmāgradakṣiṇāgrapṛṣṭhavāmadakṣiṇasaṃmukhastheṣu 
ṣaṭsukoṇeṣu hrīṃ-āṃ-aṃśaktipādu0 | evaṃ 2 caṃśaktipā0 | 2 
chaṃśaktipā0 | 2 jaṃśaktipā0 | jhaṃśaktipādukāṃ0 | 2 
ñaṃśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmīti sampūjya dhūpadīpau dattvā 
guḍaudanaṃ nivedya tāmbūlādi prāgvatkalpayet | tataḥ 
pūrvadiggataṣaṭkoṇe nīlavarṇe lākinīmāvāhya nīlavarṇāṃ 
prāgvanmukhabhujādiyutāṃ dhyātvāsanādipuṣpopacārānte proktarītyā 
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu hrīṃ-āṃ-aṃśaktipādu0 | 2 ṭaṃśaktipā0 | 2 ṭhaṃśaktipā0 
| 2 ḍaṃśaktipā0 | 2 ḍhaṃśaktipā0 | 2 ṇaṃśaktipā0 | iti sampūjya 
dhūpadīpau dattvā mudgaudanaṃ nivedya śeṣaṃ prāgvat kuryāt | 
āgneyadiggataṣaṭkoṇe udyadādityavarṇe tādṛśīṃ kākinīmāvāhya 
prāgvad dhyātvā'sanādipuṣpopacārānte prāgvat ṣaṭkoṇeṣu hrīṃ-
āṃ-aṃśaktipā0 | 2 taṃśaktipā0 | 2 thaṃśaktipā0 | 2 daṃśaktipā0 | 2 
dhaṃśaktipā0 | 2 naṃśaktipā0 | iti sampūjya nivedya śeṣaṃ prāgvat 
kuryāt | tata īśānadiggataṣaṭkoṇe hemavarṇe śākinīmāvāhya 
svarṇaṃvarṇāṃ dhyātvā'sanādipuṣpopacārānte 2 aṃśaktipā0 | 2 
paṃśaktipā0 | 2 phaṃśaktipā0 | 2 baṃśaktipā0 | 2bhaṃśaktipā0 | 
2maṃśaktipā0 | iti sampūjya tilamiśrānnaṃ nivedya śeṣaṃ prāgvat 
kuryāt atha paścimaṣaṭkoṇe śubhravarṇe hākinīmāvāhya 
prāgvadbhujādiyutāṃ śubhravarṇāṃ dhyātvā'sanādipuṣpopacārānte 
2 aṃśaktipā0 | 2 raṃśaktipā0 | 2 śaṃśaktipā0 | 2 ṣaṃśaktipā0 | 2 
saṃśaktipā0 | 2 haṃśaktipā0 | iti sampūjya dhūpadīpau dattvā 
śuddhānnaṃ nivedya tāmbūlādi prāgvat kalpayet | tato nityāṃ 
prāgvattadvidyayā sampūjya dhūpadīpau dattvā stutipraṇāmādibhiḥ 
paritoṣya ḍākinyādyāḥ sāvaraṇā asyāṃ saṃyojya tāṃ vā svahṛdi 
udvāsya tanmayaḥ sukhaṃ viharediti ||

atha pañcaśanmithunapūjā || tatra śrītantrarāje - (16 pā0 95 ślo0)

ādikṣāntākṣaraiḥ prāgvadrūpiṇīśaktisaṃyutaiḥ |
bījadvayādyaiḥ saptākṣaryyantaiḥ pañcadaśākṣaraiḥ || 1 ||

pañcāśacchaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ pañcāśatkṣetrapālakaiḥ |
teṣāṃ bījadvayaṃ varṇā rūpakṣetreśasaṃyutāḥ || 2 ||

saptākṣaryyā ca saṃyuktā mantrāḥ pañcadaśākṣarāḥ |
catuṣṣaṣṭipade madhyacatuṣke dinavidyayā || 3 ||

manīṣitaṃ samālikhya teṣu tanmithunāni vai |
ghaṭikākramayogena hṛnmāyāmadhyage'rcayet || 4 ||

dineṣu ghaṭikāyogāt pañcāśanmithunānyapi |
evaṃ maṇḍalamāsārdhātprāpnotyevābhivāñchitam || 5 ||

nityaśastāḥ samāvāhya tasmiṃścakre samarcanāt |
samastavāñchitaprāptiḥ sadā bhavati sarvataḥ || 6 ||

iti | ādikṣāntetyādi sarvata ityantasya ślokaṣaṭkasyāyamarthaḥ tatra 
prāgvacchubhasthāne samāntarālāni nava sūtrāṇi

p. 289)

prākpratyagdakṣiṇodakca vinyasya catuṣṣaṣṭipadopetaṃ caturasraracakraṃ 
kṛtvā tasmiṃścakre madhyakoṣṭhacatuṣkamekīkṛtya tatra 
taddinanityākṣarāṇi svābhimataprārthanamadhyamālikhya tadanantare 
bāhyādhaḥpaṃktisthamadhyadvaye dakṣiṇaṃ koṣṭhamārabhya 
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇāmuktakramaṃ nirgamagatyā 
cakravāmapaṃktyādhaḥ koṣṭhāvadhi ṣaṣṭikoṣṭheṣu 
taddinodayākṣarādīni mātṛkāyāḥ pañcāśadakṣarāṇi 
visargasvarasahitāni hrīmitibījamadhyagatāni vilikhyāvaśiṣṭheṣu 
punarapyudayādīni daśākṣarāṇi samālikhya teṣu 
likhitakrameṇodayākṣarādiṣu ṣaṣṭighaṭikāsu tatra ghaṭikāmithunaṃ 
ṣoḍaśabhirupacārairabhyarcya tatphalamavāpnuyāt | atra pūjāmantrastu 
hrīṃśrīṃ-aṃrūpiṇīśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi ityādiśaktividyāḥ 
pañcāśat hrīṃśrīṃ-aṃrūpakṣetreśapādukāṃ pūjayāmi ityādayaḥ 
kṣetreśāḥ pañcāśadityevaṃ pañcāśadakṣarādīni ṣaṣṭimithunāni 
yathākramamekaikaśaḥstha (?) vilambena pūjayet | pratighaṭikāpūjanasya 
tadekakāmyakarmaviṣayatvāt || iti pañcāśanmithunapūjā || atha 
kāmeśvaryādipañcadaśanityānāṃ pūjāvidhirlikhyate | tatra 
kāmeśvarīnityāyajanavidhiḥ śrītantrarāje - ( 7 pa0 1 ślo0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu dvitīyā yā samīritā |
kāmīśvarīti tāṃ sarvakāmadāṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ || 1 ||

tattvanyāsaṃ dhyānabhedāṃstacchaktīstatprapūjanam |

mantroddhārastu tatraiva - (3 | 6)

śuciḥ svena yutastvādyo lalitā syāddvitīyakaḥ |
śūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayo vyāptena saṃyutaḥ || 1 ||

prāṇo rasāgnisahitaḥ śūnyayugmaṃ carānvitam |
nabho gotrā punaścaiṣā dāhena samayojitā || 2 ||

ambu syāccarasaṃyuktaṃ vanaśaktiyutaṃ ca hṛt |
eṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikādaśākṣarī || 3 ||

iti | aiṃ sakalahrīṃ nityaklinne madadrave sauḥ 11 iti | tathā tripurārṇave -

(ṛṣiḥ saṃmohanaḥ proktastriṣṭup chanda udāhṛtam |
kāmeśvarīdevatā syādbrahmabījaṃ tu bījakam || 1 ||

śaktiḥ kāmakalā proktā dharābījaṃ tu kīlakam |)

tantrarāje - (7 | 3)

mūlavidyākṣarairevaṃ kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
ekena hṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ tāvatātho dvayaṃ dvayāt || 1 ||

caturbhirnayanaṃ tadvadastramekena coditam |
dikśrotranāsādvitaye jihvāhṛnnābhiguhyake || 2 ||

vyāpakatvena sarvāṅge mūrdhādiprapadāvadhi |
nyasedvidyākṣarāṇyeṣu sthāneṣu tadanantaram || 3 ||

samastena vyāpakaṃ tu kuryāduktakrameṇa vai |
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi nityapūjāsu coditam || 4 ||

yena devī suprasannā dadātīṣṭamayatnataḥ |
bālārkakoṭisaṅkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām || 5 ||

hāragraiveyakāñcīmirūrmikānūpurādibhiḥ |
maṇḍitāṃ raktavasanāṃ raktābharaṇaśobhitām || 6 ||

ṣaḍbhujāṃ trīkṣaṇāmindukalākalitamaulikām |
pañcāṣṭaṣoḍaśadvandvaṣaṭkoṇacaturasragām || 7 ||

mandasmitollasadvaktrāṃ (dayā ? lajjā) mantharavīkṣaṇām |
pāśāṃkuśau ca puṇḍrekṣacāpaṃ puṣpaśilīmukham || 8 ||

ratnapātraṃ sudhāpūrṇaṃ varadaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ |
evaṃ dhyātvārcayed devīṃ nityapūjāsu siddhaye || 9 ||

prayogādiṣu sarvatra vakṣye dhyānāni tatra vai |
madanonmādanau paścāttathā dīpanamohanau || 10 ||

śoṣaṇaśceti kathitā bāṇāḥ pañca puroditāḥ |
kusumā mekhalā paścānmadanā madanāturā || 11 ||

anaṅgapadapūrvāstāḥ pañcamī madaveginī |
tato bhuvanapālā syācchaśirekhā tvanantarā || 12 ||

rekhā gaganapūrvānyā pūjyā patreṣu cāṣṭasu |
śraddhā prīti ratiścaiva dhṛtiḥ kāntirmanoramā || 13 ||

manoharāṣṭamī proktā devī cātra manorathā |
madanonmādinī paścānmohinī śaṅkhinī tataḥ || 14 ||

śoṣiṇī ca vaśaṅkārī śiñjinī subhagāḥ tataḥ |
sasvarāḥ ṣoḍaśa proktāḥ priyadarśinikāntikāḥ || 15 ||

p. 290)

pūjyāstāḥ pratipatraṃ tu pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśacchade |
pūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathā || 16 ||

ṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca paratastvaṃśumālinī |
śaśinī cāṅgirā cchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalā || 17 ||

tuṣṭyamṛtākhyā kathitāḥ kalāḥ syuḥ sasvarā vidhoḥ |
soḍaśasvapi patreṣu pūjayettā yathākramam || 18 ||

bahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣu ḍākinyādyāstathārcayet |
tadbahiścaturasrasthalokeśāstatsamā yajet || 19 ||

vaṭukaṃ gaṇapaṃ dūrgāṃ kṣetreśaṃ cābhito yajet |
agnyādyasreṣu vidyādisaptākṣaryyantarāsthitaiḥ || 20 ||

tannāmabhirbaliṃ tebhyo dadyādgandhādi coditaiḥ |
tatastāmaṅgavidyābhyāṃ kḷptārghyaḥ pūjayecchivām || 21 ||

prāguktairupacārādyairhomaṃ kuryāttatastathā |
ghṛtāktairmadhurāktairvā prasūnairaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 22 ||

annādyābhyāṃ prajuhuyāttataḥ prāgvatsamāpayet |

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prātaḥkṛtyādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
kāmeśvarīvidyayāṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi saṃmohanāya 
ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe triṣṭupchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye kāmeśvarīdevatāyai 
namaḥ | guhyekaṃ bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ īśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau 
laṃkīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mama 
kartavyapūrṇābhiṣekākhyadvitīyadīkṣāphalasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā aiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | sakalahrīṃ śirase svāhā | nitya 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | klinne kavacāya huṃ | madadrave netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | 
sauḥ astrāyaphaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya dakṣanetre aiṃ namaḥ | 
vāme sakalahrīṃ namaḥ | dakṣaśrotre ni namaḥ | vāmetya namaḥ | 
dakṣanasi kli namaḥ | vāme nne namaḥ | jihvāyāṃ ma namaḥ | hṛdaye da 
namaḥ | nābhau dra namaḥ | guhye ve namaḥ | sauḥ iti sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ 
vinyasya dhyānaṃ vidhāya mānasapūjānte svarṇādipaṭṭe 
kuṃkumādinā pañcadalakamalaṃ kṛtvā tadbahiraṣṭadalaṃ tadbahiḥ 
ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tadbahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbahiścaturdvārayuktaṃ caturasramiti 
pūjācakraṃ nirmāya svapurataścandanādipīṭhe saṃsthāpya tatra 
kāmeśvarīvidyayā puṣpāñjaliṃ 
viniḥkṣipyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte pīṭhapūjāṃ kṛtvā tatra 
kāmeśvarīvidyayā mūrti parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte 
layāntaṃ sampūjya pañcadalakamalakesareṣu 
agnīśāsuravāyavyadevyagratastadādicaturdikṣu ca ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya 
devyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge pañcadalāṣṭadalayorantarāle 
prāgvaddinanityāpūjoktagurutrayaṃ sampūjya pañcadaleṣu 
devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena hrīṃśrīṃdrāṃmadanabāṇāya namaḥ 2 
drīṃ unmādana bāṇāya namaḥ | 2 klīṃdīpanabāṇāya namaḥ | 2 blūṃ 
mohanabāṇāya namaḥ | 2 saḥ śoṣaṇābāṇāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
tadbahiraṣṭadaleṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena 2 anaṅgakusumāpā0 | 2 
anaṅgamekhalāpā0 | 2 anaṅgamadanāpā0 | anaṅgamadanāturāpā0 | 2 
anaṅgamadaveginīpā0 | 2 anaṅgabhuvanapālāpā0 | 2 anaṅgaśaśirekhā 
pā0 | 2 anaṅgagaganarekhāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ | tataḥ 
ṣoḍaśadaleṣu 2 aṃ śraddhāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ | 2 
āṃprītipā0 | 2 iṃratipā0 | 2 īṃdhṛtipā0 | 2 uṃkāntipā0 | 2 
ūṃmanoramāpā0 | 2 ṛṃmanoharāpā0 | 2 ṝṃmanorathāpā0 | 2 
ḷṃmadanāpā0 | 2 ḹṃ-unmādinī pā0 | 2 eṃmohinīpā0 | 2 aiṃ 
(śānti?śaṃkhinī) pā0 | 2 oṃśoṣiṇīpā0 | 2 auṃvaśaṃkarīpā0 | 2 
aṃśiñjinīpā0 | 2 aḥsubhagāpā0 iti sampūjya tadbahiḥ 
ṣoḍaśadalāgreṣu - 2 aṃpūṣāpādukā0 | 2 āṃ-iddhāpā0 | 2 
iṃsumanasāpā0 | 2 iṃratipā0 | 2 uṃ prītipādukā0 | 2 ūṃdhṛtipā0 | 2 
ṛṃ-ṛddhipā0 | 2 ṝsaumyāpā0 | 2 ḷmarīcipā0 | 2 ḹṃ-aṃśumālinīpā0 
| 2 eṃśaśinīpā0 | 2 aiṃ-aṅgirāpā0 | 2 oṃchāyāpā0 | 2 
auṃsampūrṇamaṇḍalāpā0 | 2 aṃtuṣṭipā0 | 2 aḥ-amṛtāpā0 iti 
sampūjya tadbahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dakṣiṇāgrakoṇe 2 aiṃḍākinīpā0 | 
vāmāgre 2 aiṃrākiṇīpā0 | pṛṣṭhakoṇe 2 aiṃlākinīpā0 | pṛṣṭhavāme 
2 aiṃkākinī0 | pṛṣṭhadakṣiṇe 2 aiṃśākinī0 | devyagre 2 aiṃhākinīpā0 
iti sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇādbahiścaturasrābhyantare āgneyakoṇe 2 
aiṃvaṭukapā0 | nair-ṛte 2 gaṃgaṇapatipā0 | vāyavye aiṃdurgāpā0 | 
īśāne 2 aiṃkṣaṃkṣetreśapā0 iti sampūjya tadbahiḥ caturasre devyāḥ 
pṛṣṭhabhāgamārabhya pūrvādidaśadikṣu 2 aiṃlaṃ-indraśaktipā0 | 2 
aiṃraṃ-agniśaktipā0 ityādilokapālāṃstadāyudhāni ca 
śaktyantaistannāmabhiḥ sampūjya dhūpadīpanaivedyānte kurukullābaliṃ 
vaṭukagaṇapadūrgākṣetreśabaliṃ ca dattvā japādikaṃ śeṣaṃ

p. 291)

samāpayet | atra pañcadaśanityāsvapi pūjādau sarvabhūtabaliṃ pūjānte 
saptākṣaryā kurukullābaliṃ dadyāt iti kāmeśvarīnityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha bhagamālinīnityāyajanavidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (8 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu tṛtīyāṃ bhagamālinīm |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇām kramāt || 1 ||

tadaṅgānyatha taddhyānaṃ tadāvaraṇadevatāḥ |
tatpūjāyāḥ kramamiti mantroddhārastathaiva ca || 2 (-3 | 9)

kāmeśvaryādirādiḥ syādrasaścātha sthirā rasā |
dharāyuk sacarā paścāt sthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 3 ||

sthirāśūnye'gni saṃyukte rasaḥ syāttadanantaram |
sthirā bhūsahitā gotrā sadāho'gnī rasaḥ sthirā || 4 ||

nabhaśca marutā yuktaṃ rasā carasamanvitā |
tato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitā || 5 ||

ambu haṃsaśca sacaro raso'tha syāt sthirāyutaḥ |
sthirā dharānvito haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa tu || 6 ||

rasaḥ sthirā tato vyāptaṃ bhūyutaṃ śūnyamagniyuk |
rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniḥ śūnyaṃ javiyuto marut || 7 ||

rayaḥ śūnyaṃ cāgniyutaṃ hṛddāhaḥ sāmbvataḥ param |
rasaḥ sthirāmbu ca viyat svayutaṃ prāṇa eva ca || 8 ||

dāho'gniyugrasastasmāt sthirā kṣmā dāhasaṃyutā |
sacaraḥ syāñjavī pūrvavidyātārtīyataḥ kramāt || 9 ||

catuṣṭayamathārṇānāṃ rasastadanu ca sthirā |
hṛdambuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syāñjavī ca hṛt || 10 ||

dāho'mbumarutā yukto vyoma sāgnī rasastathā |
sthirā tu marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaścarau || 11 ||

haṃso vyāptamarudyuktaḥ śūnyaṃ vyāptamato'mbu ca |
dāho gotrā carayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥ || 12 ||

hṛddharāsahitaṃ dāharayau carasamanvitau |
rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavet || 13 ||

śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ tataḥ pūrvamataḥ param |
śūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syāddāhayuktāmbunā caraḥ || 14 ||

prāṇo rasācarayuto gotrā vyāptamataḥ param |
gotrā dāhamarudyuktā tvambu vyāptamato bhavet || 15 ||

vāto nabhaśca bhūyuktaṃ vāścareṇa samanvitam |
rasaḥ sthirāmbvagniyutaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ carānvitam || 16 ||

grāso dharāyutaḥ paścādrasaḥ śaktyā samanvitaḥ |
grāso bhūsahito devi raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛt || 17 ||

dāhenāmbu ca hṛtpaścādrayo'mbumarudanvitaḥ |
śūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ bhadre rasaśca sacarā sthirā || 18 ||

viyadambuyutaṃ dāhastvagniyuk svayutaḥ śuciḥ |
bhūmi rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthitāḥ || 19 ||

tadantaritabījāni svasaṃyuktāni pañca vai |
tāni kramājjyā sacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutā || 20 ||

haṃsaścarayuto dviḥ syāt tataḥ prāṇo rasāgniyuk |
śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho'mbumarudyutaḥ || 21 ||

vyomāgnisahitaṃ paścādrasaśca marutā sthirā |
śūnyaṃ sāgni namaḥ kuryāccareṇa sahitaṃ priye || 22 ||

ambu paścādviyat tasmānnabhaśca marudanvitam |
śūnya vyāptaṃ ca hṛdyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥ || 23 ||

haṃsaḥ sadāho'mburasācarasvaiḥ saṃyuto bhavet |
haṃsaḥ syād dāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritam || 24 ||

pañcatriṃśacchatārṇaiḥ syānnityā'sau bhagamālinī |

iti | aiṃ bhagabhuge bhaginī bhagodari bhagamāle bhagāvahe bhagaguhye 
bhagayoni bhaganipātini sarvabhagavaśaṅkari bhagarūpe nitmaklinne 
bhagasvarūpe sarvāṇi bhagāni me hyānaya varade rete surete bhagaklinne 
klinnadrave kledaya drāvaya amoghe bhagavicce kṣubha kṣobhaya 
sarvasattvān bhageśvari 
aiṃblūṃjaṃblūṃbheṃblūṃmoṃblūṃheṃblūṃheṃ klinne sarvāṇi 
bhagāni me vaśamānaya strīṃhrableṃhrīṃ iti || tripurārṇave :

ṛṣirasyātu subhago gāyatrīcchanda ucyate |
devateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priye || 1 ||

śakti śrībījamantyaṃ tu kīlakaṃ parameśvari ||

iti | iyaṃ bhagamālinīnityā | tantrarāje - (8 | 3)

aṅgāni mantravarṇaiḥ syādādyena hṛdudīritam |
tataścaturbhiḥ śīrṣaṃ syācchikhā tribhirudīritā || 1 ||

p. 292)

catuṣṭayatrayaiḥ śeṣāṇyaṅgāni ṣaḍiti kramāt |
aruṇāmaruṇākalpāṃ sundarīṃ susmitānanām || 2 ||

trinetrāṃ bāhubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirupetāṃ kamalāsanām |
kahlārapāśapuṇḍrekṣukodaṇḍān vāmabāhubhiḥ || 3 ||

dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ padmamaṃkuśaṃ paṣpasāyakam |
tathāvidhābhiḥ paritovṛtāṃ śaktibhirātmabhiḥ || 4 ||

akṣarotthābhiranyābhiḥ smaronmādamadātmabhiḥ |
pañcatriṃśacchatārṇaistai rūpiṇīśaktipañcakam || 5 ||

saptākṣarīṃ ca saṃyojya śaktīstatsaṃkhyakā yajet |
madanāṃ mohinīṃ lolāṃ bhañjanīmudyamāṃ śubhām || 6 ||

hlādinīṃ drāviṇīṃ prītiṃ ratiṃ raktāṃ manoramām |
sarvonmādāṃ sarvasukhāṃ sabhaṅgāmabhitodyamām || 7 ||

analpāṃ vyaktavibhavāṃ vividhakṣobhavigrahe |
etāḥ syuḥ śaktyaḥ pañcapañcāśadbhiḥ śataṃ tviti || 8 ||

tābhirvṛtāṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ pūjayedvāñchitāptaye |
atha pūjākramaṃ devi śṛṇu sarvārthadāyakam || 9 ||

yena viśvaṃ vaśe bhūyādapi sthāvarajaṅgamam |
caturasradvayaṃ kṛtyā kuryād dvāraṃ tu paścime || 10 ||

tanmadhye'bjaṃ pañcadalaṃ kṛtvā tatkarṇikāgatam |
yonidvayaṃ tato madhye tiryagrekhāvidhānataḥ || 11 ||

yoniḥ kuryācca tatsaṃkhyā yonayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
agrādvilomagāstāsu śaktīḥ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 12 ||

madhye vṛttadvayaṃ kṛtvā tatra viṃśatirekhayā ||
niṣpādya tāvatīryonīrmadanādyāḥ samarcayet || 13 ||

vṛttāntarāle tvabhito yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
tanmadhye bhagamālāṃ tāmāvāhyoktasvarūpiṇīm || 14 ||

saṃsthāpanādibhiryuktāmarcayedupacārakaiḥ |
arghyāmaṅgaiśca mūlena saṃsthāpyābhyukṣya mūlataḥ || 15 ||

dvārasya pārśvayo rāgadveṣaśaktī tathārcayet |
śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pūrvavat || 16 ||

tadantavṛttayormadhye ṣaḍaṅgāni tathārcayet |
tadantarbhagamālāyāṃ madanādyāstathārcayet || 17 ||

madhyasthadevīmabhito yajettānyāyudhānyapi |
tato devīṃ ṣoḍaśabhirupacārairudīritaiḥ || 18 ||

pūjayedādyavarṇena vidadyāttadbalidvayam |
japedaṣṭottaraśatamagre devyāstu nityaśaḥ || 19 ||

prāgvadagnimukhaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryād daśāṃśataḥ |
saṃyojya bindau tāṃ prāgvanmūlenābhyarcya tāṃ tathā || 20 ||

svātmanyudvāsayeduktaprakāreṇa maheśvari |
devyātmā vaśayedviśvaṃ naranārīnarādhipān || 21 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prāgvadāsanapūjanādiyogapīṭhanyāsāntaṃ 
kṛtvā mūlavidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi subhagāya ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrībhagamālinīnityāyai 
devatāyai namaḥ | guhye harableṃ bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ śrīṃ śaktaye 
namaḥ | nābhau hrīṃ kīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
jape viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ bhagasubhage 
śirase svāhā | oṃ bhaginī śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ bhagodari kavacāya huṃ | oṃ 
bhagamāle netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ bhagāvahe astrāya phaṭ iti mantraiḥ 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya prāgvanmūlavidyayā vyāpakaṃ vinyasya 
aruṇāmityādi yathoktarūpāṃ dhyātvā mānasapūjāṃ vidhāya 
svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādibhirantarbahirvibhāgena caturasradvayena 
caturaṃgulāntarālāṃ samacaturasrāṃ vīthīṃ kṛtvā tasyāḥ 
paścimabhāge madhye dvāraṃ vidhāya tasya caturasrasya madhye 
pañcadalaṃ padmaṃ virasya vṛttadvayayuktāyāṃ tatkarṇikāyāṃ 
samatrirekhāṃ karṇikāmadhyavṛttaspaṣṭakoṇāgrakāṃ yathāmānāṃ 
yoniṃ kṛtvā tasyā ekāṃ rekhāṃ caturviṃśatidhā vibhajya 
tairaṃśaistrayoviṃśaticihnāni kṛtvā tasyāstisṛṣu rekhāsvapi tathā 
kṛtvā teṣvekāṃśamānamabhitastyaktvā tadantaḥ prāgvatsamatrirekhāṃ 
yoniṃ vidhāya tasyāṃ yonyāmekāṃ rekhāmekaviṃśatidhā vibhajya 
teṣu viṃśaticihnāni pratirekhamiti rekhātraye'pi pratyekaṃ kṛtvā teṣu 
bāhyābhyantaracihneṣu cihnāccihnamiti krameṇa pañcacatvāriṃśad 
rekhāstiryagrūpāḥ pratipārśvaṃ vilikhediti | evaṃ kṛte 
bāhyarekhāgrāṇyābhyantararekhāgrāṇi ca trikoṇāni 
pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyāni sambhavanti | 
tadantastryasrarekhātrayaspṛṣṭarekhaṃ bhrameṇa vṛttaṃ niṣpādya 
tadantare'pi  tadvyāsapañcamāṃśamānabhrameṇa vṛttaṃ vidhāya 
tadantare'pyekāṃśamāne vṛttāntaraṃ kṛtvā 
pūrvavṭtayorviṣkambhasoḍaśāṃśasahitaṃ viṣkambhamānaṃ 
triguṇīkṛtya tatra samudāyamānaṃ daśadhā vibhajya teṣvekaikāṃśena 
cihnāni paritastadvṛttadvaye prativṛttaṃ daśadaśa vidhāya teṣu krameṇa 
bāhyābhyantaraṃ tasmādbāhyamiti gomūtrikākrameṇa tiryagrūpā 
viṃśatirekhā vilikhet | evaṃ

p. 193)

kṛte bāhyābhyantaravṛttaspaṣṭāgrāṇi ca trikoṇānyabhito 
viṃśatisaṃkhyakāni sambhavanti | itthaṃ pūjācakraṃ nirmāya prāgvat 
purataḥ saṃsthāpya bhagamālinīvidyayā mūrti 
saṃkalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte devyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge

prāgvadagnīśāsuravāyavyadevyagratastadādicaturdikṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni
