atha nityaklinnānityapūjāvidhiḥ || tatra śrītantrarāje - (9 pa0 |ślo0 1)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu caturthīṃ śṛṇu pārvati |
nityaklinnābhidhānāṃ tāṃ tanmantraṃ prāgudīritam || 1 ||

iti | taduddhārastu tatraiva - (3 | 32)

haṃsastu dāhavahnisvairyuktaḥ prathamamucyate |
kāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

hṛdambu marutā yuktaṃ haṃsaśca marutā yutaḥ |
ekādaśākṣarī nityaklinnā nityā samīritā || 2 ||

iti | tathā - tadaṅgāni ca taddhyānaṃ tacchaktīstābhirarcanam | iti | 
tripurārṇave -

ṛṣirbrahmā samuddiṣṭo virāṭ chanda itīritam |
nityaklinnā devatoktā vanitā drāviṇī parā || 1 ||

bījamādyaṃ vahnijāyā śaktirnnekīlakaṃ matam |

iti | tantrarāje - (9 | 3)

ādyena mantravarṇena hṛdayaṃ samudīritam |
tato dvābhyāṃ punardvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvayena ca || 1 ||

kuryāccheṣāṇi cāṅgāni karayośca nyaset kramāt |
tantre ṣaḍaṅgaṃ yatroktaṃ tatra tatra karadvaye || 2 ||

nyasedaṃguṣṭhamūlādikaniṣṭhāgrāntamūrddhvagam |
śeṣaṃ taladvaye nyasya hṛddṛkśrotranasordvayoḥ || 3 ||

tvaci dhvaje ca pāyau ca pādayorarṇakān nyaset |
aruṇāmaruṇākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm || 4 ||

aruṇasragvilepāṃ tāṃ cārusmeramukhāmbujān |
netratrayollasadvaktrāṃ bhāle dharmāmbumoktikaiḥ || 5 ||

virājamānāṃ mukuṭalasadardhenduśekharām |
caturbhirbāhubhiḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ pānapātrakam || 6 ||

abhayaṃ bibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasām |
dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayennityaklinnānityāṃ svaśaktibhiḥ || 7 ||

kṣobhiṇī mohinī lolā trikoṇādiṣu śaktayaḥ |
nityā nirañjanā klinnā kledinī madanāturā || 8 ||

madadravā drāviṇī ca draviṇā cāṣṭapatragā |
madābilā maṅgalā ca manmathārtā manasvinī || 9 ||

mohāmodā mānamayī māyā mandā manovatī |
caturasragatāḥ pūjyā madāruṇacalekṣaṇāḥ || 10 ||

madhyanityāsamākāravarṇabāhvāyudhānvitāḥ |
caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā prākpratyakdvārasaṃyutam || 11 ||

tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye tryasrakaṃ tathā |
arghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamūlābhyāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ prāṅmukho'rcayet || 12 ||

caturasre paścimādinir-ṛtyantaṃ bhajecca tām |
dvārapārśveṣu koṇeṣu dikṣu tā daśa pūjayet || 13 ||

tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu paścimādipradakṣiṇam |
arcayedaṣṭaśaktīstāstadantaryonikoṇagāḥ || 14 ||

agryātpradakṣiṇaṃ tisraḥ śaktīścoktavidhānataḥ |
karṇikāyonimadhyasthadeśe vāyvīśavahniṣu || 15 ||

p. 294)

nir-ṛtyāṃ purato dikṣu yajedaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
tato devīṃ tu tāṃ nityāṃ nityaklinnāmudīritaiḥ || 16 ||

upacārairarcayecca baliṃ dadyācca pūrvavat |
tadagrato japedvidyāṃ sahasraṃ yadi vā śatam || 17 ||

tato'bhyarcya śivāṃ homaṃ kuryāduktakrameṇa tu |
ājyasiktāndhasājyena puṣpairvā saurabhānvitaiḥ || 18 ||

juhuyāt prāgvaduditasaṃkhyaṃ prāgvat samāpayet |
abhyarcya devīmatha tāṃ svātmanyudvāsya pūrvavat || 19 ||

nyāsaṃ kṛtvā stotrayugaṃ japitvā tanmayaṃścaret |

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prāgvadāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
nityaklinnāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe virāja chandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrīnityāklinnānityāyai 
devatāyai namaḥ | guhye rhrīṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ svāhāśaktaye 
namaḥ | nābhau nnekīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye 
viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | nitya śirase svāhā 
| klinne śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | mada kavacāya huṃ | drave netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | 
svāhā astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā hṛdaye hrīṃnamaḥ | 
dakṣanetre niṃnamaḥ | vāme tyaṃnamaḥ | dakṣaśrotre kliṃnamaḥ | vāme 
nneṃnamaḥ | dakṣiṇanāsāyāṃ maṃnamaḥ | vāme daṃnamaḥ | tvaci 
draṃnamaḥ | liṅge veṃnamaḥ | gude svāṃnamaḥ | pādayoḥ hāṃnamaḥ 
iti vinyasya prāgvanmūlavidyayā vyāpaka kṛtvā 
dhyānādimānasapūjānte svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
pūrvapaścimayordvāradvayayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā 
tanmadhye'ṣṭadalapadmaṃ nirmāya tatkarṇikāyāṃ svābhimukhāgraṃ 
trikoṇaṃ kṛtvā prāgvat svapurataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya tatra nityaklinnāvidyayā tanmūrtiṃ 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte koṇāntaḥ prāgvad devīṃ paritaḥ 
ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya tadbahirdevyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge prāgvat 
prakāśānandādigurupaṃktitrayamabhyarcya caturasre 
devyagratastaddvārasya dakṣiṇe oṃ hrīṃśrīṃmadābilāpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmi namaḥ | uttare oṃ hrīṃśrīṃmaṅgalāpā0 | evaṃ 2 
manmathārtāpā0 | 2 manasvinīpā0 | 2 mohāpā0 | 2 āmodāpā0 | 2 
mānamayīpā0 | 2 māyāpā0 | 2 mandāpā0 | 2 manovatī0 iti 
prādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāntastrikoṇeṣu devyagrakoṇamārabhya 2 
kṣobhiṇīpā0 2 mohinīpā0 2 lolāpā0 iti prādakṣiṇyena sampūjya 
punarmadhye nityaklinnāṃ tadvidyayā sampūjya dhūpadīpādikaṃ 
sarvaṃ kṛtvā prāgvat samāpayet iti nityaklinnānityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha bheruṇḍānityāpūjāvidhilikhyate | tatra śrītantrarāje - (10 pa0 | ślo0 
1)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu bheruṇḍā pañcamī tu yā |
tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe kathayāmi yathāvidhi || 1 ||

mantroddhārastṛtīye'bhūdaṅgānyāvṛtidevatāḥ |
pūjākramaṃ ceti |

mantroddhārastu tṛtīyapaṭale - (3 | 35)

bhūḥ svena yuktā prathamaṃ prāṇo dāhena tadyutam |
raso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prāṇo dāhavanasvayuka || 1 ||

kaṃ ca dāhena tadyuktaṃ prabhā dāhena tadyutā |
jyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityaklinnāntato dvayam || 2 ||

eṣā navākṣarī nityā bheruṇḍā sarvasiddhidā |

iti | oṃkroṃbhroṃkroṃjhroṃchroṃjroṃ svāhā | tripurārṇave  -

ṛṣirasyā mahāviṣṇurgāyatrī chanda ucyate |
devateyaṃ varārohe tṛtīyaṃ bījamucyate || 1 ||

vahnijāyā tu śaktiḥ syāt kīlakaṃ sṛṇireva ca |

iti | tantrarāje - (10 | 4)

ādyantadvayamadhyasthaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgakam |
randhrājñāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyādhārapaddvaye || 1 ||

nyasenmantrārṇanavakaṃ mātṛkānyāsapūrvakam |
tataḥ śaktīsavṛtisthā dhyānaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati || 2 ||

bāhyāvṛtau tu brāhmyādyā yugaśaktīśca pūjayet |
tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu vijayāṃ vimalāṃ śubhām || 3 ||

viśvāṃ vibhūtiṃ vinatāṃ vividhāṃ vimalāṃ kramāt |
tadantaraṣṭakoṇeṣu kamalāṃ kāminīṃ tathā || 4 ||

p. 295)

kirātīṃ kīrtisahitāṃ kurdinīṃ kulasundarīm |
kalyāṇīṃ kākakolāṃ ca pūjayeduktayogataḥ || 5 ||

ḍākinīṃ rākiṇīṃ tadvallākinīṃ kākinīṃ tathā |
śākinīṃ hākinīṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu kramato'rccayet || 6 ||

icchājñānakriyāśaktīstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet |
aṣṭakoṇāntarāleṣu pūjayedāyudhāṣṭakam || 7 ||

caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitam |
tadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vṛttayugmamathāntarā || 8 ||

aṣṭāsraṃ bhūpuradvandvāttacca vṛttasamanvitam |
tadantastādṛśaṃ kuryāt ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vā tu vigraham || 9 ||

tadantastādṛśīṃ kuryādyoniṃ tanmadhyato yajet |
bheruṇḍāṃ pañcamīṃ nityāmuktaśaktibhirāvṛttām || 10 ||

arghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamūlābhyāṃ saṃsādhya prāṅmukho yajet |
baliṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇena dadyādādyantayoḥ kramāt || 11 ||

atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi devyāḥ sarvārthasādhakam |
tadāvṛttisthaśaktīnāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvati || 12 ||

taptakāñcanasaṅkāśadehāṃ netratrayānvitām |
cārusmitāñcitamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 13 ||

tāṭaṅkahārakeyūraratnastavakamaṇḍitām |
rasānānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīm || 14 ||

pāśāṃkuśau kheṭakhaḍgau sadāvajradhanuḥśarān |
karairdadhānāmāsīnāṃ pūjāyāmanyadāsthitām || 15 ||

śaktīśca tatsamākāratejohetibhiranvitāḥ |
pūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitasaumyamukhāṃ sadā || 16 ||

evaṃ devīmāvṛtibhirāvṛtāmarcayet tathā |
balirmādyantayordadyāt pūrvoktavidhinā yutam || 17 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
bheruṇḍāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi oṃ mahāviṣṇave 
ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye 
śrībheruṇḍānityādevatāyai namaḥ | guhye bhrāṃbījāya namaḥ | 
pādayoḥ svāhāśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau kroṃkīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya 
mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā kroṃ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ | bhroṃ śirase svāhā | kroṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | jhroṃ kavacāya 
huṃ | chroṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ |
jroṃ astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā brahmarandhre oṃ namaḥ | 
ājñāyāṃ kroṃ namaḥ | mukhe bhroṃ namaḥ | kaṇṭhe kroṃ namaḥ | 
hṛdi jhroṃ namaḥ | nābhau chroṃ namaḥ | mūlādhāre jroṃ namaḥ | 
dakṣapāde svāṃ namaḥ | vāmapāde hāṃ namaḥ | iti vinyasya 
prāgvadvyāpakaṃ kṛtvā taptakāñcanasaṅkāsadehāmityādi dhyātvā 
mānasapūjānte prāgvat svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
caturdvārayuktaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā tadantaraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ 
tadantarvṛttaṃ tadantaraṣṭāsraṃ punastadantarvṛttaṃ tadantaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ 
tadantarvṛttaṃ tanmadhye svābhimukhāgratrikoṇarūpāṃ yoniṃ ca kṛtvā 
prāgvat saṃsthāpyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte prāgvad 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcyāvāhanādiprāṇapratiṣṭhānte yonimudrāṃ 
pradarśyāsanādipuṣpopacārānte yonyantardevyabhitaḥ prāgvat 
ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya yonihṛttayorantarāle devyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge 
prāgvadgurupaṃktitrayamabhyarcya caturasradvayapārśvayoḥ 2 
brāhmīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ | 2 māheśvarīpā0 
paścimadvārapārśvayoḥ 2 kaumārīpā0 2 vaiṣṇavīpā0 
pūrvadvārasyottaradakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ 2 vārāhīpā0 2 indrāṇīpā0 
dakṣiṇadvārapārśvayoḥ 2 cāmuṇḍāpā0 2 mahālakṣmīpā0 iti 
sampūjya caturasravāyukoṇe 2 kṛtayugaśaktipā0 īśāne 2 
tretāyugaśaktipā0 āgneye 2 dvāparayugaśaktipā0 nir-ṛtikoṇe 2 
kaliyugaśaktipā0 iti saṃpūjya tadantaraṣṭadaleṣu devyagradalamārabhya 
prādakṣiṇyena 2 vijayāpā0 2 vimalāpā0 2 śubhāpā0 2 viśvāpā0 2 
vibhūtipā0 2 vinatāpā0 2 vividhāpā0 2 vimanāpā0  iti sampūjya 
tadaṃtaraṣṭakoṇeṣudevyagramārabhya prādakṣiṇyena 2 kamalāpā0 2 
kāminīpā0 2 kirātīpā0 2 kīrtipā0 2 kurdinīpā0 2 kulasundarīpā0 2 
kalyāṇīpā0 2 kālakolāpā0 iti sampūjya tadantaḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣu deyvā 
vāmāgrakoṇe 2 ḍākinīpā0 dakṣiṇāgrakoṇe 2 rākiṇīpā0 pṛṣṭhakoṇe 
2 lākinīpā0 pṛṣṭhavāmāgrakoṇe 2 kākinīpā0 dakṣiṇapṛṣṭhakoṇe 2 
śākinīpā0 devyagrakoṇe 2 hākinīpā0 iti sampūjya tatasrikoṇe 
devyagrakoṇamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena 2 icchāśaktipā0 2 
jñānaśaktipā0 2 kriyāśaktipā0 iti 
sampūjyāṣṭakoṇaṣaṭkoṇayorantarāle devyā dakṣiṇāgrāditaḥ 
pṛṣṭhadakṣiṇāgrāntaṃ sthānacatuṣṭayaṃ parikalpya 2 śarebhyo namaḥ 
2 khaḍgāya namaḥ 2 aṃkuśāya namaḥ 2 pāśāya namaḥ iti 
dakṣiṇādhaḥkarāditadūrdhvakarāntasthānyāyudhāni sampūjya devyāḥ 
pṛṣṭhavāmabhāgamārabhya vāmāgrāvadhi sthānacatuṣṭayaṃ 
parikalpya teṣu 2 gadāyai namaḥ 2 carmaṇe namaḥ

p. 296)

2 dhanuṣai namaḥ  2 vajrāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
prāgvallokapālāṃstadāyudhāni ca sampūjya punarmadhyasthanityāṃ 
tadvidyayā sampūjya dhūpādisarvaṃ prāgvatsamāpayet iti 
heruṇḍānityāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha vahnivāsinīnityāpūjāvidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (11 pa0 | 1 ślo0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu yā ṣaṣṭhī samudīritā |
sā vidyā vahnivāsinyāḥ kathitābhūnnavākṣarī || 1 ||

tadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanam |

iti | tathā tatraiva - (3 pa0 28 ślo0)

bheruṇḍādyamihādyaṃ syānnityaklinnādyanantaram |
tato'mbu śūnyaṃ haṃsāgniyutambu marudyutam || 1 ||

hṛdagninā yutaṃ śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā ca yuk |
śūnyaṃ namaḥ śaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudīritā || 2 ||

nityā sarvārthadā vahnivāsinī viśvaghasmarā |

iti | oṃ hrīṃvahnivāsinyai namaḥ || tripurārṇave -

ṛṣirvasiṣṭhaśchandaḥ syādagāyatrī devatā tviyam |
ādyantaṃ bījaśaktī syāt kīlakaṃ madhyamena ca || 1 ||

iti | tantrarāje - (11 | 3)

vidyādvitīyabījena svarān dīrghānniyojayet |
māyāntān ṣaḍbhirevāṅgānyācaret svakarāṅgayoḥ || 1 ||

navākṣarāṇi vidyāyā navarandhreṣu vinyaset |
vyāpakaṃ tu samastena kuryād devyātmasiddhaye || 2 ||

sarvāsvapi ca vidyāsu vyāpakaṃ nyāsamācaret |
tena tattanmayo būyāt sādhakastena siddhayaḥ || 3 ||

tasyācireṇa devīnāṃ prasādāt sambhavanti ca |
mātṛkāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca mātṛkānyāsameva ca || 4 ||

sarvāsāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā paścāt tatroditaṃ nyaset |
lalitāyāstu vargaistat proktamaṣṭābhireva ca || 5 ||

tena tasyāstu lipiśo nyāso naiva samīritaḥ |
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśāṃ navayauvanasundarīm || 6 ||

cārusmeramukhāmbhojāṃ vilasannayanatrayām |
aṣṭābhirbāhubhiryuktāṃ māṇikyābharaṇojjvalām || 7 ||

padmarāgakirīṭāṃśusaṃbhedāruṇitāmbarām |
pītakauśeyavasanāṃ raktamañjīramekhalām || 8 ||

ratnamauktikasaṃbhinnastabakābharaṇojjvalām |
raktābjakambupuṇḍrekṣucāpapūrṇendumaṇḍalām || 9 ||

dadhānāṃ bāhubhirvāmaiḥ kahlāraṃ hemaśṛṅgakam |
puṣpeṣu mātuliṅgaṃ ca dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ || 10 ||

svasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām |
evaṃ dhyātvārcayedvahnivāsinīṃ viśvavigrahām || 11 ||

javālinīvisphuliṅginyau maṅgalā sumanoharā |
kanakā kitavā viśvā vividhā ceti śaktayaḥ || 12 ||

aṣṭakoṇeṣu sampūjyāstadagrāttu pradakṣiṇam |
daleṣu dvādaśasvetā rāśiśaktīḥ samarcayet || 13 ||

māyāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnāmābhirīritaiḥ |
ghasmarā sarvabhakṣā ca viśvā ca vividhodbhavā || 14 ||

citrarūpā niḥsapannā nirātaṅkā ca pāvanī |
acintyavaibhavā raktā daśamī parikīrtitā || 15 ||

balidevīti samproktā kurukullādyavidyayā |
yatra noktā devatā tu balikarmaṇi tatra tām || 16 ||

saptākṣaryā samopetāṃ vidadhyādbalidevatām |
vṛttayornavayoniṃ tu kṛtvā tadbahirambujam || 17 ||

dvādaśacchadasaṃyuktaṃ vidadhyād vṛttayugmakam |
tadbahiścaturasre dve dvāradvayasamanvite || 18 ||

pūrvapaścimayostasmiṃścakre devīṃ tathārcayet |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
vahnivāsinīvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi vasiṣṭha-ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi vahnivāsinīnityādevatāyai 
namaḥ | guhye (oṃ) hrīṃ bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ namaḥśaktaye namaḥ | 
nābhau vahnivāsinyai kīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mama 
sarvābhīṣṭasiddhye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
ṣaḍdīrghayuktadvitīyabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā dakṣanetre oṃ namaḥ 
| vāme hrīṃ namaḥ | dakṣakarṇe vaṃ namaḥ |

p. 297)

vāme hriṃ namaḥ | dakṣanasi vāṃ namaḥ | vāme siṃ namaḥ | mukhe 
nyaiṃ namaḥ | liṅge naṃ namaḥ | gude maṃḥ namaḥ iti vinyasya mūlena 
vyāpakaṃ vidhāya taptakāñcanasaṅkāśāmityādi dhyātvā 
mānasapūjānte svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā dvādaśadalakamalaṃ 
vilikhya tatkarṇikāyāṃ vṛttadvayaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye 
prāgvannavayonicakraṃ kṛtvā padmādbahirvṛttadvayaṃ vidhāya tadbahiḥ 
pūrvapaścimayodvārayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kuryāditi pūjācakraṃ 
nirmāya prāgvat saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyasthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
prāgvad bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya tatra vahnivāsinīvidyayā mūrti 
parikalpyāvāhanādipūjopacārānte bāhyābhyantaravṛttayorantarāle 
prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya aṣṭakoṇeṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena 2 
jvālinīpādukā pūjayāmi namaḥ |  2 visphuliṅginīpā0 | 2 maṅgalāpā0 | 
2 manoharāpā0 | 2 kanakāpā0 | 2 kitavāpā0 | 2 viśvāpā0 | 2 vividhāpā0  
iti sampūjya dvādaśadaleṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena 2 meṣāpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmi namaḥ | 2 vṛṣāpā0 | 2 mithunāpā0 | 2 karkaṭāpā0 | 2 
siṃhāpā0 | 2 kanyāpā0 | 2 tulāpā0 | 2 kīṭāpā0 | 2 cāpāpā0 | 2 
makarāpā0 | 2 kumbhāpā0 | mīnāpā0 iti sampūjya caturasre 
devyagradvārasya dakṣiṇabhāgamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena 2 dyasmarāpā0 
| 2 sarvabhakṣāpā0 | 2 viśvāpā0 | 2 vividhodbhavāpā0 | 2 citrarūpāpā0 
iti paścimadvārapārśvadvayavāyavyottareśāneṣu sampūjya 
pūrvadvārasyottaradakṣiṇapārśvadvayāgneyadakṣiṇanir-ṛtikoṇeṣu ca 2 
niḥsapatnāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ | 2 nirātaṅkāpā0 | 2 pāvanīpā0 
| 2 acintyavaibhavāpā0 | 2 raktāpā0 iti sampūjya tadbahiḥ 
prāgvallokapālāṃśca tadā yudhāni ca sampūjya dhūpadīpādisarvaṃ 
prāgvatsamāpayet - iti vahnivāsinīnityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha vajreśvarīnityāyajanavidhiḥ || tatra śrītantrarāje - (12 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu saptamī yā samīritā |
tasyā vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasādhakam || 1 ||

proktaiva vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣaravigrahā |
tadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanam || 2 ||

iti | tathā - (3 | 41)

dvitīyaṃ vahnivāsinyā nityaklinnācaturthakam |
pañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakam || 1 ||

nityaklinnādvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhasaptamau |
aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ ca syādetadādyamitīritam || 2 ||

mahāvajreśvarīnityā dvādaśārṇā samīritā |

iti | hrīṃklinne aiṃkroṃnityamadadrave hrīṃ | tripurārṇave ṛṣirbrahmā ca 
gīyate | gāyatrī chanda ākhyātaṃ devatā parameśvarī | parameśvarī 
vajreśvarī | ādyante bījaśaktī tu vāgbhavaṃ kīlakaṃ bhavet || iti 
tantrarāje - (12 | 4)

dvayamekaikamapyatra dvayaṃ dvayamatha dvayam |
māyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt || 1 ||

(pratyekaṃ śaktipuṭitairmantrāṇairdaśabhirnyaset |)
dṛkśrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramāt || 2 ||

raktāṃ raktāmbarāṃ raktagandhamālāvibhūṣaṇām |
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām || 3 ||

pāśāṃkuśāvikṣucāpaṃ dāḍimīsāyakaṃ tathā |
dadhānāṃ bāhurbhirnetrairdayāmadasuśītalaiḥ || 4 ||

paśyantīṃ sādhakaṃ tryasraṣaṭkoṇābjamahīpure |
cakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhām || 5 ||

śaktibhiḥ svasvarūpābhirāvṛtāṃ potamadhyagām |
siṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥ || 6 ||

vṛtāṃ tābhirvinodāni yātāyātādibhiḥ sadā |
kurvāṇamaruṇāmabhodhau cintayenmantranāyikām || 7 ||

icchājñānakriyāstatra trikoṇāsthāśca śaktayaḥ |
ḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasrasthā padmadvādaśapatragāḥ || 8 ||

hṛllekhā kledinī klinnā kṣobhiṇī madanāturā |
nirañjanā rāgavatī tathaiva madanāvatī || 9 ||

mekhalā drāviṇī vegavatī dvādaśaśaktayaḥ |
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrasthāḥ śaktīrākarṇayāmbike || 10 ||

p. 298)

kamalāṃ kāminīṃ kalpāṃ kalāṃ kalitakautuke |
kirātāṃ kālakadane kauśikīṃ kambuvāhinīm || 11 ||

kātarāṃ kapaṭāṃ kīrtiṃ kumārīṃ kuṃkumāmapi |
caturasrasthāśca śaktīrākarṇaya ca tāḥ kramāt || 12 ||

bhañjinīveginī bhogā capalā peśalā satī |
ratiḥ śraddhā bhogalolā madonmatte manasvinī || 13 ||

dikṣu dvāreṣu pārśveṣu koṇādiṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ |
dvādaśaitāmahādevyāścaturasrābhito yajet || 14 ||

kṛtvārghyamaṅgamūlābhyāṃ proktarūpāṃ tato'rcayet |
śoṇābdhiṃ hemapotaṃ ca siṃhāsanamataḥ param || 15 ||

tatra cakraṃ tato devīṃ prāgvadāvāhya śaktibhiḥ |
māyāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnāmabhirarcayet || 16 ||

baliṃ dadyācca tadanu saptākṣaryā puroktayā |
devyāstu kurukullāyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 17 ||

ghṛtāktairaruṇai puṣpairghṛtairvā homamācaret |
prāgvat samāpayeditthamarcanaṃ te samīritam || 18 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ tatra prāgvadāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ | 
mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi vajreśvarīnityādevatāyai namaḥ | 
guhye hrīṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ hrīṃśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau 
aiṃkīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrīṃklinne hṛdayāya namaḥ | aiṃ śirase svāhā | kroṃ 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | nitya kavacāya huṃ | mada netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | 
dravehrīṃ astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya dakṣanetre 
hrīṃklīṃhrīṃ namaḥ | vāmanetre hrīṃnneṃhrīṃ namaḥ | dakṣakarṇe 
hrīṃ-aiṃhrīm namaḥ | vāmakarṇe hrīṃkroṃhrīṃ namaḥ | dakṣanasi 
hrīṃtrīṃhrīṃ namaḥ | vāmanasi hrīṃtyaṃhrīṃ namaḥ | mukhe 
hrīṃmaṃhrīṃ namaḥ | vakṣasi hrīṃdaṃhrīṃ namaḥ | nābhau 
hrīṃdraṃhrīṃ namaḥ | liṅge hrīṃveṃhrīṃ namaḥ iti vinyasya mūlena 
vyāpakaṃ vidhāya  taktāṃ raktāmbarāmityādi dhyātvā 
mānasapūjāṃ vidhāya prāgvatsvarṇādipīṭhe kuṃkumādinā 
svābhimukhāgratrikoṇarūpāṃ yoniṃ vidhāya 
tadbahirdvādaśadalapadmaṃ tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadalapadmaṃ 
tadbahiścaturdvārayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kuryāt iti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya 
prāgvatsvapurataḥ saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārdhyasthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhārcane maṇḍūkādipṛthivyantamabhyarcya tadanu 
śoṇasamudrāya namaḥ | kanakapotāya namaḥ | ratnasiṃhāsanāya namaḥ 
iti sampūjya tadanu dharmādipīṭhamanvantaṃ prāgvatsampūjya tatra 
mūlavidyayā mūrti parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpāntairupacārairupacaryya 
trikoṇamadhye prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya trikoṇayorantarāle devyāḥ 
pṛṣṭhe prāgvadgurupaṃktitrayamabhyarcyāntastrikoṇe 
devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena hrīṃhṛllekhāpādukāṃ pūjayāmi | 
hrīṃkledinīpā0 | hrīṃklinnāpā0 | hrīṃkṣobhiṇīpā0 | 
hrauṃmadanāpā0 | hrīṃmadanāturāpā0 | hrīṃnirañjanāpā0 | 
hrīṃrāgavatīpā0 | hrīṃmadanāvatīpā0 | hrīṃmekhalāpā0 
hrīṃdrāviṇīpā0 | hrīṃvegavatīpā0 | iti sampūjya tadbahi | 
ṣoḍaśadaleṣu kamalāpā0 kāminīpā0 kalpāpā0 kalāpā0 kalitāpā0 
kautukāpā0 kirātāpā0 kālāpā0 kadanāpā0 kauśikīpā0 
kambuvāhinīpā0 kātarāpā0 kapaṭāpā0 kīrtipā0 kumārīpā0 
kuṃkumāpā0 iti prāgvatsampūjya caturasre devyagrādidvāracatuṣṭayasya 
pārśveṣu paścimadvārasya dakṣiṇabhāgādiprādakṣiṇyena 
bhañjinīpā0 veginīpā0 bhogāpā0 capalāpā0 peśalāpā0 satīpā0 
ratipā0 śraddhāpā0 prītipā0 iti sampūjya vāyavyādikoṇacatuṣṭaye 
prāgvat prādakṣiṇyena bhogalolāpā0 madanāpā0 unmattāpā0 
manasvinīpā0 iti nir-ṛtyantaṃ sampūjya prāgvallokapālārcādi śeṣaṃ 
samāpayet iti vajreśvarīnityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha śivādūtīnityāyajanavidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (13 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu yā proktā tvaṣṭamī tadā |
tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe samīhitaphalapradam || 1 ||

vidyoddhāraḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvamatha nyāsakramaṃ tathā |
tathāvaraṇaśaktīśca taddhyānaṃ tatprapūjanam || 2 ||

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 44)

vajreśvaryantyamādyaṃ syādviyadagniyutaṃ tataḥ |
ambu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥ || 1 ||

rayo vyāptena śucinā yutaṃ syāttadanantaram |
antyarṇau vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritā || 2 ||

p. 299)

iti | hrīṃśivādūtyai namaḥ || tripurārṇave : ṛṣī rudro'tha gāyatrī 
chandaḥ staddevatā śivāḥ | śivādūtī iti | ādyante bījaśaktī ca madhyaṃ 
kīlakamucyate || iti | śrītantrarāje - (13 | 5)

kṛtvā prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni vidyādyenoktavartmanā |
tenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasu || 1 ||

ṣaṣṭhaṃ manasi vinyasya vyāpakaṃ vidyayā nyaset |
prāgvadarghya samuddiṣṭaṃ tacchaktīḥ śṛṇu pārvati || 2 ||

vihvalākarṣiṇī lolā nityā ca vana(madana)mālinī |
vinodā kautukā puṇyā purāṇā caturasragāḥ || 3 ||

vāgīśī varadā viśvā vinadā vighnakāriṇī |
vīrā vighnaharā vidyetyuktvā yantrāṣṭaśaktayaḥ || 4 ||

sumukhī sundarī sārā sumanā ca sarasvatī |
samayā sarvagā vidyetyuktāstvaṣṭāsraśaktayaḥ || 5 ||

ḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasreṣu sarvāstyagrāt pradakṣiṇam |
mūladevīsamākāravarṇākāra (yudha) samanvitāḥ || 6 ||

śivāṃ vāṇīṃ dūrasiddhāṃ tyaivigrahavatīmapi |
nādāṃ manonmanīṃ ṣaṭsu patreṣu parito'rcayet || 7 ||

icchājñānakriyāśaktīstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet |
madhye devīṃ hetivṛtāṃ pūjayedaṣṭamīṃ śivām || 8 ||

tasyā dhyānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe yanmayaṃ viśvamīritam |
tathāpi bhaktasarvāṇahetoḥ kḷptāṃ parāṃ tanum || 9 ||

nidāpakālamadhyāhnadivākarasamaprabhām |
navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarām || 10 ||

nānābharaṇasambhinnadehakāntivirājitām |
śucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 11 ||

pāśaṃ kheṭaṃ gadā ratnacaṣakaṃ vāmabāhubhiḥ |
dakṣiṇairaṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ kuṭhāraṃ kamalaṃ tathā || 12 ||

dadhānāṃ sādhakābhīṣṭadānodyamasamanvitām |
dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayed devīṃ dūtīṃ durnītināśinīm || 13 ||

vṛttadvayaṃ bahistrayasraṃ taddvayaṃ ṣaḍdalāmbujam |
(tathā ṣaḍasramaṣṭāsraṃ tadvaṣṭadalāmbujam) || 14 ||

bhūpure vahnivāsinyāḥ kṛtvā tanmadhyagāṃ śivām |
āvāhyābhyarcya tacchaktīḥ prāguktavidhinā sthitāḥ || 15 ||

japtvā hutvā namaskṛtya svātmanyudvāsayet tathā |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi rudrāya ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrīśivādūtīnityāyai namaḥ | guhye 
hrīṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ namaḥśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau śivādūtyai 
kīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrāṃhrīmityādinā karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya 
śrotrayoḥ hrīṃśiṃhrīṃ namaḥ | sarvāṅge hrīṃ vāṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | 
cakṣuṣoḥ hrīṃdūṃhrīṃ namaḥ | jihvāyāṃ hrīṃtyaiṃhrīṃ namaḥ | 
ghrāṇayoḥ hrīṃnaṃhrīṃ namaḥ | manasi hrīṃmaṃḥhrīṃ namaḥ 
ityādisamastavidyayā vyāpakaṃ vidhāya nidāghakāla ityādi dhyātvā 
mānasapūjāṃ vidhāya prāgvat svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
ṣaḍdalapadmaṃ vidhāya tadantarvṛttaṃ (vṛttadvayaṃ) madhye 
svābhimukhāgraṃ trikoṇaṃ (tadantarvṛttadvayaṃ) padmādbahiḥ 
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbahiraṣṭakoṇaṃ tadbahiraṣṭadalapadmaṃ tadbahiḥ 
pūrvapaścimayordvārayutaṃ caturasraṃ kuryāditi pūjācakraṃ nirmāya 
prāgvat purataḥ saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyasthāpanādyātma pūjānte 
mūlena mūrti parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte trikoṇe 
prāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya trikoṇavṛttayorantarāle prāgvad 
gurupaṃktitrayaṃ sampūjya caturasre devyagradvārasya 
dakṣiṇabhāgamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena oṃ vihvalāpādu0 ākarṣiṇīpā0 
lolāpā0 nityāpā0 madanāpā0 mālinīpā0 vinodāpā0 kautukāpā0 
puṇyāpā0 purāṇāpā0 iti sampūjya aṣṭadaleṣu prāgvat vāgīśīpā0 
varadāpā0 viśvāpā0 vinadāpā0 vighnakāriṇīpā0 vīrāpā0 
vighnaharāpā0 vidyāpā0 iti sampūjyāṣṭakoṇe prāgvat sumukhīpā0 
sundarīpā0 sārāpā0 sumanāpā0 sarasvatīpā0 samayāpā0 sarvagāpā0 
siddhāpā0 iti sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu devyagrakoṇamārabhya hākinīpā0 
śākinīpā0 kākinīpā0 lākinīpā0 rākiṇīpā0 ḍākinīpā0 iti sampūjya 
ṣaṭpatreṣu śivāpā0 vāṇīpā0 dūrasiddhāpā0 tyaivigrahavatīpā0 
nādāpā0 manonmanīpā0 iti sampūjyāntastrikoṇeṣu 
devyagrādiprākṣiṇyena icchāśaktipā0 jñānaśaktipā0 kriyāśaktipā0 
iti sampūjya trikoṇāntarvṛttayorantarāle devyā 
dakṣiṇādhaḥkarādivāmādhaḥkarāntānyāyudhasthānāni parikalpya 
kamalāya namaḥ |

p. 300)

kuṭhārāya namaḥ | khaḍgāya namaḥ | aṃkuśāya namaḥ | ratnacaṣakāya 
namaḥ | gadāyai namaḥ | kheṭāya namaḥ | pāśāya namaḥ | iti sampūjya 
punarmadhye devīṃ sampūjya dhūpadīpādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvat 
samāpayet iti śivādūtīnityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha tvaritānityāyajanavidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (14 pā0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu navamī yā samīritā |
proktaiva tvaritā vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣarā || 1 ||

tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe homayantrādibhiḥ samam |
yena mantrī manmathābho vikṣobhayati bhūtalam || 2 ||

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 47)

ādyaṃ tu vahnivāsinyā dūtyādistadanantaram |
haṃso dharāsvasaṃyuktaḥ tejaścarasamanvitam || 1 ||

vāyuḥ prabhācarayutā grāsaḥ śaktisamanvitaḥ |
hṛdā rayeṇa dāhena vahniḥ syādaṣṭamaṃ priye || 2 ||

haṃsaḥ kṣmāsvayuto grāsaścarayukto dvitīyakam |
dyutirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarī || 3 ||

iti | oṃ hrīṃhuṃkhecachekṣaḥstrīhūṃkṣehrīṃphaṭ || tathā tripurārṇave -

ṛṣiḥ saurirvirāṭ chando devateyaṃ ca pārvati |
kavacaṃ strī śaktibīje kṣeca kīlakamīritam || 1 ||

iyaṃ tu tvaritā nityā | tantrajāje - (14 | 3)

vidyācaturthavarṇādisaptabhistvakṣaraistathā |
kuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭ krameṇa karāṅgayoḥ || 1 ||

śirolalāṭakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyādhārakeṣu ca |
ūruyugme tathā jānuyugme jaṅghādvaye tathā || 2 ||

pādayugme tathā varṇānmantrajān daśa vinyaset |
dvitīyopāntyamadhyasthairmantrārṇairitarairapi || 3 ||

tārādyaiḥ śṛṇu taddhyānaṃ tacchaktīstatprapūjanam |
śyāmavarṇāṃ śubhākārāṃ navayauvanaśobhinīm || 4 ||

dvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitābharaṇojjvalām |
tāṭaṅkamaṅgadaṃ tadvadraśanānūpurānvitaiḥ || 5 ||

viprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrajātibhirbhīmavigrahaiḥ |
pallavāṃśukasaṃvītāṃ śikhipucchakṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 6 ||

valayairbhūṣitabhujāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām |
barhibarhakṛtāpīḍāṃ tacchatrāṃ tatpatākinīm || 7 ||

guñjāguṇalasadvakṣaḥkucakuṃkumamaṇḍanām |
trinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ mandasmitamukhāmbujām || 8 ||

pāśāṃkuśavarābhītilasadbhujacatuṣṭayām |
dhyātvaivaṃ totulāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchaktibhirvṛtām || 9 ||

tadagrasthāṃ ca phaṭkārīṃ śaracāpakarojjvalām |
prasāde phaladāne ca sādhakānāṃ tvarānvitām || 10 ||

yataḥ sā tvaritetyuktā mayā śaktirnavamyāsau |
kṛṣṇavarṇo gadāpāṇirvarvarordhvaśiroruhaḥ || 11||

kiṃkarastvagratastasyāḥ pūjyaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye |
taddvārapārśvayoḥ pūjye jayāvijayasaṃjñike || 12 ||

śaktī tatsadṛśau svarṇavetravellatkarāmbuje |
huṃkārī khecarī caṇḍā chedinī kṣepiṇī tataḥ || 13 ||

strīhuṃkāryau kṣemakarī lokapālasamā imāḥ |
pūjyāḥ padmāṣṭapatreṣu sthitā mantrārṇaśaktayaḥ || 14 ||

yābhirnityārcitābhiḥ syānnaro nārīṣu manmathaḥ |
śṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ tasyāstvaritāyā maheśvari || 15 ||

prāgvadarghyaṃ vidhāyeśīmaṣṭāsiṃhāṃghrike śubhe |
āsane hemaracite vidadhyāt bhūpuradvayam || 16 ||

paścimadvārasaṃyuktaṃ tadantarvṛttayugmakam |
tadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vidhāyātra parāṃ śivām || 17 ||

prāgvadāvāhya paritaḥ śaktibhirveṣṭitāṃ tathā |
mudrādarśanapūrvaṃ tu pūjayettāṃ yathoditām || 18 ||

agrapatrāgrake vṛttamadhye vārcyau puroditau |
kiṅkarasya baliṃ dadyād devyagre prāgudīritaiḥ || 19 ||

svasamānagaṇākīrṇamaṇḍalasthasya bhaktitaḥ |
evaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyāgre japedvidyāṃ sahasrakam || 20 ||

śataṃ vā kṛtahomastu pūjāṃ prāgvat samāpayet |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
tvaritāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi sauraye ṛṣaye namaḥ |

p. 301)

mukhe virāṭchandase namaḥ | hṛdi tvaritānityādevatāyai namaḥ | guhye oṃ 
bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ huṃ śaktaye namaḥ | nābhau kṣe kīlakāya 
namaḥ  iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ 
khecahṛdayāya namaḥ | cache śirase svāhā | chekṣaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | 
kṣaḥstrī kavacāya hum | strīhūṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | hūṃkṣe astrāya 
phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā śirasi hrīṃ oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | lalāṭe 
hrīṃhuṃhrīṃnamaḥ | kaṇṭhe hrīṃkhehrīṃnamaḥ | hṛdi 
hrīṃcahrīṃnamaḥ | nābhau hrīṃchehrīṃnamaḥ | mūlādhāre 
hrīṃkṣaḥhrīṃnamaḥ | ūrudvaye hrīṃstrīṃhrīṃnamaḥ | jānudvaye 
hrīṃhūṃhrīṃ namaḥ | jaṅghādvaye hrīṃkṣehrīṃnamaḥ | pādadvaye 
hrīṃphaṭhrīṃnamaḥ iti māyāpuṭitavarṇān vinyasya samastavidyayā 
vyāpakaṃ vinyasya dhyānādimānasapūjānte svarṇādipaṭṭe 
kuṃkumādinā paścimādidvārayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ vidhāya 
tadantarvṛttadvayopetamaṣṭadalapadmamiti pūjācakraṃ vidhāya 
prāgvatpurataḥ saṃsthāpyābhyarcyarghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśīpīṭhamabhyarcya tatra mūlavidyayā mūrti 
kalpayitvāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte karṇikāntaḥ prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni 
gurupaṃktitrayaṃ ca sampūjya paścād bahirvṛttatrayāntarāla 
thavīthīdvaye devyagradalāgrabāhye phaṭkārīpādu0 | bāhyavīthyāṃ 
devyagra eva kiṅkarapā0 (dvārapārśvayoḥ jayāpā0 vijayā0 | 
aṣṭapatreṣu huṅkārapā0 khecarīpā0) caṇḍā0 chedinīpā0 kṣepiṇīpā0 
strīkārīpā0 hūṅkārīpā0 kṣemakarīpā0 iti sampūjya 
prāgvallokapālārcādisarvaṃ samāpayediti | atra 
kurukullābalidānānantaraṃ kiṅkarasyāpi devyagre'nnādibhirbaliṃ 
dadyāt iti tvaritānityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha kulasundarīpūjāvidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (15 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu daśamī yā samīritā |
vidyoktā kulasundaryāstasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu || 1 ||

taddhyānamatha tannyāsaṃ tacchaktīstatsamarcanam |

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 51)

śuciḥ svena yutastvādyo rasāvahnisamanvitaḥ |
prāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanahṛcchaktibhiḥ paraḥ || 1 ||

itīritā tryakṣarī syānnityā sā kulasundarī |

iti | aiṃklīṃsauḥ || tripurārṇave -

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtirahaṃ śirasi vinyaset |
chandaḥ paṃktistu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya devatām || 1 ||

hṛdaye parameśānīṃ vinyaset kulasundarīm |
vāgbhavaṃ bījamityuktaṃ śaktistārtīyamīritam || 2 ||

kāmabījaṃ kīlakaṃ syāt puruṣārthe niyojitam |

iti | tantrarāje - (15 | 12)

tribhistairuditairmūlavarṇaiḥ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgakam |
ādyamadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhau kramāt || 1 ||

pratyekaṃ taistribhirbījairdīrghasvarasamanvitaiḥ |
kuryāt karāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhi || 2 ||

ūrdhvaprāgdakṣiṇodakca paścimāparanāmabhiḥ |
śucinatyantarasthaistaistadātmasu yathākramam || 3 ||

ādhārarandhrahṛtsvekaṃ dvitīyaṃ locanatraye |
tṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣu || 4 ||

pañcamaṃ (trā?cāṃ) sanābhīṣu tathorupāṇipaddvaye |
mūlamadhyāgrato nyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥ || 5 ||

lohitāṃ lohitākāraśaktivṛndaniṣevitām |
lohitāṃśukabhūṣāsraglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāmbujām || 6 ||

prativaktraṃ trinayanāṃ tathā cārusmitānvitām |
anarghyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikmukuṭojjvalām || 7 ||

tāṭaṅkahārakeyūraraśanānūpurojjvalām |
ratnastabakasaṃbhinnalasadvakṣaḥsthalāṃ śubhām || 8 ||

kāruṇyānandaparamāmaruṇāmbujaviṣṭarām |
bhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveśīṃ sarvavāṅmayīm || 9 ||

pravālākṣasrajaṃ padmaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ratnanirmitām |
ratnapūrṇaṃ tu caṣakaṃ luṅgīṃ vyākhyānamudrikām || 10 ||

dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairvāmaiḥ pustakaṃ cāruṇotpalam |
haimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kambu varaṃ bhujaiḥ || 11 ||

abhitaḥ stūyamānāṃ ca devagandharvakinnaraiḥ |
yakṣarākṣasadevarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ || 12 ||

p. 302)

dhyātvaivamarcayennityaṃ vāglakṣmīkāntidsiddhaye |
sitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapi || 13 ||

dhūmābhāṃ vairividviṣṭyai mṛtaye nigrahāya ca |
nīlāṃ ca mūkīkaraṇe smarettattadapekṣayā || 14 ||

bhāṣā sarasvatī vāṇī saṃskṛtā prākṛtāparā |
bahurūpā citrarūpā ramyāpyānandakautuke || 15 ||

evamekādaśa proktā navayoniṣu pūjayet |
bahiraṣṭacchadāmbhoje brāhmyādyāstāḥ samarcayet || 16 ||

caturasre lokapālān śaktirūpān samarcayet |
indrāgniyamarakṣorbhirvaruṇānilasomakān || 17 ||

īśānantavidhīn prāgādyaṣṭadikṣvadharottaram |
śaktyāntairnāmabhiḥ prāgvat pūjayet sarvasiddhaye || 18 ||

caturasradvayaṃ kuryāt prākpratyagdvārasaṃyutam |
tanmadhye vṛttayugmasthaṃ kuryādaṣṭacchadāmbujam || 19 ||

catustripañcacatvāribhāgato navayonikam |
kṛtvātra tāṃ samāvāhya prāgvat samyagathārcayet || 20 ||

ekādaśasvantaśaktī madhyayonestu pārśvayoḥ |
tathaiva lokapālāntaśaktī dvāradvaye'rcayet || 21 ||

viśeṣa (eva?eṣa) sāmānyamanyadarcanamambike |
saptākṣaryā baliṃ dadyāt pūjānte kurukullayā || 22 ||

evaṃ nityārcanaṃ kuryānnityahomaṃ ghṛtena vai |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanapūjādiyogapīṭhanyāsānte mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrti-ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
paṃkticchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye kulasundarīnityādevatāyai namaḥ | guhye 
aiṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ sauḥ śaktaye namaḥ | nābhau klīṃ kīlakāya 
namaḥ iti vinyasya mama puruṣārtha catuṣṭayasiddhaye viniyogaḥ  iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā pūjārambhe japārambhe āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | īṃ 
śirase svāhā | ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | aiṃ kavacāya huṃ | auṃ 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | aḥ astrāya phaṭ iti karāṅgayorvinyasya śirasi aiṃ 
āṃ ūrdhvavaktrāya namaḥ | mukhe aiṃ īṃ pūrvavaktrāya namaḥ | 
dakṣakarṇe aiṃ ūṃ dakṣiṇavaktrāya namaḥ | vāmakarṇe aiṃ aiṃ 
uttaravaktrāya namaḥ | cūḍādhaḥ aiṃ auṃ paścimavaktrāya namaḥ | 
cibuke aiṃ aḥ aparavaktrāya namaḥ iti vinyaset | pūjāmadhye 
tvāvaraṇapūjārambhe vidyāyā madhyabījaṃ ṣaḍdīrghasvarairbhinnaṃ 
kṛtvā klāṃklīmityādinā nyaset | pūjānte'pi vidyayā antyabījaṃ 
tathaiva svarabhinnaṃ kṛtvā sāṃ sīmityādinā nyaset | madhye japāne ca | 
japamadhyamuddiṣṭasaṃkhyāyā ardhajapānantaramiti | atha prakṛte 
prathamakūṭasya vaktranyāsānantaraṃ bhūtvā (yaḥ) ādhāre aiṃ | 
brahmarandhreṃ klīṃ | hṛdaye sauḥ | dakṣanetre aiṃ | vāmanetre klīṃ | 
lalāṭanetre sauḥ | dakṣaśrotre aiṃ | vāme klīṃ | cibuke sauḥ | dakṣanasi 
aiṃ | vāme klīṃ | tāluni sauḥ | dakṣāṃse aiṃ | vāme klīṃ | nābhau 
sauḥ | dakṣadormūle aiṃ | madhye klīṃ | agre sauḥ  vāmadormūle aiṃ | 
madhye klīṃ | agre sauḥ | dakṣorumūle aiṃ | madhye klīṃ | agre sauḥ | 
vāmorumūle aiṃ | madhye klīṃ | agre sauḥ | evaṃ pāṇipādadvaye iti 
vinyasya tato mūlavidyayā vyāpakaṃ kuryāt | pūjājapamadhyāntayorapi 
madhyabījāntyabījābhyāṃ vaktranyāsānantaraṃ 
mūlabījairnavavidhanyāsaṃ vyāpakasya nyāsaṃ ca kuryāditi 
sampradāyaḥ | tato dhyānamānasapūjānte prāgvatsvarṇādipaṭṭe 
kuṃkumādināṣṭadalapadmaṃ kṛtvā tatkarṇikāyāṃ 
prāgvannavayonicakraṃ vidhāya padmādbahirvṛttadvayaṃ tadbahiḥ 
pūrvapaścimadvāradvayayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kuryāditi pūjācakraṃ 
nirmāya prāgvat purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte

p. 303)

atha nityānityāyajanavidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (16 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu yā proktaikādaśī tu tām |
nityānityāṃ śṛṇu prājñe tadāyattamidaṃ jagat || 1 ||

vidyoddhāraḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ tadvidhānamihocyate |
yāsau samastabhūtānāṃ dehasthitividhāyinī || 2 ||

nyāsadhyānaṃ tataḥ śaktīstābhiḥ pūjāṃ ca sādhanam |

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 53)

haṃsaśca hṛtprāṇarasādāhakurbhiḥ samanvitaḥ |
vidyayā kulasundaryā yojitaḥ sampradāyataḥ || 1 ||

iti | hasakalaraḍaiṃ hasakalaraḍīṃ hasakalaraḍauḥ || iti tripurārṇave - 
nityānityā tu bālā ce ti atra bālānityānityayorabhedāt 
karaṣaḍaṅgārghyādikaṃ bālāyā iva jñeyam | tantrarāje - (16 | 4)

dīrghasvarasametābhyāṃ haṃsahṛdbhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
bhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyādhāreṣu ca kramāt || 1 ||

vidyākṣarāṇi kramaśo nyasedbinduyutāni ca |
vyāpakaṃ tu samastena vidhāya vidhinā yutam || 2 ||

dhyāyettāṃ sarvasampattihetoḥ sarvātmikāṃ śubhām |
udyadbhāskarabimbābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām || 3 ||

padmarāgakṛtākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm |
cārusmitalasadvaktraṣaṭsarojavirājitām || 4 ||

prativaktraṃ trinayanāṃ bhujairdvādaśabhiryutām |
pāśākṣaguṇapuṇḍrekṣucāpakheṭatriśūlakān || 5 ||

varaṃ vāmairdadhānāṃ cāpyaṃkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathā |
puṣpeṣu maṇḍalāgraṃ ca kapālamabhayaṃ tathā || 6 ||

dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairdhyāyed devīmananyadhīḥ |
anantāḥ śaktayo devyāstvākarṇaya vadāmi te || 7 ||

lalitāśaktivṛndāśca bījadvayamatho kramāt |
pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syurante śaktītisaṃyutāḥ || 8 ||

saptākṣaryā yutā saṃjñā vidyāḥ syurdvādaśākṣarāḥ |
ṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ yajettābhirvṛtāṃ śivām || 9 ||

ṣaṭkoṇakoṇeṣvāsīnā ḍākinyādyāstathārcayet |
rakṣonilendravahnīśavaruṇeṣu kramācca tāḥ || 10 ||

ḍākinī rākiṇī paścāllākinī kākinī tathā |
śākinī hākinī mūladevīsadṛśavigrahāḥ || 11 ||

hetīstāmabhitaḥ śaktirūpāstanmukuṭānatāḥ |
kṛtanyāsārdhasaṃkalpaḥ pūjayedīritakramāt || 12 ||

satiladvayahomaṃ tu japedvidyāṃ yathoditām |
ṣaṭkoṇādbahirabjaṃ tu śatārdhaikadalānvitam || 13 ||

kṛtvā teṣvapi tābhistu vṛtā pūjyā tu madhyataḥ |
dvicatuṣṣaḍdalaśatairdvādaśāṣṭadalacchadaiḥ || 14 ||

padmairāvṛtaṣaṭkoṇe yajellaghvīritārcanā |
caturasradvayaṃ bāhye caturdvārasamanvitam || 15 ||

vidhāya teṣu śākhāśca śaktīnāṃ viṃśatiṃ yajet |
brāhmyādilokapālākhyāḥ ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥ || 16 ||

anantabrahmaniyatikālarūpā vidiggatāḥ |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadāsanayogapīṭhanyāsānte 
nityānityāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrti-
ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ | hṛdi nityānityādevatāyai 
namaḥ | guhye aiṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ oṃ śaktaye namaḥ | nābhau 
īṃkīlakāya namaḥ iti vinyasya mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā hsāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hsīṃ śirase svāhā | hsūṃ 
śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | hsaiṃ kavacāya huṃ | hsauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | hsaḥ 
astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya bhrūmadhye haṃ namaḥ | 
kaṇṭhe saṃnamaḥ | hṛdi kaṃnamaḥ | nābhau laṃ namaḥ | guhye 
raṃnamaḥ | mūlādhāre ḍaṃnamaḥ samastavidyayā vyāpakaṃ vidhāya 
udyadbhāskarabimbābhāmityādi dhyātvā mānasapūjānte 
svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye vṛttaṃ 
kṛtvā ṣaṭkoṇādbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadalayutāni ṣaṭtriṃśatpadmāni 
dvātriṃśaddvātriṃśaddalayutāni aṣṭādaśapadmāni vā 
tadbahirvibhāgena kṛtvā tadbahiścaturasradvayaṃ caturdvāropetaṃ 
kuryāditi pūjāmaṇḍalaṃ nirmāya prāgvat purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
kulasundarīpīṭhamabhyarcya mūlena mūrtiṃ parikalpyāvāhyāsanādi 
puṣpopacārānte pīṭhamadhye devīparitaḥ prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya 
devyāḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge ṣaṭkoṇavṛttayorantarāle prāgvadguru 
paṃktitrayamabhyarcya

p. 304)

ṣaṭkoṇādbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadalapadmaṃ tadbahirdvādaśadalaṃ

svaraśaktīrdvādaśadaleṣu kādiṭhāntavarṇaśaktīrdaśadaleṣu

vādisāntavarṇaśaktīrdvidalayorhakṣavarṇaśaktī iti pañcāśacchaktīḥ 
pūjayet | evamuttamamadhyamakaniṣṭhapakṣeṣvekapakṣānusāreṇa

indrādīśānāntalokapālaśaktyaṣṭakaṃ prāgvat sampūjya 
vāyavyādinir-ṛtyantaṃ koṇacatuṣṭaye 2 anantaśaktipā0 2 
brahmaśaktipā0 2 niyatiśaktipā0 2 kālaśaktipā0 iti sampūjya 
ṣaṭkoṇāntavṛttayorantarāle dvādaśa sthānāni parikalpya 2 
abhayaśaktipā0 2 kapālaśaktipā0 2 khaḍgaśaktipā0 2 iṣuśaktipā0 2 
pustakaśaktipā0 2 aṃkuśaśaktipā0 2 pāśaśaktipā0 2 
akṣaguṇaśaktipā0 2 ikṣucāpaśaktipā0 2 kheṭakaśaktipā0 2 
triśūlaśaktipā0 2 varaśaktipā0 iti sampūjya punarmadhye devīṃ 
tadvidyayābhyarcya dhūpādi sarvaṃ kṛtvā samāpayet iti 
nityānityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

aya nīlapatākārcāvidhiḥ || śrītantrarāje - (17 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu dvādaśī yā samīritā |
tasyā nīlapatākāyā vidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 1 ||

nyāsakramavidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ śaktīḥ prapūjanam |

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 56)

tvaritopāntyamādyaṃ syād dyutirdāhacarasvayuk |
hṛcca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ (vajreśīpañcamaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

marut svayukto madhyādye daśamyāḥ kramaśaḥ smṛte |
bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā) vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramāt || 2 ||

ṣaḍakṣarāṇi tvaritātṛtīyaṃ tadanantaram |
dyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaram || 3 ||

uktā nīlapatākākhyā nityā saptadaśākṣarī |

hrīṃphreṃsrūṃoṃ-āṃklīṃ-aiṃblūṃnityamadadravehuṃphreṃhrīṃ 
iti | tripurārṇave

ṛṣiḥ sammohanaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā manoḥ |
nityā nīlapatākākhyā hrīṃbījaṃ hrīṃ ca śaktikam || 1 ||

kāmabījaṃ kīlakaṃ syāditi || śrītantrarāje - (17 | 5)

mūlavidyākṣarairaṅgānyācaret ṣaḍiti kramāt |
dvicatuṣṭayaṣaṭtryarṇaiḥ krameṇa ṣaḍītiritaiḥ || 1 ||

śrotrākṣināsāyugale vāci kaṇṭhe hṛdi kramāt |
nābhāvādhārake pādasandhiṣu triṣu ca kramāt || 2 ||

mantrākṣarāṇi kramaśo nyaset saptadaśāpi ca |
vyāpakaṃ samastena vidadhyācca yathāvidhi || 3 ||

indranīlanibhāṃ bhāsvanmaṇimaulivirājitām |
pañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm || 4 ||

daśahastāṃ lasanmuktāprāyābharaṇabūṣitām |
ratnastavakasambhinnadehāṃ cārusmitānanām || 5 ||

pāśaṃ patākāṃ carmāpi śārṅgacāpaṃ varaṃ karaiḥ |
dadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ || 6 ||

aṃkuśaṃ ca tataḥ śakti khaḍgaṃ bāṇaṃ tathābhayam |
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭare || 7 ||

svākāravarṇaveṣāsyapāṇyāyudhavibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
śaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakrame || 8 ||

triṣaṭkoṇayutaṃ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ tato bahiḥ |
dvya(a)ṣṭāraṃ bhūpuradvandvād vṛtte tatpurayugmakam || 9 ||

caturdvārayutaṃ dikṣu śākhābhiśca samanvitam |
kṛtvā tāmāvṛtāṃ śaktigaṇaistatrārcayecchivām || 10 ||

p. 305)

(icchājñānakriyāśaktīstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet |
agrāt pradakṣiṇenaiva yajedāvṛttipañcakam) || 11 ||

ḍākinyādyā yajeta ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu paritaḥ kramāt |
brāhmyādīraṣṭapatreṣu tatkoṇeṣu bahistathā || 12 ||

prāguktāstā yajecchaktīrnityānityādiṣūditāḥ |
balidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ prāgvat samāpayet || 13 ||

sarvatra nityahomaṃ tu kuryādannājyato'pivā |
tilataṇḍulakairvāpi proktaṃ dravyānudīrite || 14 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prāgvadyogapīṭhanyāsānte nīlapatākāvidyayā 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi sammohanāya ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye nīlapatākānityādevatāyai namaḥ | guhye 
hrīṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ hrīṃśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau 
klīṃkīlakāya namaḥ  iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjaliruktvā hrīṃphreṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | srūṃoṃ-āṃklīṃ śirase 
svāhā | aiṃblūṃnityamadaśikhāyai vaṣaṭ | drakavacāya huṃ | 
venetratrayāya vauṣaṭ | huṃ-astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya 
dakṣakarṇe hrīṃnamaḥ | vāme phreṃnamaḥ | dakṣanetre srūṃnamaḥ | 
vāme oṃ namaḥ | dakṣanasi āṃnamaḥ | vāme klīṃnamaḥ | mukhe aiṃ 
namaḥ | kaṇṭhe blūṃnamaḥ | hṛdi niṃnamaḥ | nābhau tyaṃnamaḥ | 
mūlādhāre maṃnamaḥ | dakṣorumūle daṃnamaḥ | jānuni draṃnamaḥ | 
gulphasandhau veṃnamaḥ | vāmorumūle huṃnamaḥ | jānuni phreṃnamaḥ 
| gulphasandhau hrīṃnamaḥ iti vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā 
dhyānādimānasapūjānte prāgvat svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
caturdvāropetaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā tadantarvṛttadvayaṃ 
tadantaraṣṭadalakamalaṃ tadantaḥ ṣaṭkoṇe tadantastrikoṇamiti 
pūjācakraṃ nirmāya purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya tatra nīlapatākāvidyayā mūrti 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte trikoṇābhyantare 
prāgvatṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇayorantarāle 
prāgvadgurupaṃktitrayamabhyarcya trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇayorantarāle 2 abhayāya 
namaḥ | 2 bāṇāya namaḥ | 2 khaḍgāya namaḥ | 2 śaktaye namaḥ | 2 
aṃkuśāya namaḥ | 2 pāśāya namaḥ | 2 patākāyai namaḥ | 2 carmaṇe 
namaḥ | 2 śārṅgacāpāya namaḥ |  2 varāya namaḥ iti sampūjya 
trikoṇasyāgrakoṇādiprādakṣiṇyena 2 icchāśaktipā0 | 2 jñānaśaktipā0 
| 2 kriyāśaktipā0 iti sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena 2 
hākinīpā0 evaṃ śākinī0 kākinī0 lākinī0 rākiṇī0 ḍākinī0 ityādi 
sampūjyāṣṭadaleṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena brāhmīpādu0 
evamaṣṭamātṛkāḥ sampūjyāṣṭakoṇeṣu devyagramārabhya 
prādakṣiṇyena (2 sumukhīpā0) 2 sundarīpā0 2 sārāpā0 2 sumanāpā0 2 
sarasvatīpā0 2 samayāpā0 2 sarvagāpā0 2 siddhāpā0 iti sampujya 
bahiścaturasre devyagradvārasya dakṣiṇabhāgamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena 2 
vihvalāpā0 | 2 ākarṣiṇīpā0 | 2 lolāpā0 | 2 nityāpā0 | 2 madanāpā0 | 2 
mālinīpā0 | 2 vinodāpā0 | 2 kautukāpā0 | 2 puṇyāpā0 | 2 purāṇāpā0 
iti sampūjya vahniścaturasrasya caturdvārapārśveṣu devyagradvārasya 
dakṣiṇapārśvamārabhya pratidvāraṃ 
dvidvikrameṇendrādīśānaparyantaṃ lokapālaśaktyaṣṭakaṃ prāgvat 
sampūjyāgneyādikoṇacatuṣṭaye anantabrahmaniyatikālaśaktīḥ sampūjya 
vajrādīnyāyudhāni prāgvacchaktirūpāṇi sampūjya punarmadhye 
nīlapatākānityāṃ tadvidyayābhyarcya dhūpādi sarvaṃ prāgvat kalpayet 
iti nīlapatākā nityāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha vijayānityārcāvidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (18 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu samproktā yā trayodaśī |
tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vidyā prāguditā tava || 1 ||

tadaṅgānyakṣaranyāsaṃ dhyānārcāsyāstu śaktibhiḥ |

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 61)

raso namastathā dāho vyāptaṃ kṣmā vanapūrvikā |
svena yuktā bhavennityā vijayaikākṣarā matā || 1 ||

bhamaraya-u-auṃ iti | tripurārṇave ṛṣirasyā ahiśchando gāyatrī devatā 
svayam | iti | svayaṃ vijayā | tantrarāje - (18|3)

p. 306)

vidyāyā vyañjanairdīrghasvarayuktaiścatuṣṭayam |
śeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryāt ṣadaṅgāni karaṅgayoḥ || 1 ||

jñānendriyeṣu śrotrādiṣvapi citteṣu vinyaset |
akṣarāṇi kramādbinduyutātvanyattu pūrvavat || 2 ||

pañcavaktrāṃ daśabhūjāṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanām |
bhāsvanmukuṭavinyastacandrarekhāvirājitām || 3 ||

sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ pītāmbarasamujjvalām |
udyadbhāsvadbimbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitām || 4 ||

śaṅkhaṃ pāśaṃ kheṭacāpau kahlāraṃ vāmabāhubhiḥ |
cakraṃ tathāṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṅgakam || 5 ||

dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaihastaiḥ prayoge bhīmadarśanām |
(upāsane'tisaumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanām) || 6 ||

vyāghrārūḍhābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām |
samare pūjane'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanām || 7 ||

śaktayaścāpi pūjāyāṃ sukhāsanasamanvitāḥ |
sarvā devyāḥ samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhā api || 8 ||

caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvāropaśobhitam |
śākhāṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvat samarcayet || 9 ||

tadantarvṛttayugmāntaraṣṭakoṇaṃ vidhāya tat |
tadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutam || 10 ||

tathaivāṣṭacchadaṃ padmaṃ vidhāyāvāhya tatra tām |
tattacchaktyāvṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathārcayet || 11 ||

annājyābhyāṃ nityahomaṃ kuryādvā tilataṇḍulaiḥ |
balidvayaṃ prakurvīta pūjāṃ cāpi samāpayet || 12 ||

lalitārahitāḥ pañcadaśanityāstithīśvarāḥ |
candrakhaṇḍalasanmauliyutāḥ sā tanmayī sadā || 13 ||

iti | atra kāmeśvaryādipañcadaśanityānāṃ 
vṛddhikṣayopetacandrakalāpañcadaśakarūpapañcadaśatithimayatvācca 
tāsāṃ candrakalādhāraṇatvam lalitāyāstu tāsāṃ kalānāṃ 
kāraṇabhūtākṣayendukalārūpatvāt tasyāstaddhāraṇaṃ nāsti | tathā :

māyāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnāmabhirarcayet |
tadāvaraṇagāḥ śaktīstatsamākārahetikāḥ || 14 ||

agrātpradakṣiṇenaiva tāḥ sarvāsteṣu pūjayet |
tāsāṃ krameṇa nāmāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi || 15 ||

nityānityāvaduditamarcanaṃ caturasrake |
brāhmyādilokapālāśca ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥ || 16 ||

(antaḥsthitāṣṭakoṇeṣu pūjayeduktavigrahāḥ |
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ durgāṃ bhadrāṃ bhadrakarīmapi || 17 ||

kṣemāṃ kṣemaṅkarīṃ nityāmaṣṭakoṇeṣu bhaktitaḥ) |
tadantaḥ ṣoḍaśadaleṣvarcayet ṣoḍaśābhitaḥ || 18 ||

śaktīstā gandhapuṣpādiyuto bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
vidārikāṃ viśvamayīṃ viśvāṃ viśvavibhañjikāma || 19 ||

vīrāṃ vikṣobhiṇīṃ vidyāṃ vinodāñcitavigrahām |
vītaśokāṃ viṣagrīvāṃ vipulāṃ vijayapradām || 20 ||

vibhavāṃ vividhāṃ viprāṃ proktākārasamanvitāḥ |
tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu śaktīraṣṭābhito yajet || 21 ||

proktakrameṇa gandhādyairbhaktivighnāśayo vaśī |
manoharāṃ maṅgalāṃ ca madotsiktāṃ manasvinīm || 22 ||

māninīṃ madhurāṃ māyāṃ mohinīmuktavigrahāḥ |
evaṃ pūjājapadhyānahomopāsanato vaśī || 23 ||

bhajate nityaśo devīṃ yo'sau syāt sarvataḥ sukhī |

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prāgvadyogapīṭhanyāsānte vijayāvidyayā 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi ahi-ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi vijayānityādevatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya 
bhāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | mīṃ śirase svāhā | rūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | 
yaiṃ kavacāya huṃ | uṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | auṃ astrāya phaṭ iti 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya śrotrayoḥ bhaṃnamaḥ | sarvāṅge 
maṃnamaḥ | netrayoḥ raṃnamaḥ | jihvāyāṃ yaṃnamaḥ | nāsāyāṃ uṃ 
namaḥ | citte auṃnamaḥ iti vinyasya prāgvadvijayāvidyayā vyāpakaṃ 
vidhāya dhyānādimānasapūjāntaṃ svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
caturdvārayutaṃ caturasradvayaṃ vidhāya tadantarvṛttayugmaṃ 
tadantaraṣṭakoṇam tadantaḥ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ padmaṃ 
tadantaraṣṭadalapadmamiti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
prāgvadbhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcyaṃ tasmin vijayāvidyayā mūrti 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni 
gurupaṃktitrayaṃ ca sampūjya caturasrasya caturdvārapārśveṣu 
devyagradvārasya dakṣiṇapārśvamārabhya tadvāmapārśvāntaṃ 
pratidvāraṃ dvidvikrameṇendrādīśānāntaṃ lokapālaśaktyaṣṭakaṃ 
prāgvat sampūjya vāyavyādinir-ṛtyantakoṇacatuṣṭaye 
anantabrahmaniyatikālaśaktīḥ sampūjyāṣṭakoṇeṣu 
devyagrakoṇamārabhya prādakṣiṇyena 2 jayāpā0 2 vijayāpā0

iti vijayānityāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha sarvamaṅgalāsaparyāvidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (19 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu yā proktā tu caturdaśī |
ekākṣarā tu sā proktā vidyā sā sarvamaṅgalā || 1 ||

nyāsakramaṃ dhyānavidhi śaktīrāvaraṇasthitāḥ |
pūjākramaṃ sādhanaṃ ca viniyogādikān kramāt || 2 ||

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 63)

hṛdambuvanayuktaṃ svaṃ nityāṃ syāt sarvamaṅgalā |
ekākṣaryānayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥkṣaṇāt || 1 ||

svauṃ iti | tripurārṇave - ṛṣicchando maheśāni gāyatrī chanda ucyate | 
devateyamiti | iyaṃ sarvamaṅgalā | tantrarāje - (19 | 3)

mūlavidyākṣarairdīrghasvarabhinnaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
tāni tatsvarabhinnāni tāni ṣaṭsumanovadhi || 1 ||

suvarṇavarṇāṃ rucirāṃ muktāmāṇikyabhūṣaṇām |
māṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaṅkhaddayāparām || 2 ||

dvibhujāṃ svāsanāṃ padme tvaṣṭaṣoḍaśataddvayaiḥ |
patrairupete sacaturdvārabhūsadmayugmake || 3 ||

mātuluṅgaphalaṃ dakṣe dadhānāṃ karapaṅkaje |
vāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikam || 4 ||

svasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām |
ṣaṭsaptatibhiranyābhirakṣarotthābhiranvitām || 5 ||

prayogeṣvanyadā nityasaparyāsūktaśaktikām |
tāḥ śaktīḥ śṛṇu deveśi yā nityāvaraṇasthitāḥ || 6 ||

bhadrāṃ bhavānīṃ bhavyāṃ ca viśālākṣīṃ śucismitām |
kuṃkumāṃ kamalāṃ kalpāṃ pūjayedaṣṭapatrake || 7 ||

kalāṃ ca pūraṇīṃ nityāmamṛtāṃ jīvitāṃ dayām |
aśokāmamalāṃ pūrṇāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāgyāmathodyatām || 8 ||

vivekāṃ vibhavāṃ viśvāṃ vinatāṃ cāṣṭayugmake |
pūjayedabhitaḥ śaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai || 9 ||

kāminīṃ khecarīṃ sarvāṃ purāṇāṃ parameśvarīm |
gaurīṃ śivāmameyāṃ ca vimalāṃ vijayāṃ parām || 10 ||

pavitrāṃ padminīṃ vidyāṃ viśveśīṃ śivavallabhām |
aśeṣarūpāmānandāmambujākṣīmaninditām || 11 ||

varadāṃ vākpradāṃ vāṇīṃ vividhāṃ vedavigrahām |
vandyāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ satyāṃ saṃ (ñjā?ya) tāṃ ca sarasvatīm || 12 ||

nirmalāṃ nādarūpāṃ ca pūjayet ṣoḍaśadvaye |
prāgvadgandhādibhiḥ sarvāḥ kramādatvarthasaṃjñitāḥ || 13 ||

brāhmyādyā lokapālākhyāḥ śaktīrdvāreṣu pūjayet |
paścimādi caturdikṣu catasraḥ proktavigrahāḥ || 14 ||

anantabrahmaniyatikālarūpā vidiggatāḥ |
balidvayaṃ ca homaṃ ca kuryāt prāgvat samāpanam || 165 ||

japaṃ tu nityaśaḥ kuryādagre tasyāḥ sahasrakam |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra prāgvadyogapīṭhanyāsānte 
sarvamaṅgalāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi candrāya ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi 
sarvamaṅgalānityādevatāyai namaḥ | iti vinyasya mama 
sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā svāṃ hṛdayāya 
namaḥ | svīṃ śirase svāhā | svūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | svaiṃ kavacāya 
huṃ | svauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | svaḥ astrāya phaṭ iti 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā śrītrayoḥ svāṃnamaḥ | sarvāṅge 
svīṃnamaḥ |

p. 308)

netrayoḥ svūṃnamaḥ | jihvāyāṃ svaiṃnamaḥ nāsāyāṃ svauṃnamaḥ | 
manasi svaḥ namaḥ iti vinyasya samastavidyayā vyāpakaṃ vidhāya 
dhyānādimānasapūjānte prāgvat svarṇādipaṭṭe kuṃkumādinā 
caturdvāropetaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā tadantardvātriṃśaddalaṃ 
tadantaḥ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tadantaraṣṭadalamiti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya prāgvat 
purataḥ saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādyātmapūjānte bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhe 
sarvamaṅgalāvidyayā mūrti parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte 
prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni gurupaṃktitrayaṃ ca sampūjya karṇikāyāṃ devyā 
dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ bījapūrāya namaḥ | khaḍgāya namaḥ iti 
sampūjyāṣṭadaleṣu 2 bhadrāpā0 2 bhavānīpā0 2 bhavyāpā0 2

dakṣiṇapārśvamārabhya tattaddvārapārśvāntaṃ pratidvāraṃ 
dvidvikrameṇa brāhmyādyaṣṭaśaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyena sampūjya 
pūrvadvāramārabhya pūrvādikrameṇendrādīśānāntaṃ 
lokapālaśaktyaṣṭakaṃ prāgvat sampūjya vāyavyādinir-ṛtyantaṃ 
koṇacatuṣṭaye anantabrahmaniyatikālaśaktīḥ sampūjya punarmadhye 
sarvamaṅgalāvidyayā devīṃ sampūjya prāgvat smāpayet iti 
sarvamaṅgalānityāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha jvālāmālinīnityāpūjāvidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (20 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu pañcadaśyuditā tu yā |
tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe jvālāmālinyudāhṛtā || 1 ||

nyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā śaktīḥ pūjāmapi ca sādhanam |

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 64)

bhūḥ śūnyaṃ nabhasā bhūśca rasaścātha sthirāmbu ca |
rayo'gninā yuto jyāmbu marudyuktā rasā marut || 1 ||

nabhaśca marutā yuktaṃ rasāśūnye'gnisaṃyute |
gotrā caraṇe sahitā ambu pūrvākṣaraṃ tathā || 2 ||

asvāgnī hṛt sadāhāmbu rasakṣmārayahṛt svayuk |
haṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥ || 3 ||

dāhaḥ sāgniḥ prāṇacaro jyā marutsahitā rayaḥ |
careṇāmbu ca gotrā hṛtsāgni jyāmburasā svayuk || 4 ||

rayaḥ sāgni jyāmbu rasā punaretau javī tataḥ |
dāhenānena te dviḥ syāt haṃso dāhamarutsvayuk || 5 ||

haṃsaśca dāhavahnisvairdāhakṣmāsvayutaśca saḥ |
sapta dāhāstato'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca vai || 6 ||

upāntyādhaḥ sthitaṃ nīlapatākāyā anantaram |
tvaritāntyaṃ ca bheruṇḍā aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathā || 7 ||

jvālāmālā tu nityāsau triṣaṣṭyarṇā samīritā |

iti | oṃ namo bhagavati jvālāmālinī devadevi sarvabhūtasaṃhārakārike 
jātavedasi jvalanti jvala jvala prajvala prajvala hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃ rarararararara 
jvālāmālini huṃphaṭ svāhā  iti || tripurārṇave :

ṛṣistu kaśyapaśchando gāyatraṃ devatā tviyam |
rephāstre bījaśaktī tu kīlakaṃ kavacaṃ priye || 1 ||

iti | iyaṃ jvālāmālinī || tantrarāje - (20 | 3)

ekadvayacatuṣpañcacatuṣṭayadaśākṣaraiḥ |
kuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭ karāṅgayoḥ || 1 ||

jvalajjvalanasaṅkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām |
ṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 2 ||

p. 309)

pāśāṃkuśau kheṭakhaḍgau cāpabāṇau gadādharau |
śūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ || 3 ||

svasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritā |
cārusmitalasadvaktrasarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvitām || 4 ||

dhyātvaivamupacāraistairarcayettāṃ tu nityaśaḥ |
caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitam || 5 ||

saśākhamaṣṭapatrābjamantaraṣṭāṣṭake tataḥ |
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ yajet || 6 ||

icchājñānakriyāśaktīrarcayet tryasragāḥ kramāt |
ḍākinyādyāśca ṣaṭkoṇe tvaṣṭāsre ghasmarādikāḥ || 7 ||

ghasmarā viśvakavalā lolākṣī lolajihvikā |
sarvabhakṣā sahasrākṣī niḥsaṅgā saṃhṛtipriyā || 8 ||

bahiraṣṭacchade'pyetāḥ pūjayecca pradakṣiṇam |
acintyāmaprameyāṃ ca pūrṇarūpāṃ durāsadām || 9 ||

sarvāṃ saṃsiddhirūpāṃ ca pāvanāmekarūpiṇīm |
bahirdvāreṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet prāgudīritāḥ || 10 ||

prāgvat kṛtārcaścakre tāmukte proktakramādyajet |
balihomāvasānāntamiti samyak samīritam || 11 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ - tatra prāgvadyogapīṭhanyāsānte jvālāmālinīvidyayā 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi kaśyapāya ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi jvālāmālinīnityādevatāyai namaḥ | guhye 
raṃ bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ phaṭśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau huṃ kīlakāya 
namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā oṃ 
hṛdayāya namaḥ | namaḥ śirase svāhā | bhagavati śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | 
jvālāmālini kavacāya huṃ | devadevi netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | 
bhūtasaṃhārakārike astrāyaphaṭ iti karaṣaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā mūlena 
vyāpakaṃ vinyasya dhyātvā mānasapūjānte svapurataścandanādinā 
pūjāyantraṃ vilikhya purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya mūlena mūrti 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte prāgvat ṣaḍaṅgāni

sarvāpā0 2 saṃsiddhirūpāpā0 2 pāvanāpā0 2 ekarūpiṇīpā0 iti 
sampūjya caturasrasya caturdvārapārśveṣu devyagradvārasya 
dakṣiṇapārśvamārabhya taddvārapārśvāntaṃ pratidvāraṃ 
dvidvikrameṇa brāhmyādyaṣṭaśaktīḥ sampūjya

prāgvat kṛtvā samāpayet iti jvālāmālinīnityāyajanavidhiḥ ||

atha citrānityāyajanavidhiḥ | śrītantrarāje - (21 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu yā citrā ṣoḍaśī śive |
proktā tatkalpamadhunā śṛṇu sarvārthasiddhidam || 1 ||

vidyā prāgeva kathitā tadaṅganyāsasaṃyutam |
dhyānaṃ śaktīḥ pūjanañca sādhanaṃ tatphalāni ca || 2 ||

iti | tatraiva (3 | 72) vāyuprāṇavanasvaiḥ sā citrā syādakṣaradvayā | iti | 
carkau || tripurāṇave ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya gāyatrī chanda ucyate | 
vicitrā devateti || tantrarāje (21 | 4)

vidyādivāyunā kuryād dīrghasvarayujā kramāt |
ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyaset || 1 ||

udyadādityabimbābhāṃ svarṇaratnavibhūṣaṇām |
navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalām || 2 ||

caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ śucismitalasanmukhīm |
sarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīm || 3 ||

caturbhiśca bhujaiḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ varadābhaye |
dadhānāṃ maṅgalāpadmakarṇikānavayonigām || 4 ||

p. 310)

tacchaktibhiśca taccakre tathaivārcanamīritam |
navayonāvaṣṭavargayutā brāhmyādikā yajet || 5 ||

icchājñānakriyāśaktīrarcayenmadhyakoṇataḥ |
hetiśca parito devyāḥ pūjayet tadbhujāntike || 6 ||

sarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ nāthān devyāstu paścime |
pūjayet tattadakārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhi || 7 ||

gurumaṇḍalapūjādi sādhāraṇamudīritam |
sarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥ || 8 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra yogapīṭhanyāsānte citrāvidyayā 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe 
gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | hṛdi citrādevatāyai namaḥ  iti vinyasya caḥ 
hṛdayāya namaḥ | cīṃ śirase svāhā | cūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | caiṃ 
kavacāya huṃ | cauṃ netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | cāṃ astrāya phaṭ iti 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā cakauṃ aṃnama ityādi cakauṃ kṣaṃnama 
ityantaṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyasya dhyānamānasapūjānte svarṇādipaṭṭe 
kuṃkumādinā caturdvārayuktaṃ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā 
tadantardvātriṃśaddalaṃ padmaṃ tadantaraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ 
tadantarnavayonimiti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya tasmiścitrāvidyayā mūrtiṃ 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpocārāntaṃ prāgvat trikoṇāṣṭakoṇayorantarāle 
gurupaṃktitrayaṃ ca sampūjya trikoṇāṣṭakoṇayorantarāleṣveva 
dakṣiṇavāmayoścaturṣu sthāneṣu 2 abhayāya namaḥ 2 aṃkuśāya 
namaḥ 2 pāśāya namaḥ 2 varāya namaḥ iti sampūjyāntastrikoṇe 
devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyenecchājñānakriyāśaktīḥ sampūjyāṣṭayoniṣu 
2 aṃ 16 brāhmīpā0 | 2 kaṃ 5 māheśvarīpā0 | 2 caṃ 5 kaumārīpā0 | 2 
ṭaṃ 5 vaiṣṇavīpā0 | 2 taṃ 5 vārāhīpā0 | 2 paṃ 5 indrāṇīpā0 | 2 yaṃ 5 
cāmuṇḍāpā0 | 2 śaṃ 5 mahālakṣmīpā0 | aṣṭadalādiṣu 
sarvamaṅgalāpūjoktaśaktīḥ  sampūjya tathaiva sarvaṃ samāpayet iti 
citrānityāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha kurukullāsaparyāvidhiḥ | tatra śrītantrarāje - (20 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ yā proktā balidevatā |
sā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 1 ||

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 89)

prāṇadāhau dharāyuktau punarādyaṃ rase marut |
vyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayam || 1 ||

asyādau tu rasāyugmaṃ careṇa samāyojitam |
dāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ param || 2 ||

nabho dvirhṛtsadāhāmbu jyā śūnyaṃ svena saṃyutam |
ambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priye || 3 ||

śūnyaṃ vyāptaṃ bhuvā haṃsaḥ pūrvāntyau syānmanutrayam |
asya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥ || 4 ||

ekādaśākṣarādantyau dvitīyaḥ samudīritaḥ |
tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāt || 5 ||

oṃ kurukulle svāhā iti saptākṣarī || 1 ||
kurukullāyāḥ oṃkurukulle hrīḥ svāhā iti trayodaśākṣarī || 2 ||

kurukullāyāḥ oṃ kurukullehrīḥ mama sarvajanaṃ vaśamānaya hrīṃ 
svāhā iti pañcaviṃśākṣarī || 3 ||

iti tatraiva - (22 | 2)

saiva trikhaṇḍā tatraiva proktā vidyā tu saṃkhyayā |
saptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā parā || 1 ||

tṛtīyā tu pañcaviṃśadakṣarā parikīrtitā |
evaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadā || 2 ||

iti | tripurārṇave - ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ paṃktiśchanda udāhṛtam | 
devatā kurukullā iti ||

tantrarāje - (22 | 4 )

ikṣvirāghṛtadugdhābdhimadhyage navaratnake |
dvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajet || 1 ||

tattīre pūjayed devīṃ pañcamīṃ tīrapālikām |
tatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajet || 2 ||

tadājñayā ratnapotaṃ tannāmnaiva samarcayet |
balicakraṃ ca tenaiva tanmadhye tu samarcayet || 3 ||

pūrvapaścimadigdvārasaṃyutaṃ caturasrakam |
kṛtvā tadantaḥ padmaṃ ca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam || 4 ||

karṇikāyāṃ cāru kṛtvā navayoniṃ samarcayet |
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ bālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayet || 5 ||

trikhaṇḍāmudrayā mūlamantreṇādyena cāvahet |
dhyātvaivaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramāt || 6 ||

p. 311)

vikīrṇakuntalāṃ nagnāṃ raktāmānandavigrahām |
dadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥ || 7 ||

tatsamānāyudhākāravarṇā devyastu bāhyagāḥ |
ṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ || 8 ||

hṛllekhayā sthāpanādīnupacārān samācaret |
tatastadājñayārohed bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajet || 9 ||

paścimadvāramārabhya dakṣaśākhādi pūjayet |
sūryaṃ somaṃ tithiṃ vāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapi || 10 ||

(ya?pa)kṣiṇīśca tathā (tārāṃ?māsaṃ) pūrvadvārasya śākhayoḥ |
vyomavāyavyagnitoyakṣmārūpiṇīśaktisaṃyutam 

śabdaṃ sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pūrvavat |
prāṇaṃ buddhiṃ tathā śaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayet || 12 ||

bāhyāntarasthakoṇeṣu vāgdevyaṣṭakamarcayet |
tato bāṇān dhanuḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ cābhito yajet || 13 ||

madhye trikoṇakoṇeṣu secchājñānakriyātmikāḥ |
śaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye saṃvidāsanamarcayet || 14 ||

tatastāṃ pañcaviṃśārṇamūlamantreṇa pūjayet |
tatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥ || 15 ||

paścimaṃ puṣparāgaṃ ca samprāpyāvataret kramāt |
parīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarcayet tatra tatra vai || 16 ||

ikṣvirāghṛtadugdhābdhīn paścimādivilomataḥ |
namontairnāmabhiḥ pūrvamarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ || 17 ||

navaratnamayaṃ dvīpamityādi prāgudīritam |
evaṃ samarcitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaram || 18 ||

evaṃ devī pūjayituḥ śīghraṃ bahu manīṣitam |
prasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvari || 19 ||

devīnāṃ kurukullāṃ tu potādupari pūjayet |
pañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvari || 20 ||

devyā baliḥ samākhyātastārāśaktestu vidyayā |
tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye! vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm || 21 ||

bhūḥsvena marutā yukto rayo dāhaścarānvitaḥ |
rayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutam || 22 ||

etat tṛtīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ syāccaturthaṃ saptamaṃ priye |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyād hṛdambumarudanvitam || 23 ||

haṃsaśca marutā yuktaḥ poktā vidyā daśākṣarī |

oṃ tāretutāreture svāhā | iti |

anayāsyā baliṃ dadyād vidyayā parameśvari |
dhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanam || 1 ||

asyāstoyeṣu sarvatra vādho na bhavati smṛteḥ |
śyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkaje || 2 ||

dadhānāṃ bahuvarṇābhirbahurūpābhirāvṛtām |
śaktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇām || 3 ||

ratnapādukayārnyastapādāmbujayugāṃ smaret |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra vedikopari bhūmau candanādi sindūreṇa vā 
sanavayonikarṇikamaṣṭadalakamalaṃ kṛtvā tadbahiḥ 
prākpaścimadvāradvayayuktaṃ caturasradvayamiti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya 
kurukullāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrīkurukullādevatāyai 
namaḥ iti vinyasya kariṣyamāṇabalidāne viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
bālābījatrayeṇa mūlavidyāvat karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā 
kurukullāvidyayā vyāpakaṃ vinyasya vikīrṇakuntalāmiti dhyātvā 
mānasapūjānte prokṣaṇīpātrasthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
maṇḍūkādipṛthivyantaṃ śrīcakrapūjāvadabhyarcya tathaiva 
paścimādivilomenekṣu irāghṛtadugdhān sampūjya ikṣusāgaratīre 
dvīpasya nair-ṛtakoṇe 2 vārāhīvidyāmuccārya vārāhīdevīpā0 iti 
mūladevyabhimukhopaviṣṭāṃ vārāhīṃ sampūjya tadanujñayā 2 
hrīṃratnapotāya namaḥ iti ratnapotaṃ sampūjya tadupari 
ratnasiṃhāsanādimanonmanīśaktyantaṃ śrīcakrapūjākrameṇa 
sampūjya tatastanmadhye saṃvidāsanāya namaḥ iti devyā bhartṛbhūtaṃ 
puruṣaṃ sampūjya tatra pañcaviṃśākṣaryā kurukullāvidyayā 
trikhaṇḍāmudrayā ca tāṃ samāvāhya hrīḥ iti 
sthāpanādiparamīkaraṇāntamudrāḥ pradarśya tasyāḥ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya pāśādicaturmudrāḥ 
pradarśyāsanādipuṣpopacārānte śrīkurukulle 
parivārapūjārthamanujñāṃ dehi iti prārthyaṃ tadanujñayā sādhakaḥ 
svayaṃ ratnapotamāruhya ratnapotasya pūrvapaścimakoṭyoḥ 
hrīṃbhrāmiṇīśrīpā0 hrīṃ drāviṇīpā0 iti sampūjya paścimadvārasya 
dakṣiṇaśākhāmārabhya navaśaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet | tadyathā - 
paścimadvāradakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ 2 hrīḥ sūryarūpiṇīśaktipā0 | 
vāyavyakoṇe 2 hrīḥ somarūpiṇī0 |
