haṃsaśca marutā yuktaḥ proktā vidyā daśākṣarī |

oṃ tāretutāreture svāhā | iti |

anayāsyā baliṃ dadyād vidyayā parameśvari |
dhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanam || 1 ||

asyāstoyeṣu sarvatra vādho na bhavati smṛteḥ |
śyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkaje || 2 ||

dadhānāṃ bahuvarṇābhirbahurūpābhirāvṛtām |
saktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇām || 3 ||

ratnapādukayārnyastapādāmbujayugāṃ smaret |

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra vedikopari bhūmau candanādi sindūreṇa vā 
sanavayonikarṇikamaṣṭadalakamalaṃ kṛtvā tadbahiḥ 
prākpaścimadvāradvayayuktaṃ caturasradvayamiti pūjācakraṃ nirmāya 
kurukullāvidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrti-ṛṣaye 
namaḥ | mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrīkurukullādevatāyai 
namaḥ iti vinyasya kariṣyamāṇabalidāne viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
bālābījatrayeṇa mūlavidyāvat karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā 
kurukullāvidyayā vyāpakaṃ vinyasya vikīrṇakuntalāmiti dhyātvā 
mānasapūjānte prokṣaṇīpātrasthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
maṇḍūkādipṛthivyantaṃ śrīcakrapūjāvadabhyarcya tathaiva 
paścimādivilomenekṣu irāghṛtadugdhān sampūjya ikṣusāgaratīre 
dvīpasya nair-ṛtakoṇe 2 vārāhīvidyāmuccārya vārāhīdevīpā0 iti 
mūladevyabhimukhopaviṣṭāṃ vārāhīṃ sampūjya tadanujñayā 2 
hrīṃratnapotāya namaḥ iti ratnapotaṃ sampūjya tadupari 
ratnasiṃhāsanādimanonmanīśaktyantaṃ srīcakrapūjākrameṇa sampūjya 
tatastanmadhye samvidāsanāya namaḥ iti devyā bhartṛbhūtaṃ puruṣaṃ 
sampūjya tatra pañcaviṃśākṣaryā kurukullāvidyayā 
trikhaṇḍāmudrayā ca tāṃ samāvāhya hrīḥ iti 
sthāpanādiparamīkaraṇāntamudrāḥ pradarśya tasyāḥ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya pāśādicaturmudrāḥ 
pradarśyāsanādipuṣpopacārānte śrīkurukulle 
parivārapūjārthamanujñāṃ dehi iti prārthyaṃ tadanujñayā sādhakaḥ 
svayaṃ ratnapotamāruhya ratnapotasya pūrvapaścimakoṭyoḥ 
hrīṃbhrāmiṇīśrīpā0 hrīṃdrāviṇīpā0 iti sampūjya paścimadvārasya 
dakṣiṇaśākhāmārabhya navaśaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet | tadyathā 
paścimadvāradakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ 2 hrīḥ sūryarūpiṇīśaktipā0 | 
vāyavyakoṇe 2 hrīḥ somarūpiṇī0 |

p. 312)
 
uttare 2 hrīḥ tithiru0 | īśāne 2 hrīḥ vārarū0 | pūrvadvārasyottarataḥ 
śākhāyāṃ 2 hrīḥ yogarū0 | dakṣaśākhāyāṃ 2 hrīḥ ṛkṣarū0 | 
āgneye 2 hrīḥ karaṇarū0 | dakṣiṇe 2 hrīḥ pakṣarū0 | nair-ṛte 2 hrīḥ 
māsarū0 iti sampūjya tato'ṣṭadaleṣu devyagrādi prādakṣiṇyena 
vyomarū0 | śabdarū0 | vāyurū0 | sparśarū0 | agnirū0 | rūparū0 | 
toyarū0 | rasarū0 | kṣmārū0 | gandharū0 | prāṇarū0 | buddhirū0 | 
śaktirū0 iti sampūjya antaraṣṭayoniṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena 
vaśinyādivāgdevatāṣṭakaṃ sampūjya tadantaryonerbahiḥ bāṇarū0 
cāparū0 pāśarū0 aṃkuśarū0 iti sampūjya tato madhyayonyāṃ 
devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena icchārū0 jñānarū0 kriyārū0 iti sampūjya 
tato madhye prāgvat saṃvidāsanamabhyarcya tasmin pañcaviṃśākṣaryā 
kurukullāṃ gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya dhūpadīpau dattvā'nyatsarvaṃ 
samāpya oṃ tāretutāreturesvāhā iti mantreṇa kurukullāpūjāṅgatvena 
baliṃ dattvā samāpayet iti kurukulāpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha  vārāhīsaparyāvidhiḥ || tantrarāje - (23 pa0)

atha ṣoḍaśanityānāmaṅgabhūtā tu pañcamī |
taddvidhā kathitā pūrvaṃ tadaṅgāni ca pūjanam || 1 ||

sādhanaṃ siddhamantrasya prayogadhyānapūjanaiḥ |
homairyantraiśca vakṣyāmi samastābhīṣṭasiddhaye || 2 ||

iti | tatraiva - (3 | 73)

śuciḥ svenātha śūnyaṃ syānnabhasāṃ bhūrasaḥ sthirā |
ambu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutāmburayau tathā || 1 ||

ilāyuto'gniretāni punarambu marudyutam |
dāhaśca marutā haṃsastvagniretattrayaṃ punaḥ || 2 ||

ambudāhau marudyuktau haṃso'tha dharayā nabhaḥ |
tejo'gninā yutaḥpañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥ || 3 ||

toyaṃ careṇa tatpūrvaṃ toyamagniyutaṃ tataḥ |
śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śūnyaṃ śaktyā nabhoyutam || 4 ||

dāho dharāsvasahitastoyaṃ carasamanvitam |
etatpūrvamadhaḥ proktacatuṣṭayamataḥ param || 5 ||

jyā svena yuktā sacaro rasaścaitasya pūrvakam |
raso'gninā punaḥ proktacatuṣkāt trayamantataḥ || 6 ||

nabho bhuvā careṇāpi haṃsastvetasya pūrvakam |
haṃso'gninā prāk tritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutam || 7 ||

rasaścareṇa tatpūrvamagninā ca raso yutaḥ |
paścāduktatrayaṃ vāto dharayā ca nabhaḥ priye || 8 ||

prāṇaḥ svena yutaḥ paścādhṛdayaṃ svayutaṃ rasaḥ |
vyāptametattrayaṃ paścād hṛd dāhenāmbusaṃyutam || 9 ||

gotrā dharāyutā sparśo nādayukto javī yutaḥ |
dāhena pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutam || 10 ||

śūnyaṃ marutsvasahitaṃ hṛd dāhenāmbunā caraḥ |
sparśo marutsvasahito hṛd dāhenāmbunā yutam || 11 ||

jyāgniḥ svasaṃyuto haṃsastathāmbu marutā saha |
hṛdayena svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥ || 12 ||

prāṇadāhau dharāyuktau punastau vahninā viyat |
vārdāhayuktamambu syādviyad vyāptasvasaṃyutam || 13 ||

pūrvadviruktavarṇau ca śuciḥ svena yutastathā |
sthirā rasā vanasvena dāvau haṃso dharāsvayuk || 14 ||

dyutirnādavatī paścād hṛdambu marutā yutam |
haṃsaśca marutā vidyā daśottaraśatākṣarī || 15 ||

iti | aiṃ namo bhagavati vāttāli vāttāli vārāhi vārāhi vārāhimukhi 
vārāhimukhi andhe andhinyai namaḥ rundhe rundhinyai namaḥ jambhe 
jambhinyai namaḥ mohe mohinyai namaḥ stambhe stambhinyai namaḥ 
amukaṃ stambhya stambhaya sarvaduṣṭapraṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ 
sarvajihvāstambhaṃ kuru kuru śīghravaśyaṃ kuru aiṃ ṭhalauṃ ṭhaṭha 
huṃphaṭ svāhā | iti || varṇāḥ 110 || tripurārṇave - ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrti 
gāyatrīcchanda īritam | iti | tantrarāje - (23 | 3)

aṅgāni kṛtvā mantrārṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍyugena ca |
daśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhiranvitam || 1 ||

trikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇavṛttadvayasamanvitam |
vidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmnāvāhya pūjayet || 2 ||

daśottaraśatākṣaryā vārāhīvidyayā priye |
sarvamadhye samabhyarcya vāmadakṣāgrakoṇataḥ || 3 ||

krodhinīṃ stambhinīṃ caṇḍoccaṇḍāṃ ca svasvanāmabhiḥ |
ādyabījāntyasaprāṇairupetāmatha pūjayet || 4 ||

p. 313)

ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu svāgrādi brāhmyādyā vāmato'rcayet |
vṛtte caiva mahālakṣmīṃ pañcamīṃ madhyatastathā || 5 ||

baliṃ tu ṣoḍaśārṇena kṛtvābhyarcyopacārakaiḥ |

iti || atha prayogaḥ - vedyāṃ trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttadvayacaturasrātmakaṃ 
maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi 
dakṣiṇāmūrtaye ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchadanse namaḥ | hṛdaye 
śrīvārāhīdevatāyai namaḥ iti vinyasya mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye viniyogaḥ 
iti kṛtāñjiruktvā aiṃ namo bhagavati hṛdayāya namaḥ | vāttali 2 
śirasesvāhā | vārāhi 2 śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | varāhamukhi 2 kavacāya huṃ | 
andhe andhinyai namaḥ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | rundhe rundhinyai namaḥ 
astrāyaphaṭ | iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya dhyāyet :

dhyāyecca devīṃ kolāsyāṃ taptakāñcanasannibhām |
ākaṇṭhavanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgaśiroruhām || 1 ||

trinetrāmaṣṭahastāṃ ca cakraṃ śaṅkhamathāṃkuśam |
pāśaṃ ca musalaṃ sīramabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathā || 2 ||

dadhānāṃ garuḍaskandhe sukhāsīnāṃ vicintayet |

iti dhyātvā mānasapūjānte'rghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjāṃ vidhāya 
bhuvaneśvarīpīṭhamabhyarcya mūlena mūrti parikalpya tadvidyayā 
samāvāhyāvāhanādiparamīkaraṇāntaṃ tattanmudrayā 
vidhāyāsanādipuṣpopacārānte trikoṇasya vāmakoṇe 2 kroṃ krodhinyai 
namaḥ | dakṣakoṇe 2 staṃ stambhinyai namaḥ | agre 2 kṣoṃkroṃ 
caṇḍoccaṇḍāyai namaḥ | tataḥ ṣaṭkoṇakoṇaṣu 
devyagrādiprādakṣiṇyena āṃ brāhmyai namaḥ | īṃ māheśvaryai namaḥ 
| ūṃ kaumāryai namaḥ | ṝṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ | ḹṃ vārāhyai namaḥ | 
aiṃ indrāṇyai namaḥ iti sampūjya tadbahirvṛttadvaye auṃ cāmuṇḍāyai 
namaḥ | aḥ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ iti devyagre pūjayet | tataścaturasre 
indrādīṃstadbahiśca vajrādīnsampūjya punarmadhye devīṃ tadvidyayā 
sampūjya dhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvat samāpayet iti 
vārāhīpūjāvidhiḥ ||

atha vāreśānāṃ pūjāprayogaḥ - tatra tadvedikāyāṃ ṣaṭkoṇātmakaṃ 
maṇḍalaṃ vidhāya mūlena prāṇānāyamya kariṣyamāṇa 
pūrṇābhiṣekāṅgatvena vāreśapūjanamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya 
taddinavāreśau ṣaṭkoṇamadhye 
āvāhyāsanādipuṣpopacārāntairupacārairabhyarcya taduttaravāreśādīn 
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dvau dvau krameṇa svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena sampūjya 
dhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivedyānyatsarvaṃ prāgvatsamāpayet || vāreśāstu 
- ravivārasya sūryaśivau | candravārasya somāmvike | maṅgalavārasya 
bhaumakumārau | saumyavārasya brahmabudhau | guruvārasya 
bṛhaspativiṣṇu | bhṛguvārasya śukrarame | śanivārasya kuberasaurī | iti 
vāreśārcanavidhiḥ ||

atha tithīśārcanaprayogaḥ - tatra tadvedikāyāṃ caturdaśāramaṇḍalaṃ 
vilikhya mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā 
kariṣyamāṇapūrṇābhiṣekāṅgatvena tithīśapūjanaṃ kariṣye iti 
saṃkalpya madhye 
tattattithīśamāvāhyāsanādipuṣpopacārāntamabhyarcya 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena taduttaratithīśādīn caturdaśāreṣu 
prādakṣiṇyakrameṇābhyarcya dhūpādikaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsamāpayet | 
tithīśāstu - pratipadyagniḥ | dvitīyāyāmaśvinau | tṛtīyāyāmumā | 
caturthyāṃ vighnarājaḥ | pañcamyāṃ sarpaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ | 
saptamyāṃ raviḥ | aṣṭamyāṃ mātaraḥ | navamyāṃ dūrgā | 
daśamyāṃ diśaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ ghanadaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ keśavaḥ | 
trayodaśyāṃ yamaḥ | caturdaśyāṃ haraḥ | pañcadaśyāṃ candraḥ | 
amāvāsyāyāṃ pitaraḥ iti tithīśapūjākramaḥ ||

atha nakṣatradevatāpūjākramaḥ - tatra tadvedyāṃ 
saptaviṃśatyarātmakaṃ pūjācakraṃ vidhāya mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā adyehetyādi 
kariṣyamāṇapūrṇābhiṣekāṅgatvena nakṣatreśapūjāṃ kariṣye iti 
saṅkalpya tattattithinakṣatreśaṃ madhye 
āsanādipuṣpopacārāntairupacāraiḥ sampūjya saptaviṃśatyṛkṣeṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena taduktanakṣatreśamārabhya sampūjya 
dhūpadīpādikaṃ dattvā prāgvat samāpayet || nakṣatreśāstu - 
aśvinyāmaśvinau | bharaṇyāṃ yamaḥ | kṛttikāyāmagniḥ | rohiṇyāṃ 
dhātā | mṛgaśirasi candraḥ | ārdrāyāṃ śivaḥ | punarvasāvaditiḥ | puṣye 
guruḥ | aśleṣāyāṃ sarpaḥ | maghāyāṃ pitaraḥ | pūrvāyāmaryamā |

p. 314)

uttarāyāṃ bhagaḥ | haste sūryaḥ | citrāyāṃ tvaṣṭā | svātyāṃ 
mārutaḥ | viśākhāyāmindrāgnī | anurādhāyāṃ mitraḥ | 
jyeṣṭhāyāmindraḥ | mūlāyāṃ nir-ṛtiḥ | pūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ toyaṃ | 
uttarāṣāḍhāyāṃ viśvedevāḥ | abhijiti prajāpatiḥ | śravaṇe hariḥ | 
ghaniṣṭhāyāṃ vasavaḥ | śatabhiṣaji varuṇaḥ | 
pūrvābhādrapadāyāmajaikapāt | uttarābhādrapadāyāmahirbudhnyaḥ | 
revatyāṃ pūṣā iti nakṣatreśasaparyāvidhiḥ ||

atha navagrahapūjāvidhiḥ | tatra prayogaḥ - 
hastatrayāyāmavistāravedikāyāṃ prākpratyagdakṣiṇokca catuḥsūtrāṇi 
pātayitvā samāntarālaṃ navakoṣṭhātmakaṃ cakraṃ niṣpādya 
samastakoṣṭhāntarāleṣu vṛttatrayaṃ racayitvā tattanmadhye 
sūtradvayanipātena nava koṣṭhāni niṣpādya madhyakoṣṭhe aṣṭadikṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ iti 
vātādyaṣṭasvarān vilikhya madhyakoṣṭhe moṃ iti vilikhya 
vṛttatrayasyāntarāladvaye'bhyantarāntarāle maṃ māṃ miṃ mīṃ muṃ 
mūṃ mṛṃ mṝṃ meṃ maiṃ moṃ mauṃ maṃ maḥ iti vilikhya 
bāhyāntarāle aṃ āṃ ityādikṣaḥ ityantaṃ mātṛkāṃ vilikhya tatra 
bhāskaraṃ pūjayet || tataḥ pūrvadiggatanavakoṣṭhātmakamaṇḍale 
madhyakoṣṭhe soṃsomāya namaḥ | hrīmiti vilikhyāṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu 
pūrvādi ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ ityaṣṭau svarān 
vilikhyābhyantarāntarāle haṃhāmityādiṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ 
hakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahiḥ binduyutāṃ mātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra somaṃ 
pūjayet || tata āgneyadiggatanavakoṣṭhātmakamaṇḍalamadhyakoṣṭhe 
praṇavagarbhaṃ kakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu kaṃ 5 
maṅgala ityaṣṭākṣarāṇi vilikhya abhyantarāle ṣoḍaśasvarayutaṃ 
kakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahirantarāle mātṛkāṃ vilikhya tatra maumaṃ 
pūjayet || tato dakṣiṇamaṇḍale madhyakoṣṭhe praṇavagarbhaṃ cakāraṃ 
vilikhya tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu caṃ 5 budhāya iti vilikhya 
abhyantarāntarāle caṃcāmityādiṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ cakāraṃ vilikhya 
tadbahirmātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra budhaṃ pūjayet || tato nir-ṛtimaṇḍale 
madhyakoṣṭhe praṇavagarbhaṃ ṭakāraṃ likhitvā tadbahiraṣṭaṣu 
koṣṭheṣu svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena ṭaṃ 5 sauraye ityaṣṭavarṇān vilikhya 
tadbahirantarāle ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ ṭakāraṃ tadbahirantarāle mātṛkāṃ 
ca vilikhya madhye ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ śanaiścaraṃ pūjayet || tato 
paścimamaṇḍale madhyakoṣṭhe praṇavagarbhaṃ takāraṃ vilikhya 
tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu taṃ 5 gurave iti vilikhya tadbahirantarāle 
ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ takāraṃ tadbahirantarāle mātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra 
guruṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayet || tato vāyavyamaṇḍale madhyakoṣṭhe 
praṇavagarbhaṃ pakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena paṃ 5 śukrāya ityaṣṭāvakṣarāṇi vilikhya 
tadbahirantarāle ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ pakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahirantarāle 
mātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra śukraṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayet || tata 
uttaramaṇḍale madhyakoṣṭhe praṇavagarbhaṃ yakāraṃ vilikhya 
tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena yaṃ 5 rāhave 
ityaṣṭāvakṣarāṇi vilikhya tadbahirantarāle ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ yakāraṃ 
vilikhya tadbahirantarāle mātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra rāhuṃ 
ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayet || tata īśānamaṇḍale madhyakoṣṭhe 
prāṇavagarbhaṃ ṣakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahiraṣṭasu koṣṭheṣu 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena ṣaṃ 5 ketave ityaṣṭāvakṣarāṇi vilikhya 
tadbahirantarāle ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ ṣakāraṃ vilikhya tadbahirantarāle 
mātṛkāṃ ca vilikhya tatra ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ ketuṃ pūjayet iti 
navagrahapūjāvidhiḥ ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya - 
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya - śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya - 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya - śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye 
tantre caturdaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 14 ||






atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| pañcadaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha  daiśikavaraḥ prātaḥ prabodhakāle tripurātmānamātmānaṃ 
bhāvayan mūrdhni randhragam | jyotīrūpaṃ ca 
nāthāṅghrimuttiṣṭhennyastavigrahaḥ || iti | (tantrarāje - 5 | 17) nyastavigraho 
vakṣyamāṇanyāsaiḥ 
karaśuddhiṣaḍaṅgacaturāsanavāgdevatāṣṭakākhyaiḥ kṛtanyāsaśarīraḥ 
| namaste nātha bhagavan ityādiślokaiḥ stutvā 
hrīṃśrīṃhasakṣamalavayarūṃ amukānandanātha 
hriṃśrīṃsahakṣamalavayarīṃ amukadevyambāpādukāṃ pūjayāmiti 
gurumantraṃ yathāśakti japitvā kuṇḍalinyā mūlādimūrdhāntaṃ 
gamanānusandhānapuraḥsaraṃ tripurātmānamātmānaṃ bhāvayitvā 
tripurārṇavoktaṃ stotraṃ paṭhet :

prātarnamāmi jagatāṃ jananyāścaraṇāmbujam |
śrīmattripurasundaryā jananyā jagatāṃ sadā || 1 ||

prasannāyāḥ svabhaktānāṃ namitāyā harādibhiḥ |
prātastripurasundaryā namāmi caraṇāmbujam || 2 ||

harirharo viriñciśca sṛṣṭyādīn kurute yayā |
(prātastripurasundaryā namāmi padapaṅkajam) || 3 ||

yatpādyamambu śirasi bhāti gaṅgā maheśituḥ |
prātaḥ pāśāṃkuśaśarapāśahastāṃ namāmyaham || 4 ||

udyadādityasaṅkāśāṃ śrīmattripurasundarīm |
prātarnamāmi pādābjaṃ yayedaṃ bhāsate jagat || 5 ||

tasyāstripurasundaryā yatprāsādānnivartate |
yaḥ ślokapañcakamidaṃ prātarnityaṃ paṭhennaraḥ || 6 ||

tasmai dadyādātmapadaṃ śrīmattripurasundarī |

iti stutvodvāṃsya nānāvarṇāyudhākāravāhanābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ | 
sarvagāḥ sarvadāḥ sarvasiddhidā balidānataḥ || (taṃ 5 | 18) syuriti 
vibhrāṇāt (?) svapurataḥ sādhāre'nnavyañjanapuṣpāmbupūrṇe oṃ 
hrīṃsarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo hrūṃ svāhā iti 
ṣoḍaśākṣaramantreṇa karatalayostrirāsphālanapūrvaṃ 
prasāritatarjanīdvayābhyāmubhayakaramuṣtibhyāmūrdhvādhaḥ 
sthitirūpābhyāṃ daivatebhyo niveditabalidravyadarśanarūpayā mudrayā 
balirdeyaḥ | tataścāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā klīṃ kāmadevāya sarvajanapriyāya 
namaḥ iti mantreṇa dantadhāvanaṃ kṛtvā mūladinanityābhyāṃ 
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ snānaṃ tilakaṃ ca kṛtvā vaidikasandhyāṃ nirvartya 
tāntrikasandhyāṃ kuryāt | tatastrirācamya prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt | 
ādhāre hṛdaye randhre vidyākhaṇḍatrayaṃ smaret | lohitaṃ 
tatprabhāvedhāllohitaṃ ca nijaṃ vapuḥ || (taṃ 5 | 32 ) bhāvayan vāmena 
nāsārandhreṇa pūrayeda mṛtātmanā | smarannambu marut paścād 
dakṣiṇenāpasārayet || evaṃ susādhite paścād dvātriṃśanmātrayāharet 
| dhārayettaccatuṣṣaṣṭyā recayettatturīyataḥ || (taṃ 27 | 68) evaṃ krameṇa 
trīn ṣaṭ dvādaśa ṣoḍaśa viṃśati vā prāṇāyāmān kṛtvā aṃ āṃ 
sauḥ iti karaśuddhiṃ vidhāya | aiṃklīṃsauḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ 
aṃguṣṭhayoḥ | 3 śirase svāhā tarjanyoḥ | 3 śikhāyai vaṣaṭ madhyamayoḥ 
| 3 kavacāya huṃ anāmikayoḥ | 3 netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhikayoḥ | 3 
astrāya phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhayoḥ || 3 hṛdayāya namo hṛdaye | 3 śirase 
svāhā śirasi | 3 śikhāyai vaṣaṭ śikhāyām | 3 kavacāya huṃ kavace | 3 
netratrayāya vauṣaṭ netratraye | 3 astrāya phaḍiti prasāritatalābhyāṃ 
pāṇibhyāṃ tālatrayapūrvakaṃ saśabdaṃ tarjanījyeṣṭhāyogād 
digvidikṣūparyadho madhye vighnahṛdastraṃ nyasediti ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā 
sandhyāvandanaṃ kuryāt | taduktaṃ tantrarāje :

nāthaistattvaiśca nityābhiḥ kālanityā tu vidyayā |
ādhāre hṛdaye śīrṣe vahnau sūrye niśākare || 1 ||

dhyāyaṃstrisandhyaṃ prajapet savarga vyañjanasvaram |
nyasecca mātṛkāsthāne tadā taddehaśuddhaye || 2 ||

p. 316)

iti | viśeṣastu tripurārṇave -

sandhyā caturvidhā jñeyā bālā kaumārayauvanā |
prauḍhā ca niṣkalāceti sandhyā devi prakīrtitā || 1 ||

prātaḥkāle mahādevī vidyā vāgīśvarī matā |
kāmeśvarī ca madhyāhne sāyāhne purabhairavī || 2 ||

madhyarātre mahādevī jñeyā tripurasundarī |

iti | tataḥ svapurato dhenumudrayā jalamamṛtīkṛtya 
mūlenāṣṭavāramabhimantrya tena jalena kuśairakārādikṣakārāntaiḥ 
sabindumātṛkākṣaraiḥ pratyakṣaraṃ svaśiraḥ prokṣya mūlavidyayā 
triḥprokṣya sūryamaṇḍale devīṃ yathoktarūpāṃ dhyātvā dakṣahastena 
jalamādāya laṃvaṃraṃyaṃhaṃ iti mantraiḥ saptavāramabhimantrya 
mūlena ca trivāramabhimantrya tajjalabindubhiraṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ 
mūlavidyayā svaśiraḥ prokṣyāvaśiṣṭajalaṃ vāmahaste nidhāya 
tejorūpaṃ tajjalamiḍayākṛṣya svadehāntaḥsthitaṃ sakalakaluṣaṃ 
prakṣālya tajjalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ piṅgalayā nirgataṃ matvā tajjalaṃ 
punardakṣiṇahaste kṛtvā svavāmabhāge jvalavadvajraśilāṃ dhyātvā oṃ 
ślīṃ paśuhuṃphaṭ iti pāśupatāstreṇa tasyāṃ śilāyāmāsphālya 
hastau prakṣālya mūlavidyayā jalamādāya pravahannāḍyā 
sahasradalakamalagataparamāmṛtenaikībhūtaṃ vibhāvya 
rājadantavivarānnetramārgeṇa nirgamayya tajjalaṃ vāmakare nidhāya tena 
jalena amṛtamālini svāhā iti mantreṇa svaśirastriḥprokṣya hrīṃśrīṃ 
prathamakūṭaṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | 2 dvitīyakūṭaṃ 
vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | 2 tṛtīyakūṭaṃ śivatattvaṃ 
śodhayāmi svāhā | samastavidyāmuccārya sarvatattvaṃ śodhayāmi 
svāhā | evamācamyāñjalinā jalaṃ gṛhītvothāra 2 prathamakūṭaṃ 
vāgīśvaryai vidmahe dvitīyakūṭaṃ kāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tṛtīyakūṭaṃ 
tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt iti trirarghyaṃ dattvā hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ sūrya eṣa 
te'rghaḥ svāhā iti sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā mūlavidyayā devīṃ 
triḥsantarpya hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ sūryaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥsantarpya 
mūlādhāre prathamakūṭaṃ taḍitkoṭisamaprabhaṃ 
mūlādibrahmaradhrāntaṃ sañcintya tattejaḥ suṣumnāvartmanā 
brahmarandhraṃ mītvā vahannāsādhvanākāśasthavahnimaṇḍale 
samāvāhya tattejasa udbhūtāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ dhyāyet :

pītāṃ pītāmbarāṃ pītasragvibhūṣānulepanām |
taḍitkoṭisamābhāsāṃ bālāmakṣasragujjvalām || 1 ||

pustakābjakarāmbhojāṃ vahnipīṭhaniṣeduṣīm |
vāgbhavāṃ vāgbhavaudbhūtāṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ sasmitāṃ smaret || 2 ||

ityākāśasthavahnimaṇḍalāntardhyātvā prathamakūṭaṃ 
tripurāvāgīśvarīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi iti gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya 
vāgbhavagāyatrīmuccārya tripurāvāgīśvaryai arghyaṃ kalpayāmi 
svāhā iti trirarghyāñjalimutkṣipya punaḥ prathamakuṭaṃ 
tripurāvāgīśvarīpādukāṃ tarpayāmīti triḥsantarpyaṃ śrīguruṃ 
praṇamya pūrvavatkaraṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya mātṛkānyāsasthāneṣu 
praṇavatritāramūlavidyātaddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ 2 aṃ namaḥ 
ityādimātṛkāṃ vinyasya pūrvoktagāyatrīṃ yathāśakti japitvā 
vāgbhavagāyatrīṃ japet | aiṃ tripurādevyai vidmahe vāgīśvaryai dhīmahi 
tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt iti japitvā mūlavidyāṃ prātaritthaṃ japet | 
yathā :

prātarmūlādhāragate kamale vahnimaṇḍale |
vāgbījarūpāṃ nityāṃ tāṃ vidyutpaṭalabhāsvarām || 1 ||

puṣpabāṇekṣukodaṇḍapāśāṅkuśalasatkarām |
svecchāgṛhītavapuṣaṃ yuganityākṣarātmikām || 2 ||

ghaṭikāvaraṇopetāṃ paritaḥ prāñjalīnatha |
jñānamudrāvarakarān vāgbhavopāstitatparān || 3 ||

navanāthān smarenmūlapaṅkaje yonimaṇḍale |

iti || ittha sandhyācatuṣṭaye hrīṃśrīṃmūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ 
aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ hrīṃ 
śrīṃprakāśānandarūpiṇīśrīmahātripurasundarīpā0 | prāgvat haṃsaḥ 
ityantamuccārya ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ hrīṃśrīṃ 
vimarśānandarūpi0 | punarhaṃsa ityantamuccārya kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ 
ṅaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ ānandānandarū0 | punastathaivoccārya caṃ chaṃ jaṃ 
jhaṃ ñaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ jñānanandarū0 | punastathaivoccārya ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ 
ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ satyānandarū0 | punastathaiva taṃ thaṃ daṃ 
dhaṃ naṃ hrīṃśrīṃ pūrṇānandarū0 | punastathaiva paṃ phaṃ baṃ 
bhaṃ maṃ hrīṃśrīṃ svabhāvānandarū0 | punastathaivoccārya yaṃ raṃ 
laṃ vaṃ śaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ pratibhānandarū0 | punarapi tathaiva 
ṣaṃsaṃhaṃkṣaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ subhagānandarū0 | iti

p. 317)

iti  navanāthātmakatvena mūlavidyāṃ japet | tatastaddinanityāvidyāṃ 
yathāśakti japet iti kālanityājapaḥ || tato mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ 
mūlavidyāmudyatsūryasahasrasamaprabhāṃ dhyān 
mūlavidyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā bahirākāśasthavahnimaṇḍale 
pūrvoktarūpāṃ vāgbhaveśvarīṃ dhyāyan 
prātarvāgbhavakūṭamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | tataḥ 
prāṇāyāmādipūrvakaṃ kṛtaṃ japaṃ devyai nivedya praṇamya stutvā 
sūryamaṇḍalādvahnimaṇḍalācca mūladevīṃ vāgbhaveśvarīṃ ca 
hṛdaye mūlādhāre ca visṛjya śrīguruṃ praṇamet || iti prātaḥ 
sandhyāvidhiḥ || atha karmakāleṣu gurudhyānamuktaṃ rudrayāmale 
dīkṣākāle yathārūpaṃ svasyānugrahakarmaṇi | dṛṣṭaṃ tattena bhāvena 
dhyāyannāhnikamācaret || iti guroriti śeṣaḥ | etadgurudhyānaṃ 
prātaḥsmaraṇātiriktasthaleṣu jñeyam |

prātaḥsandhyeyamīśāni sarvakarmasu sarvadā |
kartavyā matriṇā nityaṃ mantrasiddhisamṛddhaye || 1 ||

prātaḥsandhyāṃ parityajya devatāpūjanaṃ caret |
aśuddhaḥ sa durācāraḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 2 ||

prātaḥsandhyāṃ parityajya devapūjādikaṃ caret |
homān kṛtvā maheśāni nārakī jāyate naraḥ || 3 ||

prātaḥsandhyāṃ parityajya homaṃ vā tarpaṇaṃ śive |
kurvannakāraṇaṃ viprastyajañ śvā ca bhaveddhruvam || 4 ||

piśāco jāyate devī api vedāṅgapāragaḥ |
sandhyānāmapi sarvāsāṃ prātaḥsandhyā garīyasī || 5 ||

tasmāttāṃ na tyajedviprastyajannarakamāpnuyāt |

iti tripurārṇavavacanādiyamavaśyaṃ kartavyeti śivavacanam | atha 
ghaṭikāpārāyaṇatvena ṣaṣṭijapaṃ kuryāt | sa ca 
pañcabhirdivasairmātṛkāyāḥ ṣaḍāvṛttirūpaḥ || tathā tantrarāje -
(25 | 12)

ārabhya bhānorudayamekaśo ghaṭikākramāt |
ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇāḥ pañcāśad parivṛttitaḥ || 1 ||

iti | sūryodayakāle'kāraḥ udeti | tato 
dvitīyaghaṭikādipañcāśadghaṭikāparyantāsu ghaṭikāsu 
ākārādikṣakārāntā varṇā  visargasvararahitāḥ svasvaghaṭikodayakāle 
samudyanti | tata ekapañcāśattamaghaṭikāmārabhya śiṣṭadaśaghaṭikāsu 
akārādi-ḹkārāntā daśa varṇāḥ svaghaṭikodayakāle samudyanti | 
itthaṃ dvitīyadivase sūryodayakāle ekāra udeti tataḥ svaghaṭikodayakāle 
aikārādyā ekānacatvāriṃśadvarṇāścākārādyāḥ viṃśativargāśca 
samudyanti | tṛīyadivase sūryodaye cakāra udeti tataḥ 
svasvaghaṭikodayakāle chakārādikṣakārāntā (akārādiṇakārāntāśca) 
ekonaṣaṣṭivarṇāḥ samudyanti | caturthadivase sūryodayakāle takāra udeti 
tataḥ (sva) svaghaṭikodayakāle thakārādikṣakārāntā 
akārādimakārāntāśca ekonaṣaṣṭivarṇāḥ samudyanti | pañcamadivase 
sūryodayakāle yakāra udeti tataḥ svasvaghaṭikodayakāle 
yādikṣakārāntā (akārādikṣakārāntā)ścaikonaṣaṣṭivarṇāḥ 
samudyanti | evaṃ pañcabhirdivasairmātṛkāyāḥ ṣaḍāvṛttirbhavati || 
evaṃ krameṇaibhirvarṇairghaṭikāpārāyaṇākhyāḥ ṣaṣṭijapaḥ kāryaḥ || 
tatprakāraḥ pradarśyate - tatrākārādikṣāntāḥ pañcāśadvarṇā 
visargarahitā daśa daśa bhūtvā pañca vargā ata eva tannāmāno bhavanti 
taiḥ ṣaṣṭijapaḥ kārya | tatprakārastu 2 mūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ 
aṃ namaḥ | (evaṃ kṣāntān pañca vargān japtvā punarakārādi 
ḹkārāntaṃ prathamaṃ vargamāvartayet | evaṃ ṣaṣṭijapaḥ | dvitīyadine) 
2 mūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ eṃ0 | evaṃ kṣāntāṃścaturo 
vargānāvartya punarādyadvitīyavargāvāvartayet | evaṃ ṣaṣṭijapaḥ | 
tṛitīyadine 2 mūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ caṃ0 | evaṃ kṣāntāstrīn 
vargān (japtvā punarakārādiṇakārāntān trīn vargā) nāvartayet | evaṃ 
60 | (caturthadine 2 mūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ ṭaṃ0 | evaṃ 
kṣāntau dvau vargau japtvā punaḥ akārādimakārāntān caturo 
vargānāvartayet | eva 60 ) pañcamadine 2 mūlaṃ taddinanityāvidyā 
haṃsaḥ yaṃ0 | evaṃ kṣāntaṃ vargaṃ japitvā 
punarakārādikṣakārāntān pañcāśadvarṇānāvartayet | evaṃ 
ṣaṣṭijapaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍāvṛttayaḥ | tataḥ saṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe dine 
punarakārādita ārabhyoktarītyā ghaṭikāpārāyaṇajapamanavarata kuryāt 
|| atrādhunā vartamānasamaye 
sādhakairjyotiḥśāstroktaprakāreṇāhargaṇena kaliyugasya gatadināni 
jñātvā svakramārambhadinaparyantaṃ gaṇayitvā 
pañcabhirāhṛtyorvaritadinenodayākṣaraṃ jñātvā yasmin dine akāra 
udayākṣaraṃ bhavati tasmin dine ārabhya ghaṭikāpārāyaṇaṃ 
proktakrameṇa kāryamiti ghaṭikāpārāyaṇajapaḥ prātareva kāryaḥ ||

p. 318)

atha madhyandinasandhyā - tatra prāṇāyāmādisūryatarpaṇaparyantaṃ 
prātaḥsandhyāvadeva vidhāaya bījasandhyāṃ kuryāt | tadyathā - tatra 
madhyāhne'nāhatacakre mūlavidyāyāḥ kāmarājakūtaṃ raktavarṇaṃ 
dhyāyet | tattejaḥ suṣumnāmārgeṇa vahannāsāpuṭādhvanā niḥsārya 
sūryamaṇḍale samāvāhya tadudbhūtāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ dhyāyet | yathā

raktāṃ suraktāmbarabhūṣaṇāḍhyāṃ pāśāṃkuśābhītivarān 
dadhānām |
śucismitāmudbhaṭayauvanāḍhyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ saṃsmarata trinetrām || 
1 ||

iti dhyātvā 2 kāmarājakūṭaṃ śrītripurākāmeśvarīpā0 iti triḥ 
sampūjya punaḥ kāmarājakūṭagāyatrīmuccāryaṃ 
śrītripurākāmeśvaryai arghyaṃ kalpayāmi svāhā iti 
trirarghyāñjalimutkṣipya punaḥ kāmarājakūṭamuccārya 
śrītripurākāmeśvarī pādukāṃ tarpayāmi iti triḥsantarpya 
prāṇāyāmādipuraḥsaraṃ pūrvavanmātṛkāṃ vinyasya prāgvat 
turīyavidyāgāyatrīṃ japitvā kāmakūṭagāyatrīṃ japet | sā yathā - 
klīṃ trīpurādevyai vidmahe kāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tannaḥ klinnā 
pracodayāt | iti yathāśakti japitvā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātmakatvena 
mūlavidyāṃ japet || tadyathā :

madhyāhne hṛdayāmbhojakarṇike sūryamaṇḍale |
kāmarājātmikāṃ devīmarkakoṭisamaprabhām || 1 ||

prasūnabāṇapuṇḍrekṣucāpapāśāṅkuśānvitām |
paritaścātmamukhyābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaśaktibhiḥ || 2 ||

raktamālyāmbarālepabhūṣābhiḥ parivāritām |
yuganityākṣaramayīṃ ghaṭikāvaraṇāṃ smaret || 3 ||

puṣpabāṇekṣukodaṇḍadharāḥ śoṇavapurdharāḥ |
hṛtpaṅkaje ca tāḥ kāmarājopāstiparāyaṇāḥ || 4 ||

iti devīṃ dhyātvā 2 mūlavidyā taddinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ aṃ 16 
śivatattvarūpiṇī śrīmahātripurasundasrīpādu0 | 2 mūlaṃ 
dinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ kaṃśaktitattvaṃ0 | 2 mūlaṃ dinanityāvidyā 
haṃsaḥ khaṃsadāśivatattvarū0 | evaṃ gaṃ īśvaratattvarū0 | 
ghaṃśuddhavidyātattvarū0 | ṅaṃmāyātattvarū0 | caṃkalātattvarū0 |

atha sāyaṃsandhyāvidhiḥ - tatra prāṇāyāmādisūryatarpaṇāntaṃ 
prāgvadvidhāya bījasandhyāṃ kuryāt | sāyamājñācakre hakṣākhye 
candramaṇḍale mūlavidyāyātṛtīyakūṭamuccārya tripurāmṛteśvarīpā0 
iti gandhādibhistriḥ sampūjya vakṣyamāṇatārtīyakūṭagāyatrīmuccārya 
śrītripurāmṛteśvaryai arghya kalpayāmi svāhā iti trirarghyaṃ dattvā 
punastārtīyakūṭamuccārya śrītripurāmṛteśvarīṃ tarpayāmi iti 
triḥsantarpya prāṇāyāmādipūrvikāṃ turīyavidyāgāyatrīṃ 
prāgvajjaptvā śaktikūṭagāyatrīṃ japet || yathā-  2 sauḥ tripurādevyai 
vidmahe śaktikāmeśvaryai dhīmahi tanno'mṛtā pracodayāt | iti 
śaktigāyatrīmaṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ japitvā sāyāhne 
ṣoḍaśanityātmakatvena mūlavidyāṃ japet tadyathā :

sāyamājñāsarojasthacandre candrasamadyutim |
śaktibījātmikāṃ cāpavāṇapāśāṃkuśānvitām || 1 ||

yuganityākṣarāṃ devīṃ ghaṭikāvaraṇāṃ parām |
cintayitvā bhagavatīṃ nityābhiḥ parivāritām || 2 ||

pustakaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca dadhānāṃ smeravaktrakāḥ |
nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa cājñāyā.ṃ sāyaṃkāle tu saṃsmaret || 3 ||

iti devīṃ dhyātvā (1) 2 mūlaṃ dinanityāvidyā haṃsaḥ

iti ṣoḍaśanityātmakatvena japitvā prāgvat kālanityāvidyāṃ ca japitvā 
bhrūmadhyādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ tṛitīyakūṭaṃ śaraccandrakoṭinibhaṃ 
dhyāyannaṣṭottaraśataṃ tārtīyakūṭaṃ japet | tataḥ 
prāṇāyāmapūrvakaṃ japaṃ samarpya stutvā devīṃ praṇamya 
sūryamaṇḍalasthamūladevīmamṛteśvarīṃ hṛdi bhrūmadhye ca visṛjet || 
iti sāyaṃsandhyāvidhiḥ ||

tato'rdharātre turīyasandhyāmupāsīt | sāyaṃ yathārkamaṇḍale 
devīdhyānaṃ vinā prāṇāyāmādyācamanaparyantaṃ pūrvavadvidhāya 
sahasrārakamale turīyakūṭaṃ mūlavidyātrayodaśākṣararūpaṃ 
padmarāgasamaprabhaṃ dhyātvā vahannāsāpuṭena 
tārakamaṇḍalādvahiḥ paramākāśe samāvāhya tadudbhūtāṃ 
bhagavatīṃ yathoktarūpāṃ dhyāyan turīyakūṭamuccārya 
śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai arghyaṃ kalpayāmisvāheti trirarghyaṃ 
datvā punasturīyakūṭamuccārya śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāṃ 
santarpayāmiti triḥ santarpya prāṇāyāmādipūrvakaṃ prāguktāṃ 
turīyagāyatrīṃ yathāśakti japitvā kālanityāvidyāmaṣṭottaraśatavāra 
japitvā prāṇāyāmādipūrvakaṃ japaṃ samampya devīṃ stutvā 
paramākāśāt sahasradalakamalakarṇikāyāmudvāsya 
kāmakalārūpamātmānaṃ dhyāyet || iti tūrīyasandhyāvidhiḥ ||

etatsandhyācatuṣṭayopāsanametadvidyopāsakānāmāvaśyakam | 
tatrāpyaśaktau dhyānarūpamevārdharātrasandhyopāsanaṃ kāryamiti | 
akṛte dvitīyadine prāyaścittārthamaṣṭotaraśataṃ mūlavidyāṃ japitvā 
punaḥ karma kartumadhikārī bhavati iti śivaśāsanam ||

snānasandhyārcanālope japedaṣṭottaraṃ śata miti tantrarājavacanāt | 
japenmūlavidyāmiti śeṣaḥ | atra 

sandhyālopo na kartavyaḥ śambhorājñaivameva hi |
dīkṣitaḥ sandhyayā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnute || 1 ||

iti vacanāt sandhyācatuṣṭayaṃ sādhakairavaśyaṃ kartavyamiti | atra 
pramādātsandhyālopo yadi bhavati tadā tvanyasandhyāsamaye 
proktaprāyaścittapūrvakaṃ pūrvasandhyākriyāṃ vidhāya 
tatkālasandhyāṃ kuryāt || uktaṃ ca tripurārṇave :

saṃdhyāhīno'nyasaṃdhyāyāṃ pūrvasaṃdhyākriyāmatha |
vidhāyottarasaṃdhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryat samāhitaḥ || 1 ||

iti | sandhyāvandanānantara pitrāditarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | tatra 
prāṇāyāmatramṛṣyādinyāsapūrvakaṃ svapurato jale 
pūrvavattīrthamāvāhya vamiti dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya 
mūlenāṣṭavāramabhimantrya tatra śrīcakraṃ vibhāvya tanmadhye 
vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa pīṭhapūjāpuraḥsaraṃ devīmāvāhya 
ṣoḍaśopacārairjale devīṃ sampūjya 
vakṣyamāṇavidhināṅgāvaraṇadevatā sampūjya 2 mūlavidyāmuccārya 
śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāṃ tarpayāmītyaṣṭottaraśataṃ 
tadardhamaṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ vā yathāśakti tattīrthajalaiḥ 
paradevatāmukhakamale paramāmṛtabuddhvā saṃtarpyāvaraṇadevatā 
yathākramaṃ pūjoktamantraiḥ pūjayāmīti sthāne 
tarpayāmītyantairekaikāñjalinā tarpayet | tadaśaktau 
vaṭukādicatuṣṭayaṣaḍaṅgayuvatī gurupaṃktitraya saptadaśanityābhiḥ 
sahitāṃ caturasravṛṭtopetatrikoṇamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ 
sāyudhatrikoṇāvaraṇaśaktiyutāṃ mūladevīṃ tarpayet | tatrāpyaśaktau 
saṃskṛte jale devīṃ dhyātvā sampūjya devīmeva

|| padmāsanaḥ prāgvadanaḥ prāṇānāyamya saṃyataḥ | (taṃ0 5 |19) iti |

gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyatāmbūlārcanāstotrasvātmanirūpa (veda)

prākproktaprakāreṇa śaivāṣṭatriṃśatkalā

bhāvayan kalaśapātraṃ śaktyaṣṭagandhaiḥ

niḥkṣipya puṣpamālābhiḥ saṃveṣṭya tadupari śrīcakraṃ

athārghyasthāpanam - tatra trilohakā ca mṛtpātrebhyo'nyatamaṃ pātraṃ 
svapurataḥ sādhāraṃ 
saṃsthāpyāmbubhirāpūryādhārapātrāmbuṣvagnisūryasomātmaka-
tvaṃ sañcintya vidyākhaṇḍatrayātmakamaṣṭātriṃśatkalātmakatvaṃ 
jñātvāmbuni rocanācandrakāśmīralaghukastūrikāḥ krameṇa 
pṛthivyādibhūtātmikā matvā kṣiptvā tārtīyena dhenumudrāṃ 
yonimudrāṃ ca pradarśya tatra śrīcakraṃ dhyātvārghyasya samīranir-ṛti 
īśānavahnikoṇeṣu madhye paścimādyanulomena caturdikṣu 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrairdaśadaśavāramadhyarcya 
ṣoḍaśavidyānityābhiścaikaikavāraṃtārtīyena daśavāraṃ dinanityayā 
ca trivāraṃ japitvābhyarcya tenārghyavāriṇa vidyayā 
svātmapūjopakaraṇānyaśeṣaṃ prokṣayedityarghyaṃ vidhāya nyāsān 
kuryāt | tata uktarītyā prāṇānāyamya aṃ āṃ sauḥ iti vidyayā 
vāmadakṣiṇakarapṛṣṭhayoranyonyamārjanāt karaśuddhiṃ krtvā 
pādayoḥ 2 hrīṃklīṃsauḥ devyātmāsanāya namaḥ | jaṅghayoḥ 2 
haiṃhklīṃhsauḥ | cakrāsanāya namaḥ | jānvoḥ 2 hsaiṃ hsaklīṃ hsauḥ 
sarvamantrāsanāya namaḥ | liṅge 2 hrīṃklīṃbleṃ sādhyasiddhāsanāya 
namaḥ iti caturāsananyāsaṃ kṛtvā kulasundarīvidyayā dvirāvṛtyā 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kṛtvā prāgvadvaśinyādi aṣṭavāgdevatānyāsaṃ 
kuryāt | tato mūlādyaṣaḍaṅgena (dyena) mūrdhādihṛdantaṃ 
mūlāpareṇa hṛdādiprapadāntaṃ mūlāntena 
prapadādihṛdantamañjalinā vyāpakaṃ kuryāt | iti nyāsāḥ ||

p. 321)

tataḥ kalaśopari svatantroktaśrīyantraṃ vibhāvya vaindave hrīṃśrīṃsauḥ 
iti śaktyutthāpanamudrayā mūrti parikalpya hsraiṃ hsakalarīṃ hsrauḥ 
(ssrauḥ) namaḥ iti puṣpagarbhāṃ trikhaṇḍāṃ mudrāṃ baddhvā tasyāṃ 
mūlahṛnmūrdhasu (mūla?) vahnisūryasomātmakatvānusandhānarūpayā 
tripurāmudrayā tattejastrayarūpiṇīṃ devatāṃ vahannāsāpuṭena 
svāntādānīya kalpitamūrtāvāvāhya sāvaraṇāṃ dhyāyet :

lohitāṃ lalitāṃ vāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥ |
dadhānāṃ kāmarājāṅke yantritāṃ muditāṃ smaret || 1 ||

hāragraiveyaratnādimudrikānūpurānvitām |
navaratnamayaiścitraiḥ stavakaiścopaśobhitām || 2 ||

valayairaṅgadai ratnamayairapyaṃgulīyakaiḥ |
virājamānāṃ tāṃ divyāṃ divyāṃśukavidhāriṇīm || 3 ||

śucismitāṃ śaktivṛndagītākarṇanananditām |
sahajāsavasaṃbhogaiḥ sañjātānandavigrahām || 4||

dayāmadāt prāgapāṅgaparipālitasādhakām |
parito bhūṣaṇaiścitraiḥ kārṣṇacāmarakādibhiḥ || 5 ||

virājamānān dviradānaśvānapi tathāvidhān |
śaktibhirdarśitānagre paśyantīmabhitotsavām || 6 ||

svasamānāmitodāranityābhiḥ sevitāṃ parām |
madhyapradhānadevyāstu samullāsātmakatvataḥ || 7 ||

navāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ dhyānaṃ devyā samaṃ bhavet |
kāmāṅkayantrādanyatra bhūṣāvarṇāyudhādikam || 8 ||

tatsamaṃ parameśāni cakrasthānāmaśeṣataḥ | (taṃ 04 | 65)

iti | tataḥ sthāpanī sannirodhinī avaguṇṭhanī sannidhāpanīti 
mudrācatuṣkaṃ tārtīyena pradarśya sarvasaṃkṣobhinyādimudrānavakaṃ 
hetimudrācatuṣkaṃ ca pradarśya devīmupacāraiḥ samarcayet | 
tārtīyadinanityābhyāṃ pādyārghyācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca | 
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau naivedyācamanaṃ punaḥ | 
tāmbūlamarcanā stotraṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca namaskriyām || (taṃ0 5 | 3) iti 
ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ śrīmahātripurasundarīpādukāyai pādyaṃ 
parikalpayāmiti krameṇa kuryāt | kṣaudradugdhanārikelāmbuphalādibhiḥ 
kuryāt | viśeṣastu arghaṃ svāhā ācamanīyaṃ svadhā ityādi | puṣpāṇi 
vauṣaḍiti | tato'nujñāṃ labdhvā parivārārcanaṃ kuryāt | tatra devī 
pṛṣṭhabhāge trikoṇādbahirantarāle devīvāmabhāgādidakṣabhāgāntaṃ 
paṃktyupaviṣṭāṃstrīn devyavekṣiṇīdevīrupān  
divyasiddhamānavākhyān navanāthān pūjayet | yathā hrīṃśrīṃ 
prakāśānandaśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmītyādikrameṇa pūjayet | tato 
devīmūrtau tanmayīstadrūpāḥ pañcadaśatithinityāḥ pūjayet | 
hrīṃśrīṃ kāmeśvarīnityāvidyāmuccārya kāmeśvarīnityāpādukāṃ 
pūjayāmītyādikrameṇa tithinityāḥ pūjayet || athāvaraṇapūjā tatra

p. 323)

2 kāmarājakūṭaṃ pūrṇagiripīṭhe vajreśvarīdevīpā0 | śaktikūṭaṃ 
jālandharapīṭhe bhagamālinīdevīpā0 | iti sampūjya kāmeśvaryagre 2 
mūlaṃ tripurāmbācakreśvarīnityāpā0 | iti cakreśvarīṃ sampūjya 2 
mūlaṃ etāḥ parāpararahasyayoginyaḥ sarvasiddhiprade cakre pūjāṃ 
gṛhṇantu iti tasyā vāmahaste nivedya hsauṃ iti bījamudrāṃ pradarśayet || 
ityaṣṭamāvaraṇapūjā || 8 ||

tato bindusthāne - 2 mūlaṃ uḍyānapīṭhe śrīmahātripurasundarīdevīpā0 
iti sampūjya 2 mahātripurasundarīcakreśvarīnityāpā0 iti cakreśvarīṃ 
sampūjya 2 eṣā atirahasyayoginī sarvānandamaye cakre pūjāṃ gṛhṇātu 
iti tasyā vāmahaste nivedya aimiti sarvamahāyonimudrāṃ pradarśayet || iti 
navamāvaraṇapūjā || 9 ||

tataḥ punarapi prasannapūjātvena ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ punarārādhya 
saṃkṣobhaṇyādimudrāḥ pradarśya 
devatāgurusvātmanāmaikyasiddhikaraṇabhāvanāyogapūrvakaṃ mūlaṃ 
daśadhā japet | tadbhāvanā tu - mūlakhaṇḍatrayamapi tuyasvarāvasānaṃ 
kṛtvā tatsvarasya ca bindutrayaṃ matvā tadūrdhve bindunā devyā 
vadanaṃ bhāvayan tadadhaḥsthabindudvayena devyāḥ kucayugaṃ 
bhāvayan taccheṣārdhamātrayāśeṣāṅgāni devyā bhāvayan devatāyā 
mantrātmakatvaṃ gurorapi mantrātmakatvaṃ bhāvayannātmanaśca 
sarvātmakatvam | etena trayāṇāṃ 
mantrātmakatvatritayātmakatvabhāvanā phalitasarvaikyabhāvanārūpā | 
tataḥ svātmānaṃ devatārūpaṃ smaran svātmani tāḥ 
pañcadaśanityāstattadvidyābhirabhyarcya 
pañcabhūtamantrairātmānamabhyarcayet |

yathā - 2 a ā ekacaṭatapayaṣaprāṇaśaktipādukāṃ pūjayāmi | i ī 
aikhachaṭhathapharakṣa agniśaktipā0 | 2 u ū ogajaḍadabalabhūmiśaktipā0 
| 2 ṛ-ṝ aughajhaḍhadhabhavasa-ambuśaktipā0 | 2 ḷ ḹ aṃṅa 
ñaṇanamaśahasvaśaktipā0 | 2 tato oṃ hrīṃhaṃsaḥ so'haṃ svāhā 
ityātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇātmānamabhyarcyātmani prapañcena 
yāgabhāvanāṃ kṛtvā svatantroktamādyopāntaṃ yonimudrābandhanaṃ 
kṛtvā mantravīryayojanaṃ ca kṛtvā pūrvoktabhāvanāpūrvaṃ 
svatantroktaṃ mantrārthacintanaṃ kurvan svatantroktamālayā sahasraṃ 
śataṃ vā taddinajapasaṃkhyaṃ vā mūlamantraṃ japet || tataḥ 
kiñcitkālaṃ śaktyutthāpanamudrāṃ baddhvā mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ 
kṛtvābhyarcya nityahomaṃ kuryāt | tata ācāryakuṇḍe tatrārghyāmbunā 
tārtīyadinanityābhyāṃ kuśaiḥ rekhāścatasraḥ prāgagrā udgagrāśca 
saṃlikhet | tanmadhyekoṣṭhe tābhyāṃ vahnimādhāya kravyādebhyo 
namaḥ ityaṅgāraśakalaṃ dakṣiṇadiśyapāsya tābhyāṃ prādakṣiṇyena 
bhrāmayitvāmbunā pariṣicya tābhyāṃ caturdikṣu 
prāgagrairudagagraiśca kuśaiḥ paristīrya vahniṃ prajvālya 
javālinīmudrāṃ pradarśya devīrūpaṃ vibhāvya hrīṃśrīṃ-agnaye 
namaḥ ityabhyarcya hrīṃśrīṃhiraṇyāyai namaḥ ityādibhistadā 
jihvāmantrairabhyarcya hiraṇyā kanakā raktā iti 
dakṣiṇavaktrasthajihvānāṃ suprabhātiraktā bahurūpā iti 
tadvāmavaktrasthajihvānāṃ ca smaraṇapūrvakaṃ pratyekaṃ tāsu 
krameṇa navanava ghṛtāhutīrhutvā  tārtīyadinanityābhyāṃ hutvā 
bahurūpājihvāsmaraṇapūrvakaṃ tasyāṃ 
mṛgohaṃsīsūkaroṣvanyatamayā 
mudrayānnapāyasatilataṇḍuladravyeṣvanyatamadravyeṇa pūjākrmeṇaiva 
hutvā taddinanityayātmāṣṭākṣareṇa bhūtamantraiśca juhuyāt | tato 
mūlena sahasrāhutīrhutvā hutasaṃkhyaṃ mūlaṃ japet | tata ṛtvijaḥ 
svasvakuṇḍeṣu ācāryakuṇḍādagniṃ gṛhītvā saṃskṛteṣvaṣṭasvagniṃ 
prajvālya prāguktamantrairjuhuyurhutasaṃkhyākajapaṃ ca kuryuḥ | 
śāntipāṭhakā dvārapālakāśca nityākacanaṃ paṭheyuḥ | 
maṇḍapapūjā tu prāgevoktā | tato 
gururmadhyatrikoṇasthaṣoḍaśakalaśeṣu sarvamadhyasthakalaśe lalitāṃ 
pañcadaśakalaśeṣu pañcadaśa nityāḥ tu (pūjayet |) evaṃ 
ṣoḍaśīkṛtasthānasthitaṣoḍaśakalaśeṣu pūjākramo boddhavyaḥ | tāni 
sthānāni caturasrarekhātrayāntarālagatavīthidvaye siddhidaśakasthāneṣu 
brāhmyādyaṣṭakasthāneṣu ṣoḍaśadaleṣu āyudhāṣṭakapūjāsthāneṣu 
caturdaśadvidaśāṣṭāracakracatuṣṭayagatadvicatvāriṃśattrikoṇeṣu 
pañcanavatisaṃkhyeṣu śrīcakragatāṣṭāradevatāpūjāsthānatrikoṇeṣu 
pratitrikoṇaṃ rekhātraye'pi pratirekhaṃ samāntarālāni trīṇi trīṇi 
cihnāni kṛtvā teṣu cihnāccihnamiti krameṇa navatiryagrekhābhiḥ 
ṣoḍaśīkṛtatrikoṇeṣu ṣaṇṇavatitrikoṇagarbhagateṣu 
pañcatriṃśadadhikasārdhasahasrasaṃkhyākeṣu trikoṇeṣu 
sthāpitatāvatsaṃkhyākakalaśeṣu jalapūrṇeṣu vastrayugmaveṣṭiteṣu 
pañcaratnapañcapallava saptamṛttikācandanapuṣpayuteṣu devatā āvāhya 
sarvopacāraiḥ sampūjya madhyamakumbhaṃ spṛśan 
vakṣyamāṇaṣaṭtriṃśaduttarasaptaśatādhikaviṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākāḥ 
kālanityāvidyāḥ pūjayet || tāstu śrītantrarāje - (25 | 1)

p. 324)

atha ṣoḍaśanityānāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvavigrahaiḥ |
varṇaistajjanitairmantrairyantraiḥ kālātmatāṃ kramāt || 1 ||

kathayāmi prayogāṃśca nānābhīṣṭāptikārakān |
yajjñānopāstibhedābhyāṃ mantrāḥ siddhyanti varṇinaḥ || 2 ||

svarāḥ ṣoḍaśa nityāḥ syuḥ kādikṣāntāḥ svarānvitāḥ |
te tu tattvāni ṣaṭtriśadvargā nāthā navātmakāḥ ||

iti | atra ṣoḍaśasvarātmakatvena akārastvekaṃ vyañjanaṃ 
kakārādipañcatriṃśadvyañjanāni sambhūya ṣaṭtriṃśadvyañjanāni 
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvarūpāṇītyarthaḥ || athaikapañcāśadakṣarāṇāṃ tu 
vargavibhāgamāha 

aṣṭāvaṣṭau svare vargaḥ parataḥ pañca pañca ca |
mātṝṇāṃ tu svaraireko vargaḥ pūrvavaduttaram || 4 ||

iti | atra svarāṇāṃ tu aṣṭāvaṣṭau krameṇa vargadvayaṃ 
kakārādipañcatriṃśadvarṇāḥ pañcapañcavibhāgena sapta vargāḥ (ete 
nava vargā navanāthānāmityarthaḥ | brāhmyādyaṣṭamātṝṇāṃ 
vargāstu - ṣoḍaśasvarāṇāmeko vargaḥ uttara pūrvavat | kādīnāṃ sapta 
vargāḥ |) ete'ṣṭau vargā aṣṭamātṛṇāmityarthaḥ || 
pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇakramamāha :

nityānāṃ tattvasaṃyoge varṇasaṃkhyā samīritā |
ṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ tāvadabdaistu pūrṇatā || 5 ||

iti | nityānāṃ ṣoḍaśasvarāṇāṃ tattvasaṃyogāt 
ṣaṭtriṃśadvyañjanasaṃyogāt (576) | atra vyañjanātmakasyākārasya 
ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyogena a-ā-i-ī u-ū-ṛ-ṝ ḷḹ e-ai o au aṃ aḥ iti ṣoḍaśa 
jātāḥ | evaṃ kakārasya ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyogena kakākikī kukūkṛkṝ 
kḷkḹ kekai kokaukaṃkaḥ | evamanyeṣāmakṣarāṇāṃ khakārādīnāṃ 
kṣakārāntānāṃ ṣoḍaśasvarayogaḥ kartavya | tena 
ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatavarṇāḥ (576) pūrṇamaṇḍalākhyā bhavanti || 
tathā :

pūrṇakālasamāvṛttiryugaparyāyanāmabhāk |
trisahasrasamāvṛttyā proktā kṛtayugāvadhiḥ || 6 ||

tasya turyāṃśaturyāṃśahānyā tretādisaṃbhavaḥ |
māyādharāgnivātasvaiḥ kṛtādyarṇāḥ samīritāḥ || 7 ||

tān dinākṣarasaṃyuktān madhyayonau samālikhet |
dinārṇeṣu svarā nyāse bindurūpā anukramāt || 8 ||

vāmordhvadakṣapārśvaṣu pañca pañca samīritāḥ |
tattadyugārṇāṃstatsthāne svarūpeṇa vyavasthitāḥ || 9 ||

vyañjaneṣu tu sarvatra suśliṣṭāḥ svena saṃyutāḥ |
sarvatra yantravinyāsapratiṣṭhārcādyanugrahe || 10 ||

nigrahe vāstuvinyāse garbhanyāseṣṭasiddhikṛt |
ārabhya bhānorudayamekaśo ghaṭikākramāt || 11 ||

ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇapañcāśatparivṛttitaḥ |
divasaiḥ pañcabhistasyāḥ ṣaḍāvṛttirudīritā || 12 ||

evaṃ yugādimārabhya kālo'rṇātmā pravartate |
yonau trikoṇamālikhya tasmin yoniṃ samālikhet || 13 ||

teṣu paryāyanityārṇavarṇānālikhya vāhyataḥ |
yugārṇaṃ ghaṭikārṇena madhye vinyasya tatra vai || 14 ||

nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa deveśi pūjayennityamarcakaḥ |
uttamā nityanityaṃ hi madhyamā parvaparvaṇi || 15 ||

adhamā māsamātreṇa māsādūrdhvamayogyatā ||
pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syuḥ prathame tvāditaḥ kramāt || 16 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśattattvavarṇāstaddvitīyā marutā kramāt |
tṛtīyā sarvato vahnirevaṃ vidyāstu tryakṣarāḥ || 17 ||

traipurāḥ sarvasiddhīnāmākarāḥ kathitāḥ kramāt |
etāḥ pustakamāropya pīṭhe saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 18 ||

yatra tatra gadālakṣmīgrahadurbhikṣaśatravaḥ |
bhūtāpamṛtyukṛtyādyā na bhavanti purādike || 19 ||

abhīpsitāni siddhyanti tasya yo'rcati nityaśaḥ |
saṣaṭtriṃśatsaptaśataṃ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ || 20 ||

tāsāṃ saṃkhyā samākhyātā tadāvṛttistadāptikṛt |
stambhanādyeṣu tadvarṇāstadrūpā hetivāhanaiḥ || 21 ||

etairgrathitajāpena mantrāḥ sidhyanti varṇinaḥ |
nāthāvṛttirmantrarāśau dvisahasraṃ śatatrayam || 22 ||

catvāri ceti vijñeyāstattvāvṛttirudīritā |
pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyayaiva nityāvṛttiḥ sahasrataḥ || 23 ||

dviśataṃ ṣaṇavatyagrā niḥśeṣaṃ samudīritā |

iti | etadagre prapañcayiṣyāmaḥ | prakṛte prakhyātaghaṭasya 
saṣaṭtriṃśatsaptaśatottaraviṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākakālanityāvidyābhira
bhimantraṇamuktaṃ tāḥ kālanityāvidyā tripurārṇavādigrantheṣu 
proktāstāstu śrītantrarāje'pi sūcitaḥ || tantra rājoktā atra uddhriyante |

p. 325)

yathā - akārādikṣakārāntāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvavarṇāḥ 
ṣoḍaśanityātmabhiḥ ṣoḍaśasvaraiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃyojitāḥ 
ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyākāḥ pūrṇamaṇḍalākhyā bhavanti | 
kālanityāvidyānāṃ prāguktasaṃkhyānāmekaiko varṇaḥ 
ṣaṭtriṃśadvidyānāmādivarṇa iti sarve varṇā vāgbhavākhyā bhavanti || 
prāguktaṣaṭtriṃśattattvavarṇāstu sarvāsāṃ vidyānāmākāreṇa 
kṛtasandhikāḥ punaḥ punaḥ krameṇa kāmarājādyā dvitīyavarṇā 
bhavanti | īkārastu sarvāsāṃ vidyānāṃ śaktikūṭākhyastṛtīyavarṇo 
bhavanti ||

athaitā vidyāḥ krameṇa pārāyaṇajapaparipāṭyaiva pradarśyante | tatra 
sādhako mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā adyehetyādi0 
kariṣyamāṇapūrṇābhiṣekākhye karmaṇi 
ṣaṭtriṃśaduttarasaptaśatādhikaviṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākakālanityā-
vidyābhiḥ pūrṇakalaśābhimantraṇaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya 
mastakadakṣabāhumūlādiṣaṭtriṃśatsthāneṣu pratisthānaṃ 
ṣoḍaśadalapadmaṃ vibhāvya teṣvakārādikṣakārāntān 
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvarṇān pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktān vibhāvya 
madhye tatprathamākṣaraṃ vinyasya pūrvādidaleṣu 
tattadakṣaravikṛtaṣoḍaśavarṇāṃstadādikān vinyasediti | evaṃ 
pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇān vinyasya punaḥ sahitanityāvidyayā 
sahitamūlavidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā śirasi dakṣiṇāmūrtaye 
ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe paṃkticchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye kālanityā 
vidyārūpiṇyai śrīmahātripurasundaryai devatāyai namaḥ iti ṛṣyādikaṃ 
vinyasya pūrṇakalaśābhimantraṇe viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliruktvā 
tattaddinanityāvidyākṣaraistribhirdvirāvṛttyā yathāvidhi 
karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ prākproktacaturāsananyāsaṃ 
vāgdevatāṣṭakanyāsaṃ ca vidhāya raktāṃ raktāmbarāṃ 
raktasragvibhūṣānulepanām | 
pāśāṃkuśekṣukodaṇḍaprasūnaviśikhāṃ smaret iti kālanityāṃ 
hṛdaye dhyātvā vakṣyamāṇavidhinā hṛdaye śrīcakraṃ 
kālacakramadhyagataṃ vibhāvya tatra devīṃ sāvaraṇāṃ 
kālanityāvidyābhiśca parivṛtāṃ dhyātvā mānasairupacāraiḥ sampūjya 
kālanityājapamārabhet || tatrādāvaṅgavidyāstripurāṇavoktāḥ procyante

ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyāko (576) japo bhavati | mūlavidyāyā 
atra pārāyaṇe prathamaṃ taddinayugākṣarāt 
ṣoḍaśasvarabhinnādutpannaṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatavidyābhiḥ saha 
(576)mūlavidyāṃ japitvā 
paścāttaddinākṣarajanitavidyābhistāvatsaṃkhyābhiḥ saha proktakrameṇa 
mūlavidyāṃ japet | yugākṣaradinākṣare tu tattaddinavidyāyāḥ 
prathamākṣaraṃ dvitīyākṣaraṃ vā boddhavyam | 
yugākṣarotthavidyājape viśeṣastu yasmin yuge yatsvarayutaṃ yugākṣaraṃ 
bhavati tatsvaramārabhya pratisvaraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkrameṇa 
tadvisargāntimavidyāparyantaṃ japitvā punastadakṣarasya 
prathamasvaramārabhya ārabdhasvarasya pūrvasvarāntimavidyāvadhi japet | 
tadā mūlavidyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyāko japo bhavati | 
atra yuga ..... ṣaṭtriṃśaddinātmako japo bhavati (?) | 
prāguktapūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇeṣu 
ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyākeṣvekaikasyākṣarasyaikaikayugaṃ 
prati yugākṣaratvaṃ bhavati | etatsarvaṃ gurutaḥ śāstrataśca 
samyagvijñāya pārāyaṇajapaḥ kāryaḥ | evaṃ 
dvipañcāśaduttaraikādaśaśata (1152) saṃkhyāko japo bhavati | 
mūlavidyāyā aṅgavidyājapastvekaikavargādāvekanavatisaṃkhyākaḥ 
tena vargadvayādau japād dvaśotyuttaraśata (182) saṃkhyāko bhavati | 
kevalamūlavidyājapo'pi vāracatuṣṭayaṃ tristrirāvṛttyā dvādaśadhā 
bhavati sambhūya ṣaṭcatvāriṃśatādhikasahasrasaṃkhyāko (1046) japo 
bhavati | mūlavidyāyāḥ evamuktasaṃkhyākaṃ japamuktavidhinā kṛtvā 
punaḥ kevalāṃ mūlavidyāṃ trirjapitvā prāguktadīpinīvidyāṃ 
gurupādukāvidyāṃ ca sakṛt sakṛjjapitvā ḍaralakasahaiṃ hasakalaḍīṃ 
sahakalaraḍau namaḥ ityuttīrṇavidyāṃ sakṛjjapitvā mama 
sakalamanorathān sādhaya sādhaya tubhyaṃ namaḥ iti prārthanīvidyāṃ 
sakṛt kṛtāñjalirjapet | iti vargadvayasyāpyante boddhavyam | 
evamaṅgavidyājapamūlamantrajapādikaṃ pārāyaṇe praśastam | 
kumbhābhimantraṇādau tu kevalakālanityā evāvartanīyāḥ dinato 
vārataḥ pakṣādityādinā tatraivoktatvāt bahudinasādhye'pyatrāpi 
prāśastyam | dinatrayadinacatuṣṭayasādhye tu kevalā eveti tu sampradāyaḥ 
| tato vargānte idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā dvitīyavargārambhā vidheyaḥ | 
yathā tripurārṇave

kṣmāmbvagrīraṇakhārkenduyaṣṭṭaprāyayugasvaraiḥ |
mātṛbhairavagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 1 ||

kādivargāṣṭakākārasamastāṣṭakavigrahām |
aṣṭaśaktyāvṛtāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 2 ||

p. 328)

svaraṣoḍaśakānāṃ tu ṣaṭtriṃśadbhiḥ parāparaiḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 3 ||

ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṃsthāpyaśivacandrakalāsvapi |
kāditattvāntarāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 4 ||

ā-imāyādvayopādhivicitrendukalāvatīm |
sarvātmikāṃ parāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 5 ||

ṣaḍadhvapiṇḍayonisthāṃ maṇḍalatrayakuṇḍalīm |
liṅgatrayātigāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 6 ||

svayambhūhṛdayāṃ bāṇabhrūkāmāntaḥ sthitetarām |
prācyāṃ pratyakcitiṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 7 ||

akṣarāntargatāśiṣanāmarūpāṃ kriyāṃ parām |
śaktiṃ viśveśvarīṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm || 8 ||

vargānte paṭhitavyaṃ syāt stotrametatsamāhitaiḥ |

dinato vārataḥ pakṣānmāsāt ṣaṭtriṃśatā dinaiḥ |
japanto vāramekaṃ tu vidyā nityātmikāstutāḥ || 1 ||

āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vijayaṃ vāñchitaṃ kramāt |
labhante lalitā yābhiḥ saṃpradāyavatī bhavet || 2 ||

ekasmin divase tvekavārāvṛttau vidhistvayam |
madhyāhne tu samārabhya madhyarātrau samāpayet || 3 ||

vāreṣu caikadā jāpe prathamai ravivārake |
vaśinyāḥ prathamaṃ varga kāmeśvaryā dvitīyamkam || 4 ||

p. 329)

japtvā vargadvayaṃ mantrī somavārādiṣaṭsvapi |
dineṣu modinīvargādekaikaṃ prajapet sudhīḥ || 5 ||

pakṣe'pi caikadā jāpe prathamāditithiṣvatha |
paṃktidvayasthā vidyāstu prajapet prativāsaram || 6 ||

pañcamīdaśamīpañcadaśīṣu tithiṣu kramāt |
pūrṇāsu prajapedvidyāścatuṣpaṃktibhavāḥ sudhiḥ || 7 ||

māse pratidine vidvānevaṃ pūrṇā bhavanti tāḥ |
naitābhiḥ sadṛśī kāpi vidyā lokeṣu vidyate || 8 ||

tasmādābhirupāyaistaiḥ sādhayet sarvamīpsitam |
yadyannijopsitaṃ tattadduḥkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavet || 9 ||

japatarpaṇahomārcāsekaiḥ saṃsādhayet sthiraḥ | 
pañcāśadvāramāvartya vidyā bhaktisamanvitaḥ || 10 ||

mucyate nigaḍaiḥ kṛcchairvairirodhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
śatavāraṃ samāvartya vidyāvibhavavaibhavāḥ || 11 ||

labhante tanayān vandhyā api sarvaguṇānvitān |
adhyardhaśatavāraṃ tu vidyā āvartya bhaktitaḥ || 12 ||

gṛṇarūpādisaṃpannā bhāryāṃ vidantyayatnataḥ |
tāvadāvartya kanyā vā patiṃ sarvaguṇānvitam || 13 ||

labhante putrapautrādyairedhantesaṃpadānvitāḥ |
dviśataṃ tāḥ samāvartya dāridryānmucyate dhruvam || 14 ||

triśatairbhūmiśasyāḍhyaścaturbhiśca śatairdhanī |
pañcabhiśca śatairbhūpo bhavet ṣaḍbhiḥ śatairnṛpaḥ || 15 ||

saptabhistu śataistasya na muñcatyanvayaṃ ramā |
aṣṭabhistu śataistāsāṃ nṛpāḥ sarve'tha kiṃkarāḥ || 16 ||

navabhistu śatairevaṃ kandarpo vanitājane |
evaṃ navaśataṃ japtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 17 ||

samastabhajanaṃ tāsāmuktaṃ sarvārthasiddhidm |

iti | eteṣāṃ ślokānāṃ viṣamapadavyākhyā - dinata iti 
sārdhadvayaślokaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | ekavārāvṛtau 
ṣaṭtriṃśaduttarasaptaśatādhikaviṃśati sahasrasaṃkhyābhiḥ 
kālanityāvidyābhiḥ samūlavidyāyāstāvatsaṃkhyājape proktavidhinā 
pratyahaṃ kriyamāṇe ityarthaḥ | vāreṣu ravivārādiśanivārānteṣu 
saptasu vaśinyādīnāṃ vargāḥ prākproktāḥ vargaḥ paṃktiryoniḥ iti 
paryāyaḥ | seko'bhiṣekaḥ | sthiro niścalabhaktimān | 
pañcāśadityādibhiḥ ślokaiḥ prapañcitaḥ  kāmyajapaḥ 
kevalakālanityāvidyānāmeva ayaṃ kramo gurutaḥ śāstrataśca 
boddhavyaḥ || kālacakraracanāprakārastvagre vakṣyate | prakṛte 
kumbhābhimantraṇottaraṃ sarvatra ṣoḍaśīkṛtakalaśeṣu pratiṣoḍaśakaṃ 
madhye lalitāṃ pañcadaśasu pañcadaśa nityāścāvāhya 
ṣoḍaśopacārairārādhya punarmadhyapradhānakumbhasamīpamāgatya 
prasannapūjāṃ vidhāyārātrikāṃ nivedya prāguktagurustutiṃ namaste 
nātha bhagavan ityādi paṭhitvā dvādaśaślokān paṭhet | tadyathā 
(tantrarā0 2 | 88)

gaṇeśagrahanakṣatrayogīnīrāśirūpiṇīm |
devīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāṃ pīṭharūpiṇīm || 1 ||

praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ mātṛkāṃ parameśvarīm |
kālahallohalollolakalanāśamakāriṇīm || 2 ||

yadakṣaraikamātre'pi saṃsiddhe spardhate naraḥ |
ravitārkṣyandukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥ || 3 ||

yadakṣaraśaśijyotsnāmaṇḍitaṃ bhuvanatrayam |
vande sarveśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkām || 4 ||

yadakṣaramahāsūtraprotametajjagattrayam |
brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ tāṃ vande siddhimātṛkām || 5 ||

yadekādaśamādhārabījakoṇatrayodbhavam |
brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ jagadadyāpi dṛśyate || 6 ||

akacādiṭatonnaddhapayaśākṣaravargiṇīm |
jyeṣṭhāṅgabāhuhṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭipādanivāsinīm || 7 ||

tāmīkārākṣaroddhārasārādhārāṃ parāparām |
praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ paramānandarūpiṇīm || 8 ||

adyāpi yasyā jānanti na manāgapi devatāḥ |
keyaṃ kasmāt kva keneti svarūpārūpabhāvanām || 9 ||

vande tāmahamakṣayyakṣakārākṣararūpiṇīm |
devīṃ kulakalollolaprollasantīṃ paraulijām || 10 ||

vargānukramayogena yasyāṃ mātraṣṭakaṃ sthitam |
vande tāmaṣṭavargotthamahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīm || 11 ||

kāmapūrṇajakārākhyaśrīpīṭhāntarnivāsinīm |
caturājñākośabhūtāṃ naumi śrītripurāmaham || 12 ||

iti dvādaśabhiḥ ślokaiḥ stavanaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt |
devyāstvakhaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanaṃ tava tadyataḥ || 13 ||

p. 330)

iti stutvā nityākavacaṃ paṭhet - (tantrarāje 28 pa0 52 ślo0)

samastāpadvimuktyarthaṃ sarvasaṃpadavāptaye |
bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍāśāntyai sukhāptaye || 1 ||

samastaroganāśāya samare vijayāya ca |
caurasiṃhadvīpigajagavayādibhayānake || 2 ||

araṇye śailagahane mārge durbhikṣake tathā |
salilāgnimarutpīḍāsvabdhau potādisaṃkaṭe || 3 ||

prajapya nityākavacaṃ sakṛtsarvaṃ taratyasau |
sukhī jivati nirdvandvo niḥsapatno jitendriyaḥ || 4 ||

śṛṇu tatkavacaṃ devi vakṣye tava navātmakam |
yenāhamapi yuddheṣu devāsurajayī sadā || 5 ||

sarvataḥ sarvadātmānaṃ lalitā pātu sarvadā |
kāmeśī purataḥ pātu bhagamālā tvanantaram || 6 ||

diśaṃ pātu tathā dakṣapārśvaṃ me pātu sarvadā |
nityaklinnā tu bheruṇḍā diśaṃ pātu sadā mama || 7 ||

tathaivaṃ paścimaṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣetsā vahnivāsinī |
mahāvajreśvarī rakṣedanantaradiśaṃ sadā || 8 ||

vāmapārśvaṃ sadā pātu dūtī me tvaritā tataḥ |
pālayettu diśaṃ vātyāṃ rakṣetmāṃ kulasundarī || 9 ||

nityā māmūrdhvataḥ pātu sādho me pātu sarvadā |
nityā nīlapatākākhyā vijayā sarvataśca mām || 10 ||

karotu me maṅgalāni sarvadā sarvamaṅgalā |
dehendriyamanaḥprāṇān jvālāmālinivigrahā || 11 ||

pālayedaniśaṃ citrā cittaṃ me pātu sarvadā |
kāmāt krodhāt tathā lobhānmohānmānānmadādapi || 12 ||

pāpānmatsarataḥ śokāt saṃśayāt sarvataḥ sadā |
staimityācca samudyogādaśubheṣu tu karmasu || 13 ||

asatyāt krūracintāto hiṃsātaścoratastathā |
rakṣantu māṃ sarvadā tāḥ kurvantvicchāṃ śubheṣu ca || 14 ||

nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa māṃ pāntu gajārūḍhāḥ svaśaktibhiḥ |
tathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā || 15 ||

siṃhārūḍhāstathā pāntu māṃ tarakṣugatā api |
rathārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇe || 16 ||

tārkṣyārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu tathā vyomagatāstu tāḥ |
bhūgatāḥ sarvadā pāntu māṃ sarvatra ca sarvadā || 17 ||

bhūtapretapiśācāpasmārakṛtyādikān gadān |
drāvayantu svaśaktīnāṃ bhīṣaṇairāyudhairmama || 18 ||

gajāśvadīpipañcāsyatārkṣyārūḍhākhilāyudhāḥ |
asaṃkhyāḥśaktayo devyaḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā || 19 ||

sāyaṃ prātarjapannityākavacaṃ sarvaratnakam |
kadācinnāśubhaṃ paśyenna śṛṇoti ca tatsamaḥ || 20 ||

iti nityākavacaṃ paṭhitvā samyak prārthya 
vaṭukayoginīkṣetrapālagaṇapatibhyaḥ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ kurukullāyai 
vārāhyai ca tanmaṇḍaleṣu tattanmantrairannavyañjanādibhirbalīnutsṛjya 
tatraiva guruḥ saśiṣyartviksāmayiko mahotsavaiḥ saha tāṃ rātriṃ nayet || 
iti adhivāsanavidhiḥ ||

atrānukramaṇikā tu - prathamadine proktamaṇḍapādvahiḥ 
kvacidgomayopaliptaśubhasthāne svāsanoparyupaviśya 
gaṇeśapūjāmātṛkāpūjā vṛddhiśrāddha puṇyāhavācana 
ācāryartvigvaraṇāntakarma prāguktavidhinā vidhāya maṇḍape 
bhūtāpasāraṇaṃ vidhāya madhye śrīcakraṃ vipulaṃ sundaraṃ viracya 
pañcavādyaghoṣapuraḥsaramṛtviksāmayikaiḥ sārdhaṃ madhye 
vedikāparito gurumaṇḍalādiproktamaṇḍalāni tattadvedikāsu vidhāya 
maṇḍapapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya prathamato vāstumaṇḍale balipūjāṃ 
vidhāya gurumaṇḍalasarvatobhadrādimaṇḍaleṣu devatāḥ saṃsthāpya 
pūjayitvā śrīcakre proktasthāneṣu proktakalaśān saṃsthāpya 
kalaśālaṅkaraṇānyapi vidhāya kuṇḍeṣvagnisthāpanāntaṃ karma 
samāpayet || iti prathamadinakṛtyam ||

dvitīyadine prātarutthānādiyogapīṭhanyāsāntaṃ vidhāya nityakarma 
nirvartya punarapi tanmaṇḍaladevatāḥ sampūjya 
śrīcakramasthamadhyakalaśe devīṃ saparivārāṃ samāvāhya 
ṣoḍaśopacārairārādhyānyakalaśeṣvapi lalitādiṣoḍaśanityāḥ 
samāvāhya sampūjya nityahomajapanīrājanāntaṃ karma 
praharadvayamadhye samāpya praharadvayottaramārabhya madhyarātrāvadhi 
ṣaṭtriṃśaduttarasaptaśatādhikaviṃśatisahasra (20736) 
kālanityābhirmūlavidyārahitābhiḥ kumbhābhimantraṇaṃ vidhāya 
proktavidhinādhivaset || iti dvitīyadinakṛtyam ||

tṛtīyadine prāgvannityakarma nirvartya śiṣyasya janmanakṣatre kumbhe 
devīṃ sāṅgāvaraṇāṃ sampūjya mūlavidyāmaṣṭottarasahasraṃ

p. 331)

śataṃ vā japitvā kuṇḍeṣu nityahomoktavidhinā hutvā pūjāśeṣaṃ 
samāpya śṛṅgakakāhalādinānāvāditraghoṣapuraḥsaraṃ 
brāhmaṇāśīrvādaiḥ saha guruḥ prāṅnimantritairdevatātmabhiḥ 
śaktisādhakaiḥ sārdha svayaṃ pradhānakumbhaṃ samutthāpya 
prāguktavidhinābhiṣiñcet | tataḥ śaktayaḥ sāmayikāśca 
kalaśānutthāpyābhiṣekaṃ kuryuḥ | śiṣyāya sālaṃkṛtāya 
dinanityāparyāyanityodayākṣarādikaṃ svakramaṃ kathayet | śiṣyo'pi tu 
tadārabhyāvicchinnaparyāyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā gurūktakramabhajanaṃ 
kuryāt | paryāye gurvājñāmate vicchinne śiṣyaḥ sābhiṣekaṃ 
mūlamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ japet prāyaścittārthamiti vicchinnadinānāṃ 
pratyekaṃ sandhyātrayaṃ ṣaṣṭijapaṃ ghaṭikājapaṃ śatāvṛttijapaṃ ca 
prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā taddinādikramabhajanaṃ ca kuryāditi | tato gurave 
sarvasvaṃ vā tadardhaṃvā iti prāguktarītyā dravyādikaṃ dattvā 
ṛtviksāmayikebhyo dīnānāthebhyaśca dakṣiṇādānaiḥ santoṣaṃ 
sambhāvya caturthadine svagṛhe śrīgurusāmayikaiḥ sārdhaṃ 
mahāpūjāṃ vidhāya brāhmaṇān dīnāndhakṛpaṇān bhojayitvā 
dakṣiṇādibhiśca santoṣayediti pūrṇābhiṣekavidhiḥ ||

atha pūrṇābhiṣeke prāguktaṣoḍaśatrikoṇakaraṇādivistārāśaktau 
vipulaṃ śrīcakramuddhṛtya tatra prāguktaṣaṇṇavatitrikoṇeṣu 
madhyatrikoṇe vṛhatkumbhamanyeṣu kalaśān prāgvat 
saṃsthāpyāvaraṇapūjāṃ vidhāyābhiṣiñcet | athavā 
madhyatrikoṇasthabindusthāna eva khāritoyapūritaṃ kumbhaṃ 
saṃsthāpya sampūjyābhiṣiñcet | atra ṣaṇṇavatikalaśasthāpanapakṣe 
tvāvaraṇaśaktīnāṃ pratikalaśamekaikadevatāpūjanaṃ kumbhe 
mūladevyāḥ pūjanamiti | atrottaraḥ pakṣastvaśaktaviṣayaḥ || iti 
pūrṇābhiṣekavidhiḥ || khārīlakṣaṇaṃ tu bhaviṣyapurāṇe -

paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuḍavaṃ matam |
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaḥ prasthāścatvāra āḍhakaḥ || 1 ||

āḍhakaistaiścaturbhiśca droṇastu kaṭhito budhaiḥ |
kumbho droṇadvayaṃ śūrpaḥ khārī droṇāstu ṣoḍaśa || 2 ||

iti || atha kālacakraracanāprakāraḥ - tatra prathamataḥ kvacidvinduṃ kṛtvā 
taṃ paritaḥ ṣaḍaṃgulamānena vṛttaṃ kṛtvā tadbahirapyekaikāṃgula 
(antarāla)māntaḥ ṣoḍaśa vṛttānīti prathamakṛtavṛttena saha saptadaśa 
vṛttāni niṣpāditāditāni ṣaṭtriṃśadrekhābhirvibhajya 
ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśakoṣṭhayuktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvīthīrniṣpādya tāsu 
svāgravīthyāṃ sarvabāhyathakoṣṭhamārabhya praveśagatyā ṣoḍaśa 
svarān vilikhya tataḥ prādakṣiṇyakramaprāptadvitīyavīthyāṃ tathaiva 
bāhyakoṣṭhamārabhya kakākikī ityādi ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ kakāraṃ 
vilikhya tṛtīyavīthyāṃ khakhākhikhī ityādi ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ 
khakāraṃ vilikhya caturthavīthyāṃ gagāgigī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
pañcamavīthyāṃ ghaghāghighī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya ṣaṣṭhavīthyāṃ 
ṅaṅāṅiṅī ityādi ṣoḍaśakaṃ vilikhyi saptamavīthyāṃ cacācicī ityādi 
ṣoḍaśa vilikhya aṣṭamavīthyāṃ chachāchichī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
navamavīthyāṃ jajājijī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya daśamavīthyāṃ 
jhajhājhijhī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya ekādaśavīthyāṃ ñañāñiñī 
ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya dvādaśavīthyāṃ ṭaṭāṭiṭī ityādi ṣoḍaśa 
vilikhya trayodaśavīthyāṃ ṭhaṭhāṭhiṭhī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
caturdaśavīthyāṃ ḍaḍāḍiḍī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
pañcadaśavīthyāṃ ḍhaḍhāḍhiḍhī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
ṣoḍaśavīthyāṃ ṇaṇāṇiṇī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya saptadaśavīthyāṃ 
tatātitī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya aṣṭādaśavīthyāṃ thathāthithī ityādi 
ṣoḍaśa vilikhya ekonaviṃśavīthyāṃ dadādidī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya 
viṃśavīthyāṃ dhadhādhidhī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya ekaviṃśavīthyāṃ 
nanāninī ityādi ṣoḍaśa vilikhya dvāviṃśavīthyāṃ papāpipī ityādi 
ṣośaśa vilikhya trayoviṃśavīthyāṃ phaphāphiphī ityādi ṣoḍaśa 
vilikhya caturviṃśavīthyāṃ bavarga 25 vīthyāṃ bhavargaṃ 26 vīthyāṃ 
mavargaṃ 27 vīthyāṃ yavargaṃ 28 vīthyāṃ ravargaṃ 29 vīthyāṃ 
lavargaṃ 30 vīthyāṃ vavargaṃ 31 vīthyāṃ śavargaṃ 32 ṣavargaṃ 33 
savargaṃ 34 havargaṃ 35 vīthyāṃ lavargaṃ 36 vīthyā kṣavargaṃ vilikhet 
eṣāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadvīthiṣu ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyākān 
pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇānālikhya karṇikāyāṃ ā-ī haṃsaḥ iti 
varṇacatuṣṭayaṃ vilikhya sarvabāhyavṛttādbahirvṛttatrayaṃ niṣpādya 
sakesaramaṣṭadalakamalaṃ viracya tadbahiścaturasraṃ ca kuryāt | atra 
varṇavinyāsena madhyasthadevatābhimukhaḥ sarve varṇā yathā bhavanti 
tathā lekhyāḥ ||

p. 332)

iti kālacakraracanāprakāraḥ ||

etaccakrasya ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatabhedāḥ santi |
tathā tantrarāje - (pa0 25 ślo0 29)

atha yantrāṇi vakṣyante proktasaṃkhyānyanukramāt |
vṛttaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadasraṃ ca tadvadaṣṭādaśāsrakam || 1 ||

dvādaśāsraṃ navārsraṃ vā svare'ṣṭāsraṃ ṣaḍasrakam |
caturasramatha tryasramiti bhedā nava kramāt || 2 ||

etāni varṇavinyāsabhedāt pratyekamaṣṭadhā |
tena dvāsaptatirbhedāsteṣu nityārṇabhedataḥ || 3 ||

pratyekamaṣṭadhetyevamuktasaṃkhyāḥ samīritāḥ |
eteṣvādyasya vṛttasya vinyāsenānyadunnayet || 4 ||

ṣaḍaṃgulaparibhrāntyā vṛttamekaṃ tu vartayet |
evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryādekaikāṃgulato bahiḥ || 5 ||

yadā saptadaśābhūvaṃstadā tadvibhajedaraiḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhistatasteṣu nyasedvarṇāstathāditaḥ || 6 ||

anulomavilomau ca bāhyābhyantarasaṃpuṭau |
bāhyāntaraparāvṛttī tathā vyākīrṇamityapi || 7 ||

iti | anulomaḥ vilomaḥ bāhyasampuṭaḥ ābhyantarasampuṭaḥ 
bāhyaparāvṛttiḥ ābhyantaraparāvṛttiḥ bāhyavyākīrṇaḥ 
ābhyantaravyākīrṇaḥ evamaṣṭau bhedā varṇavinyāsena |

yantrāṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ tu -

karṇikāyāṃ marudvahnī nāmnā saṃlikhya sarvataḥ |
yojayedvāhyakoṣṭhasthaiḥ prāguktavidhinā kramāt || 8 ||

anyeṣāmaravinyāsaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśatsamudīritaḥ |
aṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśārāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvṛttamanyavat || 9 ||

etata paṭe samālikhya bahiraṣṭacchadāmbujam |
kṛtvā daleṣu kramaśo vāgdevyaṣṭakamālikhet || 10 ||

proktarūpāṃ tatastasya pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagīritām |
vidhāta pūjayennityaṃ pustapūjoktasiddhaye || 11 ||

ubhayaṃ yaḥ prakurute tasya vaṃśe sthirā ramā |
na kadācicchriyo hānirbhaviṣyati ca tatkule || 12 ||

varṇauṣadhikvāthajalairāpūrya kalaśaṃ mahat |
tatra devīṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhivanniśi || 13 ||

nityānāṃ tattvavidyāśca japitvānyedyurāsane |
saṃpūjya śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktyā tamabhiṣecayet || 14 ||

iti | atra tattvanityāḥ ṣaṭsaptatyuttarapañcaśatasaṃkhyākāḥ 
tattvāvṛttirudīritā pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyaiva iti tatraivoktatvāt |

evaṃ janmānujanmādipaurṇamāsīṣu sādhakaḥ |
kuryāt karṣasuvarṇasya mudrikā gauśca dakṣiṇā || 15 ||

evaṃ nirantaraṃ varṣa yo'bhiṣiktaḥ sa sādhakaḥ |
pārthivastasya vandyo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||

varṣadvayābhiṣekeṇa tadgehe syāt sthirā ramā |
varṣatrayābhiṣekeṇa siddhyā vidyādharo bhavet || 17 ||

caturvarṣābhiṣekeṇa khecarīmelanaṃ bhavet |
pañcavarṣābhiṣekeṇa pañcatvaṃ nādhigacchati || 18 ||

ṣaḍvarṣamabhiṣekeṇa lokapālasamo bhavet |
saptavarṣābhiṣekeṇa divākarasamo bhavet || 19 ||

aṣṭavarṣābhiṣekeṇa candramaḥsadṛśo bhavet |
navavarṣābhiṣekeṇa devīsārūpyamāpnuyāt || 20 ||

jayāya vidyāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadekapañcāśadeva vā |
āvṛttirjapahomārcātarpaṇaiḥ sādhu sadhayet || 21 ||

tena jitvā ripūn sarvānedhate tapano yathā |
tathotpāteṣu sarveṣu tathā rogādyupadrave || 22 ||

tathā vāṃchitasiddhyartha tathā kṛtyānivāraṇe |
tathā kṛtyāsamutpattāviyaṃ sarvārthasiddhidā || 23 ||

etaccakrāramāsthāya graharkṣādi pravartate |
etaccakrāravinyāsarūpā bhūmiśca dṛśyate || 24 ||

tastamādetanmayaṃ sarvametasya bhajanena ca |
sarve manorathāḥ siddhā bhajanaiḥ saṃpradāyataḥ || 25 ||

kālaprāptakramaṃ pūrvamāvartyānyakramaṃ bhajet |
japatarpaṇahomārcāsnapaneṣvapyayaṃ kramaḥ || 26 ||

amuṃ jñātvā vidhātavyamanyathānarthamāvahet |
kṛtyotpattau śatrubhaṅge nigrahe pratilomakam || 27 ||

kālena prāptamanyatra sarvatra samudīritam |
vaśīkaraṇarakṣāsu saṃpuṭadvitayaṃ kramāt || 28 ||

p. 333)

rājaśatrujaye prokte parāvṛttakrameṇa vai |
gobhūhiraṇyavāhādilābheṣu ca samīritaḥ || 29 ||

uccāṭaneṣu vyākīrṇaṃ teṣu śāntyai kramaṃ yajet |
etadvidhānaniṣṇātaṃ praṇamanti surāsurāḥ || 30 ||

tasminnarikṛtāḥ pīḍāḥ kṛtyādyā naiva saṃmukhāḥ |
pratyutaiva parāvṛttāḥ kartāraṃ nāśayanti vai || 31 ||

yatrāsau nivasatyeṣa tatkṣetraṃ tattapovanam |
śmaśāne parvate śūnye vipine kṣudrapīḍane || 32 ||

pratiṣṭhite yantrarāje tat syājjanapadaṃ mahat |
sarvavyākīrṇacakreṇa sthāpitenāmarāvatī || 33 ||

uccāṭitā punardevi mayāpi ca na rakṣyate |
śilāyāṃ tāmrapaṭṭe vā rājate hemanirmite || 34 ||

vilikhya bhūmau nikhaned grāmarāṣṭrapurādiṣu |
kṛtvā devālayaṃ tatra cakraṃ saṃsthāpya tasya vai || 35 ||

karṇikāmadhyage veraṃ kuryāt sāṃnidhyasiddhaye |
grāmādirakṣaṇe tatra madhye cāṣṭasu dikṣvapi || 36 ||

khātvāvaṭaṃ punasteṣu pāṣāṇairghaṭṭayeddṛḍham |
samāvāhyābhipūjyāntaḥ sthāpayenmūlavidyayā || 37 ||

pāṣāṇena tadācchādya pīṭhaṃ kṛtvopari sthiram |
nityaśaḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ samam || 38 ||

trisandhyamevaṃ kurvīta nānyathā siddhidāyakam |
tatkāloktāni kuṇḍāni nava homeṣu sarvataḥ || 39 ||

hotṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāvastrabhūbhūṣādāsagodhanaiḥ |
yadyannijepsitaṃ tattad duṣkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavet || 40 ||

ityādi || atra yuganityāsu pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyākāstattvanityā api 
tatraiva | etatparijñātaṃ tu taddinanityāvidyāyāḥ prathamākṣaraṃ 
yugākṣaraṃ bhavati | dvitīyākṣaraṃ tattvākṣaraṃ bhavati | 
taddinanityāvidyāyā api parijñānaṃ tu jyotiḥśāstroktanītyā 
gatakalpādyahargaṇaṃ vidhāya pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyayā bhāge kṛte 
urvaritākṣaraṃ taddinanityāvidyāyāḥ prathamākṣaraṃ 
(ṣaṭtriṃśatābhāge dvitīyākṣaraṃ ) bhavati | evaṃ vāgbhavaṃ 
kāmarājamityakṣaradvayaṃ jātaṃ | śaktikūṭasthāne īkāraḥ sarvāsu 
vidyāsvante yojanīyaḥ | evaṃ taddinanityāvidyāyāḥ parijñāne jāte 
taddinanityāvidyāyāḥ prathamākṣaraṃ yatsvarayuktaṃ bhavati 
tatsvarāditaḥ punastatsvaraparyantaṃ prāgvadakṣaratvena saṃyojitāḥ 576 
saṃkhyākā yuganityāvidyā jāyante | evaṃ taddinanityāvidyāyā 
dvitīyākṣaraṃ yadbhavati tadgṛhītvā prāgvadakṣaratvena yojitāḥ 576 
saṃkhyākāstattvanityāvidyā jāyante | tattvanityā dinanityā iti paryāyaḥ | 
atra 576 varṇā vāgbhavākhyāḥ 36 varṇāḥ kāmarājākhyā 
boddhavyāḥ || paryāyanityākramastu - yasmindine ācāryacaraṇānāṃ 
dīkṣā jātā taddinamārabhyāhargaṇasya pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyayā 
bhāge kṛte prathamākṣaraṃ labhyate | tathaivāhargaṇasya ṣaṭtriṃśatā 
bhāge kṛte dvitīyākṣaraṃ labhyate tṛtīyabījamokāraḥ | 
evamakṣaratrayātmikā paryāyanityāvidyā bhavati | etasyā api 
prāgvatprathamākṣaraṃ yugākṣaraṃ bhavati taddvitīyākṣaraṃ 
tattvākṣara bhavati | etena yuganityādinanitye labhyete | atra 
kālanityāvidyāstu 20736 || yuganityāstu 576 | tattvanityāstu 576 | 
taddinanityāvidyāstu 576 | paryāyanityāvidyāstu 576 | kālanityānāṃ jape 
tu nāthāvṛttiḥ | pratidinaṃ saṃkhyā jñātavyā | nityāvṛttistu pratidinaṃ 
1296 saṃkhyā | evaṃ cennāthāvṛttenaiva dināni | nityāvṛtteḥ 13 dinānīti 
bodhyam || iti kādimate pūrṇābhiṣekaprayogaḥ ||

atha naimittikapūjā - tatra dīkṣitaḥ prāptapūrṇābhiṣekaḥ 
kṛtapuraścaraṇo nityārcanānirato naimittikārcanaṃ kuryāt | 
puraścaraṇavidhistvagre vakṣyate || śrītantrarāje (6 pa0 2 ślo0)

nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ sāpekṣaṃ pūrvapūrvataḥ |
anyathā bhajanaṃ cecchan karotyāpatparamparām || 1 ||

nityārcanarataiḥ siddhaiḥ kāryaṃ naimittikārcanam |
tadvidhānamato vakṣye caitrādyaṃ phālgunāvadhi || 2 ||

iti || viśeṣadivaseṣu kriyamāṇā mahāpūjā viśeṣapūjetyucyate | 
caitrādiphālgunāvadhi vakṣyamāṇā yā pūjā sātu naimittikapūjā | 
kecittu viśeśapūjāyā naimittike'ntarbhāva iti vadanti | imāṃ 
naimittikapūjāṃ rātrāveva kuryāt || taduktaṃ kulārṇave :

nityārcanaṃ divā kuryādrātrau naimittikārcanam |
ubhayoḥ kāmyakarmāṇi ceti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ || 1 ||

p. 334)

iti || viśeṣadivasāstu tantrarājādigrantheṣūktāni dināni | tāni tu 
guruparamaguruparameṣṭhigurūṇāṃ janmavāratithinakṣatrāṇi 
svajanmavāratithinakṣatrāṇi vidyāprāptidinaṃ guroḥ kṣayadinam 
aṣṭamīcaturdaśīpūrṇimāmāvasyāravisaṃkramaṇayugādidināni 
puṣyanakṣatra ravivāra 
pīṭhopapīṭhagamanadeśikāgamanavīramahāyogidarśana tīrthagamana 
vratadīkṣādyutsavadināni viśeṣakṣetragamana 
devatādarśanākṣaratrayasampātadināni ca || akṣaratraya 
sampātadinamityekasyākṣarasya dinākṣaratvenodayākṣaratvena 
yugākṣaratvena ca darśanaṃ yasmin dine taddinaṃ viśeṣaparva | eteṣu 
dineṣu nityapūjānantaraṃ yathābalaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ yathākālaṃ 
yathādeśaṃ yathāvibhavavistaraṃ vittaśāṭhyarahito 
yathoktadravyairyathāgurūpadeśaṃ śaktisāmayikaiḥ sārddhaṃ 
viśeṣapūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ guruṃ sāmayikāśca toṣayet | atra 
guruparvadineṣu gurupaṃktipūjoktamānavaughagurusaṃkhyākān 
sādhakān tattannāmnā sarvopacāraiḥ samabhyarcya 
yathāśaktidakṣiṇādānādibhiḥ paritoṣayet | teṣu parvasu 
gurumaṇḍalapūjāpi vidheyā || śrītantrarāje - (6 pa0 4 ślo0)

caitre damanakaiḥ kuryāt samūlairvātha gucchakaiḥ |
pūrvapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayā || 3 ||

paredyurnityapūjānte kuryādetaistu pūjanam |
asmin māse ca pūrṇāyāṃ vasantotsavapūjanam || 4 ||

kuryāt tatkālasaṃbhūtaiḥ prasūnaiścandracandanaiḥ |
saugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīraiḥ pūjāṃ pūrvaduvajjvalām || 5 ||

iti | tatra vidhistu - caitre māsi pūrṇāyāṃ damanaiḥ sampūjayet | tadyathā 
- caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ sādhakaḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ sādhakaiḥ sārdha 
damanasamīpaṃ gatvā mūlamantreṇa damanamāmantrya kālīmate tu 
pūrvoktacatuṣkalpalatāvidyābhirdamanamabhimantrya oṃ 
śivaprasādasambhūta atra sannihito bhava | śivakārye samutkṣidya 
netavyo'si śivājñayā || iti damanamāmantrya tatra kāmadevaṃ ratiṃ ca 
vakṣyamāṇatanmantra(ttatpra)prakāreṇa damanakamūle dhyātvā 
sampūjya gṛhamāgacchet | tataścaturdaśyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ sādhakaḥ 
sādhakaiḥ sārdhaṃ punardamanasamīpaṃ gatvāstramantreṇa damanaṃ 
samūlamutpāṭya śastreṇa gucchān kṣiptvā gṛhamānīya aghore aiṃ oṃ 
ghore hrīṃ ghoratare śrīṃ sarvataḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste 
rudrarūpebhyaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ iti mantreṇa damanamabhyukṣya pūjāsthāne 
kvacitpātre damanaṃ navadhā vibhajya madhye'ṣṭasu dikṣu ca saṃsthāpya 
hṛnmantreṇa damanamabhyukṣya pūjāsthāne 
candanāgurukarpūrakuṃkumādipaṅkaiḥ saṃlipya haṃnamaḥ saṃnamaḥ 
kṣaṃnamaḥ maṃnamaḥ laṃnamaḥ vaṃnamaḥ raṃnamaḥ yaṃnamaḥ oṃ 
namaḥ iti navadhā vibhaktaṃ damanaṃ madhyādiprādakṣiṇyena 
sampūjyāstreṇa saṃrakṣya karadvayena triśūlamudrāṃ baddhvā 
kavacamantreṇa damanopari bhrāmayet | tato nutanavastreṇācchādya rahasi 
damanaṃ sthāpayedityadhivāsanaṃ caturdaśyāṃ rātrau kuryāt | tataḥ 
paurṇamāsyāṃ prātaḥsnānādinityapūjādikaṃ nirvartya sāmayikaiḥ 
sārdhaṃ svastivācanapuraḥsaraṃ damanaṃ pūjāsthānamānīya 
pūrvedyuradhivāsanākaraṇe caturdaśyāṃ sāyantane proktavidhinā 
damanamāmantrya pūrṇimāyāṃ damanamānīya yadvā 
pūrṇimāyāmeva damanamāmantryānīya coktavidhinā sadyodhivāsanaṃ 
vā vidhāya purataḥ sindūreṇa caturasravṛttadvayaveṣṭitaṃ 
navayonicakraṃ vidhāya tasya navayoniṣu svarṇādiracitānnava kalaśān 
yavapuñjopari dīkṣāprakaraṇavakṣyamāṇavidhinā madhyayonāvekaṃ 
vā kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya svāsanapūjādipīṭhapūjāntaṃ vidhāya 
vistarataḥ saṃkṣepato vā kṛtvā pañcāyatanī cet gaṇeśādīn damanaiḥ 
sampūjya svadakṣiṇabhāge sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ prāguktaṃ kṛtvā 
tadaśaktāvaṣṭadalakamalaṃ vā sindūrādinā kṛtvā 
tanmadhye'śokataruṃ pañcavarṇarajobhirārarcyya 
tasyādhastrikoṇamaṇḍale kāmadevaṃ taruṇamaruṇavarṇaṃ 
raktavastrābharaṇamālyānulepanaṃ vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ ratiprītibhyāṃ 
śobhitaṃ puṣpabāṇekṣudhanurdharaṃ vasantasahitaṃ dhyātvā 4 klīṃ 
kāmāya namaḥ iti mantreṇa gandhādipañcopacāraiḥ kāmadevaṃ 
sampūjya tadvāmabhāge ratiṃ gauravarṇāṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāṃ 
raktavastraparīdhānāṃ padmakarāṃ dhyātvā 4 śrīṃśrīṃkroṃ ratyai 
namaḥ iti mantreṇa ratiṃ pañcopacāraiḥ sampūjya kāmasya 
dakṣiṇabhāge prītiṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ (sarvā)bharaṇabhūṣitāṃ 
raktavastraparīdhānāṃ tāmbūlakarāṃ dhyātvā 4 
śrīṃśrīṃśrīṃkṣauṃ prītyai namaḥ iti prītiṃ pañcopacāraiḥ 
sampūjya tataḥ kāmadevasyāgre kadambavanamadhye vasantaṃ 
gauravarṇaṃ vāmahastena sudhākumbhaṃ dakṣiṇahastena 
nānāpuṣpasamuccayaṃ dadhānaṃ raktavastrābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ 
raktamālyānulepanaṃ dhyātvā vaṃ vasantāya namaḥ iti mantreṇa 
pañcopacārairvasantaṃ sampūjya punarmadhye kāmadevaṃ 
puṣpāñjalinā sampūjyāṣṭadalakesareṣu agnīśāsuravāyavyacaturdikṣu 
ca klāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ ityādi ṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya aṣṭadaleṣu 
agrādiprādakṣiṇyena oṃ kāmāya namaḥ |

p. 335)

oṃ bhasmaśarīrāya namaḥ | oṃ anaṅgāya namaḥ | oṃ manmathāya namaḥ | oṃ 
vasantasakhāya namaḥ | oṃ smarāya namaḥ | oṃ ikṣudhanurdharāya namaḥ | 
oṃ puṣpabāṇāya namaḥ | ityaṣṭau kāmān sampūjya bahiścaturasre 
lokapālāṃstadāyudhāni ca pūjayet | punaḥ kāmadevaṃ tanmantreṇa 
sampūjya dhūpadīpādikaṃ datvā praṇamya oṃ kāmadevāya vidmahe 
puṣpabāṇāya dhīmahi | tanno'naṅgaḥ pracodayāt || iti kāmagāyatrīṃ 
yathāśakti japitvā samarpya namo'stu puṣpabāṇāya jagadānandakāriṇe | 
manmathāya jagajjetre ratiprītipriyāya ca || iti kāmadevaṃ praṇamya 
mūlavidyayā ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya madhyakumbhe 
prāgvad devīmāvāhya ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ sampūjya prāgvat 
tithinityādilokapālāntān uktakrameṇa damanaiḥ sampūjya āvāhitāsi 
deveśi sadyaḥkāle mayā śive | kartavyaṃ tu yathākālaṃ pūrvaṃ 
sarvaṃ tvadājñayā || iti vijñāpya devīṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ punaḥ 
sampūjya prāgvaddhūpādinaivedyāni samarpya naimittikahomaṃ 
nityahomoktavidhinā kṛtvā rājopacārān mahadārārtikaṃ 
kumārīsuvāsinīvaṭukādipūjāṃ vidhāya sarvān 
bhojanavastrālaṅkāradakṣiṇātāmbūlādibhiḥ paritoṣya svagurumapi 
tathā paritoṣya tadabhāve tatkulīnamanyaṃ vā paritoṣya mūlavidyāṃ 
nityajapāt triguṇāṃ japitvā devyai japaṃ samarpya stutvā praṇamya 
ṣoḍaśārṇe jaganmātarvānchitārthaphalaprade | kāmān pūraya bho devi 
kāmaṃ kāmeśvarīśvari || iti devīṃprārthya punaḥ kāmadevaṃ 
tanmantreṇa damanaiḥ sampūjya ratiprītivasantāṃśca damanaiḥ sampūjya 
dhūpadīpādikaṃ nivedya kāmadevaṃ vasantaṃvisṛjya 
puṣpāñjalimādāya samastacakracakresi sarvavidyāśarīriṇi | devi 
mātarmamaivaṃ tu bhavatviṣṭaṃ tvadājñayā || iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā 
visṛjya śrīpātrodvāsanādi sarvaṃ samāpya śaktisāmayikānanyān 
brāhmaṇānapi bhūridakṣiṇābhojanādibhiḥ paritoṣayet || iti 
damanāropaṇavidhiḥ || iyaṃ damanapūjā yadi caitrapūrṇimāyāṃ na 
sampadyate tadā pakṣadvaye'ṣṭamīnavamīcaturdaśyanyatamatithau kāryā 
| caitre māsi cenna bhavet tadā vaiśākhe jyaiṣṭhe vā māsi 
proktatithiṣvanyatamatithau kuryāt | atha caitre māsi pūrṇāyāmeva 
tatkālasambhavaiḥ 
sacandanakarpūrakuṃkumakahlārairvasantotsavapūjāṃ kuryāt | atrāpi 
naimittikapūjayāṃ pūjādravyāṇi niśi pūrvedyuḥ kvacitpātre nidhāya 
mūlavidyayābhyukṣya mūlamantradinanityābhyāṃ 
gandhādyupacārairabhyarcyādhivāsanam vidhāya paredyurnityakarmānteḥ 
taiḥ saviśeṣapūjanaṃ kṛtvā svagurupūjanaṃ ca kuryādityadhivāsanaṃ 
pūjanaṃ ca boddhavyam || tathā :

vaiśākhe māsi pūrṇāyāṃ pūjayeddhimapuṣkaraiḥ |
api vā candrakastūrīcandanaiḥ śiśirodakaiḥ || 6 ||

iti || etasyārthaḥ : vaiśākhapūrṇāyāṃ himajalaiḥ 
karpūrakastūrīcandanonmiśraiḥ śītalodakairvā 
prāgvadadhivāsanapūrvakaṃ viśeṣapūjāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || tathā :

jyaiṣṭhe māsi ca pūrṇāyāṃ kadalīpanasāmrajaiḥ |
phalaistu pūjayeddevīṃ pūrvavat sarvasiddhaye || 7 ||

iti || tatra jyaiṣṭhe māsi pūrṇāyāṃ viśeṣapūjāṃ vidhāya 
kadalīpanasāmraphalairmahānaivedyairdevīṃ paritoṣya gurvādipūjanaṃ 
kuryāt iti || tathā :

āṣāḍhe māsi pūrṇāyāṃ candanaiḥ kuṃkumānvitaiḥ |
elākakkolajātībhirupetaiḥ pūjayecchivām || 8 ||

iti | spaṣṭa evaitasyārthaḥ || tathā -

śrāvaṇe māsi pūrṇāyāṃ pavitraiḥ pūjayecchivām |
tadvidhānamidaṃ bhadre śṛṇu saubhāgyadāyakam || 9 ||

sauvarṇe rājatairvāpi sūtraiḥ paṭṭasamudbhavaiḥ |
kārpāsasaṃbhavai raktairnavadhā guṇitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 10 ||

kuryāt pavitraṃ śaktīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulaiḥ |
navāṃgulairvā tatsaṃkhyasaragranthyādisaṃyutam || 11 ||

athavā'vṛtiśaktīnāṃ tattatsaṃkhyāṃgulādikam |
kṛtvādhivāsapūrvaṃ tu pūjayet tairyathākramāt || 12 ||

home tvekasaragranthi tanmānaṃ syāt pavitrakam |
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ kuryācchaktyavatārakam || 13 ||

pūjāviṣṭaramānena vitānādavalambayet |
vārāhīkurukullādiśaktīnāṃ mūlaśaktivat || 14 ||

svamānenātmanaḥ kuryāt pavitraṃ tūktasaṃkhyayā |
kramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāmātmavat samudīritam || 15 ||

anyeṣāṃ yogiśaktīnāmeka granthisarān nava |
paridhānapramāṇena maṇḍapasyaikasūtrataḥ || 16 ||

p. 336)

saragranthyaṃgulairyuktaṃ ṣaṇṇavatyā tu saṃkhyayā |
kṛtvā pavitratritayaṃ tāni devyai samarpayet || 17 ||

uktamānatraye'pyekaṃ grāhyaṃ bhavati sarvataḥ |
na kuryānmānasāṅkarya yadi kuryādvinaśyati || 18 ||

iti || asyārthaḥ : tatra śrāvaṇe māsi pūrṇāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ karma 
kuryāt | atra śrāvaṇe māsītyupalakṣaṇam | mithunasaṃkramaṇamārabhya 
tulāsaṃkramaṇaparyantaṃ pavitrotsavasya kālaḥ | tithayastu pakṣadvaye'pi 
caturthyaṣṭamīnavamī caturdaśī pūrṇimā ceti | atrottarottaraṃ gauṇaḥ 
kālaḥ | pavitrāṇi tu 
suvarṇarūpyatāmrapaṭṭasūtratrasarīpadmasūtradarbhabhujaśāṇasūtra-
vatkalakārpāsasūtreṣvanyatameva sūtreṇa kuryāt | kārpāsasūtraṃ 
suvāsinībhiḥ kartitaṃ triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya navasūtrasyaikasaratvena 
kalpitairuktasaṃkhyaiḥ sūtraiḥ pavitrāṇi kuryāt | tatra 
ṣoḍaśāṃguladairghyāṇi ṣoḍaśasūtraiḥ ṣoḍaśagranthiyuktāni 
navāṃguladairghyāṇi navarasagranthiyuktāni vā kuryāt | yasminnāvaraṇa 
yāvatyaḥ śaktayastatsaṃkhyāṃgulasaragranthiyuktāni vā pavitrāṇi 
kuryāt | tatrāvaraṇaśaktisaṃkhyāṃgulādipakṣe mūladevyāḥ 
ṣoḍaśāṃgulāyāmādi pañcadaśanityānāṃ pañcadaśāṃgulādikaṃ 
vārāhīkurukullayośca mūladevyā iva pavitrāṇi kuryāt | 
āyudhānāmaṣṭāṃguladairghyasaragranthiyuktāni gurupaṃktitrayasya 
tattadodhoktagurusaṃkhyāṃgulādikaṃ navāṃgulādikaṃ vā pavitrāṇi 
kuryāt | itthaṃ śrīcakre pūjyadevatāvṛndasamasaṃkhyātāni pavitrāṇi 
uktapakṣeṣvekapakṣānusārīṇi kṛtvāṣṭottaraśatasaragranthiyuktamekaṃ 
vitānāt pūjāviṣṭaramānadairghyaṃ bṛhatpavitramātmanaḥ 
kramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāṃ ca 
skandhādinābhiparyantadairghyamaṅgīkṛtapakṣānusārisaragranthi (yukta) 
manyeṣāṃ sāmānyayogiśaktīnāmekagranthinavasarayuktāni 
maṇḍapasyaikasūtreṇa veṣṭanapramāṇaṃ granthirahitaṃ pavitraṃ kuryāt 
| atrāvaraṇaśaktisamasaṃkhyāṃgulādipakṣe ātmanaḥ 
kramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāṃ ca mūladevīvat pavitreṣu granthayo 
mālāmantreṇa kavacamantreṇa vā kāryāḥ | granthiṣu 
sūtraveṣṭanasaṃkhyā yatheṣṭameveti | itthaṃ pavitrāṇi vidhāya 
pavitrāropaṇadināt pūrvadine sādhakaḥ kṛtyanityakriyo rātrau 
sāmayikaiḥ sārdhaṃ pavitrāṇi pūjāsthānamānīya pavitrasthāne tu 
sindūrādinā caturasravṛttaveṣṭitaṃ navayonicakraṃ kṛtvā kvacitpātre 
tasmin maṇḍale pavitrāṇi 
gorocanākuṃkumaraktacandanakastūrikarpūrapaṅkairliptāni 
lākṣāgairikādyairgranthisthāneṣu vicitritāni saṃsthāpya 
kārpāsasūtraracitapavitrāṇi ca eteṣāṃ navasūtreṣu oṃkārāya namaḥ | oṃ 
candramase namaḥ | oṃ vahnaye namaḥ | oṃnāgāya namaḥ | oṃbrahmaṇe 
namaḥ | oṃravaye namaḥ | oṃgurave namaḥ | oṃsadāśivāya namaḥ | 
oṃsarvadevebhyo namaḥ | iti pratisūtramekāṃ devatāṃ sampūjya 
śiromantreṇābhimantrya hṛnmantreṇābhyukṣyāstramantreṇāvarudhya 
pavitreṣu mūlavidyāyā ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ sampūjya soḍaśanityāśca 
pūjayitvā teṣu sugandhakuṃkumāni niḥkṣipya pañcaratnāni 
sarvauṣadhīśca niḥkṣipet | ratnāni tu hīrakamuktāphalanīla 
padmarāgamarakatākhyāni | sarṣapa kuṣṭha haridrā 
dārulodhramustośīrapriyaṃgumurājaṭāmāṃsī śilīrākhyāḥ 
sarvauṣadhayaḥ | tato navavastrayugenācchādayedityadhivāsanaṃ vidhāya 
paredyuḥ sādhakaḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ samayibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjāsthānaṃ 
praviśya pūjāmaṇḍapaṃ vitānādibhiralaṃkṛtya 
pūjāviṣṭarādūrdhvaṃ vitānāt pūjāviṣṭaraparyantaṃ 
śaktyavatārākhyaṃ mahāpavitramālambayitvā 
āsanapūjādinyāsajātaṃ vidhāya prāgvat kumbhasthāpanaṃ 
vidhāyārghyasthāpanādyātmapūjānte pīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāya 
pañcāyatanī cet pañcāyatanadevatāḥ sampūjya pavitraiḥ sambhāvya 
tasmin kumbhe devīmāvāhya sarvopacārairabhyarcya nityapūjākrameṇaiva 
raśmivṛndaṃ pavitraiḥ sambhāvya tadaṅgahavanaṃ naimittikaṃ ca kṛtvā 
guruṃ santoṣya tasmai pavitraṃ samarpya pūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā agnaye 
pavitrārpaṇaṃ vidhāya gurvanujñayā svayamapi pavitradhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā 
damanapūjāvacchaktisāmayikān 
pavitradānādibhirbhojanatāmbūladakṣiṇādānādibhiśca paritoṣya japaṃ 
naimittikatvena vidhāya devīṃ visṛjya brāhmaṇādīn 
bhojanabhūridakṣiṇādibhiśca paritoṣayet | etāvatkartumaśaktaścet 
ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulāvāmasaragranthiyuktāni pavitrāṇi trīṇi kṛtvā prāgvat 
kumbhasthāpanādipūrvakaṃ tāni devyai samarpya śeṣaṃ samāpayet || iti 
pavitrāropaṇavidhiḥ || kālīmate tu dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām :

āṣāḍha uttamo māsaḥ śrāvaṇo madhyamaḥ priye |
hīno bhādrapado māsaḥ pakṣau sitasitetarau || 1 ||

prathamaṃ śuklapakṣastu tadalābhe sitetaraḥ |
caturdaśyaṣṭamīpūrṇamāsītithiṣu vai yajet || 2 ||

iti || tantrarāje - (6 pa0 20 ślo0)

atha bhādrapade māsi pūrṇāyāṃ ketakodbhavaiḥ |
prasūnairarcayaid devīṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yutam || 1 ||

p. 337)

iti | asyārthaḥ - bhādrapadapūrṇāyāṃ ketakapuṣpaiḥ sādhivāsaṃ 
viśeṣapūjāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || tathā -

āśvayujyāṃ viśeṣastu darśāntapratipattithim |
ārabhya pūjayed devīṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ || 2 ||

home śatāditadvṛddhyā pūrṇāyāṃ ṣaṭśatādhikam |
sahasraṃ juhuyānnityaṃ japaṃ caiva samācaret || 3 ||

kanyakāyāṃ samāvāhya devīṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ |
hutvā bhūṣaṇavastrādidakṣiṇāṃ ca samudvaset || 4 ||

evamekāditadvṛddhyā pūrṇāntaṃ pūjayet priye |
tena viddhān bhavet siddho nṛpatiṃ kurute'rcakam || 5 ||

iti || atrāśvayuje māsi śuklapratipadamārabhya pūrṇimāparyantaṃ 
pañcadaśatithiṣu pratyahaṃ nityapūjānantaraṃ naimiktikatvena 
cakrakamaṃ sampūjya pratipattithimārabhyaikādivṛddhyā pratipadi 
dviśataṃ dvitīyāyāṃ triśataṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ catuḥśatamityādijapahomau 
vidhāya pūrṇimāyāṃ ṣoḍaśaśatāni japitvā ṣoḍaśaśatāni homaṃ 
kuryāt | pratipadāditithiṣvekāditadvṛddhyā pūrṇāyāṃ ṣoḍaśa kanyā 
yathā bhavanti tathā kanyāpūjanaṃ ca kuryāt | tataḥ pratyahaṃ prātaḥ 
kanyakānimantraṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjājapahomānte tāṃ susnātāṃ 
samalaṃkṛtāṃ pūjāsthāne mṛdvāsane samupaveśya tasyāṃ 
prāguktavidhānāddevīmāvāhya sampūjya 
vastrālaṅkaraṇabhojanatāmbūladakṣiṇādānādibhiḥ paritoṣya praṇamya 
visṛjet | evaṃ bahukanyāpūjane'pi pratyekaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāt | asminneva 
māsi pratipattithimārabhya navamyantāsu navasu rātriṣu viśeṣapūjāṃ 
kṛtvā ekādivṛddhyā japādikaṃ ca vidhāya kumārīpūjanaṃ 
caikādivṛddhyā kuryāt | tatra navarātre pūjane viśeṣaḥ | 
pratipadyekavarṣā dvitīyāyāṃ dvivarṣā evaṃ navamyāṃ navavarṣā 
kanyā pūjyā || tatrāpi tithau kumārīḥ pūrvadinapūjitāśca navamyāṃ 
ekavarṣādinavavarṣāntā nava kumāryyo yathā bhavanti tathā pūjayet | 
tāsāṃ nāmāmi tu - pratipadi śuddhā | dvitīyāyāṃ bālā | tṛtīyāyāṃ 
lalitā | caturthyāṃ mālinī | pañcamyāṃ vasundharā | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ 
sarasvatī | saptamyāṃ ramā | aṣṭamyāṃ gaurī | navamyām dūrgā || 
mantrāstu - aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ śuddhāyai namaḥ | 3 bālāyai namaḥ | 3 
lalitāyai namaḥ ityādi nāmamantraiḥ pūjayet || atra :

ekavarṣā tu yā kanyā pūjārthaṃ tāṃ vivarjayet |
gandhapuṣpaphalādīnāṃ prītistasyā na vidyate || 1 ||

dvivarṣakanyāmārabhya daśavarṣāntakanyakāḥ |
pūjayeduktamāgreṇa tasmāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 2 ||

iti skandapūrāṇavacanād dvivarṣakanyāmārabhya 
daśavarṣāntakanyakāḥ pūjayet || athavā navayauvanasaṃpannā 
yathoktalakṣaṇāḥ suvāsinīrvā navarātriṣu pūjayet | iti || tāsāṃ 
nāmāni tu - hṛllekhā gaganā raktā mahocchuṣmā karālikā icchā 
jñānā kriyā durgā ceti || atrāpi mantrāstritārānta hṛllekhāyai nama 
ityādayaḥ ||

atha pūjyāpūjyakumārīṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni | tatra prathamaṃ pūjyānāṃ 
lakṣaṇāni śrīkulārṇava -

arogiṇīṃ supuṣṭāṅgīṃ surūpāṃ vraṇavarjitām |
ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayet || 1 ||

iti || athāpūjyakumārīlakṣaṇāni tatraiva -

hīnādhikāṅgī duṣṭāṃ ca viśīlakulasaṃbhavām |
granthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitām || 2 ||

jātyandhāṃ kekarāṃ kāṇī kurupāṃ tanulomaśām |
saṃtyajed rogiṇīṃ kanyāṃ dāsīgarbhasamudbhavām || 3 ||

iti || atha phalaviśeṣe pūjyakumārīviśeṣaḥ | tatra skānde -

brāhmaṇīṃ sarvakāryeṣu jayārthe nṛpavaṃśajām |
lābhārthe vaiśvavaṃśotthāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajām || 1 ||

dāruṇe cāntyajātīyāṃ pūjayedvidhinā naraḥ |

iti | atha pūjyasuvāsinīlakṣaṇāni śrīkulārṇave -

surūpā taruṇī śāntānukūlā muditā śuciḥ |
śaṅkāhīnā bhaktiyuktā gūḍhaśāstropayoginī || 1 ||

alolupā suśīlā ca smitāsyā priyavādinī |
gurudaivatasadbhaktā sucittā kaulikapriyā || 2 ||

vimatsarā viśeṣajñā devatārādhanotsukā |
mantratantrasamāyuktā samayācārapālikā || 3 ||

p. 338)

manoharā sadācārā śaktireṣā sulakṣaṇā |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 4 ||

iti || athā pūjyasuvāsinīlakṣaṇāni tatraiva -
