duṣṭogrā karkaśā stabdhā kutsitā kuladuṣitā |
durācārā parādhīnā bhāvahīnā durālasā || 1 ||

nidrāsaktātidurmedhā hīnāṅgī vyādhipīḍitā |
durgandhā duḥkhitā mūrkhā vṛddhonmattā rahasyabhit || 2 ||

kutarkā kutsitālāpā nirlajjā kalahapriyā |
virūponmārgagā kruddhā paṅagvandhā vikṛtānanā || 3 ||

īdṛśīṃ matrayuktāṃ ca śaktiṃ yāge vivarjayet |

iti || iyaṃ navarātrapūjā caitrādiphālgunānteṣu dvādaśamāseṣu 
caitrāṣāḍhāśvinapauṣamāsacatuṣṭaye caitrāśvinamāsayorvānyatame 
vā śuklapakṣeṣu yathāvibhavavistaraṃ kāryā | tatrāpi 
navarātrakaraṇāśaktau tṛtīyādinavamyantaṃ saptarātraṃ 
pañcamyādipañcarātraṃ saptamyāditrirātraṃ voktatithiṣu 
kumārīpūjanādibhirnavarātrotsavaṃ kuryāt | evamanye'pi 
naimittikapūjāviśeṣā bahavaḥ santi | te tu gurutaḥ śāstrataśca 
jñātavyāḥ || śrītantrarātre (6 pa0 25 ślo0)

kārtike māsi pūrṇāyāṃ kuṃkumena samarcayet |
rātrau pradīpakairhomaṃ kuryād ghṛtasamedhitaiḥ || 1 ||

devyagre sthāpayed dīpān vidyayā ṣoḍaśa kramāt |
śaktīnāmekamekaṃ tu sthāpayet tattadagrataḥ || 2 ||

athavā bhājane madhye tvekaṃ tamabhito nava |
kṛtvā nivedayenmūlavidyayā saprasūnakam || 3 ||

iti || ayamarthaḥ - tatra kārtikapūrṇāyāṃ kuṃkumena devīṃ sampūjya 
rātrau kuṇḍasthaṇḍilādau agnisthāpanaṃ kṛtvā 
piṣṭamayairghṛtapūritaiḥ karpūravartidīpitaiḥ 
pradīpairnityahomakrameṇaiva hutvā sāṅgāyai sāvaraṇāyai devyai 
dīpadānaṃ ca kuryāt | tatra susame bhūtale sindūrādinā vipulaṃ 
śrīcakraṃ viracya tatra devīmāvāhya sampūjya madhye binducakre 
ṣoḍaśa dīpān śarkarādugdhamiśrayavagodhūmādipiṣṭaracitān 
karpūragarbhavartikān ghṛtapūritān prajvalitān mūlavidyayā 
mūledevyagre sthāpayitvotsṛjya 
nityādiśrīcakrapūjyasamastadevatābhyastattatpūjāsthāne tattadagre 
tattanmantreṇa ekamekaṃ sthāpayitvotsṛjet | etāvatkaraṇāśaktau ekasmin 
svarṇādipātre navayonicakramaṣṭadalaṃ kamalaṃ vā kuṃkumādinā 
nirmāya tasmin yathoktarūpān nava dīpān madhye'ṣṭasu yoniṣu daleṣu 
vā saṃsthāpya devīmabhyarcyotsṛjya samarpayedityarthaḥ || tathā :

mārgaśīrṣe ca pūrṇāyāṃ nārikelāmbucandrayuk |
nivedyābhyarcayenmāṣapiṣṭāpūpairyathāvidhi || 4 ||

iti || mārgaśīrṣapūrṇimāyāṃ karpūrayuktanārikelajalairarghyasthānaṃ 
vidhāya sugandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sampūjya 
māṣapiṣṭanirmitāpūrpairnaivedyaṃ ca kuryāt | tathā :

puṣye māsi ca pūrṇāyāṃ śarkarābhirguḍena vā |
pūjayediṣṭasaṃsiddhyai gavyaṃ dugdhaṃ nivedayet || 5 ||

iti || pauṣapūrṇimāyāṃ śarkarābhistadabhāve tu guḍena sampūjya 
gosambandhi dugdhaṃ kāṅkṣitāvāptaye nivedayet | tathā :

māghe māsi ca pūrṇāyāṃ tilaiḥ śuktaistathetaraiḥ |
pūjayeddugdhanaivedyaiḥ sitāpupādibhiḥ sadā || 6 ||

iti || tatra māghe māsi pūrṇimāyāṃ śuklaiḥ kṛṣṇairvā tilairdevīṃ 
sāvaraṇāṃ sampūjya śarkarādugdhāpūpādinaivedyaṃ nivedayet || 
tathā :

phālgune māsi pūrṇāyāṃ paṅkajaiḥ svarṇarājataiḥ |
cūtasaugandhimadhukaiḥ pūjayedīpsitāptaye || 7 ||

iti || tatra phālgune māsi pūrṇāyāṃ paṅkajaiḥ suvarṇarajatapuṣpaiśca 
devīṃ saṃpūjayet || tathā -

viṣuvāyanadarśāsu yugādiṣu samarcanam |
kuryādvaiśeṣikaṃ puṇyeṣvāgamokteṣu teṣvapi || 8 ||

iti naimittikapūjā ||

atha kālīmate pūrṇābhiṣekavidhau tu prāgvat 
kuṇḍamaṇḍapavedikādikaṃ ca kuryāt | atra viśiṣastu - 
saptaviṃśatihastaprarimitaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vidhāyāṣṭadikṣu kuṇḍāni 
madhye navahastaparimitāṃ vedīṃ vidhāya vedyāṃ śrīcakraṃ nirmāya 
kalaśasthāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvat vidhāya guruḥ prātaḥ 
kṛtyādipīṭhanyāsāntaṃ karma vidhāya mahāśaktinyāsaṃ kuryāt || tatra 
prathama jagacchūnyākāraṃ 

p. 339)

nirālambaṃ dhyātvā hūṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ iti svāsanādhaḥ pṛthivīṃ 
sampūjya svāsanaṃ vāmahastena spṛśan bhuvaneśvarībījaṃ 
saptavāraṃ japitvā 4 oṃ jayāyai namaḥ | 4 oṃ vijayāyai namaḥ | 4 oṃ jayantyai 
namaḥ | 4 oṃ ajitāyai namaḥ | 4 oṃ aparājitāyai namaḥ | 4 oṃ saṅgamāyai 
namaḥ | 4 oṃ rambhāyai namaḥ iti svāsane saptaśaktīḥ sampūjayet | 
mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā oṃ asya mahāśaktinyāsasya paraśiva 
ṛṣiḥ atijagatī chandaḥ śrīparāśaktirdevatā aiṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ 
sauḥ kīlakaṃ śrīvidyāṅgatvena mahāśaktinyāse viniyogaḥ | 
ṛṣyādikaṃ vinyasya dvirāvṛttyā tāratrayasya karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ 
vidhāya nyāsaṃ kuryāt | tatra yonau oṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ namaḥ | nābhau 4 
hrāṃhīṃhrūṃ namaḥ | karāgrayoḥ klāṃklīṃklūṃ namaḥ | hṛdaye 4 
hrāṃhrīṃhlūṃ namaḥ | lalāṭe 4 sāṃsīṃsūṃ namaḥ | karṇayoḥ  4 
hāṃhīṃhūṃ namaḥ | bhujamūle 4 drāṃdrīṃdrūṃ namaḥ | 
bindu(cibu)kāgre 4 sauḥśrīṃkṣauṃ namaḥ | brahmarandhre 4 aiṃ 
āṃsauḥ aṃnamaḥ iti vinyasya akārādikṣakārāntānāṃ sarveṣāṃ 
varṇānāṃ mūlabhūtamakāraṃ dugdhasya sarpirvatsūkṣmarūpeṇa 
sthitaṃ vibhāvayan tanmayānanyavarṇān vakṣyamāṇeṣu sthāneṣu 
vinyaset | tatra tāluke 4 aiṃ īṃsauḥ āṃ namaḥ | nāsāgre 4 | 3 iṃ namaḥ | 
paścimaliṅge sīvanyāṃ mūlādhāragatajyotirliṅge vā 4 | 3 īṃ namaḥ | 
gude 4 | 3 uṃnamaḥ | pṛṣṭhe 4 | 3 ūṃ namaḥ | kaṭisandhau 4 | 3 ṛṃ namaḥ | 
vṛṣaṇānte oṃ 3 | 3 ṝṃ namaḥ | pṛṣṭhamadhye oṃ 3 | 3 ḷṃ namaḥ | 
lambikāsthāne 4 | 3 ḹṃ namaḥ | sarvāṅge oṃ 3 | 3 eṃ namaḥ | 
punarbinduparigatatrirekhāyāṃ yonau nyāsabhāvanayā sarvāṅge oṃ 3 | 3 
aiṃ namaḥ iti vinyasya

yonirityucyate śaktireṣā brahmāṇḍabhedinī |
lepaṃ vilīnayed dehe repho binduriti smṛtaḥ || 1 ||

dvāsaptatisahasreṣu nāḍībhedeṣu pañjaram |
vyāpyamānā mahāśaktiḥ kāminīnāmṛtukrame || 2 ||

nāḍīcakrāgataṃ raktaṃ yonimārge nipātitam |
puṣpībhūte bhage puṣpaṃ māsapakṣādiṣu kramāt || 3 ||

aiṃkāro'pi svayaṃ yonirnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
nyastaṃ vāpyatra deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 4 ||

ityantaṃ ślokasamudāyasyārthaṃ cintayan mahākāmakalāyāṃ 
brahmarandhrasthāyāṃ layaṃ bhāvayitvā brahmarandhre oṃ 3 | 3 oṃ namaḥ | 
nādamadhye oṃ 3 | 3 oṃ namaḥ | nādānte oṃ 3 | 3 aṃ namaḥ | kaṇṭhe oṃ 3 | 3 
aḥ namaḥ | hṛdi oṃ 3 | 3 kaṃ namaḥ | evaṃ mastake khaṃ namaḥ | 
jaṅghayoḥ gaṃ namaḥ | stanayoḥ ghaṃ namaḥ | nāsikānte ṅaṃ namaḥ | 
ājñāyāṃ caṃ namaḥ | vāmakukṣau chaṃ namaḥ | dakṣiṇakukṣau jaṃ 
namaḥ | ūrumūlayoḥ jhaṃ namaḥ | dantapaṃktyoḥ ñaṃ namaḥ | 
jihvāgre ṭaṃ namaḥ | mukhe ṭhaṃ namaḥ | kakṣayoḥ ḍaṃ namaḥ | 
asthisandhiṣu ḍhaṃ namaḥ | citte ṇaṃ namaḥ | nābhau taṃ namaḥ | lalāṭe 
thaṃ namaḥ | karṇarandhrayoḥ daṃ namaḥ | kapolayoḥ dhaṃ namaḥ | 
nayanayoḥ naṃ namaḥ | śvetasahasradalakamale paṃ namaḥ | hṛtpadme 
phaṃ namaḥ | skandhayoḥ vaṃ namaḥ | bhrūmadhye bhaṃ namaḥ | 
hanumūle maṃ namaḥ | tālumule yaṃ namaḥ | liṅgagudayormadhye raṃ 
namaḥ | jihvāyāṃ laṃ namaḥ | sarvāṅge vaṃ namaḥ | 
vāmādidakṣiṇaśiraḥparyantamāpādatalaveṣṭanatvena śaṃ namaḥ | 
tālumūle ṣaṃ namaḥ | sarvāṅge saṃ namaḥ | brahmarandhre haṃ namaḥ | 
hastapādayoḥ sarvāṃgulīṣu kṣaṃ namaḥ | 
prāguktamūlādhārasthitakuṇḍalinyāṃ oṃ 3 | 3 iti vinyasya oṃ 3 | 3 
samastamātṛkāmuccaran tāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ suṣumnāvartmanā 
ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa  brahmarandhra nītvā 
tatrasthākulasahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyasthitaparamātmani śive 
vilīnāṃ sambhāvya oṃ 3 | 3 rakṣarakṣa śūlini trailokyānandadāyini tripure 
devi rakṣa māṃ tripureśvari rakṣarakṣa mahādevi asmadīyamidaṃ vapuḥ 
aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ hasaphreṃ hsauḥ 2 hasaphreṃ śrīṃhrīṃ-aiṃśrīṃ 
samayini madirānandasundari samastasurāsuravandite 
bhujaṅgabhūpālamaulimālālaṃkṛtacaraṇakamale 
vikaṭadantacchaṭāṭopanivāriṇi madīyaṃ śarīraṃ rakṣarakṣa 
parameśvari hūṃphaṭ svāhā oṃbhūḥsvāhā oṃbhuvaḥsvāhā oṃ sva 
svāhā oṃbhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvāhā narāntramālābharaṇabhūṣite 
mahākaulini mahābrahmavādini mahādhanonmādanakāriṇi 
mahābhogaprade asmadīyaṃ śarīraṃ vajramayaṃ krukuru drjanān 
hanahana duṣṭamahīpālān bhakṣayabhakṣaya paracakraṃ 
bhañjayabhañjaya jayaṅkari gaganagāmini trailokyasvāmini 
yamalavarayūṃ bhamalavarayūṃ vamalavarayūṃ śamalavarayūṃ 
śrībhairavi prasādaya svāhā |

kulāṅganākulaṃ sarvaṃ madīyaṃ tripureśvari |
devī rakṣatu divyāṅgī divyātmā bhogadāyinī || 1 ||

p. 340)

rakṣarakṣa mahādevī śarīraṃ parameśvari |
madīyaṃ madirānande āpādatalamastakam || 2 ||

ityātmarakṣāṃ kṛtvā

tripurākhyā mahādevī bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
na guroḥ sadṛśaṃ vastu na devaḥ śaṅkaropamaḥ || 3 ||

naca kaulātparo yogo na vidyā traipurīsamā |
naca śānteḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ naca kṣānteḥ paraṃ sukham || 4 ||

naca śaktisamo nyāso na vidyā traipurīsamā |
darśaneṣu samasteṣu pākhaṇḍeṣu viśeṣataḥ || 5 ||

divyarūpā mahādevī sarvatra parameśvari |

iti mantravidyayormahimānaṃ smṛtvā pīṭhopapīṭhaśiraḥsthā  
gaganagiribhuvanagiribhuvanagokulanivāsinī jayati 
kulasaśaktimahītalapātālanivāsinī kulakaulavibhedinī sakalajanamana-
ānandakāriṇī karotu mama cintitaṃ kāryaṃ bhairavīśatamekaṃ punātu 
parameśvarī madanamaṇḍalālambinī saptakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ 
parameśvarī | iti mantraṃ sakṛjjapitvā

aiṃnamo bhagavati trikoṇe tridhāvarte mahāliṅgālaṃkṛte 
trailokyotpattisthitipralayakāriṇī sahalahrīṃ kandarpānandadāyini 
sahahrīṃ brahmadaṇḍarekhe sahahrauṃ citsvarūpeṇa 
pāśāṃkuśālaṃkṛte vadavada vāgvādini śrīṃ 
mūṣṭamahapālarājyaprade aiṃ vaṃ varadāśivahaste 
samastajanānandakāriṇi klīṃ klīṃ kāmarājabījāśraye 
drāṃdrīṃklīṃvlūṃsaḥ kṣobhaya kṣobhaya kṣobhiṇi hasauḥ hasaḥ 
hsauḥ mathamatha abhayapradāyini caturbhuje trinetre pretāsanoccāriṇi 
mahākapālamālālaṃkṛte candraśekhare tripure bhuktimuktiphalaprade oṃ 
aiṃ oṃnamaḥ siddhaṃ aṃ 51 kṣamityādivilomenākārāntaṃ 51 
ddhaṃsimaḥna oṃ aiṃ oṃ sarvabījamātaḥ śrīsamayini mama manorathaṃ 
dehidehi svāhā || evaṃ japitvā aiṃ-īṃsauḥśrīmantrarājāya namaḥ iti 
traipuramantrasya pūjāṃ vidhāya tripurādimahānāmnā 
trayodaśavidyāḥ pūjayet | (1) oṃ aiṃsahau sahalahrīṃ sahahrauḥ 
aiṃsahahrīṃ sahahūṃ kāmatripurāyai namaḥ | (2) oṃ 
aiṃhrīṃklīṃhasauḥ tripurabhairavyai namaḥ | (3 ) oṃ 3 aiṃhrīṃsaḥ 
vāktripurāyai namaḥ | (4) oṃ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃsauḥ mahālakṣmyai tripurāyai 
namaḥ | (5) oṃ aiṃpreṃklīṃ mohinyai tripurāyai namaḥ | (6) oṃ 
aiṃklīṃblūṃstrīṃ bhrāmarītripurāyai namaḥ | (7) oṃ 3 
aiṃhrīṃśrīṃpreṃhasauḥ trailokyasvāminyai tripurāyai namaḥ | (8) oṃ 
aiṃḍāṃḍīṃḍūṃḍaiṃḍauṃḍaḥ haṃsyai tripurāyai namaḥ | (9) aiṃ 
aiṃ aiṃ sauḥ kaulikāyai tripurāyai namaḥ | (10) aiṃ aiṃ sauḥ 
ṣaṇḍikāyai tripurāyai namaḥ | (11) aiṃ aiṃ sauḥ tālumadhyamāyai 
tripurāyai namaḥ | (12) aiṃ aiṃ sauḥ kapālāṃkuravāsinyai tripurāyai 
namaḥ (13) ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭha || yathāśakti japitvā raktapuṣpaiḥ śirasi aiṃ īṃ 
sauḥ ātmadehāya namaḥ iti gandhākṣataiśca saptadhā sampūjya 
dhūpadīpau nivedya tasminneva traipure dehe aiṃ īṃ sauḥ iti 
vanitākṣobhakarīṃ mahākāmakalāṃ dhyāyet || tataḥ ślokaśatakaṃ 
nyāsānusandhānena paṭhet | tatra :

śaktirudramayaṃ dehaṃ madīyaṃ tripure kuru |
dehi me devadeveśi (varaṃ ni)tyamabhīpsitam || 1 ||

mastakaṃ maṅgalādevī lalāṭaṃ kulasundarī |
netrayugmaṃ mahākālī karṇau rakṣatu kuṇḍalī || 2 ||

kapālī karṇagarbhaṃ tu kapolo kamalāvatī |
dantān rakṣatu cāmuṇḍā cibuke meruvāsinī || 3 ||

bhrūmadhyaṃ kaṇṭhadeśaṃ ca rakṣenme bhuvaneśvarī |
jihvāṃ sarasvatī rakṣet tāluka tāluvāsinī || 4 ||

sthātu me kapilā skandhe skandhāṃ(vāmāṃ)se kulamālinī |
kukṣau vināyakī sthātu jayānandā stanadaye || 5 ||

kaṇṭhakūpe mahālakṣmīrhṛdaye caṇḍabhairavī |
brahmāṇī nābhideśe tu sthātu jvālāvatī gude || 6 ||

liṅge liṅgaprabhā caiva muṇḍini medamaṇḍale |
nāḍīcakre mahāyogā udbhaṭā dakṣiṇe kare || 7 ||

vāmahaste mahāmāyā vidyā hastāṃgulīṣu ca |
vaiṣṇavī vāmapāde ca sthātu cakrāyudhānvitā || 8 ||

tathā dakṣiṇapādānte ekapādā sureśvarī |
pādāṃgulīṣu kauverī romakūpe mahādbhaṭā || 9 ||

maṇḍalī nasyamūle tu vārāhī medamaṇḍala |
jālandharī jalasthāne kāmākṣī kāmamadhyagā || 10 ||

udbhaṭā nābhiliṅgānte nāsāgre pūrṇapīṭhagā |
pṛṣṭhavaṃśe jayādevī asthisandhiṣu carcikā || 11 ||

carmadhārī tvacāyāṃ tu sthātu nityaṃ mahāyaśāḥ |
raktamadhye mano'nte ca sthātu me hiṃsinī śubhā || 12 ||

māheśvarī ca kaumārī dvai caite sthātu jaṅghayoḥ |
vāmadakṣiṇayoścaiva vīrālī kaṭisandhiṣu || 13 ||

p. 341)

devī rakṣatu me gātraṃ mastakaṃ kulakāminī |
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || 14 ||

pañcabhūteṣu bhūteśī sadā rakṣatu me kulam |
rājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatī || 15 ||

māyā dadātu me nityaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśastathā |
raṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvane || 16 ||

raktanetrā mahādevī karotu mama cintitam |
samayā samayaṃ rakṣedvidyāṃ vidyā kulāgame || 17 ||

sādhakānāṃ jagannāthā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
prāṇā karotu me siddhiṃ trailokyavijayā sukham || 18 ||

ghaṇṭālī yā mahāvidyā sā me yacchatu maṅgalam |
saptakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ nāyikā tu yā || 19 ||

sā me sureśvarī devī sadā siddhiṃ prayacchatu |
ulkāmukhā mukhe sthātu mārjārī dehasandhiṣu || 20 ||

bhadrakālī tu yā vidyā sā me sthātu śivāmaye |
trikoṇaṃ ca tridhāvartaṃ traipuraṃ cakramuttamam || 21 ||

mastake sthātu me nityaṃ tasyānte bahurūpiṇī |
pūrvoktā traipurī śaktiḥ sthātu me manmathotthitā || 22 ||

kṣobhavatī jagatsarvaṃ madirānandavihvalā |
nivāsaṃ kuru me dehe sāṃprataṃ divyayoginī || 23 ||

ehyehi tva mahādevī siddhayoginī me kule |
śatrūṇāṃ ghātanārthāya jetṝṇāṃ bhogadāyinī || 24 ||

mahāyoginī dahe'smin sarvadā nilayaṃ kuru |
māhendrī ca sikhāṃ sthātu yonimadhye gaṇeśvarī || 25 ||

pretāśī nāma vikhyātā karotu kuśalaṃ mama |
ḍākinī pūrvabhāge ca mama saukhyaṃ prayacchatu || 26 ||

śākinī paścimāṅgeṣu dakṣiṇe cāpi rā(kṣasī?kiṇī) |
vāmabhāge mahāmāyā karotu kuśalaṃ mama || 27 ||

sāsmadīyaṃ śiraḥ pātu sadā tiṣṭhatu bhairavī |
yā viśālā viśālākṣī nirmalā malavarjitā || 28 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā kālakalpitā kālī kālarātrī tu kathyate || 29 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā niśācararājanyapūjitā ca niśācarī || 30 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā cordhvakeśikā nāma muktakeśī mahābhayā || 31 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā vīreti samākhyātā vīrāṇāṃ jayadāyinī || 32 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā mālinī samākhyātā nāsāgre vidrumājinī || 33 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā kaṅkālakarālāṅgī caṇḍakaṅkālakuṇḍalā || 34 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
pracaṇḍā ca virūpākṣī virūpā viśvarūpiṇī || 35 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
khaṭvāṅgī kathyate yā ca raudrī rudreṇa pūjitā || 36 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
kaliyāginī prasiddhā ca yā loke śrūyate kalau || 37 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
pretākṣī kathyate yā ca phetkārokaṭavarjitā(?) || 38 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
dhūmrākṣī yā samākhyātā śāstre'smin yoginīmate || 39 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
ghorarūpā mahādevī kathyate yā kulāgame || 40 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
viśvarūpā viśeṣeṇa karoti ca jagattrayam || 41 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
bhayaṅkarī samādiṣṭā yā coktā vai kulāgame || 42 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
kapālamālikā proktā yā devī muṇḍadhāriṇī || 43 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
bhīṣaṇā bhairavī nāma yā devī bhīmavikramā || 44 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
nyagrādhavāsinī yā ca kathyate ca surārcitā || 45 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
bhairavī bhīṣaṇī yā ca bhairavāṣṭakavanditā || 46 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
procyate dīrghalamboṣṭhī mahāmāyā mahābalā || 47 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
khaṭvāṅgī yā mahāśaktiḥ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī || 48 ||

p. 342)

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
samasteṣu mantreṣu procyate mantravādinī || 49 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
kālaghnī kathyate yā ca yugānte parameśvarī || 50 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
grāhiṇīti samākhyātā surāsuramahoragaiḥ || 51 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
cakriṇī gadyate yā ca ekapādā trilocanā || 52 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yā viśvabāhukā devī viśvanāthapriyā sadā || 53 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
darśaneṣu samasteṣu viditā parameśvarī || 54 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
kaṇṭakocchedanārthāya śāstre yā kaṇṭakī smṛtā || 55 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
kīlakī kathyate yā ca saptahastā mahābalā || 56 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
saṃgrāme yā mahādevī mahāmārīti kathyate || 57 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
yamadūtīti vikhyātā yā surāsurapūjitā || 58 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
karālinīti yā devī mahāvidyā mahābalā || 59 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
lalitāmbā mahārājñī sarvacakraikanāyikā || 60 ||

sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama |
nāsāgre kaulikā sthātu madanasyā tathā mukhe || 61 ||

vyomajaṅghe kapole ca gālake cāpahāriṇī |
sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama || 62 ||

drāviṇī kṣobhiṇī caiva stambhinī mohinī tathā |
raudrakarmā mahāghaṇṭā camarī tvaritā mataiḥ || 63 ||

raudrī ca kulamātā ca kākadṛṣṭiradhomukhī |
kapālakuṇḍalo dīrghā kapālī kulagāminī || 64 ||

daivī rakṣatu me gātraṃ mastakaṃ kulamālinī |
bhumirāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || 65 ||

pañcabhūteṣu bhūteśī sadā rakṣatu me kulam |
rājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatī || 66 ||

māyā dadātu me nityaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśastathā |
raṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvane || 67 ||

raktanetrā mahādevī karotu mama cintitam |
samayā samaye rakṣet vidyāṃ vidyā kulāgame || 68 ||

sādhakānāṃ jagannāthā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
dvijaṭī trijaṭī proktā kandalī lalitākhilā || 69 ||

gāyatrī cāmbikā tārā pārvati kamalaprabhā |
mādinī madanonmādā mandārī madanāturā || 70 ||

bhīṣaṇā bhīṣaṇī nāma pretasiddhā vibhiṣaṇā |
kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tathā nidrā kāntirbuddhistathā dyutiḥ || 71 ||

sandhyā dhṛtī ratiḥ kṣāntirhyaniśaṃ paripaṭhyate |
suranātheti vikhyātā nagaretaradevatā || 72 ||

grāmadevī hyadhiṣṭhātrī pīṭhe pīṭheśvarīṃ viduḥ |
kāverī narmadā caiva gaṅgeti yamunocyate || 73 ||

godāvarī mahāpuṇyā procyate cāpyarundhatī |
trailokye'pi mahādevī strīnāmnī yā prakāśitā || 74 ||

sā devī rūpalakṣe tu sthātu śrīrhṛdaye mama |
suvarṇarekhiṇī proktā vidyā yā procyate kila || 75 ||

nirmūlinī bhujaṅgānāṃ sā karotu sukhaṃ mama |
kurukulleti vikhyātā pakṣirājamukhodbhavā || 76 ||

yā vidyā sā mahārūpā jihvāgre sthātu me sadā |
oṃkāriṇīti vikhyātā dehe sthātu sadā mama || 77 ||

vidyāpahāriṇī nāma kalirūpavidāriṇī |
bheruṇḍā sthātu me kaṇṭhe toralā sthātu mastake || 78 ||

tathā śavalarekhāpi mūle sthātu sadā mama |
jāṅgalī viṣanāśāya vācāṃ siddhiṃ karotu me || 79 ||

sarvasiddhikarī vidyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā |
ahaṃ brahmā ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ || 80 ||

sarvabhūtanivāso'haṃ loke śrīśakticintakaḥ |
śaktinyāsena pūtena śarīreṇa surāsurāḥ || 81 ||

pradhānādeśamātreṇa āśāṃ (jñāṃ) kurvantu me sadā |
yatkiñcidyoginīrūpaṃ trailokye cāsti śaṅkara || 82 ||

tatsarvaṃ tiṣṭhate dehe śaktinyāse upāsite |
kāminī kurute cāpi yā nyāsaṃ bhaktinirmitam || 83 ||

p. 343)

tāṃ devīṃ divyarūpasthāṃ saṃsāre tripurāṃ viduḥ |
namo'stu te jaganmātarnamo'stu bhuvaneśvari || 84 ||

namo bhogaprade devī (namastubhyaṃ) maheśvari |
prakaṭā gopitāḥ sarvā nirvāṇā bhairavī śivā || 85 ||

sambhramā vijayā haṃsā śubhā sānaladevatā |
yakṣiṇī cūḍakanyā ca tathā cākāśagāminī || 86 ||

bhūcarī caritā kumbhī sarvāgamanivāsinī |
catuḥṣaṣṭyāśrayā devī yoginyo yena cintitāḥ || 87 ||

ādhāre līyamānāstu sa yogī yogavidbhavet |
lalāṭe maṇḍalā sthātu virajā sthātu mastake || 88 ||

ekākṣī dakṣiṇaskandhe vāme caiva trilocanā |
jayantī sthātu me kukṣau kaṭyām kandarpakuṇḍalī || 89 ||

mālinī liṅgasandhau ca hṛdi syātu samādhinī |
ambikā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe ca pārśvayoḥ sthātu medinī || 90 ||

diggajāṅgī karāgre ca nāgendrī nakhasandhiṣu |
vyāghrī cakrī ca jaṅghāyāṃ syātu pādatale mahī || 91 ||

amṛtā śaṅkhinī randhre locane ca vilāsinī |
kālindī mūlajihvāṃ ca raktaṃ rakṣatu raktinī || 92 ||

lāṅgalī jaṅgalī rakṣedasthinī cāsthisandhiṣu |
mañjinī dehamañjāṃ tu śukraṃ śukreśvarī tathā || 93 ||

tvacaṃ rakṣatu vetālī mama rogapraṇāśinī |
rudghaṭā kurute śāntiṃ sadaiva mama vigrahe || 94 ||

pādā pādatale sthātu pathi rakṣatu panthinī |
corāgnirājasarpebhyo bhayādrakṣatu bhairavī || 95 ||

duṣṭānāṃ dṛṣṭibandhaṃ tu sadā karotu bandhinī |
cāpeṭī nāma yā vidyā sā me karotu maṅgalam || 96 ||

markaṭī ghaṇṭakarṇī ca hanumantī ca rāvaṇī |
ghurghurā kīrtivikhyātā vande vidyācatuṣṭayam || 97 ||

ceṭakā jñānadā vidyā kaumārī caraṇāvalī |
vighnarājaistato nāma tuṣṭā santānarūpiṇī || 98 ||

mūlādhārasthitā haṃsī pātakī dalanoddhatā |
daśaitā mantravidyāstu tiṣṭhantu mama mastake || 99 ||

śubhā me cāgrataḥ sthātu lohitā sthātu dakṣiṇe |
vāmāṅgaṃ ratikāle ca paścime sthātu śṛṅkhalā || 100 ||

śikhāyāṃ śaṅkhinī rakṣedvastre vastravatī śubhā |
kavace kavacāṅgī ca netre netrakṛtotsavā || 101 ||

tiṣṭhanti yoginīrūpāstrailokye sacarācare |
yoginyo yāstu tāḥ sarvā dehaṃ kurvantu me vapuḥ || 102 ||

putrāṇāṃ ca tadā deyaṃ bhaktānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
śaktinyāsamidaṃ deyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 103 ||

manuṣyāṇāṃ mahīloke cintitārthaphalapradam |
yaḥ karoti mahānyāsaṃ ṣoḍhānyāsādikaṃ vibho || 104 ||

sa jīvan śaktirūpo vai trailokyonmūlanakṣamaḥ |
śaktinyāse kṛte jīved yaḥ kaścicchedako bhavet || 105 ||

karmaṇā manasā vācā tasya ghāto bhaviṣyati |

iti śaktinyāsaḥ || evaṃ mahāśaktinyāsaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyasya 
kārayitvāntaryāgaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā : mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ 
kṛtvā sāmānyārghyodakena svapurataścaturasraṃ kṛtvā oṃhrīṃhaṃsaḥ 
so'haṃ svāhā ityātmamanunā sādhāraṃ sakalaśodakamātmaprātraṃ 
saṃsthāpya svadehaṃ śiṣyadehaṃ ca śrīcakrarūpaṃ vicintya aṃkaṃ 36 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvara 
śuddhavidyārāgakālaniyatividyāpuruṣaprakṛtyahaṅkāraśrotratvaknetra-
jihvāghrāṇamanobuddhivākpāṇipādapāyūpastha 
śabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyvagnisalilabhūmijīvasarvātmane 
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātmakāya śrīmahātripurasundarīyogapīṭhāya namaḥ | iti 
pīṭhasamaṣṭividyayā hṛdi puṣpāñjaliṃ prakṣipya 
gandhamālyādibhirbhūṣayitvā devīṃ sammukhīṃ hṛdi 
dhyātvāvāhanādimudrāḥ pradarśyāsanādyupacārān samarpya 
dhyānapūrvakaṃ hṛdi sāṅgāmityādinā triḥ sampūjya santarpya 
mūlena gandhāditāmbulāntānupacārān samarpya 
tattvacatuṣṭayaśodhanaṃ kuryāt | yathā : aiṃ aṃ 16 
aḥbhūmijīvasarvātmane aṃ āṃ aiṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame0 (1 | 22 | 17) 
idantāpātrasambhūtamahantāparamāmṛtam | parāhantāmaye vahnau 
juhāmi śivarūpataḥ || mūlaṃ0 ātmatattvātmane sthūladehaṃ 
śodhayāmi svāhā ityātmapātrāntareṇa kiñcit svīkṛtya klīṃkaṃkhaṃ 
ityādi 25 
śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyārāgakālaniyatividyāpuruṣaprakṛtya
haṅkāraśrotratvaknetrajihvāghrāṇamanobuddhivākpāṇyātmane kaṃ 25 
klīṃ surāvantaṃ barhi padaṃ suṣīraṃ yajñaṃ hinvanti mahiṣā 
namobhiḥ | dadhānāḥ somaṃ devi devatāsu mādemendraṃ yajamānāḥ 
svarkāḥ | antarnirantaranirindhanamedhamāne mohāndhakāraparipanthini 
samvidagnau | kasmiścidbhutamarīcivikāsabhūmau

p. 344)

viśvaṃ juhomi vasudhādiśivāvasānam || mūlaṃ0 vidyātattvātmane 
sūkṣmadehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti | pūrvavat kiñcit svīkṛtya 
sauḥyaṃraṃ 10 
pādapāyupasthaśabdasparśarūparasagandhākāśavāyvagnisalilātmane 
yaṃ 10 vāmamadyasavitarvāmasu śvo dive dive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ 
| vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūre rayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma (ya0 8 | 
6) || tṛṣyantu mātaraḥ sarvāḥ bhairavāḥ savināyakāḥ | kṣetrapālāśca 
yoginyo mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ || mūlaṃ śivatattvātmane kāraṇadehaṃ 
śodhayāmi svāhā iti pūrvavat kiñcit svīkṛtya aiṃklīṃsauḥ-aṃ 51 
bhūmijīvasarvā 
maśivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyārāgakālaniyatividyāpuruṣapra-
kṛtyahaṅkāraśrotratvaknetrajihvāmanobuddhivākpāṇipādapāyūpastha-
śabdasparśākāśavāyvagnisalilātmane aṃ 51 aiṃklīṃsauḥ 
dharmādharmahavirdīpte ātmāgnau manasā srucā | suṣumnāvartmanā 
nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham || mūlaṃ0 sarvatattvātmane 
sthūlasūkṣmakāraṇamahākāraṇadehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti 
pūrvavat kiñcit svīkṛtya punarādhāre (kuṇḍe) anādivāsanendhanajvālite 
ātmacatuṣkākāracaturasre kuṇḍalinyadhiṣṭhitaṃ cidagniṃ dhyātvā 
mūlaṃ0 haṃsaḥ cidagnimaṇḍalāya namaḥ iti manasā sampūjya 
manasaiva puṇyaṃ juhomi svāhā | evaṃ pāpaṃ0 kṛtyaṃ0 akṛtyaṃ0 
saṅkalpaṃ0 vikalpaṃ0 dharmaṃ0 adharmaṃ0 ceti hutvā ātmapātraṃ 
haste saṃgṛhya mūlaṃ0 haṃsaḥ itaḥ pūrvaṃ 
prāṇabuddhimano'haṅkāradehadharmādhikārato 
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ 
padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā yatsmṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ 
gurudevatāyai samarpitamastu svāhā | iti sarvaṃ samarpya pātramādhāre 
saṃsthāpya ādhārādibrahmarandhragāṃ visatantutanīyasīṃ 
vidyutkoṭiprabhāmaśeṣajagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāriṇīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ 
devīrūpāṃ dhyātvā yathāśakti mūlamakṣamālayā sañjapya nivedya 
māyāntatattve sadahaṃ śivo'haṃ śaktyantatattve cidahaṃ śivo'ham | 
śivāntatattve sukhadaḥ śivo'hamataḥ paraṃ pūrṇamanuttaro'ham || 
daiśikavāgupadeśavinaśyaddehamarunmayaśūnyavikalpa | 
advayabodhavimarśasukhaḥ sannadya śivosmi śivosmi śivo'smi 
ityanusandhāya praṇamya śiṣyasyāpi bālābījatrayasthāne kūṭatrayaṃ 
saṃyojya saṃśodhya tathaiva ṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ khaṇḍatrayaṃ vidhāya 
saṃśodhya śrīparṇyādipīṭhe saṃsthāpya pradhānakalaśaṃ 
svayamutthāpya ṛtviksāmayikairanyān kalaśānutthāpya 
tattanmantroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ gururabhiṣiñcet | anye'pyabhiṣekāṃ 
kuryuḥ | tato vastramālyādyalaṃkṛtaṃ śrīcakre samupaveśya 
parāprāsādaśrīṣoḍaśārṇavidyābhedaṣaṭśāmbhavakramacaraṇavidyā 
āmnāya samayā pañcasiṃhāsana ṣaḍdarśana pañcapañcikāgaṇa 
pañcāyatanavidyāḥ śrīvidyāvṛndabhedādidaśamahāvidyāḥ 
śaivavaiṣṇavagāṇapatyasauraśāktavidyā gurupādukāvidyāḥ 
ṣoḍaśanityāvidyā mahāṣoḍhoktavidyādyūrdhvāmnāyakramaṃ 
sampūrṇamupadiśet | svakramamapi copadiśet | śiṣyo'pi 
gobhūhiraṇyavastragajāśvamahiṣīdāsīdāsagṛhādyaiḥ śrīguruṃ 
toṣayitvā bhūridakṣiṇādānādibhir-ṛtviksāmayikān santoṣya rātrau 
mahāpūjāṃ vidhāyāpare'hani dīnāndhakṛpaṇaiḥ saha brāhmaṇān 
bhojayitvā dakṣiṇādānaistoṣayitvā śrīgurorājñayānugrahādikaṃ 
tadā prabhṛti kuryāt || iti kālīmatarītyā pūrṇābhiṣekavidhiḥ ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya- 
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīvisṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya- 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayati viracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye 
tantre pañcadaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 15 ||





atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| ṣoḍaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha kālīmatarītyā puraścaraṇavidhiḥ | tatra -

puraścaraṇasampanno mantro hi phaladāyakaḥ |
kiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥ || 1 ||

rahasyānāṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ yadi na syāt  puraskriyā |
puraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamucyate || 2 ||

vīryahīno yathā dehī sarva(rga) karmasu na kṣamaḥ |
puraścaraṇahīno'pi tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3 ||

iti vaiśaṃpāyanena puraścaraṇasyāvaśyakatvābhidhānāt tasya tu nir-
ṛtirvidhihinānāṃ phalaṃ hanti tu karmaṇām | iti vidhihīnānuṣṭhāne 
nindāśravaṇāt tadanuṣṭhānavidhirvivicya likhyate | atra 
puraścaraṇaśabdaniruktirvāyavīyasaṃhitāyām :

sādhanaṃ mūlamantrasya puraścaraṇamucyate |
purataścaraṇīyatvād viniyogākhyakarmaṇām || 1 ||

purato viniyogasya caraṇādvā tathoditam |

iti || viniyogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ mantratantraprakāśe -

dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śāstramārgeṇa yojanam |
siddhamantrasya samprokto viniyogo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 1 ||

puraścaraṇapūrvo'sau viniyogo viniścitaḥ |
phalāya mantrasevāyā rājasevā yathā tathā || 2 ||

caraṇāt pūrvamevāsau puraścaraṇamucyate |
* * * * * * * * ||

iti | etena viniyogākhyakarmasāmarthyajanakakriyā 
aihikāmuṣmikamantrātmabuddhihetukriyā vā puraścaraṇamityuktam | atra kecit - 
prāpyaināṃ japavidhirādareṇa kāryo vidvadbhiḥ sahutavidhirnijeṣṭasiddhyai | 
(prapa0 6 pa0 123 ślo0) iti dīkṣāprakaraṇe'bhidhāya madhye madhye'pi 
tatprakaraṇe pūjājapahomānevaṃ vidhāya mantraistaddevatābhiṣṭutibhirapi 
japadhyānahomārcanādibhirityupasaṃhāre prapañcasārakāraiḥ 
śrīśaṅkarācāryacaraṇairabhidhānāt | śāradātilakakṛtāpi sarvatra 
pūjājapahomānevaṃ vidhāya prayogābhidhānāt ||

nājapāt siddhyate mantro nāhutācca phalapradaḥ |
anarcito haretkāmāṃstasmāt tritayamācaret || 1 ||

iti brahmaprakāśatantravacanāccāṅgatrayātmakaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ vadanti | anye 
tu -

saṃsāre duḥkhabhūyiṣṭhe yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ |
pañcāṅgopāsanenaiva puraścārī sukhaṃ vrajet || 1 || iti ||

pañcāṅgāni mahādevi japo homaśca tarpaṇam |
svābhiṣekaśca viprāṇāmārādhanamapīśvari || 2 ||

pūrvapūrvadaśāṃśena puraścaraṇamucyate |
* * * * * * * * ||

iti kulamūlāvatāravacanāt pañcāṅgaṃ vadanti | vaiṣṇavatantre -

japo homastarpaṇaṃ ca seko brāhmaṇabhojanam |
pañcāṅgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇamucyate || 1 ||

iti || apare tu - mūlamantradaśāṃśaṃ syādaṅgamantrajapādikam iti 
kapilavacanāt japo'ṅgānāṃ daśāṃśena kartavyaḥ siddhimicchatā iti 
vāyavīyasaṃhitāvacanāt ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vadanti | itare tu :

p. 346)

japo homastarpaṇaṃ ca svābhiṣeko'ghamarṣaṇam |
sūryārghya jalapānaṃ ca praṇāmaṃ devapūjanam || 1 ||

brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ ca pūrvapūrvadaśāṃśataḥ |
daśāṃśo (ṅgo) pāsanaṃ bhaktyā puraścaraṇamucyate || 2 ||

iti tantrāntaravacanāddaśāṅgaṃ vadanti | kvacijjapasamasaṃkhyo homaḥ 
homasamamapi tarpaṇam | kvacitsarvāṇi samānyeva | śatāṃśenāpi kvacit 
homayejjapasaṃkhyayā iti prayogāntareṣu tarpayettāvadeteṣāṃ manūnāṃ 
hutasaṃkhyayā iti nartakagopālaviṣaye yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ manuṃ japtvā 
tāvaddhomādikaṃ caret iti grahaṇakālīnapuraścaraṇādau na (?tu) 
kvaciduktestatra japasaṃkhyāyā alpīyastvāt aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ 
tatsahasraṃ tilaiḥ śubhaiḥ iti mahiṣamardinīviṣaye tatra japasya bhūyastvāt 
yadvā japacaturthāṃśaṃ svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaret iti 
vaiśaṃpāyanasaṃhitāvacanāt  varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasram 
ghṛtaplutaiḥ | pāyasānnaiḥ prajuhuyāt iti śāradātilakavacanāt kṣetrāntare 
japasyāṣṭabhāgena siddhyati iti dakṣiṇāmūrtikalpavacanāt 
juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena saghṛtaistilataṇḍulaiḥ iti sārasaṃgrahavacanācca 
homasyāniyatatvāt tarpayettaddaśāṃśena saghṛtena payondhasā | 
kuryāddaśāṃśato homaṃ tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ iti sanatkumāravacanāt 
tarpayettāvadanyeṣāṃ manunāṃ hutasaṃkhyayā | tarpaṇaṃ vihitaṃ nityam iti 
śaivāgamavacanācca tarpaṇasyāpyaniyatatvācca tattatkalpoktameva 
puraścaraṇaṃ yuktamityasmatsiddhāntaḥ || prakṛte śrīvidyājapasaṃkhyā ca 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām :

japte lakṣaikamātre tu devyau tau(yoṣito) vighnakārikāḥ |
tāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi || 1 ||

tadā lakṣatrayaṃ japyānniyamena śucirbudhaḥ |
* * * * * * * * ||

iti | vāmakeśvare -

japte lakṣakamātre tu kṣubhyante bhūtale'ṅganāḥ |
yadi na kṣubhyatītthaṃ hi sādhakasya mano manāk || 1 ||

saṃkṣubhyante tataḥ sarvāḥ pātāle nāgakanyakāḥ |
tāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi || 2 ||

tataḥ svarganivāsinyo vidravanti surāṅganāḥ |
evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ sādhakottamaḥ || 3 ||

saṃkṣobhayati deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
* * * * * * * * ||

iti | jagatkṣobhakṛtaphalasyāntarāyarūpatvāt | jñānārṇave śrīvidyāyāḥ 
puraścaraṇamuktam - (pa0 17)

yatra vā kutracidbhāge liṅgaṃ syātpaścimāmukham |
svayambhūrbāṇaliṅgaṃ vā vṛṣaśūnyaṃ jalasthitam || 1 ||

paścimāyatanaṃ vāpi itaraṃ cāpi suvrate |
śaktikṣetreṣu gaṅgāyāṃ nadyāṃ parvatamastake || 2 ||

pavitre susthale devī japedvidyāṃ prasannadhīḥ |
tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣāddevīsvarūpavān || 3 ||

tato bhavati vidyeyaṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇī |
evaṃ japaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvādau sādhakottamaḥ || 4 ||

kiṃśukairhavanaṃ kuryād daśāṃśena varānane |
kusumbhakusumairvāpi madhuratrayamiśritaiḥ || 5 ||

vidhinoktaprakāreṇa vighnaughaṃ nāśayet kṣaṇāt |
sarvakāmapradaṃ rājyabhuktimuktiphalapradam || 6 ||

iti | itaraṃ parvataliṅgam | evaṃ lakṣajapaḥ śrīvidyāyāḥ puraścaraṇam | 
daśāṃśahomasya taddharmasya kāmapradatvāditi phalasya cāpyabhidhānāt 
antastad dharmopadeśāditi nyāyāt tattvanirṇayāt prayogādau 
vidhānānuktānāṃ prayogānāṃ kathaṃ siddhirityākāṃkṣāyāṃ 
puraścaraṇapūrvo'sau viniyogo vinirmitaḥ iti vacanāt tadabhidhānasyaiva 
yogyatvācca | tathā śrīkramasaṃhitāyāmapi lopāmudrāvidyāmuddhṛtyoktaṃ 
lakṣamevaṃ vidhaṃ japtvā sarvapāpaharo bhavet iti lakṣajapamātramevoktamiti | 
vāmakeśvaratantre'pyevamevoktamiti vadanti | vastuvastu 
vicāryamāṇadakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitaikavākyatayā jñānārṇave 
śrīcakrasādhanaprakaraṇoktatrilakṣajapaḥ eva puraścaraṇamiti bhāti |

yathā jñānārṇave (pa0 14)

śṛṇu sarvāṅgasubhge śrīcakravidhimuttamam |
yasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadā śivaḥ || 1 ||

anena vidhinā yatra śrīcakraṃ kramasaṃyutam |
pūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

p. 347)

nagaraṃ vaśamāyāti deśaṃ maṇḍalamadrije |
yoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥ || 3 ||

vidyāvimūḍhahṛdayāḥ sādhake nyastamānasāḥ |
taddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥ || 4 ||

akṣamālāṃ samāśrītya mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇīm |
atha muktāphalamayīṃ vāṅmokṣaphaladāyinīm || 5 ||

sarvasiddhipradāṃ nityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarīm |
yathā muktāphalamayīṃ tathā sphaṭikanirmitām || 6 ||

rudrākṣamālikā mokṣe bhavetsarvasamṛddhidā |
pravālamālā vaśye tu sarvakāryārthasādhikā || 7 ||

māṇikyamālā phaladā sāmrājyaphaladāyinī |
putrajīvakamālā tu vaśyadā bhogadā bhavet || 8 ||

akṣamālāṃ prapūjyātha candanena prapūjitām |
samāśritya japedvidyāṃ lakṣamātraṃ yadā śuciḥ || 9 ||

yoṣito bhrāmayantyenaṃ manastasya suniścalam |
tadā dvitīyalakṣaṃ tu prajapet sādhakottamaḥ || 10 ||

pātālatalanāgendrakanyakāḥ kṣobhayanti tam |
tāsāṃ kaṭākṣajālaistu na mohaṃ yāti sādhakaḥ || 11 ||

tadā lakṣatrayaṃ kuryāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
tṛtīyalakṣe samprāpte grāvayanti surāṅganāḥ || 12 ||

abhimānena saundaryasaubhāgyamadakāriṇaḥ |
sādhakaṃ drāvayantyeva tataścāsau manaḥsthiraḥ || 13 ||

tadā lakṣatrayaṃ sādhuḥ sarvapāpanikṛntanam |
evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ svasthamānasaḥ || 14 ||

saṃkṣobhayati bhūrlokasvarlokatalavāsinaḥ |
puruṣā yoṣito vaśyāścarācaramapi priye || 15 ||

iti trilakṣajapamuktvā śrīcakrasādhanasyoktavāt śrīcakrasādhanasya 
kāmyaprayogatvāt kāmyaprayogasya vidyāsiddherapekṣitatvādvidyāsiddheḥ 
puraścaraṇamūlakatvāt puraścaraṇamanuktvā 
kamyaprayogakathanānaucityādakṣamālābhedanirūpaṇādakṣamālā-yāḥ 
puraścaraṇaprakaraṇa eva vaktavyatvādvighnabāhulyakathanādevaṃvidhānāṃ 
vighnānāṃ siddhipratibandhakatayā puraścaraṇakāla eva niṣiddhatvāt 
kāmyajapeṣu tūktavighnānāmeva phalatvenābhidhānāt vratasthaḥ 
sthiramānasaḥ iti niyamamanaḥsthairyayoḥ puraścaraṇakāla 
evātyantamāvaśyakatvena tatkathanasyaucityāt | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyāmapi 

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śrīvidyāmantrasādhanam |
śamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallaverarkasambhavaiḥ || 1 ||

śrīcakraṃ pūjayed devi māsamātraṃ samāhitaḥ |
sahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥ || 2 ||

ityārabhya prāyaścittapūrvakaṃ jñānārṇavoktaprakāreṇaiva 
sthānākṣamālopāṃśvādijapalakṣaṇaṃ prāguktaprakāreṇa 
vighnatrayakathanapūrvakaṃ ca lakṣatrayajapamuktvā taddaśāṃśena homaḥ 
syāt kusumairbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥ | kusumbhapuṣpairjuhuyānmadhuratrayalolitaiḥ iti 
taddaśāṃśahomakathanādeva lakṣatrayajapa eṣa puraścaraṇamiti tattvam | yattu 
jñānārṇave yatra vā kutracidbhāge liṅgaṃ satpaścimāmukham | ityārabhya 
japasthānakathanapūrvakaṃ tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣāddevīsvarūpavān 
ityuktaṃ satu lakṣaśabdaḥ pūrvoktalakṣatrayasmārako 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitaikavākyatvāt | ata eva śrīcakrasādhanaprakaraṇāt 
tatrānuktasthānahomāvevātroktau anyathā tvakṣamālādīnāmapyatraiva 
vaktumucitatvāt | navalakṣajapasyāpi puraścaraṇaṃ kecidvadanti | 
mārge'sminnavalakṣamakṣayaphalāprāptyai tato lakṣayet iti 
kvacitphalādhikyārtham | tathā ca vāmakeśvare pratyekalakṣaphalasmaraṇam 
tathā : (pa0 5)

lakṣamekaṃ japeddevi mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate |
lakṣadvayena pāpāni saptajanmakṛtāni ca || 1 ||

nāśayet tripurā devī sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ |
japtvā lakṣatrayaṃ mantrī yantrito mantravigrahaḥ || 2 ||

pātakaṃ nāśayedāśu yadi janmasahasrakam |
japtvā vidyāṃ caturlakṣaṃ mahāvāgīśvaro bhavet || 3 ||

pañcalakṣād daridro'pi sākṣādvaiśravaṇo bhavet |
japtvā ṣaḍlakṣametasyā mahāvidyādhareśvaraḥ || 4 ||

japtvaivaṃ sapta lakṣāṇi khecarīmelanaṃ bhavet |
aṣṭalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā vidyāṃ maheśvari || 5 ||

aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīśo jāyate devapūjitaḥ |
navalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā tripurasundarīm || 6 ||

vidhivat jāyate mantrī haramūrtirivāparaḥ |
kartā hartā svayaṃ gauri loke cāprahataḥ prabhuḥ || 7 ||

prasanno mudito dhīraḥ svacchandagatirīśvaraḥ |
* * * * * * * * ||

p. 348)

iti | anyatrāpi : athavā navalakṣaṃ tu japedvidyāmananyadhīḥ iti | japellakṣaṃ 
mantraṃ ityapi kutracit | tadasāmarthyaparaṃ pakṣatrayamadhye gurusampradāyaḥ | 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyāmapi :

athavā navalakṣaṃ tu japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
taddaśāṃśena homaṃ tu pūrvoktavidhinācaret || 1 ||

sādhayet svargabhūlokapātālatalavāsinaḥ |

iti | jñānārṇave tu navalakṣajapo noktaḥ kiṃtvekalakṣamārabhyaikalakṣasyedaṃ 
phalamityādi navalakṣaparyantasya pṛthak pṛthak phalamuktaṃ natu dvitīyalakṣasya 
tṛtīyalakṣasyeti | tasmāttatra sambhūya pañcacatvāriṃśallakṣajapo jāyate tena 
tatra puraścaraṇatvaśaṅkāpi nāsti satu kāmyajapa eveti niścitam | anyacca : 
siddhamantratayā nātra yugasaṃkhyāpariśramaḥ | iti || atha japanirṇayaḥ |

yasmiśca nigadenaiva mantrasaṃkhyā vidhīyate |
tatra tu sarvamantrāṇāṃ saṃkhyāvṛttiryugakramāt || 1 ||

kalpoktaiva kṛte saṃkhyā tretāyāṃ dviguṇā bhavet |
dvāpare triguṇā proktā kalau saṃkhyā caturguṇā || 2 ||

iti | rudrayāmale : prajapeduktasaṃkhyāyāścaturguṇajapaṃ kalau iti | atra kecit 
prapañcayāgaśāradātilakāyuktajapasyāpi caturguṇādinā kalau 
puraścaraṇamiti vadanti tatra nāradapañcarātrādidarśanāt 
prapañcasārādyuktajapaścaturguṇa eva | tathā nāradapañcarātre :

mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya trīṇyahānyekameva vā |
upoṣya śukladvādaśyāmārabhyāṣṭākṣaraṃ japet || 1 ||

aṣṭalakṣamavicchinnaṃ puraścaraṇakṛd dvijaḥ |
śuklācāraḥ śuciḥ snāto vāgyato vijitendriyaḥ || 2 ||

mantrasiddhiradṛṣṭārthā lakṣadvayajapādbhavet |
tato hi dviguṇābhyāsādaihikyāmūṣmikī ca sā || 3 ||

evameṣātmaśuddhiḥ syādetāvān prathame yuge |
tretāyāṃ dviguṇaḥ prokto dvāpare triguṇastathā || 4 ||

kalau caturguṇaḥ dvātriṃśallakṣalakṣaṇā |
* * * * * * * * ||
iti | adṛṣṭārthā mantrasāyujyakarī | aihikī ihalokasukhadā | āmuṣmikī 
svargādilokadā | ātmaśuddhistattvajñānasadhanabhūtaśuddhiriti | evaṃ 
dvātriṃśallakṣajapamata eva dvātriṃśallakṣamānena satu mantraṃ japetpunaḥ 
ityācāryacaraṇairapyuktam | jñānārṇave bālāprakaraṇe varṇalakṣaṃ 
japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunetpriye iti bālāyāmabhidhāya 
nyāsapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāḥ pūrvavadācaret iti bhairavyā mantre pradiṣṭam 
lakṣatrayajapaṃ caturguṇīkṛtya dīkṣāṃ prāpya japenmantraṃ tattvalakṣaṃ 
jitendriyaḥ iti bhairavyāmabhidhāya bālāyāṃ tāvad eṣā bāleti vikhyātā 
trailokyavaśakāriṇī | japapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāḥ pūrvavadācaret | iti 
śāradātilakakṛtāpi pradiṣṭam | tattvārdhalakṣaṃ dvādaśalakṣaṃ ato 
dvādasamaṃtrāṇi vadantyeke vipaścitaḥ iti prayogasāravacanāditi | prapañcāre 
bhairavīprakaraṇe tu : (9 | 9) dīkṣāṃ prāpya viśiṣṭalakṣaṇayujaḥ 
satsamprādāyādgurorlabdhvā mantramamuṃ japet suniyataṃ tattvārdhalakṣaṃ 
vaśī | iti dvādaśalakṣamuktam | tathā : lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantram iti 
dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyāmuktasya tripuṭāmantrasya japecca 
mantramādityalakṣam iti bhānulakṣaṃ japedenam iti 
prapañcasāraśāradātilakayoścaturguṇajapa evābhihitaḥ | tena ekatra nirṇītaḥ  
iti nyāyena sarvatra caturguṇa evābhihita iti nirṇītam | naca tadarddhasaṃkhyakaṃ 
vāpi virodhābhāvāditi prapañcasāre ardhajapābhidhānavirodha iti vācyam | 
uktanāradavacanenaiva hyaihikasiddhiparatvādāmuṣmikaparatvādvāpi 
virodhābhāvāt | iti samudragānāṃ saritāṃ ca tīre japedvivikte nija eva gehe | 
viṣṇorgṛhe vā puruṣo manasvī | samudragā sākṣādeva anyathā sarvāsāmapi 
paramparayā tathātvād viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāditi | manasvī śraddhāvān || 
sanatkumāraḥ : 

nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ tīre goṣṭhe'thavā mune |
aśvatthabilvamūle vā sindhutīre jalāśaye || 1 ||

paścimābhimukhe devagṛhe vā śailamastake |

iti | devaḥ śivaḥ | pratyaṅmukhe śivasthāne vṛṣabheṇa vivarjite iti 
kumbhasambhavavacanācca | nāradapañcarātre 

p. 349)

girigoṣṭhapraviṣyandanadyaraṇyāśramahradāḥ |
deśāḥ puṇyā japasyaite yatra vā jāyate ruciḥ || 1 ||

iti | praviṣyandaḥ prasravaṇam | nadī puṇyanadītīram | araṇyaṃ puṇyāraṇyaṃ 
puṣkarārbudādi | pāvanaṃ dhanam iti śāradātilake | trailokyasaṃmohanatantre :

bilvacchāyāṃ samāśritya mūle'śvatthasya vā priye |
gurorvā saṃnidhau goṣṭhe vṛṣaśūnye śivālaye || 1 ||

nadītīre'driśṛṅge vā tulasīkānane'pi vā |
abhīṣṭadevasāṃnidhye japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ || 2 ||

iti | nadītīre puṇyanadītīre anyanadītīrasya niṣiddhatvāt | kapilapañcarātre

tīrthakṣetravanārāmadevālayanadīhradāḥ |
harervivikta ityete deśāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥ || 1 ||

iti | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

sūryasyāgnergurorindordīpasya jvalitasya vā |
viprāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva saṃnidhau śasyate japaḥ || 1 ||

athavā nivasettatra yatra cittaṃ prasīdati |
gṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto goṣṭhe daśaguṇastu saḥ || 2 ||

ārāme ca tathāraṇye sahasraguṇa ucyate |
ayutaṃ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣaguṇastu saḥ || 3 ||

koṭirdevālaye prāhuranantaṃ mama saṃnidhau |

iti | mama śivasya || tathā śaṅkhaḥ anantaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau | iti yāmale

mlechaduṣṭamṛgavyādhaśaṅkātaṅkavivarjite |
ekānte pāvane nindārahite bhaktisaṃyute || 1 ||

sudeśe dhārmike rāṣṭre subhikṣe nirupadrave |
ramye bhaktajanasthāne nivasenna parāśraye || 2 ||

rājānaḥ sacivā rājapuruṣāḥ prabhavo janāḥ |
caranti yena mārgeṇa na vasettatra tattvavit || 3 ||

jīrṇadevālayodyānagṛhavṛkṣataleṣu ca |
nadīkūlādrikūleṣu bhūchidrādiṣu no vaset || 4 ||

puṇyakṣetrādikaṃ gatvā kuryādbhūmiparigraham |
brūyādamukamantrasya puraścaraṇasiddhaye || 5 ||

mayeyaṃ gṛhyate bhūmirmantro me siddhyatāmiti |
bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kṛtvā parimāṇaṃ ca sarvataḥ || 6 ||

nadīparvatatīrthādau parimāṇena khaṇḍitam |
grāme krośamitaṃ sthānaṃ nagare taddvayaṃ smṛtam || 7 ||

kṣīravṛkṣamayān kīlān astramantrābhimantritān |
nikhaneddaśadigbhāge teṣvastraṃ ca prapūjayet || 8 ||

kṣetreśakīlito mantro na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate |
kṣetrapālādikāṃstatra pūjayedvidhivittamaḥ || 9 ||

dikpatibhyo baliṃ dattvā tataḥ kṣetraṃ samāśrayet |
kūrmacakramavijñāya yaḥ kuryājjapayajñakam || 10 ||

tajjapasya phalaṃ nāsti sarvānarthāya kalpate |
* * * * * * * * ||

iti | tantrāntare 

kūrmacakraṃ parijñāya yo japādividhau sthitaḥ |
prāpnoti sakalānyuktānyanyathā nāśameti ca || 1 ||

tasmāt kūrmavibhāgaṃ tu vijñāyākhilamācaret |
sa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakārastathocyate || 2 ||

prathamastu paraḥkūrmastato deśagatastathā |
grāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā sa vyavasthitaḥ || 3 ||

deśaṃ grāmaṃ gṛhaṃ vāstuṃ navadhā vibhajettataḥ |
prāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyaset || 4 ||

akṣarāṇyaya yādīni tathāṣṭau padayorlikhet |
īśe dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyaset || 5 ||

īśāntāṃstu dviśaḥ paścānnāmādyarṇa yato bhavet |
tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥ || 6 ||

pucchamekamatho madhyaṃ pṛṣṭhamekaṃ ṣaḍaṅgavat |
mukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 7 ||

kukṣau tu nityanaiṣphalyaṃ pādayornaiva  siddhayaḥ |
pucche mṛtyustu niyataṃ sarvārthasiddhayaḥ || 8 ||

tasmāt tat sādhu vijñāya kuryātsarvaṃ japādikam |

p. 350)

iti | atha kādimatarītyā śrīvidyāmadhikṛtya kulamūlāvatāre -

brahmanāḍīgatānādikṣāntavarṇān vibhāvya ca |
arṇaṃ binduyutaṃ kṛtvā sveṣṭamantraṃ japetsudhīḥ || 1 ||

akārādiṣu saṃyojya tathā kādiṣu ca kramāt |
kṣārṇaṃ merumatho tatra kalpayejjagadīśvari || 2 ||

tadā lipirbhavedakṣamālārdhaśatasaṃkhyayā |
anayā sarvamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 3 ||

kṣakāraṃ merusaṃsthāne lakārādivilomataḥ |
ekaikāntaritaṃ mantraṃ japedevaṃ phalapradam || 4 ||

iti | atrāṣṭottarasahasraṃ vāṣṭottaraśataṃ vā yadā japaḥ kāryaḥ syāttadā 
vargāṣṭakavibhedena bhavedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam iti | atra 
vargāṣṭakajapastaddiṣṭaśatādisaṃkhyāvasāna eva kartavyaḥ | eṣa 
kṛtayugajapaḥ | kalāvetaccaturguṇajapādikaṃ kāryamiti | śrītantrarāje (5 pa0 68 
ślo0)

vidyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ siddhiṃ tadvrataṃ barjyameva ca |
tadābhimukhyacihnāni vighnāni prāktanādyataḥ || 1 ||

śṛṇu krameṇa deveśi sarvadā prītikārakam |
yena martyo'pi siddhyeta jīvanmukto bhavanmayaḥ || 2 ||

srātaḥ sugandhasalilaiḥ prākpūjāproktarūpavān |
guruṃ vittena saṃtoṣya raktāgare kramaṃ bhajet || 3 ||

sandhyātraye'pi japavān sahasraṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ |
mocāguḍasitāpetaṃ payaḥ pāyasamarpayet || 4 ||

nīrājanaṃ ca karpūraiḥ kuryāt sandhyāsu tāsvapi |
homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ cendumajjalaiḥ || 5 ||

svanityādūrdhvato jāpyaṃ trisahasraṃ dinaṃ prati |
kuryāttena bhavet pūrṇaṃ lakṣaṃ pūrṇāntamīśvari || 6 ||

evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ prathame tu kṛte yuge |
tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ tadvaddvāpare triguṇam smṛtam || 7 ||

kalau caturguṇaṃ proktamakṣarāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyayā |
tārtīyasaptasaṃkhyā sā tena syādekaviṃśatiḥ || 8 ||

iti | tārtīyakūṭasya svaravyañjanabindūn pṛthakkṛtya saptākṣarāṇi bhavanti 
teṣāṃ saptānāṃ varṇānāṃ prativarṇaṃ trilakṣamiti 
sambhūyaikaviṃśatilakṣajapaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtayuge | kalāvetaccaturguṇaṃ 
japa iti puraścaraṇamuktam | puraścaraṇaṃ tu 
japahomatarpaṇa(svābhiṣeka)brāhmaṇabhojanātmakaṃ pañcāṅgarūpaṃ 
bhavati | atraitadaṅgapañcakaṃ pūrvavat daśāṃśataḥ kāryamiti (tantrarāje tu 
homasaṃkhyāsamasaṃkhyaṃ tarpaṇamiti) viśeṣaḥ | tathā tatraiva :

tenānyeṣu yugeṣu syāt saṃkhyāvṛddhirudīritā |
vanītākṣobhato bhogānna vighna yadi jāyate || 9 ||

tāsu saṃkhyāsu pūrṇāsu saṃprārthya svaṃ śrayet kramam |
varjyāni śṛṇu deveśi taddineṣu sadaiva hi || 10 ||

nāstikaiḥ saha saṃlāpo maithunaṃ parininditam |
cintāśokau tathālāpaṃ deśāntaraparibhramam || 11 ||

tadvāsareṣu varjyāni proktānyanyāni śāṅkari |
śṛṇu sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nāśakāni ca || 12 ||

parakṣetragṛhastrīṣu vāñchā tannindanāni ca |
strīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca duṣṭāsvapi na yojayet || 13 ||

siddhicihnāni coktāni vāsanākathane mayā |
anukūlyasya cihnāni śṛṇu sādhayatastadā || 14 ||

sādhayataḥ puraścaraṇe niviṣṭasya | tadā puraścaraṇakāla |

svapne poteṣu vanitāvṛndaiḥ saṃmelanaṃ niśi |
gajādrisaudhaśṛṅgeṣu vihāro rājadarśanam || 15 ||

gajānāmaṅganānāṃ ca darśana nṛtyagītayoḥ |
utsavaṃ sasurāmāṃsadarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā || 16 ||

nindyāni śṛṇu deveśi vighnānarthakarāṇi ca |
kuṣṇavarṇairbhaṭaiḥ svapne prahārastailalepanam || 17 ||

mauthunaṃ paranārībhirindriyacyavanaṃ tathā |
rāṣṭrakṣobho vahnivāyuja(nanī?labhī) bandhunāśanam || 18 ||

gurāvupekṣāsaṃpattirvastūnāṃ vyādhibādhanam |
anyamantrārcane śraddhā vighno nityārcane'niśam || 19 ||

narāṇāṃ bahubhiḥ puṇyaiḥ kṛtairbahuṣu janmasu |
śraddhāsthairya saṃpradāyasiddhi nityārcane bhavet || 20 ||

atha kūrmacakram | tatraiva - (5 pa0 88 ślo0)

kūrmasthitimavijñāya yo japādividhisthitaḥ |
sa nāpnoti phalānyuktānyanyathā nāśakāni ca || 21 ||

tasmāt kūrmavibhāgaṃ tu vijñāyākhilamācaret |
sa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu priye || 22 ||

p. 351)

prathamastu paraḥ kūrmastato deśagatastathā |
grāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā tadvyavasthitiḥ || 23 ||

deśaṃ grāmaṃ gṛhaṃ vāstuṃ navadhā vibhajettataḥ |
prāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyaset || 24 ||

akṣarāṇi samānyeva catvāri parayornyaset |
īśo dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyaset || 25 ||

īśāntāsu dviśaḥ paścānnāmādyarṇa yato bhavet |
tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥ || 26 ||

pucchamekamato madhyaṃ pṛṣṭhamekaṃ ṣaḍaṅgavān |
mukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoralpasiddhikṛt || 27 ||

kukṣau tu nityanaiṣphalyaṃ pādayoḥ sarvahānikṛt |
pucche mṛtistu niyatā pṛṣṭhe sarvārthadāyakam || 28 ||

tasmāt tatsādhu vijñāya kuryāt sarva samāhitam |
vyañjanaṃ deśakūrme syād gṛhakūrme svarāstathā || 29 ||

grāmādikūrma dvitayaṃ parakūrme natu dvayam |
nityaṃ pūrvamukho yasmāttena tatsiddhirīritā || 30 ||

evaṃ kūrmavibhāgo'yamīritaste caturvidhaḥ |
mantrāṇāṃ yena siddhiḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sarvatastadā || 31 ||

saṃvarddhyāmavistāraṃ hṛtvāṣṭabhistu śeṣataḥ |
vijñāya varga teṣvekaṃ nāmādyaṃ nāmni kalpayet || 32 ||

tattatsthāneṣu niyatamanarthaśūnyatā tathā |
vāstuṣvajñātarūpeṣu prasiddhaṃ nāmato bhavet || 33 ||

iti | atra vyañjanayukte'pi deśanāmani vyañjanasya prādhānyaṃ deśakūrme 
jñeyam tathaiva grāmakūrme svarasya jñeyamiti | kevalasvarayukte tu sarvatra 
svarasyāri(bahiḥ)koṣṭhaṃ mukhaṃ jñeyam | devīyāmale :

kurukṣetre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame |
mahākāle ca kāśyāṃ ca dīpasthānaṃ na cintayet || 1 ||

iti | tatra prayogastu : tatra samudratīranadīparvataśṛṅga samudragāminīnadītīra 
viṣṇugṛhaviviktanijagṛhagoṣṭhāśvatthabilvamūlajalāśayapaścimābhimukhavṛ.
saśūnyaśivālayagurusannidhitulasīvanasveṣṭhadevatāsannidhi-
puṇyakṣetratīrthavanopavananadīhradasvābhimatasthāna 
mlecchaduṣṭamṛgavyālaśaṅkāvarjitaikāṃtanindārahitadhārmika 
sveṣṭadevatābhaktajanāśrayasubhikṣanirupadrava(rāja)tatsacivādigamanāgamana
rahitasthānānyeṣāmanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ grāme krośamātraṃ nagare 
krośadvayamātraṃ nadīparvatatīrthādau parimāṇarahitaṃ amukasyeha mantrasya 
puraścaraṇasiddhaye | mayeyaṃ gṛhyate bhūmirmantro me siddhyatāmitimantreṇa 
bhūmiparigrahaṃ vidhāya kṣīravṛkṣabhavānvitastimitān daśa kīlān 
kṛtvāstramantreṇa pṛthagaṣṭadhābhimantrya pūrvādyaṣṭasu dikṣu 
indreśānayormadhye nir-ṛtivaruṇayormadhye ca nikhanet | teṣvastraṃ ca sampūjya 
teṣu sthāneṣvindrādidaśadikpālebhyo māṣabhaktabaliṃ dadyāt | tataḥ 
kṣetrapālaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vāstupuruṣaṃ sampūjya prākpratyagāyatā 
dakṣiṇottarāyatāścatasraścatasro rekhā vilikhya nava koṣṭhāni kṛtvā teṣu 
pūrvādikrameṇa kacaṭatapayaśākhyān saptavargān saptakoṣṭheṣu 
vilikhyeśānakoṣṭhe lakṣau vilikhya madhyakoṣṭhaṃ tathaiva navadhā vibhajya 
pūrvādikrameṇa dviśo dviśaḥ ṣoḍaśasvarānaṣṭoṣṭheṣu vilikhediti 
kūrmacakraṃ nirmāya tatra madhyanavake madhye pūrvādikrameṇāṣṭasu dikṣu 
cāmṛtavṛṣabhaśaularājavāsukyārthakṛcchaktipadmayonimahāśaṅkha-
cchāyācchatragaṇān navakṣetrapālān praṇavādicaturthīnamo'ntatattannāmnā 
sampūjya grāmanāmādyakṣarayuktakoṣṭhadiśi kūrmamukhe tadalābhe madhye 
kūrmapṛṣṭhe vā mukhādadhaḥkoṣṭhadvayānyatame kūrmahaste vā gṛhaṃ 
japārthaṃ śītavātātapanivāraṇakṣamaṃ kuryāt | kālikodbhave :

sthānasādhakayornāmnoraritvaṃ yatra vidyate |
tadakṣaśāstrato jñātvā tatra samyak parityajet || 1 ||

iti | akṣaśāstre -

aritvamadvayasyoktaṃ gakāreṇa parasparam |
ṛdvayasya ṭhakāreṇa ṭhakārasyāpi tena ca || 2 ||

ḷdvayasya pakāreṇa pakārasyāpi ḷdvayam |
odvayasya ṣakāreṇa ṣakārasyauyugena ca || 2 ||

jakārasya ṭakāreṇa jhakārasya khakārataḥ |
ḍakārasya takāreṇa phakārasya dhakārataḥ || 3 ||

bhakārasya tu repheṇa yakārasya  sakārataḥ |
aritvameṣāṃ varṇānāmanyeṣāṃ mitrabhāvanā || 4 ||

kūrmacakre ripusthānaṃ sādhako yatnatastyajet |
yathā gargasya vairī syādaṭṭahāsaṃ mahatpuram || 5 ||

gayāmareśvarasyaivamākārādyeṣu yojayet |
ṛjubhaṭṭasya ṭhakkākhyaṃ ḷtakasyāriḥ padmakam || 6 ||

uḍḍiyāṇaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya raudraṃ ṣaḍguṇakasya ca |
jyantī ṭaṅkadhārasya khaṃdhāraṃ ṛṃṝ(jhaṃjha)ṇasya ca || 7 ||

p. 352)

ḍākadevasya tārākhyaṃ dharmākhyaṃ phaṇḍibhaṭṭataḥ |
bhadrasya ramyakaṃ caiva yajñadattasya somakaḥ || 8 ||

evaṃ krameṇa saṃśodhya vairisthānaṃ tyajedvudhaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * *  * * * * || 9 ||

iti || atha mālā - sātu dvividhā mātṛkākṣaramayī rudrākṣādimaṇimayī ceti | 
tatra prathamāmāhottaratantre -

akārādikṣakārāntairbindumanmātṛkākṣaraiḥ |
anulomavilomasthaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālayā || 1 ||

pratyekavarṇayukmantrā japtāḥ syuḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ |
vairimantrā api nṝṇāṃ susiddhādyāstu kiṃ punaḥ || 2 ||

iti | śāradātilake -

ādikṣāntārṇayogitvādakṣamāleti kīrtitā |
tadvarṇasaṃkhyamaṇibhirjapamālāṃ prakalpayet || 1 ||

iti | jñānārṇave -

akāraḥ prathamo devi kṣakāro'ntyastataḥ param |
akṣamāleti vikhyātā mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇī ||

iti | atra vargāṣṭakajapastu uddiṣṭasaṃkhyāvasāne kāryaḥ |
taduktaṃ mātṛkārṇave -

ārabhyākāramādau manasi parijapenmātṛkāṃ sāvasānāṃ
dhṛtvā taccāvasānaṃ punarapi ca paṭhedāantamevāvarohe |
lāntānaṣṭau ca varṇāstadanu parijapedbhūya evāvasāne
kṣāntaṃ saṃhārayuktaṃ paśupatigaditā yāmale mālikeyam || 1 ||

iti | dhṛtvā merusthāne | avasānaṃ kṣakāraṃ | lāntān kacaṭatapayaśalākhyān | 
tadanūddiṣṭasaṃkhyāsamāptyanantaram || avasāne uddiṣṭaśatādyavasāne | 
evo'vadhāraṇe || dvitīyā tūttaratantre :

atha vakṣye'kṣamālāyā vidhānaṃ mantrikāmyayā |
pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ proktā maṇibhirbhuktidāyinī || 1 ||

triṃśadbhirdhanadā saptaviṃśatyākṣaistu sarvadā |
abhicārakarī pañcadaśabhiḥ parikalpitā || 2 ||

catuṣpañcāśadakṣaiḥ sā kāmyakarmasu siddhidā |
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kḷptā sarvābhīṣṭapradā matā || 3 ||

maṇayaḥ śaṅkhasaṃbhūtāḥ proktā lakṣmīpradā matāḥ |
muktipradāḥ sphaṭikajāḥ padmākṣāḥ puṣṭivardhanāḥ || 4 ||

bhuktimuktipradāḥ proktā rudrākṣāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ |
putrajīvabhavāḥ putrapaśudhānyasamṛddhidāḥ || 5 ||

vidrumotthāstu maṇayo dhanasaubhāgyavaśyadāḥ |
mauktikā muktidāḥ proktāḥ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidāḥ || 6 ||

pāpāpahāḥ kuśamayāḥ kāmadāḥ svarṇarūpyajā |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * |

iti | tathā śāradātilake - (23 pa0 118 ślo0)

rudrākṣamālikā sūte jape jāpimanorathān |
padmākṣairvihitā mālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinī matā || 1 ||

kuśagranthimayī mālā sadyaḥ pāpapraṇāśinī |
putrajīvaphalaiḥ kḷptā kurute putrasaṃpadam || 2 ||

nirmitā rūpyamaṇibhirjapamālepsitapradā |
hiraṇmayairviracitā mālā kāmān prayacchati || 3 ||

pravālairvihitā mālā prayacchet puṣkalaṃ dhanam |
saubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālā mauktikairvihitā śriyam || 4 ||

nirmitā śaṅkhamaṇibhiḥ kurute kīrtimavyayām |
sarvairetairviracitā mālā sā muktaye nṛṇām || 5 ||

iti || sarvairiti ekena pañcamiḥ pañcabhiriti kecit | miśraṇe tu niṣedhamāha 
uttaratantre -

indrākṣairyadi japyet rudrākṣaiḥ sphāṭikaistathā ||
nānyanmadhye prayoktavyaṃ putrajīvādikaṃ ca yat || 1 ||

yadanyattu prayuñjīta mālāyāṃ japakarmaṇi |
tasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca na dadāti priyaṅkarī || 2 ||

janmāntare jāyate'sau vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
miśrībhāvaṃ tato yāti caṇḍālaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ || 3 ||

iti | brahmayāmale -

khaḍgaśṛṅgasya yā mālā pitṛṇāṃ mokṣadāyinī |
niśādārukṛtā vaśye lākṣayā jvarakarmaṇi || 1 ||

p. 353)

arkasyoccāṭane kāryā śrīphalairjñānasādhane |
gajadantasya maṇibhiḥ kuryāt sarvārthadāyinī || 2 ||

rājato sarvavaśyeṣu mohane tāmrajā smṛtā |
māraṇe cāyasī proktā śrīphalairbilvakāṣṭhajaiḥ || 3 ||

sā punastrividhā proktā sāttvikī rājasī tathā |
tāmasī ceti tāsvādyā śatairaṣṭottaraiḥ śubhaiḥ || 4 ||

maṇibhiḥ śaṅkhasaṃbhūtaiḥ śvetapadmasamudbhavaiḥ |
maṇibhiḥ sāttviko putrajīvai rajatasaṃbhavaiḥ || 5 ||

śvetacandanasaṃbhūtairanyaiḥ śvetatarūdbhavaiḥ |
kuśagranthibhavaiḥ kḷptā rājasī caturuttaraiḥ || 6 ||

pañcāśadbhī raktapadmabījaiśca raktacandanaiḥ |
sauvarṇai raktatarujaiḥ pītasārasamudbhavaiḥ || 7 ||

padmakāṣṭhasamudbhūtai rajanīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavaiḥ |
devadārusamudbhūtaiḥ kṛṣṇākāṣṭhasamudbhavaiḥ || 8 ||

maṇibhistāmasī cāṣṭāviṃśadbhirmaṇibhiḥ kṛtā |
sā śamīnimbabimvākṣairindrabhadrasamudbhavaiḥ || 9 ||

kapiśārdūla-ṛkṣāṇāṃ jantūnāmasthisaṃbhavaiḥ |
narāśvarāsabhebhānāṃ snāyubhirgrathitairapi || 10 ||

tattatkāryavibhedena sā sā kāryā vipaścitā |
* * *  * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 11 ||

iti | kuśagranthimālā tu brāhmaṇānāmeva | kuśagranthyā japedvipraḥ 
suvarṇamaṇibhirnṛpaḥ | putrajīvairjapedvaiśyaḥ padmākṣaiḥ sarva eva ca || iti 
nāradavacanāt | gopālasya jape tu padmākṣamālātīva praśastā gautamena 
tanmātravidhānāt | yathā : samāhitamanā  bhūtvā padmabījākhyamālayā 
japet iti | nāradapañcarātre'pi : japasya gaṇānāṃ prāhuḥ 
padmākṣairbhaktivarddhanaiḥ iti | vaiṣṇavānāmapi rudrākṣamālātīva praśastā 
| yastu bhāgavato bhūtve tyupakramya rudrākṣaiścottamām iti varāhavacanāt ||

atha japamālāsaṃskārakālaḥ | tatra yoginītantre -

dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavī mālā kartavyā sādhakottamaiḥ |
mantrajñairviṣṇumantreṇa divyabhāge prayatnataḥ || 1 ||

iti | divyabhāge pūrvāhne | śaktīnāmapi kartavyā bhuktvā rātrau yathāvidhi | 
bhojanaṃ tu divasa eva |

aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ tathaiva ca |
caturdaśyāṃ tathā kuryācchivasyāpi sureśvari || 1 ||

caturthyāṃ gaṇanāthasya madhyāhne bhāskarasya tu |
pūrvāhne devi kartavyā saptamyāṃ jagadīśvari || 2 ||

iti || atha sūtrāṇi tatraiva -

paṭṭasūtrakṛtā mālā devyāḥ prītikarī sadā |
kārpāsairvaiṣṇavī mālā padmasūtrairathāpi vā || 1 ||

ūrṇābhirvālkalairvāpi śaivī mālā prakīrtitā |
kārpāsasūtrairanyeṣāṃ vidadhyāñjapamālikām || 2 ||

iti | kārpāsasūtre viśeṣastatraiva | tato dvijendrapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ granthivarjitam | 
viṣṇuṃ triguṇīkṛtya sūtraṃ prakṣālya yatnataḥ || kālottare skanda uvāca

devadeva mahādeva sṛṣṭisthitalayeśvara |
rudrākṣairjapamālā tu kathaṃ kāryā maheśvara || 1 ||

saṃskāraśca kathaṃ tāta kartavyaḥ kīdṛśaṃ phalam |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

īśvara uvāca

śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha vakṣyāmi rudrākṣaiḥ kriyate yathā |
japamālā vidhānena yena sā japasiddhidā || 3 ||

ekavaktrairdvivaktraiśca caturvaktraiśca pañcabhiḥ |
ṣaḍvaktrairvātha kartavyā (nitho) miśraistu varjayet || 4 ||

mukhe mukhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ mukhe mūlaṃ tu varjayet |
rudrākṣasyottamaṃ proktaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnagam || 5 ||

dhātrīphalapramāṇena śreṣṭametadudāhṛtam |
badarārdhapramāṇena caṇakānmadhyamādhaye || 6 ||

ūrdhvavaktraṃ tu mervākhyaṃ kartavyaṃ tanna laṅghayet |
navena tantunā caitad grathanīyamasaṃspṛśat || 7 ||

p. 354)

iti | asaṃspṛśat tvanyonyasya | uttaratantre

eko merustatra deyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sthūlasambhavaḥ |
ādyaṃ sthūlaṃ tatastasmāt nyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tathā || 1 ||

vinyaset kramatastasmāt sarpākārā ca sā yataḥ |
brahmagranthiyutaṃ kuryāt pratibījaṃ yathāvidhi || 2 ||

athavā granthirahitaṃ dṛḍharajjusamanvitam |
trirāvṛttyāśca madhyena cārdhavṛttyāntadeśataḥ || 3 ||

granthiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sa brahmagranthisaṃjñitaḥ |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 4 ||

iti | tathā kālottare : ekabhaktaṃ vidhāyātha (dau) sādhako grathayet svayam | 
ekabhaktaṃ tu pūrvadine natu taddine anyathā pūrvāhne kriyamāṇāyāḥ 
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvaṃ bhojanāsambhavādayuktatvācca |

kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuddhaḥ ukteṣvakṣeṣu mantravit |
yathākāmaṃ yathālābhamakṣānānīya yatnataḥ || 1 ||

vaktrasāṅkaryākaraṇe yatna uktaḥ |

anyonyasamarūpāṇi nātisthūlakṛśāni ca |
kīṭādibhiradaṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni ca || 2 ||

gavyaistu pañcabhistāni prakṣālya ca pṛthak pṛthak |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

ādau pūrvadine | akṣān rudrākṣān | yathākāmaṃ vaktrabhede 
phalabhedaśravaṇāt | śaktivyatiriktamekabhaktaṃ jñeyam || pañcagavyaṃ tu 
nṛsiṃhapurāṇe

dugdhaṃ kāñcanavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam |
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyā nīlāyāśca bhaveddadhi || 1 ||

ghṛtaṃ vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyā ityetatpañcagavyakam |
gavāṃ varṇāstu sulabhāḥ santi deśeṣu yatra ca || 2 ||

tatra varṇavibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharet |
varṇālābhe na doṣo'sti mātrāhīnaṃ tu varjayet || 3 ||

gośakṛddviguṇaṃ mūtraṃ sarpidadyāccaturguṇam |
kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pañcagavye tathā dadhi || 4 ||

gāyavyādāya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam |
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrābṇetyṛcyā dadhi || 5 ||

tejo'si śukrabhityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam |
sadyojāteti mantreṇa kṣālayet pañcagavyakaiḥ || 6 ||

prakṣālyetyuktaṃ kathaṃ taditi vivṛṇoti svayaṃ | sadya iti pañcagavyairjalaiśca | 
kṣālayet pañcagavyena sadyojātena sajjalaiḥ | iti tattvasāravacanāt |

candanāgurugandhādyairvāmadevena gharṣayet |
dhūpayet tāmaghoreṇa kṛṣṇāgurusuguggulaiḥ || 1 ||

tatpuruṣākhyamantreṇa lepayeccandanādibhiḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

ādipadena karpūrakastūrīkuṃkumādīni gṛhyante | mantrayet pañcamenaiva 
pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śatam | meruṃ ca pañcamenaiva tathāghoreṇa mantrayet || iti | 
śaivāgame :

aśvatthapatranavakaiḥ (kaṃ) padmākāreṇa kalpayet |
sūtraṃ maṇīṃśca gandhādbhiḥ kṣālitāṃstatra nikṣipet || 1 ||

tāraṃ śaktiṃ mātṛkāṃ ca sūtre rudrākṣake pṛthak |
vinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ || 2 ||

maṇimekaikamādāya sūtre tatra tu yojayet |
gopucchasadṛśī kāryā ekāgrā vā samerukā || 3 ||

mudrāṣṭakaṃ darśayitvā pratyekaṃ pūjayet kramāt |
grathitaṃ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pūrvavacca sadā śive || 4 ||

iti | mantraiḥ sadyojātādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ | homo'pyebhireva mantraiḥ | 
pūjāhomayorekamantrasyāvaśyakatvāt | ekāgreti samarūpaḥ | mudrāṣṭakaṃ 
tvāvāhanādi anantaraṃ pūjāvidhānāt | anyamaṇiṣvapyayaṃ saṃskāra iti yat 
vadanti tadajñānavijṛmbhitam | rudrākṣāṇāmayaṃ proktaḥ saṃskāraḥ 
śruticoditaḥ | itareṣu tu tantroktaḥ kartavyo gurusādhakaiḥ | iti kālottaravacanādeva 
|| atha rudrākṣamāhātmyaṃ tadutpattistanmukhabhedāstatphalāni ca | tatra 
skandapurāṇe :

tripuro nāmadaityastu purāsīdatidūrjayaḥ |
jitāstena surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvīndradevatāḥ || 1 ||

tripurasya vadhārthāya devānāṃ pālanāya ca |
lokānāṃ bhayanāśāya ṛtudharmapravṛttaye || 2 ||

sarvadevamayaṃ divyaṃ jvalitaṃ ghorarūpakam |
cintitaṃ yanmayā putra aghorāstramanuttamam || 3 ||

p. 355)

niṣṭhāyāstasya bhāryāyāstāvadyāvadadṛśyat |
divyavarṣasahasrāṇi cakṣurunmīlitaṃ tayā || 4 ||

puṭābhyāmākulākṣibhyāṃ patitā jalabindavaḥ |
te cāsrubindavo jātā mahārudrākṣavṛkṣakāḥ || 5 ||

sthāvaratvamanuprāptā martyānugrahakāraṇāt |
phalanti sarvakālaṃ hi avicchinnaphalapradāḥ || 6 ||

iti | vāsiṣṭhe laiṅgae -

brahmendramukhyasakalāmararakṣaṇārthe śambhoḥ purāsuravimardanakṛtyakāle 
|
tat traipurekṣaṇanirodhabhavāddhi vāri rudrākṣavṛkṣanikarāṇi tadā babhūvuḥ 
|| 1 ||

rudrākṣān kaṇṭhadeśe daśanaparimitān mastake viṃśatī dve
ṣaṭṣaṭ karṇapradeśe karayugalagatān dvādaśa dvādaśaiva |
bāhvorindoḥ kalābhiḥ pṛthagiti gaditaṃ caikamekaṃ śikhāyāṃ 
vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayati ca śataṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ || 2 ||

rudrākṣabījamiti ye bhuvi dhārayanti haste ca mūrdhani tathorasi bhūmiṃ (ri) 
bhāge ||

te samvasanti sadṛśāḥ yama(śata) patranetrapadmāsanendrasurakinnarapattaneṣu || 
3 ||

śiro mālā ca ṣaṭtriṃśad dvādaśa kaṇṭhamālikā |
kūrpare ṣoḍaśa proktā dvādaśa maṇibandhayoḥ || 4 ||

aṣṭottaraśatairyuktamupavītaṃ vidhīyate |
tadardhamuraso mālā śikhāyāmekamucyate || 5 ||

karṇayoścāpi ṣaṭsaṃkhyā dhāraṇakrama īritaḥ |
saṃkhyāhīnaṃ na kartavyamadhikaṃ naiva duṣyati || 6 ||

saṃkhyābhede pravakṣyāmi japamālā tu yā bhavet |
mokṣārthe pañcaviṃśatyā saptaviṃśatiḥ pauṣṭike || 7 ||

triṃśacca dhanasampattyai pañcadaśābhicārake |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraśceti caturvidhaḥ || 8 ||

śveto raktaḥ suvarṇābhaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramādamī |
eteṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho japamālākṛte bhṛśam || 9 ||

alābhe tu dvijātīnāmapi vā svasvajātayaḥ |
atisthūlo'tisūkṣmaśca sphuṭito bhaṃguro laghuḥ || 10 ||

chinnaḥ purādhṛto jīrṇo rudrākṣo na varaḥ smṛtaḥ |
maṇau yadunnataṃ sthānaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnakam || 11 ||

ghaṭayedekadig vatsa maṇīn saddantapaṃktivat |
anyonyagharṣaṇādeva japahānirbhaved dhruvam || 12 ||

dṛḍhena rajjunā tena vartanatrayarūpataḥ |
anyonyamadhyadeśe tu kartavyā granthayaḥ śubhāḥ || 13 ||

caturdaśāntaṃ vaktrāṇi rudrākṣāṇāṃ kramādbhavet |
dhāraṇasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyate vidhivat kramāt || 14 ||

ekavaktraḥ śivaḥ sākṣād brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati |
dvivaktraṃ devadevyau tu govadhaṃ nāśayed dhruvam || 15 ||

trivaktramanalaḥ sākṣāt strīhatyāṃ harati kṣaṇāt |
caturvaktraḥ svayaṃ brahmā guruhatyāṃ vyapohati || 16 ||

pañcavaktraḥ śivaḥ sākṣāt sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
ṣaḍvaktraḥ kārtikeyastu dhārayeddakṣiṇe kare || 17 ||

brahmahatyādibhirpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
saptavaktro mahānāgo hyananto nāma nāmataḥ || 18 ||

govadhasvarṇacauryābhyāṃ mucyate sarvadā naraḥ |
aṣṭavaktro mahāsena sākṣāddevo gaṇādhipaḥ || 19 ||

vighnāstasya praṇaśyanti so'nte yāti parāṃ gatim |
navavaktro bhairavaḥ syād dhārayedvāmahastake || 20 ||

bhuktido muktidaḥ prokto mama tulyo balī bhavet |
daśavaktro bhavedvatsa sākṣāddevo janārdanaḥ || 21 ||

piśācagrahavetālabrahmarākṣasapannagaiḥ |
sambhavāni ca doṣāṇi kṣipraṃ naśyanti dhāraṇāt || 22 ||

vaktraikādaśarudrākṣa rudrā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ |
śikhāyāṃ dhārayennityaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 23 ||

aśvameghasahasrasya vājipeyaśatasya ca |
gavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalam || 24 ||

tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vaktraikādaśadhāraṇāt |
vaktradvādaśarudrākṣaṃ bhāskaradvādaśātmakam || 25 ||

bahusvarṇāśvagomedhaphalaṃ prāpnoti dhāraṇāt |
vaktratrayodaśaṃ vatsa rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet || 26 ||

pūjyate satataṃ devaiḥ prāpyate puṇyamuttamam |
caturdaśasuvaktraṃ vai rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet || 27 ||

p. 356)

mūrdhni sthite tu vai nityaṃ tasmin yo mriyate naraḥ |
pavitramayavaktrastu (?) śaśikhaṇḍaśirāḥ svayam || 28 ||

vandyate satataṃ devaiḥ satyaṃ ca śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha |
bahulaṃ prāpyate puṇyaṃ bhāgyavān jāyate naraḥ || 29 ||

snāne dāne jape home vaiśvadeve surārcane |
prāyaścitte tathā śrāddhe dīkṣākāle viśeṣataḥ || 30 ||

rudrākṣadhārī bhūtvā ca yatkiñcit karma vaidikam |
yo vipraḥ satataṃ kuryāt tatkarma saphalaṃ bhavet || 31 ||

iti | padmapurāṇe -

kaṇṭhe śirasi haste ca karṇayorupavītake |
rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva rudro bhavati mānavaḥ || 1 ||

iti | śaivapūrāṇe -

rudrākṣān dhārayedvipraḥ sandhyādiṣu ca karmasu |
tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ proktaṃ lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ dhruvam || 1 ||

liṅgadarśanavat puṇyaṃ bhavedrudrākṣadarśanāt |
tataḥ koṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate dhāraṇānnaraḥ || 2 ||

śirasā dhāraṇād koṭiḥ karṇayordaśa koṭayaḥ |
gale baddhavā koṭiśataṃ mūrdhni koṭisahasrakam || 3 ||

ayutaṃ copavīte ca lakṣakoṭirbhujadvaye |
aprameyaphalaṃ haste surudrākṣadharo bhavet || 4 ||

iti | laiṅge vāsiṣṭhe -

khādanmāṃsaṃ pibanmadyaṃ saṃgacchannantyajātibhiḥ |
sadyo bhavati pūtātmā rudrākṣe śirasi sthite || 1 ||

iti | skandapurāṇe -

rudrākṣaṃ kaṇṭhamāśritya śuno'pi mriyate yadi |
so'pi rudratvamāpnoti kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥ || 1 ||

ucchiṣṭo vā vikarmastho yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo naro rudrākṣadhāraṇāt || 2 ||

rudrākṣamālikāṃ kaṇṭhe dhārayan bhaktivarjitaḥ |
pāpakarmāpi yo nityaṃ rudraloke mahīyate || 3 ||

iti | śaivapurāṇe - arudrākṣadharo bhūtvā yatkiñcitkarma vaidikam | 
kuryādviprastu yo mohānna sa prāpnoti tatphalam iti | vāsiṣṭhe laiṅge -

rudrākṣadhāraṇe lajja yeṣāmasti mahamune |
saṃkīrṇā sā bhaved brahmaṃsteṣāṃ vaṃśaparamparā || 1 ||

iti | athānyeṣāmakṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ tu yoginītantre -

ukteṣvakṣeṣūktasūtrairgrathitāṃ sādhakottamaḥ |
mālāṃ vidhāya vai pātre kvacidgandhādicarcitām || 1 ||

bhūtaśuddhyādikāṃ pūjāṃ samāpya tatra pūjayet | 
gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadūrgāścāvāhya pūjayet || 2 ||

pañcagavye tu tāṃ kṣiptvā hauṃmantreṇa ca mantravit |
tasmāduttolya tāṃ mālāṃ svarṇapātre nidhāya ca || 3 ||

payodadhidhṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyairanukramāt |
tayodhūpāntikaiḥ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtavidhiṃ budhaḥ || 4 ||

kramāttatraiva saṃsthāpya snāpayecchītalairjalaiḥ |
tataścandanasaugandhikastūrikuṃkumādibhiḥ || 5 ||

tāṃ saṃlipya hsauṃbījamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet |
tasyāṃ navagrahāṃścāpi dikpālāṃśca prapūjayet || 6 ||

tataḥ sampūjya ca guruṃ gṛhṇīyānmālikāṃ śubhām |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 7 ||

iti | bhairavītantre

ādau gaṇapatiṃ devaṃ sūryaṃ viṣṇumumāpatim |
durgāṃ ca pūjayed vidvān mālāyāṃ susamāhitaḥ || 1 ||

pañcagavye kṣipenmālāṃ prāsādenābhimantritām |
tatastūttolya tāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayeddhemapātrake || 2 ||

atra prāsādena vakṣyamāṇaprāsādamantreṇa |

pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śītalena jalena ca |
candanena sugandhena kastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ || 3 ||

abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantrenānena mantravit |
prānaṃ jīvasamārūḍhamaukārasvarabhūṣitam || 4 ||

bindunādasamāyuktaṃ mantrarājaṃ pravinyaset |
nava grahān pūjayitvā tato dikpālapūjanam || 5 ||

tilena ghṛtayuktena śaktito homayettataḥ |
svarṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād viprāṃstu paritoṣayet || 6 ||

p. 357)

iti | anena prāsādena | pravinyasedaṣṭottaraśataṃ japedityarthaḥ | prāṇo hakāraḥ 
jīvaḥ sakāraḥ hsoṃ iti | dakṣiṇā ācāryāya | 
svarṇapātrābhāve'śvatthapātraṃ grāhyamuktayoginītantravacanāt | 
prakārāntaraṃ tu  kubjikātantre

śilpinaṃ pūjayedādau vastragandhānulepanaiḥ |
saṃhṛṣṭaḥ kārayenmālāṃ viśuddhāṃ svarṇarūpyiṇīm || 1 ||

yathāyogyaṃ vedhavatīṃ mālāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
varṇamānena sā kāryā pañcagavye tryahaṃ kṣipet || 2 ||

varṇamānena mātṛkāvarṇamānena tatsaṃkhyayetyarthaḥ | etena 
śatasaṃkhyairakṣairmālā kāryeti prāpyate |

sūtraṃ cāpi caturthe'hni kṣālayedastramantrakaiḥ |
samānavarṇasūtreṇa māpayed hṛdayāṇunā || 3 ||

suvarṇādiguṇairvāpi granthayet sādhakottamaḥ |
brahmagranthiṃ tato dadyānnāgapāśamathāpi vā || 4 ||

kavacenātha badhnīyānmālāṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ |
sarvaśeṣe tato meruṃ sūtradvayasamanvitam || 5 ||

granthayet tārayogena badhnīyāt sādhakottamaḥ |
evaṃ niṣpādya deveśi pratisṭhāṃ ca samācaret || 6 ||

sthaṇḍile maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā yathābhāgavidhikramāt |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamiṣṭadevamanukramāt || 7 ||

maṇḍalaṃ sveṣṭadevatāpūjācakram |

nyāsapūrṇaṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
juhuyācca daśāṃśena yasya devasya yatpriyam || 8 ||

yatpriyamityanena puraścaraṇāṅgahome yaddravyaṃ yasya devasyoktaṃ tena 
homayedityuktam |

tato maṇḍalamadhye tu tāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ |
astramantraṃ tato nyasya mūlamantraṃ tato nyaset || 9 ||

aṅgāni tāni vinyasya devavat paricintayet |
abhedarūpamāsādya mālāṃ kuryāt tadātmikām || 10 ||

tato baliṃ yathānyāyaṃ dadyāt taiḥ sādhakottamaḥ |
evaṃ pratiṣṭhāmāpādya mālāyāmiṣṭadevatām || 11 ||

ācāryaṃ pūjayenmantrī śilpinaṃ ca yathāvidhi |
nānyamantraṃ japet tatra yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 12 ||

iti | astrādirjaptavyamantrasya grāhyaḥ | baliṃ mālāyāstairhomadravyaiḥ | tathā 
uttaratantre 

dṛḍhasūtraṃ niyuñjīta jape tu prītito yathā |
jīrṇa sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ granthayitvā śataṃ japet || 1 ||

iti | śaivāgame -

yadā saṃtruṭyate mālā granthayitvā tu pūrvavat |
pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu mantraṃ japyādananyadhīḥ || 1 ||

iti | tathā (: tarjanyā na spṛśetsūtraṃ kampayennaiva dhūnayet | na 
spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭaṃ na kārayet || akṣāṇāṃ 
cālane'guṣṭhenānyamakṣaṃ na saṃspṛśet | japakāle sadā vidvān meruṃ naiva 
vilaṅghayet || parivartanakāle tu śabdaṃ naiva ca kārayet | kalahaśca bhavecchabde 
calantyāṃ ca calenmatiḥ || calite caiva vidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisambhavaḥ | 
hastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vinaśyati ||) iti kecittu karāṃgulibhireva japaḥ 
kāryaḥ iti vadanti tatra pramāṇaṃ cintyam vastutastu puraścaraṇe'pi jñeyam | 
japamālābhāve kareṇaiva japagaṇanā kāryā | uktaṃ ca nāradapañcarātre : 
athāṃgulibhirevāpi japakarma samārabhet | prapañcasāre'pi (20 | 40)

padmāsanaḥ prāgvadano'pralāpī tanmānasastarjanivarjitābhiḥ |
akṣasrajā vāṃgulibhirjapet taṃ nātidrutaṃ nātivilambitaṃ ca || 1 ||

iti | mantratantraprakāśe - japasya gaṇānāṃ kuryādathavāṃguliparvabhiḥ | iti 
tatprakāramāha śrībhairavītantre -

anāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhānukrameṇa tu |
madhyamāmūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitā || 1 ||

iti | gautamo'pyāha : kaniṣṭhānāmikāṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhirjapet sadā iti | 
tadānāmāmadhyamūlakaniṣṭhāmūlamadhyāgrānāmāgramadhyamā-
gramadhyamūlaparyantamiti navasu parvasu gaṇanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ navavāraṃ 
japo bhavati | evaṃ dvādaśavāraṃ punaḥ punarāvartayitvāṣṭottaraśatajapo 
bhavati | dvādaśottaraśatāvṛttyāṣṭottarasahasrajapo bhavati | 
itthamayutādiṣvapyūhanīyam | vastutastu tantrāntaradarśanāt 
tarjanīsahitāṃgulibhireva japaḥ kāryaḥ | yaduktaṃ kulamūlāvatāre :

p. 358)

atha vakṣye maheśāni japasya gaṇanāphalam |
aṃgulījapasaṃkhyājaṃ phalamekaguṇaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||

rekhayāṣṭaguṇaṃ vidyāt putrajīvairdaśādhikam |
śataṃ syāccheṣamaṇibhiḥ pravālaistu sahasrakam || 2 ||

sphāṭikairdaśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate |
padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate || 3 ||

kuśagranthyā ca rudrākṣairanantaguṇitaṃ bhavet |
śvetapadmākṣamālābhirjape syādamitaṃ phalam || 4 ||

aṃgulībhirjapaṃ kurvan sāṃguṣṭhāṃgulibhirjapet |
aṃguṣṭhena vinā japtaṃ viphalaṃ bhavati priye || 5 ||

parvabhirvāṃgulīnāṃ tu japedanudinaṃ priye |
madhyamānāmikāmadhyaparvadvayamiha priye || 6 ||

meruprakalpanaṃ kurvan pradakṣiṇamanukramāt |
anāmāmūlaparvādikaniṣṭhānukrameṇa tu || 7 ||

tarjanyagrādito devi madhyamūlāvasānakam |
gaṇayecca krameṇaivaṃ kiñcit saṃkocayet talam || 8 ||

aṃgulīrna viyuñjīta japakāle maheśvari |
aṃgulīnāṃ viyoge tu cchidreṣu sravate japaḥ || 9 ||

ullaṃghya gaṇanāṃ devi na mantraṃ prajapet kvacit |
yatastajjapamīśāni balād gṛhṇanti rākṣasāḥ || 10 ||

athavā madhyamāmadhyamūlaparvadyayaṃ priye |
meruṃ kṛtvā japed devi tarjanīmūlakāvadhi || 11 ||

anāmāmadhyaparvādiprādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 12 ||

iti | atrāṃgulījapo rekhājapaḥ parvajapa (śceti trividhaḥ karamālājapaḥ tatra 
kaniṣṭhādyaṃguṣṭhaparyantaṃ punaḥpunargaṇanāṃgulijapaḥ 
kaniṣṭhādyaṃguligatarekhābhirjapo rekhājapaḥ parvajapaśceti satu) 
proktalakṣaṇa eveti | mātṛkārṇave :

śvetamantrasya ye varṇāḥ svaravyañjanabhedataḥ |
pṛthak kṛtāstaiḥ kurvīta varṇamālāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

meruṃ ca praṇavaṃ kuryāt japet tanmālayā budhaḥ |
śīghraṃ siddhirbhavatyeva satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

aṃśādhikyaṃ tu vijñāya prastārakramabhedataḥ |
tadbhūtavarṇadeśake vyañjanānāṃ sureśvari || 3 ||

tattadbhūtasvarairyuktaṃ kṛtvā yojya svaratrayam |
tattadbhūtapradhānārṇaṃ meruṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 4 ||

tanmantraṃ prajapettatra mālayā siddhyati dhruvam |
mantrārṇauṣadhicūrṇasya guṭikākṛtamālayā || 5 ||

japet sarvārthasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 6 ||

iti || atha puraścaraṇakāle vihitāni tatra nāradaḥ -

manaḥsaṃharaṇaṃ śaucaṃ maunaṃ mantrārthacintanam |
avyagratvamanirvedo japasampattihetavaḥ || 1 ||

iti trailokyasammohanatantre -

lobhamātsaryarahitaḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ |
sarvathā labhate siddhimanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

iti | kumbhasambhavaḥ -

nityaṃ naimittikaṃ yadyat kurvan varṇāśramoditam |
tadeva karma kurvīta tanmanāstatparāyaṇaḥ || 1 ||

dāntastriṣavaṇasnāyo maunī sammārjitāntaraḥ |
yajet vaiṣṇavaṃ karmasthiradhīrniyatendriyaḥ || 2 ||

iti | gautamaḥ -

svakarmaṇi ratiryasya tasya siddhiradūrataḥ |
dūrato'pi na siddhiḥ syāditarasya dvijottamaḥ || 1 ||

krūrasyāpi na siddhiḥ syāditi satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

itarasya svadharmāniratasya dūrato cirakālenāpi || mantrārṇave -

bhūśayyā brahmacāritvaṃ maunaṃ cāpyanasūyatā |
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānaṃ kṣudrakarmavivarjanam || 1 ||

nityapūjā nityadānaṃ devatāstutikīrtanam |
naimittikārcanaṃ caiva viśvāso gurudevayoḥ || 2 ||

japaniṣṭhā dvādaśaite dharmāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | (brahmacāritvamaṣṭavidhamaithunanivṛttiḥ) taduktaṃ gorakṣeṇa -

smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kīliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam |
saṅkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyāniṣpattireva ca || 1 ||

p. 359)

etanmaithunamaṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
viparītaṃ brahmacaryametadevāṣṭalakṣaṇam || 2 ||

iti | abhilāṣapūrvakasmaraṇakīrtanaprekṣaṇāni niṣiddhāni | keliḥ 
parihāsādibāhyaceṣṭā | guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ sambhogārtha rahomantraṇam | 
saṃkalpo mānasaṃ karma | adhyavasāyaḥ sambhoganiścayaḥ | triṣavarṇa 
snānaṃ śaktaparam | snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ proktamaśaktyā dviḥ sakṛccaret | iti 
vai śaṃpāyanavacanāt | kṣudraṃ karma tu : dambhadveṣau tathotsāda uccāṭo 
bhramamāraṇe | vyādhiśca iti smṛtyantaramiti nārāyaṇīyoktam | nityapūjā 
nityaṃ tarpaṇapūrvakameva japavidhānāt naimittikārcanamayanādau 
viśeṣapūjā | taduktaṃ mantratantraprakāśe :

aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu kṛtvā tarpaṇamādarāt |
japet pratidinaṃ yattu nitya eṣa japaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 ||

ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu teṣu naimittiko japaḥ || 2 ||

nityāt triguṇitaḥ so'tha pūjā caiva harestathā |

iti | kapilapañcarātre - mantraśca devatātārātithivāreṣu japyatām | iti tathā ca 
gautamaḥ -

tato guroḥ pādapadmaṃ puṣpāñjalibhirarcayet |
tasmādāśīḥ sadā grāhyā tataḥ santoṣamācaret || 1 ||

santuṣṭe tu gurau devaḥ santuṣṭo nānyathā bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | tathā śrībhagavadvākyam -

santuṣṭo hi gururyasya tasya tuṣṭaṃ jagattrayam |
nāstyasādhyaṃ jagatyatra suprasanne guro mune || 1 ||

hṛdi nyased gurorvākyaṃ na kadācidvilaṅghayet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | kumbhasambhavaḥ -

snāyācca pañcagavyena kevalāmalakena vā |
śrutismṛtipurāṇoktamantraiḥ snāyādanantaram || 1 ||

anutiṣṭhedanuṣṭheyaṃ śucirvratatamo'niśam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | prapañcasāre (10 | 41) atha tu haviṣyaprāśī naktāśī vā japenmanuṃ caivam 
iti | vā śabdaḥ samuccaye | phetkāriṇītantre -

bhaikṣādiniyamāhāraḥ sakṛdrātrau vidhīyate |
kandamūlaphalairvāpi kuryādaśanamanvaham || 1 ||

iti | trailokyasammohanatantre -

gurugoviprabāleṣu dīnāndhakṛpaṇeṣu ca |
bhavecchuddhamatirmantrī naca drohaṃ samācaret || 1 ||

paścādgobhyaḥ samabhyarcya grāsaṃ dadyāt suśobhanam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti || gautamaḥ 
goṣu bhaktiḥ sadā kāryā goṣu śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
nityaṃ goṣu prasannāsu gopālā'pi prasīdati || 1 ||

iti || atha niṣiddhāni trailokyasammohanatantre -

nāpriyaṃ kasyacid brūyānnāmṛtaṃ vā kadācana |
na cchāyāmākramedvidvān vibhītakakarañjayoḥ || 1 ||

na kuryāt kasyacit kiñcinna gṛhṇīyājjapāntare |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayet || 2 ||

strīṣu sambhāṣaṇaṃ naiva kuryād devi vimohitaḥ |
na nagno na sugandhāḍhyo gītavādye vivarjayet || 3 ||

iti | na gṛhṇīyāditi sati sambhave asambhave tu taddinabhaikṣamātraṃ grāhyamiti 
bhakṣamānayukteḥ | vimohitaḥ kāmaparavaśaḥ | prayogasāre : 
vibhītakārkakārañjasnuhīchāyāṃ na saṃśrayet iti | kumbhasambhavaḥ :

vāṅmanaḥ karmabhirnityaṃ niḥspṛho vanitādiṣu |
strīśūdrapatitavrātyanāstikocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇam || 1 ||

asatyāślīlayornityaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ parivarjayet |
samyairapi na bhāṣet japahomārcanādiṣu || 2 ||

varjayed gītavādyādiśravaṇaṃ nṛtyadarśanam |
tāmbūlaṃ gandhalepaṃ ca puṣpadhāraṇameva ca || 3 ||

p. 360)

maithunaṃ tatkathālāpaṃ tadgoṣṭhīṃ ca vivarjayet |
asadbhāṣaṇamatyarthaṃ varjayedanyapūjanam || 4 ||

kauṭilyaṃ kṣauramabhyaṅgamaniveditabhojanam |
asaṅkalpitakṛtyaṃ ca varjayenmardanādikam || 5 ||

tyajeduṣṇodakasnānaṃ sugandhāmalakādikam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 6 ||

labhyairityatra prāyaścittamāha nāradaḥ -

sakṛduccārite śabde praṇavaṃ samudīrayet |
prokte pāmaraśabde'pi prāṇāyāmaṃ sakṛccaret || 1 ||

bahupralāpe ca cāmya nyasyāṅgāni tato japet |
kṣute caiva tathāspṛśyasthānānāṃ sparśane tathā || 2 ||

iti | yogiyājñavalkya -

yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syājjapādiṣu kathañcana |
vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam || 1 ||

iti | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

patitānāmantyājānāṃ darśane bhāṣite śrute |
kṣute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇe japamutsṛjet || 1 ||

apa ācamya caiteṣāṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam |
kṛtvā samyagjapeccheṣaṃ yadvā sūryādidarśanam || 2 ||

mārjāraṃ kukkuṭaṃ krauñcaṃ śvānaṃ gṛdhraṃ kharaṃ kapim |
dṛṣṭvācamya caret karma spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyate || 3 ||

evamādīṃśca niyamān puraścaraṇakṛccaret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 4 ||

iti | tathā śrīśivavacanam-

krodhaṃ kṣutaṃ madaṃ trīṇi niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe |
darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi || 1 ||

ācāntaḥ sambhave teṣāṃ smaredvā māṃ tvayā saha |
jyotīṃṣi ca prapaśyedvā kuryādvā prāṇasaṃyamam || 2 ||

iti | māṃ maheśvaram | tvayā saha pārvatyā saha | liṅgapurāṇe-

sūryo'gniścandramāścaiva grahanakṣatratārakāḥ |
ete jyotīṃṣi coktāni vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇastathā || 1 ||

iti || tathā -

krodho madaḥ kṣudhā tandrā niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe |
śvanī ca darśanaṃ nidrā pralāpo'mī japadviṣaḥ || 2 ||

iti || tathā viṣṇudharmottare -

upaviṣṭo japet snātaḥ kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu |
pūjāyāṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya saptavāraṃ prakīrtayet || 1 ||

iti | phetkāriṇītantre-

japakāle yadā paśyedaśuci mantravittamaḥ |
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ śeṣaṃ samāpayet || 1 ||

yadā caivaṃ bhavenmantrī svayamapyaśuciḥ punaḥ |
snātvācamya yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā nyāsān punarjapet || 2 ||

iti | nyāsamadhikārasampādakam | etena mūtrautsarjanādāvaśucisambhave ca 
snānamanyathā prāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅganyāsān kṛtvā śeṣaṃ samāpayediti 
pratīyate vaiśampāyan -

asnātasya phalaṃ nāsti tathātarpayataḥ pitṝn |
nāpyatarpayato devān nāsatyamabhijalpataḥ || 1 ||

naikavāsā japenmantraṃ bahuvāsākulo'pi vā |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti yoginītantre -

anāsthājapamatyantamaśraddhā japakarmaṇi |
ālasyaṃ bhāvanāśaktiḥ siddhināśāya niścitam || 1 ||

tyajed duṣṭapravādaṃ ca parīvādaṃ ca varjayet |
tyajed durjanasaṃsparśaṃ sāśaṅkādibhavaṃ tyajet || 2 ||

iti | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāṃ -

uṣṇīṣī kañcukī nagno muktaseśo galāvṛtaḥ |
apavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japet kvacit || 1 ||

asamvṛtau karau kṛtvā śirasi prāvṛto'pi vā |
cintāvyākulacitto vā kruddho bhrāntaḥ kṣudhānvitaḥ || 2 ||

anāsanaḥ śayāno vā gacchannutthita eva vā |
rathyāyāmaśivasthāne japenna timirālaye || 3 ||

p. 361)

upānadgūḍhapādo vā yānaśayyāgatastathā |
prasārya na japet pādāvutkaṭāsana eva vā || 4 ||

iti | kapilapañcarātre -

vikṣepādathavālasyājjapahomārcanāntare |
uttiṣṭhati tadā nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vinyaset punaḥ || 1 ||

iti | apavitrakaraḥ pavitraṃ kuśaḥ | astrī kuśaṃ kuśo darbhapavitram iti hi kośaḥ | 
vinā darbheṇa yatkarma vinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ | rākṣasaṃ tadbhavetsarvaṃ 
nehāmutraphalapradam | iti kūrmapurāṇavacanena tasyāvaśyakatvābhidhānāt | 
sūtraṃ yajñopavītam | viṣṇurapi : snātaḥ suprakṣālitapāṇipādaḥ 
śucirbaddhaśikho darbhapāṇirācāntaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vopaviśya 
maunī dhyānī devatāḥ pūjayet iti | tatra vāme bahukuśāḥ dakṣiṇe 
pāribhāṣikaṃ pavitram | tathā sandhyopakrame kātyāyanaḥ :

savye pāṇau kuśān kṛtvā kuryādācamanakriyām |
hrasvāḥ pracaraṇīyāḥ syuḥ kuśā dīrghāśca barhiṣaḥ || 1 ||

darbhāḥ pavitramityuktamataḥ sandhyādikarmasu |
savyaḥ sopagrahaḥ kāryo dakṣiṇaḥ sapavitrakaḥ || 2 ||

iti | savye vāme | nanu kīdṛśā dhāryā dakṣine dhāryā navetyata āha : hrasvāḥ 
pārvaṇapañcayajñādipracārārthāḥ dīrghā barhiḥsajñakāḥ 
prastāraparistaraṇārthāḥ | pracārādanyeṣu sandhyādiṣu darbhā bahava eva 
dhāryā viśeṣarahitāḥ karmasu śuddhisādhanaṃ natvekaḥ | kuśopagrahaḥ iti 
kuśahastaḥ samāhitaḥ iti aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ iti 
pāraskara gobhilādibhirapyuktam | ato viśeṣābhāvāt sandhyādiṣu savyaḥ 
sakuśamuṣṭiḥ dakṣiṇastu anantargarbhiṇaṃ sāgraṃ kauśaṃ dvidalameva ca | 
prādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ pavitraṃ yatrakutracit || ityuktalakṣaṇapavitrayuktaḥ | 
antargarbhabhinnaṃ garbhagarbhi dvitīyamantargarbhi tṛtīyaṃ ca vihāya caturthaṃ 
grāhyam | laghuhārītaḥ :

jape home tathā dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe |
aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ || 1 ||

iti | suvarṇadhāraṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇe'nāmikāyām | anāmikāyāṃ taddhāryaṃ 
dakṣiṇasya karasya ca iti hemadhāraṇaprakaraṇe devīpurāṇavacanāt | rajataṃ tu 
tarjanyāṃ dhāryam yatropadiśyate karma karturaṅgaṃ na tūcyate | dakṣiṇastatra 
vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāmaparaḥ karaḥ iti kātyāyanavacanāt tarjanīmūlasya 
pitṛtīrthatvena devatarajatadhāraṇaṃ tatraiva 
nyāyyamityetanmūlamahājanācāreṇa nirṇītaprāmāṇyāt tarjanyāṃ rajataṃ 
dhāryam iti smṛtisamuccayalikhitavacanācca | savyāpasavyavalitaṃ 
brahmagranthisamanvitam | laṅghayet parvamātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ naiva laṅghayet (iti 
vacanādanāmāmadhyaparvaṇi sagranthi pavitraṃ dhāryam | karmakāle prakurvīta 
sapavitrāmanāmikām | laṅghayedekaparvāsyā dvitīyaṃ naiva laṅghayet) iti
