śaṅkhavacanācca | suvarṇarajatairiti bahuvacanaṃ bahudhāraṇasya 
karmāṅgatvaṃ vyanakti | tacca 
dadhitvavatsuvarṇatvarajatatvajātyordvyaṇukādārabhya 
vṛterekadhāraṇe'pyupapadyate iti | vāmanapurāṇe :

udakena vinā pūjā vinā darbheṇa yā kriyā |
ājyena ca vinā homaḥ phalaṃ dāsyanti naiva te || 1 ||

iti | smṛtyarthasāre-

kuśāḥ kāśā yavā dūrvā uśīrāśca samaṃ śaraiḥ |
godhūmā vrīhayo muñjā daśa darbhāḥ savalvajāḥ || 1 ||

namomāsasya darśe tu śucirdarbhān samāharet |
ayātayāmāste darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 2 ||

viriñcinā sahotpanna parameṣṭhinisargaja |
nuda pāpāni sarvāṇi bhava svastikaro mama || 3 ||

iti mantraṃ samuccārya tataḥ pūrvottarāmukhaḥ |
huṃphaṭkāreṇa mantreṇa sakṛcchitvā samuddharet || 4 ||

acchinnāścāpyaśuṣkāgrāḥ pitrye tu haritāḥ śubhāḥ |
amūlā devakāryeṣu prayojyāśca japādiṣu || 5 ||

saptapatrāḥ kuśāḥ śastā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
anantargarbhiṇau sāgrau pādeśe tu pavitrake || 6 ||

caturbhirdarbhapiñjūlairbrāhmaṇasya pavitrakam |
ekaikaparṇamutsṛjya varṇe varṇe yathākramam || 7 ||

p. 362)

sarveṣāṃ bhavati dvābhyāṃ pavitraṃ grathitaṃ tathā |
tribhistu śāntike kārya pauṣṭike pañcabhistathā || 8 ||

caturbhiścābhicāre syādviniṣkārauśca (? dveṣe caika)kena ca |
sapavitraḥ sadarbho vā karmāṅgācamanaṃ caret || 9 ||

nocchiṣṭaṃ tadbhavettasya bhuktocchiṣṭaṃ tu varjayet |
yaiḥ kṛtaḥ piṇḍanirvāpaḥ śrāddhaṃ vā pitṛtarpaṇam || 10 ||

viṇmūtrādiṣu ye darbhāsteṣāṃ tyāgo vidhīyate |
nīvīmadhyasthitāstyājyā yajñabhūmau sthitāstathā || 11 ||

vāmahaste sthite darbhena pibed dakṣiṇena tu |
vastrāditoyagrahaṇe na doṣaḥ pivato bhavet || 12 ||

na brahmagranthinācāmenna dūrvābhiḥ kadācana |
snāne home jape dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe || 13 ||

sapavitro sadarbho vā karau kūrvīta nānyathā |
kuśābhāve tu kāśāḥ syuḥ kāśāḥ kuśasamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14 ||

kāśābhāve grahītavyā anye darbhā yathocitāḥ |
nārdro lunīyādrātrau vā lunīyādvā na sandhyayoḥ || 15 ||

darbhābhāve svarṇaraupyatāmrairapi kriyāścaret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 16 ||

ityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | nāradapañcarātre -

apavitrakaro nagnaḥ śirasi prāvṛto'pi vā |
pralapan vā japedyāvat tāvanniṣphalamucyate || 1 ||

iti | nagnamāhātriḥ -

nagno malinavastraḥ syānnagnaścārdrapaṭastathā |
nagno dviguṇavastraḥ syānnagnaḥ snigdhapaṭastathā || 1 ||

dvikaccho'nuttarīyaśca nagnaścāvastra eva ca |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | bhaviṣyapurāṇe

dvikacchaḥ kacchaśeṣaśca bahiḥkacchastathaiva ca |
ekakacchaḥ kacchaśūnyo nagnaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 ||

iti | devalaḥ - bahuvāsā bhavennagno nagnaḥ kaupīnavāsasā iti | kātyāyanaḥ -

dānamācamanaṃ homaṃ bhojanaṃ devatārcanam |
proḍhapādo na kurvīt svādhyāyaṃ caiva tarpaṇam || 1 ||

āsanārūḍhapādastu jānunorjaṅghayosthathā |
kṛtāvasakthiko yastu prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate || 2 ||

iti | mantratantraprakāśe tu : uktaniyamānabhidhāya śaktāvevaṃ 
sarvametadaśaktaḥ śaktito japet ityuktam ||

atha japastatra kumbhasambhavaḥ -

gurorlabdhasya mantrasya śaśvadāvartanaṃ hi yat |
antaraṅgākṣarāṇāṃ ca nyāsapūrvo japaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 ||

iti | aṅgeti sutīkṣṇasaṃbodhanam | akṣarāṇāmantarāvartanaṃ japaḥ iti 
sambandhaḥ | tadbhedānāha vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

japaḥ syādakṣarāvṛtīrvāciko pāṃśumānasaḥ |
ya uccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ || 1 ||

mantramuccārayedvācā vācikaḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ |
śanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau ca cālayet || 2 ||

kiñcicchravaṇayogyaḥ syādupāṃśuḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ |
jihvājapaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kevalaṃ jihvayā japaḥ || 3 ||

dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇīṃ padavarṇasvarātmikām |
uccaredarthasaṃsmṛtyā sa ukto mānaso japaḥ || 4 ||

uccairjapo viśiṣṭaḥ syādyajñāderdaśabhirguṇaiḥ |
upāṃśuḥ syācchataguṇaḥ sāhasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

vācikaḥ sarvakāryeṣu upāṃśuḥ sarvasiddhiṣu |
mānasaḥ mokṣakāryeṣu dhyāyedeva ca sarvataḥ || 1 ||

iti | mahābhārate -

sarveṣāmeva yajñānāṃ japayajñaḥ praśasyate |
ahiṃsayā hi bhūtānāṃ jāyate vā mahāphalam || 1 ||

japaniṣṭho dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | śrībhagavadvacanaṃ ca yajñānāṃ japajño'smi iti | pādmanāradīyayoḥ

yāvantaḥ karmayajñāḥ syuḥ pradīptāni tapāṃsi ca |
te sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 1 ||

p. 363)

japena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati |
prasannā vipulān bhogān dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāsvatīm || 2 ||

iti | bhṛgusaṃhitāyām -

ye pākayajñāścatvāro vidhiyajñasamanvitāḥ |
te sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 1 ||

iti || athāsanāni tatra nāradaḥ -

kuśājināmbarairyuktaṃ caturaṃgulamūrdhvataḥ |
caturhastaṃ dvihastaṃ ca sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdu nirmalam || 1 ||

āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu japakarma samārabhet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | vaiśampāyanaḥ -

sarvasiddhyai vyāghracarmajñānasiddhyai mṛgājinam |
vastrāsanaṃ rogaharaṃ vetrajaṃ śrīvivardhanam || 1 ||

kauśeyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ jñeyaṃ kambalaṃ duḥkhamocanam |

iti | vastramāvikam | vakṣyamāṇabrahmayāmalavacanena kevalavastrāsane 
doṣaśravaṇāt | vastreṣu kaṃbalaṃ śreṣṭhamāsanaṃ devatuṣṭaye 
ityuttaratantravacanāt | bhṛguḥ -

kāmyārtha kambalaṃ caivābhīṣṭadaṃ raktakambalam |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāptiścailājinakuśottare || 1 ||

iti | brahmayāmale-

kambalau śvetaraktau ca vicitrau nīlapītakau |
vyāghrājinaṃ ca kauraṅgamanyairnānāvidhāsanaiḥ || 1 ||

iti || atha niṣiddhāsanāni sārasaṃgrahe -

vaṃśeṣṭakāśmadharaṇītṛṇapallavanirmitam |
varjayedāsanaṃ mantrī dāridryavyādhiduḥkhadam || 1 ||

nādīkṣito viśejjātu kṛṣṇasārājine gṛhī |
viśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca snātakaḥ || 2 ||

iti | brahmayāmale -

tṛṇapallavakāṣṭhāni pāṣāṇaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tathā |
vaṃśāsanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca kevalaṃ kṣitirāsanam || 1 ||

evamaṣṭavidhaṃ devi cāsanaṃ parivarjayet |
tṛṇāsane bhavedrogaḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ || 2 ||

pāṣāṇe ca tathoccāṭo jvaraḥ syānmṛṇmayāsane |
kṣityāsanaṃ bhavet pīḍāpāpavisphoṭaduḥkhadam || 3 ||

vaṃśāsane daridraḥ syādvastre sthānavināśanam |
cintā ca prabalā hāniruccaṭo vividho jvaraḥ || 4 ||

śokaśūlādikā rogā mṛtyuḥ syād dārukāsane |
itthaṃ cāṣṭāsanaṃ devi varjayet sarvakarmasu || 5 ||

iti || tha japapūrvadinakṛtyam | tatra trailokyasammohanatantre -

śubhe muhūtre nakṣatre (śuddhe kāle yatavrataḥ | gurorājñāṃ samāsādya 
tataḥ karma samārabhet || 1 ||

iti | sanatkumāraḥ -

atha vakṣyāmi mantrasya puraścaraṇamuttamam |
kṛtābhiṣeko vidhivanmantraṃ labdhvā gurormukhāt || 1 ||

śubhe muhūrte nakṣatre) nithau snātvā yathāvidhi |
bhojanācchādanādyaistu viprān santarpayedyathā || 1 ||

bhūvittavastrabhūṣādyairguruṃ santosya cātmanaḥ |
ārabheta japaṃ paścāt tadanujñāpuraḥsaram || 2 ||

iti || prathamatantre - kṣetrapālāṃśca sampūjya baliṃ dadyādyathāvidhi | 
balimantrastu

pūrvamehidvayaṃ paścādviduṣi syānmurudvayam |
mañjayadvitayaṃ bhūyo tarjayadvitayaṃ tathā || 1 ||

tato vighnapadadvandvaṃ mahābhairavatatparam |
kṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ pāvakasundarī || 2 ||

balimantro'yamākhyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
tathaiva parivārāya balimetena cāharet || 3 ||

iti | mantraḥ prayoge vakṣyate | tataścopavāsaḥ kartavyaḥ | atha japārambhastatra 
mahākapilapañcarātre -

evaṃ nakṣatratithyādau karaṇe yogavāsare |
mantropadeśo guruṇā sādhanaṃ ca śubhāvaham || 1 ||

iti dīkṣāpuraścaraṇayoḥ samānanakṣatrādikaṃ jñeyam |
tatra prāguktavidhinā vicārya samīcīnasamayaṃ jñātvā samārabhet |

p. 364)

taduktaṃ dakṣiṇamūrtikalpe :

sādhayet pravaro vidvān pūrvapakṣaṃ samāśritaḥ |
puṇye muhūrte nakṣatre tithu snātvā yathāvidhi || 1 ||

natvā guruṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca natvā durgāṃ ca mātṛkāḥ |

iti | tathā kumbhasambhavaḥ tataḥ saṃkalpya kurvīta puraścaraṇamādarāt | 
nāradīye saṃkalpaṃ tu budhaḥ kuryāt svastivācanapūrvakam | tathā devalaḥ :

abhuktvā prātarevātha (rāhāraṃ) snātvācamya samāhitaḥ |
sūryādidevatābhyaśca nivedya vratamācaret || 1 ||

prātarvratamācarediti sambandhaḥ | vrataṃ svakartavyaviṣayo niyamasaṅkalpaḥ || 
taduktaṃ kumbhasambhavena -

kartavyasya samastasya niyamagrahaṇaṃ vratam |
niyamavyatirekeṇa sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || 1 ||

iti | abhuktvā prātarāhāramityekavacanādarthātpūrvadina ekabhaktaṃ kāryam | 
ataścopavāsāśaktasyaikabhaktaṃ jñeyam | sūryādidevatābhya iti sūryaḥ soma 
ityādinā matsyapurāṇoktaparyāyeṇa nivedyetyarthaḥ | te ślokāstu prayoge 
vakṣyante | mahābhārate :

gṛhītvodumbaraṃ pātraṃ vāripūrṇamudaṅmukhaḥ |
upavāsaṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt tathā saṃkalpayed budhaḥ || 1 ||

udaṅmukha iti niyamagrahaṇārtham | saṃkalpayet manasā niyamayediti | tathā 
gautamaḥ : antarjānukaraṃ kṛtvā salilaṃ sakuśodakam | phalaṃ samabhisandhāya 
iti | tathā kumbhasambhavaḥ : niṣkāmānāmanenaiva sākṣātkāro bhavet iti | 
sākṣātkāraḥ sveṣtadevatādarśanam anena puraścaraṇeneti | atra yadyapi manasā 
saṃkalpayati vā cābhilapati karmaṇā copapādayati iti hārītavacanāt 
tasmādyatpuruṣo manasādhigacchati tadvācā vadati tatkarmaṇā karoti iti 
śruteśca manasādhigatasya vācābhilāpe kriyamāṇe yena rūpeṇa 
manasādhigacchati tenaiva vācāpyabhilāpaḥ kartavyaḥ iti prāpyate 
ato'mukakāmena mayā idaṃ kartavyamiti phalakriyollekha eva pratīyate tathāpi 
māsādīnāmapyullekhaḥ kartavyaḥ | tathā ca brahmāṇḍapurāṇe : 
māsapakṣatithīnāṃ ca nimittānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | ullekhanamakurvāṇo na tasya 
phalabhāgbhavet || iti māsapakṣatithīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ sarvaprakāreṇa 
sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena | tatra sāmānyena (māsapakṣatithipadena viśeṣataḥ 
kārtikaśuklapratipadādipadena | dṛśyate ca asminmāsi site pakṣe 
ityādimunīnāṃ prayogaḥ | nimittānāṃ ca deśakālādīnāṃ sarvaprakāreṇa 
tatra sāmānyena) bhāratavarṣapadena tasya sarvakarmaphalahetutvāt | taduktaṃ 
viṣṇupurāṇe :

itaḥ samprāpyate svargo muktimasmātprayāti hi | tiryaktvaṃ nārakatvaṃ ca 
yātyataḥ puruṣo mune || na khalvanyatra martyānāṃ karmabhūmirvidhīyate | iti | 
viśeṣeṇa kāśyādipadena kālasyāpi sāmānyata adyetyanena viśeṣataḥ 
sūryoparāgādipadena ca | nacaivaṃ māsādīnāṃ 
nimittatāyāmullekhadvayaprasaṅgaḥ saṃyogapṛthaktvanyāyena 
sakṛdullekhasyaivobhayārthatvāt ullekhanaṃ vacanaprayogamakurvataḥ 
phalābhāvaścābhihitaḥ | ata eva garuḍapurāṇe śrāddhaprakaraṇe : oṃ 
adyāsmindeśe'mukamāse'mukapakṣe'mukatithāvamukarāśigate savitari 
ityādyabhilāpaḥ | agnipurāṇe : adya somārkagrahaṇe saṃkrāntyādau sutīrthake | 
iti tathā : makarasthe ravau māghe prātaḥkāle tathāmale | gopade'pi jale snānaṃ 
savargadaṃ pāpināmapi iti || padmapurāṇe  vidhivākye makarasthe ravau māghe 
ityuktam | evamanyeṣvapi vidhivākyeṣu śrūyate | phalaṃ cātra : mantrasiddhiḥ 
sakāmānāṃ ityuktavacanāt | nacaihikī eva mantrasiddhirityabhilapanīyam 
uktanāradavacanenobhayasiddheḥ puraścaraṇaphalatvābhidhānāditi | tathā : 
pūjā traikālikī nityaṃ japastarpaṇameva ca | homo brāhmaṇabhuktiśca 
puraścaraṇamucyate || iti kumbhasambhavena japādīnāmeva 
puraścaraṇaśabdanābhidhānācca puraścaraṇamahaṃ kariṣye ityabhilapanīyam | 
naca puraścaraṇasya cirasamayasadhyatvena adyāmukatithau puraścaraṇaṃ kariṣye 
ityanupapannaṃ syāditi | sāṃprataṃ kariṣye iti kṛdhātoḥ kṛtimātrārthatvāt 
kriyāyāḥ kṛtisāmānyānvitatvena vartamānatithau yayā kayāpi kṛtyā 
saṃpāditayā tattattitho kṛternirvāhatvopapatteriti | evaṃ japamadyārabhya kariṣye 
ityataḥ paramāśauce'pi na japabādhaḥ |

p. 365)

taduktaṃ viṣṇunā -

yajñavratavivāheṣu śrāddhe homārcane jape |
prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe ca sūtakam || 1 ||

prārambho varaṇaṃ yajñe saṃkalpo vratajāpayoḥ |
nāndīmukhaṃ vivāhādau śrāddhe pākapariṣkriyā || 2 ||

iti | vastutastu tāntrikadīkṣāvatāmāśaucādisambhave'pi nityārcanabādhopi 
nāsti | japo devārcanavidhiḥ kāryo dīkṣānvitairnaraiḥ | nāsti pāpaṃ 
yatasteṣāṃ sūtakaṃ vā yatātmanām iti devīyāmalavacanāt || sūtake mṛtake 
caiva dhūmodgārādike tathā | japārcādyaṃ tathā 
kuryānmantranyāsapuraḥsaram iti mṛḍānītantravacanāt | śivaviṣṇvarcane 
dīkṣā yasya cāgniparigrahaḥ | brahmacāriyatīnāṃ ca śarīre nāsti sūtakam iti 
viṣṇuyāmalavacanāt | sūtake mṛtake caiva nityaṃ viṣṇumayasya ca | 
sānuṣṭhānasya viprendra sadyaḥ śuddhiḥ prajāyate iti nāradapañcarātravacanāt 
upāsane tu viprāṇāmaṅgaśuddhiḥ prajāyate iti pārāśaravacanācca | tatra 
viprāṇāmityuktaiḥ kṣatriyādīnāmadhikāro nāstīti pratīyate | brāhmaṇasyaiva 
pūjyo'haṃ śucerapyaśucerapi | strīśū-ityādi saṃsparśo vajrapātāt 
suduḥsahaḥ || iti viṣṇuvacanāt | viprasya tu sadaivāhaṃ śucerapyaśucerapi | 
pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi śūdrasya punaḥ svacāravartinaḥ || iti śivavacanāt | 
naivāprapūjya bhuñjīta śivaliṅgaṃ maheśvari | sūtake mṛtake cāpi na 
tyājyaṃ śivapūjanam || iti liṅgapurāṇavacanācceti | śūdrasyetyupalakṣaṇaṃ 
viprasyetyuktatvāditi etattāntrikapūjāyāmeva pañcayajñādau tu nādhikāraḥ | 
(agnihotrādikarmārtha śuddhistātkālikī smṛtā | pañcayajñān prakurvīta 
hyaśuciḥ punareva saḥ || iti gautamavacanāt) | tātkālikī yāvatātatkarma siddhyati | 
naimittikakāmyapūjāyāṃ tu tāntrikāṇāmapi nādhikāraḥ |


sūtake mṛtake cāpi vartamāne tu nārada |
kāmataḥ pūjite mantre śāntikādau ca kutracit || 1 ||

japet pañcaśataṃ mantrī siṃhamantrasya bhaktitaḥ |
śatatrayamakāmācca prāyaścittavidhau japet || 2 ||

iti nāradapañcarātravacanāt | akāmāt naimittikārcane | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

ekabhaktavidhānena vilambatvaritaṃ vinā |
uktasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kuryāt puraścaraṇasiddhaye || 1 ||

devatāgurumantrāṇamaikyaṃ saṃbhāvayan dhiyā |
japedekamanāḥ prātaḥkālānmadhyandināvadhi || 2 ||

yatsaṃkhyayā samārabdhaṃ tatkartavyaṃ dine dine |
yadi nyūnādhikaṃ kuryād vratabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥ || 3 ||

iti | atra divā caiva japaṃ kuryātpauraścaraṇiko vidhiḥ | iti phetkāriṇītantre'pi 
divāpadābhidhānāttu japaṃ rātrau ca varjayet  iti kumbhasambhavena 
rajanījapaniṣedhācca deśakālādyupadravasambhāvanāyāṃ 
caturthamuhūrtaparyantamapi japtavyam | pañcamamuhūrtasya tu : rākṣasīnāma 
sā velā garhitā sarvakarmasu | iti matsyapurāṇe ninditatvāditi | atra 
muhūrtaśabdena bhāga ucyate divasasya pañcamabhāgo niṣiddha ityarthaḥ | tathā 
piṅgalāmate :

nādhyāto nārcito mantraḥ susiddho'pi prasīdati |
nājaptaḥ siddhidānecchurnāhutaḥ phalado bhavet || 1 ||

pūjā dhyānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ tasmāt karmacatuṣṭayam |
pratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt svayaṃ cet siddhimicchati || 2 ||

japasyāntaḥ śivaṃ dhyāyed dhyānasyāntaḥ punarjapet |
japadhyānasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ siddhyati mantravit || 3 ||

nāradaḥ -

saṃkhyāpūrtau nijairdravyairjapasaṃkhyādaśāṃśataḥ |
yathoktakuṇḍe juhuyādyathāvidhi samāhitaḥ || 1 ||

athavā pratyahaṃ japtvā pūrvasmiṃstāvadeva hi | (juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ)

iti | vaiśampāyanaḥ -

nairantaryyavidhiḥ prokto na dinaṃ vyatilaṅghayet |
divasātikramāt puṃso mantrasiddhirbhavet nahi || 1 ||

yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ japedahni pūrvasmiṃstāvadeva tu |
dināntare'pi prajapedanyathā siddhirodhakṛt || 2 ||

gautamaḥ -

dhyānārcanajapānāṃ ca prāṇāyāmāstrayastrayaḥ |
ādyantayorvidhīyante nāsikāpuṭacāriṇaḥ || 1 ||

p. 366)

iti | uttaratantre -

japādau pūjayenmālāṃ toyairabhyukṣya yatnataḥ |
nidhāya maṇḍalasyāntaḥ savyahastagatāṃ ca vā || 1 ||

iṣṭamantreṇa mālāyāḥ prokṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

oṃ māṃ māle mahāmāye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi |
caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava || 1 ||

pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhṇīyād dakṣiṇe kare |
bījaṃ gaṇapateḥ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaram || 2 ||

avighnaṃ kuru māle tvaṃ gṛhṇīyādityanena ca |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 3 ||

iti | maṇḍalasyāntarnidhāya vā savyahaste gatāṃ vābhyukṣya pūjayediti 
saṃbandhaḥ | tathā -

japaṃ samārabhet paścāt pūrvavaddhyānamāsthitaḥ |
hastena srajamādāya cintayan manasā śivām || 1 ||

cintayitvā guruṃ mūrdhni yathāvarṇādikaṃ bhavet |
mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhato dhyātvā pītavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayam || 2 ||

mahāmāyāṃ ca hṛdaye ātmānaṃ gurupādayoḥ |
ājñācakre tataḥ paścād gurormantrasya cātmanaḥ || 3 ||

devyāścāpyekatāṃ nitvā suṣumnāvartmanā tataḥ |
tattvasvarūpamekaṃ tadyaccakraṃ pratilambhayet || 4 ||

ṣaṭcakre'pi mahāmāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prayatnataḥ |
lambhayenmūlamantreṇa ādiṣoḍaśacakrakam || 5 ||

ādiṣoḍaśacakrasthāṃ sādhakānandadāyinīm |
cintayan sādhako devi japakarma samārabhet || 6 ||

bhruvorupari nāḍīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ prānta ucyate |
tatprānte tripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṃgulam || 7 ||

raktaṃ ca kūlayogajñairājñācakramitīṣyate |
kaṇṭhe trayāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇām || 8 ||

suṣumneḍāpiṅgalānāṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatṣaḍaṃgulam |
tatṣaṭcakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagam || 9 ||

trayāṇāmapi nāḍīnāṃ hṛdaye caikatā bhavet |
tatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ syāt saptāṃgulapramāṇataḥ || 10 ||

tatpītamuktaṃ yogajñairādiṣoḍaśacakrakam |
dhyeyānāmapi mantrāṇāṃ cintanasya japasya ca || 11 ||

yasmādādyaṃ tu hṛdayaṃ tasmādādīti gadyate |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 12 ||

iti | tasmāt praṇavoccārāt | taduktaṃ tatraiva

niḥsetu ca yathā toyaṃ kṣaṇānnimnaṃ prasarpati |
mantrastathaiva niḥsetuḥ kṣaṇāt kṣarati yajvanām || 1 ||

tasmāt sarvatra mantreṣu caturvarṇā dvijātayaḥ |
pārśvayoḥ setumādāya japakarma samārabhet || 2 ||

samārabheyurityarthaḥ | chāndasatvādekavacanam | mantrāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ 
setustatsetuḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ | caturdaśasvaro yo'sau śeṣa aukārasaṃjñakaḥ | 
sa cānusvāracandrābhyāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ seturucyate | atra 
śivāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ tena sveṣṭadevatāmityarthaḥ | sarvapūjāsu saṃgatamiti 
svayamabhidhānāt | tathā :

pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhnīyāddakṣiṇe kare |
madhyamāyā madhyabhāge varjayitvā tu tarjanīm || 1 ||

anāmikākaniṣṭhābhyāṃ yutāyā namrabhāvataḥ |
sthāpayitvā tatra mālāmaṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tadgatam || 2 ||

pratyekaṃ bījamādāya aṅkādūrdhvena bhairava |
prativāraṃ paṭhenmantraṃ śanairoṣṭhau na cālayet || 3 ||

mālābījaṃ tu japtavyaṃ spṛśenna hi parasparam |
pūrvaṃ japaprayuktana cāṃguṣṭhāgreṇa bhairava || 4 ||

pūrvabījaṃ japanyastu parabījaṃ tu saṃspṛśet |
aṃguṣṭhena bhavettasya niṣphalaḥ sa japaḥ sadā || 5 ||

mālāṃ svahṛdayāsanne dhṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā |
devīṃ vicintayan japyaṃ kuryādvāmena na spṛśet || 6 ||

iti | aṅkādūrdhvenāṃguṣṭhāgreṇetyarthaḥ | mālābījaṃ tatsambandhimaṇiḥ | 
śaivāgame -

tarjanyā na spṛśet sūtraṃ kampayenna vidhūnayet |
na spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭaṃ na kārayet || 1 ||

akṣāṇāṃ cālane'ṃguṣṭhenānyamakṣaṃ na saṃspṛśet |
japakāle sadā vidvān meruṃ naiva vilaṅghayet || 2 ||

parivartanakāle ca saṃghaṭṭaṃ naiva kārayet |
kaliḥ khaṭakhaṭāśabde dolamāne calanmatiḥ || 3 ||

patite caiva vidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisambhavaḥ |
hastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vinaśyati || 4 ||

p. 367)

patite madhyamāyā aṃgulyantaragate | sphuṭite maṇau | sūtracchede 
guṇacchede'pītyarthaḥ | tathā -

kāse kṣute ca jṛbhāyāmekamāvartanaṃ tyajet |
pramādāt tarjanīsparśe bhavedāvartanaṃ tyajet || 1 ||

jape niṣiddhasaṃsparśe kṣālayitvā punarjapet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | āvartanaṃ mantrasya | yoginītantre -

sarvāsvapi ca mālāsu meruḥ pārśve vidhīyate |
na spṛśetaṃ kadācit tu spṛṣṭhe hyāvartanaṃ punaḥ || 1 ||

na spṛśet tarjanyeti sarvatra tarjanīsparśasyaiva niṣedhāt 
anyāṃgulīnāmasparśāsambhavādveti | tathā mahākapilapañcarātre -

ekacittaḥ praśāntātmāpyakṣasūtrakaraḥ śuciḥ |
bhugnagrovonnataḥ śāntaḥ kaṇḍūnmīlanavarjitaḥ || 1 ||

savisargaṃ samātraṃ ca savinduṃ sākṣaraṃ sphuṭam |
nadrutaṃ nāpi viśrāntaṃ kramānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥ || 2 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

akṣarādakṣaraṃ yāvat sarvadoṣavivarjitam |
vilambitaṃ ca nātīva tathā spaṣṭapadodbhavam || 1 ||

cittavikṣeparahitamatyutkṛṣṭadhiyānvitam |
evaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ vipra vinivedyaśca yāgavat || 2 ||

iti | yoginītantre -

aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi japānte śirasi kṣipet |
tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama || 1 ||

śivaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīrya ca sarvadā |
puṣkaraṃ śikhibījasthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmānvitaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

ākāśa śaśisaṃyuktaṃ siddhyaṃ hṛdayasaṃyutam |
eṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 3 ||

grahaṇe sthāpane caiva pūjane viniyojayet |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 4 ||

puṣkaraṃ hakāraḥ śikhī rephaḥ sūkṣmasūkṣmaḥ īkāraḥ 
ākāśaśaśibhyāṃ bindvardhacandrābhyāṃ yutaṃ siddhyai svarūpaṃ 
hṛdayaṃ namaḥ | phetkāriṇītantre yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ 
caret iti | nāradapañcarātre :

japaṃ tadanu kurvīta yathā śaktyāyutādikam |
nivedayed vibhostacca vākkarmamanasānvitam || 1 ||

puṇḍarīkākṣa viśvātman mantramūrte janārdana |
gṛhaṇimaṃ japaṃ nātha mama dīnasya śāśvata || 2 ||

ityuktvārghyaudakaṃ puṣpe kṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇigam |
agrato nikṣiped viṣṇormūlamantreṇa nārada || 3 ||

mantrātmā bhagavan viṣṇuracirāt siddhido bhavet |

iti | śivādāvāha somaśambhuḥ -

mānasopāṃśuvāṣpāṇāṃ (cyānāṃ) kuryādekatamaṃ japam |
mūlasyāṣṭaśataṃ japtvā na drutaṃ na vilambitam || 1 ||

guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam |
siddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprāsādāt tvayi sthitā || 2 ||

bhogī ślokaṃ paṭhitvāmuṃ dakṣahastena śambhave |
mūlamantrārghyatoyena varahaste nivedayet || 3 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

sampūjyātha japaṃ kuryād yāvadvai praharadvayam |
tadūrdhve pūrvavat snātvā viśeṣeṇa vidhānavit || 1 ||

nyāsāvasānamakhilam karmakuryāt puroditam |
pūjāgnihomaparyantaṃ tataśca japamārabhet || 2 ||

yāvaddināvasānaṃ tu bhūyaḥ snātvā tato dvijaḥ |
upāsya pūrvavat sandhyāṃ devaṃ saṃpūjayet punaḥ || 3 ||

visṛjya bhojanaṃ kuryāt satataṃ tārakodaye |
* * * * * * * * || 4 ||

sandhyāmupāsya devaṃ pūrvavat pūjayediti saṃbandhaḥ || athāto 
varjyāvarjyāni trailokyasaṃmohanatantre

bhikṣāśī vā havipyāśī śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ |
payovratī vā niyato japedekāgramānasaḥ || 1 ||

iti | bhikṣāsvarūpamāha kumbhasaṃbhavaḥ -

vaidikācārayuktānāṃ śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ  satām |
satkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī  vāgrajanmanām || 1 ||

p. 368)

iti | nāradaḥ -

carumūlaphalakṣīradadhibhikṣānnasaktavaḥ |
etatsaptavidhaṃ proktaṃ pavitraṃ vratabhojanam || 1 ||

iti | kapilaḥ -

yāvo yavāguḥ śākaṃ ca payo bhaikṣaṃ haviṣyakam |
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syādaśanaṃ mantrasādhane || 1 ||

iti | haviruktaṃ kumbhasaṃbhavena

sitaikavidhahaimantaṃ munyannaṃ svīyasaṃśṛtam |
aśūdrāvahataṃ padbhyāmanuttolyahataṃ ca yat || 1 ||

dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ gavyamaikṣavaṃ guḍavarjitam |
tilāścaiva sitā mudgāḥ kandaḥ kemukavarjitaḥ || 2 ||

nārikelaphalaṃ caiva kadalī lavalī tathā |
āmramāmalakaṃ caiva panasaṃ ca harītakī || 3 ||

vratāntarapraśastaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ manyate budhaḥ |
avaiṣṇavamalabhyaṃ cāpyapraśastaṃ vratāntare || 4 ||

tyājyamevātra tatsarvaṃ yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ |
laghumiṣṭahitāśī ca vinītaḥ śāntacetanaḥ || 5 ||

munyannaṃ nīvāraḥ | śātātapaḥ -

haimantikaṃ sitā svinnaṃ śāli mudgāstilā yavāḥ |
kalāyakaṃgunīvārā vāstūkaṃ hilamocakā || 1 ||

ṣaṣṭikā kālaśākaṃ ca mūlakaṃ kemuketarat |
kandaṃ saindhavasāmudre gavye ca dadhisarpiṣī || 2 ||

payo'nudhṛtasāraṃ ca panasāmre harītakī |
pippalī jīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṅgakatintiṇī || 3 ||

kadalī lavalī dhātrī phalānyaguḍamaikṣavam |
atailapakvaṃ munayo haviṣyānnaṃ pracakṣate || 4 ||

mūlakaṃ havirapi vaiṣṇavānāṃ niṣiddham | taduktaṃ viṣṇuyāmale -

yatra māṃsaṃ tathā madyaṃ tathā vṛntākamūlake |
nivedayennaiva tatra hareraikāntikī ratiḥ || 1 ||

iti | atha varjyāni | tatra kumbhasambhavaḥ -

lavaṇaṃ ca palaṃ caiva kṣāraṃ kṣaudraṃ rasāntaram |
māṣamudgamasūrādyān kodravāṃścaṇakānapi || 1 ||

kṣāraṃ lavaṇamiti sambandhaḥ | mudgāḥ sitāḥ | uttaratantre -

svinnaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ māṃsaṃ gṛñjanaṃ kāṃsyabhojanam |
māṣāḍhakīmasūrāṃśca kodravāṃścaṇakānapi || 1 ||

tāmbūlaṃ ca dvibhuktaṃ ca dussaṃvādaṃ pramattatām |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

varjayet iti | brahmayāmale

niścayotsāhadhairyācca tattvajñānasya darśanāt |
alpāśanādasaṅgācca ṣaḍbhirmantraḥ prasiddhyati || 1 ||

prayāsād bahubhakṣyācca prajalpānniyamāgrahāt |
nīcasaṅgācca laulyācca ṣaḍbhirmantro na siddhyati || 2 ||

aśaṅkitamanāścaiva śivaśaktimayatvataḥ |
devī mantramayaṃ sākṣād dhyāyedātmānamātmani || 3 ||

mano'nyatra śivo'nyatra śaktiranyatra mārutaḥ |
na siddhyati varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 4 ||

paryuṣaṃ cāranālaṃ ca kodravānnaṃ masūrikam |
kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tailaṃ ca mantravīryaharāṇi ṣaṭ || 5 ||

vīryavijñānayorhantā jñānahartā ca paryuṣaḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mantrī paryuṣitaṃ tyajet || 6 ||

āranālaṃ cānyamagnaṃ mantrī dṛṣṭvā parityajet |
phalalopo bhavennūnaṃ mantravīryaṃ hared dhruvam || 7 ||

tena kāraṇabhāvena mantrī kṣārāṃśca varjayet |
pittalaṃ mṛtyudaṃ nūnaṃ kṣudradhānyaṃ ca kodravam || 8 ||

kodravānnaṃ parityājyaṃ sarvathā japakarmaṇi |
masūrī mānahantrī ca parityājyātha sarvadā || 9 ||

kāṃsyapātraṃśuddhaṃ ca tacchaptaṃ viṣṇunā purā |
mantravīryaṃ haratyāśu yadyapi syānmaheśvaraḥ || 10 ||

tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāṃsyaṃ tyājyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥ |
tilatailaṃ mantrapūtaṃ pāvanaṃ devadurlabham || 11 ||

mardayitvā prayatnena snānaṃ kāryaṃ hi sarvadā |
varjayejjapavelāyāṃ bhojyaṃ naiva sadā budhaiḥ || 12 ||

p. 369)

na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ mantriṇā tatkadācana |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 13 ||

iti || atha bhojanaparyāyastatra kumbhasambhavaḥ -

upastīryābhidhāryait saṃskṛtya prokṣaṇādibhiḥ |
pācayedvaidikairmantraiḥ punarmūlena mantravit || 1 ||

vaidikaiḥ prokṣaṇādibhiḥ pācayediti sambandhaḥ | mūlena mantrayediti śeṣaḥ | 
tathā somaśambhūḥ hṛdā sambhojayenmantrī pūtairācāmayejjalaiḥ | hṛdā 
hṛdayamantreṇa jalaṃ ca mūlenābhimantritaṃ pibediti | palāśapatreṇa 
madhyapatravarjitena kṛtapatrāvalyāmeva bhuñjīteti vadanti 
kāṃsyabhajananiṣedhādayaṃ niyama iti tattvam || atha śayanaṃ 
vijayamālinītantre adhaḥ śayānaḥ śuddhātmā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ iti | 
nāradapañcarātre :

bhuktvā śayīta śayane suśuddhe ca suśītale |
arddharātre samutthāya pādaśaucaṃ cared dvijaḥ || 1 ||

ācamya devaṃ saṃsmṛtya śīghraṃ sampūjya pūrvavat |
japaṃ kuryādyathāśakti arpayecca tatheśvari || 2 ||

iti | tathā vaiśampāyanaḥ -

śayanaṃ kuśaśayyāyāṃ vinyasecchucivastradhṛt |
tadvāsaḥ kṣālayennityamanyathā vighnamāvahet || 1 ||

iti | tathā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

ahatāstaraṇāstīrṇe sadarbhaśayane śuciḥ |
mantrite ca śivaṃ dhyāyan prākśirasko niśi svapet || 1 ||

iti | mantrite sveṣṭamantreṇa | śivamityupalakṣaṇam || kapilapañcarātre

gurupādārcanaṃ kṛtvā upavāsi jitendriyaḥ |
darbhaśayyāṃ gato rātrau dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ nivedayet || 1 ||

iti | yoginītantre -

yajjāgrato dūramudeti daivamāvṛtya mantrān prayatastriretān |
laghvekabhug dakṣiṇapārśvaśāyī svapnaṃ parīkṣet yathopadeśam || 1 ||

mantrāniti bahucanena sakalaṃ sūktaṃ gṛhyate | tathā

bhagavan devadeveśa śūlabhṛd vṛṣavāhana |
iṣṭāniṣṭaṃ samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvata || 1 ||

evaṃ suptaḥ kuśāstīrṇe tataḥ prayatamānasaḥ | niśānte paśyati svapnaṃ 
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubham || 2 ||

iti | piṅgalāmate -

tāro hilidvayaṃ śūlapāṇaye dviṭha īritaḥ |
svapnamāṇavamantro'yaṃ śambhunā parikīrtitaḥ || 1 ||

namo'jāya trinetrāya piṅgalāya mahātmane |
vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 2 ||

svapne kathaya me tathyaṃ sarvakāryeṣvaśeṣataḥ |
kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 3 ||

iti | mantratantra prakāśe -

oṃ hṛt sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave |
viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 1 ||

svapnamāṇavamantro'yaṃ kathito nāradādibhiḥ |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

iti || atha śubhasūcakasvapnāstatra yoginītantre

trividhaṃ darśanaṃ tasya yathārthamayathārthakam |
apāvakaṃ yatsvasthānāmakhyātānāṃ hi darśanam || 1 ||

yathārtha tadayathārthamasvasthānāṃ vikārajam |
apāvakaṃ mānasaṃ ca yathārthaphalamucyate || 2 ||

eṣāṃ svarūpamāha - yaditi darśanaṃ devādīnāṃ vikārajaṃ pitrādīnāṃ 
mānasaṃ manovikārajaṃ ||

āgamasiddhānte -

ādye varṣe vatsarārdhe dvitīye yāme pāko varṣapādāt tṛtīye |
māse pākaḥ śarvarīturyayāme sadyaḥ pāko yo visargaṣu dṛṣṭaḥ || 1 ||

p. 370)

ādye yāme dṛṣṭasya svapnasya varṣe varṣamātre pākaḥ phalam | evamagre'pi | 
visarge niśānte | tathā jya(dū)re'dhamā madhyamā syāddṛṣṭe'nuttamottame | 
na vidyate uttamo yasyāḥ sā siddhiruttame svapne ityarthaḥ || tānevāha tatraiva :

svapne paśyati vai devaṃ nijeṣṭaṃ sarvatomukham |
guruṃ prasādasumukhaṃ nirmalaṃ candramaṇḍalam || 1 ||

gaṅgāṃ gāṃ bhāratīṃ bhānuṃ liṅginaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram |
prasannaṃ tatra jānīyāt siddhiṃ svapnanidarśane || 2 ||

prasannaṃ nijeṣṭadevamata eva siddhamapi || nāradapañcarātre -

kṣitilābhaḥ kṣaṣajābdhitaraṇaṃ cāgnipūjanam |
homaśca jvalite vahnau saṃgrāmavijayastathā || 1 ||

haṃsakokamayūrāṇāṃ rathārohaṇameva ca |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

lokaścakravākaḥ || kapilapañcarātre -

kanyāṃ chatraṃ rathaṃ dīpaṃ prāsādaṃ kamalaṃ nadīm |
kuñjaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mālyaṃ samudraṃ phalinaṃ drumam || 1 ||

parvataṃ ca hayaṃ medhyamāmamāsaṃ surāsavam |
evamādīni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyāt || 2 ||

iti || śrutirapi -

yadā karmasu kāmyeṣu striyaṃ svapneṣu paśyati |
samṛddhiṃ tatra jānīyāt tasmin svapnanidarśane || 1 ||

iti || bhairavītantre -

nadīsamudrataraṇamākāśagamanaṃ tathā |
bhāskarodayanaṃ caiva prajvalantaṃ hutāśanam || 1 ||

grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ candramaṇḍaladarśanam | nakṣatrāṇyaśvinyādīni | 
tārā anyāniti |

harmyasyārohaṇam caiva prāsādaśikhare'pi vā |
nāgāśvavṛṣabhendrāṇāṃ taruśailāgrarohaṇam || 2 ||

vimānagamanaṃ caiva siddhamantrasya darśanam |
lābhaḥ siddhataroścaiva devīnāṃ caiva darśanam || 3 ||

evamādīni saṃdṛṣṭvā naraḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt |
svapne tu madirāpānamāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam || 4 ||

krimiviṣṭānulepaṃ ca rudhireṇābhiṣecanam |
bhojanaṃ dadhibhaktasya śvetavastrānulepanam || 5 ||

siṃhāsanaṃ rathaṃ yānaṃ dhvajaṃ rājyābhiṣecanam |
ratnānyābharaṇādīni svapne dṛṣṭvā prasiddhyati || 6 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

gururdevo dvijaḥ kanyā gogajāśvāśca kesarī |
darpaṇaṃ śaṅkhabhīryyau ca tantrīvādyaṃ ca rocanam || 1 ||

tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tathā dadhyabhiva(na)ndanam |
siddhānnamāmamāṃsaṃ ca madyastrīmadirāsavāḥ || 2 ||

chatraṃ yānaṃ sitaṃ vastraṃ tathānyaśvetacandanam |
mālyamuktāphale hāraḥ pūrṇaḥ samuditaḥ śaśī || 3 ||

pracaṇḍakiraṇaḥ khastho nimnagātha mahodadhiḥ |
praphullapādapaḥ śālī rocanā kuṃkumaṃ madhu || 4 ||

lājāḥ siddhārthakābījaṃ navabhāṇḍaṃ ca pāyasam |
upapanno'pyathācāryo gāyatrī varasaṅgatā || 5 ||

manaḥprītikarāścānye loke śaṃsāpadaṃ gatāḥ |
sarve svapnāḥ śubhāḥ proktāḥ siddhimokṣaphalapradāḥ || 6 ||

iti | athāśubhasūcakāḥ nāradaḥ -

ato'nye viparītāstu manasaḥ khedadāśca ye |
garhitā lokavidviṣṭāḥ svapnāste hyaśubhāvahāḥ || 1 ||

ata uktaśubhasūcakāt | kapilapañcarātre -

caṇḍālaṃ kalabhaṃ kākaṃ gartaṃ śūnyamamaṅgalam |
tailābhyaktaṃ naraṃ nagnaṃ śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ sakaṇṭhakam || 1 ||

prāsādamatalaṃ dṛṣṭvā naro rogamavāpnuyāt |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

kalabhaṃ bālamuṣṭram | tatra prāyaścittamāha kapilāḥ dṛṣṭvā duḥsvapnakaṃ 
caiva homāt siddhimavāpnuyāt | tathā piṅgalāmate : śubhe śubhaṃ bhavettasya 
juhuyādaśubhe śatam | astreṇeti kramādvidvān | iti | nāradapañcarātre

dṛṣṭvā samācareddhomaṃ dantakāṣṭhoditaṃ mune |
kevalenāthavājyena siṃhamantreṇa śāntaye || 1 ||

p. 371)

dantakāṣṭaprakaraṇe tāvadāha svayameva -

śataṃ sahasraṃ sāṣṭaṃ vā yathāśaktyāthavā dvijaḥ |
astrasaṃpuṭitenaiṣāṃ nāmnā svāhānvitena ca || 1 ||

doṣāñjahijahītyevaṃ padaṃ nāmāvasānagam |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

astrasiṃhamantrayorvikalpaḥ | eṣāṃ doṣanidānānām || atha svapnanivedanaṃ 
tatraiva -

śiṣyastu śucirācāntaḥ puṣpahasto gurūttamam |
praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭastasmai svapnaṃ nivedayet || 1 ||

svapne vākṣisamakṣaṃ vā āścaryamatiharṣadam |
akasmādyadi jāyeta nākhyātavyaṃ gurorvinā || 2 ||

mantraprasādajanitaṃ liṅgaṃ ca na gurorvinā |
prakāśanīyaṃ viprendraṃ kasyacit siddhimicchatā || 3 ||

prakāśayati yo mohādautsukyānmantrajaṃ sukham |
nikaṭasthāśca tāstasya siddhayo yānti dūrataḥ || 5 ||

āvirbhavanti duḥkāni śokāśca vividhā api |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 6 ||

iti | vakratuṇḍakalpe - cittaprasādo manasaśca tuṣṭiralpāśitā 
spandaparāṅmukhatvam | iti | tathā bhairavītantre -

jyotiḥ paśyati sarvatra śarīraṃ vā prakāśayuk |
nijaṃ śarīramathavā devatāmayameva hi || 1 ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

mantrārādhanasaktasya prathamaṃ vatsaratrayam |
jāyante bahavo vighnā niyamasthasya nārada || 1 ||

nodvegaṃ sādhako yāti karmaṇā manasā yadi |
tṛtīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ rājānaśca mahībhṛtaḥ || 2 ||

prārthayante'nurodhena garvitā api māninaḥ |
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ nātha mamoddharaṇakāraṇam || 3 ||

prajvalantaṃ ca paśyanti tejasā vibhavena ca |
ataste muniśārdūla niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumakṣamāḥ || 4 ||

navamādvatsarādūrdhva svayaṃ siddhyati mantrarāṭ |
nānāścaryāṇi hṛdaye mantrasiddhimayāni vai || 5 ||

atyānandapradānyāśu pratyakṣe'pi bahistathā |
jaḍadhīstu kṣaṇaṃ viprakṣaṇamasti praharṣitaḥ || 6 ||

kṣaṇaṃ dundubhinirghoṣaṃ śṛṇoti tvantarikṣataḥ |
kṣaṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ vādyaṃnānāgītasamanvitam || 7 ||

ājighrati kṣaṇaṃ gandhān karpūramṛganābhijān |
utpatantaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi paśyatyātmānamātmanā || 8 ||

candrārkakiraṇākīrṇaṃ kṣaṇamālokayennabhaḥ |
gajagovṛṣanādāṃśca śṛṇuyācca kṣaṇaṃ dvijaḥ || 9 ||

nirbharāmbudasaṃkṣobhaṃ kṣaṇamākarṣayatyapi |
tārakāṇi vicitrāṇi yogino nabhasi sthitān || 10 ||

paśyatyudgrāhayataśca kṣaṇaṃ mantraṃ vratī sadā |
kṣaṇaṃ kilikilārāvaṃ haṃsavarhiravaṃ tathā || 11 ||

kṣaṇaṃ meghodayaṃ paśyet kṣaṇaṃ rātri dine sati |
rātrau ca divasālokaṃ sasūryyaṃ kṣaṇamīkṣate || 12 ||

balena paripūrṇaśca tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ |
pūrṇendusadṛśaḥ kāntyā gamane vihagopamaḥ || 13 ||

rayeṇa yuktaḥ procyeta (śocena) gāmbhīryeṇa sukhena ca |
svalpāśanenākṛśatā bahunāpi na cīyate || 14 ||

viṇmūtrayorathālpatvaṃ bhavennidrājayastathā |
japadhyānagato mantrī na khedamadhigacchati || 15 ||

vinā bhojanapānābhyāṃ pakṣamāsādikaṃ mune |
ityevamādibhiścihnarmahāvismayakāribhiḥ || 16 ||

pravṛtteḥ saṃpraboddhavyaṃ prasanno mantrarāḍiti |
* * * *  * * * * * * * *  * * * * || 17 ||

iti | tathā baudhāyanaḥ siddhestu trīṇi cihnāni dātā bhoktā ayācakaḥ | dātā 
bhoktāpyayācaka ityarthaḥ | prapañcasāre : (10 pa0 | 43 ślo0)

tato'sya pratyayāstvevaṃ jāyante japato manum |
adhiṣṭhitaṃ niśyadīpaṃ nistamisraṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

arkābhastejasāsau bhavati nalinajā santataṃ kiṅkarī syā-
drogā naśyanti dṛṣṭvā drutamatha dhanadhānyākulaṃ tatsamīpam |
devā nityaṃ namo'smai vidadhati phaṇino naiva daṃśanti putrāḥ
pautrā mitrāṇi ṛddhāstanuvipadi paraṃ dhāma viṣṇoḥ sa bhūyāt || (10 pa0 47 
ślo0)

p. 372)

iti | evaṃ kṛte'pi na siddhyati cettadā dvayaṃ trayaṃ vā puraścaraṇaṃ kuryāt | 
taduktaṃ phetkāriṇītantre -

karmaṇā prabalenaiva pratibandho virodhinā |
yadi siddhiṃ na labhate dvistrirvā punarācaret || 1 ||

iti || aya homaparyāyo vicāryate | tatra vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

athāgnikāryaṃ vakṣyāmi kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā |
vedyāmathāyase pātre mṛṇmaye vā nave śubhe || 1 ||

iti | jñānārṇave -

nityaṃ naimittikaṃ homaṃ sthaṇḍile vā samācaret |
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau susthalarūpakam || 1 ||

hastamātraṃ tu tatkuryādvālukābhiḥ suśobhanam |
aṃgulotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ || 2 ||

iti | kriyāsāre -

samo'ṣṭadikṣu prākprahvaḥ prāgudakpravaṇo'pi vā |
udakprahvaḥ pradeśo vā sthaṇḍilasya sthalaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||

iti | prahvaḥ pravaṇaḥ | tathā ca kapilaḥ : sthaṇḍilaṃ bālukābhirvā 
raktamṛdrajasā'pi vā || tathā vasiṣṭhaḥ hastamātraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ vā saṃkṣipte 
homakarmaṇi | atra saṃkṣipte ityabhidhānāt sahasrādisaṃkhyo homaḥ sthaṇḍile 
na kartavyaḥ iti kecit | tatra : homaṃ samārabhet kuṇḍe sthaṇḍile vātha pūjite | 
agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā hyācāryaḥ sarvavedavit | tilahomaṃ 
vyāhṛtibhiraṣṭottarasahasrakam | iti vāyupurāṇavacanāt : kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile 
vātha tatra homo vidhīyate | ayutaṃ homa saṃkhyā ca palāśasamidhastathā || iti 
padmapurāṇavacanācca | atra homāśaktau tu japo'śaktasya sarvatra iti 
nārāyaṇīyavacanāt japa eva kāryaḥ | tatra brāhmaṇaiḥ 
puraścaraṇajapasaṃkhyācaturguṇajapaḥ kāryaḥ kṣatriyaiḥ ṣaḍguṇaḥ 
vaiśyairaṣṭaguṇaḥ | homakarmaṇi śaktānāṃ trayāṇaṃ japasāmyatā | 
homakarmaṇyaśaktānāṃ vedartuvasusammitam | iti uttaratantravacanāt | 
tadaśaktau tu viprāṇāṃ dviguṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ triguṇaḥ vaiśyānāṃ 
caturguṇaḥ homakarmaṇyaśaktānāṃ viprāṇāṃ dviguṇo japaḥ | itareṣāṃ tu 
varṇānāṃ triguṇādirvidhīyate || iti gautamavacanāt | tatrāpyaśaktau 
homasaṃkhyācaturguṇajapaḥ kāryaḥ | homāśaktau japaṃ 
kuryāddhomasaṃkhyācaturguṇam iti vasiṣṭhavacanāt | etadapi vipramātraparaṃ 
kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ prāgvat ṣaḍguṇāṣṭaguṇajapo bhavati prāguktavacanāt | 
tatrāpyaśaktau homasaṃkhyādviguṇajapo vā kāryaḥ | yadyadaṅgaṃ vihīyeta 
tatsaṃkhyādviguṇo japaḥ | kartavyaḥ sāṅgasiddhyarthaṃ tadaśaktena bhaktitaḥ || 
iti kumbhasambhavavacanāt | tadaśaktena 
puraścaraṇasaṃkhyācaturguṇādikaraṇāśaktena | etadapi vipramātraparaṃ 
kṣatriyavaiśyayostriguṇacaturguṇajayo bhavati prāguktagautamavacanādeva 
dvijabhaktetaraśūdrāṇāṃ tu caturguṇapakṣe daśaguṇajapo bhavati 
dviguṇapakṣe tu pañcaguṇajapaḥ iti | dvijabhaktaśūdrāṇāṃ tu yaṃ 
varṇamāśrito yaḥ śūdrastasya tadvarṇavihitajapa eveti | taduktamuttaratantre :

dvijānāṃ homavirahe yaḥ proktaḥ sūribhirjapaḥ |
tadyoṣitāṃ sa evoktaḥ śūdro yaṃ varṇamāśritaḥ || 1 ||

tat strīṇāṃ vihitaṃ jāpaṃ kuryādbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

iti | gautamo'pyāha -

homābhāve dvijānāṃ tu japaḥ proktaḥ purā tu yaḥ |
tatsubhruvāṃ ca tadbhṛtya śūdrāṇāṃ ca sa eva hi || 1 ||

iti | ataḥ strīśūdrairhomanādhikārājjapa eva kāryaḥ | uttaratantre -

tato homadaśāṃśena jale sampūjya devatām |
tarpayāmīti mantrānte proktādbhirmūrdhni tarpayet || 1 ||

iti | vaiśampāyanaḥ -

tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena namo'ntaṃ mantramuccaran |
abhiṣiñcet svamūrdhānaṃ jalaiḥ kumbhākhyamudrayā || 1 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

tadante bhojayedviprān sadācārān daśāṃśataḥ |
nānāvidhairbhakṣyabhojyairlehyaiścopyaistathetaraiḥ || 1 ||

sarvathā bhojayedviprān kṛtasāṅgatvasiddhaye |
viprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgatvamāpnuyāt || 2 ||

p. 373)

ekamaṅgaṃ vihīyeta tato neṣṭamavāpnuyāt |
aṅgahīnaṃ bhavedyadyat karma neṣṭārthasādhakam || 3 ||

nyūnātiriktakarmāṇi na phalanti manorathān |
ta eva pūrṇatāṃ yānti samastāni bhavanti cet || 4 ||

ato yatne viduṣo bhojayet sarvakarmasu |
yāni yānyapi karmāṇi hīyante dvijabhojanaiḥ || 5 ||

nirarthakāni tāni syurbījānyūṣaragānivat |
guruṃ santoṣayet paścādgohiraṇyāmbarādibhiḥ || 6 ||

gurau tuṣṭaṃ hi saṃtuṣṭo mantraḥ siddhyati mantriṇaḥ |
itthaṃ puraścaraṇataḥ prasannā devatā bhavet || 7 ||

iti | śrīkulārṇave -

yadṛcchayā śrutaṃ mantraṃ chadmanāpi chalena vā |
pareritaṃ vā gāthāṃ vā saṃjapedyadyanarthakṛt || 1 ||

pustake likhitān mantrānālokya prajapanti ye |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ teṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitam || 2 ||

anekakoṭimantrāśca cittavyākulakāraṇam |
mantraṃ gurumukhāt prāptamekaṃ syāt sarvasiddhidam || 3 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ : tatra japamālā sātu dvividhā mātṛkākṣaramayī ceti | tatra 
maṇayastu : putrajīvaśaṅkhavidrumaratnamuktāphalapadmabījasuvarṇarajatakuśa-
grarnthirudrākṣā ityakṣaviśeṣā | akṣasaṃkhyā tu 
sāttvikarājasatāmasabhedenāṣṭottaraśataṃ catuḥpañcaśatsaptaviṃśatiśceti | 
atha mālāyāḥ saṃskārakālaḥ : tatra viṣṇordvādaśopūrvāhnaḥ | 
śakteraṣṭamīnavamīcaturdaśīrātriḥ | gaṇeśasya caturthīmadhyāhnaḥ | śivasya 
trayodaśī divā | sūryasya saptamīpūrvāhna iti || atha mālāyāḥ sūtrāṇi | 
viṣṇoḥ padmasūtraṃ kārpāsasūtraṃ vā devyāḥ paṭṭasūtraṃ 
śivasyorṇābhavaṃ vālkalaṃ vā sūryagaṇeśayoḥ karpāsasūtraṃ 
paṭṭasūtraṃ vā kārpāsasūtraṃ cedbrāhmaṇokartitaṃ 
svasamānavarṇayoṣitkartitaṃ vā triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtaṃ kuryāt | anyeṣu 
sūtreṣu yathāyogyameva kāryamiti || atha saṃskāraḥ : tatra pramāṇoktapātrayā 
gomūtragomayadugdhadadhivṛtakuśajalātmakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ saṃpādya 
śaktivyatirikte pūrvadine kṛtaikabhaktaḥ sādhakaḥ prātaḥkṛtanityakṛtyaḥ 
sūtraṃ maṇīṃśca pṛthak pṛthak pañcagavyena jalaiśca prakṣālya navasu 
pippaladaleṣu padmākāraraciteṣu sūtraṃ maṇīṃśca saṃsthāpya teṣu 
praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśvarībījaṃ mātṛkākṣarāṇi ca sūtre pratibījaṃ bījeṣvapi 
vinyasya maṇīn sūtraṃ ca gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya kuṇḍādau 
nityahomavidhināgniṃ saṃsthāpya yathāśakti saghṛtaistilaiḥ kevalaghṛtairvā 
sadyādipañcamantrairhutvā homāśaktau japaṃ vā vidhāya sūtre 
rudrākṣaputrajīvapadmākṣāścet mukhena mukhaṃ saṃyojayan 
yathāmukhamanyamaṇīnityāropyaikaikamaṇimadhye gurūktavidhinā 
brahmagranthiṃ vidhāya gopucchākāreṇa granthayitvā sarvataḥ sthūlaṃ 
sajātīyamekaṃ maṇimūrdhyamukhaṃ sūtradvayamekīkṛtya meruṃ granthayitvā 
sampannāṃ mālāṃ oṃ sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | bhave 
bhave nātibhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ || iti mantreṇa pancagavyena 
śītalajalena ca prakṣālya oṃ vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ śreṣṭhāya 
namo rudrāya namaḥ kālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balavikaraṇāya namo 
balāya namo balapramathanāya namaḥ sarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya 
namaḥ iti mantreṇa candanāgarukarpūrakuṃkumairvighṛṣya oṃ aghorebhyo'ya 
ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu 
rudrarūpebhyaḥ 
ityagaruśīrakarpūraśarkarāguggulamadhucandanaghṛtairdhūpayitvā oṃ 
tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt iti 
gandhacandanakastūrīkuṃkumakarpūrairlepayet | tataḥ oṃ īśānaḥ 
sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ 
brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmā śivo me'stu sadāśivām iti mantreṇa 
pratibījaṃ śataṃ śatamabhimantrayet (meruṃ cānena aghorebhyotha ityananenāpi 
śataṃ śatamabhimantrayet | pratyekaṃ tu sakṛtsakṛditi vā) tatastatra 
pūrvoktavaktrabhedena yasya rudrākṣasya yā ca devatā 
tāmāvāhyāvāhanasthāpanasaṃnidhāpanasaṃnirodhanasaṃmukhī-
karaṇasakalīkaraṇāvaguṇṭhanāmṛtokaraṇaparamīkaraṇāni tattanmudrayā 
vidhāya prāguktaiḥ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pratibījaṃ pañcopacāraistāṃ devatāṃ 
sveṣṭadevatāvat pūjayitvetthaṃ saṃskṛtamālayā japaṃ kuryāt | iti 
japamālāsaṃskāravidhiḥ ||

itthaṃ pratiṣṭhitamālayā japaṃ kurvan yadā tatsūtraṃ jīrṇamiti jānāti tadaiva 
dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ granthayitvā tathā sveṣṭamantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ 
prāyaścittārthaṃ japitvā paścāttayā mālayā yathāpūrvaṃ japaṃ kuryāt |  
ayaṃ pratiṣṭhāprakārastu rudrākṣasyaiva nānyeṣām | anyeṣāṃ 
padmākṣādīnāṃ tu pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ pradarśya : tatra grathitāṃ mālāṃ 
kutracitpātre saṃsthāpya tasyāṃ

p. 374)
                                                                                                                                             
gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇuśivadūrgāḥ pṛthak pṛthagāvāhya sampūjya 
haumitimantreṇa pañcagavye nikṣipya punastāṃ tasmāduddhṛtya svarṇapātrastha 
pippalapatrasthe vā dhūpavāsite pañcāmṛte nikṣipya punastāmudhṛtya 
śītalajale nikṣipya prakṣālya 
candanāgarukastūrīkarpūrakuṃkumasaugandhikapaṅkairanulipya tasyāṃ haumiti 
mantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā nava grahān daśa dikpālāṃśca sampūjya 
saghṛtaistilairyathāśakti sveṣṭamantreṇa hutvā gurave yathāśakti kāñcanaṃ 
dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāṃścānnādibhiḥ toṣayediti ||

athavā sūtraṃ maṇīṃśca pañcagavye dinatrayaṃ saṃsthāpya caturthadine 
samuddhṛtyāstramantreṇa prakṣālya hṛnmantreṇa granthayitvā sthaṇḍile 
sveṣṭadevatāpūjāmaṇḍalaṃ vidhāya tatra sveṣṭadevatāṃ sampūjya 
mūlamantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japitvā 
sveṣṭadevatākalpoktapuraścaraṇahomadravyeṇa ghṛtena vā yathāśakti hutvā 
maṇḍalamadhye mālāṃ saṃsthāpya tasyāmastramantraṃ mūlamantraṃ 
ṣaḍaṅgamantrāṃśca vinyasya sveṣṭadevatārūpāṃ tāṃ vicintya 
vakṣyamāṇavidhinā sarvabhūtabaliṃ dattvā tasyāmiṣṭadevatāṃ 
sampūjyācārya dakṣiṇādibhiḥ paritoṣya praṇamya 
brāhmaṇāṃścānnādibhistoṣayeditītthaṃ pratiṣṭhitayā mālayā nityaṃ 
mantraṃ japet ||

atha puraścaraṇakāle vihitāni : tatra 
manaḥsaṃharaṇaśaucamaunamantrārthacintanāvyagratānirvedaśraddhājapotsāh
akrodhatyāgasvavarṇāśramadharmānuṣṭhānaparituṣṭatendriya-
nigrahabrahmacaryagurunati kevalāmalakasnānamaṃtrābhimaṃtritajalābhiṣekāḥ 
triṣavarṇaṃ dvisavanamaśaktau sakṛdvā snānaṃ 
devarṣipitṛsveṣṭadevatātarpaṇaṃ 
madhyapatrarahitapalāśapatraracitapatrāvalyāṃ rātrau mitabhojanaṃ 
goviprabālādiṣu kṛpā ceti ||

atha tatkālaniṣiddhāni : 
apriyānṛtabhāṣaṇakarañjavibhītakārkasnuhīcchāyākramaṇa 
pratigrahastrīśūdrapatitanāstikocchiṣṭasambhāṣaṇasnānatarpaṇādyana-
nuṣṭhānabahuvastraikavastramalinavastradhāraṇa 
kāmyakarmāsaṃkalpitasvavarṇāśramāvihitakarmācaraṇakāṃsya-bhojana 
divābhojanāsadbhāṣaṇānyapūjanakauṭilyakṣau-
rābhyaṅgāsādhusamāgamoṣṇajalasnānonmardanagītavādyādiśravaṇa-
nṛtyadarśanāṣṭavidhamaithunatatkathālāpakṣudrakarmāsthānasparśa 
prāṇihiṃsākañcukoṣṇīṣadhāraṇāsamvṛtakarāprāvaraṇakeśamā-
kṣaṇaśiraḥprāvaraṇacintākrodhabhramatvarāmanoratha 
śayanotthānagamanāndhakārāmaṅgalasthānapādukādhāraṇayāna-
śayyādhirohaṇa 
pādaprasāraṇotkaṭāsanakṣutajṛmbhāhikkāvikalamanaskānāsanaprauḍhapādan
agnakuśarāhityādīni ||

athāsanāni tatra : 
vyāghracarmamṛgājinavetranirmitakambalakuśakaṭaraktapaṭavastrātma-kāni 
vihitāni ||

atha niṣiddhāsanāni : 
vaṃśaracitadārumayapāṣāṇatṛṇavastrapallaveṣṭakānirmitāni kevalabhūtalaṃ 
ceti ||

atha puraścaraṇārambhapūrvadinakṛtyam : tatra prātaḥ snātvā nityakriyāṃ 
nirvartya brāhmaṇān bhojanādibhistoṣayitvā svagurumapi 
vastrābharaṇadhanadhānyādibhiḥ santoṣya japasthāne 
trikoṇavṛttacaturasramaṇḍale kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | kṣetrapāla ihāgaccha 
ihāgaccha iti kṣetrapālamāvāhyoktamantreṇa kṣetrapālaṃ gandhādibhiḥ 
sampūjya tadagre trikoṇamaṇḍale sādhāraṃ sānnavyañjanodakapūrṇaṃ 
balipātraṃ nidhāya ehyehi vidvi (du) pi murumuru bhañjayabhañjaya tarjayatarjaya 
vighnavighna mahābhairava kṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa svāhā iti mantreṇa 
baliṃ dattvopavaset ||

atha japārambhadinakṛtyam : tatra śubhe māsi candratārānukūle 
tithivāranakṣatrādiśodhite sudivase prātaḥ snātvā guruviprājñāmādāya 
brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivācanaṃ kārayitvā kuśahastaḥ oṃ sūryaḥ somo yamaḥ kālaḥ 
sandhye bhūtānyahaḥ kṣapā | pavano dikpatirbhūmirākāśaṃ khecarāmarāḥ || 
brāhmayaṃ śāsanamāsthāya kalpadhvamiha sannidhim | iti paṭhitvā tāmrapātre 
kuśatilākṣatajalānyādāyodaṅmukhaḥ oṃ adyāmuke māsi amukarāśigate 
savitari amukapakṣe'mukatithau bhāratavarṣākhyabhūpradeśe viśeṣakṣetraṃ 
cedamukakṣetre amukaśarmā kṣatriyaścedamukavarmā vaiśyaścedamukaguptaḥ 
śūdraścedamukadāsaḥ 
amukamantrasiddhikāmo'mukamantrasyeyatsaṃkhyājapātmakaṃpuraśca-raṇaṃ 
kariṣye adyārabhyaitāvaddinairahaṃ kariṣye iti vā saṃkalpaṃ vidhāya 
gurugaṇapatidurgāmātṝrnatvā pūjāṃ samāpya japamārabhet | tatra 
mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantrasya 
ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vinyasya hṛdi devaṃ dhyāyan japamālāṃ 
vāmahaste kutracitpātre vā saṃsthāpyārghyodakena mūlamantreṇa samprokṣya 
oṃ māṃ māle mahāmāye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī | catuvargastvayi nyastastasmānme 
siddhidā bhava || iti gandhapuṣpākṣatairmālāṃ sampūjya

p. 375)

oṃ avighnaṃ kuru māle tvaṃ iti mantreṇa dakṣiṇahastena mālāmādāya svaśirasi 
śrīguruṃ kaṇṭhe pītavarṇaṃ mūlamantraṃ hṛdaye sveṣṭadevatāṃ 
gurupādayoḥ svātmānaṃ ca dhyātvā bhūmadhyasthājñācakre 
gurudaivatamantrātmanāmaikyaṃ vibhāvya kaṇṭhasthaviśuddhicakre 
taccatuṣṭayamekībhūtaṃ suṣumnāvartmanānīya tatra devatāṃ dhyātvā 
mūlamantreṇa hṛdayasthānāhatacakramānīya tatrāpi devatāṃ dhyāyan 
hṛdayasamīpe mālāmānīye dakṣahastasya madhyamāṃgulimadhyaparvaṇi 
saṃsthāpyaikacittau bhugnagrīvonnatagātraḥ kaṇḍūnmīlanarahitaḥ 
khaṭakhaṭādiśabdamakurvan mantrārthagatacitto mālāyāḥ pratibījaṃ 
mantramuccaran pūrvabījajapasamaye'paraṃ bījamaspṛśan 
praṇavoccāraṇapūrvakaṃ mantramārabhya prātaḥkālānmadhyadināvadhi 
deśādyupadravasambhāvanāyāṃ tvarayā samāpanīye vā 
sārdhapraharadvayāvadhi japitvā sarvaśeṣāvṛttyante punaḥ praṇavamuccārya 
japaṃ samāpya tvaṃ māle sarvadevāna prītidā śubhadā bhava | śivaṃ kuruṣva 
me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā | iti mantreṇa mālāṃ svaśirasi nidhāya punaḥ 
prāṇāyāmatrayarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāyārdhyodakena 
prāguktamantreṇa japaṃ samarpya prāguktamālāpūjanamantreṇa mālāṃ 
sampūjya rahasi sthāpayet | atra praṇavoccāraṇaṃ tu traivarṇikānāmeva | 
śūdrādīnāṃ tu aukārastvādyantayoḥ praṇavatvena grāhyaḥ iti | tato 
madhyāhnasnānādikaṃ vidhāya punaḥ pūjāṃ vistarataḥ kṛtvā 
pratidinahomapakṣe japadaśāṃśaṃ kalpoktadravyairvidhinā saṃskṛte vahnau 
hutvā homadaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇadaśāṃśaṃ mārjanaṃ 
mārjanadasāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ ca pratyahaṃ kuryāt | 
pratilakṣahomapakṣe ekalakṣasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ samāpya 
taddaśāṃśahomādikaṃ kṛtvāgnimalakṣajapamārabhet | 
kalpoktasaṃkhyājapasamāptyanantara homapakṣe kalpoktasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ 
samāpya paścāt taddaśāṃśahomādikaṃ kuryāt iti pakṣatraye'pyekaḥ pakṣaḥ 
kāryaḥ | homaparyāyastu prāgeva dīkṣāprakaraṇe proktaḥ | homāśaktau tu japa 
eva kāryaḥ | tatra brāhmaṇaiḥ puraścaraṇasaṃkhyācaturguṇaḥ kāryaḥ 
kṣatriyaiḥ ṣaḍguṇo vaiśyairaṣṭaguṇaḥ kāryaḥ | atrāśaktī brāhmaṇaiḥ 
puraścaraṇasaṃkhyādviguṇā japaḥ kāryaḥ kṣatriyaistriguṇā 
vaiśyaiścaturguṇa iti | tatrāpyaśaktau homasaṃkhyācaturguṇajapaḥ kāryaḥ | 
etadvipraparaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ prāgvat ṣaḍguṇāṣṭaguṇajapo bhavati | 
tatrāpyaśaktau homasaṃkhyādviguṇajapo vā kāryaḥ etadapi vipramātrapara 
kṣatriyavaiśyayostu triguṇacaturguṇajapo bhavati | dvijabhaktetaraśūdrāṇāṃ 
daśaguṇo japo bhavati | caturguṇadviguṇapakṣe tu pañcaguṇajapa iti | 
dvijabhaktaśūdrāṇāṃ tu yaṃ varṇamāśrito yaḥ śūdrastadvarṇavihitajapa eva 
dvijastrīṇāmapi tathaiveti | strīśūdrāṇāṃ homānadhikārāt japa eva vihitaḥ iti | 
itthaṃ homaṃ vidhāya 
candanāgarukarpūrādivāsitairjalairhomasaṃkhyādaśāṃśataḥ 
prāguktavidhinā jale devaṃ dhyātvā sampūjya saṃtarpya svātmānaṃ 
devatārūpa dhyāyan kumbhamudrayā mūlamantrānte ātmānamabhiṣiñcāmi 
namaḥ iti tarpaṇasaṃkhyādaśāṃśataḥ svamūrdhni 
abhiṣicyābhiṣekasaṃkhyādaśāṃśasaṃkhyakān sveṣṭadevatābhaktān 
sadācārān brāhmaṇān prātarnimantryāhūyābhyaṅgādinā snāpayitvā 
vastragandhādibhiralaṃkṛtya ṣaḍrasairnānāvidhairbhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ 
sveṣṭadevatābuddhyā bhojayitvā tāmbūladakṣiṇādibhiḥ paritoṣya visṛjediti 
pratyahaṃ lakṣānte vā samastasaṃkhyāsamāptau vā bhaktipūrvakaṃ kuryāditi 
| tataḥ prakṛte madhyāhnapūjānantaraṃ vaiśvadevādikamāhnikaṃ vidhāya 
sveṣṭadevatāmantrajapadhyānakīrtanaśravaṇādinā dinaśeṣaṃ nītvā śaktau 
sāyantanasnānaṃ vidhāya devaṃ sampūjya bhuñjīta | tatra bhojyāni bhaikṣaṃ 
śuklaikavidhāsvinnahaimantikanīvāraṣaṣṭikāṃkaguyavāḥ śūdrānavahatā 
bahuśaḥ pādābhyāmanuttālyāvahatāḥ guḍavarjitamaikṣavaṃ 
kṛṣṇatilamudgakalāyāḥ kemukavarjaṃ kandaviśeṣāḥ 
nārikelakadalīphalalavalīpanasāmrāmalakārdrakaharītakīvāstukakālaśākahila
mocakāḥ saindhavasāmudre lavaṇe'nuddhṛtasārādigavyāni 
pippalījīrakanāraṅgatintiṇīmūlakāni ||

atha varjyāni : 
guḍakṛtrimalavaṇakṣāralavaṇasvinnaparyuṣitaniḥsnehakīṭādidūṣita-
kāñjikagṛñjanabilvakarañjalaśunamṛṇālakodravamaṇḍakatailapakva-
māṣamasūracaṇakagodhūmadevadhānyādīni atibhojanaṃ divābhojanaṃ ca ||

atha bhojanaparyāyaḥ : tatra sveṣṭadevatāprasādamannaṃ 
madhyapatrarahitapalāśapatraiḥ kalpitapatrāvalyāṃ saṃsthāpya vaidikamantraiḥ 
saṃskṛtya mūlamantreṇa prokṣya pratidravyaṃ mūlamantreṇa 
saptavāramabhimantrya mitaṃ mitaṃ hṛnmantreṇāśnīyāt mūlamantreṇa 
dvātriṃśadvāramabhimantritaṃ jalaṃ ca pivet ||

p. 376)

atha śayanam : tatra kuśanirmitāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ prakṣālitāyāṃ 
kṣārādbhiḥ prakṣālitaṃ vastramāstīrya śayyāṃ mūlamantreṇa 
saptavāramabhimantrya yajjāgrata iti sūktasya śivasaṃkalpa-ṛṣiḥ triṣṭupchandaḥ 
mano devatā sūktajape viniyogaḥ ||

yajjāgrato dūramudeti daivaṃ tadu suptasya tathaivaiti |
dūraṅgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 1 ||

yena karmāṇyapaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ |
yadapūrvaṃ yakṣyamantaḥ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 2 ||

yat prajñānamuta ceto dhṛtiśca yajjyotirantaramṛtaṃ prajāsu |
yasmānna ṛte kiñcana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 3 ||

yenedaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyat parigṛhītamamṛtena sarvam |
yena yajñastāyate saptahotā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 4 ||

yasminnṛcaḥ sāmayajūṃṣi yasmin pratiṣṭhitā rathanābhāvivārāḥ |
yasmiṃścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 5 ||

suṣārathiraśvāniva yanmanuṣyānnenīyate'mīśubhirvājina iva |
hṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yadajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu || 6 ||

iti mantrāṃstriḥpaṭhitvā |

bhagavan devadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana |
iṣṭāniṣṭe samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvata || 1 ||

iti | oṃ hili hili śūlapāṇaye svāhā |

namo'jāya trinetrāya piṅgalāya mahātmane |
vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 1 ||

svapne kathaya me tathyaṃ sarvakāryeṣvaśeṣataḥ |
kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 2 ||

namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave |
viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 3 ||

iti mantrāṃśca sakṛjjapitvā prākśirā dakṣiṇapārśvaśāyī svapnaṃ parīkṣet | 
tatra svasthānāṃ prathame prahare dṛṣṭasya svapnasya varṣeṇa phalaṃ dvitīye 
ṣaṣṭhe māsi tṛtīye māsatrayeṇa caturthe māsena niśānte sadyaḥ phalaṃ 
jñeyamiti ||

atha siddhisūcakasvapnāḥ : 
prasādasumukhasveṣṭadevatāgurunirmalacandrasūryamaṇḍala 
gaṅgāyāsarasvatīsaṃnyāsiśivaliṅgānāṃ darśanaṃ bhūmilābhaḥ 
raktasamudrataraṇaṃ yuddhajayo homavahnipūjanaṃ 
haṃsacakravākamayūrasārasadarśanaṃ 
rathārohaṇakanyācchatrarathadīpaprāsādagajavṛṣamālyasamudrasarpakulavṛkṣa
parvatapavitrāmamāṃsaturagasurāsavastrīdarśanaṃ 
nadītaraṇākāśagamanagrahanakṣatradarśana 
harmyaprāsādaśikharagajāśvavṛṣamataruparvataśikharārohaṇavimānagamanala
abhadevīdarśanāni 
madirāpānāmamāṃsabhakṣaṇapurīṣānulepanaraktābhiṣekaratnā-
bharaṇādidarśanāni ||

athāśubhasūcakāḥ : 
caṇḍālakalabhakākaśūnyagartāmaṅgamaladravyatailābhyaktanaranagna-
śuṣkavṛkṣakaṇṭakatarutalarahita prāsādadarśanaṃ rogadam | tatra prāyaścittaṃ 
nṛsiṃhamantraṃ paṭhitvā duḥsvapnasūcitān doṣān jahi 2 punarnasiṃhamantraṃ 
paṭhitvā svāhā ityaṣṭottaraśataṃ ghṛtaijuhuyāt | athavā evamevāstramantreṇa 
vā homaḥ kāryaḥ | nṛsiṃhamantrastvekākṣaraḥ saca kṣraumiti | astramantrastu 
svopāsyamūlavidyāyāḥ ||

atha svapnanivedanam : tatra gurucaraṇārabindayugalaṃ praṇamya puṣpahastaḥ 
svapnaṃ tasmai nivedayet | guroranyatra na prakāśayet ||

atha siddhicihnāni : cittaprasādo manastuṣṭiḥ 
svalpāśananidrājayajyotirdarśanākasmādatiharṣāntarikṣasthadundubhiśabdamad
huravādyanānāgītaśravaṇaṃ karpūrādisugandhiparimalāghrāṇaṃ 
candrārkakiraṇākīrṇākāśālokāni | evaṃ kṛte'pi na siddhyati ced dvistrirvā 
punaḥ punaḥ kuryāt || atha mantrasiddheranyaḥ paryāyaḥ | tatra kulaprakāśatantre :

p. 377)

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamapoṣitaḥ || 1 ||

nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre jale sthitaḥ |
sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ || 2 ||

tāvatkālaṃ japitvetthaṃ tato homādikaṃ caret |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 3 ||

iti | ayamarthaḥ : tatra sūryoparāge pūrvadinamupoṣitaścandragrahaṇe taddina 
evopoṣito grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhāyādyāmuke māsi amukarāśigate 
sūrye'mukapakṣe'mukatithau amukatīrthe sūryagrahaṇe candragrahaṇe 
vāmukagotro'mukaśarmmetyādi 
amukamantrasiddhikāmo'mukagrahaṇatatsamayamārabhya 
vimuktiparyantamamukamantrajapamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpaṃ kṛtvā 
vimuktiparyantaṃ japet | grahaṇakālīnajapadaśāṃśahoma kariṣye iti 
homasaṅkalpaḥ | homāśaktau prāguktavat japaḥ kāryaḥ || aparastu 
mantrasiddhiparyāyaḥ | tatra kumbhasambhavaḥ :

kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśī |
devaṃ dhyātvā japenmantramayutānāṃ catuṣṭayam || 1 ||

daśāśaṃ homayet paścāttarpayedabhiṣecayet |
tataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | ayamarthaḥ : tatrādyetyādyamukamantrasiddhikāmaḥ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīmārabhya 
taccaturdaśīparyantamamukamantrasyāyutacatuṣṭayajapamahaṃ kariṣye iti 
saṅkalpaṃ vidhāyāyutacatuṣṭayajapaṃ saptadhā vibhajya 
caturdaśottarasaptaśatādhikasahasrapañcakaṃ japitvā taddaśāṃśahomādikaṃ 
ca kuryāditi || aparaḥ prakārastu kālottare :

mantrī tu prajapenmantraṃ mātṛkākṣarasampuṭam |
anulomavilomena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 1 ||

triṣaṣṭyakṣarasaṃyuktamātṛkākṣarasampūṭam |
kramotkramāt śatāvṛttyā māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 2 ||

mātṛkājapamātreṇa mantrāṇāṃ koṭikoṭayaḥ |
siddhāḥ syurnaiva sandeho yasmātsarvaṃ tadudbhavam || 3 ||

iti | ayamarthaḥ : kramotkramāt mātṛkāpuṭitaṃ mantraṃ pratidinaṃ śataṃ 
māsamātraṃ japediti | atrāpyadyetyādikramotkramamātṛkāpuṭitamantrasya 
māsamātraṃ pratidinaṃ śataśatasaṃkhyajapamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpaṃ 
vidhāya prāgvat japet | atra śataśabdo nyūnasaṃkhyāvyavacchedakaḥ 
tenāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyaṃ japedityarthaḥ | mātṛkāsampuṭaprakārastu aṃ āṃ 
iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ 
ghaṃ ṅaṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ 
daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ 
haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ mūlaṃ kṣaṃ laṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ maṃ 
bhaṃ baṃ phaṃ paṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ 
ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ aṃḥ aṃ auṃ oṃ aiṃ 
eṃ ḹṃ ḷṃ ṝṃ ṛṃ ūṃ uṃ īṃ iṃ āṃ aṃ iti śatavāraṃ mūlamantraṃ 
japediti | triṣaṣṭyarṇamātṛkā tu bahvṛcaprātiśākhye triṣaṣṭiścatuḥṣaṣṭirvā 
varṇāḥ śambhumate matāḥ iti prāgevoktam (3 śvā0 64 pṛ0) | evaṃ 
triṣaṣṭyarṇamātṛkayā pratyakṣarabinduyuktayā prāgvat sveṣṭamantra 
sampūṭīkṛtya māsamātraṃ pratidinamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | saṅkalpo'pi 
prāgvadeva || aparaśca prakāraḥ kulārṇave :

māsamātraṃ japenmantraṃ bhūtalipyā puṭīkṛtam |
kramotkramāt sahasraṃ tu māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 1 ||

iti | ayamarthaḥ : tatra kramotkramabhūtalipyā puṭikṛtya 
mūlamantramaṣṭottarasahasraṃ māsamātraṃ pratidinaṃ japet | saṅkalpastu 
pūrvavadeva | bhūtalipayastu prāgevoktāḥ (3 śvā0 64 pṛ0) | aṣṭottaraśatamiti 
pāṭhe gurujaptamantraparaṃ jñeyam || prakārāntaraṃ tu vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām 
:

trikālaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairyo'rcayed devatāṃ niśi |
puraścaraṇakṛtyena vinaivāsau prasīdati || 1 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ : adyehetyādi0 amukamantrasiddhikāmo rātrau trikālapūjanaṃ 
kariṣye iti saṅkalpaṃ kṛtvā vatsaramātraṃ rātrau pratidinaṃ trikālaṃ 
sarvopacārairdevīṃ sāṅgāvaraṇāṃ pūjayet | evaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ trimāsaṃ vā 
māsamātraṃ vā pūjayet | puraścaraṇamantareṇāpi mantrasiddhirbhavati iti || 
anyaprakārastu kādimate :

yo mantrastasya (mantrasya) varṇauṣadhivinirmitāḥ |
tattadvarṇoktasaṃkhyābhirguṭikāḥ mantrasiddhidāḥ || 1 ||

tathābhiṣekastaddhāraṇaṃ tatkhādastadvilepanam |
tatpūjā ca tathā siddhidāyakāstu na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

p. 378)

iti | ayamarthaḥ : tatra mantravarṇauṣadhivinirmitamantravarṇasamasaṃkhyānāṃ 
guṭikānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tadbhakṣaṇaṃ vilepanaṃ tābhiḥ pūjāṃ 
tatkvāthajalaiḥ snānaṃ tadbhasmadhāraṇaṃ ca kuryāt | tena mantrasiddhirbhavati | 
varṇauṣadhayastu prapañcasāre : (3 pa0 53 ślo)

candanakucandanāgarukarpūrośīrarogajalaghusṛṇā |
kakkolajātimāṃsīmurācoragranthirocanāpatrāḥ || 1 ||

pippalabilva guhāruṇa tṛṇaka lavaṅgāhvakumbhivandinyaḥ |
soḍumbarakāśmarikāsthirābjadarapuṣpikāmayūraśikhāḥ || 2 ||

plakṣāgnimanthasiṃhīkuśāhvadarbhāśca kṛṣṇadarapuṣpī |
rohiṇaṭuṇṭukabṛhatī pāṭalacitrātulasyapāmārgāḥ || 3 ||

śatamūlilatādvirephā viṣṇukrāntā muṣalyathāñjalinī |
dūrvā śrīdevīsahe tathaiva lakṣmīsadābhadre || 4 ||

ādīnāmiti kathitā varṇānāṃ kramavaśādathauṣadhayaḥ |
guṭikākaṣāyabhasitaprabhedato nikhilasiddhidāyinyaḥ || 5 ||

iti | athaitāsāṃ nāmāni : yathā candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ agaru karpūra uśīra 
kuṣṭha vāla kuṃkuma jātīphala jaṭāmāṃsī murā cora granthi gorocanā patrā 
pippala bilva pṛśniparṇī citraka lavaṅga kattṛṇa kaṭphala vandi udumbara 
pāṣāṇabheda padma śaṃkhapuṣpī mayūraśikhā plakṣa agnimantha siṃhi kuśa 
kṛṣṇaśaṅkhapuṣpī rohiṇa syonāka bṛhatī pāṭala mūṣakaparṇī tulasī 
apamārga indravallī bhṛṅgarāja aparājitā tālamūlī kṛtāñjali dūrvā śrīdevī 
kumārī bhāraṅgī bhadramustāḥ ityekapañcāśadauṣadhayaḥ 
kramādakārādikṣakārāntaikapañcāśadvarṇānāmiti | aparaprakāraśca 
mantratantraprakāśe :

saṃskṛtaṃ pūjitaṃ mantraṃ dattvā śiṣyāya deśikaḥ |
kuryādatha tayoraikyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā || 1 ||

mantraṃ vidarbhayitvā tu nāmavarṇairyathākramam |
ādyante sakalaṃ nāma tataḥ praṇavamālikhet || 2 ||

svarāḥ patreṣu saṃlekhyā dhyāyet tānamṛtātmakān |
bhūrje rocanagandhādyaiḥ padmamadhye suśobhane || 3 ||

mṛdā pavitrayāveṣṭya tatpunaḥ sikthakena tu |
nikṣipenmadhure tattu mṛṇmaye laghubhājane || 4 ||

kṣīrapūrṇe nave kumbhe tat kṣipellaghubhājanam |
dhārayed deśikaḥ kumbhamagnikuṇḍasamīpataḥ || 5 ||

mantrasādhakayoraikyasiddhyarthaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ |
mūlamantreṇa mantrajñaḥ sahasraṃ śatameva vā || 6 ||

kumbhe saṃpātayeccaiva madhurāṇāṃ trayaṃ śubham |
homaṃ samāpya taṃ kumbhaṃ vinikṣipya jalāśaye || 7 ||

svaguruṃ brāhmaṇān svarṇaistoṣayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ |
etadyo na vijānāti nāsau sādhaka ucyate || 8 ||

rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ caitanna vadedyasya kasyacit |
uttamāya tu śiṣyāya putrāya ca vadedidam || 9 ||

iti | ayamarthaḥ : bhūrjapatre gorocanāgandhādibhiraṣṭadalapadmaṃ viracya 
tatkarṇikāyāṃ sādhakanāmavarṇavidarbhitaṃ mantramādyante sakalaṃ nāma 
praṇavaṃ ca vilikhya patreṣu dvandvaśaḥ krameṇa svarān vilikhya guṭikīkṛtya 
pavitramṛdā saṃveṣṭya tadapi sikthakena samveṣṭya madhuratrayapūrite 
svalpamṛtpātre nikṣipya kṣīrapūrṇe nūtanakumbhe sayantraguṭikamṛtpātraṃ 
nikṣipya prāguktavidhināgniṃ kuṇḍādau saṃskṛtya tatsamīpe tatkumbhaṃ 
saṃsthāpya oṃ adyetyādi0 amukamantrasiddhikāmo 
vidyāsādhakayoraikyatvasiddhyarthamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ śataṃ vā 
madhuratrayahomamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpya upāsyamantreṇa 
saṅkalpitasaṃkhyaṃ pratyāhuti kumbhe sampātaṃ sruvalagnaṃ hutaśeṣaṃ 
nikṣipan hutvā taṃ kumbhaṃ jalāśaye nikṣipya gurubrāhmaṇādīn 
svarṇādibhistoṣayediti | evaṃ kṛte'pi nasiddhyati tadā mantrasya drāvaṇādikaṃ 
kuryāt | taduktaṃ mahāhārakatantre :

drāvaṇaṃ bodhanaṃ vaśyaṃ pīḍanaṃ poṣaśoṣaṇe |
dāhanaṃ ca budhaḥ kuryāttataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 1 ||

drāvaṇaṃ vāruṇairbījairgrathanakramayogataḥ |
tanmantraṃ yantra ālikhya śilākarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ || 2 ||

p. 379)

uśīrarocanābhyāṃ ca mantraṃ saṃgrathitaṃ likhet |
kṣīrājyamadhutoyānāṃ madhye taṃ likhitaṃ kṣipet || 3 ||

pūjanājjapanāddhomād drāvitaḥ phalado bhavet |
drāvito'pi na siddhaścedvodhanaṃ tasya kārayet || 4 ||

sārasvatena bījena sampūṭīkṛtya taṃ japet |
evaṃ buddho bhavet siddho nocettasya vaśaṃ kuru || 5 ||

kucandanaṃ tathā dāru haridrā madanaṃ śilā |
etaistu likhito mantro bhūrjapatre suśobhane || 6 ||

madanaṃ kastūrī śilā manaḥśilā |


kaṇṭhe dhṛto bhavet siddho nocet kuryāttu pīḍanam |
adharottararūpeṇa padāni parijapya vai || 7 ||

dhyāyīta devatāṃ tadvadadharottararūpiṇīm |
vidyāmādityadugdhena likhitvākramya cāṅghriṇā || 8 ||

tathābhūtena mantreṇa homaḥ kāryo dine dine |
pīḍito lajjayāviṣṭaḥ siddhaścennahi poṣayet || 9 ||

bālātṛtīyabījena puṭitaṃ madhudugdhataḥ |
dhārayellikhitaṃ mantramathavā śoṣaṇaṃ caret || 10 ||

dvābhyāṃ ca vāyubījābhyāṃ likhenmantraṃ vidarbhitam |
bhasmanā dhārayet kaṇṭhe no ceddāhyo'gnibījataḥ || 11 ||

mantrārṇān vahnibījena caturdiśi samāvṛtān |
likhet pālāśatailena dhārayet kaṇṭhadeśataḥ || 12 ||

siddhḥ syānnātra sandeho mantra ityāha śaṅkaraḥ |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 13 ||

iti || athaiteṣāṃ prayogāḥ | tatrādau drāvaṇam  : vamiti varuṇabījena grathitaṃ 
mūlamantraṃ karpūrakuṃkumagorocanāmanaḥ śilośiraiḥ 
pūjācakrarūpayantramadhye vilikhya kasmiṃścitpātre 
dugdhamadhughṛtajalamekīkṛtya tatra yantraṃ nidhāya pūjājapahomān kuryāt iti 
||

atha bodhanam : tattu vāgbhavabījasampūṭitamantrajaparūpam ||

atha vaśīkaraṇam : tatra bhūrjapatre 
raktacandanadāruharidrākastūrīmanaḥśilābhirmūlamantramālikhya kaṇṭhe 
dhārayediti ||

atha pīḍanam : tatrādharottarabhāvena mantrapadāni prajapya 
devatāmapyadharottarabhāvena dhyātvā arkapatre arkadugdhena taṃ 
mantramālikhya tatpādenākramyādharottarakramapaṭhitamantreṇa homaṃ ca 
kuryāditi ||

atha poṣaṇam : tatra bālātṛtīyabījapuṭitaṃ mantraṃ godugdhamadhubhyāṃ 
bhūrjādau vilikhya dhārayet iti ||

atha ṣoṣaṇam : tatra yajñabhasmanā vāyubījavidarbhitaṃ mantraṃ vilikhya 
kaṇṭhe dhārayediti ||

atha dāhanam : pālāśabījatailena vahnibījasampūṭitaṃ 
mantrasyaikaikamakṣaraṃ vilikhya prativarṇamadhaścordhvaṃ ca 
vahnibījamālikhya kaṇṭhe dhārayediti | vidarbhalakṣaṇaṃ tu (śāradātilake 
mantrārṇadvandvamadhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ likhet | vidarbhaṃ eṣa 
vijñeyaḥ iti ) tantrāntare : ekāntaraṃ tu grathanaṃ vidarbho dvyantarīkṛtaḥ | iti ca 
|| ekavīrākalpe :

karmāṇyetāni kurvīta pratyekaṃ maṇḍalāvadhi |
japahomādikāṅgānāṃ saṃkhyā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 1 ||

evaṃ yadi na siddhaḥ syāttadā mantraṃ japet sudhiḥ |
aśvatthapatranavake mantraṃ yantraṃ ca mālikām || 2 ||

vidhānaṃ paddhatiṃ caiva saṃsthāpya samprapūjya ca |
jale nikṣipya dīkṣārthaṃ śīghraṃ gurumathāśrayet || 3 ||

iti | etāvatsarvaṃ mahāvidyāvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ mahāvidyānāṃ tu 
mokṣaikapradhānatvād bhogānāmanupādeyatvāt ārthasamāja (?) iti 
nyāyādbhavanti cedbhogāstadā bhavantu nāma nocetmā bhūvan 
mahāvidyānāṃ tyaktumayogyatvāt || atha prasaṅgataḥ siddhilakṣaṇaṃ 
tantrāntare :

manorathānāmakleśaḥ siddheruttamalakṣaṇam |
mṛtyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ tadvad devatādarśanaṃ tathā || 1 ||

prayogāṇāṃ tathākleśasiddhiḥ siddhestu lakṣaṇam |
parakāyapraveśaśca purapraveśanaṃ tathā || 2 ||

ūrdhvotkramaṇamevaṃ hi carācarapure gatiḥ |
khecarīmelanaṃ caiva tatkathāśravaṇādikam || 3 ||

bhūcchidrāṇi ca sampaśyet pātālādiṣu saṅgamaḥ |
ākarṣaṇaṃ surastrīṇāṃ nāgastrīṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 4 ||

pādukā guṭikāstadvadañjanaṃ vivaraṃ tathā |
aṇimādīṃśca samprāpya kevalaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt || 5 ||

ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahman pradhānaṃ siddhilakṣaṇam |
khyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanam || 6 ||

nṛpāṇāmaṅganānāṃ ca vaśīkaraṇamuttamam |
sarvatra sarvalokeṣu camatkārakaraḥ sukhī || 7 ||

p. 380)

rogāpaharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭyā viṣāpaharaṇaṃ tathā |
pāṇḍityaṃ ca kavitvaṃ ca caturvidhamayatnataḥ || 8 ||

vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ tyāgitā sarvavaśyatā |
aṣṭāṅgayogābhyasanaṃ bhogecchāparivarjanam || 9 ||

sarvabhūteṣvanukampā sarvajñādiguṇodayaḥ |
ityādiguṇasampattirmadhyasiddhestu lakṣaṇam || 10 ||

khyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanam |
nṛpāṇāmaṅganānāṃ ca vātsalyaṃ lokavaśyatā || 11 ||

mahaiśvaryyaṃ dhanitvaṃ ca putradārādisampadaḥ |
adhamāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā mantriṇaḥ prathamabhūmikāḥ || 12 ||

tīrthe mantropadeśaśca śraddhā ca japakarmaṇi |
phaliṣyatīti viśvāsastat satsiddhestu lakṣaṇam || 13 ||

nirvījā manavo ye ca teṣu bījāni yojayet |
kāmaṃ vā viṣa bījaṃ vā japatāṃ siddhido manuḥ || 14 ||

sthānasthā varadā mantrā dhyānasthāśca phalapradāḥ |
sthānadhyānavihīnānāṃ koṭijāpāt phalaṃ nahi || 15 ||

mātṛkāpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantraṃ japet sudhīḥ |
kramotkramācchatāvṛttyā tadante kevalaṃ manum || 16 ||

evaṃ tu pratyahaṃ japyāt yāvanmāsaṃ samāpyate |
niścitaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syādityuktaṃ tantravedibhiḥ || 17 ||

guruṃ santoṣayedbhaktyā bhūṣaṇacchādanādibhiḥ |
guroḥ santoṣamātreṇa mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam || 18 ||

gurumūlamidaṃ sarvamityāhustantravedinaḥ |
guruṃ vilaṅghya śāstre'smin nādhikāraḥ sureśvari || 19 ||

eteṣāṃ mantratantrāṇāṃ prayogaḥ kriyate yadi |
gurorājñāṃ vinā devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyate || 20 ||

śiva ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana |
yasya deve ca mantre ca gurau ca triṣu niścalā || 21 ||

na vyavacchidyate bhaktistasya siddhiradūrataḥ |
bhāvanārahitānāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ kṣudracetasām || 22 ||

caturguṇo japaḥ proktaḥ siddhaye nānyathā bhavet |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 23 ||

ityekavīrākalpavacanāt paśubhāvanāṃ (vanāvatāṃ) 
puraścaraṇacatuṣṭayānmantrasiddhiḥ | ata eva caturdhānuṣṭhito mantraḥ iti 
pūrvamuktam | kṣudrāṇāṃ paśūnāmityarthaḥ | bhāvanā divyavīrabhāvanā || 
atha divyapuraścaraṇaṃ tantrāntare

yadi vipraḥ kulaśreṣṭhaḥ kuladravyaparāyaṇaḥ |
tadānena vidhānena kartavyaṃ kulasādhānam || 1 ||

madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca mudrāṃ maithunameva ca |
anyonyaṃ nityatā jñeyā kuladevyāḥ prapūjane || 2 ||

iti | kulaśreṣṭho divyo vā vīro vā anena vidhānena vakṣyamāṇena vidhānena 
viprāṇāṃ pāśavamevānukalpādividhānamiti viprapradena nirastam | kulārṇave 
kulakramamupakramya :

brāhmaṇaistu sadā kāryaṃ kṣatriyaistu raṇāgame |
vaiśyairdhanaprayoge ca śūdraistu na kadācana || 1 ||

iti | anukalpastu viprāṇām ityādivacanāni paśuvipraparāṇi bāhulyena viprāḥ 
paśava eva bhavantīti | kulacūḍāmaṇau :

puraścaraṇakāle ca kulaśaktiṃ prapūjayet |
dīkṣitāṃ gandhapuṣpādyairbhakṣyaiḥ pāyasasambhavaiḥ || 1 ||

ārambhakāle vanitāṃ svayaṃ bhakṣyānnatemanaiḥ |
śūnye gehe samānīya cārghyādikaṃ viśodhayet || 2 ||

amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktiṃ cābhimukhiṃ nayet |
āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dadyāt svāgata ca vadet punaḥ || 3 ||

pādyamarghya ca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ tathā |
snāpayed gandhapuṣpādbhiḥ keśasaṃskāramārabhet || 4 ||

dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayet |
tataḥ sthānāntare pīṭhamāstīrya pādukāyugam || 5 ||

dattvā tatra samāsīnāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣayitvānulepaṃ ca gandhaṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet || 6 ||

dadyānmaṇḍalamadhye tu svarṇapātre suśobhane |
carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca pañcabhakṣakam || 7 ||

nānāvidhaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitam |
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaram || 8 ||

upalākhṇḍapūrṇaṃ ca nānāvidharasāyanam |
nārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanam || 9 ||

limpākaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dāḍimīphalamuttamam |
nānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanam || 10 ||

candanaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ navapallavam |
ṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathā || 11 ||

p. 381)

nānāśailasamudbhūtaṃ nānālaṅkārabūṣaṇam |
ādāvante ca madhye ca japapūjāviśeṣataḥ || 12 ||

na pūjayati cet kāntāṃ tadā vighnairvilipyate |
pūrvārjite phalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmani || 13 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yadīcchedātmano hitam |
mamāpi krodhasantāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanam || 14 ||

yatnataḥ pūjanīyāṃ syuḥ kulā kulajanāṅganāḥ |
* * * *  * * * * * * * *  * * * * || 15 ||

iti | ādimadhyāvasānavidhistvalābhe'vadheyaḥ atyantālābhe'pi 
ādyantayorāvaśyakavidhiḥ ārambhakāle ceti japapūrtau viśeṣata iti cokteḥ ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya 
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya- 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayati viracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
ṣoḍaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 16 ||

 
 
atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre


|| saptadaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha rahasyapuraścaraṇam | taduktaṃ svatantratantre -

atha vānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtam || 1 ||

pañcagavyena militaṃ candanādyairviśeṣataḥ |
nikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vane || 2 ||

tatra taddivase rātrau sahasraṃ yadi mānataḥ |
ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ || 3 ||

iti |

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
śavamānīya taddvāri tenaiva parikhanya ca || 4 ||

taddināt taddinaṃ yāvat tāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
sa bhavet sarvasiddhiśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 ||

iti |

atha vānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 6 ||

sūryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvat sūryodayāntaram |
tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 7 ||

iti | muṇḍamālātantre -

atha vānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
śaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

bhaktitaḥ pūjayitvā tu rātrau tāvatsahasrakam |
japedeko'pi vijane kevalaṃ timirālaye || 2 ||

aṣṭamyādinavamyantamupavāsaparo bhavet |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet || 3 ||

sahasrasaṃkhye japte tu puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
kṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīṃ prāpya navamyantaṃ mahotsave || 4 ||

aṣṭamīnavamīrātrau pūjāṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ |
daśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryānmatsyamāṃsādibhiryutam || 5 ||

ṣaṭsahasraṃ japenmantraṃ nityaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
caturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśī || 6 ||

tāvajjapte maheśāni puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
kevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhāḥ bhavanti hi || 7 ||

iti | svatantratantre -

rātrau māṃsaṃ rasaṃ devīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno gacchet kledayuto'pi ca || 1 ||

japellakṣaṃ tato devīṃ homayejjvalite'nale |
yonikuṇḍe sthiraḥ sarpirmāṃsamatsyāyutaṃ tathā || 2 ||

daśāṃśaṃ tarpayenmatsyairmāṃsamiśraistu sādhakaḥ |
tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena cābhiṣicya jaganmayīm || 3 ||

daśāṃśaṃ bhojayet svādu sādhakaṃ devatāpriyam |
ādyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca carvaṇaṃ ca nivedayet || 4 ||

tatastu toṣayedbhaktyā guruṃ svarṇādibhiḥ priye |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 5 ||

iti | divyamatasya śreṣṭhatvāllakṣa eva japaḥ sahasramātrameva 
prātyahikamata eva japellakṣamiti pūrvadarśitavacanaikavākyatvāt | 
homādau ca prathamādipadārthasya prādhānyam | kuṇḍasya 
yonirūpatāyāṃ niyamaḥ || kulasambhave -

rātro nagno muktakeśo maithune cāpi tattvataḥ |
prajaptavyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 1 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

tāvatkālaṃ japenmantraṃ yāvacchukraṃ na muñcati |
mukte śukre ca deveśi punarmantraṃ japet sudhīḥ || 1 ||

p. 383)

rātrau tambūlapūrṇāsyaḥ śayyāyāṃ lakṣamānataḥ |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

iti ca | śavāsanādhikaphalaṃ liṅgagehapraveśanam iti ca | 
yonyabhimantraṇādivat dūtīyāgavat atra ca sādhanātiriktasamaye 
nagnastrīdarśanaṃ niṣiddhamiti pūrvoktam | yadi bhāgyavaśāddevi 
kuladṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate | tadaiva mānasīṃ pūjāṃ svayaṃ tāsāṃ 
prakalpayet || iti kutracidabhihitaṃ vihitamapi | evaṃ virodhe 
vyavasthābalātkāreṇa viḍambanā na kartavyā iti niṣedhaḥ | 
bhāvapūrvakastu vidhiḥ || tathā ca tantrāntare -

tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāṃ ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathā |
sarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā sidhirodhakṛt || 1 ||

striyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striya eva hi jīvitam |
strīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamabhāve svastriyāmapi || 2 ||

taddhastāpacitaṃ puṣpaṃ taddhastāpacitaṃ jalam |
taddhastāpacitaṃ bhojyaṃ devatābhyo nivedayet || 3 ||

iti | divyo vāpyatha vīro vā rātrau lakṣaṃ japaṃ caret ityukterdivyavīrayoḥ 
samānameva vidhānam | divye kularūpasādhanamāvaśyakaṃ 
gāndharveṇa krameṇaiva pañcamī bhuvi durlabhā iti vacanāt 
śrīvidyāviṣaye divya eva kramaḥ anyatrobhayostulyatvāt || atha 
vīrapuraścaraṇaṃ kularūpaṃ bhāvacūḍāmaṇau -

vīrasādhanakāryaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vīrapūruṣaiḥ |
divyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirnaca pāmaraiḥ || 1 ||

vīraṃ divyaṃ ca yatkarma tat paśorneti niścitam |
* * * *  * * * *  * * * *  * * * * || 2 ||

iti | atra divyairapītyanena divyānuṣṭheyatā ca pratipādyate | evaṃ sati divye 
vīrakarma guptaṃ vīre divyakarma guptaṃ tadapi kādācitkam | 
divyavīraveṣau tu prakaṭau vastutastu sarvameva guptaṃ gopanīyaṃ 
prayatnena svayoniriva pārvati | prakāśanāt siddhihānirnātra kāryā 
vicāraṇā || ityāditantrāntaravacanāt | gopayenmātṛjāravat iti cokteḥ 
vīrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇādau parakīyanārīṃ dīkṣitāṃ yathāśakti 
pūjayet | taduktaṃ kulacūḍāmaṇau |

puraścaraṇakāle tu parayoṣāṃ prapūjayet |
dīkṣitāṃ vastrabhūṣādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasaṃbhavaiḥ || 1 ||

ārambhakāle niyataṃ svayaṃ pakvānnatemanam |
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaram || 2 ||

upalākhaṇḍamārdraṃ ca nānāvidharasāyanam |
nārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanam || 3 ||

limpākaṃ bījapūraṃ ca dāḍimīphalamuttamam |
nānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanam || 4 ||

candanaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ navapallavam |
ṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathā || 5 ||

nānāśailasamudbhūtaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam |
śūnye gehe samānīya cārghyodakaviśodhitam || 6 ||

amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktiṃ cābhimukhīṃ nayet |
brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇā || 7 ||

veśyā nāpitakanyā ca rajakī naṭakī tathā |
viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ || 8 ||

iti | dīkṣitā aṣṭau śaktīḥ krameṇa saṃsthāpyārghyapātraṃ 
sthāpayitvā'rghyodakena tāḥ prokṣya vamiti 
dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtyāṣṭaśaktirūpabhedaṃ kṛtvā 
brāhmyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasaṃjñakāḥ |

āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā svāgataṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ tataḥ || 9 ||

snāpayedgandhapuṣpādi keśasaṃskārameva ca |
dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayet || 10 ||

tataḥ sthānāntare pīṭhamāstīrya pādukādvayam |
dattvā tatra samānīya nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 11 ||

dhūpayitvānulepena gandhaṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet |
tāṃ tāṃ śakti samāvāhya mūrdhniṃ tāsāṃ samānayet || 12 ||

tatastāṃ śaktiṃ yathākrameṇa brahmāṇyādirūpāṃ samāvāhya 
jīvanyāsādikaṃ kuryāt | yathā 
pūrvoktaprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇā'muṣyasthāne brahmāṇyāḥ prāṇā 
iha prāṇā ityādikrameṇa prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | evaṃ 
māheśvaryā ityādikamūhanīyam | tato 
gandhapuṣpadīpānnavyañjanādikaṃ dattvā tāsāṃ savyakarṇe krameṇa 
stotraṃ paṭhet | taduktaṃ tatraiva -

bhojyaṃ maṇḍalamadhye tu svarṇapātre suśobhane |
carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ nivedayet || 13 ||

adīkṣitā bhavedyā tu tadā māyāṃ nivedayet |
tāsāṃ savyeṣu karṇeṣu tatastotraṃ samācaret || 14 ||

p. 384) 

mātardevi namaste'stu brahmarūpadhare'naghe |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 15 ||

māheśi varade devi paramānandarūpiṇi |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 16 ||

kaumāri sarvavidyeśe kumārakriḍane pare |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 17 ||

viṣṇurūpadhare devi vinatāsutavāhini |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 18 ||

vārāhi varade devi daṃṣṭroddhṛtavasundhare |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 19 ||

śakrarūpadhare devi śakrādisurapūjite |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 20 ||

cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālāsṛkcarcite vighnanāśini |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 21 ||

mahālakṣmi mahotsāhe kṣobhasantāpanāśini |
kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me || 22 ||

mitimātṛmaye devi mitimātṛvahiṣkṛte |
eke bahuvidhe devi viśvarūpe namo'stu te || 23 ||

etat stotraṃ paṭhedyastu karmārambheṣu saṃyataḥ |
vidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate || 24 ||

kulīnasya dvāradevāḥ kathitāstava putraka |
dīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nārcayedyadi || 25 ||

tasya pūjāphalaṃ vatsa nīyate yakṣarākṣasaiḥ |
yadi vrīḍāparā sā tu bhojane tadgṛhādvahiḥ || 26 ||

sthitaḥ paṭhet smaret stotraṃ yāvat tṛptiḥ prajāyate |
ācamya mukhavāsādi tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet || 27 ||

tato dadyāt punarmālyaṃ gandhaṃ candanapaṅkilam |
visṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavet || 28 ||

anyā yadi na gacchettu nijakanyāṃ nijānujām |
agrajāṃ mātulānīṃ vā mātaraṃ tatsapatnikām || 29 ||

pūrvābhāve parā pūjyā madaṃśā yoṣito mataḥ |
sarvābhāve hyekatarā pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ || 30 ||

ekaścet kulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra bhairava |
sarva eva surāḥ pūjyāḥ satyaṃ brahmaśivādayaḥ || 31 ||

ekā cedyuvatī tatra pūjitā cāvalokitā |
sarvā eva parādevyaḥ pūjitāḥ kulabhairava || 32 ||

iti | vīratantre

yaḥ kaścit kurute vīrasādhanaṃ susamāhitaḥ |
prāpnoti paramāṃ siddhiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ vīrasādhanam |
nirbhayeṇeva śucinā bhūtvā sarvārthasiddhidam || 2 ||

nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidvidyate śīghrasiddhidam |
bhairaveṇa purā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 3 ||

ghaṭī bandhena vastraṃ vai mūlena paridhāpya ca |
tadbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlenāṅgavilepanam || 4 ||

dhṛtoṣṇīṣaśca mūlena sindūreṇaurghvapuṇḍrakam |
iṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā yātrā praharamadhyataḥ || 5 ||

kāryā ca sādhakaiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛdi mantraṃ parāmṛśan |
akṣubdho bhuktabhojyastu bhuktvā sādhanamācaret || 6 ||

aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi |
bhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ sādhayet siddhimuttamām || 7 ||

upacāraṃ samādāya kulāmṛtarasādikam |
niśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥ || 8 ||

digvāsā vimalo bhasmabhūṣito muktakeśakaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 9 ||

iti | digvastratvaṃ ca kutracidvihitam | anyatra ca -

bhūmiputrasamāyuktā sāmāvāsyā śubhodayā |
bhadre puṣkarasaṃyoge tasyāṃ vīravarottamaḥ || 1 ||

iti | rudrayāmale -

satyakrame caturvarṇaiḥ kṣīrājyamadhupiṣṭakaiḥ |
tretāyāṃ pūjayed devīṃ ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥ || 1 ||

madhubhiḥ sarvavarṇaiśca pūjayed dvāpare yuge |
pūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiśca taiḥ || 2 ||

iti | yugāntareṣvanukalpavidhiḥ sarvavarṇasādhāraṇaḥ kalau 
pradhānakalpo'pi tādṛśa eva |

guḍārdrakarasenaiva surā na brāhmaṇasya ca |
gauḍī tu yā kṣatriyeṇa mādhvī vaiśyena tatra vai || 3 ||

kadalīmadhusaṃmiśraśālitvakkevalaiḥ surā |
sarvā śūdrasya saṃproktā yatra vā taddhavirbhavet || 4 ||

iti | kutracit | pūrvavadevāsya vyākhyānaṃ vastuto'nukalpaḥ 
pradhānālābhe sambhavati natu yugavarṇaparatayā gauḍīmādhvīti

p. 385)

viśeṣaḥ kāmanāparatvena | athavā surā neti bhavatītyādhyāhārastena 
surā na bhavati cedityarthaḥ | gauḍīmādhvītyatra guḍamadhuceti aṇ 
pratyayaḥ | śūdrāṇāmapi pradhānālābhe kadalyādīnyeva surā 
surānukalpaḥ | yadvā tatreti padaṃ citāyāmityarthaṃ bodhayati 
vīrasādhanaprakaraṇatvāt | yatra citāgamanaśavasparśādikamanavadyaṃ 
tatra pradhānamanavadyamiti kānupapatīḥ | tat tadā śiraścālane 
pradhānānukalpobhayavidhānāt | guḍārdrakaraseneti kadalītyādi ca 
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre dadyāttathā madhu | dadhi dugdhaṃ tathā 
tāmre guḍamiśraṃ tathā dadhi || guḍārdrakamatho vāpi pūjanārthaṃ 
prakalpayet | iti tattadapi tādṛśapātrādisaṃyogena pradhānatulyatai(tayai)va 
bhavatīti niṣedhāt tādavasthyameva | tasmāt 
pradhānalābhe'pyanukalpaparāṇyetāni vacanāni | anyacca 
kulāgamakrameṇaiva pūjayet parameśvarīm iti sakalatantrasvarasāt | 
kulāgamaśca kulārṇavaḥ | yathā (pa0 5) -

śaive vaiśaṇave śākte saure sugatadarśane |
bauddhe pāśupate sāṃkhye māntre kālāmukhe tathā || 1 ||

dakṣiṇe vāmasiddhānte vaidikādiṣu pārvati |
vinālipiśatābhyāṃ ca pūjanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

kuladravyairvinā kuryāj japaṃ pūjāṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ |
niṣphalaṃ tadbhaved devi bhasmamanyeva yathā hutam || 3 ||

yathā kratuṣu viprāṇāṃ somapānamadūṣitam |
alipānaṃ tathā devi somavadbhogamokṣadam || 4 ||

ityādi sahasraśo vacanairjyotiṣṭomādiyāgeṣu vihitavat atrāpi 
smṛtyanumitavedavihitatvāt nādharmasādhanaṃ niṣiddhe tu jāyata 
evādharmaḥ | śrīdharmācāryakṛte laghustave viprāḥ kṣoṇibhujo 
viśastaditare kṣīrājyamadhvāsavairiti | jñānārṇaveḥ 
varṇānukramabhedena varṇabhedā bhavanti vai | api ca draveṇa sātvikeneva 
brāhmaṇaḥ pūjayecchivām | iti | tathā -

evaṃ dadyāt kṣatriyo'pi paiṣṭikīṃ na kadācana |
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre dadyāttathā madhu || 5 ||

rājanyavaiśyayordānaṃ na dvijasya kadācana | 
evaṃ pradānamātreṇa hīnāyurbrāhmaṇo bhavet || 6 ||

iti | bhairavītantre -

yatrāvaśyaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ madirādānapūjanam |
brāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu madhu madyaṃ prakalpayet || 1 ||

brāhmaṇo madirāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate |
svagātrarudhiraṃ dattvā svātmahatyāmavāpnuyāt || 2 ||

iti nānāśāstravicāreṇa viprāṇāmanukalpaprakāreṇa pūjanam | 
sāttvikenaiva bhāvena brāhmaṇastarpayecchivām | iti | 
śrīkramasaṃhitāyāmapi -

āvābhyāṃ piśitaṃ raktaṃ surāṃ vāpi sureśvari |
varṇāśramocitaṃ dharmamavicāryāparyanti ye || 1 ||

bhūtapretapiśācāste bhavanti brahmarākṣasāḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | vastutastu guḍārdrakarasenaiva surā na brāhmaṇasya ca | iti vacanāt 
vāmāgame'pi vipre nādhikāraḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ nityaṃ madyaṃ 
brāhmaṇo varjayet iti nityapadaṃ kāmato yatra kutracitprāptivacanam tathā 
akāmato'pi nityaṃ niṣedhavacanaṃ tannirṇayaniścitārthaṃ 
vedenaivoktatvāt | brāhmaṇasya vāmāgame'pi niṣedha eva bodhyam | 
tathā vacanenākārādināpyartho bodhyate | brāhmaṇasya sadā'peyā
