kṣatriyasya raṇāgame | vaiśyasya dhanasaṃyoge śūdrasya na kadācana || iti 
| mahākālasaṃhitāyām kṣīreṇa brāhmaṇaistarpyā ghṛtena 
nṛpavaṃśajaiḥ mākṣikairvaiśyavarṇaistu sāsavaiḥ śūdrajātibhiḥ iti | 
sārāsāravicārastvapekṣita eva | tatra vidhistu -

niḥśaṅko nirbhayo vīro nirlajjo niṣkutūhalaḥ |
nirṇītavedaśāstrārtho varadāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibet || 1 ||

tatkarma kurvatāṃ puṃsāṃ karmalopo bhavedyadi |
tat kathaṃ tat prakurvanti saptakoṭimunīśvarāḥ || 2 ||

iti | niṣiddhe nindā ca -

āvṛttiṃ gurupaṃktiṃ ca vaṭukādīnaprapūjya ca |
vīro'pyatra vṛthāpānād devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 1 ||

p. 386)

ayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā mantratarpaṇam |
paśupānavidhau pītvā vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajet || 2 ||

ajñātvā kaulikācāramayaṣṭvā gurupādukām |
yo'smin śāstre pravarteta taṃ tvaṃ pīḍayase dhruvam || 3 ||

kaulajñāne tvaprasiddho yo dravyaṃ bhoktumicchati |
sa mahāpātakī devi sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 4 ||

samayācārahīnasya svairavṛtairdurātmanaḥ |
na siddhayaḥ kulabhraṃśastat sarva narakāya ca || 5 ||

yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmacārataḥ |
sa siddhimiha nāpnoti paratra ca parāṃ gatim || 6 ||

svecchayā vartamāno yo dīkṣāsaṃskāravarjitaḥ |
na tasya sadgatiḥ kvāpi tapastīrthavratādiṣu || 7 ||

asaṃskṛtaṃ pivan madyaṃ balātkāreṇa maithunam |
svaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 8 ||

ityādivacanāni śataśo vidhiniṣedhaparāṇi | pratiprasavastu 
kvacidyadṛcchayā prāptamalidravyaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ | gṛhītvā 
mūlamantreṇa guruṃ smṛtvā ca pādukām || tattvatrayeṇa saṃyuktaṃ 
gṛhṇīyānmūlamuccaran | ityapi saṃskṛtapūjāviśeṣadravyaparam | 
phalaśrutirapi -

sarvasiddhikarī paiṣṭī gauḍī bhogapradāyinī |
mādhvī muktikarī jñeyā surākhyā trividhā priye || 9 ||

vidyāpradaikṣavī proktā drākṣā rājyapradāyinī |
tālajā stambhane śastā khārjūrī ripunāśinī || 10 ||

nārikelabhavā śrīdā pānasākhyā śubhapradā |
mādhūkākhyā jñānakarī dāridryaripuhāriṇī || 11 ||

maireyākhyā kuleśāni sarvapāpapraṇāśinī |
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ madyaṃ valkalasambhavam || 12 ||

yasyānandaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ sāmodaṃ ca manoharam |
dravyaṃ taduttamaṃ devi devatāprītikārakam || 13 ||

surāsaṃdarśanādeva tīrthakoṭiphalaṃ labhet |
tadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa śatakratuphalaṃ labhet || 14 ||

devi tatpānataḥ sākṣāllabhenmuktiṃ caturvidhām |
māṃsasaṃdarśanādau tu surādarśanavat phalam || 15 ||

iti | tasmāt kulārṇavoktavacanānyevādaraṇīyānīti saṅgataṃ 
pratibhātītyalaṃ jalpitena | nīlatantre (pa0 11) -


devyuvāca


māhānīlakramaṃ deva sūcitaṃ na prakāśitam |
kathayasya mahādeva sarvasiddhipradaṃ mahat || 1 ||


bhairava uvāca


śṛṇu devi varārohe vīrasādhanamuttamam |
sarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt sarvadevanamaskṛtam || 2 ||

sarvapāpaharaṃ devi sarvarogavināśanam |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dikpālānāṃ ca bhāmini || 3 ||

bhairavāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca yoginām |
svataḥ siddhipradaṃ devi sarveṣāmālayaṃ mahat || 4 ||

nānyat siddhipradaṃ devi vīrasādhanavarjitam |
mahābalo mahābuddhirmahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ || 5 ||

mahāsvaccho dayāvāṃśca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
teṣāṃ kṛte mahādevi kathitaṃ nīlasādhanam || 6 ||

(aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi |
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa yathāvidhi ca sādhayet || 7 ||

bhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ yāme yāte ca bāmini |
tadardhābhyantare samyak pūjopakaraṇaṃ balim) || 8 ||

sāmiṣānnaṃ guḍaṃ chāgaṃ surāṃ piṣṭakameva ca |
nānāphalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhanam || 9 ||

citāsthānaṃ samānīya suhṛdbhiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ |
samānaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam || 10 ||

na vīkṣeta caturdikṣu devatādhyānatatparaḥ |
bhītaścet sādhakastatra caturdikṣu ca sādhakāḥ || 11 ||

no cet svayaṃ kevalo'sau bhairavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
prakṣālitāṃ citābhūmiṃ gatvā sādhakasattamaḥ || 12 ||

pra(a)kṣālitā yadi prāyaḥ kārayedasthisañcayam |
astrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu || 13 ||

gurupādarajo dhyātvā gaṇeṣaṃ vaṭukaṃ tathā |
yoginīrmātṛkāścaiva vāmapādapuraḥsaram || 14 ||

ye cātra saṃsthitā devā rākṣasāśca bhayānakāḥ |
piśācā yakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 15 ||

yoginyo mātaro bhūtāḥ sarvāśca khecarastriyaḥ |
siddhidāstā bhavantvadya tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥ || 16 ||

p. 387)

praṇamya manunānena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet |
śmaśānādhipatiṃ paścādbhairavaṃ kālabhairavam || 17 ||

mahākālaṃ yajedyatnāt pūrvādidikcatuṣṭaye |
pādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayet || 18 ||

śavabījaṃ punaḥ paścāt śmaśānādhipate param |
imamante sāmiṣānnaṃ bali gṛhna tataḥ param || 19 ||

gṛhṇagṛhṇāpayayugaṃ vighnanivāraṇaṃ tataḥ |
kuru siddhiṃ me tato'nte prayaccha svāhayānvitam || 20 ||

tārādimanunā devi prathamo balirīritaḥ |
māyānte bhairavaṃ paścādbhayānaka tataḥ param || 21 ||

pūrvanmantrāmuddhṛtya dakṣiṇe balimāharet |
hūmante ca mahākālāt paścāt pūrvavaduddharet || 22 ||

paścime kāladevāya praṇavādyena kalpayet |
śabdā (vā)nte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti padaṃ tataḥ || 23 ||

śmaśānādhipa ityevaṃ pūrvavaccottare haret |
citāmadhye tato dadyād balitrayamanuttamam || 24 ||

kālarātri mahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvane |
gṛhāṇemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi siddhimanuttamām || 25 ||

lālikāyai baliṃ dattvā bhūtanāthāya dāpayet |
śabdā(vā)nte bhūtanāthānte śmaśānādhipa ityapi || 26 ||

praṇavādyena mantreṇa dāpayedbalimuttamam |
hūṃ sarvagaṇanāthānte dhipa caiva tathā punaḥ || 27 ||

śmaśānamastake dattvā pūrvavacca samuccaret |
tārādyena baliṃ dattvā pañcagavyena sundari || 28 ||

asthisamprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhamantraṃ nyaset tataḥ |
bhūrje vā vaṭapatre vā tatra pīṭhamanuṃ nyaset || 29 ||

pīṭhamāstīrya tasmin vai baddhavīrāsanastadā |
vīrārcanena deveśi loṣṭān dikṣu parikṣipet || 30 ||

kūrcabījadvayaṃ devi māyāyugmaṃ tataḥ param |
kālike ghoradaṃṣṭre ca pracaṇḍe caṇḍanāyike || 31 ||

dānavān dārayetyuktvā haneti dvitayaṃ tataḥ |
parabījaṃ (vīraṃ) mahāvighnaṃ chedayeti yugaṃ tataḥ || 32 ||

dviṭhānto varmaśastrānto vīrārcanamanurmataḥ |
anena mantritāṃlloṣṭān daśadikṣu vinikṣipet || 33 ||

tanmadhye bhairavo devo na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate |
yadi pramādāddeveśi sādhako bhayavihvalaḥ || 34 ||

tadā taistaiḥ suhṛdvargai rakṣito nābhibhūyate |
arkendusitavāṭyālatūlanirmitavartikam || 35 ||

pradīpaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya yantraṃ tatra prapūjayet |
hate tasmin mahādīpe vighnaiśca paribhūyate || 36 ||

tadadhaścāstramantreṇa nikhanet kūladīpakam |
tattatkalpavidhānena bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ caret || 37 ||

(mātṛkākṣarasaṃyuktāṃ vidyāṃ ṣoḍhāṃ nyasetpunaḥ |
kramādvyutkramayogena tārāṣāḍhā prakīrtitā || 38 ||

ṣoḍhāvinyastadehastu sākṣādviśveśvaro bhavet) |
ṣoḍhā vā tārakaṃ vāpi vinyasya prajapettataḥ || 39 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

japānte japamadhye ca dehi dehīti bhāṣate |
baliṃ dadyāt tadā devi no cedante bhavedbaliḥ || 1 ||

balistu chāgādiḥ | sāmiṣānnādi tu balipātrāṇāmarthe | 
citāpaścimabhāge ca upaviśya japaṃ caret iti ca kvāpi | gururvāpi 
satīrthyo vā śiṣyo vā sādhako'pi vā | sthāpyo dakṣiṇadigbhāge 
bhaveccottarasādhakaḥ | kāṇḍaprakṣepabhūbhāge kiṃciddūre 
vicakṣaṇaḥ iti ca | rudrayāmale -

tataḥ pañcopacāreṇa purato devatāṃ yajet |
nimīlya cakṣuṣī paścāddevīṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japet || 1 ||

ekākṣarīṃ diksahasraṃ tryakṣarīmayutaṃ japet |
tataḥ paraṃ tu mantrajño gajāntakasahasrakam || 2 ||

niśāyāṃ vā samārabhya udayāntaṃ samācaret |
yadyasahyaṃ bhayaṃ karṇe netre vastreṇa bandhayet || 3 ||

tato'rdharātraparyantaṃ yadi kiñcinna lakṣayet |
jayadūrgākhyamanunā cārghyaṃ tenaiva sarṣapān || 4 ||

tilo'si somadevatyo gosavastṛptikārakaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ martyānāmabhayakṣamaḥ || 5 ||

bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ vighneṣu śāntikārakaḥ |
iti kṣiptvā tilān devi caturbhāge śivāditaḥ || 6 ||

punaḥ saptapadaṃ gatvā punastatraiva saṃviśet |
devaṃ tatrāpi sampūjya prajapenmanumuttamam || 7 ||

nirbhayaḥ prajapet tāvadyāvat siddhiḥ prajāyate |
bhayeti (yādi) svapnavajjñeyaṃ pare'hni śeṣāmācaret || 8 ||

p. 388)

iti | śeṣaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanādikam | tilakī pūrvadravyeṇa utthāya ca 
manuṃ japet iti bhayanivāraṇaṃ rakṣātilakaṃ ca kutracit |

kuṃkumāgarukastūrī rocanā raktacandanam |
karpūraṃ padmarāgaṃ ca kesaraṃ haricandanam || 9 ||

pratyekaṃ sādhitaṃ kṛtvā ekatra sādhayedbudhaḥ |
jihvāgrarudhiraṃ vīraḥ śmaśāne ca samāhitaḥ || 10 ||

tenaiva guṭikāṃ kṛtvā bhadrakālīmanuṃ japet |
nīlāṃ nīlapatākāṃ ca lalajjihvāṃ karālikām || 11 ||

lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam |
viyadastrānvitaṃ devi vāmākṣicandrabhūṣitam || 12 ||

bījaṃ pratyekavastūnāṃ śṛṇu tāsāṃ ca pārvati |
mūlamantraṃ tu mantrajño japet sārdhaṃ śatatrayam || 13 ||

jihvāgrarudhiraṃ gṛhṇa cāmuṇḍe ghoraniḥsvane |
baliṃ bhuktvā varaṃ dehi rudhiraṃ gahane vane || 14 ||

kāli kāli pracaṇḍogre tato'straṃ kavacaṃ punaḥ |
kāliketi samākhyātā jīvānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 15 ||

kūrcayugmaṃ mahādevi nīlāyāḥ kathitaṃ tava |
viyadagniyutaṃ devi balamindrasamāyutam || 16 ||

candrakhaṇḍasamāyuktaṃ tato nīlapadaṃ punaḥ |
tataḥ patāke hūṃphaṭ syāt pūrvakūṭamanurmataḥ || 17 ||

jayaśrīdharaṇī devī patāke varaṇaskhale |
iti nīlapatākeyaṃ yojyā vā nīlasādhane || 18 ||

yā sā vidyā mahātārā sā kālīti prakīrtitā |
padmarāgaṃ kesaraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 19 ||

iti | viyat hakāraḥ | astrānvitaṃ rephānvitaṃ | vāmākṣi īkāraḥ | 
candro'nusvāraḥ | tena hrīṃ iti bījaṃ astraṃ kavacamiti krameṇa 
tātparyam | kiṃtvastraṃ kavacamiti kramastena huṃphaṭ kūrcayugmaṃ 
hūṃhūṃ bala svarūpaṃ indra īkāraḥ tena harabalīṃ iti kūṭam | jayo 
nakāraḥ śrīḥ īkāraḥ dharaṇī lakārastena nīla iti | varaṇaṃ kavacaṃ tena 
huṃ skhalaṃ astraṃ tena phaṭ | añjanāñcitalocanaḥ iti ca kvāpi | anyacca -

svayaṃ vai tatra bhagavān bhairavo laguḍāṅkitaḥ |
bhramatītastato vīrastaṃ vilokya japenmanum || 1 ||

yadi bhāgyavaśād devi laguḍastatra labhyate |
tadā svayaṃ bhairavo'sau svayaṃ viśvambharo bhavet || 2 ||

tatra natvā mahādevaṃ mahākālaṃ ca bhāmini |
tadbhasmatilakaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavet || 3 ||

iti | tadbhasma śmaśānabhasma tilakaṃ vibhūtidhāraṇamityarthaḥ || 
prayogastu tatra prathamaṃ vihitabhaumāmāvāsyādiparva saṃlakṣya 
rātrau praharārdhe gate abhukto bhuktabhojyo vā mūlamantreṇa 
ghaṭībandhena vastra paridhāya upari 
sarvācchādakavastrāntareṇācchādya dhṛtoṣṇīṣo muktakeśo digambaro 
vā mūlena pūrvasādhitatilakaṃ kṛtvā añjanāñcitanetro 
raktacandanādināṅga vilipya mūlenaiva sindūreṇordhvapuṇḍraṃ kṛtvā 
hṛdi devīṃ mūrdhni guruṃ dhyātvā natvā 
kulāmṛtarasasāmiṣānnapiṣṭakamatsyavaṭukādipūjābalipātrasāmagrīṃ 
yathālābhaṃ samādāya valyarthaṃ chāgādi 
gandhapuṣpākṣatapañcagavyaṃ pañcāmṛtāni ca gḥītvā 
khaḍgapāṇibhiḥ suhṛdbhiḥ rakṣakaiḥ kṛtarakṣo'ghorāstrādinā 
vaddhaśikho mūlavidyāṃ hṛdi smaran aprakṣālitāṃ sadyañcitāṃ 
prakṣālitāṃ prācīnacitāṃ vā gacchet | prakṣālanapakṣe 
tvasthisañcayaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ kāṇḍaprakṣepamātrabhūmyantarā 
caturdikṣvavekṣakān suhṛda uttarasādhakān khaḍgapāṇīna 
kiñciddūrataḥ ekaśceddakṣiṇatastamuttarasādhakaṃ kāṇḍāntarā 
dhṛtvā paścimataḥ svayaṃ sāmānyayārghyaṃ datvā 
mūlamantrānte'stramantreṇa pañcagavyena yāgabhūmiṃ samprokṣya 
gurugaṇeśavaṭukayoginīrbrāhmayādyaṣṭamātṛkāṃśca namaskṛtya 
vāmapādamagre kṛtvā oṃ ye cātra saṃsthitā devā rākṣasāśca 
bhayānakāḥ | piśācā yakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ | 
yoginyo mātaro bhūtāḥ sarvāśca khecarastriyaḥ | siddhidāstā 
bhayantvadya tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥ || iti mantreṇa namaskurvan 
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kavalatrayaṃ ca citāmadhye nikṣipet | tato balipātrāṇi 
saptakṛtvā caturdikṣu catuṣpātrāṇi trīṇi pātrāṇi citāyāṃ 
paścimamadhyapūrvabhāgeṣu trikoṇākāratayā vā saṃsthāpayet | 
pūrvadiśi trikoṇopari śmaśānādhipatiśmaśānastambhaṃ 
pādyādibhirabhyarcya oṃ hūṃ śmaśānādhipate imaṃ sāmiṣānnaṃ 
(sāmṛtaṃ) baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇāpaya vighnanivāraṇaṃ 
kuru kuru siddhiṃ me prayaccha svāhā iti baliṃ samarpayet | dugdhena 
pañcagavyena vā sarvatra saṅkalpaḥ | evaṃ dakṣiṇadiśi bhairavaṃ 
sampūjya oṃ śmaśānādhipa bhairava bhayānaka ima mityādi | 
paścimadiśi mahākālaṃ sampūjya

p. 389)

oṃ hūṃ śmaśānādhipa mahākāla ima mityādi | uttaradiśi 
kālabhairavaṃ oṃ hūṃ śmaśānādhipa kālabhairava ima mityādi | evaṃ 
citāyāṃ prathamaṃ śmaśānakālikāṃ sampūjya oṃ hūṃ 
śmaśānavāsinī mahābhīme kālarātri mahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvane | 
gṛhāṇemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi siddhimanuttamām || (oṃ hrīṃ) kālikāyai 
svāhā | evaṃ bhūtanāthaṃ sampūjya oṃ hūṃ śmaśānādhipa 
bhūtanātha ima mityādi | śmaśānāmastake gaṇanāthaṃ sampūjya oṃ 
hūṃ śmaśānādhipa sarvagaṇanātha ima mityādi | 
tataścitāpaścimabhāge dakṣiṇabhāge vā kiyantyasthīni ekatra kṛtvā oṃ 
hrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ iti pañcagavyena prokṣayet | bhūrje vā 
vaṭapatre vā pañcapretapīṭhāsanamantrān raktacandanādinā vilikhya 
asthiṣūpari nidhāya tadupari kambalājinādyanyatamamāsanamāstīrya 
sampūjya vīrāsanena tatropaviśya hūṃhūṃhrīṃhrīṃ kālike 
ghoradaṃṣṭre pracaṇḍe caṇḍanāyike dānavān dāraya dāraya hana hana 
paravīraṃ mahāvighnaṃ chedaya chedaya svāhā huṃ phaṭ iti 
vīrārcanamantreṇa daśa loṣṭānyabhimantrya daśa dikṣu kṣipet | 
arkatlakarpūraśvetavāṭyālatūlairnirmitavartikaṃ ghṛtatailādikaṃ 
cāghorāstramantrābhimantritaṃ rakṣārthaṃ dīpaṃ mūlena prajvālayet | 
tatra yantraṃ prapūjayet | tathā yatnena bhāvyaṃ yathā 
japasamāptiparyantaṃ jvalati | tatastattatkalpoktavidhinā 
bhūtaśuddhyādiṣoḍhānyāsajālaṃ yathocita vinyasyārghyādikaṃ 
saṃskṛtya citāmadhye mahācakraṃ paricintya pīṭhapūjānte devatāṃ 
saṃsthāpya yathāsāmbhavopacāraiḥ sampūjyāvaraṇapūjādi vidhāya 
ca yathoktasaṃkhyayā vihitamālayā devatādhyānapūrvakaṃ japet | evaṃ 
japte yadi na kiñcillakṣayet tadā oṃ durgedurge rakṣaṇi svāhā iti 
jayadurgāmantreṇa devyai arghyaṃ dattvā tilo'si somadevatyo 
gosavastṛptikārakaḥ | pitṝṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ 
martyānāmabhayakṣamaḥ | būtapretapiśācānāṃ vighneṣu 
śāntikārakaḥ || iti sarvatra tilān vikiret | jayadūrgāmantreṇa sarṣapān 
vikīrya utthāya sapta padāni gatvā punastatrāpaviśya devīṃ sampūjya 
nirbhayā japet | chāgādibalividhānaṃ yathoktakramasamaye kartavyam | 
japasamāptau varaprārthanāṃ kṛtvā visarjanādi kṛtvā sāmagrīṃ jale 
nikṣipya snātvā gṛhamāgacchet | bhāgyena laguḍalābhaścettadā 
tamādāyāgacchet | iti citāsādhanam || atha śavasādhanaṃ nīlatantre

pūrvoktamupahārādi samādāya tu sādhakaḥ |
sādhayecca tathā siddhisādhanasthānamāśrayet || 1 ||

gurudhyānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ manasā caret |
vīrārcanākṛte bhūmau māyāmoho na vidyate || 2 ||

ye cātretyādimantreṇa puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet |
śmaśānādhipatīnāṃ tu pūrvavadbalimāharet || 3 ||

aghorākhyena mantreṇa śikhābandhanamācaret |
sudarśanenātmarakṣāmubhābhyāṃ vā prakalpayet || 4 ||

māyāsphuradvayaṃ bhūyaḥ prasphuradvitayaṃ punaḥ |
ghoraghoratarasyānte tanurūpapadaṃ tataḥ || 5 ||

caṭayugmaṃ tadante ca pracaṭadvitayaṃ tataḥ |
kahadvandvaṃ vamadvandvaṃ tato bandhayugaṃ punaḥ || 6 ||

ghātayadvitayaṃ varma phaḍantaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ |
ekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramayo manuḥ || 7 ||

hālāhalaṃ samuddhṛtya sahasrārasvarūpakam |
varmāstrānto mahāmantraḥ sudarśanasya kīrtitaḥ || 8 ||

bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset |
jayadūrgākhyamanunā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet || 9 ||

tilosīti ca mantreṇa tilān dikṣu vinikṣipet |
yaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtam || 10 ||

rajjubaddhaṃ sarpadaṣṭaṃ cāṇḍālaṃ cābhibhūtakam |
taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ bālaṃ naṣṭaṃ samūjjvalam || 11 ||

palāyanaviśūnyaṃ tu sanmukhe raṇavartinam |
svecchāmṛtaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca baddhastrīgodvijaṃ tathā || 12 ||

annābhāvamṛtaṃ kliṣṭaṃ saptārdhavarṣakaṃ tathā |
evaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ tyatkvā pūrvoktānyatamaṃ śavam || 13 ||

gṛhītvā mūlamantreṇa pūjāsthānaṃ samānayet |
cāṇḍālaṃ cābhibhūtaṃ tu śīghrasiddhiphalapradam || 14 ||

praṇavādyastramantreṇa śavasya prokṣaṇaṃ caret |
praṇavaṃ kūrmabījaṃ ca mṛtakāya namo'stu phaṭ || 15 ||

puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dattvā praṇamet sparśapūrvakam |
re vīra paramānanda śivānanda kuleśvara || 16 ||

ānandabhairavākāra devīparyaṅkaśaṅkara |
vīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi uttiṣṭha caṇḍikārcane || 17 ||

p. 390)

praṇamyānena mantreṇa kṣālayet tadantaram |
tāraṃ śaktirmṛtakāya namo'nte mantramuccaret || 18 ||

śavasnapanamantreṣu sarvatantro'yaṃ deśitaḥ |
dhūpena dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā gandhādinābhiṣicya(lipya) ca || 19 ||

raktākṣo yadi deveśi bhakṣayet kulasādhanam |
gatvā śavasya sānidhyaṃ dhārayet kaṭideśataḥ || 20 ||

yadyupadrāvayedasya dadyānniṣṭīvanaṃ śave |
punaḥ prakṣālitaṃ kṛtvā japasthānaṃ samānayet || 21 ||

kuśaśayyāṃ pariṣkṛtya tatra saṃsthāpayecchavam |
elālavaṅgakarpūrajātīkhadirasārakaiḥ || 22 ||

tāmbūlaṃ tanmukhe dattvā śavaṃ kuryādadhomukham |
sthāpayitvā tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ candanena vilepayet || 23 ||

bāhumūlādikaṭyantaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvya ca |
madhye padmaṃ caturdvāraṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitam || 24 ||

tataścaiṇeyamajinaṃ kambalāntaritaṃ nyaset |
dvādaśāṃgulamānāni yajñakāṣṭhāni dikṣu ca || 25 ||

saṃsthāpya pūjayet tatra indrādidaśa devatāḥ |
viṣamindrāya saṃlikhya surādhipataye tataḥ || 26 ||

idaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇadvandvaṃ gṛhṇāpayayugaṃ tataḥ |
vighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccha ṭhadvayam || 27 ||

anena manunā pūrve baliṃ dadyāt tu sāmiṣam |
svasvanāmādikaṃ dattvā pūrvavadbalimāharet || 28 ||

sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ tataḥ sādhakasattamaḥ |
śavādhiṣṭhātṛdevebhyo baliṃ dadyāt sureśvari || 29 ||

surayā saha catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo baliṃ diśet |
pūjādravyaṃ sannidhau ca dūre cottarasādhakam || 30 ||

saṃsthāpyāsanamabhyarcya svamantrānte trapāṃ tataḥ |
phaḍityanena mantreṇa tatrāśvārohaṇaṃ viśet || 31 ||

kuśān pādatale dattvā śavakeśān prasārya ca |
dṛḍhaṃ nibaddhya juṭikāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpasādhakaḥ || 32 ||

śavopari samāruhya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca |
vīrārcanena saṃmantrya dikṣu loṣṭāni nikṣipet || 33 ||

tato devīṃ ca sampūjya upacāraiḥ suvistaraiḥ |
śavāsye vidhivaddevi devatāpyāyanaṃ caret || 34 ||

utthāya sanmukhe sthitvā japedbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
vaśe me bhava deveśa mamāmukapadaṃ tataḥ || 35 ||

siddhiṃ dehi mahābhāga kṛtāśramapadāmbara |
mūlaṃ samuccaran mantrī śavapādadvayaṃ punaḥ || 36 ||

paṭṭasūtreṇa badhnīyāt tadotthātuṃ na śaknuyāt |
bhīmabhīma mahābhāva bhavyalocana bhāvuka || 37 ||

trāhi māṃ devadeveśa savānāmadhipādhipa |
iti pādatale tasya trikoṇaṃ cakramullikhet || 38 ||

tadotthātuṃ na śaknoti śavo'pi niścalo bhavet |
upaviśya punastasya bāhū vistārya pārśvayoḥ || 39 ||

hastayoḥ kuśamāstīrya pādau tatra nidhāpayet |
oṣṭhau tu sampūṭau kṛtvā sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥ || 40 ||

sadā devīṃ hṛdi dhyātvā maunī japamathācaret |
śmaśāne proktasaṃkhyābhirjapaṃ kuryāt kuleśvari || 41 ||

athavārambhakālāttu yāvadudayate raviḥ |
yadyardharātraparyantaṃ japte kiñcinna lakṣyate || 42 ||

tadā pūrvavadarghyādi saptapādagatāni ca |
kṛtvopaviśya tatraiva japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥ || 43 ||

calācalādbhayaṃ nāsti bhaye jāte vadet punaḥ |
yatprārthayasi deveśa naraṃ vā kuñjarādikam || 44 ||

dināntare tu dāsyāmi sva.ṃ nāma kathayasva me |
ityukte saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapet || 45 ||

punaścenmadhuraṃ vakti vaktavyaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ |
tadā satyavaśaṃ kāryaṃ varaṃ ca prārthayet tataḥ || 46 ||

yadi satyaṃ na kuryācca varaṃ vā prayacchenna ca |
tadā punarjaped dhīmān ekāgramānasaṃ smaran || 47 ||

nararūpaṃ vinā tatra devo'pi nopasarpati |
yantrāntareṇa boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonayaḥ || 48 ||

mātā vā tatsutā vāpi mātulānī tathaiva ca |
āgatya vighnaṃ carate māyayā ramyavigrahā || 49 ||

uttiṣṭha vatsa te kāryaṃ sarva jātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
prabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhe || 50 ||

prāyaśo matsarā lokā rājāno daṇḍadhāriṇaḥ |
kadācit kenacit śāsti tadā kiṃ te kariṣyati || 51 ||

ityādi vividhairvākyairnaca jāpaṃ parityajet |
mṛtapitṛgaṇāstatra paradeśanivāsinaḥ || 52 ||

prayānti bāndhavāstatra devarūpadharāstataḥ |
strīputrasevakāścaiva gṛhītvānīyate paraiḥ || 53 ||

p. 391)

rudanti putrakāḥ sarve bhrātaro'nujaśiṣyakāḥ |
nijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśavastramābharaṇādikam || 54 ||

gṛhītvānīyate yattu pālakaistadbhayaṃ tyajet |
yadi na kṣubhyate tatra tadā kiṃ vā na labhyate || 55 ||

strīrūpadhāriṇī devī dvijarūpadharaḥ pumān |
ūrūṃ (huṃ huṃ) gṛhṇeti śabdaṃ vai trivārānte varaṃ labhet || 56 ||

sādhunāsādhunā vāpi yoṣittve varadāyinī |
tadā vīrapatestasya kiṃ bhūtena na sidhyati || 57 ||

niṣpāpapuruṣe caiva kule caiva susaṃskṛtā |
asaṃskṛtatarā devi pāpayukte na saṃśayaḥ || 58 ||

sanmukhe'sanmukhe vāpi saṃskṛtaṃ vakti cāparam |
saiva devīna saṃdehaḥ sa devo bhairavaḥ svayam || 59 ||

nacedevaṃ bhaveccaiva māyākuṭilavigrahā |
na varaṃ varayet tatra na kiñcicca vadet tataḥ || 60 ||

saṃṣkṛtaṃ ca samākhyāti vakti vaktavyamīdṛśaḥ |
na cet svayaṃ laukikoktyā varaṃ grāhyaṃ nirākulam || 61 ||

athavā utkaṭaṃ kiñcit labhyetāpyātmano hitam |
śabdo vā jāyate samyak mṛ (ṛ) taṃ vāpi na labhyate || 62 ||

sarva vicārya jñātavyamevaṃ vighnāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
devatākṛtayo devi bhairavākṛtabuddhayaḥ || 63 ||

avaśyaṃ tatra bhetavyaṃ na tatra pratyayaḥ kvacit |
bhairavo vaṭukādyāśca kulaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ || 64 ||

etacchāstraprasaṅgena kṛtyā kuṭilavigrahā |
putro bhūtvā haredvidyāṃ nārī bhūtvā vimohayet || 65 ||

tasmāt tattvaparo vīro vicāre yatnamācaret |
satye kṛtaṃ varaṃ labdhvā santyajecca japādikam || 66 ||

phalaṃ jātamiti jñātvā jūṭikāṃ mocayet tataḥ |
śavaṃ prakṣālya saṃsthāpya mocayet pādabandhanam || 67 ||

padacakraṃ mārjayitvā pūjādravyaṃ jale kṣipet |
śavaṃ jale vā garte vā nikṣipya snānamācaret || 68 ||

tatastu svagṛhaṃ gatvā baliṃ dattvā dināntare |
agrime divase rātrau yeṣāṃ devānāṃ yajamāno'ham || 69 ||

te gṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ balimantro'yamīritaḥ |
atha yairyācitaścāśvanarakuṅjaraśūkarān || 70 ||

dattvā piṣṭamayāṃstena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam |
yavakṣodamayaṃ vāpi śālikṣodamayaṃ ca vā || 71 ||

candrahāsena vidhivat tanmantreṇa ca ghātayet |
pare'hni nityamācarya pañcagavyaṃ pibet tataḥ || 72 ||

brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
pañcapañcavihīnān vā kramāccaiva daśāvadhiḥ || 73 ||

tataḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca nivaseduttame sthale |
yadi na syādviprabhojyaṃ tadā nirdhanatāṃ vrajet || 74 ||

tena cennirdhanatvaṃ syāttadā devaḥ prakupyati |
trirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ gopayet kulasādhanam || 75 ||

śayyāyāṃ yadi gacchedvai tadā vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet |
gītaṃ śrutvā ca badhiro niścakṣurnṛtyadarśanāt || 76 ||

yadi vakti dine vākyaṃ tadā sa mūkatāṃ vrajet |
pañcadaśadināntā hi dehe devasya saṃsthitiḥ || 77 ||

gobrāhmaṇadevatānāṃ nindāṃ kuryānna ca kvacit |
devagobrāhmaṇādīiṃśca pratyahaṃ saṃspṛśecchuciḥ || 78 ||

prātarnityakriyānte tu pañcagavyodakaṃ pibet |
tataḥ snāyāt tu tīrthādau prāpte ṣoḍaśavāsare || 79 ||

svāhāntaṃ mūlamuccārya tarpayāmi namaḥ padam |
evaṃ śatatrayādūrdhva devatāṃ tarpayejjalaiḥ || 80 ||

snānatarpaṇaśūnyasya na syād devasya tarpaṇam |
ityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti niścitam || 81 ||

bhuktvehaiva varān bhogānante yāti hareḥ padam |
asāṅgaṃ sāṅgamevāpi niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca vā || 82 ||

kṛtvā sādhanamevaitacchakteḥ priyataro bhavet |
śavābhāve śmaśāne vā kāryā vīrasya sādhanā || 83 ||

ye bhāvā yasya vai proktāstairbhāvairyadi nārcayet |
daśāhakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥ || 84 ||

nopadiśedvīrabhāvaṃ na pūjāṃ tatra sandiśet |
kulānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tu yāvat siddhiḥ prajāyate || 85 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

sarveṣāṃ jīvahīnānāṃ jantūnāṃ vīrasādhane |
brāhmaṇaṃ gomayaṃ kṛtvā sādhayedvīrasādhanam || 1 ||

mṛtāsanaṃ vinā yastu pūjayet pārvatīṃ śivām |
tāvatkālaṃ vasedghore yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 2 ||

mahāśavāḥ praśastāḥ syurdevatāvīrasādhane |
kṣudrāḥ prayogakartṛṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddidāḥ || 3 ||

p. 392)

evaṃ nīlakramo devi kathitaśca tavānaghe |
na kasyacit pravaktavyaṃ mayā prītyā tavoditam || 4 ||

iti || prayogastu tatra pūrvoktaparva saṃlakṣya yathoktasamaye 
pūrvoktalakṣaṇastathā sāmagrīṃ samādāyottarasādhakasahito 
vihitasthānamāsādya sāmānyārghya vidhāya sthānaśodhanaṃ kṛtvā 
gurugaṇeśādīn namaskṛtya vīrārcanamantraṃ bhūmau likhet | ye 
cātretyādinā puṣpāñjalitrayādi vidhāya pūrvoktasaptabalipātrāṇi 
śmaśānādhipatibhyo nivedya oṃ hrīṃsphurasphura ghora ghoratara 
tanurūpa caṭacaṭa pracaṭapracaṭa kahakaha vamavama bandhabandha 
ghātayaghātaya huṃphaṭ ityaghorāstreṇa śikhāṃ baddhvā oṃ sahasrāra 
huṃphaṭ iti sudarśanāstreṇātmarakṣāṃ kṛtvā 
svasvakalpoktabhūtaśuddhyādinyāsajālaṃ vidhāya jayadurgāmantreṇa 
sarṣapān tilo'sīti tilān vikiret | vihitaśavanikaṭe gatvā mūlena vīkṣya 
astramantreṇa śavaṃ samprokṣya oṃ hūṃ mṛtakāya namaḥ'stuphaṭ iti 
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ śavopari nikṣipet | oṃ hūṃ re vīra paramānanda 
śivānanda kuleśvara | ānandabhairavākāra devīparyaṅkaśaṅkara | 
vīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi uttiṣṭha caṇḍikārcane iti sparśapūrvakaṃ 
praṇamya oṃ hrīṃmṛtakāya namaḥ iti pañcabrahmamantraiśca 
pañcagavyena sugandhijalena ca saṃsnāpya dhūpena dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā 
gandhādinā vilipya kaṭideśe dhṛtvā mūlamantraṃ japan 
japasthānamānayet | ānīya vā saṃskāramācaret | bhūmau 
kuśaśayyāmāstīrya tadupari saṃsthāpya 
elālavaṅgakarpūrajātīkhadirasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ tanmukhe dattvā 
śavamadhomukhaṃ kuryāt | tatpṛṣṭhe candanena bāhumūlādikaṭyantaṃ 
caturasrākāratayā vilipya tanmadhye 
caturdvārātmakabhūpurasahitamaṣṭadalaṃ vilikhya tatra 
kambalādyāsanamāstīrya dvādaśāṃgulapramāṇān 
yajñakāṣṭhodbhavān daśa kīlān daśadikṣu nikhāya 
teṣvindrādidaśadikpālān sampūjya pūrvoktamantraiḥ samiṣānnabaliṃ 
dadyāt | oṃ hūṃśavādhiṣṭhātṛdevatābhyo namaḥ oṃ ḍāṃdakinībhyo 
namaḥ oṃ hrīṃcatuḥ ṣaṣṭhikoṭiyoginībhyo namaḥ iti balitrayaṃ kiyaddūre 
dadyāt | pūjopahārasāmagrīṃ samīpe uttarasādhakaṃ dūre sthāpayitvā 
mūlamantrānte hrīṃphaṭ śavāsanāya namaḥ ityāsanamabhyarcya 
mūlamantraṃ smarannaśvārohakrameṇa śavopari pūrvamukhamupaviśya 
svapādatale kuśān dattvā śavakeśān prasārya dṛḍhajūṭikāṃ baddhvā 
svavāme arghyādikaṃ saṃskṛtya kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ prāṇānāyamya 
vīrārcanamantreṇa daśakṣikṣu loṣṭāni nikṣipet | pūrvoktarakṣādīpaṃ 
dakṣiṇe saṃsthāpya baddhajūṭikāyāṃ nijadevatāyāścakraṃ paricintya 
pīṭhapūjānte devīmāvāhya sāvaraṇāṃ sarvopacāraiḥ sampūjya 
vaṭukādibalividhiṃ ca vidhāya utthāya sammukhe sthitvā vaśe me bhava 
deveśa māmāmukasiddhiṃ dehi mahābhāga kṛtāśramapadāmbara iti 
bhaktiyuktaḥ paṭhet | mūlamantreṇa paṭṭasūtreṇa śavapādadvayaṃ 
badhnīyāt | oṃ bhīmabīma mahābhāva bhavyalocana bhāvuka | trāhi māṃ 
deva deveśa śavānāmadhipādhipa || iti śavapādatale trikoṇacakraṃ likhet 
| punastathaiva śavoparyupaviśya pārśvaddhaye śavabāhū vistārya 
hastayoḥ kuśamāstīrya nijapādadvayaṃ tatra nidhāpayet | punaḥ 
prāṇāyāmādi vidhāya nirbhayaḥ san devatādhyānapūrvakaṃ 
śmaśānoktasaṃkhyayā maunī sthirakāyavāṅmanā rahasyamālayā 
japet | ārambhādudayaparyantaṃ vā japet | kutracit śavasyottānatā 
śrūyate tadā hṛdayoparyāsanam | śavāsye devatāpūjā 
japamadhye'rghyādikaṃ pūrvavat | atibhayaṃ cedbhavati tadā 
chāgādibalistu ādau madhye samāptau vā | evamuktabhayādikaṃ parihṛtya 
sāvadhānatayā japtvā satyavacanena varaṃ samprārthya japaṃ tyaktvā 
phalaṃ jātamityavadhārya devatāṃ visarjayitvā śavajūṭikāṃ 
mocayitvā savaṃ prakṣālya pādabandhaṃ vimucya pādacakraṃ 
mārjayitvā pūjādravyāṇi jale nikṣipya jale garte vā śavaṃ nikṣipya 
snātvā gṛhaṃ gachet | dināntare pūrvasaṃkalpitaṃ baliṃ piṣṭamayaṃ 
racayitvā oṃ agrime divase rātrau yeṣāṃ devānāṃ yajamāno'haṃ | te 
gṛhṇantu mayā dattaṃ narakuñjaraśūkaram iti khaḍgena piṣṭaputtalīṃ 
ghātayet | dināntare nityaṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyaṃ pītvā pañcaviṃśatiṃ 
viṃśati pañcadaśa daśa vā yathāśakti brāhmaṇān bhojayet | svayamapi 
snātvā bhuktvā uttame sthale nivaset | evaṃ kulasādhanaṃ trirātraṃ 
ṣaḍrātraṃ vā gopayet | pañcadaśadivasaparyantaṃ 
pañcagavyaprāśanaṃ divā maunaṃ 
strīnṛtyagītavāditrabahirgamanādivarjanaṃ satyabhāṣaṇaṃ 
saṃyatendriyatā ca gobrāhmaṇadevatābhaktirviśeṣāt | ṣoḍaśadine 
tīrthādau snātvā sārdhaśatatrayasaṃkhyayā devatāṃ tarpayediti 
śavasādhanam | yā yā ugratarā devyastāsāmevaṃ vidhirmataḥ iti 
vacanādugradevatāviṣayametat | anayordivyavīrakramayoḥ rahasyamityapi 
nāmāntaram ||

p. 393)

atha saṃkṣepapuraścaraṇaṃ tantrāntare -

grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ |
nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre'bhbhasi sthitaḥ || 1 ||

sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhiḥ |
homayettaddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena tarpayet || 2 ||

abhiṣiñced daśāṃśena daśāṃśaṃ viprabhojanam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | upoṣito'bhuktaḥ | samudragāminyāṃ sākṣāt paramparayā vā | 
asambhave taḍāgādau jale sthityasāmarthye tīre sthito'pi | sparśāt 
prāṇāyāma-ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsavilambitasparśāt 
aṅgavaiguṇye'pi grahaṇapuraścaraṇaṃ kartavyamevameva mahāphalatvāt 
| tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 1 ||

sūryodayāt samārabhya yāvat sūryodayāntaram |
tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 2 ||

iti | atra tithibhedena puraścaraṇabhedaḥ | homādikaṃ tu pūrvavat | 
nirātaṅkaḥ śaṅkārahitaḥ | tahā

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
śaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

bhaktitaḥ pūjayitvā tu rātrau tāvatsahasrakam |
ekākī vijane japyāt kevalaṃ vā śivālaye || 2 ||

aṣṭamyādinavamyantamupavāsaparo bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | caturthyāditvamiti matabhedena | kṛṣṇapakṣanavamyādi pratipadādi 
ṣaṣṭhyādipakṣā api kutraciduktāḥ | vastutaḥ pratipadādipakṣaḥ 
sāṃpradāyikaḥ | rātrāvityupalakṣaṇam | tāvatsahasrakaṃ tithisahasrakam 
| sahasraṃpratyahamityeva vā | alpākṣaramantreṇa saṃkhyāvṛddhikramaḥ 
anyatra sahasrameva | tadā tāvaditi pādapūraṇe | homādikaṃ 
pūrvoktameva | paśumatānu kalpametat | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
anyatra gurumārgasya laṅghanaṃ naiva kārayet || 1 ||

aṣṭamīsandhivelāyāmaṣṭottara (raṃ) latāgṛham |
praviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarcya yatnataḥ || 2 ||

pūrvoktakalpamāsādya pūjādikaṃ samācaret |
kevalaṃ kāmadevo'sau japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 3 ||

tāsāṃ tu patramūle tu ugrāṃ sampūjya karṇake |
mantrasiddhirbhavetsadyo latādarśanapūjanāt || 4 ||

iti | sandhivelā ca śāradīyaiva pūrvakramādaṣṭottaraṃ śatamityarthaḥ | 
aṣṭāveva vā uttaraṃ tadā śreṣṭhamityarthaḥ | latāgṛhamiti latāsaṅketaḥ 
| praviśya saṅgatībhūya veṣṭito vā | pūrvoktakalpaṃ śaktipūjākalpaṃ 
patramūle mudrāmule ugrāṃ devīṃ karṇake pārśvatraye 
vidyābhāgatrayaṃ saṃlikhyeti śeṣaḥ | aṣṭottaraśatajapastu 
pratyekamavadheyaḥ | kāmadevo divyaveśadharaḥ | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
ākṛṣṭāyāḥ kulāgāre bhāvena mantramuttamam || 1 ||

karṇākṛṣṭilatāgātre likhitvā mantrameva ca |
vidhāya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedya ca || 2 ||

kiñcijjaptvā manuṃ nītvā devatābhāvatatparaḥ |
tāṃ visṛjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā sukhaṃ punaḥ || 3 ||

prātaḥ strībhyo baliṃ dattvā mantrasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 4 ||

iti | ākṛṣṭāyā upabhuktāyāḥ | kulāgāre mudrāyāṃ 
sampūrṇavidyābhāvanā | karṇatraye lekhanaṃ bhāgatrayasya | 
saṃskāraṃ śaktisaṃskāraṃ | nivedya santarpya kiñcidaṣṭottaraśataṃ 
japaḥ sparśapūrvakaḥ svayaṃ japtvāṣṭottarasahasramityarthaḥ |

athavā vijane ramye sthitvā śayyāsane rataḥ |
udayāntaṃ divā japtvā sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet || 1 ||

śayyāsane śaktisahite iti śeṣaḥ | divyamatānukalpametat | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtam || 1 ||

pañcagavyena militaṃ candanādyairviśeṣataḥ |
nikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vane || 2 ||

tatra tadvivare rātrau sahasraṃ yadi mānavaḥ |
ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavetkalpapādapaḥ || 3 ||

p. 364)

iti | kuje maṅgale naramuṇḍaṃ sadyaḥ kṛttaṃ yathālābhaṃ vā 
śavavanmuṇḍe'pi vihitaniṣiddhatā hastārdhamānato 
dvādaśāṃgulamānataḥ kānane vane'tigahane ityarthaḥ | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
śavamānīya tadvāre tenaiva parikhanya tam || 1 ||

taddināttaddinaṃ yāvat tāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
sa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2 ||

iti | tadvāre maṅgalādivāre | tenaiva mānenetyarthaḥ | 
taddinādārambhadinādaṣṭottaraśataṃ pratidinaṃ japediti śeṣaḥ ||

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
niśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥ || 1 ||

digvāsā vimalī bhasmabūṣaṇo muktakeśakaḥ |
kapālakhaḍgahastaśca japenmātṛkāya yadi || 2 ||

tadā tasya mahādevi sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | niśābhyāmardharātre mṛtahaṭṭe śmaśāne unmattānandabhairavaḥ 
prauḍhollāsasahitaḥ digvāsā digambaraḥ | mātṛkayā mātṛkāmālayā 
japedaṣṭottaraśatamityarthaḥ | vīramatānukalpametat | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
gurumānīya saṃsthāpya devavatpūjanaṃ guroḥ || 1 ||

vastrālaṅkārahemādyaiḥ santoṣya gurumeva ca |
tatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tathaiva ca || 2 ||

pūjayitvā manuṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | manuṃ japtvā sahasramityarthaḥ | tathā -

athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate |
sahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prajapya ca || 1 ||

kevalaṃ devabhāvena sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | prajapya svamantroktasaṃkhyeti śeṣaḥ | idaṃ tu gurorasāṃnidhye | 
sarvamatānukalpametat | eteṣu homādiniyabhābhāvaḥ | iti 
saṃkṣepapuraścaraṇāni ||

nānātantravicārena nānābhāvānumodanāt |
puraścaraṇarūpeṇa saṃsiddhyai yatatāṃ naraḥ || 1 ||

atha prayogaviśeṣāḥ vaiṣṇavatantre -

evaṃ nityakramaṃ kṛtvā naimittikamathācaret |
kṛte naimittike vipra nityasya pūrṇatā bhavet || 1 ||

lakṣakṛtvo japenmantramaṇimādiguṇāṁllabhet |
samudragodakāhāro japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ || 2 ||

janmasthe bhāskare padmairhomāddaśasahasrakam |
koṭijanmodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti niścitam || 3 ||

nāśayetsarvapāpāni vāksiddhiṃ cāpi vindati |
parvatāgre yajeddevaṃ śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ || 4 ||

puṇḍarīkavarairdevaṃ māsamekaṃ samarcayet |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca karasthāśca bhavanti hi || 5 ||

lakṣmīḥ sthirā bhavettasya putrapautrānuyāyinī |
śrīpuṣpairjuhuyāt tadvadvaiśākhe māsi dugdhapaḥ || 6 ||

sarvāśuddhikṣayakaraḥ sarvasiddhivivardhakaḥ |
devāḥ sarve namasyanti bhaktyā taṃ puruṣarṣabham || 7 ||

śrījalaistarpayeddevaṃ mātsyaṇḍīcandrasaṃyutaiḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā pūjānte bhaktitatparaḥ || 8 ||

maṇḍalāt sa labhet siddhiṃ duṣkaraṃ sukaraṃ tu vā |
yadyat kāmayate mantrī anāyāsena labhyate || 9 ||

dugdhabuddhyā jalairnityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ śatam |
tarpayannakhilān kāmāṁllabhenmokṣaṃ ca vindati || 10 ||

kuśapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya māsamātraṃ nirāmayaḥ |
yaśase dharmavṛddhyai ca brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ || 11 ||

hayārikusumaiḥ śubhrairmaṇḍalāt jñānavān bhavet |
tathā raktāśvamāreṇa acalāṃ bhaktimāpnuyāt || 12 ||

tathā dvābhyāṃ samabhyarcya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati |
brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ śeṣajanmanām || 13 ||

strīṇāṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa naimittikamidaṃ bhavet |
eteṣāṃ māsamātraṃ tu kṛtvā kāmyāni sādhayet || 14 ||

iti | evaṃ praṇavapuṭitamantramayutasaṃkhyayā trirātrajapena 
bṛhaspatisamaḥ sarvaśāstravyākhyātā bhavati | ravivāre 
aśvatthavṛkṣamālayā aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhūyobhūyo japet | 
śāntiraṣṭottaraśatavarṣajīvanam | aṃśukairmāsamātrapūjayā 
malinakṛcchra ghoratarapāpavimuktiḥ |

p. 395)

paṭṭasūtraiḥ pūjayātulasampattiḥ | vidrumapūjayā trailokyavaśīkāraḥ | 
māṇikyapūjayā sārvabhaumatvaṃ padmarāgeṇa pūjayā rājyatvaṃ 
gārutmataiḥ pūjayā jñānaṃ hīrakeṇa pūjayā sarvasiddhiḥ 
svarṇapuṣpaiḥ pūjayā kuberasamasampattiḥ dehānte nirvāṇapadaṃ | 
māsamātreṇeti sarvatra yojanīyam | tantrāntare evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī 
prayogānatha sādhayediti | śāradātilake (pa0 23 ślo0 123) -

athābhidhāsye tantre'smin samyak ṣaṭkarmalakṣaṇam |
sarvatantrānusāreṇa prayogaphalasiddhidam || 1 ||

śāntivaśyastambhanāni vidveṣoccāṭane tataḥ |
māraṇāntāni śaṃsanti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ || 2 ||

rogakṛtyāgrahādīnāṃ nirāsaḥ śāntirīritā |
vaśyaṃ janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritam || 3 ||

pravṛttirodhaḥ sarveṣāṃ stambhanaṃ samudāhṛtam |
snigdhānāṃ dveṣajananaṃ mitho vidveṣaṇaṃ matam || 4 ||

uccāṭanaṃ svadeśāderbhraśanaṃ parikīrtitam |
prāṇināṃ prāṇaharaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ samudāhṛtam || 5 ||

svadevatādikkālādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet |
ratirvāṇī ramā lakṣmīrdurgā kālī yathākramam || 6 ||

ṣaṭkarmadevatāḥ proktāḥ karmādau tāḥ prapūjayet |
īśacandrendranir-ṛtivāyvagnīnāṃ diśo matāḥ || 7 ||

sūryodayātsamārabhya ghaṭikādaśakaṃ kramāt |
ṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dine || 8 ||

vasantagrīṣmavarṣākhyaśaraddhaimantaśaiśirāḥ |
hemantaḥ śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇi || 9 ||

śiśiraḥ stambhane jñeyo vidveṣe grīṣma īritaḥ |
prāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyā śaranmāraṇakarmaṇi || 10 ||

padmākhyaṃ svastikaṃ bhūyo vikataṃ kukkuṭaṃ punaḥ |
vajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥ || 11 ||

ṣaṇamudrāḥ kramato jñeyāḥ padmapāśagadāhvayāḥ |
musalāśanikhaḍgākhyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasu || 12 ||

jalaṃ śāntividhau śastaṃ vaśye vahnirudāhṛtaḥ |
stambhane pṛthivī śastā vidveṣe vyoma kīrtitam || 13 ||

uccāṭane smṛto vāyurbhūyo'gnirmāraṇe mataḥ |
tattadbhūtodaye samyak tattanmaṇḍalasaṃyutam || 14 ||

tattatkarma vidhātavyaṃ mantriṇā niśitātmanā |
śītāṃśusalilakṣoṇīvyaumavāyuhavirbhujām || 15 ||

varṇāḥ syuryantrabījāni ṣaṭkarmasu yathākramam |
grathanaṃ ca vidarbhaśca sampuṭo rodhanaṃ tathā || 16 ||

yogaḥ pallava ityete vinyāsyāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasu |
mantrārṇāntaritān kuryānnāmavarṇān yathāvidhi || 17 ||

grathanaṃ tadvijānīyātpraśastaṃ śāntikarmaṇi |
mantrārṇadvandvamadhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣara likhet || 18 ||

vidarbha eṣa vijñeyo mantribhirvaśyakarmaṇi |
ādāvante ca mantraḥ syānnāmno'sau saṃpuṭo mataḥ || 19 ||

eṣa saṃstambhane śasta ityukto mantravedibhiḥ |
nāmna ādyantamadhyeṣu mantraḥ syādrodhanaṃ matam || 20 ||

vidveṣaṇavidhāne tu praśastamidamuttamam |
mantrasyānte bhavennāma yogaḥ proccāṭane mataḥ || 21 ||

ante nāmno bhavenmantro pallavo māraṇe yataḥ |
sitaraktapītamiśrakṛṣṇadhūmrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 22 ||

varṇato mantratantroktā devatāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasu |
yantrāṇāṃ lekhanadravyaṃ candanaṃ rocanā niśā || 23 ||

gṛhadhūmaścitāṅgāro māraṇe'ṣṭa viṣāṇi ca |
śyenāgniloṇapiṇḍāni dhattūrakarasastathā || 24 ||

gṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudīritam |
devatākālamudrādīn samyag jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 25 ||

ṣaṭkarmāṇi prayuñjīta yathoktaphalasiddhaye |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 26 ||

evaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantramupakramya |
tatraiva (pa0 23 ślo0 91) -

iti saṃsādhito mantraḥ ṣaṭkarmaphalado bhavet |
sthāpayenmanunā tena prāṇān sarvatra deśikaḥ || 1 ||

bījānte'muṣyaśabdānāmādau dūtīḥ prayojayet |
mṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā tataḥ || 2 ||

ākṛṣyā grathanī paścātpramādā visphuliṅginī |
kṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ || 3 ||

pāśena baddhaceṣṭasya śaktayā svīkṛtacetasaḥ |
aṅkuśenāhṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharet || 4 ||

dvādaśāṃgulamānena kṛtvā sādhyasya puttalīm |
tasyāṃ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 5 ||

p. 396)

niśīthasamaye sādhye supte tasya hṛdambuje |
daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ param || 6 ||

īśarākṣasaśītāṃśuyamānāṃ karṇikāntare |
yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret || 7 ||

śirovastra (bindu) samudbhūtatantusaṃbaddhavigrahān |
evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret || 8 ||

ātmahṛtpadmagā bhṛṅgīḥ prasthāpya śvāsavartmanā |
ekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayet || 9 ||

puttalyāṃ sthāpayenmantrī svacitte vā vidhānavit |
tantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena saṃyataḥ || 10 ||

ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛdbhṛṅgāṃstataḥ saṃstambhayedbhuvā |
evamekādaśāvṛtīḥ kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu || 11 ||

vaśyākarṣaṇayoryādīnaruṇān saṃsmared budhaḥ |
mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi || 12 ||

pītān saṃstambhane dhyāyet prāṇākarṣaṇakarmaṇi |
ākṛṣya sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi || 13 ||

krūrakarmasu puttalyāṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanamīritam |
prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān || 14 ||

saṃsmaret tatra nipuṇaḥ sadā krūreṣu karmasu |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 15 ||

vāyvagniśakravaruṇeśvararākṣasendu preteśapatralikhitairatha 
yādivarṇaiḥ |
vindvantikaiḥ kṣagatahaṃsasametamadhyaṃ prāṇātmayantramatha 
varṇavṛtaṃ dharāḍhyam || 16 ||

itthaṃ prayogakuśalo manunānena mantravit |
vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivānapi || 17 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

sādhyanāmārṇamekaikaṃ mantrārṇe saṃprayojitam |
grathitaṃ tatsamākhyātaṃ vaśyākṛṣṭikaraṃ param || 1 ||

mantramādau vadetsarva sādhyasaṃjñāmanantaram |
viparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsampuṭaṃ bhavet || 2 ||

śāntipuṣṭikaraṃ jñeyaṃ trailokyaiśvaryadāyakam |
ardhamardhaṃ tadādyante mantraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 3 ||

madhye vāsya bhavetsādhyaṃ grastamityabhidhīyate |
abhicāreṣu sarveṣu yojayenmāraṇe'pi vā || 4 ||

abhidhānaṃ vadetpūrvaṃ paścānmantraṃ tathā vadet |
etat samastamityuktaṃ śatrūccāṭanakārakam || 5 ||

dvau dvau mantrākṣarau yatra ekaikaṃ sādhyavarṇakam |
vidarbhitaṃ tatsamproktaṃ duṣṭaghnaṃ vaśyalakṣaṇam || 6 ||

mantrārṇāntaritaṃ sādhyaṃ samantāttiṣṭhate yadi |
ākrāntaṃ tadvijānīyātsadyaḥ sarvārthasādhanam || 7 ||

stobhastambhasamāveśavaśyoccāṭanakarmasu |
sakṛtpūrvaṃ vadenmantramante caiva tathā punaḥ || 8 ||

madhye cāsya bhavetsādhyamādyantamiti tadviduḥ |
anyonyaprītiyuktānāṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param || 9 ||

ādau cānte tathā mantraṃ dvivāraṃ samprayojayet |
sādhyanāma sakṛnmadhye garbhasthaṃ sampravakṣate || 10 ||

māraṇoccāṭanaṃ vaśyaṃ prayuktaṃ kārayennṛṇām |
hetinausainyadhīgarbhastambhanaṃ ca gatestathā || 11 ||

tridhā mantraṃ vadetpūrvaṃ tathaivānte punastridhā |
sakṛtsādhyaṃ bhavenmadhye tadvidyātsarvato vṛtam || 12 ||

sarvopasargaśamanamapamṛtyunivāraṇam |
sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mṛtānāmamṛtapradam || 13 ||

ādau mantraṃ tato nāma punarmantraṃ samuccaret |
evameva tridhā kuryādbhavedyuktividarbhitam || 14 ||

sarvavyādhiharaṃ proktaṃ bhūtāpasmāramardanam |
ekaikaṃ sādhyavarṇam tu kṛtvā mantravidarbhitam || 15 ||

pūrvavatkathitaṃ cānyattasyādyante prakalpayet |
vidarbhagrathitaṃ nāma mantralakṣaṇamuttamam || 16 ||

sarvakarmakaraṃ proktaṃ sarvaiśvaryaphalapradam |
evamete prayogāḥ syuḥ  siddha mantrasya siddhidāḥ || 17 ||

iti | ete grathitādayastattatkarmasu yantralekhanādiviṣaye iti boddhavyam | 
tantrāntare -

sarveṣāṃ mantravrātānāṃ praṇavaḥ śira ucyate |
huṃphaṭsvāhāvaṣaṭvauṣaṇnamaḥ pallavasaṃjñakāḥ || 11 ||

tattatkarmavidhāne tu tattanmantravicāraṇe |
śiraḥ pallavasaṃyukto mantro bhavati siddhidaḥ || 2 ||

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi cakrarajasya sādhanam |
evaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakramaṃ śṛṇu || 1 ||

p. 397)

kṛtvā sindūrarajasā cakraṃ tatra vicintayet |
sādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma likhitvā cintayet tataḥ || 2 ||

jvalantī tatkṣaṇād devi mohitā bhayavarjitā |
tyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti athānyatkathyate priye || 3 ||

tanmadhye saṃsthito mantrī cintayedaruṇaprabham |
ātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tadā saubhāgyasundaraḥ || 4 ||

aruṇairupacāraistu pūjayenmudrayāvṛtaḥ |
yasya nāmnā yutaḥ samyag sa bhaved dāsa eva hi || 5 ||

adṛṣṭastrīnāmavarṇāṃścakramadhye vilikhya tu |
yoni mudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 6 ||

devakanyāṃ rājakanyāṃ nāgakanyāmathāpi vā |
gorocanā kuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanam || 7 ||

aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā tilakaṃ sarvamohanam |
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam || 8 ||

tāmbūlaṃ pūrvajaptaṃ ca yasmai sampreṣyate sa tu |
aṅganā vā kṣaṇādeva dāsīvāsya bhavetpriye || 9 ||

karavīrai raktavarṇaistrimadhvaktaiḥ prapūjayet |
cintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥ || 10 ||

iti kurvan maheśāni pūjayedaruṇaprabhām |
sundūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt || 11 ||

trailokyamohanāṃ vāpi rambhāmākarṣayed drutam |
citāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hi || 12 ||

bāhau baddhvāthavā kvāpi jvaraṃ nāśayati kṣaṇāt |
arkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu lekhanyārkasya saṃlikhet || 13 ||

dvayornāma madhyabāhyadeśe cakrasya saṃlikhet |
gomūtre sthāpayet tacca bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt || 14 ||

dhūpayeccandanaṃ rātrau vastraṃ vā dhārayettataḥ |
aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mohayedbhuvanatrayam || 15 ||

liptagomayabhūmau tu likhedrocanayā tataḥ |
surūpāṃ pratimāṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣāḍhyāṃ paricintayet || 16 ||

tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇḍalayojitām |
janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṃkuśāntarvidarbhitām || 17 ||

sarvāṅgasandhisamlīnaṃ kāmakūṭaṃ samālikhet |
sādhyāśābhimukho bhūtvā śrīvidyānyāsavigrahaḥ || 18 ||

kṣobhaṇībījamudrābhyāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japet |
yojayettāṃ kāmagehe candrasūryakalātmake || 19 ||

sānurāgātivikalā kāmasāyakapīḍitā |
trailokyasundarī nāma kṣaṇādāyāti mohitā || 20 ||

athavā mātṛkāṃ cakrabāhye samveṣṭya mantravit |
cakraṃ prapūjayetsamyak vidyāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca dhārayet || 21 ||

avadhyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍāgarukastūrīkarpūraiśca sakuṃkumaiḥ || 22 ||

svanāma kramato lekhyaṃ pūrvavanmātṛkāṃ likhet |
tenājarāmaratvaṃ tu sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ || 23 ||

anenaiva prakāreṇa rocanāgarukuṃkumaiḥ |
cakraṃ vilikhya sādhyārṇasādhakārṇavidarbhitam || 24 ||

trailokyamohano mantrī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
kāmakūṭena deveśi sandarbhya pṛthagakṣaram || 25 ||

sādhyanāmnastrikoṇāntarmātṛkāṃ veṣṭayed bahiḥ |
svarṇamadhyagataṃ dhāryaṃ śikhāyāṃ yatra kutracit || 26 ||

lokapālāśca rājānoduṣṭāstralokyasaṃsthitāḥ |
te sarve vaśyamāyānti sannipātādayo jvarāḥ || 27 ||

anena vidhinā nāma puraṃ sandarbhyasaṃkṣipet |
catuṣpathe madhyadeśe dikṣu pūrvāditaḥ kramāt || 28 ||

tasya saubhāgyamāyāti rājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ sadā |
sphurattejomayīṃ pṛthvīṃ prajvalantīṃ carācaram || 29 ||

cakrāntaścintayennityaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tato naraḥ |
tena kandarpasubhago loke bhavati niścayāt || 30 ||

dṛṣṭyākarṣayate lokān viṣaṃ nāśayati jvarān |
tathā viṣaṃ ca harati dṛṣṭyāveśaṃ karoti ca || 31 ||

rātrau sindūralikhitaṃ pūjayedekacittataḥ |
karotyākarṣaṇaṃ dūrādyojanānāṃ śatādapi || 32 ||

akhaṇḍaṃ dikṣu koṇeṣu krameṇa paripūjayet |
yadā tadaiva loko'yaṃ vaśyo bhavati nānyathā || 33 ||

bhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ rocanāgarukuṃkumaiḥ |
svanāmadarbhitaṃ kuryād deśaṃ vā puṭabhedanam || 34 ||

maṇḍalaṃ viṣamasthānaṃ bhūmau cakraṃ nidhāpayet |
dhārayedvā tato mantrī puraṃ kṣobhayatīkṣaṇāt || 35 ||

unmattarasalākṣārkakṣīrakuṃkumarocanāḥ |
kastūryalaktasahitā ekīkṛtya tu saṃlikhet || 36 ||

yannāmnā tasya deveśi caurajaṃ vyāghrajaṃ bhayam |
grahajaṃ vyādhijaṃ caiva ripujaṃ siṃhajaṃ tathā || 37 ||

p. 398)

ahijaṃ vājijaṃ nāsti sarvān mohayati kṣaṇāt |
rocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ tu madhyagāṃ saṃlikhed budhaḥ || 38 ||

trikoṇobhayagāṃ caiva sādhyanāmāṅkitāmadhaḥ |
taccakraṃ dhārayet tasmāt saptāhādvijvaro bhavet || 39 ||

pītadravyeṇa cakrāntarlikhedvidyāmadhastataḥ |
sādhyanāma vilikhyaitat pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃkṣipet || 40 ||

tasmādbrahmāpi jīvo'pi sarvajño mūkatāṃ vrajet |
anena vidhinā nīlīrasena vilikhet tataḥ || 41 ||

dakṣiṇābhimukho mantrī vahnau dagdhvā ripūn dahet |
mahiṣāśvapurīṣeṇa gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhet || 42 ||

āranālasthitaṃ kuryād bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt |
sādhyanāma likhenmadhye kākapakṣeṇa sañcayet || 43 ||

saṃlikhya rocanādravyairākāśe dṛṣṭigaṃ yathā |
śatrūnuccāṭayedāśu haṭhoccāṭo'yamīritaḥ || 44 ||

mahānīlīrasodbhinnarocanādugdhamiśritaiḥ |
lākṣārasairlikheccakraṃ caturvarṇān vaśaṃ nayet || 45 ||

anena vidhinā nīre sthāpayettatajjalena tu |
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti snānapānānna saṃśayaḥ || 46 ||

pītaṃ cakraṃ yajetpūrve stambhayetsarvavādinaḥ |
sindūralikhitaṃ cakramuttare lokavaśyakṛt || 47 ||

paścime pūjitaṃ cakraṃ gairikālikhitaṃ tataḥ |
mantriṇo devatā vaśyāḥ kiṃ punaryoṣitaḥ priye || 48 ||

tathaiva dakṣiṇāsyastu kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayet |
sādhyasya mantrahāniḥ syānmāraṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 49 ||

kramāddigantarāsyaḥ san vahnikoṇādiṣu kramāt |
stambhaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ vyādhimuccāṭaṃ kurute naraḥ || 50 ||

dugdhe vaśyakaraṃ kṣipraṃ rocanālikhitaṃ haṭhāt |
dagdhvā tadvahnimadhysthaṃ sarvaśatrūn vināśayet || 51 ||

gomūtramadhyagaṃ caitad bhaveduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ |
vidveṣaṇaṃ bhaveccakre tenaiva parameśvari || 52 ||

sindūreṇa likheccakraṃ nirjane tu catuṣpathe |
sarvasādhyaṃ samārabhya madhyāntaṃ mātṛkāṃ likhet || 53 ||

kulācārakrameṇaiva rātrau sampūjayet kramam |
sādhakaḥ khecarī devi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 54 ||

caturdaśyāṃ niśi svastho rudrabhūmau prapūjayet |
ṣaṇmāsakramayogena sākṣādrudra ivāparaḥ || 55 ||

añjanaṃ vivaraṃ siddhaṃ gulikāṃ pādukājayam |
khaḍgaṃ vetālasaubhāgyaṃ yakṣiṇīṃ ceṭakādikam || 56 ||

sakalaṃ siddhijananaṃ mantrī prāpnoti nānyathā |
caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pratyaṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 57 ||

ekaviṃśatirātraṃ tu niśi pretaśilātale |
śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tadvat surapūjyastu sādhakaḥ || 58 ||

pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇaiḥ pauruṣeyairmaheśvari |
kāmo bhūtvā svargabhūsthapātālatalayoṣitām || 59 ||

hartā kartā svayaṃ caiva mahadākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
tadvat kāmeśvarīśastrairdevyātmā bhuvanatraye || 60 ||

puruṣākarṣaṇaṃ caitadrājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ priye |
etat kāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ bījabhedataḥ || 61 ||

vāgbhavārādhane devi jñānaṃ sārasvataṃ bhavet |
śvetābhāṃ śvetavastrāḍhyāṃ śvetapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 62 ||

anena vidhinā devi vāgbhavārādhanaṃ bhavet |
atha kāmakalā nāma sāmarthya śṛṇu pārvati || 63 ||

kāmo manmathakandarpo makaradhvaja eva hi |
mahākāmaśca pūrvoktāḥ pañcakāmāḥ krameṇa tu || 64 ||

kāmaṃ manmathamadhyasthaṃ devi kandarpaveśmagam |
tatpuṭasthaṃ mīnaketuṃ mahākāmeśamastakam || 65 ||

anena kāmatattvena mohayejjagatīmimām |
mūlādisṛṣṭisaṃhārabisatantusvarūpiṇī || 66 ||

tasmāt kuṇḍalinīśaktiḥ śaktikūṭe maheśvari |
trikūṭā tripurā devi sarvasiddhipradā bhavet || 67 ||

catuḥṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām |
cakrametat samāśrītya satāṃ siddhipradāḥ sadā || 68 ||

iti | vāmakeśvaratantre ca (2 pa0) -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mantrayogaṃ yathāvidhi |
yatrānena vidhānena sādhakena prapūjyate || 1||

deśe vā nagare grāme jagatkṣobhaḥ prajāyate |
jvalatkāmāgnisaṃtāpapratāpottaptamānasāḥ || 2 ||

pipīlikāsthinyāyena dūrādāyānti yoṣitaḥ |
mantrasaṃmūḍhahṛdayāḥ sphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāḥ || 3 ||

taddarśanānmahādevi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥ |
japte lakṣaikamātre tu kṣubhyante bhūtale'ṅganāḥ || 4 ||

p. 399)

yadi na kṣubhyatītthaṃ hi sādhakasya mano manāk |
saṃkṣubhyante tataḥ sarvāḥ pātāle nāgakanyakāḥ || 5 ||

tāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi |
tataḥ svarganivāsinyo vidravanti surāṅganāḥ || 6 ||

evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ sādhakottamaḥ |
saṃkṣobhayati deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarāram || 7 ||

likhitvā vipulaṃ cakraṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ yadā |
nāmnā likhati saṃyuktā jvalantīṃ cintayet tataḥ || 8 ||

śatayojanamātrasthā tvadṛṣṭāpi ca yā bhavet |
bhayalajjāvinirmuktā sā'pyāyāti vimohitā || 9 ||

tanmadhyago'thavā bhūtvā mantrī cintayate yadā |
sarvamātmānamaruṇaṃ sādhyamapyaruṇīkṛtam || 10 ||

tataḥ sañjāyate devi sarvasaubhāgyasundaraḥ |
vallabhaḥ sarvalokasya sādhakaḥ parameśvari || 11 ||

sarvaraktopacāraistu pūjayenmudrayāvṛtaḥ |
yasya nāmnaiva saṃyuktaṃ sa bhaved dāsavadvaśī || 12 ||

adṛṣṭāyastu saṃyojya nāma cakrasya madhyagam |
viracya yonimudrāṃ ca tāmākarṣayati kṣaṇāt || 13 ||

yakṣiṇīṃ vātha gandharvī kinnarīṃ vā sureśvari |
siddhakanyāṃ nāgakanyāṃ devakanyāṃ ca khecarīm || 14 ||

vidyādharīmapsarasamṛṣikanyāmathorvaśīm |
madanodbhavavikṣobhasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām || 15 ||

mahākāmakalādhyānāt kṣobhayet sarvayoṣitaḥ |
rocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ ca samabhāgaṃ ca candanam || 16 ||

aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtaṃ tilakaṃ dhārayennaraḥ |
tato yamīkṣate vakti spṛśate cintayatyalam || 17 ||

arthena ca śarīreṇa sa vaśyaṃ yāti dāsavat |
tathā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gandhaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ maheśvari || 18 ||

aṣṭottaraśataṃ jatpvā yasyāḥ saṃpreṣate striyāḥ |
sadya ākṛṣyate sā tu vimūḍhahṛdayā satī || 19 ||

haṭhākṛṣṭiriyaṃ bhadre na kvacit pratihanyate |
likhedrocanayaikānte pratimāmavanītale || 20 ||

surūpāṃ cāruśṛṅgāraveśābharaṇabhūṣitām |
tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇḍalayojitām || 21 ||

janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṅkuśānta vidarbhitām |
sarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnamālikhya madanākṣaram || 22 ||

tadāśābhimukho bhūtvā tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥ |
baddhvā tu kṣobhiṇīmudrāṃ vidyāmaṣṭottaraṃ japet || 23 ||

niyojya dahanāgāre candrasūryaprabhā(kalā)kule |
tato vicalitā pāṅgāmanaṅgaśarapīḍitām || 24 ||

projjvalanmadanollola pracalajjaghanasthalām |
sakticakrojjvaladraśmikalanā kavalīkṛtām || 25 ||

dūrīkṛtasvacāritrabhayalajjātrapāṅkuśām |
ākṛṣṭahṛdayāṃ naṣṭadhairyāmuḍḍīna jīvitām || 26 ||

vapraprāsāda nigaḍanadīyantrasurakṣitām |
navānurāgasaṃdhānaveṣamānahṛdambujām || 27 ||

mano'dhikamahāmantrapavanāpahṛtāṃśukām |
vimūḍhāmiva vikṣubdhāmiva śrāntāmiva drutām || 28 ||

likhitāmiva niḥsaṃjñāmiva pramathitāmiva |
vihastāmiva saṃkīrṇāmivākulitamānasām || 29 ||

nilīnāmiva niśceṣṭāmivānyatvaṃ gatāmiva |
bhramanmantrāniloddhūtapatrākārāṃ nabhastale || 30 ||

bhramantīmānayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatādapi |
athavā mātṛkāṃ sarvāṃ likhitvā cakrabāhyataḥ || 31 ||

dhārayedbāhūmūle yaḥ so'vadhyaḥ sarvajantuṣu |
tathaiva hi maheśāni svasaṃjñākramayogataḥ || 32 ||

candanāgarukarpūrairajarāmaratāṃ vrajet |
evaṃ devi vidhānena rocanāgarukuṃkumaiḥ || 33 ||

likhitvā cakrayogena yasmin kasminnapi sthitam |
sādhyanāmnā svanāmnā tu cakrasyāntarvidarbhitam || 34 ||

karoti sakalān lokānacirāt pādavartinaḥ |
madhyaṅgatena bījena mahākāmakalātmanā || 35 ||

ekamekavaṣṭabhya sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ priye |
bahirapi likhedeva veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ || 36 ||

hemamadhyagataṃ kṛtvā dhārayedvāmake bhuje |
śikhāyāmathavā vastre dhārayedyatra tatra vā || 37 ||

karoti dāsabhūtaṃ hi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
sammohayati rājānaṃ vājinaṃ duṣṭakuñjaram || 38 ||

cauraṃ kesariṇaṃ sarpa paratantraṃ mahābalam |
śatrūn vajraśataṃ śastraṃ vetālaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathā || 39 ||

bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca dhāritā cakrarūpiṇī |
tena mantreṇa sandarbhya purāṇāṃ nāma sundari || 40 ||

p. 400)

madhye catuṣpathe vāpi caturdikṣu nidhāpayet |
mahān kolāhalastatra tato lokasya jāyate || 41 ||

yoṣitāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tvadṛṣṭānāmapīśvari |
etanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanām || 42 ||

catuḥsamudraparyantāṃ jvalantīṃ cintayet priye |
ṣaṇmāsadhyānayogena jāyate'timanoharaḥ || 43 ||

dṛṣṭyaivākarṣayellokān dṛṣṭyava kurute vaśam |
dṛṣṭyā saṃkṣobhayennārīṃ dṛṣṭyaivāpaharedviṣam || 44 ||

dṛṣṭyā karoti cāveśaṃ dṛṣṭyā sarvaṃ vimohayet |
dṛṣṭyā cāturthikādīṃśca nāśayedviṣamajvarān || 45 ||

etat prapūjitaṃ rātrau cakraṃ sindūrarañjitaṃ |
karoti mahadākarṣaṃ sudūrādapi yoṣitām || 46 ||

sadā dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ yadā devi prapūjyate |
diganukramayogena tadā sarva jagadvaśe || 47 ||

bhūrjapatre vilikhyaivaṃ tarau nirvivarodare |
rocanāgarukāśmīrairmadhye sandarbhayet puram || 48 ||

vipulaṃ deśamathavā viṣayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā |
svanāmasahitaṃ devi yadi bhūmau nidhāpayet || 49 ||

dharayedathavā haste kaṇṭhe vā bāhumūlataḥ |
śikhāyāmathavā vastra yatra tatra sthitaṃ ca vā || 50 ||

cakrametanmahābhāge purakṣobhaṇamuktamam |
arkakṣīraṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca dhattūrakarasaṃ tathā || 51 ||

rocanālaktakaṃ lākṣārasaṃ mṛgamadotkaṭam |
ekīkṛtya cakrametallikhyate yasya saṃjñayā || 52 ||

tasya cauragrahavyādhiripusiṃhāhivārijam |
yakṣarākṣasavetālabhūtapretapiśācakāt || 53 ||

lūtāvṛścikakīṭādikāmalāśītikodbhavam |
bhayaṃ na vidyate tasya paramanrābhicārajam || 54 ||

nityaṃ saṃdhāraṇād devi kālamṛtyuyamādayaḥ |
na śaktā hiṃsituṃ samyagromaikamapi sarvadā || 55 ||

athavā madhyagāṃ devīṃ trikoṇodara (bhaya) gāṃ tathā |
adhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṅkumāṅkitām || 56 ||

nidhāpayecca saptāhād dāsavat kiṅkaro bhavet |
pītadravyeṇa saṃlikhya dhāraye(dindradiggatāṃ) || 57 ||

nāmnā sarvajñabhūto'pi mūko bhavati tatkṣaṇāt |
mahānīlīrasenāpi nāma saṃyojya pūrvavat || 58 ||

dakṣiṇābhimukho vahnau dagdhvā mārayate kṣaṇāt |
ekaṃ nīlapaṭaṃ samyak nīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayet || 59 ||

lambamānaṃ tadākāśe uccāṭayati tatkṣaṇāt |
mahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ gomūtreṇāṅkitaṃ likhet || 60 ||

kṣiptvāranālamadhyasthaṃ vidviṣṭaḥ sarvajantuṣu |
yuktvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣeṇa saṃlikhet || 61 ||

nīlīkarpaṭake samyaṃnīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayet |
lambamānaṃ tadākāśe paramuccāṭanaṃ bhavet || 62 ||

dugdhalākṣārocanābhirmahānīlīrasena ca |
likhitvā dhārayeccakraṃ cāturvaṇyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 63 ||

etenaiva vidhānena jalamadhye vinikṣipet |
saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya snānapānādibhirbhavet || 64 ||

etanmadhyagatāṃ devi nāgarīṃ vā varāṅganām |
saptāhāt kṣobhayetsatyaṃ jvalamānāṃ vicintya tām || 65 ||

mahāpātakayuktātmā yadi devīṃ prapūjayet |
śamīdūrvāsahāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥ || 66 ||

māsena hanti kaluṣaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ naraḥ |
likhitvā pītavarṇaṃ tu cakrametadyadārcayet || 67 ||

pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā stambhayet sarvavādinaḥ |
sindūrareṇulikhitaṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥ || 68 ||

yadā tadāsya vaśago loko bhavati sarvathā |
gaurikeṇatadālikhya pūjayet paścimāmukhaḥ || 69 ||

yaḥ sa sarvāṅganākarṣavaśyakṣobhakaro bhavet |
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayet || 70 ||

yasya nāmnā tasya nityaṃ mantrahānistu jāyate |
tadvad digantarāleṣu pūjitaṃ parameśvari || 71 ||

stambhavidveṣaṇavyādhiśatrūccāṭanakārakam |
rocanālikhitaṃ devi dugdhamadhye vaśaṅkaram || 72 ||

kṣiptaṃ gomūtramadhye tu śatrūccāṭanakārakam |
taila madhyagataṃ cakraṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param || 73 ||

jvalajjvalanamadhyasthaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam | 
athavā devadeveśi yadekānte catuṣpathe || 74 ||

tatsamīpe likheccakraṃ sindūreṇa mahāprabham |
sarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvari || 75 ||

akārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ tatra vinyaset |
pūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa yaḥ || 76 ||

p. 401)

sa tatkṣaṇānmahādevi sādhakaḥ khecaro bhavet |
pūjayitvā maheśāni tadvadekatarau girau || 77 ||

ajarāmaratāṃ satyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mahābhūtadine vāpi śmaśāne yadi pūjayet || 78 ||

pūrvavanniśi deveśi sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
pādukākhaḍgavetālasiddhadravyamahodayān || 79 ||

añjanaṃ vivaraṃ ceṭīṃ yakṣīṃ dūragatiṃ tathā |
yatkiñcit siddhisantānaṃ vidyate bhuvanatraye || 80 ||

tatsarvameva sahasā sādhayet sādhakottamaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 81 ||

iti | atra sarvatra maṇḍalāvadhi kartavyatā | jape vāyutasaṃkhyā jñeyā || 
atha kūṭatrayasādhanaṃ tatraiva  -

etasyāḥ śṛṇu deviśi bījatritayasādhanam |
dhavalāmbarasamvīto dhavalāmbaramadhyagaḥ || 1 ||

pūjayeddhavalaiḥ puṣpairbrahmacaryadharo naraḥ |
dhavalaireva naivedyairdadhikṣīraudanādibhiḥ || 2 ||

sakalpadhavalairvāpi yathākāmaphalapradām |
sampūjya parameśāni dhyāyedvāgīśvarīṃ parām || 3 ||

bījarūpāmullasantīṃ tato'naṅgapadāvadhi |
brahmagranthi vinirbhidya jihvāgre bīja rūpiṇīm || 4 ||

cintayennaṣṭahṛdayo grāmyo mūrkho'tipātakī |
śaṭho'pi yaḥ padaṃ spaṣṭamakṣaraṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ || 5 ||

jaḍo mūko'pi durmedhā gataprajño vinaṣṭadhīḥ |
so'pi sañjāyate vāgmī vācaspatirivāparaḥ || 6 ||

satpaṇḍitaghaṭāṭopajetā'pratihataprabhaḥ |
sattarkapadavākyārthaśabdālaṅkārasāravit || 7 ||

vātoddhata samudrormimālātulyairupanyaset |
sukumāratarasphārarītyalaṅkārapūrvakaiḥ || 8 ||

padagumphairmahākāvyakartā deveśi jāyate |
vedavedāṅgavedāntasiddhāntajñānapāragaḥ || 9 ||

jyotiḥśāstretihāsādimīmāṃsāsmṛtivākyavit |
prāṇarasavādādigāruḍānekamantravit || 10 ||

pātālaśāstravijñānabhūtatantrārthatattvavit |
vicitracitrakarmādiśilpānekavicakṣaṇaḥ || 11 ||

mahāvyākaraṇodāraśabdasaṃskṛtasarvagīḥ |
sarvabhāṣārutajñānī samastalipikarmakṛt || 12 ||

nānāśāstrārthaśikṣādivettā bhuvanaviśrutaḥ |
sarvavāṅmayavettā ca sarvajño devi jāyate || 13 ||

evameṣā mahādevi vāgbhavasya tu sādhanā |
tatastu śṛṇu deveśi kāmarājasya sādhanam || 14 ||

tathā kāmakalārūpā madanāṅkuragocarā |
udayādityabimbābhā samujjvalavapuḥ priye || 15 ||

sphuraddīpaśikhākārā bindudhārāpravarṣiṇī |
samastabhuvanābhogakavalīkṛtajīvitā || 16 ||

mahāsvamahīmākrāntasvacchā haṃkṛtibhūmikā |
krameṇa tu tato'naṅgaparyantaṃ prollasantyapi || 17 ||

śarīrānaṅgaparyantamekaikamubhayātmikā |
tato bhavati deveśi sarvaśṛṅgāramāninām || 18 ||

rāgiṇāṃ sādhako devi bādhako madanādhikaḥ |
taddṛṣṭipathagā nārī surī vāpyathavāsurī || 19 ||

vidyādharī kinnarī vā yakṣī nāgāṅganāthavā |
pracaṇḍatarabhūpālakanyakā siddhakanyakā || 20 ||

jvalanmadanaduḥprekṣyadahanottaptamānasā |
klinnā pracalitāpāṅgā vimūḍhā madavihvalā || 21 ||

niveditātmasarvasvā vaśagā devi jāyate |
calajjalendusadṛśī bālārkakiraṇāruṇā || 22 ||

cintitāṃ yoṣitāṃ yanau saṃkṣobhayati tatkṣaṇāt |
saiva sindūravarṇābhā hṛdaye cintitā satī || 23 ||

saṃmohonmādanāviṣṭacittākarṣakarī smṛtā |
niyojitāthavā mūrdhni varṣantī raktabindubhiḥ || 24 ||

dhāraṇāsaṃprayogeṇa karoti vaśagaṃ jagat |
athānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 25 ||

yena vijñātamātreṇa sādhako madanāyate |
kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmodarapuṭīkṛtam || 26 ||

kāmena kāmayet kāmaṃ kāmaṃ kāmeṣu nikṣipet |
kāmena kāmitaṃ kṛtvā kāmasthaṃ kṣobhayed dhruvam || 27 ||

pravakṣyāmi samāsena śaktibījasya sādhanam |
śaktibījasvarūpā tu sṛṣṭvā saṃharate yadā || 28 ||

sṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantaṃ śarīre paricintayet |
tato bhavati deveśi vainateya ivāparaḥ || 29 ||

p. 402)

nāgānāṃ darśanād devi jaḍīkaraṇakārakaḥ |
dāhināmamṛtāsāradhīradhārādharopamaḥ || 30 ||

sthirakṛtrimaśaṅkākhyaviṣopaviṣanāśanaḥ |
duṣṭavyādhigrahānīkaḍākinīrūpikāgaṇaiḥ || 31 ||

bhūtapretapiśācādyaistrinetra iva dṛśyate |
athavā yena vidyeyaṃ paripūrṇā vicintyate || 32 ||

janmamaṇḍalahṛtpadmamukhamaṇḍalamadhyagā |
kevalaiva maheśāni padmarāgasamaprabhā || 33 ||

tasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryamacirāt saṃpravartate |
manasā saṃsmaratyasyā yadi nāmāpi sādhakaḥ || 34 ||

tadaiva mātṛcakrasya vidito bhavati priye |
yadaiva jñāyate vidyā mahātripurasundarī || 35 ||

tadaiva mātṛcakrājñā saṃkrāmatyasya vigrahe |
sarvāsāṃ sarvasaṃsthānāṃ yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ || 36 ||

putravat parameśāni dhyānādeva hi sādhakaḥ |
yadā tu parameśāni paripūrṇāṃ prapūjayet || 37 ||

prayacchanti tadaivāsya khecarī siddhimuttamām |
catuḥṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām || 38 ||

cakrametatsamāśritya saṃsthitā vīravandite |
ādau sambandhini pade madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ || 39 ||

kulāṅganābhogaraṅge jāyate'naṅgavatpriye |
karaśuddhyādividyānāmekaikaṃ parameśvari || 40 ||

rudrayāmalatantre tu karma proktaṃ mayā purā |
taddhyānairmadano bhūtvā pāśāṅkuśadhanuḥśaraiḥ || 41 ||

kṣobhayet suralokasthāḥ pātālatalayoṣitaḥ |
tathaiva śāktairdeveśi tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥ || 42 ||

sādhayetsiddhagandharvadevavidyādharānapi |
tatra śāktā mahāvajraprastārajanitāḥ śarāḥ || 43 ||

mādanāstvādi parataḥ sarvādhastānniyojitāḥ |
ādyantago mahāpāśaḥ poruṣeyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 44 ||

rudraśaktiḥ kuṇḍalākhyā māyā strīpāśa ucyate |
turīyamaruṇāvargād dvitīyamapi pārvati || 45 ||

puṃstrīkodaṇḍayugalaṃ kāmāgnivyāpako'ṅkuśaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 46 ||

iti | jñānārṇave (14 pa0) -

gorocanādibhirdravyaiścakrarājaṃ samālikhet |
atīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ śubhām || 1 ||

jvalantīṃ nāmasahitāṃ kāmabījavidarbhitām |
cintayettu tato devi yojanaistu sahasraśaḥ || 2 ||

adṛṣṭapūrvā deveśi śrutamātrāpi durlabhā |
rājakanyāpyadṛśyā ca bhayalajjāvivarjitā || 3 ||

āyāti sādhakaṃ samyaṅmantramūḍhā satī priyā |
cakramadhyagato bhūtvā sādhakaścintayedyadā || 4 ||

udyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathā |
sādhyamapyaruṇībhūtaṃ cintayet parameśvari || 5 ||

anena kramayogena svayaṃ kandarpavigrahaḥ |
sarvasaundaryasubhagaḥ sarvalokavaśaṃkaraḥ || 6 ||

sarvaraktopacāraiśca mudrāsandhitavigrahaḥ |
cakraṃ prapūjayed yasya nāmarūpavidarbhitam || 7 ||

sa bhaveddāsavaddevi dhanāḍhyo vāpi bhūpatiḥ |
cakramadhyagataṃ kuryānnāma yasyāstu yoṣitaḥ || 8 ||

adṛṣṭa vā maheśāni yonimudrādharo budhaḥ |
haṭhādānayate śīghraṃ yakṣiṇīṃ rājakanyakām || 9 ||

nāgakanyāmapsarasaṃ khecarīṃ vā surāṅganām |
vidyādharīṃ divyarūpāmṛṣikanyāṃ ripustriyam || 10 ||

madanodbhayasantāpāṃ sphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām |
kāmavāṇavibhinnāntaḥkaraṇāṃ lolacakṣuṣam || 11 ||

mahākāmakalādhyānayogāttu suravandite |
kṣobhayet svargabhūrlokapātālatalayoṣitaḥ || 12 ||

rocanābhāgamekaṃ tu ekaṃ bhāgaṃ tu kuṅkumam |
atha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayetsamam || 13 ||

ekatra tilakaṃ kuryāttrailokyavaśakāriṇam |
aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayet || 14 ||

iti | śāradāyām (pa0 12 ślo0 65) -

bhāgadvayaṃ malayajaṃ bhāgaṃ kuṅkumakesaram |
ekaṃ gorocanāyāśca tāni piṣṭvā himāmbhasā || 1 ||

vidadhyāttilakaṃ bhāle yān paśyedyairvilokyate |
yān spṛśet spṛśyate yairvā vaśyāḥ syustasya te'cirāt || 2 ||

karpūrakapicorāṇi samabhāgāni kārayet |
caturbhāgā jaṭāmāṃsī tāvatī rocanā matā || 3 ||

p. 403)

kuṅkumaṃ saptabhāgaṃ syād dvibhāgaṃ candanaṃ matam |
agarurnavabhāgaḥ syāditi bhāgakrameṇa tu || 4 ||

himādbhiḥ kanyakāpiṣṭametatsarvaṃ susādhitam |
vidhāya tilakaṃ bhāle kuryādbhūmipatīna narān || 5 ||

vanitāṃ madagarvāḍhyāṃ madonmattānmataṅgajān |
siṃhavyāghrān mahāsarpān bhūtavetālarākṣasān || 6 ||

darśanādeva vaśayet tilakaṃ dhārayannaraḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 7 ||

iti | anyatra -

samastamantrakalpoktairdhyānahomajapādibhiḥ |
ye prayogāstu kathitāḥ siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||

iti vacanātmantrāntareṣu uktaprayogā api śrīvidyāviṣaye vijñeyāḥ | api 
ca -

tāvadagno na hotavyaṃ tatra tantroditaṃ yathā |
yāvadātmamahāvahnau manaḥpūrṇāhutiṃ hunet || 1 ||

svayaṃ hi tripurā devī lauhityaṃ tadvimarśanam |
pāśāṅkuśau tadīyau tu rāgadveṣātmakau smṛtau || 2 ||

śabdasparśādayo bāṇā manastasyā bhaveddhanuḥ |
vaśyapratītijanikāḥ śaktayaśca krameṇa yāḥ || 3 ||

pūrvapaścimakau dvārau prāṇāpānātmakau smṛtau |
kālāddāmābhibhūtāni navacakrāṇyanukramāt || 4 ||

karmaghīndriyacakrasthāṃ devīṃ saṃvitsvarūpiṇīm |
vihvāsahasta pūṣpaistu pūjayetsarvasiddhaye || 5 ||

ityādivacanairāntaropāsanā śreṣṭheti bodhyate || homa ityupalakṣaṇaṃ 
japādināmapyāntaratvamuktameva tantrāntareṣu | prayogāṇāmānantyād 
granthabāhulyaṃ manyamānena diṅmātrametat pradarśitam | etādṛśāni 
karmāṇi yaḥ kuryāt sādhakottamaḥ | ātmasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya 
mṛtyuñjayajapaṃ caret iti prāyaścittaśravaṇāt 
prayogāṇāmaniṣṭotpādatvamavadhāryate | 
tasmādvidvadbhirniṣkāmopāsanā kartavyeti siddham ||

athādhikāriṇaḥ kulārṇave -

nirastadeha (heya) karmāṇo mānavāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ |
samutpannakulajñānā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ || 1 ||

pūrṇābhiṣekasahitā vedaśāstrārthatattvagāḥ |
devatāgurubhaktāśca niyatāścārcanapriyāḥ || 2 ||

kulāgamarahasyajñā devatārādhanotsukāḥ |
gurūpadeśasaṃyuktāḥ pūjayeyuḥ kuleśvarīm || 3 ||

śuddhātmā cātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ krodhalaulyavivarjitaḥ |
paiśunyatādivimukhaḥ sumukhastarpayecchivām || 4 ||

kaulāḥ paśuvratasthāścet pakṣadvayaviḍambakāḥ |
keśasaṃkhyā smṛtā yāvattāvattiṣṭhānta raurave || 5 ||

iti | anyacca -

liṅgatrayaviśeṣajñaḥ ṣaḍādhāravibhedakaḥ |
pīṭhasthānāni cāgatya mahāpadmavanaṃ vrajet || 6 ||

āmūlādhāramāgatya brahmarandhraṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
ciccandramaṇḍale śaktisāmarasyasukhodayaḥ || 7 ||

vyomapaṅkajaniḥṣyandasudhāpānarato naraḥ |
madhupo māṃsasambhoktā tvitare madyapāyinaḥ || 8 ||

puṇyāpuṇyapaśuṃ hatvā jñānakhaḍgena yogavit |
pare śive layeccittaṃ palāśīti nigadyate || 9 ||

manasā cendriyagaṇaṃ niyamyātmani yojayet |
matsyāśī sa bhaveddevi śeṣāstu prāṇighātakāḥ || 10 ||

athāhantāṃ tathāsatyaṃ paiśunyaṃ krodhameva ca |
annaṃ nānāvidhaṃ caitadetānagnau juhoti yaḥ || 11 ||

kulīnaśeṣabhoktā syāt tadanye tvaghabhojinaḥ |
parāśaktyātmamithunasaṃyogānandanirbharaḥ || 12 ||

ya āste maithunaṃ tat syādaparaḥ strīniṣevakaḥ |
aprabuddhā parāśaktiḥ prabuddhaḥ kaulikasya yā || 13 ||

śaktiṃ tāṃ sevayedyastu sa bhavecchaktisevakaḥ |
ityādipañcamudrāṇāṃ vāsanāṃ kulanāyike || 14 ||

jñātvā gurumukhāddevi sevate yaḥ sa ucyate |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 15 ||

iti | api ca madhyānāṃ mukhamudrādikalpanāparikalpanam | dhyānaṃ 
śaktisamāveśaḥ sā mahatsāmarasyatā ityādi 
vacanairāntaropāsanāniṣṭhitasyaiva ca bāhyapūjādiṣvadhikāro dyotyate 
nānyasya | ayamadhikāraścāturvarṇyasādhāraṇyeneti vacanāni pūrvaṃ 
pradarśitāni | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām (31 pa0 35 ślo0) -

dīkṣitasyādhikāro'tra nānyasya parameśvari |
pustake likhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ jñātvā karoti yaḥ || 1 ||

p. 404)

brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyādi pātakaiḥ |
lipyate nātra sandeho narake nivasatyasau || 2 ||

iti | anyatrāpi guruṃ vilaṃghya śāstre'sminādhikāraḥ sureṣvapi iti || atha 
kāmyahomavidhiḥ | tatrādau tantroktaparipāṭyāgnicakraṃ vicārya 
saumyakrūragrahamukheṣvāhutipraveśaṃ vijñāya 
śubhagrahamukhapraveśadine śubhahomamaśubhagrahamukhapraveśadine 
vāśubhahomārambhaṃ kuryāt | tatparijñānaprakārastu 
sūryasthitanakṣatramārabhya candrasthitanakṣatraparyantaṃ gaṇayitvā 
pratigrahaṃ trīṇi trīṇi nakṣatrāṇi sūryādinavagrahebhyo vibhajya dadyāt | 
tatrādau sūryastato budhastattaḥ śukrastataḥ śanaiścarastataścandrastato 
bhaumastato gurustato rāhustataḥ keturiti grahāṇāṃ kramo jñeyaḥ | atra 
yasya trike homārambhastanmukhe tadāhutipraveśaḥ 
ityagnicakraparijñānaprakāraḥ || atra saumyahome sūrye śokaḥ budhe 
dhanāgamaḥ śukre'bhīṣṭaphalalābhaḥ śanau pīḍā candre saukhyaṃ 
bhaume bandhanaṃ gurau dhaprāptiḥ rāhau rogaḥ ketau mṛtyuriti 
grahāṇāṃ phalāni ||

atha svargamartyapātāleṣu vahneḥ sthitiṃ vijñāya tatphalāni ca jñātvā 
kāmyahomārambhaṃ kuryāt | tatparijñānaprakārastu | 
pratipadādihomatithiparyantaṃ gaṇayitvā tathā sūryavārādi 
homārambhavāraparyantaṃ ca gaṇavitvobhayatra 
labdhasaṃkhyākānaṅkānekonatriṃśāṅkairmelayitvā 
jātāṅkasamudāyaṃ tribhirhṛtvāvaśiṣṭāṅka ekaścedagniḥ svarge vasati 
dvayaṃ cet pātāle śūnyaścet martyaloke (iti pāvakasthitiṃ vijñāya 
tatphalāni nirdiśet | tatra svargasthite vahnāvutpātaḥ pātāle dhanakṣayo 
martyaloka) sthite sakalalokaprāptiḥ | itthaṃ vahnicakraṃ vijñāya prāgukte 
maṇḍape prāguktadvādaśarāśisthānagateṣu navasu kuṇḍeṣu 
prāguktamaṅgalāmaṅgalarūpeṣu prāguktavidhināgnisthāpanaṃ kṛtvā 
prāguktajihvābhedān vijñāya yathoktadravyairyathāvidhi juhuyāt || tatra 
saumyahomadravyāṇi jñānārṇave (17|152) -

mālatījātikāmallikusumairmadhumiśritaiḥ |
ghṛtapūrṇairhuned devi vāgīśatvaṃ prajāyate || 1 ||

mūkasyāpi hi mūḍhasya śilārūpasya nānyathā |
japāpuṣpairājyayuktaiḥ karavīraistathāvidhaiḥ || 2 ||

havanānmohayenmantrī lokatrayanivāsinaḥ |
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ devi miśraṃ mṛgamadena hi || 3 ||

havanānmadano devi mantriṇā vijito bhavet |
saubhāgyena vilāsena sāmarthyenāpi suvrate || 4 ||

campakaiḥ pāṭalairhutvā śriyaṃ prollasitāmbarām |
prāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimām || 5 ||

śrīkhaṇḍaṃ guggulaṃ candramaguru homayet tataḥ |
rājanāgendradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayet || 6 ||

sarvalokā vaśāstasya bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
lākṣāhomāllabhedrājyaṃ dāridryabhayapīḍitaḥ || 7 ||

durgopasargaśamanaṃ palatrimadhuhomataḥ |
dūrasthitānāṃ deveśi guruṇā proktamārgataḥ || 8 ||

homaḥ kāryo vaśyakāmairanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet |
rudhirāktena chāgasya māṃsena niśi homataḥ || 9 ||

madhuratrayayuktena guruṇoktavidhānataḥ |
pararāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ svavaśaṃ nayet || 10 ||

mahāpalena deveśi ripoḥ sainyaṃ vināśayet |
khecaro jāyate rātrau kṛtvā homaṃ catuṣpathe || 11 ||

kṣīraṃ madhu dadhi tvājyaṃ pṛthag hutvā varānane |
āyurdhanamahārogyasamṛddhirjāyate nṛṇām || 12 ||

krameṇa śailaje kṣīramadhubhyāṃ mṛtyunāśanam |
dadhimākṣikahomena saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt || 13 ||

sitayā kevalaṃ homo vairistambhanakārakaḥ |
kamalairaruṇairhomaḥ samyak sampattidāyakaḥ || 14 ||

raktotpalairjagadvaśyaṃ rājāno vaśyagāḥ kṣaṇāt |
nīlotpalairmahāduṣṭā vaśamāyānti nānyathā || 15 ||

śvetotpalaiḥ śriyaṃ vācaṃ labhate havanātpirye |
śvetaistu homātkamalairlakṣmīṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 16 ||

kahlārahavanānmantrī saubhāgyaṃ ca dhanaṃ labhet |
pūrṇabadarahomena vaśīkuryānmahīsurān || 17 ||

mātuli"gaphalodbhūtahomena kṣatriyā vaśe |
nāraṅgaphalahomena vaiśyā vaśtā bhavanti hi || 18 ||

kūṣmāṇḍaphalahomena śūdrā vaśyāstathā pare |
drākṣāphalaiḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau lakṣahomānna saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||

kadalīphalahomena lakṣamātreṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ |
vaśyāḥ syurdaśasaṃkhyākā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 20 ||

kharjūrīphalahomena lakṣamātreṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ |
vaśyā viṃśatisaṃkhyākā ityājñā pārameśvarī || 21 ||

p. 405)

nārikelaphalairhomātsamṛddhirjāyate priye |
lakṣamātreṇa mantrajño rājāpara iva priye || 22 ||

pasvāmraphalahomena lakṣamātreṇa sundari |
catuḥ samudraparyantā medinīṃ vaśamānayet || 23 ||

panasasya phalairhomāllakṣeṇa śatabhūbhujaḥ |
vaśyā bhavanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 24 ||

tilājyahomād deveśi kāryasiddhirbhavetpriye |
rājikālavaṇābhyāṃ tu duṣṭalokān vaśaṃ nayet || 25 ||

kuṃkumena hutedevi trailikyaṃ vaśamānayet |
guggulasya ca homena sarvaduḥkhāni nāśayet || 26 ||

vairiṇo vaśagāḥ śīghraṃ candanasyāpi homataḥ |
raktacandanahomena vaśyā hi puruṣāḥ striyaḥ || 27 ||

karpūrasya ca homena vāgvaśyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām |
kastūrihomato devi rājāno rājamantriṇaḥ || 28 ||

vaśyā bhavanti sakalāḥ parivārayutāḥ priye |
tilataṇḍulahomena śāntirbhavati mandire || 29 ||

śarkarāguḍahomena sitāyuktena mantriṇaḥ |
trailokyaṃ vaśamāyāti dhānyasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 30 ||

nānāvidhāsrahomena dhānyasiddhirbhaved dhruvam |
sopaskaraiśca vaṭakairupasargān vināśayet || 31 ||

bandhūkakusumairhomāt sarvasattvān vaśaṃ nayet |
japāpuṣpairjagadvaśyaṃ bāṇapuṣpaiśca mohanam || 32 ||

vakulasya hunet puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyaṃ jāyate mahat |
daśāṅgadhūpahomena saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet || 33 ||

iti | kulamūlāvatāre -

māṃsī śivā kauśikasarjamajjābhāgāḥ samaṃ vṛkṣarujaḥ kramārdham 
|
śaileyamustākarajaṃ ca kuṣṭhaṃ sarvārthakhaṇḍaḥ kathito daśāṅgaḥ ||

iti | tathā -

jambūphalaiḥ strīyo vaśyāḥ kūṣmāṇḍairdaityakanyakāḥ |
śrīphalairatulā lakṣmīḥ patrairvā suravandite || 34 ||

ikṣukhaṇḍaiḥ sukhāvāptistadrasādrājakanyakāḥ |
vaśyā bhavanti deveśi nārikelajalena vā || 35 ||

kevalaṃ ghṛtahomena varadāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | tathā tantrarāje - (32 pa0)

atha homaṃ pravakṣyāmi lalitāvidyā śive |
yena martyo'pi bhuvane prakhyāto devatāsamaḥ || 1 ||

tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe dravyakālādibhedataḥ |
prokteṣu navakuṇḍeṣu tatakarmasu codite || 2 ||

juhuyāduktamārgeṇa tatrāgnidhyānapūrvakam |
śuklapratipadārambhātpūrṇāntaṃ kamalairhunet || 3 ||

kairavairhavanāt teṣu dineṣu śriyamāpnuyāt |
madhuratrayasaṃsiktaiḥ puṣpairapyaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 4 ||

akhaṇḍitairabdamātrānnaro nṛpatisannibhaḥ |
teṣveva divaseṣvabjaiḥ sitaistaddhavanād ghṛtaiḥ || 5 ||

kahlārairhavanātteṣu dineṣu dhanadhānyavān |
tathaivotpalahomena śriyamāpnoti puṣkalām || 6 ||

aruṇairutpalairhomātkanyakāṃ samavāpnuyāt |
ketakairhavanātteṣu dineṣu śriyamāpnuyāt || 7 ||

saubhāgyaṃ kīrtimārogyamavāmotyarcanādapi |
taiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuṃkumakṣodāplutaistaddinahomataḥ || 8 ||

acalāṃ ca śriyaṃ prāpya sukhī jīvati bhūtale |
taiścandanāktairhavanāttaddineṣu yathāvidhi || 9 ||

putradāsīdāsayutaściraṃ jīvati mānavaḥ |
tairevendudravāktaistu homātkandarpasannibhaḥ || 10 ||

nārījanaiḥ saha naro dīrghāyurbahu jīvati |
kṛṣṇapratipadārambhād darśāntaṃ juhuyācca taiḥ || 11 ||

vṛttāktairabdamātreṇa niḥsapatnāṃ labhecchriyam |
teṣveva divaseṣvagno guḍaiḥ kṣaudrāplutairhunet || 12 ||

kāntilakṣmījayārogyayuto jīvati bhūtale |
drākṣābhirdugdhasiktābhistaddinairhavanānnaraḥ || 13 ||

kṣīrāhārī ciraṃ bhūmau jīvatyakaluṣāśayaḥ |
kharjūrīphalahomena trimadhvaktena taddinaiḥ || 14 ||

āyurārogyavijayasampannāṃ śriyamaśnute |
kadalīphalahomena tathā taddivaseṣu ca || 15 ||

puṇyakīrtirnṛpairmānyo jivedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī |
nārikelaphalakṣodaiḥ sitākṣaudrasamanvitaḥ || 16 ||

p. 406)

havanāttaddinairiṣṭamakhilaṃ samavāpnuyāt |
tairikṣuvārisaṃsiktairhavanāttaddineṣu vai || 17 ||

vāsāṃsi nānāvarṇāni mahārhāṇi labhet saḥ |
sarvaiśca taistrimadhvaktairhavanācchriyamāpnuyāt || 18 ||

taiḥ savatsasitāgavyapayoktairhavanādapi |
mahiṣīkṣīrasaṃsiktairhomādiṣṭamavāpnuyāt || 19 ||

ajākṣīraplutaistaiśca tathāvikṣīrasaṃplutaiḥ |
nārikelaphalakṣodakṣīrāktairapi tairhuned || 20 ||

tathā dvādaśabhirdravyairekaikaiḥ saṃhataistathā |
nityaśo havanād dugdhakṣaudrasarpiḥ samanvitaiḥ || 21 ||

(sampannasasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti sa niścitam) |
gobhūhiraṇyavāsobhiḥ samṛddho jīvati kṣitau || 22 ||

ravirāre sitānnaistu kṣīrāktairhavanāttathā |
abdādannasamṛddhiḥ syād ghṛtāktairvā madhuplutaiḥ || 23 ||

somavāre sitopetairnārikelaphalairhutaiḥ |
sampannaśasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti suniścitam || 24 ||

aṅgāravāre kṣaudrāktairannairhomācchriyaṃ labhet |
tairiṣṭabhūmṛṇmilitairhavanāttāṃ mahīṃ labhet || 25 ||

budhavāre ghṛtāktaistu homena tilataṇḍulaiḥ |
śriyaṃ sakalakalyāṇanilayāṃ labhate'bdataḥ || 26 ||

guruvāre dugdhasiktaiḥ panasāsthiparāgakaiḥ |
juhuyādabdamātreṇa labhate gehamuttamam || 27 ||

sitavāre nārikelakṣodaiḥ sitasamanvitaiḥ |
guḍānvitairvā juhuyātśriyā suciramedhate || 28 ||

śanivāre tailasiktaistilaiḥ śuddhaistathetaraiḥ |
havanāallabhate lakṣmīmabdādatimanoharām || 29 ||

taiḥ samastaiḥ samastāktairjuhuyātsaptasu kramāt |
taddinairindirāḍhyaḥ syādvidyāhavanavaibhavāt || 30 ||

tattaddineṣu tadbhaktyā dvau dvau trīṃstrīn subhojayet |
ghṛtakṣīrasitākṣaudraguḍāpūpasamanvitam || 31 ||

aśvinyādiṣu ṛkṣeṣu navasvapi hunetkramāt |
śālibhistaṇḍulairmudgairmāṣairgauretaraistilaiḥ || 32 ||

tathāvidhaiḥ sarṣapaiśca kodravairindirāptaye |
kṣaudrasarpistilairdugdhakerondekṣurasāplutaiḥ || 33 ||

mahiṣyajāvikākṣīraplutaistairnavasu kramāt |
maghādiṣu tathā homaṃ navabhiḥ syānnavasnapi || 34 ||

caṇakaiścaṇakānnaiśca mudagānnaiḥ kṛsaraistathā |
māṣānnaiśca haridrānnairguḍānnaiḥ pāyasairapi || 35 ||

susiddhānnaistrimadhvaktaiḥ kīrtilakṣmījayāptaye |
tathā mūlādinavake navabhirjuhuyāttathā || 36 ||

pṛthukaiḥ saktubhirlājairikṣukāṇḍaiḥ payaḥ plutaiḥ |
śālīcaṇakamudgotthairmāṣapiṣṭatilodbhavaiḥ || 37 ||

apūpairmadhurābhyaktairvijayaṃ kīrtimindirām |
ārogyamāyuḥ saubhāgyaṃ mānyatāṃ ca labhed dhruvam || 38 ||

siddhayogeṣu yaddravyairjurhuyāttatsamṛddhimān |
tathāmṛtākhyayogeṣu juhuyādrogaśāntaye || 39 ||

guḍūcītiladūrvābhistrimadhvaktābhirādarāt |
uccayogeṣu juhuyādaruṇairutpalairapi || 40 ||

uccairbhavati sarveṣāṃ svakulānāṃ suniścitam |
parvatākhye hunedyoge yaddravyaistadddhi parvatam || 41 ||

bhavedasyācireṇaiva kālena parameśvari |
athānyamadbhutaṃ homamākarṇaya vadāmi te || 42 ||

svakṣetrage svoccage vā juhuyād grahatṛptaye |
pāyasairghṛtasiktaistu sitāmiśraistu vidyayā || 43 ||

sarvadā yo hutavidhimenaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi |
tattatprokteṣu kāleṣu grahārtiḥ syānna tatkule || 44 ||

maseṣu janmatritaye homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi |
dūrvāmṛtātilairnityaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhī bhavet || 45 ||

taddineṣu japedvidyāṃ sahasraṃ dinanityayā |
na tasya kutracitkaścitkadācitkleśasambhavaḥ || 46 ||

tarpaṇaṃ kārayeccandravāsitairmadhurairjalaiḥ |
saurabhāḍhyaiḥ prasūnaiśca pūjayedvāpi taddine || 47 ||

(avandhyajanmatritayaṃ syātkadācinna māntrikaḥ ?) |
yadi syāttasya rogādipīḍā bhavati niścitam || 48 ||

uccasthe vā svarāśau vā sthite candre divākare |
vidyāṃ japetsahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā pūjayecchivām || 49 ||

yastasya rogato vādhā kadācinna bhaveddhruvam |
tasmādukteṣu kāleṣu tathā kurvan sukhī bhavet || 50 ||

graharogādidāridryakleśayuktasya mantriṇaḥ |
māntrikatvaṃ bhavelloke śokahāsāspadaṃ bhavet || 51 ||

palāśapuṣpaiśca phalaiḥ patraiḥ kāṇḍaiśca mūlakaiḥ |
havanādabdamātreṇa vāgmī syātkuṇṭhavāgapi || 52 ||

p. 407)

arkapuṣpaistrimadhvaktairhomādiṣṭamavāpnuyāt |
maṇḍalāttasya patraiśca samidbhirapi mūlataḥ || 53 ||

vilvaprasūnaistu phalaiḥ patraiḥ kāṇḍaistathā hunet |
mūlaiśca lakṣmīsaṃsiddhyai mā tadanvayagā bhavet || 54 ||

padmākṣairmadhurābhyaktairhomāttāvaddinairnaraḥ |
indirāṃ labhate ramyāṃ sarvalokacamatkṛtām || 55 ||

campakairmadhusaṃmiśrairjuhuyāttaddināvadhi |
āḍhyaḥ syādaprajāḥ putrānavāpnoti guṇānvitān || 56 ||

tairevājyaplutairhomānmaṅgale tūccasaṃsthite |
labheta sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ bhuvaṃ  bhoktā ca jāyate || 57 ||

taiḥ kṣīrāktairhutaiścandre svoccage taddinairbhavet |
śataguḥ sādhakastadvattrimadhvaktairlabhettrayam || 58 ||

pāṭalaiḥ kṣaudrasaṃsiktairhomānkanyāmavāpnuyāt |
tagarotthairapi tathā lājaiśca kuṭajairapi || 59 ||

taiḥ kṣīramiśrairhavanāccaturbhirlabhate dhanam |
ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi ca taddinaiḥ || 60 ||

śatapatraistrimadhvaktairhomāllakṣmīmavāpnuyāt |
kesaraiśca kadambaiśca kundairvicakilairapi || 61 ||

mallikā mālatī jātī punnāgaiśca namerubhiḥ |
juhuyātprathamārambhe pañcamyantaṃ madhuplutaiḥ || 62 ||

ekaikaśaḥ samastaiśca mahālakṣmīmavāpnuyāt |
taireva kṣīramilitairhomātsvarṇamavāpnuyāt || 63 ||

tathājyāktaiśca havanāllabhate bhūṣaṇaiḥ śriyam |
prasūnaiḥ karṇikārotthaiḥ kṣaudrāktairhavanāddinaiḥ || 64 ||

uditairacalāṃ lakṣmīmavāpnoti suniścitam |
kahlārai raktakumudairutpalaiḥ kamaladvayaiḥ || 65 ||

prāgvannandādipūrṇāntamekaikairvātha pañcabhiḥ |
havanāllabhate lakṣmīṃ sabhūbhūṣaṇavāhanām || 66 ||

trimadhvaktestathaikaikaiḥ sarvervā sādhakottamaḥ |
ketakīkusumaiḥ kṣaudraplutairhomācca taddinaiḥ || 67 ||

vāsāṃsi labhate citrāṇyanarghāṇi bahūnyapi |
sitaiḥ prasūnaiḥ kṣīrāktairhomādāpnoti taddinaiḥ || 68 ||

sitāni vāsāṃsi tathā muktādāmāni rūpyakam |
hunenmaruvakaiḥ kṣaudraplutairvāñchitasiddhaye || 69 ||

tathā damanakaiḥ patrairhavanācchriyamaśnute |
yadvarṇāni prasūnāni juhuyādvidyayā priye || 70 ||

tadvarṇānyeva vāsāṃsi labhate sādhako dhruvam |
maricaiḥ sarṣapaistailaplutairhomānniśātu vai || 71 ||

lajjāmānakulatyāgalolāmiṣṭāṃ samānayet |
pāṭalīkundamandāraśephālikusumodbhavaiḥ || 72 ||

campakāśokapuṃnāganamerukusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
havanādvaśayetsarvavanitāḥ kṣaudrasaṃplutaiḥ || 73 ||

tairevājyaplutairhomād vaśayetpuruṣānapi |
te rājyalakṣmīṃ labhate ghṛtāktairhavanānniśi || 74 ||

samastajīvabhuvanaṃ vaśayettaiḥ sitānvitaiḥ |
anairghṛtāplutairnityaṃ havanādannavān bhavet || 75 ||

tathaiva juhuyānnityamāyuṣe tilataṇḍulaiḥ |
madhyarātre tu lavaṇaiḥ suśliṣṭaparicūrṇitaiḥ || 76 ||

trimadhvaktairhutaiḥ sarvānvaśayedaṅganājanān |
tathā dadhyanvitairloṇairhomād dveṣyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 77 ||

tathā puṇḍrekṣutoyāktairhutaiḥ syurvaśagā nṛpāḥ ||
ājyaistu kevalairhomād dinairuktairdhanī bhavet || 78 ||

nityaśo ghṛtahomena śrīmān bhogo ca jāyate |
snāto'nuliptaḥ sragvī ca sitagandhasragambaraḥ || 79 ||

sampūjya devīṃ tuṣṭātmā saṃskṛte havyavāhane |
savatsāyāḥ sitāyā goḥ payasi dviguṇe pacet || 80 ||

prasthamātraṃ taṇḍūlaṃ tu śālijaṃ sitameva ca |
sitadugdhaghṛtopetaṃ kṛtvā vaisikthakaṃ mahat || 81 ||

gṛhītvā pāṇinā vidyāṃ japitvā śatavārakam |
śriyaṃ me devi dehīti proktvā kāṣṭhojjvale'nale || 82 ||

hutvā samāpya pūjāṃ tu tathā bhuktvā tu taddinam |
maunī tu gamayedabdāt śriyaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalām || 83 ||

nirantaraṃ nityaśaśca juhuyāccettadanvayam |
na kadāpi ramā muñcatyadbhutā mantraśaktayaḥ || 84 ||

pāyasairjuhuyāt pūrṇāsvarkavāreṣu sādhakaḥ |
nivedayecca pūjāyāmabdādāḍhyatamo bhavet || 85 ||

savatsāruṇavarṇāyā goḥ kṣīrānnavanītakam |
taddinānnaṃ tu kahlāraprasūne nikṣipettataḥ || 86 ||

taduddhṛtya hunedagnau bhaumavāre taduccake(ge) |
kāle tāvaddinairlakṣmīṃ bhūṣā(myā)ḍhyāṃ labhate dhruvam || 87 ||

tathā dhavalarūpāyā navanītaṃ sitāmbuje |
nidhāyādāya maunena hunedagnau bhṛgordine || 88 ||

p. 408)

saptavāraprayogeṇa mahatīmāpnuyācchriyam |
