nṛpamānyāṃ sarvahṛdyāṃ nānābhogānvitāṃ śubhām || 89 ||

tathāruṇāsamudbhūtanavanītaṃ raverdine |
nidhāya vikace padme karṇikāyāṃ tatastu tat || 90 ||

juhuyādaṣṭabhirvārairāḍhyaḥ syāt sādhakaḥ śive |
karṇikārasya puṣpāṇi tathā campakajānyapi || 91 ||

juhuyānnavanītāktānyucce svoccagate gurau |
nirātaṅkāmahāryyāṃ ca rājacaurāpahārakaiḥ || 92 ||

prāpnoti mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ tā tadanvayagāminī |
kevalaṃ navanītena sitopetena homataḥ || 93 ||

kīrtilakṣmīdhanārogyavijayairāyurāpnuyāt |
bandhūkaiḥ kiṃśukaiścūtaistrimadhvaktairhutakriyā || 94 ||

saubhāgyalakṣmīvijayakāntiprajñāvahā bhavet |
dadhyannahomādannāḍhyaḥ sādhakaḥ syāt trimāsataḥ || 95 ||

ādreṣu tālapatrasya khaṇḍeṣu nijavāṃchitam |
vilikhya navanītena sametaṃ juhuyānniśi || 96 ||

maṇḍalānmāsato vārāt prāpnotyeva svavāñchitam |
tathā palāśaparṇeṣu vilikhya daradairhunet || 97 ||

kuṃkumaiścūtapatreṣu likhitvā vā hunenniśi |
candanaiḥ pānase patre vilikhya juhuyāttathā || 98 ||

pakṣakṣodairvilikhyeṣṭaṃ nāgavallīdaleṣu taiḥ |
hutairavāpnoti nijavāñchitaṃ proktakālataḥ || 99 ||

kastūrīlikhitaṃ tviṣṭaṃ patre campakabhūruhaiḥ |
tairhutaistadavāpnoti taddinaistadvidhānataḥ || 100 ||

elālavaṅgakakkolajātīphalasamanvitaiḥ |
sitairālikhya ca sveṣṭaṃ patre padmasamudbhave || 101 ||

juhuyāttasya saṃsiddhyairbahubhiḥ kimihoditaiḥ |
nāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyāhomairudīritaiḥ || 102 ||

iti | atha krūrahomaḥ | tatra tantrarāje (31 pa0) -

sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ ca homaṃ te kathitaṃ parameśvari |
idānīṃ sthūlahomaṃ tu kathayāmyarimardanam || 1 ||

tattatkarmodite kuṇḍe kuryaddhomamudīritaiḥ |
vidhānairdveṣanidhanaroganigrahacāṭanam || 2 ||

āyurdāyaṃ riporjñātvā lagnoktarkṣānukūlataḥ |
tadātmakagrahāṇāṃ ca sthitimaṣṭakavargakam || 3 ||

trayāṇāmānukūlye na kuryāttadabhicārakam |
anyathā krūrakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ nāśayanti hi || 4 ||

tānyeva karmāṇi tatastattrayaprātikūlyataḥ |
kuryāt taddevatābhaktimāstikyaṃ vartanaṃ gurum || 5 ||

tatpārśvavartimantrajñānālocya ripunigraham |
vidadhyādanyathā śakti naiṣphalyaṃ vātmanāśanam || 6 ||

riporaṣṭamalagne ca kāle tvaṣṭamarāśige |
sthāne kuryādaniṣṭāni tadvināśāya sādhakaḥ || 7 ||

prācyāṃmeṣavṛṣau vahnau mithunaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā |
kulīrasiṃhamatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitā || 8 ||

tulākīṭau paścimato dhanurvāyau tu saṃsthitam |
nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīna īśe tu susthitam || 9 ||

evaṃ rāśikramaṃ jñātvā kuryāt karmāṇi deśitaḥ |
kāle tu pañca pañcasyurghaṭikāḥ kramayogataḥ || 10 ||

caitrādiṣu ca māseṣu dvādaśasvapi bhāskaraḥ |
meṣādirāśigo yāti tathānyairgrahamaṇḍalaiḥ || 11 ||

deheṣu prāṇināṃ tadvadaṣṭāṃgulivibhedataḥ |
mūrddhāṃdicaraṇāntaṃ tu tān dvādaśasu lakṣayet || 12 ||

trayāṇāmānuguṇyena kuryāt karmāṇi nānyathā |
śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi phalantyevaṃ kṛte dhruvam || 13 ||

tathāhani viṣasthānānyamṛtasthānakāni ca |
jñātvā vidadhyātputtalyāḥ prayogaṃ sarvatastathā || 14 ||

site hṛdiṃ stanagale nāsākṣiṇi tathā śrutau |
bhrūśaṅkhamūrdhamadhyeṣu tatra bhrūśaṅkhamadhyataḥ || 15 ||

karṇe netre nāsikāyāṃ vartate puruṣasya tu |
savyakaṇṭhe stanataṭe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyake || 16 ||

jānusandhyaṃghripārśveṣu tathāṃguṣṭhe ca dakṣiṇe |
aṅgau sandhau jānuguhye nābhau ceti sitetare || 17 ||

tiṣṭhedvikalā puṃsi striyāṃ vāmādi vartate |
viṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne vedhayetkaṇṭhakena tu || 18 ||

saṃkocakākhyena tathā tīvreṇāsthimayena vai |
badarādisamutthairvā tathāyaḥ sārasūcibhiḥ || 19 ||

puttalyāṃ yatra tadviddhaṃ tadaṅgaṃśatrudehajam |
vyādhinā pīḍitaṃ kālādavidheyaṃ bhaved dhruvam || 20 ||

tatra tenārtinā kliṣṭo jīviteśapuraṃ vrajet |
puttalīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nigrahasiddhaye || 21 ||

p. 409)

bhaumaśukrabudhāścandro bhāskaraḥ saumyabhārgavau |
maṅgalo gurumandārkiguravoṃ'śakarāśipāḥ || 22 ||

nakṣatrāṇi catuṣpādānyevaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
etāvatyaśca puttalyastvaṃśakakramayogataḥ || 23 ||

prathame navake candrabhāskarāṃśakayoḥ kramāt |
ṣoḍaśa dvādaśa tathā mānamaṃgulisaṃkhyayā || 24 ||

anyāṃśakeṣu sarvāśca caturdaśa samīritāḥ |
dvitīye navake'nyeṣāmadhyardhāḥ syustrayodaśa || 25 ||

tṛtīye navake'nyeṣāṃ trayodaśa samīritam |
candrārkayorekavidhaḥ proktasaṃkhyākramastathā || 26 ||

puttalīkaraṇe dravyaṃ cakrihastamṛdānvitam |
citāmṛdbhasmalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīpippalikāyutam || 27 ||

maricaṃ gṛhadhūmaṃ ca laśunaṃ hiṃgusaindhavam |
gairikaṃ ceti kathitaṃ puttalīdravyamīśvari || 28 ||

sādhyakṣaiḥ piṣṭaiśca māṣacūrṇaiśca sikthakaiḥ |
vairidehajaromādyairupetaiḥ puttalīkriyā || 29 ||

puttalīdairghyamānaṃ tu kṛtvāṣṭāṃśamathaikataḥ |
śīrṣe trayāt kaṭerūrdhvaṃ trayāt pādadvayaṃ tathā || 30 ||

kaṭiprapadayorekarmaśamevaṃ tu puttalīm |
vidhāya tantre sarvatra prayogānācarettataḥ || 31 ||

pātālayoge nīcākhye viṣayoge ca mṛtyuje |
nāśayoge ca dinajamṛtyau krakacayogake || 32 ||

caṇḍīśacaṇḍāyudhake mahāśūle ca kāṇake |
raktasthūṇe kaṇṭakākhye sthūṇe pañcārkasaṃjñake || 33 ||

kuryāt prayogān pratyarthibhaṅgāya maraṇāya ca |
nigrahāya nirīkṣyaiva kuryāt siddhimavāpnuyāt || 34 ||

vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣastambhanoccāṭamāraṇe |
vidadhyāt puttalīḥ samyak catasraḥ proktayogataḥ || 35 ||

piṣṭena sikthena tathā cakrihastamṛdāpi ca |
sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇāpyuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ || 36 ||

āsane pādayoḥ sthāne kuṇḍamadhye ca sādhakaḥ |
viṣṭamṛttarujāḥ khātvā sthāpayet sikthamambare || 37 ||

kuṇḍamadhyāduparyūrddhapadāṃ nyacchīrṣikāmapi |
evaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt karma samīritam || 38 ||

iti | athaiteṣāṃ viṣamapadavyākhyā tatra nigrahaśabdo yuddhādiṣu 
parājayaviṣayaḥ | āyurdāyamityādināśanamityantānāṃ caturṇāṃ 
ślokānāmayamarthaḥ riporabhicārakāle jyotiḥśāstre 
horāskandhoktaprakāreṇa tasya tātkālināyurdāyaṃ gocarāṣṭakavargeṣu 
grahāṇāṃ sthitiṃ ca vicāryaitattrayānukūlye sati tasyābhicārakarma 
kuryāt tatprātikūlye tu na kuryāt | tamanavekṣya kriyamāṇāni 
krūrakarmāṇi yataḥ kurvāṇameva nāśayanti ataḥ sarvathā 
nirīikṣyaivaṃ kuryāt iti | atha ca śatrordevatābhaktimāstikyamācāraṃ 
guruṃ tatpārśvavartino māntrikānapi jñātvā teṣāmānubhāvādikaṃ 
tadvidbhirālocya tatprābalye sati tadabhicārādikaṃ na kuryāditi ||

riporityādiślokasyāyamarthaḥ tatra 
śatrorjanmarkṣarāśeścandralagnarāśervāṣṭame lagne tadudayakāle 
vakṣyamāṇadvādaśarāśisthāneṣu riporaṣṭamarāśige sthāne 
tadvināśāya karma kuryāditi ||

prācyāmityādiślokadvayasyāyamevārthaḥ | 
tatrābhicārādikarmakaraṇārthaṃ racite maṇḍapādau caturastrībhūte 
navadhā vibhakte pūrvadiggatakhaṇḍe uttaradakṣiṇe krameṇa 
meṣavṛṣayoḥ sthānadvayam āgneyyāṃ mithunasya dakṣiṇe 
pūrvapaścimakrameṇa karkasiṃhayoḥ nair-ṛtyāṃ kanyāyāḥ paścime 
dakṣiṇottarakrameṇa (tulāvṛścikayoḥ vāyavyāṃ dhanuṣaḥ uttare 
paścimapūrvakrameṇa makara) kumbhayoḥ īśāne mīnasyeti | 
susthitamityanena kālacakrastharāśicakravanna bhramatītyuktam ||

evamityādiślokasyāyamarthaḥ uktakrameṇa deśeṣu rāśisthitikramaṃ 
jñātvā kāle'pi sūryādhiṣṭhitarāśyāditaḥ pratirāśi 
pañcapañcaghaṭikā bhramayogena dvādaśarāśyudayakāle'pi jñātvā 
krūrakarmāṇi kuryāditi | rāśīnāṃ nyūnādhikabhāvastu deśa (kāla) 
yorvaiṣamyād gaṇitaśāstreṣūktaḥ tadatrāprayojakamiti ||

caitrādiṣvityasya ślokasyāyamarthaḥ caitrādiṣu sauramāseṣu 
meṣādyekaikarāśibhuktikrameṇa jyotiḥśāstre tattadgrahaparivṛtti 
proktakālaviśeṣaiścandrādigrahamaṇḍalaiḥ saha sūryo yātīti ||

deheṣvityādiślokasyāyamarthaḥ samastaprāṇināṃ deheṣu 
meṣādimīnāntakrameṇa aṣṭāṃgulakrameṇa dvādaśasthāneṣu 
dvādaśa rāśīn lakṣayediti |

p. 410)

trayāṇāmityādyasyāyamarthaḥ deśakāladehātmakānāmānukūlyena 
vakṣyamāṇakarmāṇi kṛtāni phaladāni bhavantītyanyathā na bhavantīti ||

tathetyādiślokasyāyamarthaḥ tatrāhani prayogadivase 
tathetyamṛtasthānakānītyatrānvayaḥ | tāni tu 
pādāṃguṣṭhapadagulphajānuliṅganābhihṛtstanagalanāsākṣikarṇa-
bhrūśaṅkhamūrdhākhyāni eteṣu sthāneṣu śuklapakṣe pūrvaṃ 
(puruṣa) dakṣiṇapādāṃguṣṭhamārabhya mūrdhāntaṃ tatpārśvastheṣu 
pañcadakṣasu prokteṣu sthāneṣu tatprathamādipūrṇāntaṃ pañcadaśasu 
tithiṣu pratitithi ekasmin sthāne ekā kaleti 
yathākramamārohakramādamṛtakalāyāḥ sthitirbhavati | kṛṣṇapakṣe tu 
śirovāmabhāgādivāmapādāṃguṣṭhānteṣu prokteṣu pañcadaśasu 
sthāneṣu pūrṇānantaraṃ pratipadamārabhyāmāvāsyāntaṃ 
pañcadaśasu tithiṣu pratitithi 
yathākramamavarohaṇakrameṇāmṛtakalāsthitirbhavati | strīṇāṃ tu 
śirodakṣiṇabhāgādi dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhāntaṃ prokteṣu pañcadaśasu 
sthāneṣu pūrṇānantaraṃ pratipadādidarśāntaṃ pañcadaśasu tithiṣu 
pratitithi yathākramamavarohakrameṇa amṛtakalāsthitirbhavati | 
dakṣapādāṃguṣṭhādiśirodakṣiṇabhāgānteṣu prokteṣu pañcadaśasu 
sthāneṣu darśānantaraṃ pratipadamārabhya pūrṇāntapañcadaśasu 
tithiṣu pratitithi yathākramamārohakrameṇāmṛtakalāyāḥ sthitirbhavati || 
viṣasthānāni vakṣyamāṇāni |

sitetyādisārdhatrayaślokasyārthaḥ tatra śuklapakṣaprathamā 
(tipadā)didarśāntāsu triṃśattithiṣu puruṣāṇāṃ dakṣiṇabhāge 
hṛdayādimūrdhānteṣu navasu sthāneṣu punastadvāmapārśve 
mūrdhādipādāṃguṣṭhāntaṃ pañcadaśasu sthāneṣu 
punardakṣiṇapādāṃguṣṭhādinābhyantaṃ ṣaṭsu sthāneṣu ca sambhūya 
triṃśatsthāneṣu ca strīṇāṃ tu tattattithiṣu 
tattatsthāneṣudakṣiṇavāmapārśvavyatyayakrameṇa viṣaparivṛttirbhavatīti 
||

viṣanāḍyāmityādisārdhatrayaślokasyārthaḥ tatra 
saptaviṃśatinakṣatreṣu pratinakṣatraṃ jyotiḥśāstre 
proktaviṣātmakanāḍīcatuṣṭayakāle śatrupratikṛtirūpaputtalyā dehe 
proktaviṣasthāne saṅkocakākhyamatsyaviśeṣasya dehotthatīvrāsthnā 
badarādikaṇṭakairvā vedhāt śatrostattadaṅgavyādhipīḍātaḥ prayogasya 
gauravalāghavādinā śīghraṃ vilambena vā mṛtyurbhavatīti ||

bhaumetyādiślokasyāyamarthaḥ tatrārkiḥ śanaiścaraḥ | bhaumādayo 
grahā meṣādidvādaśarāśīnāmaśvinyāditribhirnakṣatrodbhava-
dvādaśadvādaśāṃśakānāṃ ca krameṇādhipataya ityarthaḥ ||

nakṣatrāṇītyasya ślokasyārthaḥ aśvinyādisaptaviṃśatinakṣatrāṇi 
pratinakṣatraṃ 
catuścaraṇakrameṇāṣṭottaraśatacaraṇairaṣṭottaraśatāṃśakā bhavanti 
teṣāmaṣṭottaraśataputtalikā bhavanti ||

prathametyādiślokatrayasyāyamarthaḥ 
tatrāśvinyādyaśleṣāntanavanakṣatrāṃśakeṣu 
sūryasomayoraṃśakaputtalīnāṃ krameṇa dvādaśāṃgulaṃ 
ṣoḍaśāṃgulaṃ ca mānaṃ bhavati | bhaumādīnāṃ 
caturdaśāṃgulamānaṃ maghādijyeṣṭhāntadvitīyanavakāṃśakānāṃ 
somasūryayoḥ prāgvadbhaumādīnāṃ sārdhatrayodaśāṃgulamānaṃ 
mūlādirevatyantatṛtīyanavakāṃśakānāṃ bhaumādināṃ 
trayodaśāṃgulamānaṃ sūryasomayoḥ prāgvat ||

puttalīkaraṇe ityādiślokatrayasyārthaḥ tatra cakrihastamṛt kulālahastamṛt 
citāmṛdbhasmasahitaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca śuṇṭhyādicūrṇitaṃ laśunaṃ 
rasonarasa sādhyarkṣavṛkṣaḥ sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣaḥ siktakaṃ 
madhūcchiṣṭaṃ śatrudehajaromādyairityādyaśabdena 
tannakhapādaparśu ca gṛhyate | atrāyaṃ nirgalitārthaḥ | 
śatrunakṣatravṛkṣeṇaikā puttalī kāryā kulālahastamṛttikayetarā 
māṣapiṣṭenāparā madhūcchiṣṭena cetarā iti catasraḥ puttalyaḥ 
sarvakarmasu kāryāḥ | tatra krūrakarmaṇi śuṇṭyādidravyāṣṭakaṃ 
citābhasmādibhasma śatrudeharomādīni ca yathāyogyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtāni 
mṛttikāyāṃ piṣṭe madhucchiṣṭe ca melayitvā paścāt tattatputtalikā 
kāryeti |

puttalīdairghyamānamityādiślokadvayasyārthaḥ tatra 
tattadaṃśakoktaputtalīdairghyāṃgulamānamaṣṭadhā vibhajya 
teṣvekāṃśena kaṇṭhādūrdhvamaṃśena kaṭipradeśamaṃśatrayeṇa 
pārṣṇibhāgādūrdhvamardhāṃśena prapadādiśeṣāṅgaṃ ca kuryāditi 
||

sarpaśīrṣasrucā homaṃ kuryādaśubhakarmasu |
vairiyonyasṛjā kṛtvā catvare juhuyāt tathā || 39 ||

trikoṇakuṇḍe yamadiṅmukho bhūtvārdharātrake |
śmaśāne nirjane deśe vidadhyādabhicārakam || 40 ||

yatrābhicārahomaṃ tu karoti bhuvi sādhakaḥ |
tatrābhito nṛpo rakṣāṃ kārayedātmasiddhye || 41 ||

p. 411)

nacedarātirnṛpatiścārairjñātvā nihantyamum |
svarāṣṭrasandhau kurvīta na kurvīta svamaṇḍale || 42 ||

yadi kuryātpramādena māntriko'jñānamohitaḥ |
tadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍayantyeva śanakairvairibhūbhṛtaḥ || 43 ||

akṣadrumasamiddhe'gnau tatphalaiśca karañjakaiḥ |
haimīdalarasāktaistu homācchatrūn vināśayet || 44 ||

naktamālasamiddhe'gnau tatphalairvā tathā hunet |
ripurugro'pi rogārtaḥ prayāti yamasādanam || 45 ||

unmattakāṣṭhaiḥ prajvālya vahniṃ tadvījakairhunet |
tatpatrāmbuplutairmāsādarātirbhrāntimāpnuyāt || 46 ||

āragvadhasamiddhe'gnau tatsamiddbhiśca tatphalaiḥ |
vitastimātraisvailāktaihaivanādvairiṇo mṛtiḥ || 47 ||

aruṣkarasamiddhe'gnau tadvījaistadghṛtāplutaiḥ |
homādarātestīvreṇa jvareṇa syātmṛtirdhruvam || 48 ||

sauvīrāktaiśca kārpāsavījairhomāttu maṇḍalāt |
arātīnāmathānyonyakalahānnidhanaṃ bhavet || 49 ||

sarṣapājyāplutaiḥ śuṇṭhīmāgadhīmaricāirhunet |
vairijanmarkṣavṛkṣāgnau maṇḍalāttanmṛtirjvarāt || 50 ||

prāguktaiḥ puttalīṃ kṛtvā dravyairuktavidhānataḥ |
sarṣapāruskaraghṛtasaṃsiktairjuhuyānniśi || 51 ||

prāgvad hutvā tadaṅgaistu kruddhacitto'ruṇāmbaraḥ |
raktasraggandhapuṣpāktairhomācchatrūn vināśayet || 52 ||

aruṣkaraghṛtābhyaktaistadvījaiḥ sarpaśīrṣakaiḥ |
havanādvairiṇo dāhajvaraprāptistribhirdinaiḥ || 53 ||

vairinakṣatrayonyutthamāṃsaistadraktasaṃplutaiḥ |
havanāttattarūdbhūtasamidhā havanādapi || 54 ||

dinaiḥ kaiścidripuḥ kliṣṭo nāśameti suniścitam |
drumakuḍyanipātena nirghātenāpi khaḍgataḥ || 55 ||

salile pāvake sarpadaṃśānmattadvipād gadāt |
yakṣarākṣasagandharvapiśācairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ || 56 ||

anyairvā kāraṇaiḥ kṣipraṃ nāśameti ripurdhruvam |
nimbapatraiśca kārpāsabījaistatkāṣṭhakāṇḍajaiḥ || 57 ||

havanāt sarṣapasnehasiktairvidveṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
nīcayoge hunedvahnau ripuvṛkṣasamedhite || 58 ||

tadvṛkṣakhaṇḍaistailāktairniśāmadhye ripurdinaiḥ |
uccāṭitaḥ prayātyeva mantraśaktyābhitāḍitaḥ || 59 ||

mṛtyupatraiśca tatkāṣṭhaistadvījaistacchucau hunet |
arāterdantino vāhā rogairnaśyanti niścitam || 60 ||

gairikaiḥ puttalīṃ kṛtvā riporaṣṭarāśike |
prāguktakaṇṭakādyaistu yadaṅgaṃ vidhayecchanaiḥ || 61 ||

viṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne tathaiva yamakaṇṭake |
ardhapraharake śīrṣe prahare vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 62 ||

arātestattadaṅge syānnidhanaṃ praharādinā |
granthibhirvā kaṇṭakādikṣatavṛddhividāraṇaiḥ || 63 ||

tannakṣatroktavṛkṣotthaputtalīṃ sthāpiterakām |
gardabhīmehasalile saṃsthāpya kvāthayecchanaiḥ || 64 ||

ripurdāhajvaragrastaḥ śanairyāti yamālayam |
madhūcchiṣṭena tāṃ kṛtvā tāpayenniśi tāṃ śanaiḥ || 65 ||

tenonmādajvaragrastaḥ prayāti nidhanaṃ śanaiḥ |
tāṃ tatkaṇṭakaviddhāṅgīṃ khanet pitṛgṛhe niśi || 66 ||

kṣaṇāt piśācāviṣṭaśca ripuryāti yamālayam |
prāguktaireva taddravyairaśeṣaiḥ puttalīṃ tathā || 67 ||

nirmāya kuṇḍamadhye tāṃ khātvā rātimahoruhaiḥ |
samiddhe'gnau tatsamidbhistailāktairjuhuyānniśi || 68 ||

sannipātajvarastasya vakrajihno'timūḍhadhīḥ |
pralapan śanakairdaihaṃ tyajan yāti yamālayam || 69 ||

tathāvidhāṃ tāṃ pratimāṃ nikhanetkṛṣṇapakṣake |
navamyaṅgāradivase mātṛgehe'grapīṭhake || 70 ||

saptāhānnidhanaṃ vairī prayāti niśi tāḍitaḥ |
bhūtādyaiḥ śirasi svīye nirdhātavadalakṣitam || 71 ||

sarṣapaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ ca tilaṃ śālijataṇḍulam |
piṣṭvā sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasya śakalairapi saṃyutam || 72 ||

eraṇḍabījairmilitaṃ kṛtvā puttalikāṃ tataḥ |
tadvakṣo'ntarnidhāyārināma tālasya patragat || 73 ||

sañjapya tāṃ spṛśan vidyāṃ tārtīyapratilomataḥ |
sahasravāraṃ sādhyasya vadharkṣe'ṣṭamarāśige || 74 ||

nibadhya tāṃ pādayostu bhānuvṛkṣotthatantunā |
gṛhītvā jīvahastena tāṃ japannikṣipecchucau || 75 ||

hutvāgnau taiḥ sahasraṃ tu tāmūrdhvāṃghrimavāṅmukhīm |
taddine tāpatṛṣṇādivihvalena jvareṇa saḥ || 76 ||

grastadeho luṭhan bhūmau visaṃjñaḥ pralapan muhuḥ |
prayāti nidhanaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayogabalataḥ śive || 77 ||

p. 412)

sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasambhṛtāṃ puttalīmarkadugdhataḥ |
vajrīkṣīreṇa vāliptāṃ baddhāṃ prāgvadadhomukhīm || 78 ||

sādhyanāmādisaṃyuktāṃ kuṇḍādūrdhvaṃ pralambayet |
juhuyāttatsamidbhistu tatkṣirāktairniśāntarā || 79 ||

jvarārtiḥ syādarātestu tribhireva dinaistataḥ |
yadyasti tasya rakṣecchā tāṃ taḍāgodare khanet || 80 ||

jambālamadhye tenāsmātsaukhyaṃ tasya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
tathā yadi na kurvīta ciraṃ rogātmako bhavet || 81 ||

tathā tāmāmabhāṇḍe tu niveśyāṅgāravāsare |
caṇḍikāyatane khātvā tadyoniṃ purato balim || 82 ||

nihatya dattvārātiṃ tu nihanyādupasargakaiḥ |
svagehe culyadhaḥ khātvā taduparyagnivardhanāt || 83 ||

avicchinnamarāteḥ syājjvarādigadasambhavaḥ |
tāṃ tathā kḷptarūpāṃ tu rurujaṅghāsthisaṃyutām || 84 ||

nibadhya pūrvasūtreṇa dviṣadgehe khanenniśi |
rāśau tadaṣṭame māsātprayātyuccāṭito'nyataḥ || 85 ||

tathāvidhaṃ puttalikāyugaṃ kṛtvoktamārgataḥ |
biḍālamūṣikācarmanaddhaṃ sādhyākhyayā yutam || 86 ||

nikhanettirayornadyāḥ pitṛgehe'thavā tataḥ |
mātṛgehe nadīpūrtyāṃ vidveṣaḥ syāddvayoḥ sadā || 87 ||

tā eva prāgvadutpādya sādhyākhyādisamanvitāḥ |
tadvidyājapasiddhāstāḥ khanedarigṛhe punaḥ || 88 ||

madhye'ṣṭadikṣu tu tathā tatkulotsādanaṃ bhavet |
evaṃ nikaṭavartīnāmabhicāra udīritaḥ || 89 ||

dūrasthitānāṃ dviṣatāṃ kathaṃ syādabhicārakam |
vadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe sudūrasthasya vairiṇaḥ || 90 ||

vināśane prayogaṃ tu kṣipramapyabhicārakam |
yenārirnikaṭasthāttu prāgeva nidhānaṃ vrajet || 91 ||

sādhyarkṣavṛkṣai puttalikā vidhāyāṣṭau śataṃ kramāt |
tāḥ prāgvadiritakṣīradvayāsiktāḥ sasaṃjñakāḥ || 92 ||

tattadaṃśakamānāpadhanāstāḥ madhyarātrataḥ |
ekamekāṃ hunerdvairidiṅmukhastā aśeṣataḥ || 93 ||

tattadaṃśakakāle vā sudūrastho'pi nāśabhāk |
kathaṃ vā māntrikabalī nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ vrajet || 94 ||

tacchṛṇu tvaṃ śive vacmi prakāraṃ tasya nigrahe |
tairmāntrikaistasya pūrvaṃ vidveṣaṃ kārayettataḥ || 95 ||

taddviṣṭe nidhanaṃ tasmin suśakyaṃ syādanāśrayāt |
bhāgyādikaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ māntrikasaṃgatam || 96 ||

rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā kathaṃ hanyātprayogataḥ |
tanme kathaya deveśa yadyupāyastu vidyate || 97 ||

vadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe tvamoghaṃ ghoravigraham |
abhicāramarātīnāmāśu nāśakaraṃ param || 98 ||

siddhamantrānatisrigdhān ṣoḍaśātisthirāśayān |
tairavicchinnarūpaṃ tu homayedyāmadikkramāt || 99 ||

tena tannidhanaṃ bhūyādrakṣitasyāpyayatnataḥ |
arātinidhanaṃ kuryādevamuktavidhānataḥ || 100 ||

atha kāmyahomadravyāṇāṃ mānam | jñānārṇave - ( 17 pa0)

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mānaṃ havanasiddhidam |
puṣpaṃ samagraṃ juhuyātkamalaṃ cāpi puṣkalam || 1 ||

kusumbhabāṇapuṣpāṇi yatheṣṭāni hunetpriye |
śatasaṃkhyā rājikāḥ syustilāśca śatasaṃkhyayā || 2 ||

lājā muṣṭipramāṇāḥ syurghṛtaṃ gāndhāramātrakam |
(cullakārdhaṃ dadhikṣīramannaṃ grāsamitaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

sthūlaṃ phalaṃ maheśāni kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuliṅgakam |
manaḥ priyaiśca khaṇḍaiśca phalaṃ bhavati niścayāt) || 4 ||

rambhāphalaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ laghu cetkhaṇḍitaṃ nahi |
nārikelasya khaṇḍaṃ hi sthūlaṃ kuryānmanaḥ priyam || 5 ||

parvasthāne cekṣudaṇḍaṃ manaḥ santoṣakārakam |
drākṣāphalaṃ samagraṃ syānnāraṅgaṃ khārjūraṃ tathā || 6 ||

gugguluḥ kramukārdhaṃ tu kuṃkumaṃ ca tathā bhavet |
guñjāsamaṃ tu karpūraṃ kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ tathā || 7 ||

candanaṃ cāguru devi kramukeṇa samaṃ bhavet |
manaḥ priyāhutīḥ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryātsulocane || 8 ||

etadāhutimānaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
yathecchayā varārohe śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayet || 9 ||

iti | tathā śāradātilake - (5 pa0 141 ślo0)

karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam |
(uktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni manīṣibhiḥ || 1 ||

tatsamaṃ madhu dugdhānnamakṣamātramudāhṛtam |)
dadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisammitāḥ || 2 ||

p. 413)

pṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathoditāḥ |
guḍaḥ palārdhamānaḥ syāccharkarāpi tathā matā || 3 ||

grāsārdhaṃ carumānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvamitaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayet || 4 ||

kadalīnāgaraṅgāṇāṃ phalānyekaikaśo viduḥ |
mātuliṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtam || 5 ||

aṣṭadhā nārikelāni khaṇḍitāni vidurbudhāḥ |
vidhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tridhā || 6 ||

urvārukaphalaṃ home kathitaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tridhā |
phalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥ || 7 ||

dūrvātrayasamādiṣṭaṃ guḍūcī caturaṃgulā |
brīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgā māṣā yavā api || 8 ||

taṇḍulāḥ syustadardhāṃśāḥ kodravā muṣṭisammitāḥ |
godhūmā raktakamalā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ || 9 ||

tilāśculukamātrāḥ syuḥ sarṣapāstatpramāṇakāḥ |
śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi triṃśatiḥ || 10 ||

puraṃ badaramānaṃ syādrāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ smṛtam |
candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca || 11 ||

tintiḍībījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | karṣalakṣaṇamuktaṃ sārasaṃgrahe māso daśa guñjāḥ syāt 
ṣoḍaśamāṣo nigadyate karṣaḥ | iti | tailasyāpyetadeva parimāṇam | śuktiḥ 
karṣadvayaṃ (prasṛtimātraṃ) paladvayamātraṃ muṣṭiḥ palaṃ 
palārdhaṃ karṣadvayam grāsārdhamaśītiraktikāmitamiti | taduktaṃ 
piṅgalāmate -

guñjābhirdaśabhirmāṣaḥ śāṇo māṣacatuṣṭayam |
dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ drakṣaṇaśca saḥ || 1 ||

tau dvau pāṇitalaṃ karṣaḥ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ |
picubiṃḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayam || 2 ||

śuktiraṣṭātmikā te dve palaṃ bilvaṃ caturthikā |
muṣṭirāmraṃ praguñjo'tha dve pale prasṛtistathā ||

iti mātuluṅgaṃ bījapūraṃ | urvārukaṃ karkaṭī | tadardhāṃśāḥ 
śuktimitāḥ | culukamātrāḥ pāṇitalapramāṇāḥ karṣamātrā ityarthaḥ | 
puraṃ gugguluḥ | badaramānamaśītiguñjāmitaṃ | rāmaṭhaṃ hiṃguḥ | 
tathā nāradapañcarātre -

tṛtīyaṃ khaṇḍamūlānāṃ hrasvāni svapramāṇataḥ | iti | śaivāgame'pi 
-

khaṇḍatrayaṃ syānmūlānāṃ sūkṣmāṇyevaṃ ca homayet |
kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ latānāmaṃguladvayam || 1 ||

iti | aya samidhaḥ | nāradapañcarātre -

samitprādeśamātreṇa samacchedānvitā tathā |
viśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhā || 1 ||

krimidaṣṭāśca dīrghāśca nistvacaḥ parivarjitāḥ |
viśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryād dvidalā vyādhisambhavam || 2 ||

hrasvayā mṛtyumāpnoti vakrā vighnakarī matā |
sthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ || 3 ||

dvidhāyāṃ netradoṣāḥ syuḥ kīṭadaṣṭārthanāśinī |
dveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ smṛtāḥ || 4 ||

sakṣīrā nādhikanyūnāḥ samidhaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ |
ārdratvacā samacchedā tarjanyaṃgulivartulā || 5 ||

īdṛśīṃ homayetprājñaḥ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam |
śrote smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 6 ||

iti | tathā vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

tāḥ pālāśyaḥ parā vāpi yājñīyā dvādaśāṃgulāḥ |
avakrāścāpyaśuṣkāśca satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ || 1 ||

daśāṃgulā vā vihitāḥ kaniṣṭhāṃgulisammitā |
prādeśamātrā vālābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api || 2 ||

iti || atha kāmyahoma(japa) vidhiḥ | tatra jñānārṇave - (17 pa0)

cakraṃ samarcayeddevi sakalaṃ niyatavrataḥ |
bāhyamadhyagataṃ vāpi madhyaṃ vā cakramarcayet || 1 ||

upacāraiḥ samārādhya sahasraṃ prajapecchuciḥ |
tadagre saṃsthito mantrī tato'nantaphalaṃ labhet || 2 ||

dhyātvāthavā cakrarājamantaḥ pūjāsamanvitam |
japārambhaṃ sudhīḥ kuryānmahāpātakahā bhavet || 3 ||

nigadenopāṃśunā vā mānasenātha vā japet |
nigadaḥ parameśāni spaṣṭaṃvācā nigadyate || 4 ||

p. 414)

avyaktastu sphuradoṣṭa upāṃśuḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
mānasastu varārohe cintanāntararūpavān || 5 ||

nigadena tu yajjaptaṃ lakṣamātraṃ varānane |
upāṃśūcāritaikena tulaṃ bhavati śailaje || 6 ||

upāṃśurlakṣamātraṃ tu yajjaptaṃ kamalekṣaṇe |
mānasoccāraṇāttulyamekena parameśvari || 7 ||

mudrāsannaddhayogaḥ san pūrvoktadhyānayogataḥ |
lakṣamātraṃ japedyastu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 8 ||

lakṣadvayena pāpāni saptajanmabhavānyapi |
mahāpātakamukhyāni nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||

tato lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā yantramātrakalevaraḥ |
mahāpātakakoṭīstu nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||

caturlakṣajape devi mahāvāgīśvaro bhavet |
kubera iva deveśi pañcalakṣānna saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||

ṣaḍlakṣajapamātreṇa mahāvidyādharo bahvet |
saptalakṣajapānmantrī khecarīmelako bhavet || 12 ||

aṣṭalakṣajapānmantrī devapūjyo bhavennaraḥ |
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhināṃ nāyako bhavati priye || 13 ||

vaśyā bhavanti rājāno yoṣitastu viśeṣataḥ |
navalakṣapramāṇaṃ hi japettripurasundarīm || 14 ||

rudramūrtiḥ svayaṃ kartā hartā sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ |
sarvairvandyaḥ sadā svasthaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavān bhavet || 15 ||

iti || atha kūṭatrayasya pṛthak sādhanavidhiḥ jñānārṇave (19 pa0 2 ślo0)

eṣā vidyā vārārohe pāramparyakramāgatā |
bhavabandhaṃ nāśayantī saṃsmṛtā pāpahāriṇī || 1 ||

japānmṛtyujayaṃ śāntiṃ dhyānāt sarvārthasādhanī |
duḥkhadaurbhāgyadāridryabhayaghnī pūjitā bhavet || 2 ||

mahāghaughapraśamanī smaraṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ |
pṛthagbījatrayasyāhaṃ sādhanaṃ kathayāmi te || 3 ||

śuklāmbaradharo vīro gandhakastūrimaṇḍitaḥ |
muktāphalasphuradbhūṣābhūṣaṇaḥ śubhramālyadhṛk || 4 ||

śubhramandirasamviṣṭo brahmacaryasamanvitaḥ |
pūjayet śubhakusumairnaivedyamapi cojjvalam || 5 ||

pāyasaṃ dugdhasampūrṇaṃ tathāmṛtphalaudanam |
ghṛtagolakasampannanānāśubhrānnapūritam || 6 ||

naivedyaṃ darśayed daivyai vāgīśvaryai sureśvari |
manaḥ saṃkalpaśuddho vā sādhayenmokṣavāṅmayam || 7 ||

vāgbhavākhyāṃ japedvidyāṃ vāgīṣīṃ saṃsmaran budhaḥ |
karpūradhavalāṃ śubhrapuṣpābharaṇabhūṣitām || 8 ||

atyantaśubhravadanāṃ vajramauktikabhūṣaṇām |
muktāphalāmalamaṇijapamālālasatkarām || 9 ||

pustakaṃ varadānaṃ ca dadhatīmabhayapradām |
evaṃ dhyāyenmaheśāni sarvavidyādharo bhavet || 10 ||

mūlādi brahmarandhrāntaṃ sravatpīyūṣavarṣiṇīm |
tasmājjyotirmayīṃ dhyāyejjihvāgre'mṛtarūpiṇīm || 11 ||

pāṣāṇena samo vāpi mūrkho jīvasamo bhavet |
atha kāmakalāsaktaḥ sādhakaḥ parameśvari || 12 ||

raktālaṅkārasubhago raktagandhānulepanaḥ |
raktavastrāvṛtaḥ samyaṅmadhye kāmakalātmakam || 13 ||

raktapuṣpaiśca vividhaiḥ kuṃkumādibhirarcayet |
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntāṃ sphuraddīpasvarūpiṇīm || 14 ||

bandhūkakusumāraktakāntibhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvarābhayalasatkarām || 15 ||

tadīyakāntisindūrabharitabhuvanatrayām |
cintayet parameśāni trailokyaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt || 16 ||

rājāno vaśamāyānti pannagā rākṣasāḥ surāḥ |
kandarpa iva deveśi yoṣitāṃ mānahārakaḥ || 17 ||

manaścintitayoṣittu dāsīva vaśagā bhavet |
calajjalendusaṅkāśāṃ taruṇāruṇavigrahām || 18 ||

cintayedyoṣitāṃ yonau kṣobhayet surasundarīm |
kiṃ punarmānuṣīṃ devi trailokyamapi mohayet || 19 ||

eṣā vai cintitā devi sindūrābhā hṛdi kṣaṇāt |
ākarṣayettadā śīghraṃ rambhāṃ vāpi tilottamām || 20 ||

raktavarṇāṃ striyaṃ dhyātvā tadīyamahasā tataḥ |
tasyā mūrdhni smared bījaṃ sravatpīyūṣavarṣiṇīm || 21 ||

dhyāyan sammohayetdevi madanottaptamānasam |
kṣaṇamātreṇa deveśi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet || 22 ||

etatkāmakalādhyānāt pañcakāmā varānane |
mohayanti jagatsarvaṃ prayogaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 23 ||

pūrvoktakāmā deveśi jñātavyāḥ pañcasaṃkhyakāḥ |
vidarbhyādyena kāmena manmathāntargataṃ kuru || 24 ||

p. 415)

kandarpasampuṭaṃ kṛtvā koṇagarbhagataṃ tataḥ |
makaradhvajasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvametadvarānane || 25 ||

mīnaketugataṃ kuryānmohayejjagatomimām |
trailokyamohano nāma prayogo'yam prakīrtitaḥ || 26 ||

iti || atra vidarbhyetyādi kuryādityantasya pādonaślokadvayasyāyamarthaḥ 
prathamaṃ manmathakūṭaṃ klīṃkāramālikhya tatra kakārasyodare 
kāmarājakuṭaṃ hrīṃkāramālikhya tasya hakārodare mama rephādhaḥ 
amukaṃ tayormadhye vaśamānayeti sādhyanāma hrīṃkāravidarbhitaṃ 
vilikhya bījadvayādbahistṛtīyakandarpakūṭarūpeṇa aiṃkāradvayena 
trikoṇākāreṇa (puṭitaṣaṭkoṇenāveṣṭya tasya ṣaṭsu koṇodareṣu 
caturthaṃ makaraketanaṃ kūṭākṣaraṃ bl-ūṃkāramālikhya 
ṣaṭkoṇāntararbahirmīnaketanakūṭākṣareṇa) strīṃkāreṇa saṃveṣṭya 
vāṃchitārtheṣu viniyuñjayāditi | atra pañcamakūṭākṣaralekhanena 
tadakṣaravahnisthānagaṃ sakalaṃ yantraṃ yathā bhavati tathā 
gurūktakramataḥ samālekhyamiti rahasyārthaḥ || tathā -

śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śaktibījasya sādhanam |
sṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantaṃ śarīraṃ cintayet param || 1 ||

sravatpīyūṣadhārābhirvarṣantīṃ viṣahāriṇīm |
hemaprabhābhāsamānāṃ vidyunnikarasuprabhām || 2 ||

sphuraccandrakalāpūrṇakalaśaṃ varadābhaye |
jñānamudrāṃ ca dadhatīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīm || 3 ||

dhyāyan viṣaṃ harenmantrī nānākāravyavasthitam |
tasya saṃsmaraṇād devi nīlakaṇṭhatvamāgataḥ || 4 ||

ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo bhūtvā vicarāmi jale sthale |
vainateyasamo mantrī viṣabhārasahasranut || 5 ||

bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca nāśayedrogasaṃcayam |
cāturthikajvarān sarvānapasmārāṃśca nāśayet || 6 ||

atha trikūṭā sampūrṇā mahātripurasundarī |
cintitā sādhakasyāśu trailokyavaśakāriṇī || 7 ||

krameṇa nābhihṛdvakramaṇḍalasthāruṇaprabhā |
padmarāgamaṇisvacchā cintitā suravandite || 8 ||

tasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca prajāyate |
tannāma saṃsmaran mantrī yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ || 9 ||

mātṛcakraṃ tasya kāye tena sārdhaṃ sukhī bhavet |
putravān devadeveśi mantrī dhyānānna saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||

iti | tathā -

yadā cakrasthitā pūrṇā khecarīsiddhidāyinī |
catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām || 11 ||

cakrametatsamāśritya saṃsthitā vīravandite |
ādau sambodhanapadaṃ madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ || 12 ||

kalāṃ dhyātvāṅganānaṅge kāmarāja ivāparaḥ |
pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇairmādanairmohayet priye || 13 ||

trailokyasundarīrdevīḥ kiṃ punarmartyayoṣitaḥ |
tathaiva śaktibandhaiśca śastraistanmayavigrahaḥ || 14 ||

siddhagandharvadevāṃśca vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥ |
etāmārādhya deveśi kāmyasaubhāgyasundaraḥ || 15 ||

hariśca parameśāni tripurārādhanāt priye |
trailokyamohano bhūtvā sthitikartābhavat sadā || 16 ||

etatsamārādhanāttu brahmā sṛṣṭikaro'bhavat |
candrasūryau varārohe sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau || 17 ||

iti || atha śrīcakrasādhanavidhiḥ tatra jñānārṇave - (14 pa0)

śṛṇu sarvāṅgasubhage śrīcakravidhimuttamam |
yasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadāśivaḥ || 1 ||

anena vidhinā yatra śricakraṃ kramasaṃyutam |
pūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

nagaraṃ vaśamāyāti daśamaṇḍalamadrije |
yoṣitaḥ sakalāḥ vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥ || 3 ||

vidyāvimūḍhahṛdayāḥ sādhake nyastamānasāḥ |
taddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥ || 4 ||

iti | tathā -

gorocanādibhirdravyaiścakrarājaṃ samālikhet |
atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ varām || 5 ||

jvalantīṃ nāmasahitāṃ mahābījavidarbhitām |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 6 ||

iti | mahābījaṃ mūlavidyāyāḥ dvitīyakūṭam | vidarbhalakṣaṇaṃ 
prāgevoktam |

cintayettu tadā devi yojanānāṃ sahasraśaḥ |
adṛṣṭapūrvā deveśi śrutamātrāpi durlabhā || 7 ||

p. 416)

rājakanyāthavā cānyā bhayalajjāvivarjitā |
āyāti sādhakaṃ samyaṅmantramūḍhā satī priye || 8 ||

cakramadhyagato bhūtvā sādhakaścintayedyadā |
udyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathā || 9 ||

sādhyamapyaruṇībhūtaṃ cintayed parameśvari |
anena kramayogena svayaṃ kandarparūpavān || 10 ||

sarvasaundaryasubhagaḥ sarvalokavaśaṅkaraḥ |
sarvaraktopacāraiśca mudrāsahita (sannaddha) vigrahaḥ || 11 ||

cakraṃ prapūjayedyastu yasya nāma vidarbhitam |
sa bhaved dāsavad devi dhanāḍhyo vāpi bhūpatiḥ || 12 ||

cakramadhyagataṃ kuryānnāma yasyāstu yoṣitaḥ |
adṛṣṭāyā maheśāni yonimudrādharo budhaḥ || 13 ||

haṭhādānayate śīghraṃ yakṣiṇīṃ rājakanyakām |
nāgakanyāmapsarasaṃ khecarīṃ vā surāṅganām || 14 ||

vidyādharīṃ divyarūpāmṛṣikanyāmṛṣistriyam |
madanodbhavasantāpasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām || 15 ||

kāmabāṇaprabhinnāntaḥkaraṇāṃ lolacakṣuṣam |
mahākāmakalādhyānayogāttu suravandite || 16 ||

kṣobhayet svargabhūrloka pātālatalayoṣitaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 17 ||

iti | atha tilakādivaśyaprayogaḥ | tathā -

rocanābhāgamekaṃ tu bhāgamekaṃ tu kuṅkumam |
atha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayet samam || 18 ||

ekatra tilakaṃ kuryāt trailokyavaśakāriṇam |
aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayet || 19 ||

rājānaṃ nagaraṃ grāmaṃ yena yadyatpradṛśyate |
mantriṇā parameśāni tatsarva tasya vaśyagam || 20 ||

tāmbūlaṃ dhūpamudakaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dadhi |
dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ cūrṇamātraṃ vastraṃ karpūrameva ca || 21 ||

kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ cailālavaṅgaṃ jātipatrakam |
phalaṃ vā vastu yadyat tu sakalaṃ parameśvari || 22 ||

śatamaṣṭottara japtvā yasmai yasmai prayacchati |
sa vaśyo jāyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 23 ||

striyastu sakalā vaśyā dāsībhūtā bhavanti hi |
haṭhākarṣaṇametat te kathitaṃ nānyathā bhavet || 24 ||

iti | athākarṣaṇaprayogaḥ | tathā -

rahasyasthānake mantrī likhedrocanayā bhuvi |
cāruśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 25 ||

pratimāṃ sundarāṅgī tāṃ vilikhya sumanoharām |
tadbhālakaṇṭhahṛnnābhi tattanmaṇḍala(janmabhūmiṣu)yojitam || 26 ||

janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṅkuśāntarvidarbhitām |
sarvasandhiṣu dehasya madanākṣaramālikhet || 27 ||

līnaṃ dāḍimapuṣpābhaṃ cintayed dehasandhiṣu |
tadāśābhimukhī bhūtvā svayaṃ devīsvarūpakaḥ || 22 ||

mudrāṃ tu kṣobhiṇīṃ baddhvā mantamaṣṭaśataṃ japet |
niyojya madanāgāre candrasūryakalātmake || 23 ||

tato vikalasarvāṅgīṃ kāmabāṇaiḥ prapīḍitām |
ananyamanasaṃ premabhramamāṇāṃ madālasām || 24 ||

evamākarṣayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatādapi |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 25 ||

iti || tathā -

mātṛkāṃ vilikheccakrabāhyataḥ sakalāṃ priye |
bhūjapatre svarṇapatre raupyapatre'tha tāmraje || 26 ||

so'vadhyaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
tathaiva mātṛkāyuktāṃ svamājñā cakramaṇḍitām || 27 ||

karpūrakuṅkumādyaistu ajarāmaratāṃ labhet |
aenaiva vidhānena rocanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ || 28 ||

likhitaṃ cakrayogena sādhyanāma varānane |
vidarbhitaṃ svanāmnā tu yasmin kasminnapi sthitam || 29 ||

sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃvāpi sakalaṃ janamaṇḍalam |
vaśīkuryānmaheśāni pādākrāntaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 30 ||

mahātripurasundaryāḥ kāmakūṭena bhāsvatā |
ekamevamavaṣṭabhya sādhyanāmākṣarāṇi hi || 31 ||

bahirapyālikhedvarṇairmātṛkāyāḥ praveṣṭayet |
hemamadhyagataṃ kuryācchikhāyāṃ vāmake bhuje || 32 ||

dhārayedyatra kutrāpi trailokyavaśakāriṇam |
rājendramapi deveśi dāsabhūtaṃ karoti hi || 33 ||

rājāno vājinaḥ sarve mahāduṣṭā madotkaṭāḥ |
vyāghrāḥ kesariṇī matā vaśyāstasya bhavanti hi || 34 ||

p. 417)

pūrvakrameṇa nagaraṃ nāma sandarbhya śailaje |
madhye catuṣpathe vāpi caturdikṣu nidhāpayet || 35 ||

mahākṣobho yoṣitāṃ tu janānāṃ mahatāmapi |
tathaiva sarvaduṣṭānāṃ purasthānāṃ ca jāyate || 36 ||

etanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanām |
jvalantīṃ sarvarājendramaṇḍitāṃ sāgarāmbarām || 37 ||

māsaṣaṭkaṃ cintayedyaḥ sa saṃkṣobhakaro bhavet |
kaṭākṣakṣepamātreṇa nāyastasya vaśāḥ priye || 38 ||

rājāno brāhmaṇā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca paśavo jagat |
dṛṣṭyākarṣayate devi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 39 ||

dṛṣṭyā viṣaṃ nāśayate nātrakāryā vicāraṇā |
bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca jvarāṃścāturthikādikān || 40 ||

śūlagulmādirogāṃśca dṛṣṭyā nāśayati kṣaṇāt |
etat sindūrasubhagaṃ rātrau sampūjitaṃ priye || 41 ||

yojanānāṃ śatāddevi samyagākarṣayet striyam |
yadā dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ samyag devi prapūjyate || 42 ||

tattaddikṣu sthitāṃllokān vidiksthānapi sundari |
vaśamānayate śīghraṃ saputrapaśubāndhavān || 43 ||

bhūrjapatre samākhyi rocanāgarukuṅkumaiḥ |
tanmadhye nagaraṃ deśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ khaṇḍameva ca || 44 ||

nāgnā vidarbhitaṃ svasya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi |
bhūmimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet || 45 ||

athavā dhārayet kaṇṭhe śikhāyāṃ bahumūlake |
yatra kutra sthitaṃ bhadre kṣobhayennagaraṃ mahat || 46 ||

arkakṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ dhattūrakarasaṃ tathā |
rocanākuṃkumaiścaiva lākṣālaktakasaṃyutam || 47||

kastūrīdravasaṃyuktamekīkṛtya tataḥ param |
cakrametatsamālikhya yasya namnā maheśvari || 48 ||

tasya vyāghrabhayaṃ vyādhiripusarpagajādikam |
cauragrahajalāriṣṭaṃ śākinīḍākinībhavam || 49 ||

bhayaṃ na vidyate devi paramantrābhicārajam |
nityaṃ samarcayed devi kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayet || 50 ||

athavā madhyagāṃ devi trikonobhayamadhyagām |
adhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṃkumānvitam || 51 ||

nidhāpayecca saptāhād dāsavat kiṅkaro bhavet |
pītadravyaiḥ samālikhya pītapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 52 ||

pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā stambhayet sarvavādinaḥ |
sahasravadano devi mūko bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 53 ||

nāmnā yasya sa vāgmī hi pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ |
jāyate devadeveśi mahānīlīrasena tu || 54 ||

nāma saṃyojya vidhivad dakṣiṇāśāmukho budhaḥ |
vahnau dagdhvā maheśāni mārayedvairiṇaṃ priye || 55 ||

mahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ sāramākṛṣya śailaje |
gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhya nāma sandarbhya pūrvavat || 56 ||

(kṣiptvāranālamadhyasthaṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param |
kṛtvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣasya madhyagam) || 57 ||

lambamānaṃ tadākāśe śatrūccāṭanakārakam |
mahānīlīrocanābhyāṃ dugdhalākṣārasādibhiḥ || 58 ||

vilikhya dhārayenmantrī sarvavarṇān vaśaṃ nayet |
anenaiva vidhānena sthāpayettīramadhyagam || 59 ||

tenodakena saṃsnātaḥ pītaṃ tatsarvavaśyakṛt |
saubhāgyaṃ jāyate tena pānīyena na saṃśayaḥ || 60 ||

etanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ nagaraṃ vāmalocane |
saptāhātkṣobhayet satyaṃ jvalamānaṃ vicintayet || 61 ||

atha vakṣye maheśāni mahāpātakanāśanam |
śivāṃ sampūjayed devi sugandhaiḥ kusumaiḥ priye || 62 ||

mahāpātakayuktātmā tatkṣaṇāt pāpahā bhavet |
śamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥ || 63 ||

māsena hanti kaluṣaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ naraḥ |
pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pītadravyaiḥ samarcayet || 64 ||

pītasthānaṃ samālikhya stambhayet sarvavādinaḥ |
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhet || 65 ||

sampūjya vidhivadbhaktyā sarvalokaṃ vaśaṃ nayet |
paścimābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhet || 66 ||

sampūjya vidhivadvidvān sarvayoṣinmano haret |
vallabho jāyate tāsāṃ dāsīmiva vaśaṃ nayet || 67 ||

yamāśābhimukho bhūtvā cakraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yadārcayet |
yasya nāmāṅkitaṃ tatra mantrahāniḥ prajāyate || 68 ||

agnirākṣasavāyavyaśambhukoṇeṣu pūjitam |
pūrvavat parameśāni krameṇa paritoṣitam || 69 ||

p. 418)

stambhavidveṣavyādhiśatrūccāṭanakārakam |
rocanālikhitaṃ cakraṃ kṣīramadhye ksipedbudhaḥ || 70 ||

sarvavaśyakaraṃ devi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
gomūtramadhyagaṃ samyak śatrūccāṭakaraṃ param || 71 ||

tailasthaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param |
jvalajjavalanamadhyasthaṃ śatrunāśakaraṃ bhavet || 72 ||

yadyekānte caturmārge sindūrarajasā likhet |
sarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvari || 73 ||

akārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ tatra vinyaset |
pūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa tu || 74 ||

sādhakaḥ khecaro devi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
girāvekatarastadvadarcayet kulamārgataḥ || 75 ||

ajarāmaratāṃ labdhvā sukhī bhavati māntrikaḥ |
śmaśāne pūjayeccakraṃ mahābhūtadine tu yaḥ || 76 ||

pūrvakrameṇa vidhivat sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
khaḍgasiddhiṃ ca vetālasiddhiṃ ca guṭikāṃ labhet || 76 ||

pādukāñjanasiddhiṃ ca manaḥ siddhiṃ ca dhātudām |
samahāvīrasiddhiṃ tu yakṣiṇīceṭakodbhavām || 77 ||

tatsarva labhate mantrī nātrakāryā vicāraṇa |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 78 ||

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapāda śrīgovindācāryaśiṣya 
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayati 
viracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre 
saptadaśaḥ svāsaḥ || 17 ||





atha

śrīvidyārṇavatantre

|| aṣṭādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ ||

atha samayācāraḥ prayogasāre -

devasthāne gurusthāne śmaśāne vā catuṣpathe |
pādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunāni vivarjayet || 1 ||

(devaṃ guruṃ gurusthānaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrādhidevatāḥ |
siddhaṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrvaṃ samudīrayet) || 2 ||

pramattāmantyajāṃ kanyāṃ puṣpitāṃ patitastanīm |
virūpāṃ muktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayet || 3 ||

(kanyāyoniṃ paśukrīḍāṃ digvastrāṃ prakaṭastanīm |
nālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayet ) || 4 ||

dhānyagogurudevāgnividyā kośanarān prati |
naiva prasārayet pādau naitānapi ca laṅghayet || 5 ||

ālasyamadasaṃmohaśāṭhyapaiśunyavigrahān |
asūyāmātmasammānaṃ paranindāṃ ca varjayet || 6 ||

iti | ālasyaṃ mandatā | mado vidyādhanābhijātyasampatsamudito manasa 
ullāsaḥ | moho mityābhiniveśaḥ | śāṭhyaṃ śaktigūhaṇam | paiśūnyaṃ 
parokṣe paradoṣaprakāśanam | asūyā guṇeṣu doṣāropaḥ | 
ātmasamānaṃ ātmani samyakpūjyatvabuddhiḥ |

liṅginaṃ vratinaṃ vipraṃ vedavedāṅgasaṃhitāḥ |
purāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayet || 7 ||

vedāṅgāni prasiddhāni | saṃhitā manvādipraṇītasmṛtiśāstrāṇi | 
āgamaśāstrāṇi śivādyuktayāmalādīni | āgamaṃ śivavaktrebhyo 
gataṃ vai girijāmukhe | mataṃ ca vāsudevasya tasmādāgama ucyate | 
ityāgamaśabdaniruktiḥ | kalpān nakṣatrakalpo 
vidhānakalpo'bhicārakalpaḥ śāntikalpaścetyatharvavedavibhāgarūpān 
śrāddhakalpādikānanyāṃśca ||

yugaṃ musalamaśmānaṃ dāma cullīmulūkhalam |
śūrpaṃ sammārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vaiḍūryamāyudham || 8 ||

kalaśaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ darpaṇaṃ bhūsaṇaṃ tathā |
bhogayogyāni cānyāni yāgadravyāṇi yāni ca || 9 ||

mahāsthāneṣu vastūni yāni vā devatālaye |
divyoktāni padārthāni bhūtāviṣṭāni yāni vai || 10 ||

laṅghayejjātu naitāni yadvā naca padā spṛśet |
yā goṣṭhīrlokavidviṣṭā yā ca svairavisarpiṇī || 11 ||

parahiṃsāratā yā ca na tāmavatared kvacit |
pratigrahaṃ na gṛhṇīyādātmabhogavidhitsayā || 12 ||

devatāgurupūjārthaṃ yatnato'pyarjayeddhanam |
dhārayedārjavaṃ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ ghṛtim || 13 ||

kṣāntiṃ dayāmanāsthāṃ ca divyāṃ śaktiṃ ca sarvadā |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 14 ||

ārjavamavakratā | satyaṃ yathādṛṣṭārthabhāṣaṇam | sauśīlyaṃ 
susvabhāvāvasthānam | samatā rāgadveṣādirāhityam | dhṛtiṃ 
duḥkhādibhiravasīdataścittasya sthirīkaraṇaṃ kṣāntiḥ kṣamā 
paribhavādiṣūtpadmamānakrodhapratibandhaḥ | dayā paraduḥkhāsahanam 
|| mantratantraprakāśe -

vibhītakārkakārañjasnuhīcchāyāṃ na saṃśrayet |
stambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā || 1 ||

nakhāgrakeśanirdhūtasnānavastraghaṭodakam |
etatsparśa tyajed dūre kharaśvājarajastathā || 2 ||

iti | liṅgapurāṇe -

ajaśvānakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ mārjanībhavareṇukam |
saṃspṛśedyadi mūḍhātmā śriyaṃ hanti harerapi || 1 ||

p. 420)

na nindet kāraṇaṃ devaṃ na śāstraṃ tena nirmitam |
na guruṃ sādhakaṃ caiva liṅgacchāyāṃ na laṅghayet || 2 ||

nādyāllaṅghenna nirmālyaṃ taddadyācchivadīkṣite |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

taditi śivanirmālyam | tathā nāradapañcarātre -

sādhanasya svabhāvena keśaśmaśrūviluñcitaḥ |
sambhave navavastraśca malayūkāvivarjitaḥ || 1 ||

suvinītaḥ sadāyaśca mantramārādhayet param |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | sādhanasya svabhāvenetyanena puraścaraṇamadhye na vapanaṃ 
kāryamityuktamapanītakeśaśmaśrurityarthaḥ | atra tu -

gaṅgāyāṃ bhāskare kṣetre pitrośca maraṇaṃ vinā |
vṛthā cchinatti yaḥ keśāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakam || 1 ||

prayāgatīrthayātrāyāṃ pitṛmātṝviyogataḥ |
kacānāṃ vapanaṃ kuryād vṛthā na vikaco bhavet || 2 ||

iti | kālikāpurāṇaviṣṇubhyāṃ yadvapanaṃ niṣidhyate tadadīkṣitaparam | 
jaṭilā muṇḍitāścaiva śuklayajñopavītinaḥ | brahmacaryaratāḥ 
śāntāvedāntajñānatatparāḥ iti || kūrmapurāṇe śaivānāṃ 
muṇḍitatvokteḥ | tathā -

sāmānyasiddhyai rakṣārthaṃ pareṣāṃ na kadācana |
prayoktavyaḥ svamantraśca āpadyapi na cācaret || 15 ||

gāruḍaṃ bhūtavādaṃ ca bhayāt svārthe na cātmani |
kṛpayā parayā kuryādanātheṣu asaṃsadi || 16 ||

somasūryāntarasthaṃ ca gavāṃ cāśvā (vāyva)gnimadhyagam |
bhāvayeddaivataṃ viṣṇuṃ guruṃ vipraśarīragam || 17 ||

manyetmātāpitarau viṣṇuṃ tadvad priyātithim |
jñeyo viśvāśrayo viṣṇurātmā jñeyaśca viṣṇuvat || 18 ||

yatra yatra prīvādo mātsaryācchrūyate guroḥ |
tatra tatra na vastavyaṃ prayāyātsaṃsmaran harim || 19 ||

yaiḥ kṛtā ca gurornindā vibhoḥ śāstrasya nārada |
nāpi taiḥ saha vaktavyaṃ vastavvaṃ vā kadācana || 20 ||

karmaṇā manasā vācā na kuryāt pāradārikam |
na nindyā brāhmaṇā devā viṣṇurdhenustathaiva ca || 21 ||

rudrāścādityā agniśca lokapālā grahāstathā |
gururvā vaiṣṇavaścāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvadīkṣitaḥ || 22 ||

na tena kutracit kārye śāpānugrahakarmaṇī |
na tena mantro vaktavyo mudrā vā samayā api || 23 ||

svānuṣṭhāne'pi yatkarma sarvaṃ sarvasya gopayet |
mantraguptiśca kartavyā satataṃ mantrasiddhaye || 24 ||

iti | tena sādhakena tantrāntare -

sarvabhūteṣvanukampā dānaṃ cātithipūjanam |
pañcejyā tīrthasevā ca svādhyāyo gurusevanam || 1 ||

sāmānyaṃ sarvalokānāmeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
brahmacārī dīkṣitaścet trisandhyaṃ devamarcayet || 2 ||

snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ tasya vedādhyayanameva ca |
bhaikṣyaṃ samprārthayet sākṣād dhyāyed devaṃ nirantaram || 3 ||

gṛhastho dīkṣayā siktaḥ sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret |
na japo nārcanaṃ naiva dhyānaṃ nāpi vidhikramaḥ || 4 ||

kevalaṃ satataṃ śrīmaccaraṇāmbhojabhāginām |
sannyāsināṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ mānasaḥ kathitaḥ kramaḥ || 5 ||

parivrāḍaviraktaśca viraktaśca gṛhī tathā |
ubhau tau narake ghore pacyedābhūtasamplavam || 6 ||

gṛhastho dharmapatnyā ca pūjayeddevamanvaham |
dayā dānaṃ mahārhaṃ ca yena devaḥ prasīdati || 7 ||

saṃnyāsināṃ dravyadāne nādhikāro'sti suvrata |
varṇināṃ ca vanasthānāṃ ko vadedanapekṣitam || 8 ||

iti | anyatrāpi -

athācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yat smṛtvāmṛtamaśnute |
sarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ samayācārapālakaḥ || 1 ||

anityakarmasaṃtyāgī nityānuṣṭhānatatparaḥ |
mantrāṇāṃ sādhanadvāre śivabhāvanatatparaḥ || 2 ||

parasyāṃ devatāyāṃ tu sarvakarmanivedakaḥ |
anyamantrārcana śraddhāmanyamantraprapūjanam || 3 ||

kulastrīvīranindāṃ ca taddravyasyāpahāraṇam |
strīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca varjayedbhaktimān sadā || 4 ||

strīmayaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ svayaṃ caiva tathā bhavet |
strīṣu dveṣo na kartavyo viśeṣāta pūjanaṃ striyāḥ || 5 ||

p. 421)

bhakṣyaṃ tāmbūlamanyacca bhakṣyadravyaṃ yathāruci |
peyaṃ carvya tathā coṣyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ lehyaṃ tathā sukham || 6 ||

sarvaṃ ca yuvatīrūpaṃ bhāvayedyatamānasaḥ |
kulajāṃ yuvatīṃ vīkṣya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥ || 7 ||

bālāṃ vā yauvanaprauḍhāṃ vṛddhā vā sundarīṃ tathā |
kutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtyā vibhāvayet || 8 ||

kumarīpūjanaṃ kuryāt sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā |
kumārīpūjanād devi sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 9 ||

iti | kumārīpūjanamagre vakṣyāmaḥ | anyacca -

yasmin mantre ya ācārastatra dharmastu tādṛśaḥ |
kṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vā || 10 ||

nādharmo jāyate tena kiṃca dharmo mahān bhavet |
vismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥ || 11 ||

bhrāntistatra na kartavyā siddhihāniḥ prajāyate |
viśuddhacittastatsiddhiṃ labhate cāpavargajām || 12 ||

nirvikalpastu mantrajño brahma sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ |
bhairavī yadi sañjātaḥ siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||

rātrau pūjā viśeṣeṇa kartavyā siddhimicchatā |
devyai niveditaṃ yadyattat sarvaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥ || 14 ||

yadannā devatā yasya tadannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
naivedyanindakaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛtyante yoginīgaṇāḥ || 15 ||

raktapānodyatāḥ sarvā māṃsāsthicarvaṇodyatāḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 16 ||

iti | kulārṇave -

asaṃskṛtaṃ vṛthāpānaṃ balātkāreṇa maithunam |
svaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajed || 1 ||

ātmārthaṃ prāṇināṃ hiṃsā na kadācinmayoditā |
balidānaṃ vinā devyā hiṃsā sarvatra varjayet || 2 ||

animittaṃ tṛṇaṃ vāpi cchedayenna kadācana |
māmanādṛtya puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ syāt pratyavāyataḥ || 3 ||

mannimittaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ bhavati śāmbhavi |
yairevāpyāyanaṃ dravyaiḥ siddhistaireva coditā || 4 ||

kuṇḍīkumbhakapālāni madhupūrṇāni vibhṛtaḥ |
kiṃ na paśyati loko'yaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān || 5 ||

śrīguroḥ kulaśāstrebhyaḥ samyagvijñāya vāsanām |
pañcamudrā niṣeveta cānyathā narakaṃ vrajet || 6 ||

kuladravyāṇi sevante ye'nyadarśanamāśritāḥ |
tadaṅgaromasaṃkhyābhirjāyante bhūtayoniṣu || 7 ||

iti | tathā (8|7) -

adīkṣitairanācārairatantrajñairadaivataiḥ |
dūṣakaiḥ samayabhraṣṭairna kuryād dravyasaṃgatim || 1 ||

abhijñammanyamāneśca prapañcaḥ vratadhāribhiḥ |
paśubhikṣudrakarmasthairna kuryād dravyasaṅgatim || 2 ||

strīdviṣṭairgurubhiḥ śaptairbhaktihīnairdurātmabhiḥ |
kulopadeśahīnaiśca na kuryād dravyasaṅgatim || 3 ||

anabhijñairanarhaiśca na kuryād dravyasaṅgatim |
padavākyapramāṇajñāḥ śrutismṛtyarthavedinaḥ || 4 ||

kuladharmānabhijñā ye tān sarvān varjayet priye |
svakule'pi prasūtā ye vṛddhācārapravartinaḥ || 5 ||

tvatpūjāvimukhāḥ syuścetaiḥ saṅgaṃ varjayet priye |
strīputramitrabandhūnāṃ snigdhānāmapi pārvati || 6 ||

kulācārānabhijñānāṃ saṃgatiṃ varjayet priye |
adṛṣṭapuruṣāṇāṃ ca deśāntaranivāsinām || 7 ||

vinā saṅketayogena na kuryād dravyasaṅgatim |
kulīnaṃ nāvamanyeta pūjayet taṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 ||

kulīneṣu prasanneṣu prasannā devatā bhavet |
svapātrasthitaśeṣaṃ ca na dadyādbhairavāya ca || 9 ||

yadi dadyāt kuleśāni devatāśāpamāpnuyāt |
āsanaṃ bhojanaṃ pātramupānacchayanāni ca || 10 ||

anabhijñairanarhaiśca saṅkaraṃ naiva kārayet |
kulapūjāntarāyaṃ tu yaḥ karoti hi durmatiḥ || 11 ||

sa yāti narakaṃ ghoramekaviṃśatibhiḥ kulaiḥ |
tasmāt sarva prayatnena kulapūjārato bhavet || 12 ||

labhate sarvasiddhiṃ ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
ārādhanāsamarthaścet dadyādarcanasādhanam || 13 ||

yo dātuṃ naiva śaknoti kuryādarcanadarśanam |
samyak śatakratūn kṛtvā yatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 14 ||

p. 422)

tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sakṛtkṛtvā kramārcanam |
dattvā ṣoḍaśadānāni yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 15 ||

tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dattvā śrīcakrasādhanam |
sārdhatrikoṭitīrṣeṣu snātvā yatphalamāpnuyāt || 16 ||

tatphalaṃ labhate bhaktyā kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanam |
bahunoktena kiṃ devi yathāśaktyā dadāti yaḥ || 17 ||

kulācāryāya pūjārthaṃ kuladrayaṃ sa sarvavit |
yathaivāntaścarā rājñaḥ priyāḥ syurna bahiścarāḥ || 18 ||

tathāntaryāganiṣṭā ye priyā me devi nāpare |
samarpayanti te bhaktyā tvāvābhyāṃ piśitāsavam || 19 ||

utpādayati cānandaṃ matpriyaḥ kaulikaḥ priye |
anadhītopyaśāstrajño gurubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ || 20 ||

kulapūjārato yastu sa me priyatamo bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 21 ||

iti | tantrāntare -

kulajāṃ yuvatīṃ vikṣya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥ |
yadi bhāgyavaśād devi kuladṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate || 1 ||

tadaiva mānasīṃ pūjāṃ tatra tāsāṃ prakalpayet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

tāsāṃ bhagādidevīm | tathā -

bhaginīṃ bhagajihvāṃ ca bhagāsyāṃ bhagasākṣiṇīm |
bhagadantāṃ bhagākṣīṃ ca bhagakarṇāṃ bhagatvacām || 3 ||

bhaganāsāṃ bhagastanīṃ bhagasthāṃ bhagasarpiṇīm |
sampūjya tābhyo gandhādyairmānasairgurumeva ca || 4 ||

namaskṛtya vidhānena svayamakṣobhitaḥ sudhīḥ |
bālāṃ vā yauvanonmatāṃ vṛddhā vā sundarīṃ tathā || 5 ||

kutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtyā vibhāvayet |
tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāṃ ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathā || 6 ||

sarvathā ca na kartavyamanyathā siddhirodhakṛt |
striyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striyaścaiva vibhūṣaṇam || 7 ||

strīsaṅginā sadā bhāvyamanyathā siddhihānikṛt |
japasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhva japaṃ caret || 8 ||

striyaṃ gacchan spṛśan paśyan viśeṣāt kulajāṃ śubhām |
bhakṣaṃstāmbūlamanyāni bhakṣyadravyaṃ yathāruci || 9 ||

bhuktvā hyaśeṣabhakṣyāṇi bhuktvā śeṣaṃ japaṃ caret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 10 ||

iti | vīratantre -

dikkālaniyamo nātra sthityādiniyamo naca |
na jape kālaniyamo caryādiṣu baliṣvapi || 1 ||

svecchāniyama uktaśca mahāmantrasya sādhane |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti | mahāmantrāstu tatraiva -

kālī tārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī |
bhairavī cchinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī matā || 1 ||

bagalā siddhavidyā ca mātaṅgī kamalātmikā |
etā eva mahāvidyā daśa vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2 ||

nātra śuddhyādyapekṣāsti nārimitrādidūṣaṇam |
navā prayāsabāhulyaṃ samayāsamayādikam || 3 ||

iti | atra kālī dakṣiṇākālikādibhedāḥ | tārā tārābhedāḥ | mahāvidyā 
ṣoḍaśīśrīmahātripurasundaryāḥ | ṣoḍaśīpañcadaśībhedasahitā | 
bhuvaneśvarī tadbhedasahitā | bhairavī bālādibhedasahitā | chinnamastā 
tadbhedasahitā | vidyā dhūmāvatī tadbhedā gharmaṭīmarkaṭī-
ārdrapaṭītadbhedasahitā | bagalā tadbhedasahitā vārāhyaṣṭabhedasahitā | 
siddhavidyā ca mātaṅgī 
sumukhīśyāmālaghumātaṅgīrājamātaṅgībhedasahitā | kamalātmikā 
mahālakṣmī bhedasahitā | tathā -

vastrāsanasthānagehadehasparśādivāriṇaḥ |
śuddhiṃ na cācaredatra nirvikalpamanāścaret || 4 ||

iti | kulārṇave -

kulācāragṛhaṃ gatvā bhaktyā pāpaṃ viśodhayet |
yācayedamṛtaṃ kaulaṃ tadabhāve kulaṃ bhavet || 1 ||

kulācāreṇa yatkṛtvā daṇḍapātraṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
namaskṛtya ca gṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajet || 2 ||

iti | anyatrāpi -

vṛthā na gamayetkālaṃ dyūtakrīḍādinā sudhīḥ |
gamayed devatāpūjājapayāgastavādinā || 1 ||

p. 423)

vīrāṇāṃ japayajñastu sarvakāle praśasyate |
sarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

śaktiḥ śivaḥ śivaḥ śaktiḥ śaktirbrahmā janārdanaḥ |
śaktirindro raviḥ śaktiḥ śaktiścandro grahā druvaḥ || 3 ||

śaktirūpaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yo na jānāti nārakī |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 4 ||

iti | vīratantre -

snānādi mānasaṃ śaucaṃ mānasaḥ pravaro japaḥ |
pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikam || 1 ||

sarva eva śubhaḥ kālo nāśubho vidyate kvacit |
na viśeṣo divā rātrau na sandhyāyāṃ divāniśam || 2 ||

sarvadā pūjayed devīmāsnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥ |
mahāniśi śucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayet || 3 ||

rātrāveva mahāpūjā kartavyā vīravandite |
taddine sarvathā kāryā śāsanānmama suvrate || 4 ||

iti | mahāniśā tu tatraiva -

ardharātrāt paraṃ yacca muhūrtadvayameva ca |
sā mahārātriruddiṣṭā tadgataṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 5 ||

iti | gandharvatantre -

pṛthvīmṛtumatīṃ vīkṣya sahasraṃ yadi nityaśaḥ |
tadā vādī svasiddhāntahataḥ kṣititalaṃ vrajet || 1 ||

pṛthvīṃ | kulam | nityaśa iti śoḍaśadinaṃ yāvat |

parvate hastamāropya nirbhayo yatamānasaḥ |
kavitāṃ labhate so'pi amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati || 2 ||

tatrāpi sahasramiti sambandhaḥ | parvataḥ stanaḥ | nīlatantre -

padmaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā bimbaṃ khañjanaṃ śikharaṃ tathā |
cāmaraṃ ravibimbaṃ ca tilapuṣpaṃ saroruham || 1 ||

triśūla vīkṣya japtvā ca śataśaḥ śuddhabhāvataḥ |
mukhaprasādaṃ sumukhaṃ sulocanaṃ suhāsyakam || 2 ||

sukeśaṃ sugatiṃ caiva sugandhiṃ sukhameva ca |
labhate ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || 3 ||

padmaṃ mukhaṃ bimbamadharam khañjanaṃ cakṣuḥ śikharaṃ stanaṃ 
cāmaraṃ keśaṃ ravibimbaṃ sindūraṃ tilapuṣpaṃ nāsikāṃ saroruhaṃ 
nābhiṃ triśūlaṃ trivalīmiti || bhāvacūḍāmaṇau -

ekākī nirjane deśe śmaśāne vijanaṃ vane |
śūnyāgāre nadītīre niḥśaṅko viharet sadā || 1 ||

mahācīnadrume devīṃ dhyātvā tatra prapūjayet |
taddrūmodbhavapuṣpeṇa pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ || 2 ||

sa bhavet kuladevaśca kulakramagataḥ śuciḥ |
brahmatarormahāpadme devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhiḥ || 3 ||

tatsudhārasasāreṇa tarpayenmātṛkānane |
mahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭitaḥ sādhakottamaḥ || 4 ||

rātrau yadi japenmantraṃ saiva kalpalatā bhavet |
tithikrameṇa saṃkhyābhirlatābhirveṣṭito yadi || 5 ||

tadā māsena siddhiḥ syāt sahasrajapamānataḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ dviguṇaṃ yadi dṛśyate || 6 ||

tatraiva mahatīṃ siddhiṃ devānāmapi durlabhām | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 7 ||

iti | kulacūḍāmaṇau -

śṛṇu putra rahasyaṃ me samayācārasambhavam |
yena hīnā na sidhyanti janmakoṭisahasraśaḥ || 1 ||

mānavaḥ kulaśāstrāṇāṃ kulācāryānucāriṇām |
tadā caret tu sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ || 2 ||

paranindāsahiṣṇuḥ syādupakārarataḥ sadā |
parvate vipine vāpi nirjane śūnyamaṇḍape || 3 ||

catuṣpathe janaśūnye yadi daivādgatirbhavet |
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā natvā gacchedyathāsukham || 4 ||

gṛdhraṃ vīkṣya mahākālīṃ namaskuryādalakṣitam |
kṣemaṅkarīṃ tathā vīkṣya jambukīṃ yamadūtikām || 5 ||

kuraraṃ śyenabhūkākau kṛṣṇamārjārameva ca |
kṛśodari mahācaṇḍe muktakeśi balipriye || 6 ||

kulācāraprasannāsye namaste śaṅkarapriye |
śmaśānaṃ ca śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajan || 7 ||

praṇamyānena manunā mantrī sukhamavāpnuyāt |
ghoradaṃṣṭre karālāsye phiṭiśabdapraṇādini || 8 ||

p. 424)

ghoraghoraravāsphāre namaste vindyavāsini |
bhāgyodayasamutpanne namaste varavarṇini || 9 ||

kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tathā puṣpaṃ rājānaṃ rājapūtrakam |
hastyaśvarathaśastrāṇi phalakān vīrapūruṣān || 10 ||

mahiṣaṃ kuladevaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mahiṣamardinīm |
praṇamya jayadurgāṃ vā sarvavighnairna lipyate || 11 ||

jaya devi jagaddhātri tripurādye tridaivate |
bhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣaghni namo'stu te || 12 ||

madyabhāṇḍaṃ sadālokya matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ varastriyam |
dṛṣṭvā ca bhairavīṃ devīṃ praṇamedvimṛśan manum || 13 ||

ghoravighnavināśāya kulācārasamṛddhaye |
namāmi varade devi muṇḍamālāvibhūṣite || 14 ||

raktadhārāsamākīrṇāṃ varade tvāṃ namāmyaham |
sarvavighnaharaṃ devi namaste haravallabhe || 15 ||

eteṣāṃ darśane caiva yadi naivaṃ prakurvate |
śaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya siddhirna jāyate || 16 ||

kulācāre kulāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
yoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanam || 17 ||

yathā viṣṇutithau viṣṇuḥ pūjito vāñchitapradaḥ |
tathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinī || 18 ||

iti | kulācāraniyamastu yāmale -

raviścandro guruḥ sauraścatvāraścākulā ime |
bhaumaśukrau kulākhyau tu budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥ || 1 ||

dvitīyā daśamī ṣaṣṭhī kulākulamudāhṛtam |
viṣamāścākulāḥ sarvāḥ śeṣāśca tithayaḥ kulāḥ || 2 ||

vāruṇārdrābhijinmūlaṃ kulākulamudāhṛtam |
kulāni samayugmāni śeṣamānyakulāni ca || 3 ||

tithau vāre ca nakṣatre hyakule sthāyino jayaḥ |
kulākhye jayino nityaṃ sāmyaṃ caiva kulākule || 4 ||

iti | evaṃ kulācārādikaṃ jñātvā sādhakaḥ karma kuryāt | atha 
śivābaliḥ | kulacūḍāmaṇau -

bilvamūle prāntare vā śmaśāne vāpi sādhakaḥ |
māṃsapradhānaṃ naivedyaṃ sandhyākāle nivedayet || 1 ||

kālikālālīti vaktaye tatromā śivarūpiṇī |
paśurūpadharāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ saha || 2 ||

bhuktvā rauti yadaiśānyāṃ mukhamuttolya sasvaram |
tadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇam || 3 ||

avaśyamannadānena niyataṃ toṣayecchivām |
nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 4 ||

tathaiva kulasevyānāṃ nityatā kulapūjane |
paśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjane || 5 ||

śivārāveṇa tasyāśu sarva naśyati niścitam |
japapūjāvidhānāni yatkiñcit sukṛtāni ca || 6 ||

gṛhītvā śāpamādāya śivā roditi nirjane |
ekayā bhujyate yatra śivayā deva bhairava || 7 ||

tatraiva sarvaśaktīnāṃ pritīḥ paramadurlabhā |
paśuśaktiḥ pakṣiśaktirnavaśaktiryathākramāt || 8 ||

pūjanādviguṇaṃ karma saguṇaṃ sādhayet tataḥ |
tena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat || 9 ||

rājādibhayamāpannai deśāntarabhayādike |
śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharet || 10 ||

gṛhṇa devi mahābhāge śive kālāgnirūpiṇi |
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tava || 11 ||

evamuccārya dātavyo baliḥ kulārcanapriyaiḥ |
yadi na bhujyate vatsa tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavet || 12 ||

śubhaṃ yadi bhavet tvatra bhujyate tadaśeṣataḥ |
evaṃ jñātvā mahādeva śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret || 13 ||

iti | kulavartma sarvatra gopanīyam | tantrāntare -

nirjane caiva kartavyaṃ na caivaṃ janasaṃnidhau |
kiṃvā pakṣipataṅgādidarśane naiva kārayet || 1 ||

pātālamaṇḍape vāpi gahvareṣu niyantrite |
niśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ naca sannidhau || 2 ||

kulapuṣpaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulapūjāṃ kulaṃ japam |
kulaṃ kulapatiṃ caiva kulamālāṃ kulākulam || 3 ||

kulacakraṃ kuladhyānaṃ sarvathā na prakāśayet |
prakāśāt kāryahāniḥ syāt prakāśānnidhanādikam || 4 ||

prakāśānmantranāśaḥ syāt prakāśāt kulahiṃsanam |
prakāśānmṛtyulābhaḥ syānna prakāśyaṃ kadācana || 5 ||

pūjākāle ca deveśi yadi ko'pyatra gacchati |
darśayedvaiṣṇavīṃ mudrāṃ viṣṇunyāsaṃ tathā stavam || 6 ||

p. 425)

prakāśādyadi guptiḥ syāttatprakāśānna dūṣaṇam |
gopanādyadi vyaktiḥ syānna guptirabhidhīyate || 7 ||

kadāciddehahāniḥ syānna ca vyaktiḥ kadācana |
varaṃ pūjā na kartavyā vyaktirnaiva kadācana || 8 ||

iti | vīratantre śivābalimadhikṛtya -

nṛpalaṃ vairināśāya samare vijayāya ca |
chāgalaṃparasenyasya stambhanāya viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||

sarvarogopaśamanaṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam |
paravādimukhastambhe māhiṣaṃ śasyate palam || 2 ||

mṛgajaṃ sarvaśatrūṇāmucāṭanakaraṃ param |
śaśotthaṃ vaśyakarmādāvāvikaṃ kṛṣṭikārakam || 3 ||

paśūtthaṃ mohane śastaṃ vidveṣe turagodbhavam |
uccāṭe coṣṭrajaṃ śastaṃ kharotthaṃ prītināśanam || 4 ||

mahāmāṃsāṣṭakasyeha phalaṃ śṛṇu krameṇa ca |
āyuḥ kīrtidhanārogyaputraśrījayakāntidam || 5 ||

iti | mahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ tatraiva -

gonarebhāśvamahiṣavarāhājamṛgodbhavam |
mahāmāṃsāṣṭakamidaṃ devatāprītikārakam || 6 ||

khecarāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa khecarīsiddhidaṃ phalam |
sarvamāṃsa surāyuktaṃ dadyād devyai viśeṣataḥ || 7 ||

matsyotthaṃ mantrasiddhayai ca kaukkuṭaṃ kārmaṇāpaham |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *  || 8 ||

iti | athaitasya prayogaḥ bilvamūle prāntare vā ityādi vijanasthale 
sandhyākāle tatra gatvā balidravyaṃ kvacitsaṃsthāpya svayamāsane 
samupaviśya purataḥ pāṣāṇadau pūjāyantramathavā 
trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturasrātmakaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ candanādinā viracya 
gurugaṇapatikṣetreśān praṇamya mūlena 
prāṇāyāmatrayarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānāni vidhāya adyetyādi 
amukadevaśarmāmukakāmaḥ śrīparadevatāprītyarthaṃ śivābalividhiṃ 
kariṣye iti saṅkalpya balimaṇḍalāya namaḥ iti gandhādinā maṇḍalaṃ 
sampūjya tatra balidravyaṃ nikṣipya balidravyāya namaḥ iti balidravyaṃ 
sampūjya mūlavidyāmuccārya kāli kālyume śivarūpiṇi paśurūpadhare 
parivāragaṇaiḥ sahātrāyāhi dhūpadīpādisahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa 
svāhā punarmūlaṃ amukadevatāyai sāyudhāyai saśaktikāyai 
paśurūpadharāye eṣa balirnamaḥ ityutsṛjya gṛhṇa devi mahābhāge śive 
kālāgnirūpiṇi | śubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tava || iti 
prārthya kvaciddūre gatvā ekānte svāsanoparyupaviśya 
prāṇāyāmādipūrvakaṃ mūlamantraṃ japet | yāvadāgatya śivābaliṃ 
svīkṛtya rauti tāvatkālaṃ japitvā japaṃ samarpya nadyādau pādau 
prakṣālyācamya devī dhyāyanmaunī paścādapaśyad gṛhamāgacchediti ||

atha dūtīyāgaḥ | devīyāmale - śrīmahādeva uvāca

dūtīyāgavidhiṃ vakṣye kauladharmottamottamam |
tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa svayaṃ brahmatvamāpnuyāt || 1 ||

santi nanāvidhā dharmā aihikāyuṣmikapradāḥ |
tatsāraṃ tu samālokya tathānyanmantrasaṃgraham || 2 ||

tanmadhye sārabhūtaṃ ca sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam |
na kasyāpi varārohe proktavāṃstridaśeṣvapi || 3 ||

dūtīyāge kṛte mantrī sarvajño jāyate dhruvam |
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 4 ||

devā yakṣāśca gandharvā ṛṣayaśca munīśvarāḥ |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstathānye pitṛdevatāḥ || 5 ||

dūtīyāgavidhiṃ kṛtvā tattatpadamavāpnuyuḥ |
vidhivat sukṛtī kṛtvā dūtīyāgaṃ tu pārvati || 6 ||

kṛtakṛtyo na sandehaḥ sundarī suprasīdati |
yeṣāṃ vaṃśe prajāyeta dūtīyāgo maheśvari || 7 ||

te dhanyāśca samṛddhārthārate vandyāḥ suhṛdaḥ samāḥ |
kāyena manasā vācā sarvathā na prakāśayet || 8 ||

sutaṃ patnīṃ śiro dadyānna deyamidamuttamam |
kuryāt prayatnataścaiva dūtikāyajanaṃ priye || 9 ||

yaiḥ kṛtaṃ yajanaṃ dūtyāstairiṣṭāḥ kratavo'khilāḥ |
sarvatīrthamayaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevamayo bhavet || 10 ||

puraścaryādi sakalaṃ kṛtaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥ |
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca || 11 ||

āsamudrā ca dharaṇī dattā tena sadakṣiṇā |
merumandaratulyāni suvarṇānyarpitāni vai || 12 ||

p. 426)

gokoṭidānādyat puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate priye |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dūtīyāgaṃ samācaret || 13 ||

pūjāsampūrṇadaṃ bhadre sarvāriṣṭapraśāmakam |
yadanuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvamācaritaṃ bhavet || 14 ||

śaktipūjā prakartavyā vidhivadbhaktisaṃyutaiḥ |
atha dūtīṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇāni ca sundari || 15 ||

acañcalā salajjā ca kulagā(jā)mṛdubhāṣiṇī |
paṭvī suśīlā priyavāg guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratā || 16 ||

dayādharmaratā śāntā hitadā sukharūpiṇī |
rūpayauvanasampannā niścalā mantratatparā || 17 ||

sadā tuṣṭā supuṣṭāṅgī sundarī māninī śuciḥ |
nātikubjā ca hrasvā ca cārusarvāṅgasaṃyutā || 18 ||

dīrghakeśī viśālākṣī sūtrasuspaṣṭanāsikā |
pūrṇagaṇḍakapolā ca raktoṣṭhī ca sudantikā || 19 ||

vartulānanagaurā ca suhanuḥ kambukaṇṭhinī |
subāhuvallīsaṃyuktā vṛttapīnapayodharā || 20 ||

kṛśamadhyā sunābhiḥ syādūrustambhātimāṃsalā |
saralāṃgulikāyuktā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 21 ||

kāyena manasā vācā svārthalaulyavivarjitā |
pūjanīyā prayatne pañcaviṃśativārṣikā || 22 ||

aprasūtā viśeṣeṇa śyāmā caivottamā matā |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 23 ||

śyāmālakṣaṇaṃ tu kāmaśāstre snigdhanakhanayanadaśanā niranuśayā 
māninī sthirasnehā | susparśaśiśiravarāṅgavivarāṅganāḥ śyāmeti ||

ata ūrdhvaṃ na pūjā syādityājñā parameśvarī |
pūjitāścedvarārohe tarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 24 ||

arcaneṣu prayoktavyāḥ kāminyo bhakticetasaḥ |
tā yadā rajasā yuktāstataḥ pūjyā mahāphalāḥ || 25 ||

ātmīyāśca parāścaiva puṣpavatīḥ prapūjayet |
tatra dveṣaparo mūrkho dāridryaṃ samavāpnuyāt || 26 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

yāmamātre gate rātrau kulagehaṃ tataḥ pumān |
tāmbūlāpūritamukho dhūpāmodasugandhitaḥ || 1 ||

raktacandanadigdhāṅgo raktamālyānulepanaḥ |
raktavastraparīdhāno lākṣāraktagṛhaṃ gataḥ || 2 ||

raktamānyena saṃvīto raktapuṣpavibhūṣitaḥ |
pañcīkaraṇasaṃketaiḥ pūjayet kulanāyikām || 3 ||

iti | kulanāyikā yathā tatraiva -

naṭī kāpālino veśyā pukkasī nāpitāṅganā |
rajakī rañjakī caiva sairandhrī ca suvāsinī || 4 ||

ghaṭikā khaṭikā caiva tathā gopālakanyakā |
viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ || 5 ||

gurubhaktā devabhaktā ghṛṇālajjāvivarjitāḥ |
saṃgopanaratāḥ prāyastaruṇyaḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ || 6 ||

akṣatācārasampannāṃ śīlasaubhāgyaśālinīm |
sadāparigṛhītāṃ vā yadvā saṅketamāgatām || 7 ||

athavā tatkṣaṇāyātāṃ madanānalatāpitām |
viliptāṃ raktagandhena raktāmbaravibhūṣitām || 8 ||

sugandhiraktakusumāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
sadānuṣṭhānaniratāṃ sāttvikīṃ bhaktisaṃyutām || 9 ||

kāluṣyarahitāṃ kuryāt sabhāyāṃ bhaktavatsalām |
cāturyaudāryadākṣiṇyakaraṇādiguṇādhikām || 10 ||

rūpayauvanasampannāṃ śīlasaubhāgyaśālinīm |
sudhūpadhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmasu yojayed || 11 ||

iti | kumārītantre -

naṭī kāpālinī veśyā rajakī nāpitāṅganā |
brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā || 1 ||

brāhmaṇīti brahmaṇaviṣayam |

mālākārasya kanyāpi nava kanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
evaṃ bhūtāṃ yajettāṃ tu prasūnatūlikopari || 2 ||

arthādvā kāmato vāpi saukhyādapi ca yo naraḥ |
liṅgayonirato mantrī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 3 ||

iti | devīyāmale -

atha pūjāphalaṃ vakṣye utarottaratottaram |
svaśaktyā ayutaṃ puṇyaṃ paraśaktiprapūjane || 1 ||

p. 427)

tato veśyādhikā jñeyā rajakyapi tato'dhikā |
rajakyāḥ kṣurikī śreṣṭhā kṣurikyāścarmakāriṇī || 2 ||

tato'dhikatarā proktā hetunārī varānane |
tato'dhikāntyasambhūtā caṇḍālī ca tato'dhikā || 3 ||

tato mātaṅginī śreṣṭhā mātaṅgayāḥ pukkasī matā |
pukkasyā akṣatā śreṣṭhā tato'tisundarī smṛtā || 4 ||

sundarīparataḥ proktā prītivatyanugāminī  |
tatparā parameśāni tanmanāḥ śubhalakṣaṇā || 5 ||

samayācārasampannā mantrajñā bhayavarjitā |
vidagdhā tvaprasūtā ca dhairyasvātantryasaṃyutā || 6 ||

evaṃ guṇasamāyuktāḥ pūjayet sarvayoṣitaḥ |
ātmīyāśca parāścaiva śaktimātrraṃ maheśvari || 7 ||

mantrādhidevatābuddhyā pūjyāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ |
vividhaiḥ phalatāmbūlairvastrālaṅkārahemabhiḥ || 8 ||

sampūjya vidhivadbhaktyā bahuhetuṃ pradāpayet |
sambhogavāsanāṃ dhṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchaktipūjanam || 9 ||

sa dāridryamavāpnoti nārakī ca bhaved dhruvam |
paramānandarūpeṇa deha bhāvavivarjitaḥ || 10 ||

śaktyā yaduktaṃ deveśi tadṛce śāmbhavī stavam |
tadājñā tu prakartavyā tadā śreyaḥ pravartate || 11 ||

śaktyājñāṃ laṅghayenmantrī tapastepe nirarthakam |
kṛte tatropahāsādi kuṣṭhī bhavati nānyathā || 12 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tadvākyaṃ tu samācaret |
vyaṅgā vā vikṛtāṅgī ca kāṇākṣī badhirā tathā || 13 ||

muṇḍinī vidhavā mūkā pralāpinyamṛtabhāṣiṇī |
adīkṣitā bhaktihīnā gurusevāvivarjitā || 14 ||

dūṣakī samayādbhraṣṭā ghorā kaitavacāriṇī |
vṛddhāturā vakramukhī krodhadurgandhakaśmalā || 15 ||

sadā niṣṭhuravākyā ca anācārā ca kākavāk |
dīrghadantā ca lamboṣṭhī śuṣkastananitambini || 16  ||

kṛṣṇavarṇātimalinā kṛśā vikalacetanā |
mahāsthūlātirogārtā pralambitapayodharā || 17 ||

īṣannāsikanetrā ca śuṣkāṅgī cordhvakeśinī |
kaniṣṭhā kroḍadantā ca sadā svārthasamanvitā || 18 ||

kuṣṭhī hīnāṅginī caiva paṃgvandhā cāturālasā |
śvetāṃṅginī raudrabimbā cchāgayoniḥ piśācikā || 19 ||

matibhraṣṭātivikalā atidīrghātikubjikā |
etallakṣaṇasampannāḥ śaktīryatnena varjayet || 20 ||

śaktipātraṃ na dātavyaṃ vidhavāyai kadācana |
ajñānāllobhato mohād datte pūjā tu niṣphalā || 21 ||

tasmād dūtī prakartavyā lakṣaṇoktā tu pārvati |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 22 ||

iti | tathā brahmayāmale nārada uvāca -

sarvajña jagatāṃ nātha śāktaṃ cecchruticoditam |
mātaṅgīpūjanaṃ tatra kathaṃ muktipradāyakam || 1 ||

arcane prathitā veśyā veśyā sā tu rajasvalā |
rajasvalā ca mātaṅgī sā dūtī sarvamaṅgalā || 2 ||

iti proktaṃ tvayā pūrvamidānīṃ tadviparyayaḥ |
tava vākyamabhūt brahmannetadvada pitāmaha || 3 ||

brahmovāca -

mā kuruṣvātra sandehaṃ vedoktaṃ śāktamuttamam |
asmin sarvajña kalpo'sau mātaṅgī munipuṅgavaḥ || 4 ||

varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vatsa tapa ugraṃ cacāra ha |
tena prītā mahādevī devānāṃ hitakāriṇī || 5 ||

varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhagavan dāsyāmi tava vāñchitam |
tacchrutvā dvijavaryastāṃ yayāce dharmasādhanam || 6 ||

he devi jagatāṃ mātaḥ prītā cedyadi sāmpratam |
apatyatāṃ samāsādya matkulālambanaṃ kuru || 7 ||

ityabhyarthya muniśreṣṭho janayāmāsa tāṃ sutām |
śyāmalāṃ cāruvadanāṃ vīṇāśukasamanvitām || 8 ||

śārikāṃ jñānasampannāṃ japamālāṃ karāmbujaiḥ |
dhārayantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ śaṅkhatāṭaṅkaśobhinīm || 9 ||

sā vabhūva mahādevī mātaṅgakulanandinī |
mātaṅgīti tadā devī vikhyātā varadāyanī || 10 ||

tāṃ vilokya tadā śambhurdūtīṃ cakre sulakṣaṇām |
tripurājjetukāmena yonipūjā tadā kṛtā || 11 ||

pratyālīḍhāsthitā devī pūjāṃ svīkṛtya niścalā |
yadā dṛṣṭarajā bhūtvā tāṃ vavre śaṅkaraḥ priyām || 12 ||

p. 428)

tadā prabhṛti sañjāto dūtīyāgo manoharaḥ |
praṇavena tadā śambhustayā sārdhaṃ rataṃ bhajan || 13 ||

praṇavāntargataṃ mantraṃ mātaṅgākhyaṃ ca nirgatam |
sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mālāmantramabhūt tadā || 14 ||

rasāvāptipadaṃ divyamanindyaṃ lokarañjanam |
mātaṅgīmantramatyarthaṃ manmathapratipādakam || 15 ||

ādyantaśūnyā sā devī tasmāt khyātā tadantyajā |
mātaṅgīcāntyavarṇasthā tadāsā antyajābhavat || 16 ||

antyajānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca cakre aikyaṃ praśasyate |
sā devī sarvavarṇānāṃ varaṃ dattvā niruttaram || 17 ||

kṛtvā saṅketasamayaṃ cakre mātaṅgamuttamam |
na doṣaḥ sarvavarṇānāmiti dattvā varaṃ tadā || 18 ||

na doṣaṃ tatra vijñeyaṃ sarvataḥ śruticoditam |
devīmuddiśya mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaṃ yad doṣavarjitam || 19 ||

etacchāstramidaṃ divyaṃ na vācyaṃ śruticoditam |
antaryāgamidaṃ jñeyaṃ bahiryāgaṃ ca vaidikam || 20 ||

mantratantrasamāyuktaṃ taddvayaṃ brahmabodhakam |
cakrasaṅketasamayaṃ sarvaṃ tubhyam prakāśitam || 21 ||

gopanīyaṃ prayatnena na vācyaṃ paśusannidhau |
tyaja śaṅkāṃ mahābhāga satyametanmayoditam || 22 ||

mātaṅgīpūjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dūtīyāge manohare |
yonipūjāṃ vinā pūjā kṛtāpi hyakṛtā bhavet || 23 ||

kṛtvā kenāpi sarvajña sa bhavedvigatāmayaḥ |
āyurārogyavibhavānamitāṃllabhate naraḥ || 24 ||

anenaiva vidhānena viṣārto nirviṣo bhavet |
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || 25 ||

mātaṅgīśaktimabhyarcya tayā sākaṃ samarcayet |
mātaṅgīmanmathopetā sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 26 ||

śaktyā sākaṃ tadā pūjyā mātaṅgī mantradevatā |
sā devī śaktihīnā tu na dadāti manoratham || 27 ||

niḥśaṅkāṃ nirmalāṃ tanvīṃ śyāmāṃ cārupayodharām |
kaulikānvayasambhūtāṃ dīkṣitāṃ krodhavarjitām || 28 ||

dīkṣitāṃ kaulike yāge suśīlāṃ ca dṛḍhavratām |
triṃśatsaṃvatsarādhaḥsthāṃ ṣoḍaśābdādhikāmapi || 29 ||

pūjayet parayā bhaktyā tasyā yoniṃ sunirmalām |
yonimadhyagatāṃ devīṃ kālarātrimanusmaret || 30 ||

tatra bhogaṃ samāsādya devīṃ santarpayet sadā |
sakṛjjapena saṃsiddhirdvistrirvā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 31 ||

paśustrīsaṅgame prāpte śuddhiścet paśubandhanam |
athavā gṛhiṇī pūjyā pūtā puṣpavatīṣṭadā || 32 ||

arcane kanyakāḥ śreṣṭhāḥpramadāśca viśeṣataḥ |
tāsāṃ bhojyaṃ prakartavyamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 33 ||

śaktyullāsakaraṃ bhogamānandaṃ mokṣa ucyate |
dūtyaśca bhaginī putrī pautrī naptrī tathā snuṣā || 34 ||

rajakī carmakārī ca mātaṅgī gṛhiṇī varā |
arcane prathitā veśyā mantrayuktā manoharā || 35 ||

mātaṅgī yadi cedveśyā sāpi rajasvalā |
rajasvalā yadā cāsīt sarvotkṛṣṭā iti smṛtā || 36 ||

ityādi | tathā kulacūḍāmaṇau -

taruṇollāsasaṃyuktāṃ paryaṅke tu niveśayet |
bhayalajjādisarvāṇi parityajyātha dūtikām || 1 ||

kañcukaṃ ca parityajya tathā vastraṃ ca pārvati |
ācāryānucarī raktā manasā sukhadāyinī || 2 ||

dehabhāvaṃ parityajya saṃsaktabhujakau priye |
cumbanāliṅgane caiva nakhadantakṣatāni ca || 3 ||

bahunā ca kimuktena prāṇasyaikyaṃ samācaret |
dūtī yasya susaṃjñātā saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam || 4 ||

vaṃśadvayaṃ samuddhṛtya labhate śāśvataṃ padam |
sarvadā sukhamāpnoti sarvaiśvaryaṃ ca labhyate || 5 ||

na tasya duritaṃ kiñcin naca mārībhayaṃ bhavet |
cumbane paramaiśvaryaṃ nakhadantakṣatairyaśaḥ || 6 ||

sambhoge ca sukhaṃ yadyat tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam |
na dadyāccumbanaṃ yastu daridro jāyate dhruvam || 7 ||

āliṅganaṃ vinā devi kuṣṭhī bhavati pārvati |
vinā dantakṣataṃ devi loke bhavati ninditaḥ || 8 ||

pañcamīṃ (maṃ) tu sakṛd dattvā sāvitrī jāyate satī |
dvitīyena ca lakṣmīḥ syāt tṛtīye pārvatī bhavet || 9 ||

tato dadyāt sukhādhikyaṃ tasyāḥ puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate |
āliṅganairharedrogān dhanadhānyādi cumbanaiḥ || 10 ||

nakhadantākṣatādyaiśca tadā mokṣaḥ prajāyate |
sāyujyaṃ saṅgamena syāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||

p. 429)

iti || pañcamayāgapraśaṃsā bhairavayāmale -

kuryāduccāṭane dveṣe māraṇe mohane tathā |
surūpāṃ ca suveśāṃ ca taruṇīṃ sundarīṃ tathā || 1 ||

prasannamukhaśobhāḍhyāṃ tathā saubhāgyagarvitām |
udāravaṃśasambhūtāṃ pūjāgrahaṇaharṣitām || 2 ||

suvāsinīmīdṛśīṃ ca pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
tatkāle kāryasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 3 ||

viśeṣato yonipūjāṃ kuryādīpsitasiddhaye |
surūpāṃ taruṇīṃ veśyāṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaret || 4 ||

sarvajanamohanaṃ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
surūpāṃ taruṇīṃ dāsīṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaret || 5 ||

sarvalokasya vaśyārtha nātra sandeha iṣyate |
mātaṅginyāḥ surūpāyāḥ suguṇāyāstathaiva ca || 6 ||

taruṇyā yonipūjāṃ ca stambhanārthaṃ samācaret |
yasyā aṅge devatāsti tasyā yoniṃ prapūjayet || 7 ||

ākarṣaṇārthaṃ mantrajño nātra sandehasambhavaḥ |
surūpāyastaruṇyāśca yoginyā yonipūjane || 8 ||

ucchāṭanādikarmāṇi jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ |
madaghūrṇitanetrāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjane || 9 ||

rajasvalāyā vidveṣo bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
vidhavāyāḥ surūpāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjane || 10 ||

māraṇaṃ jāyate śīghraṃ nātra sandehasambhavaḥ |
paraṃ tu nirbhayo bhūtvā sarvametat samācaret || 11 ||

rajasvalā yā ca bhavet sarvajātisamudbhavā |
tasyāstu pūjane sarvakāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvam || 12 ||

sarvakārya suvāsinyāḥ pūjanaṃ nyāsapūrvakam |
bhagamālinimantreṇa kuryāt prārthanāpūrvakam || 13 ||

sarvakāryeṣu niṣpattirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu pūjā sarvatra śasyate || 14 ||

yasyā aṅge devatāsti tasyāḥ pūjāṃ samācaret |
vaśyākarṣaṇakārmāṇi manasā yadyadīpsitam || 15 ||

tatsarvaṃ bhavati kṣipraṃ nātra sandeha iṣyate |
aspṛśyāyāstaruṇyāstu pūjā dveṣārthamīritā || 16 ||

gurutaḥ śāstrato jñātvā sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet |
tāṃstān prayogān kurvīta kāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvam || 17 ||

paracakrastambhane ca jalastambhana eva ca |
meghākarṣe bhayāvāptau sarvaśatrunivarhaṇe || 18 ||

iti | athaitat prayogaḥ tatra sādhakaḥ proktakramalakṣaṇaḥ 
(kṛtātmapūjanakriyaḥ) svaśirasi śrīgurupādukāṃ dhyātvā sampūjya 
praṇamya proktakrameṇa śrīgurorājñāmādāya 
sarvalakṣaṇasampannāṃ brahmavidyādīkṣitāṃ dūtīṃ 
prātarnimantritāṃ sādaraṃ svayaṃ gatvā praṇamya samāhūyānīya 
pūjāsthāne mṛdvāsane samupaveśya tasyāḥ pādāvuṣṇajalena 
prakṣālya sukhopaviṣṭāṃ tāṃ praṇamya kṛtāñjaliḥ san bhagavati 
śrīparadevatāyajanārthaṃ tvaṃ me dūtībhūtvā māṃ kṛtārthaṃ kuru 
iti tāṃ prārthya devyagrataḥ svāsane samupaviśya kṛtāñjaliḥ adyetyādi 
śrīparadevatāprītyarthaṃ dūtīyajanamahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpya 
mūlavidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān 
vidhāya svavāmabhāge dūtīṃ samupaveśya mūlavidyayā 
sugandhitailenābhyaṅgaṃ kṛtvā sugandhāmalakādyudvartanaṃ 
vidhāyoṣṇodakena snapayitvā nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā 
sūkṣmavastreṇāṅgago?ñchanaṃ vidhāya 
raktapaṭavastrayugamāraktakañcukaṃ ca paridhāpya 
nānāvidhābharaṇairalaṃkṛtya keśān vijaṭīkṛtya dhūpayitvā saṃyamya 
sindūrakajjalālaktakādibhiḥ sīmantanayanacaraṇādi rañjayitvā 
ratneśvarīvidyayā sakuṃkumacandanatripuṇḍrayukte bhālatale 
sindūratilakaṃ kṛtvā sugandhakusumamālābhiḥ 
sugandhānulepanaiścālaṃkṛtya svavāmabhāge mṛdvāsane samupaveśya 
svayaṃ svāsane samupaviṣṭaḥ prāṇāyāmatrayamṛṣyādinyāsāṃśca 
vidhāya dūtīṃ devīrūpāṃ dhyāyan prāksthāpitaśaktipātra 
vatsvapurataḥ pātrāntaraṃ kalaśasthahetunāpūrya saṃskṛtya 
taddhatumuddharaṇapātreṇoddhṛtya bhogapātre kṛtvā sadvitīyaṃ 
bhogapātraṃ tasyai punaḥ punarnivedya taruṇollāsayuktāṃ jñātvā 
cakrasyottarabhāge svarṇarūpyavidrumagajadantādinirmitaṃ svacchaṃ 
(sudṛḍhaṃ) navaṃ paṭṭasūtraracitāraktapaṭṭikābhirgumphitaṃ 
paryaṅkamāstīrya tadupari paṭṭavastraracitāṃ 
bahutaratūlabhārabharitāṃ tūlikāmāstīrya 
taduparyucchīrṣakopavarhaṇādikaṃ niveśya tatra sugandhapuṣpāṇi 
karpūrarajāṃsi ca vikīrya tatra prāguktavidhinā yogapīṭhaṃ sampūjya 
tadupari śrīcakraṃ vibhāvya tathaiva sampūjya mañcakasya paścime 
yoginībaliṃ pūrve kṣetrapālabaliṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇeśabalimuttare 
baṭukabaliṃ ceti balicatuṣṭayaṃ dattvā paryaṅkopari dūtīṃ 
paścimābhimukhīṃ samupaveśya svayaṃ pūrvābhimukha upaviśya 

p. 430)

mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayamṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsāṃśca kṛtvā 
dūtīdehe kevalāṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyasya vaśinyādyaṣṭakaṃ vinyasya 
śirasi 4 drāṃ drāvaṇabāṇāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ 4 drīṃ 
kṣobhaṇabāṇāya namaḥ | mukhe 4 klīṃ vaśikaraṇabāṇāya namaḥ | 
guhye 4 blūṃ ākarṣaṇabāṇāya namaḥ | hṛdi 4 saḥ sammohanabāṇāya 
namaḥ | iti pañcabāṇān vinyasya tasyā lalāṭe 4 hrīṃ kāmāya namaḥ | 
gale 4 klīṃ manmathāya namaḥ | hṛdi 4 aiṃ kandarpāya namaḥ | nābhau 4 
blūṃ makaradhvajāya namaḥ | mūlādhāre 4 strīṃ mīnaketave namaḥ iti 
vinyasya tasyā dehe pūrvoktāḥ kāmakalāḥ somakalāśceti vinyasya 
tasyāḥ śirasi subhagāya ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīcchandase namaḥ | 
hṛdaye śrībhagamālinyai devatāyai namaḥ | guhye hrbleṃbījāya namaḥ | 
pādayoḥ strīṃ śaktaye namaḥ | nābhau hrīṃ kīlakāya namaḥ | iti 
ṛṣyādinyāsaṃ vinyasya tasyāḥ śarīre bhagamālinīvidyayā 
mūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ trirvyāpakaṃ vinyasya tasyāḥ śirasi trikoṇaṃ 
vibhāvya śirastrikoṇamadhye vakṣyamāṇavidhinā bālāṃ dhyātvā 
tadvidyāmuccārya śrībālādevīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ | 
agrakoṇe klīṃ kameśvarīśrī0 | vāmakoṇe aiṃvāgīśvarīśrī0 | 
dakṣiṇakoṇe sauḥ kulagaṇapatiśrī0 iti prādakṣiṇyena sampūjya tasyā 
dakṣiṇastane klīṃkāmadevaśrī0 | vāme vaṃ vasantaśrī0 | yonau 
śrīratidevīśrī | nābhau śrīprītidevīśrī0 | punaḥ śirastrikoṇādbahiḥ 
gaṃgaṇanāthaśrī0 | 4 siṃhapādaśrī0 | 4 vijayapādaśrī0 | 4 
anaṅgapādaśrī0 | 4 bhujaṅgapādaśrī0 | 4 citrapādaśrī0 | (4 
kanakapādaśrī0) 4 kanakādhyakṣapādaśrī0 | iti trikoṇādbahiḥ paritaḥ 
svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena sampūjya śirastrikoṇasya vāmakoṇe 4 māṃ 
mahālakṣmyai namaḥ | dakṣe 4 saṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ | tasyā romarājisu 4 
naṃ nandanodyānāya namaḥ | iti sampūjya tasyāḥ śirastrikoṇamadhye 
navayonyāḍhyakarṇikaṃ sakesaramaṣṭadalakamalaṃ dalāgreṣu 
triśūlayuktaṃ tadbahirvṛttaṃ tadbahiścaturdvārayuktaṃ 
caturasratrayaveṣṭitaṃ bālācakraṃ vibhāvya tatra 
maṇdūkādiparatattvāntaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ sarva śirasyeva 
sampūjyāṣṭadalakesareṣu 4 vāmāyai0 4 jyeṣṭhāyai0 4 raudryaiḥ 4 
ambikāyai0 4 icchāyai0 4 jñānāyai0 4 kriyāyai0 4 kubjikāyai0 4 
vibhvyai0 4 viṣaghnyai0 4 dūtaryai0 4 ānandāyai namaḥ iti sampūjya 
madhye 4 hsauḥ sadāśivamahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ iti 
navayonisthatrikoṇamadhye sampūjya tatra bālāvidyāmuccārya 
śrībālāmūrti kalpayāmi iti puṣpāñjalinā mūrti parikalpya 
punarbālāmuccārya śrībālāmūrtaye namaḥ iti mūrti sampūjya 
karābhyāṃ puṣpāñjalimādāya hṛdayakamale vakṣyamāṇarūpāṃ 
devīṃ dhyātvā punastejorūpāṃ tāmāpādya tattejaḥ 
suṣumnāmārgeṇa brahmarandhraṃ nītvā vahannāsāpuṭādhvanā 
bahirniḥsārya karasthapuṣpāñjalau saṃyojya 4 aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ 
śrībhagavatīhāgacchāgaccheti dūtyāḥ śirasi puṣpāñjaliṃ 
niḥkṣipyāvāhyāvāhanīmudrāṃ pradarśya 
sthāpanādiparamīkaraṇāntaṃ tattanmudrayā vidhāya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ 
kṛtvā varadābhayapustakākṣamālāpāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇakapāla-
kamalākhyā daśa mudrāḥ pradarśya

bhramadbhramaranīlābhadhammillāmalapuṣpiṇīm |
brahmarandhrasphuradbhinnamuktālekhāvirājitām || 1 ||

muktālekhārandraratnatilakāṃ mukuṭojvalām |
viśuddhamuktāvajrāḍhyacandralekhākirīṭinīm || 2 ||

bhramadbhramaranīlābhanetratrayavirājitām |
sūrya bhāsvanmahāratnakuṇḍalālaṃkṛtāṃ parām || 3 ||

śukrākārasphuranmuktāhārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām |
graiveyāṅgadapratrālīsphuratkāntivirājitām || 4 ||

gaṅgātaraṅgakarpūraśubhrāmbaravibhūṣitām |
śrīkhaṇḍavallīsadṛśabāhuballīvirājitām || 5 ||

kaṅkaṇādilasadbhūṣāmaṇibandhalasatprabhām |
pravālalatikākārapāṇipallavaśobhitām || 6 ||

vajravaiḍūryamuktālimekhalāṃ vimalaprabhām |
raktotpaladalākārapādapallavaśobhitām || 7 ||

nakṣatramālāsaṅkāśamuktāmañjīramaṇḍitām |
vāmena pāṇinaikena pustakaṃ cāpareṇatu || 8 ||

abhayaṃ ca prayacchantīṃ sādhakāya varānane |
akṣamālāṃ ca varadaṃ dakṣapāṇidvayena tu || 9 ||

dadhatīṃ cintayeddevīṃ vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradām |
kṣīrakundendudhavalāṃ prasannāṃ saṃsmaret priye || 10 ||

iti dhyātvā bālāvidyāmuccārya bhagavati etatte āsanaṃ namaḥ | evaṃ 
svāgataṃ pādyaṃ arghyaṃ ācamanīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ 
punarācamanīyaṃ snānaṃ vastraṃ ācamanīyaṃ ābharaṇāni samarpya 
eṣa te gandho namaḥ | imāni te puṣpāṇi vauṣaṭ iti puṣpāntairupacāraiḥ 
sampūjya prāgyonimadhyayonyorantarāle 4 aiṃ paramagurubhyo namaḥ |

p. 431)

spṛśan aiṃhrīṃ capale capalacittereto muñca muñca

hṛdayakamale prāguktānaṅgakusumādyaṣṭaśaktibhiḥ parivṛtāṃ 
kāmeśvarīṃ raktavarṇāṃ 
raktamālyābharaṇānulepanavasanālaṃkṛtāmikṣukādaṇḍapuṣpabāṇa-
dharāṃ (candraśekharāṃ) dhyāyan klīṃkāmakalātmike retā muñca 
muñca svāhā iti kāmeśvarāmantre tasyā hṛdi vinyasya 
paśusammohanedevi svabhaktānandadāyini | bindurūpe parānande retaḥ 
śīghraṃ tu mocaya || iti hṛdayaṃ spṛśan paṭhitvā 
aiṃsvīṃsstrīṃblūṃblaḥ iti yonimudrābījasmaraṇāt 
tadīyamūlādhāradeśe śaktikṣobhaṃ cintayitvā punastāṃ śaktiṃ 
mūlādhārād hṛtkamalaṃ nītvā aiṃklīṃstrīṃ iti kṣobhiṇīvidyāṃ 
smaran hṛdaye śaktikṣobhaṃ vicintya punastāṃ śaktiṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ 
nītvā tatra aiṃblūṃaiṃklīṃ iti drāviṇīvidyāṃ smaran 
tayālātacakrabhramaṇakuśalayā sakalakamalakānanaṃ vihvalībhūtaṃ 
cintayan brahmarandhraṃ nātvā parāmṭakalāsrāvapūreṇa saha 
punarmūlādhāramānīya aiṃguhye rablauṃblaḥ 
aiṃhrīṃśrīklīṃhrīṃblūṃ iti sarvāṅgasundarīvidyāṃ tatra smaran 
svayaṃ paramānandanirbharamāstallayo bhūtvā kiyatkṣaṇaṃ na 
kiñcidapi cintayet | itthaṃ nirālambamudrā tatastatsmaraketane'pi 
cintanīyā | tatastasyāḥ śirasi vadane hṛdaye guhye pādayośca 
glūṃslūṃplūṃmlūṃnlūṃ iti pañcaratnabījāni vinyasya 
tadvarāṅgāṃkuraṃ dakṣakarāgreṇa gṛhītvā vāmakarāgreṇa 
mūlavidyayā vāgbhavakūṭamuccaran tadyonipaṅkajaṃ spṛṣṭvā

udyadbhānusahasrakāntimatulaṃ śītāṃśuvacchītalaṃ
vyākośāruṇapadmarāgaruciraṃ dṛṣṭvā varāṅgaṃ tataḥ |
kastūrighusṛṇenducandanayutaṃ gorocanālepitaṃ
dhyātvā tatra parāṃ parāparakalāṃ tanmadhyagāṃ cintayet || 1 ||

p. 432)

iti tatpaṅkajaṃ tanmadhye parakalāṃ ca dhyātvā tatra 
vāgbhavakūṭamavaṭopari avaṭābhyantare kāmarājakūṭaṃ ca vilikhya 
gandhākṣataraktakaravīrapuṣpaistriḥ sampūjya varāṅgasya vāmabhāge 
gurupaṃktitrayamabhyarcya tasyā vāmapādāṃguṣṭhe śāmbhavyai 
namaḥ dakṣapādāṃguṣṭhe śambhave namaḥ iti mūlavidyayā sampūjya 
nābhideśe balināthebhyo gamaḥ iti devatāśca sampūjya tāṃ praṇamya 
tadājñayā svayamakṣubdhaḥ san 
nānāvidhāsanapariṣvaṅgakarajaradaghātādivividhavicitralīlāvilāsa-
viśeṣaistāṃ samyak paritoṣayan tadaṅgajamadanamathanaṃ kṛtvā 
tadaṅgaṃ niṣpīḍya tannirgataṃ tattvāmṛtaṃ sugandhakusumenoddhṛtya 
kalaśaviśeṣārghyaśrīpātreṣu mūlavidyayā saṃyojya tadavaṭaṃ hetunā 
prakṣālya tad hetuṃ kalaśe nikṣipya tāṃ praṇamya 
bhojanatāmbūlavasanābharaṇadakṣiṇādānaiḥ paritoṣya svātmānaṃ 
kṛtakṛtyaṃ matvā śrīguruṃ praṇamet | tatra tattvasya 
uttamamadhyamatvādiviśeṣo devīyāmale -

kuṇḍodbhavāmṛtaṃ devi uttamottamameva ca |
uttamaṃ rajobījāni madhyamaṃ kevalaṃ rajaḥ || 1 ||

adhamaṃ pauruṣaṃ vīrya tathānyaccādhamādhamam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti || atha saṃkṣepataḥ śaktiśodhanaṃ svatantre -
