aṅganyāsakaranyāsau prāṇāyāmamataḥ param |
vidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ kulāṅge'pi pravinyaset || 1 ||

iti | bhāvacūḍāmaṇau -

adīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyate |
balādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaret || 1 ||

ādau bālāṃ samucārya tripurāyai samuccaret |
namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet || 2 ||

pavitraṃ kuru śabdānte mama śaktiṃ kuru priye |
vahnijāyāṃ samucārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvari || 3 ||

iti mantreṇābhiṣicya tasyāḥ karṇe'bhedabuddhyā māyābījaṃ 
samuccarediti śaktiśodhanam | tato'rghyasthāpanānantaraṃ 
paryaṅkamadhye maṇḍūkādiparatattvāntaṃ pīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāya 
gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpādikaṃ dattvā samantatodhūpāmodaṃ kṛtvā 
tūlikopari kulaṃ saṃsthāpya tadupari pūrvādidikṣu madhye ca hrīṃ 
kāmāya namaḥ | klīṃ manmathāya namaḥ | aiṃ kandarpāya namaḥ | 
blūṃ makaradhvajāya namaḥ | strīṃ menaketave namaḥ | iti sampūjya 
tasyā lalāṭe sindūreṇa trikoṇa vilikhya aiṃklīṃstrīṃhrīṃblūṃ 
ādhāraśaktiśrīpādukāṃ pūjāyāmi iti | hrsauḥ 
mahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ iti sampūjya bālāṃ kāmeśīṃ ca 
pūjayet | kulārṇave -

gaṇeśaṃ ca kulādhyakṣaṃ durgāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm |
trikoṇeṣu ca sampūjya vasantaṃ madanaṃ priye || 1 ||

stanayoḥ pūjayet paścānmukhaṃ tasyāḥ sudhākaram |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || - ||

iti | uttaratantre -

maulau gaṇeśaṃ keśāgre kulādhyakṣaṃ lalāṭake |
durgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm || 1 ||

atra sthānavaiparītyamaicchikam | jñānārṇave -

dakṣapādādimūrdhāntaṃ vāmamūrdhādi sundari |
pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥ || 1 ||

śraddhā prītī ratiścaiva dūtiḥ kāntirmanoramā |
manoharā manorāmā madanonmādinī tathā || 2 ||

modinī dīpinī caiva ṣoḍaśī ca vaśaṅkarī |
rañjanī caiva deveśi ṣoḍaśī priyadarśanā || 3 ||

svaraṣoḍaśasaṃyuktā etāḥ kāmakalā yajet |
tataḥ somakalāḥ pūjyāḥ śivādyāścaraṇāvadhi || 4 ||

pūṣā ramā ca subhagā ratiḥ prītistathā ghṛtiḥ |
śuddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca śailajā aṃśumālinī || 5 ||

aṅgirā vaśinī caiva cchāyā sampūrṇamaṇḍalā |
tathā tuṣṭyamṛte caiva kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśa || 6 ||

p. 433)

iti | evaṃ svarādikāḥ sampūjya tadbhage aiṃ cāndryai namaḥ | aiṃ sauryai 
namaḥ | aiṃ āgneyyai namaḥ iti tisro nāḍīḥ sampūjya 
bhagamālāmantreṇa pūjayet | aiṃhrīṃśrīṃaiṃjūṃblūṃ klinne 
sarvāṇi bhagāni vaśamānaya me strīhrīṃklīṃblūṃ bhagamālinyai 
namaḥ aiṃhrīṃśrīṃ iti mantreṇa pūjayet | tantrāntare -

ihāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāso maheśvari |
athaivaṃ ca vidhānena ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ || 1 ||

iṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet |
arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaram || 2 ||

mūlamantraṃ tataḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya tataḥ param |
yajettatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmeśasaṃjñakaiḥ || 3 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

avadhūteśvarīṃ kubjāṃ kāmākhyāṃ samayāmapi |
vajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīm || 1 ||

mahācaṇḍeśvarīṃ tārāṃ pūjayedatra sādhakaḥ |
tadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva ca || 2 ||

śivaṃ ca tatra nikṣipya gajatuṇḍākhyamudrayā |
dharmādharmahavirdīpta ātmāgnau manasā srucā || 3 ||

suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham |
svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥ || 4 ||

tato japet striyaṃ gacchan vidyāṃ trirbhuvaneśvarīm |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 5 ||

japediti aṣṭottarasahasraṃ śataṃ vākṣubdho japet |

prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam |
dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyaham || 6 ||

svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ śukratyāge prakīrtitaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 7 ||

iti | yāmalatantre -

saṃyogābjāyate saukhyaṃ paramānandalakṣaṇam |
kulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyād durlabhaṃ naraḥ || 1 ||

tenāmṛtena divyena sarve tuṣṭā bhavanti hi |
yatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tatkṣaṇādeva siddhyati || 2 ||

kuladravyaṃ ca saṃśodhya śivaśaktimayaṃ priye |
bījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japan nikṣipya sundari || 3 ||

arghyapātrāmṛtairyatnānnirvikalpaḥ sadānaghaḥ |
śrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavet || 4 ||

śrīvidyetyupalakṣaṇam | kulāmṛtaśodhanamantrastu oṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave 
amṛtavarṣiṇi devi śukraśāpaṃ pramocayapramocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya 
srāvaya amṛtaṃ kuru kuru svāhā iti saptavāraṃ japediti || iti kulayāgaḥ || 
ayaṃ prakārastu tādṛśayāyisthāyinām | śuddhasthāyināṃ tu 
prathamata eva svavāme śaktiṃ saṃsthāpya prāṇāyāmādikaṃ kuryāt | 
taduktaṃ kumārīkalpe -

tataḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ nārīmānīya mantravit |
yuvatīṃ vā madonmattāṃ suveṣāṃ cāruhāsinīm || 1 ||

sadā rate sābhilāṣāṃ sindūrāṅkitabhālakām |
sādhakaḥ śreyase tanvīṃ vame saṃsthāpayed budhaḥ || 2 ||

tasyāstu bhūtaśuddhyādi kṛtvā vai mātṛkāṃ nyaset |
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā yathāvidhi || 3 ||

iti | atra kulayāgottaramantaryajanaṃ praśastam | taduktaṃ tantrāntare -

kulayāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā hyantaryajanamācaret |
athāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam || 1 ||

gurordhyānaṃ prakurvīta yathāpūrvaṃ viśāladhīḥ |
snāyācca vimale tīrthe puṣkare hṛdayāśrite || 2 ||

bindutīrthe'thavā snāyāt punarjanma na vidyate |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

iti | athavā -

iḍā suṣumnā śivatīrthake'smin jñānāmbupūrṇe vahataḥ śarīre |
brahmāmbubhiḥ snāti tayoḥ sadā yaḥ kiṃ tasya gāṅgairapi puṣkarairvā || 
4 ||

iti | snānam |

śivaśaktyoḥ samāveśo yasmin kāle prajāyate |
sā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhisthaiḥ pratīyate || 5 ||

p. 434)

iti sandhyā |

candrārkānalasambandhādgalitaṃ yatparāmṛtam |
tenāmṛtena divyena tarpayet paradevatām || 6 ||

iti tarpaṇam |

brahmarandrādadhobāge yaccāndraṃ pātramuttamam |
kalāsāreṇa sampūrya tarpayet tena khecarīm || 7 ||

ityarghyadānam | ādhāre liṅganābhāvityādyantarmātṛkānyāsaḥ |

īḍyamānahṛdayo'yaṃ hṛdaye syāccidātmakaḥ |
kriyate tatparatvena hṛnmantreṇa tataḥ param || 8 ||

sarvāṅgādiguṇotsaṅge saṃvidrūpe parātmani |
kriyate tatparatvena śiromantreṇa deśikaiḥ || 9 ||

hṛcchironte ca ciddhāma manasā bhāvanā dṛḍhā |
kriyate nijadehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥ || 10 ||

mantrātmakasya dehasya mantreṇānena tejasā |
sarvato varmamantreṇa kriyate dehasaṃvṛtiḥ || 11 ||

vauṣaḍiti manuṃ japtvā kriyate dehanetrakam |
tato'streṇa ca mantrajñaḥ karotyastra caturdiśaḥ || 12 ||

iti ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya dhyānaṃ kuryāt |

yaddadāti paraṃ jñānaṃ saṃvidrūpe parātmani |
hṛdayādimayaṃ tejaḥ syādetanmantrasaṃjñitam || 13 ||

ādhyātmikādirūpaṃ satsādhakasya vināśayet |
avidyāyāḥ svatantraṃ yatparaṃ dhāma samīritam || 14 ||

iti vā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya dhyānaṃ kuryāt |

śaktidvayapuṭāntaḥsthaṃ kamaladvayaśobhitam |
jyotistattvamayaṃ dhyāyet kulākulaniyojanāt || 15 ||

athavā -

śṛṅgāṭadvayamadhyasthaṃ śaktidvayapuṭīkṛtam |
sadā samarasaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyānaṃ tatkulayoginām || 16 ||

iti dhyānam |

arcayan viṣayaiḥ puṣpaistatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhavet |
nyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena cintayet || 17 ||

amāyamanahaṅkāramarāgamamadaṃ tathā |
amohakamakarmatvamadveṣākṣobhakau tataḥ || 18 ||

amātsaryamalobhaṃ ca daśapuṣpaṃ vidurbudhāḥ |
ahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ || 19 ||

dayāpuṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpaṃ kṣamāpuṣpaṃ ca pañcamam |
ityaṣṭasaptabhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayet paradevatām || 20 ||

iti pūjanam ||

mālā pañcāśikā proktā sūtraṃ śaktiśivātmakam |
grathitā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ kalānte merusaṃsthitiḥ || 21 ||

japtvā japaṃ paraṃ dhāmni tejorūpe nivedayet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 22 ||

iti japaḥ |

amūlamaparicchinnaṃ vibhāvyātmāntarātmakam |
paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca tathā jñānātmarūpakam || 23 ||

caturasraṃ ca citkuṇḍamānandamekhalāyutam |
nābhauvibhāvya tanmadhye juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ || 24 ||

mūlāgnau nābhicaitanyahaviṣā manasā srucā |
jñānapradīpite nityamakṣavṛttirjuhomyahaṃ svāhā || 25 ||

iti prathamāhuti | tato mulānte -

dharmādharmahavirdīpta ātmāgnau manasā srucā |
suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛtīrjuhomyahaṃ svāhā || 26 ||

iti dvitīyāhutiḥ | mūlānte -

prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam |
dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyahaṃ svāhā || 27 ||

iti tṛtīyāhutiḥ | tatau mūlānte -

antarnirantaranirindhanamedhamāne mohāndhakāraparipanthini saṃvidagnau 
|
kasmiṃścidadbhutamarīcivikāsabhūmau viśvaṃ juhomi 
vasudhādiśivāvasānam || 28 ||

p. 435)

iti caturthyāhutiḥ |

ityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet |
na tasya puṇyapāpāni jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam || 29 ||

ityantaryāgaḥ ||

atha madhuparkāṅgacchāgādipaśubalividhānam paśuṃ snapayitvā oṃ 
paśave pādyaṃ namaḥ evamarghyācamanagandhān dattvā 
śṛṅgayormadhye sindūrādinā tilakaṃ dāpayitvā paśuśirasi puṣpāṇi 
dattvā etadadhipataye'gnaye namaḥ iti paśupṛṣṭhe puṣpaṃ dattvā 
mūlaṃ0 etatsampradānarūpāyi sāṅgopāṅgāyai 
śrīmahātripurasundaryai namaḥ iti devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā 
vāmahastena paśuskandhaṃ dhṛtvā pāśupatāstreṇa tridhā samprokṣya 
vāṅmanaḥśrotratvakcakṣūrasanāghrāṇaprāṇahastapādapāyumeḍhra-
māṃsarudhiramedosthimajjāśukranāḍīcakraromapucchasarvaśṛṅgāṇi te 
āpyāyantām | evaṃ sarvāṅgāni te śundhāmi | agniḥ 
paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etallokamajayadyasminnagniḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati 
taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā āpaḥ | evaṃ oṃ vāyuḥ paśurāsīt0 | oṃ sūryaḥ 
paśurāsīt0 | oṃ viṣṇuḥ paśurāsīt0 | oṃ rudraḥ paśurāsīt0 | oṃ haṃsaḥ 
śuciṣat0 | oṃ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ0 | varuṇasyottambhanamasi0 | 
pañcabrahmamantrairgāyatryā mūlamantreṇa ca paśuṃ prokṣayet | tato 
gandhākṣatakusumaiḥ 
śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāgghastapādapāyupasthaśiraḥ 
skandhapṛṣṭhapucchamukhakaṇṭhahṛdayodaravṛṣaṇaromarudhiramāṃsa-
vasāprāṇāsthināḍīcakrasarvāṅgeṣu 
digvāatasūryapraceto'śvivahnīndropendramitraprajāpaticāmuṇḍā 
bhadrakālīgandharvavīrabhadrasarasvatīmahālakṣmībhairavī 
samudravārāhī oṣadhīvanaspati 
brahmaviṣṇurudraparamātmasadāśivagaṅgāyamunā 
jīvātmamarudgaṇebhyo namaḥ iti pūjayediti paśupūjā | tataḥ paśukarṇe 
paśupāśāya vidmahe paśurūpāya dhīmahi tannaḥ paśuḥ pracodayāt | oṃ 
hilihili kilikili paśurūpadharāyai hrīṃdūrgāyai vauṣaṭ mūlavidyāṃ ca 
japet | tataḥ -

yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭā yajñārthaṃ paśughātanam |
atastvāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi tasmādyajñe vadho'vadhaḥ || 1 ||

śivādvṛttamidaṃ piṇḍamatastvaṃ śivatāṃ gataḥ |
ābudhyasva paśotvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivo'si hi || 2 ||

paśo tvaṃ balirūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ |
caṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśaya || 3 ||

paśurūpaṃ parityajya tvaṃ gandharvasvarūpadhṛk |
gaurīrūpaṃ samāsādya mama kalyāṇado bhava || 4 ||

paśupāśavimokṣāya hetukūṭasthitāya ca |
paśave ca namastubhyaṃ namaste balirūpiṇe || 5 ||

chedyo'si balirūpastvamājñayā parayā guroḥ |
chedabhedodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣamasva paśurūpadhṛt || 6 ||

iti samprārthya saṅkalpaṃ kuryāt | oṃ adyāmuke māsi 
āmukapakṣe'mukatithau amukagotro'mukadevaśarmā 
daśavarṣadevīprītikāmo madhuparkāṅgatvenemaṃ chāgaṃ 
vahnidaivatyaṃ dakṣayajñavināśinyai mahāghorāyai 
yoginīkoṭiparivṛtāyai hrīṃdūrgāyai bhadrakālyai 
śrīmahātripurasundarīdevyai sāṅgāyai sāyudhāyai savāhanāyai 
saparivārāyai sāṅgopāṅgāyai saśaktikāyai tubhyamahaṃ ghātayiṣye iti 
paśuśirasi akṣatayuktaṃ jalaṃ dadyāt || atha khaḍgapūjā khaḍgamānīya 
purataḥ sthāpayitvā pāśupatāstreṇa prokṣya cakramudrayā saṃrakṣya 
dhenuyonimudre darśayitvā sindūreṇāstramantraṃ khaḍge vilikhya 
mūlenāstreṇa vābhimantrya prārthayet | oṃ aṣṭabāhurmahātejāḥ śyāma 
āraktalocanaḥ | bhīmadaṃṣṭraḥ karālāsyo lolajihvo bhayānakaḥ || iti 
dhyātvā bāhyaprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā pādyādibhiḥ sampūjya oṃ 
khaḍga tīkṣṇacchindi chindi kaṭṭha kaṭhṭha iti trirjapitvā oṃ asiviśasanaḥ 
khaḍga tīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ | śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva 
dharmapālanamo'stute || karavāla kṛpāṇa tvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ kare sthitaḥ 
| paśuraktapradānena cāmuṇḍāprītimāvaha || iti samprārthya oṃ kālikāli 
karāli kālike kālarātrikecchindhi chindhi phaṭ phaṭ huṃphaṭ rudhiraṃ piba 
piba māṃsaṃ bhakṣaya bhakṣaya asthīni carvaya carvaya svāhā iti 
paśuskandhe khaḍgaṃ sparśayet | tataśchedayitvā 
kiñcidraktamāmamāṃsakhaṇḍaṃ devyā dakṣabhāge sthāpayitvā oṃ 
raktadantikāyai svāhā iti samarpya tena rudhireṇa devīṃ tristarpayet | tataḥ 
sadīpaṃ śiro devyā vāmatastrikoṇamaṇḍale sthāpayitvā jalaṃ gṛhītvā 
oṃ mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālini | 
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te || oṃ cāmuṇḍāyai svāhā iti 
samarpayet | iti paśubalividhiḥ | atha kumārīyajanavidhiḥ | tatra 
jñānārṇave -

p. 436)

homādikaṃ tu sakalaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ vinā |
paripūrṇaphalaṃ naiva saphalaṃ pūjanādbhavet || 1 ||

puṣpaṃ kumāryai yaddattaṃ tanmerusadṛśaṃ bhavet |
kumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitam || 2 ||

kumāryai yajjalaṃ dattaṃ tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam |
annaṃ tu mīnanayane kulācalasamaṃ bhavet || 3 ||

ekābdāt ṣoḍaśābdāntāḥ kumāryaḥ pūjane śubhāḥ |
vivāharahitāḥ syuśceduttarottarasiddhidāḥ || 4 ||

vivāhitāstu deveśi bālā eva kumārikāḥ |
suvāsinyo mahāprauḍhāḥ saṃśayaṃ tyaja suvrate || 5 ||

kumarīpūjanaṃ devi kumārīmanunā bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 6 ||

iti | trailokyaḍāmaratantre -

sarvayajñottamaṃ bhūpa kumārīpūjanaṃ śṛṇu |
kṛte yasmin mahālakṣmīracireṇa prasīdati || 1 ||

āmantrayed dine pūrve kumārīmantrapūrvakam |
pūjādine samāhūya kumārīmādyadevatām || 2 ||

maṇḍale caraṇau tasyāḥ kṣālayeduṣṇavāriṇā |
arcayed hemapātreṇa vāripuṣpākṣataiḥ samam || 3 ||

suvitāne śubhe sthāne paṅkajopari pīṭhake |
upaveśya kumārīṃ tāṃ svāṅge nyāsaṃ samācaret || 4 ||

tattanmatrokta-ṛṣyādinyāsam |

ātmānaṃ vidhivat pūjya krodhadarpavivarjitaḥ |
atha dhyāyet kumārīṃ tāṃ malālakṣmīsvarūpiṇīm || 5 ||

navākṣareṇa mantreṇa susiddhena samācaret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 6 ||

mahālakṣmīsvarūpiṇīmiti navākṣareṇeti ca tatprakaraṇāt tena 
sveṣṭadevatāsvarūpiṇīṃ sveṣṭamantreṇa yajedityarthaḥ |

dadyādācamanaṃ tasyai dadyādvastraṃ sakautukaṃ |
sakaṅkaṇāṃgulīyāni karṇālaṅkaraṇe śubhe || 7 ||

graiveyakaṃ pradāyātha candanena vilepayet |
pūjayet puṣpamālābhirdivyairdhūpaiḥ sudhūpayet || 8 ||

kuryādārātrikaṃ rājaṃstathopacārya tāṃ muhuḥ |
bhojayedbhaktibhāvena pāyasaṃ śarkarāghṛtam || 9 ||

supakvānnāni cānnāni sarvakṣobhavivarjitaḥ |
phalekṣu svādu cānyacca dadyāt tasyai punaḥ punaḥ || 10 ||

yāvat sā bhojanaṃ kuryāt tāvanmaunī japet sudhīḥ |
dadyādācamanaṃ tasyai tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayet || 11 ||

anarghyeṇa ca dānena kumārīṃ praṇato'sakṛt |
pradakṣiṇanamaskārān kṛtvā mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ || 12 ||

visarjayet kumārī tāṃ svagṛhaṃ harṣa nirbharaḥ |
anena vidhinā bhaktyā kumārīpūjayāpnuyāt || 13 ||

yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ devānāmapi durlabham |
kumārīpūjanaṃ kṛtvā taṃ taṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 14 ||

brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ kumārī paramā kalā |
tatpūjanena rājendra trailokyaṃ syād supūjitam || 15 ||

samyak ṛtu phalaṃ tasya yaḥ kumārīḥ prapūjayet |
tasmāt pūjaya bhūpāla kumārīryatamānasaḥ || 16 ||

svarājyaṃ prāpsyase viśvaṃ mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 17 ||

iti || atha prayogaḥ tatra sādhakaḥ kṛtanityakriyaḥ pūjādināt pūrvadine 
kumāryā gṛhaṃ gatvā mūlavidyāṃ smaran kumārike bhagavati 
pūjārthaṃ mayā nimantritāsi māṃ kṛtārthaṃ kuru iti 
nārikelapūgīphalādinā nimantrya pūjādine nityapūjānantaraṃ 
kumārīṃ sugandhatailādinā susnātāmalaṃkṛtāmāhūya 
pūjāgṛhādbahiḥ kvacinmaṇḍale tasyāścaraṇāvūṣṇajalena svayaṃ 
samyakprakṣālya sūkṣmavastreṇa proñchaya pūjāsthānaṃ nītvā 
aṣṭadale sindūrādiracite śubha pīṭhe śubhāstaraṇe paścimābhimukhīṃ 
samupaveśya svayaṃ tatsammukhaḥ svāsane samupaviśya adyetyādi0 
amukakāmaḥ kumārīpūjanaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya 
gurvādivandanapūrvakaṃ mūlavidyayā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā 
ṛṣyādisamastanyāsajātaṃ kṛtvātmapūjāṃ vidhāya 
pīṭhapūjāpūrvakaṃ tasyāṃ devīmāvāhya dhyātvā 
mūlavidyayācamanaṃ dattvā 
vastrālaṅkāragandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāntānupacārān samarpya 
pāyasādinānāvidhānnapānairbhojayan yāvatsā bhojanaṃ karoti 
tāvatkālaṃ maunī mūlavidyāṃ japet | tato bhuktavatyāstasyāḥ 
karakṣālana gaṇḍūṣācamanāni dattvā sakarpūraṃ tāmbūlaṃ 
samarpyārātrikaṃ kṛtvā chatracāmarādirājopacārairārādhya 
yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇamya visṛjediti || athātra 
pūjyāpūjyakumārīlakṣaṇāni | tatrādau pūjyakumārīlakṣaṇāni 
skānde -

p. 437)

arogiṇīṃ supuṣṭāṅgīṃ surūpāṃ vraṇavarjitām |
ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayet || 1 ||

iti || athāpūjyalakṣaṇāni tatraiva 

hīnādhikāṅgīṃ kuṣṭhāṅgīṃ viśīlakulasaṃbhāvām |
granthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitām || 2 ||

jātyandhāṃ kekarāṃ kāṇīṃ kurūpāṃ tanulomaśām |
saṃtyajedrogiṇīṃ kanyāṃdāsīgarbhasamudbhavām || 3 ||

iti | atha phalaviśeṣe pūjyaviśeṣaśca tatraiva -

brāhmaṇīṃ sarvakāryeṣu jayārthe nṛpavaṃśajām |
lābhārthe vaiśyasaṃbhūtāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajām || 4 ||

dāruṇe cāntyajātīnāṃ pūjayedvidhinā naraḥ | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 5 ||

iti kumārīpūjanam ||

atha vaṭukādibalipañcaka prayogaḥ tatra 
pūjācakrasyeśānādikoṇacatuṣṭaye trikoṇavṛttacaturasrātmakāni 
balimaṇḍalāni viracya teṣvīśānamaṇḍale vāṃ vaṭukabhairavāya namaḥ 
iti vaṭukaṃ gandhādibhi sampūjya tatrānnavyañjanatoya puṣpādibharitaṃ 
sādhāraṃ tāmrādipātraṃ saṃsthāpya vaṭukavalidravyāya namaḥ iti 
vaṭukabalidravyaṃ sampūjya 4 ehyehi devīputra vaṭukanātha 
kapilajaṭābhārabhāsvara trinetra jvālāmukha sarvavighnānnāśaya 
nāśaya sarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā iti 
pūrvasthāpitārghyapātrāt pātrāntareṇoddhṛtajalena 
vāsāṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ balimūtsṛjet |

evamāgneyamaṇḍale yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ iti yoginīḥ sampūjya

ūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍato vā divi gaganatale bhūtale nistale vā 
pātāle vā'nale vā pavanasalilayoryatra kutra sthitā vā |
kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādikena 
prītā devyaḥ sadā naḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu vīrendravandyāḥ || 1 ||

yāṃ yoginībhyaḥ svāhā sarvayoginībhyo huṃphaṭsvāheti 
vāmāṃguṣṭhānāmāmadhyābhirarghyajaladhārayā balimutsṛjet |

tato nir-ṛtikoṇagatamaṇḍale kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ iti kṣetrapālaṃ 
sampūjya prāgvad balipātraṃ nidhāya 
kṣāṃkṣīṃkṣūṃkṣaikṣauṃkṣaḥ 
sthānakṣetrapāladhūpadīpādisahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā iti 
vāmāṃguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tarjanyaikayā vā 
prāgvadbalipātre'rghyajaladhārāṃ dadyāt |

tato vāyavyamaṇḍale gāṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ iti gaṇapatiṃ sampujya 
prāgvad balipātraṃ vidhāyābhyarcya gāṃgoṃgūṃgaṇapataye 
varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāheti 
vāmāṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ prāgvadbalimutsṛjet iti 
vaṭukādibalicatuṣṭayavidhiḥ ||

atha kullikādilakṣaṇam | tatra śrīrudrayāmale īśvara uvāca

kullukāṃ mūrdhniṃ sañjapya hṛdi setuṃ vicintayet |
mahāsetuṃ viśuddhaṃ tu sahasrāre tu coddharet || 1 ||

maṇipūre tu nirvāṇaṃ mahākuṇḍalinīmadhaḥ |
svādhiṣṭhāne kāmarājaṃ rākiṇīṃ mūrdhniṃ saṃsthitām || 2 ||

vicintya vidhivad devi mūlādhārāt trikaṃ śive |
viśuddhāntaṃ smared devi visatantutanīyasīm || 3 ||

vedisthānaṃ hi jihvāntaṃ mūlamantrovṛtaṃ muhuḥ |
icchākriyāsvamaniśaṃ sveṣṭadevīṃ svarūpiṇī || 4 ||

jñātavyā parameśāni japenmantramanuttamam | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *  ||

śrīdevyuvāca

kullikā kīdṛśī nātha seturvā deva kīdṛśaḥ |
kīdṛśo vā mahāseturnirvāṇaṃ nātha kīdṛśam || 5 ||

anyadvā kathitaṃ yanme kīdṛśaṃ tadvada prabho |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

p. 438)

īśvara uvāca

guhyadguhyatamaṃ devi tava snehena kathyate |
vinā yena maheśāni niṣphalaṃ parameśvari || 6 ||

tārāyāḥ kullikā devi mahānīlasarasvatī |
pañcākṣarī kālikāyāḥ kullikā parikathyate || 7 ||

kālī kūrcaṃ vadhūrmāyā phaḍarṇā parameśvarī |
chinnāyāstu maheśāni kullikāṣṭākṣarī bhavet || 8 ||

vajravairocanyai ca ante huṃphaṭ prakīrtitam |
saṃpatpradāyāḥ prathamaṃ bhairavyāḥ kullikā matā || 9 ||

śrīmattripurasundaryāḥ kullikā dvādaśākṣarī |
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmarājaṃ tataḥ param || 10 ||

lajjābījaṃ tataḥ paścāt tripureśī tataḥ param |
bhagavatīpadaṃ dadyādante ṭhadvayamuddharet || 11 ||

kālikāyāḥ svabījaṃ tu kūrcaṃ vadhūṃ niyojayet |
lajjāstramantake dadyāttārā nīlasarasvatī || 12 ||

anyeṣāṃ tu maheśāni tryakṣarī kullikā bhavet |
tāraṃ kūrcaṃ samuddhṛtya paścādaṃkuśamuddharet || 13 ||

iti te kathitā devi saṃkṣepāt kullikā mayā |
ajñātvā kullikāmenāṃ japate yo'dhamaḥ priye || 14 ||

pañcatvamāśu labhate siddhihānistu jāyate |
vṛthā ca tajjapaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjayenmūrdhni kullikām |
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva priyaṃvade || 16 ||

yasyājñānena viphalaṃ japahomādikaṃ bhavet |
viprāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ setuḥ kṣattriyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 17 ||

vaiśyajāteḥ phaḍantaśca māyā śūdrasya kathyate |
japtvā tvidaṃ tu deveśi sundaryā bhuvaneśvarī || 18 ||

kālikāyāḥ svabījaṃ tu tārāyāḥ kūrcabījakam |
anyeṣāṃ tu vadhūbījaṃ mahāseturvarānane || 19 ||

ādau japtvā mahāsetuṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
dhane dhaneśatulyo'sau vāci vāgī'svaropamaḥ || 20 ||

yuddhe kṛtāntasadṛśo nārīṇāṃ madanopamaḥ |
jayakāraṃ bhavettasya sarvakāle na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||

atha vakṣyāmi nirvāṇaṃ śṛṇu devi varānane |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya mātṛkādyaṃ samuccaret || 22 ||

evaṃ puṭitamūlaṃ tu prajapenmaṇi pūrake |
evaṃ nirvāṇamīśāni yo na jānāti pāmaraḥ || 23 ||

varṣakoṭiśatenāpi siddhistasya kadāpi na |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yadyaduktaṃ maheśvari || 24 ||

tattadācarya vidhivat prajapenmantramuttamam |
ṛṣiśchando devatā ca tadbījaṃ śaktikīlake || 25 ||

bhāvayedyatnato devi tataḥ setvādikaṃ japet |
evaṃ yadi japenmantrī mantrarājamanuttamam || 26 ||

ṣaṇmāsāt siddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇa |
sākṣāt sa eva jagatāmadhiśo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 27 ||

sa śaraṇyaṃ sa vai jñānī sa eva mantratattvavit |
sa eva nṛtyate bhūmau vicarecca yathāsukham || 28 ||

tasya darśanamātreṇa palāyante ca vairiṇaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

evaṃ kṛtvā sakalapuṭitaṃ yo japenmantrarājaṃ tannirvāṇaṃ 
bhavanarudhitaṃ kullīkāntāni japtvā |
teṣāṃ tadvannikhilabhuvane siddhayo'ṣṭau ca haste teṣāṃ tattvaṃ vacasi 
vacanaṃ padmapadmāntare ca || 29 ||

iti | atra tu hrīṃstrīṃhūṃ iti tārāyāḥ sabhedāyāḥ kullikā bhavati | 
krīṃhrīṃstrīṃhrīṃphaṭ iti pañcākṣarī dakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ 
sabhedāyā kullikā bhavati | vajravairocanyai huṃphaṭ iti chinnāyāḥ 
sabhedāyāḥ kullikā bahvati | aiṃklīṃhrīṃ aiṃklīṃsauḥ bhagavati 
svāhā iti dvādaśākṣarī śrīmattripurasundaryāḥ sabhedāyāḥ 
sampatpradāyāḥ bhairavyāḥ sabhedāyāśca kullikā bhavati | oṃ 
hrūṃkroṃ iti tryakṣarī anyeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca sarvatra 
kullikā bhavatītyarthaḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ ca praṇavaḥ seturbhavati | 
kṣatriyāṇāmapi sa eva  vaiśyānāṃ phaḍiti seturbhavati | śūdrāṇāṃ tu 
māyābījaṃ seturbhavati | krīmiti kālikābhedānāṃ mahāseturbhavati | 
hūmiti tārāyā mahāseturbhavati | anyeṣāṃ tu strīmiti mahāseturbhavati | 
oṃ aṃ mūlaṃ0 aiṃ aṃ oṃ oṃ āṃ mūla0 aiṃ āṃ oṃ oṃ iṃ mūlaṃ aiṃ 
iṃ oṃ ityādi pratyakṣarasampuṭitamūlaṃ nirvāṇamityucyate | kecittu oṃ 
aṃ mūlaṃ0 aiṃ aṃ samastamātṛkā ante omiti maṇipūrake saptavāraṃ 
japediti vadanti | atra yathāgurūpadeśaṃ kāryamiti |

athaitasya prayogaḥ mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā asyāḥ 
śrīmahātripurasundarīvidyāyāḥ śirasi amukāya ṛṣaye namaḥ |

p. 439)

mukhe amukacchandase namaḥ | hṛdaye śrīmahātripurasundaryai devatāyai 
namaḥ | guhye amukabījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ amukaśaktaye namaḥ | 
nābhau amukakīlakāya namaḥ | iti vinyasya aiṃklīṃhrīṃ aiṃklīṃsauḥ 
bhagavati svāhā iti kullikāṃ mūrdhni saptadhā tridhā vā japet | omiti 
setuṃ hṛdi tathaiva smṛtvā hrīmiti mahāsetuṃ sahasrāre tathaiva smṛtvā 
oṃ aṃmūlaṃ0 oṃ aiṃ aṃ 51 oṃ iti nirvāṇaṃ maṇipūrake tathaiva smaret | 
liṅge klīmiti tathaiva smaret | jihvāyāṃ mūlavidyāṃ tathaiva smaret | 
mūrdhni sahasrāre oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rāṃ roṃ rūṃ raiṃ rauṃ raḥ 
ramalavarayūṃ rākiṇi māṃ rakṣa rakṣa sarvasattvaśaṅkari devyāgaccha 
2 imāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa aiṃ ghore devi hrīṃ saḥ paramaghore 
hrūṃ ghorarūpe ehyehi namaścāmuṇḍe ḍalarakasahaiṃ 
śrīmahātripurasundari devi varade vicce iti rākiṇīṃ mūrdhni smarediti | iti 
kullukādividhiḥ || atha prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānam | kulārṇave -

tāraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ senduṃ māyāmaṃkuśamuddharet |
yādyān sabindūn saptārṇānuddhṛtya viyadoyutam || 1 ||

binduyuktaṃ cājapākhyaṃ paramātmamanuṃ vadet |
amuṣya śabdamuddhṛtya prāṇā iha itīrayet || 2 ||

prāṇāḥ pāśādikān varṇāṃstithisaṃkhyān punarvadet |
amuṣya jīva iha ca sthita ityuddharet tataḥ || 3 ||

punaḥ pañcadaśārṇānte amuṣyeti padaṃ vadet |
sarvendriyāṇi ca tataḥ punaḥ pañcadaśārṇakān || 4 ||

amuṣya vāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotraghrāṇapadādatha |
prāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu ca dviṭhaḥ || 5 ||

itthaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhākhyamanuḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ |
caturdaśottarairvarṇaimantraḥ sarvārtha siddhidaḥ || 6 ||

iti | tāraḥ praṇavaḥ nārāyaṇa ākāraḥ senduḥ sānusvāraḥ māyā 
bhuvaneśvarībījaṃ aṃkuśaḥ kroṃbījaṃ viyat hakāraḥ oṃ svarūpa 
binduranusvāraḥ tena hoṃ iti | ajapā haṃsa iti paramātmamanuḥ so'hamiti 
dviṭhaḥ svāhākāraḥ amuṣyapadasthāne sādhyapada ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ 
yojyam | svayaṃ sādhyaścenmameti yojyam | atra kecit 
pāśabījādipañcadaśavarṇānāmādāvevoccāraṇaṃ na sthānāntareṣu 
kāmyaprayogakāle teṣāṃ sthānāntareṣūccāro japapūjādiṣu 
nāstītyāhuḥ | pratyamuṣyapadaṃ pūrṇaṃ pāśādyāni prayojayediti 
śāradātilakavacanāt | tatra svagurumataṃ pramāṇam | tathā -

ṛṣayo brahmaviṣṇvīśā mantrasyāsya samīritāḥ |
chandāsi ṛgyajuḥ sāmānyāhurāgamapāragāḥ || 7 ||

prāṇaśaktirdevatā syāt sarvaprāṇihṛdi sthitā |
pāśo bījaṃ śaktireva śaktiḥ kīlakamaṃkuśam || 8 ||

viniyogastu vijñeyaḥ prāṇasthāpanakarmaṇi |
śrīkaṇṭhaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ kavarga bindusaṃyutam || 9 ||

ākāśavāyvagnijalapṛthivyātma ca ne vadet |
sabindvananto hṛnmantraḥ sūkṣmaṃ binduyutaṃ vadet || 10 ||

binduyuktacavargānte śabdasparśa ca rūpa ca |
rasagandhātmane tvante trimūrtīśaṃ sabīndukam || 11 ||

vadedayaṃ śiromantrastvamareśaṃ sabindukam |
ṭavarga ca tathoddhṛtya śrotratvakcakṣurityatha || 12 ||

jihvāghrāṇātmane'rghīśo binduyuktaḥ śikhāmanuḥ |
jhiṇṭīśa bindusaṃyuktaṃ tavargaṃ tādṛśa vadet || 13 ||

vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane bindubhautike |
varmāṇubinduyuk sadyaḥ pavargo bindusaṃyutaḥ || 14 ||

vacanādānavisargagamanānanda cātmane |
anugraho binduyukto netramantra udāhṛtaḥ || 15 ||

tithisvarānte yādyarṇān daśa binduvibhūṣitān |
uktvā manobuddhyahaṅkārāntacitātmane padam || 16 ||

visarga eṣa samprokto manurastrābhidhānakaḥ |
evaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamanavastārabījatrayādikāḥ || 17 ||

nyastavyā jātiyuktāśca mantribhiḥ svakarāṅgayoḥ |
nāmitaḥ pādayugmāntaṃ kaṇṭhadānābhimastakāt || 18 ||

kaṇṭhāntamiti bījāni pāśādīni pravinyaset |
tato hṛtpadmamadhye tu dhyātvā vasudalāmbujam || 19 ||

tasya vāyvagnipūrveṣu paścimeśānayorapi |
nair-ṛtyottarayāmyeṣu karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca || 20 ||

yādikṣāntānyakṣarāṇi binduyuktāni vinyaset |
ekaikaśo lavarjyāni tato devīṃ hṛdi smaret || 21 ||

iti || asya prayogastu asya prāṇapratiṣthāmantrasya śirasi 
brahmaviṣṇuśivebhyaḥ ṛṣibhyo namaḥ | mukhe ṛgyajuḥ 
sāmabhyaśchandebhyo namaḥ | hṛdaye parāprāṇaśaktyai devatāyai 
namaḥ | guhye āṃbījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ hrīṃśaktaye namaḥ | nābhau 
kroṃkīlakāya namaḥ | iti vinyasyāmuṣya prāṇapratiṣṭhārthe viniyogaḥ iti 
kṛtāñjalirvadet | tataḥ oṃ āṃhrīṃkroṃ aṃkaṃ 5 āṃ 
ākāśavāyvagnisalilapṛthivyātmane āṃhṛdayāya namaḥ |

p. 440)

oṃ āṃhrīṃkroṃ iṃcaṃ 5 īṃśabdasparśarūparasagandhātmane 
īṃśirase svāhā | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ uṃ ṭaṃ 5 
ūṃśrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇātmane ūṃśikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ 
āṃhrīṃkroṃ eṃ taṃ 5 aiṃvākpāṇipādapāyūpasthātmane 
aiṃkavacāya huṃ | oṃ āṃhrīṃkroṃ oṃ paṃ 5 
auṃvacanādānavisargagamanānandātmane auṃnetratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ 
āṃ hrīṃkroṃ aṃ yaṃ 10 aḥmanobuddhyahaṅkāracittātmane aḥ astrāya 
phaṭ | iti ṣaḍaṅgamantrānaṃgusṭhādikaratalāntaṃ karayorvinyasya 
hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgeṣvapi nyaset | tato nābhyādipādadvayāgrāntaṃ āṃ 
namaḥ | kaṇṭhādinābhyantaṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | murdhādikaṇṭhāntaṃ kroṃ 
namaḥ | tato hṛdayakamale vāyavyadale yaṃ namaḥ | āgneye raṃ namaḥ | 
pūrve laṃ namaḥ | paścime vaṃ namaḥ | īśāne śaṃ namaḥ | nair-ṛtye 
ṣaṃ namaḥ | uttare saṃ namaḥ | dakṣiṇe haṃ namaḥ | karṇikāyāṃ kṣaṃ 
namaḥ | iti vinyasya oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ 
rho haṃśaḥ sohaṃ amuṣya prāṇā iha prānāḥ 15 amuṣya jīva iha sthitaḥ 
15 amuṣya sarvendriyāṇi 15 amuṣya vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥ 
śrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā oṃ iti 
matreṇa sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ tridhā vinyasya dhyāyet |

raktābdhipotāruṇapadmasaṃsthā pāśāṃkuśāvikṣuśarāsabāṇān |
śūlaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ karāgrai raktāṃ trinetrāṃ praṇamāmi 
devīm || 22 ||

evaṃ dhyātvā jagaddhātrīṃ lakṣamekaṃ japanmanum |
juhuyād taddaśāṃśaṃ ca carubhirdhṛtasaṃyutaiḥ || 23 ||

ṣaṭkoṇāḍhye śaktipīṭhe vidhinānena pūjayet |
arcayet ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśvaram || 24 ||

vāṇīṃ lakṣmīṃ ramāṃ paścāt ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjayet |
daleṣu mātaraḥ pūjyāstadbāhye lokanāyakāḥ || 25 ||

evaṃ sampūjayed devīṃ sugandhikusumādibhiḥ |
iti saṃsādhito mantraḥ ṣaṭkarmaphalado bhavet || 26 ||

sthāpayenmanunānena prāṇān sarvatra deśikaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | atra tadupāsanāvidhistu prāgvat prātaḥ kṛtyādi yogapīṭhanyāsāntaṃ 
kṛtvā mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān 
vidhāyāntaryāgottaraṃ svapurataḥ sindūrādinā 
ṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalabhūpurātmakaṃ pūjāyantraṃ vilikhya purataḥ 
saṃsthāpyābhyarcyārghyādisthāpanādyātmapūjānte 
maṇḍūkādiparatattvāntaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ sampūjya kesareṣu oṃ jayāyai 
namaḥ | vijayāyai namaḥ | ajitāyai namaḥ | aparājitāyai namaḥ | nityāyai 
namaḥ | vilāsinyai namaḥ | dogdhryai namaḥ | aghorāyai namaḥ | 
maṅgalāyai namaḥ | iti sampūjya hrīṃsarvaśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ iti 
samastaṃ pīṭhaṃ sampūjya mūlamantreṇa mūrtiṃ 
parikalpyāvāhanādipuṣpopacārānte ṣaṭkoṇeṣu devyagre 
devīpṛṣṭhadakṣiṇavāmakoṇeṣu oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | 
oṃ rudrāyai namaḥ | dakṣiṇāgradevīpṛṣṭhavāmabhāgeṣu sarasvatye 
namaḥ | lakṣmyai0 | gauryai0 | saṭkoṇasandhiṣu pragvadaṅgāni 
sampūjyāṣṭasu patreṣu devyagrādiprādakṣiṇena 
prāguktabrāhmayādyāḥ sampūjya caturasre lokapālāṃstadastrāṇi ca 
sampūjya dhūpadīpādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvat samāpayediti | tathā -

lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ |
sājyena caruṇā paścāt tarpaṇādi samācaret || 17 ||

iti | śāradāyām - (23|62)

bījānte'muṣya śabdānāmādau dūtīḥ prapūjayet |
mṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā punaḥ || 1 ||

ākṛṣyā grasanā paścādbhramadā visphuliṅginī |
kṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ || 2 ||

pāśena baddhaceṣṭasya śaktyā svīkṛtacetasaḥ |
aṃkuśena hṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharet || 3 ||

dvādaśāṃgulamānena kṛtvā sādhyasya puttalīm |
tasyāḥ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 4 ||

niśīthasamaye sādhye supte tasya hṛdambuje |
daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ param || 5 ||

īśarākṣasaśītāṃśuyamānāṃ karṇikāntare |
yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret || 6 ||

śirobindusamudbhūtatantusambaddhavigrahān |
evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret || 7 ||

ātmahṛtpadmagā bhṛṅgīḥ prasthāpya śvāsavartmanā |
ekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayed || 8 ||

p. 441)

puttalyāṃ sthāpayenmantrī svacitte vā vidhānavit |
tantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena sarvataḥ || 9 ||

ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛdbhṛṅgān bhuvā saṃstambhayettataḥ |
evamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu || 10 ||

vaśyākarṣaṇayoryādīnaruṇān saṃsmaret sudhīḥ |
mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi || 11 ||

pītān saṃstambhane dhyāyet prāṇākarṣaṇakarmavit |
ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi || 12 ||

krūrakarmasu puttalyāṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanamīritam |
prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān || 13 ||

saṃsmaret tatra nipuṇaḥ sadā krūreṣu karmasu |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

vāyvagniśakravaruṇeśvararākṣasendupreteśapatralikhitairatha 
yādivarṇaiḥ |
vindvantagaiḥ kṣagatahaṃsasametasādhyaṃ prāṇātmayantramatha 
varṇavṛtaṃ dharāstham || 14 ||

itthaṃ prayogakuśalo manunānena mantravit |
vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivāñjanān || 1 ||

iti | atra puraścaraṇavidhimuktvā viśeṣo brahmayāmale -

atra nityaṃ hunenmantrī japākiṃśukasambhavaiḥ |
puṣpai raktotpalairvāpi mūlena ca navāhutīḥ || 1 ||

hutvā bījatrayeṇātha hunedekaikaśaḥ kramāt |
yādihaṃsāntavarṇotthāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ || 2 ||

mṛtā vaivasvatā caiva jīvahā prāṇahā tathā |
ākarṣiṇī ca grasanā bhramadā visphuliṅginī || 3 ||

kṣetrajñahāriṇī ceti samproktāstā yathākramam |
tattadvarṇādinā nāmnā tāsāṃ caiva hunet kramāt || 4 ||

āṃhrīṃkroṃyaṃ mṛtāyai svāhā ityādiprayogaḥ |

dhyānaṃ vakṣye prayogeṣu yathā dhyeyā maheśvari |
gatvā sādhyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā pāśabījena sundari || 5 ||

śaktibījena tacchaktiṃ gṛhītvāṃkuśabījataḥ |
prāṇāmākṛṣya sādhyasya cānayantīṃ sadā smaret || 6 ||

niśīthasamaye sādhye supte tasya hṛdambuje |
daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāṃ sureśvari || 7 ||

īśarākṣasasaumyeṣu dakṣiṇe karṇikāntare |
yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret || 8 ||

śirobindusamudbhūtatantusaṃbaddhavigrahān |
evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret || 9 ||

ātmahṛtpadmagā bhṛṅgīḥ prasthāpya śvāsavartmanā |
ekaikān sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayet || 10 ||

puttalyāṃ sthāpayenmantrī svacitte vā vidhānavit |
tantucchedaṃ prakūrvīta vahnibījena pārvati || 11 ||

ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛdbhṛṅgān stambhayedbhūmibījataḥ |
evamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu || 12 ||

vaśyākarṣaṇayoyādīnaruṇān saṃsmaret priye |
mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi || 13 ||

pītān saṃstambhane devi prāṇākarṣaṇakarmavit |
ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi || 14 ||

krūrakarmasu puttalyāṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanamīritam |
prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān || 15 ||

saṃsmared devadeveśi sadā krūreṣu karmasu |
itthaṃ prayogakuśalo manunānena sundari || 16 ||

vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivāñjanān |
vāyvagniśakravaruṇaśivarākṣasasomagān || 17 ||

dakṣiṇāntān likhedyādīn hāntānaṣṭasu pārvati |
daleṣu bindusaṃyuktān kṣakāraṃ karṇikāntare || 18 ||

vilikhya tasya madhye tu haṃsa ityakṣaradvayam |
sādhyanāmasamopetaṃ vilikhedgirisaṃbhave || 19 ||

veṣṭayeccaturasreṇa yantraṃ prāṇamanoridam |
krūrakarmasu samproktadravyairaṣṭaviṣādibhiḥ || 20 ||

kṛtāṃ puttalikāṃ sādhyanarakeśasamanvitām |
dvādaśāṃgulamānena spaṣṭāṅgīmatimañjulām || 21 ||

tasyāstu hṛdaye devi prāṇayantraṃ vinikṣipet |
likhitaṃ śavavastre ca sakīṭaṃ varavarṇini || 22 ||

prāṇān saṃsthāpayettasyāṃ sādhyasya proktarūpataḥ |
chitvā tāñjuhuyādrātrau sādhyaṃ smṛtvā citānale || 23 ||

saptarātraprayogeṇa mārayet ripumātmanaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

p. 442)

sakīṭaṃ sajīvaṃ saṃsthāpitasādhyaprāṇamiti yāvat | aṣṭaviṣāṇi tu -

śyenāgniloṇapiṇḍāni dhattūrakarasastathā |
gṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudāhṛtam || 24 ||

ityuktāni | śyenaḥ śyenaviṣṭā agniścitrakaṃ loṇapiṇḍaḥ 
kṛtrimalavaṇaṃ | anyatsugamam | tathā -

kalā āvāhayet kumbhe pratimādiṣu mantravit |
śaive ca gāṇapatye ca ṣaṇṇavatyaḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ || 25 ||

pañcaśītiḥ kalāḥ saure caturnavatirvaiṣṇave |
śākte tu saptatiḥ proktāḥ śaivyaśceti ca kecana || 26 ||

śaivyaḥ ṣaṇṇavatikalāḥ śākte'pi yojyā iti kecana vadantītyarthaḥ | 
śaivīḥ kalā āha -

tatra tattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśad dvātriṃśat kāmasomayoḥ |
dūtyo nava daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥ || 27 ||

kalāḥ śaivā (vīḥ) vadāmyatra śivaśaktisadāśivāḥ |
īśvaraḥ śuddhavidyā ca māyā vidyā kalā tathā || 28 ||

rāgaḥ kālaśca niyatiḥ puruṣaḥ prakṛtistathā |
ahaṅkāraśca buddhiśca manaḥśrotratvacastataḥ || 29 ||

jihvā ghrāṇaśca vākpāṇipādāḥ pāyustataḥ param |
upastha śabdausparśaśca raso gandho viyanmarut || 30 ||

vahniḥ salilapṛthvyau ca śvaddhā prītī ratirdhṛtiḥ |
kāntirmanoramā caiva tataścaiva manoharā || 31 ||

manorathā ca madanonmādinī mohinī tathā |
śaṃkhinī śoṣiṇī caiva vaśaṃkarī ca śiñjinī || 32 ||

sutagā sasvarāścaiva ṣoḍaśātra samīritāḥ |
pūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathā || 33 ||

ṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca tataścāpyaṃśumālinī |
śaśinī cāṅgirācchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalā || 34 ||

tuṣṭāmṛtākhyāḥ kathitāḥ kalāstāḥ sasvarā vidhoḥ |
amṛtādyā daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥ || 35 ||

ṣaṇṇavatyaḥ kalāḥ proktāḥ śaive śākte ca gāṇape |
atha vakṣye vaiṣṇavākhyāḥ kalāḥ śṛṇu varānane || 36 ||

jīvaprāṇau buddhimanaḥ śrotrādyā viṃśatistathā |
hṛtpadmaṃ sūryasomāgnivāsudevāhvayāstataḥ || 37 ||

saṃkarṣaṇaśca pradyumnaścāniruddhastataḥ param |
śraddhādayo'tra vijñeyāḥ saurāḥ śṛṇu vadāmi te || 38 ||

ākāśavāyvagnijalapṛthivīśabda eva ca |
sparśo rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvak cakṣureva ca || 39 ||

jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca vākpāṇī pādapāyū tathaiva ca |
upasthaśca mano garvo buddhirdhīḥ prakṛtistataḥ || 40 ||

śraddhādayo'tra vijñeyāḥ śāktāḥ śṛṇu varānane |
ātmavidyāśivāścaite pratilomakramāt punaḥ || 41 ||

anulomena te bhuyaḥ sarvatattvaṃ tathaiva ca |
śraddhādayastataḥ proktāḥ kalāḥ sarvāḥ samīritāḥ || 42 ||

iti | asyārthaḥ saumyakarmasu pratimādiṣvāvāhane tu sādhakaḥ 
kṛtanityakriyaḥ yathoktalakṣaṇapratimāgre svāsane samupaviśya 
dināntarāvāhitasamastakalāpūrṇapūrṇakumbhamātmapratimayormadhye 
sādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya prāṇānāyamya 
adyetyāditithyullekhanānte'mukākṛtipratimāyāmamukadevatāsānnidhya
kāriṇyo'mukasaṃkhyākakalā āvāhayiṣye iti saṅkalpya prāṇayantraṃ 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa pratiṣṭhitaṃ pratimāyā gale baddhvā āvāhayet 
|

prāṇayantraracanāprakārastu bhūrjādāvaṣṭagandhenāṣṭadalakamala 
vilikhya karṇikāyāṃ sasādhyaṃ kṣakāraṃ vilikhya haṃsa 
ityakṣaradvayena kṣakāraṃ veṣṭayitvā vāyavyadale yaṃ āgneye raṃ 
pūrve laṃ paścime vaṃ īśāne śaṃ nair-ṛtye ṣaṃ uttare saṃ yāmyadale 
haṃ iti varṇāṣṭakaṃ vilikhya bahirbhūpuraṃ vilikhya 
mātṛkārṇairveṣṭayitvā tattatsthāneṣu dikpālabījāni vilikhediti 
prāṇayantraṃ vilikhya homasampātaṃ kuryāditi | tata 
āhavanīyadevatāmantreṇa 
prāṇāyāmarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānāni vidhāya pratimāyā 
bhūtaśuddhimātṛkānyāsāntaṃ vidhāya pratimāhṛdaye spṛśan 
prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa amuṣyapadasthāne āhavanīyadevatānāma 
ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ saṃsthāpya prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantramaṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ 
japitvā kalā āvāhayet | yathā 
sugandhajalapuṣpabharitapūrṇakumbhamukhapidhānavastraṃ niṣkāsya 
tanmadhyasthapuṣpamekamuddhṛtya oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ haṃsaḥ so'haṃ 
yaralavaśaṣasahoṃ amukadevatāyāḥ śivatattvarūpaprāṇakalā iha 
sthitāḥ 15 amukadevatāyāḥ śivatattvarūpajīvakalā iha 15 
amukadevatāyāḥ śivatattvarūpasarvendriyakalāḥ 15 amukadevatāyāḥ 
śivatattvarūpavāṅmanaścakṣustvakśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇakalā 
ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā ityuccārya pratimāśirasi 
nikṣipet | evaṃ śaktitattvarūpa0 īśvaratattvarūpa0 ityādi krama ūhyaḥ | 
atra sampradāyastu prathamakalāmekavāramuccāryāvāhayet |

p. 443)

dvitīyāyā vāradvayaṃ | tṛtīyāstrivāraṃ | caturthyāścaturvāraṃ evaṃ 
krameṇaikottaravṛddhyoccāraṇamiti || tantrāntare -

śuklapratipadārambhādyāvat pūrṇā tithirbhavet |
kuryādāvāhanaṃ mantrī pratimādau śubhe tathā || 1 ||

ākarṣaṇaṃ kalānāṃ tu kṛṣṇe pratipadāditaḥ |
kalānāṃ hāsavṛddhyendoḥ kṛṣṇaśuklaprabhedataḥ || 2 ||

tithikrameṇa jāyate tathaivātra dinakramaḥ |
gurutaḥ śāstrataḥ samyagjñātvā kūrvīta deśikaḥ || 3 ||

ajñātvā kurute yastu mriyate mūḍhadhīḥ svayam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 4 ||

iti || atha nityahome'gnisthāpanavidhiḥ - pūjāsthānasyeśānabhāge 
kṛṇḍasthaṇḍilādyanyatame gomayenopalipte mūlena vīkṣyāstreṇa 
saṃrakṣyāstreṇaiva kuśaiḥ saṃtāḍya kavacamantreṇa prokṣya 
hṛnmantreṇa viṣṇurudrendradevatākāstisro rekhāḥ prāgagrā 
brahmayamacandradevatākā uttarāgrāstisro rekhāḥ kuśamūlena vilikhya 
kuśāmbunāstramantreṇa samprokṣya hrīṃsarvaśaktikamalāsanāya 
namaḥ iti tanmadhye yogapīṭhaṃ sampūjya tatra buvaneśīmṛtumatīṃ 
sañcintya tadyonāvāvasathyasthāne śivabījatayā 
sūryakāntādibhavamagniṃ pranavena saṃsthāpya oṃ citpiṅgala hanahana 
dahadaha pacapaca sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā iti mantreṇa 
kuśairmukhaphūtkṛtyāgniṃ prajvālya kāṣṭhai paṭūkṛtya oṃ agniṃ 
prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam | suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ 
samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham || iti paṭhan kṛtāñjalirupasthāyopaviśya liṅge 
sarayūṃ hiraṇyāyai namaḥ | gude ṣarayūṃ kanakāyai namaḥ | śirasi 
śarayūṃ raktāyai namaḥ | mukhe varayūṃ kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ | 
nāsikāyāṃ larayūṃ | suprabhāyai namaḥ | netrayoḥ rarayūṃ atiraktāyai 
namaḥ | sarvāṅge yarayūṃ bahurūpāyai namaḥ | iti saptajihvā vinyasya oṃ 
sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ svastipūrṇāya śirase svāhā | oṃ 
uttiṣṭhapuruṣāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ dhūmavyāpine kavacāya huṃ | oṃ 
saptajihvāya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ dhanurdharāyāstrāya phaṭ | iti 
ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāya śirasi agnaye jātavedase namaḥ | vāmāṃse agnaye 
saptajihvāya namaḥ | vāmapārśve agnaye havyavāhanāya namaḥ | 
vāmakaṭyāṃ agnaye aśvodarāya namaḥ | liṅge agnaye vaiśvānarāya 
namaḥ | dakṣiṇakaṭyāṃ agnaye kaumāratejase namaḥ | dakṣiṇapārśve 
agnaye viśvamukhāya namaḥ | dakṣāṃse agnaye devamukhāya namaḥ | 
ityaṣṭau mūrtīrvinyasya garbhaṃrahitairdarbhairagniṃ 
prāgādikrameṇottarāgraiḥ pūrvāgraiśca paristīrya vahnermukhe 
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vibhāvya tatra (madhye ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu madhyādiprādakṣiṇyena 
prāguktāḥ saptajihvāḥ sampūjya tadbahiraṣṭakamalaṃ vibhāvya 
tatkesareṣu agnīśānanir-ṛtivāyukoṇeṣu tadagrādi prāgādicaturdikṣu ca) 
prāguktaṣaḍaṅgāni sampūjya tadbahiraṣṭadaleṣuprāgādiprādakṣiṇyena 
prāguktā aṣṭamūrtīḥ sampūjya tadbahiścaturasre 
dikpālāṃstadāyudhāni ca sampūjya madhye oṃ vaiśvānara jātaveda 
ihāvaha lohitākṣa sarvakarmāṇi sādhaya svāhā ityagniṃ gandhādibhiḥ 
sampūjyastramantreṇa kṣālitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nikṣipya 
mūlenāṣṭadhābhimantrya vamiti dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya kavacena 
pradīptadarbhadvayena nīrājya darbhadvayamagnau nikṣipya punardarbhān 
prajvālyāstramantreṇa ghṛte pradarśyāgnau tān nikṣipya sruksruvau 
tadabhāve palāśasya madhyapatradvayamaśvatthapatradvayaṃ vā 
gṛhītvāgnau pratāpya kavacena darbhaiḥ sammārjyaṃ punaḥ 
pratāpyāstreṇa prokṣya darbheṣu nidhāya mārjanadarbhānadbhiḥ 
rāṃspṛśyāgnau nikṣipya sruveṇājyamādāyāgnerdakṣiṇanetre agnaye 
svāhā iti hutvā agnaye idaṃ na mametyuddeśatyāgaṃ kṛtvā 
punarājyamādāyāgnervāmanetre somāya svāhā iti hutvā somāya idaṃ 
na mama | punaragnerbhālanetre agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā | agnervaktre 
agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā tataḥ oṃ bhūḥ svāhā agnaye idaṃ na mama | oṃ 
bhuvaḥ svāhā vāyave idaṃ na mama | oṃ svaḥ svāhā sūryāya idaṃ na 
mama | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svāhā prajāpataye idaṃ na mama ityāhuti 
catuṣṭayaṃ hutvā oṃ vaiśvānara jātaveda iti mantreṇāhuti trayaṃ hutvā 
agnergarbhādhānaṃ sampādayāmi svāhā iti garbhādhānapuṃsavana 
sīmantonnayana 
jātakarmānnaprāśanacūḍākaraṇopanayanasamāvartanavivāhākhyān 
saṃskārān pṛthākpṛthagaṣṭāvaṣṭāvājyāhutīrhutvā 
prāguktajihvādimūrtyantadevatānāṃ sarayūṃ hiraṇyāyai svāhā 
ityāditattannāmabhiścaturthīsvāhāntairekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā oṃ svāhā | 
oṃ śrīṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ svāhā oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ svāhā | oṃ 
śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ svāhā | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃ svāhā 
| oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye svāhā | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ 
glauṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada svāhā |

p. 444)

oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me 
svāhā | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ 
me vaśamānaya svāhā | iti gaṇapatimantraṃ daśadhā vibhajya hutvā 
punaḥ samastena gaṇapatimantreṇa (caturdhā juhuyāt | iti saṃskṛte vahnau 
devaṃ dhyātvā mūlamantreṇa gandhādibhiḥ sampūjya 
vahnidevatayoraikyaṃ vibhāvayan mūlamantreṇa 
svāhāntenājyapāyasatilataṇḍulavrīhayavabhaktānāmanyatamena 
ghṛtavyatiriktadravyeṣu tridhā yogaṃ kevalaghṛtayogaṃ ca kṛtvā) 
pañcaviṃśatyāhutīrhutvā mūlamantrasya ṣaḍaṅgamantraiḥ 
ṣaḍāhutīrmūlamantreṇa 
pañcaviṃśatyāhutīrhutvāvaraṇadevatānāmekaikāmājyāhutiṃ hutvā 
oṃ bhūragnaye ca pṛthivyai ca mahate ca svāhā | oṃ bhuvo vāyave 
cāntarikṣāya ca mahate ca svāhā | oṃ svarādityāya ca dive ca mahate ca 
svāhā | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścandramase ca nakṣatrebhyaśca digbhyaśca 
mahate ca svāhā | iti catasra ājyāhutīrhutvā oṃ itaḥ pūrvaṃ 
prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārajāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā 
vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā yatsmṛtaṃ 
yaduktaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā iti 
mantreṇāṣṭāvekāṃ vājyāhutiṃ hutvā vahniṃ prāgvat sampūjya 
nyūnātiriktasiddhyarthaṃ dadāmi saghṛtaṃ tilam | oṃ hvaṃ sāṅgaṃ kuru 
kuru svāhā iti tilerekāmāhutiṃ hutvā | oṃ sahasrārcirmahātejā namaste 
bahurūpadhṛk | sarvāśine sarvagata pāvakāya namo'stu te || tvaṃ 
raudraghorakarmā ca ghorahā tvaṃ namo'stu te | viṣṇustvaṃ kokapālo'si 
śāntimatra prayaccha me | ityagniṃ prārthya ghṛtena srucamāpūrya 
tadupari puṣpaṃ dattvā adhomukhena sruveṇa tanmukhaṃ pidhāya 
śaṅkhavatsampūṭābhyāṃ gṛhītvotthāya mūlamantreṇa 
vauṣaḍantenāhutitrayaṃ hutvā prokṣaṇīyajalena vahniṃ pariṣicya 
mūlamantreṇa sveṣṭadevaṃ tatra sampūjya saṃhāramudrayā pūjācakre 
visṛjya svahṛdyudvāsyāgniṃ sampūjya bho bho vahne mahāprājña 
sarvakarmaprasādhaka | karmāntare'pi samprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru 
sādaram || ityagniṃ prārthya saṃhāramudrayā svahṛdyudvāsayet iti 
niyahome agnisthāpanavidhiḥ ||

atra nityapūjāvidhistu śrīvidyāyāḥ prāgeva (181 pṛ0 10 śvā0) 
nirūpitaḥ | sāmprataṃ sāmānyataḥ sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ 
nityapūjāvidhiḥ pradarśyate | pūjā dvividhā anirmālyā sanirmālyā ceti 
| anirmālyā mānasapūjā sanirmālyā bāhyapūjā | taduktaṃ tattvasāre -

anirmālyaṃ sanirmālyaṃ sanirmālyamarcanaṃ dvividhaṃ matam |
divyairmanobhavairdravyairgandhapuṣpaiḥ sragādibhiḥ || 1 ||

yadarcanamanirmālyaṃ divyabhogāpavargadam |
grāmyāraṇyādisaṃbhūtairyāgadravyairmanoramaiḥ || 2 ||

bhaktairyat kriyate samyak sanirmālyaṃ tadarcanam |
jātamātrāṇi puṣpāṇi ghrātānyeva nisargataḥ || 3 ||

pañcabhiśca mahābhūtairbhānunā śaśinā tathā |
prāṇibhiśca dvirephādyaiścoṣyante ca na saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||

ato nirmālyamityuktam iti | atra cādye yatīnāmadhikāraḥ | yadāhāgastyaḥ 
dvividhaṃ syāllabdhamanorbāhyāntaramupāsanam | nyāsināmāntaraṃ 
proktamiti || yattu -

manasā pūjayedyogī puṣpairvāraṇyasambhavaiḥ |
śivārthaṃ puṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavet sa tu hiṃsakaḥ || 1 ||

tattu jitendriyayatiparam |

parivrāḍ jñānamātreṇa homadānādibhirvinā |
sarvaduḥkhapiśācebhyo mukto bhavati nānyathā || 2 ||

puṇyastriyo gṛhasthāśca maṅgalairmaṅgalārthinaḥ |
pūjopakaraṇaiḥ kuryurdadyurdhānāni cārhaṇam || 3 ||

vānaprasthāśca yatayo yadyevaṃ kuryuranvaham |
saṃskārānna nivartante vidyātikramadoṣataḥ || 4 ||

āruḍhapatitā hyete bhaveyurdukhabhājanam | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 5 ||

iti kumbhasambhavoktereva yatīnāmasaṃyatendriyatvaṃ doṣāyaiva 
atasteṣāṃ mānasapūjanameva vihitamiti | yadvā sarveṣāmevādhikāraḥ | 
yaduktaṃ padmapurāṇe -

smaraṇe pūjane viṣṇostathā mānasapūjane |
sadādhikāraḥ sarveṣāṃ mahāpātakināmapi || 1 ||

iti | anyatra tu gṛhasthānāmevādhikāraḥ | yaduktamagastyena 
anyeṣāmubhayaṃ tatheti | anyeṣām gṛhasthānāmubhayaṃ 
bāhyamārabhyantaraṃ ca | atrāntaryajanaṃ bāhyārcanasyāṅgatvenoktaṃ 
na kevalaṃ mānasārcane niṣedhadarśanāt | yadāha svayameva

na gṛhī jñānamātreṇa paratreha ca maṅgalam |
prāpnoti candravadane dānahomādibhirvinā || 1 ||

p. 445)

gṛhastho yadi dānāni dadyānna juhuyādapi |
pūjayedvidhinānena kaḥ kuryādetadanvaham || 2 ||

na brahmacāriṇo dātumadhikāro'sti bhāmini |
nāraṇyavāsināṃ śaktirna te santi kalau yuge || 3 ||

gurubhyo'pi ca sarvebhyaḥ ko vā dātumapikṣate | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 4 ||

iti | atra

ghrātaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ siddheralaṃ no mānasādyatha |
tasmādaparihāryatvādanyathā cānupāyataḥ || 5 ||

alpabuddhitvato nṛṇāṃ bāhyapuṣpairbhavet priye | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *  || 6 ||

iti yattattvasāaravacanaṃ 
tattadaṅgabhūtasyābhyantarayajanasyātyantamāvaśyakatvaṃ 
gṛhasthānāmupapādayatīti | tasmādgṛhasthānāṃ bāhyapūjaiva nityā 
sāca pañcavidhā | uktaṃ ca mantratantraprakāśe -

pūjā pañcavidhā proktā pañcarātrāditantrake |
tāścābhigamanā copādānejyādhyāyayogakāḥ || 1 ||

tatrābhigamanā nāma mantribhiḥ parikīrtyate |
sammārjanopalepādisaṃskāro devamandire || 2 ||

upādānaṃ bhaved devapūjāsādhanamelanam |
tataścāpi bhavedanyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ punaḥ || 3 ||

pīṭhapūjā ca devasya sāṅgāvaraṇapūjanam |
mantrārthabhāvanāpūrvaṃ japo mantrasya kīrtanam || 4 ||

tacchāstrādhyayanaṃ samyak svādhyāyo mantribhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
gurudevātmanāmaikyabhāvanā yoga ucyate || 5 ||

sālokyamapi sārūpyaṃ sāmīpyaṃ sārṣṭināmakam |
sāyujyamapi pañcānāṃ phalānyevaṃ viduḥ kramāt || 6 ||

iti | tatrādāvijyānirūpaṇena sarvāsāmapi nirūpaṇaṃ syādityataḥ 
pradhānabhūtejyā nirūpyate | tatra śrīnāradapañcarātre -

niśāvasāne śayanāt smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
utthāya dakṣiṇāṅgena vāmapādaṃ nyasedbhuvi || 1 ||

niśāvasāne paścime yāme |

kecidvā madhyamau yāmau rātrau suptvā viśāṃpate |
sañcintayanti dharmārthoṃ yāma utthāya paścime || 2 ||

iti bhāratokteḥ | dakṣiṇāṅgenotthāya nārāyaṇaṃ smṛtveti sambandhaḥ | 
nārāyaṇamityupalakṣaṇaṃ tena sveṣṭadevatāṃ smṛtvetyarthaḥ | 
uttaratantre -

rātriśeṣe samutthāya kṛtvāvaśyakamādarāt |
rātrivāsaḥ parityajya vāsasī paridhāya ca || 1 ||

ācamya śuddhadehaḥ san devatāyāgamandiram |
mārjayitvopalipyātha bhaktiyuktastu śaktibhiḥ || 2 ||

upaviśya śucau deśe praṅmukhaḥ prokta āsane |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā nyāsaṃ vidhānataḥ || 3 ||

nyāsamṛṣyādinyāsam |

nirmālyamapakṛṣyātha dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā |
arghyapādye nivedyātha dadyādvai dantadhāvanam || 4 ||

mukhaprakṣālanaṃ dattvā dadyādācamanīyakam |
karāsyaproñchanāyātha dadyādvāso'malaṃ śubham || 5 ||

iti | dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām - (24 pa0)

prātarutthāya śirasi saṃsmaret padmamujjvalam |
karpūrābhaṃ smaret tatra śrīguruṃ devarūpiṇam || 1 ||

suprasannaṃ lasadbhūṣāmaṇḍitaṃ śāntibhūṣitam | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 2 ||

iti padmaṃ śirasi | gurupādāmbujadvandvaṃ saṃsmarennijamūrdhani | 
ityuttaratantravacanāt | bhairavatantre -

vyomāmbuje karṇikamadhyasaṃsthe siṃhāsane saṃsthitadivyamūrtim |
dhyāyedguruṃ candraśilāprakāśaṃ satpustakābhītivarān dadhānam || 1 
||

śvetāmbaraṃ śvetavilepapuṣpamuktāvibhūṣaṃ muditaṃ trinetram |
vāmāṅkapīṭhasthitaraktaśaktiṃ mandasmitaṃ sāndrakṛpānidhānam || 2 
||

raktāṅgarāgābharaṇāmbarāḍhyāṃ smerānanāṃ pīnakucāṃ 
priyāṅke |
vāme niṣaṇātiraktakāntiṃ vāmena līlākamalaṃ kareṇa || 3 ||

dhyāyed dadhānāmapareṇa nāthamāśliṣya gāḍhaṃ dvibhujāṃ 
trinetrām |

p. 446)

arcayedgandhapuṣpādyairvahiṣṭhairmānasaistu vā |
nāmabhistasya saṃketasaṃsiddhairgurukīrtanaiḥ || 4 ||

tadajñāne gurubhyo'tha namo'nte vai samarcayet |
stuvīta stutibhiḥ prīta ācārya sarvasiddhaye || 5 ||

iti | prātaḥ smaraṇātiriktakāle svagurudhyānamāha śaivāgame -

dīkṣākāle yathārūpaṃ svasyānugrahakarmaṇi |
dṛṣṭaṃ tattena bhāvena dhyāyannāhnikamācaret || 1 ||

iti vaikhānasapañcarātre tathaiva rātriśeṣaṃ ca kālaṃ sūryodayāvadhi | 
aruṇodayāvadhītyarthaḥ | tasyaiva snānakālatvāt kartavyaṃ sajapaṃ 
dhyānaṃ nityamārādhakena vai | iti | kapilapañcarātre -

vibhajya pañcadhā rātriṃ śeṣe devārcanādikam |
japaṃ homaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ nityaṃ kurvīta sādhakaḥ || 1 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

iti stutvā hṛdi svīye dhyāyediṣṭāṃ ca devatām |
gurudevatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayecca nirākulaḥ || 1 ||

iṣṭārthaprārthanāṃ kṛtvā hyājñāṃ samprārthayet tataḥ |
iṣṭadevasya bhūmeśca tasyāṃ śvāsānusārataḥ || 2 ||

vinyasya pādamutthāya kuryādāvaśyakīṃ kriyām | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 3 ||

prārthanāślokastvagre vakṣyate | itthamuccāryalabdhājño deśikaḥ 
śaucamācaret | iti nāradapañcarātre -

pade pade smaredastraṃ dūre yāyād gṛhālayāt |
tata udvāsayed devān mantreṇānena deśikaḥ || 1 ||

tṛṇaloṣṭaprakṣepeṇa dattvā tālatrayaṃ punaḥ |
uttiṣṭhantvṛṣayodevā gandharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ || 2 ||

paritastyajatāṃ sthānaṃ viṇmūtrotsarjanāya me |
kṛtvā malacyutiṃ tatra vāsasā kaṃ praveṣṭya ca || 3 ||

(kaṃ mastakam |)

khaṃ diśaścānavīkṣet tato yāyājjalāśayam |
śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ vidhinācamanaṃ tataḥ || 4 ||

dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato bhuktvā snāyāttadanu nārada | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 5 ||

dvijeti nāradasambodhanam | ālayād dūre iṣukṣepadūramatītya | nir-
ṛtyāmiṣuvikṣepamatītyābhyadhikāṃ bhuva mitiviṣṇuvacanāt | 
śaucamāha nāradapañcarātre -

tisro liṅge mṛdo deyā ekaikāntaramṛttikāḥ |
pañca vāmakare deyāstisraḥ pāṇyorviśuddhaye || 1 |

mūtrotsarge viśuddhiḥ syāt purīṣasyāpyanantaram |
pañcāpāne mṛttikāḥ syurekaikāntaramṛttikāḥ || 2 ||

daśa vāmakare deyāḥ sapta tūbhayahastayoḥ |
pādayostisṛbhiḥ śuddhirjaṅghāśuddhistu pañcabhiḥ || 3 ||

niyojayet tato vipra kaṭyāṃ vai sapta mṛttikāḥ |
svadehe svedadoṣaghna brāhmaṇaḥ karmasiddhaye || 4 ||

bhaktānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca varṣāsvevaṃ nirūpitam |
prāvṛṇmuktāvathaitasmādekamṛdapanodanam || 5 ||

śaradgrīṣmavasanteṣu nityaṃ kāryaṃ kriyāparaiḥ |
etasmādapi caikaikāṃ mṛttikāṃ parilopayet || 6 ||

hemante śiśire caiva śrotriyaḥ saṃyataḥ sthitaḥ |
pathi śaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ deśakālānurodhataḥ || 7 ||

gandhalepaṃpāsyaiva manaḥ śuddhyā viśudhyati | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 8 ||

iti | ekaikāntaramṛttikā ityayamarthaḥ - prathamamekavāraṃ 
mṛtjjalairliṅgaṃ prakṣālya tato vāmakaraṃ mṛjjalaiḥ prakṣālya 
punarliṅgamiti krameṇaḥ || kapilapañcarātre -

yad divā vihitaṃ śaucaṃ tadardhaṃ niśi kīrtitam |
tadardhamāture proktamāturasyārdhamadhvani || 1 ||

iti | dantakāṣṭhaṃ mantramāha dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ -

klīmante kāmadevāya sarvānte jana cālikhet |
priyāyeti hṛdanto'yaṃ sa manurdantaśuddhaye || 1 ||

p. 447)

iti | pañcamīśvaratantre -

pratyahaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu plakṣakāṣṭhaṃ tu māraṇe |
mohane khādiraṃ proktaṃ stambhane cūtapallavam || 1 ||

vaśye cāśvatthakāṣṭhaṃ tu rakṣārthaṃ vañjulasya hi |
ayaṃ kramo mahādevi trilokeṣu na vidyate || 2 ||

iti | uttaratantre - vaktraṃ mūlāṇunā nityaṃ kṣālayet siddhihetave | iti || 
atha snānaṃ tacca trividhamaudakamantradhyānabhedāt | tatraudakaṃ 
snānaṃ nāradapañcarātre -

ayādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ snānaṃ vakṣyāmi pūrvataḥ |
yena bhakto'bhiṣiktastu yāgahomārhatāṃ vrajet || 1 ||

śaṃkunāsyābhijaptena śucisthānātu mṛttikām |
gṛhītvāstreṇa saṃcintya yāyājjalaniketanam || 2 ||

tatrādau jalakūlaṃ tu kṣālayedastravāriṇā |
mṛdaṃ kṛtvā dvidhā tatra ekabhāgopagaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||

nidhāya gomayaṃ darbhāṃstilāṃścāpyabhimantritān |
laukikaṃ gauṇaṃ madhyena bhāgenaikena yatnataḥ || 4 ||

malasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * || 5 ||

iti | abhimantritānastreṇa | vidhisnānaṃ vaidikasnānam | smṛtisamuccaye - na 
prātarmṛttikāsnānaṃ na kuryānniśigomayairiti | vasiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām -

kṛtvādau vaidikaṃ snānaṃ tatastāntrikamācaret |
vinyasyāṅge ṣaḍaṅgāni prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram || 1 ||

śrīsūryamaṇḍalāt tīrthamākṛṣyāṃkuśamudrayā |
ātmarakṣāṃ tataḥ kuryādvārikṣepeṇa cāstrataḥ || 2 ||

nimajjya tatra śrīdevaṃ dhyāyan śaktyā manuṃ japet | 
unmajjya kumbhamudrāṃ ca baddhvā siñcet svamūrdhani || 3 || 

tīrthāvāhanamantrāstu prayoge vakṣyante | etattīrthe'pi 
phalātiśayārthaṃ sāvāhanaṃ snānamabhidhāya vahnipurāṇe -

yo'nena vidhinā snāyādyatra kutra jale dvijaḥ |
sa tīrtha phalamāpnoti tīrthe daśaguṇaṃ phalam || 1 ||

iti | siñcet saptadhā tridhā vā | saptakṛtvo'bhiṣicyātha manunā 
mantritairjalairiti kapilavacanāt | tridhābhiṣicya mūleneti uttaratantrāt | tathā 
- tataḥ saṃkṣepato devān manuṣyāṃstarpayet pitṛn | iti ||

snāne veśeṣamāha tripurārṇave -

vidhāya vaidikaṃ snānaṃ tatastāntrikamācaret |
mṛdamastreṇa cādāya tena tāmabhimantrya ca || 1 ||

śikhāmantreṇa saṃśodhya mantrayenmūlamantrataḥ |
mūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ vilipya ca tayā vapuḥ || 2 ||

sammukhīkaraṇīṃ mudrāṃ baddhvā prāṇān nirudhya ca |
nimajjya tūṣṇīmutthāya nābhimātrajale sthitaḥ || 3 ||

prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mūlamantreṇa mantravit |
vinyasya ca ṣaḍaṅgāni kalpayettīrthamagrataḥ || 4 ||

tataḥ samprārthayet tīrthaṃ sūryāt tanmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ |
sṛṇīmantreṇa mantrajño bhittvā cāṃkuśamudrayā || 5 ||

tīrthāvāhanamantreṇa tīrthamāvāhayet priye |
mūlamantreṇa saṃyojya kalpite tīrthamaṇḍale || 6 ||

tīrthaśaktiṃ ca tatraiva samāvāhyārkamaṇḍalāt |
dhyātvā tanmanunābhyarcya gaṅgāmantreṇa mantrayet || 7 ||

saptakṛtvaḥ śive vacmi śṛṇu mantradvayaṃ priye |
jalasthaṃ vyoma ṣaṭdīrghasvarabhinnaṃ sabindukam || 8 ||

sarvānandamaye tīrthaśakti caihiyugaṃ dviṭhaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | jalaṃ vakāraḥ vyoma hakāraḥ tena hva etata ṣaḍdīrghasvarabhinnaṃ 
hvāṃ hvīṃ hvūṃ hvaiṃ hvauṃ hvaḥ iti dviṭhaḥ svāhākāraḥ | tathā - 
ekaviṃśākṣaraḥ proktastīrthaśaktimanuḥ priye | atra śaktīti 
sambodhanapadaṃ divyatvāt | cakāro visandhidyotakaḥ ekaviṃśākṣara 
ityukteḥ |

tāraṃ namo bhagavati brūyādambe tato'mbike |
ambālike mahāmālinyehyehi bhagavantyatha || 9 ||

aśeṣatīrthālavāle māyāśrībījayoratha |
śivajaṭādhirūḍhe ca gaṅge gaṅgāmbike dviṭhaḥ || 10 ||

gaṅgāvidyeyamākhyātā tripañcāśadbhirakṣaraiḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

p. 448)

iti | tāraḥ praṇavaḥ māyā hrīṃ dviṭhaḥ svāhākāraḥ ambe iti divyatvāt 
| anyatsugamam tathā -

bhuvaneśyā samālekhyāmṛtīkṛtya sudhāṇunā |
kavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha saṃrakṣyāstreṇa mantrayet || 11 ||

mūlena devatāṃ tatra sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ priye |
samāvāhya jale dhyātvā tatpadadvayanirgatam || 12 ||

dhyātvā tīrthaṃ smaran mūlamantraṃ mantreṇa tarpayet |
tridhā devīṃ samuttīrya jalād dhaute suvāsasī || 13 ||

paridhāyātha tilakaṃ kṛtvā sandhyāṃ samācaret | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | tīrthaśaktidhyānaṃ prayoge vakṣyate | 
athaitadvāruṇasnānāśaktānāṃ mantrasnānavidhimāha - 
nāradapañcarātre -

* * * * * * * * * * * * atha māntraṃ śubhaṃ śṛṇu |
toyābhāve tu yatkāryaṃ dūrge kāle tu śītale || 1 ||

gamane kṣiprasiddyarthaṃ gurukāryeṣvatandritaḥ |
prāptāpadyatha viprendra niśābhāge tathā mune || 2 ||

prakṣālya pādāvācamya proddhṛtena tu vāriṇā |
sthānaṃ daśa diśaḥ prāgvat saṃśodhyopaviśettataḥ || 3 ||

astraṃ hastatale nyasya kramānnyāsāṃstatastu vai |
mūlamantrāditaḥ kuryāt sarvamantragaṇena vai || 3 ||

kevalādudakasnānāt saṃskāraparivarjitāt |
prabhāsādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ snātakasya tu || 5 ||

jñeyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ snānānmantrasnānasya nārada |
dhyānasnānamatho vakṣye dvābhyāmapi paraṃ ca yat || 6 ||

khasthitaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mantramūrtiprabhuṃ smaret |
tatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ nipatantīṃ svamūrdhani || 7 ||

cintayet sūkṣmarandhreṇa praviśantīṃ svakāṃ tanum |
tayā saṃkṣālayet sarvamantardehagataṃ malam || 8 ||

tatkṣaṇādvirajā mantrī jāyate sphuṭikopamaḥ |
idaṃ snānaṃ varaṃ mantrāt snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ smṛtam || 9 ||

tasmādekatamaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ śraddhāpareṇa tu |
snānapūrvāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yataḥ sabhyāstu nārada || 10 ||

tasmātsnānaṃ purā kuryādyadīcchedātmano hitam | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | śaivāgame -

manasā mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram |
kūrvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yat || 1 ||

iti | puṇḍarīkāṣamityupalakṣaṇaṃ tena sveṣṭadevatāṃ smarediti | 
mantrastu sveṣṭaḥ śaive tu tataḥ śivātmakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ 
śivātmakam | mārjanaṃ sahitāmantraistattoyena samācaret || iti 
śaivāgamāt | saṃhitā tu - vyomavyāpī ca yo mantraḥ pañcabrahmāṇi 
yāni ca | ye mantrāḥ śivagāyatryā rudraṃ ceti yathākramam | 
sarvapāpaharāḥ proktā vidyeyaṃ śivasaṃhitā || iti vyomavyāpī tu 
āmīmūmādyato vyomavyāpī caiva prakīrtayet | 
praṇavādyantaruddho'yaṃ vyomavyāpī prakīrtitaḥ || iti 
nāradapañcarātre -

sudhautaṃ paridhāyātha vastrayugmamakhedakam |
tadabhāvādadhaḥ śāṭīyogapaṭṭakasaṃyutam || 1 ||

na caikavāsasā yasmād bhavitavyaṃ kadācana | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | nṛsiṃhapurāṇe -

jalāntikaṃ samāsādya śukle dhaute ca vāsasī |
paridhāyottarīyaṃ ca na kuryāt keśadhūnanam || 1 ||

iti | smṛtisamuccaye -

vahiḥsnātastu nadyādau snānavastramadhastyajet |
ūrdhvaṃ tyajet snānavastraṃ gṛhasnāto yadā bhavet || 1 ||

ūrū karau mṛdādbhiśca kṣālayecchuddhihetave |
niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu prātaḥsandhyāṃ samācaret || 2 ||

madhyāhne tarpaṇādūrdhvaṃ vastraniṣpīḍanaṃ bhavet | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | yāmale vibhṛyādvāsasī śuddhe tilakaṃ varṇabhedataḥ | iti | vasiṣṭhaḥ 
- ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tripuṇḍraṃ vā kṛtvā sandhyāṃ samācaret | atra 
vāśabdastūrdhvapuṇḍratripuṇḍrayorvarṇaparatvopasthāpakaḥ | ata eva 
nāradapañcarātre -

brāhmaṇasyordhvapuṇḍraṃ syāt kṣatriyasya tripuṇḍrakam |
vaiśyapuṇḍramardhacandraṃ śūdrāṇāṃ vartulākṛti || 1 ||

p. 449)

iti | ūrdhvapuṇḍralakṣaṇaṃ tu kūrmapurāṇe -

yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ prapannārtiharaṃ param |
dhārayet sarvadā śūlaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāribhiḥ || 1 ||

yattatpradhānaṃ triguṇaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam |
dhṛtaṃ tacchūladharaṇād bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||

iti | śaivaśāktānāṃ tu cāturvarṇikānāmapi 
tripuṇḍradhāraṇamāvaśyakam |

vinā bhasmatripuṇḍrena jalaṃ vā bhojanādikam |
bhakṣaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtitam || 3 ||

apyakāryasahasrāṇi kṛtvā yaḥ snāti bhasmanā |
tatsarvaṃ bhavati bhasma yathāgnitejasā vanam || 4 ||

iti liṅgapurāṇavacanāt | bhasmatripuṇḍradhāraṇavidhistu 
vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -

śivāgnerbhasma saṃgrāhyamagnihotrodbhavaṃ tu vā |
vaivāhāgnyudbhavaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ śuci sugandhi ca || 1 ||

kapilāyāḥ śakṛcchastaṃ guhītaṃ gagane patat |
na līnaṃ nātikaṭhinaṃ na durgandhi nacoṣitam || 2 ||

uparyadhaḥ parityajya gṛhṇīyāt patitaṃ yadi |
khaṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnau tu nikṣipenmūlamantrataḥ || 3 ||

apakvamatipakvaṃ sa saṃtyajya bhasitaṃ sitam |
ādāya vāsasāloḍya bhasmādhāre vinikṣipet || 4 ||

bhasmasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryādvahnyanudvāsite sati |
udvāsane kṛte yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāyate || 5 ||

iti | gomayāpaharaṇādau viśeṣamāha tatraiva -

yadvā dharāmasaṃspṛṣṭāṃ sadyenānīya gomayam |
vāmena pātre saṃśoṣya aghoreṇa vinirdahet || 6 ||

puruṣeṇa samuddhṛtya īśānena viśodhayet |
itthaṃ tu saṃskṛtaṃ bhasma agnirityādimantrataḥ || 7 ||

tasmādbrahmeti yajuṣāṃ mantrayed rudrasaṃkhyayā |
praṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśakaiḥ || 8 ||

pañcavarṇādyakṣarādyairbhālāṃsodarahṛtsu ca |
tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ kuryānmūrdhni pañcākṣareṇa ca || 9 ||

tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayenmantrī sākṣācchiva ivāparaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | nāmabhiḥ sadyojātādibhiḥ aṃsaśabdoṃ'sadvayavācako 
nāmapañcakatvāt | atra 
tripuṇḍradhāraṇeṃ'guliniyamojābālopaniṣadbrāhmaṇe tripuṇḍraṃ 
dhārayetpaścād brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam | madhyāṃgulibhirādāya 
tisṛbhirmūlamantritam anāmāmadhyamāṃguṣṭhairathavā syāt 
tripuṇḍrakamiti skandapurāṇe sanatkumāraṃ prati śrīśivavacanam -

sadyādibhirbrahmamayairmahāmantraiśca pañcabhiḥ |
parigṛhyāgnirityādimantrairbhasmābhimantrayet || 1 ||

mā nastokena saṃmardya śiro limpet triyambakam |
tisro rekhā bhavantyeṣu sthāneṣu munipuṅgava || 2 ||

bhruvormadhye samārabhya yāvadantā bhaved bruvoḥ |
madhyamānāmikāṃgulyo madhye tu pratilomataḥ || 3 || 

aṃguṣṭhena kṛtā rekhā tripuṇḍrasyābhidhīyate |
tisṛṇāmapi rekhāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ nava devatāḥ || 4 ||

akāro gārhapatyo'gnirbhūścātmā ca rajoguṇaḥ |
ṛgvedaśca kriyāśktiḥ prātaḥ savanameva ca || 5 ||

mahādevaśca rekhāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
ukāro dakṣiṇāgniśca nabhaḥ sattvaṃ yajustathā || 6 ||

madhyandinaṃ ca savanaṃ icchāśaktyantarātmakaiḥ |
maheśvaraśca rekhāyā dvitīyāyāśca devatāḥ || 7 ||

makārāhavanīyau ca paramātmā tamodivau |
jñānaśaktiḥ sāmavedastṛtīyasavanaṃ tathā || 8 ||

śivaśceti tṛtīyāyā rekhāyāstvadhidevatāḥ |
etā nityaṃ namaskṛtya tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayecchuciḥ || 9 ||

maheśvaravratamidaṃ sarvavedeṣu kīrtitam |
muktikāmairjanaiḥ sevyaṃ punasteṣāṃ na sambhavaḥ || 10 ||

tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayedyastu bhasmanā vidhipūrvakam |
brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vanastho yatireva ca || 11 ||

mahāpātakasaṅghātairmucyate copapātakaiḥ |
tathānyaiḥ kṣatraviṭśūdrastrīgohatyādipātakaiḥ || 12 ||

vīrahatyāśvahatyābhyāṃ mucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

ityādi || atha prakārāntareṇa tilakaprakārastu -

itthaṃ tu saṃskṛtaṃ bhasma agnirityādimantrataḥ |
vimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśya punarādāya mantrataḥ || 1 ||

p. 450) 

tasmād brahmeti yajuṣā mantrayed rudrasaṃkhyayā |
lalāṭe brahma vijñeyaṃ hṛdaye havyavāhanaḥ || 2 ||

nābhau skando gale pūṣā rudro dakṣiṇabāhuke |
ādityo bāhumadhye ca śaśī ca maṇibandhake || 3 ||

vāmadevo vāmabāhau bāhumadhye prabhañjanaḥ |
maṇibandhe ca vasavaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe haraḥ smṛtaḥ  || 4 ||

śambhuḥ kakudi samproktaḥ paramātmā śiraḥ smṛtaḥ | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | amantrakaṃ vāyavīya saṃhitāyām - punarnyastakaro mantrī 
tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā likhet | iti etacchūdrādiviṣayaṃ jñeyam | atra 
bhasmadhāraṇe ye viśeṣāste vakṣyante | śāktānāṃ 
vāmakeśvaratantraṣaṭśatyāṃ śrīvidyāyajanaprakaraṇe -
tripuṇḍrakavidhārī ceti | etat tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ 
candanādisugandhadravyeṇa kāryam | ramyaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ dadhad | bhāle 
nandanacandanena janani dhyāyāmi te maṅgalamiti bhagavatā 
śrīdūrvāsasoktatvāt ||

atha sandhyā | tatra mahākapilapañcarātre -

upaviśya śucau deśe prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kramāt |
mūlamantreṇa kṛtvā tu dehe kurvīt mārjanam || 1 ||

iti | śaivāgame -

prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantreṇa mantrayet |
aṅgāni vinyased dehe karanyāsapuraḥsaram || 1 ||

amṛtīkṛtya purato jalaṃ vaṃ dhenumudrayā |
abhimantrya ca mūlena saptavāraṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 2 ||

akāradikṣakārāntairmātṛkārṇaiḥ sabindubhiḥ |
pratyarṇaṃ prokṣayenmūrdhni kuśairmūlena ca tridhā || 3 ||

devaṃ dhyātvātha manuvid bhānumaṇḍalasaṃsthitam |
ādāya toyamāmantrya bījairbhūtātmakaistathā || 4 ||

laṃvaṃraṃyaṃhamiti ca tānyuktāni surārcite |
saptakṛtvastato mūlamanreṇa triḥ punaśca tat || 5 ||

vāmahaste nidhāyātha galitairjalabindubhiḥ |
samprokṣya mūlamantreṇa dakṣahastena mūrdhani || 6 ||

nāsayāśliṣya śiṣṭena tejorūpeṇa tena tat |
praviśyāntargataṃ sarvaṃ malaṃ saṃśodhya nirgatam || 7 ||

dakṣanāsāpuṭenaitata smṛtvā dakṣiṇahastagam |
vāmabhāge vajraśilāṃ dhyātvāstreṇa ca tat kṣipet || 8 ||

prakṣālya hastāvācamya mūlamantreṇa mantravit |
gāyatryā cātha mūlena dadyādarghyatrayaṃ sudhīḥ || 9 ||

śivāya maṇḍalasthāya ravermūlena tarpayet |
tridhā japtvā ca gāyatrīmaṣṭāviṃśativārakam || 10 ||

japitvā mūlamantraṃ ca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ |
samarpya tajjapaṃ mantrī devamudvāsya maṇḍalāt || 11 || 

nidhāya svīyahṛdaye tatastarpaṇamācaret | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | mūlenārghyadānaṃ tu gāyatrīrahitamantraparaṃ jñeyam | tathā 
śaivāgame -

sandhyālopo na kartavyaḥ śambhorājñaivameva hi |
dīkṣitaḥ sandhyā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnute || 1 ||

sandhyāhīno'nyasandhyāyāṃ pūrvasandhyākriyāmatha |
vidhāyottarasandhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryādatandritaḥ || 2 ||

iti | atra prāyaścitamapi kāryam | yaduktaṃ tantrarāje -
snānasandhyārcanālope japedvidyāṃ śataṃ śive | iti | tathā -

dhyātvā devaṃ jale samyak pūjayitvātha mūlataḥ |
aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā tarpayenmūlamantrataḥ || 1 ||

tadardhena tadardhena daśadhā vātha tarpayet |
tatastadaṅgāvaraṇadevatāstarpayet kramāt || 2 ||

ekaikāñjalinā tattannāmamantreṇa mantravit |
punaḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ sāṅgāvaraṇakaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||

samudvāsya hṛdi svīye svātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ smaret |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | nāradapañcarātre -

tataścodakasampūrṇaṃ bhāṇḍamādāya pāṇinā |
ekāntaṃ nirjanaṃ yāyānmanojñaṃ doṣavarjitam || 1 ||

hunmadhyasthaṃ smaran viṣṇuṃ prabuddhānandavigraham |
digantaraṃ na vīkṣeta (maunī) saṃruddhalocanaḥ || 2 ||

p. 451)

iti | mahākapilapañcarātre -

mūlamantraṃ japan gacched yāvat prāpnoti vai gṛham |
prāpya hastau ca pādau ca prakṣālyācamya yatnataḥ || 1 ||

yāgamaṇḍapamāsādya viśet kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | uttaratantre -

ācāntaḥ śucitāṃ prāptaḥ susnāto devapūjane |
pūjāvedyā bahiḥ sthitvā cuturhastāntare dhiyā || 1 ||

gṛhe ced dvāradeśasthaḥ praṇamya manasā gurum |
praṇamediṣṭadevaṃ svaṃ dikpālānapi cetasā || 2 ||

yat pūrvamarjitaṃ pāpaṃ taddine'nyadine'pi vā |
prāyaścitternāpanudet tadā pāpaṃ smared dhiyā || 3 ||

tatpāpasyāpanodārthaṃ mantradvayamudīrayet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

mantradvayaṃ tu prayoge vakṣyate (20|42) | tathā -

evaṃ kṛte parthamataḥ pāpotsāraṇakarmaṇi |
yat syād dṛḍhataraṃ pāpaṃ tad dūre cāvatiṣṭhate || 1 ||

atīte pūjane sthānaṃ svaṃ prayāti punaśca tat |
yat syādalpataraṃ pāpaṃ tannāśamupagacchati || 2 ||

pūjayā tyaktapāpasya kāmamiṣṭaṃ kṣaṇād bhavet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | tantrāntare -

prātaḥ prakṣālya pādau ca hastāvācamya yatnataḥ |
dadyādarghyaṃ dineśāya tatprakāramihocyate || 1 ||

gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau kṛtvā tu maṇḍalam |
sindūreṇa tataḥ paścādupaviśya nijāsane || 2 ||

prāṅmukhaḥ praṇamediṣṭadevatāṃ bhaktitatparaḥ |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantreṇa mantravit || 3 ||

vinyasya ca tadṛṣyādīn dhyātvā sūryamananyadhīḥ |
tatkalpoktavidhānena pūjayedupacārakaiḥ || 4 ||

purato maṇḍale kṛtvā jalena caturasrakam |
nidhāya tatra sādhāraṃ sajalaṃ tāmrapātrakam || 5 ||

gandhapuṣpākṣatān darbhān dūrvāsarṣapasaṃyutān |
satilān raktapuṣpāṇi dūrvāścāpi pravinyaset || 6 ||

sūryamantreṇa tatpātraṃ spṛśannaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
abhimantrya ca tatpātraṃ samutthāpya karadvayāt || 7 ||

mūrdhānta sūryamantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
japet tato yathāśakti sūryamantramananyadhīḥ || 8 ||

tadarghyāmbuplutaṃ sūryaṃ dhyāyan deśikasattamaḥ |
smṛtvā praṇamya visṛjenmaṇḍalānte divākaram || 9 ||

sūryamantraṃ tryakṣaraṃ tattu tatprakaraṇe (29 śvā0) draṣṭavyam |

yāvanna dīyate cārghyaṃ bhāskarāya dine dine |
tāvanna pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā sureśvarīm || 10 ||

arghyadānamidaṃ puṃsāmāyurārogyavardhanam |
dhanadhānyapaśukṣetraputramitrakalatradam || 11 ||

tejovīryayaśaḥ śaktividyāvibhavabhāgyadam |
tata utthāya vidhivad dvārapūjāṃ samācaret || 12 ||

dvāramarghyāmbunā prokṣya vighnaṃ tūrdhve samarcayet |
taddakṣiṇe mahālakṣmīṃ vāme caiva sarasvatīm || 13 ||

dvāraśriyaṃ ca tanmadhye śākhayordakṣiṇānyayoḥ |
gaṇapaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhī kramāt || 14 ||

māyāśaktiṃ ca cicchaktiṃ gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tataḥ |
dhātāraṃ ca vidhātāramūrdhvādikramato yajet || 15 ||

adhaśca dehalīmiṣṭvā dvārapālān samarcayet |
paścimadvāramārabhya dvārapālā amī kramāt || 16 ||

nandī caiva mahākālo gaṇeśo vṛṣabhastathā |
tato bhṛṅgiriṭiskandāvumācaṇḍeśvarau tataḥ || 17 ||

ete cāṣṭau maheśasya dvārapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
nandaḥ sunandacaṇḍo ca pracaṇḍabalasaṃjñakau || 18 ||

prabalo bhadranāmā ca subhadraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kramādamī samabhyarcyā vaiṣṇavadvārapālakāḥ || 19 ||

vakratuṇḍaikadaṃṣṭrau ca mahodaragajānanau |
lambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnarājastataḥ param || 20 ||

dhūmravarṇaśca samproktā vighneśadvārapālakāḥ |
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā || 21 ||

vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā ca śriyā saha |
etā devyāḥ kramādaṣṭau śaktayo dvārapālikāḥ || 22 ||

p. 452)

etā eva sauradvārapālikā api jñeyāḥ | sauraṃ śaktimayamaho vijayate 
saundaryasīmāspadamiti vāmadevatantravacanāt | ārkamāśvaśiśiraṃ 
viśveśikāyā vapuḥ iti tantrāntaravacanāt | atra dvāradevatādhyānāni 
prāgevoktāni (5 śvā0 83 pṛ0) | tathā -

paścimadvāramāsādya tālatritayapūrvakam |
dvāramudghāṭya cāstreṇa mantritān sarṣapākṣatān || 1 ||

puṣpayuktāṃstu vikirenmaṇḍapābhyantare budhaḥ |
nārācamudrayā samyagastramantreṇa deśikaḥ || 2 ||

iti | tūrṇāyāge -

siddhārthākṣatapuṣpāṇi nārācāstradhiyā budhaḥ |
astramantaṃ samuccārya maṇḍapāntarvinikṣipet || 1 ||

iti | nārāyaṇīye -

apakrāmantu bhūtānītyetanmantradvayaṃ punaḥ |
paṭhitvākṣatasidhārthapuṣpāṇi vikiret tataḥ || 1 ||

astramantreṇa mantrajño maṇḍapābhyantare budhaḥ |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

mantradvayaṃ prayoge (20 śvā0) vakṣyate | astreṇa 
svopāsyamantrāṅgabhūtena | yaduktaṃ pārijāte -

hakārarephau ca visargavantāvastrāyaphaṭkāravacastadante |
uktvāntare sarṣapamakṣatāṃśca puṣpāṇi muñcediti || 1 ||

tūrṇāpaddhatau - nirgacchatāṃ tu vighānāṃ vartma dadyāt svavāmataḥ 
| iti | somaśambhuḥ -

maṇḍapābhyāntare vidvān vāmapādapuraḥsaram |
praviśya vighnān trividhān pātālabhvantarikṣagān || 1 ||

utsāryāstraṃ samuccārya pārṣṇighātādibhistribhiḥ |
vighnānutsārayet | iti | tūrṇāyāge -

pārṣṇighātaistribhirbhaumāṃstālaistānantarikṣagān |
vighnānutsārayed divyānastratīkṣṇāvalokanāt || 1 ||

pārṣṇighātairvāmapādasya | vāmapārṣṇinā 
tribhirghātairbhūmiṣṭhāniti somaśambhuvacanāt | uttaratantre -

vighnānutsārya vidhivad dvāramācchādya vāsasā |
pañcagavyārghyatoyābhyāṃ prokṣayenmaṇḍapāntaram || 1 ||

iti | śrīkulārṇave -

saṃmārjanopalepādyairdarpaṇodaravat kṛtam |
vitānadhūpadīpādi puṣpadāmādiśobhitam || 1 ||

pañcavarṇarajaścitraṃ sthānaśuddhiriyaṃ matā |
nair-ṛtyāmarcayedvāstupuruṣaṃ candanādibhiḥ || 2 ||

īśāne dīpanāthaṃ ca kṣetrapālājñayā tataḥ |
saṃviśedāsanaṃ mantrī iti |

kṣetrapālaprārthanāmantraḥ prayoge (20 śvā0) vakṣyate | uttaratantre -

aḥ phaḍiti ca mantreṇa pūjāvedīṃ tato viśet |
saṃskuryādāsanasthānaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ || 1 ||

saṃskāraistatra sampūjya vedyantaḥ pīṭhadevatāḥ |
ādhāraśaktimārabhya svāsanaṃ tatra vinyaset || 2 ||

iti | āpastavaḥ -

pūjāsanamathānīya celājinakuśottaram |
tatropaviśya vidhivat smared viṣṇuguru mudā || 1 ||

iti yoginītantre - pṛthvīmantreṇāsane sanniviṣṭaḥ iti | mantraḥ prayoge (20 
śvā0) vakṣyate |

bhairavītantre -

merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ sutalaṃ chanda īritam |
pṛthivī devatā proktā viniyogo nijāsane || 1 ||

iti | uttaratantre -

āsane tu catuṣkoṇe gaṇeśaṃ ca sarasvatīm |
dūrgāṃ kṣetrapatiṃ cāpi vahnyādiṣu samarcayet || 1 ||

iti | gautamītantre - prāṅmukho vodaṅmukho'pi svastikāsanamāsthitaḥ | iti 
| uttaratantre -

p. 453)

udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā bhūtva prayatamānasaḥ |
svastikāsanamāsīnaḥ padmāsanamathāpi vā || 1 ||

iti | tantrāntare 

svastikādikrameṇaiva ṛjukāyo viśed budhaḥ |
sthāpayed dakṣiṇe bhāge pūjā dravyāṇi cātmanaḥ || 1 ||

suvāsitāmbusampūrṇa savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanam |
prakṣālanāya karayoḥ pātraṃ pṛṣṭhe nidhāpayet || 2 ||

ghṛtādijvalitān dīpān sthāpayet paritaḥ śubhān |
darpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca pāduke || 3 ||

yathāyathaṃ tu saṃsthāpya saṃskuryāt tāni cātmavān |

iti | uttaratantre -

puṣpanaivedyagandhādi hāṃhūṃphaḍiti mantrakaiḥ |
nārācamudrayā dṛṣṭyā samayā ca vilokayet || 1 ||

yadātmanā na vijñātaṃ samyak puṣpādidūṣaṇam |
aspṛśyasparśanaṃ vāpi yadanyāyārjitaṃ ca vā || 2 ||

tathā nirmālya saṃspṛṣṭa koṭādhyārohaṇaṃ ca yat |
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti naivedyādyavalokanāt || 3 ||

tato ramiti mantreṇa śikhāṃ dīpasya saṃspṛśet |
sa tu syācchūbhado vāpi niṣkravyādaḥ sukhapradaḥ || 4 ||

pataṅgakeśakīṭādidāhāt kravyādasaṃhateḥ |
vasāmajjādisambhūtairyajñādāvupayojane || 5 ||

ajñātarūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ doṣaḥ sparśādvinaśyati |
nārasiṃhena mantreṇa devatīrthena saṃspṛśet || 6 ||

pānīyaṃ ghaṭamadhyasthaṃ vīkṣya guhyaṃ ca yājakaḥ |
vāmena pāṇinā dhṛtvā vāmapārśvasthitaṃ tadā || 7 ||

pātramādhāramantreṇa saṃskurvan saṃspṛśejjalam |
yadajñānādapeyādisaṃsṛṣṭiriha saṅgatā || 8 ||

yadanyad dūṣaṇaṃ pātre toye vājñānato bhavet |
jalāśayaśavasparśāñjanasnānācca saṅgatam || 9 ||

dūṣaṇāni vinaśyanti tāni vai devapūjane | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

nṛsiṃhamantra ekākṣaraḥ sa tatprakaraṇe (20 śvā0) jñeyaḥ | 
ādhāramantrastu - svasaṃjñādyakṣaraṃ binducandrārghapariyojitamiti 
svayamuktaḥ | saṃjñādyakṣaraṃ nāmādyakṣaramityarthaḥ | uttaratantre -

kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ |
natvā guruṃ gaṇeśānaṃ purataḥ sveṣṭadevatām || 1 ||

sugandhapuṣpāṇyādāya candanāktāni mantravit |
mardayitvā karau samyak surabhīkṛtya sādhakaḥ || 2 ||

vāmahaste samādāya nirmathyāghrāya tatpunaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa caiśānyāṃ duratastyajet || 3 ||

nārācamudrayā tyāgaḥ | kṣipeduttarataḥ puṣpaṃ mantrī nārācamudrayā 
| iti tantrāntaravacanāt | kālikāpurāṇe -

kusumaṃ viṣṇumantreṇa svāṃgulyagreṇa sādhakaḥ |
vimardanārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt karaśodhanakarmaṇi || 1 ||

nirmanthya romabījena jighran ghrāṇena tatpunaḥ |
prasādena parityāgo diśyaiśānyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||

evaṃ kṛte tu karayorviśuddhiratulā bhavet |
aṃgulyāgrāṇi śuddhāni puṣpāṇāṃ grahaṇādbhavet || 3 ||

taladvayaṃ mardanāttu viśuddhamapi jāyate |
nirmanthanāt pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ ghrāṇānnāsāgramuttamam || 4 ||

tīrthāni ca samāyānti nāsikāgraṃ karaṃ prati |
upāntyaḥ sāgnicandreṇa rañjitaḥ śūnyasaṃyutaḥ || 5 ||

rudrāntoparisaṃspṛṣṭo mantro ayaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
prāntādirvāsudevāntavarṇenāpi ca saṃhataḥ || 6 ||

śambhucūḍāśikhābinduyuktaḥ prasāda ucyate |
(agniḥ sadyo binduyutā romabījamudāhṛtam) || 7 ||

upāntyo hakāraḥ | atra hakārasyopāntyatvaṃ tu mātṛkāyāḥ 
pañcāśadakṣaratvena dvitīyalakārasyāgrahaṇāt | agnīrephaḥ candraḥ 
sakāraḥ śūnyaṃ binduḥ rudrānta aikāraḥ | etena bhairavyā 
vāgbhavabījamuktaṃ | prāntādirhakāraḥ vāsudevānta aukāraḥ | 
śambhucūḍāśikhārdhacandraḥ binduranusvāraḥ | etena prāsādabījaṃ 
siddham | romabījaṃ roṃ | agnīti mantraḥ prayoge vakṣyate | nṛsiṃhakalpe -

p. 454)

karaśuddhiṃ samāsādya kuryāt tālatrayaṃ tataḥ |
ūrdhvordhva mūlamantreṇa digbandhamapi deśikaḥ || 1 ||

tena sañjanitaṃ tejo rakṣāṃ kuryāt samantataḥ |
astramantreṇa iti |

karaśuddhyādiṣu triṣu sambandhāt pāṇiṃ viśodhayedastramantreṇa 
manuvittamaḥ iti dakṣiṇāmūrtikalpavacanāt | astramantrastu 
tattadaṅgabhūtaḥ natu kevalaṃ phaṭkāraḥ | raḥ astrāya phaṭ procya 
bhrāmayeddakṣiṇaṃ karamiti kumbhasambhavavacanāt | ata eva yatra 
yatrāstrādipadenābhikhyānaṃ tatra tatra tadaṅgabhūtāstrādimantrā 
ūhyāḥ | natu phaṭkāramātramuktavacanāt | nacaivaṃ pādyaṃ 
pādāmbuje dadyād devasya hṛdayāṇunā 
ityādāvapyaṅgamantradānaprasaṅgaḥ nirākāṃkṣatvāt tatra 
mantroddhāre'tiprasaṅgāt aṅgamantragrāhakābhāvāt | 
mantroddhārānantaramevāṅgamantroddharāt | kvacidastrapadena kvacit 
phaṭpadenoddhārācceti | digbandhasvarūpamuktaṃ prayogasāre -
ācchādyadikṣu tarjanyā jyeṣṭhāgraskhalitāgrayā | iti | uttaratantre - 
prakāratritayaṃ vahneḥ kṛtvāstreṇa svamudrayā | 
svamudrayāgniprakāramudrayā | sātvagre (20 śvā0) vakṣyate | 
sanatkumārīya gopālakalpe -

sukhāsanenopaviśya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya vai |
bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsaṃ kuryādanantaram || 1 ||

nyāsaṃ mātṛkāyāḥ | uttaratantre -

bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram |
pādato jānuparyantaṃ caturasraṃ savajrakam || 1 ||

laṃyutaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca bhuvaḥsthānaṃ vicintayet |
jānvorānābhi candrārdhanibhaṃ padmena lāñchitam || 2 ||

śuklavarṇaṃ svabījena yuktaṃ dhyāyedapāṃ sthalam |
nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ raktavarṇakam || 3 ||

svastikābhaṃ svabījena yuktaṃ vahnestu maṇḍalam |
kaṇṭhād bhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyostu maṇḍalam || 4 ||

ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bindubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiryuktaṃ bījena cintayet |
bhrūmadhyād brahmarandhrāntaṃ vartulaṃ dhvajalāñchitam || 5 ||

dhūmravarṇaṃ svabījena yuktaṃ dhyāyennabhaḥsthalam |
iti dhyātvā tu bhūtāni svakīye deśikottamaḥ || 6 ||

dharmakandasamudbhūtaṃ jñānanālaṃ suśobhanam |
aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ caiva paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam || 7 ||

svīyahṛtkamalaṃ dhyāyet praṇavena prakāśitam |
kṛtvā tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibham || 8 ||

suṣumnāvartmanātmānaṃ paramātmani yojayet |
yogayuktena vidhinā so'haṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 9 ||

tatraiva sarvatatvāni vilīnāni vicintayet |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | tataḥ puruṣanibhaṃ pāpamityādi (5 śvā0 87 pṛ0) prāgevoktam |

tataḥ saṃśoyedenaṃ pūrakādikrameṇa vai |
vidhāya prāṇasaṃrodhaṃ vāyubījena vāyunā || 11 ||

vahnībījena tenaiva saṃdahet sakalāṃ tanum |
bhasma tadvātamārgeṇa nirgataṃ cintayet sudhīḥ || 12 ||

tato vamiti bījena plāvayet sakalāṃ tanum |
sañjāte sakale dehe devatopāsanakṣame || 13 ||

ātmalīnāni tattvāni svasthānaṃ prāpayet tataḥ |
ātmānaṃ hṛdayāmbhojamānayet paramātmanaḥ || 14 ||

haṃsamantreṇa vidhivat tejorūpaṃ kalevaram |
devatārādhane yogyamutpannamiti bhāvayet || 15 ||

iti | atra kecit saṃyojya jīvamatha durgamamadhyanāḍīmārgeṇa 
puṣkaraniveṣṭaśive susūkṣme | haṃsena dehamamarendrapurogameneti 
yoginītantravacanāt |

so'haṃ -

mantreṇa tāmādyāṃ nādānte siddhibhāvitām |
dhyātvaivaṃ brahmarandhrācca hṛdi jīvakalāṃ nyaset || 1 ||

iti vasiṣṭhasaṃhitāvacanācca haṃsamantreṇa jīvasyonnayanaṃ 
so'haṃmantreṇa punarānayanaṃ vadanti | yathāgurupadeśamatra 
vidheyamiti | atra vāyubījādijape catuḥṣaṣṭyādisaṃkhyāmāhuḥ | tatra 
pramāṇaṃ cintyam | vastutastu tattatkarmabhāvanāvadhireva japo 
vāyubījādīnām | yaduktaṃ kātyāyanīsaṃhitāyām - tato 
bhūtātmakaṃ devaṃ vāyubījena vāyunā | vāyumuttolya saṃśoṣya 
jñātvāmuṃ dakṣayā tyajet | iti | tathā yoginītantre - dakṣiṇe vahnibījena 
prāgdagdhamiti bhāvayet | iti | kumbhasambhavaḥ - bhūtaśuddhivihīnena 
kṛtvā pūjābhicāravat | viparīphalaṃ dadyādabhaktyāpūjanaṃ yathā | 
ityata eveyamāvaśyakīti |

p. 455)

kecittu śrīmacchaṅkarācāryacaraṇairyogaprakaraṇe 
proktatvādyogiparamiti vadanti | tanna pratyavāyaśravaṇāt | śrīkulārṇave -

ātmasthānamanudravyadehaśuddhiśca pañcamī |
yāvanna kurute devi tāvad devārcanaṃ nahi || 1 ||

susnānabhūtasaṃśuddhiprāṇāyāmādibhiḥ priye |
ṣaḍaṅgādyakhilanyāsairdehaśuddhiritīritā || 2 ||

iti | uttaratantre bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ tato vai sthāpayedasūn | adūn 
prāṇān | prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānaṃ tu (5 śvā0 88 pṛ0) prāgevoktam | 
tailokyasammohanatantre - prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā 
mātṛkānyāsamācaret iti | prāṇāyāmalakṣaṇaṃ tu (6 śvā0 94 pṛ0) 
prāgevābhihitam ataḥ paraṃ svopāsyamantrasya 
ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān kṛtvā yogapīṭhanyāsaṃ kuryāt | tatra 
ṛṣyādipadārthānāṃ nyāsāsambhavāttadvācakapadānāmeva kāryaḥ | 
tathā dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -

ṛṣistu dakṣiṇāmūrtirahaṃ śirasi māṃ nyaset |
paṃktiśchandastu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya pārvati || 1 ||

devatāṃ hṛdaye bālāṃ vinyaset parameśvari |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | nyāsaprakārastu yoginītantre - ṛṣyādīn vinyaseddevi 
caturthihṛdayānvitān iti | ṛṣayai namaḥ chandase namaḥ | ityādi || 
prapañcasāre - (6 pa0 2 ślo0)

ṛṣirgurutvācchirasaiva dhāryaśchando'kṣaratvādrasanāgataṃ syāt |
dhiyāvagantavyatayā sadaiva hṛdi pratiṣṭhā manudevatāyāḥ || 1 ||

iti | ṛṣyādipadārthāstūttaratantre -

ṛvarṇādistu gatyartho dhātuḥ prāptyarthakastathā |
ṣivarṇādistu vijñānamatastadvyāpakaṃ ca saḥ || 1 ||

anayo rūpasampattau ṛṣirgururitoritaḥ |
chādīti dhāturicchāyāṃ dādirdānārthako bhavet || 2 ||

chando vakti manorvarṇān dvayoricchāpradānataḥ |
vrīḍārthakāddadātīti sampannaṃ devatāpadam || 3 ||

sādhakāya manorbhāvaṃ dadātīti jaguryataḥ | 
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | jñānārṇave - (2 pa0 113 ślo0)

ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret |

hṛdayaṃ ca śiro devi śikhā ca kavacaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

netramastraṃ nyasenṅe'ntaṃ namaḥ svāhā krameṇa tu |
vaṣaṭ huṃvauṣaḍantaṃ tu phaḍebhiḥ saha vinyaset || 2 ||

iti | prapañcasāre - (6 pa0 6 śl0)

hṛdayaśirasoḥ śikhāyāṃ kavacākṣyastreṣu saha caturthībhiḥ |
natyā hutyā ca vaṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaḍebhiraṅgakavidhiḥ || 1 ||

iti | natyā namaḥ padena | āhutyā svāhākāreṇa | śāradāyām - (4 paṃ0 
33 ślo0)

hṛdayāya namaḥ proktaṃ śirase vahnivallabhā |
śikhāyai vaṣaḍityuktaṃ kavacāya humīritam || 1 ||

netrāya vauṣaḍityuktaṃ astrāya phaḍudīritam |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

iti | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ karanyāsapūrvakaḥ kāryaḥ | ādau kṛtvā 
karanyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu tato nyasediti tantrāntaravacanāt | atra kecit 
karanyāse aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ ityādi nyāsān vadanti | tatra 
pramāṇaṃ cintyam | vastutastu jñānārṇavādinānātantradarśanāt 
tadajñānavijṛmbhitamiti bhāti | yathā śāradātilake - (4|31) 
aṃguṣṭhādiṣvaṃgulīṣu nyasedaṅgaiḥ sajātibhiḥ | astraṃ tu 
talayornyasyediti sajātibhirnamaḥ svāhā ityādisahitaiḥ | 
aṅgaistattanmantroktaiḥ tena hṛdayāya namaḥ śirase svāhā 
ityādibhirityarthaḥ | jātilakṣaṇaṃ tu kāraṇāgame -

namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ huṃ ca vauṣaṭ phaṭkāra eva ca |
jātiṣaṭkamidaṃ proktaṃ hṛdādyastrāntasaṅgatam || 1 ||

p. 456)

iti | nāradapañcarātre'pi athacāṅgāni yojayet | kaniṣṭhādyāsu ca tato 
hṛdayādikrameṇa tu || iti || hṛdayādikrameṇa hṛdayāya namaḥ śirase 
svāhā ityādikrameṇetyarthaḥ | yoginītantre -

uccaret praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ māraṃ bindusamanvitam |
khaḍgāya hṛdayāyeti namoyuktaṃ kanīyasī || 1 ||

īkāraṃ praṇavād devi candrabimbasamāyutam |
sukhaḍgāya tato vācyaṃ śirase tadanantaram || 2 ||

svāhāyuktaṃ pravinyaset tarjanyānāmikāṃgulau |
huṃkāraṃ praṇavād devi bindulāñchitamastakam || 3 ||

śrīvajrāya tato vācyaṃ śikhāyai ca tataḥ param |
vaṣaḍantaṃ pravinyasyet madhyamāmadhyamāṃgulau || 4 ||

mātrā dvādaśakā tārādvindupāśāyasaṃyutāḥ |
kavacāya humityetat tarjanyāmapyanāmayā || 5 ||

akārādivisargāntaṃ yojayet praṇavāt param |
astrarakṣayamāye cāpyastrāya tadanantaram || 6 ||

phaḍakṣarasamāyuktaṃ vinyaset talayoriti |
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * ||

spaṣṭa uktaḥ |

iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyabhagavatpūjyapādaśrīgovindācāryaśiṣya 
śrībhagavacchaṅkarācāryaśiṣya śrīviṣṇuśarmācāryaśiṣya 
śrīpragalbhācāryaśiṣya śrīvidyāraṇyayati viracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye 
tantre aṣṭādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ || 18 ||

samāptamidaṃ pūrvārdham |
